In the corridor of the aisle, Ron and Ivan talked about the gossip they had heard from their two older brothers, and they did not forget to feed the spot on the right hand.
"Isn't it? Professor McGonagall is also the dean, I haven't seen her favoritism." Hermione couldn't help but retorted.
"I'm not the only one who thinks so... Many senior Gryffindors say so!" Ron was very disdainful of Hermione's rhetoric. and turned to face Harry and Yi. Fan said.
"Do you think that is the case too? Professor Snape has been so dark all day, and there are even rumors in the school that Professor Snape used to be a dark wizard..."
When talking about the rumors, Ron obviously lowered his voice so as not to be heard by others.
"Impossible, Professor Dumbledore wouldn't let a dark wizard come to the academy." Harry shook his head.
Although Harry felt that Professor Snape who taught the potions class seemed to dislike him at the banquet at the beginning of school, but in the past few days at school, teaching professors in various subjects has been quite good.
No matter how bad Snape is, it won’t go bad...
Hermione also nodded again and again, and Ron had no choice but to turn his head to look at Ivan.
At this time, Ivan was holding a multi-flavored bean and teasing Scaly, when he heard a few people talking, he glanced at Harry and said.
"Professor Snape's needle is not aimed at Gryffindor, I don't know, but it must be aimed at us."
At this point, Ivan is also a little depressed. It is impossible for him to get an excellent evaluation in Snape's class.
After all, I love the house and the crow, and hate the house and the crow. Even if Snape gave him a bad review after class, Ivan would not be surprised.
Harry was seen by Ivan a little inexplicably, I really didn't understand what Ivan meant.
"Are you saying that Professor Snape hates Harry?" Hermione frowned, guessing what Ivan was thinking from the look at Harry before.
Ivan admired Hermione's tact in his heart, but he couldn't tell the truth, so he shook his head. "I'm just skeptical, don't you think that Professor Snape looks something wrong every time he looks at Harry?"

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Potions class
chapters.content:
Harry was deeply impressed, but he couldn't help but speak as he saw Ivan feeding the multi-flavored beans to Scabbard all the time.
"Ivan, if you continue to feed like this, Scabbers are about to die."
Hearing Harry said this, Hermione, who was thinking of continuing to ask questions, turned her attention to Scab on Ron's hand.
The mouse, which was originally skinny with its hair tied together, has now changed its appearance.
After scurrying around in the dormitory, the spots were cleaned by Ron with a brush, and after being fed these days, they are now obviously a little fatter.
"Why? This amount of feeding is normal. In the past, Zebra was hungry and thin, so I should have an extra meal!" Yifan insisted on his opinion, and once again handed a piece of multi-flavored beans to Zebra's mouth.
"Furthermore, this can be regarded as an expression of my apologies." Ivan said again.
Shaban's performance was not even the slightest bit of empathy. He glared at Ivan angrily, and his little paw arrogantly pulled Ivan's hand away.
Until Shaban realized that his small paws were not enough for Ivan's power, then he took a bite of the multi-flavored beans that had been sent to him.
After all, it’s the lips, no matter how angry you are, you have to eat rice, right?
I can't resist anyway...
恩.. In fact, taste carefully, except for the individual flavors, the multi-flavored beans are quite delicious...
Noting the weakening of the resistance, Ivan couldn't help but sigh that Pettigrew Peter has been working for so many years. Nothing else works, but his mentality is quite stable.
Mingming was still being chased by the most scared person a few nights ago, and after only one night, he was able to continue to feast on.
Even though the chase was in a dream...
But this also means that Peter Pettigrew doesn’t know the dark magic of the Fear Curse. Maybe he just thought Ivan used some magic to turn his dream into a nightmare...
After all, Ivan, the little wizard, has no reason to know what happened eleven years ago, let alone know that Sirius’ Animagus is a black dog.
"What if I raise too much fat?" Ron looked at the "special attention" of Ivan and said with some concern.
"It's okay, you don't need to send a letter to Scab, and you can save it from running around." Ivan comforted.
Ivan thought to himself that Voldemort's resurrection plan would not have been so easy to succeed if it weren't for Peter Pettigrew.
When the time comes to feed the fat into the ball, Ivan wants to see if Shaban is chased by Crookshanks and Sirius, but can't run.
A few people walked towards the basement where the potions class is located while chatting.
When they walked into the classroom, Harry and Ron believed the rumor that Snape was a dark wizard again.
The whole classroom is not big, but the atmosphere is a bit dark and terrifying. There are some glass bottles around, and the bottles are filled with blue-green liquid. Some animals can still be immersed in the liquid.
In addition, the classroom is built underground. If it weren't for Hogwarts, Ivan would have thought it was the secret laboratory of the dark wizard.
"Get to your seats, we have to be careful in this class!" Ron said.
At this time, Ron had no doubt about George's previous words, and quickly took Ivan, Harry, and Hermione to sit down, lest Snape found a reason for the deduction.
However, Ivan knew in his heart that Snape would make up an excuse to find fault even if they had a good class.
嘭~
After the little wizards of the two academies sat down, the gloomy door was suddenly pushed open, and the sound of the door hitting the wall reverberated in the classroom.
Not long after, a thin figure walked in through the gate, his sallow skin covered under the long black cloak, his indifferent eyes swept across the little wizards, and it was only momentary when his eyes touched Harry. Stopped for a while, and the hook-like nose made him look like a giant human-shaped bat...
Snape walked all the way to the front of the stage, waving his wand with his right hand, and the curtains around him were automatically pulled down. Without the sunlight shining into the basement through the windows, the classroom immediately became darker.
When the light became dim, Ivan clearly noticed that Snape's tight expression relaxed slightly.
After finishing all this, the potion master looked around the little wizards who were restrained by his aura while taking the starting list.
"I will be a full name next, I hope no one will dare to disappear in my class!"
Snape's low voice began to reverberate in the classroom, and the naughty little wizards were all quiet. At this time, only Draco Malfoy of Slytherin could laugh.
"Neville Longbottom."
"Ivan Hals..."
......
"Harry Potter..."
Snape's plain tone fluctuates slightly when he says Harry's name.
"Ha~ By the way, I almost forgot." Snape was expressionless, but there seemed to be a hint of sarcasm in his words. "There is a new celebrity in our school!"
The little wizards all around looked towards Harry when they heard the words, and Draco and two of his followers even snickered in private.
was inexplicably targeted to make Harry a little uncomfortable, but what he didn't know was that this was just the beginning.
Snape turned his head and no longer looked at Harry, but at all humanity.
"You come here, is to learn the subtle techniques of pharmacy."
"Since there is no silly wave of wands here, many of you don't believe that this is magic. I don't expect you to truly understand the beauty of pharmaceutical technology."
Snape said there was a pause, then he spoke with a fascinating taste.
"Think about it, when you simmer medicinal materials in a big steam pot, the medicinal water slowly boils, and white smoke curls up...and the liquid flowing in the veins of the human body, the liquid with incomparable subtle power...It can almost make you Be drunk and fascinate all your senses...I can teach you how to canned fame, how to brew glory, and even say...stop death...as long as you don't be as stupid as the bunch of stupid people I taught before. "
Snape spoke a long time after speaking.
"Potter, if the powder of the narcissus bulb is added to the wormwood juice, what will be the consequences?"
Harry looked blank.
What is narcissus? What is wormwood?
Harry looked at Ron for help, Ron also looked blank. Hermione held her right hand high, but Snape just pretended not to see it.
Ivan was far away, and could only open his mouth, silently vomiting the words of stagnant water and sleeping pills.
Harry was a little eager, but Snape's compelling gaze made him afraid to look at Ivan. Naturally, he couldn't guess what Ivan was talking about. After a long time, he could only spit out a few words with difficulty.
"I don't know the professor!"
Ivan helplessly supported his forehead with his hand, he has tried his best.
It is useless even if he tells Harry the answer in advance, unless Harry can memorize all the books about potions, otherwise Snape has a way to target Harry.

chapters.title: Chapter 12: Poor scaly
chapters.content:
Then watching Harry gradually shut himself up under Snape's repeated questioning, Ivan remembered a conjecture he had seen in his previous life.
These several questions that Snape asked Harry had a deeper meaning.
The most obvious is that the narcissus (asphodel) used to prepare potions is interpreted in Latin as Myregretsfollowyoutothegrave (my regrets walk into the grave with you).
Wormwood (wormwood) usually implies pain and regret.
It was hard for Ivan to imagine what kind of emotion Snape, who was somber and bitter, faced Harry when he faced Harry.
Are you ashamed of Lily's death by leaking information? Or is it the affection that knows that the lover has died and is willing to die together?
Thinking like this, Ivan's eyes gradually became more compassionate.
"Ivan Hals!" Or he noticed something wrong with Ivan's eyes. After asking Harry three questions, Snape turned his wand and pointed at Ivan.
"Next you will answer these three questions!"
Ivan was stunned at first. He didn't expect Snape to ask himself a question, but he quickly reacted and replied.
"Adding the powder of the narcissus bulbs to the wormwood juice will give you life and death water. It is a powerful sleeping pill. The bezoar is in the stomach of the cow, and the boat-shaped aconite and the chamaejasme aconitum refer to the same plant. "
Of course Ivan, who has read the original, will not be stumped by these three questions, but Ivan is also a little worried, for fear that Snape is asking other questions.
Even though Ivan had read the potions textbook several times before taking the potions class, Snape obviously would not follow the routine. He asked Harry three questions before, none of them were in the first grade. What should be learned.
[Ding, you answered the difficult problem carefully prepared by the professor in class, and you answered the questions three times, with a 100% correct rate, and 9 points for academic achievement...]
Unexpected system sounds sounded in Ivan's mind.
Ivan's face instantly changed from worry to surprise and then immediately turned into ecstasy, and all his original worries were thrown aside.
Come! Even if you ask the question, frown it and count me as losing!
Ivan looked at Snape resolutely, true warriors never fear any challenge!
It’s best to have ten questions and eight questions. Ivan doesn’t believe that he can’t even know a single question. It’s a little bit more academic point...
Ivan’s face-changing skills impressed all the little wizards.
However, to Ivan's expectation, Snape didn't even look at him. Instead, he turned his head blankly and mocked Harry.
"Have you heard, Potter? It seems that not every little wizard who just started school is as stupid and ignorant as you..."
"Professor, I..." Harry stood up angrily and planned to refute it, but Snape interrupted Harry's words neatly.
"Potter! Because of your performance...Gryffindor got one point deducted!"
After speaking as if reading a verdict, Snape turned around mercilessly to continue teaching, while Harry was dragged by Ron desperately, his original white cheeks flushed with anger.
Just getting ready to face Snape's troublesome Ivan, facing such a neglect was a bit inexplicable, after a slightly apologetic glance at Harry, he had to continue listening to the class with peace of mind.
Looking forward to when Snape will continue to pose questions to make things difficult for himself...
It was a pity for Ivan that in the next class, Snape seemed to forget him in general. Apart from occasionally taking time out to scold the little wizards who made the wrong steps, he only had a great deal with Harry. Strong interest.
He is like an iron block attracted by a magnet, constantly wandering around Harry, his hollow eyes carefully looking at every step of Harry's potion refining, if there is a little mistake, it is a meal. A ridiculous mockery.
Ron, who was sitting next to Harry, was also unlucky. Snape found out the mouse spots he was carrying with him. He carried his tail and publicly designated a white mouse with the effect of the experimental potion. Ron almost cried on the spot. .
When I learned my destiny, the screaming cries called a miserable...
If it wasn't for Neville's accidental act of burning through the crucible in the end that spoiled Snape's interest, Shaban would be forced to drink the feces yellow potion made by Ron with unknown ingredients.
Ivan glanced sympathetically at the limp spots on the table, and sighed that Peter Pettigrew's bad fortune had been frightened twice in just a few days since he came to school.
The one-hour potions class time, for most young wizards, is simply suffering, after class, they all escape from the dungeon.
"Oh my God, how could Dumbledore hire Snape as a professor, he almost killed Shaban!" After finishing the potions class, Ron calmed the shivering Shaban while angrily wanted to smash the wall. .
Harry nodded in agreement, and stood on the same front with Ron. He was so clearly targeted in the first class of school, and no one could bear it.
Harry really couldn't understand why Snape hated him so much?
"Harry, if you can read more books before class, you won't be able to answer Professor Snape's questions. UU Reading www.uukanshu.com" Hermione had a different idea, and she read it after she said it. Look at Ivan, then continued.
"Like Ivan, Professor Snape knows that Ivan can answer it, so he won't make things difficult for him."
Hermione’s appreciation made Ivan really ashamed. If he didn't know the plot, he might not be able to answer Snape's question.
"Hermione, not everyone can memorize the potions book within a few days of school. Besides, the questions Snape asked Harry were not in the first-grade textbook." Ivan Sighed.
Hermione pursed her mouth and did not refute, because she also saw what Snape did in the potions class today, but she was accustomed to abide by the law and obey the professor's arrangements before opening it in Ron. When spraying, help to say a few words of excuse.
Ron and Harry were very dissatisfied with Hermione’s act of helping Snape speak. The three of them walked awkwardly. Thanks to Ivan’s persuasion, they finally got rid of the three before they reached Hagrid’s cabin. The grievance in my heart.
"Hagrid, we came to see you!"
Harry moved forward and knocked on the door, and then a group of four heard dogs barking and running from inside the house. After a while, the door was opened and a huge figure came out of the house. Came out.
"Harry, you are here, come in soon..." Hagrid greeted Harry enthusiastically, while still not forgetting to calm his restless dog.
Ivan followed Harry into the hut.
There is only one room in the whole house, and the layout is a bit messy. There are many dried meat and ham hanging by the window, and there is a large stove in front of it. A pot of boiling water was burning on the stove, and the patched bed was placed on the right side against the wall.

chapters.title: Chapter 13: Secrets hidden in the restricted book zone
chapters.content:
"Come, sit down, don’t be so restrained."
Hagrid brought a plate of rock cake to the table, and took the lead and sat down on the chair. The wooden support frame made a creaking sound, which made Yifan and others look a little worried. Fortunately, the quality of the chair was good. It is still stubbornly supporting the weight that should not be carried.
"Hagrid, this is Ron, this is Hermione..." After sitting down, Harry pointed to the crowd to introduce Hagrid, but Ivan stood up before he could introduce him.
"Hello, Hagrid, my name is Ivan, nice to meet you!"
"Oh, me too." Hagrid stretched out his big hand and shook Ivan, but the difference between the two figures made the handshake look funny.
The big dog teeth in the room were turning around Ron's side, and sometimes they pounced on Ron's saliva.
Ron concealed the spots in his pocket as soon as Fang rushed over. Although he had never heard of dogs eating mice, Ron was always a little suspicious after the past few days.
It's like someone is deliberately trying to murder his mouse...
Next, Harry and Ron were bitter here in Hagrid, telling Snape deliberately about them in class, Hermione frowned, but didn't mean to refute.
Ivan did not participate in their discussion. Although Snape could not understand Harry, he was biased towards the students of Gryffindor, but he still had no problem in teaching. He taught a lot of potions. The recipe was improved by Snape himself.
especially unexpectedly gave him an excellent evaluation in the first potions class, which made Ivan's curse a little unspeakable.
Of course, it would be better if Snape could produce more questions in class.
"Gringotts Bank stolen?" Just as Ivan was so bored that he wanted to try Hagrid's cake roll, a newspaper next to the teapot immediately caught Ivan's interest.
Harry and Ron, who were chatting about the sky, also stopped and leaned in front of the newspaper. They saw that it was written on the night of July 31, that a major robbery occurred in Gringotts. The people concerned believed that it was some black witch or The black wizard did it, but the goblins of Gringotts insisted that nothing was lost.
"Happened on July 31st." Harry suddenly yelled as if thinking of something, "Hagrid, I remember it happened to be my birthday, and we stayed there too!"
"Really?" Hagrid said vaguely, his eyes didn't dare to contact Harry directly, and the blunt topic turned to the rock cake, warmly inviting everyone to eat more.
Harry, Ron and Hermione were all pitted by this hard brick-like rock crust, almost not breaking their teeth, but seeing Hagrid's ardent face, it was not easy to throw them away.
Ivan secretly soaked the rock cake in the tea, trying to soften it a bit, and barely ate half of it in.
When he went back, Hagrid was still very enthusiastic, holding a basket of rock cakes and stuffing everyone's pockets a lot, even though they didn't want it...
The four of them went back to the castle together, and then moved away on the stairs. Harry and Ron returned all the way to the bedroom, while Ivan took the time to find the trace of the house of responsiveness in the castle.
Because in previous experiments, Ivan found that no matter how much knowledge is reserved, without actual combat experience, the growth of proficiency may also stop.
The search continued until the morning of Tuesday of the second week, when Ivan found some traces on the eighth floor of the castle.
It was a wide corridor with many portraits hung, and at the end was a tapestry of a giant stick beating Barnabas.
Ivan walked to the opposite wall of the tapestry and concentrated on the practice field he needed. After walking back and forth three times, a door appeared out of thin air on the originally flat wall...
The door extended close to the wall, without the slightest gap, as if it was already here before.
Ivan opened the door with a hint of excitement. After he entered, the door behind him closed automatically. Inside was a large training venue. The hall was decorated brightly and transparently. The left and right rows were filled with Dummy for practicing spells.
【Ding, I found the mysterious place where there is a responsive house...】
The voice in his mind was as expected by Ivan, but the task of exploration increased by three percentage points, which Ivan didn't expect.
Knowing that the library that inherits knowledge is only a five-point increase in progress, which shows how important this place is.
"Fall to pieces!" After Ivan warmed up a bit, he waved his wand to practice the spell he had learned.
The white light hit the dummy directly, and the dummy swelled and exploded with one arm with a "bang" sound. The sawdust flying in the sky was restored by Ivan with a healing spell.
In the next half an hour, various colorful lights swept back and forth in the practice room,
Transfiguration Curse, Petrification Curse, Flying Curse, Bright Curse...
After nearly half a month of crazy learning, Ivan has learned all the basic spells, although the level is not high, but all have been upgraded to the level of a level, not always the time. Not working.
But for the first time, Ivan soon discovered that his spell hit rate was a bit worrying. The fixed target was okay. If it was a moving target, several shots would not necessarily make a single hit.
Ivan also tried to redeem a Xueba experience card during actual combat practice, and found that this learning buff is also useful during actual combat practice.
The improvement of brain comprehension ability and analysis speed enables Ivan to be faster and more accurate in the process of releasing the spell, the hit rate is greatly improved, and even the movement direction of the distant target and the trajectory of the spell light can be predicted. trace.
This makes it clear that the level of the spell is the same, but in the state of the experience card, Ivan's strength is much higher than usual.
"I'm stupid, and stronger..."
Ivan, who once again exited the experience mode, couldn't help sighing. After each use, the decline of his brain comprehension always gave Ivan a feeling of suddenly becoming stupid.
After practicing for a whole morning, Ivan’s brain was already groggy, and his magic power was almost dry. Taking into account the flight lesson in the afternoon, Ivan left the responsive room after a while, and found one on the eighth floor. The secret road that I walked through, I plan to return to the hall of Hogwarts all the way.
Just as Ivan stepped out of the secret road with his forefoot, the long-lost system alert sounded again.
【Ding, explored the unknown underworld, the progress of exploring Hogwarts has reached 40%.
Reward grade points: 20 points
Extra bonus: Please collect it by yourself in front of the twelfth column of the seven rows of bookshelves in the restricted area between 11:00 midnight and 1:00 am...]

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Flight lessons with frequent conditions (Part 1)
chapters.content:
The exploration mission reaches a certain value, and there are additional rewards?
Ivan is a little curious, this reward is not directly given out, but to find it in the forbidden book area in the middle of the night, this process always makes Ivan feel a little creepy.
But since it was a reward, Ivan decided to go. Anyway, I have seen the ghost and ghost. What else is there to be afraid of at night?
In the lobby, Harry and Ron were sitting at a round table eating lunch, and they hurriedly greeted after seeing the dazed Ivan.
"Ivan, this way!"
"Where have you been this morning? You are so embarrassed?" Harry was curious to see Ivan's collapsed appearance.
"Just find a place to practice the spell." Ivan rolled his eyes, stuck a piece of grilled sausage with a knife and stuffed it into his mouth. He was consumed this morning and didn't eat anything. He almost starved to death.
It is the first time that Ivan has consumed his magic power so intensely in so many days. Until now, he still feels dizzy.
Ivan was eating up in the hall, while Harry and Ron were excitedly discussing flying skills and the new broomstick, rocket and crossbow.
And Ivan only remembered after listening to it for most of the time that there seemed to be a flying lesson in the afternoon, which aroused some interest.
After all, flying is almost everyone’s dream. Even if you have to ride a broom under your crotch, this enthusiasm is not affected.
Slytherin College, it was even more lively. Draco Malfoy was surrounded and surrounded by everyone, boasting loudly about his previous experience of flying.
"Before I went to Hogwarts, I would ride a flying broomstick. My dad took me all the way home, and once ran into a Muggle plane. If I didn't hide it quickly, I would knock it off. !" Draco said triumphantly.
Ivan just took a sip of goat milk and almost squirted out in public.
hit a plane? So awesome, why don't you go to heaven?
Flying so high with a flying broom, without any protection, I'm afraid it would freeze to death long ago...
"Ivan, have you ever ridden a flying broomstick before?" Harry had been upset after listening to Draco's boasting. Now that Ivan has reacted so strongly, he hurriedly asked.
"No." Ivan shook his head decisively, even if he had learned it before, he has forgotten...
"What about you, Ron?" Harry said with a glimmer of hope.
Ron didn't disappoint Harry, he talked about the scene when he used Charlie's old broom to practice at home.
Ivan just watched and listened to Ron and Draco's bragging. Anyway, after the flight class, all of them will be revealed...
Sure enough, in the afternoon flight class, following the whistle of the teacher, Mrs. Hooch, among the twenty little wizards present, only Harry summoned the broomstick placed on the ground into his hand.
Draco Malfoy, who boasted that he had almost hit an airplane before, tried several times but failed. Fortunately, after listening to the broomstick at the last minute, he flew into Draco's hands obediently and stopped. Yu lost face in front of Harry.
And Ron was miserable, maybe because he shouted too loudly, the broom bounced all of a sudden and hit his forehead directly.
"Get up!" Ivan called for the broom as Mrs. Hooch demonstrated, but the broom just stayed on the ground and whirled lazily and didn't mean to get up at all.
Ivan was anxious, and couldn't help but regret that he hadn't read a few more flying books before and brushed up on his proficiency.
It wasn't until Mrs. Hooch turned her head around that she had a clue to hook the broomstick with his foot and kicked it gently into his hand, becoming the third student to get the magic broomstick.
Madam Hooch saw that Ivan was holding the broom steadily, and she nodded her head appreciatively and taught the other students to go.
Harry was a little dumbfounded at Ivan's show operation. Ivan put his hand in front of his mouth and made a silent gesture to Harry. At the same time, he was relieved. At least this lesson will not be enough. A bad review.
As long as you have academic points, riding a broomstick is not easy...
However, for the system, there is only one exchange option such as the Xueba experience card, and Ivan has also complained for a long time.
How come there is no exchange that can enhance talent?
He is a mediocre student, what if he pretends to be a tyrant and is dismantled by others? Where can I get a grade point?
In order to keep his class evaluation, Ivan imagined hundreds of handsome riding styles in his mind when Madam Hooch taught other students, as well as the troubles he might encounter in the process of flying.
And pray that the tattered broomstick in your hand must give some face, if you can’t fly on it, wouldn’t it be embarrassing...
"Let me show you all, I will only demonstrate it once." After seeing everyone holding the broom steadily in their hands, Mrs. Hooch walked to the front and demonstrated the correct riding posture.
"Wait, as soon as I blow the whistle, you will push hard to the ground, remember to hold your broom tightly, and try to rise to a few feet..."
Madam Hooch commanded the crowd loudly, and Ivan also rode the broomstick in time, preparing to experience the first high-altitude flight.
However, before Ivan could try, Neville, who was not far away, flew from the spot to high altitude with a loud scream in mid-air.
"Ahhh~"
Naville flew out at least twenty feet high in horror. The little wizards underneath were all messed up. Ivan remembered that Neville seemed to fall and took out the staff first.
"Yugadim Leviosa!" Ivan waved a floating spell and shot it at Neville, who was falling rapidly from midair.
The power of magic instantly stopped Neville's fall, hanging in the air over three meters above him.
Madam Hooch's high-hanging heart also let go. God knows how worried she was just now. If Neville had a problem with her professor's flight class, Madam Hooch felt that she would have no face here at Hogwar. Ci stayed.
"Good job, Gryffindor adds five points!" Madam Hooch gave Ivan an admiring look.
At the same moment, Yifan also received a prompt to increase his grade point, and he was slightly happy.
The students of Gryffindor also applauded under the leadership of Harry and Ron.
But before everyone's palms were slapped a few times, Neville fell directly from mid-air.
The scene was very embarrassing...
"Sorry, Madam Hooch, I seem to have run out of magic power." Ivan's smile stuck on his face, and then she shrugged helplessly. After practicing the spell all morning, he had just caught the rapidly descending Na Wei is pretty good.
Anyway, the grade points have been obtained, and the five points added will be deducted back...

chapters.title: Chapter 15: Flight lessons with frequent conditions (medium)
chapters.content:
Mrs. Hooch didn't mean to blame Ivan, but hurried to Neville to check his injuries.
"Mrs. Hooch, is Neville all right?" Ivan asked.
Ivan feels that he has buffered a bit, and shouldn't cause more injuries, right?
"It's not bad, it's just a minor injury." Madam Hooch checked for a while and helped Neville, who had a swollen nose and a swollen face.
The scene where Neville fell straight from the sky just now almost frightened her, so even if Neville's injuries were not serious, Madam Hooch insisted on sending him to the medical room.
"Okay, kids, I want to take Neville to the hospital. Before I come back, I hope you can stay here obediently. No one is allowed to fly privately!"
After Mrs. Hooch finished speaking, she took Neville, who was still with tears on her face, and walked towards the castle.
As they walked farther, the Slytherin students burst into laughter, and Draco Malfoy laughed even more.
"Did you see it just now? That stupid, slug fell from the sky, I guess he won't even dare to ride a broomstick in the future."
"Enough, Malfoy!" Harry couldn't stand it, and stood up for Malfoy to shut up.
However, Malfoy did not mean to repent, but taunted even more severely. "My God, our Potter is that stupid friend!"
"Of course we are friends, and you are not allowed to be called Neville!" Harry said angrily at Malfoy.
Ivan also frowned upon hearing this. But when I first watched the movie, Ivan knew that Malfoy was a bear kid, but his temperament was not too bad.
Ivan was thinking so, but suddenly he heard Malfoy pointing at him.
"Friend? Like him, is he a friend who throws the stupid big man from the sky after adding points?"
Ivan twitched the corners of his mouth, stepped forward and rolled up his sleeves, punched Malfoy in the face, and knocked Malfoy directly to the ground.
MMP, bear children really hate it the most...
"Do you dare to hit me? I must let my father fire you!" Malfoy touched his reddish cheeks, got up from the ground angrily, and said cursingly.
Ivan didn’t care about Malfoy’s threat. Although the old Malfoy was a director of Hogwarts, he did not have the right to expel a student directly. Dumbledore would not expel him for this trivial matter. After all, he is now Somewhat a friend of Harry the savior.
"Ivan, good job..." Ron stood up with his sleeves rolled up at this time. He had already seen Malfoy upset.
"Enough! Ivan, Ron, what would you think if Mrs. Hooch came back and saw you fighting? You will be fired!" Hermione looked at Ivan and the others angrily, looking a little hysterical.
And Malfoy took advantage of Ivan's distraction and flew directly into the air on a broomstick.
Perhaps the advantage of high altitude has brought Malfoy a little sense of security. Malfoy, who was beaten up, didn't mean to repent, but took out a crystal ball with greater force, raised it high, and said to everyone.
"Look at what this is? That stupid crystal ball! Let me think about where I should hide it? How about throwing it in a tree? Are you not that stupid friend? Come and get it!"
"Malfoy!"
Harry was almost furious, and despite Hermione's dissuasion, he chased him into the air on a broomstick.
Although Harry was flying on a broomstick for the first time, it was steady, and soon the two of them fought in the air.
Ivan naturally planned to go to help when he saw this, put the broom under his crotch, and learned Harry's take-off posture, hoping to experience the feeling of flying.
However, the broom seems to have its own ideas, no matter how Ivan shakes the top of the broom, the latter will not move.
move... move... why don't you move?
Ivan patted the body of the broomstick depressedly, only then did he remember that he hadn't even completed the first step of sensing the broom.
Fortunately, before Ivan stood there stunned for too long, Hermione had already stood in front of Ivan with her hands open.
"Ivan, are you going to violate the school rules too?" The little witch stared at Ivan in front of her with enthusiasm.
"No, I think Harry could handle it without me." Ivan hurriedly took the opportunity to throw the broomstick in his hand on the ground, shrugged indifferently, and motioned Hermione to look at the sky.
Harry riding a broomstick was just like a fish in the air, and soon suppressed Malfoy. Hermione even wondered if Harry had practiced before he came to school.
However, Malfoy obviously wouldn't admit defeat so easily. Seeing that he was not Harry's opponent, Malfoy threw the glass ball in his hand decisively into the distance.
"Here, then..." Malfoy said viciously.
The glass ball flew far away under Malfoy's throw. When Harry saw it, he followed up in a rush, almost hitting the bricks of the castle, and then swooped down with the glass ball.
"No, Harry, stop!"
Hermione yelled in horror. Malfoy laughed loudly until he saw Harry holding the glass ball in his hand in a beautiful dive, and Malfoy smiled. Frozen on his face.
It's just that neither Malfoy nor Harry noticed, Professor McGonagall's surprised expression in front of an opened window in the distance.
Hermione and the others, who had been worried about Harry, breathed a sigh of relief, and Ron even pulled out his wand.
"We are going to teach Malfoy a lesson!"
"Legs stand and stop dead!" Ron shouted out the leg-locking spell he had just learned in the spell class.
In class, Ron used it once by chance, letting an experimental toad jump on its hind legs together for a class.
However, luck was not on Ron's side this time, the pitch-black staff just emitted a bunch of weird white smoke without any reaction.
Malfoy, who was flying in the sky on a broomstick, was shocked at first, and he was even ready to evade, but he suddenly laughed when he saw Ron's embarrassment.
Ron's cheeks were swollen and flushed, and he was so angry that he could not wait to jump into the air and poke the wand in his hand into Malfoy's broken mouth!
"I'll come here..." Seeing Ron's desperate appearance, Ivan sighed helplessly, and at any rate took a break again. There is no problem with one or two magic spells.
But there was an accident, Ivan still said to Hermione, who seemed a little at a loss due to various changes.
"Hermione, do you remember the spell of the floating spell?"
"Of course..." Hermione glanced at Ivan strangely, and nodded dazedly.
Ask what this does?
"That's good..." Before Hermione could understand, Ivan said softly while raising the wand in his hand...

chapters.title: Chapter 16: Frequent Flight Lessons (Part 2) [Happy Mid-Autumn Festival]
chapters.content:
"All petrochemicals!"
Following the petrification spell, Ivan chanted a gray-white light beam from Ivan’s wand and flew towards Malfoy in the distance.
In mid-air, the proud Malfoy did not expect Ivan's movements at all. He was sturdily hit by the petrification curse. The original white skin turned into a stiff gray in less than half a second, his expression And the action also stayed at the moment of being petrified.
Malfoy in this state couldn't even move a finger, let alone manipulate the broom under him, and immediately fell straight down from the sky.
Of course, even though the body is petrified, Malfoy's consciousness is still intact.
It's just that if he had a choice, Malfoy would prefer to know nothing.
After all, he fell from a high altitude and watched the ground get closer and closer. This feeling of getting closer to death was enough to make people collapse. If it weren't for the petrified Malfoy, he would have started to soar.
And the moment Ivan hit Malfoy with the Petrification Charm, he turned to face Hermione.
"Hermione, it's now!"
The clever little witch understood Ivan’s plan the moment I started her hands, but now Hermione obviously has no time to blame Ivan. She only had time to stare at Ivan and shouted...
"Yugadim Leviosa~"
At this time, Malfoy was also horrified to the extreme, imagining in his mind that he was smashed into several pieces in a petrified state.
Malfoy even thought of how old Malfoy would torture Ivan, Harry and others to avenge himself after he died.
Just when Malfoy was thinking that the Malfoy family was likely to decline due to his unfortunate death, the rapidly falling body stopped abruptly when it was more than ten centimeters above the ground, and Malfoy could clearly see the floor when he was close. The lines on it.
Miss Granger, who successfully cast the spell in an emergency, breathed a sigh of relief, and Ivan quietly put down his wand.
"Malfoy..." When Malfoy landed steadily, the little wizards of Slytherin College immediately surrounded him.
The students of Gryffindor Academy were gloating, after all, Malfoy's pretentious appearance was really annoying.
And the only one who is dissatisfied with this is Miss Granger.
"Ivan, how can you use a petrification spell on Malfoy... you know, you almost killed him!" Hermione glared at Ivan angrily, her eyes full of incredibility.
"So your floating spell is very good, if Professor Flitwick sees it, it will definitely give you extra points." Ivan smiled.
Of course, it is impossible for Malfoy to fail just because of one of his petrification spells. At most, he suffers a little bit. Even if Hermione fails to cast the spell, wouldn't he still have him as insurance?
"Yeah... Maybe Professor Flitwick will expel you by the way!" Hermione said in an angry voice.
shouldn't be enough, right? Ivan scratched his head, thinking that some points would be deducted. At most, adding a trophy or a night tour of the Forbidden Forest?
If it’s the latter, Ivan thinks it’s still pretty good...
Of course, Yifan is definitely not going to go to the Forbidden Forest this semester, nor is he going to die.
After all, Quirrell, who was possessed by Voldemort, often likes to wander around in the forbidden forest. God knows if he will run into bad luck...
So it's better to stay stubborn. If you don't take the initiative, Hogwarts is still safe before the fourth grade.
Ivan recalled his unreliable golden finger. After four years, coupled with the fact that he had a system as a cheater, he would always have the ability to save his life, right?
Ivan thought as he walked towards Malfoy.
Halfway through, he was stopped by a few Slytherin wizards. The leader was a Slytherin Ivan who managed to make some reflections, which seemed to be called Bryce.
"Halse, what are you doing here?" Bryce clasped the staff in his hand and frowned.
In the face of foreign enemies, Slytherin College is still very united. Although Malfoy usually looks arrogant, there are still many little wizards who are willing to stand up and defend Malfoy, and a group of people vaguely surround Ivan. Up the posture.
Gryffindor's righteous little lions, not to mention, stood behind Ivan one after another, both of them drew out their staff...even though these beginner magic may not be effective yet.
Ivan shook his head, raised his hand to stop Ron who was about to roll up his sleeve, and said to Bryce.
"I'm here to help Malfoy lift the petrification curse. I believe you can clearly see the situation just now. Malfoy picked the matter first..."
Bryce seemed to hesitate, but after thinking about it, he signaled everyone to leave. Ivan also solved the petrification curse in Malfoy as he said.
Malfoy had just experienced the ups and downs, his calves were still trembling, but in order not to lose face in front of everyone, he climbed up from the ground rigidly, sternly directed at Ivan Shouted.
"How dare you cast a spell on me! You are done Hals!"
"Really?" Ivan looked at Draco Malfoy. "What if you tell the professor about your stealing of Neville's crystal ball and flying privately?"
Ivan approached Malfoy step by step, and his tone suddenly became serious.
"I heard that Filch likes to take disobedient children to his office most, and then tie their hands with chains and hang them from the ceiling, and then do strange things with whips and sticks... ."
Malfoy was frightened for a while, because there was indeed such a rumor among the senior students in the school.
Malfoy even forgot that if this was true, Ivan who violated the school rules would have to enjoy the same treatment as him.
Ivan was ready to make persistent efforts when he saw the effect was good, but before he could speak, he heard Madam Hodge's voice behind him.
"You guys... how dare you guys!"
Mrs. Hodge, who rushed back in time after sending Neville to the infirmary, saw Malfoy who fell from the sky halfway down the road, and now saw Gryffindor and the little wizards of Slytherin College fighting with each other. Looks like, suddenly angry.
Especially Harry, who was holding the crystal ball, just came down from the sky on a broomstick with a blank face, which made Mrs. Hodge even more angry.
Ivan reluctantly covered his face with his hands. He hadn't even calculated that Madam Hodge would come back at this point. He still wanted to have a good talk with Malfoy. I'm afraid this is the end...
Thinking about it carefully, Ivan found that it seemed that he had pitted himself. If he hadn't saved Neville with the Levitating Charm before, Mrs. Hodge would still be worried about Neville in the medical room.

chapters.title: Chapter 17: Am I right? Malfoy?
chapters.content:
"Who can tell me what happened here!" Mrs. Hodge looked around the little wizards, and then turned her attention to Malfoy and Harry.
Harry and Malfoy both turned pale in fright, and Ivan was the first to answer.
"Mrs. Hodge, as you can see, they are just practicing flying skills."
A tangled color flashed across Malfoy's face, and he opened his mouth to tell the story of Ivan's attack on him with the petrification spell, but in the end he closed his mouth and did not refute it.
After all, Malfoy understood that if he said it, Ivan would definitely steal the Neville crystal ball and provoked him. Which of the two punishments is heavier, Malfoy still knew clearly in his heart.
In order to avoid going to the confinement room and being lifted by Filch, Malfoy reluctantly accepted that he and Harry were “friendly” to practice flying together.
But Malfoy would never allow the annoying Ivan to stay out of the matter, even when he spoke.
"Yes, but it was not just the two of us who flew just now."
While talking, Malfoy raised his eyebrows at Ivan. The threatening expression on his face was obvious. Mrs. Hodge also shifted her attention from Malfoy and Harry to Ivan.
"Okay, I admit..." Ivan shrugged indifferently, and his heart was filled with the character of the bear kid who had been spitting out the Malfolk.
Ivan and Malfoy glanced at each other uncomfortably, but the two sides still faintly reached an agreement in the intersection of their eyes, without revealing the truth to each other... a temporary truce!
Malfoy was frightened by the punishment Ivan said, and Ivan was worried about being drawn to patrol the forbidden forest.
With Ivan’s current small body, he is not ready to take this risk...
Harry, who had been watching, had a dazed expression on his face. Shouldn't it be Malfoy who took Neville's crystal ball and then took it back by himself?
When did he practice flying friendly with Ivan and Malfoy?
But under the frequent hints that suggested Ivan's eyes, Harry still wisely chose to shut up.
"I should have said before I want to leave, no one is allowed to fly a broomstick until I come back!" Hearing that three students were flying privately while they were not there, Mrs. Hodge was very angry for a while.
Navi has just been taken to the hospital by her, what if there is another accident?
"I'm sorry, Professor!" Ivan first apologized politely, and then said immediately.
"But I think no little wizard can resist the temptation to fly freely on a broomstick. Who doesn't want to be a glorious Quidditch after graduation to win glory for the country?"
"As for Malfoy and Neville, it was just an accident. Fortunately, our Levitation Charm worked well, and no one was injured."
Ivan talked endlessly about his love for Quidditch, only to say that he was going to become a Quidditch champion in the future!
Mrs. Hodge's face looks better. As a flight class professor, Mrs. Hodge is also a fan of flying and Quidditch, so she can naturally understand the desire.
"Even so, you must pay the price for violating school regulations..."
Even though she was not as angry as she was at the beginning, Mrs. Hodge put down her face, thinking about how to punish these troublemakers, but was interrupted by Professor McGonagall who arrived in time.
"Mrs. Hodge, can you stop first? I might want to borrow Mr. Potter from you."
"Of course..." Madam Hodge was a little surprised at first, then nodded quickly.
Mrs. Hodge didn’t see the process of Harry’s flight just now. She thought it was Harry who made other mistakes and was found by Professor McGonagall, so it was simple to take Harry’s flying class privately on the broomstick. Said it.
Professor McGonagall just nodded, and then motioned to Harry to follow him.
There was a paste in Harry's head, and he still didn't know what happened. He could only follow Professor McGonagall in fear.
After Madam Hodge watched the two leave, she turned around and realized that there was still someone to deal with. "Ivan, Malfoy, your actions will deduct five points for your respective colleges, and then continue to class!"
Ivan's face turned bitter, and he didn't care about being deducted points. In the past few days, just answering questions in class, Ivan had won ten points for the academy, and a five-point deduction would not make anyone blame him.
But Ivan felt a little painful when I continued to take the flight class. He secretly prayed that the class would end soon, or would I just wear it for help?
Ivan would have to pretend to be holding a broomstick in a flying posture, while trying to reduce the sense of presence and fish quietly.
However, things went counterproductive. Due to the frequent situation in the previous flight class, Mrs. Hodge didn't dare to let these little wizards fly around. She prepared to come one by one. Malfoy gave Ivan the unfortunate platoon. In the first place.
Ivan looked at the flying broomstick in his hand, couldn't help sighing, and couldn't help but regret it. He had known that he had a bad flying skills.
Now being trapped by Malfoy, he wants to say that he can't fly.
Ivan tried helplessly, this time the flying broom gave Ivan a little bit of face, and under the control, he flew staggeringly.
Despite this, Ivan was very happy to experience flying for the first time. After a little acceleration, he felt the cold and stern wind echoing in his ears. The surrounding roof tiles flew by one by one. This feeling of freedom is far more than flying by plane. It's wonderful.
After flying for a while, Ivan landed smoothly.
Madam Hodge pursed her lips, obviously not too satisfied. After all, Mrs. Hodge held high hopes for Ivan’s previous performance. How come she flies and shakes now...
Ivan had to cough a clear cough, covering his embarrassment. "Ahem, professor, I think this broomstick may be too old...it's a bit unstable when flying...I used to fly pretty well."
Malfoy was grinning and snickering. He didn't expect that Ivan's flying skills were so bad. No wonder he had been on the ground before and didn't fly up like Harry.
But unexpectedly, Ivan said suddenly.
"You mean? Malfoy? How else would you suddenly fall from under the broom..."
Malfoy, who was snickering, couldn't laugh anymore, so he had to look at Ivan bitterly, and it took him a long time to hold back a word.
"Of course, I also think there may be a problem with these broomsticks..."
How else can he say? Slap yourself in the face?
Malfoy said that he was also very desperate. In order not to be punished, the truth cannot be told, or else it can be said that he fell because of his poor skills?

chapters.title: Chapter 18: Rejected duel
chapters.content:
The flight class of the afternoon passed quickly in Ivan's entanglement. Fortunately, everything went smoothly. Ivan was the first student to complete the flight training.
Ivan also took special care of Malfoy, and carefully told him to be careful when flying, and don't fall from the sky again.
Mrs. Hodge in the distance saw Ivan's performance in her eyes, and her evaluation of Ivan improved a little bit in her heart.
Gryffindor and the little wizards of Slytherin have never dealt with it. In her opinion, it is rare for Ivan to put aside the prejudice in her heart and care about Malfoy so much.
And Malfoy was so angry that he threatened to show everyone a difficult flying maneuver to prove his skills, but it was a pity that Mrs. Hodge stopped him in time.
After all, Malfoy has a precedent for falling. Mrs. Hodge is still a little worried about his accident, and she doesn't even allow Malfoy to fly on a broomstick during this class.
......
【Ding, the flight class is over, this comprehensive comprehensive class evaluation: excellent
Evaluator: Rolanda Hodge
Reward: academic points*10】
Ivan, who was walking in the corridor, was finally relieved when he saw the final class evaluation given. Even if the bear boy Malfoy made trouble, he still achieved his expected goal.
Relatively speaking, Ron and Hermione are not in a good mood. Both are worried about Harry who was taken away by Professor McGonagall.
Especially Hermione, who hasn't calmed down until now, couldn't help but ran up to Ivan after the get out of class, and said babblingly.
"I think we should tell Professor McGonagall and Mrs. Hodge! Otherwise, what if Harry is fired?"
Ivan stopped and looked at Hermione.
"No, Professor McGonagall won't fire Harry because of this trivial matter. Maybe it's because Harry flew well just now, so Professor McGonagall intends to let Harry join the Quidditch team."
"If you want to join the Quidditch team, you need to be at least the second grade!" Hermione corrector Ivan made a mistake in his words.
