By the time the trio arrived at the auditorium to have dinner, Harry had already been sitting there. Before they had passed, Harry had already greeted him and couldn’t wait to give Professor McGonagall a spotter. Said it.
Even though Ivan had vaccinated the two of them in advance, they were still very surprised, especially Ron, who was extremely excited.
"Harry, I didn't expect you to actually join the Quidditch team. You may be the youngest seeker ever at Hogwarts! I mean they still lack manpower? For example, a batsman or a goalkeeper. Yes?" Ron looked at Harry expectantly, hoping to hear some good news.
"No, I heard Wood say that there is enough manpower." Harry shook his head awkwardly. He didn't understand why Ron could be so excited. He only heard about Quidditch matches today. He didn't know exactly what it was. What's going on.
"By the way, Ivan, what happened in the flight class today?" Harry turned to look at Ivan depressed.
"Didn't Malfoy take Neville's crystal ball? Then I chased it? When did we train with Malfoy?"
When he was taken away by Professor McGonagall before, Harry was almost terrified. He even thought he was going to be expelled from Hogwarts and returned to the dirty and cramped cupboard of his uncle’s house. Fortunately, The situation is not as bad as he thought.
Ivan didn't mean to conceal, he used the petrification curse to attack Malfoy and told him something ugly.
"If I'm exposing Malfoy, I'll have to be locked up with him. Anyway, he's learned enough, right?" Ivan spread his hands.
Ron also added enthusiasm and talked about Malfoy's flight restriction by Ivan Pit in flight class. Harry's depression suddenly disappeared and he was amused to laugh.
Only Hermione still cares about everyone's violation of school rules. Seeing Ivan and the others are chatting happily, she turned around and left angrily.
Ivan thought for a while and still didn't say anything to keep her, Hermione's temperament was about to change.
Of course, it's not that it's bad to follow the rules, but sometimes it's too rigid to get yourself completely into this frame without leaving any room.
Just like in the original book, Malfoy, who caused trouble in flight lessons, was basically unpunished.
This is certainly due to Harry's bad luck, and Professor McGonagall did not give him a chance to explain, but even if Harry explained the reason clearly, Professor McGonagall probably deducted the credits of the two people, which is fundamental to Malfoy. There is no loss.
At least now Malfoy is very scared, I believe he will not dare to do things again in a short time. UU Reading www.uukanshu.cOM
It's a pity that the face slap came faster than Ivan expected. Before Ivan had finished eating, Malfoy brought Crabbe and Gore to find the difference.
Perhaps because of the two attendants, Malfoy returned to his original arrogant appearance, but when he saw Ivan, his teeth were itchy with hatred.
"Potter, are you eating your last meal? Tomorrow you are going to bid farewell to your Muggle world, right?" Malfoy sneered loudly.
Ivan and Harry didn't do anything when they heard that, instead they looked at Malfoy like a fool. Ron even thought that Malfoy's expression would be funny if Harry became a Seeker.
The indifferent attitude of Ivan and others made Malfoy a little uneasy, but he gritted his teeth and said what he should say.
"Hals, if you have the courage, come to the prize showroom tonight, I will fight you!"
However, what Malfoy didn't expect was that Ivan shook his head resolutely.
"Don't go!"
What a joke, he is still going to the forbidden area to receive the rewards from the system tonight, so what effort is there to play a duel game with Malfoy.
Not to mention that in the impression that Ivan still had, Malfoy was planning to release the pigeons this time, and then notified Filch to arrest people. He would go to this kind of thing if he was stupid.
"Halse, are you scared?" Malfoy sneered.
"I'm not interested in a duel with the defeated opponent. It's a waste of time." Ivan squinted at Malfoy for a while, and said with a look of no interest in weak chickens.
"When you learn more advanced magic, come back...or you fall down again, but no one will save you."

chapters.title: Chapter 19: Explore the restricted book zone
chapters.content:
Ivan said, suddenly as if he had remembered something, he spoke again.
"Also, Malfoy, you still owe Hermione a thank you, don't forget!"
"Halse! That was your despicable attack on me!" Malfoy drew out his wand and pointed it at Ivan, his white cheeks flushed red.
"Even if Malfoy fell from the sky and fell to his death, and was locked up in Azkaban... I would never thank a Muggle!"
Crabbe and Gore also drew out their magic wands, but they responded to them with the surprised look of many Gryffindors. This reminded the three of them that this is Gryffindor’s long table. Let’s do it here. , They only have to be beaten...
Hearing the three words Muggle Seed, Ivan frowned involuntarily, and Ron even jumped up and shouted.
"Malfoy! We accept your challenge! I must teach you a lesson tonight!"
"Okay, then I'll wait tonight..." Malfoy raised his eyebrows, smiled and turned away.
"Duel, what is a duel? Do two people stab each other with swords?" When Malfoy left, Harry asked, confused.
"Of course not, how could we be as stupid as those Muggles?" Ron proudly said the rules he knew.
"Well... you first need to stand opposite each other, and then bow to the opponent. The two sides hold up their wands and use magic to perform a glorious duel. If one party dies, the assistant must connect it. It will not be over until one party falls!
Ron got more and more excited as he talked about it. It was more fun to do duels than boringly reading books in the classroom every day. Besides, he had already seen Malfoy upset.
"Dead?" Harry swallowed.
"Ron is too exaggerated. It was a regular wizard duel. At best, we use some magic such as disarming curses and leg-locking curses, sometimes not as useful as fists." Ivan shook his head and explained to Harry. .
"Ivan, are you going to go tonight?" Ron expected.
"No, I said before, there's still business tonight, but I don't have time to pay attention to Malfoy." Ivan shook his head.
In Ivan’s opinion, this kind of silly face-to-face magical duel with wands was too stupid. It doesn’t fit his mind as a wizard at all. It’s not as interesting as watching a fencing performance, at least it has some Ornamental.
In view of Ron and Harry's restless temperament, Ivan kindly reminded them.
"It's still a matter of two to say whether Malfoy will come tonight, maybe he just wants to fool us over, and then let Filch come over and catch us all..."
"impossible?"
Ron and Harry looked at each other, thinking that Malfoy shouldn't be so shameless, this is an honorable wizard duel!
Seeing the look of Harry and Ron, Ivan knew that he couldn't persuade them. After sighing, Ivan was no longer admonishing, and turned up the "Teach You Fast Flight" on the table.
Anyway, according to his memory, the actions of Harry and others tonight should have been shocking, but they could learn more about the Sorcerer's Stone.
Even if there is an accident, Dumbledore will be responsible for the finishing touches, and the principal will not let his appointed savior have an accident.
"Ron, are we really going to a duel at Malfoy at night? What if Malfoy doesn't come at all, as Ivan said?" After eating, Harry, who returned to his bedroom with him, said worriedly to Ron. .
"Of course we are going, this is a duel! Malfoy can't fail to come. If he arrives and finds we haven't gone, how ashamed of us?" Ron desperately cheered Harry, after all, he just agreed. Down.
"But without Ivan, we are only two, how could we have beaten the three of Malfoy!" Harry said.
"We can call Neville together, so there are three people!" Ron thought for a while, and it seemed to make sense. Although Malfoy's two followers were a little stupid, they were much stronger than them, and they suffered a lot from fighting. Up.
"Neville?" Harry opened his mouth, trying to say something, and then swallowed back after a while.
Why does he suddenly feel more worried?
Or else, two people will go for it...
......
At midnight, in the Gryffindor lounge, Ivan put down the "Teach You to Fly Fast" in his hand.
In order to avoid the embarrassment of the previous flight class, Ivan borrowed the books related to flight technique after the get out of class. After a few hours of reading, plus one flight class, the flight technique is almost close to the second level. Level up.
At this time, the bedroom was already empty. Harry and Ron had pulled Neville sneaking out ten minutes ago.
Ivan can only wish them good luck, but the three-headed dog has no good temper.
Seeing that the time was almost the same, Ivan crawled out of the cylinder-like passage. Looking back, the intersection of the passage had been automatically closed.
The fat lady who is in charge of guarding the passage doesn't seem to be there, maybe she stopped by.
Hogwarts at midnight was a bit more deserted than usual, and it was a little frighteningly quiet. The entire corridor was pitch black, and only the dim candlelight that lit up every ten meters made Ivan barely able to see the road ahead. U U Reading www.uukanshu.com
Fortunately, in this wizard’s world, ghosts are not terrifying. Ivan also chatted with some of them, so I didn’t panic at all, just complaining about the rewards given by the system in my heart.
This is too hard-core, the reward actually requires him to go to the forbidden book area to get...
This is not systematic at all!
Ivan went straight through the long corridor and encountered an annoying spiral staircase on the way to the restricted area.
At night, these stairs seem to be skinier than during the day, and there is no pattern at all. Sometimes when Ivan arrives, they suddenly turn to the other side. I don’t know if I gave Ivan this kind of likes on purpose. The little wizards who came out to wander around in the middle of the night made it more difficult.
Fortunately, Ivan’s curse is not learned for nothing. Using the floating curse can make oneself float for a short time, relying on borrowing force to float to the place where you want to go, and using the petrified curse can block the connection between the stairs and the stairs, let They cannot move...
With the help of a few hardly advanced spells, Ivan went very smoothly.
There are a large number of portraits hung around the spiral staircase. A few old scholars with white beards watched Ivan jumping up and down with interest, and a few portraits greeted Ivan enthusiastically.
After 　　 Ivan went downstairs, he responded politely one by one, and then turned from the auditorium to the way to the library.
"Araho Cave Open!" Ivan opened the closed library door with the unlocking spell, closed it with his backhand for safety, and then waved his staff and used the fluorescent spell.
"Fluorescence flickering..."
The bright white light from the tip of the wand flashed by. After it stabilized, the light was already dimmed a lot, but it was enough for Ivan.

chapters.title: Chapter 20: Origin of Blood
chapters.content:
Ivan walked through the sea of ​​books holding his magic wand, without the slightest intention of staying in the normal area, and walked straight to the restricted area.
"Advanced Transfiguration Guide"..."Ancient Magic Veins...".. "Contemplation-Peeping into Your Brain"...
Ivan's gaze flicked across the rows of bookshelves, and a large number of banned books whose names were quite high-end made Ivan greedy, and there were even books he had been longing for in dementia and Occlumency.
If possible, Ivan can’t wait to use hundreds of Xueba experience cards to watch here for ten days and a half, and then his strength will rise..
But in the end Ivan resisted the temptation, because he didn't have so many academic points to redeem, and he didn't forget what he was here for today.
Following the sign number in the forbidden book zone, Ivan quickly found the seven-row and twelfth-column bookshelf, but it didn’t seem to be any different here. A large number of magic books were neatly arranged, and the bookshelves were piled up full. Leave a little gap.
Ivan was unwilling to try to find out something like the secret tunnel, but found nothing. Instead, he accidentally bumped a book of black magic on the ground.
The book has no wind and automatically, as if you have your own consciousness. Pages are automatically turned up. After a few pages are turned, billowing black mist emerges from the pages of the book. You can faintly see a man's head with his mouth open. Screaming loudly!
What frightened Ivan was that he obviously didn't hear any sound, but his eardrums began to swell, and his brain gradually became dizzy, as if someone was actually yelling in front of him.
The thick black fog gathered more and more, and the head seemed to burst out of the book for a while...
slap~
Ivan closed the book abruptly and flattened his black head on the page. As the book was closed, the black fog disappeared.
"It's just a book, have you turned the sky upside down?" Ivan rubbed his ears and gritted his teeth.
It took a long time before Ivan dared to pick it up. The cover of the book reads "The Decryption of Advanced Black Magic". The feel of the cover is obviously different from that of other books. It feels a bit like touching the skin.
Isn’t it human skin?
A thought flashed in Ivan's mind, and Ivan suddenly felt a bit chilly. Thinking of the painful appearance of the man's head just now, it is really possible.
Ivan glanced at the reward task in the system, and there was no change in the slightest, indicating that it had nothing to do with the reward, so he really accidentally touched it.
Ivan had to shove the "Cutting-edge Black Magic Decryption" back in depression, planning to look for the missing mechanism, and suddenly noticed that the bookshelf in front of him seemed to be a little different from just now.
one two three four five six?
Every bookshelf in the forbidden book zone is exactly the same. Books are divided into six rows and seven columns according to their type. However, Ivan keenly noticed that the twelfth column of bookshelf cabinets was obviously missing by one.
What makes Ivan feel a little awkward is that there is obviously a missing cabinet, but the entire column of bookshelves is still neat and tidy, as if the space here has been distorted.
"Someone used the Confusion Curse here? Hid one of the cabinets."
Ivan squinted his eyes. He had checked this bookshelf many times just now. It was only possible that someone had set a confusion curse here, which affected his judgment, and then happened to be caught by the screaming sound just now. The confusion curse was broken.
Even if he knew where the anomaly was, Ivan was a little bit blind. After reading "Basic Charm Principles", he might be able to judge that this is a kind of hidden object curse, but he knows too little magic. , None of them can come in handy.
Ivan had to use his brain to try to recall the books he had read, and accidentally remembered a magic that Snape used in the original book.
"Aparecium (emergency manifestation)!" Ivan tried to put his wand on the bookshelf, and whispered the manifestation curse.
The entire bookshelf began to shake slightly, and a trace was cracked in the middle of the twelfth column of bookshelves. After a while, it suddenly expanded, and a new bookcase appeared in front of Ivan's eyes.
The hidden bookcase looks no different from the others. They are filled with thick books. Ivan reached out and scanned these books one by one. When the last one was encountered, the system's prompt sound was truthful. Sounded.
【Ding, the reward has been issued. 】
Ivan’s mouth twitched, but his heart was already madly complaining.
That's how rewards are distributed? If it wasn't for his luck, if it wasn't for his wit, God knows how long it will take!
This broken system is not caring at all!
Ivan can’t help but feel sad when thinking about what other people’s homes want and what kind of caring system. As a host, it’s really hard for him...
Even though thinking about this, Ivan was excited to pull the book out of the shelf. The cover of the book was slightly rough, with a few words "Origin of Blood" printed on it, and the paper pages were slightly yellowed for long-term preservation. As far as the magic book is concerned, the age can be seen.
Ivan discovered that this was another magic book that was not mentioned in the original work. Since this was a reward given by the system, Ivan looked through it directly.
After reading a few pictures, Ivan was disappointed to find that "The Origin of Blood" was not a magic book that recorded powerful spells in his imagination. On the contrary, was a bit like a history book, and it recorded before the Wizarding War. History.
At that time, the wizards did not dominate the entire magical world like they do now, and they were even able to enslave the house elves, which are magical creatures with strong ability to cast spells as adults.
On the contrary, compared to these magical creatures that are born with powerful power, human wizards are really weak and pitiful. It can only be said that they rely on their number advantages to occupy a place in the magical world.
Fortunately, humans have always been creatures that refuse to admit defeat.
Some wizards choose to specialize in magic and create more powerful spells to enhance their strength. Others focus their attention on quick methods...such as taking the power of those powerful magical creatures!
Some wizards have succeeded and their strength has been amazingly improved. What is even more terrifying is that the power of this bloodline can continue, so that the descendants of these wizards can also gain power.
Although the power of the bloodline may be gradually weakened due to iteration, this discovery is enough to make more wizards crazy!
However, the risk of blood fusion is extremely high. Except for a few successful people, most wizards died miserably during the process of experimentation and fusion. Some lucky losers survived, but at the price they became monsters and cursed for generations. Such as werewolves, vampires, etc.
There are even wizards who choose to cultivate more powerful and more suitable magical creatures to carry out blood fusion experiments to enhance their power.
This reminds Ivan of the basilisk sleeping in the secret room and the eight-eyed giant spider in the forbidden forest...
The most maddening thing is that some wizards find ways to choose the less unacceptable magical creatures and establish super-friendship relationships, hoping that their offspring can continue the blood of the other party...

chapters.title: Chapter 21: Put down your axe first, we have something to say
chapters.content:
Among the many recorded successes, Ivan even saw the Dumbledore family, which surprised him somewhat.
Then, Ivan remembered Dumbledore’s Phoenix Fox and the rumors about Dumbledore’s family in Greenward’s Crimes.
[Whenever a member of the Dumbledore family urgently needs help, the phoenix will come...]
Ivan wondered if it was related to their fusion of Phoenix blood.
Of course, according to the book's records, the Dumbledore family is a relatively moderate group, and even obtained the consent of the other party before conducting the fusion experiment. This is probably the reason why the relationship between the Phoenix and the Dumbledore family is so close.
"Well? Why did I break it here?" Ivan was reading the book with enthusiasm, but when the fusion method was described at the end of the book, he suddenly disconnected, as if several pages were forcibly torn off in the middle. The rest are content that is not nutritious.
When Ivan was confused that the so-called reward was just some information, the system prompt sounded again.
["The Origin of Blood" has been read, and the challenge task is activated.
Challenge task: defeat (or kill) giant monsters
Reward: Blood Vessel Fusion Potion Formula]
"Challenge mission..." Ivan was stunned. He always thought this was a learning system, but he didn't expect that there would be a setting for killing monsters.
Ivan is even more curious about who actually hid this book here, and even set up a confusing curse and special hidden magic in the forbidden book area.
Dumbledore was the first to think of Ivan, the greatest white wizard of this century, who has the authority and reason to hide "Origin of Blood".
After all, blood fusion is extremely dangerous. Therefore, wizards who die are definitely dozens of times more alive. This terrifying death rate prevents such wizards with special blood from becoming the mainstream of wizards.
In addition, James Potter, Sirius and others are also possible, after all, hiding some important items is in line with their style.
There is also Tom Marvolo Riddle who once stayed at Hogwarts, or Voldemort...
Various guesses flashed through Ivan's mind one by one, but Ivan didn't stay here any longer. There were too many things to digest in his brain tonight, and even when faced with a large number of banned books, Ivan didn't have the thought of reading.
On the way back, Ivan’s attention was on the newly activated challenge task.
Seeing that the target is the troll, Ivan has a headache, but he will not despise the troll just because Harry and Ron defeated it in the original book.
They were able to win, and coincidence factors accounted for a large proportion. If it hadn't been for the halo of Harry's savior, it would have been cold when the professors arrived.
Judging from the information obtained by Ivan from reading books, trolls are not easy to deal with. They are huge, powerful, and have certain resistance to magic. Even an adult wizard must be careful when confronting them. Handle.
Ivan sighed. If it hadn't been learned from "The Origin of Blood" that fusion of the blood of magical creatures could improve magical talents, he wouldn't want to face such monsters in the first grade.
Ivan walked through the silent castle, and the smoothness of the previous arrival made Ivan more or less vigilant.
However, not long after walking out of a secret road, a blue, fast-traveling gloom suddenly collided with Ivan.
Just as if his whole body was immersed in ice water, Ivan shuddered all over, and turned his head to look over and found that it was an ugly ghost with a shabby hat... Pepi ghost.
Pippy Ghost was even more excited, clapping his hands, and shouting in his throat.
"Look, see what I found? Another new student, come on! There is one more here!"
"All petrification!" Ivan's backhand was a petrification spell. The blue-gray light accurately hit Pepigui's chest, but the latter was only repelled a little, and he smiled happily.
"Hahaha... useless, you can't hurt me!" Pippi triumphantly circled Ivan, seeming to want to drag Ivan here.
Seeing that ordinary magic is useless for Pippi, Ivan is not discouraged, because the ghost is not immune to all magic, and it happens that he has a trick that specializes in spirit.
"Fear is coming~"
Just as Pippi was arrogantly making faces in front of Ivan, a purple light shot from the top of Ivan's wand, and Pippi immediately changed his face and screamed into a classroom in the distance. Ivan who was far away could still hear Pepigui's sharp yelling.
"No, Barrow, let me go, I swear I didn't do anything bad! And Nick, put down your axe first, we have something to say..."
Seeing Pippi’s reaction, Ivan nodded in satisfaction, and called up the magic bar of the system, and found that the Fear Curse had unknowingly reached the second level in these days, no wonder the effect was so good.
After dealing with the annoying Pi Pigui, there was another rush of footsteps in the distance. Then Ivan remembered that Pi Pigui had previously said that he had "found" a new born againWaiting for Yi It was too late when they were about to re-enter the underpass to evade, and Harry, Ron, Hermione and Neville rushed out across from Ivan.
Harry and the others didn't expect to meet Ivan here, but it was obviously not the time to talk about this. Harry was just stunned for less than a second, and took the lead in pulling Ivan's arm and running together.
"Ivan, run! No time to explain, Filch is behind!"
Ivan didn't even finish saying a few words about the secret road behind, he was dragged into another aisle by Harry, and had to run with him.
Ivan faintly felt that this scene seemed a bit familiar as he ran, until Harry took the lead and stepped into the forbidden corridor on the fourth floor that Ivan realized something was wrong.
"Quick... come in, Filch is coming!" Harry and Neville pulled in Ivan, who didn’t want to come in. Hermione closed the door. It was rare for Ron not to fish. He locked the door hard.
"So Filch won't be able to come in." Harry breathed a sigh of relief.
"Yeah, it's just that we can't get out anymore." Ivan muttered to himself while looking at the locked door, and then sighed as he looked deep in the corridor.
"If you want me to say it's better to go out and face Filch..."
Harry didn't understand Ivan's meaning, but soon he felt something sticky on his shoulders. He turned his head and looked at him and found that three huge heads were looking at him, and there was a foul smell from his open mouth. From time to time, yellow muddy saliva fell from the edge of his big mouth, and some even splashed on his clothes.
"Ah~" In the next second, Hermione and the others also saw the three-headed dog, and the cry of fear suddenly tore the silence of the night...

chapters.title: Chapter 22: Which **** was the one who locked the door?
chapters.content:
Harry's position happened to be at the back of the crowd. Facing the huge mouth of the abyss that suddenly struck, Harry was a little dazed for a while.
The foul smell sprayed on his face, making Harry almost nauseous. Just as desperation spread throughout his body, Ivan's voice suddenly rang in Harry's ears.
"There are so many obstacles!"
A series of invisible barriers blocked the three-headed dog's ferocious heads in mid-air, but the next second, the barrier constructed by Ivan's magical powers was torn and shattered by another big mouth with fangs!
Fortunately, in just one second of effort, Harry had reflected in time and barely escaped.
But after Ron yelled to run fast, the whole person had already swooped on the door, and after pulling hard with both hands a few times, he realized that the door had been locked.
"Which **** locked the door!" Ron said desperately.
Ivan, who temporarily restrained the three-headed dog with a coma spell and a petrification spell, couldn't help but roll his eyes. Didn't you lock the door yourself?
Ron was panicked, even suspecting that he might die here, Hermione pushed it away and put the wand on the door lock.
"Alaho Cave is open!"
Hermione spelled the door and broke the door lock violently. A group of five people escaped as quickly as possible, and then closed the door back in time before the three-headed dog Norway came out.
嘭.. 嘭嘭!
After 　　 was far away, listening to the faintly banging and roaring in the distance, the few people who had escaped from the dead were relieved, especially Ivan who was caught in somehow.
When he was pinning the three-headed dog Norway, Ivan found that his magic level was too low and its effect was limited. When the coma curse was applied, it would affect the actions of the three-headed dog at all.
If Hermione opens the door later, he might get a lunch box. After all, in such a small space, there is not even a place to hide.
This also made Ivan deeply understand his weakness. It may be easy to deal with a first-grade wizard like Malfoy, but he doesn't even have the ability to struggle in the face of real danger.
"That monster won't hit the door and run out, right?" Ron glanced at the door that hadn't stopped behind him, then complained again.
"No, this should be a special door, otherwise it would have been broken." Ivan explained.
"How could Professor Dumbledore keep such a monster in the castle?" Harry was also a little frightened. He had never thought that he would meet such a terrifying thing at Hogwarts, and he would almost be eaten by it!
Hermione reminded her angrily.
"I think you should remember that when you first entered school, Dumbledore told us that we shouldn't come here. If we didn't come out in the middle of the night in violation of school regulations, we wouldn't rush into this place in a panic!"
Maybe it was because she had just escaped from the dead, Hermione's tone was sharper than usual.
Harry and Ron knew when they heard that Hermione was going to talk about it again, and Neville almost cried.
Who would have thought that after her vent, Hermione did not intend to sue. Instead, she revealed the fact that she saw a trapdoor under the three-headed dog before, and she suspected that the three-headed dog was guarding something. Guess.
But before leaving, Hermione still warned Harry and the others that no matter what was there, it had nothing to do with them. This should be something Professor Dumbledore had to consider!
Hermione's attitude made Harry and the others unpredictable, but fortunately, Hermione would probably not tell Professor McGonagall about their violation of school rules tonight.
"I didn't expect Malfoy to be so insidious. He must have told Filch what we were in the trophy showroom!" Ron was still a bit angry when he returned to the bedroom, threatening to beat Malfoy tomorrow. .
"Ivan, I knew we should have listened to you." Harry said embarrassedly, after all, Ivan had already mentioned this possibility to them in the afternoon.
"Forget it." Ivan waved his hand and said that he didn't care. After all, he had never expected Harry and Ron to stay in the dormitory without the temptation. It was just his luck to hit him halfway. .
"By the way, Ivan, why were you in the corridor just now?" Harry asked curiously.
"I haven't come to you yet." Ivan said casually. He can't always say that he sneaked into the forbidden book zone to read in the middle of the night, right?
Harry and the others became even more ashamed, but before this emotion persisted for a few minutes, they were thrown aside by a few people, and they discussed the trapdoor guarded by the three-headed dog, guessing what was hidden inside. ...Finally, Harry told about the fact that he had taken out a package from Gringotts with Hagrid before school started.
Ivan was not involved. The challenge task just activated was enough for him to have a headache. He had no interest in interfering with Dumbledore's layout.
The only thing to be thankful for is that there is still some time before Halloween, when the monsters are infested, and he still has some time to prepare.
...
In the next week or two, Ivan worked hard to improve his strength, while the rest of the time was frantically searching for books about trolls in the library.
"Detailed Explanation of Common Magical Creatures"... "Guide to the Domestication of Dangerous Monsters"... "On the possibility of hybridization between giants and giants"...
Even the "Walk with Giant Monsters" was turned over by Ivan. U U Reading www.uukａnshu.com
Yes, the author of this book is Guidro Lockhart, who will replace Kino in the next semester to teach the Defense Against the Dark Arts class.
Although Ivan knew Lockhart was a liar who could only forget the curse, this did not hinder the authenticity and professionalism of the content of the book, which is why he could find it in the Hogwarts library.
To be honest, after seeing Lockhart’s iconic smile with white teeth on the cover, Ivan didn’t want to open it.
But who made the contents of the first few books unreliable? The "Detailed Explanation of Common Magical Creatures" only mentions that giant monsters have no medicinal value, and there is nothing delicious from the brain to the torso after being put in the pot. ...
The description of trolls in the "Guide to the Taming of Dangerous Monsters" is that wizards can usually use more powerful power to make them succumb..
Isn't this TM nonsense?
If he has the strength to defeat the trolls, what else would he do here to flip the book?
The book "On the Possibility of Hybridization between Giants and Giants" even made Ivan's eyes hot with an academic approach with both illustrations and texts.
Instead, it is a biographical method in "Walking with Giant Monsters", which gives a detailed introduction to the habits and weaknesses of the Giant Monster.
For example, trolls usually have low IQs, have a large appetite, and eat everything, so if you want to deal with it, placing bait is a more correct choice. Trolls have a high probability of eating the bait.
There is also the giant monster’s small bean-like head and huge body, which makes the overall stability weak. If you use a powerful spell to hit the giant monster’s leg, it may break the balance and knock the giant monster down. A few more steps before being eaten...
Finally, the head of the troll itself is also a weakness, much more fragile than other parts of the body. If it is hit by gravity, it is likely to go into a coma directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 23: I can still get 1 point in the skin
chapters.content:
Ivan, who finished reading the book, smashed his mouth. I don’t know which master was so unlucky. When he told his own experience, Lockhart spotted him...
can tell in such detail, it is obvious that he has been in close contact with the smelly monster.
Ivan closed the book and put it back in place. Even if he knew the weakness of the troll, he still had to make various preparations.
For example, the improvement of potions, or the learning of some more powerful magic, in short, is that his grade point is missing...
The only way to get grade points is to answer the professors' questions in each class, except for the usual class.
But Ivan soon discovered that it is not so easy to be a good student. Even answering questions needs competition these days.
Regardless of the course, as long as the professor on the stage asks a question, our know-it-all lady will always raise her hand high for the first time, and then quickly and accurately speak the answer with the professor's permission.
After 　　 Ivan joined the ranks of answering questions, the class became a battlefield for two people, and two arms raised high in each class.
And Hermione seemed to be having fun too, and she worked harder, she often stayed in the library with Ivan until the door was closed and the lights went out before returning to the bedroom.
Ivan just wanted to cry without tears, he just wanted to earn some school points, but Hermione's gain was directly reduced by more than half.
Ivan couldn't bear it, so he had to use some "special" methods.
......
"Disarming Curse and Obstacle Curse are what we will focus on next, and they will also be one of the most frequently used spells in the future..."
In the spell class, Professor Flitwick, the short fairy, is standing on a stool, spreading common magic knowledge for a group of little wizards, and flicking a magic wand to demonstrate to everyone from time to time.
has taught spell lessons for more than ten years. Professor Flitwick's teaching experience is very rich, and it will not be long before the learning emotions of the little wizards are stimulated.
"Okay, then does anyone know what the disarming spell is? What does it do?" Professor Flitwick looked at the students in the audience and asked.
Hermione took the lead in raising her arms, and at the same time she turned her head and glanced at Ivan. Hermione was still very concerned about the only threatening competitor in class.
However, Ivan stood up directly in Hermione's surprised eyes and said to Professor Flitwick.
"The spell of the disarming spell is Professor Expelliarmus (except your weapon). The effect is to deprive the opponent’s wand after hitting the opponent. At the same time, the disarming spell also has a certain impact. The knockback effect and the level of the caster and the difference between the magic power of both parties related."
Professor Flitwick, who was standing on the stool, was just about to ask Hermione a question, but he didn't expect that Ivan suddenly stood up and crackled and said a big deal. He was a little dazed for a while.
"Good point, Gryffindor adds two points."
Professor Flitwick quickly reacted, but Ivan's behavior of rushing to answer was somewhat bad, so Professor Flitwick reminded him again.
"Also, Mr. Hals, I think you'd better raise your hand before answering the question next time."
"Okay, Professor..." Ivan glanced at the rewards in the system column and sat down satisfactorily.

"Unexpectedly, I will still have a day of shooting the phoenix!" Ivan happily put his hands on Fox, using his previous experience of driving the parrot on it, and it is best to brush his goodwill to the point where he does not resist the blood.
Phoenix Fox also gradually changed from being impatient at the beginning to being indifferent, and in the end he was even willing to raise his arrogant head and let Ivan fling the feathers on his neck.
While Ivan was pushing Fox, he was also carefully looking at the phoenix in Western legends.
Unlike the phoenix that Ivan had in his previous life, Fox looks more like a large turkey with beautiful golden red feathers. Although it looks majestic, but somehow, Ivan sees it in his mind. I just wondered how it tasted...
When Ivan had a brainstorm, he might be able to fill his brain with food, and just do it when he thought of it. Ivan was thinking of deep-fried, fried, fried, grilled, fried, and various kinds of food in his mind.
. Just as Ivan was thinking of the fire-roasting phoenix, a gentle voice suddenly rang.

Ivan turned his head and looked at it. Dumbledore's tall body was walking in from the door. His over a hundred years of age did not seem to have caused any obstacles to the greatest white wizard of the century. He was still full of energy, and even more. Xingzhi joked with Ivan.
Fox, who was kicked by Ivan, hurriedly flew up, pecked Ivan's head angrily, and then flew onto Dumbledore's hat, looking at Ivan with a vigilant look.

"Professor, I am curious how do you know that I am thinking about this? Can you read my memory?" Ivan asked innocently after touching his aching head.

Ivan had a suddenly realized expression on his face, but in his heart he had already begun to spit out wildly.
I believe you a ghost! You bad old man is so bad!
Perhaps it was because the time had not expired for the previously exchanged Xueba experience card. When Dumbledore spoke for the first time, Ivan felt a force sneak into his brain until he asked, this This power disappeared without a trace.
Ivan can guess that this power is Dumbledore’s contemplation even with his toes, but I don’t know why he can perceive such silent and soul-related magic traces in the experience card state.
For some reason, Dumbledore didn’t use it after taking back the Dementia. Instead, he dragged a long blue-purple robe and sat on the principal’s chair. While motioning for Ivan to sit down, he pulled out of the drawer. Take some snacks out and put them on the table.
"Would you like some cockroach piles? Or how about the latest flavour of sizzling honey candy?" Dumbledore would pick out a little too and let Ivan taste it.
As for the infamous pile of cockroaches, Ivan didn't even touch it, but he was a little interested in Chi Honey, took out an unpacked one, and threw it into his mouth.
Teeth bite, the mouth is full of the sweetness of honey, the broken pieces of sugar seem to have self-consciousness, beating wildly in the mouth, avoiding Ivan’s teeth, a bit like the popping candy he had eaten in his previous life. It's just a bit sweeter on the bite.
Dumbledore did not rush to ask, but gave Ivan another glass of iced lemon juice, which made him look like a listener ate some sweets and poured half a cup of lemon. As the juice went down, Ivan gradually eased the anxiety of seeing Dumbledore for the first time, and began to tell what happened.
Of course, what Ivan said was not what Hermione said when she lied. After all, it was a bit too fake, let alone Dumbledore, he didn't believe it.
Furthermore, Ivan was not sure if Dumbledore would suddenly use dementia during his narration, or if he could see something on his face.

The last thing he said was that before the Halloween party, he learned from Harry that Hermione was hiding in the bathroom alone, and went looking for it with anxiety. After encountering a troll halfway, he went into the underpass to escape. It was Hermione who passively attracted him, and he stepped forward to finally kill the troll.
In order to increase the credibility, Ivan even said roughly the course of the battle.
The remaining doubts are the iron thorns that have been deformed in advance to limit the actions of the trolls, and the sleeping potion ingredients that may be detected on the trolls' corpses.
Ivan can’t explain the former. If Dumbledore asks, he can only avoid that he is practicing the transformation and reduction spells. Fortunately, Ivan started making this stuff a few days ago. Many little wizards can testify to him, so No matter how Dumbledore investigates, he can only reach this conclusion.
Ivanty didn't mention the latter, because even if he was detected, Dumbledore was not the only one suspected of, and Chino was the one most likely to be the one who was behind.
Ivan quickly calculated the doubts in his words to see if there were any omissions.
However, Dumbledore’s next reaction made Ivan seem to hit the cotton with a hard punch...

chapters.title: Chapter 29: Hero Hals
chapters.content:
The great white wizard didn’t seem to think there was anything wrong with Ivan’s words. When I heard that Ivan used the iron thorns that "happens" to carry with the Transformation Curse, he completed a Jedi Rebellion within ten seconds. After the kill, Dumbledore clapped his hands and clapped his hands, making no secret of his admiration in his expression.
"A wonderful battle! You are better than I thought. I think Severus is right. Hogwarts has an extra genius!" Dumbledore said with emotion.
A little wizard who has just entered school for only a few months can be calm and calm when facing a giant monster for the first time. He also cleverly uses what he possesses to easily defeat it. He has not seen this in decades. Excellent little wizard.
was boasted by Dumbledore for a while, but Ivan was a little uncomfortable. After all, this meant that he was being watched by Dumbledore.
The next conversation became more relaxed. There was no temptation or tit-for-tat suspicion in Ivan’s imagination. Aside from the initial contemplation, Dumbledore was kindly like a neighbor who chatted with family. The old man is average.
This makes Ivan maliciously suspect that Dumbledore is dementia?
However, in the course of the conversation, Dumbledore accidentally mentioned Ivan’s mother, Esia Hals, which made Ivan interested.
"Professor, do you know my mother?" Ivan pretended to be curious.
"Yes, when your mother went to school here, it was really impressive." Dumbledore blinked at Ivan, motioning pointedly. "No matter what aspect it is..."
Dumbledore’s half-talking behavior made Ivan very painful. He didn’t know if it was because of his lack of intelligence, or maybe it was simply a way of communicating between smart people...
But he really doesn’t understand!
Ivan had to squeeze an awkward and polite smile...
In the end, under Ivan’s side percussion, I only got the information that his mother had studied at Slytherin College. Ivan didn’t ask about his father’s affairs, because there was nothing relevant in his messy memory. Information, it’s not good if you make mistakes rashly.
Dumbledore seemed to avoid this topic deliberately. After a short chat, he smiled and said to Ivan. "Okay, kid, you can go back, I believe there will be a surprise waiting for you later."
Ivan didn't hold any hope for the surprise Dumbledore said, and the news of being able to return was enough surprise for him.
So, Ivan left here in an elegant and swift manner. Dumbledore, who was sitting in the chair, calmed Fox with one hand, and looked at Ivan's distant back, not knowing what he was thinking.
......
"Dessert souffle!"
In front of the Hogwarts lounge, Ivan shouted an order to guard the fat lady here and then nodded, letting her body reveal a circular passage.
Every time Ivan climbed, he couldn't help but complain about the designer of this passage. Something was wrong with the design, so he wanted to make a pipe.
The Gryffindor lounge at midnight was pitch black. The dark brown fireplace on the right that was always burning was extinguished at some point, and the magic lights around did not turn on. The silence was a little abnormal.
Ivan’s complexion remained unchanged and walked forward slowly, but his right hand had gradually slipped off and held the wand pinned to his waist.
嘭~
Just when Ivan walked to the middle, a fiery flame suddenly rose from the sky in the fireplace, and then the magic lights around burst out dazzling white light, and the red lion flag representing Gryffindor on the ceiling was slowly in mid-air. Unfolding, there are still a series of colorful unidentified objects slowly falling down.
The Weasley brothers in strange uniforms rushed out of the dormitory and threw a large group of festive ribbons made from torn sheets on Ivan's head, and then shouted behind him.
"Let us welcome the return of the Gryffindor heroes!"
Gryffindor's hero? Who? How dare to be so arrogant?
Ivan, who thought it was the celebration of Halloween on the big night, was immediately stunned after the Weasley brothers spoke, but before Ivan could react, dozens of lower-grade children swarmed into the entrance of the bedroom. wizard.
It was Harry and Ron in the front row. They directly joined forces to lift Ivan down, and then the Weasley brothers also smirked and threw Ivan away together...
"Cheers for the return of our Gryffindor hero!" Fred yelled.
The little lions of Gryffindor next to 　　 also booed excitedly.
"Hero Hals~"
"Troll Killer!"
...
Ivan was thrown around by everyone, and his body was almost falling apart. After a long period of trouble, the little lions whose excitement subsided put Ivan down.
Taking advantage of this time, Ivan had already understood what happened during the questioning. It turned out that after Harry and Ron returned to the dormitory, Ron, who had a big mouth, added fuel and jealousy to kill Ivan head-on. UU Reading www.uukａnshu. Com and the story of saving Hermione are told.
Because of the troll incident, the little wizards who can only spend Halloween in the lounge, how can I hear such a hot news?
Suddenly pass ten, ten pass a hundred, the more the pass, the more exaggerated, Ivan was touted as the hero of Gryffindor, as for this welcome party, of course it was organized by the Weasley brothers who like to do things.
After understanding what happened, Ivan was still a little confused. After all, Harry and Ron, who defeated the trolls in the original book, were not treated like this.
However, Ivan has forgotten that he is fundamentally different from Harry and Ron. Although the two of them succeeded in stunning the troll, they looked embarrassed afterwards, and the means to defeat the troll was really not very glorious. It's pure luck.
In the eyes of bystanders, Ivan is simply a textbook hero to save the United States, and the method of killing trolls is simple and neat.
In addition, the troll happened to fall in front of Ivan, and the death that was pierced through the head is also very legendary. After Ron's words of added fuel and jealousy, it caused such a big response!
Ivan can even see some little witches in the crowd secretly sending a look at him, and some daring ones even took the initiative to post and ask him about the details of killing the trolls.
He almost made Ivan forget that he came to Hogwarts to study...
The very energetic Gryffindor cubs kept making trouble until the middle of the night. They returned to their respective dormitories after taking into consideration that they would have classes tomorrow.
As the protagonist of the welcome party, Ivan was already exhausted and dry.
"This surprise is really big..." Ivan couldn't help but complain about the last words Dumbledore said before he left.
However, I can't help but smile at the corners of Ivan's mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 30: Unexpected letter (2 in 4000 words)
chapters.content:
"Ivan, what you did tonight is amazing!" After everyone left, Harry, who had been squeezed to the edge in the crowd just now, stepped forward and gave Ivan a big hug.
"Perhaps." Ivan shrugged, then explained. "Actually, you shouldn't be so exaggerated. I took a lot of effort to deal with the monsters."
It's not that Ivan is humble, but the news has been distorted. In one of the versions that Ivan heard, the twelve-inch tall monster even became twenty feet tall!
It's a big deal...
"Hey, come on, you are the hero of Gryffindor. We only saw you killing the trolls after saving Hermione. God, that was so fast." Ron hammered Ivan's chest. , Said with a smile.
"Besides, we just mentioned the passing, who knew it would be like this?" Harry said that they didn't say anything about it.
"Right, where's Hermione?" Ivan asked.
"I don't know, I saw it just now." Harry was also a little strange.
"You saved her. I didn't expect that she would not even thank her now." Ron said angrily.
"It should have happened temporarily." Ivan shook his head. Hermione is not such a person.
Because Hermione had taken all the punishment for her righteousness before, and the two of them had changed her, Harry and Ron also accepted Ivan's statement.
Next, Harry and Ron mysteriously took Ivan to see a package, which contained the brand new light wheel 2001, which was sent to Harry by Professor McGonagall this morning. Ivan will be in the book because of that. So I just missed it in the museum.
Even though he wasn't interested, seeing the excitement of the two men still boasted a few words out of conscience, and then hurriedly sent them to sleep.
Ivan, who was free, finally had time to look carefully at the rewards he received for killing the trolls.
【Blood Fusion Reagent (Potion Formula)
Required materials: dried nettles, epiphyllum, valerian, mussel parasitic berries, black veratrum petals, buckthorn, black bat cutin, mountain flower powder...
Special material: 150ml of active blood from Miracle Creatures (Note: If the blood leaves the body for more than three days, the activity will be greatly reduced)
Prerequisite: Potions Level 6 (Note: Potions Level 4 is required under the experience card status)]
Looking at the series of names in the demand material, Ivan felt a little dizzy. Is this too much?
And many of them are high-grade potion materials, and the price is amazing. Even if he runs the risk of being caught to Hogsmeade Village or Diagon Alley to buy, the Jin Jialong on his body is far from enough.
The preposition of the sixth level of potions makes Ivan frown, even though his potion has been upgraded to the level of three, but the higher the level, the slower the increase, and the higher the level of three, the difficulty of each level is increased. It's even harder than going from level zero to level three!
Fortunately, Ivan was relieved to see the small print at the back. At the fourth level of Potions, he would still have a chance to work hard, but he didn't expect that the refining of potions under the experience card mode would also have a bonus.
The best thing for Ivan to get is the blood of the magic creature. Despite the limitation that the activity would decrease in three days in vitro, Ivan knew that Hagrid would hatch a little dragon soon.
A grown-up dragon, Ivan can't beat him, but isn't this just born to be bullied by him?
It's easy to draw some blood or something... as long as you prepare everything else before the dragon is sent away.
咚咚...咚咚...
When Ivan was thinking a little fascinated, he faintly heard a noise from outside the window, turned his head and looked over, but it was a black-gray owl outside the window tapping the glass with his beak, and a rope tied to his leg, as if tied. Holding something.
Gula?
A word appeared in Ivan's mind. Ivan guessed that this might be the name of this owl.
Stepping forward and opening the window, the black-gray owl flew in quickly, and fell on Ivan’s shoulders and shook his body, because the entire dormitory had gone to the welcome party for Ivan before, so this poor little thing Forced to blow the night wind all night.
Ivan is no longer in the mood to care about the safety of an owl at this time, and all his attention is on the envelope hanging on its leg.
because it clearly says Ivan Halsche,
Ivan untied the rope, grabbed the envelope in his hand but didn't have the courage to open it. The expression on his face changed again and again, and finally he sighed.
He knew that there would be such a day, but he didn't expect it would come so soon.
Ivan hesitated for a while and opened the envelope. What made him feel a little relieved was that the content of the letter was very ordinary. He only asked him about his current situation at Hogwarts and which college he was assigned to. It's Irene Hals, her mother.
There are also three Jin Jialongs as a gift. There is a small note underneath, which says that he can send a letter back when he is short of money.
But the more concerned about the content of the letter, the more Ivan feels guilty and worried...
Needless to say, I am guilty. Although this crossing was not under his control, it was inexplicably replaced the other's child halfway. Of course, Ivan could not accept it with peace of mind.
Worry comes from Dumbledore’s ambiguous evaluation of his mother, and the conspicuous black magic fear curse in the system bar...
Thinking of the fear curse, Ivan was somewhat speechless. Generally speaking, a normal mother would teach the fear curse this dangerous black magic before going to school.
And the teaching process can never be cheerful and peaceful, otherwise, he would not feel the emotion of fear when he recalled before. Obviously, this mother personally let her child experience it for a quick success.
These unknowns all made Ivan feel uneasy, which made Ivan an urgent need to have at least enough strength to protect himself before going home and leaving school.
The fastest way to increase strength is to make this newly acquired blood fusion reagent. So even if Ivan felt that the three Jin Jialong in the letter were a bit hot, he finally put it away.
No way, he is so short of money now...
"Cuckoo~" The black Owl Gula who delivered the letter had been waiting for a long time to see Ivan lingering for a while, and had to tap Ivan's head with his beak as a reminder.
Ivan also woke up from his contemplation. Now the most urgent thing should be to reply to the letter. While giving the food box of his own Maca to Gula to make it a little more patient, Ignored Maca’s protest and picked it up tangledly. Quill pen.
After pondering for a long time, Ivan wrote down on a blank piece of paper that he was assigned to Gryffindor, as well as some interesting things that happened in the school recently.
Ivan originally planned to mention the troll matter, but before sending the letter, he deleted all relevant content.
Not long after enrolling, he only challenged the trolls. Ivan estimated that his mother's first reaction should be to run to school in horror to question Dumbledore, not to be proud of him.
It is better to keep a low profile, don't cause trouble...
After a period of revisions, deletions, deletions, and deletions, Ivan closed the envelope and sealed it so that the Owl Gula returned the same way.
After all this was done, the sky was a little bit brighter, and Ivan pulled the quilt and lay on the bed.
In a daze, Ivan suddenly thought of a question. The surprise Dumbledore said was referring to the welcome party or this letter?
...
The next morning, Ivan, who had only slept for less than two hours, reluctantly got up to class. They had the same experience and had been yawning, as well as Harry and Ron.
But after the three of them got up and looked at each other's thick dark circles, they couldn't help but laughed, and their spirits were also refreshed a lot.
After a whole night of fermentation, Ivan’s killing of the troll seems to have spread throughout the school, causing Ivan to hear whispers no matter where he goes.
Ivan couldn't help speeding up his pace, and the situation got better when he arrived at the metamorphosis classroom.
Hermione came earlier than the three of them, and she had already sat quietly on the right side and turned the pages of the book, and the space beside her was full.
The little witches of Gryffindor were chattering not knowing what they were discussing, and they asked Hermione from time to time. The latter looked very impatient. It was only after seeing Ivan that his face showed joy. , Put down the book and get ready to come.
"Okay, kids, I will return to my seat when I start class now!" Professor McGonagall walked in just then, frowning while watching the messy classroom.
Ivan, Harry, and Ron quickly found three empty seats and sat down, and Hermione had no choice but to sit back.
Professor McGonagall glanced at Ivan consciously, then cleared his throat, and said to the little wizards who had already sat down.
"I think I should have said at the beginning of school that Transfiguration will be one of the most complicated and dangerous magic you can learn at Hogwarts. As long as you can learn it well, Transfiguration will be enough to solve you. Most of the problems encountered."
"You should have heard that, just yesterday, Mr. Hals successfully killed a troll in the corridors of Hogwarts, relying on a superb Transfiguration spell and excellent mind!"
"For this, Professor Dumbledore added a full twenty points to Gryffindor College!" Professor McGonagall added at last.
After Professor McGonagall finished speaking, there was an uproar in the audience, and there was a burst of discussion, and Ivan suddenly became the focus of everyone.
Although many little wizards had heard of this news before, it came from Harry and Ron's mouth after all. It may not be credible, but now it's a stone hammer!
was suddenly praised by Professor McGonagall, but Ivan was not happy at all, because in his experience, there would usually be a **** after this, which is in line with the speaking process of ordinary teachers.
As expected, Ivan then heard Professor McGonagall continue.
"But... I want to warn you seriously that the troll is a very powerful and dangerous creature. It is definitely not something a little wizard who has not graduated can overcome! Hals is the only example, even teaching Professor Chino in your Defense Against the Dark Arts class was so frightened that he passed out at the Halloween party!"
After saying this, Professor McGonagall's eyes became sharp, and he continued.
"If you let me know that someone else is doing similar dangerous things, I will definitely advise Professor Dumbledore to expel him."
"And even Hals, defeating the trolls is not as easy as you think." After speaking, Professor McGonagall glanced around and noticed that the little wizards underneath were all silenced before looking at Ivan. He gave him a look and motioned him to show it.
Ivan immediately stood up knowingly, with a solemn expression and a deep voice.
"Yes, professor, I swear, the troll is definitely the most difficult opponent I have encountered in the past 11 years...no one!"
As soon as Ivan finished speaking, there was a burst of laughter from below, because many smart little wizards had heard the meaning hidden in Ivan's words.
As a first-year little wizard who is only eleven years old this year, in their opinion, the giant monster should be the first opponent Ivan encounters, and of course the most difficult one.
Professor McGonagall is very dissatisfied with Ivan's perfunctory attitude. She is more inclined to talk about Ivando's fear and fear when facing trolls, and the thrilling process, so as to give these eager children a shot.
Ivan shrugged his shoulders unceasingly, and admired Professor McGonagall’s brilliant methods First, he used his defeat of the trolls to arouse the enthusiasm of the little wizards to learn the transformation spell. The speech sets the tone for this matter and puts an end to rumors that are getting more and more exaggerated.
After all, blocking is worse than sparse. Instead of concealing this matter and letting everyone guess, it is better to use it as a model to promote the positive effect. Use expulsion as a warning to prevent some little wizards from having the idea of ​​"he can do it, and I can do it" and go further and further on the road to death.
In the end, it was to suppress his reputation, so that he would not become proud and complacent after defeating the troll.
The only poor thing is Chino, who was used by McGonagall as a backdrop for the strength of the trolls. After today, he will probably become the laughing stock of Hogwarts.
Ivan, who was far more than eleven years old in his heart, guessed Professor McGonagall’s thoughts in a short period of time.
If possible, Ivan would not mind cooperating with Professor McGonagall. After all, low-key is the kingly way. Unfortunately, there are some doubts in his process of killing trolls. The more he says, the more mistakes he makes.
Otherwise, Professor McGonagall would have to ask him again, what is he trying to deform a bunch of sharp iron thorns?
So, Professor McGonagall carefully prepared the opening remarks, and under Ivan's uncooperative attitude, only half of the expectations were achieved.
This led to the next class, Professor McGonagall solemnly reminded Ivan that if she answers questions without her consent again in class, she may consider using the Silence Charm so that Ivan can shut up for a while and give it to others. An opportunity for the little wizards to perform.
Ivan looked at his double-digit grade point and the potion that was only 731 points short of proficiency to upgrade. He could only say with difficulty that he might consider the professor’s valuable advice and play fair. , Try to raise your hands to speak.

chapters.title: Chapter 31: Bold ideas
chapters.content:
After the reminder, Professor McGonagall ignored Ivan again and officially started today's class-using the Transfiguration Curse to turn any personal item into a button.
For Ivan, whose transformation spell has been upgraded to level three, it is of course easy. Lightly swinging the magic wand will transform the quill pen on the table into a round button. The beautiful ring pattern can be seen on it, in order to add Fen Yifan has already used the Transformation Curse to its extreme.
Professor McGonagall passing by nodded in satisfaction, and gave Ivan a point reservedly.
But other little wizards don’t have such strength. They can successfully release the Transformation Curse even if they are at a very good level. They have become all kinds of strange things.
Seamo Finnigan, who was sitting not far in front of Ivan, directly exploded the ink tank used for deformation, and the jet black ink sprayed the face of the little wizard next to him.
Ivan even saw a little wizard who just secretly pulled off a button on his clothes, trying to pretend that it was made by himself. Unfortunately, Professor McGonagall was not old enough to get Alzheimer’s, so he could easily tell the difference. , The final result can only be a penalty stop at the door.
After seeing Ivan’s wonderful Transfiguration Curse, Professor McGonagall’s standard was raised a lot. Except for the buttons that Hermione used to make a ball of paper can be considered good, the rest made her really a little bit better. It's hard to accept.
Professor McGonagall clapped his hands and attracted everyone's attention.
"Everyone, stop the transformation magic in your hand. Does anyone know what is the point of releasing the transformation spell?" McGonagall said.
"Professor, the Transfiguration Curse is a kind of advanced magic, which requires the caster to imagine what it needs to be transformed in the brain.
The more similar the shape of the object to which the deformation curse is applied and the object that needs to be deformed, the closer the properties are, the easier it is to deform successfully. In addition, deforming creatures are much more difficult than deforming objects. Only a few wizards who are proficient in the transformation spell can complete the transformation of creatures..."
"Ivan Hals, I think I reminded..." Professor McGonagall had already formed a conditioned reflex, and subconsciously wanted to scold Ivan, but he turned his head and found that Ivan was regular at this time. Raised his hands and looked at the other side blankly.
"Granger? How could you?" Professor McGonagall discovered that the answer was actually Hermione Granger, who was usually regular.
At this time, Miss Know-How, even though her nervous body was trembling, she still raised her neck and said calmly.
"Professor, what I said is right?"
"Of course... and very comprehensive, but given your behavior, I can't give you extra points." Professor McGonagall stuttered in shock, and it took a long time for Hermione to sit down.
Hermione looked a little disappointed, but when she saw Ivan's sluggish expression with her hands raised, a smile came up at the corner of her mouth.
Ivan slowly put his raised hand down, his mind was full of doubts, wondering if he was in a dream now, or was this a fake Granger in front of him?
Like Ivan, Harry and Ron were the two who thought Hermione was wrong, so Ron couldn't wait to complain after the lesson.
"What's wrong with Hermione? I saw her stand up without consent in Professor McGonagall's class today. Oh my God, I think Professor McGonagall must be stunned."
Ron wanted to hear Harry and Ivan's spitting as he talked, but he didn't see any movement for a long time, and turned his head strangely to find Hermione behind him.
"H... Hermione..." Ron said in surprise.
"I just want to win back all the college points I deducted. Besides, this is not a violation of Hogwarts school rules. Professor McGonagall will understand!" Hermione glared at Ron first, then looked at Yi. Wherever there are some hesitations.
"Ivan, I heard Ron and Harry say that you only came to see me yesterday to meet the trolls. Anyway... anyway...thank you!"
"Nothing, aren't we friends?" Ivan smiled.
Even though Ivan somewhat complained about Hermione’s rash appearance and disrupted his plan when he was fighting the Troll yesterday, he also understood that more of his site selection was a mistake. Fortunately, the final result was not bad, so this The little episode Ivan didn't take it to heart.
"Hmm..." Hermione smiled and nodded, then said again. "Next I will work hard to earn back the lost credits as soon as possible!"
Ivan is a bit headache. If Hermione works hard, then he earns student points by answering questions. Isn't the plan to upgrade the potions really compromised?
"Aren't you only deducted ten points by Professor Dumbledore? You earned it back in class earlier, right?"
Ivan is very puzzled, is it so entangled? This is not much compared to the college points Hermione has earned by answering questions in the first half of the semester.
"Precisely speaking, up to now, a total of 67 college points have been added." Hermione emphasized. At this point, the little witch still stared at Ivan for a long time. if it wasn't for Ivan. Shamelessly rushing to answer in time, there could have been more.
"Then why..." Ivan wondered.
"I remember you said that you must earn it back ten times a hundred times." Hermione looked at Ivan and smiled.
Ivan was speechless, wishing to go back to strangle the nonsense self a few weeks ago.
In the next way, Ivan was trying to persuade Hermione to dispel the idea of ​​disrespecting the instructor, but unfortunately it was of little effect, and Miss Know-How, who had made up her mind, didn't seem to want to change her plan.
Finally chatting, I don't know when I was involved in learning, Ivan was surprised to find that Hermione was actually better than herself in theoretical knowledge reserves in some subjects by virtue of her extraordinary talent for memory.
Of course, this is also related to the fact that he spent half of his grade points on the training ground of the responsive house in the past few weeks in order to improve his actual combat ability.
Even so, Hermione's knowledge reserves are scary enough.
Harry and Ron were following but couldn't speak, because they didn't understand the content of Hermione and Ivan's chat.
Or they know every word, but together they don’t understand...
Is this the conversation between school masters? Harry and Ron always felt that they seemed to have a lot of things...
【Ding, after a period of study and discussion, your proficiency in basic magic theory has increased slightly. 】
Ivan, who was chatting with Hermione about the principle of the magic spell, stopped abruptly after hearing the beep in his mind, and called up the system bar to take a look. The proficiency of the basic magic theory really improved a little. point.
This made Ivan suddenly have a bold idea in his heart...

chapters.title: Chapter 32: I ran all the way over, so you just show me this?
chapters.content:
Hermione, who was about to talk to Ivan about the different uses of the Transfiguration Curse, faintly discovered that Ivan's eyes became more and more eager when she looked at her.
"Ivan, what's the matter?" Hermione pretended to be calm.
"Come with me first, and explain later!" In the shocked eyes of Harry and Ron, Ivan eagerly pulled Hermione's wrist and ran.
Hermione didn't even figure out what was going on, so Ivan was dragged forward all the way, Harry and Ron, who had recovered from the shock, also hurriedly chased up with gossip.
Along the way, because Ivan is very popular at this time, there are not a few people who recognize him. In addition, Ivan’s behavior of holding Hermione in his hand rushes all the way, which has caused many little wizards to burn with gossip. .
Big news!
After all, the fact that Ivan rescued Hermione from a battle with a monster last night has already been spread. This situation and this scene naturally made them think about it, and some young witches were disappointed. However, the curiosity was full of interest and immediately followed.
George and Fred even whistled excitedly when Ivan and Hermione passed by, giving Ivan a big thumbs up.
More and more people followed. Ivan felt a little inexplicable. Hermione was dragged by Ivan and ran all the way. Hermione noticed the gaze around her, her cheeks were full of flushing, and her head started to start. After thinking about it, I just faintly feel that this section of the road becomes more and more familiar as I look at it?
seems to be the way to the library?
Sure enough, Hermione quickly saw the library door. Ivan rarely ignored the tradition of keeping quiet, and hurriedly pressed Hermione to the rest area to sit down, and then took a copy of the book that I hadn't finished reading before. "Basic potion formula and medicinal material analysis" opened the plug into Hermione's hand, and pointed to one of them.
"Hermione, the medicinal properties of black blood plant and buckthorn are opposed to each other in the seventh chapter of this book, but why are they used at the same time when making many potions..."
"Huh...huh?" Hermione woke up from the confusion, the blush on her cheeks had not completely disappeared. Hermione, who realized that she had misunderstood, was rather embarrassed, and even wished to get into the stack of books and hide. When she found out that the book Ivan had forced herself to read before, Hermione calmed down and quickly entered the state.
"That's because the black blood plant is too strong, so it is usually added to the opposite of the medicinal properties, but the milder buckthorn has a neutralizing effect..."
After Hermione finished speaking, Ivan continued under the banner of learning to communicate, and turned to the next page for Hermione to explain. Whenever she happened to know, Ivan would also say a few more words to communicate with each other. ...
After the tired half-dead Harry, Ron, and the gossip party who came to join in the fun, they all rushed to see such a harmonious scene.
"They... actually came to study?" As a member of the gossip party, George almost thought he had some hallucinations.
My god, what is going on in this world?
Other people are also a little unacceptable, they ran all the way over, just show them this?
"I think I should go back and play Wizard Chess." Ron said blankly.
"Wood also definitely wants me to practice Quidditch now." Harry also nodded in agreement. They didn't want to waste their great time in the library.
George and the others did not give up and wanted to stay and watch the progress, but such a large group of people blocked the door and soon attracted the attention of Mrs. Pins.
"Quiet! If you want to go to the library to read, please be quiet, or go away quickly!" Mrs. Pince said impatiently.
Seeing that Mrs. Pins had plans to rush people, all the little wizards who had come to join in the excitement dispersed in disappointment, and few were willing to stay.
At this time, I was immersed in the learning improvement, and Ivan did not notice this at all, but looked at the rapid increase in proficiency in the system bar, and felt relieved.
As long as it is basic theoretical knowledge, regardless of subjects, there is almost nothing Hermione does not know. It can be said that it directly saves the step of Ivan's inquiry of other books to verify each other.
In addition, the understanding ability of the little witch is far beyond that of Ivan in a normal state, so after Hermione's interpretation, the efficiency of learning is naturally greatly improved.
Hermione's existence is like a learning accelerator. Compared with his reading efficiency when he didn't use the experience card, the increase in proficiency is more than twice as fast!
After a dozen pages, Hermione raised her head nervously to look at Ivan, for fear that she might have something wrong.
No way, after witnessing Ivan’s easy killing of trolls and that excellent transformation spell, in Hermione’s heart, Ivan was already far ahead of him, so in the process of explaining, I was always worried that there would be What's wrong.
"Well? Why did you stop?" Ivan, who was listening to Hermione's explanation, suddenly realized that she was silent, and turned her head strangely, only to find that Hermione was looking at herself nervously.
Ivan changed his mind and understood what was going on, and hurriedly said.
"You just said very well here... I happen to think so too."
"Here too, it just happens to be the same as I thought..."
"I have a different understanding here..."
......
In the next few hours, UU reading www.uukanshu.com, Ivan and Hermione spent time studying and discussing.
Thanks to the hard work of the previous half semester and the accumulation of a lot of knowledge, Ivan was able to maintain a relatively equal state in the discussion process.
Unknowingly, Ivan has already read several books that he has read before but has not fully understood, and his reading progress has been pushed all the way to 100%!
[Ding, the reading progress of "Basic Potion Formula and Medicinal Material Analysis" has reached 100%, reading reward: five academic points]
[Ding, the reading progress of "Transfiguration Curse Advanced" has reached 100%, reading rewards...]
...
The academic points gained from reading a large number of books plus the previous rewards and spell upgrades, the academic points owned by Ivan once again broke the 100 mark.
Without any hesitation, Ivan searched for a few difficult books while the iron was hot, activated the Xueba experience card, and read quickly while explaining to Hermione, which was regarded as the feedback from Hermione for helping herself.
Ivan thought that this would greatly slow down his learning efficiency in the experience card state, but he didn't expect that he just said his opinion and explained it, and Hermione immediately understood it.
Learning and memory abilities really make Ivan ashamed...
However, what Ivan didn’t know was that Hermione was also under a lot of pressure, and fine beads of sweat appeared on her forehead in a short while. She had to turn her already intelligent brain at full speed to become more profound in Ivan. During the explanation, understand the content.
This made Hermione a little frustrated after a period of discussion, thinking that she had a slight advantage in theory of knowledge. I am afraid that Ivan’s previous questions were to examine her learning progress. Now is Ivan’s true level?

chapters.title: Chapter 33: Gamble with Malfoy
chapters.content:
In a blink of an eye, the time has come to November, and the weather is getting colder.
Ivan's potion level, in the daily academic discussions with Hermione, is also close to the level four, and it is estimated that it will not take long to reach the lowest level for making blood fusion potions.
In order to avoid the dilemma of searching for memory by contemplation, Ivan took the time to sneak into the forbidden book area again, and used the academic grade points accumulated in the past few weeks to close his brain in a few nights. The technique was upgraded to the second level.
It’s just that Ivan has not had time to be happy yet, and has made difficulties for the large amount of potion materials needed to make the blood fusion potion.
He only has three golden gallons, fifteen silver sikes, and two dozen copper nats. Even if he finds an opportunity to sneak from the secret road to Hogsmeade village, I’m afraid he can’t afford it. All the materials.
And this is thanks to the letter sent by his mother, whom he has never met before. Otherwise, he doesn't even have a Jin Jialong in his hand.
"You said, is there any way to earn a lot of Jin Jialong in a month?" Ivan asked abruptly with everyone on the way to the auditorium, worrying about how to make money.
"Then how about we go grab Gringotts? Remember to add me at that time." Ron joked.
"Come on, you will be thrown into Azkaban by the goblin guarding there before you do it." Hermione rolled her eyes and said, and then even a few people popularized why Gringotts was called the whole The safest place in the wizarding world.
In addition to various strict defense systems, it is said that there is a giant dragon guarding the vault...
Harry and Ron both listened with gusto, but Ivan, who knew all the inside information, started to complain in his heart.
Come on, this safest place has just been broken into by Kino possessed by Voldemort this year, and it will be breached by you again in a few years.
Tucao return to Tucao, Gringotts defense system is still a nightmare copy for Ivan, so Ron can make such unreliable suggestions.
"By the way, Ivan, what do you want so much Jin Jialong for?" Harry suddenly asked curiously.
"Before I came to Hogwarts, I took a little from the vault. If you don't need much, I can actually borrow it from you."
said here, Harry eagerly grabbed a dozen Jin Jialong from the pocket of the wizard's robe and placed it in front of Ivan, and said that it was not enough. He also put a lot in the bedroom...
