Harry’s heroic behavior brightened Ivan’s eyes, and Ivan, who had read the original book, understood even more that the “point” of Jin Jialong that Harry said he took out of the vault might be hundreds of!
No matter how many potions are needed to make the bloodline fusion potion, these Jin Jialong are more than enough, and even said that Harry took out and put it in front of him almost enough.
Looking at Harry's sincere eyes, Ivan was a little moved, knowing that they realized that there is only half a semester, and Harry's behavior like this is definitely righteous!
Of course, this is also related to Harry's lack of money concept...
"Forget it, I'll just talk about it, no amount of Jin Jialong can be spent here." Although I can get enough Jin Jialong now, Ivan finally shook his head. He declined Harry's kindness.
In the eyes of many people, this may be stupid. You can reach your goal by reaching out. No matter how much Jin Jialong you borrow, you can return it in the future, and you don't even care if you don't even return it to Harry.
But Ivan doesn’t think so. In his opinion, accepting Harry’s kindness now means that he owes a lot of affection. This is nothing for Ivan who does not want to participate in Dumbledore’s layout too much. Good thing.
Besides, there is still some time now, and when there is no way, it will not be too late to ask Harry to borrow money.
Under Ivan's deliberately changing the subject, Harry quickly forgot about it, and the group gradually began to chat about the upcoming Quidditch match.
As the trump card that Gryffindor Academy has always hidden, Harry did not have the confidence that everyone imagined, but was very nervous.
He couldn't imagine that if Gryffindor lost the game because he couldn't catch the Snitch, how disappointed Wood would be. Gryffindor hadn't won the Quidditch trophy for a long time.
Ivan was confident enough to cheer on Harry. I am afraid that no one knows Harry’s flying talent better than him. Coupled with Harry’s own good luck, unless it’s a plot kill, Gryffindor It's hard to lose.
In view of Harry's righteousness, Ivan is even more ready to help him stare at Chino on the day of the game to avoid accidents.
The group of people came to the Hogwarts auditorium without knowing it. When Ivan was about to enjoy lunch at the long table in Gryffindor, he heard Malfoy at the next table mocking Gryffindor. The experience of being defeated by Slytherin for several years in a row.
Ron was so angry that he wanted to beat Malfoy Harry and Hermione finally stopped Ron. There was a conflict in the auditorium. There were not enough college points to deduct.
However, Ivan took the initiative to walk towards Malfoy while the three were arguing.
Slytherin table, Malfoy, who was still talking about it, saw Ivan approaching, the smile on his face turned into disgust, with a trace of fear.
After all, the news that Ivan had killed the trolls went viral in the academy some time ago. Even Professor McGonagall admitted himself that Malfoy was afraid that Ivan was coming to trouble him.
Fortunately, Malfoy soon realized that this was the Slytherin long table, and Ivan was unlikely to contradict himself here. Only then did he have some courage, and rebuked with a stern voice.
"Halse, what are you doing?"
"Nothing, I just want to make a bet with you." Ivan smiled and took out three Jin Jialong and placed them on the table.
"I bet that Harry can successfully catch the Snitch in the next game and win the game!" Ivan said.
Malfoy looked at the three Jin Jialongs on the table, and did not agree directly.
This small amount of money is nothing to Malfoy, but he still remembers the experience of being scammed by Ivan before, so Malfoy had to wonder if Ivan would have any conspiracy.
As for Harry, Gryffindor's secret weapon, it has been exposed during these days of training, at least Malfoy still knows it.
"You don't have to bet, you still want to make a fortune with the little money you have." Ivan shook his head indifferently, put Jin Jialong away and prepared to leave.
"and so on..."
Malfoy was a little confused about Ivan’s attitude, but he heard a message of interest from Ivan’s words...

chapters.title: Chapter 34: Weasley
chapters.content:
"How about we increase the bet?" Malfoy pretended to clap his hands, Crabbe and Gore behind them immediately took out their pockets knowingly, but only took out two gold gallons after touching them for a long time. Eight silver sikes.
Seeing that his two followers are so poor, Malfoy's face was a bit unbearable, and he immediately took out four Jin Jialong from the wizard's robe and patted them on the table.
"I only have three gold gallons, fifteen silver sikes, and twenty copper nats." Seeing Malfoy take the bait, Ivan took out all the money neatly from his pocket.
"It doesn't matter... these are enough, then the game is set!" Malfoy raised his eyebrows and said with a smile. He just wanted to empty out all the money in Ivan's pocket.
In case he loses, there are only four Jin Jialongs, but if he wins, **** Ivan will probably be struggling to survive for a long time.
Don’t look at Hogwarts College. After paying the tuition, boarding, lodging and studying are free, but you need to spend money to buy daily necessities, materials used in extracurricular refining potions, gifts, snacks and so on.
Malfoy is looking forward to seeing Ivan borrow money to survive.
"Okay, then it's established!" Malfoy offered to give money, of course Ivan would not refuse, one more Jin Jialong can buy a lot of materials.
As for whether I will lose?
Ivan feels that the probability is very poor. If you don’t even dare to bet on this, do you want to earn Jin Jialong quickly? It's almost the same in the dream.
Successfully pitted Malfoy, and Ivan felt very refreshed. When the game is over, he will have seven Jin Jialongs, which should be able to meet most of his needs.
"Ivan, what did you say to Malfoy just now?"
Ivan returned to the Gryffindor table when he was in a good mood. Harry and Ron immediately came up and asked curiously. The conversation between Ivan and Malfoy just now wasn't too loud, so they didn't hear much. Instead, they saw Jin Jialong which they put on the table and put them away.
"It's nothing, but Malfoy and I bet that Harry will catch the Golden Snitch in the game a few days from now and let Gryffindor win." Ivan said.
"How can you do this? Gambling is not a good thing. What if Professor McGonagall finds out?" Hermione frowned.
"Okay, who would tell Professor McGonagall if you don't say it?" Ron opened his mouth carelessly.
Listening to Ivan's words, Ron wanted to gamble with Malfoy.
Harry felt his pressure was getting more and more...
After eating, Ivan, who was about to return to the dormitory, was intercepted by the Weasley brothers who suddenly broke out halfway.
George pulled Ivan aside with a mysterious look, then he whispered after looking around to see no one.
"Ivan, we just accidentally heard a conversation between you and Malfoy."
"Just don't know if you are interested in making some money with us?" Fred and George sang together.
"Cooperate? Develop magic tricks and props?" Ivan glanced at the system bar proficiency in making magic items that hadn't been moved for a long time, and suddenly became interested.
"How do you know we have plans to develop this?" George and Fred looked at each other, Gu was a little surprised.
"Isn't it?" Ivan shrugged nonchalantly. He couldn't say that he knew their future.
"Of course not, at least we still lack the funds needed for development! If we are ready, you are welcome to join in!" Since Ivan didn't say anything, George didn't bother to ask, and Fred said directly.
"We mean to make a bet for the next game, and it will definitely make a lot of money!"
"But we lacked funds, and it was impossible to come forward as a team member, so we thought of you."
After the two had finished speaking, they looked at Ivan nervously.
"You don't want to fight a fake match, do you deliberately lose?" Ivan thought of a certain possibility.
"How is it possible? Are we such people?" Joel shouted angrily, and Fred also said angrily.
"Furthermore, we Gryffindor have lost for several years, who will buy us to win? The counterfeit match won't make money at all!"
Ivan’s words of apology were stuck in his mouth, and he thought Wood would cry if he knew what the two men thought.
And Joel and Fred are getting more excited as they talk.
"We have Harry as the trump card this time, and we will definitely be able to report a big upset. He is the best seeker I have ever seen to fly. We are set to win!"
"Yes, when the time comes, the gambling game can still increase the odds of Slytherin, and then lower the odds of Gryffindor, those Slytherins will definitely be angry and obediently pay!"
The two people talked more and more crooked ideas, and even wanted to buy Lee Jordan as the game commentator, and use words to add confusion to the opponent, although this guy was originally a fanatical Gryffindor, regardless of whether he charged money for the game. At the time, they would favor Gryffindor.
Ivan wiped the cold sweat on his head, and suddenly felt that Joel would only open a joke toy store in the future. It would be too awkward. Based on this business sense, he should go to run the regular Quidditch gambling game.
The guaranteed profit is full...
"Okay.. I agree, how much Jin Jialong is there?" Ivan pondered, UU reading www. uukanshu.com felt that there was nothing wrong with Joel and Fred's plan, and those Slytherin proud tempers were likely to be pitted in, which just happened to allow them to experience the hardships of the world in advance.
"Five Jin Jialong, this is all the money we have on hand." Joel and Fred gritted their teeth and took out all the money they had.
"Plus what I have, the principal should be enough." Ivan nodded, and then discussed the details with the two.
Ivan groaned, then said again.
"However, don't tell Jordan about the gambling game. If the matter is exposed, he may have to be punished more severely as a commentator."
"Okay, yes." Joel thought for a while and nodded cautiously.
Fred said at this moment.
"We will set up a secret magic, which will be imposed on all participants at that time. If anyone dares to breach the contract or inform the secret, they will be severely punished."
"So the contract is established?" Ivan nodded and stretched out his right wrist.
"Well, the contract is established!" The Weasley brothers also made the same action, and then Joel waved their wands, and there was an extra mark on the wrists of the three of them.
Ivan glanced at the system bar, and found that there was indeed one more state there. The effect was that his tongue became five times larger after violating the contract, lasting for a full week.
Although it is not a particularly serious consequence, it should be enough to deter the minor wizards.
In fact, judging by the proud temperament of the little wizards of Slytherin College, as long as they win the bet head-on, they will probably not choose to inform them even if they are angry.
Thinking of this, the corners of Ivan's mouth whispered. In this case, the Jin Jialong needed to buy the potion should be enough.

chapters.title: Chapter 35: Sad Chino
chapters.content:
With this plan, the Weasley brothers drew up hatred, dangling around the Slytherin long table every day, and threatened that the Gryffindor team had a brand-new tactic, which could easily blow up. Their old rival Slytherin.
also quietly let out the wind. Ivan, known as the hero of Gryffindor, recently made a bet. If Gryffindor wins, it loses one out of ten. If Slytherin wins, make more money from the investment.
The little wizards of Slytherin jumped in anger when they learned about it. Doesn't that mean that Slytherin was defeated?
As the most tyrant academy in Hogwarts, it is naturally not bad for money. Ivan quickly received several Jin Jialong, but more of them were Silver Sicco and Copper Nat.
After all, this bet is just for fun, and the participants are all little wizards, so the general bet is only a few copper nats or a silver cic...
Even so, Ivan has already received a lot of bets in the past few days. Coupled with the occasional betting by students from other colleges, their principal is no longer enough to pay.
If you lose, it will be over...
In view of this, Joel and Fred also became nervous, and suddenly felt that they had to do something to save the unfavorable situation.
For example... Give Harry some more training!
The amount of training that Harry, who has been so utterly innocent, has been training again...more!
Fortunately, these tragic days did not last long, and the Quidditch game had already begun.
"Harry, come on, you must catch the Snitch!" Backstage, Joel stared at Harry solemnly and said tragically, as if this Quidditch match was related to the survival of the world.
"Yeah, otherwise we will have to eat the dirt..." Fred also nodded in agreement.
Fred's words left Harry confused. In fact, more than one person had said this in front of him these days.
At the beginning, Harry still felt a heavy sense of responsibility, thinking it was the encouragement of his seniors, but Harry soon discovered Slytherin... Ravenclaw... even Hufflepuff. From time to time, the students in, said some inexplicable words to him.
This made Harry very depressed, but he couldn't find anything wrong.
Captain Wood, after giving an inspiring speech, watched Harry, who was a little absent-minded, reminded him.
"Don't be distracted by Harry, the game is about to begin."
"En..." Harry relieved his nervousness and nodded.
At this time the gate of the arena also opened, and the Gryffindor players rode out together on broomsticks, and Harry followed behind.
Passing through the slightly dark backstage, a wide circular arena appeared in front of Harry. The seats that were usually empty were already full, and Gryffindor's seats came after they came out. There were bursts of cheers.
Ron and Neville are holding a huge banner transformed from a torn sheet, on which Hermione has cast a spell, flashing "Potter must win" in mid-air.
Harry was moved, but it was strange that he did not see Ivan there. After looking around, Harry successfully found Ivan in the stands near Slytherin, and he was sitting right there. Beside Professor Chino.
Harry was wondering why Ivan was sitting here, and then he saw Ivan smile at himself and pointed the wand in his right hand at the sky.
After a while, a pyrotechnic beam shot into the sky and exploded at a height of tens of meters. The faint spots of light converged into the words "Gryffindor must win, Harry Potter!"
Harry immediately felt warm in his heart, and instead of thinking about the problem just now, he focused his attention on the upcoming game.
Ivan's side, after using magic to cheer Harry up, Ivan began today's mission... staring at Kino.
In fact, if it wasn't for the victory or loss of this Quidditch match that was directly related to whether he became rich overnight or went bankrupt instantly, Ivan would not even intend to have anything to do with Chino this semester.
After all, during this time period, apart from the mysterious Dumbledore who may have noticed, Ivan can be said to be the only person who knows that Voldemort lives on the back of Kino's head.
In the first grade, I will be indirectly exposed to the existence of this ultimate boss, Ivan is still very guilty.
Fortunately, Ivan doesn't need to really do anything, just sit next to him and pay attention to Chino occasionally. Ivan doesn't believe that Kino dares to chant a spell while being stared at by him.
"What are you doing looking at me like this?" Ivan's gaze from time to time made Kino who was sitting curled up in the corner very uncomfortable, as if all his secrets had been seen.
Ivan also realized that staring at Chino straightforwardly at every turn is easy to be suspected, and instead pretended to be curious, and chatted with Chino awkwardly.
"Professor Chino, I heard that you once met a vampire in the Romanian jungle. Is that true?"
"Ah... yeah, there is such a thing, I finally got rid of it..." Chino only agreed.
"Really? Then teach you how to defeat the surviving zombies in Africa..."
"I also heard that the professor was shocked and fainted when reporting the troll news at the Halloween party..."
"and also..."
For the first time indirectly chatting with the Dark Lord, Ivan's heart was still very nervous, and he didn't even know what to talk about. Would it be too deliberate to talk about learning things in this cheerful atmosphere?
Ivan had to pick some lighter topics first...for example, some interesting things that happened recently.
"Enough!" Chino couldn't help but interrupted aloud. Originally, with Chino's good temper, he would not easily get angry, but Ivan never chatted at all. Every time he asked The black history I want to forget...
Especially for Halloween, as long as you think of Chino, you will get angry. Originally, he pretended to be dizzy at the Halloween venue to remove the suspicion of releasing trolls. It was a manifestation of his high-end acting skills and was highly praised by the Dark Lord. ..
But who would have thought that a giant monster was easily killed by a first-year kid like Ivan. In addition, Professor McGonagall, who had fallen into trouble, used him as a background board to set off the power of the giant monster and put him in the Halloween venue. The fainting incident spread throughout the school.
Caused his Chino to become the laughing stock of the whole school overnight, and every time he was in class, he could hear a lot of discussions underneath that his identity as a professor of defense against the Dark Arts was traded with Dumbledore PY.
The most important thing is that he still dare not explain, no matter how hard or tired, he can only hold it silently in his heart...

chapters.title: Chapter 36: I have added too much to the college... I have done much for the college, I want to see Deng...
chapters.content:
Qi returned to his anger. As a ethical undercover, Chino quickly adjusted after discovering that he had lost his temper, looking for a reason in a low tone.
"Sorry... I'm too tired now, I want to sleep for a while..." After speaking, Kino pulled up the hood on his back to cover his head, and went to sleep with his eyes closed in a strange posture of leaning forward.
"Okay." Ivan shut up decisively, not provoking Chino, anyway, his goal has been achieved.
He dared to tease Chino because he knew that Chino could not do anything to him for this little contradiction. In the original book, the Weasley brothers took a snowball and smashed the back of his head. There was Voldemort’s snake. Where the face is.
Kino didn't even hit Voldemort's face so straightforwardly, which shows that they are the first in their minds to get the Sorcerer's Stone, and everything else can be endured.
As for after the fall?
Save it. At that time, Chino had no ash left, and Voldemort who had fled could not care about his little role.
Seeing that Chino was really closing his eyes and intending to sleep, Ivan also turned his attention to the arena. At this time, the game had entered a white-hot game, and all kinds of small movements continued.
A Slytherin batter pretended to score a goal but hit the ghost fly ball towards George not far away with a stick. Fortunately, George temporarily reacted in time and escaped the ball dangerously and dangerously.
"Slytherin, this is a foul...this is a foul!" Jordan Lee, who is in charge of the commentary, is also worthy of being a senior Gryffindorist. He yelled at Slytherin's foul, and his words were sharp and audible. Professor McGonagall frowned again and again.
George on the field was not to be outdone. He joined Fred on the batter who flanked Slytherin from both sides and almost made him hit the railing...
But Jordan treats the actions of the Weasley brothers as if he hadn’t seen them, and admires their flying skills from time to time.
Such a double standard naturally caused the dissatisfaction of the little Slytherin wizards, especially those who participated in the gambling game. If it weren't for the professors watching at the scene, the black magic on the full screen would have been on the stage long ago. Up.
Even so, there are still many Slytherin students who are close to throw the debris in their hands towards Jordan.
"It's not fair to explain the interference in the arena!"
"Shady...this is shady!"
"We ask for a different explanation, or else we will compare it!"
...
Jordan was on the stage while dodge the cans, waste paper, and underwear flying around, while continuing his own explanation, until Professor McGonagall couldn't stand it, he asked the two students to pull Jordan away and replace it with Hufflepuff College. Cedric came as an interim commentary.
Jordan clung to the railing on the platform, but in the end he lost to the strength of the two and was dragged along. From a distance, he could hear Jordan's unyielding cry.
"I have done too much for the Academy... I have done much for the Academy... I am innocent! I want to see Professor Dumbledore!"
Professor McGonagall raised his hand as a silent spell, and the world was finally quiet...
Ivan, who is not too far away, looked at Jordan, who seemed to be possessed by a genius, and twitched the corners of his mouth, but he was not worried about what would happen to Jordan.
Because they secretly engaged in gambling, Jordan didn't know that, relying entirely on his own blood, he forcibly beat Slytherin.
This episode did not involve too much energy from Ivan, because the success or failure of this game still depends on whether Harry can catch the Snitch.
And Harry was also very powerful. He galloped over almost the moment he spotted the Slytherin, and threw off the two Slytherin pilots who were trying to stop him, and reached out to catch the Golden Snitch.
At this moment, the broom under Harry suddenly shook violently, as if he was trying to throw him from the air. Harry had to grab the broom desperately to prevent himself from being shaken. .
The sudden change caused an uproar in the audience, and the Weasley brothers even doubted whether any Slytherin student didn't want to lose the game, so they deliberately cast a spell on the arena.
The two eagerly looked at Ivan off the court. In the previous agreement, Ivan would handle everything off the court.
Ivan was also a little stunned at this time. He quickly turned his head and looked at Chino, who was curling up in the corner and did not move at all. He seemed to have fallen asleep, but Ivan with sharp eyes could faintly see the mouth under the hood. One in one.
Silent casting...Wandless casting...
Ivan's expression was stunned, and he didn't expect that Kino would really dare to make small moves under his nose, and still use such high-end skills.
Although the release may not be high-end magic, with this hand, Kino's strength is definitely not as simple as that shown in the original book. It is more than enough to serve as a professor of defense against the dark magic. As for whether he has the help of the Dark Lord Ivan doesn’t know the power of it.
After raising Chino's evaluation of strength in his heart, Ivan was a little bit confused. What reason should I use to "wake up" Chino who was "sleeping".
Isn’t it better than acting? Who is afraid of whom?
Ivan gritted his teeth and put on an anxious expression on his face, pressing his hands on Chino’s thighs and shaking them wildlyProfessor Chino, look, Harry’s broom seems to be a problem. It's almost falling from the sky, you quickly think of a way to save him! "
Under Ivan's vigorous shaking, the hood on Kino's head was directly shaken, revealing a stunned face and a big mouth that had not been closed.
"Unfortunately, Professor, you didn't see it. It was really thrilling just now!" After seeing Harry regaining control of the broom, Ivan quickly removed his hands from Chino's lap, his face covered. A look of fear.
......
On the stands, there were many people who cared about Harry as much as Ivan. Among them, Malfoy stood up from his seat with excitement, looking forward to when Harry would fall from the sky.
In this case, the **** Ivan would have to hand over all his savings and live the hardships of the first half semester with difficulty.
Malfoy can only think of this way of revenge when he thinks he is not an opponent...
Not to mention that he heard that Ivan made a gambling game to make money and he might be in debt... Just as Malfoy got more and more excited, Harry's broom suddenly calmed down again.
Malfoy had to sit back again disappointed.
"Draco, look, Potter, he really fell!" Gore yelled, pointing to the sky, but Harry was accidentally hit by a Slytherin Seeker while catching the Slytherin. Come down.
Malfoy stood up from his seat again excitedly, and relived his previous thoughts in a short moment.
Until Harry spit out a golden ball from his mouth with difficulty and held it high in his hand, the excited Malfoy sat back again.
Because that's the Golden Snitch...

chapters.title: Chapter 37: Live spot map
chapters.content:
After the game was over, George and Fred didn't even attend the celebration. They couldn't wait to find Ivan, and the three gathered quietly in an empty classroom.
Ivan also piled up fifteen gold gallons from this harvest, as well as a large amount of silver sike and copper nat on the table.
According to the previously negotiated share agreement, Ivan took 40% of it, a total of six gold gallons, nineteen silver sikes, twenty-eight copper nats, and the rest belonged to the Weasley brothers.
Ivan’s gains actually include those who bet against Malfoy...
"So much?" George looked at the money on the table and said excitedly.
Don't think they could take out five gold gallons before, but it was the two of them that have survived these years, but like now, they can easily make so much.
"If we could come once a year, wouldn't we have made a fortune?" Fred imagined.
"Forget it, it's not very good to do this kind of thing, one time is enough, and after all, the secrecy curse is not really 100% secrecy. If this continues, some day problems will arise." Yifan shakes After shaking, the two people's unrealistic thoughts were dispelled.
George and Fred glanced at each other, the smiles on their faces faded a lot, and they nodded cautiously.
"Of course, we don't want to be caught. This money should be enough for us to develop in advance. Later, we can earn money by selling our joke toy products!"
"We discussed it and decided to hire you as our special adviser?" Speaking of the joke toy, Fred resumed his grinning appearance, and the original slightly serious atmosphere was suddenly wiped out.
"No problem, as long as I have time." Ivan agreed without thinking too much. After all, there is still a magic item in the system bar that hasn't moved. Maybe he can be a little proficient with the Weasley brothers. Degree or something.
"We also need to buy the corresponding supplies a little bit. Before that, we have prepared a gift for you." George magically drew a rectangle from his sleeve, folded parchment a bit like an envelope, and handed it to Ivan.
"You can guess how this works." Fred smiled.
Ivan naturally recognized that this was a live map at a glance. With a hint of excitement, he took the parchment and spread it out flat. There was nothing on the yellowish parchment.
Ivan didn't feel surprised, and raised his hand against the tip of the magic wand, and said solemnly.
"I solemnly swear that I did nothing good!"
The delicate ink lines suddenly spread from the top of Ivan’s wand, spreading like a spider web line, connecting and spreading to every corner of the parchment, and then green squiggles appeared on the top:
Moon face, Wormtail, Bigfoot and Prongs...
gentlemen who provide help for magical prankmakers,
Introducing...
Live the map!
The moment Ivan got the live spot map, his eyes swept to the vivid names on the map.
Harry, Ron, and Hermione’s names are in Gryffindor’s lounge. Ivan guessed they were celebrating Quidditch’s victory. Ivan tried to find it again, and he saw Peter Pettigrew not far away. name.
Ivan has always been very strange in his previous life. The Weasley brothers, who hold the map of the survival point in his hand, have not discovered why a guy named Peter Pettigrew is following their younger brother for several semesters.
Now Ivan realized that after getting the map of the live spot, this map is not omnipotent.
Or maybe the parchment is too small, and Hogwarts is too huge, it can only roughly distinguish the approximate area where everyone is located, plus thousands of names of students and professors are mixed together, dormitories and lounges are even more names. Where there is a little dwarf, Peter is not conspicuous at all.
Ivan immediately found Chino's position, wanting to see if the words Tom Marvolo Riddle appeared next to him.
Soon, Ivan found Chino in the professor's office, but unfortunately there is only his name on it, and I don’t know if it’s because Voldemort is not a living person now.
Ivan was thinking, but the Weasley brothers were shocked by Ivan's proficient operation techniques. When they first got the live spot map, it took a long time to successfully crack it.
"Ivan, have you used something similar before?" George asked.
Ivan shook his head and explained.
"No, it just happens to have some understanding of the creators of the live spot map."
"By the way, how could you give me such a precious thing." Ivan curiously asked. The importance of the map to the Weasley brothers who are keen on doing things in school is self-evident.
It can be said that with this thing, the Weasley brothers do not have to worry about being caught in the school for anything. UU reading www. uukanshu.cOM
The smile on George's face narrowed slightly, looking at Jin Jialong on the table.
" Fred and I don't know what you want so much money for, but we guess you won't stay in school honestly after you get the money.
We have written down all the contents of the 　　huodian map. It is in your hands and more useful than ours! "
"Yes, we don't want any accidents with the special counselor we just found." Fred patted Ivan on the shoulder.
"Thank you," Ivan was a little touched in his heart, but did not say any more words of thanks, but silently remembered it in his heart.
If he is able in the future, he will try to rewrite the result of Fred's death, after all, the two brothers are still quite interesting.
"By the way, have you been to Hogsmeade Village?" Ivan put away the map of the spot and asked aloud.
"Of course, you were going to go there." Fred hesitated. He and George had actually hesitated before handing over the map to Ivan. They were worried that he would slip out of Hogwarts and then go. Some dangerous places.
I didn't expect that Ivan just wanted to go to Hogsmeade Village, it was relatively safe there.
The two did not conceal it, and they told all the information about Hogsmeade Village that they knew.
Holding a live spot map, George and Fred naturally also sneaked out, but they didn't go out for a long time each time, and they knew very little about it.
After talking about some interesting incidents that happened between the two of them in Hogsmeade Village, George hesitated for a moment and said to Ivan solemnly.
"Although you are the hero of our Gryffindor and killed the troll again, I still want to remind you, be careful, the wizards outside are not as stupid as the trolls!"

chapters.title: Chapter 38: Infiltrate Hogsmeade Village
chapters.content:
Saying goodbye to the Weasley brothers, Ivan returned to the Gryffindor lounge alone.
On the way, Ivan also found that there was an additional piece of information about the live spot map in the magic items in the system bar.
[Magic Item: Living Point Map
Magic: Strong
Description: This is a map that records Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. It can show all the living people in this school of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Unless some special methods are used, no one can escape its detection. 】
The powerful magic power made Ivan very surprised, but after thinking that the map of the live spot could even monitor Dumbledore's whereabouts, Ivan took it for granted.
I don’t know how James Potter, Sirius and Lupin made such powerful magic items more than ten years ago.
Peter, the dwarf star close at hand, may also know something,
Ivan, who has a live spot map, actually has the ability to report on Peter Pettigrew, but Ivan is not prepared to do so.
First, Sirius came because he saw the spots in the newspaper, but his suspicions had not been cleared before, and he didn't want to face Dumbledore again in a short time.
After 　　 had a live spot map in his hand, Ivan became more sure of his plan to sneak out to buy the necessary potions. All he needed was a free time.
In the Gryffindor lounge at this time, Harry, Ron, and Hermione gathered around the burning stove, but the expressions on everyone's faces were not as relaxed and happy as Ivan thought.
"Hey, Ivan, where did you go?" Seeing Ivan coming in from outside, Ron immediately pulled Ivan over.
"You have to ask your two brothers." Ivan answered briefly, and then changed the subject. "Are you here to celebrate Harry's capture of the Snitch?"
"Come on, we were discussing why my broom suddenly lost control during the game." Harry shook his head.
"Snape must have done it!" Ron said angrily.
"Yes, I saw Professor Snape doing bad things with my own eyes before, and that happened to be when Harry's broom had a problem. When Harry's broom returned to normal, Snape shut up." Hermione didn't have it this time. Standing on Snape's side, after all, this was what she saw with her own eyes, and Harry was one of her best friends.
Since Ivan “handled” the problem in time this time, Harry was already safe before Hermione had started to act, so there was no fire in the stands.
Ivan listened to the three of them talking about the possibility of Snape murdering Harry, and after thinking about it, he retorted.
"Harry, it was Professor Chino who caused your broom problem. I sat next to him before and interrupted his spelling."
Ivan briefly explained what he found Kino pretending to be sleeping and casting a spell, but Harry couldn't believe it.
"Professor Chino? How is this possible?"
"Then Hermione...why did you see Snape also chanting a spell." Ron refused.
"Obviously one of them will recite the anti-curse again to save you. If Chino is saving you, then he doesn't have to hide like this at all!" Ivan explained to them.
"Perhaps Professor Chino is afraid of Snape's revenge!" Harry said stumblingly.
Actually, after Ivan said this, Harry had already believed a little bit, but in his heart, Harry could not accept the possibility of Snape saving him.
Ron and Hermione were also skeptical. Every time Snape was in class, Snape's eyes and behavior were clearly that he wanted Harry to die!
Ivan sighed and didn't make much excuses for Snape. After all, the entanglement in it was too complicated, and it would be better for the person involved to talk about it in person.
I can only say that Snape caused too much hatred in Gryffindor...
"Anyway, you should stay away from them this semester." Ivan could only remind in the end.
"But I'm far away from them! But some of them are ready to kill me!" Harry said angrily. Since entering Hogwarts, he has been targeted by Snape, and now Chino also has He might be murdered, and Harry didn't understand why so many people wanted to deal with him.
Everyone was relieved, and Harry gradually calmed down, and then several people told Ivan the information they had obtained from Hagrid after the game, and Hermione finally concluded it.
"So, there must be someone between Snape and Chino who wants to sneak through the trapdoor guarded by the three-headed dog and find what Dumbledore is hiding inside."
"By the way, Ivan, do you know Nicol LeMay?" Hermione suddenly thought of a question they hadn't understood this afternoon.
Ivan hesitated for a moment, not knowing that because they shouldn't be told about the Philosopher's Stone at this time, Ivan finally shook his head.
Firstly, during the time he was making potions, the more stable the better, secondly, rashly destroying Dumbledore’s savior development plan may lead to very serious consequences. Ivan doesn’t want to Was interviewed for the second time.
Don't think his Occlumency has been improved to the second level, but facing Dumbledore's contemplation is still far from enough.
As for Kino, will he get the Sorcerer's Stone after this time difference? Ivan is not worried,
Because Dumbledore, the old slicker, hasn't put the Eris Mirror in yet, it will not be put in until Dumbledore is sure that Harry can pass the test of the Eris Mirror.
Now Kino finds the Sorcerer's Stone, hell...
Seeing Ivan, I don’t know who Nicol LeMay is. Hermione, Harry and others are a little disappointed, but they soon began to discuss the speculation.
Ivan is not interested in the Philosopher’s Stone he can’t get. He now only matters if Hagrid’s dragon egg is cooked.. ah no, whether it has hatched....
But from the perspective of time, maybe I haven't got it yet. Ivan decided to prepare the potion materials first during this period of time.
Two days later, Ivan quickly found an opportunity. After a boring lesson on Defense Against the Dark Arts, the whole afternoon was a pleasant break.
This time is enough for him to visit Hogsmeade...
After repeatedly confirming that there was no one beside the secret road leading to Hogsmeade Village on the map of the live spot, Ivan tapped the statue of the one-eyed witch with a magic wand, and whispered "Left and right separation".
There was a slight sound, and the hunchback of the statue separated from the main body, revealing an irregular passageway. Ivan waved his wand and used the light curse to sneak into the short and narrow secret passage.

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Sorry, I don’t sell ecstasy to the little wizard here
chapters.content:
After a long walk, when Ivan reached the end and opened the trap door, he found himself in a cellar full of cardboard boxes.
Ivan knew that this should be the Honey Duke Candy Shop in Hogsmeade Village.
squeak...
Ivan carefully pushed open the door of the cellar, but he didn't see the overcrowded scene he imagined, and the spacious storefront was a bit empty.
is also right, it is not Christmas, nor the weekend, those little wizards above the third grade don't have much time to come here, Ivan thinks so.
Due to lack of cover, Ivan was caught before the plan of slipping away quietly could be implemented.
"Hey... boy over there, when did you come in?" The boss of the Honey Duke is a kind wizard, always wearing loose robes, but when he saw Ivan wandering around his cellar, he immediately Scolded.
"Just now, maybe you didn't see it?" Ivan didn't panic, but joked very casually.
Ivan's casual attitude made the boss of Honey Duke dispel his idea of ​​stealing candy, his tone became much better, and he ridiculed.
"You should have sneaked out of Hogwarts, right? The little ghosts in the third grade are not as short as you. No wonder I didn't see you just now."
Ivan’s mouth twitched, regretting that he hadn’t learned a forbidden spell, he was already considered advanced in the first grade, okay?
Ivan took out a silver crinkle from his pocket depressed and put it on the table.
"So, don't you plan to sell me candy?"
"Of course," the boss of Honey Duke collected Yinxi Ke at a speed that Ivan could not see clearly, and backhanded out a lot of snacks from the cabinet and introduced them one by one.
"What are you going to buy? Bibi bee candy? Chocolate frog? Bibidou beans? How about some cockroach pile? That is your principal's favorite."
bought some like Ivan, and curiously plucked up the courage to try Dumbledore’s favorites. I have to say that the cockroach pile looks really disgusting, and it looks like a large cockroach.
Ivan carefully broke off his legs, endured the nausea, and tasted it, only to realize that it was sweet, obviously made with syrup, but it was a bit crispy on the bite, as if he was really chewing on bugs.
"By the way, do you know where there are potions in Hogsmeade Village?" Ivan took a few more bites of chocolate frogs and bibido beans before pretending to ask casually.
"There is only one potion shop in Hogsmeade." The boss of Honey Duke suddenly became serious, and looked around.
Ivan was playing drums in his heart, and when he was thinking about whether he had said something wrong, he saw the boss leaned down and lowered the volume.
"If you want to buy ecstasy, you'd better go to Diagon Alley. Recently, the investigation here is very strict. Old Rick doesn't sell those contraband."
fascination agent? Ivan rolled his eyes. What did he do to buy that thing?
He is only eleven years old this year, can he be motivated and powerless?
Ignoring the wretched smile on the boss of the Honey Duke when he left, Ivan turned all the way into the alley, only to see a half-downed sign on which the word potion could be seen faintly, and it was full of weird and unpleasant smells. The smell of potion.
Ivan covered his nose and entered it. He didn't see the boss here. He could only faintly see green smoke and gas floating out of the room at the end.
Just as Ivan was about to say something to attract the other's attention, he heard a voice coming out of the room.
"The basic potion materials are placed at the door, and the compound decoction and booster are in the cabinet next to it... In addition, the combination of ecstasy and vitality tonic is temporarily not sold to the little wizard who has not graduated! No amount of money!"
Ivan is already too lazy to complain about ecstasy. How many little wizards have come here to ask before answering so skillfully.
Ivan consciously walked towards the place where the potion material was placed,
Fortunately, his potions have been successfully upgraded to level four these days, and the materials needed to configure the blood fusion potions are quickly sorted out.
It is inevitable that someone can guess the formula of the potion based on the materials he selected. Ivan also selected some unnecessary herbs, and made some adjustments in the quantity.
After Ivan was selected, the old Rick wearing a patch coat opened the door, and there was a faint smell of potion on his body, which was what Ivan had smelled at the entrance of the store before.
"What do you buy so many materials for?" Old Rick thought that Ivan was here to buy the enhancer, but he did not expect to pick a lot of materials.
"You have money.. Practice your hands." Ivan took out nine Jin Jialong and put them on the table.
Old Rick stopped talking for an instant, and quietly collected the money, and then took out twelve silver Xi Ke and handed it to Ivan.
"Where are the Fugu grass and hemolytic grass?" Yifan took the remaining Yinxike and asked aloud.
Old Rick's face changed, he leaned down, his bloodshot eyes fixedly looked at Ivan, and it took a while to speak to Ivan.
"I don't know what weird formulas you found in the Hogwarts library, but I advise you not to try it at will. Both the Boneweed and the Hemolysing Weed are prohibited materials. Only a few high-level potions can be used. Will use it. UU reading www.uukanshu.com"
"What if I double Jin Jialong?" Ivan asked.
"One ounce of Pseudomonas, three golden gallons... One ounce of hemolysin, two golden gallons, seven silver sike..." Old Rick's eyes were full of sarcasm.
"After doubling?" Ivan frowned.
"No, before that..." Old Rick smiled.
Why don’t you grab it? Ivan almost blurted out, knowing that in Diagon Alley, one ounce of dragon liver guessed seventeen silver Sicos, and the price of dragon blood is estimated to be similar.
Even if there is dragon farming, the price has plummeted, but it is the top material after all.
Why is a Pseudomonas and Hemolysin so expensive?
"I said, that is a contraband, and every time it is sold, there must be a corresponding record. Nowhere will it be sold to a little wizard like you." Old Rick could see that the little wizard in front of him did not have so many gold pluses. Long, there was a lack of interest at once, but he still reminded him.
"And even if you pay, I can't give it to you now, it will take a while."
Ivan sighed, and dispelled the idea of ​​obtaining Pseudomonas and Hemolysin by purchasing.
I had made a lot of money from gambling games before, plus what I had originally in my hand, the total was only eleven gold gallons, and I wanted to buy all the materials.
Ivan also considered whether to use Floo powder to send it to Diagon Alley to confirm the price, so as not to be pitted by Old Rick.
But Diagon Alley is much more dangerous than Hogsmeade Village,
At any rate, there are often third-grade little wizards wandering here alone, so both the Ministry of Magic and Hogwarts College have strict supervision here, and the safety is self-evident. This is why Ivan dares to come here alone. the reason.

chapters.title: Chapter 40: Christmas
chapters.content:
In Diagon Alley or Knock Down Alley, unless the compound decoction is brewed or the strength is improved, Ivan is not going to go.
Going there alone is too dangerous for a first-grade little wizard.
Ivan turned around and left. Before leaving, he bought a bottle of deodorant that eliminates the smell of his body. After throwing twelve silver sikes to the old Rick, Ivan left here without nostalgia.
He knew that there must be a place where there must be a boneweed and hemolysin, and that is in Snape's potion storage room...
Although there is a big risk in doing this, Ivan has no other way now.
returned along the same path. Fortunately, the boss of the Honey Duke was entertaining the guests, and Ivan was able to pass through the cellar smoothly.
Coming out of the secret secret tunnel, Ivan went to the responsive house for the first time.
"I want a place to refine potions." Ivan said.
In the next moment, Ivan opened the door of the House of Requests, and he has come to an unfamiliar space, surrounded by many bottles and pots, and a lot of equipment for making potions.
The only thing Ivan felt sorry for was that the cabinets and bottles used to store potions were empty, not even the most basic herbs.
"There is a room for all requests, and sure enough, there are restrictions." Ivan said disappointed, originally he wanted to try if he could prostitute some potion materials for nothing.
Ivan found a cabinet and stored all the purchased materials in it, so that he can take it directly when making potions later, leaving only the deodorant that can eliminate his own odor.
After doing all this, Ivan turned and left without nostalgia. On the way, sharp-eyed Ivan also happened to see the sneaky Chino wandering on the fourth floor.
Ivan's heart moved, and he took out the map to confirm the location of Snape and the other professors and principals. A plan suddenly appeared in Ivan's mind.
......
In the next few weeks, Ivan watched Snape's movements on the Live Point map and occasionally looked at Chino's. Unknowingly, the time had come to Christmas.
As December entered, the weather became more and more cold, and a few days before Christmas, there was a heavy snowfall of goose feathers. When Ivan woke up in the morning, he found that the outside was covered with a thick layer of snow. Harry and Ron even shivered with cold, and had to add a few more sweaters to the large wizard robe.
Ivan took the two of them to the fireplace in the lounge to cook a fire, and used the Transfiguration Curse to create transparent windshields to block the ventilation openings, so that the whole lounge could be warmer.
But this has suffered the owls who delivered letters. Several of them directly hit the side windshield. A large number of envelopes were scattered all over the floor. Ivan went to the window and removed the windshield.
Outside the window, poor Chino was being hit by a bunch of magical snowballs. Ivan even saw one of the snowballs that looked very solid and hit the back of Chino's head very accurately. Ivan couldn't help but Sweat for the Weasley brothers.
It is estimated that these two guys dare to spoof Chino this way, I don’t know if this is the pinnacle of their lives...
In the afternoon, Ivan and Harry and the others finished the last potions class. The whole Hogwarts was boiling, because tomorrow is their long-awaited holiday, and more importantly, they can finally Go home!
However, Ivan is not happy at all, because he doesn't want to go back at all. At least it is safer to stay in school until he can figure out his memory.
So when Professor McGonagall came to register the student list, Ivan did not hesitate to sign it, and Harry did the same.
"Ivan, are you not going to go back?" Harry asked strangely.
"Well, how can I feel at home in school at home." Ivan replied with a smile.
Harry seemed to have found sympathy with Ivan. He even wanted to stay at Hogwarts forever instead of returning to his so-called uncle's house.
What makes Harry even more happy is that the Ron and Weasley brothers will also stay, because their parents are going to Romania to visit Charlie this year.
The only pity that Harry felt was that Hermione had to go home, otherwise this Christmas would be perfect...
Ivan, Harry, and Ron were blocked by Malfoy on the way back after signing the agreement to stay in school.
"Huh? Look what I found? A few kids who no one wants to stay in school," Malfoy yelled at Harry exaggeratedly, then turned to Ron.
"And Weasley, your mother must think that she gave birth to too much so she doesn't want you..."
"Malfoy!" Ron rushed up angrily with a punch. Malfoy drew out his wand and wanted to cast a counterattack. His two followers, Bancrab and Gore, also surrounded him.
Faster than them, Ivan took Malfoy’s wand directly with a disarming spell. The remaining two silly big men who only use fists, Ivan’s two leg-locking spells made them fall To the ground.
Malfoy, who had lost the ability to resist, had to take Ron's right uppercut head-on.
Ron still wanted to keep doing it, but an invisible barrier appeared in front of Malfoy to block Ron's fist Snape stepped down the stairs with a stern face. Randomly waving the magic wand dispelled the magic of Crabbe and Gore, and then looked at Ivan and others.
"Assault classmates on campus, wanton abuse of magic, Gryffindor was deducted 10 points!"
"Professor, it's Malfoy..." Harry wanted to argue, but unexpectedly Snape spoke again.
"Fifteen points are deducted now!"
Ivan stopped Harry and Ron who were about to continue speaking. Judging from the fact that Snape waved his wand and dispelled his magic, it was not enough for the three of them to go together.
Since he couldn't beat it, Snape was a professor again, and he would suffer no matter how much...
Snape didn't embarrass Ivan and the others anymore, after a slightly disappointed glance at Malfoy, he turned straight and left.
Malfoy got up from the ground angrily, stared at Crabbe and Gore, who were easily resolved by Ivan, followed behind Snape, and walked proudly from the side of the three, but their faces were a little swollen. ...
"Snape simply deliberately had trouble with us, asking me to say that Harry had a problem with your broom last time. Snape must have done it!" Ron dissatisfied.
"At the end of this semester, Snape has deducted nearly 100% of our Gryffindor." Harry also nodded, agreeing with Ron's statement. Compared with Professor Chino, who is harmless to humans and animals, Nep is more likely.
Ivan didn't help Snape to explain again this time, because Snape was too capable of pulling hatred, even he was a little dissatisfied with Snape.
But that’s okay. Ivan was still a little bit resistant to sneaking into Snape’s potion storage room and stealing the Boneweed, but now he doesn’t think so much anymore...
What is missing is just an opportunity.

chapters.title: Chapter 41: Deathly Hallows and Gifts
chapters.content:
A few days later, the time Ivan was waiting for still did not appear, and Chino seemed to have become more cautious, and for several days there was no major movement.
Ivan had to focus on the coming Christmas first, preparing to prepare a Christmas gift for Harry and the others. Thanks to Ivan, there was still a lot of gold left after purchasing the materials. Long.
As for the rest of the time, half of the time was spent in the library, and the other half was staying with the Weasley brothers. After they had relatively sufficient funds, they could not wait to start their own business, taking advantage of this holiday opportunity. , Studied the production of magic items.
Ivan, of course, joined as a special adviser, and the production of magic items that hadn't grown since the beginning of the semester finally broke through to the first level.
As a result of making magic items as an upgrade, Ivan intends to give Ron his own work, a special set of wizard flags, as a Christmas gift, so that he can save some money.
The reading notes he gave to Hermione were his own reading notes, which contained a lot of magic tricks he knew, which I believe the little witch would like.
As for Harry’s gift, Ivan thought for a long time and didn’t think of any special preferences he had. He simply gave him a small Christmas gift box. Just open the four little people inside and they will pop out and go around in circles. , Sing a Merry Christmas song together.
These four villains are Harry, Ron, Hermione and Ivan himself...
On the side of the Weasley brothers, Ivan gave a few fat tongue toffees, which he developed in advance by imitating their works in the original book. I hope the two brothers will feel "surprise" after eating them.
At the same time, Ivan is also looking forward to what gifts I can get tomorrow...
One night passed quickly. On Christmas Day, Ivan, who had just gotten up, saw Harry and Ron who were unpacking the gift box. Ivan also joined in.
As soon as I opened the first gift, Ivan heard Ron beside him exclaimed excitedly.
"Gosh, this wizard banner is so cool... Ivan, how did you do it?"
Ron would be playing around with the wizard flag he sent.
These flags were all put on beautiful and gorgeous skins by Ivan during the production process. The soldiers became various wizards in robes. The knights were replaced with unicorns and night riders, as well as fire dragons. Of the advanced arms. The red king was an old man with a white beard. Ron could tell that it was Dumbledore, but the black king Ron could not.
Although there are no changes in the various rules, but in terms of various configurations, this chess game is like a wizard's war. The battle scene is also blessed by Ivan's magic, and various light special effects continue.
Ron liked it so much, but he still asked who was the opponent of the red Dumbledore?
"Mysterious man?" Ron thought of this possibility, then shivered.
"No, it's Greenward." Ivan explained.
"Who is that?" Harry also leaned over at this time, because he heard Ron said the three words mysterious man.
"Don't you remember? Professor Dumbledore's greatest achievement, in addition to discovering the twelve uses of fire dragon blood, was defeating the dark wizard Grindelwald in 1945." Ivan reminded.
Harry also remembered at this time that he had once received a Dumbledore card, and it was indeed written like this.
Afterwards, Harry also succeeded in dismantling the things Ivan gave him. This gift that can jump out of the villain to play Christmas songs almost made him think that this must be the best gift to receive at Christmas.
Until, he took out a silver-gray color from the last package, a bit like a strange fabric flowing liquid.
"What is this?" Harry touched it and asked curiously.
"This is an invisibility cloak." Ivan took a glance, walked over with interest, looked at this legendary Deathly Hallows, and asked.
"Can I touch it?"
"Of course..." Harry handed the Invisibility Cloak to it, and Ivan reached out and took it.
At the same time, Ivan noticed that there was more information about the invisibility cloak in his system magic inventory.
[Magic Item: Invisibility Cloak (Death Hallows)
Magic: very strong

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Yes, Snape stole the potion himself...
chapters.content:
Acquiring a life-saving meniscus pendant did not relieve Ivan’s anxiety. On the contrary, he strengthened the idea of ​​brewing the bleeding veins and fusing potions at the fastest speed to improve his own strength, and his actions became more radical. stand up.

Maybe it’s because what Chino is doing is unsightly, so his name basically doesn’t overlap with anyone else on the live spot map, which means that only Ivan in the school knows where Chino has gone.
And Ivan was even more pleased that Snape was not in his office at this time, the time had come...
......
In a potions class a few days later, Snape’s stern face seemed to be more gloomy. After the whole class, the little wizards in Gryffindor suffered one after another, even Hermione and Yi There are no exceptions.
"Is Snape crazy? He deducted our Gryffindor forty-five points in one class today!" After class, Ron just walked out of Snape's basement and couldn't help complaining.

Snape?
Harry and the three were at a loss. Why did Snape steal his potion?
Oh, no, Snape doesn't need to steal it at all, okay? That was originally his potion storage room!
"Have you forgotten the trapdoor under the three-headed dog Norway? Someone has always wanted to pass it, and only Hagrid knows how to pass." Ivan didn't say it clearly but just mentioned it slightly.
"The compound decoction! Snape must have wanted to use the compound decoction to pretend to be someone Hagrid knew. It's a good deal of what he said." Hermione understood Ivan's meaning for the first time, and immediately guessed.
Harry got excited too, because he saw Snape hurt on his thigh a few days ago.

After all, although the potion storage room is located in Snape's office, it is strictly the property of Hogwarts. Most of the money spent on the purchase of potion materials is paid for by the school.
Harry suddenly felt that he had seen the truth of the facts, and couldn't wait to share his thoughts with Ivan, Hermione, and Ron.
"That must be the case, Harry, you are right! Let's go tell Professor Dumbledore now! Frustrate Snape's evil plan!" Ron was instantly smashed, with a sense of responsibility and mission. Keep pouring in my heart.
Ivan was a little embarrassed, he didn't expect that he just said casually, Harry and others would be able to make up for it..
"I never knew you had such a rich imagination."
Snape's low voice came from behind the four.
Ron, who was full of excitement, immediately shook his spirits, and the flame in his heart was instantly extinguished.
"Teach...Professor..." Harry turned his head hard and stammered.
Hermione was also very scared, only Ivan pretended to be scared, because he had said those words to Snape on purpose.
Snape walked up to the four of them and slowly leaned down, looking at them with hollow eyes, and the hook-like nose almost poked Harry in the head.
Harry's brain has even begun to imagine what terrifying means Snape will use to punish them, is it the Forgotten Curse, or other evil curses, or death curses?

However, to Harry's expectation, Snape did not draw out his wand or throw them out of the window. only left a sentence "Gryffindor is deducted 10 points!" "After that, he left in a hurry.

Go to the principal's office to find Dumbledore?

"I think there seems to be something wrong with the cake I ate at noon..." Ivan's complexion suddenly changed, and he covered his stomach with his right hand.

came to the principal’s office again, Ivan no longer had the first panic in his heart.

was placed so conspicuously that it was obviously not only Ivan who found it, but Harry stood in front of the mirror even more fascinated, looking at it in a dazed manner for a long time without regaining his senses.

It seems that his previous guess is not wrong. Dumbledore, the old skater, didn't plan to put the mirror and the Philosopher's Stone where it should be before he was sure that Harry could pass the test of Eris's Mirror.
"Eris Mirror? Is this its name? Do you know it?" Harry asked anxiously at this time, ignoring the memory of his parents in the mirror.

After deciding to send Norbert away a month later, Hagrid was lost for a while before he regained his strength, and cherished the remaining time together Ivan looked at the ugly little fire dragon in front of him. , The enthusiasm for caring was not weaker than Hagrid, and he had already wondered how to secretly draw a tube of blood while Hagrid was not paying attention.

Before that, Ivan decided to make a good relationship with Norbert first, just like he played Fox, so that he would not encounter too much resistance when he took blood later.

Ivan did as soon as he thought of it, and immediately stared at Norbert who couldn't move.
Even in order to improve his viciousness, Ivan grinned deliberately, but after staring for a few minutes, Ivan's eyes were so sore that Norbert was still the same.
Is something wrong?
Ivan tilted his head and looked at the mirror that was not far away. Through the mirror, Ivan saw what he looked like at this time. It didn't seem to be vicious at all, even inexplicably cute?
Ivan sighed, it's not his fault to be handsome...
In this regard, Ivan had to use the Transformation Curse to temporarily create a two-handed sword that was more than one meter long and held it high in the air. The sharp double-sided blade was faintly shining with cold light, and there was an evil smile on his face. Walk away.
Of course, the two-handed sword is just a look, it's actually completely hollow inside, otherwise Ivan wouldn't be able to hold it.
But Norbert didn't know this. He watched the figure of Ivan holding the huge sword getting closer, desperately trying to struggle, and creaked the floor that bound his limbs.
Ivan deliberately slowed down the speed of walking, killing Norber's irritable temperament, and when he walked in front of him, when Ivan hesitated whether to cut it, Norber decisively accepted it...
Ivan nodded with satisfaction, put down the pretending giant sword, and then he can gradually train Norbert's obedience.
Thinking that he had been so diligent for so long before and had nothing, Ivan was furious. If he had known this smoothly, why should he be a **** shoveling officer for so many days.
"Noble, get down..."
A few hours later, Ivan, who was a safe distance away, gave orders to the young dragon not far away. Noble reluctantly got down on his body, and then Ivan threw the grilled fish on the table over.
Noble ate the fragrant grilled fish He smashed his mouth depressedly. Although the rope on his mouth had been untied, Noble was wise not to try to use the fire-breathing fish. The demon in front of him burned to death.
Because the previous failures told him that the demon in front of him has mastered the farthest distance of its fire, so it is not only useless, but also suffers various punishments.
Watching Norbert obey the order and start to eat the food he gave, Ivan’s heart is full of accomplishment. It is worthwhile that he has been practicing the same instruction all afternoon...
Seeing that the sky was almost the same, Ivan estimated that Hagrid was about to return, and waved his wand to lift the transformation curse that bound Norbert's limbs.
Norbert stayed where he was, and he didn't look like he had rushed up violently before, because the two-handed sword, which was more than one meter long, was quietly placed within Ivan's reach.
Sure enough, just two minutes after Ivan lifted the curse, fangs screamed outside the hut, followed by the sound of pushing the door, and Hagrid's big face with a weird beard appeared in front of the door. .

Ivan was about to answer when he saw that Norbert suddenly seemed to have been beaten with blood, his limbs and wings flapping towards Hagrid, the long eyes of the goose egg were full of tears of grievance, as if he had been bullied outside The cub returned to its mother's embrace.
"Oh, Norbert, good boy," Hagrid experienced this treatment for the first time, and he couldn't even believe it. He only noticed the big teardrops dripping from the corner of Norbert's eyes and the bruises on his face. Something is wrong.
"You hit it, my God, it's still a baby without a full moon!" Hagrid stretched out his hand and touched Norbert's fangs head, very distressed.

"I just provided it with some training." Ivan explained, trying to hide behind him a two-handed giant sword not much smaller than him. After all, it was too late to lift the Transfiguration Curse at this time.

Knowing that he couldn't help it, Ivan waved his magic wand to turn the giant sword back into a broom, and said directly to Hagrid.
"Hagrid, you are so spoiled for Norbert. We have to find a way to discipline him. Otherwise, it will take down your house in a few days."
"And we must also teach it to hunt and fight skills through training." Ivan then added.
"But... Norbert is too young, you will scare him like this." Hagrid hesitated.
"Noble, get down!" Ivan said suddenly to show Hagrid the results of his training deliberately.
Already in a few hours of training, Norbert, who had initially formed a conditioned reflex, subconsciously lay down, until he realized that he had a backing, then he got up again, hid behind Hagrid, and faced Yi. Fan showed his fangs.
These two-ha general behaviors made Ivan a little bit to laugh.
Hagrid also saw the transformation of Norbert, and he was a little bit happy, but also a little bit disappointed, as if he had finally seen some growth in his child.
"Otherwise, how about waiting for Norbert to grow up?" Hagrid asked Ivan in a low voice.
"If you still want to raise Norbert for a while, you'd better train it now!" Ivan shook his head resolutely. What a joke, Ivan doubted whether he could fight any more. It's been Norbert.
Ivan's words were like the last straw, crushing the balance in Hagrid's heart, because he knew that Ivan was right, and Norbert would soon be exposed if he continued like this.

"Well, but I will be patrolling in the forbidden forest in the near future, so I only have time in the evening." Hagrid said.

Hagrid hesitated for a while, wondering if he should tell the matter, but couldn't hold back Ivan from asking again and again, and finally revealed some information.
"A unicorn was attacked..."
"Fortunately, it escaped in time. It was only injured. I think the purpose of patrolling in the forbidden forest is to figure out what attacked it. The other party did not succeed this time, and it is likely to come back again."
Hagrid's tone seemed a little low, he couldn't imagine what kind of evil creatures would attack the holy unicorn.
Ivan fell silent, because he knew very well that Chino must have attacked the unicorn, but he couldn't stop it.
Because he had tentatively reported Chino with Harry and the others before, but Dumbledore obviously did not intend to deal with Chino now, and the same result would be the same again.
Ivan has already regretted his behavior to change the plot in order not to be disturbed, because in this case, Hagrid, who frequently enters and exits the Forbidden Forest, is likely to be in danger.
Hagrid didn't know Ivan's concerns. He just muttered and cursed the murderer who attacked the unicorn, then turned to discuss with Ivan enthusiastically about how to train and raise the dragon.
Ivan only temporarily suppressed the worry in his heart and explained it to Hagrid.
Ben also felt that he had found Norbert, who was backing him. Seeing Hagrid’s gradually changing expression, he shuddered inexplicably...
In the next few days, what Ivan worried about never happened. With Hagrid's help, Norbert lost the last bit of resistance...

made a certain Norwegian Ridgeback who was accustomed to tearing down the house every day, sleeping, and roasting the fire. It was very uncomfortable, and even felt unlovable...
When I eat grilled fish every day, I can feel that there is still a little warmth in the cold life...
...
"Ivan, we can't go on like this!"
In the quiet library, Hermione's anger suddenly resounded with a little helpless voice, which attracted the attention of other little wizards, and even Mrs. Pince looked over here.
The little witch blushed, UU reading www.uukanshu. com lowered the voice a bit,

I can't imagine what it would be like if the Transfiguration class test is smashed, if I only get an E (exceeding expectations). How disappointed Professor McGonagall would be..." "Yes, I heard George and they said that Ivan's level of Transfiguration is okay to participate in OWLs." Harry couldn't help but interject.

immediately decided to add dragon blood tonight...

chapters.content:
