chapters.title: Chapter 56: Dragon Rescue
chapters.content:
"Yes, I saw it." Professor McGonagall also understood the seriousness of the matter at this time, with a serious expression on his face.
"Anyway, I'll go there first. You'd better go to Professor Dumbledore and find him. In addition, the command of the principal's office is... Zizi Honey Candy." Professor McGonagall exploded with a curse after speaking. He turned over and jumped from the window on the third floor with a domineering attitude that was not suitable for his age.
"Professor McGonagall!" Hermione rushed to the window anxiously, watching Professor McGonagall fall quickly from the sky, and then landed smoothly after waving his wand.
"It's really cool, it's a floating spell, how about we try it too?" Ron said with envy.
"This is the third floor. If we don't have time to cast the spell, we will fall to death!" Harry had to remind him.
"Let's go to Professor Dumbledore as soon as possible." Although Professor McGonagall rushed to support her, Hermione was still a little worried. Only Dumbledore could give them enough security.
"No, I heard what I said just now."
Just when Hermione was about to lead the team, Dumbledore's figure suddenly emerged from the shadow on one side, looking at the forbidden forest in the distance. There was also a slight movement on Gujing Bubo's face, obviously. What happened in the Forbidden Forest has exceeded his expectations.
......
At this time, there was a burst of noisy sounds deep in the originally silent black forbidden forest.
After a while, a huge figure more than two meters high came out of the bushes with difficulty, and the patchy clothes on his body were stained with blood, and a strong smell of blood drifted in the forbidden forest. in.
If it is normal, the predators hidden in the forbidden forest have long been wandering around, but now except for the slight noise made by Hagrid, the silence can only be heard by insects.
"Huh..." Hagrid panted heavily, holding the wooden stick he had found halfway as a weapon in his hand, leaning against a big tree, and staring at the front closely.
In the shade of the trees, a figure shrouded in black robes slowly approached, and Hagrid, who was already unable to walk, threw the wooden stick in his hand forcefully.
As a half-blooded half-giant, Hagrid's power is naturally far beyond ordinary people, which is one of the reasons why he can smoothly tame many magical creatures.
The thick wooden stick brought a fierce wind in the air, but it was a pity that such a method seemed meaningless to a vigilant and powerful wizard.
"Fall to pieces!" The black-robed wizard just waved his wand randomly, the wooden stick exploded in mid-air, and sawdust all fell down one after another.
"Who are you? Why are you attacking unicorns in the forbidden forest?" Hagrid said angrily with red eyes.
The black-robed wizard did not answer, nor was he stupid enough to explain to Hagrid the reason for hunting the unicorn. He just lifted his wand gently, pointed it at Hagrid, and whispered in his mouth.
"Avada Kedavra!"
A gloomy green light lased towards Hagrid at an extraordinary speed, and Hagrid, who had read the spell from the black robe wizard’s chant, fell into deep despair.
Harry...Dumbledore...Aragok...Ivan...Hermione...Ron...Noble...
A series of memories appeared in Hagrid's mind like a revolving lantern. Just as Hagrid was about to wait quietly for death, a white and gleaming figure rushed out like lightning, blocking the middle.
"No!" Hagrid screamed with a sullen expression.
But no matter how Hagrid roared, he couldn't change the facts. The green light hit it straight, and the white figure stopped abruptly and fell to the ground.
That is a unicorn...
Even as a powerful top-level magical creature, after a death curse, vitality is fading quickly, and life is about to come to an end. The white mane is stained with blue blood, but even so, it is still strong. Struggling to stand up.
Hagrid was already in tears, and wanted to climb over to check the unicorn situation, but his body had already lost a trace of strength.
Kino, who was wrapped in a black robe, was a little trembling, because the voice of the Dark Lord resounded in his mind.
"Trash, even a beast can't be killed." Voldemort felt that this was the most dish he had ever brought, and Avadaso, who hit him in the front, didn't kill the target immediately for the first time.
Kino was very wronged. This is obviously because Voldemort has absorbed too much life force in these days, which has caused the power of magic to be weakened a lot...
But facing the Dark Lord who controls his own life and death, Kino didn't dare to complain, so he poured his anger on Hagrid in front of him.
Hagrid hadn't been for this reckless idiot who suddenly popped out when he was hunting the unicorn, he would have succeeded, so how could he have lost so much time?
So Kino ignored the unicorn whose life was passing by and was about to die. Instead, he walked slowly towards Hagrid, admiring the powerlessness and despair in Hagrid’s eyes.
Kino waved his magic wand and was about to end Hagrid's life with Avadaso again When he raised his hand, he saw that Hagrid's eyes suddenly burst with a different brilliance...turning from despair At the end, I was shocked.. With the corners of his mouth trembling slightly, Kino could faintly read the words he wanted to say.
Long...
"Don't want to use this little trick to deceive me." Chino disdainfully, he has seen too much of this little distraction.
Besides, where did the dragon come from at Hogwarts?
"Look at the sky, you idiot!" Voldemort's voice appeared in Kino's mind again.
Although there is a cloak, Voldemort's perception ability is greatly reduced, but he can still detect an attack that is about to threaten his life.
At the moment Voldemort spoke, a clear dragon roar entered Kino's ears. By the time Kino turned around, it was too late, only to see a hot flame getting closer and closer to him.
Voldemort violently seized control of Kino's body, and the disgusting and weird snake face had turned to the front for some unknown time, and it was closely attached to Kino's face. The two faces overlapped like a weird appearance.
Even so, Voldemort had no time to reach out and wave his wand, and he was swallowed by flames...
Amidst the flame dragon's breath, a purple magic barrier suddenly lit up, barely isolating the flames, but the scorching heat and billowing air wave made Voldemort afraid to relax at all, not to mention the hastily released magic barrier has gradually cracked There are signs of collapse.
Fortunately, the flame breath lasted for only three seconds, and it was over. Just as Voldemort was relieved, a huge dragon head suddenly appeared in front of him. With the huge force of diving, it instantly broke through the barrier, and this weird body was destroyed. Flew out...

chapters.title: Chapter 57: Just set the fire. Dumbledore should be able to do it, right?
chapters.content:
Norbert flapped his wings, bent forward and landed on the ground. Ivan stood domineeringly on Norbert's back. After a worried look at Hagrid, he held up his wand and found the enemy.
"Hagrid, where's the enemy?" Ivan looked around and asked strangely.
"Just... it just seemed to fly out..." Hagrid still had some teardrops on his face, and he stammered and said, pointing to the dense forest on the right.
flew out?
Ivan recalled that when he landed on Norbert just now, he seemed to be hindered.
Ivan suddenly felt a little regretful. Judging from the intensity of the collision, Chino mostly successfully released the defensive spell, and it is unlikely that he would hang up directly.
So Chino should still be alive?
"The flames are raging!" Thinking of this, Ivan immediately became nervous, raised his hand and cast several flame spells at the place Hagrid pointed.
The red flame rose to the sky, spreading in all directions...
Even so, Ivan still felt unsafe, and immediately ordered Norbert to continue to breathe the dragon's breath in that direction. The greater the power, the better. It is best to ensure that no one can come out alive in that direction...
Facing Chino, who was possessed by Voldemort, Ivan didn’t dare to have the slightest chance in his heart. He was just right...
Norbossa happily took out all his strengths. It liked the fire-breathing thing the most. After a few dragons breathed down, a large number of bushes were engulfed by the billowing flames...
Hagrid watched this scene blankly, and said something for a long time...
"Is this a bit too much..." Ivan also fell into contemplation under the reflection of the fire, thinking that the fire was too big? What if this can't be eliminated?
Set fire to the forbidden forest, will he be caught in Azkaban? Professor Dumbledore should be able to do it, right?
Thinking of this, Ivan became a little angry and kicked Norbert with his foot. He planned a sneak attack to take Chino away in a wave, all of which was destroyed by Norbert's roar.
Otherwise, he doesn't need to make up the knife with flaming fire...
Norbert whimpered twice aggrievedly, it finally flew two times in the sky, what's wrong with the shout?
Ivan did not pay attention to Norbert anymore, but after beckoning it to be on guard, he jumped off Norbert's back and ran to Hagrid quickly.
And Yaya rushed to Hagrid at the beginning of the landing, sticking out his scarlet tongue and licking his face constantly, making Hagrid's face full of saliva.
"Hagrid, are you okay? I have asked Harry to inform the professor, and they will be here soon." Ivan leaned forward and carefully checked the wounds on Hagrid's waist, abdomen, and thigh.
Although these wounds look scary and bloody, and even faintly oozing black energy, Ivan breathed a sigh of relief. They weren't fatal wounds. Unfortunately, he didn't heal the curse and couldn't heal Hagrid. .
"Don't worry about me, I'm fine, you go and see how about Cecilia? It just got the Avadaso curse to protect me..." Hagrid pushed Ivan anxiously and told him First go and see if there is any help.
"Cecilia?" Ivan asked strangely.
"That's the name I just gave it. If it weren't for Cecilia, I would have died long ago." Hagrid choked up and wiped the tears from his face with his big dusty hand.
After confirming that Hagrid was really fine, Ivan nodded and walked towards the dying unicorn.
After 　　 approached, Ivan was shocked by the charm of the unicorn.
Under the reflection of the firelight, Cecilia is like a legendary pegasus, emitting a faint white shimmer all over her body, with a unique spiral-shaped sharp corner standing on her forehead, but a few long and narrow strips are pulled apart from her abdomen and hind legs. The wound, the blue blood is constantly flowing down...
But Ivan understands that Kino’s Avadaso’s Mantra is really deadly... Even with the huge vitality of the unicorn, persistence has reached its limit now.
Cecilia’s bright cyan pupils gradually dimmed, revealing sadness and pain...
Ivan gently stroked its mane, feeling the unusually soft hand, and all he could do now was comfort.
The effect of Avada's Mantra is irreversible, which is why it is listed as the three unforgivable spells, even if it is as strong as Dumbledore, it is helpless.
Cecilia gradually closed her eyes under Ivan’s comfort, and the vitality gradually peeled off. Ivan sighed. In the principle of not wasting, she took out a test tube from her pocket and filled the blood flowing down the wound. Into the bottle.
Ivan tightened the cap with a cork, looked at the dreamy blue in the test tube, and said to the dead unicorn.
"Your enemy will probably not live long anyway... Rest in peace..."
After finishing speaking, I don't know if it was an illusion. Ivan felt that Cecilia's body seemed to have changed a little, but he couldn't see the difference.
However, Ivan’s words are not all comfort Because Chino’s identity has been exposed, even if the lucky one is not burned to death this time, I am afraid that Voldemort will be drained of vitality because of his injuries.
Ivan stood up and put the test tube containing the blood of the unicorn away. He seemed to hear the system's prompt sound vaguely, but before he had time to check it, he saw a tabby cat galloping through the dense forest in the distance. come.
That is far faster than ordinary people running at full speed. Ivan even wondered if he had misunderstood. How could a cat run so fast?
Norber, who was in charge of the vigilance, immediately became vigilant, with a big mouth full of fangs, and yelled at the tabby cat, but he did not dare to attack easily.
Because the pressure on it from the other party is much greater than that of Ivan as the shovel officer.
"Norbo, stop, that's not the enemy!" Ivan hurriedly told Norbo to step back. He still recognized Professor McGonagall's Animagus form.
It is not clear what method McGonagall used to increase the speed of movement after transformation. Judging from his impression of Animagus in the original work, the values ​​after transformation should be no different from that of a normal cat.
Sure enough, after the tabby cat galloped in front of Hagrid, its body shape was quickly distorted and restored to the original appearance of Professor McGonagall.
"Clear water is like a spring!" As soon as Professor McGonagall arrived, he noticed the spreading fire, waving his wand, a huge amount of clear water was drawn from a distance, and gathered in mid-air like a growing snake, toward the right. Mopped up.
Although the tongue of fire spreads in a wide range, it is more scattered than the long snakes gathered by clear water, and there is no command, so it will be extinguished in a short time...
Even so, there is still a large area burned to white ground, I am afraid that it will not be restored in decades...

chapters.title: Chapter 58: That's right, Professor Dumbledore instructed
chapters.content:
Noting this scene, Professor McGonagall pursed her mouth, her eyes filled with anger. She did not expect that those who attacked Hagrid would be so frantic that they would set fire in the forbidden forest...
If she comes a little later, I am afraid there will be no way to stop the fire.
But anger turned anger, Professor McGonagall squatted down and checked Hagrid's injuries for the first time.
After confirming that the injury was not life-threatening, Professor McGonagall breathed a sigh of relief and waved his magic wand to pull the black air out of the wound, and then used several healing spells to stop the bleeding and heal the wound.
"I can only do this for the time being. You will still need to go to Madam Pomfrey to train for a while." Professor McGonagall said.
"Thank you.. Okay, I don't think I have anything wrong... Can you go and see Cecilia? I think it can be rescued..." There are still some tears on Hagrid's face, some Choked up.
"Cecilia? Who is that?" McGonagall questioned.
"That's the name Hagrid gave to this unicorn... it was hit by the Avadasuo curse to protect Hagrid." Ivan watched for a while, noticing that Hagrid was a little tired, and took the initiative to continue Words.
"It's dead, Hagrid." McGonagall also noticed the unicorn that fell on the ground without sound. After hearing that the opponent was hit by Arvada, McGonagall shook his head weakly.
"I killed her..." Hagrid crumbled, covering his face, crying bitterly.
McGonagall saw this, guessing that he couldn't ask anything from Hagrid, so he turned his eyes to Ivan, who looked pretty good.
"Halse! What the **** is going on? How could Hagrid be injured?" McGonagall sullen his face, and a unicorn died. Hagrid was hit by a curse in the Forbidden Forest again. The situation is obviously serious. .
Ivan didn't hide it. When he and Harry and the others ran into the injured Fang outside Hagrid's hut, he guessed that Hagrid encountered the attack in the Forbidden Forest.
then said again.
"In order not to delay the time to ask for help, Harry and the others went back to ask for help. I rode Norbert a step forward, just when I saw a black-robed wizard preparing to attack Hagrid, so I used the impact of the dragon's breath and the high-altitude dive to carry out a sneak attack. It succeeded. Repelled the opponent."
Professor McGonagall pursed her lips. Although Ivan's words are very concise, she can still think of the thrilling scene. Ivan's ability to use the fire dragon's air superiority to carry out a sneak attack on the fly made McGonagall admire his agility.
Ivan finished talking about what happened, and finally pointed to the bush on the right that was burned to white ground.
"Professor McGonagall, the black-robed wizard who was thrown by Norbert fell into the bushes over there. I think he was injured very seriously, but he should be alive."
"Are you sure?" McGonagall frowned, because according to Ivan's description, it was the fire dragon hit and the flame burned, and it was impossible for a normal person to survive.
"Professor, you also saw that there is no his body there. I don't think it will be burned to ashes at this time?" Ivan shrugged. He was also very sorry about this. He didn't expect that he would make up the knife like this. , Was still run away by Chino.
Professor McGonagall was about to nod with a sullen face, but then suddenly realized a problem.
"Wait, who set the fire?"
"Of course I put it..." Ivan Cancan said, and then solemnly explained that it was the spirit of caution necessary to face a dark wizard who could use the Avadasuo spell.
Professor McGonagall looked at the forbidden forest with black smoke from time to time after it was extinguished, and the corners of his mouth twitched suddenly.
Is this kid overly cautious?
Especially she couldn't reprimand Ivan, because the black-robed wizard used the Avadasuo Mantra and successfully escaped from the fire, which is enough to prove the danger of the other party.
"Professor, I feel that the other party should have suffered a serious injury. Maybe it hasn't been far away. If you chase it now, it may be too late." Ivan said eagerly.
Don't take advantage of Chino and Voldemort's bad condition now, beating him with a stick, are you still waiting for them to come back and find him after they recover?
"No, it is the most important thing to protect your safety now. The investigation and pursuit will wait until Albus arrives." Professor McGonagall shook his head without hesitation, facing the unknown enemy who hid in the forbidden forest and chased him rashly. It is extremely dangerous.
Of course, she was not worried about her safety, but was afraid that after she left, the black-robed wizard would come back here and hurt Ivan and Hagrid.
Ivan sighed. He knew that with Voldemort's ability, no matter how badly he was injured, he wouldn't know which hidden place he would sneak into when Dumbledore arrived.
"I haven't asked you about one more thing, Hals!" McGonagall's gaze turned to Norbert, who was lying lazily on the ground, and asked.
"Where did this dragon come from? When I heard Hermione say that you were riding a dragon to save Hagrid, I almost thought they were crazy! Because Hogwarts didn't raise a dragon at all~www.mtlnovel. com~ It is illegal to raise a dragon without permission from the Ministry of Magic!"
Professor McGonagall’s words were so aggressive that he didn’t even leave Ivan with half a face, because she was not the only one who heard the previous dragon roar. If the Ministry of Magic investigates, the person who raises the dragon will definitely be arrested. Go to Azkaban!
Hagrid had recovered from the blow at this time, watching Ivan remain silent under McGonagall's questioning, he gritted his teeth and said.
"Actually this dragon is..."
"Professor Dumbledore asked Hagrid to raise it!" Hagrid was about to admit it when Ivan suddenly interrupted.
He felt that Dumbledore had let Kino leave for so long, he still had to carry the pot, otherwise, Professor McGonagall might be inclined to send Hagrid to Azkaban.
"Albus?" Professor McGonagall's tone obviously slowed down a lot, but he still couldn't believe it.
"It is indeed me, Minerva."
Dumbledore’s voice came from the other end of the Forbidden Forest, followed by his iconic silver-white beard. Dumbledore was still wearing his iconic robe and the purple cloak over him had grown to maturity. Dragged to the ground.
Ivan was caught on the spot when he was throwing the pot for the first time. It was a bit embarrassing for a while. Fortunately, Dumbledore didn't expose his meaning, but instead helped him round the lie.
"How could you make Hagrid do this? What if the Ministry of Magic comes to inspect? What should we say?" Professor McGonagall frowned.
"I'll explain the specific reasons later. As for now, I want to know what happened here." Dumbledore looked at Hagrid.
Hagrid regained some energy at this time, intermittently telling the whole story...

chapters.title: Chapter 59: Listen to me, deal with it with the Vanishing Curse, absolutely clean...
chapters.content:
As early as a month ago, Hagrid, who was the guard of the hunting ground, found traces of strangers entering and leaving the forbidden forest.
Originally, he only thought that some senior students ran into the forbidden forest to take risks, but he did not expect that a few days later, during an accidental inspection, he discovered that a unicorn had been attacked in the forbidden forest. Only then did he realize that something was wrong. .
After that, Hagrid frequently went into and out of the forbidden forest, trying to find out what happened. He didn't expect to bump into a black-robed man attacking the unicorn during today's routine inspection.
Witnessing this scene with his own eyes, Hagrid was so dazzled by anger that he rushed forward without thinking about it.
Needless to say, it turns out,
If he attacked, Hagrid might be able to defeat the opponent unexpectedly by relying on his innate great power, but in a face-to-face confrontation, Hagrid's huge size became a living target.
Hagrid would have died if it weren't for being a half-blood giant with thick skin and a unicorn and fangs.
"For such an important matter, you should notify Albus as soon as you notice something wrong! How can you want to deal with such a dangerous enemy by yourself?" McGonagall interrupted.
McGonagall is somewhat afraid, if Ivan hadn't arrived in time this time, the consequences would have been serious...
Hagrid opened his mouth and didn't know how to answer. At that time he was secretly raising Norbert, so he dared not go to Dumbledore at all.
"Later, I got separated from Yaya and led the black-robed wizard away by myself. I thought Cecilia had already left, but I didn't expect her to follow nearby and blocked the death curse for me."
Speaking of this, Hagrid's mood is very low. Although he and Cecilia have only met a few times, they have fought side by side just now, and the other party has resisted the death curse for him, so Hagrid has regarded it as a friend. .
"The unicorn is a smart and arrogant magical creature. It will not take risks easily. Obviously your courage has been recognized by it..." Dumbledore said with relief, and then looked at Ivan.
"Halse, you did a good job this time, I have to say that your performance always surprises me every time."
"This is what I should do. Hagrid is my friend." While maintaining Occlumency, Ivan nodded reservedly. To be honest, he didn't want Dumbledore's attention at all.
Dumbledore nodded, and instead of continuing the topic, he turned to Professor McGonagall.
"Minerva, you **** Hagrid and Hals home first, and also notify other professors to restrain the children in each college."
"As for me...I will cast the spell myself to find the murderer in the forbidden forest..." A rare trace of anger appeared on Dumbledore's old face, and huge magic power spread to the surroundings as the emotions temporarily lost control. , The heavy pressure made Yifan a little bit frightened after a distance.
Norbert, not to mention, shrank into a ball on the spot, without the slightest dignity of a top predator.
It was the first time Ivan saw Dumbledore's angry look, and he couldn't help but feel a little more hopeful. Maybe Dumbledore could find Chino and Voldemort and kill them directly.
Professor McGonagall looked at Norbert. "Albus, what about this dragon?"
"Just take care of it before the people from the Ministry of Magic come to inspect." Dumbledore explained, waving his wand and summoning countless blue light spots, using magic to drive them in all directions, and then chose a direction. Disappeared in the forbidden forest.
"What to do? Use Vanishing Curse?" Professor McGonagall still didn't understand Dumbledore's meaning, but in her opinion, the best way to make a dragon disappear from Hogwarts in a short time was to use Vanishing Curse.
Absolutely clean and clean... guarantee that nothing will be left,
With Dumbledore's strength, it should be possible to do it, right? Professor McGonagall is a little uncertain...
Ivan was ashamed at once. He didn't expect McGonagall to be a staid person on the surface, so cruel behind his back... he quickly explained it.
"Ron's brother Charlie is studying dragons in Romania. We have made an agreement with him and we can send Norbert away in two days."
McGonagall didn't say anything. He recognized this method of treatment and glanced at Hagrid, who was still a little difficult to get up.
"Can you transform the stretcher?" McGonagall said to Ivan.
"Of course," Ivan instantly understood what Professor McGonagall meant. He took out his wand and tapped it on a long piece of broken wood, recalling in his mind and constructing the impression of the rescue stretcher.
At the same time, with the injection of magic power, the branches were twisted and elongated...Slowly transformed into a black metal stretcher, with a hardwood board between the two metal cylinders for support.
The weird thing is that the support frame and the wooden board are tightly connected, as if the two are grown together. In order to make Hagrid lie more comfortable, Ivan also intimately put a soft cotton cushion on the wooden board.
The first attempt at such a complicated transformation was also a challenge for Ivan. Fortunately, it was successfully completed in the end.
"Very good... I don't think you can find a better student in Hogwarts with the Transfiguration Curse Professor McGonagall's face showed a little admiration.
She planned to correct her mistakes and be an on-the-spot teaching, but she didn't seem to need it anymore.
The spikes that Ivan had deformed when he killed the trolls before were enough to surprise her. After a while, Ivan's transformation ability has been greatly improved.
"Professor McGonagall, I feel that my transformation spell has reached a bottleneck, and I haven't improved it for several days." Ivan is not satisfied, because his transformation spell reached level three (799) a week ago. /800) Just the last bit of proficiency will be able to break through to level 4.
However, no matter how Ivan practiced, the progress bar remained motionless.
"I must remind you, Hals." Professor McGonagall pursed his lips and said solemnly.
"The Transfiguration Curse is an extremely profound and dangerous magic. You can never rush for quick success and quick gain. Your level is far beyond that of your peers, so you should settle down with your heart."
In his decades of teaching career, McGonagall has seen too many talented little wizards try various dangerous magic transformations because of overconfidence, and even use the transformation magic on his own body.
It is natural that successful people need not say much, they can successfully break through the boundaries of transformation magic, transform themselves into an animal, and have their own Animagus form.
But the fate of those losers is simply horrible...It is a good result that the magical power is disturbed in the process of transformation and death is a good result...The most terrifying thing is to become a monster that is half human and half animal...
Since this transformation technique that can change the essence cannot be reversed once it fails, they may have to continue to exist in this weird way.

chapters.title: Chapter 60: I said nothing happened in the forbidden forest, do you believe it?
chapters.content:
After the warning, Professor McGonagall told Ivan that when his magic power gradually increased with age, the Transfiguration Curse would naturally break through the bottleneck.
Prior to this, he could use more magic to perceive the differences in the structure of different objects. Generally speaking, the more a wizard understands the things to be transformed, the lower the difficulty of casting spells and the lower the consumption of magic.
"Yugadim Leviosa~"
After finishing speaking, McGonagall waved his magic wand and moved Hagrid into the stretcher with a floating spell, then lifted the stretcher with his magic power and Hagrid floated in the air together, moving with her and Ivan's steps.
Along the way, Ivan took this opportunity to ask Professor McGonagall about the precautions for releasing the Transfiguration Curse and how to increase the casting speed.
Professor McGonagall didn't conceal the slightest concealment. While maintaining the Levitating Curse, he explained to Ivan.
When the two of them walked out of the forbidden forest, Ivan felt that he had learned a lot of new skills, but the level of the Transformation Curse remained unchanged. He just didn't know if drinking the blood fusion potion could break through this bottleneck.
Beside the hut by the Forbidden Forest Lake, Harry, Hermione, and Ron had been waiting there anxiously, seeing Ivan and Professor McGonagall coming out together, hurriedly greeted them.
Especially when he saw Hagrid lying on the stretcher beside him, he was even more worried.
"Hagrid, are you okay?" Harry only had time to say hello to Professor McGonagall, and moved in front of Hagrid.
"I'm okay... it's Cecilia and she..." After a period of rest, Hagrid's state has recovered a bit, but once he is in memory, he can't help but feel sad.
Harry and the others were confused, and Ivan had no choice but to explain.
"Secilia is a unicorn. She was hit by the Avadas Curse in order to save Hagrid."
"Avadazo? That's an unforgivable curse, who would use it?" Hermione was shocked.
Harry didn't know this at all, Ron had only heard of the name of the Imperius Curse, and didn't know much about the Avada Spell, so Hermione immediately explained it to the two of them.
"I have seen in a book that it is a powerful killing curse that can instantly deprive the opponent of life, and is extremely evil magic.
The Ministry of Magic lists it as one of the three unforgivable spells, and all users will be caught to Azkaban if they find it! Because once someone is cursed, he will undoubtedly die, and there is no way to crack it. "
"Oh, I mean, apart from Harry, he is the only person who survived the Avadasuo curse and was released by the mysterious man himself." Hermione suddenly realized that there was a success from Ava. Those who survived under Dassault's curse added a bit embarrassingly.
Harry touched the some tingling scars on his forehead. He didn't even know that he had been under such a dangerous unforgivable curse. Before, people would only say that he defeated the mysterious man and saved the magic world, but no one told him the process. What is it like?
"The people who attacked Hagrid don't care about this, don't expect those dangerous dark wizards to abide by the rules of the Ministry of Magic..." Ivan felt that Hermione was a bit naive, so he reminded him timely.
"Okay, kids, let's talk later, we have more important things to do now! For example, hide the dragon so that no one will find it, or send Hagrid to the school hospital. Go..." Professor McGonagall had to interrupt their conversation.
"Norbo can hide in Hagrid's house, as long as he sleeps with a coma spell." Ivan suggested.
Professor McGonagall thought for a while and found it feasible, so he asked Ivan to take Norbert into the house, and then waved his wand to use a coma spell.
"fainted!"
Professor McGonagall shot quickly, and Norbert was knocked out before he even reacted.
Considering that dragons are very resistant to magic, Professor McGonagall had to use the coma spell a few more times to extend Norbert's coma time. In addition, he used the Transfiguration Curse to secure his limbs, wings, and mouth. In this way, even if he wakes up midway, he won't be able to make trouble.
Ivan looked at Norbert who was tied into rice dumplings in front of him, and remembered that Professor McGonagall was planning to use the Vanishing Curse to "handle" Norbert's affairs. He immediately listed Professor McGonagall as someone who must never offend... The method is really cruel. Up...
After trapping Norbert in the hut, everyone quickly returned to Hogwarts Castle. Professor McGonagall asked Ivan and the others to gather in the large exhibition hall. He first took Hagrid, who was lying on a stretcher, to Pang. Go to Mrs. Frey.
When Ivan stepped into the large exhibition hall, he found that the long tables of the four major colleges were already full of people, just like when welcoming new students at the beginning of school.
It's just that the atmosphere is more serious than that. The little wizards whispered in twos and threes, and no matter how the prefects who maintain order reprimanded, it didn't help. Ivan could still hear the words of the dragon faintlyIvan and his party of four The arrival of drew the attention of everyone present.
Especially those third-year students who witnessed Hermione, Harry, and Ron pulling Professor McGonagall away, they couldn't wait to rush to ask.
So that as soon as Ivan found a seat to sit down, George and Fred couldn't wait to squeeze up.
"Ivan, what happened in the Forbidden Forest? Someone saw a dragon spewing fire and fell into the Forbidden Forest. We also heard the dragon roar in the classroom. Is that true?" George asked excitedly. Tao.
The little wizards all around heard the words and they all turned their eyes on Ivan, expecting him to reveal some information to satisfy their gossip mentality.
However, Ivan shook his head apologetically.
"I don't know, the professors will say it later."
Ivan really doesn’t know how to say it, because later Dumbledore or Professor McGonagall will have a set of official rhetoric. What if it doesn’t match what he said? Isn't that a face slap?
George and Fred looked at each other and didn't ask any more, because they knew Ivan would never hide them if they could.
It's just that other people don't think so. They only think that Ivan, Harry and others must know what happened, but deliberately concealed them, and immediately began to rush into questions.
"Nothing happened there, no dragons, nothing!" Hermione was annoyed by the question and shouted very dissatisfied.
Harry and Ron were also very depressed when they were asked, and the feeling of knowing that they could not say made them very uncomfortable.
But even Ron, who has a big mouth, didn't reveal a word this time, because Ivan told them before he came in that if Hagrid was caught in Azkaban, he had better shut up!

chapters.title: Chapter 61: I'm sorry, but I don't understand these roundabout words
chapters.content:
Ivan's silent attitude is not very useful, but there are more students trying to squeeze here.
This crowded and noisy situation made the professors on the bench a little unbearable. Snape took out his wand against his throat and blessed himself with a loud curse, and then spoke.
"Quiet! Everyone will give me back to my seat!"
Snape's deep tone was like thunder under the blessing of the loud curse, and it reverberated continuously in the large exhibition hall.
The noisy large exhibition hall for a while was as if someone had pressed the pause button, and it immediately went out. The little wizards who had surrounded Ivan ran toward their original position at the fastest speed in their lives.
Ivan even saw a Slytherin student who was squeezed and fell to the ground halfway, and he was stepped heavily on his feet, but he climbed up firmly and quickly while crying, even the academy. All of the students behaved like this, which shows that Snape's reputation has long been firmly established.
Snape was very satisfied with this, he turned to see Harry.
"Potter, if you plan to make up some lies to gain some attention, get out of me immediately!"
Harry was trembling with anger. He felt that if he knew the Killing Curse that Hermione said, it would probably hit Snape's face. He hadn't said a word since he came in!
Hermione and Ron were also aggrieved for a while, because they had suffered a lot this time before, so this time they did not choose to stand up and protest loudly.
Ivan had long been used to Snape's poisonous tongue, and even wondered why there was no routine deduction.
Waiting to calm down and taste it carefully, Ivan faintly heard the warning hidden in Snape's words, but didn't know why the dead arrogant attitude reminded them not to disclose any information.
Harry, a reckless man, doesn’t understand at all, he can’t do anything...
No matter what, under Snape's strong pressure, he can finally stop for a while now, and only occasionally hear a few extremely low-pitched whispers around him.
At the same time, Ivan also noticed that the faces of several teaching professors were obviously worried. Only Snape silently sat back in his seat and looked at the corner of the teacher's bench. There is no emotion.
Ivan looked in the direction of Snape's gaze.
The seat representing Chino on the teacher's bench was really empty. Ivan estimated that Chino would never come back after this serious injury.
Because the absent Chino would be 100% as the first suspect in attacking Hagrid, unless Voldemort's brain broke, he wouldn't let Chino fall into the trap, after all, Chino couldn't accept the investigation at all.
What surprised Ivan a little was the giant eagle statue on the stage, where a translucent phoenix glowing with blue light was standing there!
"Is there a blue phoenix?" Harry also noticed this at this time, and couldn't help but lowered his voice and asked quietly.
He thought it was so beautiful, even more beautiful than the phoenix he saw in the principal's office. Just looking at it made Harry's a little irritable mood calm...
"That is the patron saint of Professor Dumbledore!" Ivan said.
Ivan, who has read the original book, is very clear that Dumbledore’s patron saint is different from others and can be used as a medium to convey information. The patron saint is here, which means that Dumbledore’s gaze has been watching here.
This also made Ivan understand why Professor McGonagall hadn’t returned before the other professors had already prepared and gathered all the students in the large exhibition hall.
Obviously, this is the credit of the patron saint...
"Patron saint, what's that?" Harry felt that he had changed back to when he was just in school and didn't know much about it all this day.
"That is the guardian deity summoned by the high-level guardian spell call the guardian, condensing the happy memories of the caster, generally used to deal with dementors..." Ivan said.
Harry opened up and wanted to ask what a dementor was. Before Ivan could say it, Ivan explained it quietly as expected, just to distract other people's attention.
"The dementor is a very dangerous creature. It looks a bit like the death **** of Muggles. Its body is corrupt and cold, and it lives on pleasure..."
Ivanti's mouth really attracted the attention of the little wizards around him. After all, the call to the gods is a high-level curse, and even the senior little wizards may not be able to master it.
Dementor, not to mention, many people have not even heard of it, so they stopped thinking about dragons for a while, and curiously listened to Ivan’s story.
Ivan said that within a few minutes, Professor McGonagall walked out of the side door in the hall, his expression relaxed a bit compared to before, but his brows were still frowning, and several professors also came up to ask about the situation.
Because of the long distance, UU reading www.uukanshu. Com Ivan couldn't hear what they were talking about. When he was guessing, he saw the blue phoenix on the giant eagle statue gradually become illusory and transparent, and finally turned into a light spot and disappeared.
At the same time, the gate of the closed exhibition hall was opened again, and Dumbledore's figure appeared in front of everyone. Unlike the usual humorous appearance, there was a heavy color on his face, which also made him pass through the deans of various universities. When I was at the table, the whispers of the little wizards became much smaller.
Walking up to the stage, Dumbledore's gaze paused for a while on the empty seat representing Chino, then he cleared his throat and said.
"The reason why you are here at this time is because there are important things to announce..."
Dumbledore's eyes swept around, and when he saw the little wizards watching him, no one was escaping, he said again.
"The school's forbidden forest guard, Rubeus Hagrid was attacked by an unknown person while patrolling the forbidden forest this evening. Although there is no life-threatening threat... but we have not found any trace of the assailant for the time being."
"From today onwards, the school is under full martial law. No one is allowed to leave the castle without authorization. I will let the professors who have free time to patrol the castle until the holiday or the murderer is caught!" Dumbledore's tone was serious. Everyone can see that he is not joking.
Ivan looked disappointed. He didn't expect that Dumbledore would not be able to find Kino's trace this time. It would be difficult to find Kino's trace after this time.
The little wizards in the audience started talking in low voices, and Dumbledore had to use a louder voice.
"In addition to these disappointing things, I also need to give extra points to a few people here..."

chapters.title: Chapter 62: He is a man riding on a dragon's back!
chapters.content:
"First of all, Mr. Harry Potter, Mr. Ron Weasley, and Miss Hermione Granger. They discovered the abnormality in the Forbidden Forest in time, and they chose to notify the professor to rush to the rescue and let the school avoid A greater loss..."
Speaking of this, Dumbledore's gaze stayed on Ivan's body. If Harry and them hadn't notified him in time, maybe the Forbidden Forest would no longer exist.
Ivan doesn’t regret it very much. If he doesn’t set the fire, Chino, who was hit by the fire dragon, might be killed again. Then he and Hagrid will be cold if they can’t wait for support...
"For this, I will add twenty points to each of them!" Dumbledore said.
Gryffindor’s long table burst into enthusiastic applause. An increase of sixty points was enough to make Gryffindor College surpass Ravenclaw, which was originally ranked second, and be equal to Slytherin College, which was at the top of the list.
Harry jumped up with excitement, the gloom in his chest swept away, he couldn't help but want to see Snape's expression, want to see how disappointed that face would be. However, he turned his head to find that Snape still had that plain expression on his face, unchanged.
Hermione is still reserved, but the smile on the corner of her mouth reveals her excitement.
Ron raised his head high, this is the first time he has received applause from so many people.
After the applause lasted for a while, Dumbledore continued.
"Then Mr. Ivan Hals! With his dexterity and bravery, he successfully repelled the attacker, allowing Hagrid to be rescued...
I announce that Gryffindor Academy will add another fifty points! "
As soon as Dumbledore finished speaking, the audience fell into a brief silence, countless eyes gathered on Ivan, and even a few professors looked over, their eyes full of incredibility.
Although they are not very clear about what happened in the Forbidden Forest, they heard the roar of the dragon first, and then there was a billowing smoke from the Forbidden Forest. Even Hagrid was attacked. The degree of danger can be seen...
And Dumbledore said very clearly that the attacker was successfully repelled by Ivan, not the professor who rushed to support...
Snap slap...
In the silent exhibition hall, Dumbledore clapped first.
For a moment, thunderous applause erupted from the background...
This time it is not just Gryffindor Academy, except for some jealous people, even the little wizards of the other three academies have applauded.
Because even the proud Slytherins had to pinch their noses and admit that Ivan's behavior this time exceeded their imagination.
It's the second time Ivan saw this battle. Naturally, I didn't feel any excitement. On the contrary, it was a bit strange. Shouldn't I hide these things as much as possible now?
The deafening applause lasted for several minutes before gradually stopping.
Then, all the little wizards in the audience looked at Dumbledore expectantly, should I talk about dragons next?
Unexpectedly, Dumbledore didn't even mention it. Instead, he waved his wand and pointed it in the air, and immediately after four long tables, there were more desserts.
Custard pudding, chocolate cake, corn flakes, crushed almond ice cream...just looking at it is mouth-watering...
"I think you may need to eat some desserts, which will help you calm down the agitated mood." Dumbledore said again after a pause.
"As for the attacker, don't worry too much. I already know his identity. The Ministry of Magic will send someone to investigate in the near future. As long as you stay in the castle honestly, you won't encounter any danger."
Dumbledore's words have always had a magical power, which makes people involuntarily repay their trust. Even the sad color on the faces of the professors on the stage has disappeared a lot.
Ivan didn’t listen to it for half a minute, and started eating dessert on his own. He went to Hagrid’s hut in the afternoon. So many things happened in the middle, and he didn’t even have time for dinner...
Dumbledore planned to leave after speaking. He still has a lot of things to deal with...
But at this moment, on the long table of Gryffindor, someone suddenly spoke.
"Professor, what about the fire dragon? Don't you talk about that?"
The audience was silent, and Dumbledore stopped at this time.
Ivan looked back while eating the cream pudding, to see which warrior had said it.
After seeing people, Ivan was a little stunned. Isn't this the blaster Seamus? Ivan didn't expect him to have such courage...
Under Dumbledore's "kind" gaze, Seamus stood up slightly trembling, but the old principal obviously did not blame him, but explained.
"I must remind you that Hogwarts is not authorized by the Ministry of Magic to raise dragons. As for the dragon's call, it may be a magical effect. As far as I know, there are many ways to do this.
Before I became the principal of Hogwarts, there were some little wizards who liked to do similar pranks. At that time, Filch liked to hang these students in a small dark room. I always persuaded him to treat the children. We have to be more forgiving..."
Dumbledore told his own little story without saying a word and pretended that everyone likes to listen...
Ivan curled his lips, spitting out Dumbledore as always pretending to be crazy.
"But, I saw it with my own eyes." Seamus looked very nervous, but still insisted on speaking. "It's about the size of a house, or maybe it's bigger, with four feet and a pair of wings... and it can breathe fire!"
The little wizards all around laughed. Isn’t this the same as not saying? Every dragon described in the story grows like this.
"I really didn't lie to you just now!" Seamus yelled, blushing.
Ivan suddenly understood that Seamus must have seen Norbert by accident, and then came back to brag with others. Now that Dumbledore denied the existence of the dragon, Seamus naturally stopped doing it and plucked up the courage to retort.
However, Seamer's crude description of Norbert made Ivan a little strange, but after thinking about it, I understood it.
The terrain of Hogwarts Castle is very high. Only at the moment when Norbert swooped down from the sky can he see it directly from the castle. It may be that the distance is too far, so Seamus can't see it very clearly.
After Ivan wanted to understand this, he picked up a glass of iced lemon juice and drank it, wondering curiously how Dumbledore would explain...
Just before Dumbledore could answer, Seamus seemed to have thought of something again.
"I still remember someone riding on the back of that fire dragon..."
"I can't be 100% sure, but I think it might be Hals!" Seamus said loudly.
噗~
Ivan spouted a sip of juice and looked at Seamus depressed. You can see him from such a distance. Don’t call the blasting ghost Seamus, just call the god’s eye Seamus!

chapters.title: Chapter 63: You even believe this, how can I explain it?
chapters.content:
Dumbledore didn't expect this to happen, but after hesitating for a moment, he reacted, and the expression on his face remained unchanged.
"Mr. Seamus Finnigan, I think I have explained it very clearly before. As for why you see this..."
Dumbledore paused, then smiled again. "Maybe you can ask Mr. Hals how he did it."
Dumbledore's voice just fell, everyone's attention was once again concentrated on Ivan, and even several professors cast curious eyes.
Ivan looked dumbfounded. He never thought that the kind-faced old principal in front of him would cheat himself at this moment. He hurriedly cast his eyes to Dumbledore and asked him, but saw the centenarian wink at him. The meaning of those eyes was clearly saying to let him find reasons for himself.
Ivan was depressed for a while. He felt that this must be Dumbledore's revenge for burning the forbidden forest...
Facing the inquisitive gaze of everyone, Ivan had to shrug his shoulders.
"You would believe that a first-year little wizard tamed a dragon and rode it while breathing fire while flying in the sky? This is too ridiculous..."
"We believe it!" George and Fred looked at each other and said in unison.
If it were someone else, they would still doubt it, but Ivan really has this possibility!
Ivan rolled his eyes helplessly, how did he answer this?
Fortunately, Ivan’s explanation won the approval of most of the little wizards.
Indeed, the dragon is one of the top magical creatures!
Adult dragons are usually much larger than a house, and they are grumpy and ferocious. Even professional dragon trainers may not dare to ride on the dragon's back, because this is often regarded as offensive by the fire dragon.
Of course, they didn't know that Norbert was only over a month old, otherwise they would not think so.
Because of the fact that he was riding a dragon and flying by Seamus, Ivan had to eat a few cakes hastily, then said goodbye to many delicacies, and quickly ended the dinner.
Hermione, Harry, and Ron also had the same experience, and they were annoyed to be asked as they knew it.
They didn't stop until they returned to the dormitory and closed the door, but at the same time they accidentally shut out Neville who was in the same dormitory.
"Ivan, what should we do now? Seamus saw Norbert with his own eyes. Should Hagrid be imprisoned in Azkaban?" Harry said worriedly.
Ron nodded, not only that, there are many little wizards in the school who heard Norbert's call, and it is impossible to hide it.
"Don't worry too much. We just need to send Norbert away before the Ministry of Magic comes to inspect. As long as there is no decisive evidence, I believe Professor Dumbledore should be able to handle it." Ivan comforted.
"Then I will write a letter to Charlie. He should be on the way now. I told him to come over tomorrow!" Ron acted immediately, took out an envelope from the drawer, and started to write. .
"Remember not to say too obvious in the letter, and don't even mention the word "Long", so as not to be intercepted halfway." Ivan reminded.
"Okay.. I get it." Ron thought this was too cautious, but he changed it honestly.
After the envelope was sent, Harry and Ron breathed a sigh of relief.
Ivan didn’t worry much from beginning to end. Dumbledore, as the most influential person in the entire wizarding world today, can’t turn up anything at Hogwarts based on just a few rumors and the testimony of a little wizard. The waves come.
After several people had a secret discussion in the dormitory, they remembered that Neville, who was in the same dormitory, was still locked outside by them. When Harry opened the door, the Gryffindor cubs outside the door were early He left, leaving only Neville.
Poor Neville is like a puffed bag. Several buttons on the wizard's robe were torn off when it was crowded before. He obviously didn't know anything.
Ivan was very embarrassed. After apologizing, he used the repair spell to help Neville get the button back.
With so many things happening throughout the day, Harry and Ron couldn't hold them any longer, they almost fell asleep as soon as they touched the bed.
Ivan, after resting in bed for a while, got out of bed again at midnight. For him, there is one most important thing that he has not done.
Before going out, Ivan remembered that the castle would be warned today, so he tried the magic that he learned before but hadn’t used it much—the phantom spell!
"Charm~" Ivan chanted a spell, waved his wand and tapped it on his forehead.
In the dark, Ivan only felt something enveloping his whole body. It was a feeling of coldness as if being soaked in water, a bit like egg white, or a little more viscous than that, but not at all. Affect his breathing and walking.
This is completely two feelings than being in an invisible cloak. There is no sense of alienation and security of being isolated from the world, but it is more convenient without the restrictions of clothes.
Ivan stood in front of the bed and looked at the small mirror hung on the right. The mirror faithfully mapped out the quilt and pillow on the bed. seemed to see through his body.
Night tour of Hogwarts has long been a familiar road for Ivan, especially after having a map of live spots, the paths of Filch and the professors on duty patrolling the castle were avoided by Ivan one by one.
By the way, Ivan also looked it up carefully. Kino's name did not appear in the castle.
Maybe he doesn't dare to come back anymore, right?
Ivan guessed so.
"I need a place to make potions..." Ivan stood on the carpet in front of the responsive house. After walking back and forth three times, he opened the door that appeared and entered the hidden potion storage room.
Compared to the first time I entered, this place is already very different. Nearly one-third of the empty bottles around have been filled with liquids of different colors...
Aging agent...Bone-building medicine...Joy agent...Fireproofing agent...
These potions were made by Ivan using potion materials stolen from Snape. It would be a waste to put them there anyway, so it's better to give him a potion proficiency.
And in the middle of the crucible, he placed the blood fusion potion that he had prepared for a whole semester!
After a long time of precipitation, the chaos in the crucible is no longer the same as ordinary water.
If Ivan hadn't witnessed this change every day, he would have thought that his potion had been secretly replaced.
With a hint of excitement, Ivan took out the two test tubes containing the blood of the magical creature from the pocket of the wizard robe...

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Blood Fusion Ceremony
chapters.content:
The crimson and azure blue blood is also very conspicuous in the night, and you can still see the fluorescence of magical power flowing.
[Magic Item: Dragon Blood
Description: This is the dragon blood extracted from the juvenile Norwegian Ridgeback. Its activity and magic are inferior to that of the adult Norwegian Ridgeback, but it has the same potential...]
[Magic Item: Unicorn Blood
Description: This is the blood extracted from the body of an adult female unicorn. It has extremely large vitality. Drinking it can even save the life of the dying and delay the footsteps of death! But those who prolong their lives will also suffer the curse of life. 】
possessing the blood of two magical creatures at the same time made Ivan a little bit difficult for a while, hesitating which one to add.
There is no doubt that these two are the most top-notch magical creatures, possessing huge magical powers, and the fusion of any one can greatly increase his strength.
"System, can I add two together?" Ivan, who has choice difficulties, asked unwillingly.
However, there was no reply as expected, and Ivan couldn't help but vomit why his system didn't have the legendary system wizard, and he had to explore any function himself.
It is inevitable that the two blood conflicts. Ivan still did not try this act of death. After preparing for so long and finally failing because of greed, he would lose a lot.
Ivan hesitated again and again, and finally chose to use Unicorn Blood.
After all, Noble is really too small. The magic power and activity in the blood are far behind that of adult dragons. Although the potential is the same, who knows how long it will take to develop the potential.
Although there is an unknown curse in the description of the unicorn’s blood, it was drunk directly, and death was delayed accordingly.
As far as he knows, due to the huge vitality in the blood of unicorns, many high-level medical potions need to be used, but I haven't heard of any side effects.
Along with the inflow of blood, the originally transparent liquid in the cauldron was gradually infiltrated into azure blue. Ivan no longer hesitated, and drank the blood fusion potion in one breath.
The smell of the potion tastes a bit bitter, but it is barely acceptable. After drinking, Ivan smashed his mouth, as if it didn’t feel anything...
Just when Ivan was strange, he suddenly felt a piercing itch in his body, and then the blood rushing in his body seemed to boil, accompanied by a rapid increase in magical power in his body.
But Ivan didn't have any joy, on the contrary, he was extremely scared.
Because the magic power that originally lurked in the body was completely out of control under the growth, the huge magic power fluctuations radiated in all directions wantonly...
The bottles and cans placed on the table burst open suddenly, and the tables and chairs were lifted out in the next second during the air shock...
Ivan gritted his teeth, he could clearly perceive that the Fusion Potion was rudely transforming his body. Under the agitation of the magic, his body even showed signs of collapse.
Ivan then remembered that the book "The Origin of Blood" mentioned that the blood fusion ceremony is extremely risky. Most wizards will end up dead or deformed into monsters, otherwise ordinary wizards will not become the mainstream.
Just when Ivan thought his body was about to be torn, he suddenly felt that the world in front of him had changed, the pain in his body gradually disappeared, and the soaring magic power for a time also rose from the huge wave that became a gentle current.
More importantly, his consciousness seemed to spread to every corner of the storage room with the magic power, and everything here was under his control.
Within the scope of magic, he is the omnipotent god!
Ivan realized that in his heart, he tried to float the table that fell on the ground a little, without any movement of casting spells, just a slight movement of his thoughts, and the mahogany round table floated in the air with his mind.
then hit the ceiling all the way...
Ivan’s mouth twitched, he really just wanted to lift it up a little bit.
After one defeat, Ivan was not discouraged at all.
In this peculiar state, Ivan is like a child who has found a new toy, constantly pouring more magic power into the mahogany round table.
After reaching a certain limit, Ivan can clearly perceive everything inside the table, even every wood fiber has been decomposed and developed in his mind...
Perceive the structure of things with magic power...Ivan's mind remembered what Professor McGonagall had said, and at the same time, there was a system reminder of crazy screen swiping.
[Ding, after exploration and practice, your proficiency in the transformation spell has been greatly improved, and it has been upgraded to level four...]
[Ding, after groping, your proficiency in the transformation spell has been greatly improved...]
[ding, passing by...]
...
If I change to normal, Ivan will definitely be very happy, but now there is no mood swing, because he feels that he can do more For example, complete a real biological transformation.
is not the temporary transformation of the nature of the object by the general transformation technique, but the complete transformation of an object into a living creature from the inside!
When Ivan just gave birth to this idea, the original solid wooden round table began to deform and twist. Under the magic of kneading, it changed into a shape like a piece of plasticine, shrunk into a ball, and stretched repeatedly.
The system sounds in his mind began to quickly swipe the screen again. This time Ivan directly blocked these sounds and put all his heart on fabricating animal shapes.
Slowly, the wood fibers were transformed into flesh and blood cells under the influence of magical powers. It didn't take long for "Fox" with golden red feathers and beautiful tail wings to appear in front of Ivan's eyes.
But this "Fox" is not very smart, his eyes are dead, and if it weren't for the occasional shaking of feathers and flapping its wings, Ivan would even wonder if it is alive.
But even so, he personally made a phoenix, or a bird that looks like a phoenix...because it does not possess any magic power, and tears cannot heal injuries...
Ivan even had time to think maliciously, if he secretly replaced it with Fox, could he prostitute a real phoenix for nothing, how long would it take Dumbledore to find out?
Of course, just that, Ivan was not satisfied, he even wanted to inject magic power into this phoenix and turn it into a real magical creature.
Just as Ivan had this thought, a sense of powerlessness suddenly surged in his mind, and the huge magic power that was originally obedient and obedient fell into chaos again...
This caused the phoenix that was hard-created in an instant to be torn apart by the violent magic...

chapters.title: Chapter 65: Magic burst
chapters.content:
A rain of red blood sprinkled around, and flesh and blood feathers were dismembered into pieces and scattered from the air...
Ivan, who had just been freed from that peculiar state, collapsed to the ground feebly. He just omnipotent, now he can't even build a magical barrier, and can only let a few disgusting pieces of meat stick to his face.
After a long rest, Ivan finally recovered, and tried hard again to enter the magical state just now.
But at this time, the radiating magic power had already retracted into his body obediently, no matter how hard Ivan Ivan tried, he couldn't lift an object with a single thought, let alone complete a profound transformation spell.
This kind of experience is like suddenly being beaten back to a mortal from the omnipotent god. It made Ivan extremely uncomfortable.
But recalling the scene just now...
Vaguely, Ivan felt that "she" seemed to have had a similar experience before...
That was when the magical awakening broke out at the age of eight in my memory.
When he was awakened by a nightmare in a small room, the burst of magic power destroyed everything around him, and by the way, he temporarily activated the wood carving he was holding in his arms.
From the beginning to the end of the whole process, he did not wave his wand or chant any spells. It was just because of fear of subconsciously rejecting everything, which caused large-scale destruction. Because of the insecurity induced by fear, the wood carving was activated to protect himself. .
As for why I can do this after the magic burst, Ivan doesn't know, but when I think of Harry's magic burst in the original book, it seems that he can achieve almost what he wants.
includes, but is not limited to, growing hair, turning the teacher’s wig blue, and using mind to make a piece of glass in the zoo disappear.
This means that any little wizard should have a similar experience when magic erupts.
Ivan felt that the sudden increase in magic power led to the second magical explosion, but this time it was more powerful and lasting, and even for unknown reasons, Ivan was able to take the initiative to control it for a short time.
"Is it because of the fusion of potions?" Ivan recalled that many of the materials used to make potions by himself were related to healing magic.
I didn't understand it for the time being, so Ivan put it aside and waited for a chance to study it later.
The blood on his body is sticky, making Ivan feel very sick, and the surrounding area is even more messy, as if he had been ravaged by a storm.
"Clean up~" Ivan drew his wand from his sleeve, first clicked on his clothes, and then started to deal with the mess around.
Under the invisible and invisible magical power fluctuations, everything is as if time has reversed. The cabinets that fell in the corner stand up and return to their original positions, and the tables and chairs crucibles squeezed in the corner return to where they should have been, even on the ground. The contaminated dust and sawdust were also swept away...
Ivan couldn’t help but feel the magic of magic. It’s so convenient. If he organizes such a large potion storage room alone, it may take a few days to finish it.
If it were changed to yesterday, Ivan’s dust removal curse would definitely not reach this level, the magic power had almost doubled and the power of the curse would have been greatly increased.
And after fusing the blood of the unicorn, Ivan felt that his magic wand had become extremely smooth, and the transmission of magic power had almost no obstacles, but instead he had obtained a lot of bonuses.
Of course, even so, the cleansing spell released by Ivan is not omnipotent.
At the very least, the mahogany round table that was turned into a "phoenix" could not be restored. The dismembered pieces of meat, blood, and feathers were only summed up in the corner, and Ivan had to use a flame curse to burn it to ashes.
Many potions spilled on the ground were not recovered because of the explosion of magical power and the bottles were broken, and they all turned into rubbish. Looking at Ivan, I felt distressed. If all these potions were sold, they were worth hundreds of gold gallons, so they were all gone.
Fortunately, Ivan found that there was a bottle of fireproofing agent well preserved, which was more or less a bit of comfort.
After 　　 sorted out, Yifan was in the mood to check the status bar of the system. He was very curious about how much his strength would improve.
【Ivan Hals
Occupation: Blood Wizard
Magic Bar: Fear Curse Level 3 (608/800) Levitating Curse Level 3 (760/800) Transforming Curse Level 4 (1260/1600) Disarming Curse Level 3 (700/800) Dust Curse Level 3 (774/800) Curse Level 3 (774/800)... [The rest is omitted]
Bloodline Magic:? ? ? ? ?
Knowledge Theory: Magic Item Making Level 1 (600/1000) Basic Magic Principle Level 4 (107/1600) Potions Level 4 (1152/1600)
Magic items:
[Magic wand (yew wood, unicorn hair, eleven inches and three-quarters long)
Magic: Medium
Fit: 100%]
【Live Spot Map
Magic: Strong
Description: This is a map that records Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. It can show all the living people in this school of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Unless some special methods are used, no one can escape its detection. 】
【Crescent Moon Pendant
Magic: Strong
Description: This is a magical item made with a lot of precious metals for the bearer to resist a deadly attack, and it will automatically be destroyed when the magic power is exhausted.
Note: Only high-intensity lethal attacks can trigger its effects, and it contains more than magic power...]
......
Academic points: 179]
Ivan looked at the updated system panel, and there were many things on it that were not there before.
First of all, it was a profession. He changed from a wizard to a bloodline wizard. For the time being, Ivan did not know what the difference was.
Secondly, the proficiency of all magic has grown wildly. Ivan suspects that this is related to the kind of strange state he accidentally entered after the magic burst just now.
The Transfiguration Curse not only broke through to level four, but also increased his proficiency by more than a thousand in one fell swoop. Ivan looked at the system's prompt bar, where dozens of screen messages were reserved, most of which were The proficiency of prompting the transformation spell has been greatly improved.
This made Ivan couldn't help but wonder if he hadn't had any transformation magic creatures that he wanted to die just now, would it last longer, and directly raise the transformation spell to level five.
Of course, it would be better to be able to maintain this state forever... Ivan even felt swollen that he could break the wrist with Dumbledore.
恩...Limited to the range covered by magic.
At the end is the extra blood magic column, which Ivan had expected.
According to the record of the "Origin of Blood" found in the forbidden book area, after successfully fusing the blood of a magical creature, you can usually obtain part of the other's talents. For example, a wizard with the blood of Veeva has super Unusual charm.
But Ivan found that there were only five big question marks in the column of Blood Magic, and nothing else was displayed...

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Shut up, I never said that!
chapters.content:
Ivan is very depressed, what about the powerful blood magic? Or is he not taking the medicine in the right posture?
Suddenly, Ivan remembered that when he was taking blood, he seemed to have received a system prompt, but because of the arrival of Professor McGonagall, he had not had time to check it.
After opening 　　, Ivan realized that it was a task.
After reading it, Ivan's expression suddenly became very exciting, and he even wanted to swear.
【Task: Promise of Revenge
Mission Objective: Kill Chino
Mission description: Cecilia is an adult female unicorn, as a free and holy creature cruising in the depths of the vast forbidden forest, until one day is killed by an evil wizard, in Cecilia suffering and suffering In despair, you comforted it and solemnly promised revenge for it in the future.
Note: You need to fulfill your promise and get Cecilia's approval. Before that, it will choose to wait and see instead of helping you. 】
Ivan looked dazed, when did he promise to avenge Cecilia?
He clearly remembered what he said clearly...
[Your enemy will probably not live long anyway... Rest in peace...]
This is just a statement of fact, without any promise... How come it is misinterpreted like this?
Ivan shouted angrily in his head,
system, please get out and explain!
However, there is no indication of the high-cooling system.
"Noble, I shouldn't dislike your blood magic power is too low." Ivan who was inexplicably trapped sighed helplessly, but at this time it was too late to regret it.
There is no blood magic, right? Who knows if there is such a powerful as described in the "Origin of Blood"... Maybe it is actually very weak.
Ivan can only think about the benefits he has gained in his hardships, at least his magic power has been greatly improved, isn't it? Also increased a wave of magic proficiency.
More importantly, there is no punishment for the task released by the system. He can just leave it like that. Maybe Chino will hang up because of his injury in a few days. Is the task automatically completed?
After all, it was calculated in accordance with the causal relationship, and it was indirectly killed by himself.
After sorting out his mood, Ivan retired from the potion storage room and re-entered the training ground through the responsive room.
He needs some time to master his surged strength, so as not to cause irreparable consequences due to misjudgment in actual combat.
When Ivan returned to the dormitory, the sky was already bright. After practicing for a whole night, Ivan found that he was going to class again before he had time to rest.
Dragging his tired body, Ivan was eating breakfast one after another in the large exhibition hall. What made him a little strange was that no matter where he went, there were people watching him.
Ivan at first thought it was yesterday that things were still fermenting, but soon realized that something was wrong, because even Harry and Ron looked a little strange in his eyes.
"What have you been looking at me for?" Ivan finally asked out loudly, unable to bear it.
"I think you seem a little different from yesterday." Ron finally said what he had held in his heart for a long time, and Harry nodded again and again.
They really couldn't understand. They just slept at night and woke up in the morning in the same dormitory. Why did Ivan change so much.
Ivan was terribly scared for a while, wondering if he had become a half-human, half-unicorn monster, and hurriedly tapped an empty plate with a magic wand to transform it into a square mirror, and then took it. Get up and view.
After seeing the face reflected in the mirror, Ivan finally breathed a sigh of relief.
The blond and black pupils are right, but the skin is whiter and tenderer, the blue magical streamer is faintly visible in the eyes, and more importantly, the temperament has changed a lot, and the affinity is involuntarily exuded. It was a bit like a fairy in the legend, even he wanted to get close when he saw it.
"Ivan, your Transfiguration Curse is even stronger." Hermione also sat over with the book at this time, looked at the mirror on the table and sighed, and then said playfully.
"Of course, you are also more beautiful, a little bit taller..."
"If you didn't use beautiful as an adjective, I would be happier." Ivan waved his magic wand to change the mirror back and rolled his eyes.
Ivan has some speculations about his current state. This should be inherited from the unicorn's affinity talent, but I don't know why it is not displayed on the system bar.
Logically speaking, this is a very powerful ability, but Ivan is a headache, because the changes overnight were too sudden and obvious, and he was worried that Dumbledore would see something.
"How did you do it? What potion did you use? Could it be the legendary ecstasy?" Ron asked curiously.
"Who does anyone use ecstasy on themselves? And ecstasy can't achieve this effect at all." Hermione directly rejected Ron's statement, but still looked at Ivan earnestly, obviously she wanted it too. know.
"I don't know, probably because the growth was a little bit faster last night. The age you know is when the growth is faster." Ivan said vaguely.
Ron and others were speechless. It was obvious that everyone was about the same age, so why didn't they see them develop like this?
Ivan saw that they didn't believe it but they didn't explain anything. He didn't intend to expose the blood fusion potion.
The method of collecting materials was not very glamorous. If Snape knew that he had stolen his potion, he would have done nothing.
The success rate of Erlai's blood fusion is not stable, and Yifan is not sure that the potion formula given by the system can be 100% successful, let alone let others try.
Just as a few people were chatting, a strange voice suddenly came over the long table of Slytherin College.
"I think Principal Dumbledore hasn't stayed in the school very long. I sent a letter back yesterday. My father knew that there was a dragon in Hogwarts. He was almost terrified. He told the Minister of Magic overnight. It is said that the investigating officer was this evening. Will be there!"
Ivan quickly turned his head to look over, but saw Malfoy holding a letter in his hand, showing off everywhere.
"Malfoy!" Harry slapped the table, wishing to rush up and punch him twice.
Malfoy also noticed Harry at this time, and the corner of his mouth raised a smile, and said yin and yang weirdly.
"Isn't this Potter? Wait for Principal Dumbledore to leave, no one can protect you."
"I didn't know that Malfoy, your father, was so timid, but he was frightened when he heard that there was a dragon at Hogwarts. You know, according to Seamour, I rode it twice in the sky. Yeah." Ivan said lightly.
Malfoy flushed immediately, and subconsciously wanted to yell at him, but for some reason, Malfoy was always a little bit silent when he saw Ivan's face, instead he wanted to boast a few words.
"My dad is just worried about me!" Malfoy barely squeezed out a word in this twisting entanglement, and then hurried away. He always felt that he was caught by Ivan's charm magic.

chapters.title: Chapter 67: Ron, you are such a clever ghost!
chapters.content:
Malfoy's strange behavior left Harry and the others at a loss.
Ivan understands what's going on. I didn't expect this affinity talent to work so well, but I don't know if it will last forever.
But Ivan was not happy for long, because the bad news from Malfoy made him understand that time is running out.
"What should we do now? The people from the Ministry will come today! Where's Charlie? Hasn't he answered the letter yet?" Harry panicked even more directly, ignoring that it was in the hall, and pressed his voice to ask.
"Not yet, I don't know when Charlie will write." Ron was also a little anxious, and he proposed. "Otherwise we'll hide Norbert secretly."
"But Noble is so big, there is nowhere to hide." Hermione frowned.
"Maybe we can sink it into the lake!" Ron said vowedly. "I mean you can put a bamboo pipe in Norbert's mouth so that it won't drown."
Ivan gave him a weird look.
Ron, you are such a clever ghost!
But Ron is right about one thing, if Charlie can't get there in time, they really want to hide Norbert.
Given Norbert's size, Shenhu is also one of the alternatives.
If Dumbledore can cast a super-large bubble head curse and persuade the fish people to be neighbors with a sleeping dragon for a few days.
Maybe Dumbledore would find it easier to use the Vanishing Curse?
Ivan really wants to complain, and the Aurors who said that they will always rush to the end when the matter is over?
When did the efficiency of the Ministry of Magic become so high?
After eating breakfast in a hurry, Ivan went to today's Defence Against the Dark Arts class with everyone. Although Chino as the teacher suddenly disappeared, they did not receive the news that this class was not needed.
Obviously, there will be other professors temporarily taking over.
Just as Ivan had thought, a familiar figure in a black robe walked out of the door when it was approaching class.
The moment he saw Snape, Harry thought this class must be terrible.
However, no matter how disgusted Harry was, it wouldn't help. Snape went all the way to the podium smoothly, put down the textbook in his hand, glanced across the classroom, paused briefly on Ivan, and then suddenly spoke.
"Since your Professor Chino is considered to be the first suspect in killing unicorns, stealing potions, and attacking the guards of the hunting grounds, the Ministry of Magic has issued an arrest order, and I will temporarily act as an agent until the holiday. Defense against the Dark Arts class in the third grade!"
The sudden revelation caused the little wizards below to blow up the pot.
what? The murderer was Professor Chino? How is this possible?
