Chino has always been a cowardly, good old person image, so that many little wizards can not accept the change of Chino's identity for a while.
How could a person like that be a dark wizard? He was so timid that he was scared and fainted at the Halloween party...
"So, I'm going to teach you the first class of Defense Against the Dark Arts, that is, don't be fooled by the appearance of affairs. Many evil dark wizards are good at weaving lies... You'd better have a few more thoughts." Pu said mercilessly, regardless of whether this would scare the children's young hearts.
Some of the Gryffindors were scared pale, because they used to think Chino was a bully, and they secretly teased him during class, and now they are very worried that Chino will come back to retaliate against them.
Harry, Ron, and Hermione were a little surprised when they heard the news, but they accepted it quickly. After all, they had already noticed something wrong with Chino.
Not to mention Ivan. He always knew what Kino was like, but he was a bit surprised that Dumbledore persuaded the Ministry of Magic so quickly to mark the missing Kino as a murderer. I don’t know if it was Kino. What crucial evidence was found in Nuo’s office.
"Quiet!" The noisy noise in the audience made Snape frown frequently, and directly increased the volume to interrupt the discussion.
"Next, let's take the first class, pick up your books, today we are going to study the contents of Chapter 3 on page 9..." Snape said here, suddenly as if thinking of something. , Went on.
"In addition, I need to inform you that the polymorphism class in the afternoon of the first grade is cancelled..."
Hermione raised her hand high, and wanted to ask why, Snape reprimanded mercilessly.
"Don't ask me the reason, this is not what you need to know!"
......
Ivan was very satisfied with the Defense Against the Dark Arts class this morning, because Snape was more competent as a professor than Chino. At least he was teaching some related knowledge sincerely, not like Chino. Hold the textbook and read it over and over again.
Ivan also learned from Hermione that the affinity talent he exudes seems to be weakening, and is more introverted, at least not as obvious as it was in the morning.
This is good news for Ivan, because the previous talents were powerful, but even Harry and Ron were aware of it. Not only would it not be effective, but it would also easily arouse other people's vigilance.
At noon, another good news came. Ron successfully received a letter from Charlie. It stated that he would come with a few friends at three o’clock in the afternoon to take the dragon away, and Norbert was spared Shenhu may be the fate of being "disappeared".
It happened that the polymorphology class was suspended in the afternoon, allowing them to spare time to send Norbert away.
By the time they arrived at Hagrid’s hut after eating, it was already two o’clock in the afternoon, and Norbert was still sleeping by the fire. He didn’t mean to wake up at all. It should have been Professor McGonagall who had strengthened the magic midway.
Yaya stayed outside the hut and did not dare to go in at all. After seeing Ivan's figure, he immediately swooped over and made a whimper in his mouth, accusing Noble who had taken the house.
Ivan was comforted for a while, and then checked the injury on the tooth leg, where it was bandaged, apparently Madam Pomfrey had already treated it.
Approaching three o'clock exactly, Ivan saw six figures on the horizon flying towards this side riding a broomstick.
"It's Charlie, here he is!" Ron waved his hands excitedly.
After seeing Ron, the few people in the sky quickly descended. The head of the person had fiery red hair, freckles on his face, and his skin was tanned black. At first glance, he was weather-beaten in Romania.
Dragon research is not a simple task. In addition to knowing a lot of dragon knowledge, it is also indispensable to be able to bear hardships and stand hard work. Sometimes it also requires a lot of strength...

chapters.title: Chapter 68: Believe me, Hogwarts never does anything illegal!
chapters.content:
"Hello, I'm Charlie, here are some of my friends who will come to receive the fire dragon." Charlie looked a little fat, and his tone was very enthusiastic. Obviously this Weasley is a good person to get along with.
Ivan was worried that the officials of the Ministry of Magic might arrive early, so after a brief introduction by the two sides, they were taken to Hagrid's hut.
"Who did this? It saves us a lot of time." Charlie was also a little surprised when he saw that he was still asleep while being **** tightly.
Charlie stepped forward and waved his wand confidently to release the Transfiguration Charm that had bound Norbert, but the effect was minimal after several consecutive spells, and he immediately looked at Ivan with an embarrassed face.
"It's Professor McGonagall." Ivan explained.
"Why didn't you say it earlier..." Charlie's mouth twitched, and he hurriedly asked other people to come and help. It took a lot of energy to release the deformation curse that fastened Norbert's limbs.
also awakened Norbert because of his excessive movements, which shocked them. In the end, Ivan calmed Norbert and used a coma spell to make it fall asleep again.
Charlie also praised this, bluntly saying that Ivan has a talent for raising dragons, and asked if Ivan would work with him in Romania after graduation.
Of course, Ivan refused without hesitation. He raised Noble solely for the convenience of blood collection, otherwise he would not have the leisure time to raise a dragon.
Charlie was a little disappointed, but he was not trying to persuade him. Together with others, he put Norbert in a special cage, and kept blessing the Levitation Charm and the Stunning Charm.
The former is to reduce the weight of Norbert to facilitate transportation, and the latter is to prevent Norbert from waking up midway.
After 　　 was done, Charlie didn't stop much, and asked a few friends to ride the broom and lead the cage to the sky.
"Finally it's done." Harry was relieved after sending Norbert away.
"We have to take advantage of this time to erase the traces of Norbert's life." Ivan pointed to the messed up hut, indicating that they still have another job to do.
Although Ivan used the Dust Removal Charm to solve most of the problems, some of them still require them to do it themselves.
After the four people finally finished their work, the sky was already a little darker, and Ivan was about to take them away when I suddenly heard the sound of footsteps coming in front of the door.
......
On the shore of Lake Hogwarts, in front of Hagrid's cabin, Minister of Magic Fudge walked in the forefront, accompanied by Dumbledore and McGonagall, followed by an old woman wearing a pink cardigan with a squirming expression.
"Albus, you should know that I am willing to trust you. After all, you have helped me so much before, but the Ministry of Magic is not my sole responsibility..." Fudge had a false sadness on his face.
"I also assure you that Hogwarts has always acted in accordance with the regulations of the Ministry of Magic and has never done anything illegal." Dumbledore nodded irresponsibly, if it hadn't been for Fudge to let go of his various government affairs. He signed an investigation order as quickly as possible, and rushed here with someone personally, and he almost believed it.
As far as he knows, the efficiency of the Ministry of Magic in dealing with business matters has never been so fast!
Professor McGonagall, who was half a step behind, looked sad. Because she had misestimated Fudge’s reaction speed, she was worried that the children could not deal with it in time. Nor was still in Hagrid’s cabin. It's hard to explain at that time.
"Umbridge..." Fudge stood in front of the door and spoke softly. As the Minister of Magic, he certainly couldn't open the door himself.
"Okay, Minister..."
If the shrill and delicate tone is spoken from a young girl, it will make people feel extremely comfortable, and it will be a bit disgusting to be said by Umbridge.
However, Umbridge did not realize this, pretending to take a wand out of his bag, and point it on the door.
"Alaho Cave is open!"
Umbridge slammed the door open, and Professor McGonagall's heart also hung up. Fudge noticed this keenly, and suddenly became interested.
However, to the disappointment of Fudge and Umbridge, there was nothing they had imagined in the house. It was an ordinary log cabin, even a little shabby.
If it were changed to normal, Fudge would not even come to such a place.
But there is not nothing here, Umbridge's gaze swept towards Ivan and the others who were still in the wooden house.
"Albus, I thought you had let the students stay in the castle honestly." Fudge turned to Dumbledore with interest.
"There are always exceptions, aren't they?" Dumbledore's gaze stayed on Ivan's face for a while, keenly aware of the changes in Ivan's body, but now is not the time to inquire.
"Minister Fudge, hello, I am Ivan Hals, and I am glad to meet you." Ivan leaned slightly politely. Thanks to his affinity and talent, Fudge's favor increased for a while Of course, I too..." Fudge reached out and shook Ivan lightly, then turned to look at the others, and immediately became interested when he saw the iconic scar on Harry’s head. As for Luo in the back. Eun and Hermione were directly ignored by him.
"Potter? Are you Harry Potter?" Fudge stepped forward and stroked Harry's head affectionately, as close as his uncle and nephew.
Harry was very uncomfortable and wanted to avoid it, but Fudge's big hands were not so powerful that he couldn't break free.
"I have to admit that you did a very good thing when you were a kid... a hero, otherwise the Ministry of Magic might lose more manpower..." Fudge said with emotion.
Lost more manpower? Should the Ministry of Magic be destroyed or surrendered? Ivan murmured silently in his heart.
"By the way, what are you guys doing here?" Fudge asked strangely.
Harry and Hermione were a little at a loss, but Ivan didn't panic at all, just pointed to the big dog next to them.
"We are Hagrid's friends, because he was hospitalized, so please let us take care of his teeth, lest he has no one to take care of his wounds or starve to death."
Fudge looked at Ivan’s direction and found that it was a large Mustiff dog with a circle of bandages tied to its legs, and there were traces of blood on it.
Thinking of the investigation report he had read before, Fudge nodded. It was this dog who was guarding him who returned to report when the forest ranger Hagrid encountered an attack that allowed him to be rescued.
Hey.. Who doesn't like a good and loyal dog?
Fudge bent down and wanted to stroke Ya Ya’s head, but the latter didn’t appreciate it. He grinned at him for a while, making Fudge very embarrassed. The dissatisfaction flashed on his face. He didn’t like the one that gnawed at him. dog.

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Ministry of Magic's routine investigation
chapters.content:
Fortunately, Umbridge obviously fits the definition of a good dog. As soon as he came in, he couldn't wait to search in this cabin.
She worked tirelessly to search for any possible traces. From time to time, she used her magic wand to knock on the table and chairs, or used her nails to stick the sheets to see if there were any letters or letters underneath. It's a pity. She can’t find anything she handles very cleanly...
"You guys, if there is nothing else, go back to the castle." Professor McGonagall hinted that they should leave quickly.
Ivan nodded and was about to leave, but Umbridge's voice came over before he left.
"and so on.."
"Minister Fudge, these children happen to be the insiders in the report. I think they should know something?" Umbridge said.
"Umbridge, I remember what happened. Dumbledore has already told you very well. The children don’t know much about it. They just found a clue by accident and came back to inform me." Professor McGonagall frowned. Said.
"But I think there may be something to hide." Umbridge took a few steps forward, her broad, loose-skinned face was close to Ivan and others, and Ron, who was the closest, couldn't help but turn. After a few steps back, Umbridge didn't care, and said with a tired smile.
"As far as we know, someone saw a little wizard riding on a dragon's back yesterday."
"That's what Seamer said. Didn't you ask in school? He is a famous bomber in the school, because he will fail with any spell, so Seamer may want to make up a story so that people can pay attention to him. "Ivan said lightly.
"Then I will ask more." Umbridge's eyes were fixed on Ivan, wanting to see something on his face.
However, Umbridge quickly became disappointed, and Ivan's expression did not change in any way.
"Well, Umbridge, maybe we should go to other places." Fudge said impatiently, he was not interested in wasting time on a story made up by a little wizard.
In fact, Fudge didn't have much interest in the so-called dragon thing at all.
He came here in person, just wanting to see if Dumbledore did any small actions behind his back. It would be great if Dumbledore's reputation could be weakened by this thing.
Although he admitted that when he was seeking the position of Minister of Magic, Dumbledore also helped to do some "tiny" jobs, but since he took the most powerful position in the magic world, Fudge certainly didn't want someone to stay on him. On his head, even speaking is more effective than his own minister!
This is something he absolutely cannot tolerate!
When Fudge first became Minister of Magic, he naively thought that Dumbledore was already old, and would retreat behind the scenes for a few years at most, or would die directly.
But he didn't expect that a whole decade later, Dumbledore was still alive, and mentally better than him. Fudge doubted whether he was waiting for his old age and Dumbledore was still his principal at Hogwarts.
He knows that the personal relationship between the greatest white wizard of this century and Nick Lemay has always been good, and he drank some life-prolonging potions if he could.
"Then I think we can go to the fourth floor of the castle. According to some students, they were warned at the beginning of school that if they don't want to die tragically, they had better stay away from there." Umbridge is not worthy of being a good one. Dogs, new ideas soon came up.
"Okay, let's go there and have a look..." Fudge was interested again.
"Fudge, do you think I would hide a dragon in the corridor of the castle?" Dumbledore, who had been silent, suddenly said.
"Look, I just watched... how could the next dragon be hidden there?" Fudge noticed Dumbledore's eyes under his half-moon glasses, a panic in his heart, but he still pretended to be calm. Looks like, don't want to show timidity in front of the other party.
"I also took you to the scene of the accident. It was an ordinary assault." Dumbledore increased his tone and continued.
"Hagrid was wounded by magic. There are traces of the flame curse in the place where the fire burned. The death of the unicorn was also due to the killing curse... There is no evidence that Hogwarts raised a dragon. , Or violated the regulations of the Ministry of Magic!"
"I know, but this is a routine investigation by the Ministry of Magic!" Fudge felt that his authority had been challenged like never before, and he spoke very hard.
Umbridge took out a search warrant in due course and showed it in front of Dumbledore...
But Dumbledore didn't look at it, he just looked at Fudge so quietly.
In the wooden house that seemed to be a little crowded, there seemed to be a rush of pressure for a while, which made Harry and the others very uncomfortable. They curled up into a ball and clipped their tails. Umbridge wanted to speak but couldn't tell. Words come.
Ivan was quietly in front of his melon-eating crowd, and didn't mean to blend in, because this was entirely Dumbledore's own work, has nothing to do with him.
What surprised him a little was that Dumbledore used the Philosopher’s Stone to fish. The Ministry of Magic did not even know, or that the Ministry of Magic knew very little.
But thinking about Fudge's attitude towards Voldemort's resurrection in the original book, Ivan somewhat understood, Fudge didn't want to believe that Voldemort was still alive, let alone set a trap for such a precious thing as the Philosopher's Stone.
Even if Fudge really agreed to do this, the place where the traps were set would be at the Ministry of Magic, and Fudge himself would bring dozens of Aurors squatting and guarding it.
Harry, Hermione, and Ron did not have the leisurely mood of Ivan. What Fudge said made them a little worried. After all, they knew very well that there was a three-headed dog in the corridor on the fourth floor. They couldn't imagine what Minister Fudge would look like when he saw it. reaction.
The solemn atmosphere lasted for a while, and finally Dumbledore broke the strange atmosphere.
"Of course it is okay for the Ministry of Magic to investigate. There is nothing shameful there." Dumbledore slowed down. After all, Fudge was the Minister of Magic. If he could, he didn't want to get too stiff with the Ministry.
"I also assure you that this is the last place to be searched." Fudge also sighed in relief and voluntarily backed down.
Dumbledore didn't say much, and took the initiative to walk out of the door. His calm and calm appearance made Fudge doubt whether his persistence was right.
But Fudge quickly strengthened his confidence again, because Dumbledore's previous reaction proved that he definitely had something to hide from himself, thinking of this Fudge winked at Umbridge.
Umbridge suddenly understood, and turned around to show a tired smile to Ivan and others.
"You guys should keep up with you, it's best not to let me find out that you are doing little tricks on the road."

chapters.title: Chapter 70: Don't worry, the professor should be able to do it himself
chapters.content:
Ivan nodded indifferently, because he didn't plan to do anything anyway.
Just back to the Hogwarts castle, Dumbledore stopped suddenly and reached out and patted Harry on the shoulder.
"You should go back to the dormitory first, the next thing is not convenient for you to participate."
Fudge nodded, he was here anyway, and he didn't worry that Ivan and others would go to confess the news or something.
After the group separated, Ivan walked in the corridor to the Gryffindor Academy lounge, Harry, Hermione, and Ron all looked worried.
"What if the three-headed dog kept on the fourth floor is discovered by Secretary Fudge? Will Professor Dumbledore be removed?" Harry said.
"Don't worry, the professor can do it by himself." Ivan said confidently. He didn't think Dumbledore was so easy to deal with.
Maybe in the confrontation with Fudge just now, Dumbledore might have a solution, or else he wouldn't be so calm when he came all the way.
"But I think the professor seems to be unable to solve it by himself..." Hermione stopped abruptly and looked at Harry's shoulder.
"What's wrong? Is there anything on my face?" Harry asked strangely.
"It's on the shoulder, there seems to be a word." Ron said blankly.
Ivan looked at the words composed of golden light spots, and the corners of his mouth twitched faintly. He wanted to pretend not to see it, but it was a pity that he was not alone here.
"This must be Professor Dumbledore who just stayed. It says the secret path...fourth floor! Professor Dumbledore asked us to take a shortcut to the fourth floor through the secret path." Hermione said excitedly.
Harry and Ron are also very excited, they think they can do something again.
But where is this secret road?
The three of them were confused and looked at Ivan together. Since it was the message from Dumbledore, it proved that someone must know the secret message.
Ivan wanted to say that he didn't know anything, but considering that he would have to study at Hogwarts for some time in the future, Dumbledore would wear small shoes, so he decided to solve this trouble.
"You better prepare, this secret path is not easy to walk." Ivan sighed. He didn't understand how Dumbledore guessed that he knew these secret paths.
Ivan ran all the way with a few people, and then stopped in a path on the first floor, where there was a statue of a soldier holding a sword.
Ivan stretched out his magic wand and tapped lightly on the wall next to the statue. The soldier's statue suddenly lifted the sword, frightening Ron, and the stone bricks on the back wall were embedded in a narrow passage. It was revealed.
Inside 　　 is a weird space, with walls made of bricks up, down, left and right, extending in all directions. These walls move and derive constantly as if they have life.
At the moment when everyone paused, the space to the left was completely submerged and closed by a huge amount of bricks. Seeing that the standing space was about to be swallowed, Ivan hurriedly pulled Hermione and the others away.
All the way to the right, the terrain went higher and higher, and the retreat behind him was also squeezed by new bricks. Ivan suddenly crashed into a gray wall. Harry almost thought he was crazy from time to time, but Ivan’s body Go straight through the wall.
"Hurry up, this secret door will change!"
Ivan's voice came from the other end, and Harry and the others woke up. This should be similar to the situation on platform nine and three-quarters. Then he stopped hesitating and ran directly into it.
Entering it, Harry felt like he was passing through a wall of water. When Hermione, who was running at the end, was walking through, he clearly felt the pressure around him was gradually increasing, slowly becoming solid, and they were about to change back. The real wall....
Fortunately, Hermione ran out at the last minute. At this time, she touched her back, and it was already a solid wall.
"What if I didn't come out in time just now?" Hermione asked curiously.
"Then we won't see you." Ivan said solemnly.
Hermione was frightened for a while, Harry and Ron were also very frightened. Just as they vowed in their hearts that they would never enter these dangerous secret passages again, they heard Ivan chuckle.
"I mean I won't see you temporarily, you will be teleported to somewhere in the castle."
This is Hogwarts. Of course, these institutions and secret doors are non-lethal. Otherwise, there have been so many little wizards who died in the past, and this school would have been closed long ago.
Hermione glared at Ivan angrily. If it weren’t for the emergency, they would have ganged up and beat him up.
"Where are we?" Harry looked around.
"Of course it is the fourth floor." Ivan and a few people quickly found the forbidden corridor.
The wooden door was still closed, but they all knew that there was a ferocious three-headed dog inside.
"Harry, are you still carrying the music box I gave you?" Ivan turned to look behind him.
"Of course, that's a great gift..." Harry didn't know what Ivan did with this but took it out of his pocket.
"By the way, Hagrid once said that Norway likes to listen to music and will fall asleep as soon as I hear it!" Hermione immediately remembered. Harry and Ron were also excited, so they wouldn't have to deal with three-headed dogs. .
Ivan nodded. With this music box, he doesn't need to use Transfiguration to temporarily get a musical instrument out.
Pushing open the wooden door in the corridor, Ivan signaled Harry to prepare to open the music box, but after entering, he found that the three-headed Norwegian dog was actually asleep with his eyes closed.
But the noise when entering the door is still somewhat affected, Norway's eyelids move slightly, and he will wake up as soon as he sees it.
No need to be prompted, Harry opened the music box when he moved again in Norway, and cheerful Christmas songs resounded in the hallway. After hearing the music in Norway, he fell asleep again.
Everyone was relieved, but facing such a big three-headed dog, they didn't know what to do for a while.
"I mean, let's forget it? How can we get such a big three-headed dog outside." Ron looked at Norway's three big mouths with fangs and swallowed. Spit, he really couldn't think of any way to hide it.
"Isn't there a trapdoor here?" Ivan ignored Ron, but went straight to the trapdoor, opened it, and then used the extension spell to double the trapdoor.
If Ivan’s magical power and spellcasting level had not been greatly improved after completing the fusion ritual, it would have been impossible to complete it.
"Are you going to just throw it down like this?" Hermione was a little worried whether Norway would just fall to death, or make some movement underneath.
"So some other work needs to be done..." Ivan said.

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Let's have some fun with Professor Dumbledore...
chapters.content:
"Fluorescence blinking~"
As Ivan chanted the spell, the dazzling light penetrated the darkness and shone on the devil's net. These light-and-heat-fearing plants immediately took back the outstretched vines.
is about four meters high. After Ivan made a simple judgment, he asked Harry, Ron, and Hermione to help him send Norway down with a Levitation Charm.
Harry also hung the music box on the chain around the neck of Norway, lest it wake up midway.
Norway is so big that even if four people use the Levitation Charm at the same time, it almost can't maintain it. Halfway through, Norway almost wakes up.
Fortunately, the music never stopped. After the last toss, everyone successfully sent Norway down, and the devil net that was dispelled before was also closed again during this time.
"But what about this trapdoor? And the emptiness here must arouse Secretary Fudge's suspicion." Hermione worried.
"Do you have any useless things on your body? I'll dress up here with Transfiguration Charm." Ivan sighed helplessly. He felt like he was almost becoming a professional finishing toucher, and Dumbledore didn't pay any more Jin Jialong gave it to him.
After hearing this, the three of them rummaged in the pockets of the wizard robes, but they really found a lot of small objects.
Ron pulled out a bag of cocoa beans from his pocket, Harry followed with some golden Jialong and silver Sico, Hermione found a few small wooden combs and round mirrors.
The total number is still quite large, especially Ron’s cocoa beans, there can be hundreds of them in a package.
It might be that the level of the Transformation Curse was too low and it was directly seen that Ivan directly refused their help, released it personally and completed the arrangement.
"Well, it's not bad." After it was done, Ivan looked around and nodded in satisfaction.
"Will this be a bit bad?" Harry looked at the hanging objects on the ceiling, suddenly scared.
"Follow it, I think Professor Dumbledore will have a way to explain it!" Ivan said with deep resentment. He is not the kind of person who doesn't fight back after being cheated.
He was thinking of making Dumbledore more fun...
Ivan was a little disappointed, because they didn't have any big objects on them, and it might be impossible for him to make big news.
Just when Ivan was casting a spell, from a distance, I heard Professor McGonagall’s loud voice coming from afar.
"The corridor on the fourth floor is nothing special. Adding a door is just to separate the space."
Now how to do?
Harry did not dare to speak, but hinted with his eyes.
Ivan also didn't expect the people from the Ministry of Magic to come so quickly. He thought that Dumbledore would take Fudge around the school to buy them time.
But fortunately, Professor McGonagall knows to remind them aloud.
"We can jump down. Below is the Devil Net. We just don't resist." Hermione lowered her voice, pointed to the trapdoor, and then jumped down first.
She had already seen the vines of the Devil Net have reclosed. With this as a buffer, there is no need to worry about being thrown to death.
Harry and Ron also gritted their teeth and stomped their feet and jumped down. They could only pray that Norway was still sleeping underneath.
Ivan had no time to stop, and the three of them had already jumped off.
"Actually, I would use the phantom spell..." Ivan murmured silently, using the transformation spell on the trapdoor, and then entered the trapdoor before the transformation spell was completed.
As the trapdoor slowly closed and merged with the floor, the wooden door was pushed open, and Umbridge’s disgusting voice was in the corridor.
"I don't think so, maybe there are secrets hidden in it."
Umbridge walked in with a smile on his face, and just turned his head, the empty corridor seemed to be triggered by some mechanism, and the ghost faces hooked by the string on the ceiling fell one after another. It fell in the air and swayed, or smiled or stared at her hollowly, and one of them happened to be suspended in front of Umbridge's eyes.
"Ah!!!" Umbridge sat down on the ground and let out a shrill cry.
McGonagall suddenly became nervous outside the door, and Dumbledore also thought that Umbridge had discovered Norway, and suddenly felt that he was miscalculating the transfer of Norway to a few children.
With a few little wizards, it is indeed impossible to transfer a three-headed dog in such a short period of time.
But after entering, Dumbledore realized that things were a little different from what he had imagined. Rows of ghost faces in the corridor were hung from the ceiling. Dumbledore was a little bit dumbfounded for a while.
McGonagall was also taken aback for a while, and his eyes were inquiring.
Dumbledore shook his head insignificantly, indicating that he did not know it, and it seemed that Ivan would surprise him differently every time.
"Albus, what the **** is going on?" Fudge looked at the hallway like a haunted house The expression on his face was wonderful, and he looked at Dumbledore with a very strange look.
He had to wonder if Dumbledore was carrying some dangerous black magic on his back. Even Fudge regretted coming to the fourth floor. Shouldn't he be silenced?
You can take a closer look at these ghost faces, Fudge discovered that these don't seem to be black magic items, just ordinary masks.
Dumbledore pondered for a while. He didn't have any preparation for these arrangements of Ivan, but it was obvious that this little trick could not bother him.
In just a few seconds, Dumbledore had a change of Alzheimer's, often forgetting things, and clapped his hands.
"Ah.. I remember. I asked Severus to buy them. I plan to use them on Halloween. If I didn't come and have a look, I would have forgotten them here."
Dumbledore said that he took a mask and put it on. It was a vampire mask with red paint sprayed on the corners of his mouth, which looked a bit like blood.
"It looks good, doesn't it?" Dumbledore said.
Severus?
Professor McGonagall's mouth twitched. Dumbledore's reason was really casual. She didn't believe Snape would do such a thing.
Fudge picked up a mask for Faith and Suspicion and looked at it. It was an exquisitely crafted goblin mask, which seemed to be made of mahogany, and nothing could be seen on the surface.
Umbridge also got up from the ground at this time. She was a little bit irrational when she was acting out in public. She drew her wand out of anger and chanted spells to the ghost faces around her.
"Appears in a hurry~"
A wave of magical ripples stretched along the top of the wand in all directions, and the ghost face hanging in the air shook and made a slight noise...

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Are you going to look at that corridor again?
chapters.content:
Umbridge’s sudden spell was beyond everyone’s expectations.
Professor McGonagall was even more shocked. She had guessed that these ghost faces were mostly made by Ivan using the Transfiguration Curse. If they were cracked on the spot by the Visibility Curse, it would be over.
However, what neither McGonagall nor Fudge had thought of was that the Manifestation Curse was of no use, and the ghost face remained unchanged.
"It's impossible!" Umbridge yelled out of control.
Dumbledore was not too surprised by this result. Just when he came into contact with these masks, he had a rough estimate of the level of Ivan's transformation spell. It is that these wooden ghost surface structures that have been deformed for some reason are very stable, even beyond the level they should be.
Dumbledore didn't know that Ivan accidentally used magic to analyze a mahogany round table during the second magic burst, and he knew the wooden structure very well, otherwise he would not be so surprised.
On the other hand, although Umbridge is a high-ranking official of the Ministry of Magic, he has been busy consolidating power and intrigue over the years, and his casting level is very average. Even with the use of the Manifestation, it is impossible to quickly dissolve the wooden ghost faces transformed by Ivan.
McGonagall was speechless. She remembered that Ivan’s Transfiguration Curse a few days ago was far from reaching this level. If she hadn’t known it was the place where the three-headed dog was, she would have almost thought Snape was it. I really bought a bunch of masks and hung them here.
"Impossible, you must have done something!" Umbridge looked at Dumbledore sharply. She thought that the other party had buried some secrets in advance, and she had nothing to gain.
Her judgment is absolutely impossible to go wrong!
"Are you questioning me?" Dumbledore turned his head, the vampire mask still on his face.
But what frightened Umbridge more was Dumbledore's eyes under the mask, as if he could see her thoroughly. Under the gaze, Umbridge's mind could not help but recalled that it was buried deep in memory. Those sordid things she thought she had forgotten...
Umbridge then remembered that the centenarian in front of him was not the small character he usually faced, but the most prestigious and powerful wizard in the magic world today!
Umbridge's legs trembled, and emotions such as fear, resentment, and anxiety surged into his heart, but he did not dare to say any more.
Dumbledore didn't put much effort on a small role like Umbridge, took off the mask on his face, put it in his arms at will, then turned his head and said to Fudge.
"Fudge, you should have seen everything that should be seen? Everything in Hogwarts conforms to the regulations of the Ministry of Magic! There are no dragons and no dangers. The little wizards studying here are extremely safe..."
"Of course, I saw it." Fudge's face was a little uncertain. He was sure that Dumbledore was hiding something from himself, but he had no way of doing it, so he had to pinch his nose to admit it.
"Umbridge, let's go." Fudge threw the ghost face in his hand aside in disappointment, and said to Umbridge, who was trembling on the side.
"Perhaps you can take a stroll at Hogwarts." Dumbledore joked casually.
"No, the Ministry of Magic still has a lot of government affairs to deal with." Fudge opened the door and walked out with a sullen face, Umbridge followed suit, but he could no longer maintain the greasy smile on his face.
Professor McGonagall walked at the end and closed the opened wooden door. He vaguely saw that the ghost face thrown by Fudge in the corner turned into a small wooden comb in a twist, and the others turned into various small objects, more than a hundred. The flavored beans crashed down.
McGonagall smiled and closed the door with his backhand.
"Wait, what is that sound?" Fudge, who was walking in the front, seemed to hear something vaguely. He turned his head and glanced suspiciously, but could only see that the wooden door was closed.
"Are you going to look at the corridor again? I think you can pick a mask as a souvenir... what about this one?" Dumbledore gestured with the vampire mask out of his arms.
"Forget it..." As soon as he saw the mask, Fudge couldn't help but burst into flames. He thought he could catch Dumbledore's handle here, but he didn't expect that there would be such an inexplicable thing inside.
Dumbledore nodded and put the mask in his arms again, losing his magical support, the vampire mask was twisted and changed back to its original appearance.
That is a small round mirror...
......
On the other side, Ivan who fell from a height did not suffer any harm. Because of the devil net as a buffer, Ivan released a Levitating Charm on himself before falling, and landed in a very stable posture.
But other people are not so lucky. The broken bones are about to fall apart, but they dare not scream because the three-headed Norwegian dog is still here. If you accidentally wake it up , That's it.
"Where is this? Underground secret room? I didn't expect that there is such a place in the castle." Ron looked around, quietly lowered his voice.
"Didn't we guess before? This is the place where Professor Dumbledore placed the Philosopher's Stone. Norway and the Devil's Net should be used to prevent others from invading." Hermione explained softly.
No, the Devil.com was specially designed by Professor Sprout. was designed to prevent you from falling and falling to death... Ivan was silently complaining.
At the same time, Ivan discovered that it was a long passage. The gray stone walls around it were covered with moss and vines. It should not have been temporarily opened up, but a space in Hogwarts itself. Maybe Dumbledore. Lido just remodeled this place a bit.
In order to avoid a conflict with Norway, which might wake up at any time, Ivan had to continue to move forward.
At the end of the corridor is a room. Through the light, you can see that the wooden door has been blown up, and there are circles of key-shaped objects scattered on the ground.
"Someone came first than us... He cast a flame curse first, and then blasted the wooden door!" Hermione knelt down and picked up a key with traces of being burned by the flames.
"It must be Chino!" Ivan's face sank. No wonder the Norwegian three-headed dog was asleep when they came in. Maybe it was a coma curse, or Chino used a transformation curse to make a flute. What.
But judging from the experience of these flying keys, Ivan guessed that it was mostly the former, because the invader seemed to have no intention of playing these level-breaking games at all. It may be very grumpy and even expended a lot of magic to force the level...
shouldn't be because of him?
Ivan thought with a guilty conscience...
It’s just that Ivan doesn’t understand. Where did Chino or Voldemort have the courage to enter Hogwarts again? How did you get in again?
"Let's go and tell Professor Dumbledore!" Harry said anxiously.
But after speaking, the four people realized one thing at the same time. Today, Minister of Magic Fudge visited Hogwarts in person. Dumbledore and McGonagall, as the principal and vice principals, must accompany the whole process. They can’t get away...

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Raging Wizard Chess
chapters.content:
Ivan suddenly realized that Voldemort would choose to steal the Philosopher’s Stone today. As long as he knew some of the secret paths of Hogwarts and sneaked in smoothly, he would have nothing to do with Dumbledore. fear.
From the perspective of Voldemort hiding his Horcrux in the responsive room and finding the Slytherin Secret Chamber, he should have explored the school very deeply, knowing that part of the secret path is normal.
"Then what should we do now? Just here waiting for Kino to steal the Philosopher's Stone?" Ron was desperate, because he was in a dilemma now.
"We must not stay here. When Kino gets the Sorcerer's Stone, we will still face us. Norway may wake up at any time!" Hermione was holding her tan hair depressed and letting her go. No matter how the clever head turned, he couldn't think of a solution.
"Then let's stop Kino from getting the Philosopher's Stone. There are four of us here, and he is only one!" Harry said courageously.
"Kino's strength is not as weak as you think, maybe he is related to the mysterious man...that is, Voldemort." Ivan said lightly.
"Voldemort?" Harry asked in surprise.
Ron and Hermione were so shocked that they couldn't speak. They thought that they were big enough to deal with a professor, but they didn't expect that their opponents had upgraded again, and they were still the rumored Dark Lord.
"Then we have to stop him! Kino wants to get the Sorcerer's Stone, he must be prepared to give it to Voldemort, or resurrect him." After being surprised, Harry quickly said firmly again.
In fact, Ivan’s mind is also in the battle between heaven and man,
Go or not?
If his design is reasonable enough, he may not be able to hit Chino or Voldemort by surprise like before on a dragon-riding rescue, use the protective magic in Harry's body to skip the stage of battle and directly kill Chino.
All he had to do was to use the killing spell to grab the head while Kino was caught by Harry and unable to move.
In this way, you can complete the inexplicable promise task, unlock the blood magic, and have more self-protection strength before returning to Knockdown Alley.
But Ivan would not naively think that everything will go as smoothly as he imagined. If something happens in the middle, he will have to face the final boss in the original.
Even Voldemort, who is so weak that only his soul is left, is extremely dangerous!
"If you want to leave, there are just a few broomsticks here." Harry pointed to the broomstick by the door, and when he learned that Chino was related to Voldemort, he decided to stop it.
"Forget it, it's not that we are willing to let Chino go, Chino will let us go, I don't want to watch out for an enemy in the dark all day." Ivan sighed.
Although Ivan knew very well that Voldemort would not be able to get the Sorcerer's Stone without their intervention, this would not solve the problem. When Voldemort realized that he had been tricked by Dumbledore, he would definitely be more cautious and even more angry. They are in danger when they leave school on holiday.
Hermione and Ron also did not plan to leave. For the Gryffindor lion cubs, the danger is acceptable, but the unacceptable is to let their friends face the danger alone. Besides, their impression of Ricino is nothing. What a clever look.
They should...probably...maybe...can beat him?
Just when Ivan made a decision, the system prompt sounded in his mind.
【Activating new mission...
Mission objective: Loot the Philosopher’s Stone!
task reward: related alchemy knowledge
Mission description: This is a series of tests carefully prepared by the principal of Hogwarts, Dumbledore. Although most of them have been devastated, it should be noted that the difficulty of entering the level has not been reduced. Please enter Be prepared for death. 】
The sudden task reminder made Ivan feel better, which means that as long as he successfully kills Chino this time, he will be able to complete two tasks at once.
The reward is still very generous.
As for the danger, this is something he already knew...
"Let's go." Ivan cleared up his emotions and continued to walk out of the small room. Because the wooden door had been destroyed, they did not need to ride a broom to find the key.
Moving forward, Ivan thought it was just a small challenge to play wizard chess, but he didn't expect to find that it was more like a fierce battlefield when he approached.
A large number of dismembered chess pieces were scattered on the ground. Under the influence of magic, the body was slowly repaired, and the remaining ten intact chess pieces were all looked over.
These stone chess pieces obviously have no faces, let alone eyes, but Ivan unexpectedly feels that he is being stared at by them. Obviously these chess pieces do not rely on eyes to lock the targetIvan soon Just decided that the phantom curse might lose its effect here...
The moment Ivan stepped in, the stone soldiers drew out their knives one after another, the knight with a broken hand got up from the ground, stepped on the horse and clenched the spear, the king raised the scepter high. ..
"Is this going to play the live-action Wizard Flag Battle?"
Looking at the stone chess pieces two or three meters high in front of him, Ron swallowed. Although his wizard's banner is not bad, the live-action version is forgotten.
It's a pity that when they came in, the attack had already begun. The stone soldiers approached with heavy steps, and the only knight rushed towards them on a horse...
"Split!" Ivan threw a split spell, and the forelegs of the stone horse that ran halfway burst open. The knight above fell to the ground like a gourd, and half of his head was shattered.
But the knight still stood up again, and kept adsorbing the scattered stones around him, slowly repairing his injuries.
"They will fix it automatically, how can I fight this?" Harry said silently.
"Try to attack the legs of these stone men and restrict their movements, then bless the iron armor curse and rush over!" Ivan used his magic wand to counter himself, and an invisible magic barrier enveloped his body, which gave him some safety. sense.
Although the iron armor curse is a magic used by wizards to defend and reflect specific spells, it does not mean that the curse does not have physical defense. Its essence is to build a magical barrier around the body, and it also has a certain resistance to physical damage.
"But we don't know the iron armor curse at all!" Ron tried to attack one of the **** soldiers with the leg-locking curse, but it had no effect at all, and he shouted in despair.

chapters.title: Chapter 74: In the 1st grade textbook, there is no iron armor curse at all.
chapters.content:
"So I usually ask you to review and read more books!" Hermione said angrily, but still waved his wand and blessed them both.
But in the first grade textbooks, that was not taught at all!
Harry murmured silently in his heart, and didn't dare to say it out loud, because he and Ron were the only ones who could not curse iron...
"It's now, rush!" After Ivan saw the timing and temporarily restricted a few of the nearest stone soldiers, he rushed forward.
These demonized chess pieces do not move fast, but they are triumphant in a large number, scattered everywhere, even if Ivan is careful to avoid them, they will inevitably encounter a few.
Fortunately, Ivan’s wand is not a decoration. A few suitable obstacle spells and split spells can deal with these troubles and temporarily restrict the movement of these stone chess pieces.
But Harry’s side was more exciting. A stone soldier wielded a large sword and almost slashed on him. Fortunately, the iron armor curse took effect a little bit, making him worthy of relying on awkward rolling and hiding before being hit Past.
The witty Hermione followed Ivan closely from the beginning, so there was no danger along the way, and even had free time to use the obstacle curse to help Ron block the knight's spear attack.
The four rushed all the way out of the magic of the chessboard. The stone chess pieces stopped their attacks, gathered their weapons, and returned to their original positions to be repaired.
Except for Ivan, everyone else was in a cold sweat. The feeling of dancing on the tip of a knife was really thrilling.
Turning around, Ivan realized that he had gone to another place, where there was a small platform, and the front seal was burning with black flames.
The ground around 　　 is inscribed with complex inscriptions. Some characters Ivan have seen in ancient magic literature, but I don’t understand what they mean.
After waiting for Hermione, Ron, and Harry to come in together, purple flames all around suddenly rose up, sealing the entrance and trapping them here.
It seems that the test here has not been destroyed by Chino, Ivan wondered whether it was fortunate or depressed.
Hermione had already looked at a few things on the platform at this time. They were seven transparent glass bottles with liquids of different colors clearly visible. There was a piece of parchment on the front, and Hermione whispered. come out.
Danger is in front of us, safety is behind,
There are two of us who can help you.
Drink them down, one will lead you forward,
Another one sends you back to the original place
...
"This should be logical reasoning! We don't need to use magic to solve it," Hermione said in surprise, and then turned her head to say full of letters as if thinking of something. "Should we come to Bibi to see who can solve it first?"
"Otherwise, forget it?" Ron looked at the long headache riddle, and Harry was thinking hard.
Hermione didn't expect them to answer at all, but looked at Ivan.
"Seven bottles, three poisons, and two wines. The smallest bottle contains potions that can let people pass through the black flames, and the one on the far right allows us to return."
Time is urgent. Ivan is not interested in playing any riddle-guessing game. After confirming that the parchment is the same as he expected, he reveals the content of the riddle.
Hermione couldn't believe it. In her opinion, Ivan just glanced at random. Hermione immediately used the information given by Ivan and combined the content on the parchment to make inverse inferences, and the result was actually correct.
But this is too fast... Hermione thought depressed.
"It would be nice if Harry and I would go together before. You can stay here. It's safe to be protected by flames," Ivan said.
"How can this work? Are you going to leave us behind?" Hermione glared at Ivan angrily.
"There are too few potions in the bottle, it is impossible for us to get in." Ivan pointed to the smallest potion and said.
"I'll go alone, this potion should only be enough for one person to drink!" Harry grabbed the potion bottle, and Harry continued without waiting for their veto.
"Voldemort killed my parents, and I killed him when I was just born. If Voldemort really resurrects, he will definitely not let me go, so I will stop him anyway!"
"And maybe I can beat him a second time!" Harry touched the lightning scar on his forehead, so he was the only one who couldn't hold back!
"Come on, you shouldn't even know how you defeated Voldemort in the first place? I have an idea. If it can be implemented successfully, we should be able to be safe."
Ivan admired his courage, but considering that Kino’s state might have changed drastically because of himself, Ivan couldn’t rest assured that Harry would go in alone. Besides, he still wanted to complete the task...
Harry nodded helplessly. Although he was brazen just now, he actually didn't even have a reliable plan. He just wanted to get into the wave.
Since Ivan said that he already had an idea of ​​opposing the enemy, Harry naturally dispelled the idea of ​​being tough.
"But how do you get in?" Harry wondered.
"I have my own way." Ivan took out a bottle of fireproof potion from the wizard's robe and drank it all at once.
Ivan never thought that this bottle of medicine would be put away by him in the responsive room, and now it can be used just right.
can only say that fate is impermanent...
"What did you drink?" Hermione asked.
"Fireproofing agent, homemade, the effect should be good, it can last for several minutes." Ivan closed his eyes and felt it, his body was cold, but it didn't affect his actions.
"This is obviously not just a person's weight..." Hermione stared at Ivan very dissatisfied sorry, but there is nothing now, I will pay attention next time. "Ivan smiled and turned the bottle in his hand upside down. He drank the fire prevention agent very cleanly, and there was nothing left.
He doesn't want to protect Hermione and Ron by the way when dealing with Chino or Voldemort, so that he will go from fighting a nightmare difficulty dungeon with a strategy to a real hell-level dungeon!
Hermione walked up a few steps, her lips trembled, her fist was clenched, and she wanted to punch Ivan in the face.
But in the end, Hermione still didn't do anything, and suddenly grabbed him.
"Be sure to protect yourself before I come back!" Hermione hugged Ivan tightly, blushing for several seconds before letting go. She felt that Ivan must be unwilling to let herself take risks, so she did it deliberately. of.
But she wouldn’t just wait like that...
Hermione snatched the empty glass bottle in Ivan's hand, ran to the platform as fast as possible, filled half of the potion on the right side, threw the remaining half to Ron, and then took a mouthful of her own. Drink it.
"Quick! Let's go to Professor Dumbledore!" Hermione stared at Ron, and after he drank the potion, he ran out by the collar.
"But what about the stone men outside?" Ron shouted, being dragged along.
Far away, Hermione's angry voice came.
"Of course I used magic to break them all into pieces!"
Hermione didn't even pay attention to the Ministry of Magic's inspection at this time. She planned to drag Professor Dumbledore over as soon as she went out.
Ivan and they are now going to deal with the Dark Lord, what about the Minister of Magic?
Let him die!

chapters.title: Chapter 75: What is the operation of muddling your face with your hands?
chapters.content:
Watching the two disappear into the sea of ​​fire, Ivan opened his mouth to stop it.
Because if you want to go back, you have to go through those violent chess pieces. It's not easy for the four of them to come all the way, let alone Hermione and Ron.
But staying here does not mean absolute safety. It would be nice if he and Harry won, but if they lost, they could not even escape in this closed space facing Chino and Voldemort.
"Let's go." Ivan sighed, he should worry about himself first.
Harry nodded solemnly, and poured the vial of potion down, looking like he was about to die, but with Ivan's company, Harry is still somewhat confident compared to the original.
However, Harry soon discovered that Ivan was chanting some weird spell in the mouth of Ivan next to him. Under the light of the wand, his figure quickly disappeared in front of him.
On the empty platform, except for the tongue of fire rising everywhere, he was left alone.
"Ivan? Are you still there?" Harry suddenly panicked...
"I used the phantom spell, the effect is similar to your invisibility cloak, and it's right next to you now." Ivan's voice rang in his ears.
Harry became calmer now. Although the inability to see Ivan made him a little vain inexplicably, Harry did not let Ivan exit this state and accompany him in.
With this light and dark, they can have more winning percentages.
Even if he would be used as bait in this case, Harry had no objection, because in his opinion, Ivan was different from himself. He did not have to face the responsibilities and obligations of the Dark Lord, but he was involved.
Before stepping into the black flame, Ivan spoke again as if thinking of something.
"After you go in, don’t panic no matter what you see, and don’t immediately clashed. Try to get close to Chino or Voldemort, then restrict his movement, grab his hand, or use your hand to confuse him. Faces are fine, it's better not to give Chino a chance to pull out his wand."
Harry was confused and restricted his movement. He understood. What is the operation that can be used to confuse his face?
Does 　　 block the line of sight?
Harry couldn't figure it out, but he still agreed directly. He wouldn't feel like some old-fashioned wizards, who didn't feel that fighting without magic would compromise their identity as a wizard.
Anyhow, it's over...
Ivan was also a little relieved. As long as Voldemort wanted to get the Philosopher's Stone, he would not immediately attack Harry, and once Harry got in, they would win.
"Redeem the experience card..." Ivan opened his mouth and said silently.
【Ding, redeemed, 100 grade points deducted...】
As the beep sounded, Ivan’s brain speed increased rapidly, and various senses seemed to be much more sensitive.
The opponent is Voldemort, Ivan dare not relax a little bit, as far as possible to improve the state to the limit.
stepped forward a few steps and stepped into the enveloped range of the black flame, and the hot tongue rushed over his face. This weird flame still maintained a very high temperature without any attachments.
Fortunately, the effect of the fire prevention agent is good. A thin water curtain automatically emerges around the body, blocking the flames and high temperature.
Further forward, there is a large room, surrounded by twelve huge supporting pillars, and in the middle is a huge mirror, a wizard dressed in a black robe and a hood to cover himself tightly. He was standing in front of the mirror with his back to them.
Perhaps hearing the movement behind him, the figure in the black robe gradually turned around, Harry's eyes widened, and a chill rushed to his head from the soles of his feet.
Ivan almost couldn't sustain the phantom spell...
What kind of face is that?
'S face was full of pits and pits burned by the fire. There was no good skin from top to bottom, and the white bones on his forehead were clearly visible.
Both eyes have lost the protection of the eyelids and are directly exposed. The most weird thing is this scorched face, which seems to overlap with another illusory snake face, and it is only weird enough to describe it.
Ivan swallowed hard. Although he had guessed that Chino and Voldemort could not be unscathed under his and Norbert's attack, he did not expect Chino to be injured so badly, and the wounds were like this. Still alive...
"Harry... Potter!" A low, hoarse voice came from Kino's burnt mouth, mixed with anger, surprise, and surprise...
"Are you Chino? Or Voldemort? How did your body become like this?" Although Harry's heart was extremely frightened, he quickly calmed down. Following Ivan's previous prompts, he approached Voldemort step by step. .
"You ask me why?" Voldemort's fluctuating emotions became even more angry.
is not Chino's trash!
It took so much effort to solve a unicorn, which caused him not to drink enough blood. Instead, he was hit by a fire dragon that did not know where he came from.
Originally, this attack was barely blocked by his forcible shot It was just a hard fall, but the point was that before he could relax, the hiding place was ignited with a large-scale flame curse. Now, there are several hot dragon breaths in it!
Chino, the idiot, was stunned and stunned, so that the wand was temporarily released. If he hadn't fully taken over the control of the body, he would force the wandless cast to continue for a wave, and then retrieve the wand and escape in time. Gu's body has long been roasted into coke.
What made him even more angry was that he didn't see what the attacker looked like from the beginning to the end. He dared to use the flame curse on a large scale in places like the Forbidden Forest, even if in his Legion of Death Eaters, such a frenzied wizard. Not much...
For Kino, Voldemort had completely lost his patience. After rough repairing the broken body with black magic, he suppressed Kino's own consciousness.
Although this state cannot be maintained for a few days, as long as he can successfully obtain the Philosopher's Stone, he will get back everything he has lost!
Now the key to breaking through Dumbledore’s magic is right in front of his eyes, and Voldemort has been unable to contain the excitement in his heart.
Harry had already closed his mouth at this time. He had already understood that the person in front of him was probably not Chino, but Voldemort. Although he was scared in his heart, he still shook his legs and slowly approached him according to the original plan.
"Yes, come here, that's it... What a pleasant meeting." Voldemort looked at Harry with eager eyes, but his voice turned halfway, as if he had sensed something, his face darkened.
"But before that, it's better to clean up some bugs that have sneaked in..."
Harry's complexion changed, and when Ivan heard this, he rushed towards the bunker beside the stone pillar...

chapters.title: Chapter 76: Ding, your principal Dumbledore is on his way to support
chapters.content:
"Avada Kedavra!"
A green light hit Ivan's original position, and the low and hoarse voice resounded in the hall.
has excellent dynamic vision. Before Voldemort waved his wand, Ivan had already made an evasive action.
I don’t know if it’s because of the fusion of blood. Ivan feels that his physical strength and various physical qualities have increased to a certain extent, and his body seems to be lighter.
Voldemort, who possessed Kino, waved his wand disappointedly and was about to cast the spell again, but at this moment, Harry had already rushed towards his position.
"Get out of the way!" Voldemort, who could not find a good piece of flesh all over his body, was completely unrecognizable, and he kicked Harry out.
If the condition is intact, Voldemort may still be in the mood to play with the two little wizards in front of him, admiring their desperate expressions, but now this body is suffering from severe pain all the time, he has no patience.
The hard-hit Harry lay on the ground and almost vomited out for lunch, clutching his stomach and trying to get up with difficulty, vaguely as if to see Voldemort in the magic mirror of Eris behind Voldemort, the other himself was lying on the ground and directed at him. After blinking, he put a stone-like irregular object into the pocket of the wizard's robe.
Harry felt something hard in the pocket of the wizard's robe. He guessed what it was, but he didn't have time to check it because he had seen Voldemort raise his wand and aimed it at him.
"The flames are raging!" At the critical moment, Ivan, who was slowing down, released a flame curse on Voldemort.
The tongue of flame rising out of thin air surrounded Voldemort, but Ivan as the caster was not happy at all.
Because the development of the matter has been completely out of his control, Ivan is not sure whether he can defeat Voldemort, who is not in good shape, with his current strength.
The flame curse only delayed for less than a second, and a large black mist emerged from Voldemort's broken body, directly extinguishing the rising flame.
And Voldemort's face was even more distorted to the extreme, and he spoke very angry.
"Flame Curse... So it was you!"
Before, he felt that Ivan’s voice seemed a bit familiar, and now he was even more sure that the small wizard in front of him was the one who harmed him so miserably!
"I said it was actually an accident that day, would you believe it?" Ivan said with a guilty conscience.
He was greeted by another green light, and Harry was not well, because the black mist spreading around Voldemort had already poured over him, so fast that he could not escape.
"Ivan then, I'll stop him, you run!" Harry gritted his teeth, threw the Philosopher's Stone in his pocket towards Ivan in the distance, then forced himself to get up, rushing into the black mist and running towards Voldemort as if he was dead. go with.
He knew that Ivan had just drunk a lot of fire prevention potions, and the effect could last a long time. He was the only one among them who could cross the black flames again. With Ivan’s strength, he could definitely easily pass the raging chessboard and put magic Give the stone to Dumbledore to prevent Voldemort from resurrecting...
Ivan subconsciously caught what Harry had thrown over, only to see that it was the Philosopher's Stone after he got it.
When I looked back, Ivan found that Harry had been eroded by the black mist and fainted on the ground. He didn't know his life or death. Voldemort didn't even have the idea of ​​making a knife. His hot eyes stared directly at his hand. The irregular stone inside.
Harry, you actually cheated me!
Ivan was so angry that he wanted to scold his mother, but the most important battle force actually fainted. He was left alone. How could he fight this battle?
At this moment, the system reminder sounded...
【Ding, get the Philosopher’s Stone, the mission to **** the Philosopher’s Stone has been updated...
Mission goal: hold on for five minutes or kill Chino (Voldemort)
task reward: related alchemy knowledge
Task reminder: Your principal Dumbledore is on his way to support, about...it will take five minutes...]
"Go to your uncle's Dumbledore, you will die if you use a teleport to support you!" Ivan finally couldn't help but explode.
Thinking about his hard work these days for the school, Dumbledore actually treated him like this, Ivan said that he really wanted to cry without tears...
Hearing Ivan talking about Dumbledore, Voldemort was taken aback for a while, and even ignored the snatching of the Philosopher’s Stone, looking around fearfully.
But then, Voldemort's face darkened, because he felt that there were no other people around.
And, if Dumbledore was around, he would have died...
"It seems that Dumbledore has not told you that protection magic has been applied within Hogwarts, and no one can use the transformation here." Voldemort laughed at Ivan's ignorance.
Ivan rolled his eyes and felt that Voldemort was very naive, and he would believe Dumbledore's nonsense. No wonder the future will be so miserable.
Is that old bee slicking around and playing around? In the future, this kind of displacement magic will be used in Hogwarts more than once, and it will still teleport with people.
After all, Dumbledore is the principal of Hogwarts and has privileges that no one else has...
"Hand over the Philosopher's Stone!" Voldemort stretched out his dry and charred arm and stepped closer to Ivan who was hiding behind the bunker. The five fingers on his palm only had a thin layer of skin attached to the bones, which looked very It's disgusting.
This broken body made Voldemort unable to run, even walking and moving quickly.
Ivan shook his head resolutely. Without reply, he didn't think that Voldemort would let him go by handing over the Sorcerer's Stone.
"The magic stone is coming!" Voldemort lost the last trace of patience and waved his wand to point at the magic stone in Ivan's hand.
This irregular stone trembled in the palm of Ivan's hand, but to what Ivan expected, the Philosopher's Stone trembled twice and stopped, and did not get out of it.
Voldemort didn't think of this either, but there was excitement immediately, because it showed that the magic power contained in the Philosopher's Stone was far beyond his imagination, otherwise it would be impossible to resist his flying curse at such a close distance.
So relying on the power of the Philosopher’s Stone might really resurrect him!
"The flock of birds!" Ivan did not let Voldemort's short moment of stunned, and under the wave of his wand, the gravel underneath changed into flocks of birds and shot towards Voldemort.
The flocks of birds are just Ivan’s means to restrict Voldemort’s movements, followed by a brilliant purple light...
It's a pity that with the heart-pounding magic flames gushing from the top of Voldemort's wand, the swarms of birds were all turned to ashes under the fierce fire, and the brilliant purple light was also given by the thick black mist around Voldemort. Blocked....

chapters.title: Chapter 77: Offensive and defensive reversal-the shadow of the unicorn!
chapters.content:
In an instant, the fiercely cremated growth snake entrenched around Voldemort rushed towards Ivan.
The power of fierce fire, Ivan, who has read the original work, can be said to be very clear, even the Horcrux can be destroyed, the fireproof potion he drank can't resist such flames.
"Sorcerer's Stone for you, take it!"
When 　　 was about to touch, Ivan suddenly yelled out loud that he was about to throw the magic stone into the mouth of the fiery snake.
"No!" Voldemort's snake face suddenly twisted, and he forcibly changed its direction and hit a side wall.
Ivan glanced at the rapidly melting bricks on the wall, swallowed, and took a peek at the countdown to support, only more than twenty seconds passed.
Ivan felt that five minutes had passed so slowly for the first time, but he still held the magic stone in his hand tighter...
Voldemort saw Ivan’s movements, how could he not know that he was being tricked, and at the same time he was angry, but he did not dare to use the fierce fire curse again, because he was not sure whether the Philosopher’s Stone could survive the fiery fire.
However, Voldemort did not use the fiery spell, and Ivan's situation did not improve at all, because as the master of black magic, Voldemort was not only capable of these kinds of magic.
The only thing that allowed Ivan to persevere was that Voldemort's state was continuously declining. This body belonging to Chino was burned by the flames, not to mention, was also absorbed a lot of vitality. It is a miracle to stand intact. .
It can be said that every time Voldemort casts a spell, he is draining the last bit of vitality of this body. If you run two more steps, you may fall apart immediately...
This is what Ivan wants to see...
"Are you only hiding?" Voldemort yelled anxiously, and once again used a piece of shredded bones, the powerful magic exploded the stone pillar Ivan relied on into two pieces.
Owing to Voldemort’s inconvenience, Ivan jumped up and down in this wide room, using Transfiguration Curse to transform the venue from time to time, or harassing it with flame curse and magic such as all bullets. For a while, it was barely counted. There is back.
Voldemort, who was so angry that his body was about to collapse, finally couldn't help it, and finally no longer had any reservations.
In the distance, Ivan could even clearly see the flesh and blood on Voldemort's burnt face suddenly shrank, and then a large amount of black mist poured out of the broken body and spread towards Ivan.
"There are many obstacles!" Ivan tried to build a magical barrier in front of him, but the black mist was surrounded from all sides, and burning with a flame curse would not have any effect.
Before being completely surrounded, Ivan reluctantly used an iron armor curse on himself, but this layer of defense was breached by the black mist in an instant.
I don't know what these black mists are made of. Ivan feels all kinds of negative emotions flooding into his mind when they are enveloped in the surrounding area. What's worse is that these black mists quickly penetrated into his body through his mouth, nose, and pores.
The biting cold spread all over his body, and Ivan felt that the heat and vitality of his body were all taken away by the black mist, and even the high-speed thinking slowly fell into paralysis.
At this time, the pendant hanging on Ivan’s neck faintly emits a light gleam, allowing him to barely stay awake in the black mist.
It’s just that this protection is not infinite. As time goes by, cracks begin to crack in the middle of the pendant...
The protective power of the 　　 pendant allowed Ivan to survive for a while, and more importantly, Ivan faintly felt a warm current gushing out of his heart, and magical blood gradually flowed throughout his body.
Ivan, whose thinking was stiffened, regained his ability to act, and the dazzling white light from the top of the wand he was holding tightly appeared suddenly, and the black fog surrounding him, in the next instant, seemed to have encountered a natural enemy, gradually dissolving like the first snow in the sky. ..
At the same time, the system prompt sounded in Ivan's mind.
[Ding, task: promised revenge, status has been changed, blood magic is temporarily unlocked, please check in time...]
Ivan, who had just escaped the danger, couldn’t help but take a look at it.
【Task: Promise of Revenge
Mission Objective: Kill Chino
Mission description: Because you are fighting against the enemy, you have temporarily obtained Cecilia’s approval. If you want to retain this power, you need to fulfill your promise as soon as possible.
Note: The Shadow of the Magic Unicorn Bloodline has been unlocked! 】
Several question marks in the bloodline magic column in Ivan Ye’s system have disappeared, replaced by the unicorn shadow flashing blue light!
Under the acceleration of the experience card’s thinking, Ivan mastered the newly acquired abilities in just a few moments. As the wand was swung, more white light and shadow gushed out from the top of the wand, the strands of light were like phantoms and then faintly gathered into one. The look of a unicorn.
It is just like what Ivan saw in the Forbidden Forest, beautiful, arrogant, sacred and inviolable. The only different figure is completely composed of white phantom light and shadow, which is more illusory and ethereal, and the eyes are red Staring straight ahead at Voldemort's figure.
"Blood awakening?" After the black mist was completely dispelled, Voldemort as the caster also fell into a sluggishness.
"No...no, this is not the awakening bloodline..." Voldemort retorted immediately.
Bloodline Awakening refers to some ancient wizard family members with special bloodlines. When their strength breaks through a certain limit, or when they are subjected to major stimulation, they may activate the special bloodlines hidden in the body, combining their own conditions to obtain some magical abilities.
It's just that the power of these bloodlines has been greatly reduced after many iterations. It is hard to say how much power can be improved. It is almost impossible to integrate the power of magical creatures into a certain kind of magic like Ivan!
Not to mention the unparalleled familiarity of the unicorn in front of him. Voldemort was very sure that it was the one that Kino had killed before, and now appeared in front of him in such a state, then there is only one possibility.
The first-year little wizard in front of him has completed the most dangerous blood fusion experiment in the magic world, and successfully survived, stealing part of the opponent's power!
However, Ivan quickly became acquainted with his own power when Voldemort was uncertain. He clearly felt that his vision suddenly divided into two parts, one was seen by his own eyes, and the other was through independence. What the eyes of the horned beast saw, the body controlled by the brain seemed to have become two.
"From now on, offense and defense have reversed..." Ivan said lightly when he looked at Voldemort, who had no good flesh on his face due to the excessive extraction of his vitality.
This is a very magical feeling, and it also brings Ivan's unparalleled confidence. Furthermore, he was chased by a pass before and almost swallowed by the black mist, even a clay figure has a three-point anger!
Now it's finally time to fight back...

chapters.title: Chapter 78: There are so many little tricks I know...
chapters.content:
"Stupid!" Voldemort laughed at Ivan's remarks. He admitted that the little wizard in front of him was able to do this is great, but just relying on this is like making up the gap in strength?
What are you kidding?
Ivan ignored Voldemort's taunt, but tried to control the unicorn and rush towards Voldemort.
The white light and shadow stepped in the air, without the restriction of gravity and body, Cecilia was as fast as a white lightning!
"Ten thousand bullets!" Voldemort held his wand high, and the surrounding large pieces of rubble rose into the air. There were hundreds of them. With the fall of the wand, these stones of various sizes pierced in the air. Sound, shot down towards the front.
is also a shot of ten thousand bullets, in the hands of Voldemort, the power is almost several times that of Ivan!
This is still Voldemort's weakness. So far, when the strength is not one of the ten...
The indiscriminate range of blows allowed Ivan to hide behind the collapsed stone pillar again and concentrate on controlling the shadow of the unicorn.
This white illusory figure does not exist at all. These sharp sharp stones of various sizes pierced straight out of the unicorn’s body, bringing up strands of transparent smoke...
Seeing that his spell was useless, Voldemort waved his wand and placed more than ten magical barriers around his body.
However, these temporary defenses did not play a role at all.
The next moment, this white light and shadow, which looked like an illusion, had already passed through the layers of magical barriers and arrived in front of Voldemort.
Although the previous sharp stones and magic barriers predicted that the unicorn in front of him seemed to be just a false phantom, Voldemort did not dare to relax at all. The thick black mist had already wrapped his body, and the tip of his wand pointed to a bear. Burning fiercely!
However, the fierce fire that can burn everything did not take effect this time. Half of the unicorn's body went straight through. The black mist produced some obstacles, but it was obviously too late...
A pair of hooves fell heavily on Voldemort's body from a virtual blur, and the chest cavity was dented visible to the naked eye. Voldemort's body was knocked out by a huge force in an instant, and it slammed into a distant pillar.
The weird Li Huo was attached at the moment the unicorn's figure manifested. The magical body spread out again and turned into a white streamer, and then gathered again and changed back to its original appearance, as if Li Huo. The curse has no effect on it.
But as the controller, Ivan felt that most of the magic in his body had been emptied in an instant, his head dizzy, and he almost fell to his knees.
also lost the best time to chase...
Waiting for him to slow down and look at the place where Voldemort had fallen, the weird figure has stood up.
The black robe draped on Voldemort's body was now tattered, the robe on top of his head was lifted, revealing the top of his head full of wrinkles without any hair, and the exposed skin can faintly see the burnt. trace.
More importantly, a black mist was constantly seeping from the bare skin, so that the breastbone collapsed, and Voldemort still showed no signs of death.
This life is so hard that Ivan is speechless, this is not dead!
"You **** it!" Being so miserable by a first-year little wizard, Voldemort had already lost his mind at this time. Raising his hand was the most adept Avada Spell!
The dazzling green light penetrated the white light and shadow in front of him until Ivan himself left,
It is a pity that this kind of curse of direction is the best for Ivan to deal with, after all, he only needs to hide behind the bunker again.
It was inevitable that Voldemort would use a wide range of spells to attack indiscriminately, and Ivan controlled the shadow of the unicorn to launch an attack again.
is still the same routine, the unicorn transforms into a galloping light, any magic that Voldemort casts is useless in front of it, only the mysterious black fog can play a certain blocking effect.
Perceiving this, Voldemort also started desperately. The black fog that had originally been used to defend his body all gushed out, faintly forming a long and narrow snake shadow. Under the entanglement, the white light and shadow could not get close for a while.
Seeing that Voldemort was about to take care of himself, Ivan saw that the situation was not good, took out two round irregular objects from the wizard's robe, and threw them forward.
"Fall apart!" Voldemort didn't have the guts to let this thing come close. His backhand was a splitting spell, which exploded the two round objects!
However, what Voldemort did not expect was that after these two things exploded, there was still a yellow viscous liquid in them, like raindrops, which spilled in all directions, partly on the top of his head and clothes.
Voldemort was still worried about whether these liquids would be poisons that can corrode the human body, but he soon discovered that he didn't feel any discomfort on his body.
It’s just that the smell is amazing.. It seems to be... feces?
