Voldemort's brain was stunned He had never encountered such a situation in battle, but what followed was the humiliation of anger!
"Are you just these disgusting little tricks?" Voldemort furiously said, and the black mist snake that contained the shadow of the unicorn almost disintegrated directly.
"I've got a lot of tricks, how about trying this?" Ivan noticed this sharply, and decided to make persistent efforts. The wand was lightened, and the purple light shot out. There was no black mist protection on the hit. Voldemort with limited mobility.
"Fear is coming!"
Voldemort, who was extremely angry, experienced fear in an instant, because he found that his body, which was barely supported by magic, could no longer withstand the heavy pressure. From the palm of his hand, he began to shrink and age, and his skin and bones kept cracking and collapsing... .
"What kind of magic is this?" Voldemort was horrified to find that his immortal soul was beginning to decline...
impossible! How could one's own soul with Horcrux die?
Voldemort soon realized that something was wrong with his state. When he realized this, his fear curse had been lifted, and his body was restored to its original withered appearance...
Seeing that Voldemort broke free of the Fear Curse easily, Ivan was not surprised. In fact, if the Dark Lord’s power declined to the extreme at this moment, the scene he constructed happened to be the death that Voldemort was most unwilling to face. Will not take effect.
But the delay of two or three seconds is enough. The shadow of the unicorn has broken through the black mist, and the spiral horns on its head pierced through the heart, and the tip with scarlet blood pierced out from the back. , Pushing Voldemort all the way towards the fiery wall.

chapters.title: Chapter 79: Is my hand poisonous?
chapters.content:
Since Voldemort cannot be killed by ordinary means, Ivan is ready to give it a try!
He does not signal that the fierce fire that can burn everything and never extinguish can not destroy this body...
"No!" Voldemort was clearly aware of this, and shouted hoarsely, if he was really pushed into the fire, it would be all over.
The body that had been drained of vitality could no longer squeeze a trace of potential. Voldemort had to use one hand for the price of a certain amount of self-protection.
As the left arm exploded suddenly and the flesh and blood was swallowed by magic, more black mist emerged from Voldemort's body, corroding the shadow of the unicorn made of magic...
This is a contest between magic power and time. Although Ivan nearly doubled his magic power after completing the fusion ritual, it was only doubled compared to the little wizard. The magic power was consumed early in several large-scale consumptions. It can't be too much to squander.
Voldemort’s situation was also half-hearted, a hole was opened in his chest, several ribs were broken, not to mention, it was so miserable that he needed to destroy an arm to maintain the scale of the black mist.
It’s fortunate that it’s Chino’s body. Voldemort doesn’t feel distressed at all when he uses it...but he’s still constantly being approached by the unicorn against the burning wall against his chest. Death is only a matter of time...
Under such a stalemate, it was Ivan who was the first to be able to hold on. The repeated adjustments of magic power made his brain groggy, and the cells of his body warned him, if not for the speeding operation of the experience card. Mode, I am afraid I have fainted a long time ago.
After barely maintaining for a while, the unicorn made up of white light and shadow gradually dissipated, and had to rely on the last few strengths to overturn the opponent, causing Voldemort to be hit on the Eris mirror not far away, even with a wand in his hand. Fall aside.
But Voldemort laughed, because he could even clearly see the unwilling color in the red pupils before the shadow of the unicorn dissipated.
"Hahahaha... or I won!"
Voldemort stood up with his only hand propped on his body, picked up the wand on the ground, on his rotten body, two overlapping faces split the corners of his mouth at the same time, and the grim laughter echoed in the wide space. Inside..
just smiled and laughed, Voldemort couldn't laugh, because he found that there was no despair or loss on the face of Ivan opposite...
"Harry, don't pretend to be dead, get me up and muddle his face!" Ivan yelled at Harry who was lying down not far from Voldemort, closing his eyes tightly, like a corpse.
In the previous stalemate, when Ivan's magic power was about to be exhausted, he keenly noticed that Harry's body seemed to have moved, so he immediately changed his thoughts of competing with Voldemort's magic power consumption.
Because Ivan knew very well that the black mist might kill him, but it would never kill Harry!
In Voldemort's incredulous gaze, Harry Potter, who should have been dead in his cognition, jumped up from the ground and leaped towards him!
In fact, Harry didn't lie on the ground pretending to be dead as Ivan thought, but just couldn't move his whole body before.
After inhaling a large amount of black mist, Harry thought he was dead, and his consciousness fell into a brief coma, but there seemed to be some power in his body to protect him and resist the black mist all the time.
It wasn't until Voldemort recovered all the black mist and concentrated on dealing with Ivan that the power to protect him gradually allowed him to regain certain consciousness and mobility, but his body was still a little numb, and he didn't even open his eyes much. open.
But Harry knew very well in his heart that the battle had reached the most critical time, so he didn't care about his physical weakness, forcibly got up and pressed his hands on Voldemort's grotesque snake face according to Ivan's orders!
The withered snake face felt like a rag with some slippery yellow liquid on it...
The sizzling noise spread from the place where Harry’s palm touched. Voldemort let out a painful wailing. The skin on his face seemed to have been scalded by a soldering iron. It was peeled off piece by piece, and he forcefully pulled Harry away. Kicked to the ground, but couldn't stop the body from collapsing...
Harry sat down on the ground, staring blankly at Voldemort's misery, and at the same time looked at his hands in disbelief. He just stepped forward and touched it twice...
Is my hand poisonous...
Harry wondered whether he was happy or depressed...
"Bone to pieces!" Ivan mobilized the last trace of magic, and aimed his wand at Voldemort's gradual collapse...
Sorry, this head belongs to me!
Seeing Voldemort's body burst open, turning into powder and floating in the air, Ivan listened to the system sound in the mind of the listener, and fell to the ground with satisfaction, without a trace of strength...
Voldemort's black soul rushed out of the body turned into dust in the roar, and swept away in the direction of Ivan.
But before touching it, the illusory soul suddenly changed its direction and rushed out of this room.
The next moment, the quiet blue phoenix flew in over the black flames at the door, and a soothing blue gleam bloomed all over the body, wandering and wandering in this room continuously...
Seeing this phoenix, Ivan's heart that had been holding it was finally let go, but I still couldn't help but want to curse...
Dumbledore, you came really in time...
There was a bit of scolding in his heart, but after the spirit was relaxed, all kinds of tired emotions also surged into his heart, Ivan held it hard for a while, and finally fell asleep.
Just as Ivan lost consciousness, Dumbledore's voice slowly sounded at the entrance.
"All curses are over!"
The black flame blocking the door gradually extinguished, and this magical power even spread to the large interior room.
is a fierce fire that will never go out, and under this kind of power, the fate of disappearing is unavoidable.
"Professor! Quick! Ivan and Harry are inside..." Hermione couldn't bear to rush in when the black flame went out.
Of course, the little witch did not forget to pull Dumbledore by the sleeve and pull him in, while Ron followed behind panting.
The three of them walked into this spacious room, and immediately saw the dilapidated scene inside..
Most of the twelve columns used to support the room were broken, large pieces of rubble were scattered on the ground, and the surrounding walls were scorched and dilapidated. The pits and pits were all traces of damage by powerful curses. A strong smell.
Fighting like this, even Dumbledore did not expect that even though he had seen it through the patron saint before coming in, he still felt a little shocked to see this scene with his own eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 80: We still don’t know where the mysterious man was hiding that day...
chapters.content:
Hermione and Ron, not to mention, seeing this scene, they even thought that Ivan and Harry had died heroically...
After all, this kind of battle is not something that two first-year little wizards can take.
"Ivan... Harry!" Hermione saw the two people lying on the ground who didn't know their life or death with sharp eyes, tears welled up in her eyes.
"Don't worry, they're fine. Harry suffered some minor injuries, and Hals just fainted after his magic was exhausted." Dumbledore stepped forward to check, and then he reminded.
What happened today is really beyond his expectations. Dumbledore did not expect Voldemort to sneak in while the Ministry of Magic came to inspect.
It wasn't until the little magic he applied on the Philosopher's Stone was touched that he learned that fighting broke out there, but it was a pity that Fudge was still in Hogwarts at that time, so Dumbledore had to spend some time to settle the power of greed Idiot.
Walking all the way to the Mirror of Eris, Dumbledore looked at the broken wizard's robe that had fallen on the ground, gently lifted it with his wand, and the remaining ashes underneath gradually disappeared in the wind.
"Professor, where's Chino?" Ron looked around and didn't see the enemy in this room, so he asked immediately.
"Isn't that what you saw just now?" Dumbledore squinted at Ron.
Ron shuddered when he thought of the ashes. He couldn't think of what kind of magic could cause such terrifying consequences.
Dumbledore knew that this was the effect of the guardian charm inside Harry. It was the same as he had originally expected, but...
Dumbledore glanced around at the scene where the surroundings were completely destroyed, and the battle in the middle might be beyond his expectation.
Just as Dumbledore was about to put down the wizard robe, he faintly smelled something, approached his nose and smelled it on the wizard robe, and Bubo Furui's face suddenly became very exciting.
Where did Voldemort hide during his disappearance?
Why is there a smell of feces on the clothes?
Dumbledore was thoughtful, no wonder he couldn't find him...
Hermione would have ran to Ivan's. Although Dumbledore had said that Ivan and Harry were not dangerous, Hermione couldn't help but be a little worried.
Noting Ivan's pale face and the scars on her body from the gravel, Hermione was very upset, if only she could move faster.
In fact, Hermione didn’t know that if she hadn’t dragged her sleeves all the way, Dumbledore could have run faster...
"Okay, let's go back now. We'd better send them to Madam Pomfrey quickly." Dumbledore waved his wand and lifted the bodies of Ivan and Harry with the Levitating Charm.
......
Hogwarts, the bed in the school hospital,
Ivan opened his eyes tiredly, and there was a white ceiling in front of him. The white sheets covered him seemed familiar, and he almost made him think that he had crossed back.
Fortunately, the ancient decoration style around and the smell of all kinds of weird potions remind him that this is in the Hogwarts school hospital.
clutched his groggy head and sat up, as if it was the feeling of waking up the next day after a hangover. Ivan decided that no matter what happened next time, he could not squander the magic again. This experience was really uncomfortable.
Ivan looked around, and the table beside him was piled with various gifts, most of which were small gifts such as candies, but there were also small cards with words such as blessings.
Harry was not seen on the bed next to 　　, maybe he was discharged from the hospital before he woke up.
"So, how long have I slept?" Ivan felt that his stomach was empty. If a whole roasted lamb was placed in front of him, he would surely be able to eat it all.
"No, where's my Philosopher's Stone?" Ivan searched all over but couldn't find it, his face drooped.
It was definitely Dumbledore who took the Philosopher's Stone that he had so hard to grab while he was in a coma.
This made Ivan a little worried about whether his task was considered complete, so he hurriedly opened the task list of the system and looked at it.
He remembered that he should have grabbed the head...
【Task: Promise of Revenge
Mission objective: Kill Chino (completed)
Mission description: Your trustworthy behavior has gained Cecilia's favor and trust. Although it is a pity that you have not witnessed the death of the enemy with your own eyes, it is still willing to fight for you... if you know how to call it. ...]
[Task: Loot the Philosopher’s Stone
Mission goal: hold on for five minutes or kill Chino (completed)
Task reward: related alchemy knowledge (whether to receive it)
Task description: In addition to those crappy levels, you turned the tide of the battle with luck and shameless tactics in the final asymmetrical battle. Although the process is not commendable, you still achieved an epic victory! 】
Seeing that both missions have been completed, Ivan breathed a sigh of relief. It seems that the loss of the Philosopher’s Stone will not affect the outcome of the mission.
However, the description of the task of snatching the Philosopher’s Stone made Ivan quite depressed What is the tactic of relying on luck and shame?
That is the result of wisdom and courage!
Ivan looked at the task description very dissatisfied. If he hadn't used various tactics to anger Voldemort and made Voldemort lose his mind during the battle, then in the final magic power competition, he would definitely die.
Receive award...
Ivan said silently in his heart. The next moment, a huge amount of knowledge poured into his mind. After Ivan sorted it out for a while, he discovered that the so-called related knowledge in the task reward refers to the method of refining the magic stone.
It seems that the task of sticking for five minutes may not only be related to Dumbledore's support, but it may also take some time for the system to analyze the Sorcerer's Stone.
But with this reward, Ivan didn't know for a moment whether he should be happy or depressed.
On the one hand, the Philosopher’s Stone is the omnipotent sage’s stone in the legend. The only known abilities are the two terrifying abilities of refining immortal potions and turning stones into gold. Holding it is equivalent to having an endless life and wealth.
But judging from the information he got in his mind, in order to refine the Philosopher's Stone, in addition to all kinds of precious materials, alchemy also needs to be upgraded to at least level 7.
As for now, Ivan looked at the alchemy in the magic knowledge column in the system, and it was only level two. With urinary **** that doubles the proficiency required for each level, it would be an extremely long time to reach level seven. The process cannot be done in a short time.
While the magic item making disappeared from the system bar, Ivan guessed that it might have been merged into alchemy. After all, making magic items is an important branch of alchemy.
I just don’t know how to improve my proficiency with this alchemy...

chapters.title: Chapter 81: Professor, where did you hide my Philosopher’s Stone?
chapters.content:
While Ivan was thinking hard, a gentle female voice rang in the room.
"I suggest you lie down in bed for a while when you first wake up, and it is best not to move."
Ivan turned his head and looked over, but saw Madam Pomfrey coming from the other side. The expression on her face was serious, and she was holding a big bowl in her hand, and she brought it to Ivan.
"Come on, drink this potion first."
Ivan looked at the gray-black in front of him, and there was still some unidentified muddy soup on it, with a bitter face, but still obediently picked up the potion and drank it.
The potions of the wizarding world don’t taste bad at all. This may be related to the strange potions materials...
"Soothe the nerves... Four-leaf clover... Rat plum..."
With up to level four knowledge of potions, Ivan quickly distinguished most of the medicinal materials contained in this gray-black soup.
is to speed up the recovery of magic power and calm the nerves...
"Well, that's right, it's basically the same, except that the tail wing of the black bat and a little snail slime are omitted. Unfortunately, I am not a teaching professor, but I can't give you extra points!" Madam Pomfrey did not expect Ivan's potion level It's so high, although I can't recognize them all, but it's already pretty good.
Hearing that there was something like snail mucus in the material, Ivan’s face changed and he almost vomited the medicine he had drunk...
This is disgusting...
"You will need to rest for a few days, so you need to drink twice a day." Madam Pomfrey said to herself as if she didn't see Ivan's uncomfortable expression.
"In addition, how did you exhaust all the magic in your body?" Madam Pomfrey looked at Ivan very dissatisfied. "Fortunately, it was timely when Albus sent you over, otherwise you might be a dumb gun in the future."
"Such a serious problem? There are no sequelae, right?" At this time, Yifan didn't care about the nausea of ​​the potion, so he hurriedly asked.
"Not this time, but I hope this kind of thing won't happen a second time!" Madam Pomfrey said seriously.
Ivan nodded frequently like a chicken pecking at the rice.
Although I don't know if this is Madam Pomfrey's exaggerated statement, it is still true, anyway, he has no guts to try a second time.
In fact, if he hadn't forcibly grabbed the head before, he wouldn't have drained all the magic power.
After Mrs. Pomfrey talked about a lot of precautions, she asked Ivan Dodo to rest, then took the empty bowl away, and before leaving, she was still mumbling about how he was in safe Hogwarts. Make it like this.
Safety?
Ivan’s mouth twitched a few times. Over the past semester, he has seen or dealt with giant monsters, fire dragons, unicorns, and even the Dark Lord at Hogwarts. Can this be called security?
How dangerous are other places?
Ivan kept complaining in his mind, the door of the school hospital was pushed open again, and the person here was Dumbledore.
The old principal was wearing a conspicuous purple magic robe today, with a crimson scarf tied around his neck, and he seemed to be in a good mood. After a few conversations with Madam Pomfrey at the door, he walked towards Ivan. .
Ivan once again started Occlumency, and spent a hundred academic points to redeem the experience card mode. There is no way that he is so persuaded..
Who made his Occlumency level too low...
However, Dumbledore did not come up as a profound conversation like Ivan had imagined. Instead, he gently tapped the long table next to him with his magic wand and expanded it to form a semicircular dining table.
The snacks and cards on it seemed to be activated, and they leaned against the wall and stacked themselves up, vacating the large area.
Ivan was very jealous when he cast such a spell-free spell, he didn't know how long it would take him to do it.
"Even though Mrs. Pomfrey thinks you should eat something light, I still think you need to ask your opinion first, how about it? Would you like something to eat?" Dumbledore is elegantly like the order of a fine dining restaurant. The diners are average.
"Here is a roasted whole lamb, put more cumin...more pepper...thank you!" Yifan said.
Dumbledore's figure paused, and he intentionally said that it was too greasy, but considering that his words were released, he had no choice but to wave his magic wand to realize Ivan's expectations.
A whole roasted golden lamb appeared on the extended long table, sprinkled with cumin, spring onion, pepper and a little sesame seeds, and next to it was thoughtful with corn flakes and apple pie. Kind of lighter foods, drinks such as lemon juice.
"Since you have been in a coma for two days, I think you'd better eat something else to cushion your belly first, or else you'll break your belly, and Mrs. Pomfrey will never let me in again next time." Dumbledore walked away Stepping forward to sit on the side of the bed, he said helplessly.
was in a coma for two days? Then why haven't I starved to death?
Ivan had this idea in his mind, but quickly threw it aside.
After being hungry for so long, Ivan casually ate a few pieces of apple pie, drank some lemon juice, and then took a knife and fork to cut a piece of lamb and put it in his mouth.
I have to say that the house elves at Hogwarts are really good at craftsmanship. The skin of the lamb is roasted until it is browned and crispy, but the meat inside is extremely tender. The taste of the seasoning seems to penetrate into the meat and dispel the lamb. The smell of itself...
If this kind of cooking is also a kind of magic, then he must learn how to do it.
Dumbledore sat quietly, watching Ivan's unimaginative feasting with interest, and from time to time Ivan refilled his glass after Ivan drank the lemon juice.
Maybe he was too hungry. In about half an hour, Ivan swept away all the food on the table, leaving only a messy dinner plate. He hiccups satisfied and rests comfortably on the pillow.
Dumbledore did the cleaning job again, swiping his wand swept the plate away, and then returned the table where the extension spell was cast back to its original state.
Ivan then remembered that Dumbledore was unlikely to have come to deliver him food, and he became nervous inexplicably.
But Ivan knew very well that Dumbledore could not be given a chance to ask questions first, so he asked first. .
"Professor, where's my Philosopher's Stone? I finally snatched it from the snake-faced wizard. Did you put it away?"
Ivan looked at Dumbledore expectantly, his eyes clearly saying,
When do you plan to return the Philosopher’s Stone to me?
Dumbledore's expression took a while, and then looked at Ivan dumbfoundingly. When did the Philosopher's Stone become his?

chapters.title: Chapter 82: I didn't expect you to be such a professor...
chapters.content:
"The Sorcerer's Stone belongs to my good friend Nico LeMay. He had previously received news that Voldemort might be thinking about it, so he asked me to protect it.
For this, I brought the Philosopher’s Stone to the school and put it in the Eris Mirror. "
Dumbledore had to explain to Ivan the origin of the Philosopher's Stone, lest he still worry about asking for the Philosopher's Stone.
At the same time, Dumbledore also explained the destruction of the Philosopher’s Stone with Nicol Lemay’s consent, in order to stifle Ivan’s unrealistic ideas.
Even though I knew the result for a long time, Ivan still felt a little pity.
When I was reading in the previous life, I didn’t think the Philosopher’s Stone was so great. Now that I really face it, Ivan knows how much temptation of endless wealth and endless life is to a person.
This is the ultimate dream of most people!
Dumbledore saw the disappointment in Ivan's eyes, so he had to remind him.
"It may be difficult for a little wizard like you to understand, but there are many things in the world that are more precious than wealth and longevity. For example, the courage to pay for a friend’s danger, or the wisdom shown in times of crisis, these things are A real treasure.
In contrast, the power of the Philosopher’s Stone is powerful, and it is not unlimited, just like we can’t create things out of thin air. "
Dumbledore’s blue eyes under his half-moon glasses stared straight at Ivan, and he saw many rare qualities from Ivan’s recent deeds.
He has seen too many talented wizards, obsessed with power, wealth, power, immortality, such as Grindelwald, Tom Riddle...
Even...when I was young, I was no exception.
Had it not been for Ariana’s death to wake him up in time, I am afraid that the wizarding world would have been at war with the Muggles under the joint control of him and Grindelwald...
Ivan nodded inconspicuously. Although he did not pursue immortality and strength like Voldemort, he would not despise these things like Dumbledore.
Even if the Philosopher’s Stone has any limitations or sequelae, it is not concealed. You must know that Nicole Lemay lived more than 600 years old!
Fortunately, he has now obtained the method of making the Philosopher's Stone. Perhaps N years later, as the level of alchemy increases, he can also have his own Philosopher's Stone.
Because of this, Ivan quickly cleared up his emotions, which was also seen by Dumbledore, which made him very satisfied, so he planned to say something happy.
"You and Harry defeated Chino in the secret room. I don't know who passed it out. I'm afraid this incident will spread throughout the school in a few days.
And your behavior has also allowed Gryffindor to get the highest school score in the history of the school, which is nearly double the second place Slytherin College! It's a pity that you fainted at the time, and you were not there, otherwise you must be able to see how surprised the little wizards were..."
Ivan rolled his eyes, besides bonus points, can he give something more real?
Besides you, who else can get the news?
Ivan is well aware of Dumbledore's act of granting Harry prestige, so he can add dozens or hundreds of points without blinking, and this time he just brought him with him.
"Well, when we're happy, we should talk about something else," Dumbledore changed the subject with a smile.
"You know, two days ago, Miss Granger and Mr. Weasley suddenly ran up to me out of breath and asked me to go under the trapdoor to rescue you and Harry. I was almost terrified.
Fortunately, after I arrived, you were very safe and defeated Voldemort who was possessed by Chino..."
"That's Harry's credit, Professor! After he touched Voldemort, the opponent's body collapsed." Ivan didn't mean to take credit for anything, and tried to reduce his sense of existence as much as possible.
"Of course, I know, that's the protective magic in Harry's body, that's the power of love!" Dumbledore nodded, of course he knew what was going on after seeing the scene, but that was not what he wanted to ask.
"But I'm even more curious about how you alone held Voldemort for so long. I learned some information from Harry, but it's not thorough enough," Dumbledore said.
Although Voldemort was so weak that only his soul was left, and he was manipulating a broken body, it was definitely not something a first-grade wizard could contend with.
In addition, he was also very interested in the changes that suddenly happened to Ivan two days ago.
Ivan wanted to ask Dumbledore what the **** did Harry tell him, and think about how to make up next...
But it seems that Ivan knew that Dumbledore, the old slicker, would definitely not tell him, only confessed part of the information.
Ivan sighed, found out what he could say, and then organized the language.
"Professor, have you ever experienced the feeling of being able to cast all kinds of spells without a wand and no spells without a magic wand, as if within the scope of magical power?"
"Do you mean this?" Dumbledore thought for a while, and placed his empty left hand lightly on top of a white porcelain cup.
Without seeing any movement from him, the cup suddenly twisted and stretched. A few seconds later, an owl with white feathers appeared in front of Ivan's eyes.
The eyes of this owl are very smart. After discovering that he suddenly appeared in a strange place, he wanted to fly out of the school hospital in horror, but hit the glass with one head and fell straight to the ground, shaking his wings from time to time.
Ivan was speechless, he could see that this was probably not an ordinary transformation spell, otherwise, when the owl hits the glass, it will turn back into a cup and be broken into pieces.
Dumbledore’s hand is slightly different from the situation where he cast a transformation spell at a distance when the magic power bursts, but the principle is the same.
also didn't wield a magic wand or chant a spell. He could complete a high-end biological transformation only with magic power.
Fortunately, he still wondered if he could challenge Dumbledore in such a magical state, but he didn't expect that the other party would also do it. Now thinking about it, it was too bloated...
"These are just small tricks, and they don't have much effect in actual combat." Dumbledore explained Ivan's surprised expression lightly.
This is also called a trick?
Ivan did not expect that Professor Dumbledore usually looks humble and conservative, but he has a heart that desperately wants to pretend.
Actually Ivan didn't know that Dumbledore didn't lie to him.
This kind of feeling of relying on magic to cast spells as you want is very cool, but the power of magic is far less than when holding a wand.
special.. What he holds in his hand is the Deathly Hallows-the Elder Wand!

chapters.title: Chapter 83: What's wrong with the horns? That's also a horse!
chapters.content:
Dumbledore’s displayed strength surprised Ivan somewhat, but after a little surprise, Ivan simply exploded his magic power for a second time, and in the process of magic explosion, he entered the kind of omnipotence similar to omnipotence. The magical state has caused his strength to be raised a lot.
This increase in strength is an important factor for him to contain Voldemort.
As for the fusion of the blood of a unicorn, Ivan hesitated to say.
This is not something that cannot be said at all.
After all, he found the book "The Origin of Blood" in the restricted book zone. The missing part can also be said that there is a similar book in the home that can complete it, although there is a possibility that Dumbledore can see it on the spot.
Ivan felt that the most excessive thing he did was stealing Snape’s potion, and sneaking into the forbidden book zone to read...
Given that he has made so many achievements this semester, Dumbledore is unlikely to do anything to him. The most is to strengthen guidance and covert surveillance...
There is absolutely nothing to say, only the secrets of travel and the portable system...
While Ivan was hesitating, Dumbledore suddenly spoke after hearing his experience.
"This may be the awakening of blood..."
"Blood Awakening? What is that?" Ivan had heard this word for the second time, and he remembered that he had mentioned it when he was fighting Voldemort.
And the "Origin of Blood" obtained by him does not have many records of this aspect, I don't know if it is in the missing part.
"The Hals family..." Dumbledore did not immediately respond to Ivan's words, but fell into a period of thought.
He still has some knowledge of the Hals family where Ivan is located. There seems to be no special blood in the ancestors.
Of course, it may also be from the lineage handed down by Ivan’s mother, Aisia, and he doesn’t know much about things over there.
Dumbledore thought for a while, then answered Ivan's doubts.
To put it simply, someone from the ancestors used a variety of methods to fuse the blood of divine creatures, steal their power, and then pass it down from generation to generation.
This kind of power will be reduced through iterations, so that after a few generations, the offspring will actually be no different from ordinary wizards.
But these children always have a few talents, but their strength is increased to a certain level, or when they are severely stimulated by chance, they can re-energize the power hidden in the body.
Among the best, they are able to integrate the power of magical creatures into magic freely, and exert incredible abilities.
Ivan nodded, which was similar to his guess based on the content of the book, except that Dumbledore said more.
"Then the same is true for your family?" Ivan thought of the records in "The Origin of Blood", pretending to be curious, and asked.
Ivan remembered that not everyone in the Dumbledore family was able to summon the Phoenix. Only the old principal in front of him and Credence Beerburn (Orelius Dumbledore) could do this. ).
Dumbledore heard Ivan's question and fell silent again. His blue eyes looked at Ivan as if he were looking at another person.
His time seems to go back decades ago,
"What's wrong with you?" Ivan asked strangely.
"It's nothing, I just thought that someone asked me the same question many years ago..." Dumbledore said a long time later.
Ivan faintly guessed who it was, and a little annoyed that he asked what he shouldn't ask, but Dumbledore suddenly smiled.
"I'm very happy, you are not the same as him, you have things he doesn't have..."
Ivan breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed that he hadn't been in vain to help with the finishing touches before, and Dumbledore was still reading some old feelings.
"Principal Dumbledore, the people from the Ministry of Magic are looking for you, and they insisted on waiting for you in front of the principal's room." As the atmosphere gradually eased, Madam Pomfrey opened the door and walked in. At the same time, she also looked at Ivan. At a glance.
"In addition, I think Hals should take a break."
Dumbledore nodded. The Ministry of Magic's reaction speed was still so slow. Two days ago, he notified Chino Fuzhu about the matter, and until now they sent someone to deal with it.
This is obviously a world away from the previous investigations of the fire dragon. If Fudge and his Ministry of Magic can use the active spirit of fighting for power and profit in business, there will be so many troubles in the magical world...
Temporarily needs to leave, Dumbledore did not continue to inquire, because the ones Ivan answered have been able to alleviate most of his doubts, and he also has some guesses for the rest.
After exhorting Ivan a few words to let him rest, Dumbledore got up and stood up and walked outside the door.
Ivan, who had been terrified, finally breathed a sigh of relief. He glanced at the countdown to the experience card and only a few minutes were left.
Ivan estimated that Dumbledore’s mind-inducing mind was at least level six, and his Occlumency has just risen to level three. Once he loses the blessing and protection of the brain in the experience card mode, Ivan can’t be sure. Can I hide it from each other?
And, this is still when Dumbledore didn’t use his full strength...
At the same time, in the corridor outside the school hospital, Dumbledore met Harry and the others who came to visit Ivan after class.
"Professor, is Ivan already awake?" Hermione asked as soon as she saw Dumbledore.
Harry and Ron also watched it together.
"Well, he seems to be in good condition, but Hals just woke up. I guess you have to convince Madam Pomfrey to go in and see him." Dumbledore smiled.
Then Dumbledore seemed to have thought of something again, then looked at Harry.
"Harry, you said earlier that Hals released an illusory light and shadow during the battle. Can you tell me what the light and shadow look like?"
Harry tried hard to think about it. He was lying on the ground, so he could only see an outline.
"Horse... the light and shadow look like a horse professor!" Harry said with some uncertainty.
Horse?
Is it a horse-shaped water monster?
Dumbledore guessed what kind of horse it was, and walked towards the principal's office.
Watching Dumbledore's figure disappear at the end of the corridor, Harry remembered halfway through, that the horse-shaped phantom he vaguely saw seemed to have a pointed horn on its head...
Harry hesitated and shook his head, maybe he was wrong, maybe...
(PS: Please recommend... Please collect...)

chapters.title: Chapter 84: Exam before leaving school
chapters.content:
Two days later, Ivan, who was about to rust in the school hospital, was finally allowed to leave the hospital.
He has had enough of being able to lie in a hospital bed and having to drink medicine every day.
Had it not been for Madam Pomfrey's insistence that the consequences of giving up training were serious, Ivan would have been discharged by himself.
However, my life after being discharged from the hospital was not satisfactory because it was not long before the end of the semester exams.
On the first day after he left the hospital bed, Hermione held a thick stack of books in front of him.
"History of Ancient Magic", "Standard Spells, Elementary", "Beginner's Guide to Transfiguration", "Basic Potions Encyclopedia"...
"The exam is about to take place in a week, I think you need to make up for the time you lost before..." Hermione sat next to Ivan and offered advice.
"I remember these books, have we read them a long time ago?" Ivan said blankly.
"How can it be the same? If we want to be foolproof in the exam, we have to memorize all these books!" Hermione vowed to say again, before Ivan retorted.
"I have finished memorizing them all. In addition, the professor has taught a lot of new lessons in the past few days when you are away. I will tell you one by one later."
Ivan felt a headache while looking at the books that were about half his height stacked together. He was not interested in reviewing the books that he had understood thoroughly.
Ivan turned his head to look at Harry and Ron, and found that they were both watching the excitement happily.
Noting Ivan's gaze, Harry hurriedly stood up the book in his hand. Ron even took the book upside down, but still pretended to read hard.
They don’t want to attract Hermione’s attention. With so many books, they won’t be able to memorize them until next year...
Ivan snorted and motioned to Hermione to ignore the two jerk-watching bastards.
"Because they are out of help!" Hermione vaguely said.
Harry and Ron, who were hit, buried their heads in the books, speechless...
Fortunately, in the exam a week later, Harry and Ron discovered that their knowledge level was not as bad as Hermione said.
Because the performance of other little wizards is worse, they are still very good in comparison. Ron is very confident that he can get E in the two courses of spells and herbal medicine.
After the Potions exam, Ron lost this confidence, because Snape often wandered around them during the exam, which made Harry and Ron tremble.
But this little pressure is of course not a big deal to Ivan. His Level 4 potion level is not in vain. The potion allocated is far beyond the level of a student, and it is no problem to sell it directly.
After he was finished, Snape stopped writing and painting. Ivan could see that it should be a big O (outstanding).
Harry's performance has also been very stable, so Snape couldn't find a chance to be poisonous at all.
The next one is the test of the transfiguration class. Professor McGonagall asks the students to come in one by one and turn a small round piece of wood into a button shape in front of her.
As long as it can be deformed successfully, it is considered qualified. If the size of the button transformed by someone is suitable, and then the delicate pattern is added to it, it will get the highest evaluation!
Ivan observed for a while. Among the first-year students at Gryffindor College, only Hermione should be able to achieve this, because the little witch was very happy when she came out, with her mouth raised.
"Ivan Hals!"
Professor McGonagall’s voice came from the classroom.
Ivan calmly walked in. There was only a long table in the empty classroom. Professor McGonagall was not looking at him, but was staring at the delicate buttons on the table.
Obviously, that was Hermione’s exam work just now.
"Professor McGonagall, can I start?" Ivan took out his wand from his cuff, eager to try.
"Of course, but I think these quizzes are not that difficult for you." Professor McGonagall raised her head and looked at Ivan, with satisfaction in her eyes. She even drew on the report card in front of Ivan. A big O.
Whether it was the ghost face I saw on the fourth floor or the stretcher Ivan deformed in front of her a few days ago, Professor McGonagall knew that Ivan's level of transformation skills was far beyond that of his peers.
The exam is plain, it is actually to let the professors know whether the students' progress is up to the standard, and this exam obviously cannot detect the true level of Ivan.
"So, I don't need to take the exam?" Ivan asked in confusion.
"No, I have prepared another topic for you. How about trying to make an object alive? Whatever you want." Professor McGonagall took out a new wooden block from the drawer and promised that no matter what. Whether or not he can transform successfully will not affect his test scores.
This is just an extra test...
Ivan nodded. He also wanted to try the limit of his metamorphosis So, Ivan conceived the image of a metamorphic creature in his mind, and finally chose an owl. This It can be regarded as being stimulated by Dumbledore before, ready to restore the scene of the other party's deformation.
Here is a real biological transformation, the irreversible one!
Professor McGonagall watched quietly, wondering why Ivan was still not using his hands, when he saw him suddenly waving his wand, and the tip lightly touched the round wood...
The deformation this time is very slow,
It is extremely difficult to transform a piece of wood that is only ten centimeters in size into a living creature the size of an owl...
Ivan tried hard to recall the scene where his magic power broke out in the responsive room, trying to make his magic power penetrate the wood, analyze its structure, and then change its form and even its nature!
Because of one experience, Ivan went very smoothly, but he encountered difficulties with metamorphosis because he did not understand the structure of flesh and blood cells...
Perhaps it is precisely because of this that the "Phoenix" he finally created at the beginning exploded instantly after injecting magic power!
"Wait... Flesh cells?" Ivan suddenly realized something, isn't his own body?
Just use magic to analyze your body.
Thinking of this, Ivan immediately started to move, first concentrating the magic power on his little finger to do an experiment, confirming that there was no problem, and then slowly spreading it all over his body.
But under normal conditions, Ivan can't let the magic power go deep into the cells, he can only analyze a rough idea, and he doesn't dare to mess with some important places.
Even so, it is enough. The round wooden blocks on the table are constantly being stretched and changing to the shape that Ivan expected...

chapters.title: Chapter 85: Stop your bold ideas, the owl is the wizard’s best friend...
chapters.content:
Professor McGonagall was in shock at the beginning of the transformation, and she could naturally see what Ivan was doing from her eyes.
About a minute later, an owl with snow-white feathers appeared in front of the two of them, cooing twice, and looking around curiously.
However, Ivan let out a sigh of relief and said depressed.
"Pity.."
Ivan was very disappointed. Although this deformed owl is exactly the same as the real one, this conversion is only temporary and lasts longer at most, because he still failed to change its essence in the end.
This is obviously his closest success...
[Ding, after your unremitting practice, the proficiency of morphology has slightly improved...]
In his mind, a reminder of the improvement in the proficiency of the Transfiguration Spell came over, which gave Ivan some comfort.
"It's no pity, you can do this, it's far beyond my estimation." Professor McGonagall came back to his senses at this time.
She felt that even Dumbledore would not be able to do what Ivan is now in the first grade.
But after the praise, Professor McGonagall sank his face again and asked.
"You just used magic to analyze what your body is doing? I almost thought you were performing a dangerous Animagus transformation! Fortunately, you didn't go deep, or I would like to interrupt your transformation process..."
"Did Animagus practice this way?" Ivan's eyes lit up, and he felt that he had found a way to quickly improve the transformation spell.
If he can learn Animagus, his transformation spell level should be able to greatly improve again.
Professor McGonagall felt speechless. She regretted her momentary gaffe, but since she had said everything, she went on to remind her.
"Animagus is a very deep transformation spell, you'd better not try to try it alone, because once the transformation fails, the consequences will be disastrous!"
"If you are really interested, when you come back next semester, I can give you some pointers." Professor McGonagall was also hesitant to say this. She didn't know if I should be allowed to contact this high-end one so early. Transfiguration.
But she knows very well that persuasion cannot be persuaded. Instead of letting Ivan try secretly in private, it is better to teach herself.
Of course, Ivan agreed without hesitation. If someone is willing to teach, he won’t be so stupid to try it. After all, Animagus’s body is deformed, but what if he makes a mistake?
In Hogwarts College, except for Dumbledore, who he does not want to touch too much, Professor McGonagall has the highest level of polymorphism!
"Since you agree, let's make an agreement that you can't try to analyze your body by magic before the next semester." Professor McGonagall warned.
"Then can I analyze other living things?" Ivan is very clear that now his Transfiguration Curse wants to improve his proficiency, reading general related books is no longer useful.
, only by performing high-end biological transformation like this time, can he contribute some proficiency to him.
Thinking of this, Ivan looked at the deformed owl on the side, and hit Maca in the bedroom with his attention.
Professor McGonagall couldn't see this, and said angrily.
"The owl is the best friend of the wizard. No wizard will hurt his own owl at will..."
"Otherwise cats are not good either." Professor McGonagall added. "Perhaps you can experiment with a toad or a mouse."
Are they not friends of wizards?
Ivan opened up and wanted to complain,
Professor, this is a discriminatory species!
Ron and Neville will cry.
After all, Ivan still failed to vomit, because he was quickly kicked out by Professor McGonagall. The reason was that if he was allowed to stay any longer, the others would not have to take the exam.
Before leaving, Professor McGonagall felt that I could not be too complacent, so he reminded him.
"Don't forget to review textbooks and read more books at home. I will test and teach again when the time comes. If it doesn't meet the standards, don't blame me for temporarily breaching the contract."
Ivan nodded, he wouldn't be complacent because of his strength.
When dealing with Voldemort's remnant soul, Ivan had already realized his weakness. Even when the opponent had no mobility, he had to rely on the protective magic in Harry to be able to win the battle. It.
If he faced the real Dark Lord, he was afraid that he would not even have the ability to resist.
Therefore, Ivan had made up his mind a long time ago to make use of the long vacation time after leaving school, and one day can not be wasted!
But the little wizard seems to be unable to cast spells outside the school.
Thinking of this, Ivan was a headache. He remembered the magic wands sold in Ollivander’s shop in the original book. Each one had traces on them. The Ministry of Magic could easily check whether these wands were being used until the little wizards. It will disappear after graduation from Hogwarts.
This means that unless he thinks of a way to get another adult wizard’s wand, he can only stay in the room and read a book during the summer vacation.
After all, the Ministry of Magic's regulations on this aspect are extremely strict. As long as a little wizard is found casting a spell outside the school, the first warning, the second expulsion, and the third break of the wand!
Not everyone is the famous Harry Potter Ivan doesn't think he will have the right to immunity.
Depressed Ivan walked out of the classroom, and Harry and the others, who had been waiting outside for a long time, thought he had failed the exam.
"Ivan, it's okay to play it once in a while, we all know that your Transfiguration spell works well." Hermione comforted.
Harry and Ron also nodded frequently.
"Improper performance? No? Professor McGonagall gave me the highest score on the spot." Ivan knew that they had misunderstood, and waved his hand.
"Then why are you not so happy?" Harry asked strangely, and Ivan had been inside for so long, so logically he should be fast.
"It's just that Professor McGonagall added a temporary quiz to me. I didn't pass it." Ivan explained in a perfunctory way. He couldn't say that he was trying to take advantage of the Ministry of Magic so that he could cast spells outside of school, right?
"Harry Potter!"
Harry was also about to ask what kind of quiz it was. In the classroom, Professor McGonagall’s voice rang and he had to take the test first.
pushed the door open and walked into the classroom. Harry saw the snow-white owl on the table on the right with a few round buttons underneath.
Harry wondered why Professor McGonagall brought an owl to the examination room, and suddenly remembered the "quiz" Ivan had mentioned to him.
He heard from the little wizards who returned from the exams that the right side seems to be the display area of ​​excellent exam works, which is specially used by Professor McGonagall to add "a little" pressure to the new candidates. It also serves as a template and demonstration role. .
Only this time... Harry looked at the owl and swallowed. He felt that the pressure was too much, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 86: I am a mysterious person, I speak for Big Dung Egg!
chapters.content:
At the same time, Hermione outside the examination room was also asking about the quiz. When she learned that Ivan had used a small wooden block to make an owl, she was rather depressed.
Hermione thought that after studying hard for so long, she could pull in a little gap, but she didn’t expect that the gap would get bigger and bigger...
On the way back, Ivan also happened to meet George and Weasley who were frowning. They had just taken the third-grade magic history exam and looked like the sky was falling.
"What's wrong with you? It's not time to announce the results yet, right?" Ivan asked curiously.
"No, but we must have failed the exam." Fred sighed, then turned his eyes to George. "I blame you George, I told you to put aside the research matter first, and review it a few days before the exam."
"So? Did you review it well? Who did the study in the dormitory yesterday until the middle of the night." George rolled his eyes.
"I'm studying the answering quill, the one that can automatically write the answer! The one who prepares for the exam is different from you!" Fred defended.
"Yes, it turns out that this quill will only write about topics that we know. This is definitely the worst invention!" George said dissatisfiedly, because he believed in Fred so much in the morning, but as soon as he arrived in the examination room shocked.
Answer the quill automatically? It is still very good for homework..
Ivan thought in his heart, seeing the two people blaming each other noisily, Ivan’s mood improved a lot.
This is not to say that he is gloating, but that these two people are born with a charm to make others happy.
"Professor Bins has a good temper. Generally speaking, as long as he finishes writing, the answer is not too outrageous, and it should be no problem to pass." Ivan felt amused and comforted.
"Yes, I think so too, so I secretly ate a quick-acting skipping candy, shed some nosebleeds, and tried to pretend to be uncomfortable to win sympathy. At first it went well, but in the end..." George shrugged.
"Fred also ate it?" Ivan had already guessed what was going on.
It must be the same as the two of them, and Professor Bins is sometimes a little confused, but he is definitely not stupid. The two students have a continuous nosebleed and can't stop it. Anyone can see the problem.
"So we're done..." George and Fred looked at each other, and they were a little bit eager to cry.
"I can only wish you good luck." Ivan spread his hands and said that he could do nothing.
"Forget it, let's not talk about it, did you use the big dung eggs we gave you, how do you feel? We are going to officially sell them in school next semester." George quickly sorted out his mood and asked.
"I used it on Chino, how should I put the effect...very good! Otherwise I might not be able to see you!" Ivan looked weird.
"Is it when you and Harry defeated Professor Chino in the basement? Tell us..." Fred suddenly became excited.
George had a whole new idea.
"Maybe we can write this as a slogan next semester, and then put Chino's picture on the box, so the big dung eggs will definitely sell!"
Listening to George's whimsy, Ivan's mouth twitched faintly, and he had a new understanding of their ability to die.
You **** like this, the Dark Lord doesn't want face, ah?
Ivan hesitated to tell the story of Kino being manipulated by the Dark Lord, so as to dispel their thoughts of death.
But remembering that in the original time and space, both of them dared to spoof the black magic mark in the heyday of Voldemort's power, Ivan still felt it better not to say it.
Otherwise, they might dare to print Voldemort's portrait on the big dung egg, and then paste a slogan...
I am a mysterious person, I speak for the big dung egg?
Ivan imagined the scene in his mind, thinking that the dark lord who was running away might be so angry that he would come back and kill the two brothers...
......
A few days later, the test results were finally announced.
Prior to this, the whole Hogwarts seemed panicked. Even the Weasley brothers turned their grief and anger into motivation and came up with a kind of amulet that was said to temporarily improve their performance. It sold very hot for a while, and in the end even the two of them themselves. I believed it all, and I took it all day long, and tried to send one to Ivan.
Ivan certainly didn’t accept it, because he didn’t need that kind of thing at all.
His transfiguration, potions class, herbalism, and spell classes are all full marks, which can't be higher.
Even Ivan, who was originally not good at flying lessons, got outstanding reviews.
After fusing the blood of the unicorn, it is not only the strength that is improved, but also the talent!
Especially the perception and manipulation of magic power have been greatly improved, and it is easy to control a flying broomstick.
The only thing that went beyond Ivan’s expectations was the history of magic. He only got an E (exceeding expectations), which made Ivan confused and missed the first throne of grade because this position was taken away by Hermione. .
Hermione was happy all day for this, but she still confronted the answer with Ivan reservedly, looking for points to be deducted.
"No, I remember that the ancestors of werewolves were deformed by wizards... Obviously it was not wrong Ivan looked at the sheepskin scroll in his hand.
"That must be a mistake in your memory. The fifth section of Chapter 17 of the History of Magic states that the first werewolf appeared because of the wrong treatment after a certain wizard was bitten by a wolf. I'll show it to you! "
Hermione snapped out a thick "History of Ancient Magic" and quickly found the corresponding content and presented it to Ivan.
Ivan only remembered after reading it. He remembered that it had always been the content of the book "The Origin of Blood"...
Obviously Professor Bins changed it according to the content of the textbook...
Forget it, let the truth go with the wind...
Ivan thought rather helplessly, after all, he couldn't take that book to confront Professor Bins, right?
After the results came out, there was only one or two days left before the holiday period.
Ivan doesn’t mean to relax at all.
Saying goodbye to Hogwarts and returning home may be a happy thing for other little wizards, but it is a bit bad for Ivan.
This means that he has to face a strange family and a new environment that is even more strange and even dangerous...
Don't look at Ivan who has sorted out his memory through Occlumency, but he is not himself after all, and it is difficult to guarantee that he will not reveal his flaws.
The only thing to be thankful for is that he has been at Hogwarts for almost a year. If there is any difference, it can also be explained as the growth in school.
But Ivan was in a cautious heart, and spared no effort to take advantage of the last effort to improve his strength and knowledge reserves as much as possible.
The most important point is to explore the newly acquired bloodline magic unicorn shadow!

chapters.title: Chapter 87: "Happy" memories
chapters.content:
This unique bloodline magic can be described as the most powerful hole card in Ivan's hand. If used properly, it is not impossible to compete against adult wizards, so the priority of practice is much higher than transformation.
Ivan thought this should be an easy task, after all, he had already released it once successfully, and it was also displayed in the magic bar of the system.
But Ivan was dumbfounded when he practiced it. He didn't know the spell required to summon Cecilia.
was automatically activated because he was in danger of life, he couldn't restore his original state to try to summon, right?
Wait, is it related to that...
Ivan inexplicably thought of the faint blue phoenix, and what Dumbledore had said before, that some wizards were able to integrate the power of magical creatures into magic and exert incredible abilities.
In this way, will his bloodline magic be related to the Hushen Guardian? After all, both are summoning the ghost of an animal, and they have many similarities.
It’s just that the shadow of the unicorn is more special, and it can also fight through special magical materialization. Ivan guessed that this might be because the soul of Cecilia replaced the patron saint.
With these speculations, Ivan immediately went to the library to find books about Hushen Guarding, and after a few hours, he successfully raised Hushen Guard to the first level.
"Holy guard!" Ivan couldn't wait to enter the responsive room and waved his wand to test.
A plume of white smoke gushes from the top of Ivan's wand, and a calm and peaceful mood gradually flows into my heart.
Although nothing appeared, Ivan’s face showed a joyful expression.
Because he was incomparably confirmed at this time, there is absolutely any connection between the shadow of the blood magic unicorn and the guardian of the god!
If it is normal to call the gods, the guard should summon blue light and shadow, not white...
In the following time, Yifan spared no effort to practice the protection of God, even at the precious academic points.
It’s just that it’s the end of the semester, and when there is no way to answer the questions in class, the grade points can only be consumed and cannot be refilled, so that the more you use it, the less.
"The last five hundred points are left..." Ivan finally missed the kind Professor Dumbledore again, leaving aside other aspects for the time being. He has always been generous in bonus points.
Light Dumbledore gave him at least two hundred points this semester!
But even this won't change the dilemma Ivan is facing now.
Considering that he may need to deal with emergencies during the vacation, he needs to leave two hundred grade points for emergency, so only three hundred grade points can be used!
means that there can only be three hours of accelerated learning or practice time!
"Exchange the Xueba Experience Card." After adjusting his own state, Ivan did not hesitate to start the first accelerated practice.
[100 grade points have been deducted! 】
Along with the system's prompt sound, Ivan felt that his brain was much clearer, and his control of magic power had also improved to a higher level, and then he waved his magic wand.
"Call God to guard!"
The faint white mist reappeared, floating from the top of Ivan's wand, and became filamentous, like strands of misty smoke, surrounding him.
The white mist that emerged this time is much more than before.
After practicing for a while, Ivan quickly realized the special feature of Hushen Guarding, which is a kind of profound emotional magic.
It is necessary for the caster to mobilize positive emotions and gather this power to successfully summon his patron saint!
Ivan is stuck in this final step!
If only a dementor could practice him, Ivan thought so.
Although he is in the room of responsiveness, Ivan did not try to use the characteristics of the room of responsiveness to get a dementor out of it.
As early as in the previous experiment, he has understood the limitation here, that is, it is impossible to embody living creatures and magical items, and he is more inclined to provide a venue.
For example, it can manifest a dragon farm, but there is no dragon in it, or it can manifest a vault, but there is no gold in it...
There are weapons in the arsenal, but they are all old antiques a thousand years ago, and there are no magic weapons...
Ivan sighed, his thoughts were shaken, and the large amount of white mist that was finally condensed disappeared without a trace. Ivan quickly stabilized his mind, settled, and kept reminiscing about the things that made him feel happy. Scenes...
When teasing Peter Pettigrew, when he needs Professor Chino to top the pot, when he smashes the Dark Lord with a big dung egg..
Memories kept pouring in my heart, Ivan’s mouth was filled with a smile, blessed to the soul, the magic wand was gently waved, and the white mist around him seemed to be drawn towards the center.
A long hissing sound resounded throughout the practice room. Among the white light and shadow, Cecilia's illusory figure appeared in the air, happily circling around Ivan, faintly showing a sense of intimacy.
What surprised Ivan the most was that Cecilia’s pupils were no longer blood red but like blue water waves.
Is it because of successful revenge?
Ivan thought in his heart, but before Cecilia's shadow lasted long, it turned into a white mist and dissipated in the air.
At the same time, the system prompt sounded in his mind.
[Ding, the time limit of the Xueba experience card has expired, do you want to renew it? 】
"No more, go!" Ivan said with a black face, unknowingly he has accelerated his practice for three full hours!
Called up the system bar and saw that the Hushen guard was upgraded to the second level. Ivan tried to use the Hushen guard again in a normal state, but the result was still some white mist... unable to let them condense together.
However, in the system bar, a lot of information about the shadow of the unicorn has been added, and Ivan only has some understanding after checking it.
【Blood Magic: Shadow of the Unicorn (Shadow of Cecilia)
Requirement front: Hushen Guardian Level 4 (Level 2 in Experience Card Mode)
Description: This is a special magic that combines blood and soul power. As a soul body patron saint, Cecilia can ignore most obstacles, and only a few magic can cause damage to it. You can also choose to spend a lot of magic power to temporarily construct a body for Cecilia so that it can temporarily interfere in the material world.
Note: Unless the host dies, when the soul body is defeated by a fatal injury, it will not completely die and dissipate. Instead, it will live in your body and rest until it regains its shape. 】
"So, I have become Cecilia's Horcrux?" Ivan muttered to himself while looking at the last comment.
just seemed to reactivate it by relying on the experience card mode before the Hushen guard level was raised to level four again.

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Look, how peaceful this mouse walks...
chapters.content:
Just learning and tangling, Ivan made it to the end of the semester.
At the end of the term, Dumbledore said in a clichéd manner in the large exhibition hall that the little wizards in the following academies were drowsy, and not many people even cared about the ownership of the Academy Cup.
Because even the second Slytherin Academy has long since given up the idea of ​​contention, there is no way, the gap between the two sides is really too big.
However, the little wizards in Gryffindor were still very interested. After Dumbledore announced the ownership of the Academy Cup, they all clapped their hands and looked proudly at Slater on the opposite long table. Lins, this is the first time they have won by an overwhelming advantage.
Ivan also received a lot of attention during this process, but he was tossing with the mouse he had just caught, and he didn't have time to bother.
The study of Hushen Guardian has entered a small bottleneck, and ordinary practice or reading has little effect, so Ivan is going to practice the Transfiguration Mantra first.
Just like when they came, after signing the school leaving agreement, the huge Hagrid led them these first-year freshmen to the Hogwarts station.
Looking at Hogwarts Castle further and further away, in Ivan's mind, the system prompt finally sounded.
【Ding, this school year is over, do you want to make a school year summary? 】
"Yes!" Ivan said silently in his heart.
When the results were announced before, Ivan wondered why the system didn’t respond or rewards. It turned out that the summary reminder was only when he left school.
【As of today, your performance this school year is as follows..
class evaluation: excellent
Reward: 100 academic points
......
Final exam results: Potions (excellent), Transfiguration class (excellent), Herbology (excellent)...Magic history class (exceeding expectations)
Reward: 650 academic points
......
Glory: Quidditch champion (not participating), Gryffindor Academy Cup (100 grade points).
Overall reward: 850 academic points]
suddenly won the award of 850 grade points, which surprised Yifan, who had been worried about the lack of grade points.
It's so timely!
This gives Ivan a little peace of mind when he is about to go to the new environment. With the two hundred academic points he originally reserved, he can reserve ten hours of fighting time, or it can be used for fast learning.
"Well, children, go faster, we must hurry up to the station!"
At the forefront, Hagrid with the team shouted at them loudly, like a drum.
Ivan condensed his mind and followed Hagrid's footsteps to Hogwarts Station not far from the lake. From a distance, he saw the old-fashioned steam locomotive, with beautiful red paint underneath and large exhaust. There was a thick white steam coming from his mouth.
Ivan didn’t expect that the first time he boarded the Hogwarts Express was when he was leaving. This is really different...
While Ivan was still sighing, Harry and Ron had already pulled him into one of the boxes.
The space in the box is still very large, and there are three or four people sitting down without feeling crowded.
Hermione also ran from other boxes. She was in the same box with roommates Parvati Petir and Lavender Brown, but she was not used to it after all.
A few people got together and chatted quickly, especially Hermione and Ron. Although they were very happy in Hogwarts, they still missed the family very much.
When Harry echoed without a sentence, he occasionally complained about his uncle's family who adopted him.
Ivan took advantage of this time and took a comatose mouse from the small iron cage he brought and placed it on the table, preparing to continue the practice of using magical power to analyze blood cells.
After getting out of the car, I can no longer use magic at will.
"Is this your new pet? A mouse? What about Maca?" Harry asked, looking at Ivan's strange behavior. .
"This is not a pet, it's just a prop for practicing transfiguration." Ivan explained, closing his eyes and infiltrating the mouse's body as much as possible of magic.
Hearing Ivan's words, Hermione and Ron also turned their heads and looked at Ivan's movements curiously.
However, they only saw Ivan put his wand against the mouse's forehead, just so dumbfounded and motionless.
"Is this really useful?" Ron grumbled.
"Using magic power to resolve objects is a prerequisite for learning advanced transfiguration." Ivan opened his eyes and looked at them.
"Like your deformed owl?" Harry asked curiously.
"Almost." Ivan nodded. He didn't mention the transformation of Animagus, and there is nothing wrong with understanding it this way anyway.
Harry and the others immediately became interested, but they knew how powerful Ivan’s Transfiguration Curse was. They didn't expect to practice it in this way, and they all took out their wands excitedly to prepare to experience it.
Ivan didn’t stop, let them try, anyway, this kind of rat is everywhere, and he caught more than one at Hogwarts.
Harry tried his best to put his body like Ivan just now, with his wand pressed against the mouse's forehead, trying to input magic power into it, and Hermione watched curiously.
Ron remembered that he also had a mouse, so he almost grabbed the spot that was gnawing on the multi-flavored beans, and gestured with his wand, trying to send some magic power in.
Banban was frightened for a while, screaming in horror, but couldn't run away when Ron was pulling his tail. He could only twist his body to avoid Ron's wand poked...
"Don't move, let me cast the spell properly..." Ron pressed his spotted body dissatisfied, and pushed his wand onto its head.
Scabbard had an expression of impossibility. At this moment, Ron was attracted by the movement from Harry.
The mouse, lying on the table in a coma, was suddenly and quickly convulsed after Harry lost a spell of magic power. There was foam in his mouth. A few seconds later, his legs slammed on the table, stiffened and stopped moving.
Banban saw this scene, the boss staring at him, he felt that he might not survive today.
Harry's face was a bit awkward, he just lost some magic casually, not knowing how it became like this.
"It doesn't matter, I have fainted this mouse with a coma spell beforehand. It went peacefully when it left..." Ivan waved his hand, saying that he is a very humane wizard and never abuses animals.
It’s the same even if the other party is just a mouse...
"Ron is abusing mice like that!" Ivan glanced at Scab on Ron's hand, and suddenly remembered that Scab was from Animagus...

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Platform
chapters.content:
Thinking of this, Yifan's thoughts turned, and there was a trace of fire in his scaly eyes.
You must know that the risk of transformation of Animagus is extremely high. I don't know how many talented wizards have been planted on it in the past, so that there are only seven Animagus registered in the magical world.
Even if you add those who are careful to hide that they have not registered, it probably won't exceed 30 people.
It can be seen how difficult it is to deform!
And before that, if an Animagus' body can be analyzed, it may be able to greatly reduce the risk of deformation.
Along with Ivan's gaze, everyone's gaze also focused on Scabble.
This gray-black mouse was being pressed by Ron on the table, shivering under the gaze of three pairs of eyes, and there were tears in his eyes.
He didn't even think that what happened to Hogwarts College all these years? The little wizards in the first grade are so cruel...
"Ron, I'll help you. I haven't used the coma spell." Hermione thought it was very pitiful and decided to faint it first, so that Ron would not be too painful during the experiment.
However, Shaban didn't dare to let these brutal little wizards touch him anymore. At this time, he was full of desire to survive. At this time, he was possessed by the play spirit. After witnessing the tragic death of the same kind, he let out a scream and rolled his eyes. With a kick on his legs, he lay motionless on the table, looking like he was dead soon.
Ron didn't dare to try it when he saw this. Scabbard was his pet anyway. If he accidentally killed him like Harry, his mother wouldn't buy him a second one.
Shaban was really relieved when he heard Ron's words, but in the next second, a light flashed, and Shaban went into a coma very neatly.
"Ivan? Scattered like this, or else, forget it." Ron frowned and asked suspiciously.
"I'm not Harry, I won't hurt Scabble." Ivan comforted, then continued.
"If something goes wrong, I will buy you another brand new one, whether it is an owl, a mouse, a toad, or a cat."
"This is very important for the transfiguration I want to practice!" Ivan looked at Ron and said.
Ron looked at his hands, he was dark and ugly, he thought about the new pets in the pet shop, and quickly made a decision.
"Well, if this helps you." Ron put Scab on the table.
"Of course, I promise he will live." Ivan smiled, not surprised Ron made this decision.
The reason Ron cares about Scabbers so much is because that is one of the few things he owns on his own.
Although this pet was given to him by his brothers...
took the unconscious Zebra in his hand, Ivan was very careful to put his wand against its head, input a very small amount of magic power in to test, and found that the internal structure of Zebra was not the slightest difference from when he analyzed other mice.
If Ivan hadn't been able to see that Zebra was missing a paw, he would almost never be sure that this was Peter Pettigrew.
It seems that the magic of Animagus is far beyond his imagination...
Ivan's interest was mobilized, and the output of magic power was increased. He carefully examined every blood cell in the spotted body, until the magical power emerged on the spotted head, Ivan found a subtle difference.
There seemed to be some power protected there, Ivan hesitated for a moment, and did not dare to continue.
Because he is not sure, once he uses magical power to analyze what will happen to the speckled brain, if he accidentally disarms Animagus and awakens Peter Pettigrew, then the other people in the carriage will be in danger.
In fact, when Ivan was in school, he thought of relying on the survival map to denounce Peter and eliminate such a threat that stayed with him.
But after thinking about it, I dispelled the idea.
Most of the officials of the Ministry of Magic did not want to admit it, because their incompetence at the time brought a hero who resisted the Death Eaters into Azkaban for more than ten years...
So we still wait for the parties to arrive before throwing them to Dumbledore together...
[Ding, after practice, your proficiency in the transformation spell has improved...]
The prompt of the system sounded, and Ivan returned Scabbers to Ron without nostalgia. Although he did not really analyze the secret of Animagus, Ivan understood a little bit. During the deformation process, the brain is estimated to be The most critical and dangerous link.
This is enough....
"Woo..."
Amid the clear roar, the red train slowly stopped on the platform with billowing smoke.
Ivan packed his luggage and put the dead mouse on the table into Maca’s cage to provide him with a full meal.
completely clean and pollution-free...
And at this moment, when he just woke up, he was curled up in Ron's pocket, and he shuddered when he saw this scene.
Outside the carriage, the little wizards lined up to get off, but there was no guidance from the professors, so after the door was opened, it suddenly became crowded. Someone accidentally knocked over the cage with toads in the middle. The toad inside ran out, and I don't know if anyone was trampled to death.
While being pushed forward by someone, Ivan was doing the final rehearsal in his heart, thinking about how the first meeting with his family would be like, what should I say in the first sentence? How should I behave?
In his memory, the relationship between his mother Aisia and him is very good, even a little spoiled?
Ivan, as a substitute, is worried that his acting skills will not pass the test. He can't pretend the longing for reunion after a long absence.
Fortunately, the original body seems to be a little repulsive of Aisia's doting behavior, so that he often gets into trouble with the other party, he only needs to grasp this degree.
"Ivan, come down, why are you absent-minded?" Harry struggling with his large suitcase in both hands, jumped out of the car, and then turned to look at Ivan who was still standing still. .
"It's nothing, I think I'm going home, I'm a little excited." Ivan heard the urging of the little wizard behind, shook his head, and quickly followed behind.
A few people walked through the 9th and 3rd quarter of the platform together, and Ivan also experienced the thrill of passing through the wall, which was a bit like the feeling of passing through the fourth floor secret road.
London Station in the UK, compared to the other side of the wall, is full of modern atmosphere. The flat tiled floor, the bright waiting hall, and the whistle sound from time to time in the distance all make Ivan feel familiar.
After spending a long time at Hogwarts, he always felt that he was living in the Middle Ages.
Perhaps it is because this point is also the peak time for Muggles waiting for buses, so the station is somewhat crowded. Among the crowd of Muggle pedestrians in suits and leather shoes, a large number of parents of little wizards huddled in it, and they basically replaced them. The clothes of Muggles, even if there are a few exceptions, are harmless...

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Home and Knock Down Alley
chapters.content:
"Ron, this way!"
Among the crowd, Ivan saw someone beckoning to them. It was a middle-aged red-haired man with a rich-looking appearance. Ivan also saw him nodding to him kindly.
Next to the red-haired middle-aged man stood a slightly chubby woman. She was thrusting her waist and angrily reprimanding the brothers George and Fred. The two drooped their faces like frost hitting an eggplant. Dare not say.
Ivan immediately understood that they must be the Weasleys, and George and Fred were reprimanded probably because the history of magic was exposed.
"My dad called me. I'm going over first. You can come to my house when you have time. I will send you a letter during the holidays." Ron turned his head and said something, then pushed his suitcase into it. In the pile of people.
Because it is too crowded here, Ivan didn't mean to get to know him in the past. Besides, he didn't know that the other party knew that he was the child of the black wizard and couldn't wait to see himself.
Then Harry was quickly pulled away by his Uncle Dursley. The other party didn't even want to stay longer for a moment, put on a stinky face, and ignored Ivan and the others.
Hermione’s father, Mr. Granger, is very good contact, and Ivan also politely chatted with him a few more words.
Most of the little wizards were picked up, and the crowd was sparse. Ivan tried to find the figure of his mother, Aisia, in the crowd, and suddenly noticed that someone was holding his shoulder.
Ivan’s wand hidden in his sleeve was already in his hand, but he was hugged in his arms before he could do anything.
A scent of lavender came from behind, and Ivan relaxed his vigilance. In his memory, this was the perfume that his mother used to be.
Unexpectedly, the next moment, Acia's unique and gloomy voice rang in his ears.
