"I haven't seen each other for a year. It seems to have grown a lot taller and become more cuter. Have you missed your mother these days?"
"Of course...I think!" Ivan told a lie helplessly.
Turning to look over, there is a beautiful witch behind her, wearing a dark green wizard robe, which seems to have been carefully tailored to retain the original retro flavor, but also to highlight her figure. Over thirty years old.
Ivan is very uncomfortable with being in such close contact with a beautiful and unfamiliar woman, even if the other person is nominally her own mother...
"Yes? Then why didn't I see you actively mailing even a letter back?" The smile on the corner of Aysia's mouth was closed, and she stretched out her index finger to hit Ivan's head with great dissatisfaction.
Ivan hesitated to find the reason, his eyes swept across the snow-white owl in the cage, and he had an idea and said vows.
"I sent it, maybe Maca found the wrong place halfway!"
"You know, I just bought it at the beginning of school, so Maca may not even recognize the way home..." Ivan quickly threw the pot to Maca, and the latter was safe. Staying in the cage looked at him innocently.
"Really?" Aysia didn't refute, but looked at him with a smile on his face.
Ivan swallowed, only feeling the air pressure around him a little cold.
Aisia did not reveal Ivan's lies, but looked at the owl in the cage and smiled softly.
"I happened to learn a new dish yesterday, called stewed owl soup, otherwise we will eat this tonight."
Stewed owl soup?
The corners of Ivan’s mouth twitched, don’t you need to be so cruel?
"But I heard from Professor McGonagall that the owl is the wizard's best friend, and no wizard can harm the owl..." Ivan tried to persuade.
"Really? The Ministry of Magic does not have a prohibition on cooking owls..." Esiah said without comment, then pulled Ivan's wrist and walked out of the station.
Even if there are regulations, would you still listen to the Ministry of Magic?
Ivan thought helplessly, but still tried his best to say good things for Maca, and finally dispelled Aysia’s thoughts...
The reason is very simple. It takes a lot of money to change a pet...
The two of them went all the way. Ivan had already replaced a wizard robe when he was at the station. Now he is wearing blue casual clothes like the pedestrian Muggles from the outside, which is well integrated into the pedestrians. .
But Esiah is the opposite, her unique temperament, beautiful face and weird wizard robes, attracting the attention of pedestrians, but she doesn't care at all, and walks ahead of herself.
After leaving the station, there were more and more pedestrians, all the way to the commercial street, Ivan looked up and saw a dirty and small bar, which looked dark and shabby, compared with the gorgeously decorated clothing stores and record stores nearby. It seems a little out of place.
In fact, the same is true. There seems to be some invisible obstacle here. Ivan saw a lady trying to move forward, but took a big turn, and he didn't even notice it.
Is this the magic to expel Muggles?
Ivan looked at this magical scene I kind of wanted to explore how it works, but it's obviously not the time now.
Aisia has taken him into the Broken Axe Bar at this time,
As one of the important intersections between the magical world and the real world, 　　 Broken Axe Bar is a hot business at all times. On the quaint bar counter, the quaint boss Tom is chatting leisurely with the weird-looking old witch.
The two witches and witches sat on the side table and whispered something. A few idle drunks drank butter beer, and even whistled at Aisia, but they didn't come up to talk presumptuously.
"I'm going to use Floo powder and fireplace!" Aysia completely ignored the drunks, her face looked very gloomy, and she didn't have the gentle wind and drizzle in front of Ivan, so she threw a copper Nat to the front desk. The tone was tough.
This kind of performance is very unpleasant, but sometimes it can reduce a lot of unnecessary trouble...
"Of course, you are free..." The bar owner is a very kind person. After receiving the money, he reminded them that the Floo powder was placed in the box above the fireplace.
"You come first, don't move around when you get there, remember, Knock Down Alley!" Esiah grabbed a handful of Floo powder and handed it to Ivan.
Ivan was a little surprised why he didn't send it directly to the house, but he still waved the Floo powder, and the little fluorescent light was ignited by magic in the fireplace.
"Turndown Alley!" Ivan said.
The faint blue flame rose up, and Ivan faintly felt a little hot in his body, but it was not like a flame burning.
Then there was a burst of space replacement. The body seemed to be drawn into the drum, and it spun quickly, making Ivan dizzy for a while, and he couldn't even open his eyes to see the entire transmission process clearly.

chapters.title: Chapter 91: Eyes of Conflict and Exploration
chapters.content:
When the light in front of him reappeared, Ivan found himself in a brand new place. It was probably in a store. The light transmission was very poor. The surroundings looked a little dark and the cabinets were placed with transparent ones. Glass cover.
The cover closest to Ivan contained a small skull. It looked like it had undergone some special treatment, and there were deep scratches on both sides.
The other glass covers are filled with strange things, withered hands.. blood-stained poker chips.. jagged chandeliers, one is stranger than the other...
After Ivan waited for a while, a faint blue flame rose again in the fireplace, and Aasia was late, and retracted the wand in her sleeve into her sleeve.
"Did you do something to them?" Ivan noticed this, and wondered if Aysia was in trouble with those drunks.
"What do you want? That's the Broken Cauldron Bar. If you dare to make trouble there, the people from the Ministry will be there next moment." Aisia shook her head.
Ivan doesn't believe it. A dark wizard wants to figure out a few drunks, what can he make?
But these drunks are also responsible for their own sake. Judging from the methods of Esiah in his memory, it is not enough to die, but it is necessary to suffer.
"Don't think about it, follow me!" Esiah said with a slight warning, and then took a step first, and Ivan quickly followed behind.
Jingle Bell,
When the two crossed the cabinet, the wind chime hung on the door of the store shook, and a hunchbacked middle-aged wizard playing with a strange ball in the counter said in a hoarse voice.
"Here is someone again, who is it this time?"
"Mr. Borkin, it's me." Aysia walked over from behind the cabinet and said lightly.
"It turned out to be Mrs. Hals..." The shopkeeper Karaktakus Bok looked a little lacking in interest, and sat lazily and leaned on the chair.
"You guys come in and out like this, making my fireplace dirty. It seems I will have to charge for it next time."
"Or put the transfer station in Knockdown Alley to me?" Aysia said with a grin.
"Forget it, that's not something that can be moved casually. If it gets dirty, it gets dirty." Bok twitched the corner of his mouth, and it was vaguely visible that there was a gold tooth embedded in his mouth.
While the two of them were chatting, Ivan was also looking at the owner of the Bojinbok Magic Shop in front of him.
He looks about forty or fifty years old. He has greasy hair that is well-kept, two dark black rings are pinned on his slender, haggard hands, and he is wearing a black wizard robe that could not be more common. , It seems that apart from always bending over, it is no different from the average wizard, and the speech is also harmless to humans and animals.
But judging from the original work or the memory in Ivan's mind, this is obviously not an ordinary character.
You must know that even the famous Dark Lord worked here when he was young...
may be aware of Ivan’s gaze, Bok did not talk much about the previous topic, but turned his attention to him.
"This is little Hals, right? It's the first time I saw...how about it? Did you see any favorite little things in the store..."
Bok placed the strange ball-shaped object in his hand in front of Ivan. After I got closer, Ivan could see that it was an eye. It seemed that some magic power was applied to it, and the black eyeballs turned freely, and Ivan looked at each other.
At the moment of staring at each other, Ivan faintly felt dizzy, and then subconsciously operated Occlumency, which regained consciousness.
嘭!
A blue light flashed, and the eye was immediately knocked out and fell straight on the door frame.
"What are you going to do?" Aysia's face was very ugly. I didn't know when he had pulled out the wand, and pointed at Bok's head. The tip of the wand was faintly shining with black light, as if some black magic was brewing.
"Don't be angry, I'm just making a little joke. You should know the Eye of Detecting." Bok used a flying curse to call the Eye of Explorer back and said apologetically, but he didn't get half of the wand. Pointing with a panic look, he pointed to Ivan.
"Besides, isn't Mr. Hals okay?"
Aisia turned his head to look at Ivan, and saw that he shook his head at himself with a relaxed look, and then put the wand away with a gloomy face.
This is also related to Aysia's understanding of the effect of the Detecting Eye. If this is a lethal magic item, then she would never have been so fooled.
Ivan was relaxed on the surface, but a moment of fear in his heart. Knockover Alley looked more dangerous than he had imagined. He almost walked away. This was still under the protection of Aysia.
If possible, Ivan would like to tear it down with Aysia.
However, it is extremely unwise to fight against a shopkeeper in a dark magic shop. No one knows how many trigger-type magic items the other party has placed in the shop. What's more, Boke is totally confidentSo Yi Fancai took the initiative to pretend to be indifferent and stopped the conflict.
"As an apology, I can give this little gadget to Little Hals." Bok looked like a lack of interest from beginning to end, but at this time he was curious about Ivan and was able to resist the eye of probing. There are not many wizards, but he has seen this one at such a young age.
"No, I'm not interested." Ivan shook his head and said.
"Put away your tricks." Esiah also didn't give a good face, and was really not in the mood to stay here more, grabbing Ivan's wrist, and walking towards the door.
"What is the function of the same thing as the eye just now? Is it called the Detecting Eye?" Ivan asked when he went out.
At the same time, Ivan stared around and found that it was a small alley with red bricks and tiles on both sides, but it was obvious that there was a lack of maintenance, and the bricks on the right had some green moss. Some red bricks are even partly corroded.
I can still vaguely see some **** piled up in the corners of the street, and a stinking smell even drifts here.
"The Detecting Eye can confuse the opponent's mind and let the other person enter a state of trance. The questioner will answer whatever he asks." Esiah squinted at Ivan for a while, and explained aloud.
Veritaserum for magic props?
Ivan was envious for a while, and the Detecting Eye seemed to be able to activate as long as he looked at each other, which is really a good thing for Yin people.
"What? I regret not asking for it?" Aisia asked.
"No, I don't think that blog would be so kind." Ivan shook his head. He thought it was good, but he was not stupid enough to accept something from a strange dark wizard. There might be some trap hidden in it.

chapters.title: Chapter 92: The turkey made in this way has no soul...
chapters.content:
"Just know it." Aysia nodded, and then curiously asked how Ivan resisted the probing eye.
"Occlumency, I found it in the school's forbidden book area." Ivan thought for a while, did not hide it, and said it directly.
I would also like to thank Dumbley for this. He used the mind-absorbing mind several times to help him improve his Occlumency proficiency. It is precisely because of his habit that Ivan can react so quickly.
"Good job, it seems that you have learned a lot of good things in it, you know I only dared to sneak into the restricted book zone in the second grade."
Aisia looked at Ivan with a look of admiration. He didn't mean to reprimand him for violating the school rules at all. He just reminded him that he had some knowledge records in his heart. Don't try it lightly if you don't have full confidence.
Ivan’s reaction was entirely within Ivan’s expectations. In his memory, Ivan didn’t care about the rules so much, but the behavior of encouraging him to go to the forbidden book zone really made Ivan embarrassed...
Next, considering that Ivan had just been frightened, Aysia told Ivan about some interesting things that happened in the school at the beginning, such as that she was almost caught by Filch when she went to the restricted book area for the first time.
Later, she tried her best to get revenge and hid Filch’s cat, which caused Filch to search for several days...
Or occasionally use the fear curse to tease those ghosts and the little wizards of the same grade...
Ivan's gaze at Aysia became more and more weird as I listened, and suddenly remembered that when the school just started, the Sorting Hat seemed to have told him that someone had used the magic of the Fear Curse to engage in pranks, which caused Dumbledore a headache. ..
I didn’t expect to be talking about his mother Aisia...
Ivan echoed with each other, and then remembered the question he hadn't asked before.
"By the way, why didn't we just use Floo powder directly into the fireplace at home?"
"The fireplace at home was magically set by me, I remember I told you." Aysia looked at Ivan suspiciously for a while.
"When did that happen, how could I always remember it?" Ivan shrugged and hurriedly searched for related memories in his mind.
Although Ivan has sorted out his memories through Occlumency, it was a person's life experience for ten years after all, and he couldn't remember everything clearly.
Sometimes I still have to think about it for a while.
It would be too wrong to say more, Ivan then shut up the whole process, only watching the surroundings with his eyes.
If Dijiao Alley is a bustling city street, Turnover Alley is somewhat similar to a slum, perhaps even more dangerous.
Because this is also a gathering place for dark wizards, and the Second Wizarding War has just ended ten years ago, there are many Death Eaters who have escaped sanctions hiding here, and the rules of the Ministry of Magic can hardly be said to start in Knock Down Alley. What a great effect.
Just coming all the way, Ivan felt several malicious gazes, both bright and dark, but probably because of Aisia's side by his side, the owner of these gazes quickly closed his gaze back.
About seven or eight minutes, Ivan finally saw the appearance of the house in his memory, which was also a dark magic shop. Perhaps because it is relatively remote and the land price is relatively cheap, it looks very large and spacious.
Looking through the glass window, I can vaguely see many magic items on the shelves.
Different from the dark and terrifying Bojinbok store, Ivan found out that they were mostly small things like bracelets, necklaces, cards, etc., which looked like ordinary things, but Ivan understood most of these things through memory. Blessed the trigger type evil curse.
The whole shop is divided into upper and lower floors. The first floor is the place where magic items are sold, the second floor is the living area, and there is a basement where Asiah makes or researches magic items. Ivan hadn’t done it before. How did you get in.
"You take a break, I'll cook." Aysia led Ivan in and walked freely into the kitchen.
After Aisia left, Ivan was finally relieved when he had some time alone. He searched for memories and chatted with Aisia along the way with fear, which made him a little physically and mentally exhausted.
Thinking of next, he will have to get along like this all summer vacation, Ivan has a headache.
The clanging sounds in the kitchen sounded like a back kitchen in a hotel, attracting Ivan’s attention.
After Ivan looked along the window, he found that Aysia was standing in the middle of the kitchen gently waving his wand, and a turkey that had been cleansed without hair consciously jumped onto the chopping board.
The knife hanging on one side floated slowly. When passing by, cut a steak on the table neatly into several large pieces, and then began to process the turkey, and the various jars filled with seasonings were not idle. Then, the cooking wine was poured straight down and the turkey was soaked in a basin. The steak was sprinkled with unknown seasoning and then sent to the magic oven. UU reading www. uukanshu.com
Ivan even saw that when the turkey was greased, the turkey actively turned its body over and raised its wings so that the brush could apply more oil to the underside of the wings, and it would be more fragrant when roasted. a little.
Seeing this scene, Ivan’s expression was very strange. I searched through the memory and found out that it had been transformed into a magic kitchen by Esiah. The cooking process is basically the same as making assembly line products...
The things they made were all similar in appearance, and they were very fast. With Aesya barely moving, a luxurious turkey meal was soon released...
Ivan wanted to say that the dishes made in this way are soulless!
It’s just that when Esiah brought the plate to the table, Ivan couldn’t help but swallowed, because it seemed to be very fragrant...
However, Ivan is a little surprised how the dinner today is so rich. Even with the magic kitchen, Esiah rarely buys so many ingredients on weekdays.
"This was originally for Christmas..." Aisia's dark purple eyes stared directly at him, his gaze a little bit resentful.
"Um... next semester, I will definitely be back next semester." Ivan said stammeringly, because he did release Asia's pigeons on Halloween, and he didn't even send a letter back.
Ivan can imagine how Esiah prepared everything alone, and then waited for him at the station.
I didn’t expect to keep even the ingredients...
wait... Halloween? That seems to be a few months ago, right?
Ivan, who was eating a turkey meal, was stunned.
So how long has the turkey been kept?
"This chicken hasn't expired, right?" Ivan asked, turning his head to look at Aysia.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Say it again, which college are you in?
chapters.content:
"Of course it hasn't expired. I had eaten Christmas a long time ago. This is the one to celebrate your coming home." Aixia laughed. She originally felt that Ivan had changed too much in the past year, and she always felt a little strange. , But now I am familiar a lot.
Because the reaction is still the same interesting...
Ivan rolled his eyes, but he was so touched before, and next time he won’t believe it again...
There are not so many rules in the Hals family. The two chatted while eating, or it was just Aesia alone asking Ivan’s current situation at school.
Naturally, Ivan also tried to pick up what he could say, which were all learning matters, focusing on his talent report, active learning, and keen to answer (answer) every question in class. The professors of all subjects loved him. The performance of learning is "satisfactory".
As for killing trolls on Halloween, fighting the Dark Lord at the end of the semester, and raising a fire dragon for a month, Ivan didn’t mention a word, lest Asiah worried that he would drop out of school and stay at home in the future...
Then where does he go to get grade points to improve his strength?
Aisia listened proudly, especially when I heard that Ivan’s final grades were all outstanding evaluations except for the history of magic.
This is also what Ivan deliberately did, so as not to make a fuss about Esiah when he needs to cast a spell.
But when Ivan talked about the fact that Gryffindor won the Academy Cup through his own efforts, Aysia's face suddenly became weird, and the more I listened, the more I felt something was wrong, and she suddenly asked.
"Are you not in Slytherin College?"
"Of course, didn't you send a letter to Professor Dumbledore? He didn't tell you that I was assigned to Gryffindor?" Ivan looked at Esiah strangely. He didn't mention this in his previous reply. , He thought his mother should have known it a long time ago.
"Gryffindor? You entered the arrogant and arrogant Gryffindor Academy?" Aysia's tone gradually increased, and there was a thick anger on her delicate cheeks...
Ivan opened his mouth. He thinks the Lion House is not that bad, right?
Before he could speak, Aysia squeezed the glass in her hand angrily, the sharp glass pierced the palm of her hand, and orange juice mixed with a little blood on the table.
"Where did your **** principal put you?" Aisia asked every word.
Ivan doesn't understand the source of Aixia's anger at all, because there is no content related to it in his memory, but he still speaks under pressure.
"The academy should belong to the branch cap."
However, Aysia didn't believe it. She felt that someone must have used her authority to force the Sorting Hat to change the decision, so she scolded Dumbledore in front of his child without hesitation, using almost all the greetings she knew. On the body of the old professor.
"I should have sent you to Durmstrang School of Witchcraft and Wizardry!" Aisia concluded angrily.
Then why I am at Hogwarts now...Ivan was trembling when I heard it, but I didn't understand it. So, after thinking about it, the reason Isiah sent him here seems to be because the tuition at Hogwarts is cheaper?
Are you a real mother...
Ivan was speechless.
However, I will complain about it. Ivan knew in his heart that things would never be as simple as he thought.
He remembered that in the yelling letter that Aysia had sent him earlier, it seemed that Dumbledore was called something wrong, but he thought it was Aycey Yatai who was angry at the time.
Now it seems that there should be other reasons...
"You have a bad relationship with Professor Dumbledore?" Ivan asked cautiously.
"Anyway, stay away from him at school..." Aysia had already cleared up her emotions, found a piece of gauze from the cabinet to deal with the wound, and said to Ivan angrily.
Ivan nodded in agreement. He was always far away from Dumbledore in school...
The Last Supper was in a hurry. After eating, Aysia entered the basement and fiddled with her dark magic items, and then had to set up a defensive spell.
The Knockdown Alley at night is not safe, not to mention that it has not been peaceful recently...
Ivan returned to his small room.
The whole room is simple and tidy, with only one bed, one desk, and one cupboard, but it is very clean and spotless.
It seems that he should use the dust removal spell to clean up from time to time. One year has passed in my memory, and this place is still the same as when he left.
After finishing the clothes in the luggage, Ivan subconsciously pulled out his wand and prepared to continue practicing magic. Then he remembered that he couldn't cast spells now, and finally sighed helplessly. This kind of life is really unaccustomed.
Especially now that someone has just gotten rid of it, Ivan desperately wants to improve his strength.
I can only ask Esiah if there is a solution tomorrow...
As for now?
Ivan felt that he had better not feel bad, although he also wanted to ask exactly what contradiction his mother had with Dumbledore.
Flipping through the book until midnight, Ivan faintly felt the magic wave outside the window. When he moved to the window, he realized that something he couldn't see was slowly rising I couldn't see it with the naked eye, but it was Ivan's keen sense of magic power can detect its existence.
Is this a safe guard?
or similar magic?
Ivan was thinking, and there were wolves howling in the distance, and Ivan suddenly raised his head to find that a full moon was hanging high in the sky.
Full moon... Werewolf transforms...
Ivan frowned. Although there were indeed some werewolves hiding in Knock Down Alley, this situation had rarely been encountered in his memory for a whole decade.
After all, there are a lot of ruthless characters in Knock Down Alley. Those werewolves will consciously find a place to hide on the night of the full moon, instead of swaying the market like this.
woo...
The long howl of the wolf gets closer, and Ivan holds the wand in his sleeve in his hand, and in his heart is complaining about the rule that the little wizard cannot cast spells outside the school.
Wait... It seems that the little wizard is allowed to cast a spell to fight back when his life is in danger...
Ivan hesitated and saw a tall black shadow rushing out of the alley under the moonlight. It was a half-wolf and half-human creature with brown-gray hair all over his body, long and narrow limbs, and his eyes were dark red. , The big mouth full of teeth keeps breathing heavily...
This was the first time Ivan really saw a werewolf, and the other party didn't seem to be able to see it here, and didn't mean to stay too much. He quickly dashed into the other side and broke into one of the houses.
Ivan was just about to mourn for the residents inside, but he didn't expect that within a few seconds, this big werewolf was knocked out the same way and hit the red brick wall behind, wailing in pain, and he was overwhelmed. There are deep scars on the bones...

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Another peaceful and peaceful day in Turnover Alley
chapters.content:
"Hey...it's miserable..." Ivan muttered.
Standing on a high place, he could see that a wizard in an old wizard robe came out of the ripped room cursingly. Judging from the shape of his mouth, he seemed to be complaining about his bad luck.
After all, there are so many houses around, why did you attack his house?
The werewolf's recovery ability is really amazing. During the time he was knocked to the ground, the wounds on his body had already begun to heal.
The wizard obviously saw this too, his expression became even more impatient, the magic wand in his hand began to spread black, and his mouth was chanting an unknown weird spell.
The black air spread to form the appearance of a human face, his mouth opened and closed, and he rushed towards the werewolf on the ground with a piercing scream.
At this moment, the red brick wall behind was knocked down by a huge force, and another taller werewolf with silver-white hair rushed into the battlefield and slammed the thinner werewolf aside. But the black gas corroded his arm.
The silvery-white hair was corroded by the black gas and fell off. There were pits and pits on his arms. There was no sign of healing at all. The werewolf let out an angry roar, and then bit the thin werewolf and ran away.
The wizard's face was gloomy as if it could drip out, but he didn't mean to chase, instead he waved his wand and cast a repair spell to restore everything to the way it was before the battle.
Even if there was such a big noise, the rest of Knockdown Alley was still quiet, and no one would come out to stop or check it.
For them, Turn Down Alley is just another peaceful and peaceful day..
At least there won’t be one or two more dead bodies on the street tomorrow...
Ivan, who watched the whole battle, looked very ugly. The strength of both sides in the battle exceeded his expectations. If he had been involved just now, it would be difficult to say whether he could escape unless he used academic points to experience the card mode.
But his grade point is only one thousand points, which cannot be replenished. It is used once and once less.
It seems that we must find a way as soon as possible to raise the level of the Hushen Guard to Level 4, Ivan urgently thought of it.
and I am too lacking in the curse of high lethality...
[Ding, the first school year is over, the host is detected to return safely, the system is updating...]
While Ivan was lying on the bed planning how to improve his strength during the summer vacation, the long-lost system prompt sounded at this moment.
system update?
Ivan immediately got up from the bed and began to check the update items in his mind, but the system was still cold. There was no hint or even mention when the update was completed.
The only thing that makes Ivan feel a little safer is that when updating, the system's functions will not be closed because of this, which means that he can still consume academic points to improve combat effectiveness in critical moments.
......
The next morning, Ivan still followed the biological clock when I didn't fall asleep. Relying on his memory, he brushed his teeth in the bathroom, and then Ivan sat at the dining table, holding a knife and fork, and preparing to eat.
However, after waiting for more than half an hour, I didn't see Esiah. If Ivan didn't know how to operate the magic kitchen at home, he would have done it himself.
It wasn't until the time was near nine o'clock that Aisia in her nightgown yawned and walked out of the room.
"You sit down first, I'll cook." After Esiah finished speaking, she entered the kitchen and walked out with the plate in a few minutes.
Breakfast is very simple, a few sandwiches, two bowls of porridge, but the taste is not bad, only slightly worse than the house elves in Hogwarts.
"Mom.. Mom.. What happened to those werewolves last night?" Ivan yelled out a little stiffly, but fortunately, Esia didn't seem to notice the slight difference in the title.
"Did you hear that too?" Esiah squinted Ivan for a moment, and tapped his head with a spoon. "Then go to bed early next time!"
Ivan was quite speechless, and he had to sleep with such a loud wolf howling.
Aisia then explained aloud.
"The group of werewolves suddenly came to Knockdown Alley more than two months ago. It is possible that they could not stay in other places and were driven over. It was just that they had been very low-key and did not cause any major trouble before, so no one wanted to. Deal with them."
"I just don't know why it was out of control yesterday?" Aisia said there was some doubt here, but didn't think too much.

But after the wand left his hand, Ivan felt empty and insecure. What should I do in the next few days?

fit: 89%

However, the explanation in the appendix still surprised Ivan. He looked at the middle of the wand. There were a few weird characters there. When he used the Levitation Charm before, he noticed that the fluctuation of the spell was indeed much weaker than usual.

"Of course not. Making a magic wand is a very high-end technique. I just processed this magic wand." Aysia shook her head.

chapters.title: Chapter 95: Look, I think it's right to cultivate and protect the gods...
chapters.content:
Ivan was a little disappointed. He was still thinking whether he could learn the skills of making magic wands and make a magic wand by himself. It seemed that he was hopeless.
But this is reasonable. If the production of wands is so easy, then Diagon Alley will not be the only wand shop like Ollivander.
"By the way, mom, how do you use your god-calling guard?" Ivan asked instead.
"Not bad, what's the matter, you plan to learn this in the summer vacation?" Aysia said in surprise, then frowned.
"Although the Hushen Guardian is a high-level spell, it doesn't have much effect under normal circumstances. I think you should learn something more basic!"
"Basic spells? Do you mean these?"
Ivan waved his magic wand again and again, and muttered a spell in his mouth. A sandwich on the table floated first, then was torn into several large pieces, and then quickly transformed into several flying birds in the air.
The crisp bird song just sounded in the hall, and the next moment it was burned into coke by the raging fire...
A scent of grilled meat came out.
Due to the destruction of the deformed structure, the charred meat quickly turned into ashes and disappeared in the wind.
Ivan noticed this, so she shrugged and gave up the idea of ​​showing a few more basic spells, looking at Aisia...
Look...I think it's the right time to practice and protect the gods...
Aisia stared at this scene blankly,
Even though Ivan told her that she had good grades in school, except for the history of magic, all subjects were evaluated as outstanding.
As far as Esiah is concerned, Ivan is only in the first grade this year. No matter how good his grades are, how can his ability to cast spells be so strong?
And Ivan’s performance just now greatly exceeded Aysia’s expectations. In just a few seconds, he used the Levitating Curse, Splitting Curse, Transfiguration Curse, and Flame Curse one after another. , Without the slightest pause, we can see the solid foundation.
The deformation of this hand alone is more powerful than some adult wizards in Knock Down Alley.
Ivan looked at Esiah, who hadn't recovered for a long time, and wondered if he was acting too high-profile. He knew that he should hide some strength.
Ivan was annoyed. The next second he felt his cheek pinched, and he let out a painful cry, only to realize that Aysia was rubbing his face with both hands, and leaning forward to sniff the smell on his body. By the way, I asked a lot of questions.
Then it was confirmed that he was not pretended by a certain wizard with compound decoction...
"What are you doing?" Ivan was kneaded and a little slurred. In the process, he was a little frightened, but he still tried to restore the surprise and dissatisfaction that he should have.
"Unexpectedly, I would have given birth to a genius!" Aisia put her hands on her chin, and her purple pupils stared straight at Ivan, how she hadn't noticed before.
"No way, genius cannot be explained by common sense, just like Harry Potter, the savior of the magical world, who defeated the Dark Lord when he was born." Ivan vowed.
Deliberately mentioning Harry, Ivan is also preparing a little test, after all, Aysia's dissatisfaction with Dumbledore makes him very concerned.
"I don't see how special you were when you were born!" Aysia squeezed Ivan's hair with her hands anger, and gave him a white look. "And next time use other things to practice magic, don't waste food!"
Ivan nodded, but Esiah did not overreact and he was a little relieved, and then asked in a low voice.
"Then call the **** guard?"
"I'll wait until the meal is over." Aisia put a sandwich into Ivan's mouth and told him to shut up first. She hadn't recovered from the shock before.
After eating breakfast in a hurry, Aysia finally accepted the fact that her child is a super genius, and then she became extremely excited, and couldn't wait to see Ivan's strength.
"Go, let's go to the practice room in the basement, if I am satisfied, I will consider teaching you."
Ivan reluctantly followed Esiah all the way to the basement, and found that it was much larger than the two floors above. The overall area was divided into three areas, storage area, work area, and practice room.
It seems that Aisia has been building illegally in recent years.
Aysia entered the compartment of the practice room and changed into her nightgown. She put on her usual dark green wizard robe. She wore black gloves on her right hand. The silver silk on the gloves outlined strange lines. , And a few rings were put on the fingers of the empty left hand.
"Okay, let's stop here." Aysia walked to the right and stopped, turned to Ivan, and motioned for him to take the first shot.
Ivan looked around at the empty space around, only some practice dummies, and a few wooden tables and chairs placed beside or in the corner.
To be honest, Ivan is still not used to wielding a magic wand in a face-to-face battle like this, especially when facing a wizard who is obviously better than him...
How can he fight like this?
Ivan was depressed for a while and Esiah waited for a while, and became a little impatient, frowned, and wanted to speak...
The moment I noticed the change in Aysia's mentality, Ivan suddenly pulled out his wand.
There is no so-called duel etiquette, and there is no prompt to start the battle...
"Except your weapons!"
A dazzling red light passed in the air,
Aixia suffocated what he wanted to say, smiling at the corner of her mouth, and tapped a magical barrier in the air with her magic wand to block the red light.
When Aisia saw Ivan again, he had already blessed the iron armor curse on him.
Immediately afterwards, the sound of birdsong sounded in the practice room, but under the sweep of Ivan’s wand, dozens of small flying birds were in a blink of an eye under Ivan’s wand. Down, galloping towards Aisia.
Aixia has never intended to take the initiative, she is only testing Ivan's strength, so she slowly moved closer to Ivan, and on the black silk glove of her right hand, the stream of magic flashed by.
Not to see the curse, Aisia just tapped his right hand, and a little spark flew out of the wand, and then the spark expanded into a wide purple flame barrier. The flying birds continued to hit it, and it was turned into ashes before it passed...
At this moment, Esiah suddenly thought about it, and tilted his head, a dazzling white light from the flame went straight through the wiping hair, hitting the dummy far behind him.
"It's no good that the intention to fight is so obvious..." Aixia smiled and pointed, but her face suddenly changed in the next moment.
A gust of wind swept across behind him, and Aisia lowered his head to dodge, then forcibly twisted the waist and turned his body, kicking the slender thigh and kicking the activated dummy behind him.

chapters.content:
You are a wizard, not a berserker!

So the first thing to do is to limit her ability to move...
The purple flame barrier in front of him lost control and slowly disappeared. When Aysia stood still, more dummies had been activated. Ivan shamelessly hid behind several dummies, using them as shields, and then Control the other dummies to attack from the front, left, and right directions.
Perhaps feeling that such an offensive force was too weak, Ivan was about to block Aysia's only retreat, so he waved his wand and pointed at the square wooden tables behind Aysia.
"The wooden table is flying here!"
Under the traction of magic, several wooden tables rolled and flew in the direction of Ivan, while Aisia was just in the middle...
The size of the wooden table is not small, even the purple flame barrier before can not easily burn it...
Ivan feels that even if Esiah is undefeated, she should be in a panic, but Ivan soon happens to happen that Esiah laughs happily, and the laughter even makes him a little scared...
"Thunderbolt explodes!"
Aisia's voice suddenly sounded in the practice room, the wand was pointed, and the orange flame ignited, crashing into the galloping wooden table...
At the moment of contact, several wooden tables were blown into pieces with a bang, and then swallowed by flames...
Sawdust and ashes drifted down from the sky, affecting the light of the magic lamp. The entire practice room was covered with gray, and a dark ghost fire rose in the middle. After seeing it clearly, Ivan realized that it was not a ghost fire, but a small group of fierce fire. !
The activated dummy that rushed past was instantly burned to ashes. Ivan swallowed hard, but fortunately, the fierce fire quickly dissipated. I don’t know if it can’t be maintained or if I’m just afraid of him being burned to death...
"The whirlwind swept away!"
The violent wind blew on the training ground, and the sawdust floating in the air was swept away. Aysia's face was smiling but not smiling. There were faint magic patterns flashing on the few rings on her left hand, step by step towards Yi Where near...
is followed by a dazzling magic light...
The blue one is a coma spell... the purple one is a fear spell... the black-gray Ivan has no impression, but if he is hit, there is absolutely no good result.
Ivan was struggling to construct a magic barrier in front of him, but the various spells came too quickly and quickly, and the magic barrier just constructed was torn to pieces in less than a second.
The sundries and obstructions available around were almost smashed in the first few rounds. Now, besides him and Aysia, there is only one piece of debris left in the lounge...
The activated dummies around him suffered a few more times and fell to the ground.
Ivan even wondered if Esiah didn't need to chant spells and cast spells at all, and how did he practice his inhuman hand speed?
After resisting it for a while, Ivan soon noticed the abnormality of Aysia's right hand glove and the magical fluorescence flowing on the ring.
You are cheating!
Ivan almost yelled at him, but when he was distracted, he didn't check it for a while. He was hit by a black light. The reflective barrier built by the iron curse flashed past and the light bounced off before breaking and disappearing. West Asia shoots away.
Asya did not see it, the black light was automatically extinguished before it approached, and at the same time, the badge on Esiah’s magic robe gradually dimmed, and a crack appeared.
"Except your weapon!" Aysia did not dare to give Ivan the slightest chance. After breaking Ivan's Iron Armor Curse, the Disarming Curse followed.
Lost the last protection, Ivan subconsciously had to spend academic points to activate the experience card and use the Shadow of the Unicorn, but in the end he held it back. After all, this is not a real battle, and it is not worth the price.
After hesitating, the wand in Ivan's hand flew high and fell into Esiah's hand.
Esiah reached out to take it, and then pointed his wand at Ivan again..
"Fuchsia..."
"Wait...I surrender!" Ivan raised his hands without hesitation, but it didn't work. The body quickly turned upside down under the action of magic, so that Ivan's eyes could only be seen. Aysia's thighs.
"In a real battle, the enemy won't let you off because of surrender." Aisia knelt down and tapped Ivan's forehead with her magic wand.
After a lesson, Aysia waved his magic wand and put Ivan down.
"I have never seen any magic props in ordinary combat practice. You are cheating..." Ivan got up from the ground depressed.
After fighting for so long, of course he could see that in the course of the battle, Aysia relied on the blessing of a large number of magic items to achieve the same strength as before.
"Magic props are also part of the wizard's power!"
Aysia spoke out a lesson, but her heart was dripping blood. Many of the magic items used before are one-time magic items, which are difficult to repair after being destroyed...
It takes a lot of energy to reproduce, and a lot of Jin Jialong...
I can only say that Ivan’s strength really exceeded her expectations. In order to preserve her majesty as a mother, she would not be disgraced in the battle, so she could only burn money...
After Ivan got up to return the wand, summing up the previous battle process, I have to say that Esiah's strength is amazing.
Even at the beginning of passive defense, he can easily defuse his attacks, and when he actively attacks later, he can only parry.
Ivan estimated that even if he used blood magic, he couldn't confirm that he could win, because Aysia had obviously not exhausted all his strength just now, and many destructive magics could not be used in the battle.
Thinking of this, Ivan was somewhat disappointed, and Aysia naturally saw this and said with a smile.
"Why, you still want to beat me to be satisfied?"
Ivan shook his head frantically when he saw Aysia’s smiling face. He didn't want to experience the feeling of being hung in the air once.
"Then can I learn to call the gods now?" Ivan didn't forget the purpose of this battle, and hurriedly asked.
Aisia stretched out her hand to tidy up Ivan's clothes that seemed a little messy after the battle, and then asked Ivan to use the Hushen to protect her once. She really thought about how to teach it.
"Holy guard!" Ivan waved his wand, and the white mist gushed out from the top of the wand, gathering more and more around the two people, faintly hearing the unicorn neighing.
A breath of tranquility and peace surged into the hearts of the two of them...
Such a peculiar sight also surprised Esiah a little bit. The normal call to the guardian is not like this...

chapters.title: Chapter 97: Don’t believe me, after fighting this one, the family will go bankrupt..
chapters.content:
"Forbidden book area..." Ivan briefly explained.

I practice something to protect the gods?

Ivan guessed, but soon felt that it was impossible. It was not so easy to get a dementor.
Most of those things are guards in Azkaban, and the rest are also seen in groups in places where death and disease are spreading. It is difficult to deal with, let alone catch one alive.
The most likely one should be Bogut, which can transform what people fear most.
The expression on Ivan's face is a bit strange.
Aysia thinks that the thing he fears most is the dementor, so he rushed to learn to protect him, right?
Ivan Zhang wanted to ask, but Aysia was secretive, and probably wouldn't tell herself directly.
Forget it, Bogut is Bogut...

In my free time, I was pestering Aysia to learn how to make magic items.

"Detailed Explanation of Basic Magic Materials", "On the Conductivity of Metal Magic Power", "Magic Pattern Arrangement-Tips You Don't Know"...

But Ivan didn't have any repulsive thoughts. When he was at Hogwarts, he himself liked to soak in the library.
After throwing the book to Ivan, Aysia stayed in the basement to repair the magic items consumed before except occasionally going out.
And Ivan was successfully promoted to be the agent of this dark magic shop, or the salesperson at the front desk. When he encountered something that couldn't be solved, I would let Esiah deal with it.
Every week he works, he has two Jin Jialong as his salary, which is regarded as his pocket money...
So in addition to practicing magic all day long, Ivan just sat at the counter, flipping through books, and taking care of his black magic shop.
For several days, Ivan finished reading two books, but did not wait for any visitor to come.
Ivan is not surprised, selling dark magic goods, sometimes it is normal not to visit customers for ten and a half months. Only three or five deals are needed in a month, and the gold Jialong earned is enough for them to survive.

Jingle Bell...

Com has two sleeves, one long and one short. Dougt...
Former...Vice President of the St. Mungo Hospital for Magical Injuries!
is also his mother's most important friend in Knockdown Alley... and an ally!

Ivan subconsciously hid, and after hiding, he was stunned. Why was he so proficient?
Looking through the memory, Ivan discovered that he had done this action many times before, and there was about a half chance of being able to dodge it.
Dougt was not embarrassed if he failed to touch his head, he calmly retracted his hand, and Ivan spoke at this moment.
"My mother is in the basement, she should be repairing magic items? Is there anything you want?"
"I just came to see her." Dougt mumbled, and then walked inside.

"By the way, do you know any conflicts between my mother and Professor Dumbledore?"
Hearing Ivan talking about Dumbledore, Douglas didn't look good, so he hesitated for a while before speaking.
"That's because ten..."

chapters.content:

Dougt talked half way, leaving Ivan confused.
ten... ten what?
While Ivan was guessing silently in his heart, Aysia threw a book over and hit him on the head.
"Read me well, don't keep asking about irrelevant things..." Aysia gave him a dissatisfied look, and finally looked at Dougter.
"Did you get what I need?"
"Of course, it's just that this thing is not easy to handle. You have to find a box that can trap it, and it took a lot of effort to send it here."
Dougert grinned and continued to complain, but then the conversation changed, and he patted his chest to indicate that if he could help, this trouble would not be a big deal...
Aisia was not interested in listening to these nonsense, and threw the bag in her right hand over.
"Is this enough?"
"Look at what you said, I'm just doing a little favor, not a deal." Dougter smiled flatteringly, and after receiving it, he changed hands and threw it on the counter, beckoning Ivan to put it away.
The bag is not big, and it is very light when it hits the wooden counter, but there is a sound of metal crashing against each other.
Ivan guessed that the internal space of the bag may have been expanded and its weight reduced.
I looked in through the unfastened opening, there are glittering gold inside, there are many, all of them are Jin Jialong...
The conversation between the two of them, Ivan can also understand very clearly, the Jin Jialong that needs to spend this value, Dougt can only get a dementor...

As for the bag thrown on the table by Doug, Ivan didn't mean to touch it, because he understood the character of his mother, Aisia, and was never willing to accept help from others.

Even the Malfoy family was affected and had to find a way to dispose of the Horcrux notebook. It can be seen that the Ministry of Magic's investigation was not a simple trivia.
Aisia's face changed. If the Ministry of Magic really does this, then in the next few months, I am afraid that even a single big business will be gone.
After all, those who really buy magic items are mostly rich people from pure-blood families. It is not realistic to expect the poor ghosts of Knockdown Alley to consume them.
Even so, Aysia insisted.
"I will find a way to deal with this matter, you should put away the money first."
Seeing Esia's insistence, Dougt had no choice but to put the bag of Jin Jialong into his pocket, and then left for lunch with a dead skinny face.
This time, Aysia did not refuse, but Ivan was very helpless, because Doug always tried to get close to him, and seemed to want to start from him to get closer to Aysia.
Ivan rummaged through his own memories, and found that Dougte had been like this before, and he had never concealed his affection for Aysia.
Of course, the relative Aisia has never concealed that he has no interest in Dougt, but the other party is still happy...
Until the afternoon, Ivan was unable to get rid of the middle-aged man, because the dementor who practiced calling the gods was placed in Dougert’s house and it was said that it was not easy to move.
Dougt directly suggested that if he was going to do something to the dementor, he could go to his home, and it would be safer to have him under his care.
Aisia readily agreed, and then drove Ivan and Dougout out of the Black Magic Shop...
"So, the dementor is the little Ivan you want?" Dougt's expression is very strange, he thought it was Aesia who was involved in some dark magic experiments that needed the dementor.
"I used it to learn to call the gods, or else?" Ivan shrugged.
"I knew you were going to use it, so I brought the box over." Dougt muttered to himself.
Ivan naturally saw Dougt's careful thoughts, and was speechless, and he didn't want to spend an afternoon with this old man.
As soon as he went out, within a few minutesDougt took out a hip flask from his long sleeves and filled it up. The reason why he didn't drink it in front of Aysia was that Dougt didn't want to influence himself in the other side's mind. In front of Ivan, he couldn't help it.
Dougert’s house is not far from here, only a small alley, but the location is relatively remote, there are almost no houses around, but some trees and weeds grow empty, the side of the house is still slanted and slanted. There was a dusty sign with a few words outlined on it.
St Mungo’s Magic Hospital...
Ivan looked a little weird, if he remembers correctly, the hospital in the wizarding world seems to be called the Saint Mungo Hospital for Magical Injuries, right?
I dared to hang up the sign after deleting two words, this is also a ruthless person...
Fortunately, no one came to trouble him all these years...
When I reached the door, Ivan realized that someone was waiting there. It was a wizard in his thirties. The wizard robe on his body was very shabby. His eye sockets were deeply sunken, and the left hand under his sleeves was faint. Braving the black air.
Werewolf?
Ivan looked at him, and he quietly held the wand in his right hand. After only a few days, Ivan did not forget the battle that night. One of the silver-haired werewolves was hit by black magic in his left hand.
The scruffy wizard didn't mean to do anything. Instead, he walked up to Dougt and pulled his sleeves apart, revealing the corroded pits and pits, with a weird appearance of his left hand.
"Is there any help?" said the wizard.
Dougte drank, but that didn't affect his judgment at all. After looking at it for a while, he opened his five fingers and gestured.
"I can only last for five days?" The wizard was silent for a while before speaking.
"I mean, there are a total of five hundred Jin Jialong..." Doug said gruffly.

Five hundred Jin Jialong?
The shaggy wizard's eyebrows furrowed, anger flashed in his eyes, but he still said in a deep voice.
"I don't have that much.. But I can work for you to pay."
"No, I don't need manpower here...especially I don't need a werewolf! How much money do you have, I think about how you can cure it..." Dougter was very impatient.
After being exposed, the wizard's figure trembled, but there was no overreaction. He touched his tattered robe with his right hand and searched it. The search was very serious. In the end, he found only more than 50 Jin Jialongs. There are some silver sike and copper nat.
After thinking for a while, the wizard was ready to take back some more, but Dougt took all Jin Jialong with him, Yinxi Ke and Tong Nath did not move, and mumbled "Poor ghost werewolf... "After that, the wand was pulled out to prepare for treatment.
Dougt was muttering something in his mouth, the wand was placed on the pitted left hand of the wizard, and then the thick black energy was gradually drawn out and poured into the grass on the right under the guidance of the wand in Dougt's hand.
