has long been used to being treated this way, the werewolf wizard didn't react much but just turned and left dumbly.
"The fresh white juice can heal injuries, and the roots of wormwood ground into powder should have a certain effect on the injuries caused by black magic." Ivan suddenly reminded after the werewolf wizard left.
The werewolf wizard had a pause, then looked back at him with a slightly surprised look, then nodded, whispered as if to say something, turned and left...
"I didn't expect you to know a little knowledge about potions?" Dougt asked unexpectedly.
"It's not the first day that Hogwarts has a potions class." Ivan shrugged.
"I was also at Hogwarts back then, and I wouldn't teach these things in the first grade." Dougter looked appreciative, and he reached out his hand and wanted to stroke Ivan's hair, but this time he was still hidden. past.
"By the way, Dean Dougert, you don't want to see the werewolf?" Ivan asked aloud.
"There are no wizards to see them. Even in Knockdown Alley, few people are willing to recruit werewolves to work. They are just a group of troublesomes. They get out of control on the night of the full moon and are usually not very stable." Dougt watched. He gave an explanation with a glance.
"Isn't there a wolf poison potion?" Ivan asked in a puzzled way.
"Lemon Potion? What is that?" Dougt asked strangely.
Ivan suddenly shut up, he suddenly remembered that the wolf poison potion might not have been developed by Marcus and his uncle. No wonder the werewolves were so miserable.
But even if it is developed, most werewolves may not be able to afford it...
Dougt looked at Ivan suspiciously for a while, took out the key, opened the door of the mansion, and walked in.
Ivan followed Doug into this somewhat run-down mansion.
Everything inside looks a little messy. There are a lot of empty wine bottles on the mahogany table in the hall, the floor is stained with some yellow, yellow, green and green stains, and the flying broomstick hanging on the wall is full of dust. I don’t know how long it has not been. Used it.
Although Ivan knew that this was a work place transformed from a part of the mansion, he never expected it to be like this.
Is this really a hospital? You just let the patient stay here?
Ivan gave Dougt a weird look.
Dougte patted his head. It must have been too much alcohol yesterday. He originally planned to clean it up when he got up in the morning, but he forgot it for a while. Fortunately, it wasn't Esiah that came with him.
But when he usually stays alone, he obviously doesn’t think it’s too dirty, it’s okay...
Dougt muttered to himself, while waving his wand.
"Clean up!"
The magical ripples gradually spread to the surroundings, the crumbled empty wine bottles were automatically collected in the corners, the tables and chairs were moved to where they should be, and the dust was swept away in a short time. ...
In just a few minutes, this mansion was cleaned up to live in...
Only then did Ivan notice that there were many big photos hanging on the walls around the mansion.
is a young and handsome wizard with thick brown hair, holding a trophy in his hand, or taking photos with others, with a hearty smile on his face...
"Who is that? Your brother, or a child?" Ivan stared left and right.
"That's me!" Dougt glared at Ivan, he couldn't recognize him?
Ivan carefully looked at Dougt, especially the thinning hair and beer belly, comparing the young and handsome appearance in the photo.
He really can't tell...
But think about it, who was never handsome before...
Dougert didn't let Ivan stay in the hall but took him to a closed room.
It was empty here, only a big box was placed in the corner. Ivan walked a few steps and found that the surface of the box was burned with a large number of unknown magic texts, and he had a big booth in the wand and when he passed through the barriers. What you see on it is different.
Other than that, it’s hard to imagine that a terrifying dementor can be trapped with just a large box.
Ivan pretended to accidentally touch it lightly,
[Magic Item: Save Box
Magic: Medium
Description: This is a special box that has the ability to isolate magic power after some ancient magic texts have been burned. 】
"Don't touch it, I bought this box from the Wizard Market with a 30% discount. The seal may not be tight." Dougt came forward and slapped his hand, and said solemnly.
"I don't know why Aysia would agree with you to use a dementor to practice calling the gods, but I want to remind you that this is a terrifying-looking creature..."
Ivan nodded, he knew when he was reading in his previous life, and of course he knew the danger of dementors.
"How are you going to practice? Do you need me to demonstrate it?" Dougt was not pouring wine into his mouth, looking at Ivan with some worry. He would not be in danger of life by his side, but if I made a heart-wounding Aisia I'll blame him.
"No need, just come on..." Ivan thought for a while, but refused.
What he needs is pressure, the bigger the better...
If something really happened anyway, Dougt would take care of it in time.
(PS: I found a lot of information about the potion of wolf poison. The original book didn't seem to mention the specific time of the invention, only that it was invented recently, so it was set when Harry was in the second grade, um... This book shall prevail.)

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Let go of this dementor, it has worked hard enough...
chapters.content:
"Well, you pay attention..."
Dougert put his wand on the lock, shattered it, and slammed the box open, and then retreated to the other corner with great strides, lest he become the dementor's primary target.
The next moment, the surroundings seemed to become dim, and the box containing the dementors looked even more black holes.
cold...dead silence...
Ivan feels his body has fallen into the ice cellar, what power is there to draw away the heat from his body.
Then, a withered, crusted palm stretched out from the box, and a weird figure in a cloak floated out.
It doesn’t seem to have legs, it just floats in the air... the exposed body is rotten and the bones can be seen...
Ivan has seen the pitted arms of the werewolf, and also seen Chino's body after being burned by flames, but it is far from being compared with the dementor. The dementor looks like a mummy covered in rags. Only an empty body...
Ivan tried hard to think of happy things in his heart, but couldn't remember at all. He just felt like he was back in the hospital bed. The devil named Pain was drawing his only vitality bit by bit. He was unable to resist and could only sit and watch his own death.
Dougt took a sip of wine, his wand was already in his hand, ready to intervene at any time, he felt that Ivan might not be able to hold on, he only hoped that this would not leave any psychological shadows.
The dementor had already floated in front of Ivan at this time, breathing out a cold breath, and then gradually peeled off an illusory thing with various colors from Ivan's body, and sucked into the hollow space. In the mouth...
I don’t know when, the dementor’s dry fingers have grabbed the brim of the hat, ready to open it, Dougart is about to make a move, but stops again, because a magic wand has been stretched into the dementor’s mouth...
"Call God to guard!"
Under the threat of death, Ivan shouted loudly.
In the dim and dead space, the color was restored, accompanied by a neighing sound, the dazzling light pierced the body of the dementor, and then more light penetrated from its tattered cloak.
The silent wailing sound shook the surrounding air, and the light body of the dementor seemed to have received a heavy blow. The figure was a little illusory, and it flew out, and finally got into the box under the pressure of the white mist. .
The white mist was about to pour in, and the box was suddenly covered, but Doug had walked to the box for some time and started to clean up the mess.
"How do you feel? Is it okay? I don't have chocolate here, maybe you can drink a little... wine?" Dougt asked concerned.
"No, I'm fine.. The wine is fine." Ivan shook his head, then glanced at the system panel.
Hushen's Guardian was directly promoted to Level 3. The pressure this time was not normal. It's worth noting that he deliberately didn't use Occlumency to resist the Dementor's ability to absorb happiness.
"Go ahead!" Ivan spent a few minutes adjusting his emotions and then continued.
"So fast? Don't take a break?" Doug raised his eyebrows.
"Go on!" Ivan insisted.
Dougteyiyan opened the box, and the dementor rushed out again. Its face was hidden in the cloak, but for some reason, Ivan could feel the anger of the other party...
"Holy guard!" Faced with the dementors again, Ivan is already familiar with the road, and his fear has been reduced a lot. More importantly, the upgrade of skills has made him find happiness...
The white mist reappeared, this time more than before, and even faintly condensed into the appearance of a patron saint, the white mist wrapped the body of the dementor and pressed it back into the box again.
[Ding, after practice, the proficiency of calling the gods and guards has been greatly improved...]
"Huh..." Ivan looked at the prompts in the system bar and was very satisfied. Faced with the dementors to practice calling the gods, the proficiency really increased quickly.
In this case, you might be able to raise your level to level four in one afternoon...
Thinking of this, Ivan said excitedly.
"carry on..."
Dougt's look is very strange, the dementor's horrible ability to absorb pleasure and create pain, even many adult wizards are reluctant to face them.
I didn't expect that not only did Ivan endure the pressure, but on the contrary, he became more and more excited. Although he was a little puzzled, Dougt still did.
Out of the box for the third time, the dementor looked like a black rag, pressing on its flat body, and rushed towards Ivan, but was entangled in the white mist and defeated by Ivan..
For the fourth time, the Dementor wanted to escape, but Dougt cast a call to the guard and pushed it back into the box again.
the fifth time...
the sixth time....
Ivan had a great time playing, and the level three guards were not enough to kill the dementors, so you can safely practice boldly.
And every time the proficiency increases will make him happier...
[Ding, after practice, the proficiency of calling the gods and guards has been greatly improved...]
【Hushen Guardian rose to level four, current proficiency (1/1600), and 20 academic points awarded! 】
After defeating the Dementor for the eleventh time, the system prompt finally sounded in Ivan's mind.
The white mist floating around slowly condensed, and the long hiss of the unicorn was clearly visible in the basement.
Dougt raised his brows. He had already noticed the difference between Ivan Hushen's guards, but thought it was related to Esiah, so he didn't inquire.
I am a little curious now, what exactly is Ivan's patron saint.
However, the Hushen guard who faintly condensed into a horse turned into a white mist again at the last moment, Doug shook his head and sighed.
Ivan didn't have any disappointed look on his face, because he did it deliberately this time.
Although Dougt is one of the few people who can be trusted in his memory, they have only met Ivan for less than a day. The Shadow of the Unicorn is his biggest trump card today. Of course, the fewer people who know, the better. ..
"Do you want to continue?" Dougter asked Ivan nodded, since the Hushen Guardian is related to his blood magic, the higher the level, the better, and finally he has the opportunity The dementor is a sparring partner, of course, as long as you can practice.
However, after Dougt opened the box for the twelfth time, Ivan, who was standing on the side, had not waited for the Dementor to attack for a long time.
Just as Ivan doubted whether the dementor was killed by himself, a rotten arm stretched out, clutching the lid and closing the box with a "bang"...
It thinks it’s good to stay in the box, and doesn’t want to come out...
Ivan stood in front of the box blankly, completely unexpected that the Dementor would react like this.
Ivan turned his head and looked at Dougt with a strange expression.
Dougt was also confused, and said awkwardly. "En... I think it may be tired today and needs a rest... or we will come again tomorrow."
"Isn't it said that the dementor is a dark, cruel, and confused creature?" Ivan said silently.
"That's right, but they still have an IQ and can understand commands, otherwise the Ministry of Magic would not use dementors to guard Azkaban." Dougt explained.
(PS: Lupin had never drunk the wolf poison potion when he was in school. Every time he turned into a full moon, he would lose control and could only stay in the screaming hut. Moreover, as an important member of the Order of the Phoenix, Lupin participated in the resistance. Voldemort’s hero, Dumbledore would never allow him to be so poor if he had a way. So it is likely that the wolf poison potion was developed when Harry was in his second grade, and Dumbledore received the news and dismissed his amnesia at the end of the semester. Lockhart immediately retrieved Lupin, who was wandering outside, and made him a professor of Defense Against the Dark Arts.)

chapters.title: Chapter 101: Say it again, and I will press your head into the cauldron!
chapters.content:
Isn’t the Ministry of Magic employing dementors because they don’t need money, they are open all year round, and they bring their own "torture instruments"?
Ivan murmured silently, but still said generously.
"Forget it, let it rest for a day... We will come back tomorrow."
is able to upgrade the Hushen Guard to Level 4, which is enough for him, and then he only needs to take the time to practice slowly.
Dougt could see that Ivan was in a good mood, but since Ivan had been fighting the Dementors for so long, he still made suggestions.
"It's still early, how about I take you outside for a stroll?"
Ivan nodded, staying in the black magic shop every day and couldn't go out, he was a little bit too busy for a long time.
After 　　 came here, Ivan always wanted to know what Knockdown Alley looked like, but he had not upgraded the Hushen Guard to Level 4 before, so he didn't have the guts to go out alone.
"Let's go, I think you'll like that place..." Dougt said mysteriously.
Ivan has some interest.
Dougert re-locked the box holding the dementor, and then planted protective magic in this empty room, and then took Ivan out of the house.
"What if I wait for a patient to come?" Ivan glanced back.
"They'll wait there obediently." Doug said nothing.
Those who are willing to come here to treat are some special patients, either because they are injured because of shameful reasons, or else they are the dark wizards with criminal records. They can't go to a regular hospital, they can only come to him.
They have to wait no matter how long!
Ivan quickly figured out this, and understood in his heart, it's no wonder that Dougte offered such a cruel price during the treatment. It turned out that he was not afraid of the opponent's rejection...
After walking for about twenty minutes, Dougte's path became more and more skewed, and Ivan's brows frowned.
If it weren’t for his memory to show that Doug had been acquainted with his mother for more than ten years, and the relationship had been good, Ivan would almost think he was trafficked.
Fortunately a few minutes later, Ivan found that there were more pedestrians around him.
Further ahead, there is a large square that is somewhat dilapidated, but it is very lively. On both sides of the square, many wizard seats are sitting on the ground, and a piece of rag is placed in front of them, on which weird magical objects or materials are placed. ....
"That's what you're talking about?" Ivan looked around curiously. He felt that these wizards were like street vendors in the night market in the previous life.
"Of course, your mother hasn't brought you here yet?" Dougt looked back at him, and then explained.
"This is the Wizard Market in Knock Down Alley. Regardless of whether it is legal or illegal, everyone can find what they want here."
"No." Ivan shook his head, remembering that Aixia would only take him to Diagon Alley occasionally to play.
"Did you buy the dementors here too?" Ivan asked.
"You want to be beautiful!" Dougt rolled his eyes. "It took me a lot of tongues and a lot of Jin Jialong to get it with a friend."
"Even here it is impossible to buy it." Doug said proudly, but didn't notice Ivan muttering to himself.
Can you sell everything that is good? con man!
"Let's take a look, if there is anything you want... I pay it and treat it as a gift for you." Dougter gestured, but saw Ivan's eyes light up, and then added another sentence.
"Don't choose too expensive..."
Ivan ignored him, but walked to one of the stalls, squatted down, and picked up a bottle of blood.
This is a bottle of Ye Qi’s blood, and there are bottles with dragon blood and unicorn blood beside it. Ivan was a little emotional for a while. What he had so painstakingly wanted to get could be so easy to buy in the market. To.
But after getting in touch, Ivan realized the difference.
【Blood of Ye Qi
Activity: very low
Explanation: This is the blood of a male adult Ye Qi, which contains the magic power of death. 】
Noting the prompt in the system's inventory, Ivan shook his head disappointedly and put the bottle back. The activity of the blood was too low, and I didn't know how long it was left for it to be used to make blood fusion potions.
"A bottle of dragon blood 35 gallons, night skeletal blood 50 gallons, unicorn blood...70 gallons!"
The stall owner is an old witch with a pipe dangling, wearing a top-pointed hat and smoking smoke in her mouth. After seeing Ivan shaking her head, she leaped forward and stared at him.
"But seeing you look cute, how about your sister giving you a 30% discount?"
Ivan leaned back calmly. He didn't understand the market price, but he also knew that the price was really high. It was a bit abnormal. The horn of a unicorn in Diagon Alley was only 21 gallons. but...
"Why is unicorn blood so much more expensive than others?" Ivan asked strangely.
"Have you heard that someone raises unicorns?" the old witch asked.
Ivan understands that dragons are bred in some places, and some of the night rides are also tamed by wizards. It is normal for the price to be lower.
"Have you not chosen yet?" Dougt walked up at this time, and when he saw the three bottles under Ivan's gaze, he frowned, picked up one of them, and took out some gold from the bag. Kanon put it on the stall.
"The black market price, Ye Qi blood 11 gallons, just buy this!"
The old witch shook her hand with the cigarette. and started cursing with her eyebrows raised, but after raising her eyes to see the person, she stopped talking again and smashed her mouth.
"Mad Dog Dougt?"
"You say it again, I'll press your head into the cauldron!" Dougter grinned, and after dropping the money, he took Ivan and left the small stall.
"Why are you buying Ye Qi blood? I just look at it." Ivan said helplessly.
"Don't worry, it won't be wasted. Even if you don't need it, your mother will use it." Dougt blinked at him.
Ivan looked at him, thinking that Dougte had discovered the secret of his blood fusion, but then he reacted. Dougte pointed out that it should be used to make certain magic items, and he slowly breathed a sigh of relief. Then asked curiously.
"Why did that old witch call you just now?"
"Hmm... sometimes multiple deterrent nicknames can save a lot of trouble..." Dougt explained casually with his eyes flashing.
Ivan didn’t ask more. After spending an afternoon together, he didn’t see that Doug was like a mad dog. Although he liked to drink and behave strangely, he was still normal.
Does it mean that he is drunk and likes to go crazy?
Ivan looked at Dougert’s drunk appearance, calmly a little farther away from him...
(PS: The inventor of the wolf poison potion was Bellby's uncle Damocles Marcus, not Snape. It is mentioned in the sixth book of the original work, and I have mentioned it in the previous chapters. In addition, as In contrast to prices, the original Unicorn Horn sold 21 Jin Jialong, and 17 ounces (28.350 grams) of Dragon Liver.)

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Circle of Magic
chapters.content:
After shopping like this for a long time, Ivan picked and bought a lot of materials for making potions, and prepared to practice his hands after returning home.
In the future, black magic items may not be easy to sell. In order to make the family's business better, maybe he can make some potions to try.
In view of Dougt’s status as the former deputy director of the St. Mungo’s Hospital for Magical Injuries and Injuries, Ivan asked for advice on the production and sale of potions.
"Are you going to sell potions?" Dougt stopped walking.
"Listen, the making of potions is never easy. If the various processes are a little bit close, the effect will be very different. Maybe you have successfully made some potions in the potions class at Hogwarts. , But that is far from the level that can be sold!"
"For a bottle of potion for sale, it not only needs to have a significant effect, but also has a strong stability, instead of making the purchaser not know how much the potion can do before drinking it."
Dougert patiently explained to Ivan, and then even suggested.
"If you are interested in potions, I suggest that you should go to the potions department of the St. Mungo Hospital for Magical Injuries and Injuries for a period of time after graduation."
Ivan listened very carefully, but he still had some confidence in his potion level, especially in the experience card mode, even blood fusion potions that required a level 6 potion level could be deployed smoothly.
"Well, you first go to the neighborhood by yourself, don't get too far away, call me if you have something." At this time, Dougt, as if he had discovered something, grabbed some gold gallons from his pocket and gave it to him. Ivan, after an order, squeezed towards a lively stall.
Ivan took the money, but didn't refuse. Taking advantage of this opportunity, he just wanted to buy something, so he just assumed it was borrowed, and he would return it when he had money.
By the way, Ivan glanced in the direction where Dougt was, and found that there were a few wizards and goblins playing cards, possibly a gambling place, and suddenly lost interest.
"Drinking...gambling...extortion, how did this character become the deputy dean in the first place?" Ivan shook his head looking at the enthusiastic appearance of Dougt sitting there.
After Doggett left, Ivan let go of his hands and feet, and walked around the wizarding market.
With the identification function of the system, Ivan felt that he might be able to find some good things in the market.
Special offer Dragon Liver Qixico one ounce...
The venom of the eight-eyed giant spider is only sold for 60 gallons...
...
There are all sorts of weird things in various small stalls, and there are endless screams, many of which are far below the market price of Diagon Alley.
But relatively, here is also chaotic. Many of the goods sold are fake and defective products, which are difficult to distinguish with the naked eye.
Ivan saw a light wheel 2000 that only sells for sixty gallons at a stall, but after contacting it, he found that the speed of this thing was only a pitiful 40 miles per hour, and he didn’t know what it was. The method makes it look like the light wheel 2000.
In the end, Ivan only found something worth buying in an inconspicuous small stall.
It is a silver bracelet, which seems to be made up of some animal bones in series. The link at the end is a circular mark on which there are seventeen magic texts arranged in a certain order.
These are some brand new ancient magic texts that he doesn't know... even the book introducing ancient magic texts given to him by Esiah didn't mention it.
At the moment of contact, the system's information appeared in Ivan's mind.
【Magic Item: Magic Ring
Magic power: low (high)
Effect: Condensing magic power, repelling objects within one meter (three meters) of the whole body
Explanation: It only looks intact on the surface...but due to improper use by the holder, this bracelet is close to the edge of damage, and you can only stimulate its power twice. 】
"The circle of magic power, 900 gallons!" The stall owner was a short wizard. Seeing that Ivan was just an eleven or twelve-year-old wizard, he couldn't really draw much interest, but he still introduced it.
"As long as the magic power is poured in, the stored magic power can be exploded when needed, and the power can knock an adult wizard into the air."
"A thing that is about to be damaged, would you dare to sell it so expensive?" Ivan glanced at him and said without hesitation.
The short wizard was stunned first, then furious.
"Damaged? This is intact! If you can't afford it, get out!"
"Really? Not necessarily..." Ivan said as he took out ten Jin Jialong from his pocket and placed it on the stall.
"This is ten golden gallons. How about a bet with you? Your magic circle can only be used twice, and the effect is not half of what you said... If I lose, the money goes to you, I won the bracelet to me..."
The short wizard shut up. Over the past few months, he has been setting up a stall. Many wizards have been able to see that there is a problem with the bracelet, but this is the first one to be so precise.
Even he himself is not sure how many times this bracelet can be used, only knowing that it will be broken soon.
"My house sells magic items."
Ivan explained that the short wizard knew it, and after looking at him for a while, he said depressedly.
"Sixty Jin Jialong, you can take it away if you want...maybe it can still be used for repairs."
"Six pieces, I will tell you with the most professional eyes, this has the value of research at most..." Ivan doesn't understand the market price, so I just cut it off. .
The short wizard looked at him for a while, only to offer him one word.
"Go!"
"If the price is too low, we can talk again..." Ivan didn't mean to leave, but he also knew that the bargaining was too harsh, and his tone slowed down a lot for a while.
In the end, Ivan finally got it at the price of thirty-five gold gallons after going through a bitter fight.
Did I make a profit? Still lost?
Ivan put the bracelet on his left hand, always struggling with this question in his mind, but thinking that the real precious thing might be the magic text on it, I feel better.
Seeing the sky gradually dimmed, Ivan did not go to other stalls, but found Dougte, who was still playing cards in that small stall.
The stall owner seemed to be a fairy. He was so casually draped in a piece of rags and sat on a tall stool. If it weren’t for the stall owner’s position, some Jin Jialong had been placed in front of him. I thought it was a house elf brought out by a wizard.
"Lost?" Ivan stepped forward, looked at the situation on the court, and asked Douglet.
He doesn’t know how to play the wizard card, but just look at the expressions of a few people. The stall owner’s goblin has always been smiling, and the other two card players’ faces are not very good. The worst expression is Doug, he The facial features are almost squeezed together..
(PS: Thank you for your recommended tickets and rewards. This book should be available on the first day of next month. It will be added and updated at that time. Please also support it, even if it is the first order... Thanks ...)

chapters.title: Chapter 103: Mad Dog Dougt
chapters.content:
"It's just a momentary victory, I'll play two more games, and I'll win it back soon..." Dougt frowned tightly, staring at the cards in his hand, not paying attention to his meaning at all.
Ivan shook his head helplessly, and had to wait.
said it was playing two rounds, but when the addiction came up, Dougt played for another full hour. Fortunately, this time it seemed to be a transfer, and he actually won several times in the middle.
Earned some money, Dougt finally closed his hand after losing another round. He always felt that there was something wrong with the hand today, so he was about to pull Ivan away.
"Dougt, are you not playing anymore? You may win a few more rounds..." the goblin stall owner threw a few gold gallons and said with a grin.
"Forget it, let's talk about it when I have time." Dougter waved his hand, his expression not very pretty.
"What a coward... just so afraid of losing it?"
The fairy stall owner murmured a few words unswervingly, and reached out to collect Jin Jialong from the table, but as soon as the voice fell, a big hand grabbed his head and hit the table heavily... .
嘭~
The round table made of mahogany was smashed with several cracks, the golden Kanon rolled from the round table to the ground, the goblin’s ugly wrinkled big head was bruised, red blood, and white nose. They came out of the nose together.
"Who do you think is a coward?" Dougter looked like a madman and didn't mean to stop at all. After holding the goblin's head and hitting it **** the wooden table a few times, he grabbed the hot water bottle and poured it directly on it. ..
The shrill wailing sounded in the wizard market, attracting attention from the wizards around, but no one came up to help, just watching the excitement. Managing order is what the law enforcement team does.
The two wizards who played cards together were also shocked. One of them stepped back abruptly, obviously not wanting to participate.
Another wizard in a green robe drew his wand after reacting and pointed it at Dougt.
However, before he could successfully cast the spell, the overturned cup on the table turned into a purple zebra snake and bit it on the wizard's right hand holding the magic wand, and the long snake body entangled directly. , Tied the wizard's right hand.
"Ah~" The green-robed wizard screamed a few times before he noticed the existence of Ivan, an eleven or twelve-year-old wizard, but it was too late...
"Faint!" Ivan waved his magic wand, and the green-robed wizard fell to the ground.
Although Ivan didn't know what Dougt was suddenly nervous about, he wouldn't have any hesitation since the fight started. After taking care of the trouble, Ivan held his wand and looked at another wizard who was participating in the card game vigilantly.
He wouldn't swell up just because he easily knocked down an adult wizard just now. He just caught the opponent by surprise.
However, the wizard directly raised his hand and acted to show that he had no malice, and had nothing to do with the stallholder fairy, and would never participate.
More importantly, the wizard thinks this combination of big and small is too cruel... he can't beat...
Ivan didn't expect that the other party would react like this, but he didn't relax his vigilance and just stared at him.
Dougt took a look here, and when he saw that Ivan had dealt with the trouble for him, he turned his head, opened his mouth wide, put his wand on the goblin's neck, and questioned again angrily.
"Who did you say was a coward? Who?"
The fairy stall owner whose head was pressed on the mahogany table has not yet understood why he was beaten. There is a paste in his head, his mouth opened to leak the air, and his mouth with several teeth broken, and said slightly trembling.
"I... I'm a coward..."
At this moment, there was a commotion in the crowd, and Ivan looked over and found that a group of neatly dressed black-robed wizards were rushing toward this side.
"Help!" The fairy stall owner yelled with tears as if he had seen a savior, but the next second his head hit the corner of the table and fainted directly.
Several black-robed wizards looked here and even drew their wands. It was obvious that they were coming to him and the others. Ivan squeezed the wand, and Dougt vented some anger at this time. After fainting the goblin, He pulled Ivan closer, and then cast a spell.
"Phantom Shift..."
The colorful rays of magic power had already struck, but fortunately, the timing of Dougt's spellcasting was just right, and all of these magics were missed.
is another space displacement, it feels not much better than when using Floo powder.
When Ivan saw his surroundings again, he found that he was already in a dilapidated alley with some **** piled up next to him, and the surrounding houses were all dilapidated, and they seemed to have been abandoned for a long time.
After he was safe, Ivan also had some anger in his heart. This fight was simply inexplicable, just because the goblin scolded him Dougt a coward?
Are you crazy?
Not to mention being chased by a group of wizards in the end, and had to run away in a hurry. It feels terrible!
Ivan was trying to question, but saw Dougt's face change drastically, he grabbed his arm and ran.
"Let's go, they have magic items that can locate the apparition!"
"Who are these black-robed wizards who are chasing us? Are they from the Ministry of Magic?" Ivan also knew that it was not the time to quarrel and asked with restrained anger.
"Of course not. They are some wizards privately hired by the wizard market. They are called law enforcers by many people and are responsible for managing order..." Dougt calmed down at this time, although there were still some drunken red spots on his face. But the consciousness is still awake.

why did he come here?
......
On the first floor, in the black magic shop, Aysia opened the door,
Outside the door was Dougt, who hadn't seen him in a few days, with a large box behind him. It was the storage box containing the Dementor.
"Dao...Ge...T!" Seeing the person who came, Aysia's anger that had been about to strike Ivan completely turned to Dougte.
Dougt also knows the newspaper very well, waved his hand, his face looked guilty.
"Asiah, this time, it was all my fault. If Ivan hadn't made the shot in time two days ago, I might have been caught by those law enforcement officers."
Aisia wanted to accuse Dougt of arbitrarily involving Ivan in a dangerous battle, but he was stunned when he heard Dougt's words.
Isn’t it written in the newspaper that he solved the five law enforcement officers alone?
How to listen to Dougert's meaning, it seems like Ivan did it.
Aisia turned her head suspiciously and looked upstairs. She remembered that someone said that she had just done some minor auxiliary work...
"What, didn't Little Ivan tell you?" Dougt saw Aysia's movements and suddenly asked with some doubts.
He asked Ivan to conceal the news for a while, but he wanted to wait for the matter to be dealt with before he came to apologize.
It’s just that the plan is somewhat different from the actual actions in the future, and such a big thing can’t be concealed at all, so he simply made a lot of trouble and took the matter to himself. He thought that Ivan had already told Aysia after the news came out. .
"No, so what is going on in the end?" Aysia gritted her teeth.
Dougt felt guilty and didn't mean to conceal it. He drank too much, and made a little noise in the wizard market. Finally, he talked about the fight with the law enforcement team.
The shadow of the unicorn used by Ivan in the battle still shocked Dougt. After speaking, he couldn't help but sigh.
"This is the first time I know that the Hals family has such a powerful spell, no wonder I have to practice it with Dementors."
The Hals family has such a powerful spell? I do not know how?
Isiah was confused, especially when Dougter said that the Ivan had used a powerful curse similar to the guardian of God before he showed up, and easily solved a few law enforcement officers~www. mtlnovel.com~ almost thought that Dougte was telling a story.
You must know that the law enforcers in the wizard market are all professionally trained. Although there is still a gap compared to the Auror of the Ministry of Magic, they are definitely much better than the average wizard.
"I don't think even that person can do this in this grade." Dougt muttered to himself, thinking of someone who frightened him.
"By the way, how come I have never seen you use this spell before." Dougt asked curiously instead.
"That's because I don't know how to..." Aisia's face was very strange, but he did not deny that the shadow of the unicorn is the curse of the Hals family.
"That's right, this level of curse also requires talent." Doug nodded his head, thinking that Aysia was saying that only Ivan in the Hals family could learn this mysterious and powerful magic.
Aisia was silent for a while. She really didn't know how to deal with Dougt's brain supplement. After thinking about it, she turned her head and shouted upstairs.
"Ivan Hals!"
There was silence upstairs, and there was no response. After a while, the sound of "stepping down the stairs" sounded.
Ivan heard the voice of Aisia talking with Dougte upstairs, and now he can only bite the bullet and go downstairs.
In front of Dougte, Aysia was not good at asking questions directly, but angrily gave Ivan a look, indicating what is going on with that so-called powerful spell?
Ivan looked back with an innocent expression and said.
Didn’t you know before? My Hushen Guard is a little bit special...

chapters.title: Chapter 109: It's this book that taught me bad
chapters.content:
Is this just a bit special?
Aisia thinks Ivan has any misunderstandings about the term "Little"...
After some eye contact, Ivan keenly noticed that Aysia's expression became more and more wrong, and hurriedly looked at Dougt and changed the subject.
"Dean Dougter, have you settled with the people in the wizarding market?"
After glaring at Ivan fiercely, Aysia turned to look at Dougt.
"It's almost... we have beaten them this time. Of course, I lost some Jin Jialong, so that the wizard market will not lose face."
said this, Dougt's face also showed a little pride. He became famous in Knockout Alley through this incident, and then he was afraid that not many people would dare to provoke him.
"Are you sure?" Aysia frowned. The most important thing in the pure-blood wizard family is face.
"I am also a member of the Bohan family anyway, they still have to take care of one or two." Doug sighed.
"Didn't you tell me that you have been removed from the Bohan family?" Aisia asked.
"But few people know that right?" Dougt smiled mockingly. He didn't expect that after he was removed, he would have to rely on his family's reputation one day.
Bohan family? Which Bohan family?
Ivan recalled the memories in his mind, as if none of the famous families was named Bohan.
Occasionally, Ivan remembered that he had seen a related name in Hogwarts' books of famous modern figures.
Mungo Bohan... the founder of the Saint Mungo Hospital for Magical Injuries!
Ivan finally understood, it’s no wonder that Dougt was able to become the deputy director of the Saint Mungo’s Hospital for Magical Injuries and Injuries at around thirty. In addition to his outstanding ability, I’m afraid it was also because he was a member of the Bohan family.
Although this family is not well-known in the magic world, and the number of people is small, it is not included in the Twenty-Eight Pureblood family.
But since members of the Bohan family have served in the Saint Mungo Magical Injury Hospital for almost generations, the potential influence is extremely large, not to mention that the current dean is a member of the Bohan family.
"So, the matter has been settled now." Thinking of this, Ivan was relieved and relieved a lot.
"It should be so, at least on the surface they won't conflict with us anymore." Doug nodded his head, and then hesitated again.
"But I'm not sure if those purebloods will stumble upon us in private. Especially the Ministry of Magic has recently begun to investigate the proliferation of black magic items...maybe they will use this to make a fuss."
"Are you worried that they will put pressure on the Ministry? Find Knockover Alley... Find me here?" Aysia said with a frown.
"Yes, many people in Knockdown Alley know that we have a good relationship, and I only have a broken house, there is nothing to target, but you are different here, so I am a little worried." Doug sighed, this That's why he came today.
"Can the hands of the Ministry of Magic reach here?" Ivan asked strangely.
"Strictly speaking, Knockdown Alley is also under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Magic, but it is too messy here, and there is not much oil and water to fish, so the Ministry of Magic has always adopted a laissez-faire attitude."
Dougert answered Ivan's doubts, and then looked at Esiah.
"Although there is only this possibility, you can't help but prevent it. In short, you may have to remove the black magic items in the store first, or temporarily suspend business for a while.
I will ask for information, and when the Ministry of Magic's operation is over, you will return to the original state. "
While talking, Doug took a bag from his waist apologetically and threw it over.
"There are a thousand gold gallons in it, which should be enough for you to use during this time."
"No, you remember to drink less next time!" Aysia shook her head, and after taking it, she threw it back again.
Aisia knows very well that for Dougte, who is a good wine and a gambler, this daughter is probably all his savings.
Dougte persuaded him for a while, but he still couldn't keep the bag of money, so he had to leave in grief. Since he got into trouble, he had to deal with the follow-up.
In the black magic shop for a while, only Ivan and Esiah were left.
Ivan kept a calm face, still thinking about the bad news from Dougt.
Originally, because of the Ministry of Magic's inspection problem, the business in the store was already too bad, but now that this one comes again, I am afraid that even a single business will be gone in this period of time.
was thinking about it, Ivan suddenly felt a chill, but when he looked up, he realized that Asiah was looking at him.
"Now you can tell the truth about what happened?" Aysia's face was full of anger, and she seemed to want to curse a few words, but in the end it all turned into a sigh.
Ivan was silent for a while, remembering the crescent moon pendant that Aysia had given him, and reflecting on whether he was too guarded against Aysia.
As a traverser who came over halfway, although Ivan relied on learning Occlumency to organize his memories, it did not mean that he was able to accept all this.
He just pretended to look like himself in his memory with a trace of guilt After all, when he first crossed over, what he worried most was that the original black wizard mother discovered that he was a fake.
took the risk to perform a dangerous blood fusion ceremony, in order to save his life in the hands of the furious Aisia in the worst case.
It's just that Aysia's trust and worry for him touched Ivan a little bit. After thinking about it, I thought he might be able to give back some trust, and said.
"Mom.. I didn't hide it from you, I just don't want you to worry about it."
"The Origin of Blood is coming!" Ivan turned around and waved his wand.
In the small room on the second floor, the suitcase placed in the corner suddenly shook. A heavy book flew out of the suitcase and flew all the way to Ivan's hands.
"This book is?" Aysia didn't understand why Ivan suddenly took out a book, and after leaning up to take a look, he found that it was an old book with a slight yellowing of the paper, which was obviously old. .
"I found this book in the forbidden book zone. I relied on it to gain a lot of magical powers, so I kept it with me and didn't return it." Ivan turned the pages of the book and handed it to Aisia.
Aisia took it curiously, and after turning two pages, her complexion became a lot more dignified.
Because the book contains a lot of content that violates her previous cognition, especially about the origin of deformed creatures such as werewolves and vampires, and the history of ancient wizards who seized the power of other magical creatures.
If it spreads out, the entire magical world will boil...

chapters.title: Chapter 110: Hals Strange Magic Item Store
chapters.content:
"Why are there a few pages missing from this book?" Aisia turned to the end and found that the key pages had been torn off.
"I don't think it's safe to keep it around, so I tore off the key pages and burned them. The specific fusion method was only recorded in my mind." Ivan thought for a while and didn't tell the truth, because He couldn't explain how he got the blood fusion potion formula.
Aixia nodded. The fewer people who know this level of secret information, the better. Although Ivan was more cautious in doing this, it was not wrong.
But after thinking about it, Aysia realized that something was wrong again.
"So, if you find a book in the forbidden area, dare you follow the above method to fuse your blood?"
"You forgot how I taught you? What if the content on this is nonsense?" Aysia grabbed Ivan's cheek angrily and said angrily.
"But this book makes a lot of sense." Ivan said depressedly, but he was feeling weak in his heart. He can't say that the system has confirmed it...
Besides, he worked hard to improve his strength, but he didn't want to save his life.
Aisia didn't know what Ivan was thinking in his heart, and he had been preaching for more than half an hour without any intention of stopping.
After watching "Origin of Blood", Aysia understood the risks involved. In her opinion, Ivan is still standing here now, it is completely the result of overwhelming luck.
Until the curse was dry, Esiah stopped, and then asked about Ivan's physical condition and whether he was uncomfortable after fusing the blood of the unicorn.
"No, it's better than expected." Ivan shook his head hurriedly, and patted his chest to show that his talent has exploded and his strength has improved.
And it only requires concentration to greatly increase the speed of thinking. You can learn all kinds of spells as soon as you learn it, but it consumes more energy (achievement points).
Ivan almost pushed all the abnormal phenomena in his body to the fusion of blood.
Although Aysia couldn't believe that he could get so many benefits after fusion of blood, but the facts were placed in front of her, and she couldn't help but believe it.
After all, "The Origin of Blood" does mention that this method can improve the wizard's talent.
"Then Dougert said that the mysterious spell that you used to defeat the law enforcement team is your newly acquired bloodline magic?" It took a long time for Esiah to completely digest this information, and then he remembered the incident. .
"Well... this is it... the guard of God!" Ivan waved his wand, and for the first time fully demonstrated his blood magic in front of Aysia-the shadow of the unicorn!
The white mist gushes out from the tip of the magic wand, and finally gathers into an illusory and holy creature.
It stepped into the void, surrounded by white mist and light and shadow, and its neck was raised high, faintly exuding a powerful aura.
Ivan’s thoughts moved, and the illusory patron saint rushed towards the table and chair on the right, as fast as lightning, pulling out a long white shadow in the air.
I moved to a chair in an instant, and my imaginary body passed directly through it, and then the body was lifted out of the original wooden table from the horn of the virtual reality, and then passed through the middle of another chair in the next second. Past...
Aisia stared intently. Although she had heard Dougte boast about how powerful this curse was before, she didn't know the power of this curse until Ivan demonstrated it.
This attack mode is simply impossible to guard against. Any wizard who does not understand this blood magic will suffer a big loss.
It’s no wonder that the law enforcers in the wizarding markets were defeated by this magic.
Aisia even doubted that he could defeat this son now.
"It's a pity that the actualization consumes too much magic power, I can't use it a few times." Ivan didn't think it was a big deal, but was very dissatisfied with the huge consumption of blood magic. After the battle, he felt like collapsed.
"Magic power will increase when you grow up slowly." Aysia gave him a blank look and said, and how could such a powerful magic have no limits?
Ivan nodded helplessly, but the growth of this natural magic power was too slow.
However, showing the blood magic and taking out the book "The Origin of Blood" are just to dispel Aisia's doubts. At least the goal has been achieved now.
So, Ivan asked about the question he had been puzzled before.
"Since the Ministry of Magic wants to thoroughly investigate the proliferation of black magic items, why don't we just do some defense or auxiliary magic items?"
is like the crescent moon pendant you gave me...
Ivan originally wanted to add this sentence, but just remembered that the pendant was broken, so he closed his mouth again.
"How can it be as simple as you think, when I teach you ancient magic texts tomorrow, you will know." Aysia shook her head, and then said again.
"As for now, let's clean up the black magic items in the shop."
Ivan had no choice but to remove all the items in the store with Aysia. put it into the big box in the basement, and transferred it to another place after preparation.
In the process of transporting, Ivan did not touch these dark magic items less, using the identification function of the system, he could easily see the effects of these items.
Most of them are cursing or triggering, and the effects are all sorts of weird. There are exquisite rings that make the bearer unlucky for a period of time, and there are also artificial hands that can trigger corrosion magic after injecting magic power. Ivan is amazed.
If he can get a magical item like Esiah, coupled with the shadow of the blood magic unicorn, even if he faces some dark wizards, he will be sure to win the battle!
there is no need to hide behind the scenes and shoot black guns every time.
This is why Ivan has always expected to learn magical item making with Aesya.
put the last skull-shaped magic sculpture into the basement. When Ivan came out again, he saw Aisia standing at the door with a wooden signboard beside him.
Ivan walked out curiously, and saw that the wooden signboard was full of mud and dust. I don't know how long it had been placed.
"Clean up!" Aysia stretched out her wand and clicked on it, but within a moment, the dust and dirt on the sign were stripped off, revealing the words below.
Hals strange magic item shop?
After Ivan took a look, he couldn't move his eyes...
What the **** is this name?

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Magic shop renovation plan
chapters.content:
"Why is our store's name like this?" Ivan turned his head to look at Esiah with a dazed expression. The latter looked calm and calm, waving his wand and hanging up the sign, then he explained.
"Don't you think this name is very appropriate? It is impossible to call it directly called the Black Magic Store, right? The Ministry of Magic will not allow this name to pass the registration review."
Ivan looked suspiciously at Esiah, thinking that she must have registered the name of the store. He thought about it. Otherwise, he wouldn’t keep putting the store’s sign in the corner to make ashes. Until today, I learned that the Ministry of Magic has May come to review, and hung up in a hurry.
"Okay, let's open it like this today!" After I made it up, Esiah patted some dust on her body and walked into the store again, but her cheeks were slightly red.
She shouldn't have taken the name of the store back then...
In view of this, Aysia continued to give Ivan the important task of looking at the store, but he hid in the basement. It is said that he planned to make some simple magic items to fill the store in the past few days and prevaricate the inspectors of the Ministry of Magic.
"Can I take this sign off first?" Ivan sighed, sat down at the counter with a book in his hand, and glanced at the store that was almost emptied.
Rows of shelves are empty there. Only a few shelves still have one or two magic items. If you don’t know it, you will probably think that this place has been ransacked.
"I can't go on like this." Ivan sighed, this is also his magic shop anyway, it seems that he needs to find a way.
Otherwise, Ivan feels that he might not even be able to buy textbooks. After all, he needs to buy Lockhart's series of books next semester, which are too many and expensive.
Just as Ivan was thinking this way, the system prompt sounded in his mind.
【Ding, the task is being generated...】
Ivan was stunned. He didn't expect to be able to activate the mission at this time. He thought that this function was turned off when the system was upgraded.
Ivan looked curiously.
[Task: Revitalize Hals’s Strange Magic Item Store
Mission objective: Pass the inspection of the Ministry of Magic in one month
Task reward: depends on evaluation.
Mission description: This is a magic shop located in Knockdown Alley. Now it is facing the risk of closing. You can’t sit back and watch this happen, so you decide to revitalize this magic shop... and you need to go through the Ministry of Magic first. Inspect. 】
"Will the Ministry of Magic's inspection be in a month?" Ivan muttered to himself after scanning the mission information.
He thought it would be sooner...
But think about it, the Ministry of Magic, as an official agency, handles affairs in accordance with the procedures. In addition, there is a lot of people, and the news has been revealed by insiders long before the Ministry of Magic takes any action.
Dougert got the gossip revealed by insiders, so he was so uncertain.
Ivan is also quite speechless when he thinks of this. It is foreseeable that when the Ministry of Magic really starts to move, only some dark wizards with no connections can be found, and those who are able to deal with it have already been dealt with.
is like the old Malfoy who disposes of the Horcrux in advance after receiving the news in the original time and space.
Fortunately, this kind of operating mechanism of the Ministry of Magic is great news for Ivan, which means that he has a month to prepare and pass the review.
Ivan turned his head and glanced in the direction of the basement.
Although Isiah said, some simple magic items will be made and put on the shelf to fool the inspectors of the Ministry of Magic.
But Ivan doesn't think it is very reliable, and the reward for completing the task is based on the evaluation. Ivan is not going to get the lowest evaluation.
It’s best to use the reviewers of the Ministry of Magic to promote this magic shop.
This is not impossible, as long as he can come up with some magic items that are enough for the Ministry of Magic to purchase.
Ivan remembers that in the original work, the Weasley brothers, after being expelled from school, made a kind of anti-curse hat (anti-curse gloves) in the joke toy store, and let the Ministry of Magic purchase a full five hundred sets!
Maybe he can also get something similar, maybe he can impress the members of the Ministry of Magic who come to inspect, then the evaluation will be improved, right?
Thinking of the way to complete the task, Ivan took out a notebook and began to scribble and write, sorting out his plan for the transformation of Hals' strange magic item store.
In his vision, it is best to make his store a black and white eat-all, selling everything.
During normal business hours, it sells general defensive and auxiliary magic items. In private, you can sell some extremely dangerous and lethal dark magic items. In short, as long as the guests need it, they can buy everything they want here!
Even Ivan felt that after his alchemy level was raised, he could still sell some real alchemy products here.
恩...The potion may also be sold!
The next day, while eating, Ivan talked about his grand store renovation plan.
Aixia just smiled casually, bluntly he wouldn't think so when he started learning how to make magic items.
"Is it really that difficult?" Ivan asked in confusion.
"Of course and it's boring. You'd better be prepared to suffer. In a month, as long as you can learn some basics, I'm very satisfied." Fan's head, let him not daydream.
"My learning speed is very fast..." Ivan murmured silently in his heart, especially when he wanted to be a master student.
After eating breakfast in a hurry, because I was going to teach Ivan how to make magic items, Esiah simply closed the magic shop, and there was nothing to sell anyway.
After entering the work area in the basement,
Aixia didn't start teaching immediately, but asked first.
"How do you think a magic is the release process?"
"Use the magic wand to guide the magic in the body, plus gestures and spells." Ivan replied after thinking for a while.
"Yes, like the Levitating Curse." Aysia gently waved her wand and floated a carving knife, as she explained.
"Lifting the object is the final effect of the spell, and all we need to do is to use gestures and spells to let the magic in the body know that we want this thing to float."
Ivan nodded, and combined with the books he read these days, he probably figured it out.
If the body is a pistol, then the magic is a bullet, and spells and gestures are the actions of loading and pulling the trigger.
"In other words, magical items replace gestures and spells. We only need to inject some magic power to release magic directly." Ivan concluded.
"That's good." Aysia was very satisfied with Ivan's savvy understanding. She was worried that Ivan was too young to understand it.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: The learning of Mowen is really too difficult!
chapters.content:
Since Ivan understood it quickly, Aysia said it out of his head.
"To be more precise, we can achieve this through magic texts. Each magic text has a specific meaning. Arranging some magic texts in a specific way can release the magic power in the body like interpreting gestures and spells. Out the magic you want."
"What if we could tell the magic power directly what we want to do?" Ivan suddenly remembered the magical state he had entered.
"Then it involves the knowledge of wandless casting and spellless casting. Only a handful of wizards can do this." Aysia explained, and then reminded Ivan not to be too lofty, that's not what he can do now. Arrived.
briefly explained the principle of making magic props, Aisia put the carving knife in Ivan's hand.
In the end, a stone carved plate was placed on the workbench. More than a hundred different ancient magic texts were burned on it, but only about half of them were marked with annotations, and there were only more than 30 detailed instructions!
Most of the marked magic texts are related to death...corrosion...pain, and only a few magic texts represent the positive attributes of guarding and isolation.
Seeing this, Ivan finally understood, why most of the black magic items made by Esiah were originally because only this part of the magic text was analyzed.
"Next, you will try to burn these magic texts on wood. Just practice the first one today, until you can engrave the magic texts completely!" Aisia pointed to the boardwalk on the table.
Ivan picked up the carving knife and experimented. It didn't seem to be difficult to burn symbols on the wood.
Although I had never had similar experience before, Ivan had enough patience. After failing more than ten times in a row, he finally burned the first character completely on the wood.
just looks a little crooked, and the nicks are of different depths.
This kind of magic text certainly can't satisfy Ivan, so he continued to work hard.
However, it is not an easy task to carve complex magic texts on wood. At least it can't be learned in a day or two. Ivan has burned dozens of times in succession, but can't achieve the regularity of the stone slab.
[Ding, after a period of practice, your alchemy proficiency has improved, the current level 3 (196/2000)]
Hearing the prompt sound in his mind, Ivan paused the practice of engraving the magic text and was very depressed. After more than three hours of practice on his own, his alchemy proficiency only increased by a few dozen points.
Obviously, burning magic texts is a skill that requires energy and a long time of training.
A few days... even a few weeks may not be enough.
or else... try that?
Ivan's heart moved. Since returning home, he hasn't consumed student points anymore to buy the Xueba experience card.
Previously, it was reserved for self-protection at critical times. Now that he is able to use blood magic freely, the danger of Knockover Alley has been reduced a lot for him, and keeping so many academic points is not very useful. .
Just do it when I think of it, and when Ivan changed his mind, the system prompt sounded.
【Ding, one hundred grade points have been deducted! 】
In the next second, a familiar feeling came to his heart, and Ivan suddenly felt that the carving knife in his hand was not so difficult to control. As long as his hand was stable enough, it would not be difficult to burn the magic text.
Aisia looked around for a while, seeing Ivan’s expression slowly turning from calm at the beginning to depressed, which was very interesting.
It took her a long time to learn to burn runes back then. She tried to give up countless times, and then she reluctantly made the engraved magic texts reach the standard that can be used. Even now, she doesn't know how much energy she has spent.
Thinking that this kind of basic learning might take a long time, Aysia turned to study the new arrangement of magic texts.
I don’t know how long it has been. When the research reached a bottleneck, Aysia was stunned when she turned her head to check the progress of Ivan’s study.
The large wooden boards have been engraved with densely packed ancient magic texts. The front one is skewed and twisted, and the notches are of different depths, but the later, the overall magic text appears more regular.
The last few are not even the slightest difference from the ones carved on the slate.
Aisia's complexion became very weird. If it weren't for the growth trajectory of Ivan Mowen's burning on the wooden board, she would have thought that Ivan had been practicing privately behind her back for several years.
The speed of this progress is too fast!
Aysia’s gaze was quietly staring at Ivan’s right hand holding the carving knife. The hand was steady without a slight tremor. Under her gaze, Ivan once again recorded more than 30 magic inscriptions. Each one is more accurate than the previous one.
Obviously, Ivan's level of burning magic texts is still continuously improving.
Aisia remembered that Ivan had said beforehand that he had acquired a magical ability after fusion of blood. Concentration can greatly increase the speed of thinking and quickly learn various spells.
Isiah didn't believe it before, so how fast can I learn faster?
But now I have to believe it...
Can the fusion of blood really have such a big improvement?
Aysia looked at it blankly for a while, if Ivan hadn’t told her that the success rate of fusion of blood is very low A little careless consequence would be disastrous, Aysia could not help but want to try it. .
Ivan was very dissatisfied with this, because compared to the ones he had seen before, he always felt that something was missing.
Moreover, it also injected magic power without any effect.
"Mowen learning is really too difficult!" Yifan sighed. It took him a full two hundred grade points and two hours to reach the current level in the experience card mode. He didn't expect to burn. The magic text is still not standard enough.
Wait when you exit this state, wouldn't it be worse to burn?
Thinking of this, Ivan worked harder.
Aisia was speechless for a while, and hurriedly interrupted.
"You can now pour magic power into the carving knife, burn the magic text on this yew wood, try again!"
"Can you still inject magic power?" Ivan was taken aback, and quickly did so, only to discover that the carving knife in his hand was also a magic item. After the magic power poured in, the tip of the carving knife was faintly glowing with magical power.
Ivan gently slid the wooden block with a carving knife, pulling out a trace.
The carving knife has become a lot sharper, and more importantly, the carved marks seem to be completely different from the previous ones, and the marks caused by magic are still on it.
Ivan then realized that the method used just now was wrong, so he burned it on the yew wood given by Esiah, and selected a cross-shaped star with bifurcated magic text on both sides, which represents corrosion..
