chapters.title: Chapter 113: I'll give you the book, you can learn it by yourself!
chapters.content:
After the carving knife was injected with magic power, the operation became more and more difficult. If too much magic power was injected inadvertently, or the force was slightly stronger, it needed to be burned again.
Even though Ivan was in the thinking acceleration mode of the experience card, it was only after two failures that he successfully burned the magic text on the yew for the third time.
After the engraving, Ivan tried to inject magic power into it, and the magic text immediately reacted, and a faint black air came out.
"Is this a success?" Ivan turned his head, looked at Aisia and asked.
Aysia nodded subconsciously, staring blankly at the magic text on the yew, too fast!
She remembered that she burned a complete magic text on yew for the first time and successfully activated it. How long did it take?
Two months...Three months?
Fortunately, she thought she had a good talent at first, and she was even complacent about it...
Thinking of this, Aysia was a little discouraged, but due to the reservedness of a teacher, Aysia still put on an expressionless appearance.
"Burning runes is only the most basic work. The really difficult thing to learn is the arrangement of the runes."
Ivan nodded solemnly, preparing to continue to invest in grade points and start the arduous study...
A few days passed in a flash, and Aysia, who was explaining the magic text arrangement to Ivan, had begun to doubt life.
Because after she briefly explained the meaning of the magic text and the several arrangements, Ivan has already begun to strongly demand other content instead of repeating and consolidating learning.
"Are you sure you understand?" Aysia didn't believe it.
"Of course, if you want to make a corrosive magic item, you can use the arrangement formula of 11367.
Rune No. 1 represents corrosion and is the core of the magic text arrangement formula, and No. 3 is used to conduct magic. Number six controls whether magic items are activated or not, and the last rune number seven is a protective shell to prevent the power of magic from hurting yourself. "
Ivan said solemnly, then bowed his head and burned on a well-made ring. A few minutes later, a brand new magic item was produced.
Ding, you have made a new magic item, please name it!
Ring of Corrosion... Ivan muttered silently in his heart, and then checked the item's information.
Magic Item: Ring of Corruption
Magic: Low
Effect: After injecting mana, a corrosive black magic is instantly cast
Description: The only advantage of magic props made by novices using the most common magic materials is that the magic texts are incredibly beautiful. You'd better not expect it to give you too much help when fighting.
Looking at the item description in the system bar, Ivan's mouth twitched. At any rate, this is also the first real magic item he made. Can you give me a good comment?
Ivan tried to activate the ring and set the workbench as the target. A black light flashed by, and the corners of the workbench were slowly aging and decayed.
The effect is not bad, but the corrosion speed is too slow. No wonder that the role is limited in battle. The bodies of wizards are protected by magic power. This degree of corrosion magic is indeed weaker.
Ivan sighed and threw the ring aside in disgust, ready to wait for a better one.
"Mom... so can we start to learn some more difficult magic formulas?" Ivan said, unable to wait.
"The book is for you, you can learn it by yourself!" Aysia threw a copy of "Advanced Magic Text" on the table with no expression, she felt that she needed to be quiet now.
She remembered what she was going to teach these days?
It seems that Ivan was asked to burn one or two basic magic texts on the board?
Now Ivan has almost learned the results of her painstaking research over the years, and she has to sort out the things that are really pressing, otherwise I don't know how to teach.
After Aysia left the work area with a weird expression, Ivan also studied carefully and opened the new "Advanced Magic Text". For a while, all kinds of weird ideas came to mind, and even considered whether he could crack it by himself Some simple magic text sequences.
Just when he was preparing to act, Ivan suddenly felt that his various ideas were forcibly interrupted, and he was stunned for a while.
"What did I want to do just now?"
Ding, the experience card mode has expired, do you want to renew it again?
"No, get out!" Ivan said distressedly.
The reason why he was able to record the meaning and arrangement of various magic texts in his mind within a few days was completely because he used the experience card mode for seven hours intermittently, which cost him most of the academic points.
Of course, even this does not mean that his study these few days can be compared to the accumulation of Aysia over the years.
After all, it takes a lot of time and energy to analyze a magic word formula, but learning a magic word formula can be much simpler.
In addition, Aysia has given everything in one's pocket this time, without the slightest concealment in all kinds of skills. If he can't learn quickly in this way, then he would have spent so many academic points in vain.
After exiting the state of accelerated learning, Ivan picked up the carving knife again and practiced the burning of the magic text.
This time Ivan engraved very slowly, and the magic text was far from the previous standard, but Ivan was not surprised, this was something he had known before.
What he can do in the experience card mode does not mean he can do it usually.
But anyway, the knowledge he acquired and the feel of the recording still remain, all he has to do is to consolidate it through a lot of practice.
In the next period of time, Ivan was learning more advanced magic text knowledge, and the daily magic text burning practice never stopped.
His current grade point can only be improved by increasing the level of the spell The growth is very slow, so the usual effort is particularly important.
Occasionally, Ivan also discusses a new arrangement of magic texts with Esiah.
Prepare to develop some defensive magic items based on the principle of the anti-spell hat developed by the Weasley brothers in the original book.
Since both George and Fred can do it with their own research, Ivan thinks he and Aysia can do it with some effort.
When I really started to act, Ivan realized how difficult it is to develop a new arrangement of magic texts.
In addition to consuming time and energy, it also needs a lot of support from Jin Jialong.
Because the magic text must be burned on those highly conductive magic materials to be excited, and the unknown magic text formula is very risky. It is a good result to destroy the props used to carry the magic text. It's possible to play with yourself carefully, so you can only try cautiously.
Otherwise, the more than one hundred ancient magic texts on the stone slab would not have detailed explanations for only one third.

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Lucius Malfoy!
chapters.content:
But where did George and Fred obtain the corresponding knowledge?
Could it be in Hogwarts' banned book zone?
Ivan thinks it is very possible that the collection of books in the forbidden book area is vast, and the books he has visited many times in a school year may not be one ten thousandth of the books in the forbidden book area.
Some books about ancient magic texts are also normal. After all, there are even knowledge about Horcruxes...
But these days, he is not in vain, he has made some ordinary magic props, plus those made by Aysia, a quarter of the shelves in the store are already stocked with merchandise.
At the same time, Hals' strange magic items shop also reopened.
This kind of life continued until the early morning of the second week. Ivan, who was practicing the magic text on the counter, heard the bell ringing outside the door.
With a look, Ivan put down the carving knife. It will take more than half a month for the people from the Ministry of Magic to arrive. It seems that some guests are here...
"Hello, welcome to the Hals Strange Magic Item Store, do you have anything you need?" Ivan raised his head and said.
Immediately afterwards, Ivan was stunned. The man was dressed in a black wizard robe and had pale blonde hair. His face was pale and scary. After entering the store, the snake-shaped cane held in his right hand stepped heavily on the ground, giving a burst of boredom. ring...
Lucius Malfoy!
Ivan squinted his eyes to confirm the identity of the visitor, and guessed what the other party was coming from.
Is the trouble caused by the wizard market?
No, judging from the information Dougter gave him, the Malfoys are not the shareholders behind the wizarding market.
Then it can only be...
As Ivan was thinking about it, he heard someone talking.
"Isn't Mrs. Hals in the shop?"
Lucius Malfoy's indifferent gray eyes swept across the shop, keenly aware that this place was a little different from when he came before.
Most of the shop is empty, leaving only a few magic items.
"Yes," Ivan spit out a word, and then continued.
"But now I am the agent, Mr. Malfoy, if you have anything, you can talk to me."
"Listen, boy, I'm going to talk about a big deal and call your mother over." Lucius Malfoy waved his hand impatiently. He was not interested in wasting time with a kid.
"Mr. Malfoy is going to sell some dark magic items?" Ivan said straightforwardly.
Lucius was taken aback for a moment, hesitated for a moment, and then nodded.
"Then my mother will definitely not agree. Mr. Malfoy should also be aware of the recent big moves of the Ministry of Magic, so there is no plan to purchase large quantities of black magic items here." Ivan replied.
"People from the Ministry of Magic generally don't find the Knockdown Alley, right?" Seeing that Ivan's words are very organized, Lucius couldn't help putting away his previous contempt, and asked.
"It seems that Mr. Malfoy still doesn't know much about what happened in Knockturn Alley." Ivan shook his head.
Lucius was silent, especially when he was busy dealing with prohibited items in his home recently, and he was already burnt out, so he cared about the things in Knockout Alley.
Ivan didn't say much, but mentioned that the Ministry of Magic might also find it in Knockdown Alley, so the out-of-date magic items were removed from the shop.
Lucius's face was very ugly, and if things were as Ivan said, it would be troublesome.
Among the three black magic shops in Knockturn Alley, he had already visited the one opened by the fairy, and the other party directly refused to help him handle the black magic items.
The owner of the Bojinbok shop is very difficult to deal with, and Lucius thinks that the other party may seize this opportunity to lower the price.
That's why he came here to try it first, but he couldn't go there again, but he didn't expect to learn from Ivan that the Ministry of Magic would be patrolling Knockdown Alley.
Lucius didn't know that the people at the Ministry of Magic would only check this dark magic shop, and thought Fudge was going to clean Knockdown Alley.
Thinking of this, Lucius looked gloomy and prepared to leave, planning to find other old friends and see if he could drag them to deal with it.
"Wait a minute, Mr. Malfoy." Ivan's gaze paused for a moment on the diary that Lucius was holding in his left hand.
"What's the matter?" Lucius Malfoy stopped.
"Although our family can't buy your things in large quantities, it's okay to have more stocks." Ivan did not maintain the calm expression before, but changed his tone of joy.
"Especially any novel and fun magical items..."
Lucius shook his head secretly in his heart. He thought that this little wizard was very mature before, and he thought that Draco would be great if he was like this.
Unexpectedly, it was just a child's xinxing after all, and a few more words would expose it.
Lucius opened his mouth and planned to refuse, because what he needed was to sell in bulk, but he didn't have the time to sell piece by piece.
But thinking of the notebook in hand, Lucius hesitated again, and suddenly realized that this was a good opportunity to deal with troubles.
"What do you think of this?" Lucius turned around and put the diary in his left hand on the table.
Ivan looked carefully a few times,
It doesn't look thick. The date printed in ink on the cover has faded. I don't know how long it has been left. Apart from this, there is nothing else.
But Ivan knew it was Tom Marvolo Riddle's diary and Voldemort's first Horcrux.
If he leaves it alone, this Horcrux diary will be possessed by Ginny Weasley in the next semester, releasing the basilisk in the secret room and making waves in Hogwarts until it is sanctioned by the savior Harry Potter!
The experience of the last semester clearly tells Ivan that after he joined, many things have become different.
Therefore, Ivan did not think that things would still be as coincidental as the original time and space a big basilisk, but did not kill any student in several attacks in the school.
If Hogwarts died of a few students, he would have to be shut down for rectification immediately, not to mention that he was also in school by then, and he might also encounter a basilisk.
Now that he has this opportunity, Ivan certainly wants to solve the trouble of Horcrux once and for all, as long as he learns to be fierce, he can do it.
Moreover, Ivan remembered the incomplete "Origin of Blood" in his hand, and he had some questions that needed an insider to answer.
At Hogwarts, Ivan had considered contacting Voldemort's other Horcrux, Ravenclaw's crown, but finally gave up.
Voldemort was already extremely powerful when he made the crown. Unless he was destroyed immediately after receiving it, or directly handed over to Dumbledore, he might be controlled even if he brought it around.
The diary is different. It carries the memory and power of Voldemort in the fifth grade. It is the most suitable one of many Horcruxes....

chapters.title: Chapter 115: Do you want something soft or something hard?
chapters.content:
Ivan stared at the Horcrux diary for a while, a thousand thoughts flashed through his mind, and finally asked a question pretending to be curious.
"Does this look like a book? Or notes? Is it useful?"
"I don't know, I only know that this is indeed a black magic item. If you want it, I can sell it to you at a low price." Lucius said vaguely.
Ivan curled his lips, feeling that Old Malfoy was too careless about him, the little wizard, so he made up a reason.
Even if this is someone's study notes, it is better to be able to answer the questions automatically than to be so dry, so that he can't answer even if he wants to answer.
However, what Ivan didn't know was that Lucius did not know how the Horcrux diary should be used.
After all, this is something that the Dark Lord personally handed over to him to keep him, maybe there is something terrifying in it.
So after Lucius got his hand, he placed it in a secret place and never touched it again.
It was not until this year that the people from the Ministry of Magic wanted to thoroughly investigate the problem of the proliferation of black magic items, and then they took this thing out and prepared to find a place to deal with it, so as not to be detected by the people from the Ministry, thinking that he and the defeated Dark Lord had something to do with him. What link.
"Do you want or not?" Lucius said impatiently when Ivan looked at him with a strange expression.
"Since there is no way to confirm the function of this thing, then it may be the most ordinary diary book, so how about a copper nat?" Ivan calmed down, pondered for a long time, from his arms. He took a copper Nat and put it on the table.
Lucius was smirked, a copper nut?
Even if you buy a Muggle book for more than this price, this is a dark magic item!
"The Ministry of Magic is investigating dark magic items, Mr. Malfoy, I'm helping you deal with the trouble..."
Ivan pretended to be a snobbery businessman, looking at the timing to suppress the price, but because of his young age, the proposed price was naive and ridiculous, completely ruining the atmosphere of the negotiation.
But with such performance, Lucius made a decision.
"Okay! Then a copper nat!" Lucius looked at Ivan deeply, put down the diary, picked up the copper nat on the table, held the snake-shaped cane, and turned away. .
After going out, Lucius threw Tong Nath casually and threw it into the grass. This was definitely the stupidest deal he had ever made in his life.
A copper nat sold a black magic item...
However, thinking of the little wizard who was mature on the surface but childish in heart just now, Lucius's face wore a gloomy smile.
This is what the other party wants to buy. If something happens, you can't blame him...
After Lucius walked away, Ivan also put away his disguise, and lightly waved his magic wand.
"Copper Nath is flying here!"
A billowing coin with a little patina flew out of the grass not far away, and fell straight into Ivan's hands.
Lucius didn't conceal too much about the action of throwing out the copper nut. It was just an expression of his disdain, and Ivan did not have the habit of dismissing a copper nut.
No matter how small it is, it is money!
"It seems that you are not worth any money in Mr. Malfoy's heart." Ivan put the copper coin on the table and turned it around, sighing.
Ivan was also hesitating in his heart, what kind of attitude should he use to touch this Horcrux diary.
Huairou?
Dear Mr. Tom Marvolo Riddle, I am your younger brother who has passed more than fifty years. Have you ever done anything to destroy the book collection in school?
Or use a more direct method?
Ivan thinks that he might be able to ask Aysia for a black magic item that can release fierce fire to threaten the Horcrux...
Do you see this fierce fire? If you dare not tell the truth, you are dead!
Ivan hesitated for a long time, and threw these two extreme thoughts aside, and after the occlusion of the brain was operated, his left hand lightly touched the black cover.
Magic Item: Tom Marvolo Riddle's Diary (horcrux)
Magic: strong
Explanation: This was originally a diary book used to record some information during Voldemort's youth, but after accidentally acquiring a profound knowledge of Horcrux from the forbidden book zone, Voldemort used a killing ceremony to divide the soul and integrate it into the diary. Produced the first Horcrux.
After picking it up, Ivan did not feel the feeling of thinking being invaded, but he did not relax his vigilance. Instead, he looked up and down, trying to find something special in this diary, such as some magic engraved on it. Text or something.
It's a pity that Ivan didn't find anything, which shows that the production principle of Horcrux is different from what he expected. It is not the magic text that drives the core, but it is more likely that part of the remnant soul.
Thinking of this, Ivan cautiously opened the diary, the Occupational Cerebral technique was almost turned to the extreme, and the first page was written in blurry ink-T.m. Riddle.
Ding, after a certain amount of practice, your Occlumency Proficiency has improved...
Ivan looked at him, and finally came.
Tom Riddle's ability to contemplate is something he expected, but looking at the system's prompt sound, the level is not too high, Ivan thinks it should be similar to his Occlumency level.
The level of both sides is half a catty,
And unlike when facing Dumbledore, the prompts that came up were all that after a period of hard practice, the proficiency of Occlumency was greatly improved.
In this case, even if he does not consume academic points to purchase an experience card, he can still do a good job in front of the Horcrux diary, and he can also brush his Occlumency proficiency by the way.
Ivan grabbed the quill pen placed aside and dipped it with ink. When he was hesitating about the attitude to communicate, the ink from the nib was suddenly sucked in.
Hello, this is Tom Riddle...
Suddenly a sentence appeared in the empty diary, UU read www.uukanshu. The faint ink marks of com spontaneously linked together, and after displaying for a few seconds, they disappeared without a trace.
Ivan's mind moved a little, and he asked a bunch of questions.
Hello, you said your name is Tom Riddle? How old are you this year? Why can you talk to me? How was it made again? Are there any special abilities?
After Ivan finished writing, he waited quietly, preparing to read how his identity would be fabricated after reading the diary, so that Ivan could decide what kind of attitude he would take to obtain information.
A series of questions smashed Tom Riddle for a while. After a long while, the handwriting left by Ivan in the diary was shuffled and reorganized, and then it became a few lines of handwriting.
I'm just a diary. The person who made me is called Tom Riddle, and he kept some of his memories, so I can communicate with you...
It’s nothing new. Ivan curled his lips. After so long, you think of such a clichéd identity...
He thought that Tom Riddle would pretend to be a peerless wizard and make a plot with the grandfather to fool him...

chapters.title: Chapter 116: Tom, you are swollen!
chapters.content:
Perhaps I was scared by Ivan's question, and after an explanation, the ink changed again.
Are you a student at Hogwarts? I guess you are at Slytherin College? Then I should be your senior. If you have any academic problems you don't understand, you can ask me at any time, no matter what kind of problem it is!
No, I'm actually in Gryffindor, and Ivan whispered silently in his heart.
Between the lines, Ivan could feel Tom Riddle's bursting self-confidence.
But think about it, Tom can drive the top magical creature basilisk in fifth grade, split the soul to make the first Horcrux, and complete the first small goal on the road to immortality. Everyone will swell.
Ivan thought for a while, and began to write down in his diary the questions he had been pondering for a long time but had not figured out.
What is the nature of magic?
After a long time, Ivan's ink left on the notebook hasn't moved for a long time.
Perhaps it was because I thought this question was a bit too difficult, Ivan paused again, and then wrote.
What is the formula for making Fu Ling Ji?
The blessing potion can make the person who drank the potion become extremely lucky within twelve hours. It is the potion that Ivan has always wanted to configure, but it is a pity that even the corresponding formula is not found in the forbidden book area.
So I look forward to his diary instinct to give him the answer.
However, to Ivan's disappointment, Tom Riddle did not give him an answer.
Do you know everything if you say it? con man!
In fact, the Horcrux was stunned when faced with these problems of Ivan. It was only in the fifth grade when it was made. How could it be possible to know the nature of magic?
The formula for making Fuling Potion is something that very few potions masters know, even if he is knowledgeable and talented, it is impossible to get a formula for Ivan out of thin air.
Two consecutive answers have not received a response, and Ivan also understands that the Dark Lord in his youth is not as bad as he imagined.
So the next questions become simpler, they all ask some basic magic spell questions.
The Horcrux finally had a reaction, regrouping the handwriting written by Ivan to form the answer one by one.
Perhaps because of losing face on the first two questions, or wanting to gain trust, Tom Riddle's answer is very detailed, and even contains some spellcasting skills that he has summed up.
After talking for a while, a series of system prompts sounded in Ivan's mind.
Ding, after a period of learning, your iron armor curse proficiency has greatly improved...
Ding, after a period of learning, your disarming spell proficiency has greatly improved...
Ding, after a period of study....
......
Ivan’s heart was overjoyed, and his gaze toward the Horcrux became much softer.
This is another useful learning accelerator!
Before squeezing out its usefulness, Ivan temporarily dispelled the idea of ​​destroying it with fierce fire.
Suddenly, Ivan thought of the problem he was facing now, and took a quill pen to write in the diary.
Can you make magic items?
Tom Riddle was silent for a while, then replied in the diary.
will not..
Ivan was a little disappointed. Just as he was about to close the diary, the ink suddenly began to change.
But I know some ancient magic text knowledge!
Seeing the words displayed in the diary, Ivan finally smiled.
He guessed that Tom Riddle should have a certain understanding of ancient magic texts or the making of magic items.
After all, when the Dark Lord just graduated, he didn't choose another way out, but went to work in the Bojin-Bok Black Magic Store. It proved that he was very interested in ancient magic texts, most likely he had come into contact with the corresponding knowledge in the forbidden book area of ​​Hogwarts, and wanted to understand more deeply.
Perhaps this is also related to several other Horcruxes...
Ivan thinks of the other Horcruxes made by Voldemort, many of which directly use powerful magic items as carriers. If you don't understand some relevant knowledge, it will never be possible to do this.
You are really good, you know everything... can you teach me?
Ivan wrote in the diary happily, and praised the other party, but within a moment, Horcrux responded.
it is good!
.......
With the magic knowledge given by Tom Riddle, Ivan finally made a major breakthrough in the research process of the anti-cursive gloves!
Because of those Shintoku magic texts, there is just one that can be used as the core of the anti-cursive magic text formula!
After another week of magic practice, Ivan finally produced the finished product after many failed attempts.
Magic item: Anti-cursive gloves
Magic: Medium
Effect: Rebound curse
Explanation: This is a qualified magic item. Take it with you. When someone casts a curse on you, stare into his eyes and the curse will be reflected back.
Note: Its effect is limited, too frequent use may damage it, and you can't expect to use it to resist some deep black magic.
"Finally finished..." Ivan looked at the curse-proof gloves he had made over and over again. The more I watched, the more I liked it.
For the shortcomings stated in the system remarks, Ivan didn't think it was a big deal. Anyway, this is the version to be sold, and the material cost is only five silver sike.
This kind of effect is already very good!
As for the damage of items, after a batch is damaged, the Ministry of Magic can just buy another batch...
With a little calculation in his heart, Ivan quickly found Aysia, who was doing research, and showed off the curse-proof gloves he had made.
"Have you parsed that magic text?" Aysia asked in surprise.
Ivan told her a week ago that he had seen a few ancient magic texts in Hogwarts, and I was going to study it, but Isiah did not care, because the analysis of magic texts is a long work just I didn't expect Ivan to achieve results so quickly.
"You know, it's not that difficult." Ivan shrugged, and shamelessly ignored the teachings of the Horcrux diary.
Because of Ivan’s strong talents deliberately before, Aysia was quite familiar with the fact that Ivan made anti-cursive gloves. After a short surprise, she quickly accepted this fact and began to experiment with anti-cursive gloves. The effect of gloves.
Although Ivan has read the introduction of the system, it is certainly not clear that he has tried it himself.
The two soon arrived in the training ground in the basement...
"So... why is it me who is the target?" Ivan stood on the training ground and put the anti-cursive gloves on his left hand.
"As a developer, isn't it normal to experiment with your own products?" Aysia explained, but as she said, or simply want to vent the depression of being hit these days, I don't know. ..

chapters.title: Chapter 117: We're friends
chapters.content:
"Come on!" Ivan settled, staring at Aysia's eyes.
"Incisor game big stick~" Aysia waved his wand, starting with some of the simplest attack spells.
The light of the spell flashed by, and Ivan who was hit only felt a slight movement of his body, and a ring on the glove of his left hand suddenly lit up with a triangle embedded in it.
At the next moment, the light of the spell bounced back, and Aysia, who had been prepared, dodged in time.
Then, Aysia gradually strengthened the strength of the curse, and Ivan resisted one by one. It was not until Aysia used the upside-down clock that the anti-cursive gloves showed something strange. After a burst of strong light, they "teared" and cracked. Got out.
Ivan's figure shook suddenly, barely resisting the effect of the fuchsia clock.
"Very practical props, the effect looks similar to that of the Iron Armor Curse." Aisia said with appreciation.
"No, it's much weaker in comparison." Ivan shook his head. As a developer, he personally experienced the effect of the anti-cursive gloves. Ivan knew the weakness of this glove.
Compared with the full-protected iron armor curse, the anti-cursive gloves need to look into the eyes of the opponent when they are activated, and they cannot defend against the black magic that is too strong.
But the biggest advantage of this magic item is its suddenness. Imagine that two wizards are fighting. One side obviously does not bless the defensive spell, but rebounds the spell. If the other side does not respond in time, it can only reap the consequences. Beat on the spot!
"It would be more perfect if it could be improved..." Ivan touched his chin and thought about the improved concentration plan. He now knows more than forty magic texts.
Most of them are taught by Professor Aisia, and a few are from the Horcrux diary, with countless ways of combination.
Just two weeks before the arrival of the Ministry of Magic, Ivan felt that he could get a few more magic items out.
At that time, it is impossible to rely on an anti-cursive glove to support the scene, right?
.....
Because of the success of the anti-cursive gloves, Ivan easily persuaded Aysia to study new magic items together.
Coupled with Tom Riddle in the Horcrux, and the three of them work together, the research progress of various magic text formulas can be described as rapid!
Almost every two or three days, a new magic text formula can be discovered. Just when Ivan was a little overwhelmed with joy, Tom Riddle made a new request.
"Want to learn about the outside world?" Ivan looked at the words appearing on the diary and was silent for a while.
In fact, Tom Riddle was able to endure it now and only put forward the conditions, which was far beyond Ivan's expectations.
Because in the past few days, he can almost be said to be asking crazy questions, and he has gained a lot of knowledge.
The other party only got a few magic formulas in the discussion, as well as the production process of a series of magic items such as anti-cursive gloves.
To others, these things may be extraordinarily precious, but to Tom Riddle they are useless.
Yes, the Malfoy family has kept this diary in the storage box since it got it, so now I want to get information from the outside world.
Black ink traces emerged from the paper, and after staying for a few seconds, they changed again.
Are we friends? You will tell me, right?
Of course.... We are friends, what do you want to ask?
Ivan reluctantly wrote in the diary with a quill, if he refused to answer this, then don't try to extract information from Tom Riddle.
In the diary, the ink writing gradually disappeared, and Tom Riddle was also thinking about how to ask. After a while, the writing reappeared.
I want to know what happened in the magic world in recent years... Also, who is the most famous and powerful wizard in the magic world now?
Ivan smiled in his heart. Now the most famous and powerful wizard in the magical world is of course Dumbledore, or else it can be you?
But on the surface, Ivan still pretended to be contemplative, and began to write.
I have not inquired about major events in the magical world in recent years, but the most powerful wizard in the magical world is Albus Dumbledore, the principal of Hogwarts!
Tom Riddle held back for a long time before he came up with another sentence.
Except for him?
That should be Nico Lemay, the alchemist who has lived more than six hundred and sixty years old in rumors!
Ivan touched his chin. Although Nicole LeMay is relatively low-key, he really can't think of anyone else. It's impossible to write Minister of Magic Fudge, right?
Fudge is not enough!
Where is the Dark Lord? Have you heard of it?
The handwriting on the diary is not neat, but scribbled and rushed. Later, maybe I thought that such an inquiry would not be appropriate, so I hurriedly added.
I mean.. I heard this name from them before being put up by the Malfoy family, so I was very curious and wanted to ask...
As a split soul, Tom can faintly feel that the main soul's situation is very wrong, but the distance is too far, and his strength is too weak, so he doesn't know the specific situation, which is why he is anxious to ask.
A little uncomfortable, Tom... Ivan gently tapped the table with his finger, and the fifth-grade Dark Lord was still too tender.
However, from the performance of the original book, it can be seen that the young Voldemort was arrogant, arrogant, extremely ambitious and extremely conceited, and it is normal to be a little gaffe by his series of teasing.
The Dark Lord? It is said to be dead... more than ten years ago...
Ivan casually wrote in the diary, and after lifting the other's interest, he immediately changed the subject.
Are you not a diary? Curious about what this does? Let's continue to study the magic text formula... I saw a magic text in one place and I have been trying to figure out what it means.
Without waiting for the Horcrux to respond, Ivan drew a semi-circular umbrella-shaped magic text on the page of the diary. This was the ancient magic text he saw on the box where the dementor was being held.
This is a kind of isolation magic text, which can block magic...usually used to make storage boxes and place some precious magic props. Tom Riddle replied to Ivan's question subconsciously. Although he wanted to know the follow-up, he could only suppress his thoughts to avoid being suspected, and then slowly ask later.
Anyway, he can't really die when he's still at Voldemort,
Or in other words, he will become the new Voldemort...
After a while of communication, Ivan closed the diary with a "pop" and placed it in the deepest part of the cabinet.
"Thank you, Tom..." Ivan muttered to himself, took out a semi-finished diary cover from the drawer of the desk, and carved the isolation magic text in the corner.
Hope there will be no need to use it...

chapters.title: Chapter 118: The weakest alchemy creature
chapters.content:
In the full study and discussion, two weeks passed in a flash,
After Ivan completed the production of various anti-cursive props, only three days were left before the inspectors from the Ministry of Magic arrived.
Exquisite magic props were placed on the empty shelves in the store, most of which were researched by Ivan together with Aisia and Tom Riddle these days.
The remaining small part was sent by brothers George and Fred...
As early as when he first studied the anti-cursive gloves, Ivan sent a letter asking them about the knowledge of ancient magic texts.
It's just that the number of magic texts they know about is not many, which overlaps with Professor Tom Riddle's part, so it doesn't play a big role.
However, considering that the prank goods they produced are very popular in the original book, Ivan sent another letter a few days ago, asking them to send some finished products and put them in the store for sale.
This morning, two owls flew to the magic shop and brought a package and a reply...
To Ivan Hals:
Thank you for remembering us in the pleasant summer vacation,
We have read your letter. George and I, as the shopkeepers of Weasley’s Witchcraft and Wizardry (although it has not officially opened yet), authorize you to sell the goods of Joke Witchcraft and Wizardry on your behalf.
We will solemnly introduce to you our latest invention, the Pygmy Pu, a kind of alchemy creature. It has no attack power and is very fragile, but it looks very cute. We believe that this thing will be able to sell well!
In addition, there are fake magic wands, witty answering quill, telescopic ears, big dung eggs...I have written the specific usage on the attached page..
Remarks: It would be a case of being intercepted by someone halfway. The protective magic is applied on the attached page. The spell that is cracked should not embarrass you...Finally, I hope that the address we filled in is not wrong, if you say... you really live in the flip In the back alley...
Ivan picked up the package. It was very light. It should be a weight reduction spell.
No wonder it can be delivered with an owl.
"These days, they are not idle either." Ivan sighed as he opened the package and looked at the contents.
He remembered that before leaving school, George and Weasley only made big **** eggs and a quill pen. They had only made so many interesting things in just over a month after the holiday.
I don't know how they did research under Mrs. Weasley's nose...
Ivan smiled, and turned his gaze to Dwarf Pu's body again, very interested in this so-called alchemy creature.
It looked like a pink fluffy ball, about the size of a little wizard's fist. Ivan tried to put it on his hand and found that this guy was very light.
Dwarf Pu just stayed quietly on Ivan's hand, arching and arching his body, and the pink hair rubbed against Ivan's palm, surprisingly comfortable.
Alchemy Creature: Pygmy Cat
Magic: Low
Explanation: This may be the weakest alchemy creature ever. Its abilities include but are not limited to selling cuteness, rolling, jumping, and spinning...it will absorb the magic power radiated by the holder at an extremely slow speed for maintenance Physical activity.
Looking at the prompt message given in the system bar, Ivan was also somewhat speechless.
Well, it’s enough for this thing to be cute, so what else can you ask for?
Putting the pygmy cat on his shoulder, Ivan held the explanatory paper that came with the package, but it was blank and there was nothing on it.
"Hmm... let me think about it." Ivan touched his chin and thought about what secret words the two of them would use, and then suddenly realized something, and pointed his wand at the blank paper.
"I swear I didn't do a good job!"
The magical ripples spread along the center of the paper, and lines of text appeared on the surface.
"Sure enough." Ivan smiled. He had seen similar protection magic on the map of the point of life, but he didn't expect the two of them to actually get this magic out.
In contrast, the attached sheet of paper is not as special as a live-point map. It uses the most common parchment paper and is not a magic item.
After Ivan glanced a few times, he unexpectedly discovered that the Weasley brothers, besides attaching descriptions of the items, even wrote down the production methods of each item on paper, and asked him for his suggestions for improvement.
Ivan took this trust in his heart, and then checked the production method of the pygmy cat.
After reading it, Ivan realized that Dwarf Puss is actually similar to some intelligent (mentally retarded) robots in the Muggle World, and only performs some simple actions according to planned procedures.
George and Fred's father, Arthur Weasley, was originally an employee of the Muggle Abuse Bureau of the Ministry of Magic. There are many Muggle machinery in the family, and most of them are inspired by it.
Jingle Bell...
Just as Ivan was about to study the pygmy cat, a crisp bell rang at the door, and when he turned his head, he found that it was Dougt, who hadn't seen him for a long time.
"What's the matter? Dean Dougert?" Ivan put down the cute dwarf cat and asked.
"I received the news that the inspectors from the Ministry of Magic will be here in two days." Dougt frowned and said in a hurry.
After walking in, Dougert realized that this place was a little different before, but Dougt didn't take a closer look, so he asked anxiously.
"It's been so many days, why haven't you disposed of these dark magic items? What about Asia?"
"Dean Dougt, this is a formal magic shop, there is no black magic item you mentioned..."
Ivan interrupted Dougt's words with a serious face, and then spoke again.
"Don't look at us in the Knock Down Alley, opening a shop here, but our heart is very longing for the light. Therefore, we have been committed to the research work of preventing dark magic. Now there have been some results...please allow I solemnly introduce you to the flagship product in the store-curse-proof gloves!"
"Do you need to buy a pair? Dean?" Ivan pointed to the conspicuous shelf behind Dougt looked dumbfounded. Did he go in the wrong place or the kid took the wrong medicine? ?
"You'd better keep these words and tell the people at the Ministry of Magic." Aisia did not know when he had already walked behind Ivan and rubbed his hair.
Speaking of it, Aysia was also very helpless. She really didn't know why Ivan had so many weird thoughts at a young age.
What did the current professors at Hogwarts teach when they were in class?
But Isiah thinks about it carefully, what Ivan said is quite reasonable, maybe he can use it when the time comes..
"I'm just rehearsing it in advance, Dean Dougert, what do you think is the effect?" Ivan shrugged and looked at someone who was sluggish.
(Ps: Thank you very much for your support and encouragement. The author is very touched. There will be at least four chapters today! In addition, Esiah’s Fuchsia is not a bug, and I will explain it later.)

chapters.title: Chapter 119: This thing doesn't make much profit at all
chapters.content:
"So, what happened during the month that I didn't come?" Douglas looked around in surprise and found a lot of things he had overlooked before.
For example, Ivan's pink, fluffy orbs that move and bounce around, the curse-proof gloves and cloaks hanging in a conspicuous place, and a large number of magic items that have never been seen before, all seem to be brand new.
"No way, black magic items are not easy to sell, so my mother and I had to research some good selling things." Ivan said in a relaxed tone.
But Dougte didn't quite believe it. He knew Aisia for so many years, and he knew how difficult it was to develop a new magical way. He hadn't been here for a month, not a year, so he suddenly changed his career to do legitimate business?
The change is too fast, right?
When he tried a few magical goods in person, Dougte had to believe it, especially Ivan's latest protective ring.
Just input the magic power to form a magical barrier similar to the iron armor curse, a 360-degree magical barrier to resist some magical attacks.
Dougte was eager to watch, and if he used it well, this is a life-saving artifact!
So Doug licked his face and asked.
"How to sell this stuff?"
"60 Jin Jialong!" Ivan said.
"Tsk, it's really expensive, can't it be cheaper?" Doug slapped his mouth. If it were replaced a month ago, he would probably buy it without blinking.
But it doesn't work now. In order to get through the relationship with the Ministry of Magic, he smashed hundreds of Jin Jialong in and learned the accurate news of the Ministry of Magic's inspection. The poor are about to eat the dirt.
"No way, for this level of magic items, the materials alone have to cost a lot of Jin Jialong, and there is no profit at all to sell one."
Ivan explained that the protective ring is an enhanced version of the anti-cursive gloves, and it is regarded as the highest level among all the magic items he has made!
At the same time, Ivan also found that the more powerful magic items are, the more expensive magic materials are needed. Otherwise, the magic fluctuations caused by activating the magic text sequence will instantly scrap those cheap magic materials!
Dougter had to put down the protective ring in disappointment. He knew a little about magic items, and he knew very well that Ivan was telling the truth.
Aysia rolled her eyes and found that the material cost of a protective ring was only nine gallons, but someone always thought that his labor costs were worth fifty gallons, so he made a gallon.. .
"What is this?" Aysia didn't break through Ivan's words, but was attracted by the pink pompon on his shoulder.
"Pygmy Pu, a kind of alchemy creature, was sent by two friends and is going to be put in the store for sale." Ivan responded casually, teasing the pink fluffy ball with his hands.
"Alchemy creatures? Do they have any special abilities?" Aysia's eyes lit up and asked.
Dougte also looked at it curiously. He had only seen the legendary alchemy creatures in books, and it was rumored that there were many in the home of the alchemist Nick LeMay.
"Well... is it cute?" Ivan said, tilting his head.
"Isn't that just rubbish? Who would buy something like this..." Dougte curled his lips in disdain, but then saw Aysia **** the dwarf cat from Ivan's shoulder.
"I think it's a bit interesting, you can study it..." Aisia tried to poke the dwarf cat, and the latter began to turn into a small pink ball and spin.
Ivan sat and watched helplessly as his new toy was taken away, but couldn't help but complain...
Ugh...women...
Dougt was speechless. He really couldn't understand what a pompom was worth studying, but he quickly adjusted it and asked Ivan to introduce him to other magic items.
After seeing a few magic items, Dougart couldn't help sighing.
"I think the inspectors of the Ministry of Magic will be shocked to see these things."
"Perhaps, I always feel that I need to add something..." Ivan looked around, still feeling a little unsatisfied, and there was still too little.
The things the Weasley brothers sent over were interesting, but only suitable for a specific group of people.
He is ready to make a fortune.
Thinking of what he had left plus the skill upgrade rewards, and about 300 points of academic performance, Yifan thought about it and asked.
"What if I make some potions and sell them here?"
"You want to sell potions? I should have told you before, but that requires a high level of potion production." Dougt frowned.
"Don't worry, the potion I brewed is very stable, and the effect will not be worse than that of the regular store." Ivan said confidently.
"What you think is simple. Potions are not sold by the way. Only wizards who have passed the certification can sell potions." Dougt dismissed Ivan's thoughts in an angry manner. Before, it would be no problem to do it casually. , This time facing the inspectors from the Ministry of Magic, they must not make mistakes.
"Then do you have this certification?" Ivan suddenly asked.
"Of course!" Doug said triumphantly.
Not long after he graduated, he had obtained this qualification certificate when he took up the post of St. Mungo's Magical Injury. Even if he was dismissed later, the qualification certificate was retained.
"Then what are we afraid of? Someone asks, just say that you put it here to sell on your behalf!" Ivan said indifferently.
But what if something happens?
Dougter opened his mouth to refute, so he subconsciously looked at Esiah, hoping that she would help dispel Ivan's unrealistic idea.
It's a pity that even though Aysia was half-believing, considering Ivan's previous performance, he did not hesitate to choose to support Ivan's decision.
Dougte wanted to cry without tears, thinking that this trouble was entirely his fault, so he had to bite the bullet and reluctantly agreed.
However, Dougt insisted on personally checking Ivan's potion level to see if he could reach the corresponding level.
Only in the afternoon, Ivan took Dougt to Diagon Alley to buy potion materials and cauldrons.
As for the crucible that he bought at school before, he left it in the school and didn’t bring it back, and one was not enough...
Compared with the poor and dangerous Knock Down Alley, Diagon Alley is like a place for normal people to stay.
There are many shops here, the streets are full of hustle and bustle of people, messy joking and bargaining, and occasionally you can see some little wizards chasing and playing...

chapters.title: Chapter 120: That was what the Half-Blood Prince taught me...
chapters.content:
Walking on the streets of Diagon Alley, Ivan looked around curiously.
A towering and solemn building that resembles a castle comes into view. People come and go, and the shiny bronze gate opens inward. Several goblins in scarlet and gold uniforms guard both sides of the gate, watching the surroundings vigilantly, facing the guests. It is a polite bow.
If you don't count the experiences in his memory, he is still here for the first time, so he is naturally interested in everything.
Along the way, Ivan also saw the ancient Ollivander wand shop and Lihen Bookstore.
But that was not where they were going, Ivan just looked a few more times, then turned his head, and stopped at the Pataki Cauldron.
"If you want the crucible, I have it there, so I don't need to buy another one." Doug said with a slap in his mouth.
Ivan ignored him and walked straight in, Doug sighed and only followed.
Because it was not time for the little wizards to start school, there were not many customers in the cauldron shop. The manager Patitch tried hard to sell them the pure gold cauldron from the recent fire, but Ivan refused without hesitation.
"The pewter crucible will do. Give me three...no, five!" Ivan took out the money from the pocket of the wizard robe and put it on the counter, using the sealing fee that Doug had previously given him.
"Five... five cauldrons?" Store Manager Patitch was also taken aback. It was the first time he saw a little wizard buy so many cauldrons, and then turned his head and glanced at Dougt. He thought it was mostly It's just that the child is playing around.
"What do you buy so many crucibles for?" Dougt was equally strange.
"Of course it's to make the medicine faster." Ivan glanced at him obliquely, picked a few crucibles in the store, and after paying, he left here straightaway, and went to the herb store not far away. After purchasing, there was not much left after giving the dozen gold Jialongs to the flower.
Dougt was still painstakingly persuading him, trying to dispel Ivan's idea of ​​using five cauldrons to boil medicine at the same time.
"Making potions is a delicate task, and you can't be distracted at all. I can use my years of experience to tell you that potions made from multiple crucibles are doomed to fail..."
Ivan Li ignored him. After returning home all the way, he couldn't wait to enter the work area in the basement and found an empty place to start preparations.
Dougte gritted his teeth helplessly, and decided that if there was something wrong with the potion that Ivan made, he would personally get a batch of potions out of it and secretly replace those that Ivan had boiled, lest he smashed the signs .
Stepping into the work area, Ivan did not immediately start brewing the potion, but picked up the carving knife to transform the newly bought crucibles and potion tools.
What Dougt saw was inexplicable, and he tried to interrupt and ask about the situation several times, but he didn't succeed.
Two hours later, in Dougt's surprised gaze, Ivan continued to wield his magic wand, like a music conductor in a Muggle band performance.
The potion materials that were placed aside and allocated according to their types jumped into the cauldron spontaneously.
Cutting and grinding tools on the side appeared one after another, suspended, cutting the potion materials into suitable sizes, grinding them into powder, and stirring them together.
"This...this isn't..." Dougt stared roundly, thinking of Aysia's magic kitchen.
But making potions is not cooking, it requires subtle control...
Just as Doug was about to speak out, he noticed that the potion materials on the five cauldrons were processed extremely accurately, without any omission.
How can one person be distracted to do so many things at the same time?
Dougt was confused.
In fact, he didn't know that Yifan was able to achieve such precise control by consuming grade points to activate the thinking acceleration mode of the experience card.
This is also thanks to Dumbledore’s demonstration of how to use magic to control objects when Ivan was in the school hospital, plus the inspiration of Asia’s Magic Kitchen, which led to this semi-finished pharmaceutical factory.
The original cumbersome process of making potions became easy under the control of Ivan's subtle magic, and even quite artistic, just like the bartender in the bar making cocktails as pleasing to the eye.
The roots of daisies...the powder of dried nettles...the petals of sunflowers...and a small peppermint.
Dougert quickly recognized that what Ivan brewed was a euphoria. As a common potion, the euphoria has a wide range of uses and can make the drinker's mood very good for a period of time without side effects.
When he was treating the wounded in his own dark hospital, he liked to add a diluted euphoria to the drinking water of some patients...
This usually allows the patient to walk out of the hospital with a smile after paying high medical expenses...
But what made Dougt frowned was that he remembered that peppermint was not the material required for the delight formula, so he interrupted.
"What do you do with peppermint? Did you remember the recipe wrong?"
"No, adding peppermint can improve the efficacy of the euphoria." Yifan shook his head and explained softly.
"Impossible, why have I never heard of...Where did you hear about it?" Doug said in disbelief.
"I was taught by the Half-Blood Prince..." Ivan said lightly, his wand frivolous, and the potion made by grinding was poured into the reagents that had been prepared.
After the incident, Ivan didn't want to stop at all, and continued to make the next batch of potions, this time it was a decoction of living hell.
The experience card mode of redemption of 100 academic points is only one hour, and he doesn't want to waste a minute.
Only the potion made in this state is the highest level he can achieve.
In addition, when Ivan was reading the original work in his previous life, he obtained some tips for making potions, and the final finished product will have a much higher potency than ordinary potions or how? May compete with those regular potion shops.
Thinking of this, Ivan suddenly felt that he was a little miscalculated. Why had he forgotten to get Snape's old textbook when he was at Hogwarts.
Ivan vaguely remembered that the thing seemed to be in the advanced class classroom of the upper grades. In addition to the knowledge of potions summed up by Snape, there were a lot of advanced spells in it.
Seeing that Ivan was so addicted to making medicine and unable to extricate himself from it, Dougt could only hold his doubts in his heart, and set his eyes on the five bottles of delight on the table.
Dougt picked up one of the bottles, shook it, and found that the color was lighter than the normal euphoria.
Judging from his years of simmering medicine, the quality of this potion is not bad, but he obviously saw Ivan add peppermint to it...
It stands to reason that even if the potion does not fail, its efficacy should be greatly reduced!
(Ps: The addition of Wanshou comes in one round, and all the book friends who have given Wanshang will be added one more round, and then the second round will be added.)

chapters.title: Chapter 121: We are trained Aurors
chapters.content:
Cruelly, Dougt opened the bottle and took a sip, a faint mint scent lingered in his mouth.
Immediately after a spontaneous happy mood surged into my heart, the worries in his heart were swept away in a short time, and Dougt's brows that had been frowning because of the Ministry of Magic's inspections were also loosened.
"It's so powerful..." Dougt muttered to himself with a smile on his mouth.
The euphoria agent Dought has not been made before, but the effect is far inferior to the one made by Ivan now.
The most important thing is that while improving the effect, it hasn't affected his normal thinking, just adjusted his mood.
"How? Can this kind of potion be sold?" Ivan ran out of time for an experience card, then stopped and asked instead.
"As long as the publicity is in place, it will definitely sell well, much better than the average potion store."
Dougte had to admit that Ivan's level of cooking medicine far exceeded his imagination!
Before, Dougert was still worried about whether Ivan would smash his golden sign by selling potions under his name. Now Dougert doesn't think so. This is the rhythm of becoming famous!
"Who is the half-blood prince you are talking about?" Dougt couldn't help but ask.
"It's Snape Severus! The potions professor at Hogwarts..." Ivan said.
"It turned out to be him! No wonder, I didn't expect you to be Snape's proud pupil at school."
For Snape, the potion master, Dougt certainly knew.
But he obviously heard that Snape hated the Gryffindor students the most, and the rumors had spread to him. It shouldn't be a rumor.
Could it be that geniuses have special treatment, Doug thinks so.
Ivan didn't correct Dougert's misunderstanding, because his method of making potions was indeed Snape's exclusive skill.
After receiving Dougert’s approval, Ivan breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed that the selling standard of potions was much lower than he had imagined. From this point of view, the potions he usually made should also be sold. .
As a result, in the face of Dougt's shock, after Ivan boiled a few waves of potions in a fancy manner, suddenly and honestly used a knife to cut the potion bit by bit.
In the face of Dougt's suspicious inquiry, Yifan called for a potion hierarchy to make some normal potions and separate them at different prices so that everyone can afford potions at the right price.
However, Dougt didn’t know, but Ivan felt a pity in his heart. It’s really too little to buy five crucibles. Only a dozen bottles of potions can be brewed in one hour. It’s a waste of academic points. Tomorrow Must buy ten more crucibles back!
"By the way, Dean Dougt, you should also brew these potions, right?" Ivan suddenly turned his head to look at Dougt, who was in a daze.
"En. Of course..." Dougt nodded subconsciously before he recovered from the shock.
"Then come over and help quickly and brew some normal potions to recharge!" Yifan threw a medicine-cutting knife over.
Dougt took it in a daze, feeling a strong sense of disobedience inexplicably.
The deputy director of his dignified St. Mungo’s Magical Injury Hospital, the potion he made was reduced to the point where it was used to replenish...
However, in order to steal some tricks of making potions from Ivan, Dougte rolled up his sleeves. Although he was frustrated in his heart, he still had a happy smile on his mouth...
After all, the efficacy of the euphoria agent has not yet passed...
After three busy days, Ivan finally ushered in the day when the system mission said the Ministry of Magic came to inspect.
Dougte left as early as yesterday, and Aysia has a new research project-Pygmy Pu, she is said to be remodeling this thing.
Ivan is at a loss, but the dwarf Pu needs to be remodeled?
Is the transformation more cute?
Precisely because of this, Ivan became the state of looking after the shop alone.
Until the afternoon, not far from the store, the space was distorted. Two men and a woman, three figures appeared in a side alley.
"This is Turnover Alley. It looks like it's nothing special except a little deserted." Among the three silhouettes, the young wizard who seems to be in his early twenties, looked around, and said in a relaxed tone.
"Don't let your guard down, Ellison! Knockdown Alley is definitely the most dangerous place in the entire magical world."
The one who spoke was a man with stiff and short hair, who looked very strong on the outside, but there was a deep worry in his words.
Seeing the Auror whose name is Ellison's unrelenting expression, he once again warned.
"You have just become Aurors not long, so it may not be clear that the Ministry of Magic had done an action to rectify Knockout Alley ten years ago. As a result..."
"What happened, Captain Dalis?" Ellison asked curiously.
"Most of the dozen or so Aurors in the action team were killed and injured. Since then, Minister Fudge has never launched a similar operation again." Dawlish sighed.
"Hiss~" Ellison took a breath and looked around carefully. Although it was empty, he still felt danger everywhere.
"Then let's go quickly, Captain... Go back and say we have searched and there is nothing in it..." Ellison said cautiously.
"How can that work?" Before Dalis could speak, the female Auror who had not spoken before scolded.
"We are Aurors, how can we give up action because we are afraid of danger! Ellison, have you forgotten why we chose this profession in the first place?"
Of course because the salary is relatively high! Ellison murmured silently in his heart.
"Sonny, Ellison, stop arguing. UU Reading www.uukanshu.com" As the captain, Dalis felt a headache. The Ministry of Magic arranged for him to have two players, either a fool or a fool, one more than one. Not reliable.
Sometimes Dawlish wondered if he was abandoned by the ministry, or how could he receive such a dangerous task and arrange such a team member for himself.
"Listen to me. We are here to investigate the proliferation of black magic items. The target is the shop opposite. Someone reported that many black magic items on the market are sold here..."
Having said this, Dawlish increased his tone and continued.
"So this must be a dark magic shop. After entering, you need to be careful not to touch the contents casually! Anyway, hold your wands tightly. We are trained Aurors. Don't panic no matter what you encounter... "
The female Auror named Sonny nodded cautiously, while Ellison swallowed and followed the Dlex worriedly, as if the shop in front of him was a magic cave...
(Ps: Four more complete! Ask for subscription, ask for votes..)

chapters.title: Chapter 122: This is the legendary black magic shop?
chapters.content:
"Remember, be careful, be careful, be careful again! The other party is a dark wizard, and it is very likely that they will attack us when they enter the door." Before entering the door, Dalis lowered his voice and told them.
"En..." Ellison and Sonny nodded like chickens pecking rice.
The three of them walked to the door, and the bell hung on the door shook gently with the wind, and it made a pleasant ringing.
Dawlish was like a big enemy, and a handsome man subconsciously turned his head, and with a "swipe" he took out his wand and pointed it at the bell..
The long training also made Sonny and Ellison quickly reacted, learning the Dawlish movements in a hurry.
In short, you can never go wrong with the actions of the predecessors...
However, a few seconds passed and nothing happened...
The two young Aurors looked at Dalis with nervous expressions. Could it be that something happened, but they didn't see it.
"Ahem..." Delish coughed a little awkwardly, and was looking for a reason to fool around, but at this moment someone heard someone say.
"Welcome to the strange magic item store, do you have any needs?"
At the front desk of the store, Ivan looked strangely at the door with his magic wand, like three Aurors facing the enemy. He really didn't understand what they wanted to do with their door, but he still spoke enthusiastically.
Ivan's right time to speak relieved the awkward atmosphere on the scene. Dawlish quickly retracted his wand, expressionless, pretending that nothing had happened.
The attention of Ellison and Sunny also shifted to Ivan in an instant.
Before coming in again, Ellison thought about what the shopkeeper inside would look like.
The gloomy, eccentrically dressed bald wizard? Or an old witch with a blind eye and a weird smile on her face? But no one thought that the eleven or twelve-year-old little wizard would come to greet them.
"Where is Mrs. Hals?" Dawlish frowned. He didn't even think of this, but his cautious attitude kept him from letting his guard down.
He remembered that in the materials he had read, the owner of this dark magic shop should be a young witch.
"Mom, she's upstairs, and she will be there soon." Ivan explained, and then walked out of the counter and motioned to the three of them.
"Are several gentlemen and ladies here to buy things? Then I can introduce them to you. I think you will definitely be interested."
The female Auror Sanny opened her mouth and wanted to explain her intentions, but she was stopped by Delish. This strong man like an iron tower shook her head at the two team members and said.
"Yes, we just buy things."
Ellison and Sunny immediately understood what Dalis meant. The captain asked them to pretend to be guests and understand the situation in the store.
Even though they came here in uniforms, the little wizard may not know who they are...just let the other party tell them about these dark magic items, it's best to come personally and get something.
Ivan was clear about the identities of the Aurors, but didn't mean to expose them at all, so he took a few people around in the store and introduced the products in the store.
Because he also counted on these Aurors to buy more things to go back, and then help publicize...
The three Aurors from the Ministry of Magic tremblingly shuttled among the many magic items. Although these things looked normal, they guessed that there was some ferocious black magic in them.
"This is a fake wand..." Ivan pointed to the closest wand made of logs.
"What, you still sell fake and shoddy products here?" Sunny said angrily.
"This is not a fake or shoddy product. Wouldn't you read the instructions yourself?" Ivan said silently with blue veins on his forehead.
Sonny immediately got close and glanced at her, and there was a sign on it that said the use of fake wands.
"When touched, it will become a toy made of rubber or tin?" Sonny murmured.
It seems that there is nothing special about this, but the black magic items are definitely not that simple..
"Could it be said that this thing will turn us into toys? That's horrible!"
Sunny took a few steps back with a look of horror.
Ellison was also speechless when he heard this.
Ivan was speechless, looking at the appearance of a few people, he had to hold the fake magic wand in front of them.
The three of them also noticed Ivan's movements, and subconsciously moved a little further away, staring at the magic wand closely.
As everyone watched, the fake wand suddenly turned into a soft rubber mouse after being touched by Ivan. The Weasley brothers also built a kind of sound magic inside, which can emit squeaks. Scream.
Sonny screamed when she saw the mouse, but Ellison looked back at Dlex with a weird face...
This is the black magic item you mentioned, Captain?
It doesn't seem to be terrible...
This is just a toy, it's not a black magic item... Dalis rolled his eyes, and then he used his eyes to signal the two of them not to relax their vigilance. This is probably something specially made to confuse them.
Sonny and Ellison solemnly nodded. They are well-trained Aurors. Although they have not been in office for a long time, they have also heard of a lot of dark wizards during training. They usually use some disguise to make The victimized wizard relaxes and is launching a fatal blow!
However, as Ivan introduced the magic items in the store, Sunny and Ellison's faces became more and more weird.
A big dung egg that can spew foul-smelling juice after hitting an enemy, a quill that automatically answers questions to complete school tasks, or a potion that can temporarily increase charm after drinking...
With a series of explanations, coupled with Ivan’s potential affinity talent, Sonny almost couldn’t help but tempted to pay for the purchase several times, and Ellison was also heart-stricken to hear He was extremely hopeful to be able to. Buy a quill pen, so he doesn't have to do it himself every time he writes a report.
However, every time the two were about to move, they were stopped by Dawlish with a stern look.
Now, when performing the mission of the Ministry of Magic, how can you buy something in the store of the mission target?
Alas.. What a picky customer, Ivan sighed. He knew that if he didn't get Dawlish, he wouldn't be able to sell anything today.
Thinking of this, Ivan paused and took a few people to a shelf in the center. There were a pair of black and red gloves on it, and a metal patch in the shape of a shield on the back. The patch was printed with a shop icon. , There are golden patterns around.
For an Auror who has been fighting for a long time, what can be more exciting than a magic item that enhances combat effectiveness and survivability?
(Ps: Thanks to the leader of the phantom feather, the angel only wanted to be a salted fish with two shifts a day after she was put on the shelves, and occasionally turned over to get three chapters, but it seems impossible. Today is the fourth shift. The fifth shift, just watch the evening, it will be sent together.)

chapters.title: Chapter 123: This is a protective ring? No, this is just one more life...
chapters.content:
"What is this?" Dawlish also discovered the difference in this glove, looking like a high-end magic item.
"It's called the anti-cursive gloves, and it's the main product in our store!" Ivan introduced to Dalis with enthusiasm, then looked at Ellison and Sonny, and said again.
"If you don't like wearing gloves, you can change to a cloak or hat. Trust me, it can definitely surprise your enemy!"
"What does it do? Can it kill the enemy instantly after contact? Or is there a curse or something inside." Dawlish became nervous in an instant. He felt that after seeing so many normal magic items,
He didn't dare to underestimate the main product of a black magic shop.
We must know that when he was on a mission to capture a dark wizard, the dark magic items in the opponent's hand were extremely powerful, killing one of his companions almost instantly!
Seeing the Auror Captain reacting like this, Ellison and Sunny also became nervous, their expressions tense to the extreme.
"Kill the enemy? Carry a curse? How is it possible? This is not a black magic item..." Ivan shook his head.
Isn't this a black magic item shop? A shop that does not sell black magic items, what do you sell?
Dalis and the others were confused, but they heard Ivan introduce them.
"I said this is an anti-cursive glove. As long as you carry it and stare into the opponent's eyes, you can reflect the enemy's curse."
Rebound the curse, are you sure that it is not a curse?
Ellison on the side opened his mouth and wanted to spit out. He felt that he was waiting for someone to go in the wrong place, or that this was not a black magic shop after all.
"It can really defend against evil curses?" Dawlish frowned.
"Of course, who of you wants to try?" Ivan took the gloves off, looked at several people, and motioned.
Ellison and the others hesitated, because of the specific effect of the gloves, they just listened to Ivan and did not rule out that it was a trap.
"Then I'll do it." Ivan looked at the three Aurors who were awkward, suddenly a little speechless, Fan shrugged and prepared to demonstrate by himself.
"This thing is so amazing as you said?" At this time, the courageous Sunny gritted her teeth, grabbed it directly, and asked suspiciously.
After listening to Ivan for a long time, Sunny felt that the captain must be fooling them. Where is the black magic shop? She looked pretty normal. For example, the charm potion was pretty good..
Sunny looked carefully, except for some nice patterns on the back of the glove, which seemed to be no different from ordinary gloves.
Dlex opened her mouth and wanted to stop it, but at this time Sunny had put the gloves on her hand, and there did not seem to be any bad reactions, so Dlex had to shut her mouth temporarily and sighed in her heart what to say next time. No more newcomers.
"Which one of you will try to attack me?" Sunny said.
Dawlish saw that the matter was over, so he had to give Ellison a look and let him go on the field. The latter understood immediately and stood opposite Sonny with his wand in his hand.
"How about a Tarantella dance spell first? To be honest, I haven't seen Sonny dance with you. It must be very interesting..."
Ellison smiled, and before Sonny could retort, he raised his wand and started the spell.
"Tarantella dance~"
Sunny will scold if she is angry, because people who are hit by this spell are usually forced to perform a funny dance. She doesn't want to make a fool of yourself here...
However, what Sunny didn't expect was that the curse-proof gloves she thought were unreliable played a role at this time, and the light of magic was instantly bounced back and hit Ellison.. .
The smile on Ellison's face suddenly got stuck, and he felt horrified that his body was uncontrollably and spontaneously, his feet lightly tipped up, alternately stepping on the ground, making a kicking sound.
"Which one of you will help me solve this spell, hurry!" Ellison shouted in a collapsed voice.
Sanny curled her lips. Who wanted to make a fool of her with this spell just now, deserved it!
Immediately afterwards, Sunny looked at the glove she was wearing on her right hand again, her expression in astonishment, but she didn't expect this thing to be really useful!
"The curse stops immediately!" Dawlish waved his wand, dispelling Ellison's magic, and then cast his gaze on the ordinary glove.
As an elite Auror of the Ministry of Magic, Dalis knows exactly what a magical item that can bounce back spells represents...
It can be said that as long as you have this, you will definitely be able to take advantage in one-on-one battles.
"How much does this thing cost?" Although Dalis knew that he might be in a dark magic shop, he couldn't help asking.
"Seven Jin Jialong!" Ivan said suddenly.
"So expensive?" Sonny curled her lips and was about to say a few words when she heard Dawlish trembling suddenly.
"It's so cheap?"
Sonny and Ellison were stunned for an instant, and looked at their Captain Auror with weird eyes. It was the first time they saw anyone who thought the prices of goods were too cheap.
Ivan knew what Dalis meant in his heart. If the curse-proof gloves could really resist the evil curse without limit, seven Jin Jialong would simply be the price of jumping off the property.
"The reason why they are sold so cheaply is because the anti-cursive gloves can only deal with some low-level evil curses. If the opponent uses powerful black magic, the gloves will be destroyed immediately!" Ivan did not intend to conceal the slightest, but took all the shortcomings. Out.
After all, he is a conscientious businessman, and he doesn't sincerely deceive customers, especially for such shortcomings that can be seen after a try.
Hearing Ivan's words, Dawlish felt disappointed. He thought he really had such a powerful magic item.
However, at this moment, Ivan's voice changed and his tone became high.
"But don’t worry... we have the latest upgraded version of the protection ring! Just enter the magic power, you can release a 360-degree magic barrier without dead ends, allowing you to fight in the most intense battle. You can easily defeat your opponent in the middle of the game!"
Dlex's thoughts that had just cooled down suddenly rose again!
what? A 360-degree magical barrier without dead ends!
Instant!
What is this concept?
Good use is almost equivalent to one more life!
Dalis can no longer contain the excitement in his heart. He has been in the position of Auror for more than ten years and has encountered various dangers, and he has had several near-death experiences.
He couldn't help thinking, if he had such a ring at the beginning, would the mission process not be so thrilling...
(Ps: The author did not expect that there would be a reward from the leader, so he did not save the manuscript accordingly, and overestimated his codeword speed. There are only four changes today...)

chapters.title: Chapter 124: This is obviously a store of conscience!
chapters.content:
"This... can this ring really achieve the kind of effect you said?" Dalis couldn't believe it.
Ivan did not speak, and entered the magic power into the protective ring. Almost at the same time, a light magic barrier enveloped him.
The barrier is semi-transparent. If it weren't for standing so close, plus the look in his eyes, Dlex couldn't see it at all.
"Except your weapon!" Dawlish stretched out his magic wand, and a red light shot towards Ivan, which had the same effect as the protective ring, and the curse was bounced back in an instant.
Because the distance was too close, the elite Auror Dalis couldn't escape the curse of the rebound. For a while, the wand dropped out and flew out.
Ivan stretched out his hand to take the magic wand that flew toward him, and returned it to Dalis with his backhand. The magic barrier on his body disappeared without a trace after about two seconds. It could not be activated continuously for a short time, otherwise it would be greatly improved. The possibility of damage to the ring.
With Ivan's relaxed and freehand appearance, Dlex looked at him with heat, and after receiving the wand, he couldn't help asking.
"How much is this protective ring?"
"70 Jin Jialong!" Seeing that the other party had already taken the bait, Ivan couldn't help but smiled. The price for Dougte was the internal price, and of course it would be more expensive for the official sale.
Dawlish hesitated, it was not cheap...he had worked for more than ten years and he couldn't save much money..
"There is only this protective ring in the store for the time being. Once it is sold, I don't know how long it will take to buy it next time!" Ivan said lightly at this moment.
"Buy!" Hearing Ivan's words, Delish made a decision without hesitation.
He gritted his teeth and paid for the seventy Jin Jialong!
But there is only one protective ring, and the effect is so good. Dawlish felt that he had come early, otherwise it would have been bought if it was discovered by other colleagues.
Thinking of this, Dawlish eagerly took out all the Jin Jialong he brought from the pocket of the wizard's robe, but after counting it, he found that it was a little bit awkward.
After all, seventy Jin Jialong is not a small amount of money, unless he goes out to buy things, otherwise he will not bring so many.
"How much money do you have? Quickly, bring it out to me, so I can get it together!" Dlex turned his head and said to the two adorable Aurors.
Captain...Aren't we here to investigate the proliferation of black magic items?
Ellison opened his mouth, but seeing Dawlish's eager appearance, he held the words in his heart again, and took out some Jin Jialong from his pocket.
Dawlish took it over, but the count was still not enough, so he turned to look at the female Auror Sanny.
"Seventy Jin Jialong, isn't this a bit expensive?" Sonny whispered, looking at Dawlish.
This is enough for her to buy more than a dozen bottles of charm potions...
"You look like you are buying a ring, but sometimes it is equivalent to buying a life!" Dlex shook his head, noticed the puzzled look of the two, and talked about some of his own experiences.
