As a senior Auror of the Ministry of Magic, Dalis has been working for more than ten years, and even participated in the last Wizarding War.
It is his daily job to catch dangerous dark wizards. Of course, it is different from these cute new ones. He knows that Auror is a very risky industry!
"Oh... I have seen many colleagues who cast spells too slowly when they were in danger, and died tragically under the magic of the dark wizard. If the Aurors of the entire Ministry of Magic are equipped with defensive magic items, then They won't die anymore." Dalis couldn't help sighing.
Ivan nodded in satisfaction, he was about to say so, but it was naturally better to say from Dawlish's mouth.
Ellison and Sunny were stunned when they heard the words. They didn't expect the Auror's job to be so dangerous.
Especially Ellison, he is already wondering whether he should also pay for a protective ring. Although there is only one of this thing for the time being, he can save money first, right?
"Are you Aurors?" Ivan looked at everyone's reaction, tried to pretend to be surprised, and said.
Dalis has already said so clearly just now, he is not a fool, and he has to react a little at this time.
"Of course, brother, do you see this dress?" Sanny pointed to the standard robe on her body and said proudly.
"It's so cool! My biggest dream after graduation is to become an Auror!" Ivan said with envious eyes sparkling.
"Then you have to work hard, the Ministry of Magic's review is very strict, and only true elites can come in!" Sunny was very helpful, and she squinted happily. It took her a long time for the Auror to get admitted.
Dalis also nodded aside,
After listening to Ivan's introduction of so many products, Dalis had some doubts about the information given to him by the Ministry of Magic, because it was more like a normal magic item store with its own style.
With so many interesting magic items, there is no need to sell black magic items.
In addition, after Ivan took his wand and returned it as soon as possible, Dlex dispelled many doubts.
If the other party really has any bad intentions, then it is the best time to take action...
"By the way, why did your mother open the store to Knock Down Alley?" Dalis still had the last question in his heart. After thinking about it, he squatted down, looked directly at Ivan's eyes, and asked.
"Of course it's because... poor!" Ivan shrugged.
poor?
Dawlish was speechless for a while, and it seemed to be the same. If it wasn't for this reason, who would stay in the ruined place of Knockdown Alley?
but...
Dalis looked at the protective ring in his hand, and then at the bag of Jin Jialong he had just handed to Ivan.
Is it really that poor to open a magic goods store? Why didn't he believe it?
Ivan saw the doubts of the Auror Captain and explained aloud.
"My mother has seen too many wizards persecuted by black magic, so these years have been dedicated to the research work of black magic prevention, and spent a lot of energy on this.
The research cost of magic props is very high. It takes at least a few years, thousands of dollars of investment, countless failures to get the corresponding magic formula, we have only recently had some results, so... "
"There is no profit at all!" Ivan said at last.
Dawlish nodded, so it seems that the price of 70 gallons for such a high-end magic item of the protection ring is really cheap.
I really don’t know if it’s the **** who told the Ministry of Magic that this is the shop of the Dark Arts?
This is obviously a conscience shop!
Wouldn't the hearts of those who spread the rumors hurt?
(Ps: The leader is a bit special, adding two changes per round, so today’s two changes are for the magic feather..)

chapters.title: Chapter 125: This shop is so miserable!
chapters.content:
Thinking of this, Dawlish hesitated and said.
"I think your protective ring, the batters in the department will definitely like it, and protective gloves should also be very popular. Maybe it can make the department buy in large quantities!"
Ivan was naturally overjoyed and thanked for a while. He had been preparing for so long, and he was waiting for this sentence!
Dalis said very politely that you are welcome, and Ellison and Sunny also bluntly said they would help propaganda in the ministry.
"By the way, Captain Dalis, did you come here to buy things after hearing about it?" Ivan was there, pretending to ask casually.
The three Aurors were all embarrassed when they heard this, and they didn't know what to say, but Sonny finally said angrily.
"We have received a mission from the Ministry of Magic. Someone reported that you sell a large number of dangerous black magic items here, and I don't know which **** made the report."
Dawlish looked at Sonny helplessly, how could you just state the tasks given by the ministry.
"Sister Sonny, have you heard that the Ministry of Magic inspects other shops in the Knockdown Alley?" Ivan thought for a while, then asked.
"It doesn't seem to..." Sunny hesitated.
Dawlish and Ellison also noticed something wrong. If the Ministry of Magic were really going to investigate the dark magic items in Knockdown Alley, it would never be possible to check only this shop.
In the entire Knockdown Alley, there are a total of three dark magic shops. Except for the one where they are located, the Bojinbok shop and the fairy shop have been reported in the past, but there was no action in the department, all of which were deemed to have not been seen.
So if there is no tricky, they don't believe it.
"It must be those dark wizards who are preparing to retaliate here!" Sunny said angrily.
Ellison also nodded, showing indignation.
Dalis was silent. He could imagine that the lady who opened this magic shop must be someone who had been persecuted by dark magic in the early years, so even if she was destitute, she insisted on doing research work in Knockdown Alley.
It’s only recently that results have been made. When it was ready to sell, it was deliberately targeted by other dark wizards. This is really miserable...
Upon seeing this, Ivan was ready to make persistent efforts to see if he could shed some information, but at this moment, Ayia's special gloomy and delicate voice sounded in the shop.
"Three Aurors, Mrs. and Madams, can you please inquire for us in the Ministry of Magic, specifically who is deliberately targeting this, so we can take precautions in advance..."
The Dalismans were attracted by the sound, turned their heads and looked over, and saw Aisia wearing a dark green wizard robe coming out from the side of the shop.
Ivan keenly discovered that Esiah seemed to be different from usual. The rings on his hand were taken off. The long hair was scattered so casually, and there was a black fluffy ball on his shoulders. biological.
Are you going to hide things on your body? Ivan wondered why Esiah came so late.
Humans are visual animals, and Aysia's exquisite face won the favor of three Aurors almost when they first met.
With the addition of the story made up temporarily by Ivan, the Delish people have a little more sympathy for Esiah.
"Don't worry, we will definitely help with the investigation..." Dlex promised, patting his chest.
Sonny and Ellison also promised that after returning to the ministry, they would mobilize their friends to help.
Aysia smiled, and thanked her softly.
However, she glanced at Ivan calmly. Not long after she arrived, she only heard part of the conversation, so she was really curious about how the child worked for such a while, so she gave the three Aurors to It's done.
However, although Aysia didn't get the full picture of the matter, after some conversation, she quickly understood what kind of temporary identity Ivan had created for herself.
So not only did not reveal any flaws in the conversation, but instead used this identity to greatly improve Bo's favor. Soon after, Sunny, the newly promoted female Auror, shouted one by one sister.
"Sister Aisia, what is this, Dwarf Pu? It doesn't seem to be, anyway, it looks so cute?" After familiarizing it for a while, Sunny finally asked about the cute fluffy ball on Aisia's shoulder.
After Esiah's transformation, the hair has become gray-black, and there are also a pair of big watery eyes, so big that it is impossible to appear on a normal creature, but it also makes it look more adorable.
Under Sunny's gaze, this thing hopped on her shoulders. It was very cute, and the heart of seeing was melted.
"This is an alchemy creature made based on the look of the magical creature pygmy cat. The price is..." Aysia explained to Sonny, turning her head to look at Ivan when she mentioned the price of the item.
"The original version only needs a Jin Jialong!" Ivan said.
"It's so cheap, can I buy one?" Sunny was immediately moved. Since it's not expensive, she also wants to get one to wear by her side.
"Of course it's okay, just need to wait for a day or two. For the time being, this one is specially made in the shop, just as a sample." Aixia smiled and nodded.
For a day or two, Sunny was still waiting, but she was also pestering Aysia to touch this alchemy version of the pygmy cat.
After hesitating for a while, Aysia agreed, but reminded Sunny that this dwarf cat is very fragile and it is best not to input magic power into it.
Ivan felt a little strange to listen to it. As an alchemy creature, this thing can only run by magic, so it won't collapse.
But seeing that Isiah had already gotten one of the Aurors after flicking the other party to buy and buy, Ivan did not think too much, and put his energy on the two Aurors Dlex and Ellison. .
"Captain Dalis, besides the protective ring, do you need anything else?" Ivan asked aloud.
"Forget it, no need..." Delish hesitated for a while, shook his head and said, his money has long been taken out by this ring, even if he wants to buy it, he can't afford it.
"Are you sure?" Ivan pointed to the two ear-shaped magic items on the other side and introduced.
"This is a telescopic ear. As long as you hold one of them, you can hear the sound on the other side. The most important thing is that it has no magical fluctuations and cannot be detected. It should be useful when detecting intelligence. Now the special price is only Selling sixteen cico...not even a gallon!"
Dalis, who had already made up his mind and didn't want to buy anything, was moved again. It seemed that it was very cheap...
(Ps: In the original work, the dwarf cat is a magical creature. The author made a mistake before, so I made some corrections based on the plot.)

chapters.title: Chapter 126: The thing is just kept in the store, it is actually yours!
chapters.content:
In the eyes of Dylish, the telescopic ear is really a good thing with a very high cost performance.
The Auror’s missions often require tracking or finding out the identity of the opponent. If you use magic, you will inevitably be noticed by the opponent. If you get close to it rashly, it will arouse the opponent’s vigilance. If you can have an auxiliary prop, it will be convenient. too much...
Not to mention that the special price is only 16 cents, not even a gallon, it can't be cheaper!
The only pity that made Dalis feel a little bit is that the appearance of the telescopic ears is too obvious, the two ears, at first glance, are an eavesdropping device, and they need to be connected to a thin wire.
After understanding Dlex's troubles, Ivan did not hesitate to say that as long as you add money, everything can be solved!
The big deal is to use Muggle technology to disguise it. Ivan feels that technology is much better than magic when it comes to eavesdropping...
Considering that the Auror captain did not bring enough money, Ivan said intimately.
"If you don't have enough money, you can book first and pay half of the deposit!"
While talking, Ivan poured out half of the previous bag of Jin Jialong and returned it to Dalis, and then took back the protective ring.
Dlex subconsciously cooperated with Ivan's movements, but then he remembered something was wrong, so why didn't he bring the money to buy it tomorrow?
"These products are all available, and if you order one, you will be less." Yifan explained, and then said seriously.
"Furthermore, what you bought is only temporarily stored here, it is actually yours!"
Dawlish nodded, as if so.
After taking back half of Jin Jialong, Dalis felt that he had become rich again, so he bought a telescopic ear and used it first, and then ordered a deluxe version.
Immediately afterwards, Ivan introduced a quick answer quill to Dalis, focusing on the fact that this thing can automatically help him complete the heavy copywriting task.
Although Dawlish had seen this thing before, he was frightened and didn't even think about buying it. Now it's different.
Hearing what Ivan said, I quickly understood that the automatic answering quill can greatly improve my daily work efficiency, so I bought it again with money.
"The intelligence enhancer can keep your brain awake, and you can find all kinds of clues in time when performing tracking tasks." Ivan pointed to the potion on the other side.
"Buy!" Dlex gritted his teeth.
"Quick-smoothing hair lotion... I think your hair may need some care..."
"buy!"
......
"Fake wand...big dung egg..."
"...buy!"
Dawlish subconsciously said, and when he took the two things Ivan handed over, he thought that these toys seemed useless to him.
Why don't you buy this if you have nothing to do?
But looking at Ivan waiting for him with a look of expectation, he had to take out the last few silver Sicos from the fluttering money bag, which was regarded as supporting the cause of anti-dark magic..
Ellison on the side had already spent the little savings he had accumulated during this period of time, and even owed a lot...
Because Ivan is very considerate to provide the service of installment payment, as long as he signs a magic agreement.
To spend tomorrow's wages to buy today's combat power is simply a conscience that can no longer be conscientious.
When the group of three people walked out of this magic shop, they all felt as if they were hollowed out, but when they glanced at the pile of things they were holding, they suddenly felt a lot more fulfilled.
......
In the shop, Ivan was happily counting the Jin Jialong in the bag, there were nearly a hundred!
This is still only a small part. According to the agreement, the three Aurors will pay another 200 Jin Jialong within the next six months!
Ivan predicted that in a short period of time, he would not be able to make a fortune from these three people.
At the same time, the shop has also become a lot empty, and most of the items on the counter have been sold.
After considering that protective ring, Ivan didn't choose to press it in the shop, but let Dawlish use it first, so that he could help him publicize it when he arrived at the Ministry of Magic.
When Ivan finished counting Jin Jialong, a white arm stretched out and snatched the bag containing Jin Jialong, and then ten Jin Jialong was picked out and placed on the table.
Ivan:? ? ?
He can only divide a point? Ivan looked at Esiah bitterly...
"This Jin Jialong is not enough for you to study before!" Aysia said angrily.
Ivan thought for a while, as if that was the case. The yew wood used to practice magic writing, the metal used to make magic props, and the countless materials that he scrapped in order to study the magic writing arrangement require a lot of use. Jin Jialong purchased.
In this way, the Jin Jialong earned today can only be regarded as a return.
If you want to make money, you have to count on a large order from the Ministry of Magic.
What really made Ivan feel a little surprised was that the task given by the system was delayed in showing completion.
Isn't the review of the Ministry of Magic finished yet?
Or is it still not yet time to evaluate?
......
Ministry of Magic, Magic Law Enforcement Department, within the Auror Command.
The then Director Pierce Sinknis sat in the main seat with a gloomy face, while Auror Supervisor Rufus Scrimgeour waited quietly, with an ugly expression.
The two listened to the reports of several Auror captains.
"When we were tracking the 72nd target, we encountered strong resistance, and the two players were seriously injured...
It was a dark wizard who wounded us. He suddenly used powerful black magic items in the battle. We didn't have time to react..."
"Trash... trash! You have four Aurors at all, but you wounded two of them. In the end, you didn't even catch the dark wizard!" Pierce patted the table heavily angrily The office roared loudly.
As the reporter, the Auror Captain lowered his head, did not refute, his face was full of guilt.
After cursing for a long time, Pierce stopped for a while, pacing at the desk, his head bald.
Supervisor Rufus Scrimgeour dared to exhort him at this moment.
"Director, blame the Seventh Action Team for failure to complete this mission. The effects of the black magic items are strange, and some are extremely powerful. I think the Aurors have done their best..."
Pierce sighed and clicked helplessly. Since the ministry began a large-scale investigation of the problem of the proliferation of black magic, he has heard similar news many times.
Almost every day, one or two Aurors are injured because of this. Even yesterday, the first victim appeared unfortunately. During the search, this poor Auror was unfortunately blown up by a triggered black magic item. A small half of the body.
Before being sent to the St. Mungo's Hospital for Magical Injuries, he died...

chapters.title: Chapter 127: Are these the black magic items you checked?
chapters.content:
Just as Pierce wondered whether he should persuade the Minister to temporarily stop the investigation, a knock on the door sounded.
"Come in!" Pierce took a sip of the tea on the table and said helplessly.
After the incoming Auror nodded, he reported.
"Director, Captain Dalis wants to see you, saying that there is something important to report!"
"Dris?" Pilston paused, looking at Auror Supervisor Rufus.
"Dalis is the captain of the ninth team. I arranged for him to take people to Knockoff Alley to investigate a dark magic shop..." Rufus quickly explained.
Originally, this investigation did not include Knockover Alley, but some time ago, the department suddenly changed its attention for some reason, saying that it was news that the magic shop was selling black magic items on a large scale, and he asked him to send someone to investigate.
As the head of the Auror, Rufus, who has been in the Ministry of Magic for so many years, certainly understands that there must be something tricky in it.
There is no one who can open a black magic shop in Knockoff Alley. He is not so stupid as to become a knife in the hands of others, and it adds to the Auror's loss.
So Rufus had let out the news in advance, and let the more cautious Dawlish take a few Aurors over to deal with the matter.
But it took so long for Dalis to come back, and now there are important things to report, which makes Rufus feel a very unpleasant feeling.
After explaining to the director, Rufus sighed and looked at the Auror.
"How is Dalis now? How about the other two Aurors who went with me? Aren't they already in the hospital?"
Pierce also frowned, ready to hear some bad news.
"Captain Dalis looks pretty good, Sonny and Ellison are also outside, they seem to be very happy..." The Auror who came in to report had a strange expression.
"En?" Rufus raised his head questioningly. Could it be that the Auror he sent was beaten stupid? Or is it hit the Imperius Curse?
Just as Rufus was puzzled, the Auror hesitated and continued.
"They also came back with a bunch of things. It looks like they are all magical items."
Rufus was a little excited when he heard that, Pierce suddenly thought of something.
Since Dlex came back with so many things, it is only possible that they successfully completed the task and really checked a dark magic shop!
If this is the case, it can be said to be the biggest harvest since the action!
With this achievement, the ministry will not blame him for the loss of manpower...
Although it still felt a little unbelievable, but the fact was right in front of him, Pierce patted the table and stood up and said excitedly.
"Hurry up and let Delish come in!"
......
In the execution hall at this time, Dlex holding a pile of magical items was waiting quietly in the lounge, and the faces of Ellison and Sunny behind them were filled with satisfaction.
The expressions of the three of them were really inconsistent with the solemn and tense atmosphere in the execution hall, and the Aurors who had come and went frequently for a while.
Many insiders were even more shocked secretly. They knew that Operation 9 had gone to Knock Down Alley to investigate a dark magic shop. Before, some people thought that the three of them might not be able to return. I came back and checked a lot of dark magic items...
This is a rare achievement!
"Captain Dalis, you can go in now. The director looks like he is going to commend you personally." The door of the office was opened, and an Auror walked out of it, enviously speaking to the people waiting outside.
The executive director came in person? Want to reward the captain?
Ellison and Sunny were at a loss. They just went to the shop in Knockoff Alley and bought something back. They didn't seem to be doing anything, right?
Dawlish had guessed something faintly, and explained it after he was ready to go in.
However, after entering, Dalis had not had time to speak, and Pierce, the executive director, greeted him immediately. He patted Dlix's strong shoulder with enthusiasm and spoke in admiration.
"Dawlish, I did not misunderstand you. You are the most cautious of all Aurors. I knew before that you would be able to complete the tasks assigned to you by the Ministry."
Auror Supervisor Rufus also looked at the three with admiration. When handing over this task to Dalis, he never thought that these three could actually complete it.
"Director... Director, this..." Dawlish stammered and wanted to explain, but Pierce didn't give him this opportunity. Instead, he looked at the many magic items in his arms and said with satisfaction. .
"These are the black magic items that you have checked? Is there any effect for someone from the Department of Affairs to verify?"
"Director, this is not a black magic item, but a commodity that we paid for there." Dawlish explained cautiously.
"What? I bought it?" Pierce's excitement turned into incomprehension.
If Dawlish said that he bought a few black magic items back, they could still think that they were reluctantly thinking that they were collecting evidence, but knowing that these were not black magic items, why did they buy them back?
Rufus Scrimgeour, the head of the Auror, had a stagnant expression on his face. After a while, he furiously said.
"Dalis, I remember that I asked you to lead the team to investigate the dark magic shop, but I didn't let you go shopping there!"
"Director, Director Scrimgeour, we have investigated the magic shop and there is no problem." Dlex swallowed hard and explained, and the Auror in charge of Rufus became more gloomy. Under his expression, he spoke again.
"Furthermore, we found some very useful magic items, which we thought might be of some help to the Ministry, so we bought some samples back."
Pierce looked down at the magical objects he was holding in Dlex’s arms.
A pair of gloves that don't seem cheap, a few round irregular objects, a quill pen, a few potion bottles sloshing around for unknown reasons, and a lot of other sundries.
Pearston felt that the Auror captain was fooled by the opponent However, Dalisi tried his best to introduce this magical item to them.
"Director, Director, you can take a look at these retractable ears. As long as you wear one of them, you can hear the movement from the other side. Only sixteen Sikors are sold, which is too cheap!"
"There is also this quick answer quill. With it, those colleagues who deal with official documents can greatly improve their work efficiency..."
"The most important thing is this protective ring. As long as you put it on your hand and input magic power, it can instantly form a defensive barrier with no dead ends. Not only can ordinary spells fail to penetrate its defenses, they will also be bounced back."
Dawlish introduced these magic items one by one, and the expressions on Pierce and Rufus' faces gradually changed from impatient to surprised...
(Ps: The author has saved too many manuscripts a few days ago, and the codeword itself is too slow, so the whole plot is needed. Two changes will be made temporarily in these two days, and then will be added later... Please understand the big guys of Wanshang a bit...)

chapters.title: Chapter 128: I wanted to try this a long time ago
chapters.content:
When the protective ring was introduced, Director Rufus finally couldn't help it, and interrupted aloud.
"You have tried it yourself. This thing really has the effect you said?"
Pierce, the executive director, also set his sights on the mediocre ring in Dlex's hand.
He knew exactly what this defensive magic item meant. If what Dawlish said was true, it would mean that the Auror's loss rate would be greatly reduced in the future.
Compared with destructive black magic items, this kind of defensive nature is pitiful, and the price is usually not low, which is why the Ministry of Magic has not equipped the strikers and elite Aurors with corresponding equipment.
"Of course, I can demonstrate it for you now." Dlex said enthusiastically, and then stood in a wider place.
Before Dalis could indicate that he could attack him now, Rufus quickly drew his wand and pointed it at Dalisdao.
"Except for your weapons!"
The red magic light went straight to Dalis,
Rufus suddenly made a move just to test whether this ring could work in an emergency, so he almost used all his strength.
However, how can the disarming curse that requires chanting and gestures can be compared to the instant magical barrier. Although Dawlish was a bit slower, it still activated the ring's defense function in time.
In the next second, the red light returned to the original path and hit Rufus' body. The huge impact drove Rufus directly into the air. The wand in his hand flew high, spinning towards Dawlish. In the direction of the flight.
Dawlish learned what Ivan did before, grabbing the wand with his left hand and holding the wand in his hand, with a calm expression on his face, and a dark refreshment in his heart. He had wanted to try it a long time ago.
Later, Dawlish remembered that it was his boss who had flown out, and quickly changed to a worried look, ran to Rufus's side in small steps, and helped him up.
Dawlish was also a little worried, worried that Rufus would wear small shoes to him in private because of this matter.
But fortunately, Rufus didn't care. He didn't avoid it before, just wanting to experience the counterattack effect of the protection ring by himself. Now after confirming, he hurriedly addressed the executive director Pierce.
"Director, I think we should immediately propose to the Ministry to set up a special fund, specifically for the purchase, so that Aurors who go out on missions can be equipped with such defensive magic items."
Speaking of this, Rufus is also a little aggrieved. In this strike, the opponents of the dark wizards more or less have some powerful black magic items.
But as Aurors, they can only rely on their own strength to fight, how can this keep them from being stunned?
Pierce also knew the truth, nodded, turned to look at Dawlish, and asked aloud.
"Captain Dalis, how much did you use for this ring?"
"A 70 gallon..." Dawlish replied casually.
The executive director's face twitched, so expensive!
The seventy gallon alone is certainly not a big deal to their executive department, but the problem is that if this thing is to be sold in large quantities, he expects to buy a hundred rings!
This is still very small, it can only be carried by the Aurors who are on the mission, even if it is, it will take a full seven thousand Jin Jialong!
This is not a small sum, and the funds issued by their Ministry of Magic to their Executive Division simply cannot make up that much.
It is also unrealistic to expect the ministry to allocate seven thousand gallons... he expects that the ministry will award two thousand gallons at most.
Rufus was also a little sad for a while, apparently thinking about this problem as well.
Fortunately, at this moment, Dalis said in time.
"Director, in addition to the protective ring, there are cheaper anti-cursive gloves. Although the effect is relatively worse, it only takes seven gallons."
Hearing that there are other bargains, Pierce was finally relieved. After listening to Dlex introduced the effect of the anti-cursive gloves, he immediately decided and waited for the special funds in the department to purchase two hundred. Try it out!
By the way, I can also buy ten protective rings with extra money for the elite Aurors.
Other magic items like telescopic ears...automatic feather pens can also be bought.
As for whether the Ministry of Magic will agree to the establishment of special funds?
Pierce was not worried,
Spending some Jin Jialong to buy curse-proof gloves and a small amount of protective rings is cheaper than paying for medical expenses and pensions!
Not to mention that it can significantly improve the combat effectiveness of these Aurors...
Pierce believed that Secretary Fudge was clear about this account.
After all, this special task of investigating the proliferation of black magic items was decided by Fudge against the crowd. If there are too many people damaged, his face will not look good.
After asking Dawlish to leave these magic items as a sample, Pierce waved his hand to indicate that Dawlish could leave. He needed to sort out a proposal to convince Minister Fudge.
Dawlish took off the ring very reluctantly and put it on the table together with other things, but before leaving, he suddenly thought of something, and asked cautiously.
"By the way, Director, will I be reimbursed for the things I bought for the department this time?"
Rufus on the side gave him a fierce look. At this time, Pierce nodded indifferently to say such a disappointment.
......
For three days in a row, Ivan was waiting for someone from the Ministry of Magic, but it was a pity that no one was waiting.
Dalis and others came here once or twice in the middle of the journey. paid the remaining balance and bought some new interesting small items. The heroic almost made Ivan think they had made a fortune. .
After inquiring, it was realized that the Ministry of Magic had reimbursed them for the cost of the last mission. By the way, I also learned that the Ministry of Magic was preparing to set up special funds for the purchase of curse-proof gloves and protective rings.
After receiving this news, Ivan was finally relieved.
Although in the original time and space, the Ministry of Magic ordered a large number of anti-cursive gloves made by the Weasley brothers, but that was after the Dark Lord’s resurrection and the Death Eaters were rampant, so there is an urgent need to strengthen the Auror’s battle. force.
It was not until two days later that the Ministry of Magic finally sent a procurement staff, a total of four people, the leader was a middle-aged witch who looked a little squat, wearing a pair of gold-rimmed round-framed glasses, showing a shrewdness while walking. color...
Ivan tried hard to remember for a long time, and never remembered such a character in the original book.
The reason for her coming is also very simple, only two words...
Bargain!

chapters.title: Chapter 129: protocol? That is for the Ministry of Magic..
chapters.content:
After entering the store, the short squat witch helped her glasses, and then walked to the counter where the magic items were placed, commenting one by one.
"This anti-curse glove is a bit interesting, but you need to stare into your opponent's eyes to be able to reflect the curse, bad review!"
"This telescopic ear can monitor, but it needs to be connected to a thin wire. Is it true that everyone else is blind? Bad review!"
"This protective ring can build a defensive barrier, but...too expensive, bad review!"
......
The chunky witch strolled around in the store and sprayed every item he encountered. Ivan was confused. If he knew in advance that the other party was here to buy things, he almost thought that this guy was sent by the wizard market. Find the difference...
Fortunately, among the four people who came over, Dalis and Sunny were among them, and Ivan leaned forward to inquire about the situation.
Dawlish did not answer with a solemn expression, but Sunny lowered her voice and said quietly.
"This is Mrs. Mu En from the Finance Department of our Executive Department, who was sent by the Ministry to lower the price."
Speaking of this, Sanny is also blushing, because their executive department is extremely poor recently, otherwise it would not be like this...
Does the Ministry of Magic still need to keep prices down? Are you not an official agency?
Ivan was speechless. He thought that the Ministry of Magic was rich in money?
No wonder this woman started picking up shortcomings as soon as she walked in.
Mrs. Mu En suddenly turned her head to look at Sunny. This little girl who had just joined the job was shocked, and then she didn't dare to disclose more information to Ivan.
After watching it for a while, Mu Enfu finally stopped, touched the gold round-rimmed glasses, and said.
"In short, although these items meet the procurement standards of the Ministry of Magic, they are far from my expectations. In addition, I think the price should be discussed again..."
"For example, the anti-spell gloves, the Ministry of Magic intends to buy in large quantities at once, and the price should not exceed five gallons... Otherwise, the Ministry will reconsider whether the purchase is worthwhile.
Ivan frowned slightly, he was really not suitable for bargaining, but fortunately, Aysia spoke at this moment.
"I'm sorry, Mrs. Mu En, seven gallons are already the lowest price. If you include the research cost, you can't even earn a sico, so if the Ministry of Magic refuses to purchase because of this, then I can only express regret."
Aixia looked at Madam Mu En **** for tat, without any intention of giving in.
Judging from the news she received, the Ministry of Magic has suffered a lot of personnel losses in the past few days, and it is absolutely impossible to abandon the purchase of curse-proof gloves and defensive rings.
Madam Mu En's gaze suddenly moved away from Ivan, and she turned to Aisia, and the atmosphere on the court seemed to freeze.
Ivan was caught between the two, feeling that he was under pressure for a while, so he simply gave up the field and prepared to fool the other idle Aurors.
The next step was almost the home court of Mrs. Mu En and Aysia. The two sides had been talking about each other for more than an hour before reaching a formal agreement.
The Ministry of Magic purchased three hundred curse-proof gloves at a price of 6 gallons and ten seccos, a total of nearly 2,000 gallons.
The protection ring was purchased for ten, and the price of one was reduced to sixty-five gallons, for a total of six hundred and fifty gallons.
In addition, telescopic ears and quizzical quill pens have also been purchased in small quantities, and the miscellaneous ones add up to three thousand gallons.
After the talk, Mrs. Mu En was obviously very satisfied, feeling that she had almost reached the cost price.
But she didn't know that the so-called research cost and research time were not as high as she had imagined. It was a miracle created by the power of three geniuses in one month!
What Ivan didn't expect most was that Mrs. Mu En was extremely interested in the enhanced potion he made.
"These potions have really improved so much?" Madam Mu En held a bottle of the enhanced version of the euphoria potion in her hand, and the sign below said that the potion was twice as effective as the normal potion!
The potions on the other counters have a much higher effect than normal potions in the above description, but the prices are not much higher than those on the market.
"Of course, if you don't believe it, you can try it yourself." Ivan said confidently.
Madam Mu En hesitated for a moment, unscrewed the cork of the bottle of the euphoria, and shook it gently as if tasting red wine, and finally poured it out and took a sip.
The next moment, Mrs. Mu En's wrinkled face stretched out instantly, and she felt that her body and mind seemed to have been washed once, and the troubles and depressions in the work were swept away, with a satisfied smile on her mouth, slightly A hint of surprise said.
"Which potion master's work is this? It has such a strong medicinal effect?"
It is important to know that common potions such as blissful potions are generally stable in efficacy, and it is difficult to make a big improvement unless a potion master has modified the original formula.
Ivan just smiled and didn't speak.
Mrs. Mu En didn't ask too much. The high-quality purchase channel is always a secret, but it feels a pity that she originally thought whether she could invite the other party to the Ministry of Magic as a consultant.
Regardless of the fact that the Ministry has a cooperative relationship with the Saint Mungo Hospital for Magical Injuries, some ordinary potions can be purchased from there, but those special high-level potions can only be configured by individual potion masters.
Perhaps because of the effectiveness of the euphoria, Mrs. Mu enlisted some potent potions in the purchase list.
After leaving the deposit and signing two agreements, Mrs. Mu Enn left with satisfaction.
"Anti-cursive gloves...11 Gallon? The protective ring 120 Gallon. Didn’t Mrs. Mu En lower the price? Why is the price higher?" Ivan curiously stepped forward and took a look at the content of the agreement. The discussions are different.
"Because this agreement is for the Ministry of Magic!" Aysia faintly explained, and then put the agreement awayMinistry of Magic? Are they not members of the Ministry of Magic? "Ivan said strangely.
"To be precise, it is from the Executive Department of the Ministry of Magic!" Aysia glanced at Ivan.
Ivan suddenly understood.
The Ministry of Magic is also divided into multiple departments. Although it is a big business as an official institution, there are too many places to spend money. Every department is waiting eagerly for the Ministry of Magic to issue funds. The competition for funds is fierce. The executive department they contacted is only one of them. It's just one department.
Therefore, when reporting funds to the above, the Executive Department will naturally report as much as possible, and what is left will be added to the department’s independent treasury for use in other places where it is needed.
However, Ivan was a little strange afterwards, how could Aysia let Mrs. Mu En lower the price.
Perhaps after seeing Ivan's mind, Aysia spoke out again.
"In exchange, they are willing to order some potions from us in the future."

chapters.title: Chapter 130: Don't worry, I will use the Forgotten Curse!
chapters.content:
The corners of Ivan’s mouth twitched. He had always thought that Mrs. Mu En's potion was so outstanding that he planned to purchase it. That's how it turned out...
Mrs. Mu En's acting skills are no longer there, even he hasn't seen it.
However, what Ivan didn’t know was that Mrs. Mu En was originally only thinking about purchasing one or two potions at random to deal with the matter, but after knowing that it was made by a potion master, she was moved to purchase a lot of thoughts. .
However, this wave of operations by the Executive Division also allowed Ivan to see the corruption and corruption of the Ministry of Magic.
No wonder the Ministry of Magic, as the official institution of the magical world, failed to serve the Death Eater legion that emerged in the later period. In the end, even the newly appointed minister was cast into an Imperius curse and became a puppet of Voldemort.
From this purchase, Ivan can see some clues...
The Ministry of Magic will be over sooner or later!
But Ivan didn't want to care about these messy things, but looked at Aysia and said.
"By the way, mom, what should the Ministry of Magic give us an order?"
"Didn't you think of a solution?" Aysia said in a puzzled way. She thought that Ivan had already had an idea when she proposed the store renovation plan.
How about thinking all day about what the Ministry of Magic's large order is doing?
Then the two were silent for a while, looking at the deposit on the table, they were dumbfounded.
Ivan had a headache. When signing the agreement, he promised to deliver everything in two weeks...
With the two of them alone, it would not be possible to finish it in ten days of exhaustion!
"Otherwise, how about we get a magic factory?" Ivan suggested with a thought.
"Magic Factory?" Aisia asked puzzled.
"It's like your magic kitchen..." The more Ivan thought about it, the more I realized it was possible, so he popularized the Muggles' technique of making bulk items for Asia.
As for the source of the news, Ivan directly said that he had heard it from some Muggle wizards at Hogwarts.
As Ivan's words got deeper and deeper, Aysia's eyes became brighter and brighter. She, who had worked out the magic kitchen, of course could understand what Ivan said.
Although the production of magic items is a delicate task, and magic is used when burning magic texts, but other cumbersome steps can be completed with the magic version of the machine.
"Where are the things you said? I'll get one for reference." Aysia asked enthusiastically.
"Generally speaking, Muggle gloves are made in factories, and you can buy them in the Muggle market." Ivan touched his chin. There were only ten rings in total. Mantra gloves need to be produced in large quantities.
But Ivan immediately realized something was wrong.
Get a machine for reference? how to do?
Seeing that Aysia was about to perform Apparition, Ivan hurriedly reminded.
"Muggles don't charge Jin Jialong!"
"Don't worry, if you really can't figure it out, I will use the Forgetting Curse!" Aysia added, and with a light wave of the magic wand, as the spell was read, the whole person disappeared.
Forgotten spell?
Ivan reluctantly held his forehead with his hand. This thing is not very expensive, and it is not a secret. You can buy it on the market with Jin Jialong for a little pound.
Can't you follow the process properly?
After Esiah left, Ivan put his gaze into the bag on the table and opened it to take a look. There was a lot of space inside. It should have been cast without a trace extension curse, and the deposit was about a thousand gold gallons.
But making a magic factory cost a lot of money, and various materials also need a lot of Jin Jialong, so it is estimated that there are not many that will be left in the end, let alone a part of the Weasley brothers.
Ivan couldn't help but smiled thinking about this, thinking that if George and Fred knew that their retractable ears and quill pens could sell so hot, they would probably be crazy.
"Shoo~" Ivan touched his right thumb with his index finger, placed it in front of his mouth and whistle.
After a while, a snow-white owl flew down from upstairs, with a quill in its beak and an envelope on its paw.
"Good job, Maca!" After Ivan took the quill and envelope from Maca's mouth and paws, he teased the little cutie with satisfaction.
He felt that he had become more and more talented as an animal trainer.
"Cuckoo~" Maca flapped his wings and flew to Ivan's shoulders, pecking Ivan's cheek with his beak to express closeness.
Unfolding the envelope, Ivan picked up the quill brush and wrote a reply. He wrote in the Ministry of Magic’s large purchase of telescopic ears and quill pens, and asked them to prepare the order within two weeks. Mail it together.
After writing the reply, Ivan took out another fifty gold gallons from the deposit. Without this money, George and Fred might not even be able to buy materials for making a large number of retractable ears and quill pens.
It's just that I was intercepted halfway, and Ivan didn't dare to give too much at once.
After fixing it, Ivan stuffed these things into the package together.
It was the package that George and Fred sent over last time, and the weight-reducing magic was solidified on it, and it just happened to be reused this time.
"I'm going to trouble you again, Maca..." Ivan tied something to Maca's feet.
The snow-white owl "cooed" twice in response, then fluttered its wings all the way to the sky, gradually turning into a white spot under Ivan's gaze.
Not long after being idle, the space in the center of the hall was distorted for a while, and Aysia's figure appeared in front of Ivan, bringing back nothing.
"Mom, where's the stuff?" Ivan asked strangely.
"There are too many equipment there, I don't know which one to take." Aysia blushed. She thought that the Muggle machines were all the same.
Ivan rolled his eyes, and he knew it would be so.
However, Aysia didn't give him a chance to complain After waving the magic wand and closing the store, he performed Apparition again and led Ivan to disappear into the magic shop.
At the same time, I did not forget to hold the deposit on the table..
......
A few hours later, the Burrow, in the bedroom of George and Fred.
A pudgy middle-aged witch was thrusting her waist angrily, pointing at a large number of joke magic goods found on the ground, and roaring angrily.
"It's no wonder that your grades in the history of magic are so bad. You used to be doing these pranks all day long. If you can't pass the owLs exam in the fifth grade, I won't have any surprises!"
George and Fred were trembling under the splashing spit stars, and they were depressed. They had known that they would be more cautious, and they were doing research when they were waiting to go back to school.
They really didn't expect to be searched out when their mother cleaned...
George and Fred looked at each other, their faces looked uglier than crying...

chapters.title: Chapter 131: So much Jin Jialong, isn't it fragrant?
chapters.content:
Mrs. Weasley scolded angrily for more than half an hour, and then pointed her magic wand at the joke magic goods underground.
"I'm going to burn all of these things now, and next time I see you are not doing your business properly and fiddle with these useless things, I will throw you all out!"
"No! Mom, you can't do this!" George said crumbled, rushing to the pile of joke goods, defending their efforts to the death.
Fred's cheeks flushed red, and he plucked up courage, and retorted dissatisfiedly.
"These are not useless things, we will sell them soon! Ivan said the people at the Ministry of Magic will definitely buy them!"
"Ministry of Magic? They will buy your things unless they are crazy!" Mrs. Weasley was angry for a while, and they didn't look at what they had made?
An ugly-looking ball, according to George and Fred, has the effect of producing foul-smelling juices when it hits someone else.
A telescopic ear for eavesdropping, a quill for automatic homework, and other messy things that I don't know what it is for.
According to Mrs. Weasley, only those little wizards who also like pranks would buy this kind of thing
"Quickly get out of me" Mrs. Weasley was angrily pulling her sleeves and preparing to pull George away, Fred begged bitterly from the side, but she was unmoved.
Fred had to look at the other people in the family for help.
Ron hid behind and watched the excitement. Ginny was willing to help persuade her, but she closed her mouth again as she watched Mrs. Weasley's angrily.
Arthur Weasley turned a deaf ear and looked at the newspaper in his hand. George and Fred were very angry with the poor grades of the previous school year.
At this moment, an owl suddenly flew in from the open window, with a package tied to its paw. After seeing George and Fred, it made a burst of joyful screams towards the two of them. Fly over
"It's Maca! Ivan must have replied!" Fred said excitedly.
Hearing Fred saying this, everyone turned their eyes away, and George, who was lying on the ground, jumped up.
Seeing the excitement of these two people, Mrs. Weasley became even more angry, and grabbed the owl who was about to fall. She wanted to know what these people were doing.
When Mrs. Weasley was about to remove the package tied to the owl's feet, she turned it over impatiently and trembled vigorously.
George couldn't do it angrily, it was their thing, but the next second he was almost blinded by a flash of golden light.
A lot of round, golden things spilled out of the package, crashing on the ground and making clanging noises, and a lot of Jin Jialong fell everywhere.
"Oh my God, the bag is all Jin Jialong!" Ron looked at Jin Jialong sprinkled on the ground, his eyes popped.
One of them grumbled to Arthur Weasley's feet.
Arthur ignored the newspaper at this time, squatted down and picked it up blankly. After looking carefully, he was sure that the gold gallons were real, not the gold coins of the Leprechaun.
Mrs. Weasley never thought that there would be so much money in the bag, and she opened her mouth for a while and didn't know how to react.
"These are all ours!" George and Fred rushed up excitedly, picked them up one by one, and even snatched the one in Arthur's hand. Together they counted fifty. Jin Jialong.
"Where did the money come from?" Mrs. Weasley frowned, feeling very puzzled, a little panicked, and a little scared.
Fifty gallons is not a small number!
"We said that the Ministry of Magic is willing to order our products. These are only deposits. You can earn 200 gold gallons in total. You can read this letter by yourself!" George shook the envelope in his hand and said confidently.
Fred also nodded. He felt that Ivan's letter was too timely, and if it was later, their efforts for so many days would be burned.
Mrs. Weasley glared at them fiercely, took the envelope and looked at it.
Arthur couldn't sit still and leaned over to check the envelope.
Ron and Ginny wanted to see too, but Mrs. Weasley took it high and prevented them from watching.
George and Fred looked at them triumphantly, and both felt that their mother would definitely not stop their research anymore. After all, that was an order from the Ministry of Magic!
After reading the envelope, Mrs. Weasley still couldn't believe it. She looked at Arthur in confusion, wanting him to confirm.
Arthur pondered for a while, then said aloud.
"It seems that there is such a thing. Recently, the Executive Department applied for a batch of funds from the Ministry due to personnel injuries. There are about 5,000 Jin Jialong. I heard that they purchased a lot of magic items from a magic shop. "
"That's the magic shop of Ivan's house, we just put things on his behalf for sale!" George said.
Fred was shocked by the five thousand Jin Jialong that Arthur said.
They thought they and George had already made a lot of money, but they didn't expect it to be just a fraction of the money compared to Ivan.
Envy belongs to envy. Fred thought about it and thought it was normal. After all, Ivan’s house was the official seller of magic items, which was different from their amateurs who engaged in research in private.

chapters.title: Chapter 135: Magic wand transformation
chapters.content:

It's okay to ask some simple tips or basic spells, and the Horcrux diary will answer honestly.
But when it comes to knowledge of some advanced spells, it's different. From time to time, Tom will give wrong information on certain key points, which makes people hard to guard against.
Fortunately, with the supporting evidence of the system prompt, Ivan was able to find out in time every time.
What Ivan is rather depressed is that he still can't talk about this matter.
Because Tom Riddle said at the very beginning that he was just a diary written by a little wizard, it is normal for some errors and omissions to understand some advanced knowledge.

In fact, Ivan didn't know that Tom Riddle, who was in the Horcrux, was even more depressed. He had never seen a little wizard who learned so quickly.
The knowledge that a normal person can learn in a few months can often be mastered in Ivan within a few days. If he does not make some restrictions on the knowledge of some advanced spells, the knowledge reserves in his mind will not be able to persist. how long.

[Tom, thank you, you are also one of the most wise wizards I have ever seen...]

A useful learning accelerator is not easy to find. If you want to quickly improve your strength, it is worth taking some risks.
The next day, Ivan sorted out the content of the discussion with Tom Riddle last night, and discussed the possibility of implementation with Aysia.
Aysia was dizzy and bombarded with a lot of information for a while, and after listening to Ivan's plan, her face became very weird.
If she remembered it correctly, it seemed that Ivan had only raised the issue of conflicting magic text formulas with her yesterday, and already had a plan in just one day?
"Build a closed loop of magic text, and finally form a closed loop of magic?" After finally getting back to her senses, Aysia also began to seriously think about the feasibility of this plan.
"Yes, since activating multiple magic text formulas at the same time doesn't work, just separate them." Ivan explained.
According to Ivan's understanding, constructing a circular magic circuit is equivalent to turning active skills into passive skills.
It is a pity that Ivan has only created a loop of hidden magic texts for the time being. This magic text is very stable and hardly consumes much magic power, so it is less difficult to construct.
This is why he and Tom studied it in just one day.
The more I thought about it, the more I realized it was possible, and she couldn't wait to start trying.
The experiment used a hawthorn tree. Aysia inscribed the circuit of the secret magic text on it, and then tried to burn another simple magic text formula on it. After activation with magic power, a faint black air came from the hawthorn wood. When it came out, the magic fluctuations were negligibly low.
"Feasible!" Aysia was excited as if she had discovered a new treasure. But in fact, it is almost the same. For Aysia, any discovery related to Mowen is a big gain.
After personally testing the feasibility, Aysia took out the magic wand soaked in the special liquid, handed it to Ivan together with the carving knife, and solemnly reminded.
"You only have one hour to burn, and you only have one chance. If you fail, you may have to change your magic wand."
Ivan nodded, knowing that now is the most critical time, and then he did not hesitate to spend academic points to improve his abilities, and devoted himself to the transformation of the magic wand.
Compared with normal wooden materials, the texture of the wand that has undergone special treatment has become extremely soft, and the wand itself is relatively slender, which causes a lot of trouble for the burning of the magic text.
It took a full fifteen minutes before Ivan finally completed the transformation of the magic wand, and then checked his work with satisfaction.
[Magic item: magic wand (yew wood, unicorn hair, eleven inches and three-quarters long)
Magic: strong
Mowen circuit: covert casting (passively reduce the fluctuation of magic power when casting a spell)
Magic text sequence: strengthen the magic text formula (after activation, greatly increase the power of the next spell. Note: two consecutive use within an hour will cause unexpected consequences!)
Fit: 100%
Explanation: This is a magic wand that has been specially modified. 】
The attributes of the magic wand after the transformation are still in line with Ivan's expectations. The only thing that disappoints him is the long cooling time after the enhanced magic text is stimulated.
After working with Tom to develop this magic text arrangement formula that can increase the power of the spell, Ivan was happy for a long time, but he did not expect such a big limit.
After waiting for forty minutes and noticing that the texture of the wand returned to normal, Ivan tried to activate the enhanced magic text, waving the wand and pointing to the cabinet to the side ready to try the effect.

In a small work area, sawdust was all over the sky for a while...
Ivan was very satisfied, and the power of the spell was at least doubled!
To change to normal, the Smashing Curse he released could not achieve such an effect.
Ivan has also figured out the one-hour release interval limit.
Every time this magic text formula is activated, it will put a great burden on the magic wand itself. Continuous use may exceed the carrying capacity of the magic wand. At that time, it may explode directly...
While Ivan was thinking about it, he suddenly felt something wrong. The cabinet just now seemed to contain alchemy materials.
Sure enough, afterwards, Ivan heard the angry roar of Aysia...

After a while, a thin young wizard walked out. He looked about seventeen or eighteen years old. At best, he was only a little older than George and Fred. He was wearing an old shaman robes that was not very decent. All of them are a little whitish.
He seemed to laugh at himself and said sarcastically.
"There are not many wizards in this ruined place, so let's talk about what you are here for first, right?"
Seeing his appearance, Ivan faintly remembered the other small werewolf he saw in front of the second-floor window, but this was obviously not the time to think about it. Ivan quickly sorted out his thoughts and pointed to Dougt said.
"This is the former Deputy Dean of St. Mungo's Hospital for Magical Injury and Injury, Dougter. He has been studying the emotional out-of-control of the werewolf after transforming into Knockdown Alley for so many years.
Now the research has made some breakthroughs, so I want to ask a few werewolf wizards. "
Considering that he is a little wizard who will only be in the second grade next semester, there is really no convincing, so Ivan put the title of research on the head of the deputy dean Dougt.
It was a misunderstanding, and he didn't directly mention the blood sampling.
Listening to Ivan's words, Dougter had a strange expression. He didn't know when he was studying the werewolves in Knockdown Alley.
But Dougt didn't refute anything, but followed Ivan's words and said to the little wizard.
"Yes, do you know the werewolves here?"
"Dougt? You were the one who wounded Fren last time?" The young wizard did not answer Dougt's question, but frowned.
"Fren?" Douglas paused and continued.
"Some time ago, I did treat a werewolf. If you were referring to him, of course it was correct."
"If you know him, then you should know how good my medical skills are." When he said this, Dougt was a little triumphant, and he felt that it would be easier to handle things with layers of relationships.
After all, he was also the savior of the werewolf.
But Ivan was not so optimistic, he became vigilant, because he found that the other party's expression became more and more angry.
Huh~
A dazzling red light flew out of the young wizard's wand and shot into the sky.
Seeing the other party's movements, Ivan, no matter how stupid he was, knew that the other party didn't plan to have a good talk. He suddenly turned his head and looked at Dougert angrily, asking what was going on? I knew he would come alone.
The latter had an innocent expression. He usually didn't bother to pay attention to the werewolf. The only contact he had was to heal the other party's injuries.
Unless the werewolf was put to death by him last time...Dougt stroked his chin, but this shouldn't be...
According to his judgment, the werewolf who was troubled by the black qi would heal for a few days at most.
The attitude of the two being uninhabited made the young wizard feel insulted, and a splitting curse was thrown out after raising his hand, and the target was directed at Dougt.
"Torn apart!"
Ivan didn't mean to shoot at all,
Dougte didn't care either. I don't know when the iron armor curse had been blessed on his body, and the light of the curse returned to its original path.
Not only that, but Doug did not have the habit of being passively beaten. Tap his wand lightly and cast one spell after another.
Although the werewolf wizard doesn't look great, his skill is unexpectedly good The most important thing is that he doesn't care about the image at all, and he rolls on the ground in a awkward manner and evades several spells.
But that's it.
Seeing Dougte failed to deal with the opponent in the first time, Ivan frowned, worried that the rising red light would attract more enemies, so he waved his magic wand...
The winding vines on one side of the wall were instantly activated, like a long whip drawn towards the opponent. The werewolf wizard who had been embarrassed under the attack of Dougert's curse, was unable to dodge and was drawn in his right arm.
In the next second, the vine rolled up with the arm, and the other vine underneath was a violent pull on the right leg of the werewolf wizard, forcing the opponent to lose his balance and fall to the ground...
Dougt took the opportunity to throw out a black light, and the werewolf wizard's struggling strength slowly diminished.
"Let’s catch him and leave first. I'm afraid it will be a little troublesome to stay here. Anyway, you only need a few tubes of blood, don’t you?" Dougter said, looking at the young werewolf wizard in the underground, very curious. Why did the other party hear his own name and act...
Thinking of this, Dougt was a little annoyed. When did his reputation get so bad?

chapters.title: Chapter 137: How many times can you defend against such a spell?
chapters.content:
Ivan nodded. Although this approach is a bit violent and may even cause some misunderstandings, it can only be so for the time being.
However, it was beyond the expectations of the two.
Falling to the ground, the young wizard who had lost the ability to resist, listened to their conversation, and suddenly his eyes became red, and his body quickly grew brown-gray hair. Accompanied by a roar, the vines that bound his body were covered. It was torn apart in an instant.
Ivan swiftly backed away, his face was shocked, and it was not the night of the full moon.
Although it is rumored that a werewolf wizard loses his mind and transforms into a wolf when caught in extreme anger, that is just a legend!
Even though he was surprised, Ivan's reaction was still swift. Under the wave of his magic wand, more vines entangled, restricting the opponent's ability to move while the transformation was not completed.
Dougret also retreated to the other side at this time, and released a coma spell in a tacit understanding.
"Faint!"
The cyan light hit the werewolf easily, and the werewolf's figure shook suddenly, but he forcibly resisted it.
Dougter was surprised. He was the first time he had dealt with a werewolf. He didn't expect this monster to be so resistant to the Stunning Curse!
Ivan's expression was not very good, and he knew in his heart that they had lost the best opportunity to shoot.
Not far in front of him, the young wizard who was originally small and thin, only a few meters tall, has now turned into a monster nearly two meters high, with narrow arms and covered with hair.
"Hoo~Goo~" The werewolf was breathing heavily with saliva in his big, fangs mouth, making some weird noises in his stomach.
Ivan was secretly frightened. When he was watching from the window on the second floor, he didn't think there was anything. Now he is facing the horror of the werewolf.
With a tall body, excellent fighting instincts, extraordinary recovery and resistance to magic, coupled with terrifying infection ability, it is no wonder that werewolves can leave a variety of terrifying legends in the wizarding world, and even cause small-scale panic.
"It seems that we may have to use some rough methods." Dougt said jokingly.
It’s just a werewolf, and Dougte didn’t take it seriously. He kept his hands just now because he didn’t want to hurt the opponent’s life. Otherwise, while the opponent was restrained, he would cast an Avadasuo life spell. The werewolf died long ago.
But soon, Dougt changed his face, because a hurried shout came from a distance, and he suddenly remembered the red light that the werewolf had fired before the battle.
Ivan also noticed this. As far as his eyes could be, a few wizards were rushing over, but they looked more like refugees.
Ivan had no energy to pay attention to other places at this time, and the irritable werewolf rushed towards him the moment he broke free.
"There are many obstacles!" Ivan raised his hand to release the obstacle curse, but was torn apart by the werewolf's claws in the next second.
In the distance, a series of colorful spells also struck towards this side one after another.
Doug had constructed a large number of magical barriers in front of him, which could withstand the curse that was shot at him.
Ivan's side was even more thrilling, most of the attacks were directed at him, and dozens of curses and werewolves were already in front of him in an instant.
Knowing that he was treated as a soft persimmon, Ivan frowned. With a thought, the magic ring on his left wrist suddenly lit up.
The next moment, a huge wave of magical power gushed out of Ivan's body, and various spells were annihilated under the impact of magical power. The werewolf who was speeding up was hit by a car and rolled and fell into the pile of rocks.
Dougt, who was not too far away, was also backed by a few aftermaths before he stabilized his figure.
The magic ring on Ivan's wrist has been completely silent, and can't be used again until the magic is refilled.
But the werewolf wizards who came to support did not understand the weakness of the magic circle. Seeing this scene, they were involuntarily stunned for a while, looking at Ivan standing in the center with some surprise and uncertainty.
"We didn't have any malicious intentions, we just came to talk about it. It was the attack that the werewolf launched first!" While the opponent stopped, Ivan gave Dougt a wink and told him not to act rashly, and then said.
Several werewolf wizards glanced at each other, and an old witch stood up, watching Dougt speak with stern expression.
"Impossible, Walker will not attack others at will, besides, what are you doing here? If you don't say it clearly, don't even want to leave here."
Doug raised his eyebrows, and did not reply, but left the right to speak to Ivan, an eleven or twelve-year-old wizard. He was just a bodyguard during this trip.
Dougte didn't care about the threats of the wizards in front of him. Before facing the five well-trained law enforcement agents, they were easily handled by them, not to mention the poor wizards of these wild roads.
Ivan does not have the confidence of Dougt. Only he himself knows that the Unicorn Shadow’s battery life is insufficient. If all the werewolf wizards in front of him can transform into one by one, relying on the werewolf’s rapid recovery ability, they The possibility of fleeing in embarrassment is higher.
For this reason, Ivan repeated what he had said to the young wizard named Walker.
It's a pity that the werewolf wizards present were dubious,
"You throw away the magic wand in your hand, we will trust you!" the old witch warned.
Ivan was angry for a while. As a wizard, what is the difference between throwing away his wand and surrendering?
Facing a group of strange wizards who hadn't been in contact for long, he would only do what the other party said unless he was crazy.
Seeing the werewolf who had been knocked into the air stood up again, the rest of the wizards also faintly surrounded themselves and others.
Knowing that the battle just now was not enough to deter them, Ivan sighed, activated the enhanced magic text on the wand, and said helplessly.
"If we are really malicious we won't have to be so troublesome at all!"
Before the werewolf wizards understood the meaning of the words, Ivan waved his magic wand, facing the street wall not far away, and released the only high-level offensive spell he possessed.
"Thunderbolt exploded!"
Orange flames gushed out from the top of the wand, expanded more and more in the air, and finally hit the street wall straight.
The next moment, the orange-red flame the size of a human head expanded into a huge fireball, accompanied by a violent explosion and roar.
Just now he was standing upright on the high street wall, and in an instant it was blown into a pile of rubble...Countless rubble and red bricks fell from the air like rain.
Ivan stood quietly on the spot without seeing any movement, but a magical barrier floated on his body automatically to block the falling debris.
Looking around, looking at the werewolf wizards who were sluggish, Ivan asked.
"As I said just now, how many times can you defend against such a spell?"

chapters.title: Chapter 138: This is too cruel...
chapters.content:
The Thunderbolt explosion is an incredibly powerful and aggressive spell. According to records, Peter Pettigrew even used it to blow up an entire street, causing the deaths of 13 Muggles.
So after seeing Esiah used it, Ivan, who lacked aggressive spells, naturally included this spell in the alternative plan.
Until this time, I was worried that he would encounter danger in the process of searching for the werewolves, so Ivan urgently spent some grade points to master it.
As for the use of the enhanced magic formula to bless the magic of the thunderbolt explosion, Ivan is the first time. Fortunately, the effect is outstanding. There is no accident. The power is beyond his imagination...
Although this is far inferior to the horror that Peter Pettigrew sacrifices a finger and blows up a street, it is also beyond the scope of the general curse!
The only disadvantage is that the mana consumption is too serious, and Ivan can clearly perceive that the magic power in his body has been reduced by nearly half...
But the desired effect has been achieved, and under Ivan's gaze, the werewolf wizards who were still trying to do something have silenced their voices.
The stone wall that collapsed suddenly reminded them of the consequences of rushing to do it!
They finally understood what Ivan said just now. If the other party is malicious, there is no need to deceive, and they can choose to destroy them!
The old witch was speechless at this time. The rubble falling from the sky hit her, and the witch did not respond. She stared in astonishment at the little girl who stood in the center, who was at most eleven or twelve years old. wizard.
The powerful power of the curse and the immature and short figure of Ivan caused a strong contrast, which made her unable to react for a long time.
At a certain moment, the witch even wondered if this was a powerful wizard, and used the compound decoction to disguise it as it is now...
Dougt is the same. He looked at the stone wall that was turned into ruins, and then thought about the thunderbolt explosion he had released at the beginning. It seemed that it had blown up a small pile of gravel, right? There is not even half of this power, and for a while, Dougt was messed up in the wind.
Noting the fearful expressions of everyone, Ivan breathed a sigh of relief in his heart. It is worthwhile that he continuously used the magic ring and strengthened magic text to establish deterrence!
"Woo~"
At that moment, the mutation reborn, Walker, who had long been transformed into a werewolf, suddenly stood up to the sky and howled, his sharp claws pulled the dirt on the ground,
Both sides suddenly became nervous. The werewolf was irrational when he was transformed. He could only act on his bloodthirsty instinct. No one knew what Walker would do now.
Ivan secretly screamed that the enhanced magic text can only be used once within an hour, and the magic power stored in the magic circle has also been exhausted. Once it is found out, it may be fought again.
The werewolf wizards were even more frightened, for fear that Walker would attack the small wizard who looked rather small but had a terrifying spell.
Their bodies are not as hard as a street wall, and the scope of the explosion makes it difficult for them to dodge. Such a curse will destroy them here as long as they are released a few times.
Only Dougert was as steady as a mountain, and his face was calm. After a few days, Ivan refreshed his cognition again and again. Suddenly, Dougert felt that he might be old, so he just drank soy sauce on the side. Great.
The thick white mist gradually poured out from the magic wand, and Ivan hesitated whether to release the blood magic to stabilize the current situation.
Only by crushing down Walker who turned into a werewolf, can he continue to shake the group of werewolf wizards.
Just as Ivan's eyes flickered and he was about to take a shot, the werewolf Walker suddenly twisted his body and fled to the distance the next second after he made a hint of attack.
Although the werewolf's state relies entirely on bloodthirsty instincts, but because of this, he is very sensitive to danger. After witnessing the collapse of the street wall under the power of the curse, and smelling the breath of danger, he did not hesitate. Give up the offensive plan.
Ivan's tight expression relaxed a little, but his eyes widened in the next second.
The werewolf who rushed to the corner of the street was about to rush out. At the exit of the street, I don't know when there was already a middle-aged wizard in his thirties and wearing shabby robes.
Facing the rushing werewolf, the wizard stretched out his sturdy arms, his palm pressed the werewolf’s neck accurately, and slammed it against the wall.
Then the figure that suddenly appeared hammered the werewolf's head with his fists.
Walker the Werewolf let out a scream, sharp claws scratched on the opponent's body, scratching out bloodstains, but the middle-aged wizard was unmoved, and he smashed the out-of-control Werewolf Walker alive.
Ivan twitched the corners of his mouth, and at a glance, he could see that the middle-aged wizard named Fran in front of him was the one who asked Doug to heal the wound last time...
But this is too cruel...
Ivan couldn't believe his eyes, a wizard turned over a runaway werewolf with his fist!
However, the group of werewolf wizards are accustomed to this, and the elderly witch headed by them even found the backbone, and said.
"Fren, you came just right, or Walker will run out of control,"
"What the **** is going on here? What happened to the explosion just now?" Fren's arms were covered with blood, and there were scratches on them.
But he didn't care, because the wound had stopped bleeding in a short time, and even if it was left alone, it would heal automatically after a week or so.
Fren's slightly convex eyes looked around, especially staying for a while on the blasted rubble.
If he remembers correctly, there should be a stone wall before...
The color of surprise flashed in his eyes, and then Fren turned his attention to Ivan and Dougt, and quickly recognized their identities.
At this time, the rest of the werewolf wizards also gathered to Fren's side, reporting the situation to him.
Only then did Ivan see clearly Excluding Fren in front of him and Walker who fell on the ground and fainted, there are four wizards who are suspected to be werewolves, but all of them are not young and in a very state. Great.
After thinking about it, Ivan said to Fren.
"Your name is Fren, right? We came here for something to seek some help. There is no malice. The little wizard named Walker attacked us first for some reason. We just passively counterattack."
Forren didn't reply. After listening to the report from the werewolf wizards, he nodded and looked at Ivan with a trace of doubt.
"The stone wall over there was destroyed by you?"
"Of course..." Ivan nodded.
"Amazing..." Fren said surprised words in a plain tone, making Ivan frown, but he couldn't hear the irony in it. Before Ivan could think about it, Fren continued.
"Thank you for what happened last time, Bai Xian and wormwood are very useful... Don't you have something to talk about? Come inside."

chapters.title: Chapter 139: 3 How about a bottle of blood?
chapters.content:
After speaking, Fren carried Walker, who had changed back to his original shape, and walked past Ivan and Dougt towards the end of the street.
Ivan exchanged opinions with Dougt with his eyes, and after secretly becoming vigilant, he immediately followed Fren...
At the end of the dilapidated street is a large house that looks pretty good on the outside. After entering, Ivan discovered that it was empty inside, and there were basically not many good things.
Thinking that these werewolves had been driven over by other places, Ivan knew why they lived here.
What makes Ivan a little relieved is that the cleaned up inside is fairly tidy, not as messy as he had imagined before.
As it is now approaching the evening, food is being cooked in a large pot on the corner, and white steam is blowing from it...
"You go to finish the meal first, I'll just have a chat with them." Fran put Walker aside, who had passed out, and then said to the rest of the werewolf wizards.
After leaving the rest of the people, Fran walked to a fairly clean place on the side and signaled them to sit down and talk.
Without the encirclement of those werewolf wizards, Ivan slightly relaxed his tight nerves.
"Do you usually treat guests like this?" Ivan said jokingly after finding a place to sit down.
Compared to Fren, who was flat from the beginning to the end, Ivan could clearly feel that the other werewolf wizards had been guarding the two of them all the time. After entering the house, they were even more faintly encircled. Make Ivan think that the other party is about to do it.
"This is probably because you put too much pressure on them." Fren said lightly.
Ivan raised his eyebrows inconspicuously. If these werewolf wizards hadn't come up to fight, he wouldn't have used some magic props to pretend.
"Fren..." While the two were chatting, the old werewolf witch came over with a big bowl and handed it to him.
Fren reached out his hand to take the bowl, turned to Ivan and the others, and said.
"Bread porridge, do you want some?"
Ivan glanced at the big bowl in Fren’s hand. There were a few pieces of bread floating in the light soup, and there was no meat foam, but there were some vegetable leaves that were unknown. It was not so much porridge as it was added Something in the water.
"You just eat these?" Douglas raised his brows, wondering.
"No, it's just a little harder in the past two months." Fren didn't care about the two people's eyes at all, picked up the bread soup, and drank mouthfuls.
"Ahem..." At this moment, Walker, who was lying on the side, suddenly opened his eyes and struggled to sit up, leaving a little bruise on his face.
After a little cough, Walker looked at Dougt and said angrily.
"If you didn't take away our hard-earned savings, why would we eat this kind of food every day?"
Savings? Ivan remembered that when Fren came to heal the injury, Dougte had a blackmail and extortion to Fren, and finally detained more than fifty Jin Jialong.
It turned out to be because of this. Ivan turned his head to look at Dougt with a weird look. At last he knew why Walker had an expression of resentment.
