Dougt has no guilt, he looked at Walker and sneered. "Grab? You'd better figure out that it is the cost of treatment. If it is too expensive, you can also choose to die!"
"You!" Walker's face flushed with anger, and his fists were squeezed tightly.
"Walker!" Fren interrupted in a deep voice, and then looked at the werewolf youth who was still a little unwilling and rebuked. "If you hadn't sneaked out at the beginning, and finally broke into someone else's house out of control, I wouldn't have been injured to save you. I thought the last experience had taught you enough..."
After Fren's reprimand, Walker lost his anger, drooping a face that was guilty and shameless, and wanted to explain, but in the end he said nothing.
Seeing his appearance, Fren didn't say anything, and turned to look at the two of them. "Sorry, this kid is a bit extreme, I apologize for him, and please don't care."
Ivan waved his hand and said that he would not remember it in his heart, and Dougt was not interested in doing more with a small werewolf kid.
"Then talk about business? What are you doing here?" Fren asked puzzled.
"I'm currently developing a special potion that can solve the problem of losing your mind after you turn into a werewolf." Ivan thought for a while and didn't use Dougert as a cover, because these werewolf wizards treated Doug. Te's senses are very poor, so he said straightforwardly.
Ivan thought that after he finished speaking, these werewolf wizards would surely forget about it happily, but there was a moment of silence on the court.
The other werewolf wizards not far apart have actually been paying attention to the situation here.
When they heard Ivan, a small wizard who was not too old, said that they wanted to solve the werewolf problem, they wanted to refute him for his whimsical thinking.
But the shock that Ivan brought to them before is still in their hearts, so they don't know why they actually feel that the other party may really be able to do it.
This strange contrast makes them very uncomfortable...
"So you plan to let us cooperate with your research experiment? When your experiment material?" Furen frowned.
Fren knows that it is not easy to develop a potion formula. In addition to time-consuming and laborious work, more importantly, someone has to drink the semi-finished potions that have been researched to confirm the effect. .
Drinking an unknown potion is extremely risky, anything can happen...
"No, I have almost studied the formula, only a little blood is the key material, you werewolf's blood!" Ivan shook his head and said seriously.
This is the reason why he came here. Other materials of the wolf poison potion can be bought in the potion shop in Diagon Alley, except for werewolf blood.
In Ivan’s opinion, the only way to make the wolf poison potion first made Dougte see the results and completely trusted himself, and then he can be used as a guarantee to win the trust of the Ministry of Magic and the Merlin Knights.
Otherwise, he is a little wizard who is still attending Hogwarts, even if he holds the formula, the people from the Ministry of Magic and the Merlin Knights will not pay attention to him at all.
"Do you want our blood?" Fren squinted his eyes and looked at Ivan carefully, and Walker refused without hesitation.
"It's impossible! Who knows if what you are saying is true? I heard that many dark wizards can use a person's blood to complete curse magic..."
Ivan was not disappointed either. He stood up, looked around, paused for a while on the food and worn-out clothes of these werewolf wizards, and deliberately increased the volume so that other werewolf wizards too Can hear it.
"I didn't mean to let you help for free, so let's...3 How about a bottle of blood?"

chapters.title: Chapter 140: We werewolves are poor and poor, but...there is still blood!
chapters.content:
Three gallons and a bottle of blood?
Ivan's words resounded in the hall, and the werewolf wizards whose eyes were full of suspicion were moved.
Although there are not many three Kalong, it is still very impressive for them.
You must know that there are very few wizards in Knock Down Alley who are willing to let them and werewolves work. Even if they are recruited, the salary is pitiful, only a few gallons a month.
Now as long as a little blood is released, they can earn more than half a month's salary. They are naturally very excited, and even Fren begins to hesitate.
Seeing that Ivan, the little wizard who had just defeated him, was about to use a few gold gallons to buy their blood, Walker was very angry, feeling that the dignity of their werewolf wizard was offended.
"Enough! No one here will sell you blood!" Walker stood up and pointed at Ivan with his wand.
Ivan didn't pay attention to his meaning at all, but spoke loudly.
"Four gallons and a bottle!"
Following Ivan’s words, the werewolf wizards in the hall became more emotional, but no one chose to speak out.
Walker heaved a sigh of relief when he noticed this, and turned to look at Ivan triumphantly, wanting to tell the little wizard that although they are poor, they are dignified!
However, Walker didn’t know, no one spoke, just hoping that Ivan would continue to increase the price...
For them, their dignity and bloodliness have been consumed in so many years of exclusion and discrimination. At most, there are still some insurmountable bottom lines...
Ivan also knew this, so instead of continuing to increase the price, he added a restriction.
"I only need five bottles of blood!"
The next moment, the werewolf wizards who had been silent suddenly couldn't sit still, put down the bread and porridge in their hands, and leaned over here.
"Five bottles of blood, 20 gallons in total, I can give it to you!"
"With my blood, they are too old, mine is more energetic!"
"It's only five bottles, which is too little. Are you sure it's enough for research? Don't you need more? We can also draw out one hundred or eighty bottles..."
......
Walker stared blankly at the werewolf wizards who lifted up their sleeves and were ready for bloodletting, as if something was broken in their hearts...
suddenly turned his head to look at Ivan. Walker thought the other person would look at him mockingly, and even made a few sarcasm.
However, Ivan didn't even look at him at all, but instead persuaded the eager werewolf wizards.
"Don't worry, everyone has a share for everyone!"
Walker, who felt that he was being ignored, turned red and white, and finally ran into the yard with anger...
Ivan ignored him at all. This bear kid just lacks social beatings, and he will behave if he is hungry for a few days...
Waving the magic wand, the cups on the table began to be distorted and turned into a few large beakers... Ivan was very accurate, and each beaker could hold 600 ml of werewolves. blood.
This amount of bloodletting does not affect their daily work, and more of it may cause some discomfort.
After all, Ivan is not a devil, he still cares about these blood banks.. Bah, I am very considerate of these werewolf wizards, if it is not enough, I will come back later.
According to Ivan's estimation, the blood is enough to make more than 30 bottles of wolf poison potion, whether it is distributed as a sample or sold in the early stage.
Such a big bottle? The werewolf wizards looked at the large beaker on the table, and suddenly no one said anything like one-person all-inclusive. Except for Walker, there were exactly five werewolf wizards present, one by one honestly letting out their blood.
At the beginning, Ivan also planned to deform a few needles to help draw blood. Who knew that these werewolf wizards were more irritable than the other, and directly cut their wrists and let out blood!
Fren saw this situation, sighed, rolled his sleeves and joined the bloodletting ranks, four gallons are quite a lot...
Scarlet blood ran down from the wrist and poured into the beaker.
Ivan once again saw the superior recovery ability of the werewolf wizards, especially Fren. After cutting his wrist, the blood had stopped before the beaker was filled with blood. Fren had to frown and cut again.
Ivan suddenly felt that he had underestimated the blood recovery speed of the werewolves. He had known that he should get a bigger bottle.
Before long, the five beakers were filled with blood. A group of werewolf wizards looked at Ivan eagerly, waiting for him to pay the agreed Jin Jialong, and even asked if they wanted more wolf blood. !
Ivan did not let them down, took out twenty Jin Jialong from the wizard robe, put it on the table, and reminded by the way.
"After the blood draw, you'd better eat more nutritious things during this period. The bread and porridge are not filling your stomach and it is not conducive to recovery. If you have the conditions, it is better to buy some cheap tonics...or to Buy some red dates at the Muggle market and eat them..."
After taking over Jin Jialong, the werewolf wizards who were originally eager to sell blood were a little moved when they heard Ivan's words of sincere concern.
Because of their special identities, almost no normal wizards are willing to approach them, let alone care about them, usually they can only hug each other to keep warm.
After the mood turned positive, Ivan's affinity talent gradually began to play a role. Until he left, the relationship between the two parties had eased a lot.
at least not as full of vigilance and alert as it was at the beginning...
Ivan is very satisfied with this Once the wolf's poison potion needs to be produced in large quantities, these werewolf wizards are excellent blood banks. Naturally, this relationship should not be too stiff.
Until the evening, Ivan finally left with five bottles of werewolf blood.
On the road, Ivan, who was passing by the abandoned street, stopped suddenly, and Dougt held his wand, his eyes full of playfulness.
As far as his eyes can reach, at the end of the street, a thin figure is standing there. It is Walker who ran out because of anger.
"What's the matter? Or are you still going to compete with me?" Ivan asked puzzledly.
"If the two of you hadn't worked on me together, I wouldn't have lost!" Walker said angrily. His memory still lingered at the moment he turned into a wolf, so he didn't know that Ivan had blown it up with a spell. The thing about the stone wall.
Ivan raised his eyebrows inconspicuously, but at this moment, he was surprised to find that Walker's condition was a little wrong, his face was pale and scary, and his lips were not even bloody.
Could it be that I came to touch porcelain?
All sorts of thoughts flashed in Ivan's mind. When he was puzzled, he saw Walker suddenly threw two bottle-like objects over. Ivan subconsciously took it and found that the bottle was filled with blood. He was surprised. Looking at each other...
(PS: ask for subscription.. ask for monthly pass...)

chapters.title: Chapter 141: Your ambition is already obvious, no need to hide it!
chapters.content:
Two bottles of blood.. Eight Jin Jialong... right? "Noting Ivan's gaze, Walker embarrassedly popped out the words one by one, and clear blood stains could be seen on the left hand of the bottle...
Ivan wanted to say that the previous five bottles of wolf blood were enough.
But looking at Walker's miserable appearance, Ivan was worried that if he said that, the other party would be **** off directly...
While Ivan hesitated, Walker was anxious. "These two cans of blood are definitely more than the beaker you used before! If you feel that it is not enough, I can still make up some more!"
Ivan shook his head. Of course he could see that the two jars thrown by the other party were bigger than the beakers he had used before.
The werewolf blood inside must be more than one thousand two hundred milliliters. Thinking of this, Ivan took out eight Jin Jialong from the wizard's robe and threw it over.
Walker took them one by one sensitively, and his pale face looked better.
"You can still stand, great!" Ivan looked at the young werewolf wizard in admiration. Normal people would have fainted if they lost so much blood at once.
"Of course, I'm a werewolf. If you need it, you can come back tomorrow." Walker felt weak, but insisted.
"No, I don't need werewolf blood anymore in the short term." Ivan hurriedly refused, for fear that the child would draw himself to death.
Walker was a little disappointed, but soon thought of other methods, and after hesitating for a while, he spoke.
"Aren't you going to study a potion to restore sanity in the werewolf state?"
Ivan nodded, not quite sure what he meant.
"I can transform into a werewolf on a non-full moon night... so I can help you experiment with potions..." Walker hesitated for a moment, his words were a bit twisted, but he emphasized.
"Of course, it's not free!"
"Drink one potion ten... five.. No, as long as three gallons is fine!" Walker wanted to say that ten gallons would drink a potion once, but he was worried about being rejected, so he reduced it again, and finally watched nervously. Ivan.
"Aren't you not believing in the potion I made, and worrying about it?" Ivan said amused.
"Yes, don't believe it!" Walker nodded in Ivan's surprised eyes, and then continued.
"I drink, better than they drink! I can become a werewolf to recover at any time, as long as I am not dead on the spot, I can quickly recover."
Walker knew the consequences of drinking the semi-finished potion in his heart, and maybe there was a risk of death.
But after seeing the process of werewolf wizards selling blood for gold and gallons, Walker also knew that as long as Ivan could afford the price, some people were willing to risk death as a test subject.
With the look of Walker looking at death, Ivan shook his head helplessly. He didn't need anyone to experiment with potions. After all, he had a finished wolf poison potion formula.
However, thinking that he still needs a successful example to gain trust, Ivan nodded and agreed.
"Then we're settled!" Seeing Ivan nodded in agreement, Walker got up and jumped, leaning over the raised stone bricks on the street wall, turning over, and disappearing in front of Ivan.
Ivan sighed in his heart for the werewolf's excellent physical fitness, and said to Dougt.
"Dean Dougt, in the past two months...no, have the werewolves doing anything bad since they came here?"
"I don't know, but I haven't heard any rumors. It should be considered safe and self-defeating." Dougt thought for a while before repliing.
"Let's go back." Ivan nodded and didn't ask more.
The latter had no opinion, but looked at Ivan in surprise.
Dougte witnessed Ivan's actions today and saw how he persuaded the guarded and hostile werewolf wizards to donate blood obediently.
First of all, in the first battle, it strongly demonstrated its crushing strength, established its power, and grasped the next initiative.
Then take advantage of the weakness of the werewolf wizards who are short of money, and gradually use Jin Jialong to dissolve their inner defenses,
After the blood was drawn, they used affectionate and caring words to resolve their dissatisfaction,
The next wolf poison potion was even more tightly gripped by the werewolves...
So Dougt can’t understand what the kid wants to do.
It's impossible...
Dougt took a deep breath, and found that he saw that person's shadow in Ivan's body...
Although Ivan's methods are still a little immature in Dougt's opinion, considering that Ivan is only eleven or twelve years old, by comparison, he is even smarter, more cunning, and more ambitious than someone of the same age!
After all, it is absolutely impossible for that person at this age to use his strength to deter a group of werewolves...
"Unexpectedly, you have such ambitions..." Dougter couldn't help but exclaimed. He felt that Ivan must have known about that, but he didn't expect the child to start preparing now.
He should have known that things couldn't be kept hidden forever...
Ivan, who was thinking about how many Jin Jialong the wolf poison potion should sell, turned his head strangely and looked at Dougte with a confused look. He didn't quite understand what the other party was saying...
[Ding, task generation...]
At this moment, in Ivan's mind, the system prompt sounded suddenly.
Ivan inexplicably opened the taskbar and checked it.
[Task: Become the King of Knock Down Alley
Objective: To conquer the werewolf wizard in Knockdown Alley (Part 1)
Mission duration: two years
Quest Reward: Wolf Poison Potion Formula (Strong Effect)
Mission description: You are disappointed by the corruption of the Ministry of Magic, and saddened by the corruption of the magic world,
However, before achieving a more ambitious goal, you decide to set a small goal for yourself, for example-first unify Knock Alley!
Remarks: Your ambition is already obvious, no need to hide it! 】
Ivan looked at the extra tasks in the system bar, and stopped in a daze.
what? I still have such ambitions? Why don't I know?
Ivan looked at Dougte behind his eyes with a weird expression, opened his mouth, and wanted to ask what he had made up his mind?
As a result, he was a first-year little wizard who would swell to the point where Unity Knockdown Alley was a small goal...
However, before Ivan could speak, Dougte took the lead and spoke earnestly and comfortedly.
"Having ambitious goals is not necessarily a bad thing, but you must be careful about doing things step by step. You are only twelve years old now, too young, and insufficient deterrence. Those werewolves will not be willing to follow you."
"You think too much by yourself, Dean Dougert." Ivan was speechless, and almost couldn't help but throw a thunderbolt directly on his face, sending him to heaven!
Fortunately, the mission issued by the system does not have a failure penalty, otherwise, Ivan feels that he will be killed by this bastard...

chapters.title: Chapter 142: This Jin Jialong, the value of the flower!
chapters.content:
"Then you asked me what is happening with the werewolf wizard before?" Dougt asked playfully.
Ivan rolled his eyes, he was just watching the werewolf wizards who were poor and lacking money, so he was thinking about whether he could hire them to help him find out the news of Knock Down Alley.
As early as when the Ministry of Magic was investigating his store, Ivan had a deep understanding of how blocked his news was.
All the information he got was either learned from the system mission, or was told to him by Esiah or Doug.
In such a dangerous place as Knockturn Alley, it’s not enough without a source of intelligence.
For this reason, Ivan will look at the werewolves,
What's more, in the previous revitalization mission, there was a clear reminder to pay attention to the fish that escaped the pursuit of the Ministry of Magic, which made Ivan more vigilant.
However, Ivan didn't explain all these considerations. He felt that if he mentioned it a little, he might have been supplemented by Dougt's brain.
Ivan's silent attitude made Dougte more certain of his conjecture. While feeling emotional, he became more concerned about the wolf poison potion Ivan said before.
He immediately decided to do his best to help Yifan develop a potion for wolf poison within one year!
So when he left, Dougt took away two bottles of werewolf blood, ready to go back and study it.
Ivan was not easy to stop, so he let him take away two bottles of blood.
Back home, Ivan eagerly began to prepare the wolf poison potion. All the materials had been prepared a few days ago, and all that was lacking was the blood of the werewolf.
Soothing flowers, fig peels, rhizomes of sage...
After Ivan processed the various potion materials one by one, they added them to the cauldron, added a little werewolf's blood, and stirred them carefully. The potion in the cauldron suddenly boiled, and bubbles were blowing...
A little bit... The potion in the cauldron is like lava erupting from a volcano, erupting...
This means that the brewing of the potion has failed!
Fortunately, the crucible did not explode directly. When Ivan noticed something was wrong, he quickly reacted to avoid injury.
"Clean up!" Ivan waved his magic wand and began to clean up the mess.
The remaining potion juice and waste materials spilled everywhere were gathered by magic, and then they were thrown into the trash can together as garbage.
"En.. It should be that the moonstone powder used as a fusion agent is not enough. Add a little more this time!" After processing, Ivan thought about the mistake he made earlier, and re-added the material of another wolf poison potion. It was sorted out.
A defeat did not shake Ivan's mind.
It’s something he has known for a long time that it’s difficult to configure wolf poison potions. Among the potion ingredients, in addition to the mild ingredients such as tranquilizer flower and moonstone powder, there are also a lot of conflicting ingredients. If you don't pay attention, there is a possibility of configuration failure.
However, seeing that he was approaching the fifth-level potion, Ivan felt that there was no need to use academic grade points, so he started the allocation of the wolf's poison potion again.
During the configuration process this time, Ivan was very cautious, step by step according to the dosage on the formula, no more than no more.
After tossing for an hour, the potion in the cauldron gradually stabilized from turbidity and slowly turned into a thick liquid.
"Huh... finally succeeded!" Ivan breathed a sigh of relief, and he said that it should be possible, otherwise the formula given by the system should show the pre-level of potion.
After putting the finished wolf poison potion aside, Ivan continued to prepare the next bottle until all the ingredients were used up and Ivan stopped.
"Probably a 60% success rate." Looking at the discarded potion materials in the trash can, Ivan murmured.
Perhaps only by upgrading the potion to level 5, can the wolf poison potion be allocated 100%.
As for the cost price, Ivan's rough calculation is about two or three Jin Jialong. The most expensive material is werewolf blood. Each bottle of werewolf blood needs to consume 100 ml of werewolf blood regardless of whether it is successful or not.
After doing all this, Ivan began to repair the protective ring that had been badly worn out in the previous battle.
I used it several times in a short period of time in the afternoon battle. The material of the protective ring has been worn out by the impact of magical fluctuations. Although it seems to be able to be used normally, it is better to repair it just in case.
By the way, the ring of magic power also needs to be charged.
Thinking of this, Ivan was depressed for a while. After the magic ring was repaired by him, there was no limit to the number of times it could be used, but it needed to be charged, and the magic power was infused before it could be used.
Ivan has already figured out the general meaning of the magic text above, which is a very simple storage plus release.
This leads to a very low utilization rate of magic power in the circle of magic power,
If the total amount of magic power in his body is one unit, then the circle of magic power needs a full five units to be able to store up.
The only good thing is that it can be released without the need to store up, but the effect is not very good.
After instilling most of the magic power in the body into the circle of magic power, Ivan realized that the sky was already bright, and hurriedly turned off the light and went to bed.
......
"Ivan Hals!" Aysia's shout came downstairs.
In a daze, Ivan heard Esiah's cry from downstairs.
Turning over from the bed while yawning, Ivan ran downstairs "driving". Every time his mother called him his full name, there was an urgent matter, otherwise he was in trouble.
When he got downstairs, Ivan was relieved, and Aysia called him because someone from the Ministry of Magic had arrived.
The three Aurors who came were Dalis, Ellison, and Sonny. They came to receive the last batch of protective items.
Before Ivan could say hello, Esiah urged him to get the joke toy goods of the Weasley brothers, which were all piled up with him after they were sent.
Ivan had to run again, dragged a big package down and put it on the table. Only then did Ivan have time to ask.
"Captain Dalis, how is the Ministry of Magic's recent cleanup operations going on?"
Because of the previous system task prompts, Yifan is very concerned about this.
"The situation is not very good. Several colleagues have been injured in the past few days." Dawlish hesitated and chose to tell the truth.
"But it's much better than before. Thanks to your protective equipment, none of the Auror captains who used the protective ring were injured."
Having said this, Dawlish is somewhat fortunate. He led the team to participate in a big operation of the Ministry of Magic a few days ago and was accidentally caught by a large-scale black magic. Fortunately, the protective ring helped him withstand it. Otherwise, He is now lying in the hospital with those colleagues.
Those seventy golden gallons are very worthwhile!
Sogou

chapters.title: Chapter 143: Your recipe...couldn't it be stolen?
chapters.content:
During the two talks, Sunny couldn't help but vomit.
"I heard that the injured Aurors are planning to protest to the ministry. They said that if the ministry doesn't equip them with protective equipment, they will not do such dangerous tasks in the future..."
"Then you can just persuade your executive director to buy more things and go back." Ivan said with a smile.
Sonny stuck out her tongue, she didn't have the guts to persuade her.
At this moment, Ellison quietly pulled Ivan aside, revealed the dim protection ring on his right hand, and asked quietly.
"If the protective ring is broken, can it be repaired?"
Broke so soon? Ivan is very strange.
Although he used relatively cheap materials when he made the protective ring, it is expected that one or two years will be no problem.
Unless it is repeatedly used in a short period of time, it will cause obvious wear.
"Didn't you just become an Auror for a long time? Fighting so frequently?" Ivan asked.
Ellison smiled wryly, and then explained his experience somewhat proudly.
Because of his protective ring and anti-cursive gloves, he has been extremely brave in combat these past few days. He dared to stand up to attract firepower, and was unanimously approved by other Aurors. Even the executive director gave him a verbal statement during a meeting Commendation!
"I think if this continues, it won't take long for me to pass the batter's review." Ellison said with a **** expression.
Ivan's mouth twitched. He felt that if he died like this, Ellison might not be able to live until the day he became a hitter...
And, if he remembers correctly, wasn't this guy Ellison horrified when he came last time? Is it possible to be crippled by someone?
"The protective ring can of course be repaired, but it's not free. You can repair it once every 30 gallons." Ivan said after thinking about it.
Originally, Ivan was planning to refuse the repair request, so that it would help increase the sales of the ring, but after careful consideration, this idea was dispelled.
Seventy gallons is not a small number. If it is worn out and cannot be repaired, the other party may not be willing to buy a second one.
So it is better to charge a little service fee.
"Thirty gallons... so expensive?" Ellison was depressed for a while. He didn't have so much money. Last time he bought the protective ring or bought it in installments.
"You're a job loss, won't you apply for reimbursement from the department?" Ivan looked at Ellison, the new Auror in doubt, how expensive it is to repair, what does it have to do with him?
"Can it be like this?" Ellison was stunned, and then suddenly realized that he had never thought about it before.
Ellison was completely relieved, and then quietly asked if he could wear multiple protective rings at the same time.
After all, in addition to what he bought himself, after becoming an elite hitter or Auror captain, the ministry should give him another one.
Only then did Ivan realize that this guy hasn't changed at all, and he is still so embarrassed...
It is of course possible to equip multiple magic items at the same time, but the improvement is not as big as Ellison thought, otherwise Ivan would have given himself ten rings and one finger...
In the afternoon, after the Aurors of the Ministry of Magic left, before Ivan had time to rest, Doug rushed to the door.
"I thought about it. I finally thought about it. We can use calming flowers and sage to suppress the tyrannical factors in wolf blood. As long as we start from here, we can produce a finished product within half a year..."
Dougte explained it to Ivan in a hurry, and he couldn't help but feel the excitement in his heart.
Last night, he began to analyze the components in wolf blood. He made a major discovery before he made it. He remembered the herbs that Ivan had mentioned before. After trying them one by one, Dougt suddenly felt that the research on wolf poison potion was difficult. He has already solved most of it.
All that is left is to work out the ratio of the potion materials and find the werewolf wizards to conduct experiments again and again.
Dougt was also proud of thinking of this, which meant that the Merlin Medal was already within easy reach.
"Oh.. That's it." Ivan replied lightly.
Dougt was puzzled by Ivan's plain attitude. When he was about to ask, he saw Ivan take out a test tube containing a brown potion from the pocket of the wizard's robe and slowly put it on the table.
"What is this?" Dougt's expression changed.
Could it be...Dougt had some guesses, but in the end he shook his head. It should be impossible.
"This is wolf poison potion..." At this moment, Ivan said.
"Wolf's poison potion?!" Douglas looked at the brown potion placed on the table in a daze, and said in a daze.
"You made the finished product so soon, ready to experiment?"
Dougt couldn't believe his eyes, but soon thought of another possibility, looked around and lowered his voice.
"The formula for this potion was not stolen from your potions professor Snape when you were in school, right?"
"How is it possible? I just researched out the wolf poison potion, just last night." Ivan rolled his eyes, and Doug's ability to replenish the brain was no longer there.
Dougt knew that he had failed, and smiled apologetically.
That's right, if Snape had already worked out the formula for the wolf poison potion, he would have announced it long ago, how could he have waited until now.
After trying to understand this, Dougt was depressed. He was exquisite and analytical last night. Only then did he gain some gains. When he was about to share the good news with Ivan, he found that the other party even Get all the finished potions.
Ivan watched Dougt transform from excitement to depression, so he had to persuade him to start studying this subject from school, and also got some help from professors by the way.
Dougert was relieved now, and he said, no matter how genius it is, it is impossible to develop a finished potion overnight.
Ivan flicked for a while, and after resolving Dougt's doubts , he took the wolf poison potion he made last night and went to the base of the werewolf wizard.
Walking to the middle of the dilapidated street, Walker jumped directly from the tree on one side, strangely.
"Ivan? Why did you come today? Didn't it mean that we don't need more werewolf blood in a short time?"
Ivan raised his eyes and looked over, and was surprised to find that Walker's face was pale, but compared to yesterday, he already had a little blood, and he couldn't help but admire the werewolf wizard's excellent recovery ability.
"Yes, so we came to find someone to test the medicine today!" Ivan took out the wolf poison potion from the pocket of the wizard robe, and the dark brown liquid was shining brightly in the sun.
"It's done so soon?" Walker was a little surprised. He didn't expect that Ivan had only mentioned it to him yesterday, and there will be results today.
Isn't this potion mixed randomly?
Walker looked at the wolf poison potion in Ivan's hand, swallowed hard, and began to wonder if he had promised too soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 144: That's right, this is the Potion of Wolf's Venom!
chapters.content:
Thinking of his previous promise, Walker was cruel, took the wolf poison potion, looked at the dark brown liquid in the reagent, and hesitated.
"It's good to drink three gallons once, don't forget!"
Ivan threw Sangalon amusedly, and then added another word.
"I have studied the formula of the wolf poison potion a long time ago. All that is missing is the werewolf blood, so it has not been made."
Having said this, Ivan felt depressed for a while, he worked so hard to make out the wolf poison potion, but in the end he had to spend money to find someone to drink it.
Walker now had some confidence, looking at the brown liquid in the test tube in his hand, he poured it directly into his mouth.
Grumbling...
After Walker drank it, he clearly felt that the cold potion turned into a cold stream and poured into his stomach, and then slowly penetrated into his body. The brain seemed to become cold and cold. After a while, it returned to normal. .
"How do you feel?" Dougte asked hurriedly. He didn't want to have full confidence like Ivan. The research results of the first phase seemed to him to be pretty good without any problems.
"It seems that nothing happened." Walker said with a smashed mouth.
"The wolf poison potion is a potion that keeps a werewolf sensible. How do you know if it's useful if you don't change your body?" Ivan reminded.
Walker nodded, thinking about things that made him angry.
But Ivan and Dougt have been on the same level for several minutes, and Walker hasn't changed much except that the expression on his face looks angry.
"I haven't taken the initiative to transform before, maybe it's not angry enough, let me think about it..." Walker explained with some embarrassment.
"Forget it, I'll help you out." Ivan said helplessly.
"Help? How to help?" Walker asked strangely.
"Fear is coming!" Ivan stretched out his wand and tapped it in the air, and the purple magical light shot out and hit Walker.
In the next moment, Walker's expression became distorted, his body suddenly began to change and swell, his limbs became narrow and long, and gray-brown hair continued to grow from his body...
However, Ivan’s focus was on why Walker’s transformation didn’t break his clothes. Logically speaking, his body shape had changed so much that he would have torn his clothes out a long time ago.
Unless the werewolf transforms, it is also a kind of Animagus!
When Ivan was guessing, Walker's transformation had already been completed.
The two-meter-tall werewolf just towered in the middle of the street. The huge beast pupils stared at the two men, sharp claws scratching the ground, and his eyes were full of resentment...
"It seems that the potion has no effect." Dougt held the wand in his hand, some of his scalp was numb when he was staring at, and he asked instead.
"Stop playing, Walker." Ivan shook his head and interrupted.
"En? How do you know that I pretended to be?"
A slightly depressed tone came out of the terrifying werewolf's mouth, and Dougte, who looked at the contrast, changed a bit, but more surprised.
This means that the development of the wolf poison potion is really successful!
"If you are really irrational, you might have rushed over to bite us long ago." Ivan said casually, and then continued. "More importantly, I have confidence in the potion I made!"
"It turned out to be like this..." Walker curled his lips. He originally wanted to scare Ivan, so that he could avenge him for letting him see such a terrifying thing.
"How are you feeling now?" Ivan asked.
"It's... awesome!" Walker's hideous wolf face was full of excitement. He had never experienced being rational in the form of a werewolf.
Walker looked at his arm. It was shaggy and had sharp claws. He felt that his whole body was full of strength. He couldn't help but ran around Sa Huan, his powerful limbs ran out several times with just a single leap. Meters away.
"He seems to be quite comfortable with his identity as a werewolf." Dougt looked at Walker who was excited, and said with complacency and suspicion.
Ivan tilted his head and didn't quite understand what Doug was referring to, but after thinking about it, he understood.
The other werewolf wizards seem to be more or less repelling their own werewolf identities,
Just like Lupin in the original book, even after taking the wolf poison potion, during the period of transforming into a werewolf, he would only choose to hide in one place, quietly waiting for the end of the transformation time, once he was discovered It was a frightened look...
But Walker was obviously different. The first time he turned into a werewolf, he was excited, happy with the improvement of his strength, and even started to adapt to his strength in front of them, and felt that there was nothing wrong with the werewolf form at all.
It's really different...
Walker ran around like a mad dog, and the wolf howls with excitement from time to time, quickly alarmed the werewolf wizard in the house.
After seeing Walker run away again, they all drew out their wands. The colorful magic power condensed on the top of the wand, ready to wake him up. The leader Fren frowned and rolled up his sleeves.
Seeing this posture, Walker was frightened for a while, climbed up to the tree with his hands and feet in two or three steps, hugged one of the sturdy branches, and yelled tremblingly.
"Wait, don't fight for now!"
It's fine if you don't have any reason when you transform, but now that he is conscious, Walker doesn't want to be beaten severely. No wonder he always feels pain all over his body every time after his transformation is over...
Ivan looked at the two-meter-high, cruel-looking werewolf rushing to the tree, holding the branches of the tree, with a strange expression.
For a group of werewolf wizards, it was shock, incomprehension, fear, and incredible.
"Walker, can you speak?" Furen's expression also changed again. If it weren't for the abnormal behavior of the werewolf hiding in the tree, he would almost think he had heard it wrong.
"Of course I can speak Walker jumped down from the tree very loudly and jumped in front of everyone.
Except for Fren, all the werewolf wizards clenched their magic wands, their faces uncertain, for fear that Walker was briefly awake and would soon lose his mind.
Fren didn't have any fear, even if Walker lost control at close range, he would not be able to beat him, so instead he said with a little excitement.
"How can you stay sane in a werewolf state? How do you do it? Can you be sure how long it lasts?"
Walker was in trouble because he didn't know how long it would last, so he turned to look at Ivan and others.
Fren, who had been attracted by Walker, noticed that Ivan and Dougt were walking towards this side from the street.
Vaguely thinking of something, Fren couldn't bear to ask, and he heard Ivan speak first.
"The effect of the medicine will give him at least a week of awake time...This is what I told you before...Which poison potion!"

chapters.title: Chapter 145: we agreed! How much does such a potion normally sell for?
chapters.content:
Potion of wolf poison? !
Hearing Ivan’s explanation, all the werewolf wizards were so excited that they couldn’t be on their own.
Yesterday, although they heard Ivan mention the wolf's poison potion, it was totally useless at that time. They couldn't believe that a little wizard could develop a potion that could solve their werewolf problem.
Now it is different. Walker, who can still communicate normally after transforming into a werewolf, is right in front of them. No matter how surprised he is, he must admit that this is the truth!
"You mean, as long as we drink the wolf poison potion, we can all be like Walker?" Even Fren, who was always calm, couldn't restrain his inner emotions and asked.
"Of course." Ivan nodded, and when he was about to push the potion for them, he saw an old werewolf witch who couldn't control his emotions, she burst into tears, and started sobbing in a low voice.
Ivan is a little puzzled, even if he is happy, he won't be so.
"Thank you!"
Ivan was stunned, Fren stepped forward and patted him on the shoulder, thanking him sincerely.
After finishing speaking, Fren looked at the crying old witch again, and said to Ivan with a wry smile.
"You are not werewolf wizards, it may be difficult to understand our feelings.
Actually, those who stay here are poor people. They are not born werewolf wizards, but were scratched and bitten by other out of control werewolves in the early years. They were forced to change because they were not treated in time. "
"The experience of transforming from a normal wizard to a werewolf almost ruined their original life. Especially after their identity was exposed, it was very difficult for them to find a job that could support themselves, because there was almost no place to welcome one at any time. The runaway werewolf..."
Fren sighed and told Ivan one story after another about werewolf wizards, everyone has their own misfortune.
Otherwise, I wouldn't fall into Knockout Alley, and sometimes I don't even have a full meal.
Ivan was silent for a long time. He is not a werewolf wizard and cannot fully understand the feelings of these people, but in his opinion, the werewolf wizard is like an infectious disease patient in the Muggle world...
He spent a long time in the hospital in his previous life, knowing what kind of discrimination an infectious patient would suffer in his life...
While Ivan was thinking about it, Fren had already briefly said the experiences of everyone except himself and Walker.
After another pause, Fren sighed.
"Your wolf poison potion gives us hope for a normal life. I think every werewolf will thank you."
Ivan was not so optimistic, shook his head, and said softly. "Even if there is a potion of wolf poison, it is difficult to change the long-standing concept of wizards in a short time. You'd better be psychologically prepared."
If possible, Ivan didn't want to pour cold water at this time, but he knew that if these werewolf wizards believed that the wolf poison potion could eliminate the barriers, they would only witness a more cruel reality in the end.
"Of course we know this, but there is finally some hope now, right?" Fren looked openly and smiled freely.
The rest of the werewolf wizards, at this time, also eased from the previous excitement, and they all came forward to thank them.
was praised one after another, Ivan was not embarrassed, because he made wolf poison potions more selfishly.
"By the way, how much does this potion cost?" Amid praise and thanks, someone suddenly asked.
The group of werewolf wizards also realized this crucial problem, and looked at Ivan in anxiety.
Although the wolf poison potion can relieve them of the problem of running away after transforming, they have to be able to afford it.
"Twenty...no, forget it, just sell it for ten gallons!" Ivan sighed.
Ivan was thinking of setting the price at 20 gallons. According to his budget, this price is almost excluding the werewolf wizards who have jobs or odd jobs in other places outside of Knockover Alley, saving money for a month. Can be saved.
The other party can't afford it when it is high, and he can't make much gold gallon when it is low. Twenty gallons is just the limit that both parties can accept.
However, seeing the werewolf wizards present looking at him eagerly, thinking about the stories Fren said, after Ivan hesitated, the price dropped to half of the original price.
After the price was set, Ivan suddenly thought of something. He squinted at Fren for a while, and then he said, how could this guy suddenly tell him a story? It turned out that it was this idea.
Fren gave Ivan an apologetic look. He didn't mean to intimidate Ivan with these things. He just wanted to truly inform Ivan of their werewolf's difficulties, the inventor of the wolf poison potion... Werewolves are really poor!
How could the werewolf wizards present fail to see that Ivan had taken their situation into consideration and lowered the original price, which was moved for a while.
"thanks, thanks!"
"For ten gallons, if you work harder, you can still save it every month."
"With the wolf poison potion, we will soon find a formal job...leave this place."
......
Several werewolf wizards talked about their visions for the future, and more of them expressed their gratitude.
Fren also said solemnly at this time.
"Ivan Hals, if you need our help in the future, you can come to us. You are always welcome here, if you say...we can help."
"Yes, if you run into any trouble, just tell me!" Walker gathered up the excitement at this time, and his sharp wolf claws clenched into fists patted his chest and said carelessly.
Ivan smiled, and the original depression was swept away. In his previous life, he couldn't wait for the hope that others gave. He didn't expect that after crossing, he gave hope to a group of people.
In the original book, Ivan doesn’t know what the price of the wolf's poison potion is. It is estimated that ten gallons is impossible, because the cost, publicity, research and development costs, and the complexity of the potion brewing are all destined for the wolf's poison potion. Expensive!
Even if Ivan has a formula directly given by the system, which saves research and development costs, the cost of publicity and the cost of the potion cannot be solved.
In addition, it is impossible for Ivan to spend all his time on brewing the wolf poison potion, and needs to let others contract the production of the potion, so for every bottle of wolf poison potion sold, he may only earn one or two gold Kanon only...
But it’s not bad to sell it cheaply.
After all, you need to buy at least one bottle of this potion every month, and the price is a little lower so that all werewolf wizards can afford it.
How can there be hundreds of werewolf wizards in Europe? Even if one-third of the werewolf wizards were willing to buy wolf poison potions every month, that would still make a lot of money.
There are many ways to earn Jin Jialong. Ivan is not cruel enough to make a fortune by exploiting werewolf wizards...
Sogou

chapters.title: Chapter 146: You know? You know a hammer!
chapters.content:
Confirming the effect of the wolf poison potion, Ivan declined the enthusiasm of the werewolf wizards to stay.
After leaving the station, Dougte, who had not spoken, spoke in praise.
"You did a good job this time. Compared to vulgar money, fame is really important..."
Dougte also sighed when he said that, he found that he had seriously underestimated the little wizard Ivan, not only was able to develop the wolf poison potion in a short period of time, but also resisted the temptation of money.
This made the next operation extremely easy. Dougt felt that as long as the publicity was in place, Ivan would be able to easily gain the favor of all werewolves, which would be very helpful for the implementation of the plan in the future.
You deserve it!
Dougter looked at Ivan with a little amazement. If he had such courage back then, how could he have fallen to where he is today.
Ivan didn't know that Dougter was crazy about his brains, but he didn't agree with Dougt's statement.
Vulgar money?
You don't want it, you can give it to me!
"Dean Dougt, since you think money is vulgar, I will beg you to make the wolf's poison potion in the future. If this is the case, we can further reduce the price of the wolf's poison potion." Ivan rolled his eyes and said. .
"Ahem.. Although Jin Jialong is vulgar, but sometimes it is indispensable." Dougert coughed awkwardly.
All the way afterwards, Dougt was discussing with Ivan how much the employment fee should be paid, and he tried his best to fight for the slightest profit, until he was almost home.
Every time a bottle of wolf poison potion is made, Dougte can get a gold gallon.
Ivan was thinking of lowering the price a little bit, but Dougt resolutely refused to give in, and did not promote the vulgarity of money, so Ivan had to give up.
After all, the wolf poison potion is not something that ordinary people can configure, and it needs to have a high level of potion to ensure the success rate of potion brewing.
If you are looking for another potion master, you may not decide how high the price will be, so it is better to hand it over to Doug to make it.
Ivan thinks that this guy is idle at ordinary times, he might as well boil some wolf poison potions to sell every day, so that he can only earn black-hearted money by blackmailing patients.
After discussing the price, Yifan suddenly remembered that he didn't even have a follow-up publicity plan, and he still had to say whether the wolf poison potion could be sold.
And I don’t know if there is a patent in the magic world. If so, where do I need to apply for it?
Ivan was about to ask, when he saw Dougte wave his hands and said.
"Don't worry, I understand, I understand! You think about your words for the past two days, then change into a decent outfit, and be more generous. Two days later, I will take you to the Ministry of Magic!"
After speaking, Dougt waved his magic wand to perform Apparition, and hurriedly disappeared in front of the store.
Ivan was left standing in front of the door in a daze, and it took a long time before a word came out of his mouth.
"You know a hammer!"
......
Until Ivan returned home, he didn't fully understand the meaning of Dougt's words, but he probably understood a little bit. Two days later, he should go to the Ministry of Magic to meet some important people.
At the time of dinner, Aisia, who was holding the dinner plate, looked at Ivan with frowning, and said with concern.
"What's wrong? Didn't it go well today?"
Ivan made a potion of wolf poison and went to find the werewolves in the Knockdown Alley to test the medicine. Naturally, Aysia was very clear about it, so I thought it was a problem with the development of the potion.
"No, everything went well, the effect of the wolf poison potion was as I expected!" Ivan loosened his frown, shook his head, and said.
"It seems that you will soon become the smallest Merlin Medal recipient in the magic world." Aysia was a little surprised, but there were more surprises.
"Awesome! Mom knows you will be successful!" Aysia said happily, and couldn't help but step forward and kiss Ivan on the forehead.
"Well, it should be available! Eat.. Eat first!" Ivan flushed his cheeks uncomfortably, picked up a knife and fork and changed the subject forcefully. I didn't worry about what Dougt was going to do for a while, anyway, I knew it in two days.
Ivan didn't waste the two days of free time.
In addition to the daily practice of magic, and occasionally discussing the spell release technique with Tom, he also went to the residence of the werewolf wizards from time to time to learn about their situation.
Ivan has not forgotten that one of the purposes of looking for the werewolves in the first place was to ask them to help investigate the news of Knockdown Alley, especially paying attention to whether there is any idea of ​​a dark wizard playing his magic shop.
After Fren heard about this, he did not hesitate to agree on the spot, even unwilling to receive payment from Ivan.
In Fren's view, Ivan lowered the price of the wolf poison potion for their werewolf wizards, and the loss was not small, and it was a matter of course to do a small favor.
What's more, Fren also counted on Ivan, the creator of the wolf poison potion, to develop a potion to cure these werewolves in the future.
If something happens, the flame of hope that has finally ignited will be extinguished?
So not only Fren, but the other werewolf wizards also promised to help him inquire about relevant news in his spare time.
It's just that Ivan didn't intend to report the favor, so after thinking about it, he decided to hire them in another way.
Just afterwards, it takes a lot of werewolf blood to make the wolf poison potion, so he promised that the werewolf wizard present will draw blood twice a month, and he will be able to exchange for a bottle of wolf poison potion for free!
The werewolf’s ability to recover was excellent. Walker took thousands of milliliters of blood at a time and he almost recovered within a few days. It can be seen that a blood draw in the last half month will not cause any damage to the body of the werewolf wizard.
After switching the remuneration, Fren smiled bitterly, and the other werewolf wizards did not refuse.
Because the price of ten gallons of wolf poison potion is indeed a huge expense for them, if they can get a bottle of blood after drawing twice, then they don't need to save money frugally.
The only thing that confuses Ivan is that the werewolf wizards agreed to his employment, but the first ring of the unified Knockdown Alley in the system to conquer the werewolf wizards did not show completion.
"It doesn't seem to be so easy to complete the task...no wonder that I have given two years of task time. UU reading www.uumshu.com" Ivan muttered to himself as he looked at the task list without any changes.
After thinking about it, Ivan understood.
Now he is more like a benefactor to these werewolf wizards. Although everyone is very grateful, he obviously does not intend to take refuge in him, the eleven or twelve-year-old wizard.
Thinking of this, Ivan was helpless.
This is not to say that he was suddenly full of ambitions to recruit a group of werewolf men to dominate the Knockdown Alley.
Rather, as soon as the task is completed, he will be able to get the formula of the powerful wolf poison potion.
Although I don’t know the difference between this and ordinary wolf poison potion for the time being, after all, it has two words of powerful effect.
Maybe it can really cure these werewolves...
(PS: The group number of the book friend group is 446421565, and there is only one person in the group temporarily, so if your application is sent too late, the angel may not be able to agree immediately.)

chapters.title: Chapter 147: teach
chapters.content:
"Ten thousand bullets are all fired..."
"Faint!"
......
In the morning two days later, at the east side of the ruins, a werewolf stretched out powerful limbs, swiftly avoiding the smashed boulders and the colorful spell rays among the ruins.
Suddenly, a scream sounded.
The werewolf looked up and found that hundreds of birds had gathered in the sky at some point, and they were swooping toward him. For a while, they dodged in embarrassment, but he was still pecked out with wounds.
However, the slight pain and injury stimulated the werewolf's eagerness. He didn't dodge and rushed towards the little wizard who was waving his wand not far away.
The limbs of the werewolf are long and narrow, and a long jump is a few meters away, and it quickly draws the distance between the two sides very close.
If it is an ordinary wizard, being close by a werewolf is undoubtedly extremely dangerous.
Ivan was obviously not among the ranks of ordinary wizards, and when the werewolf swooped in front of him, the effect of the magic circle was activated.
The next moment, the terrifying magic wave swept away in all directions, and the close werewolf was knocked into the air several meters away in an instant.
Ivan's wand waved again, and the weeds on the ground began to grow wildly around the werewolf's legs and tied it up.
Immediately Ivan made a gesture and wanted to continue to do it.
At this moment, the scary-looking werewolf made a sound of horror.
"Stop! I give up! I give up!"
Ivan then put down his wand. After a while, the werewolf body in front of him twitched and slowly transformed into its original shape.
Walker got up from the ground with difficulty, feeling weak and depressed.
After taking the wolf poison potion and gaining the ability to maintain his sanity in the werewolf state, Walker inevitably swelled a little.
All day long clamoring to fight Ivan again,
But the result is obvious.... After several battles, he was brutally tortured, and there was no way to fight back.
"Are you really a first-year little wizard? I didn't expect that I would become a werewolf this time and could not beat you..." Walker scratched his head and said admiringly.
"Accurately speaking, the next school year will be the second grade." Ivan said casually, and then felt something was wrong. What's wrong with this kind of elementary school students' self-introduction feeling?
Ivan shook his head, leaving this feeling behind.
I didn't pay much attention to Walker's compliments. I knew my family's affairs. If the blessing of magic items and the special bloodline magic were removed, Ivan felt that he might not be able to defeat Walker in the werewolf state so easily and freely.
Otherwise, when being close, he does not need to use the magic ring to consume the magic power that has been hard-stored for these days.
It can only be said that in order to deter the werewolf wizards, they performed too much, so that they can't get off the stage with strong support...
Thinking of this, Ivan immediately praised.
"Your werewolf form is very powerful. If you control it better, you might be able to defeat me."
"How is that possible? I listened to my uncles and they said that you used a powerful spell to blow up a whole section of the street wall..." Walker didn't believe it at all, and even said this, with a hint of wonder in his words. color.
A few days ago, Walker asked curiously about what happened after he lost control of his transformation.
Then I learned that after Ivan defeated him, one person resisted the attacks of all the werewolf wizards, and by the way, a whole section of the street wall was blown into ruins with a powerful spell!
At first, Walker didn't believe it very much. He had never seen anyone release such a terrifying curse. Even if he personally inspected the ruins, he was still a little doubtful.
After all, in his impression, Ivan seemed to be nothing more than an eleven or twelve-year-old little wizard, and he was defeated last time with Dougt.
Until recently, they challenged Ivan one after another, and were easily defeated by the opponent. Walker believed this completely, and in his heart he raised Ivan's strength to a place comparable to Fren.
No, maybe it's higher, because Furen couldn't easily blow up a section of the street wall with a spell.
Thinking of this, Walker asked curiously. "Ivan, what spell did you use last time? It's so powerful!"
"That's a thunderbolt explosion! A deep lethal curse..." Ivan explained, then looked at Walker with an enviable look, and then smiled.
"The power of the spell is closely related to the caster. If you release this spell, I am afraid that it will not even have a third of its power."
Having said that, Ivan could see that Walker wanted to learn this spell, but he was not embarrassed to say it. After thinking about it, he spoke.
"It's not that this spell can't be taught to you. It's just that your basics are too poor. If you rush to learn the thunderbolt explosion, there is a risk of losing control, so it is better to learn some basic spells first..."
In the previous few matches, Ivan noticed that Walker's spells were astonishingly poor, and the spells he released were sometimes strong and sometimes weak, and very unstable.
After questioning, Ivan learned that Walker had attended Durmstrang School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, but unfortunately the identity of the werewolf was discovered by his classmates in the second grade, and then the school received complaints from other parents. , And later he was expelled.
So Walker did not go through formal academic study at all, and most of the spells he learned were taught by Furen in his spare time.
After hearing about Walker's experience, Ivan suddenly felt a little regretful. If Walker had gone to school at Hogwarts, he would be lucky. He might be able to make a few friends like Lupin and graduate from school smoothly.
After all, Dumbledore treats students very well. He never discriminates against outliers, and even gives some help.
Walker didn't care about his experience of being expelled. In his opinion, it would be fine if he didn't go to school, just because he didn't need to hide in hiding every month, and he had to be stared at with doubt.
Ivan shook his head helplessly For Walker's easy-going temperament, he didn't know what to say, so he simply gave Walker a basic curse course.
Although Ivan had only taken a one-year course, he was no worse than an adult wizard based on the theoretical basis of the fourth-level magic spell.
What's more, he has obtained a lot of tricks to release spells from Tom Riddle these days, and it is no problem to teach Walker, a werewolf wizard from a wild background.
At first, Walker didn't pay much attention to the basic courses taught by Ivan. In his opinion, these spells would have already been learned by himself, and there is no need to relearn them. He still wants to learn the extremely lethal spells like Thunderbolt. .
It's just that Ivan has established authority in several battles, even if Walker is reluctant, he can only be patient and listen to the meeting.
After being forced to correct several mistakes and omissions in the process of casting spells, and tried it personally, Walker was surprised to find that the power of the spell has actually become greater!
Sogou

chapters.title: Chapter 148: What do you think of this identity setting?
chapters.content:
With this discovery, Walker really closed his mind, listened to Ivan's lecture earnestly, and from time to time experimented with the knowledge of spells Ivan told him.
Now I am more and more admired for Ivan. He feels that the professors at Durmstrang School of Witchcraft and Wizardry are not as good as Ivan's teaching.
At least Ivan was able to increase the power of his spell in a short period of time, but he didn't have this experience when he was in school.
It's just that Walker doesn't have a systematic blessing like Ivan, and even if he knows what to do, he needs a lot of practice to be able to master it.
Ivan watched Walker happily and began to practice the spell over and over again, and smiled.
His deliberate teaching this time was also out of some compensatory psychology,
After all, in the past two days, Ivan has used the name of wolf poison potion effect to analyze Walker's body structure in two different states of werewolf and wizard.
Greatly increased the proficiency of the Transformation Curse, not to mention, it also became more and more certain that the werewolf form was a special Animagus.
Because just like when he used magic power to analyze the spots, Walker's brain in the werewolf state also has magical protection.
The only difference between the two is that Walker's body is also full of magic, as if his whole body is activated by magic, and all functions have been improved a lot.
This reminded Ivan of the fast-running brindle cat in the forbidden forest... guessing whether Professor McGonagall can achieve a similar increase in the form of Animagus.
However, Ivan thought that he hadn't even learned Animagus now, and it didn't make sense to think about it for the time being.
Considering that today seemed to be the day that I had agreed with Doug to go to the Ministry of Magic, Ivan turned to look at Walker and spoke.
"I will teach you here for the time being. In the past few days, you will practice it yourself. When I have time, I will teach you the release techniques of the Iron Armor Curse and the Splitting Curse.
When you can freely control the power of the spell, you can start to learn the spell of thunderbolt explosion. "
"Are you really willing to teach me such a powerful spell?" Walker, who was practicing the spell, said in disbelief.
Although Ivan had promised this before, he thought it was a shirk.
"Of course, if you can meet my requirements." Ivan nodded indifferently.
In fact, the curse of a thunderbolt explosion is not that rare. In the original time and space, Hermione and Harry had released this curse when he was in seventh grade, and its power was normal.
Not to mention blowing up the entire street like Peter Pettigrew, even blowing up a section of the street wall like him can't do it.
As he said before, the specific power of the spell varies from person to person...
The most important thing is that the standards he set are not so easy to achieve. It will take at least one or two years for Walker to control the power of the spell freely.
At that time, even if Walker mastered the thunderbolt explosion, it would not be possible to pose any threat to him.
Walker didn't know this, he jumped up with joy, imagining that soon after he cast a spell to make the enemy tremble with fright, he began to practice harder.
Ivan was amused for a while, if the wolves were as easy to deal with as Walker, it would be great. His task would be completed in a few days.
After making the promise, Ivan did not stay here too much and went straight back home.
After lunch, Ivan finally waited for Dougt to arrive.
Not seen for two days, Dougte had already changed his appearance, a black wizard robe inlaid with gold, his stature was straight, and the moaning scum on his lips had been shaved, completely without the decadent appearance before.
What surprised Ivan most was that Dougt's sparse hair grew back in two days, put on the oil, and combed it neatly behind his head.
"Are you drinking a potion for additional issuance?" Ivan said with a weird expression, but it seems that the additional issuance will not be permanent, otherwise Dougt won't wait until today.
Dougt glared at him fiercely, knowing it in his heart, what to do?
Immediately afterwards, Dougt looked up and down on Ivan's body again, and saw that he was just wearing an ordinary wizard robe, and said in a puzzled way.
"Didn't I ask you to dress up? You just wear this?"
"Isn't it? I think this dress is pretty good. Could it be that we went to the banquet?" Ivan raised his eyebrows.
"Of course not." Dougt shook his head.
"Isn't that enough? We are poor wizards from Turnover Alley. Although our family is poor and difficult to eat and wear, we are still worried about the future of the magical world. Therefore, we have been studying in Turnover Alley for many years and are determined to solve the problem of werewolf runaways. ...."
Ivan talked eloquently, stunned what Dougt had said, and finally asked aloud.
"What do you think of the identity of this poor genius?"
Dougt was confused, and it took a long time before he could barely keep up with Ivan's brain, wondering if he wanted to change his old clothes.
Seeing Dougte's dumbfounded look, Ivan smiled in his heart. Since this **** likes brain supplements, let's continue with brain supplements!
Just as Ivan was proud, he suddenly felt a burst of chill behind him, turned his head and looked over, only to find that it was the sullen Asia...
"I don't remember when it was difficult to eat and wear at home..." Aysia squeezed Ivan's cheek with no anger.
Then Aysia unbuttoned Ivan's coat, took off Ivan's ordinary wizard robe, and replaced it with another robe with delicate patterns.
"It looks pretty good." After helping Ivan folded his sleeves, Aysia satisfactorily looked at the little wizard in front of him and said with satisfaction.
Ivan waved his magic wand and turned into a mirror and found that it really depends on clothes, and when he changed his clothes, he actually looked like a noble wizard.
It just feels that wearing this suit is always a little restrained, not at all the usual ease.
"Well...this dress is okay," Ivan finally commented, but accidentally turned away the smiley face of Aysia, and then quickly changed his words. "I mean, this dress is pretty good, impeccable!"
"It's almost time, so let's go first." Dougt looked at the clock, gestured to Aysia, and reminded Ivan.
Ivan nodded solemnly, and then he was held down on his shoulders, and a familiar spatial tear came from him, and Dougt's voice rang in his ears.
"Apparition..."
The next moment, the two people who were still in the magic shop disappeared in front of Aysia...
(PS: Recommend a well-written one-million-word HP comrade "Harry Potter: The Shopkeeper of Ten Thousand Worlds", with a large volume, and it is said that there are still 200,000 words in deposit, which can be updated at any time... )

chapters.title: Chapter 149: Enter the Ministry of Magic
chapters.content:
After a while, ripples appeared in the space, and two figures, one large and one small, appeared out of thin air on the open space on one side.
After returning to his senses, Ivan subconsciously looked around and found that this was not the Ministry of Magic he had imagined, but was located in a long narrow alley.
"Why don't we teleport directly to the Ministry of Magic?" Ivan asked strangely.
"Unless you are authorized and have important things, you can't just use Apparition to teleport to the Ministry of Magic. Even if you get to work there, you must enter through other channels when you go to work." Doug took a picture of Ivan On the shoulders, explained aloud.
Ivan nodded, that's right, if everyone used Apparition to teleport back and forth in the Ministry of Magic when doing business, it would definitely be a mess.
More importantly, it will damage the majesty of the Ministry of Magic!
"Come with me. The entrance to the Ministry of Magic is right in front. There may be more people on the road. We'd better pretend to be like Muggles."
Doug put away the wand in his hand, tidyed up his clothes, and after a word of warning, he took the lead in walking forward.
Pretending to be like Muggles? Do you know what Muggles look like in general?
Ivan kept spitting in his heart, but he still followed quickly and walked out of the alley, only to find that there was a bustling street outside.
There is a torrent of people here, the most common are those men and women wearing suits and leather shoes and carrying briefcases. They look in a hurry and never stay too much in the same place.
Under Dougert's leadership, Ivan mixed into the crowd, but the two's distinctive costumes still attracted the attention of passers-by.
Even so, Dougt still felt that he had a good disguise, and from time to time he told Ivan some Muggle common sense that I didn't know where it came from, but it was a pity that it all sounded outdated in Ivan.
With the rise of Dougte’s talk, he even thought of showing Ivan the use of the Muggle machine on the vending machine on the side of the road. However, after holding a silver Sico into it, nothing happened. It didn't take long for the machine to spit out Yinxike again.
"Damn it, Muggle machines don't collect cash from Sico and Tongnat." Doug patted his head and muttered in a low voice. It suddenly occurred to him that he had forgotten to exchange some Muggle currency at Gringotts today. .
Not long after they walked, the two came to an ancient street, where the walls were covered with all kinds of graffiti. There are only a few shops and a tavern on both sides of the street that are opening, which looks extremely desolate.
Because of this, there are very few pedestrians here, and occasionally a car honking its whistle passes by.
In the front, there is a red telephone booth, which seems to be in disrepair and tattered, so that the red paint on it has fallen off.
But Dougt walked in indifferently, and by the way he greeted Ivan also coming in, the small phone booth seemed a bit crowded for a while.
"This is a Muggle phone booth. It is said that Muggles can use this to realize remote communication, just like your telescopic ears. How about? Surprising, right? I felt a little weird when I first found out... "
Doug slapped his mouth, showing off his Muggle knowledge, and he looked triumphant.
Ivan rolled his eyes helplessly. It was just a phone booth. It was not that he hadn't used it in his previous life. Now Muggles even have mobile phones?
While doing a commentary to Ivan, Dougt picked up the handset, dialed the number on it, entered 62442, and waited in the phone booth.
Not long after, Ivan heard a voice ringing in his ears, which seemed to be very close, but no one could be seen around him.
"Welcome to the Ministry of Magic, please state your name and your affairs."
It was an indifferent female voice. Ivan couldn't help but complained. The poor service attitude of the Ministry of Magic receptionist shouldn't be a warm welcome?
Dougt was used to it, and didn't think there was anything wrong, he said.
"I'm Dougt, this is Ivan Hals, the developer of the wolf poison potion. We are going to the patent office. I believe someone should have greeted you!"
After Dougt finished speaking, the receptionist seemed a little surprised, and then continued to speak after a pause.
"Hello, guest, please take your badge...not in front of your clothes."
Jingle...
A square silver badge slipped out from the coin refund entrance of the phone booth. Ivan reached out and took it and turned it over and looked at it. It clearly read Ivan Hals, Patent Application.
Ivan Yiyan put the badge away from his chest, and heard the receptionist continue.
"Guests from the Ministry of Magic, the security checkpoint is at the end of the main hall. You need to be checked there and register your wand."
As soon as the voice fell, Ivan felt that the phone booth suddenly began to sink. It felt like when he was riding an elevator, sliding down to the ground steadily.
Through the glass of the phone booth, Ivan could clearly see that they were going deep underground. Layers of rocks passed by, and the speed of falling seemed to be getting faster and faster. There was a fine friction sound around, which made Ivan a little worried. Will there be any problems with this magical elevator?
Fortunately, everything went well in the end, the phone booth stopped smoothly, the closed door opened automatically, and then closed again after Ivan and Dougt walked out.
Ivan watched the phone booth re-launch, and then turned his head to look forward, only to realize that they were already on the side of a wide hall.
As the facade of the Ministry of Magic, it was built to be magnificent. The ground is covered with neat dark wooden floors, which are bright enough to reflect people's reflections. The peacock blue ceiling is engraved with many golden patternsfor a moment. Constantly changing and moving.
There is a gilded fireplace at every interval of the surrounding walls, and from time to time you can see the flames raised by the wizard when entering and exiting through the fireplace.
In the middle of the hall is a fountain, which looks the size of a pool, and a golden statue stands in the center of the circle.
The largest and tallest is a wizard holding a magic wand. The graceful statue of a witch next to it, together with statues of horsemen, fairies, and house elves, surrounds the surrounding like a moon and stars, looking at the wizard in the center with infinite admiration. ..
Ivan went all the way, looking around from time to time.
In his previous life, he had imagined the Ministry of Magic in his mind, and saw similar scenes in film and television. However, he was surprised that the mysterious magic of magic can be combined with architectural art so perfectly when he was in close contact with him.
"Well, don't watch, we still have business to do."
Dougter interrupted Ivan’s idea of ​​continuing to visit, and after leading him through the checkpoint of the wand, he pressed a few times on the elevator...

chapters.title: Chapter 150: Meeting with Damocles-Marcus
chapters.content:
Ding..
The elevator door slowly opened, and Ivan found that this was the main hall of the Ministry of Magic. Unlike the wide and luxurious hall below, the decoration of the main hall looked more solemn and majestic.
As soon as the two came in, they attracted the attention of everyone present, and a forty-year-old bald middle-aged wizard walked up and hugged Dougt.
"Old friend, long time no see!" Dougter slapped the middle-aged wizard on the back very passionately. After the two separated, Dougter looked down at Ivan and introduced.
"This is Director Stamp of the Patent Office, one of my best friends."
"Hello Mr. Stamp..." Ivan replied politely.
"You are the inventor of the wolf poison potion? God, although Dougt mentioned your age in the letter, I always thought this guy was joking..." Stamp looked at Ivan at most eleven. The two-year-old's tone was full of surprise, and then he said to Dougert half-jokingly.
"To be honest, several of my old friends are reluctant to believe that a little wizard can develop a wolf poison potion. You know, that must have a deep study of werewolves..."
"But this is the truth, isn't it? Mr. Stamp?" Ivan could not help but interrupted, then went on.
"In addition, I think it is not that the development of the wolf poison potion is too difficult, but that there are too few potion masters who care about the recent situation of werewolves, so that no one can come up with a solution before this..."
Ivan's words made Stamp somewhat embarrassed.
At this moment, there was a round of applause in the hall, accompanied by a deep voice.
"we agreed!"
Ivan turned his head and looked over, and saw that the man who praised him was a young wizard, who looked about thirty years old, and should be the youngest in the main hall except him.
Before Ivan could ask, he heard the other party say angrily.
"What you said just now is true. The entire magical world doesn't care about the status quo of werewolves at all. It simply thinks that werewolves are aliens, troublemakers and unstable factors.
But they forget that most of the poor victims of werewolves were also attacked. They were also normal wizards before. They didn't do anything wrong, but they needed to be treated like this! "
Compared with Ivan's slightly euphemistic words, the young wizard has to appear more straightforward, without the slightest concealment.
After the wizard had finished cursing angrily, his tone slowed down a lot, and he looked at Ivan.
"By the way, I haven't introduced myself yet. I am Damocles Marcus, a wizard who is studying the issue of werewolves."
"Hello, Mr. Marcus!" Ivan said calmly on the surface, but he felt guilty in his heart.
If he remembers correctly, this is the inventor of the wolf poison potion in the original time and space, and Ivan never expected to see himself here.
The most important thing is to look at the time. Marcus should be able to independently develop the wolf poison potion in a short time. I don't know if he has produced the finished formula now.
Ivan suddenly felt a headache, worried that this guy was coming to trouble him.
After all, anyone who is about to come up with research results and finds that he is one step ahead of him is absolutely unhappy.
However, what Ivan did not expect was that Marcus was very enthusiastic about him.
After a few words of courtesy, Marcus talked to him about the status quo of werewolves and the conjecture of werewolf riots... and even threw out some of his own experimental results and discussed them together.
Fortunately, Ivan's potions are not low, and coupled with the contact with the werewolves for a period of time, it is very easy to deal with, and even put forward some new ideas.
"Do you think the transformation of werewolves is a special kind of Animagus?" Marcus said in surprise. He has been studying werewolves for many years, and he has seen the appearance of werewolves running many times, but never Thought about it here.
