"Yes! When I was at Hogwarts, I once listened to Professor McGonagall, who taught the transformation course, and talked about some details about the transformation of Animagus.
In addition, I have a few werewolf friends in Knockdown Alley. After experimenting with my wolf poison potion, they can freely control their own power in the form of werewolves. That's why I have this conjecture. "
Having said that, Ivan hesitated for a moment, and did not say what he discovered when he analyzed the werewolf's body, but shook his head and said with a slight disappointment.
"It's a pity that the wolf poison potion has a duration. If it can be improved again so that the werewolf wizards can freely control their transformation while remaining sensible, what is the difference between the Animagus transformation?"
After listening to Marcus, he thought that Ivan was whimsical, so he wanted to refute it, but after careful consideration, he found that it was actually possible.
"If this conjecture is true, the magic world will definitely boil." Marcus said in shock.
You must know that Animagus is a kind of advanced transformation magic, which can be mastered by more than a dozen people in the entire British magic circle.
The deformed are usually harmless animals, which can only play a role of detection and concealment, far incomparable with the form of werewolves.
If one day, Ivan can really develop what he called an improved potion, then the werewolf wizard will no longer be the object of fear, and will even be enthusiastically sought after by some wizards!
After all, the biggest weakness of the wizard is the fragile body behind being close, and the werewolf form can solve this problem well.
More importantly, this ability is extremely easy to master, as simple as being caught and bitten by a werewolf, and then drinking a bottle of modified version of wolf poison potion can be unlocked.
Thinking of this, Marcuston looked at the little wizard in front of him with admiration.
Before coming to the Ministry of Magic Marcus had certain doubts about Ivan, the developer of the wolf poison potion.
Because he has been studying the werewolf problem with great concentration over the years, and he has worked hard to get some results, only one or two key points have not been figured out.
This led to the fact that two days ago, after receiving this news, Marcus's first reaction was whether his research results were stolen by others, so he put aside his research work and rushed to the Ministry of Magic to meet with the other party.
After some discussions, Ivan freely answered various professional questions he put forward, and showed sympathy for werewolves and dissatisfaction with the Ministry of Magic for ignoring the werewolf problem. Marcus only slightly let go of his doubts and started. Face this little wizard who doesn't look too big.
When Ivan proposed a new idea of ​​werewolf form, Marcus completely forgot his previous suspicions, and was even ashamed of his original idea.
Because in his opinion, Ivan's research on the werewolf problem is more profound and far-reaching than he thought!
Sogou

chapters.title: Chapter 151: Uninvited Dumbledore
chapters.content:
"Amazing!" Marcus exclaimed from the heart.
Facing Marcus, the true inventor of the wolf poison potion, Ivan was about to say a few words of modesty, but at this moment Dougte got up and interrupted his words.
"Genius is always beyond the reach of ordinary people..."
Dougter sighed with sorrowful emotion on his face, attracting everyone to gather their eyes, then patted Ivan on the shoulder and then boasted.
"You may not know that Hals can identify all kinds of herbs at the age of five, and can cook some simple potions by himself at the age of six...Of course, this is also inseparable from my hard teaching over the years.
To be honest, he was able to develop a wolf poison potion at this grade, personally, I am not surprised at all. "
what? I can recognize herbs at the age of five and make potions at the age of six?
Ivan stared at Doug with a dumb face, he didn't know when he was so good?
Who will believe this?
Ivan was complaining, even if he wanted to help him improve his reputation and put a title of genius, this is too much, right?
But when he turned his head, Ivan found that Marcus and Stamp looked at him with admiration, and obviously they were going to eat it.
Just as Dougt was about to continue his efforts, the words suddenly stopped, his eyes turned to one side, his face became very ugly.
Ivan turned his head in a puzzled way and found an old man with a white beard that Dougt was looking at. He was wearing a dark green robe with a blue-purple badge on his shoulders. The brows looked unique to Doug. It's a bit similar.
Ivan hadn't had time to think about the relationship between Dougt and the other party, and his calm complexion couldn't help but change, because Ivan suddenly found that the old principal Dumbledore, who hadn't seen him for a long time, was standing next to that person. Walked over.
"Albus, this is the little genius wizard you've been talking about just now?" The old wizard's bones seemed extraordinarily tough, and he was still full of breath when he spoke. He looked at Dumbledore and said with a smile.
"If you hadn't promised me all the time, I couldn't believe that a little wizard could come up with a solution to the werewolf problem."
"President Bohan, in fact, I am also very surprised that he can achieve such an achievement, but thinking about it, it seems that every time I meet Hals, I can be a new surprise!" Dumbledore said briskly, turning He blinked at Ivan.
"This makes me look forward to what it will look like the next time I meet."
Who wants to meet you? Ivan murmured speechlessly, but on the surface he said hello very well.
"Professor Dumbledore, Dean Bohan. I just made a wolf poison potion by accident. This is also due to Mr. Dougert’s years of teaching. Without the information he compiled when he studied werewolves, I couldn’t do it. Develop it."
Dean Bohan nodded unavoidably, then looked at Dougt again, and said suspiciously.
"I didn't know that besides causing trouble, you were still studying the werewolf problem after hiding in Knockoff Alley all these years? This is really surprising....It seems that you do some business occasionally."
"That's because you only believe in the things that come out of your mind, that's why you are so ignorant!" Dougte said angrily.
Dean Bohan didn't seem to have heard him. He chatted with Ivan happily, especially his praise for Ivan's price reduction and sales of wolf's poison potions.
The enthusiasm made Ivan a little overwhelmed, he even wondered if this Dean Bohan was also a werewolf, or how he cared so much about the wolf poison potion.
It didn't take long before Ivan realized that he was thinking too much.
From the conversation, Ivan quickly learned that the St. Mungo Hospital for Magical Injuries and Injuries has received dozens of patients who were scratched and bitten by werewolves over the years.
Most people missed the best treatment time when they came to the hospital. Bohan could only watch them being transformed, but was powerless.
This is undoubtedly a torture for Bohan, who is highly skilled in medicine.
Although the wolf poison potion developed by Ivan cannot cure the werewolves, it can reduce the number of similar werewolf riots and can also allow many innocent werewolf wizards to reintegrate into normal lives.
"Albus, I think Hals' contribution to the Ministry of Magic is enough to earn him a second-level Merlin Medal, what do you think?" Dean Bohan said with emotion.
"Well, I think so too. I will write to initiate the nomination tomorrow." Dumbledore nodded and agreed without hesitation.
Ivan was very surprised. He didn't expect that these two magicians would be willing to help him nominate the Merlin Medal.
On the way here just now, he learned from Dougt that in order to obtain the Merlin Medal, in addition to making enough merits, there must be a nominee line.
This nominee is best to be a recipient of the Merlin Medal, or someone who has a certain influence in the magic world.
If there is no nominator, the Merlin Knights will automatically initiate nominations, but the efficiency is hard to say.
This is also the reason why Dougter found these people this time, and desperately helped him brag, because it was to find a reliable nominee, and the patent registration was done incidentally.
"Thank you, Professor Dumbledore, and of course you... Dean Bohan!" Ivan said gratefully.
He understands that his merits are only enough for a third-level Merlin Medal. If he wants to obtain a second-level Merlin Medal, he must rely on the influence of these two bigwigs.
Although Ivan doesn’t catch a cold with the Merlin Medal, he won’t neglect these two people who helped him Ivan is about to say thank you again, but sees Dumbledore waving his hands. It’s rare. Sighed.
"No, I want to thank you, Hals, your wolf poison potion can save one of my werewolf friends. He has done a lot for me before, but over the years he has been impoverished as a werewolf wizard. I But there is nothing I can do, I can only watch..."
Werewolf friend? Ivan's thoughts moved, and he realized that Dumbledore was talking about Lupin the werewolf.
If he remembers correctly, the core member of the Order of the Phoenix, now because of his identity as a werewolf, should he still wander somewhere, right?
Could it be that Dumbledore deliberately called him back to become a professor of Defense Against the Dark Arts for the next school year?
Ivan looked forward to it. After all, Lockhart in the next school year is completely a parallel importer. Taking his Defense Against the Dark Arts class is simply a torture...
However, it seems impossible to think about it, because now there are only about ten days left to go to school, the choice of professor for the Defense Against the Dark Arts class should have been decided long ago...

chapters.title: Chapter 152: Sorry, this is the creator of the wolf poison potion
chapters.content:
The small talk with Dumbledore did not last long. It is worth mentioning that Ivan found that Dougte was there all the time like a transparent person, with a black face without any interruption.
It wasn't until Dean Bohan and Dumbledore moved away that Dougt came forward and patted Ivan on the shoulder.
"It's really hard for you..." Doug said with emotion.
Ivan didn't quite understand the meaning of Dougert's words, but he saw that Dougert had a very bad relationship with Dean Bohan, so it was a bit strange why Dougert invited him over.
"I didn't invite these two, they came by themselves!" Seemingly seeing Ivan's doubts, Dougt said with a sullen face and sullen expression.
"Let's go, I'll show you a few more friends!" Dougt quickly got his mind set, and took Ivan to the rest of the hall to talk with the remaining wizards.
After introducing them one by one, Ivan realized how widespread Dougte's popularity is. There are many wizards present at the Ministry of Magic, and some are even core members of the Merlin Knights.
This meeting in the main hall lasted for several hours, and Ivan, who kept a smiling face throughout, felt that he was about to laugh and paralyze.
"How long are we going to stay here?" Ivan rubbed his aching cheeks, and said very dissatisfied.
"Of course it was until night. Did you forget that today is the night of the full moon?" Dougt said with a low voice while smiling at the well-dressed wizards around him.
"Although the Ministry of Magic has already appraised your wolf poison potion and confirmed its effect, always find a werewolf to see the effect with his own eyes..."
Ivan nodded, but then turned to depressed thinking, why don't you come back tonight...
After a while, Ivan knew why.
Because after the bell rang in the night, a bunch of people hurried in. They looked like tabloid reporters in the Muggle world, holding old-fashioned cameras or parchment paper and shorthand pens in their hands. .
Several Aurors were working hard to maintain order nearby.
Ivan soon saw that Minister of Magic Fudge was also there.
After many days of absence, Fudge was already full of energy. While walking, talked about the current situation in the magical world.
In particular, the Ministry of Magic, under its own leadership, has successfully combated the proliferation of black magic items that has been plagued by the magic world, and arrested a large number of vicious black wizards.
Afterwards, Fudge showed his concern for the living conditions of the werewolf wizards again with a sad face, which attracted everyone to join in.
After entering the hall, a wizard dressed as a civil servant with glasses leaned in Fudge's ear and whispered a few words, and pointed in the direction of Ivan and Doug.
Fudge didn't hear a word, and with a kind smile on his mouth, he couldn't wait to walk over here, and said to Dougt.
"This is the creator of the wolf poison potion, right? I have to say that the potion you studied has changed the living conditions of werewolf wizards to a certain extent, and has made a great contribution to the magical world..."
Fudge enthusiastically prepared to shake hands with Dougert, but after a while, he found that the latter did not respond, but pointed to Ivan Dao with an embarrassed expression.
"Minister Fudge, this is the developer of the wolf poison potion."
The smile at the corner of Fudge's mouth froze immediately, and the hand stretched in the air didn't know whether to retract it or not.
On the field, only the sound of the camera shooting kept ringing, faithfully recording this rare scene.
A middle-aged witch in a magenta robe was even more excited and couldn't help herself. She wrote swiftly on the parchment. She felt that this would definitely be the headline news tomorrow!
If this article can pass the review smoothly...
Just as the atmosphere on the court became more awkward, Ivan stretched out his hand and shook Fudge.
"Minister Fudge, hello, I'm Ivan Hals, the developer of the wolf poison potion. I think we should have met before."
Having said this, Ivan paused, and then continued.
"In addition, you are not wrong before. Mr. Dougert is my enlightenment mentor of potions. I was able to develop the medicinal chamomile potion thanks to his help. In a sense, he is also one of the developers of the potion potion. ."
"Ah, yes... yes! That's what I meant just now!" Fudge quickly adjusted, and shook hands with Ivan forcefully, and drove down the donkey with his words, barely rounding it back.
At the same time, his gaze floated and stared at a certain clerk, but he turned back in time under the flickering of the camera lens, and his gaze looked at Ivan with a little more admiration.
Ivan didn't pay much attention to the change in Fudge's attitude. He said to help out the siege but worried that Fudge was too small-minded and would hate them for making ugly things in public.
However, Fudge became more and more interested in Ivan, especially after the executive director who listened to the side talked about the magic supplies recently purchased from the magic shop of Ivan’s house, he even appreciated it. Fan finally forced Ivan to take a few group photos.
After a lot of toss, seeing the time is almost up, Fudge suggested to go to the observation room to test the effect of the wolf poison potion.
Ivan readily agreed, he didn't want to stay here for a long time.
As a result, the group soon moved from the hall to the observation room downstairs, where there is full defense to prevent all accidents from happening.
The tester was an ordinary-looking werewolf wizard, and what Ivan had expected was that he turned out to be an employee of the Ministry of Magic.
"Can a werewolf work in the Ministry of Magic?" Ivan lowered his voice and asked Douglet quietly.
"Of course, the Ministry of Magic reserved a position for them in the Sports Department, which is responsible for doing chores. When the werewolf wizard can no longer do it, the Ministry will recruit another werewolf wizard to do the same job." Grid said tauntingly.
The chat between the two did not last long As the focus of everyone, Ivan was constantly stared at by several Magic News reporters.
In particular, one of the middle-aged witches with blonde hair and a big pie face kept looking at him, and from time to time they used a pen to record something on the parchment. Ivan heard someone call her in the crowd. For Rita Skeeter, he immediately became vigilant.
If he remembers correctly, Rita Skeeter is a reporter for the Daily Prophet and an illegal Animagus who turns into a beetle. He is best at writing all kinds of eye-catching gossip news.
As long as it can attract attention, making up things is commonplace...
(PS: Angel’s codeword speed is very slow. This is mentioned in the testimonials on the shelves. In addition, recent plots are more difficult to write, so it is more difficult to add. In addition, angels do not mean hydrology, but generally like to write. It’s more detailed. If you review the previous chapters, you will find that most of the chapters that are not useful have revealed certain information or hidden foreshadowing. Just like the first part, you will basically use it when you write it. Please be patient.)
Sogou

chapters.title: Chapter 153: Interview with Rita Skeeter
chapters.content:
When I saw Rita Skeeter, Ivan knew he was going to suffer.
Sure enough, after a moment of Kung Fu Rita Skeeter squeezed all the way, fiddled with the curly hair, leaned forward and stared at Ivan intently and said.
"Hello, Mr. Hals, I am Rita Skeeter, a reporter for the Daily Prophet. You can call me Mrs. Skeeter..."
Ivan frowned and didn't want to pay attention to the old woman, because he knew very well that no matter what he said, the other party could make up a lot of things.
Fortunately, Dougte stopped in time, glared at Rita, and said very dissatisfied.
"If you want to interview, please after the experiment is completed, Hals has no time to answer your questions before then."
Rita Skeeter didn't want to pay any attention to him at all, but Dougt was just like a tower horizontally in the center, and he didn't mean to give in at all.
"Well, I will have an exclusive interview later." Rita Skeeter had to put away her quill, but before leaving, she stared at Ivan and said.
"I mean, if your wolf poison potion is really useful..."
After speaking, Rita Skeeter twisted and walked away.
"Unexpectedly, the Daily Prophet would arrange this woman for an interview. She is not a good role to deal with..." Doug said with a headache.
"Then why did you agree to interview her for me just now? Wouldn't it be okay to just refuse it?" Ivan asked in confusion, he was not interested in cooperating with this difficult woman for an interview or something.
"The Daily Prophet is the largest newspaper in the magical world. It's best not to offend it casually, not to mention that if you don't accept the interview, they won't write related articles." Dougt explained.
After a pause, Dougt continued. "And I heard that this guy can be bought by money, you may be able to start from this aspect..."
Ivan muttered to himself, then I would have to have so much Jin Jialong.
Without a word, Ivan walked up to the stand of the observation room, which looked like a small Colosseum. The stands on all sides were raised high, and the center was a flat open space.
The werewolf wizard stood there early, looking a little nervous, motioned to the crowd, and drank the dark brown potion in his hand.
Ivan looked at the hanging clock in the distance, and it was late at night in five minutes.
As time gets closer,
The surrounding Aurors who were in charge of protection clenched the wands in their hands, staring at the figure on the platform vigilantly, ready to subdue it after the opponent ran away.
The werewolf wizard keenly noticed this, with a bitter expression on his face, only when he turned his gaze to Ivan, did he show a little gratitude.
Under the focus of everyone's eyes, five minutes passed slowly.
The werewolf wizard suddenly shuddered, his body gradually elongated, his thin arms grew frantically with hair, and his nails became sharp and slender...
The most shocking thing is the huge wolf head with fangs, and the terrifying appearance makes many observing wizards frown frequently.
But in contrast, after the transformation was completed, the werewolf wizard was a bit at a loss under the gaze of everyone, and looked very uncomfortable, trying hard to cover it with his long-haired arm. The sight of everyone.
As Dougte said before, most werewolves are reluctant to let others see their ugly appearance after transforming.
Although most of the wizards present were honorable, they saw the transformation of a werewolf wizard for the first time, so they all looked at it with interest.
"It seems that the werewolves are not as scary as the legend, and I don't know why every year there are adult wizards being attacked by werewolves."
Seeing the trembling look of the werewolf on the field, Stamp shook his head in disappointment. This performance was really inconsistent with the ferocious look of the werewolf he imagined.
"That's because of the effect of the wolf's poison potion, or alone, the werewolf has bitten your throat now!" Marcus interrupted Stamp's conjecture very unceremoniously.
As a wizard who has been in contact with a large number of werewolves at close range, Marcus is well aware of the difficulties and horrors of werewolves, and naturally he can't listen to Stamp's nonsense.
The two quickly quarreled, attracting the attention of the wizard on the side.
Ivan's attention is not here, his eyes have been fixed on the few people in the front row of the stands, they are the ones who can really make the decision.
Dumbledore's azure blue pupils under his half-moon glasses carefully looked at the werewolf's body, as if he was confirming the state of the other party, and he spoke first before long.
"It seems that Mr. Hals's wolf poison potion is very successful... it perfectly maintains the sanity of the werewolf wizard."
"Well, yes, I think so too!" Fudge nodded with satisfaction. Although he didn't have much research on werewolves, he saw a transformed werewolf squatting there shivering, like a dog. .
That's enough, isn't it?
Dean Bohan leaned in at the first time. He didn't care about the guard of the Auror. He ran to the werewolf wizard to inquire about the other party's status. He tapped the wand on the werewolf's body from time to time. ...
The camera lights flickered all around, and Rita Skeeter took out a quill pen to record something, and even wanted to get in for an interview.
The expression of the werewolf wizard became more bitter, and only when he glanced at Ivan did he show a little gratitude.
After waiting for a while until it was confirmed that the werewolf had completely lost his aggressiveness, Fudge walked slowly to the stage and met with the werewolf wizard. After a long and boring speech,
Fudge smiled and held the palm of the werewolf, and made a final summary. Werewolf wizards are no different from normal wizards. They are all part of the magic world!
Ivan thought maliciously, if the werewolf wizard on the stage suddenly lost control and infected Fudge, would the Minister of Magic still laugh out.
It is a pity that his wolf poison potion works very well, and the werewolf wizard did not have the guts to attack the Minister of Magic.
Leaving the venue, Ivan followed Dougt to the patent office on the seventh floor of the basement to register the wolf poison potion, and then saw Rita Skeeter as soon as the door opened. She just stood by the door of the patent office, seemingly waiting It's been a long time.
"Then, our little genius Mr. Ivan Hals, can we start the interview now?" Rita Skeeter said with a smile.
"Of course, if you want to know something." Ivan shrugged, it didn't matter.
Just ask, he is not as good at dealing with Harry...
Sogou

chapters.title: Chapter 154: We can sit down and have a good talk now
chapters.content:
After obtaining the authorization for the exclusive interview, the two men sat down in an uninterrupted inquiry room.
Rita Skeeter couldn't wait to take out a roll of parchment and a shorthand quill from her crocodile leather handbag, put them aside, and then looked at Ivan with a sweet smile on her lips.
"I am accustomed to using shorthand quill pens to record. Wouldn't you object? That way I can talk to you without distraction."
"No, I object!" Ivan said without hesitation.
"That's good..." Rita Skeeter replied subconsciously, and then realized what Ivan was talking about, and the smile on the corner of her mouth froze for a while.
She never thought that the person interviewed would say that...
"No? Why?" Rita tried to maintain the professional smile on her face, asking every word.
Ivan looked at her with suspicion, tapped his fingers on the table, and spoke slowly.
"Mrs. Skeeter, you are against professional ethics like this. This makes me wonder if you have to rely on this magical quill pen to write a decent article..."
"Perhaps I can reflect to the editor-in-chief of the Daily Prophet and ask them to hire your quill pen!" Ivan did not give Rita any face in his words.
When she saw her take out the shorthand quill, Ivan knew that this interview would not be 100% peaceful.
Because that pen is the most important "magic weapon" of Rita Skeeter, the one who is best at adding fuel and jealousy to tampering with the interviewer's words into all kinds of explosive content, the basis for spreading rumors is even better than Rita Skeeter himself Awesome!
Rita Skeeter was very angry for a while, and under Ivan's suspicious gaze, she had to take out a new quill pen from the package.
Her professionalism cannot be questioned by anyone!
"Shall we start now? Mr. Hals?" Rita took a few deep breaths, calmed her emotions, and said with a smile.
"Of course, there is no problem!" Ivan nodded, he felt that Rita should not have a second shorthand quill.
"Then the first question, how did you think of researching wolf poison potions?" Rita asked.
"Knockdown Alley is the gathering place for werewolf wizards. I often contact them and understand their plight. That's why the idea of ​​developing a wolf poison potion was born..." Ivan carefully considered the sentence and tried to use short words as much as possible. Speak clearly, so as not to be caught by the other party.
"You often come into contact with werewolves? Why? What makes you take such a big risk?"
Rita Skeeter immediately found the part she was interested in from Ivan's words, her eyes lighted up, and the heavily-makeup face moved closer, and said excitedly.
"Is it because of your little werewolf girlfriend?"
In a short period of time, Rita Skeeter had already made up a poignant love story, and her hand with the quill began to tremble, trying to write something.
"There are no female werewolves among my friends!" Ivan rolled his eyes and interrupted.
Rita Skeeter was very disappointed. She had already thought of a story, but she couldn't write it. Thinking of this, Rita Skeeter said unwillingly.
"Then do you have any other emotional experiences in school?"
Ivan shook his head without hesitation, trying to cut off Rita Skeeter's last thoughts of making up her mind.
However, Ivan seriously underestimated Rita Skeeter's ability to talk nonsense. She didn't care what others said. With just a few words, she could piece together the sentences she wanted.
The sharp-eyed Ivan clearly saw Rita Skeeter holding a quill pen and writing such a paragraph on the parchment.
[Ivan Hals pays much attention to male werewolves and is ashamed of mentioning his relationship history. It seems unspeakable...]
After writing, Rita Skeeter smiled cordially at Ivan.
The blue veins on Ivan's forehead jumped wildly, and he regretted that he didn't learn the Forgetting Curse, otherwise, he could beat the old woman violently, and then use the Forgetting Curse to erase all her memories...
"Mrs. Skeeter, I must remind you that I will only be in the second grade next school year, and you may not have any credibility in writing your relationship history." Ivan retorted, holding back his anger.
"Is that so?" Rita nodded thoughtfully, and crossed out the sentences just written.
Just as Ivan breathed a sigh of relief, Rita continued to write.
[The potion genius Ivan Hals yearned for a love very much, but his too young age made him suffer setbacks in the process of searching for love, and in the end he could only be with a werewolf..]
Ivan is completely speechless, so no matter what questions Rita Skeeter asks, Ivan will not answer.
It's just that this old woman is obviously not upset. She looked at Ivan's expression on her own, and added a large analysis sentence to portray Ivan on the parchment as a arrogant and indifferent monster with many quirks. Medicine genius.
Rita Skeeter felt that such an image would surely arouse the public's attention, while Ivan coldly watched more and more content recorded on the parchment.
"Okay, that's all for today's interview?" Rita Skeeter nodded in satisfaction after writing the parchment she brought, she felt that this content was enough to occupy the headlines for several days. .
Just as Rita Skeeter was packing her crocodile leather handbag and stood up and was about to leave, Ivan, who had been silent for a long time, suddenly spoke.
"Mrs. Skeeter, please wait a moment..."
Rita Skeeter gave a look, then turned her head, but then heard Ivan continue.
"Or I should call you an illegal Animagus shapeshifter, Ms. Beetle!"
Rita Skeeter's figure trembled suddenly, staring at Ivan in disbelief, but soon a smirk rose from the corner of her mouth.
"Mr. Hals, I don't quite understand what you mean..." Rita Skeeter pretended to be calm.
"Really? As long as I understand it!" Ivan raised his eyebrows, looked at her playfully, and said casually.
Rita Skeeter was really not sure if Ivan was doing her own routine, but after thinking about it, she found it impossible, because Ivan accurately said that her Animagus metamorphosis was a beetle.
But this secret should not be known to anyone...
"There are no absolute secrets in the world, right?" Ivan changed his expression and pointed to the seat in front of him. "I think we can sit down now and have a good talk..."
Sogou

chapters.title: Chapter 155: How much did you give to that reporter?
chapters.content:
Rita Skeeter hesitated and sat down reluctantly, worried that Ivan had any decisive evidence.
In fact, even if there is no evidence, Ivan only needs to report to the Ministry of Magic to cause her huge troubles.
After all, in order to write explosive articles over the years, she has often used the Animagus form to track the interviewee, or sneak into the other party's home to get some secret information.
This not only violates the regulations of the Ministry of Magic, but also offends a large number of prestigious wizards. If the identity of the illegal Animagus is revealed by Ivan, then she will most likely be imprisoned in Azkaban. ..
"Where is the parchment?" Ivan said with a more serious tone.
Rita Skeeter touched her crocodile leather handbag, and Ivan snatched it as soon as she took it out.
Looking at the nonsense on the parchment, Ivan rudely tore it to pieces in front of Rita Skeeter.
"You... how dare you..." Rita Skeeter's eyes widened, her lips trembled as she wanted to say something, but Ivan's words were held back in Ivan's indifferent gaze. .
"Rewrite, I watched!" Ivan knocked on the table and said.
Rita Skeeter hesitated, and finally reluctantly took out a new roll of parchment and wrote on it again.
Under Ivan's gaze, Rita Skeeter thought about all kinds of praise.
At first, it was not going well, but after writing a few paragraphs, Rita Skeeter seemed to have found inspiration. The more she wrote, the more excited she became, and finally she was completely released...
Ivan was dumbfounded when he watched from the side.
Especially in a certain paragraph that he had the general mind of the Minister of Magic when he was eight years old, and he often thought about the future of the magic world under the silent night sky...
"Ahem..." Ifan couldn't help but coughed slightly.
Rita Skeeter, who was writing to the point, looked up at Ivan suspiciously.
"I think what you wrote needs to be corrected a bit." Yifan reminded concisely.
Fix it? Rita Skeeter didn't quite understand the meaning of Ivan's words, but then suddenly realized.
It must be that she hasn't boasted enough!
Rita Skeeter thought of this, and decided to go back after she decided to polish it up and try to make the other party satisfied.
.......
When the two came out of the inquiry room, Dougert just finished talking with the Director of the Patent Office.
After seeing Rita Skeeter shook hands with Ivan with a smirk on her face, she ran away in a hurry as if she had encountered a nemesis without looking back. She was a little worried and turned to Ivan. Said.
"Did you offend that old woman? She is not a broad-minded person..."
"No, we had a very good chat, you will know by reading the Daily Prophet!" Ivan shrugged and said indifferently.
Dougter was very curious, and didn't quite understand why Ivan had such a great confidence, but he knew some details about Rita Skeeter.
As the most famous journalist of the Daily Prophet, Rita Skeeter is best at digging out all kinds of fierce materials. People who are targeted by her opponent usually fall into various troubles and scandals. No one has ever known about Rita Skeeter. How did Kit learn about these secret messages.
Ivan shook his head and did not intend to disclose more information. He was able to stop Rita Skeeter because he had read the original and knew the weakness of the other party and was unable to prove the source of the information with Dougte.
Dougert had to resist the curiosity in his heart and led him away from the Ministry of Magic.
It was almost early in the morning when I returned home, Ivan sent away Dougte, and briefly explained to Aysia that the trip went well, so he lay down sleepy.
......
On Wednesday morning, Ivan, who was eating breakfast, was yawning. In a flash, she saw flocks of owls flying in from the door, window, and fireplace.
Owl disaster at home?
Before I could understand what happened, he saw countless envelopes falling from the air, piled up high, almost overwhelming the dining table, accompanied by some Owl feathers.
Except for the envelope, Ivan saw that there was a newspaper mixed with it, Ivan reached out and took it, and found that it was the Daily Prophet, which was sent by Rita Skeeter.
The front page dynamic photo of the newspaper was the one taken with the werewolf before leaving the observation room with Fudge.
Below is Rita Skeeter’s article. Ivan read it carefully and found that not only did she not listen to her own opinions, but she also wrote the content even more exaggerated, making her laugh and cry.
But Ivan also had to admit that Rita Skeeter's writing is indeed good.
A few paragraphs made him appear as a potion genius on paper. Coupled with a few touching stories made up by Rita Skeeter, Ivan was moved to cry when he saw it.
"What the **** is going on?" After hearing the movement, Aysia, who walked out of the kitchen, still holding the kitchen utensils in her hand, looked at the envelopes full of the room blankly.
"Well, I don't know too much, probably because of this?" Ivan waved the Daily Prophet in his hand.
Aysia picked it up curiously, and after a few glances, her expression became more and more strange.
"How much did you give to that reporter? How would she help you?"
"I didn't give a copper Nat. Maybe the reporter of the Daily Prophet thought I was just such a person..." Ivan spread his hands and said innocently.
Aysia smiled and squeezed Ivan's cheek, she didn't believe a word...
Afterwards, the two together used magic spells to collect the envelopes on the ground Under the influence of magic, countless letters were collected and piled neatly in the corner.
Ivan opened a letter casually and read it, and found that it was a letter from a werewolf wizard. The content of the letter was deep and affectionate. It was all thanks to him for caring so much about the living conditions of the werewolf wizard and praised his contribution to the werewolf.
Ivan blushed a little when he saw that, he didn't know that he had done so many things for the werewolf.
At the end of the envelope, there was also a deposit for the first batch of wolf poisoning potions.
"Should these letters have the same content, right? When will the reply be returned?" Ivan stared at the letters piled up in front of him with a headache.
"A lot of people who want this treatment don't have this chance yet." Aysia gave him a blank look, but still helped to open the envelope and count the number of people who ordered the wolf's poison potion.
Regarding the specific reply, Ivan remembered the answering quill in the store. As long as he slightly changed the judgment mechanism, he could automatically reply.

chapters.title: Chapter 156: Book list and at Lihen Bookstore
chapters.content:
With the help of the answering quill, the efficiency of replying has been increased several times. Ivan only needs to open the envelope and read it again, then put it aside, and the quill on the table will automatically start writing the reply.
Even so, Ivan still spent a full morning,
When I opened the last envelope, Ivan found that this letter was different from the others, it was sent from the school.
The specific content is to let him go to King's Cross Station to take a train to school on September 1st, and the second-grade book list is also attached.
Ivan simply scanned it, and in addition to a few professional books for each subject, there were seven Lockhart's books, and the price was more expensive than one.
Ivan suddenly understood who the professor was for the Defense Against the Dark Arts class next semester.
However, Lockhart's shameless realm also surprised him, and he was surprised to use his status as a professor to let Hogwarts students to increase the sales of books....
"Mom, you might have to give me more Jin Jialong. This year's book is extra expensive, maybe dozens of Jialong." Looking at the price marked above, Ivan sighed and had to ask for help. .
Although he has solicited a lot of business for his family's magic shop, after all, it was Aysia who collected the money, and he couldn't get it at all, and the golden Jialong accumulated before was almost used up.
"Dozens of gallons? So expensive?" Aisia, who was helping to gather the replies, took the book list curiously and glanced twice.
"Gidro Lockhart?" Aysia said in surprise.
"Mom, do you know him?" Ivan had a bad feeling. If he remembered it correctly, Lockhart seemed to be a friend of women and had countless fans in the magic world.
Fortunately, Ivan soon saw Aisia shook his head.
"No, I don't know it, but I heard it a little bit. I heard that he is a powerful character. The book he wrote has won the recognition of many famous people."
"It looks like you will have a great Defence Against the Dark Arts class next school year." Aysia said with a smile.
Ivan curled his lips. This guy is a parallel importer, so it's better to forget the spell.
But Ivan didn't tell Esiamin that this guy will show up as soon as he becomes a professor in the next school year. Even if the basilisk incident does not cause memory loss, it is estimated that he will be in trouble.
Aysia helped Ivan organize the list, then took out a hundred Jin Jialong from the cabinet and put it in a magic bag and handed it to Ivan.
"These should be enough, and the rest is for you to use in school." Aysia said very generously.
A hundred gold gallons is not a small sum. If Ivan did not perform well during the summer vacation and never spends money randomly, Aysia would not be assured that a child would hold such a large sum of money.
In fact, Aysia wanted to stop business for a long time and took this opportunity to take Ivan to take a stroll in Diagon Alley, but this idea was rejected by Ivan.
Ivan didn't go to Liheng Academy just to buy books. More importantly, he remembered that one of the ways he could earn grade points was to read through magic books.
As long as the progress reaches 100%, you will be able to get rewards of student status equivalent to the difficulty, and you will be able to improve your magic knowledge.
Therefore, in the remaining few days before school starts, Yifan plans to go to the Lihen Bookstore to see as much as he can.
Of course, Esiah couldn't be closed for a few days, especially when the business had just turned better, so she had no choice but to dispel the idea of ​​accompany.
"Otherwise, let Dougt accompany you these days." Aysia was somewhat worried that Ivan walked through Knockdown Alley alone.
"No, I would rather drink the compound decoction alone!" Ivan shook his head resolutely.
He was fed up with the **** of Doug, and there was nothing good about going out with him every time except for the Ministry of Magic.
"Okay, then," Aysia sighed and agreed with Ivan, who was stubborn, but then reminded him again. "You are not allowed to go out like me."
Ivan nodded, he didn't have the habit of becoming the opposite sex.
Back in the room, Ivan took out the compound decoction placed in the drawer, which he had boiled before, and can be used by adding other people's hair.
Thinking about it, Ivan added a piece of hair he had collected and took a sip, which was estimated to be enough for him to get out of Knockout Alley.
In the next moment, Ivan felt as if his body was torn apart, and numbness spread all over his body, followed by dislocation of bones, stretched skin, and stretched the originally fitted robe.
Ivan felt a little miscalculated. He actually forgot about the things that would break his clothes after transforming. He should have prepared in advance.
Fortunately, this little thing could not be difficult for Ivan, who was already close to level 5 in Transfiguration. Under the wave of his wand, the clothes that had been broken were quickly restored, and then became wider and larger under the effect of Transfiguration.
Putting on his clothes, Ivan stood in front of the mirror again, looking at the 17- or 18-year-old man opposite, with some freckles on his face, just exactly the same as Walker.
The reason why he chose to become him is naturally because there are not many people he can come into contact with every day, only the hair of Aysia, Doug, and Walker.
He didn't plan to transform into the middle-aged man Dougt, the only choice was this.
"Mom, then I'll go out first." Before leaving, Ivan greeted Asiah who was still sending the letter.
Aysia turned her head and looked at the seventeen or eighteen-year-old young wizard in front of her with a weird expression, but she nodded.
This is also the reason why Esiah did not let Ivan become herself, it always feels weird...
......
Walking alone in the streets of Knockdown Alley Ivan felt another experience, and there seemed to be some malice in the surroundings.
Along the way, Ivan met several times with strangers, some who promoted all kinds of goods, and some invited him to "certain places" to have fun...
But none of them dared to do it. Even so, Ivan had to be tougher to make these people retreat.
When he was about to leave Knockout Alley, Ivan found that the street leading to Diagon Alley on this side was half blocked. A grinning old witch was pulling a small wizard in front of him.
The wizards around seemed to have not seen them, and there were a few wizards squatting in the corner, which should be watching the excitement.
Ivan raised his eyebrows and was hesitating to interfere or detour, only to find that the figure of the little wizard was somewhat familiar.
That seems to be Harry Potter?
But what about Hagrid? Where did he go?

chapters.title: Chapter 157: Let's go... Brother takes you to a good place...
chapters.content:
I am not lost, madam, where I want to go is right there..."
Knock Knock Alley, the intersection of the intersection, Harry hurriedly vetoed his captured right hand in a panic.
"It doesn't matter, my dear, I can take you there. Are you going to go home? Then just follow me..." The old witch grinned, showing moss-grown teeth, and said softly. Dao, kindly like the grandmother next door.
But Harry felt cold all over, and the opponent's skinny arms were unexpectedly strong, and violently grabbed his shoulders, pulling him towards the inside of Knockout Alley.
Harry didn't know what the consequences would be after he was taken away, but there would be nothing good if he thought about it. He immediately looked at the wizards around him with help-seeking eyes, hoping that anyone could help him.
However, what Harry didn’t expect was that so many wizards around him didn’t even bother him. He even saw a few wizards squatting in the corner, wearing ragged robes, smiling at him, but the smile contained With more special meaning.
"Madam, I don't know you at all!" Harry tried to persuade the old witch in front of him to let him go, regretting why he made a mistake when using Floo powder, or that he shouldn't use it at all. For the fireplace.
"We will meet soon..." the old witch said with a strange smile, gently tapping Harry's cheek with her right hand holding the wand.
"Harry, why did you get here?"
Just when Harry felt desperate, a voice rang behind him, and the two pulling and pulling heard the voice and immediately turned their heads to look over, only to realize that the person speaking was a young wizard of seventeen or eighteen years old.
After hesitating, the young wizard had already walked up to him and put his hand on his other shoulder. Harry felt his body torn apart by the drag of the two, and hurriedly said.
"Madam, my friend came to pick me up, can you let me go?"
Harry didn't know who the young wizard was in front of him, but still knew that the other party might come to save him, so he decisively leaned on the young wizard's side.
"Hunboy, young..." Seeing the young man came, the old witch frowned and was about to curse, but before that, Ivan suddenly started to do it.
"Except for your weapons!"
The red magical light directly hit the body, and the old witch was knocked out by the light and hit the street wall behind. A weird-looking magic wand came out, hitting Xuan'er and landed on Ivan. Hands.
At this time, the fall was terrible, and the old witch felt that her bones were about to fall apart, and it took a long time to regain her strength, and her heart burst into anger.
She didn't expect that a little devil who seemed to be eighteen or nineteen years old would come up and act directly, so she was caught off guard.
Even if the old witch stretched her hand into her arms, she drew something out, but before that, Ivan's wand had been pointed at the tip of her nose, and the black magic power condensed at the top of the wand could be excited at any time.
"You move again, I'll chop off your hand!" Ivan stared at the hand of the old witch and warned.
Ivan is very clear that he does not have the deterrence brought by Hagrid's huge body. Only with some more direct and powerful means can he force the other party to recognize the facts!
The old witch stared at Ivan angrily, but did not dare to make extra moves. If she were to change to a small wizard of average size, she might also gamble on the other side's mercy.
But Yifan's performance just now made her understand that the other party would really be ruthless!
Ivan threw the wand he had just captured into another alley in the distance. It happened to fall at the feet of a shabby wizard lying there, and then said to the old witch.
"Get out! Better not let me see you again!"
Lost the wand, and was pointed at by the other party's wand, even if the old witch was too angry, she had to get up from the ground obediently and leave. Especially after seeing that the wand thrown into another alley was picked up, he changed his face and hurriedly chased it.
Harry watched this scene, feeling relieved, but he did not forget to turn his head to express his gratitude to the enthusiastic young wizard.
"Thank you, sir!"
Ivan saw the change in Harry's expression in his heart, and intentionally let Harry understand the cruelty of the wizarding world, and grinned in fright.
"Don't thank you so quickly, kid!"
"First... sir..." Harry watched at the young wizard who had helped him change his face instantly, and the heart he had just put down was lifted up instantly, and he stammered.
Ivan looked at Harry's look of fear, and it felt very funny. He tried hard not to laugh, but in the end he couldn't help but laughed strangely.
"Let's go, brother takes you to a good place..."
After speaking, Ivan pushed Harry forward. The latter's heart became more and more flustered, tremblingly thinking that he might be killed today, and praying in his heart whether he could come to save himself again.
However, fate obviously won't take care of a person twice in a row. Harry walked all the way without waiting for the second savior.
The only thing that made Harry somewhat thankful was that the other party at least walked in the direction of Diagon Alley.
Stepping from the gloomy Knockdown Alley into the bustling Diagon Alley, Harry’s inner tension relaxed a little, but it didn’t take long, because he soon discovered that this strange young wizard was pulling him to go. Walking in remote places.
When Harry gathered up his courage and was about to scream, he suddenly saw the young wizard stretch out his wand and click on his clothes.
When Harry was strange, his eyes widened suddenly because he clearly saw the body of the young wizard in front of him was shrinking, getting shorter and shorter, the one with some freckles His face also changed into another look he was very familiar with. The clothes on his body shrank in sync with his figure, and it didn't take long for him to become a little wizard about his size.
"Ivan?!" Harry stared at this scene blankly.
"Hi! Harry, it's been a long time!" Ivan greeted freely after turning his head to relieve the transformation spell on his clothes.
"What's going on? How could you... how could you become that person? No, how could that person become you?" Harry felt that his brain was not enough, and his words seemed a little confused.
"This is the effect of the compound decoction, um... it's a potion that can be transformed into someone else's appearance." Yifan explained.
Harry nodded, and then remembered that he had been walking with Ivan in fear, and then said angrily with a puffed face.
"Then why didn't you tell me earlier, I thought I was going to be kidnapped just now!"

chapters.title: Chapter 158: Can we be a guest in Knockturn Alley?
chapters.content:
Facing the angry Harry, Ivan calmly explained.
"Harry! Knockoff Alley is a very dangerous place, you saw it just now.
The person I transformed into is not very old and has no deterrent effect. It is easy to be targeted by people just taking you like this, so it is better to be a little bit fierce and pretend to be a bad person. "
"Is that so?" Harry asked dubiously.
"Of course..." Ivan said with a vow.
Harry faintly felt that Ivan was fooling himself, but couldn't find evidence.
"By the way, Harry, why did you come to Knockdown Alley?" Ivan hurriedly changed the subject.
Naturally, Harry didn't mean to conceal it. He told him about the accidental use of Floo powder when he was choked by soot to pronounce the wrong words.
Ivan nodded, and it didn't seem to have changed much from the original, but I didn't know why he didn't meet Hagrid this time.
But after thinking about it, Ivan realized it again. Hagrid met Harry because he happened to buy something in Knockover Alley. As long as there is a slight error in time, the course of action of both sides will be diverged. It may be he who sent it. Some butterfly effects caused by the letter to George and Fred.
Fortunately, Harry was lucky enough to be able to meet himself, otherwise, the savior of the magic world might really be cold.
There were countless questions in Harry's heart, such as what Ivan was doing in Knockoff Alley, and why he became like that.
As the two walked all the way, Harry said one by one the questions in his heart.
"Why?" Ivan stopped moving forward, and then spoke to Harry.
"Because my house is in Knockdown Alley! I came out this time to buy books for the next school year. I am too young to be safe, so I have to use compound decoction to make myself look more deterrent."
"You live in such a dangerous place? Why don't you move to another place?" Harry looked at Ivan in surprise. He really couldn't understand how Ivan lived in such a place.
He had only been inside for a short while, and even so, he had already experienced the indifference and danger of Knockout Alley, and was almost dragged away by the street, so he had some psychological shadow on Knockout Alley.
"Of course it's because of poverty!" Ivan rolled his eyes and said, if he earned enough Jin Jialong, the ghost would be willing to stay there.
Harry was silent for a moment, and there was a hint of pity in his eyes when he looked at Ivan.
Before that, Harry had always thought that living in his uncle's house was the worst thing in the world.
But after seeing these people in Knockturn Alley, Harry suddenly felt that his living environment might not be too bad, at least no one would try to kidnap him there, let alone become someone else's when traveling like Ivan. Looks good.
Thinking that he and his parents had left a large inheritance, Harry hesitated whether to use it to help his best friends, perhaps by lending them to them first.
When Harry made up his mind to ask questions, Ivan shook his head amusedly and refused, then watched Harry and said.
"Did you not read the Daily Prophet? I have produced a new type of potion, which sells very well. The orders received today will flood my house. It won't be long before I can move out."
Harry nodded. He remembered that Mr. Weasley was stunned when he was reading the Daily Prophet in the morning, and he handed the newspaper to everyone.
Harry also saw the contents of the newspaper. The front page was a photo of Ivan and the Minister of Magic. It was written that Ivan had invented a potion that could treat werewolves, and made a significant contribution to the magical world.
It's a pity that Harry didn't know much about the magic world, and didn't quite understand the value of this potion.
However, he heard George and Fred conscientiously saying that Ivan must be able to get something called the Merlin Medal. Mrs. Weasley thought it was impossible because Ivan was too young. No wizard had ever been able to get it before. Received the Merlin Medal in this grade.
The three of them argued for several hours, and almost missed the time to come to Diagon Alley!
Along the way, Harry walked in the direction of Lihen Bookstore, while telling Ivan an interesting story about himself in the Burrow, and finally asked curiously.
"What is the Merlin Medal? I think everyone cares about it."
"That's a symbolic thing, it's not of much use!" Ivan said casually, thinking that this thing had Jin Jialong hair before, but it didn't work at all.
Harry didn't believe it, because Mr. Weasley was envious when he talked about the Merlin Medal, and Percy was even more jealous, threatening that he would definitely get it in a few years.
"Ivan... Harry!"
When the two reached Gringotts, they unexpectedly saw a little witch with shaggy hair in front of them greeted them.
"Hermione!" Ivan shifted the route and walked over. The little witch ran off the standing steps quickly, stepped up to hug him, and then broke free, chatting non-stop. .
"I wrote a lot of letters to you throughout the summer, but I don't know where you live. I wrote to Harry. I wanted to ask him, but he didn't reply at all."
Hermione was also a little angry when she said this, because Ivan hadn't sent her even a single letter throughout the summer, nor did Harry. She had clearly stated where her family lived.
Harry hurriedly explained, telling the story of Dobby's interception of the envelope.
Ivan was speechless. There were so many things that happened during his summer vacation. He couldn't stop all day long, otherwise he was obsessed with alchemy and couldn't help himself, so he completely forgot about this mess.
But looking at Hermione's angry look, Ivan had to start thinking about the reason Fortunately, the Weasley family who was looking for Harry rushed over and diverted Hermione's attention.
"Harry, where were you teleported to just now?" Mr. Weasley said, breathing heavily. "Just now we have been searching for a long time and haven't found you, Molly is crazy!"
George, Ron, Fred and others who followed over noticed Ivan on the side and greeted him happily.
Harry also took advantage of this time to stray himself into Knockover Alley and was almost dragged away. Finally, he told me about Ivan's rescue.
In particular, it was mentioned that Ivan knocked down that nasty old witch all at once, so that the other party could only flee in embarrassment.
"It's cool! You deserve it!" George looked at Ivan and couldn't help but said. He thought this must be a wonderful adventure.
Fred also wanted to experience this stimulating feeling, so he said to Ivan.
"We always wanted to see it in Knockdown Alley, but it's a pity that my mother never let us get close there. Can we go to your house to play?"

chapters.title: Chapter 159: The most evil black wizards live in Knock Down Alley!
chapters.content:
Go to Knockoff Alley as a guest?
Ivan looked at the two men who were burning up as the souls of death, and planned to refuse, but it was Mrs. Weasley's roar that was faster than him!
"How can you think so?"
A long distance away, Mrs. Weasley heard George and Fred's death speech, so she came up and patted the two on the head and said angrily.
"Knockdown Alley is the most dangerous place in the entire magic world! The most evil black wizards live there!"
"Mom, how can you say that? Ivan lives in Knockdown Alley." George covered his head with his hands, but he retorted.
Only then did Mrs. Weasley notice that Ivan was here, and she was a little overwhelmed and said vaguely.
"Oh, sorry, kid, I didn't mean that..."
"It's okay," Ivan shook his head, saying that he didn't care, and turned to George and Weasley. "Mrs. Weasley is right. Knockover Alley is very dangerous. It's not a place you can drop by."
The two were dubious, but Ivan's refusal made it difficult for them to inquire about Knockturn Alley.
But soon, George thought of something, took out the Daily Prophet folded in his pocket, and said to Ivan excitedly.
"Ivan, in the morning, we saw in the newspaper that you developed a wolf poison potion, and there was a photo of you and the Minister of Magic! Is this true? We told my mother that you would definitely get the Merlin Medal. But she doesn't believe it!"
Hearing George's words, everyone's eyes gathered, looking at Ivan, they also want to know if this is true.
In the eyes of everyone, Ivan nodded casually and said. "Yes, I was nominated for the Merlin Medal because of the development of the wolf poison potion. Professor Dumbledore is willing to be my nominee..."
"That's great!" George said very excitedly. With Dumbledore as the nominee, Ivan is already a sure thing to get the Merlin Medal.
Fred turned his head to look at Mrs. Weasley and spoke.
"Mom, let's just say Ivan can definitely do it!"
"I heard..." Mrs. Weasley rolled her eyes and said angrily.
She didn't have any opinion on Ivan, but George and Fred used Ivan's name to excuse them when they were at home, so as to study their messy jokes and toy goods.
"Merlin Medal, what's that?" Hermione's father, Mr. Granger, was confused at the hearing, and couldn't help asking.
"It's an award in the magic world, the highest honor! Everyone who wins has made an outstanding contribution to the magic world!" Arthur explained, then looked at Ivan with admiration, and then said.
"The potion Hals developed solved the werewolf riot problem that plagued the magic world, so it was nominated for the Merlin Medal."
"Is it the same as our Nobel Prize? That's really amazing!" Mr. Granger looked at Ivan as just as old as his daughter, suddenly surprised.
"Nobel Prize? What's that?" This time it was the Weasley's turn to be confused.
I have to say that the generation gap between wizards and Muggles is still very large. Fortunately, there is a middleman like Hermione. After some explanation, everyone quickly understands.
"Hmm.. So it seems that it's almost the same." Although Arthur thought that Muggle awards could not be compared with wizarding world awards, there were still some similarities between the two in nature.
"Ivan, I didn't expect you to do such an important thing in the summer vacation. I misunderstood you before." Hermione turned her head embarrassedly and looked at Ivan.
Since she hadn't read today's newspaper, Hermione didn't know that Ivan had done such a big thing before.
She felt that Ivan must be busy researching wolf poison potions during the summer vacation, so she didn't have time to write to her.
Hermione still read the report about werewolves in the book. It was a cruel creature. Every night of the full night, he would lose his mind, transform into a monster and attack the innocent.
Ivan immediately nodded following Hermione's thoughts, indicating that he was such a busy person for the peace of the magical world that he couldn't stop.
The group just talked and laughed and went to Lihen Bookstore together.
On the way, George and Fred quietly wanted to discuss with Ivan about making jokes about the toy store next school year, but Mrs. Weasley took them very tightly and did not allow them to discuss those pranks.
What surprised Ivan slightly was that Arthur actually took the initiative to chat with him, and even asked about some of his family situation.
After a few simple responses, Ivan asked curiously.
"Do you know my mother?"
"Um... not quite familiar..." Arthur hesitated for a moment, then said. "But my father and I have had some intersections..."
"My father? Can you tell me who he is? My mother never tells me this." Ivan suddenly became interested and asked.
Although Ivan is a fake who crossed over halfway and doesn't care much about his father, it is definitely impossible to say that he is not curious.
"How could Asiah be like this? Because of that thing, she actually kept it from you for more than ten years!" Mrs. Weasley also realized who Ivan's child is at this time, looked at him in astonishment, and said in disbelief.
"Did my father do anything bad?" Ivan frowned, feeling a little messy.
"No, no, not at all!" Mrs. Weasley increased her tone and looked at Ivan with a little more pity, she said softly. "Child, don't think so, your father has never done anything wrong, he is a hero!"
"Mrs. Weasley, can you tell me?" Ivan felt even more weird, if that's the caseAsiah has no reason not to tell him.
"Of course..." Mrs. Weasley started to speak without hesitation, but was interrupted by Arthur before she said a few words.
"Molly! At least that shouldn't be ours!"
With that, Arthur looked at Ivan and said sorry. "My boy, if you want to know more, I suggest you ask your mother Aysia, or you can ask Dumbledore when you go to school, they will know everything."
Ivan rolled his eyes, and if Acia was willing to say, what else would you do?
As for asking Dumbledore?
Ivan didn't even think about it.
There are too many secrets in him, and who will ask who will not be sure when that happens. Ivan wished to stay away from Dumbledore before brushing Occlumency to Level 6 or Level 7...
Sogou

chapters.title: Chapter 160: Did you steal my headlines?
chapters.content:
After some exchanges, even though Arthur remained silent after that and was unwilling to mention more, Ivan still got some news about his own life experience.
It's just that the more news I get, the more doubts I get...
Could it be that the matter of his father was related to Dumbledore, or was it simply killed by Dumbledore?
Ivan guessed, but soon felt something was wrong again, because he had met Dumbledore several times in isolation when he was in school, and the old principal obviously had no objection to him.
Furthermore, if this were the case, Aysia would be unlikely to send him to Hogwarts...
Even Ivan wondered if his father would be a member of the Order of the Phoenix. That's why Mr. Weasley knew him. He just couldn't ask, because he shouldn't know about the Order of the Phoenix now!
Thinking about it all the way, I came to Lihen Bookstore without knowing it.
Perhaps because of the approach of school, it seemed very lively, with a lot of people crowded outside the door.
Looking closely at Ivan, I found that most of them are witches, from teenage little wizards to dozens of old witches. They have fanatical expressions, and all of them are excited, and they all want to squeeze in from the outside. .
"God! It was Mr. Lockhart's book signing event! What a coincidence we came!" Hermione looked at the banner hanging in the window upstairs and screamed excitedly.
Ivan looked at the place Hermione's eyes were looking at, and found that the banner read impressively, Gildro Lockhart signed the autobiography "I Can Magic", the time is this afternoon!
"Gidro Lockhart? Who is that?" Harry looked at the crowd at the door of the bookstore, thinking that it might not be easy for them to squeeze in.
"You don't even know him?" Hermione was surprised, and then continued like a cannon.
"Most of the books we are going to buy this year are written by him! I guess the new professor must be a big fan of Lockhart!"
Hermione didn’t stop for a moment, and introduced the "great achievements" of Guidro Lockhart to the two. For example, he has won the "Witcher Weekly" most charming smile award five times, and used magic to destroy trolls, and The vampires traveled on the same ship, and they were also the winner of the Merlin Medal III!
"Merlin Medal? Isn't that the same as Ivan?" Harry was dizzy by Lockhart's "Great Contributions", but only the last sentence could be understood.
"Yes! I think Ivan will definitely have Mr. Lockhart's achievements in the future!" Hermione said excitedly.
"No, I'm not the same as Lockhart, I got the second-level Merlin Medal!" Ivan said calmly, saying that he was just one level higher than Lockhart.
He didn't want to be said to be the same as Lockhart in the future.
Hermione continued to brag about Lockhart's words and stopped. Harry almost laughed. He didn't catch a cold to Lockhart. Seeing Hermione's whispering in his ears, it was even more rebellious.
Hermione pursed her mouth and stared at them.
At this moment, the crowd gradually dispersed. Lockhart, who had completed the signing of the book sale, was walking out of the door. The flash of the camera was flashing all around. From time to time, several middle-aged witches were smiled by Lockhart. The captive screamed excitedly.
Lockhart was about to respond to these enthusiastic fans, but when he glanced over Ivan's side by chance, he suddenly seemed to have discovered some treasure, pushed away the reporter and the crowd blocking him, and walked towards this side. come.
Ivan frowned and pulled Harry as he was about to dodge, but they were obviously a step slower, Lockhart rushed up quickly, grabbed Harry's arm, and said in surprise.
"Isn't this Harry Potter?"
There was another sound of pressing the shutter on the court, and Harry was very uncomfortable with the dazzling flash. What made him a little uncomfortable was that Lockhart kept holding his arm.
Harry wanted to break free, but Lockhart's arms were like iron tongs, which bound him tightly.
Harry had to look at Hermione and Ivan for help...
Ivan shrugged and said that he was powerless, and asked him to ask for his own blessings.
Hermione was so excited after seeing Lockhart that she couldn't move. She anxiously wanted to say something to Lockhart.
But Lockhart didn't mean to pay attention to her at all, and even felt that the little witch who came up was a little in the way, and subconsciously pushed her to the side of the crowd, looking at Ivan who was standing behind.
"And you! Ivan Hals, the genius who developed the wolf poison medicine!"
"What day is it that I have met so many celebrities!" Lockhart seemed very happy. He paid more attention to Ivan than Harry, and he unknowingly increased his volume.
After all, this is a little wizard who stole his headlines!
When Lockhart got up this morning, he thought that the headline he saw would be his own autograph book sales event, but he did not expect to go through the entire Prophet’s Daily, but he couldn’t find any relevant reports at all. It's all talking about the genius story of Ivan Hals!
God knows how sad this man was at the time!
However, Lockhart was not a careful person, at least when he was in front of the media, so he took the two of them very kindly to take pictures, and spoke to Ivan in a tone of supporting the younger generation.
"I have read today's report, and I have to say that you can achieve results at such an age that surprised me."
Having said this, Lockhart smiled, blinked at Ivan, and joked in a brisk tone.
"I have to say that you have a good time! I was busy solving the fairy dispute last year I didn't have time to go to my werewolf friend to optimize my research results."
"You have to know that I have been in contact with werewolves three years ago. You can read my book "Wandering with the Werewolves". Since then I have been engaged in related research, but unfortunately I was a step faster by you!"
Lockhart's speech speed is amazing, especially in his best-selling books, and the method of touching porcelain is beyond Ivan's expectations.
The corners of Ivan's mouth twitched, indicating that he had never seen such a brazen person!
However, Lockhart didn't feel that there was anything wrong, and he took out the style of his predecessor members of the Merlin Knights and looked at Ivan Dao.
"Tell me to read the newspaper and say you want to get the Merlin Medal? This is not an easy task. I only got this honor after I solved countless troubles (in the book)."
"Of course, if you have me, the winner of the Merlin Medal of Level 3, as your nominee, these will not be a problem." Lockhart swore his chest and expressed his willingness to recommend Ivan, or the kind that does not charge any money. .

chapters.title: Chapter 161: I'm sorry, I'm afraid you can't be my nominee
chapters.content:
"I think you don't need Mr. Lockhart. I'm afraid you won't be my nominee." Ivan shook his head and refused without hesitation.
"What? You have found a candidate?" Lockhart raised his eyebrows, somewhat surprised, but didn't mean to give up, but continued to speak.
"You know that I am the winner of the Merlin Medal of the third level, a well-known figure in the magic world, and there are very few people in the Merlin Knights that I don't know..."
Harry couldn't help but interrupted while Lockhart was bragging about himself.
"Ivan's nominee is Professor Dumbledore! Sir!"
Lockhart's continuous words stopped, no matter how arrogant he was, he would not dare to say that he was more famous than Dumbledore.
At this moment, Harry remembered what Ivan had said before, and made up again.
"And Ivan got the second-level Merlin Medal!"
Lockhart's confident smile froze on his face.
He is a third-level Merlin Medal winner, but he is not eligible to nominate a second-level Merlin Medal winner!
This is also why Ivan said bluntly that Lockhart could not be a nominee...
"Ah...this...that's it." Lockhart was embarrassed, but the cheeky he had honed over so many years made him quickly adjust, and said with a regretful expression.
"It's a pity, I was about to say that I had a great conversation with the Grand Captain of the Merlin Knights a few days ago. I wanted him to nominate you. I didn't expect Dumbledore to be the first."
"Then I really want to thank..." Ivan said silently, thinking that Lockhart is really a talent, and he can come back on his own, and even climbed up to the head of the Merlin Knights. Not afraid that the other party will expose his lies.
"No thanks, it's something I should do to help the younger generation!" Lockhart shook Ivan's shoulders, taking Ivan's ironic words as thanks to himself.
Perhaps due to the successive deflations in front of Ivan, Lockhart did not dare to show off his words next.
After the public announced that he would become a Defence Against the Dark Arts teacher at Hogwarts in the next school year, Lockhart went away amidst the applause of the crowd and the skepticism of a few people.
This made Ivan have to sigh with the lack of brains of these enthusiastic fans. Obviously Lockhart’s words were full of loopholes just now. Anyone with a discerning eye could see that this guy wanted to rely on himself for his life, so as to get a wave of heat, but these fans But he insisted on believing that Lockhart planned to support his younger generation out of good intentions.
"I think the Defence Against the Dark Arts class next school year must be terrible." Harry grumbled dissatisfiedly as he looked at Lockhart's going away figure.
Although he and Lockhart had only been in contact for less than ten minutes, the other party's performance was like a funny and absurd clown, showing off on himself all the time, which really made him unlikable.
"How can this happen? Professor Lockhart is still very good. He has performed so well in the book. Maybe he was just a little impatient today!" Hermione softly defended Lockhart, her eyes were a little red and swollen. After Lockhart pushed away, it was very sad.
Ivan shook helplessly, not knowing how to tell Hermione that Lockhart was a liar. After all, he didn't have any evidence in his hands. It would be better to wait for this guy to reveal himself next school year.
The difference with Hermione seemed to think Lockhart was a good person, and Mrs. Weasley.
She was in a hurry to get Lockhart’s autographed book, but was blocked by the crowd in the bookstore. Now when she came out, she talked about Lockhart’s charming temperament, which made Mr. Weasley a little jealous. .
"Hals, do you have anything else to do after you buy the book? If you have time, how about coming to the Burrow as a guest?" Mr. Weasley then handed a complete set of old books to Ginny, turning his head to face Ivan said.
"Yeah, Ivan, come to our house to play," George and Fred also looked expectant.
"No, I still want to read more books here." Ivan hesitated for a while, and finally shook his head and refused.
Although he wanted to take a look at the legendary Burrow, he had already planned for the next time and didn't want to change his mind temporarily.
The most important thing is that if he goes to live in Shao for a few days, Aysia will be left alone.
"All right." Arthur looked disappointed, but didn't force it.
Mrs. Weasley took the opportunity to teach the little ghosts in the family.
"Look, look all! You all know how to play all day, when do you want to come to the bookstore to read books? Especially you George, and you Fred! If you have the learning spirit like Ivan, I too I won’t object to your research at home!"
After some scolding, Ron, George, and Fred looked at Ivan with resentment. The latter said that he was helpless with the gun, but he couldn't help.
After everyone had bought the textbooks for the next school year, Ivan waved goodbye to everyone. Hermione wanted to stay and read together, but unfortunately, Mr. Granger would have other things for a while, and she was not relieved that Hermione was alone. Stay here.
"Strange, why didn't I see Malfoy and his father?" After leaving the Weasley family, Ivan looked around and didn't see the Malfoy family.
Then I realized that it might be because of him that the old Malfoy didn't go to the Bojinbok shop to discuss the sale of dark magic items, so maybe he had already bought the book and went home.
It’s not bad that Old Malfoy came to make trouble, Ivan thought so, turned his head back to the Lihen Bookstore.
After Lockhart left, it was obviously deserted, and only a few parents who brought their children to buy books stayed here.
The owner of Lihen Bookstore is a very kind middle-aged witch with a pair of round-frame glasses. She is turning over a book in her hand, and she seems to be an intellectual lady.
But after Ivan got closer, he saw Lockhart's big smiling face on the cover of the book he was holdingThe white to shining teeth were clearly visible.
Obviously, this is another Lockhart fan, and Ivan is rather helpless. No wonder Lockhart will be invited here for autograph book sales activities.
"Madam, can I read books with you these days?" Ivan asked, considering the importance of magic knowledge, and added another sentence.
"If it is inconvenient, I can pay a certain reading fee!"
"Do you want to read a book here? Of course! I mean you can read it if you want. There is no need to pay extra. You are welcome to come here anytime." The shopkeeper witch put down the book in her hand, and she looked at Yi in surprise. Fan responded with a happy glance.
"Thank you!"
Ivan nodded politely, and then strolled around the bookstore.
Sogou

chapters.title: Chapter 162: The story of "The Muggle Princess and the 7 Goblins"
chapters.content:
"Basic Curse Level Four", "Anthology of Ancient Magic Essays", "Curse and Anti-curse"...
Ivan walked by the side of the bookshelf and looked around at the books on it.
The entire Lihen Bookstore does not look big, much smaller than the Hogwarts library.
And there is no banned library, or it will not be open to ordinary people, resulting in the lack of many advanced magic books on the bookshelf.
Ivan doesn't care about this, anyway, these have been enough for him to watch for a long time.
Randomly took an "Anthology of Ancient Magic Texts" from the shelf, and Ivan found a remote corner and sat down and looked through it alone.
The wife of the shopkeeper in front of the counter would occasionally pay attention to Ivan's movements. It was a little surprising to see him sitting in the corner for a few hours. She had rarely seen a little wizard with such patience.
Ivan kept seeing the bookstore closing, before getting up and leaving. At the same time, he saw the bookstore manager, the husband of the intellectual lady.
It's just that the wizard manager doesn't look like the manager of a bookstore, and he doesn't look elegant at all. When I came in, Ivan almost mistakenly thought that this guy was from the bookstore.
For several days, Ivan soaked in Lihen Bookstore and improved his knowledge at the speed of reading three to five books a day.
At the same time, he was also perfecting his understanding of the magic world.
This speed is obviously difficult to satisfy Ivan. The basic magic books are okay, but the more advanced ones are mostly obscure, and it is difficult to push the reading progress to 100% even after repeated reading.
After consuming an excessive amount of academic points, Ivan finally remembered the learning accelerator that he had left at home and didn't know how many days he had left—the Horcrux Tom’s diary.
On the third day, Ivan took it over and used it as a study notebook, and asked if he didn't know it.
During the entire summer vacation, Ivan also had a rough estimate of the level of Tom Riddle's basic spell theory, which was about level five.
The level of black magic is higher, and the others are slightly lower. As far as the little wizard who taught him this basic magic theory is still at level 4, it is still no problem.
