With the further improvement of Ivan's knowledge system, the relationship between the two parties gradually moved from teaching to discussing with each other.
[Ding, after a period of study, your proficiency in basic magic principles has improved, the current level 4 (916/1600)]
[Ding, after a period of practice, your Occupational Cerebral skill level will be raised to level 4, and 20 student status points will be awarded. 】
Two consecutive system prompts sounded in his mind, and Ivan closed the "Detailed Explanation of Basic Curses" in his hand, put it aside, and looked at the Horcrux diary with more satisfaction.
With the help of Tom Riddle, his learning efficiency has increased several times!
You must know that after the skill level of the spell reaches level 4, it will be more difficult to improve. The progress bar of the proficiency is simply desperate!
If you just rely on reading and learning on your own, you can't even think of making any big progress in a year or two.
What's more, the "kind" Tom will help him brush his Occlumency level in the process of learning, which is quite rare!
If it weren't for Ivan who knew the danger of Horcrux diary, he wouldn't want to destroy it.
Of course, Tom's "selfless" contribution is not unrequited, at least he also got a lot of information he wanted from Ivan.
Just after getting this information, Tom couldn't believe it at all, and even felt that he had heard it wrong.
[You said that the savior of the magic world who killed the Dark Lord twelve years ago was a newborn baby? How is this possible? 】
The black ink marks covered most of the paper in a short time, and the handwriting was scribbled. Obviously Tom couldn't restrain the consternation in his heart.
This could not help but he was not surprised. Anyone who heard that he was killed by a newborn baby after he painstakingly cultivated in the future and became a great existence in the magical world would be ridiculous.
If Ivan said that the Dark Lord was defeated by Dumbledore or some powerful wizard, he would be more accepting.
For Tom’s question, Ivan became more tolerant, anyway, he planned to destroy the diary before going to school, so it didn’t matter whether he answered or not...
Not long after, Ivan talked nonsense in the diary.
【Correct! I heard that because the Dark Lord killed the Savior’s parents, the Savior killed the Dark Lord in his anger... Every wizard in the entire British magical world knows this! 】
Tom Riddle was silent.
He really couldn't imagine how a baby who was just a few days old destroyed the Dark Lord in anger. Even in the Muggle orphanage, he dared not write it like that on the collection of fairy tales he had read!
But under the search for the mind and mind, Tom clearly understood that the little wizard in front of him really thought so in his heart, and did not deceive himself.
Because of this, Tom became more and more confused. Did he think something went wrong in this world?
Ivan didn't know that Tom almost began to doubt the world because of his words.
But Ivan didn't think he had deceived Tom. After all, many rumors about Harry in the magical world did have similar claims.
Isn't it normal for him, an eleven or twelve-year-old wizard, to believe the rumors?
Because of this, Ivan continued to pretend to be his little wizard and wrote in his diary.
[You also think that the savior Harry is very powerful, right? He killed the powerful Dark Lord so easily just after he was born...]
[Ah... Yes, it's amazing! ! Tom was silent for a while, and replied very aggrieved.
Being shocked by Ivan's words, Tom did not continue to inquire about the magic world for a long time after this conversation.
This makes Ivan somewhat disappointed.
Mocking Tom Riddle has become his pastime to relieve the boredom of reading, and it usually has the effect of pleasurable body and mind.
Ivan felt that if Voldemort learned that the Horcrux he had worked so hard had developed so many functions, would he feel so relieved...
Seeing the setting sun, taking into account Ivan, who is about to start school in two days, brought the unfinished books to the front desk. He didn't plan to come here again.
"Madam, how much does this "Advanced Transfiguration" cost?"
"Three gallons, eleven Sico." The shopkeeper's wife took a look and said, then hesitated for a while and continued.
"This book is not what you should read now, boy, it is a good thing to love knowledge, but sometimes we have to know how to make progress step by step!"
"Yes, kids as old as you should read storybooks. For example, the story of "Muggle Princess and the Seven Goblins". I just bought today only nine Sikors. I heard that Muggles The children at home love this most.” The manager also came over to join in the fun at this time, holding some books in his hand.
He thinks that Ivan pretending to be an adult and reading some esoteric books is better than reading a few fairy tale books, just like this one in his hand, although the Muggle Princess abandoned the seven little fairies who took care of her, and finally chose The ending of the story of living with a giant is sighing...
Sogou

chapters.title: Chapter 163: You just show this to your kids?
chapters.content:
Ivan looked at the dynamic picture of seven goblins and giants robbing the Muggle Princess on the cover of the book, feeling very hot.
I don't know which wizard has plagiarized the story of "Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs", and then the magic changed it like this.
Are you sure that this kind of dark fairy tales and children's cults are for children?
But being able to sell it here obviously means that the content of the book is not out of line, and there should be nothing strange.
"I don't think I need this kind of thing, sir!" Ivan refused without hesitation, even though he knew in his heart that this was a kindly suggestion from the two.
In fact, this is not the first time the shopkeeper’s wife reminded him. When he was reading, she would come over to persuade him to read some basic books from time to time when it was convenient for him.
In this regard, Ivan was also very helpless. After thinking about it, he drew out his magic wand and clicked on the spicy-eyed storybook.
In the surprised eyes of the shopkeeper and his wife, the book slowly turned into a toad under the magical force. It stayed there lazily, with bulging cheeks, and the unpleasant "gurgling" sound came from the toad. I heard...
Although the difficulty of transforming a magic book is very high, only the cover of this "Muggle Princess and the Seven Fairies" storybook has been given a shadow magic, so Ivan does not find it difficult to transform it.
"This is three gallons and elevens. If there is nothing wrong, I will leave first... Also, thank you for your care these days!" Ivan put the counted money on the table and said politely , And then turned away neatly.
Behind him, the manager and the shopkeeper’s wife surrounded the toad with a weird look, because they found that they couldn’t change the book back.
You can only wait for its magic power to dissipate automatically, and you have to lock it in a cage before that, so that the book will not run away by itself.
......
Back home, Ivan considered it for a while and decided it was time to deal with the trouble of Horcrux.
He needs a magic called Lihuo to help him destroy the Horcrux!
Put Tom Riddle's diary back in the room and hide it, Ivan turned to find Aysia who was busy preparing dinner in the kitchen, and asked aloud.
"Mom, can you teach me how to release Li Huo?"
Aysia stopped controlling the magic kitchen, and the kitchen utensils floating in the air fell from the air, but Aysia didn't care. She frowned and said to Ivan.
"Great fire? What do you learn from this?"
"I heard that fierce fire is a very powerful magic, and when I saw you use it last time, it burned all the dummy in the practice room at once." Ivan looked extremely interested. , Said softly that he wanted to learn this magic.
This is how Ivan learned the thunderbolt explosion last time...
To Ivan's expectation, Esiah did not agree to his request, but refused without hesitation.
In her opinion, fierce fire is an extremely dangerous black magic, and evil black magic is not something Ivan should learn now.
Ivan is very speechless. Isn't it dangerous that the Thunderbolt that I learned before is not dangerous?
"That's different." Aysia shook her head.
"Once Li Huo is not well controlled, there is a danger of running away and devouring the caster, causing great damage. The most important thing is that there are very few magics that can stop Li Huo from spreading, and I don't have it."
Ivan's heart shuddered, and he remembered the destroyed House of Request in the original book. It was because Crabbe who had released Fierce Crabbe couldn't control his magic, and finally Fierce ate everything and Crabbe as the spellcaster.
In Ivan’s impression, the only high-level curse that can contain this horrible flame is the curse—all curses are the end curses!
Ivan didn't think he couldn't control the fierce fire, but what made him a little depressed was that no matter how he persuaded Esiah, he was unwilling to teach him this magic.
Coupled with the Horcrux diary, Ivan didn't intend to talk about it, and there was no reason to persuade Aysia.
So until the meal, Ivan was still frowning, thinking about how to destroy the Horcrux.
Do you want to go to the banned book zone of Hogwarts to teach yourself?
After dinner, Ivan was about to go upstairs to go back to the room, but was stopped by Aysia, and as soon as he turned around, he saw his mother threw a ring-like thing over.
Ivan took it in a panic, looking at her suspiciously.
With one hand in her waist, Aysia pointed at Ivan with a spoon in the other, and warned.
"This is a ring that can release a fierce fire curse. It can be used twice. Although the range of fierce fire released is a bit small, it is not easy to lose control. When you use it, be careful not to burn yourself."
"Can you tell me now what are you going to do to be fierce?" Aisia asked.
"When I can tell you, I'll say it!" Ivan quickly put the ring away and replied casually.
Before Esiah was angry, Ivan slipped into his room as quickly as possible.
Outside the door, Aysia's roar faintly came.
At this time, Ivan had no time to pay attention, so he hurriedly called up the magic inventory of the system and took a look.
【Magic Item: Ring of Fierce Fire
Magic: higher
Effect: Summon Fierce Fire (2/3)]
"Has it been used once?" Ivan muttered to himself as he looked at the black-gray ring in his hand and the humble ring.
This reminded him that when he went home to play against Aysia, Aysia used fierce fire, which should be the effect of this magic item.
Ivan didn't pay much attention to the limit on the number of uses. After he cracked the magic text formula above, he could make a similar magic item by buying some materials from Jin Jialong.
However, this made Ivan realize that there are still things that Aysia hasn't taught himself in the making of magic items.
In addition to this dangerous magic related knowledge related to fierce fire, the method of making the Crescent Moon Pendant is also a little understood to him.
As early as after the alchemy reached the fourth level, Ivan tried to repair this pendant that could resist death, so as not to make it difficult for Aysia to ask questions.
It's a pity that when it was finally repaired Ivan found that he had no way of starting.
With his current alchemy level, he can make exactly the same meniscus pendant, but the defensive effect is at most similar to the protective ring, and it is impossible to block high-intensity lethal attacks!
【Magic Item: Crescent Moon Pendant
Magic: low (stronger)
Special status: damaged
Explanation: This is a magical item made with a lot of precious metals. It has resisted a deadly attack for the bearer. It has now been damaged.
Note: It contains more than just magic power, your alchemy level is not enough to repair it...]
"Is it not only the power of magic?" Ivan looked at the explanation at the end of the crescent moon pendant and fell into contemplation.
Sogou

chapters.title: Chapter 164: Possibility of fusion of multiple bloodlines
chapters.content:
Ivan remembered the protective magic that Lily Potter had set on Harry.
In the tone of the old principal, that is the power of love!
Ivan’s current knowledge of magic cannot understand how this power works, and the curse he came into contact with called the guardian of Gods as magic that transforms emotions into power.
However, what Ivan can confirm is that this pendant was definitely not made in the past one or two years. This can be seen from the slight wear on the metal material.
Ivan’s alchemy knowledge told him that the production time of the crescent moon pendant should have been more than ten years ago!
Putting away this precious pendant, Ivan took out the Horcrux diary that was deep in the closet, and left the house secretly without Esiah, found an empty place nearby, and put it in silence. magic.
It was approaching midnight, and the quietness in Knockdown Alley was a little frightening, and the surrounding area was gray. Only the moonlight in the sky brought a little light.
Ivan adjusted his state and planned to destroy Voldemort's Horcrux.
Perhaps it was sensing something was wrong, the Horcrux diary automatically flipped, and lines of ink on it gradually appeared.
【what happened? Hals, what are you taking me here for? 】
Ivan smiled and wrote in the diary with a quill pen.
[Of course I practice some magic, which is not very convenient at home! 】
Ivan didn't have the habit of being a narrator before the enemy died, and it was in line with his expectations that the enemy's death was unclear.
Tom Riddle in the diary fell into a short silence. Ivan's words didn't have too many loopholes, but he always felt something was wrong.
Especially since it's getting late now, is it really necessary to practice magic now?
The handwriting on the diary is shuffled and reorganized, and the black ink reappears on the white paper.
[Is that so? Then I am here with you. 】
The Horcrux diary was just opened and not closed again, and the pages of the book turned on its own from time to time, which looked very strange.
Ivan ignored it, sitting on the overgrown stone, and placing the Horcrux diary aside, activating the ring of fierce fire.
At this moment, a system sound interrupted his actions.
[Ding, the system update is complete, please check it in time! 】
Along with the prompt sound, there are a lot of updated information pouring into my mind.
After sorting out the information that suddenly appeared in his mind, Ivan paused the action of destroying the Horcrux.
Because in addition to the update, the system once again released a mission related to blood fusion, which happened to have something to do with Tom Riddle.
【Task: The Mystery of Bloodline
Mission: Find a way to integrate multiple bloodlines
Current task progress: 5 percent
Task reward: legendary value*1
Task description: After experiencing the substantial increase in strength of the fusion ceremony, you are not satisfied with the current situation, and you are still tirelessly looking for more relevant information.
Note: Although the fusion of multiple bloodlines means more risks, this is not an unsolvable thing...]
Is the blood mystery? Ivan looked at the extra tasks in the taskbar, and thought in his heart.
It was the first time that he heard about the ability to integrate multiple bloodlines. It is important to know that even in the book "The Origin of Bloodlines", those bloodline families that are recorded on the record just choose to merge the bloodlines of a kind of magical creature. .
Blood fusion itself has a very high risk, and it is obviously more difficult to fuse multiple blood vessels!
Ivan felt that the missing part of "The Origin of Blood" might have relevant information.
This is why he suspended the destruction of the Horcrux diary.
Among Ivan’s previous conjectures, among the few people who have the ability to hide "Origin of Blood" in the restricted area, Tom Riddle is the most likely.
Because when he used the bleeding magic for the first time, Voldemort instantly judged that he was not awakening, but completed the fusion of blood.
If that's the case, Ivan even suspects that Tom might have done what he did last school year when he was in fifth grade.
After all, with the Basilisk being able to control the basilisk at will, taking blood could not be easier for Tom, and the materials used to make the potion are not too difficult for him.
The only thing that can cause some obstacles to Tom is the difficulty of potion brewing. The level 6 potion level is not a potion master, but it is not something ordinary people can have.
Of course, this is difficult. Ivan didn't think he could stump Tom Riddle, who was good at rhetoric. He couldn't do it at the time when someone in Hogwarts could do it.
Thinking of this, Ivan looked at the Horcrux diary quietly lying on the stone,
The talent of the basilisk is likely to be related to death and soul. Voldemort is able to maintain his rationality even when the soul is divided one after another, and his strength is getting stronger and stronger. Maybe this is the reason.
【what happened? Don't you want to practice magic? 】
Under the silent night sky, Ivan stayed still for a long time, leaving Tom Riddle confused and reminded.
Only then did Ivan come back to his senses, and then another headache. I'm afraid he really has to practice magic for a night...
"Torn apart!"
"Faint!"
"A flock of birds!"
......
In the deserted, colorful spell rays flashed in the night sky from time to time, the small tree in the distance was broken into two sections, and the stones were shattered...
In order not to arouse the suspicion of the Horcrux diary, Yifan had to practice until the wee hours of the morning before returning home sleepily. He didn't even have time to check some details after the system upgrade.
Under Ivan's manipulation, Tom Riddle temporarily dispelled his doubts, but inexplicably felt that the little wizard in front of him might have a brain problem, so he would often do some inexplicable things.
......
The next morning, Ivan, who avoided the Horcrux surveillance, was eating breakfast while checking the changes after the system was updated.
Open the status bar!
Ivan said silently in his heart.
In the next second, a message appeared in front of him,
【Ivan Hals
Occupation: Blood Wizard
Magic scale: 64
Magic Bar: Fear Curse Level 4 (15/1600) Thunderbolt Explosion Level 4 (7/1600) Transfiguration Curse Level 4 (1560/1600) Calling God Guardian Level 4 (500/1600) Occidental Cerebral Level 4 (4/1600) ... [The remaining three levels are omitted]
Blood Magic: Shadow of the Unicorn
Theory of Knowledge: Alchemy Level 4 (710/4000) Basic Magic Principles Level 4 (916/1600) Potions Level 4 (1452/1600)
Magic Item: Circle of Magic
Magic: strong
Storage magic: 212/300
Effect: Concentrate magic power Repel objects within three meters of the body
......
Magic item: magic wand (yew wood, unicorn hair, eleven inches and three-quarters long)
Magic: strong
Mowen circuit: covert casting (passively reduce the fluctuation of magic power when casting a spell)
......
.....
Grade points: 575
Legendary value: 3/3】
(PS: Angel finally got the character information, now everyone can check it freely..)

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Thank you so much, Seamus..
chapters.content:
After opening the status bar and browsing, Ivan found that there were more things that were not available before, such as the magic scale.
Or in layman's terms, it is magic value!
Judging from the information provided by the system, the magic power scale of an adult wizard will probably be around 100 points, and some powerful wizards will far exceed this value.
"In other words, my current magic power is roughly equivalent to more than six levels of an adult wizard." Ivan muttered to himself.
This is because he doubled his magic power in the process of fusing the blood of the unicorn, otherwise he now only has the magic power of an adult wizard.
Comparing his status as a second-year little wizard, it's normal.
Then Ivan focused on the focus of this update, that is, the newly-appearing legendary value.
After checking the instructions, Ivan figured out that this thing had only one effect.
Consumption of five legendary points can activate the protection mode of the system once, which can be used when the blood is fused, which can eliminate the risk of fusion.
This made Ivan a little relieved. Without this, he wouldn't dare to use the method of fusing multiple bloodlines.
After all, the risk of fusing one bloodline is high enough, let alone mixing multiple ones together.
Ivan was slightly surprised that his legendary value initially had three points!
Looking through the system bar, Ivan found the extra legendary title bar. The three titles on it were Troll Killer, Trainee Savior, and Dragon Knight.
Ivan casually clicked one and looked at it with a weird face.
[Legend Title: Dragon Knight (Young Dragon Knight)
Legend: 1
Legendary event: The fact that you rode a dragon (dragon) to repel the invaders at the end of the semester has been spread throughout the school. Although this statement has been rejected by the Ministry of Magic, Mr. Seamus Finnigan insisted on telling everyone The people I met told about your great achievements...]
"I really thank you, Seamus..." Ivan said silently.
Ivan didn't expect that Seamus, a bastard, would still try to prove to everyone that he was flying on a dragon.
For the other two events, Ivan can roughly understand what they represent even if they don’t check it out. One is the legend that contributed to the Halloween killing of trolls, and the other was obtained by preventing the resurrection of black magic in the quest to **** the Philosopher’s Stone. .
It's just that the titles are more uglier than the other, and the monster killer is fine. What about the trainee savior?
The only better Dragon Knight always reminds him of some strange things...
Ivan kept spitting out in his heart, but he knew very well that it would be very difficult to gather the five points and fuse the next bloodline without risk.
Basically every legendary event represents a dangerous experience, and when riding a dragon to rescue, because of his careful and careful calculation, he defeated the enemy in one encounter.
But now he hasn't found a way to fuse multiple bloodlines, and even more legendary values ​​are useless.
Thinking of this, Ivan was a little depressed, and throughout the summer he chatted with Tom many times that he had visited the restricted area of ​​Hogwarts.
Although Tom was suspicious, Ivan did not dare to ask too obvious, but it was also a variety of side-knock queries, but Tom Riddle was very plain, and occasionally discussed with Ivan about a few books about black magic. Banned books.
Tom's reaction caused Ivan to overthrow his previous thoughts, which is why he chose to destroy the Horcrux without asking clearly.
It's just different now. The missing content in "Origin of Blood" is most likely to be related to the method of fusing multiple bloodlines, and it is understandable to take some risks.
After all, the temptation to increase strength is really too great, and most of his current strength is due to that blood fusion ceremony. The shadow of the blood magic unicorn obtained has been his biggest trump card until now!
Ivan was eating breakfast carelessly, thinking about things with a frown, when a white hand stretched out and smoothed his frowning brow.
"What's the matter?" Aysia asked worriedly.
"Nothing, I thought that school was about to start soon, so I didn't feel comfortable..." Ivan shook his head, temporarily set aside these annoying things, and said instead.
"If you don't get used to it, you have to go!" Aysia scolded with a smile.
After breakfast, Ivan went upstairs and packed his luggage.
Originally, Aysia wanted to come and help, but he refused. The Horcrux diary should not be exposed, otherwise it would be burned by Aysia with fierce fire, and the clues he finally got were interrupted. .
In the afternoon, Ivan took time to practice his blood magic in the basement.
Now that he can clearly see his magic scale, Ivan certainly wants to confirm his casting limit. So not long after, there was a rare sight of a silver-white unicorn running around in the basement, stepping on white smoke, chasing a terrifying-looking dementor.
Considering that after going to school tomorrow, there will be no chance to use the Dementor to practice his blood magic.
Ivan tossed all afternoon, and waited until the dementor's body was faint to the extreme, and it seemed to be crumbling and about to collapse, before he let it go.
The mana consumption was almost the same, and Ivan also figured out the mana consumption of the Unicorn Shadow.
It only consumes one unit of magic power in five minutes in the case of incorporealization, but it is extremely scary to consume in the case of materialization, and it consumes ten magic power in every second.
In other words, without overdrawing the magic power, he can maintain the Unicorn Shadow for a maximum of 6 seconds.
It takes a lot of magic power to reorganize after being disintegrated in the actualized state The specific consumption depends on the degree of destruction.
"Huh..." Ivan, who confirmed the casting limit, cancelled the blood magic he released, and opened the storage box.
He didn't even need him to drive it away. The dementor moved quickly, and put it into the storage box with a "swish" sound, and sealed the lid by himself, which consciously surprised Ivan.
Aysia, who was making a protective ring in the studio, saw this scene and didn't know what to make for a while. A good dementor was about to be shut down by her own child.
.......
One day passed in a flash. On the morning of September 1, Ivan hurriedly dragged his luggage and came downstairs. Before leaving, he did not forget to put Tom's diary in his pocket.
Except for sleeping, Ivan kept it by his side at the rest of the time, lest Tom find a chance to confuse others, or be stolen by someone altogether.
Although this diary looks ordinary, and it may not be necessary for someone to throw it away, it is better to be careful...

chapters.title: Chapter 166: Look! Are they here now?
chapters.content:
Knock Down Alley, outside the Black Magic Store, Ivan with luggage waited at the door for a long time, but Esiah did not come out, only shouted.
"Mom... hurry up, there is not much time left until the train starts. We have to set aside some time to ride the Cavaliers bus."
Just as Ivan was hesitating whether to leave first, Aysia changed her clothes and arrived late.
After waving the magic wand to close the shop, Aysia pinched Ivan's cheek and said.
"What's the hurry? Isn't it all right if you don't take that rider bus?"
How do we go?
While Ivan was still thinking about it, Aysia grabbed his arm, followed by a burst of space replacement.
When Ivan came back to his senses, he found himself in a corner of the street not far from King's Cross Station.
"Look! Isn't there enough time now?" Aysia rubbed Ivan's hair and smiled.
"It's too dangerous, what if it is discovered by the Muggles?" Ivan said helplessly.
Although adult wizards don't have school-leaving spell casting restrictions like those of little wizards, if they are seen by a large number of Muggles when they cast spells, thus exposing the existence of the wizarding world, they will be punished by the Ministry of Magic.
Because of this, when Dougt took him to the Ministry of Magic, he only dared to teleport him to the nearby remote alleys, so Esiah was obviously much bolder than Dougt...
"Isn't it because no one found it?" Aysia spoke indifferently, but then frowned and looked behind her violently.
At the corner of the street, a middle-aged man in a suit and leather shoes was holding a piece of bread in his mouth. He was stunned. He obviously saw two people who appeared out of thin air, and he couldn't react for a while.
After seeing the eyes of Aisia and Ivan, the middle-aged man showed a look of horror, the bread in his mouth fell to the ground, he let out a piercing scream, turned around and ran away in a hurry.
But it was a magical ray that ran faster than him.
"Forget it all!"
As Aisia's voice sounded, the middle-aged man fell to the ground.
"Finished, let's go!" Aysia put away her wand and walked towards King's Cross Station before the scream attracted more Muggles.
Ivan turned his head and looked over. The hapless Muggle had stood up again, but looked a little dazed, perhaps because he had forgotten why he appeared here.
Ivan observed a moment of silence for him, hoping that this guy would not be late today.
Entering the platform waiting for the bus, Aysia gave another warning for a while, babbling about safety, eating regularly at school, and especially remembering to send letters back frequently!
"Okay, I know... Mom!" Ivan heard that his ears were almost puffed up, and quickly interrupted Aysia's continuous words.
Then, Ivan hesitated for a moment, then continued.
"By the way, mother, the werewolf wizards in the ruins on the east side promised me that they would help collect some news from Knockdown Alley. If you have any trouble, you can also ask for their help..."
Ivan did not hide the matter of contact with the werewolf, as he had already said a lot about it before.
After all, Dougt knew this matter.
In order to prevent this guy from using his own name and fooling these werewolf wizards into Knockdown Alley, Ivan had to involve Esiah to check and balance.
Before leaving, Ivan gave special advice to Fren and Walker. If he heard any news, he would either write to himself or ask Aysia to connect...
"Okay! I'll watch them for you." Aixia smiled and nodded.
Only then did Ivan bid farewell to Esiah, dragging his suitcase, rushing into the nine and three-quarters platform, and smoothly entering the wizard station.
After Ivan left, Aysia sighed, and she found that she couldn't understand her children's thinking more and more.
After hesitating, Aysia remembered what Dougt had mentioned when talking to her a few days ago. She didn't want to believe it at first, and even wondered if Dougt had too much brain supplement.
But Ivan was quite concerned about these werewolf wizards, which made Aysia hesitate again.
"Forget it, check the identities of these werewolf wizards first, if they are really as innocent as the introduction..." Aisia muttered to herself.
......
Inside the wizard station, Ivan, who had walked through the platform, turned his head and looked at the passage behind him.
He didn't know if the Horcrux diary was taken away by him, Dobby would block the passage and block Harry and Ron outside.
While thinking about it, Ivan put his luggage on the cargo box of the train, and then the one who got on the train found a relatively remote and empty carriage and sat down.
Woo...
Before long, the red-skinned train moved slowly, and the billowing steam gushed out from the chimney, gathered into a cluster, and passed away with the wind...
Ivan, who had nothing to do, opened the Horcrux diary to continue his study, and of course it was best to pry out information about blood fusion from Tom's mouth.
Ivan wondered if he would simply use fierce fire to threaten Tom’s obedient submission, but in the end he dispelled the idea because this will not only completely break the relationship between him and Tom, and lose a good one. Used learning accelerator, and the Dark Lord is not so easy to be threatened.
Not to mention that Tom was a guy who was good at rhetoric since he was a child. He didn't have a few truths in his mouth. The information in "The Origin of Blood" was different from his usual study. After a mistake, his grade point would be deducted to let him confirm the truth.
Tom only needs to get some half-truth and half-false information to increase the task progress, which will make him waste a lot of time.
Ivan racked his brains against Tom, and it didn't take long for the door of the carriage to be pushed open.
"Ivan, why are you alone here? Where are Harry and Ron?" Hermione walked in quickly, sat down on the opposite side, and asked strangely.
"I don't know, maybe I haven't gotten in the car yet?" Ivan said, and calmly lowered the diary to avoid being seen by Hermione.
"What?" Hermione was surprised, and then panicked. If Harry and Ron missed the train, how would they come to school?
"Don't worry, I think they can do something..." Ivan comforted and said, and then as if he had seen something, he pointed to the road outside the window.
"Look! Aren't they coming now?"
Hermione turned her head in a puzzled way and looked over, then she was stunned.
In the high altitude in the distance, a turquoise Muggle car is speeding in the sea of ​​clouds, flickering and flickering.
After a while, without knowing what went wrong, the car suddenly fell from a high altitude, spinning around in the air, and rushed towards the Hogwarts train...
(PS: The first volume is attached with the title of Shadow of the Unicorn. In order to avoid spoilers, there was no sub-volume.)

chapters.title: Chapter 167: A man flying in the sky is the great savior Harry...
chapters.content:
As the car got closer, Hermione could even see the look of horror on Ron's face while driving the car, and Harry's expression next to him was not much better. Obviously, driving a magic car to the two of them. Not so proficient...
Especially this car that can drive automatically has its own ideas...
"Harry, Ron!" Hermione was so frightened for a while that she hurriedly opened the window and shouted at the two.
Harry and Ron, who were sitting in the magic car, apparently heard Hermione's voice, and looked over here together.
But before they could say hello, the magic car with its own thoughts flew back into the clouds with a whistle, leaving only the horrified shouts of Harry and Ron still ringing in their ears.
"Ivan, we have to find a way to save them!" Hermione said worriedly, then frowned for a while and continued.
"Maybe we can get Harry and Ron to drive down the car at the same speed as the train, and then figure out a way to get them over."
"This is too risky, they can't control the car." Ivan shook his head, expressing that he could do nothing about the death of the two children.
Originally, it was not a big deal to miss the train. Harry and Ron only needed to go home or return to the Broken Cauldron Bar for help, just to make things clear.
Even if Dobby is making trouble and it is not convenient to send a letter, there is always a way to contact Dumbledore. There is no need to fly over in a car.
This is nothing but death...
Ivan thought so, and then realized that he seemed to have too high a standard for them.
Harry and Ron are now just twelve-year-old little ghosts. They can do anything if they are in a hurry.
What's more, they are more leathery...
Suddenly, Ivan felt the diary in his hand tremble.
Ivan looked at it strangely, and the black ink on the diary appeared scribbled, telling the master's emotions that could not be calmed down.
[That kid sitting in the car just now, is the great savior Harry Potter you said? 】
Ivan could clearly feel the shock in Tom's heart by looking at the ink on the diary. After snickering in his heart, Ivan wrote seriously in the diary.
[The appearance of the savior is always so shocking, right? Tom? 】
Tom was silent. He wondered why his main soul was lost to such a mentally retarded child...
Shouldn't this?
Hermione looked out the window from time to time, looking worried, and didn't even notice Ivan's small movements.
It's a pity that the car has already flown above the clouds and can't be seen again.
The train slowly approached the station.
As soon as she stopped, Hermione anxiously wanted to inform the professors in the school, for fear of something wrong with the car that Harry and Ron were driving.
But when he got there, Hermione was dumbfounded, because the second-year students didn't have to cross the lake, but followed the upper-grade little wizards to the castle in a carriage.
In the crowded crowd, Hagrid had already boarded the boat crossing the lake with the first-year little ghosts, and drifted above the lake with dim lights.
Hermione felt unlikely that she would chase into the lake to tell Hagrid that Harry and Ron got in a flying car and were going all the way to school.
Unable to seek Hagrid's help, Hermione had to obediently follow the large group to the platform, and of course Ivan was no exception.
Ivan turned his head and looked at the boat Hagrid was sitting on from time to time. He was a little worried that the boat could not bear Hagrid's huge weight, so that it sank halfway into the lake.
The two were pushed out of the station by the crowd and crossed a section of the road. They soon saw hundreds of black-and-grey carriages parked on the street outside. The only difference was that there were no horses on these carriages. Put it straight there.
"Does this carriage really move? How do we make it move?" Hermione got on one of the carriages and curiously touched the edge of the carriage. The railings on it were icy, but the carriage under her didn't move. Make her a little anxious.
"When the seats are full, you will move..." Ivan replied, but he looked at the front of the carriage with a strange expression.
Because Ivan found out that he couldn't see Ye Qi, he had already died once, and he also killed Chino, so logically he should be able to see it.
But thinking about it carefully, Ivan thinks of him like Harry in the original time and space.
It was obvious that Harry had witnessed the death of his parents when he was born, and destroyed Chino in the first grade, but he still had to wait until Cedric's death to see it.
Obviously, Ye Qi is not so easy to see... Maybe a deeper understanding of death is needed...
Listening to Ivan's words, Hermione had to put down her worry about Harry and Ron for the time being, and waited for the carriage to fill up.
But Ivan looked at the sound in front of the carriage, which made Hermione a little curious.
Ever since, the little witch asked aloud.
"Ivan, what are you looking at? Is there anything in there?"
"Yeqi..." Ivan subconsciously replied when he was thinking about the matter, and then saw Hermione's surprised look, and then continued.
"I heard this from senior seniors. They said that all the carriages in the school were pulled by a creature called the night skeletal creature."
Hermione stared in the direction shown by Ivan, but saw nothing.
Just as Hermione was about to ask, somebody took the lead.
"You said something is pulling a cart? But I heard that the carriage here can't move by itself? What's the other Yeqi?"
Ivan turned his head and looked to one side, and found that they were talking about two small Gryffindor girls, both of whom appeared to be in the second grade. One of the girls looked a little dark it didn't look like it was. European descent.
"Parvati? Lavender?" Hermione said in surprise.
Ivan was stunned when he heard these two names, and then he remembered that these two were Hermione's roommates.
"Hermione, can we come up? I don't know anyone in the nearby carriage..." Lavender Brown said.
Parvati Petir added something. "We won't bother you?"
After speaking, the two sneered and laughed, and the silver bell-like laughter echoed in the air...
"What are you two talking about?" Hermione glared at them angrily, then gave Ivan a worried look.
Seeing that Ivan didn't change her expression, she just nodded casually. Hermione was relieved, but suddenly she felt a little embarrassed...
Sogou

chapters.title: Chapter 168: It won't be too much time..
chapters.content:
Come on..."
Ivan said to Parvati and Lavender, feeling in his heart that the current little wizard is really precocious. At the age of twelve or thirteen, he was thinking about group CP.
After the two climbed up and sat down, the carriage that had been stagnant for a long time finally started slowly. It seems that they have reached the starting standard...
The carriage that Ye Qi was pulling was not fast, and it made a creaking noise during the action, which made Ivan sitting on it feel a little uncomfortable, but it was still bearable.
Parvati and Lavender who got in the carriage curiously continued to ask about Ye Qi.
In desperation, Ivan explained to them the habits and nature of the creature, Ye Qi.
"You mean that only people who have witnessed death can see this kind of creature? Then how do we know if the night sky you are talking about actually exists?" Parvati asked in confusion.
Although Hermione couldn't see Ye Qi, she had no doubts about Ivan's statement. She just felt that she hadn't read enough books and hadn't seen the introduction of this creature.
"Yeqi can't see it, but it should be okay to touch..." Ivan thought for a while and said.
The courageous Lavender stood up suddenly and leaned out of the carriage to touch the position of the front rein. He quickly touched a long, whip-like thing in the palm of his hand, possibly a tail.
"Oh my god, there really is Ye Qi!" Lavender said in shock.
Parvati was also a little curious when he heard the words, and planned to touch it after learning Lavender to go out.
Seeing the bold actions of the two little witches, Ivan hurriedly stopped.
"Yeqi is a very dangerous creature. Don't touch it indiscriminately now. This guy can fly. What if you anger him and throw us into the sky with a carriage?"
Parvati hurriedly closed her hand, but there was still a slight smile on the corner of her mouth. Obviously she still touched it...
"It's so dangerous? Will they bite?" Lavender asked.
Ivan nodded without hesitation, and by the way explained the fact that Ye Qi was attracted by raw meat and blood, and also described the appearance of Ye Qi, which was extremely terrifying.
Although Ivan knew that the night skies in the school had been domesticated, they were very docile and generally would not attack people.
But Parvati and Lavender couldn't see Ye Qi at all. They were little children. What if they became addicted to the Ye Qi on a whim, what should they do?
No matter how docile the Ye Qi is, it is essentially a magical creature listed as dangerous by the Ministry of Magic. It is of course no problem to simply confirm its existence, but it is better not to lose your vigilance.
Under Ivan's intimidation, Parvati and Lavender completely dispelled the idea of ​​touching Ye Qi again.
However, Ivan did not see Hermione sitting next to him, and wanted to touch Ye Qi, but when he heard his words, the little witch quietly retracted her hand and looked at him resentfully.
The carriage drove steadily on the trail, following the long convoy ahead, four people sitting in the car chatting, or Ivan listening to the others chatting gossip, Hermione was a little worried with Harry and Ron. His safety, just follow along with a sentence at will.
After half an hour, the carriage slowly stopped beside the stone steps leading to the oak gate.
When I arrived at the castle, it was already night, there was no moon in the sky, and the light from the stars was very dim. The few people could only follow the street lights and the guidance of the crowd...
"Ivan, what's the matter?" Hermione walked a few steps and found that Ivan hadn't followed, still standing by the car, reaching out and stroking something.
This reminded Hermione of the Ye Qi that Ivan had mentioned...
Ivan withdrew his hand, and he suddenly became interested because he thought that Yeqi seemed to be a good magical creature, and he didn't know what kind of abilities would be gained by fusing the blood of Yeqi.
Get a body that is invisible to ordinary people?
Ivan was thinking, suddenly heard Hermione's questioning, turned his head with a smile, and said.
"Hermione, didn't you confirm the existence of Ye Qi?"
"But you just said that Ye Qi is a dangerous and magical creature. It's better not to touch it at will?" Hermione said hesitantly, somewhat moved.
"Usually this is true, but the Ye Qi here is well domesticated. As long as you are careful, there is no danger. I lied to them just now..." Ivan explained.
At the same time, Ivan looked at Parvati and Lavender in the distance.
The two little witches of Gryffindor had obviously signaled that Ivan and Hermione had not followed up. Parvati wanted to go back and ask what was going on, but was dragged away by the wise Lavender. Up...
Hermione hesitated for a while, she remembered that Harry and Ron were still in danger.
"Just a few seconds, it won't be too much time..." Ivan continued, and he estimated that Harry and Ron were now fighting the beating willow.
After all, the speed of the magic car is not slow, it almost arrived at the same time as the train. When they were in the carriage, this thing should have landed.
Even if they go to inform the professors now, it is too late...
Only then did Hermione let go of her worries, and ran over quickly, with a hint of curiosity and excitement in her eyes, remembering the various terrifying words Ivan had described before, and tremblingly stretched out her hand.
She was a little worried about whether she would be bitten.
Ivan smiled, put his palm on the back of Hermione's hand, and directed her to touch to the front left. This was also the place he had touched just now. It should be the position of Yeqi's wings.
Realizing that her hand was being held by Ivan, the little witch's cheeks turned a little red, she pretended not to care, but quietly glanced around her eyes.
The students nearby were almost gone at this time, and the rest of them didn't look at them, and Hermione quietly breathed a sigh of relief.
Immediately afterwards, the touch from the palm of her hand made Hermione's eyes widen rough and cold...
It seemed that there was nothing in front of her, but she touched a thin layer of leather, with bones in it, which was very hard.
Hermione experienced this magical feeling,
Suddenly, both of them felt something licking their hands, and the back of their hands felt slippery.
Hermione was taken aback first, but fortunately, she quickly realized that it was Ye Qi's tongue, guessing that the other party might be showing goodwill to them.
It seemed that this creature was not as scary as Ivan had said before, Hermione thought to herself.
"Okay, I've touched it, let's go." Ivan withdrew his hand, staring at the empty surroundings, and said.
"Ah, it's been so long! Harry and Ron are still in the car." Hermione, who also realized this, changed her face and hurriedly took Ivan's arm and ran towards the castle...

chapters.title: Chapter 169: Why didn't we think about coming in a car?
chapters.content:
Ivan took Hermione all the way back to the castle, and met Professor McGonagall who was welcoming the freshman. Hermione hurried forward and reported the matter anxiously.
"What? You said Porter and Mr. Weasley drove a Muggle car and were about to fly to school?" Professor McGonagall was surprised, almost thinking that Hermione was joking.
As far as she knows, Muggle cars can’t fly!
But noticing that the worried look on Hermione's face did not seem to be false, Professor McGonagall immediately understood the seriousness of the matter.
"I think Harry Ron might be in some trouble, so that he missed the train and drove over in a Muggle car." Ivan added.
"That's not okay. If you miss the train, you can send a letter and let us find someone to pick it up. How can they do such a dangerous thing?" Professor McGonagall rebuked angrily, his lips trembling constantly.
What if the Muggle car that Harry and Ron drove had a problem, or it crashed halfway?
Thinking of this, Professor McGonagall said anxiously.
"I will go to your principal Albus now and ask him if he can do anything about it."
"As for you, go to the hall now and don't run around!" Professor McGonagall warned, and then hurried away.
Hermione vaguely wanted to follow, but was stopped by Ivan, and they couldn't help now.
Entering the auditorium, Ivan took Hermione to find a place to sit down, and looked at the teacher's seat. The seats of Snape and Professor McGonagall were empty, and the seat that represented Chino before was Occupied by Lockhart.
At the same time, Dumbledore was not seen.
As time approached, the sorting hat was babbling about when it started, and it couldn't help but want to sing its newly compiled lyrics.
The freshmen became more and more uneasy, and all of them looked nervous.
Several professors on the faculty chair discussed it and discussed who will be in charge of the freshmen's branch.
"You all listen to me, I'm afraid that no one in the magical world understands the branch better than me!" During the argument, Lockhart stood up and said confidently.
In the expressions of a group of professors, Lockhart tried hard to promote himself, wanting to get this opportunity for the freshman branch. And it has been repeatedly emphasized that he has presided over similar branch work in Muggle schools many times.
Even Boothbatten and Durmstrang, the two major magic schools in Europe, invited him to attend the opening ceremony.
It's a pity that the other professors obviously didn't trust him. Finally, Professor Flitwick, the most prestigious professor, jumped off the chair, left his position, and walked towards the stage.
The Sorting Hat can finally sing, although its voice is not good, but it sounds surprisingly good in time.
Then the freshmen walked to the front desk one by one, sat in small chairs and started sorting the hospital.
Professor Flitwick soon discovered that he was not suitable for this job. As a fairy, when he was holding the sorting hat, he could not reach the top of the students' heads with his feet on his feet.
Just as Flitwick was about to use a spell to lower the chairs where the students were sitting. The clever Lockhart has moved a chair over and signaled that Professor Flitwick can stand on the chair for sorting!
After some manipulation, Professor Flitwick was embarrassed, but Lockhart didn't realize it...
Ivan doubted this guy was deliberate...
Ivan looked at the small theater on the stage with relish, but felt that his clothes were pulled by someone, and turned his head to find that it was Hermione.
"It's Harry!" The little witch was looking at the door of the hall at this time.
Ivan followed and saw that Harry and Ron, who were disgraced, were planning to sneak in through the door.
The two little ghosts might think that no one would pay attention to them when they were sorting out, but they forgot to look behind them. Snape waited for them for a long time.
"Harry and Ron won't be expelled because of this?" Hermione said with some worry as they watched Snape take them away.
"Don't worry, it won't!" Ivan said comfortingly.
No one would fire Harry when Dumbledore fired, even if they drove a magic car to the school, they also crashed a beating willow.
Time passed slowly, and Dumbledore was late until the Sorting Ceremony was over, his expression on his face was very flat, as if nothing had happened.
He gave a brief and concise speech, and after arranging dinner for everyone with his magic wand, he left again.
Ivan guessed that Dumbledore might have swept Harry and Ron, after all, they drove a flying car to school, and I don't know how many Muggles saw it along the way.
The Ministry of Magic estimated that it would send a large number of people to erase the memories of these Muggles.
Having caused such a big trouble, if Dumbledore hadn't been around, the Ministry of Magic would have troubled them...
But this has nothing to do with Ivan. He ate a rich dinner on his own, while also thinking in his mind what he should do this semester.
First of all, of course, look for the remaining pages of "The Origin of Blood" and find a way to merge multiple bloodlines.
Secondly, you can't slack off in your daily study. Accumulate student status and improve your skill level. This is the root of strength.
There is also the practice of Animagus, Ivan has not forgotten the agreement with Professor McGonagall at the end of last semester.
What gives Ivan a little headache is how to obtain the legendary value. This thing needs to collect five points to make it work. He only has three points now, even if he completes the mission of the bloodline mystery, it only has four points.
After dinner, Ivan followed the other Gryffindor students back to the lounge.
On the way back to the bedroom, Ivan unexpectedly heard that many little wizards were discussing the missing Harry and Ron. Apparently, he and Hermione were far more likely to see the Muggle car when they were on the train.
After talking with a senior Gryffindor next to him for a while, George couldn't help turning his head and speaking to Fred.
"This is so cool, why didn't we think about driving those two cars to school?"
Fred nodded and was also surprised. He and George had never had the guts to do this, because if their mother knew they would definitely be killed!
Never thought that their brother Ron would have such courage.
It seems that they usually underestimate Ron...
Ivan listened in the sidelines, quite speechless about the logic of the two.
But George is not the only one who thinks this way. Many little wizards in Gryffindor think this trip is very exciting.
Because of this, when the distraught Harry and Ron returned to the dormitory, they were greeted with warm applause, and many little wizards gathered around and asked them about driving to school.
For a while, the two even received heroic treatment, as if they had done something amazing.
Harry and Ron were embarrassed at first, but slowly they forgot their previous experience of being near death, and talked to Neville about today's thrilling experience in the dormitory...
Ivan yawned and went back to bed to sleep, sincerely hoping they could laugh tomorrow...

chapters.title: Chapter 170: Letter from the Merlin Knights
chapters.content:
The next day, Ivan came to the auditorium early to enjoy the first breakfast at the beginning of school.
Harry and Ron seemed a little absent-minded. They always felt that something bad was going to happen, until Neville greeted them, and they agreed.
On the side Hermione was very angry at their adventure yesterday, her expression on her face didn't look good.
Not long afterwards, there was a huffing sound from outside the hall. Ivan looked up and saw that a large number of owls swarmed in from outside the castle, flew to their respective targets, and sent letters and items to the long table of the four major colleges. .
Nearly half of the owls flew towards Ivan, and several of them were crowded and bumped into each other during the flight. A large number of envelopes fell from the sky, and they were scattered everywhere.
Ivan frowned and stretched out his wand and knocked it. All the envelopes that fell on the ground flew over and piled up in front of him. Gao's even somewhat blocked his vision.
This abnormal phenomenon quickly attracted the attention of a group of little wizards.
"Wow! So many letters? Who sent you?" Hermione asked curiously.
"Should it be the order for the wolf poison potion?" Ivan said casually, and then continued. "Strange I asked them to send the order to the store."
Picking up one of the letters, Ivan hesitated for a moment. He found that this envelope was different from the others. It had a white background with a gold edge and a strange circular pattern painted in the center.
The signature is Richard Gorschak, a name that has never been heard
Ivan got some interest, opened the envelope, and checked it.
[Dear Mr. Hals:
Since your invented wolf poison potion has improved the living conditions of werewolf wizards and has made outstanding contributions to the magical world, we are happy to inform you that you have been selected into the Merlin Knights and will soon become the smallest second-level Merlin Medal winner in a thousand years!
According to your nominee Albus Dumbledore’s proposal, after the investigation, we will send someone to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry to issue you the Merlin Medal II!
Leader: Richard Gorshak (Grand Captain of the Merlin Knights, Vice President of the International Magic Federation, winner of the Merlin Medal of the First Class)
Yours sincerely! 】
"It seems to be a letter from the Merlin Knights..." Ivan shrugged and handed the envelope to Hermione who was full of curiosity aside.
After checking the contents of the envelope, Hermione said happily.
"Congratulations, Ivan!"
Ivan nodded, but was thinking of other things in his heart.
He estimated that this time when the medal was issued, he should be able to obtain the legendary value. After all, the matter of obtaining the Merlin Medal was more influential than his playing in school during the last school year.
It was just that the time for awarding the medal was delayed until around Halloween, and it was still held at Hogwarts. I don't know what Dumbledore meant.
However, in Ivan's view, the Merlin Knights are quite rigorous.
He actually planned to spend a few months tracking and researching the effects of the wolf poison potion, and getting a report on the survival status of the werewolf wizard to evaluate his contribution to the magical world.
As for the other envelopes, there are some ordinary content inside. Ivan just looked through it at random. Most of them are letters from fans, most of which are werewolf wizards.
Ivan suspected that the remaining few letters might have been sent by wizards who hated or opposed the werewolves.
Because it was filled with intimidating and insulting words, and bluntly said that werewolves were abnormally evil existences, this trouble could only be solved by eliminating all werewolves.
Ivan didn't bother to pay attention to these mental disabilities, and crumpled the two letters into a ball and prepared to throw them in the trash can.
Harry and Ron also leaned forward at this time, wanting to read the letter from the Merlin Knight Commander.
It's just that before Harry could speak, he saw that besides a pile of envelopes, there was an extra newspaper on the table.
The headline of the cover is a picture of a magic car driving through the sky of the city, and two figures can be vaguely seen on the car.
"Gosh, Ron, we reported it!" Harry said in astonishment.
Actually, he didn't need to remind him, Ron's eyes had been fixed on the newspaper long ago, and there was a bit of fear in his eyes, and he suddenly felt that the trouble might be bigger than they thought.
Above the head, a trembling owl flew over, with a red letter in its mouth, flapping its wings feebly, and flying extremely slowly, making people wonder whether this owl will be in the next moment. Suddenly fell down.
Fortunately, the gray-black owl finally completed its task and delivered the thing to Ron, even though it slammed into Hermione’s milk jug after that...
Ivan Limara backed Hermione a few meters away, covering her ears tightly.
"What's the matter?" Hermione asked strangely.
"That's a yelling letter, I advise you to be like me!" Ivan reminded him by turning his head and looking at her.
Although the little witch didn't know what was going on, she still blocked her ears like Ivan, and the Gryffindors who knew about it all ran away.
Harry swallowed and looked at Ron in horror. He had seen the power of the yelling letter in the last semester, and the sound could even wake up the entire Gryffindor lounge.
Ron's expression was also very ugly, he seemed to be almost crying... his fingers trembling and slowly opened the envelope.
Originally Ron was planning to destroy the roaring letter, or simply throw it into the lake.
But Neville stopped Ron, because doing so would have more serious consequences!
Anyway, don't ask how he knew...
Ron just tore the envelope through a small opening The letter moved on its own, folded into a big red mouth, and the loud voice suddenly echoed in the large exhibition hall, the nearest one of them The two felt that their ears were almost deaf!
"Ron! Why do you have the guts to do such a thing without telling us?! Ah? You drove that magic car to school without authorization!"
"If they fire you for this, I won't be surprised at all, and see how I will clean you up then. You probably never thought about it at all. Your father and I were in the mood when we found out that the car was gone..."
Mrs. Weasley's voice is usually very loud. After the bellowing letter was amplified hundreds of times, the sound wave formed even clinked the cup on the table.
Everyone in the auditorium heard it clearly, trying to see who received the yelling letter, and Harry and Ron were ashamed to death under everyone's attention.
It's uncomfortable to be executed in public, not to mention that Arthur might be expelled from the Ministry of Magic because of their involvement!
The roar lasted for more than ten minutes before it stopped. Then the envelope burned on its own and turned into ashes...

chapters.title: Chapter 171: You definitely think it's easy to make headlines, right? Harry?
chapters.content:
When the roar surrounding the hall completely disappeared, Ivan released the hands that tightly covered his ears.
There was a brief silence in the hall, only Harry and Ron were awkwardly at a loss as everyone watched.
At this moment, a mocking voice came over the Slytherin academy desk.
"Potter, it seems that you have done another showy thing..." Malfoy walked over with Gore and Clark, and he gave Harry a mocking look, then he was at Ron's. Stayed there for a while.
"Weasley, I guess your father must hate you to death by now. He may be forced to lose his job and get out of the Ministry of Magic dingy..."
As he said, Malfoy laughed, and Gore and Clark behind him also smirked...
Ron's face flushed red, he was anxious, and even ignoring that it was in the hall, he suddenly pulled out the taped wand and pointed it at Malfoy.
"The front teeth match is great!"
Malfoy was taken aback, panicked and wanted to draw out his wand to fight back.
But what surprised him was that as Ron chanted the spell, nothing happened.
Only a faint black mist floated out from the wand in Ron's hand...
"Weasley, what are you doing? Do you perform any magic tricks for us?" Malfoy sneered.
Ron was so angry that he couldn't wait to throw away the wand in his hand. Since this thing was broken by the beating willow last night, it hasn't been normal again...
For a while, Ron wanted to rush over to fight Malfoy in desperation, but was held back by Harry and Hermione. It was not a wise thing to do it in the big exhibition hall. If they didn't want to be locked up...
Ivan ignored their "friendly" interaction, and couldn't fight anyway. He waved his wand and began to clean up the mess on the table.
By the way, he put the letter away, and when he was ready to return to the bedroom, he would reply with an automatic quill pen.
However, what Ivan didn't expect was that Malfoy's courage was fattened a lot, or his confidence was inflated by mocking Ron's success...
"Halse!" Malfoy said loudly, and stepped forward and picked up the Daily Prophet on the table to look through it. After noticing the news content under the headline, he immediately said.
"Before I read the newspaper, I didn't know Hals, you actually live in a shabby place like Knock Down Alley... Isn't that the place where the poor ghosts and black wizards live? And you are also with a group of werewolves. .."
Ivan's brows frowned and she was about to speak, but Hermione was a step faster than him and scolded.
"Shut up Malfoy! It's no shame to live in Knockdown Alley. Ivan got the Merlin Medal, the highest honor of the Ministry of Magic, by his own efforts, can you?"
"So what? I heard my dad say that the wizard who lives in Knockdown Alley is like a mouse in the sewer!" Malfoy scorned his neck.
Thinking of his father always reprimanding him for this some time ago, Malfoy was very upset, and he was about to continue speaking when he was interrupted by Ivan's words.
"Do you only rely on your father? Malfoy?" Ivan looked at him lightly, tapped the wand in the palm of his right hand, and said.
"I thought you would be a little more independent in the second grade, instead of naively listening to your father."
Malfoy was so embarrassed that he was about to defend himself, but Ivan didn't give him this chance, and said mockingly.
"In addition, when I was talking and laughing with your dad a few days ago, you didn't know where you were! He told me that if your grades didn't improve this year, you probably won't have much success in this life..."
Ivan was full of nonsense, combined with the old Malfoy's dissatisfaction with his son in the Boquimbok store in the original book, and he just confuses Draco Malfoy.
Malfoy was originally unwilling to believe Ivan's words, especially not believing that Ivan could talk and laugh with his father, but the old Malfoy did scold him for this when he was at home...
"Don't believe it? Still haven't heard your dad talk about it? Then don't you hurry home and ask your dad to go!" Ivan looked at Malfoy who was a little shaken and scolded unceremoniously.
......
"Ivan, do you know Malfoy's father?"
In the morning, when heading to the corridor of the herbal medicine classroom, Hermione asked curiously what had happened, Harry and Ron were also a little confused.
They didn't expect Ivan to be in contact with Malfoy...
"No, in fact, we are not familiar, we just met once!" Ivan understood what Hermione wanted to say, and explained aloud.
"Then you dare to say that just now?" Hermione's eyes widened.
"What's the matter? You still talked and laughed with Minister Fudge last school year." Ivan said indifferently.
Harry and Ron were speechless, and Hermione rolled her eyes even more. If they remember correctly, they and Fudge had just had a face-to-face and said a word or two. Can this be called a joke?
Answering the three people's doubts, Ivan walked quickly into the greenhouse.
It didn't take long for Professor Sprout, who was strapped on his arm, to walk in from the outside lawn. Her face was not very good.
This is not just because Lockhart has been following her, trying to instill some messy knowledge of herbal medicine.
It’s even more because Lockhart released a so-called healing magic while treating the beating willow just now, which caused the beating willow to fall into a runaway state. In order to appease the tree, her arm was also drawn. Fortunately, the injury was not It's serious.
However, Lockhart did not have this self-consciousness at all. He was still full of confidence, proud like a peacock with an open screen, and generously walked in front of Professor Sprout, even blocking her. In front of him, shouted at everyone.
"Hello! I just showed Professor Sprout how to beat Liu to heal injuries! But I don't want you to think that I am better at herbalism than her! I just happened to have seen a few during my travels. This strange plant..."
Lockhart might still want to say a few more wordsProfessor Sprout did not hesitate to interrupt his words, loudly let all the students go to the third greenhouse, and start now Class!
Ivan hurriedly followed the crowd to the classroom.
When Harry tried to follow him, Lockhart stopped him.
"Professor Sprout, can I talk to Harry alone? Just two minutes! Don't you mind?" Lockhart turned his head and said to Professor Sprout.
Professor Sprout was very concerned, but Lockhart took Harry's arm on his own, took him to the side, and said earnestly.
"You must find it easy to make headlines, right? Harry?"
"What are you talking about, Professor? I don't quite understand?" Harry was confused, not understanding what Lockhart meant.

chapters.title: Chapter 172: Who on earth is this in class?
chapters.content:
Ivan who walked into the third greenhouse could vaguely hear the conversation between the two. Compared with the confused Harry, he understood Lockhart's aggrieved situation.
Lockhart's appointment as the Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor at Hogwarts was originally a matter worthy of media coverage, and was expected to top the headlines today, but was cruelly crushed by Harry and Ron driving in public. Under the feet.
This is undoubtedly a major blow to Lockhart, who is almost pathologically hungry for fame...
Not only that, Ivan thought for a while, and his popularity has not subsided recently. There are two positions in the first edition that are still analyzing whether he can get the Merlin Medal.
As for the news about Lockhart, it was swept directly into the corner of the page.
Ivan is very fortunate to think of this, but fortunately Harry has prevented him from doing so, otherwise he would be dragged to talk...
"Who can tell me the characteristics of mandela grass now?" Professor Sprout, who was holding some earmuffs in his hand, stood in front of some potted plants and asked loudly.
Although Ivan was a little distracted thinking about things, answering questions had already become his instinct. So after Professor Sprout’s words were finished, Ivan succeeded in rushing ahead of Hermione. Opened his mouth and said.
"Professor Sprout! The so-called mandela grass, also called mandela grass root, is a powerful healing agent that can restore the deformed or cursed person to a normal state, and it is also An important part of most antidote...
It is worth mentioning that the cry of mandela grass can kill people, but the young mandela grass will only make people feel dizzy until they are unconscious...
How to raise this plant..."
Ivan talked endlessly about the knowledge he had seen from the book, basically covering all aspects, and finished all the talk.
Then he rolled up his sleeves, ready to show everyone how to change the pots of Mandela grass.
Before that, Ivan certainly hadn't forgotten to remind the little wizards around to wear earmuffs so that something bad would happen.
Ivan was full of enthusiasm, and felt that he worked so hard, Professor Sprout would definitely add a lot of points to himself, and then give him a super high evaluation after class.
However, Ivan didn't see it, and Professor Sprout looked at him with a weird face.
You have done everything, so what shall I do?
Who on earth is this in class?
......
After class, Ivan hadn't gotten a grade point for a long time, which made him feel good.
The only regret is that Professor Sprout only gave him five points in the class, even though he explained all the characteristics of mandela grass, and by the way, he gave several mandela grass to change pots.. .
Ivan was even more looking forward to the next transfiguration class.
But when I was in the real class, Ivan was disappointed again, because today's course teaching is too simple, they need to spend one class to learn how to turn a beetle into a button!
Ivan waved his magic wand casually, and the unknown beetle that looked like a ladybug on the table trembled into a gray-black button with a clear and delicate pattern.
The most important thing is that the form is very stable. If no one takes the initiative to release it, it will not change back for more than ten days...
If this beetle hadn't starved to death by that time.
"Wonderful Transfiguration Curse! Gryffindor adds 10 points!" Professor McGonagall just finished distributing, he saw the buttons on Ivan's table, and said without hesitation while feeling that Ivan's Transformation Curse had improved. .
Professor McGonagall stepped forward and raised Ivan's deformed button high, showing it to the other little wizards to watch.
Hermione, who was not far away, looked at the buttons in McGonagall's hands, and then at the beetle that had just changed its shape at her table. She couldn't help but pouting her mouth. The gap between her and Ivan seemed to increase again. ..
Harry and Ron had long been used to them, and had no idea of ​​comparing them with Ivan. Harry was fighting against the beetles running around the table, lest it run under the table.
Ron's wand was completely out of control, like a short-circuited electrical appliance, bursts of black smoke came out...
The most unlucky thing was Seamus. He just waved his wand as instructed, and a flash of light burst from the top. When I looked again, there was a fire on the table, and the beetle was cooked by him...
This disappointed Professor McGonagall, who looked around. She had to return the button to Ivan, and rushed to Seamer to put out the fire. After a reprimand, she started doing it for other little wizards. guide.
Seeing this, Ivan couldn't help shook his head, turned the button back into a beetle, and used the remaining time to practice magic analysis.
In terms of his current level of curse theory, the second-year course is really simple for him, and it does not play a good role in learning. It is mainly used to obtain student status.
During class time, Ivan felt that he needed to think of other ways to use it.
As the lunch bell rang, most of the little wizards in the classroom practicing the Transfiguration Spell heaved a sigh of relief, which meant that they could finally take a break.
Ivan waited for the rest of the students to leave, then walked to the front desk and said to McGonagall, who was packing up his textbooks.
"Professor McGonagall! Do you remember our agreement last school year? The one who studied Animagus?"
"Hmm..." Professor McGonagall stopped, and the pupils under the round eyes looked at Ivan for a while, his eyes filled with appreciation and a little helplessness.
"Of course I didn't forget, Hals!"
"But it takes a lot of time to learn Animagus, so how about choosing this week's rest day?" McGonagall said.
"Of course!" Ivan nodded, indicating that he had no opinion.
He knows very well that Hogwarts professors usually have heavy academic tasks One person teaches seven grades. Professor McGonagall is willing to take a break to start a small stove for him, which is considered very good.
Thinking of this, Ivan was grateful for a while.
No teacher would dislike polite and gifted students, and Professor McGonagall naturally did the same. There was a smile on her tightly pressed mouth, but she still reminded.
"During this time, I hope you can reconsider whether you want to learn Animagus. I think you should understand the danger of this magic!"
"I won't give up, Professor!" Ivan said swearingly.
His transformation spell level has been stuck at level 4 for a long time, and his usual practice progress is minimal. He feels that the opportunity to break through to level 5 should be when he learns the transformation of Animagus!
(PS: Everyone has seen the like angels given in the honor selection, thank you for every book friend who likes!)
Sogou

chapters.title: Chapter 173: You must not know how this professor's position was vacated...
chapters.content:
With the promise of Professor McGonagall, Ivan went to the auditorium for dinner in a good mood.
When he arrived, the auditorium was already full of people, but fortunately, Hermione, Harry, and Ron had reserved a place for him...
"Ivan, why did you come so late?" Hermione was struggling with a steak, turned her head and asked aloud.
"Just ask Professor McGonagall for some questions..." Ivan smiled and said casually, without revealing much information.
The transformation of Animagus is a secret. Although he trusted Hermione, the less people know about this kind of thing, the safer it is..
"No wonder your Polymorph is so good!" Hermione said annoyedly.
The little witch somewhat understood the gap between herself and Ivan. It must be that she hadn't worked hard enough and didn't actively ask the professors of various subjects for questions!
Thinking that when Ivan was in the school year, he often tried to practice transfiguration while eating. Hermione also took the last cup to practice, and asked for the release techniques of transfiguration from time to time, and Ivan answered one by one.
Harry and Ron couldn't speak at all, and they had to complain to each other about the recent bad luck.
Ron, in particular, kept complaining about something wrong with his wand. Harry reluctantly asked him to write home and ask for another one, but Ron directly refused because he didn't want to be scolded again.
Ivan suddenly thought of something and asked.
"Ron, can you show me your broken wand?"
Ivan has always been curious about the method of making the wand.
However, he usually doesn't have any extra wands to study, and he doesn't want to take those intact wands apart and have a look, so Ron's broken one aroused his interest.
"Of course, Ivan, can you fix it?" Ron immediately handed his wand over, looking at Ivan expectantly.
Ivan took the magic wand and looked at it carefully, and found that the wand was badly damaged, almost broken in two, only some wood fibers were barely connected in the middle, and the outside was repaired by Ron with magic glue. Once, so that the wand won't fall off.
After opening the system bar, the information was displayed clearly.
[Magic items: magic wand (ash wood, unicorn hair)
Magic: low (medium)
Special state: broken
Explanation: This is a badly damaged wand. Although it did not damage the core of the wand, using this wand to cast spells has a certain probability of injuring yourself. 】
"Perhaps it can be repaired, but I can't guarantee it!" Ivan was a little sure after seeing the explanation, but he was still uncertain.
"Then you can do it whatever you want, it's bad enough now anyway." Ron said indifferently, and he was angry when he saw the wand now.
Ivan nodded and temporarily put the wand away.
Hermione suddenly remembered something at this moment. "Ron, you gave Ivan your wand, what about the next Defense Against the Dark Arts class?"
"Trust me, I won't use the wand in the next Defense Against the Dark Arts class!" Ivan said.
"Why?" Hermione was holding a brand new timetable in her hand, which circled Lockhart's courses in a heart shape, she said expectantly. "I think Professor Lockhart will definitely let us learn some new spells!"
Ivan looked at Hermione with a weird look. He thought that Lockhart's ruthless performance in Diagon Alley had already saddened Hermione.
But I believe this Defence Against the Dark Arts class will definitely impress Hermione...
"Even if I teach us a new spell in the next class, I won't be able to release it with that broken magic wand." Ron was very discerning, anyway.
Harry faintly felt that Lockhart's teaching was absolutely terrible, because the other party didn't look like a serious professor.
The facts were worse than they thought, or they were in trouble on the way to the classroom.
A first-year, very thin, gray-haired boy was stuck in the middle of the road with a Muggle camera in his hand. He blushed when he saw Harry and couldn't wait to greet him.
"Hello, Harry? I...I'm Colin Crevy and I'm also at Gryffindor College. Excuse me... I mean, can I take a picture of you?"
Take a picture? Harry was very confused. No one had ever asked him like this before.
Colin seemed very enthusiastic. He talked about Harry's legendary deeds, such as how Harry escaped the mysterious man's murderous hand, and even planned to let Harry sign a name for himself.
Ivan glanced sympathetically at Harry. Being famous doesn't seem to be all good, and sometimes it can be troublesome.
But what Ivan didn't expect was that this little devil named Colin Creevey, after telling Harry's legendary deeds all over, quickly looked at himself again.
"Also, you are Ivan Hals, right? I've read the newspapers these days, my God, it says you are the savior of the werewolves, the best potion genius in hundreds of years!
