According to records, Haierbo also became the first person to integrate the blood of the basilisk, and was also the most famous dark wizard at the time It is rumored that he could instantly put his opponent to death...
Salazar Slytherin is probably the second person to incorporate the blood of the basilisk!
It's just that there is no record on the sheepskin scroll, what kind of abilities the founder of Hogwarts has acquired...
But one thing is clearly recorded on the sheepskin scroll, that is, fusion of snake blood will not have any sequelae...
Only then did Ivan put down the sheepskin scroll in his hand and walked to the cauldron that was "grumbling" bubbling, watching the chaotic fusion potion gradually turning into it, and he didn't hesitate to add the cold basilisk blood to it. .
The chaotic-colored fusion potion rose up, slowly turning into dark green in just a few minutes, flashing with faint fluorescence...
"System, exchange protection mode!" Ivan put the potion into the test tube, held it in his hand, and said.
(PS: The reason for Voldemort's snake face will be explained later, and it is related to many factors... Anyway, the protagonist will not change...)

chapters.title: Chapter 237: Fusion of the blood of the basilisk!
chapters.content:
Latest website: Just after Ivan spoke, a strange feeling came to my heart.
Suddenly, Ivan found that the magic in his body became extremely active, even so active that he could directly control it.
This reminded Ivan of the magical state he entered on the verge of collapse when he first performed the blood fusion, and felt very similar to the current feeling.
Ivan stretched out the index finger of his right hand, Shen Feng Wuying instantly activated, and the invisible magic blade slashed across the square table in front of him.
Hum~
There was a crisp sound of breaking through the air,
In the next moment, the square table and the crucible on it were neatly cut into two pieces and fell to the ground!
"Is this the protection mode?" Ivan said with emotion, he can freely control the magic in his body without the need to cast spells or wands.
This made Ivan realize that the protection mode can not only be used to fuse multiple bloodlines, but also to improve strength and protect himself at a critical moment...
I just don't know how long it will last...
Ivan glanced at the information prompt in the system bar, then his face changed drastically...
"Oh, it's only one minute!"
Ivan suddenly became nervous, because five seconds have passed since the time was delayed!
Seeing this, Ivan no longer hesitated, and poured the fusion potion in his right hand into one mouthful.
The green liquid inlet was extremely bitter, and Ivan forcibly endured it and swallowed it into his abdomen with difficulty.
But then, Ivan felt a cold deep into the soul, gradually spreading from his stomach, gradually flowing into the body, deep into the bone marrow and blood, all the way up to the brain...
What made him even more shocked was that there seemed to be some power in his blood that had awakened, boiling like hot oil...
Ivan could even clearly hear the neigh of unicorns in his mind...
Under the influence of this force, the biting coldness gradually receded, but it soon came up like a wave again...
Perhaps because of the protection mode turned on, Ivan found that he seemed to have acquired the ability to look inside.
He can clearly see his body, representing the magic power of the basilisk and the magic power of the unicorn, as if using the body as a battlefield, constantly intertwined and collided...
It was only then that Ivan understood what was going on with the conflict of fusion of multiple bloodlines.
"Stop it for me!" Ivan naturally didn't want these two distinctive powers to consume each other in his body.
Decisively mobilized the manipulable magic power in the body and suppressed the unicorn's power.
After losing control, the fusion potion finally came into play, slowly blending into the whole body, Ivan obviously felt that his magic power began to increase rapidly...
The magic scale in the status bar increases a little almost every few seconds...
More new-born magic power is gathered all the way up, pouring into the eyes!
Ivan soon felt a burst of pain in his eyes, but he didn't dare to knead it with his hands. He could only endure the discomfort, and finally closed his eyes temporarily when he couldn't bear it.
This kind of suffering lasted for an unknown amount of time, and when Ivan felt that the magical power of the restlessness in his body had calmed down and his eyes had returned to normal, the system prompt sounded in his mind.
[Protection mode is over! 】
Ivan opened his eyes and adapted to it for a while, listening to the system's prompt sound, somewhat disappointed, he originally wanted to use the protection mode to practice some magic.
It was like the first biological transformation through the improvement of the state during the first blood fusion.
But soon, Ivan adjusted it, and in one minute, it would be good for him to complete the second blood fusion.
What's more, he wasted a few seconds before.
Open the status bar..
Ivan muttered silently in his heart, preparing to see how his state would change after he merged with the second bloodline.
【Ivan Hals
Occupation: Blood Wizard
Blood Fusion: 2/7
Magic scale: 97
Magic Bar: Thunderbolt Explosion Level 4 Transfiguration Curse Level 5 Calling God Guardian Level 4 Occupational Technique Level 5 Shen Feng Wuying Level 4...
Blood Magic: Shadow of Unicorn, Eye of Basilisk
......】
Ivan looked at the status bar in front of him.
Compared to before, the magic power has increased by more than 30 points, and now the magic power scale close to ninety points is equivalent to an ordinary adult wizard.
The proficiency of various magics has also improved somewhat, but it is not high in relative terms. Only Shenfeng Wuying's proficiency has soared, and it is one step closer to the fifth level!
The most important thing is naturally the newly acquired bloodline magic, this time it is directly displayed on the list.
"The pupil of the basilisk... is it the eyes of the basilisk that see who is dead?" Ivan suddenly became excited, this is a bug-like ability.
Ivan hurriedly walked to a smooth mirror and checked his current appearance.
"En.. It seems that nothing has changed.."
Ivan found that his appearance hadn't changed much before the fusion, except that his temperament was a little bit colder, neutralizing the affinity that the unicorn brought him, and his eyes were still black.
Ivan thought for a while, closed his eyes, and tried to transfer some magic power to his pupils.
Immediately afterwards, I felt that my eyes seemed to be soaked in ice water. When he opened it again, his black eyes had turned into orange-yellow vertical snake eyes.
Looking at the eyes in the mirror, Ivan couldn't help feeling a palpitating heart.
But just like the basilisk looking at the reflection in the water and not committing suicide, Ivan didn't feel any other reactions in his body except for the feeling that these eyes were a little diametrically opposed.
At this moment, two crisp **** sounds suddenly sounded beside him...
Ivan turned his head and looked at only to find that the two roosters who had survived the battle with the basilisk were awake at some point.
However, at the moment when his eyes met the two roosters, Ivan suddenly felt that his eyes were like two black holes, rapidly extracting the magic power from his body, plundering nearly half in just one second!
Ivan immediately panicked, and sooner or later he would be drained if this went on, but the magic in his body was constantly pouring into his eyes, and he was unable to stop it.
In the end, he could only close his eyes forcibly to avoid the fate of being sucked up.
After a while, Ivan felt that his eyes should have been restored to their original state, and then slowly opened his eyes.
"It's too difficult to control..." Yifan rubbed his aching eyes, then glanced at the magic scale in the status bar, and found that his magic power had actually consumed 70%!
Ivan couldn't help being a bit stunned. How did he feel that although the total amount of his magic power had increased a lot, it seemed to be less and less useful!

chapters.title: Chapter 238: Those who are my enemy, die!
chapters.content:
Latest URL: How are my two chickens? "Ivan suddenly thought of the two roosters who were looking at him.
When I turned my head and looked over, I realized that there were only two lifelike chicken-shaped stone sculptures...
With so much magic power, is it just petrification?
Thinking of this, Ivan was somewhat disappointed. He thought he could stare at whoever died like the eyes of a basilisk.
Ivan shook his head and waved his wand to dispel the petrified magic. But after chanting the spell, the two chicken-shaped stone sculptures did not respond....
"Spell stop!" Ivan tried again, but still failed to lift the petrified state.
Ivan's face changed.
He remembered that after Colin, Hermione and others in the original time and space saw the eyes of the basilisk through cameras, mirrors and standing water on the ground, they seemed to have entered this unremovable petrified state.
"In that case, this is not simply petrification, but a weakened death!" Ivan muttered to himself.
No wonder he had already petrified the two roosters, but these magic eyes were still constantly pumping the magic power in his body. I am afraid that if enough magic power was injected, he could achieve the effect of directly staring at the enemy.
But killing two chickens requires so much magic power. Wouldn't it be more difficult to stare a wizard to death?
The runaway of Snake Eye just now made Ivan realize that the new abilities he acquired might not be so easy to master...
To convert it into combat power, it takes a long time to explore and practice!
...
In the next few days, Ivan was experimenting with the newly acquired blood magic.
This has caused the rats and spiders in the castle to suffer one after another, and there are also a pile of lifelike stone statues in the responsive house.
While experimenting with the new magic, Ivan also did not forget another important thing, that is, looking for the lost Horcrux!
The Horcrux had been lost for nearly a week, but Tom Riddle didn't cause anything, and the door of the secret room showed no sign of being opened.
This abnormality made Ivan a little uneasy.
It stands to reason that he had been so furious with Tom Riddle before, and the other party should choose to drive the basilisk to avenge himself at the first time.
Could it be that the Horcrux was picked up by some professor, or simply picked up by Dumbledore?
"You shouldn't be so cold, Tom... this is not your style!" Ivan muttered to himself.
After dinner, Ivan, as usual, took a few mice he had caught, and went to the responsive house.
When I walked to a corridor on the eighth floor, Ivan's pupils shrank suddenly, and a chill came to his heart.
At the end of the front corridor, a girl in a Ravenclaw uniform was lying down in a pool of blood, with a clear wound on her left wrist.
On the opposite wall, a line of handwriting was written in a red, unknown liquid.
[The secret room has been opened, and those who are enemies with me, die! ——Ivan Hals]
"Damn it, Tom, you actually want to cheat me!" Ivan felt a surge of anger when he looked at his name on the inscription, but it was obviously not the time to pay attention to this.
Ivan rushed to the Ravenclaw girl and tried a little bit. Seeing that she was still breathing, she should have just fainted, so he quickly grabbed her wrist and pressed her wand against it.
"The scar is healed!" Ivan slowly said the healing magic he had learned from Doug, and the scar on the girl's left hand quickly healed.
However, the girl's face was still pale and scary, and Ivan hesitated for a while and didn't care anymore, but hurriedly dealt with the writing on the wall.
Ivan knows that this kind of planting method is clumsy, but sometimes it is extraordinarily effective...
After all, he really went into the secret room and couldn't stand any investigation!
"Clear water is like a spring!" Ivan summoned a bunch of clear water to wash the blood red writing on the wall, but these writings were not so easy to be cleaned out...still attached to it.
At this moment, there was a sound of footsteps in the distance...
"Split to pieces!" In anxious, Ivan exploded his name with a splitting curse, and then cast the phantom curse again, concealing his figure.
At the other end of the corridor, two Ravenclaw students walked in doubtfully hearing the noise.
The next moment, high-decibel screams spread throughout the floor.
"what!!!"
Ivan covered his ears and walked slowly outside the two Ravenclaw students in an invisible form.
But he didn't intend to leave, but calmly hid in a corner where no one noticed, and lifted the phantom curse, then walked out again, mixed in the crowd, pretending to have just arrived, and returned to the original place. .
In just such a short time, the corridor was already crowded with people. Everyone gathered around here to watch this terrible scene, and even a little girl fainted on the spot.
Ivan's heart was full of anger. He carefully checked the expressions of everyone, especially the little wizards who arrived first...
It is a pity that under his gaze, everyone's expressions seem to be normal, and the appropriate fear and surprise are not pretending.
"Get out! What are you all gathering here for?" Professor McGonagall's voice came from the rear, and the little wizards in front automatically stepped aside.
Professor McGonagall stepped forward and saw the Ravenclaw girl lying in a pool of blood.
"What the hell...what the **** is going on?!" Professor McGonagall saw this scene, his heartbeat slowed by a beat, and he almost didn't faint.
Professor McGonagall rushed to the Ravenclaw girl and tested her snorted with a trembling hand.
"Fortunately, she is still alive!" Professor McGonagall breathed a sigh of relief. She almost thought that this poor child was already...
Professor McGonagall stood up and prepared to take the Ravenclaw girl directly to the school hospital.
But Mrs. Pomfrey, who had been notified long ago, has arrived at this time. Dumbledore and several professors at Hogwarts walked in with her...
"Oh my god, what the **** is this?" Madam Pomfrey was also shocked when she saw the pool of blood on the ground, and quickly succeeded Professor McGonagall to check the girl's condition.
Lockhart also leaned in for the first time, wanting to see how that girl was going.
But it was pushed away by Madam Pomfrey. The situation was urgent. She didn't want someone in the way to be by her side.
Dumbledore was staring at the writing on the wall, paying special attention to the damaged place...
Ivan noticed this, and his heartbeat increased a lot...
"Who was the first to arrive here!" Dumbledore looked around and asked.
"It's us...Professor! But she was already lying there when we first arrived..." The two hapless Ravenclaw boys raised their hands in fear, and then explained the matter anxiously. It has nothing to do with yourself.

chapters.title: Chapter 239: Is this the fix you are talking about?
chapters.content:
The latest website: "So is it the blood you stopped her?" Madam Pomfrey, who was half-kneeling on the ground, was checking the left hand of the Ravenclaw girl. She turned her head and said admiringly.
"You did a great job! Saved her life!"
"No, professor, we didn't do anything." The two boys shook their heads in horror, saying that this was the case when they first arrived.
"Who would it be?" Madam Pomfrey stood up and asked strangely.
"Isn't it the guy who attacked this girl did it?" Lockhart said a joke, thinking he was humorous.
"It's possible!" Professor McGonagall interrupted.
Several other professors also nodded. They thought that the student should be the one who attacked the girl. It was probably impulsive, and then they couldn't bear the death of the other party to remedy it.
Dumbledore was silent for a while, looked at the two Ravenclaw boys, and asked.
"Did you find anything unusual when you came? For example, you heard a sound, or there were other people nearby..."
The two Ravenclaw boys remembered the noise they had heard before and truthfully reported to Dumbledore.
"Is that so? It looks like someone is eager to cover up something... Why don't we use the restoration spell to restore it..." Professor McGonagall also noticed that there were traces of damage by the spell on the wall, and he wanted to raise the wand. Cast spells.
Ivan, who was on the sidelines, raised his throat with his heart. He couldn't imagine what would happen to everyone looking at his name after the handwriting was restored?
How should he explain?
I didn't admit it to death, insisting that I had never been here, the handwriting and broken marks on the wall were made by the person who framed me...
Or just admit it, saying that after arriving at the scene, he rescued the girl immediately, and then discovered that someone was about to frame him, so he broke the wall and hid?
Both explanations seem blank...
Ivan seemed to see the sixteen-year-old Slytherin boy smirking at himself.
He finally realized why Tom Riddle placed this **** the eighth floor.
Because there is a responsive house behind this corridor, he basically goes there at this time of the day, and the other party put the girl there, just for him to discover it.
If this happens to a student who can't cure magic, he can only watch the Ravenclaw girl die, and then immediately want to erase the writing on the wall.
As the behind-the-scenes Tom Riddle, he only needs to let the student he controls appear here with someone, and seeing all this can complete a perfect planting...
Ivan knows that although he has avoided the worst, he still hasn't escaped Tom Riddle's trap.
Unless you can clean up all traces in a short period of time, and remove the Ravenclaw girl who fell in a pool of blood, you will not be able to remove the suspicion in anything...
Ivan kept thinking in his mind how to explain it later,
Just then Lockhart's voice rang.
"Let me come, I am afraid that no one here is better at doing this kind of repair work than me!" Lockhart waved his magic wand before Professor McGonagall.
A crimson magical ray hit the wall, and then a violent roar sounded. A big hole appeared in the wall of the corridor, and dust fell from the sky...
"This is the fix you said? There is nothing there now..." Snape said sarcastically in a timely manner.
Everyone stared at this scene blankly, several professors looked at Lockhart with weird eyes, the latter looked at a loss.
Dumbledore took a step forward at this moment, drew the old wand from his sleeve, and waved it, and all the lime embers on the ground were glued back to the wall.
However, many of the rubble had been stained with blood on the ground, and Ivan was first washed with water like a fountain curse, so the writing on it was completely indistinguishable.
Ivan was finally relieved, he has never been so lucky...
Dumbledore frowned when he saw this situation. He glanced at Lockhart dissatisfiedly, then turned and said to the two Ravenclaw boys.
"Mr. Abel, Mr. Adrian, please come with me!"
Dumbledore left with the two of them, and several professors maintained order, and the little wizards who surrounded here quickly returned to their dorms. Mrs. Pomfrey took the Ravenclaw girl who had passed out into a coma to the school hospital.
Ivan managed to get away, but he was not happy at all in his heart.
Since Tom Riddle can do a similar attack, it is very likely that there will be a second or a third time!
Ivan didn't think he was so lucky every time.
The only way is to find the person who holds the diary before the next attack!
"Halse, how about going to my office later?" Lockhart suddenly chased him from behind as Ivan was thinking about it, and patted him on the shoulder.
"Okay!" Ivan looked at him for a while and nodded.
......
Stepping into Lockhart's office again, Ivan looked around, and there were some books stacked on the table, all of which were magic books.
When I came back last time, Ivan saw these books on Lockhart's desk. He thought he was a three-minute heat, but he didn't expect it to be there today.
"Are you able to release magic normally now?" Ivan asked curiously. Didn't he remember Lockhart would run away when releasing magic? Reading these books doesn't seem to be of much use, right?
"No, but if only one magic is practiced for a period of time, maybe it can be used normally like my forgetting spell..." Lockhart shook his head and said helplessly.
Immediately after Lockhart said again without giving up. "Halse, do you really have no way to quickly improve your strength?"
"I think I've said it before, no!" Ivan shook his head.
"What you are doing now is very good. Improve your knowledge of magic. Spend the time you have to reply to your fans on the practice of magic. After a few years, you should be able to regain the ability to cast spells that a normal wizard should have." Fan added.
"It took several years to become an ordinary wizard? That's not what I wanted!" Lockhart was very disappointed.
But Lockhart soon adjusted and talked about business, which is the exchange of identities in the duel club tomorrow.
Ivan then remembered that there was still this thing, if Lockhart didn't mention it, he almost forgot.
However, Ivan hesitated for a while and did not refuse, because it means that he can use his status as a professor to reach most of the students and check whether they are suspected...

chapters.title: Chapter 240: Absorbed vitality
chapters.content:
Latest website: After agreeing to Lockhart's request, Ivan did not leave directly, but asked him to teach himself the forgetting spell.
The experience of this semester made Ivan deeply understand the importance of this spell.
If he had forgotten the curse in the first place, Hermione would not have known about sneaking into the Gryffindor girl's bed.
It can also allow him to deal with today's things more calmly, for example, he can completely erase the memories of the two Ravenclaw boys and clean up the handwriting on the wall before the others arrive.
"You want to learn the Forgetting Curse? Why? Are you going to erase anyone's memory?" Lockhart asked curiously.
"Just in case." Ivan glanced at him without explaining. "What do you ask so much for? I won't use it to you..."
"I didn't say that, it's just that this magic is not so easy to learn..." Lockhart smiled brightly, and began to explain to Ivan the spells, gestures, and methods of the Forgotten Curse.
In other magic, Lockhart may be just a mediocre, but in the accomplishments of the Forgotten Curse, he is a real master, and the entire magical world may not find a better wizard for the Forgotten Curse.
After all, Lockhart has used all his ingenuity on this curse for decades.
Finally, there was an opportunity to show off the truth. Lockhart said that he was very devoted, and even explained some of the small skills he had summarized.
Of course, this is also related to the little wizard in front of him holding his handle.
Under the guidance of Lockhart, the master of the Forgotten Curse, Ivan's understanding of the Forgotten Curse also increased linearly.
After consuming a certain grade point, Ivan can hear the sound of rising proficiency in his mind every once in a while.
Soon, Ivan saw the magic of Forgotten Curse appearing in the magic column of the system.
"Forget it all!" Ivan waved his wand, and a creamy white spell light hit the wall.
Since there is no goal, Ivan doesn't know how much it is.
"You learned it? So fast!" Lockhart was surprised. As a master of the Forgotten Curse, he of course could see that Ivan had already mastered this curse.
You must know that the Forgotten Mantra is a very difficult memory mantra. It took him three days to learn it. He thought it was already very fast. He had been complacent about it before.
"Almost." Ivan nodded casually.
"Your talent is really amazing." Lockhart sighed with emotion and a little jealousy.
"There is no need to envy me, for the simple understanding of the Forgotten Curse, I am afraid that no one in the magical world is better than you." Ivan shook his head and said aloud.
"That's natural, otherwise I wouldn't be so famous." Lockhart said triumphantly.
This is also the only thing he deserves to be proud of. Not everyone can clear the memories of so many powerful wizards with the Forgetting Curse, without revealing any flaws.
Ivan doesn't bother to correct Lockhart's ideas, everyone has their own way of living.
After learning the forgetting spell, Ivan opened the door and was ready to leave.
Suddenly, Ivan remembered something, turned his head and tentatively asked.
"By the way, Professor Lockhart, what do you think about the attack today?"
Lockhart was stunned, and then replied regretfully. "That's an enthusiastic Ravenclaw. I signed the girl before, but luckily she's okay..."
......
Walking out of Lockhart's office, Ivan followed the crowd back to the Gryffindor lounge.
Almost everyone along the way was guessing who attacked the Ravenclaw girl, and all kinds of rumors continued.
This situation continued until noon the next day. After Hermione asked about the secret room from Professor Bins, the little wizards who were born in Muggle families suddenly felt themselves in danger.
They think that the opener of the Chamber of Secrets must be like the rumors that the Muggle-born wizard is not worthy of learning magic, so they wanted to kill the Ravenclaw girl.
The writing on the wall is to warn everyone that anyone who intends to prevent the other party from cleaning the campus will also be killed together.
The most unlucky is Harry, who was listed as the first suspect in the attack because of his previous exposure of the snake-like voice.
Because it is said that the Chamber of Secrets was established by Salazar Slytherin, and the most famous trait of the founder of Hogwarts is the vibe!
"Damn, how could they suspect you? You were with us all the time yesterday!" Ron said angrily in the hallway outside the classroom after class.
Harry was also very depressed. He obviously did nothing, but was somehow thought to be the attacker.
"Do you think it has something to do with Voldemort?" Harry suddenly thought of Ivan's stolen diary, lowered his voice, and said.
"Perhaps..." Ivan said casually, then turned to look at Hermione, and asked aloud. "Hermione, is the injured Ravenclaw awake?"
To find out who took the Horcrux, the most direct way is to ask the girl who was injured yesterday. The other party will most likely know some clues.
"Not yet, I heard from Madam Pomfrey. In addition to being injured, she seems to have been hit by a very powerful black magic, and the lack of vitality is very serious." Hermione said sadly.
"Lack of vitality..." Ivan frowned, and he found that the situation was worse than he thought.
It seems that Tom Riddle is not only planning to frame him, but also secretly trying to restore his strength.
This discovery also gave Ivan some clues.
Having been in contact with Tom for so long Ivan has a deep understanding of the power of Horcruxes.
Unless the girl has 100% trust in the Horcrux and is willing to open up part of her soul for it, it is absolutely impossible for Tom to absorb so much vitality from a little wizard in a short time.
This means that the Ravenclaw girl is likely to hold Horcrux for a long time to establish this degree of trust.
Now that the poor child has lost the value of use, Tom cruelly abandoned him, threw it out as an abandoned child, and caused him some trouble by the way.
"Amazing, Tom, you are really getting more and more skillful." Ivan is having a headache. He used to tease Tom every day by relying on the advantage of information, but now he is almost cheated by Tom.
Compared with Ginny in the original time and space, Ivan understands that Tom has now recovered a certain amount of strength, but it should not be enough to be resurrected, because the Ravenclaw girl is still alive...
But wait for Tom to breathe in the vitality of a few more people!

chapters.title: Chapter 241: Duel with Snape
chapters.content:
Latest URL: night,
In the office of the Defense Against the Dark Arts class, Ivan came here half an hour early, drank the compound decoction, and turned into Lockhart's appearance.
"Cape, gloves, ring! And magic wand!" Ivan wrinkled looking at himself in the mirror, then stretched out his hand to the side.
Lockhart handed the three-piece suit of his own pretense, but when he finally handed the wand he hesitated and said reluctantly.
"Why do you even want my wand? I gave it to you, so what should I do?"
"If you don't want me to be seen through, then take them all!" Ivan rolled his eyes, then looked at Lockhart, who had turned into his own appearance with the compound decoction, and warned.
"Also, you'd better stay in your office and don't go anywhere!"
"How can that work? I don't want to miss such an important moment. Give me your magic wand, what if I am called on stage by another professor?" Lockhart raised his eyebrows.
Ivan shook his head, and there was nothing to do with him, so he threw him a protective ring.
As for his unicorn wand, Ivan was not going to give it to Lockhart. Fortunately, he still had a wand with a dragon heartstring, which he has not returned since he got it from Aysia last time.
It happened to be used by Lockhart now, but even so, Ivan still urged Lockhart not to take the stage at will and ruin his reputation.
......
All the way to the venue of the duel club, Ivan found that the decoration in the large exhibition hall has been very different from the previous one.
The flags of the four colleges were hung high in the air. With the gentle breeze floating, four high stages were placed in the center, ensuring that most of the students could go on stage and show off their skills in one night.
Ivan was pretty sure that this was not Lockhart's idea, because this guy would only set up a stage so that everyone's eyes could be on him.
"There are so many people here..." Ivan looked at the bustling exhibition hall, somewhat surprised. It seemed that there were more little wizards here tonight than the last time.
He thought that yesterday's attack would affect the organization of the duel club today.
When Ivan thought this way, an ethereal voice sounded behind him.
"Because everyone is worried, so I want to know how to protect myself..."
Ivan turned his head to look over, and behind him was a familiar figure in a Ravenclaw robe.
"Lu...cough cough..." Ivan almost missed his mouth, but fortunately, remembering that Lockhart and Luna were not so familiar, he changed his words.
"Miss Lovegood, what you said makes a lot of sense, yes, that's why I organize a duel club."
"By the way, Miss Lovegood, what's the matter with you when you came to me?" Ivan was very surprised that Luna came to see Lockhart for what she did. She was not a fan of Lockhart.
Luna's silver-gray pupils looked at him for a while, and did not reply. After a while, she suddenly pointed to his right wrist.
Ivan lowered his head and glanced confusedly, only then did he notice the magic ring on his wrist.
"It turned out to be because of this..." Ivan sighed, unexpectedly he was already so cautious, but still exposed his identity because of the magic circle.
"I have been carrying it before I saw you, so I guess you won't give this thing to someone else, will you? In addition, the real Professor Lockhart will immediately walk up to the stage so that everyone can watch it the first time. To him..."
Luna kept talking about what was wrong with Ivan, which to her was as interesting as solving a mystery.
"I'm glad that not every student is as smart as you, otherwise I'll just go back and forget it." Ivan said helplessly, but Luna clearly told him what is missing in disguise.
Thinking of this, Ivan removed the magic ring from her right hand and put it on her wrist in Luna's surprised gaze.
"You made a mistake just now. When necessary, I will temporarily leave this thing to others for safekeeping!"
"You can use its power in the duel, but in exchange, you have to help me cover when others ask." Ivan said with a smile.
There are a lot of smart little wizards in Hogwarts, and the few teaching professors are not easy to deal with. He is wearing a bracelet on his right hand. It is estimated that many people will be able to notice.
Put it here, it can be said that it was temporarily loaned to her...
Whoosh~
After making an agreement with Luna, Ivan raised his magic wand and shot a magical light into the air, which exploded suddenly in the air, and colorful fluorescent light spilled from the air.
"I'm very happy to see so many people here today!" Yifan was attracting everyone's attention, adjusted his expression and Shi Shiran stepped onto the stage, looked around the crowd, and said loudly.
"I think you all have heard of yesterday’s attack, and are worried about it, and eagerly hope that you can learn some magic to protect yourself in today’s course... This is also the original intention of opening this duel course. !"
"But what I want to tell you is that in addition to practicing spellcasting skills to improve your own strength, it is more important to stay vigilant at all times!
Many dark wizards seem harmless to humans and animals on the surface, and even provide you with a certain amount of help in order to gain trust. The same is true for certain dark magic items.
I have heard such a sentence, don’t believe in anything that is self-conscious, unless you can clearly know where its brain is placed..."
Ivan's gaze swept across the crowd below, watching everyone's expressions and movements and remembering them one by one.
But Ivan didn't dare to say too clearly. He could only use Lockhart's identity to mention a little bit, and ask them to pay attention to them in peacetime. It is best to travel with three or five people. If you find any abnormalities, come to him immediately!
After some preaching, Ivan found that the little wizards below were dizzy and sleepy. Only a handful of people took his words in their hearts. Several professors looked at him with admiration and nodded frequently.
"Well, it seems that you are not interested in what I said, so now we officially start our today's course." Ivan shrugged helplessly, and then said loudly.
"Next, I have your Potions professor and Dean of Slytherin School-Snape to be my opponent! We will show you what a real wizarding duel is!"
As Ivan's voice fell, the little wizards who had been dizzy and drowsy suddenly became sober, and their eyes were placed on the other side of the high platform, expecting Snape to take the stage.
The duel between the two professors is extremely rare, and they are speculating about who will win the final victory...

chapters.title: Chapter 242: I hope you can be as good as the biography is written!
chapters.content:
Latest URL: Snape, wearing a dark green magic robe, had already stood under the stage for some unknown time, and walked up quickly, dragging a long black cloak.
Looking at the slightly thin figure in front of him, Ivan faintly felt a great pressure.
Compared to Lockhart, who rashly challenged the opponent in the original time and space, Ivan was very clear about Snape's strength.
It can be said that Snape is one of the most powerful wizards in the magical world, except for wizards that exceed specifications such as Dumbledore and Voldemort.
Even if Voldemort, who had possessed Chino last school year, stood here, he couldn't be Snape's opponent!
But this is also the reason why Ivan chose to challenge Snape. He urgently needs to know his level of strength after the second blood fusion, and the best way is naturally to fight!
"Professor Snape, are you ready?" Ivan asked.
"I never need to prepare!" Snape spit out two words expressionlessly, and then said sarcastically. "I hope you can be as good as a biography in a while!"
"You'll know right away..." Ivan said noncommittal.
After saying that Ivan bowed in accordance with the duel process, Snape only slightly nodded under the gaze of the little wizards.
"Three...two...one!" Ivan shouted the countdown, and when he said the last number, the wand in his hand flicked.
"Except for your weapons!"
A red spell ray flew towards Snape.
Snape indifferently blessed an iron armor curse on his body, and the magic barrier rose up, resisting the disarming curse.
However, the rebound effect of the Iron Armor Curse hadn't been activated yet, and two more spell rays collided. The magic barrier was instantly shattered, and Snape staggered back a few steps before stabilizing his figure.
"Very well... you really exceeded my expectations." Snape's expression became extremely ugly, put aside his thoughts of contempt, and glanced at Ivan's gloves, ring and cloak.
From his eyes, it was natural to see that Lockhart had several powerful magic items on his body. Just now, Lockhart took advantage of the instantaneous magic items to release three spells in one second. Caught him by surprise.
Although it was seen that the other party had borrowed external force, Snape didn't point it out.
After all, magic items are part of the power of the wizard, not to mention the continuous use of magic items to cast spells usually requires high magic skills...
"You made a big mistake, that is, you didn't pursue the chase when I made a mistake. That is your only chance to win me!" Snape walked back to his previous position with a sullen face, and Ivan Relatively far away.
"That kind of victory is not what I want!" Ivan shook his head.
He was going to use Snape as a sharpening stone to increase his strength, so he didn't intend to win by trickery!
Even Ivan reminded the little wizards who were watching leisurely. "Did you guys see it just now? This is the first thing I need you to keep in mind. Underestimating the enemy is a big taboo in battle!"
Snape's face suddenly darkened.
Seeing Ivan using Snape as a negative textbook, many students in the audience couldn't help laughing. George and Fred even took the lead in applauding. It was the first time they saw Snape deflated. ..
Seeing that Snape's expression became more ugly, Ivan secretly beat a drum. Was he too exciting?
"You will regret it... Oolong goes out of the cave!" Snape chanted the spell coldly. Under the swing of his wand, three huge black snakes ejected, sharp fangs in the mouth of the serpent in mid-air. Faintly shining cold light.
At this moment, a red light exploded in the air, and the three large black and red snakes were torn into dozens of segments. The broken body of the snake turned into countless white birds before it hit the ground and lased again towards Snape.
Snape's face didn't change, and he waved down with his wand.
Hundreds of candles floating above the exhibition hall were generally guided. The faint flames swelled up, splitting out a series of flames, burning flocks of birds to ashes, and then without stopping, a large number of candlelights gathered into a flame Long snake...
"Disperse! Disperse! Everyone stay away!" The professors in the audience suddenly changed their faces. Flitwick saw that the two sides were really moving, and quickly scolded the students around the platform to make them empty. Get a safe distance.
"The thunderbolt exploded!" At the same moment, Ivan chanted the spell, and the orange fireball flew from the top of the wand, swelled in the wind, and finally hit the flame snake.
Although Ivan could not use the enhanced magic text for blessing this time, the power of the thunderbolt explosion is still amazing!
Under the collision of the two, a violent roar sounded in the large exhibition hall, and the flames spattered everywhere!
Professor Flitwick outside the court saw this, holding his magic wand and preparing to remove the aftermath, so as not to affect the little wizards watching.
But before he could do anything, the escaping flames were once again gathered into the duel. Ivan's wand danced lightly, the flames changed form, and a flaming steed rose into the sky, constantly neighing in the air!
Snape pursed his mouth and no longer kept his hands. The invisible and invisible magic blade pierced the void, smashing the flaming steed in an instant!
Without staying at all, the invisible blade rushed towards Ivan not far away...
The Iron Armor Curse hung on Ivan's body as early as the battle, but this magical barrier could not completely defend against the penetrating Shenfeng Wuying, and was soon defeated...
Fortunately, the protective cloak worked, and the second magical barrier blocked it, safely defending against this attack...
Professor Flitwick led the onlookers to retreat and retreat still felt that it was not safe enough.
Looking at the battle on the field seems to have an escalation trend. Professor Flitwick intentionally asked Snape and "Lockhart" to stop, but he knew that neither of them would listen to him, so he sighed and had to give up.
At this time, Ivan, shortly after fighting with Snape, has activated the experience card to increase his combat power. After all, there is no better practice place than actual combat. He can hear the sound of increased proficiency every time he casts a spell. .
But even so, it was still suppressed by Snape.
The duel field under his feet is less than eight meters long and three meters wide. Being restricted to such a small place means that neither side of the duel has a retreat, and the competition is based on magic!
If you can't crack the opponent's magic in the first time and counterattack, there is only one way to lose!
Ivan has been frowning. His current identity is Lockhart, so naturally he cannot use blood magic. His understanding of various spells alone is far inferior to Snape, who was able to create spells in his student days.. .

chapters.title: Chapter 243: I heard you can sec me?
chapters.content:
The latest website: The powerful spells and superb fighting skills used by Ivan and Snape opened the eyes of the small wizards onlookers, and they were fascinated for a time.
A few courageous Gryffindor students even wanted to get closer, so that they could see more clearly, but under Professor Flitwick's repeated scolding, they had no choice but to dispel this idea.
"Magic can still be used like this!" Hermione saw Ivan and Snape reusing the magic aftermath released by the other party more than once, integrating them into the new magic, and then returning to attack the other party, and couldn't help but speak. Exclaimed.
"Yeah, I didn't know that Professor Lockhart was so amazing!" Ron's eyes widened and he stared at Lockhart who was fighting Snape on the stage in a daze.
"But it looks like Snape is better, Lockhart seems to be about to lose." Harry added.
The surrounding little wizards nodded in agreement, and Professor Flitwick also nodded slightly. In his opinion, Lockhart was not far from defeat.
Lockhart, who became Ivan's with the compound decoction, frowned dissatisfiedly. He felt that Ivan Hals had released the water too badly in the battle, and he was simply sorry for the three thousand gallons he spent!
Listening to the discussions of the little wizards in his ear, Lockhart said loudly in disdain. "You too underestimated him. If it were true, Snape would have died long ago!"
Lockhart's high voice spread throughout the hall, everyone turned their heads and looked at him strangely, even the two professors were no exception, Harry asked suspiciously.
"Ivan, how did you know that Professor Lockhart didn't use all his strength?"
Lockhart coughed slightly and was about to make up a reason, when Hermione suddenly grabbed his right wrist and stared directly at him.
"Wait, what about the bracelet you have been wearing?"
how could I know? Lockhart panicked suddenly, but Ivan didn't give him that thing, so he could only make up his mind.
"Hmm... I have lent that thing to someone temporarily..."
"Who did you lend it to?" Hermione became even more suspicious.
Lockhart dodged his gaze at Ivan on the duel, but found that Ivan, who was fighting Snape, didn't have anything like a bracelet in his hands, and he froze for a while and didn't know what to say.
Lockhart kept silent, and Hermione's repeated questioning made the two professors keenly aware of what was wrong.
It wouldn't be a problem if a little wizard behaved a little weird at another point in time.
But now it's different. There was an attack in the school yesterday, and the murderer has not been found so far. Lockhart's anomaly attracted their attention.
Fortunately, an ethereal voice rang from the crowd.
"He lent me the hand ring."
Luna struggled to squeeze out of the crowd. Seeing that Hermione and the others were looking at her, she raised the magic ring on her right hand and shook it. The bone fragments collided with each other and made a crisp sound.
Hermione pursed her lips and said nothing.
Flitwick and Professor Sprout noticed the change in Hermione's expression, and their eyes stopped on Luna again, finally dispelling the suspicion of Lockhart.
At this time wasted, the situation on the duel field changed again.
Just as the little wizards in the audience had guessed, Ivan, who had barely stalemate with Snape for a while, was about to lose it.
As the offensive side, Snape didn't mean to keep his hands at all. He caught the mistake caused by Ivan's late reaction, and hit out several consecutive spells, tearing open the iron armor curse and protective cloak layer by layer. A defense built together...
Finally Snape picked his wand, and a red light flashed.
"Except for your weapons!"
The disarming curse hit the target, and Ivan stepped back a dozen steps in a row, and almost fell off the high platform. The lines on the protective cloak became very dim, and it was no longer usable for a period of time.
The most important thing was that the wand in Ivan's hand fell out of his hand and fell into Snape's hands.
Ivan frowned. Although he still had a stronger wand in his sleeve, it was obviously inconvenient to take out.
For this reason, he has already lost...
However, what Ivan didn't expect was that Snape threw the wand back in his hand.
Ivan reached out and took it, looking at Snape suspiciously at what he meant...
"You gave me a chance before, and I also give you a chance..." Snape said slowly, then glanced at Lockhart in the audience, turned his head and said sarcastically to Ivan.
"I just heard Hals say that you can kill me easily, but you haven't used your full strength yet? I want to see it!"
The corners of Ivan's mouth couldn't help but twitched, and Lockhart's utterance in the audience, he also heard it, but he didn't expect Snape to actually mean it.
"Professor Snape, we are demonstrating a wizard duel to the children, or it is better to restrain it." Ivan said very clearly that he was not in line with his current identity, and said euphemistically.
"Restrain? No, no, I think everyone would prefer to look at something bloodier." Snape's face became gloomy, and he thought that Ivan's words would undoubtedly acknowledge Lockhart's statement just now.
Thinking of this, Snape turned his head abruptly, and said to the little wizards watching the excitement in the audience.
"Everyone, give me back twenty meters!"
"Let your Professor Lockhart release so amazing magic that it affects you..." Snape added mockingly.
"Stay back, do what Professor Snape said!" Flitwick commanded loudly, ordering everyone to retreat to a safe distance, so as not to be affected by Lockhart's super magic.
A few shameless little wizards, as well as Lockhart's diehard fans, also shouted.
"Professor Lockhart, we support you!"
"Professor Lockhart, you are the strongest!"
......
Standing on the duel field, Ivan saw everyone looking forward to it, and for a while, he didn't know how to step down.
If he holds the unicorn wand that he has modified in his hand, he can also activate the enhanced magic text to make an explosive explosion to fool it, and by the way, see how Snape will resist it.
But you can't do this now, you won't expose the blood magic, right?
Ivan couldn't wait to choke Lockhart who was talking nonsense to death.
Snape waited impatiently, and raised his wand to take the lead.
The door of the exhibition hall was knocked open heavily at this moment.
The sudden noise disrupted the atmosphere on the court. Everyone turned their heads together. Filch, holding the oil lamp, rushed in in a panic, and he screamed loudly.
"Assault! Another kid was attacked! It's in the corridor on the third floor!"

chapters.title: Chapter 244: It seems we misunderstood you before
chapters.content:
Latest website: Hearing this shocking news, the hall fell into a short silence, and the two professors, Flitwick and Sprout, whose faces changed a lot, immediately ran out.
There was no need to continue the duel on the field. Ivan turned his head and asked Snape to restrain and protect the students in the hall, and then eagerly followed.
Snape was very dissatisfied with Ivan's command, but still fulfilled his duties as a professor, ordering all the students to stay where they are, not to go anywhere!
On the other side, Ivan rushed to the third floor as quickly as possible.
Except for Snape, the several teaching professors at Hogwarts had all arrived, and Madam Pomfrey squatted on the ground to check the attacked person.
Dumbledore stood aside frowning, not knowing what to think...
Ivan walked a few steps before seeing the injured girl. She looked like a Hufflepuff girl in the second and third grade. Her complexion was extremely pale, and her breathing was very weak.
Unlike the last time, the girl was not hurt and bleeding, and there was no mess of handwriting on the surrounding walls.
Ivan is not surprised, he has been in the duel club tonight, Tom may know that there is no possibility of planting him.
"Poor child, her vitality loss is very serious, just like the Ravenclaw girl before." Madam Pomfrey sighed with a sad face, but she couldn't help it.
"What kind of dark magic can cause this effect?" Professor McGonagall was very angry, and her wand was shaking. She looked at Dumbledore and expected him to answer.
"The important thing is not how to do it, but who did it!" Dumbledore did not answer, but said in a deep voice.
"Perhaps we can investigate which students have not come to my duel class tonight, I think the number of students should not be too many." Ivan made a suggestion.
He suddenly realized that this was a good opportunity to catch Tom Riddle. The corridor on the third floor was not remote, so the time for the girl to be killed should be very short, at least after the duel club started!
This means that the suspicion of the vast majority of people is eliminated at one time!
The remaining few little wizards who did not come to class, as long as they investigate one by one, they will immediately know whose hands the Horcrux is in!
"Very good advice! We'd better act now!" Professor McGonagall soon wanted to understand this, and said in surprise.
"By the way, where's Severus?" Professor McGonagall hadn't seen Snape come back for a long time, somewhat puzzled.
"I let him stay in the big exhibition hall to protect the children, lest the attackers take advantage of our absence to attack them, and now it is just convenient for us to count who is not there!" Ivan said confidently. He thought this Tom will never run back!
"Professor Lockhart, it seems that we misunderstood you before. I didn't expect you to be very reliable at a critical time." McGonagall was surprised by Ivan's careful arrangements.
The other professors also looked at "Lockhart" in front of them strangely. It was hard for them to believe that Lockhart had said the words just now.
Seeing everyone's puzzled gaze, Ivan realized that he had acted too far, not in line with the personality of Lockhart.
But because this opportunity to find the Horcrux was so rare, he was so excited that he even forgot to play the role.
Ivan hurriedly coughed twice and remedied it out loud.
"Ahem... That's natural. I don't know how many times I have encountered such an emergency in my legendary career. I dare say that no one in the magical world knows how to deal with a crisis better than me!"
Ivan reluctantly came back, but fortunately, several professors didn't have the intention to study carefully, and their thoughts were all on how to catch the attacker.
Ivan volunteered to catch the little wizards who hadn't come to class.
He felt that he had better find the Horcrux before the others, and make up a reason to destroy it before reporting it, lest Dumbledore learn something unfavorable for him from the Horcrux.
Although this possibility is very small, it must be guarded.
Unfortunately, after Ivan offered to participate in the search, Dumbledore rejected it.
"No! I need you to inform Severus, protect the children in the hall with him, and count all the students who did not attend duel classes!" Dumbledore said.
Can't you send someone else to this little thing? Ivan opened his mouth to refute, but noticed that the eyes under Dumbledore's half-moon glasses were staring at him, and then closed his mouth decisively.
"Okay, I'm going to inform Snape..." Ivan cast aside his eyes, avoiding looking at Dumbledore, and turned away.
Ivan had been running Occlumency, but when he walked out of the corridor, he didn't find any traces of the brain being invaded.
Even so, Ivan was aware that Dumbledore seemed to have a slight doubt about his identity, otherwise he would not reject his proposal to participate in the search.
"Damn, I should have brought the map of the live spot with me at any time!" Ivan couldn't help sighing as he headed to the large exhibition hall.
Because he was going to exchange identities with Lockhart today, he put away everything that didn't meet his identities, so as not to fall out and be suspected during a fight.
Ivan did not expect Tom Riddle to be so bold that he would choose to carry out a second attack at this time!
...
Back in the large exhibition hall, Ivan found that Snape had cast a spell to remove the duel platform and replaced it with the long table of the four major academies. All the little wizards stayed in their seats honestly.
Snape saw Ivan walking in the hall and walked over with a sullen face. "What happened? Someone encountered an attack?"
Ivan nodded and talked about the attack on a third-year Hufflepuff girl and then continued.
"In short, we need to count the number of people now. I believe the attackers should be among the few students who did not come to class! I will be in charge of Gryffindor and Ravenclaw College, as for Slytherin and Hufflepuff. is you."
After explaining, Ivan rushed to the long table of the two colleges to check the list of personnel.
Snape was very awkward. He didn't want to follow Ivan's command, but he had to admit that the other party's arrangement was reasonable, so he had to do it with a black face.
After spending more than half an hour, Ivan and Snape checked the list of personnel, and were overjoyed for a while. There were fewer little wizards than he had imagined, and there were only two girls in lower grades!
The Horcrux must be in the hands of one of them!
Ivan felt that Tom was afraid that it would not be long, but things went so smoothly that Ivan faintly felt something wrong...
(PS: I wish you all a happy New Year's Day! In addition, 2020 is coming soon, everyone vote for a monthly pass to celebrate!)

chapters.title: Chapter 245: We now only need a small spell to solve the problem...
chapters.content:
Latest website: Ivan shook his head, forgetting the anxiety in his heart, turned to look at the Gryffindor long table, and said.
"Halse, come out with me, I have something to ask you! In addition, the prefect is responsible for maintaining order here when I am away!"
Feeling that the time for the compound decoction was almost up, Ivan led Lockhart out of the large exhibition hall, but did not notice that Hermione was staring at them.
The two went all the way back to the Defence Against the Dark Arts classroom, waiting for the compound decoction time to pass, and exchanged their identities.
Ivan told Lockhart carefully, what he did with the identity of "Lockhart" tonight, and told him not to show the bottom.
Lockhart heard Ivan talk about the attack and asked curiously. "How is the Hufflepuff girl who was attacked? Is she still alive?"
"Still alive! Just Madam Pomfrey said that the girl was sucked away a lot of vitality, and I don't know if she can wake up later." Ivan sighed.
According to what happened to Ginny in the original time and space, I am afraid that the Horcrux needs to be destroyed to heal the two attacked.
At the same time, Ivan is also a little strange, why does Tom look for such a young girl every time.
Is it simply because it's easier to cheat? Or is it that Tom Riddle discriminates against boys in school and is not willing to absorb their vitality?
After Lockhart learned that no one was killed, he was not interested in asking more, and then complained about Ivan's performance in the duel field today.
He spent a whole three thousand gold gallons, thinking that he could see himself showing up on stage, but he almost lost to Snape.
"This is not in line with my identity!" Lockhart said depressedly.
Ivan rolled his eyes, too lazy to pay attention to Lockhart, who had no self-knowledge, and warned him not to talk nonsense when he returned to the auditorium, so as not to implicate himself in the open.
After passing a corner, the two stopped together.
The little brown-haired witch in the corridor in front of her was staring at them angrily.
"Hermione?" Ivan was surprised. She didn't expect that Hermione, who had always been abiding by the rules, would sneak out of the auditorium. She seemed to have heard their conversation just now.
"Don't worry, this is what I do best... We only need a small spell now!" Lockhart fancyly took out his wand from his sleeve, ready to use the Forgotten Charm to solve the problem.
Ivan turned his head and glared at him.
Lockhart had to put his wand away again, stepping back step by step, and said slyly. "Then you talk slowly, I suddenly remembered something else... I won't bother you."
Hermione ignored Lockhart who was leaving, instead she rebuked it furiously. "How can you help Lockhart, a liar, and unite with him to deceive us!"
The little witch was angry like a lion. After hearing the conversation between Ivan and Lockhart, she quickly figured out why Lockhart's strength has fluctuated over the past few months. Ivan is helping him.
"Hermione!" Ivan suddenly interrupted the little witch's condemnation. There were other people hanging out in the castle. He lowered his voice and said very solemnly. "This is because we are doing something very important..."
Before Hermione's anger was vented, she was suppressed by Ivan's words, and her eyes looked at him in surprise.
"You should be aware of the attacks these days. I need to borrow the identity of Professor Lockhart to investigate some suspicious students." Ivan talked eloquently, but naturally ignored the money he earned from Lockhart. A lot of things about Jin Jialong.
Is that so? Hermione always thinks something is wrong...
However, Ivan did not wait for Hermione to understand, and continued to reveal that this attack was probably another conspiracy of the mysterious man. The mysterious man must have used some means to deceive a certain student in the school to carry out his evil. s plan.
"Then what should we do? Have you and Lockhart figured out who the attacker is?" Hermione's attention was suddenly drawn to her, and she said worriedly.
Seeing that Hermione stopped mentioning that he turned into Lockhart with the compound decoction, Ivan quietly breathed a sigh of relief and spoke instead.
"Almost, the attacker should be one of the two girls who didn't come, um... Filch who came to inform us may also be suspected!"
Ivan was filtering the list of suspects in his mind. Tonight, most of the students, plus Snape and Lockhart, were in the large exhibition hall, and it was impossible to attack them in person.
And the other staff in the school have good strength and knowledge, Tom is unlikely to confuse them...
Hermione nodded listening to Ivan's analysis, but suddenly remembered something and asked with her lips pursed. "Then why is your bracelet in Luna's hand tonight?"
Ivan didn't mean to conceal it. He told about what Luna recognized when he entered the duel, and then said again.
"So I temporarily lent the hand ring to Luna to use it, so as to block her mouth and let her help me cover it."
"What about me? Now I know the same as her..." Hermione asked suddenly, her brown eyes fixed on Ivan.
"Or...how about I ask Lockhart to sign for you? You can sign a few hundred copies!" Ivan scratched his head, vaguely remembering that Hermione was Lockhart's number one fan.
"I don't want it! Don't mention that liar to me again!" Hermione gritted her teeth when she remembered that she had put Lockhart's photo in the bedroom before.
......
The duo sneaked back to the auditorium, and because they had lost their identity as a professor Ivan could only stay at the Gryffindor table, waiting for a result.
Until late at night, Dumbledore hurried over, and after talking to Snape for a while, he said in a deep voice.
"I think you need to rest here for one night today!"
Dumbledore waved his magic wand, and the long academies tables flew up, automatically piled up in the corners, and then hundreds of purple sleeping bags appeared in the empty spaces.
"Everyone, take a good rest. In addition, I hope that the prefects can guard the entrance. The chairman of the male and female student union is responsible for managing the order. If you find something wrong, you can immediately send a ghost to report to me!"
Dumbledore walked out of the auditorium after he finished speaking, and there was a burst of discussion in the hall. Everyone understood that the matter might be more serious than they thought, or they wouldn't even be able to go back to the bedroom.
Ron wondered if there would be a second person being attacked tonight. As he continued to spread the panic, he felt a cold behind him inexplicably, and turned his head trembling slightly to realize that it was Snape who had not left yet...

chapters.title: Chapter 246: The wish of the Dark Lord
chapters.content:
Latest URL: Weasley, I think you have to learn when to shut up! "Snape waved his wand, and a gray light hit Ron's body.
Ron suddenly realized he was speechless in horror, and Snape nodded and left with satisfaction.
Ivan took a moment of silence for Ron's tragic experience, and at the same time he was guessing how things were going.
Dumbledore prevented them from returning to the dormitory to rest, which proved that the two girls who did not come to class have not yet been found, or...something else happened midway!
Ivan lay quietly in his sleeping bag, thinking over and over again about the series of events that occurred after the loss of the Horcrux. I don't know how long it took before he fell asleep...
......
The next day, the results of the search last night spread, and Ivan found that the matter was once again beyond his expectations.
Of the two lower-grade girls who did not come to class, one of them was unconscious after the attack and was taken to the school hospital.
The remaining Slytherin girl in the second grade has not been found so far, and is determined to be temporarily missing...
Hearing this news, Ivan became more and more disturbed, and now it was basically certain that the Horcrux was in the hands of this Slytherin girl.
But he secretly used the live spot map to check it in the morning, and the entire school could not find the other's name, which meant two possibilities.
Either the girl is hiding in a mysterious place similar to a secret room, or she is already dead...
After absorbing the vitality of at least three people, Ivan guessed that Tom Riddle's power should be nearing resurrection. This Slytherin girl may be dispensable to him, and it is not impossible to be abandoned...
In terms of strength, Ivan was not afraid of the sixteen-year-old Voldemort. The memory between the Horcrux and the body would not be shared, which meant that after Tom was resurrected, he was far from reaching the level of his body.
When discussing and studying various spells with Horcrux before, Ivan had roughly judged that Tom Riddle's spell level was about level five, which was not significantly different from himself.
Counting a few magic item boosts and two special bloodline magic, Ivan felt that he should be able to secure the victory.
The only thing to consider is how to find Tom's whereabouts...
Ivan tried to analyze the common ground of these victimized girls, hoping to find something from them, but nothing was gained.
Their colleges are different, and there are different ages, and he even asked specifically that these girls usually have no intersection.
Ivan frowned and thought, while eating lunch in the auditorium.
As the results of the search have been circulated, many little wizards are also talking about the attack last night, speculating that the missing Slytherin girl is the heir to the secret room.
More people are panicked, for fear that the next person to be attacked is themselves.
George and Fred took the opportunity to come up with a safety talisman, which is said to be able to effectively resist the attack. It was very popular for a while, and most girls were willing to buy one to hang on them.
After lunch, Ivan looked at the timetable. There were two Defense Against the Dark Arts classes in the afternoon.
Ivan was ready to listen to the story for an afternoon, but to his surprise, Lockhart did not let Neville come on stage to perform with him during class.
For two whole classes, Lockhart not only boasted that he had deliberately released water in order to protect Snape's face in the duel last night, but also spread a lot of magic knowledge to these second-year little wizards.
Ivan was still a little strange, but it became clear when he thought of the magic books in Lockhart's office.
After class, Ivan was walking on the way to the auditorium,
In the hallway, a group of little witches were chatting about today's Defence Against the Dark Arts class, and of course the duel between Lockhart and Snape last night.
They firmly believe that Professor Lockhart is so powerful, that he will find the attacker soon, just like every one of his adventures!
Listening to their conversation, Ivan faintly thought of something, but he couldn't grasp the key.
"That guy is a true liar!" Hermione murmured at the side, then gave Ivan a dissatisfied look and continued to speak.
"You must have told Professor Lockhart the magic knowledge, right?"
"It's not, maybe Lockhart saw it from that book." Ivan shook his head and frowned. He felt as if he had been ignoring something...
Suddenly, Ivan heard the reminder of the completion of the system task in his mind.
Ivan opened the system list very strangely, and suddenly realized that his legendary value was a little bit higher. He looked at the taskbar and found that the status of a task had indeed changed.
[Task: The Dark Lord’s Wish (Completed)
Mission: Tom Riddle directly or indirectly teaches Defence Against the Dark Arts class
Task reward: legendary point*1 (distributed)
Task description: Although the Dark Lord completed this task by himself, the rewards that belong to you will not be reduced in any way...]
Ivan gritted his teeth while looking at the mocking task description.
"Lockhart... is it you?!"
Ivan was puzzled. Lockhart was clearly in the auditorium yesterday, and there should be no chance to attack those girls.
Unless... Ivan thought of a possibility, took out the map of the spot to find Lockhart's name, and found that Lockhart did not go to the auditorium on the first floor after class, but kept going upstairs instead.
Seeing this, Ivan immediately ran towards Lockhart's position...
Hermione was very strange. She was going to have dinner soon. Where is Ivan in a hurry at this time?
The little witch frowned, remembering what Ivan had said before, and immediately realized something.
Although I haven't figured out how Ivan judged, UU read www.uukanshu.com, but Hermione gritted her teeth and accelerated her pace. She was going to the auditorium to report the news to Dumbledore.
After all, Ivan had told her before that the attack was probably related to a mysterious person!
In her opinion, only Dumbledore can help Ivan now...
......
On the other side, Ivan was tracking Lockhart's movements with the map of the live spot, and soon discovered that Lockhart seemed to be heading to the abandoned girl's bathroom, which was the entrance to the Slytherin Secret Chamber.
Ivan doesn't quite understand why Lockhart chose to go to the secret room at this time, but these are not important anymore, he can ask them all as long as he catches the opponent.
Seeing Lockhart's name disappearing at the entrance of the secret room, Ivan put away the map of the live spot, and instead squeezed his wand tightly.
It’s just that Ivan didn’t notice. Soon after he moved his gaze away from the live spot map, in a corridor on the eighth floor of the castle, suddenly there was a name he was familiar with...

chapters.title: Chapter 247: If you can, no one wants to be a liar!
chapters.content:
The latest website: sizzle~ open! "Ivan rushed to the abandoned girls' bathroom as quickly as possible, reopened the entrance to the secret room, and jumped in without hesitation.
After passing through the silky, dark pipe, it took a long time to fall to the ground. Ivan didn't even have time to clean the sticky dust and dirt on his clothes, so he held his wand and walked toward the interior of the secret room.
The sound of the rustling water slowly spread to the ears, the huge snake-shaped statue stood on the side, and a stream of water was gushing out of the Shekou and into the pools on both sides.
In the center of the pool is a long aisle. On the platform at the end, a figure dressed in a dark purple robe and a golden red cloak is standing in front of the Slytherin statue with his back facing him...
Hearing the footsteps behind him, Lockhart turned his head abruptly and saw Ivan on the other side of the aisle. His expression became very flustered. He waved his hands in a panic and said in a shameless voice. "Hals, why are you here?"
"Luo...ha...te!" Ivan waved his wand angrily.
Whoosh~
A dazzling red light hit Lockhart, but was bounced off by the protective cloak, hitting the serpentine stone sculpture aside, the huge snake head was blown out of a big pit, and a large amount of rubble and dust fell from the air...
Lockhart swallowed hard after seeing the end of the stone sculpture, and stepped back.
Although this curse was resisted by the protective cloak, Lockhart couldn't feel the slightest sense of security. After all, he had seen Ivan's true strength.
"Don't install it anymore, give me the Horcrux!" Ivan didn't care too much when seeing this situation, and approached step by step.
In the past few days of experiments at school, Ivan has already researched the use of the blood magic basilisk pupil, and a protective cloak is not an obstacle.
"Horcrux? What is that? What are you talking about?" Lockhart wanted to continue to argue with a guilty conscience, but after seeing Ivan raised his wand again, he hurriedly changed his words.
"If you were talking about a black diary, it is no longer in my hands!"
"You gave it to your admirers?" Ivan was not surprised, but sneered.
"They trust you so much, so you use them as a tool to feed Tom Riddle? You really did it..."
At the moment when he saw the task was completed, Ivan would understand everything he hadn't thought of before.
After Dobby lost the Horcrux, it was Lockhart who picked it up, and only Lockhart could easily win the trust of so many little witches from different schools and different grades.
"I can't blame me, they volunteered to pay for me... Besides, they didn't die, didn't they? Thanks to their dedication, I'm one step closer to becoming a master of magic." Lockhart Spreading his hands, said very innocently.
"So? Did Tom heal you?" Ivan laughed at Lockhart's remarks. He never knew Lockhart could be so stupid.
He thought Lockhart had fooled so many powerful wizards and wrote so many legends that he could learn some lessons from them.
I didn't expect to believe the words of an evil diary easily.
However, beyond Ivan's expectation, Loha nodded and said triumphantly.
"Of course! He cured me, otherwise I wouldn't cooperate with him."
"Split!" Lockhart waved his wand as if showing off, a magical ray hit the stone pillar on the side, making a small hole in it.
"Did you see it? I just released a curse smoothly! Of course, I know that there is still a big gap between this kind of strength and the magic master, but I believe it will be different soon."
"Not only that, I even speak snake language now..." Lockhart flushed red, showing Ivan his changes with excitement and excitement.
For Lockhart, who likes to show off and show off, his strength has improved so much at once, but he has not dared to tell outsiders, almost suffocating him to death.
"Do you really understand who you are dealing with? That's the Dark Lord! Do you think he would be so kind?" Ivan's heart became cold as he listened to Lockhart's words.
In his opinion, Lockhart has been deeply affected by the Horcrux, and may even have been corroded by Tom Riddle without realizing it before he could speak snake language.
Thinking of this, Ivan moved closer to Lockhart step by step. The closer the basilisk pupils were, the better the effect.
He needs to retain the enhanced magic text once every six hours, and enough magic power to deal with Tom Riddle, and does not want to spend too much power on Lockhart.
"But I have no choice!" Lockhart suddenly calmed down a bit. He looked at Ivan and said with disappointment.
"Halse, I once asked you to help me twice. I hope you can tell me the secret of getting stronger quickly. I am willing to pay more for this, but you still refuse it, don't you?"
"I said I didn't have that kind of thing at all..." Ivan replied, frowning.
"Don't try to lie to me! I saw all the content you communicated with him in that diary. There is a way, isn't it? It's in this Slytherin secret room!"
Lockhart interrupted Ivan's words excitedly, his eyes turned red, and his whole body was trembling under the influence of his emotions.
He stared at Ivan, with a look of envy and even jealousy on his face, and muttered.
"Do you know, Hals? I have always envied you!"
"You have almost everything I want! Whether it is strength or prestige You are so special wherever you go, and you can master a profound curse in just a few hours... "
"But I'm different from you. I'm so mediocre. I can never get ahead without relying on some special methods! Forever!" Lockhart looked a little hysterical.
"Your Forgetting Curse is better than anyone else. It's not your talent? You just use the wrong place all the time!" Ivan imprinted Lockhart's madness in his mind, and his heart arose. A hint of chill.
"What's the use?" Lockhart sneered.
"No matter how good the Forgetting Curse is, you can only be an ordinary employee in the Department of Affairs of the Ministry of Magic. Working every day is to cast spells on those stupid Muggles over and over again, so that they can forget something. Things to remember!"
"I need flowers and applause, and I also need everyone to pay attention to me and admire me. This is the life I should live!" Lockhart's expression on his face was drunk and turned into extremely hideous.
"Halse! No one wants to be a liar forever if you can!"

chapters.title: Chapter 248: Sorry, I lied to you!
chapters.content:
Latest URL: "Hiss~ (Talk to me, Slytherin-the greatest of the Big Four of Hogwarts!
Lockhart spit out a snake word, but after waiting for a long time, the Slytherin statue behind him didn't move, his heart sank suddenly, and he tried again without giving up.
"Are you calling that basilisk? Since I've been in the secret room, do you think I can let it live to this day?" Ivan sneered and said, he narrowed the distance with Lockhart again, and continued to speak.
"It seems that Tom has concealed a lot of things from you. I guess he must have not told you. Remember to close your eyes when you call the basilisk?"
Within three meters of each other, as Ivan's voice fell, his black eyes instantly turned into orange-yellow vertical snake eyes...
Lockhart hadn't figured out what Ivan's words meant, and his mind became blank. Ivan's eyes were like whirlpools that swallowed his mind and soul...
"Except for your weapons!"
With a loud shout from Ivan, Lockhart regained consciousness, but the next moment he felt like his body was hit by a bull, rolling all the way and hitting the Slytherin stone sculpture behind.
The wand came out, spinning around in the air, and finally fell into Ivan's hands...
Ivan reached out and took Lockhart's wand, and by the way, he glanced at the magic scale in the status bar, which was about one-tenth less.
Ivan sighed, the magic resistance of the wizard is really much stronger than ordinary creatures.
He only activated Snake Eyes for less than a second, and his purpose was not to stare Lockhart to death, but to make Lockhart stuck in a stalemate and unable to activate the protective cloak, and he used magic to destroy the opponent's resistance.
After all, the protective cloak is a magic item made by him with a lot of precious materials. It takes a lot of time to break it normally.
Only by surprise can the winner be determined by one blow and save the consumption of magic power.
Ivan walked towards Lockhart step by step,
Lockhart, who was hit in front of the statue, wanted to get up in horror, but found that his body was extremely heavy, as if he was filled with lead, and he raised his right hand with difficulty, and then was stepped on by a foot.
"Tell me, where is Tom Riddle now?" Ivan stepped on Lockhart's right hand, ripped off several pieces of his magic equipment, put his wand against Lockhart's cheek, his eyes were extremely cold.
"I... I don't know..." Lockhart said in horror, looking at the light gleaming at the top of Ivan's wand.
"Do you want to try the taste of heart-cutting bones?" Although Ivan doesn't know this spell, it doesn't prevent him from using it to threaten Lockhart.
Lockhart, one of the three unforgivable spells, was naturally very clear. Hearing Ivan talked about it, he immediately struck a spirit, racking his brains to think about where Tom Riddle would go.
"He must be looking for something on the eighth floor of the castle! He told me before that you often go there to get in the way, and I hope I can find a way to get you away..." Lockhart said suddenly.
Ivan's heart sank, and he had a very bad feeling.
I'm afraid that Tom wants to go to the room on the eighth floor. I'm afraid he is looking for the second Horcrux Ravenclaw's crown!
And because of the previous attack, he didn't dare to go to the responsive house during this period of time, just in line with the other party's wishes...
"So you got that Ravenclaw girl to the eighth floor? You planted me again?" Thinking of this, Ivan burned with anger, his black eyes faintly transformed into orange-yellow vertical pupils...
Lockhart looked at each other for a moment and felt that he was about to die, but the next moment Ivan's eyes returned to their original state, he retorted in a hurry. "No, I didn't do it! The diary controlled me!"
Lockhart quickly explained it to Ivan.
