"He is a very brave man, a well-deserved hero. He will always fight on the front line. Together, we have defeated many conspiracies of the Dark Lord..."
Sirius was talking about things from thirteen years ago, intending to get closer with these things, but Ivan interrupted his words impatiently.
"But he died in the end, didn't he?"
Sirius's expression froze. He wanted to correct Ivan's words, because in his opinion, Ivan's father was a heroic sacrifice, and it was great!
However, Ivan didn't give him this opportunity, and before Sirius spoke, he increased his tone and continued.
"If I guessed right, his death was related to Dumbledore?"
Sirius was completely stunned, he looked at Ivan blankly, and then said angrily.
"That's how your mother taught you? I knew she was a selfish and mean person! A downright dark wizard! Your father must be blind to like her..."
"More than ten years ago, she had been trying to prevent your father from joining the Order of the Phoenix, constantly instigating him to leave everyone behind and flee to America at the most critical time, and even secretly stumbled, your father’s friends, including No one of me looks down upon her!"
Sirius's tone was very sharp, and he was so angry that he wanted to scold him a few more words. At this time, a dazzling red light suddenly flew past his cheek, interrupting his words.
After a while, a huge explosion sounded, and a circular crater was created in the wall behind.
"You shut up!" Ivan looked at Sirius coldly.
Compared to the plain masked "hero" father, Ivan trusted Esia more and was willing to stand on Esia's side. Naturally, Sirius would not be satirical.
Ivan's radical reaction far exceeded Sirius's expectations. He looked back at the huge crater that was exploded behind him, cold sweat broke out.
If this spell hits directly, he will probably be seriously injured...
Sirius was silent for a while, but he didn't get angry anymore.
From Ivan's reaction just now, he noticed something wrong, plus Ivan was alone in this dilapidated house late at night, Sirius lowered his tone and asked softly.
"Where is your mother?"
"She's fine... you might as well care about yourself when you have time. UU reading www.uukanshu.com" Ivan replied stiffly.
He blocked the news of Aysia's death, first to confuse the messenger behind the scenes, to facilitate his use of the compound decoction, and secondly to avoid causing Aysia's social death.
Ivan doesn't know much about the time paradox, but understand one thing, if many people know that Aysia is dead, it will definitely not help him return to the past to save people!
After thinking about it, Ivan turned his head and said to Dobby.
"Dobby, you are responsible for staring at Black. If he says a few more words, you can use the Stunning Charm to calm him down."
"Yes, sir!"
Dobby was very excited, the index finger of his right hand lit up with magical fluorescence, and two copper bell-sized eyes stared at Sirius' every move and every move, and the coma curse was ready to go.
Under Dobby's close monitoring, Sirius closed his mouth very aggrieved, but sighed in his heart. He already had some guesses...

chapters.title: Chapter 272: It’s said that the Aurors were terrified that day
chapters.content:
In the early hours of the next morning, before dawn, Sirius, who was curled up in the corner, was awakened by a slight noise. He jumped up and touched the wand subconsciously with his right hand, but he touched nothing.
Later, Sirius thought of where he was, and then he relaxed his vigilance.
Ivan on the side is dealing with the remnants of the potion that failed to brew last night. Even with his current level of potion level 5, the first time he brewed Veritaserum, a highly difficult potion, he failed several times before succeeding. of.
"You got up so early?" Sirius was surprised, and then he frowned when he thought of something. "Or you didn't rest all night?"
Ivan ignored him at all.
For Ivan, now is not a time to rest, every time is precious.
He had already thought of a way to restore the scene that day.
While tempting those snoopers this time, I was also preparing to use them for an experiment.
Sirius was very dissatisfied with Ivan's silence, and he spoke again.
"Listen, boy, you should go to bed now, and give me your magic wand. I can handle who you are going to deal with and what you do for you. Killing is not something a wizard of your age should do. , You can’t make your own risk!"
Sirius said it very seriously. Although he was eager to find Peter's movements after he escaped from Azkaban, it does not mean that he would just sit back and watch the children of his comrades-in-arms in trouble.
In fact, Sirius didn’t want to see a child as old as Ivan face a dangerous dark wizard. The time wasted for this reason is also worthwhile...
Ivan glanced at him, his eyes full of distrust, it was obvious...
Just rely on you? Save it...
Sirius understood the look in Ivan's eyes, and he felt that he was completely underestimated. He was a wizard with many battles, and he had solved countless black wizards.
In the Order of the Phoenix, even if his combat effectiveness is not ranked first, it is still in the forefront.
Sirius thought that the main reason why he was easily caught earlier was because he didn't have a magic wand in his hand.
Ivan's next words defeated Sirius' self-confidence.
"How many dark wizards can you solve at once? Three? Five? Ten? What if they have dozens of them? What do you do with them?" Ivan asked.
Sirius was speechless. He didn't expect that there would be so many enemies that he might face. He was already struggling to face three or five dark wizards at the same time, and even risked defeat.
No matter how much, he is more inclined to avoid...
"There are so many enemies?" Sirius said in a speech. The Auror who is in the Ministry of Magic has only more than a hundred people. He had thought that the opponent was just a certain powerful dark wizard.
"You better prepare for this!" Ivan is also not sure what will happen next, but he doesn't want Sirius to be too careless.
Sirius saw that Ivan was not joking, so he didn't just persuade him blindly, but asked about Ivan's follow-up actions in detail.
Ivan didn't mean to conceal, he told his decoy plan again, and then handed over the ten magic wands he had confiscated, and asked Sirius to choose a suitable one.
He got these wands from the black-robed wizards who attacked the magic shop.
It is worth mentioning that, for some reason, he did not find Aysia's wand on the scene.
While Sirius was choosing his wand, Ivan drank the compound soup, which tasted very uncomfortable, like an expired thick soup.
After a while, Ivan's figure continued to stretch and deform, and when he looked in the mirror, he found that he was already exactly the same as the young wizard who was killed by him with snake eyes.
Ivan used the Transfiguration Charm to make his clothes fit better, and told Dobby and Sirius not to follow him too tightly, so as not to be suspected.
After speaking, Ivan walked straight out of the temporary residence with a kettle of compound decoction.
Sirius became a black dog again, and slowly followed, while Dobby disappeared in place with snapping his fingers.
......
After Ivan went out, he wandered aimlessly in Knockdown Alley, walked as far as possible to crowded places, and made some weird behaviors, or provoked right and wrong, so as to attract most people's attention.
As for the behavior of the young wizard in black robes who did not match his disguise, it was not important.
The difference is nothing more than whether the other party sends someone to make friendly contact with him, or sends someone to arrest him for interrogation.
After just wandering around for a day, Ivan found that no one had come to contact him on his own initiative, nor had he encountered any attacks.
Ivan frowned, but went to the final location as originally planned...
In the evening, Ivan wore a black robe and stepped into the Broken Cauldron Bar.
It was still anomalously noisy here, the rising stove was passing heat, and the two goblins were sitting in the front row, arguing over who would pay for the alcohol.
A sorrowful wizard in the back sang a bad tone in public. The other guests didn't care, and some people joked out kindly.
Ivan even saw Harry eating dinner in the corner. He seemed to be in a good mood, maybe because he escaped punishment?
At the next table, two wizards were playing cards, and one of them looked towards Harry vaguely.
The other person stared at Ivan, who had just entered, and saw that he hadn't walked toward Harry, so he was interested in putting his sight on the wizard card in his hand.
Ivan guessed that these two might be the Aurors who were responsible for protecting Harry, but this had nothing to do with him.
"Boss, a bottle of butterbeer!" Ivan yelled, and threw a few copper Nats over.
"I see, what do you say so loudly?" Tom, who was chatting with a gorgeous witch, said in dissatisfaction. Then he accepted the money and put a bottle of butter beer on the table.
The other people in the tavern were also attracted by Ivan's loud voice and all looked at him.
Ivan also turned his head to indicate to them, his purpose is to attract enough people's attention.
Ivan turned his head and poured a few sips of Butterbeer into his mouth. Without waiting for anyone for a while, Ivan deliberately complained to Tom. "Recently, Knockoff Alley is not very peaceful, and I always feel that it is not safe to travel."
When Tom heard the words, he immediately became interested, and immediately spoke up. "Yes, I heard that two gangs of dark wizards fought in a dark magic shop. The fight lasted for a long time, leaving a lot of corpses and blood flowing all over the place."
"Tsk tusk tusk... It is said that the Aurors who rushed over there were frightened..." Tom said with emotion.
Ivan frowned. He remembered that he had placed the assailant's body in the compartment, and the traces had been cleaned up.
Could it be that the Auror led the team when he went to find Douglet?
Ivan always feels that what Tom said and what he said are not the same thing...

chapters.title: Chapter 273: The disguise seen through
chapters.content:
Which dark magic shop are you talking about? "Ivan asked tentatively.
"Of course it's Bojinbok... After playing for so long, I don't know which side won." Tom sighed.
Ivan frowned. He has been living in the temporary residence these days, looking for a way to change the past, so it is not clear that this is the case.
However, two consecutive black magic shops encountered attacks, and Ivan had to wonder if there was any connection between them.
Who is specifically targeting the owner of the Black Magic Store? Or...
All kinds of thoughts flashed through Ivan's mind.
Ivan put on a look of interest, and then asked.
"What happened later? Didn't it mean that the Auror checked? Did you find out who did it?"
"Come on, those Aurors don't have such things as biliary..." Tom curled his mouth in disdain, took a sip of butter beer, and continued slowly.
"Furthermore, the dead are all black wizards. I heard that there are still many werewolves rushing from other places. The Ministry of Magic hopes that the more they die, the better."
"With so many people dead, the order has been much better this month..." Tom said gleefully.
Was this attack a month ago?
Just as Ivan was about to continue inquiring to see if he could get some useful information, a hand suddenly fell on his shoulder.
Ivan subconsciously wanted to activate the effect of the Ring of Protection to eject the opponent.
But then Ivan thought of his purpose of coming here, suppressed the thought in his heart, held his right hand on the wand, and turned his head calmly.
Next to him was a middle-aged wizard who held his shoulders. His appearance was very ordinary, but his figure was unusually tall. His palms hugged Ivan's shoulders tightly like pliers, making him unable to move.
"Daniel, why are you here? Where are the others?" The middle-aged wizard snatched Ivan's butterbeer with his other hand, took a few sips, and looked at Ivan suspiciously.
"Of course I am waiting for you here..." Ivan replied freely.
Then Ivan lowered his voice and complained.
"You didn't tell us that the woman is so powerful before, but we suffered a lot from doing it, and we were also overcast..."
"Let's go back and say it again!" The middle-aged wizard interrupted Ivan's words, gave the eavesdropping Tom a warning look, and then forcibly pulled Ivan away.
Tom shrugged indifferently, and put away the half-drinking bottle of Butterbeer.
He doesn't care about these nosy matters, not to mention that Ivan's words are very vague, there is no substantive content at all...
Ivan, who was pulled away, didn't mean to resist, which was just what he wanted.
It's not a good idea to act rashly at the Broken Cauldron Bar. The Auror who was in charge of protecting Harry was not far away, and it wouldn't be good if it caused a misunderstanding.
In this way, Ivan was clamped out of the Broken Cauldron Bar, and the two of them walked all the way to the dark alley in Knockdown Alley.
Walking to no one's place, the sturdy middle-aged wizard suddenly launched a trouble, pressed Ivan to the corner of the wall, pulled him by the collar, and said eagerly.
"Tell me, what the **** is going on?"
In such a hurry? !
Ivan is a little confused, or is there a friend of the other side among the dead assailants?
Thinking of this, Ivan pretended to be afraid, and said falteringly.
"When we entered the black magic shop and played against the female shopkeeper, we accidentally caught a trap. A black magic prop caused an explosion. Many people were injured. In the end, I was the only one who escaped..."
"Then where have you been for such a long time? Why don't you come to us?" The middle-aged wizard's eyes were full of distrust.
"I have been hiding in a broken room on the east side to recover from my wounds. I dare not look for you anymore. The other eight people are dead and I am the only one who is still alive. So..." Ivan tried hard to think of the appropriate Vocabulary, try to restore your own image.
These words seemed to make the middle-aged wizard relax his vigilance, and he put down the right hand that clamped Ivan.
But before Ivan was about to breathe a sigh of relief, the middle-aged wizard clenched his right hand and slammed it directly.
Under the action of the protective ring, a transparent magic barrier instantly blocked Ivan's face.
The fist hit it and rippled waves, and the strength of the recoil made the sturdy middle-aged wizard retreat again and again.
"Except your weapon!" Ivan didn't know how he was exposed, but he waved his wand for the first time, and a dazzling red light flashed in the dim night.
At such a close distance, the disarming curse was shot in the air, and the middle-aged wizard twisted and rolled around on the ground twice, and dodged dangerously and dangerously.
"Are you not Daniel?!" The middle-aged wizard had a gloomy face.
"Of course not!" Ivan was not interested in disguising at this time, but still asked strangely. "Did I say something wrong just now?"
The wizard did not answer, and quickly jumped from the ground a few steps to sprint in front of Ivan, and smashed it with an elbow.
The magic barrier once again resisted Ivan...
The Iron Armor Curse was not originally a curse developed to resist physical attacks. After two consecutive heavy blows, signs of instability had already appeared.
Are you still a wizard?
Ivan is very depressed, but he also knows that at such a close distance, for ordinary wizards, unless they can cast spells without spells, fists are more effective than magic!
Fortunately, he is not an ordinary wizard, Ivan’s heart moved, and the runes of the magic ring on his wrist lit up.
Before the next punch hit his face, a shock wave composed of pure magic spread centered on Ivan.
The wizard who was as strong as an iron tower was lifted off in an instant and hit the wall behind.
"Faint..." Ivan waved his wand to cast a spell, subduing the opponent, but suddenly felt a palpitation.
"Avada Kedavra!"
A low male voice sounded from the other side of the alley, and a deep green light flew out from the darkness.
The moment Ivan saw the green light, he threw a few buttons in that direction.
Flying in mid-air, the deformation curse that was released on the button was released immediately. Several black fist-sized mice crossed the middle, and the green light hit one of the mice, leaving the rat terrified~www .mtlnovel.com~ Disperse after landing.
These mice, which were transformed into buttons, were naturally prepared by Ivan.
The last time I was almost killed by Tom Riddle's Avadaso, Ivan has been thinking about ways to deal with the Killing Curse.
The effect of this curse is simple and straightforward, that is, it ends a life, and there is no way to solve the curse after the curse.
There is no way to deal with it. Just find a living animal to resist the killing curse, just like the phoenix who resisted the killing curse in the secret room last school year...
Taking advantage of the slaughter curse under Ivan's defense, the strong wizard had stood up from the ground, and two figures walked out of the dark alley in the distance.
Ivan's complexion was slightly dark, and it was obvious that the other party had planned to bring him here...

chapters.title: Chapter 274: Isn't she following us?
chapters.content:
One of the black-robed wizards looked at the strong wizard who had just risen from the ground and sneered.
"Joseph, you are really getting worse and worse, I thought we didn't need to act..."
"You better worry, he is not so easy to deal with!" Joseph pointed at Ivan with his wand, and said with dread.
"Will the four of us still lose if we fight one?" Another wizard shook his head and retorted.
Four? Is there anyone hiding in the dark?
Ivan frowned as he looked at the three people who surrounded him in a half-circle. Where did Sirius and Dobby go? Or is it that there are other enemies that are being held back?
When Ivan was thinking about it, Joseph suddenly said to the two of them.
"What about Kelly? Why are you only two coming over?"
"Didn't she always follow us?" The two black-robed wizards also realized that something was wrong at this time, and one of them turned his head in confusion.
At the moment when the three of them were distracted, a black dog suddenly leaped down from the roof beside it, bit on Joseph's right hand holding the wand, and yanked..
The screams of screams resounded in the silent lanes,
A black-robed wizard who reacted for the first time was ready to cast spells, but Ivan was faster than him!
"Shen Feng Wuying!"
The invisible and shadowless blade of magic power cut across the body of the black-robed wizard, splashing blood sprayed on the wall next to it.
Another black-robed wizard just turned his head and found that the situation on the field had undergone a 180-degree reversal. The originally foolproof siege broke down in an instant, and there was only one who had combat power on the field. He alone...
"I..." the black-robed wizard opened his mouth and was about to surrender, but Ivan did not give him this opportunity, and a coma spell was sent and knocked him out.
After taking care of the two black-robed wizards, Ivan then looked towards Sirius.
One person and one dog on the ground are fighting fiercely.
A piece of meat was bitten off on Joseph's right hand, and he didn't know where he dropped his wand, but with a strong physique, he stubbornly endured the pain and hit the black dog with a fist the size of a sandbag.
Sirius is also incapable of having an iron head. He just used the form of Animagus to fight the opponent, and a pair of dog paws scratched the opponent's face with blood marks...
"Faint!" Ivan waved his magic wand to help him, and the cursed Joseph quickly lost consciousness.
At the same time, Dobby's figure appeared in a messy alley with a gorgeous witch who had passed out in a coma.
Obviously the so-called fourth person has been secretly dealt with by Dobby.
What surprised Ivan was that the gorgeous witch he had met was the one who had previously chatted with Tom, the owner of the Broken Cauldron, and it seemed that she had notified Joseph and the others in some way.
"Dobby take them, let's go back!" Ivan felt that the sound of the previous fighting might have attracted other prying eyes, and he ordered.
Dobby nodded, grabbed the black-robed wizard on the ground, and used Phantom Shift to teleport back and forth, bringing people back to the temporary stronghold in batches, and finally teleporting Ivan and Sirius.
Taking people to teleport many times in a short period of time is not an easy task for Dobby, but fortunately, nothing went wrong.
Back at the temporary home, Sirius looked at the four wizards lying on the ground and said disdainfully. "It seems that these people are not as good as you said..."
"They are just some spies." Ivan shook his head and healed Joseph with a healing spell to prevent him from bleeding to death.
Afterwards, Ivan took a bottle of Veritaserum and poured Joseph a sip, and then lifted the coma spell in the opponent.
Soon, Joseph woke up, but his eyes were hollow and he sat there motionlessly.
"Who are you?" Ivan asked tentatively.
"Joseph Grint..." Joseph's low voice came over.
Ivan nodded, and then asked Joseph to whom he was ordered, why he attacked his black magic shop, how many people they had, and where the members were.
Joseph answered Ivan’s question without hesitation.
Only then did Ivan learn that Joseph and others were all dark wizards who were targeted when the Ministry of Magic cleaned up dark magic items last year.
Compared to the others caught in Azkaban, they escaped with better luck.
But even so, the loss was heavy. Many people even survived the Auror's chase, and it was naturally difficult to swallow this breath.
The Ministry of Magic and Minister Fudge who proposed this cleanup plan naturally didn't dare to provoke them, so they focused on the magic shop that provided assistance to the Ministry.
If it hadn't been for those Auror captains who had a protective ring in their hands, they wouldn't have been chased so miserably.
"Beware of the fish that slipped through the net..." Ivan listened to Joseph's and thought of a line of hints in the revitalization mission notes.
At the end of the summer vacation last school year, Ivan planned to deal with these people.
But at the time the Ministry of Magic's cleanup operation was not over yet, each of these dark wizards didn't know which horn was hidden in them. He couldn't even find anyone, so let alone kill them.
In order to be on the safe side, he deliberately made friends with the werewolf wizards in Knockdown Alley, so that these werewolf wizards and Esiah could take care of each other when he was away.
Unexpectedly, I still miscalculated...
And the person who picked the head this time, Ivan was completely unexpected.
"Are you saying that the person calling you is the owner of the Bojinbok store?" Ivan asked word by word.
Joseph nodded blankly.
"Karaktakus Bok!" Ivan muttered the name slowly, and anger gradually came to my heartOf course, Ivan still remembers this person, and he was deeply impressed. When it came to Knockturn Alley, this Bok clouded himself with probing eyes.
If he hadn't practiced Occlumency, he would have been pitted, and for this reason, Aysia almost had a fight with him in the dark magic shop.
Obviously, that blogger and Esiah have a deep contradiction, which may be related to the transit station in Knockdown Alley...
"Where is Bok now? How many dark wizards are there beside him?" Ivan asked, pulling Joseph by the collar.
"I don't know..." Joseph's face still didn't fluctuate at all, he replied in a deep voice. "We lost contact with Mr. Borkin more than a month ago."
Ivan subconsciously suspected that Joseph was deceiving himself. He had actually broken free of the effects of Veritaserum.
But Ivan soon remembered that when Tom was chatting with him in the Broken Cauldron Bar, he seemed to mention that the Bogembock Magic Shop had been attacked...

chapters.title: Chapter 275: Change the method of death
chapters.content:
There are werewolf wizards!
Ivan has not forgotten that Tom said that many werewolf wizards participated in that battle, and several werewolf wizards were left behind...
Will it be Walker, Fren and the others?
Ivan frowned deeply and continued to torture Joseph, trying to get more information from him.
But to Ivan's disappointment, Joseph knew very little.
When the Bockin Bock store was attacked, Joseph happened to be outside in charge of snooping for information. When he returned, the battle had already ended.
Therefore, for more than a month, Joseph has been in a state of losing contact, wandering in Knockdown Alley, wanting to know what happened that day, and summoned the other people who had lost contact.
Ivan did not give up and poured Veritaserum into the remaining black-robed wizards, and after inquiring one by one, the news he got was almost the same.
No one knows whether Karaktakus Bok is alive or dead, only that the Ministry of Magic has not found his body.
It looks like I have to go to the Bogembock Magic Shop...
Ivan's thoughts moved slightly, and he was going to go to the scene to see if he could get any useful clues.
While the effect of Veritaserum was still working, Ivan finally asked. "How did you confirm my disguise before?"
"We sent ten people to attack the dark magic shop, and your answer was wrong..." Joseph said dullly.
"Ten people in all? But I only found the bodies of nine attackers there." Ivan muttered to himself.
During the question and answer, Sirius who was in the audience gradually understood the cause and effect, and there was a little pity in his eyes when he looked at Ivan.
"Don't be too sad, Hals, sooner or later we will find the murderer and kill them all to avenge your mother." Sirius said comfortingly.
"No, there is another possibility!" Ivan interrupted Sirius's comforting words. There were indeed ten dead bodies at the time, but...
Thinking of this, Ivan decided to verify it and put a long hair into the bottle containing the compound decoction.
He remembered that in the original time and space, someone had crossed the sea with a concealment, causing one person's body to be buried as another person, creating the illusion that that person was dead, and successfully deceiving everyone...
After debugging, Ivan walked to the gorgeous witch named Kelly and poured the potion in her hand.
While pouring the medicine, Ivan's wrists were trembling, and his eyes fixedly looked at the gorgeous witch in front of him and began to change his body shape in front of him.
After a while, her appearance changed to another strange witch, with the same hair color as Asiah.
Ivan was trembling with excitement all over, his eyes glowing, and he grasped Kelly's face and looked at it carefully several times.
"What are you going to do?" Sirius looked at Ivan's expression in a short period of time, confused, and worried that Ivan was too irritated and went crazy.
Ivan ignored Sirius' words and muttered to himself in a low voice.
Before putting Aysia's body in the basement, he once took a piece of Aysia's hair as a spare, just to confirm some things through this method.
It's just that Ivan has never had the guts to do this, because the time converter cannot change the established reality. Once the result is confirmed, the closed loop is completed, even if it goes back to the past, it cannot be reversed.
Ivan knows this very well, so he even plans to abandon the idea of ​​verification, so that the result will always be unknown.
The unknown means that it can be changed...When he uses the time converter to return to the past in the future, he will be able to deflect things according to his own expectations.
It wasn't until Ivan learned from Joseph that the number of assailants was one more than he had imagined, did he remember this again, and made up his mind to verify.
Because if Aysia’s corpses were counted at the scene, there would be exactly ten corpses, the same number as the assailants...
"No, this is not enough!" Ivan quickly suppressed the excitement in his heart, because he still had a lot of questions that needed to be confirmed.
Next is the point...
"Bone to pieces!" Ivan silently walked behind Kelly, and suddenly drew out his wand to cast a spell on her back.
The white light hit Kaili's back, and a screaming screams sounded, and the huge pain directly broke Kaili out of her trance state.
Before Kelly could resist, Sirius waved her magic wand, and a cyan magic hit her head. The screams in Kelly's mouth stopped and the body fell to the ground.
"Enough, Hals! I know you are angry now, but I hope you can calm down." Sirius exhorted with a calm face.
Sirius can understand Ivan's inner pain, but he really doesn't want to see Ivan lose himself in hatred.
Whether it was killing or torturing, Sirius felt that this was not something a child of Ivan's age should do. If it is really necessary, Sirius hopes to do it for him...
"No, I'm not interested in torturing her, I'm just confirming something." Ivan shook his head, then turned to Dobby and said.
"Dobby, be optimistic about him, don't let him make trouble..."
"Yes, sir!" Dobby nodded, his copper bell-sized eyes staring at Sirius' every move, his fingers were shining with magical light, ready to knock him out at any time.
"I'm not so easy to deal with..." Sirius grinned. With a wand, he wouldn't be afraid of a house elf.
However, Sirius hesitated for a while still did not interfere with Ivan's follow-up actions, he was ready to see what Ivan wanted to do.
Ivan did not continue to torture or kill the next person as Sirius imagined, but stared at the dead Kelly.
Kaili's body was lying on the ground quietly, losing its vitality, but the effect of the compound decoction still worked on her body.
Ivan was not surprised, because this was something he had known for a long time.
In the original time and space, young Crouch once said that his mother had been taking the compound decoction during Azkaban instead of him, so that after his death, he did not immediately change back to the original appearance, and was finally regarded as him. Buried into the earth.
This means that taking a sufficient amount of the compound decoction may allow one person to die and maintain the appearance of another person in a short time...
As long as he can go back to the past, directly intervene in the battle, save Aysia, and then use compound soup to find someone to die, he can reproduce the scene he saw when he returned to the black magic shop!

chapters.title: Chapter 276: A compound decoction that breaks the balance and becomes ineffective
chapters.content:
Thinking of this, Ivan couldn't help but get excited, but he still needs to do an advance rehearsal to determine if this is feasible.
"The scar is healed!" Ivan tentatively held the wand against Kelly's **** back, healed her wound with a healing spell, and tried to restore what he did that day.
The magic soon began to work, and the fleshy wounds on Kelly's back healed quickly...
Sirius looked at Ivan's weird behavior and healed a dead person in a puzzled way? why? Is there any special significance?
While healed the wound, Ivan slowly breathed a sigh of relief, and things were exactly the same as he expected.
But the next moment, Ivan's pupils shrank slightly and froze in place.
The female corpse in front of me suddenly returned to its original appearance, and the effect of the compound decoction disappeared...
"Impossible, is it because I drink too little potion?" Ivan frowned, staring blankly at Kelly.
The dead don't know how to drink potions. Ivan can only let go of Kaili's body and cast his eyes on the other three black-robed wizards.
Fortunately, he still has three guinea pigs...
After pouring the compound decoction for the three of them and recording the data in batches, Yifan discovered a problem.
After death, although the effect of the compound decoction will remain, it will become very unstable, the duration will be greatly reduced, and it will be extremely easily affected.
The healing spell he used undoubtedly broke this balance. Once he healed the wound, no matter how many doses of compound decoction he took in front of him, it would be lifted in a very short time...
When the last black-robed wizard turned back to its original corpse and fell to the ground, Ivan's face became worse and worse.
"What exactly is going on?"
Ivan was completely confused. If the healing magic would affect the effect of the compound decoction, when he used the healing magic to heal "Asia", why was the corpse not affected at all?
Or did he go back to the past and didn't use compound decoction? Instead of using other methods?
Ivan looked at the four corpses underground and thought for a long time.
Before I was about to use the time converter to change the past, Ivan had considered various options.
One of the more reliable ones is to use deformity or compound decoction to make a fake corpse.
After all, he saw Aisia's corpse with his own eyes, and took the corpse to find Dougt to confirm the death, so this step is indispensable.
At first, Ivan tried to use Transfiguration, but after personally experimenting, he gave up this plan.
The fifth-level Transfiguration Curse cannot perfectly engrave a wizard, let alone cause the replica to be injured and healed.
This is simply impossible, so the compound decoction becomes the only possibility.
Ivan was so convinced before, that's why Dobby bought a large number of books related to potions to confirm the possibility of the implementation of this plan.
Unexpectedly, there was a problem on the last step...
Sirius saw Ivan's uncertain face.
Although he didn't know why Ivan did this weird thing to these black-robed wizards, he could see that it might be verifying something, and the result might have deviated from Ivan's imagination.
He was no longer silent, and Ivan would jump at the horns and change the subject.
"Hals, didn't you say that you are going to check the situation at the Bojinbok Magic Store? When will we start to act."
"Of course it's now!" Ivan breathed out a deep breath, returned to his senses, and said without hesitation.
He has at least confirmed that it was not Aysia who died in the first place...
How to replace the corpse, he still has some time to think about...
Ivan turned his head and prepared to ask Dobby to take him to the Bogimbok store with a shadow change, but he noticed the tired color on Dobby's face and closed his mouth again.
Not long ago, Dobby frequently used shape-shifting, and it was not easy to transfer the six of them to this temporary stronghold, and Ivan did not want to squeeze the house elf too much.
So, Ivan told Dobby to guard the stronghold and handle the corpse, but he changed his body shape, gradually shrinking into a gray-white owl, flapping its wings and flying out of the window.
Sirius shook his head and changed into an Animagus form to follow.
......
The gray-white owl was waving its wings in the night sky, and a pair of eagle eyes scanned the streets below.
Perhaps due to the attack a few days ago, a large number of shops closed their doors and windows and closed their business early, and there were not many wizards in the alleys.
The temporary stronghold Ivan chose was on the west side of Knockdown Alley, some distance from the Bojinbok store.
About fifteen minutes later, Ivan stopped near the Bokimbock store, thinking about how to get in.
The doors and windows of the store were all locked. The only good news was that there were no Auror seals and no patrol officers.
Ivan suspects that this may be related to the fact that Bok has not been determined to have died...
Because of this, Ivan was very cautious and slowly flew in from the chimney above, and then returned to his human form in the fireplace.
It looks hollow and black, and you can vaguely see a large number of shelves neatly arranged, which seems to be no different from when I came last time.
"Fluorescence flashes!" Ivan waved his wand and released a bright curse.
After approaching, Ivan discovered that all the shelves were empty, and everything that was originally placed on them was gone.
I don't know if it was confiscated by the Ministry of Magic as an illegal item, or if it was transferred to another place by Bock.
And to Ivan’s surprise, it didn’t look like a battlefield where a fierce battle took place.
Is it because of the healing spell?
Ivan thought of After carefully inspecting the floor and shelf cabinets, Ivan indeed found some traces of battle. The restoration spell is not a panacea, and the effects of some powerful spells are not so easy Be eliminated.
Bang~
As Ivan was thinking about it, a clear sound came from the side. Ivan waved his wand and pointed at him, only to realize that a black dog had jumped in from the broken window.
"How's it going, Hals? Have you found any clues?" Sirius quickly changed back to his original appearance and asked.
"Not yet..." Ivan shook his head helplessly.
"Anyway, let's search here first." Ivan glanced around the dark magic shop.
He has a hunch, maybe he will fight the opponent here when he comes back, so it is important to be familiar with the terrain in advance...

chapters.title: Chapter 277: I never make a choice, I have to take every one of these courses!
chapters.content:
In a blink of an eye, there was only one week left until September. As the weather slowly turned cooler, a letter from Hogwarts was accurately delivered to Ivan's hands.
Ivan opened the envelope and glanced at it. Inside was a list of books with books for the next school year.
"Does school start?" Ivan put aside the letter in his hand and sighed.
A few days ago, he and Sirius had searched the Bokimbock store for a whole night, turned inside and out, but didn't find much.
For this reason, Ivan can only give up his plan to find a blog for the time being. After all, he still doesn't know whether the messenger behind the scenes is still alive.
So over the past few days, Yifan's energy has been focused on studying why the compound decoction suddenly fails.
The hair taken from the corpse of "Asia" can be incorporated into the compound decoction and change a person's appearance, which proves that his previous thoughts and conclusions are correct.
What needs to be considered is how to solve the problem of extremely unstable efficacy of compound decoctions on dead people, which is also the main cause of conflict.
After a period of research, Ivan found that there is only one way to solve this problem...
That is to improve the potion, so that the efficacy of the compound decoction becomes more stable!
This is undoubtedly very difficult. Ivan doesn't have any relevant experience, and he doesn't even know where to start.
Fortunately, Ivan quickly remembered Snape’s research notes on "Advanced Potion Making", which not only recorded the self-created spell like Shenfeng Wuying, but also Snape. General research and improvement of potions.
"Sir, it's time for dinner..." Dobby reminded me cautiously, holding a few plates on the round table aside.
"Okay!" Ivan nodded, flipping through Snape's notes while sitting on the stool by the round table.
After a while, a **** dog ran over from a distance, and when it ran to the table, it instantly changed into its original form. It sat down skillfully on the opposite side of Ivan, grabbed a steak and put it in its mouth. Stuffed.
Ivan didn't care either. While he was busy studying how to improve the compound decoction these days, Sirius was not idle, and went out to get information almost whenever he had time.
Occasionally, Sirius would go outside the Broken Cauldron Bar, visit Harry from a distance, or step on a spot near the Burrow, and then come back every day when it's time for dinner.
"You went to the Burrow again?" Ivan looked at Sirius' exhausted appearance, and considering that he didn't return on time today, he quickly judged the other party's whereabouts, frowned and continued.
"I should have told you that it is best not to approach there randomly. If Peter is wary and escaped by him, you will never find him..."
"Don't worry, I just want to make sure that the family has returned from the trip, and Peter is still in the hands of the little wizard." Sirius grinned, his expression a little sullen.
Today, when he wandered around the Weasley mansion, he happened to see the Weasley family who had returned from the trip, and he also saw the mouse in Ron's arms.
Peter was raised black, fat, and without warning, and he seemed to have a pretty good life.
At that time, Sirius almost couldn't hold back, and wanted to rush to tear Peter to pieces...
"It's good if you know it! If you kill him now, you will never get away with it. Think about Harry..." Ivan reminded him after taking a look at Sirius's hideous face.
Sirius nodded and quickly adjusted his emotions.
More importantly, he can't find a chance to kill Peter now. The Arthur Weasley family is not that easy to mess with. If they sneak into their house and get caught, it will be over...
After eating lunch in a hurry, Sirius noticed that Ivan, who had been flipping through the books in his hand, was somewhat helpless.
After getting along these days, Sirius discovered that Ivan spent almost all of his time reading books and doing some strange potion experiments, and basically only took two or three hours of rest a day.
Sirius opened his mouth, but he didn't know how to comfort him. He guessed that Ivan probably wanted to rely on this kind of intensive study to forget the fact that Isiah died... but it won't work forever!
"Is Hogwarts coming to school soon? That's right, it's September..." Sirius glanced over the letter thrown on the table by Ivan, his heart moved slightly, and the subject changed.
"Hals, I remember that Hogwarts is about to choose courses in the third grade? Do you need me to give you some advice?"
"In my opinion, fortune-telling and Muggle studies are not very useful. Fortune-telling requires an excellent talent for prophecy. People who are not talented are unlikely to learn these divine things.
The knowledge learned in Muggle Studies is rarely used, so you don’t need to waste time on this course. I suggest you learn from ancient Runes, which should be very helpful to you..." Sirius talked freely, telling Ivan about his own experience.
He felt that since Ivan's parents were gone, if he was able, he would of course shoulder the responsibilities of some elders.
Ivan stopped flipping through the book, looking at Sirius who was preparing to introduce him to the pros and cons of each class, shook his head, and interrupted.
"No, I'm not going to make a choice. I have to take every one of these courses!"
"Are you sure?" Sirius was stunned, looking at Ivan with a weird expression, and stopped talking.
"Hals, although the idea of ​​you want to learn a few more courses is encouraged, but many useless courses will share your energy Besides, you will know when you get the timetable. Many courses are in class. Time can all conflict with each other!"
"I think the professors will find a way to solve the problem of curriculum conflict." Ivan shook his head and didn't say much.
He made this decision naturally to get the time converter.
This kind of magical magic item that can reverse time and space is strictly guarded by the Ministry of Magic, and it is almost impossible for normal wizards to come into contact with such things.
Ivan had no confidence to sneak into the Ministry of Magic to steal one out.
Therefore, the best opportunity to obtain the time converter is to be like Hermione in the original time and space. When selecting courses in the third grade, select all the courses, and ask a professor to guarantee that they can apply for a time from the Ministry of Magic. converter.
The Ministry of Magic will never turn down a little wizard who loves to learn, abides by the law and performs well.
He just won the Merlin Medal, the highest honor in the magic world last school year, and I believe the Ministry of Magic will give it this face.

chapters.title: Chapter 278: Learn to Apparate
chapters.content:
As for the professor to help him, Ivan already has a candidate, and Lupin, who is in charge of the Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor next school year, is a very good choice.
As the developer of the wolf poison potion, it should be easy to gain the trust of Lupin, a werewolf wizard...
Ivan was thinking in his heart how to persuade Lupin to help himself write an application to the Ministry of Magic...
Sirius on the other side felt helpless when seeing Ivan insisting on doing this, and to persuade him to no avail.
When he was a student, there was no little wizard who would check all the courses in one go when selecting courses in the third grade.
So Sirius didn't know that he could still apply for a time converter to the Ministry of Magic. I thought the school would have other arrangements at that time, or adjust the curriculum for Ivan separately.
Thinking of this, Sirius stopped persuading him, and instead proposed to go to the Liheng Bookstore in Diagon Alley in the afternoon to buy the books that he needed for the next school year.
It's not enough to stay in the room all the time, he still expects Ivan to find time to go out for a walk.
Ivan shook his head without hesitation, and just leave it to Dobby to buy the little book, he didn't want to waste time on it.
But then, Ivan seemed to have thought of what it was, paused, and asked. "Mr. Black, you should be able to use Apparition, right?"
"Of course, what do you ask this for?" Sirius was a little strange.
"Can you teach me?" Ivan put down Snape's research notes and said seriously.
This time, the magic shop was attacked, making Ivan fully aware of the importance of changing form.
If he knew this teleportation magic at that time, when he sensed something was wrong, he could immediately return to his magic shop and kill those invaders, thus avoiding that thing from happening.
So this is almost the magic that Ivan is most eager to learn today!
Had it not been for the house elves to cast spells differently from the wizards, Ivan would have asked Dobby to teach himself.
"You have to learn to change your form"" Sirius subconsciously wanted to refuse.
Ivan’s age is so young that he will only be in third grade next semester...
The transformation of shadows in the magical world is usually limited to students aged 17 and above, because young wizards of this age have enough magic power and control ability to control this kind of difficult magic.
But Sirius also knew that Ivan was not an ordinary little wizard!
Even Animagus is able to master the high-end transformation magic, and he also possesses a powerful petrification magic. In comparison, there is nothing special about changing shape and shadow.
"Okay! If you insist...I can teach you!" Sirius nodded and agreed after careful consideration.
......
In the afternoon,
Sirius took Ivan to an uninhabited ruin in Knockdown Alley. It was very empty, and under normal circumstances, no one would come. It was very suitable as a place to practice transformation.
After standing in the middle of the ruins, Sirius turned his head and looked at Ivan with a serious expression on his face.
"Before I teach you, I want to know, how much do you know about Transformation?"
Ivan picked up the information of the apparition from his mind, and replied.
"This is a high-level magic. Its function is to allow the wizard to teleport from one place to another. Whether the spell is Apparated or Apparated. Different spells depend on two different situations..."
Ivan was talking endlessly, and he didn't know much about this magic. I just remembered that this seemed to be a learning course for Hogwarts grades six and seven, and there might be a danger of splitting during the course of study. More specifically, he remembered it not very clearly.
After Ivan finished talking about his understanding, Sirius nodded. It seemed that Ivan had some understanding of this magic, so he skipped the introduction and started teaching.
Sirius waved his wand, blasted a hole in the ground in the distance, then pointed at it and said.
"Did you see the pothole? The first step in practicing Apparition is to establish the goal of teleportation. You need to focus your consciousness on the goal you want to reach before casting the spell!"
Ivan looked at the pothole in the distance, and according to Sirius's words, focused his attention as much as possible and looked at it with both eyes.
"The second step is to make up your mind and think that you must move to the target! Let the thoughts of going there fill your whole body from your brain, this step is especially important!" Sirius said very solemnly.
The vast majority of losers who practiced Apparition had problems in this step when they were split.
They don't trust their own power, worry that they will fail to cast the spell, or they may be shaken in their hearts when they cast the spell.
Under such circumstances, it is easy to show that part of the body appears in the target body while the other body is still in place.
Of course, after being split, the wizard will not die on the spot. The magic power will remain in the broken wound, connecting the two separated bodies. As long as there is an experienced wizard who is good at transforming shadows to rescue, it will Turn danger to bargain.
But if this state continues for too long, and the magic remaining at the break disappears, the divided wizard will be completely finished.
Sirius talked about the danger to Ivan, who nodded cautiously.
This time, Ivan does not intend to use grade points to accelerate the efficiency of learning.
All the grade points, he is ready to use potions!
Ivan knew very well that his talent was limited, and he was definitely not as good as Snape, who created magic spells and improved potions when he was a student.
Thinking of making an enhanced version of the compound decoction in a short time the only learning acceleration mode that can be relied on is the Xueba experience card, and the academic grade point can be saved or it should be saved!
Because of this, Ivan listened very carefully to Sirius's teachings, and after the other party had said all the difficulties and points and understood them, he continued to speak.
"Then there is a third step?"
"The third step is to be calm!" Sensing that Ivan was a little nervous, Sirius said with a smile.
"The more natural the performance when releasing the Apparition, the better, just like this!" Sirius said as he gave a demonstration to Ivan.
"Apparition!" Sirius waved his magic wand, turning his body freely, his body disappeared suddenly and appeared at the marked spot.
"Like this! Do you understand?" Sirius flashed again and appeared in his original position.
Ivan nodded, eager to try, staring at the location of the mark, and chanting a spell like Sirius...

chapters.title: Chapter 279: Conquer fear
chapters.content:
"Apparition!"
pronounced the spell,
In an instant, Ivan felt the space around him squeeze him, his body seemed to be out of control, and then this feeling disappeared without a trace...
Did you make it?
Ivan turned in a circle, stopped and looked around, he was still in place...
"I failed this?" Ivan said awkwardly.
"Failure is normal. Practicing this magic is not that easy!" Sirius said with a smile.
Ivan quickly adjusted it. Transformation is a very difficult magic to learn. I imagined that it was really a problem to be able to learn it all at once.
Without using academic grade points to cheat, Ivan estimated that his talent and magic affinity were the level of an excellent student under the two bloodline fusion transformations.
During the week before school, it’s not bad to be able to master the apparition successfully and proficiently.
"Well, I will take you familiar with the Phantom for a few times. It should be helpful to remember this feeling." Sirius thought for a while and said.
After finishing speaking, Sirius grabbed Ivan's wrist, waved his magic wand, and used Phantom Change a few times, moving between the two targets.
Ivan tried hard to remember this feeling of instantaneous movement in his heart.
However, when I tried it myself again, Ivan realized how difficult it is to complete a spatial displacement.
also thoroughly understood why in the process of practicing, the most important thing is to establish determination!
Whenever Ivan senses space and shifts, he will feel a great fear surge in his heart. It is a feeling that his body is about to be slapped, compressed, and cut into segments.
There are so many horrible scenes of failure to cast all kinds of spells in his mind, so that he can't think about the destination with all his heart.
After practicing for more than an hour, Ivan stopped tiredly, and at the same time the system prompt in his mind sounded.
[Ding, after a period of practice, your proficiency in transforming shadows has improved, the current progress is 29/100]
"Let's take a break first. If you are unsteady, it is easy to cause splitting when you rush to Apparition." Sirius stepped forward, patted Ivan on the shoulder, and said comfortingly.
Ivan nodded, and the two found a place to sit down.
Sirius patiently explained to Ivan the mistakes he had just cast.
Finally, Sirius also jokingly talked about how he was too impatient when he first practiced transforming shadows. As a result, he was divided into two parts during one practice.
At that time, many students were frightened. Thanks to the professor who was there, he brought his body back in time.
"And then?" Ivan asked curiously.
"I'm so courageous by nature, isn't my body divided into two parts? That can't stop me, so I am the first one of those students to learn Apparition!"
At this point, Sirius is very proud. At that time, James and Lupin were much slower than him, not to mention the mediocre Peter...
Thinking of this betrayer, Sirius’s face is a bit unsightly.
At this time, Ivan asked curiously. "How long did it take you to learn this magic?"
Ivan’s question interrupted Sirius’ memory, he quickly adjusted his emotions and said provocatively.
"Excluding the time for theory class, it took about five or six classes...what? Do you want to compare with me?"
Is it about ten hours or so? so fast!
Ivan thought with emotion, but still accepted the provocation of Sirius. Only when there is pressure, there is motivation!
After a short rest, Ivan continued the practice of Apparition.
While the system reminder sounded constantly in his mind, Ivan was also gradually overcoming the sense of spatial alienation, trying hard to establish a connection between the two places.
"Apparition!"
A few hours later, the sky gradually darkened. During a spell, Ivan suddenly felt that his body seemed to be squeezed into a small space.
The consciousness seemed to be stripped away, and the body was spinning inside, and the fear of being separated from reality gradually came to my heart.
Ivan kept thinking about the location of the pothole in his mind, and shouted in his heart.
I want to go there, right away, right away!
Ivan soon felt that his body was kicked out of that place, and the world was spinning around. When it stabilized, Ivan found that he had reached the target location.
【Ding, Phantom Shift has reached level 1, current proficiency (9/200), and five academic points awarded! 】
As the system prompt sounded, Ivan realized that he had completed a spatial transformation, and initially learned the curse.
Snap slap...
Sirius clapped and walked over and said admiringly. "It looks like you succeeded! Much faster than I thought..."
"It was just a fluke." Ivan shook his head and looked at the darkening sky. He has been practicing for about seven hours.
Although this speed is faster than the five or six class hours that Sirius said.
But Ivan is very clear that this is the progress in the case of one-to-one teaching When Sirius was learning Apparition, there was no teacher to give him a single tutor.
"With this successful experience, I believe you only need more practice to release this magic at will." Sirius patted Ivan on the shoulder and said encouragingly.
Ivan's ability to initially learn this magic within half a day is far beyond his expectations.
The difficulty of learning Phantom Shift Sirius is very clear. In addition to requiring learners to have sufficient magic power and excellent spatial sensing ability, the most important thing is to overcome fear!
Because every time a wizard uses Apparition, he runs through the cracks of space at the risk of being separated.
The stronger the space-sensing ability of the wizard, the more the feeling of fear can be experienced, so determination and self-confidence are so important in the process of casting a spell!
When learning this magic at Hogwarts, there will be one or two days between each class, so students have plenty of time to adapt.
Sirius was prepared before, and spent a few days to practice with Ivan. He thought that Ivan would not be able to sustain it for an hour or two at most.
I didn’t even think that Ivan not only persevered, but also successfully released Apparition!
A successful spell-casting experience certainly did not satisfy Ivan.
But after practicing for so long, Ivan has long been exhausted physically and mentally, and his magic power is almost exhausted, so he can only give up temporarily and wait until tomorrow to continue practicing.
Then Sirius brought Ivan to a long-range apparition and returned to their temporary stronghold.

chapters.title: Chapter 280: Start of school
chapters.content:
Dobby waited in the stronghold early, and a sumptuous dinner was already placed on the round table, but it was a bit cold after being left for too long.
Neither Ivan nor Sirius cared, they sat down and enjoyed dinner as they usually did, chatting some interesting things in this windy, broken room.
"By the way, Mr. Black, can the magic of Phantom Shift be used in battle?" Ivan suddenly asked curiously.
He has always felt that Apparition is a very practical magic, if it is used in battle, both offense and evasion can have an advantage.
"No, I advise you to not try to do this!" Sirius shook his head, then continued with a serious face.
"I think when you practice Apparition, you should already understand the dangers of this! Even a wizard who can master this spell must always stay focused when casting this spell, not a little bit. Distracted!
When using this magic in a fierce battle, the caster can easily cause his body to separate. Then the enemies will not kindly put your body back together! "
"No one among the wizards I know can do this." Sirius added.
"Can't Dumbledore either?" Ivan asked.
No way!
Sirius had planned to say this, but the words came to a halt again, because he was also not sure, the centenarian... the strongest white wizard in the magical world can always do it easily that some ordinary wizards can't even think of. Dare to think about...
Ivan was caught in thought, and he knew that Dumbledore and Voldemort could do this.
In the first battle between Yuan Shikong and the Ministry of Magic, they disappeared out of thin air and appeared out of thin air in the battle. Although it is not certain whether it was achieved by Phantom Transformation, it also proved the feasibility of using teleportation magic in the battle.
I just don't know how many levels of Phantom Transformation training to be able to do..
Level six? Level seven? Or higher?
Ivan thought so.
After going through so many battles, Ivan has a general understanding of the strength of most wizards.
Normally, the fourth level in the system classification standard is the spellcasting level of a normal adult wizard.
Level 5 is basically professional.
The general Auror, the rigorously trained law enforcement officers in the wizard market, and some dangerous dark wizards, the offensive magic they are good at are basically at this level.
The upper six levels of magic can only be achieved by a very small number of wizards, and represent the authority of a domain!
Ivan guessed that Professor McGonagall’s Transfiguration Curse, and Professor Flitwick’s combat magic is basically at this level.
As for Dumbledore and Voldemort, their magic level may be seven or even above!
Of course, the victory or defeat of the two wizards in the battle depends not only on the amount of magic mastered, and the level of level.
Additional factors such as combat experience, on-the-spot status, etc. can affect the final win or loss...
Ivan estimated his strength level without using blood magic, which was about the level above the fifth level. If he did it with all his strength, he should be able to reach the sixth level of combat power.
Sirius didn’t know that Ivan had thought about so many things in just a few minutes, and he was still bitterly persuading Ivan not to try to do such dangerous things in battle.
Ivan reluctantly agreed, unless he had full certainty, otherwise he would not use this unstable magic in battle.
After eating dinner, Ivan continued his potion improvement experiment, and Sirius quietly watched Ivan work late into the night.
When the third potion improvement failed and the cauldron exploded, Sirius reminded him.
"Halse, you'd better rest early! Tomorrow I will teach you how to perform Apparition from a long distance to the place you have been before. You need to maintain a good mental state to avoid being split during the practice. , It feels uncomfortable..."
Ivan's movements paused, then turned to look at Sirius, and nodded hesitantly.
......
A week passed in a flash while practicing the alternation of shape-shifting and improving potions.
In a blink of an eye, it was September 1st, the day when school started.
Dobby bought back all the magic books used in more than ten courses early on, in addition to a large number of books on potion development.
Many of these are expensive out-of-print books, which Sirius brought to Ivan during a trip to Black's house.
Ivan packed all these dozens of books into the suitcase of the Curing Extension Curse, and then used the apparition that he learned these days.
Thinking of an alley near King's Cross Station in his mind, Ivan Riso swung his wand to recite a spell.
A burst of light and shadow intertwined, and when Ivan came back to his senses, he suddenly realized that he had reached his destination.
"It consumes about one-ninth of the mana, and the mana consumption is really serious..." Ivan checked the status bar and found that the magic scale was short.
He had never tried such a long-distance teleportation before, but he knew a general idea from Sirius. The farther the Phantom Teleportation distance is, the more magic power it consumes. The more blurred the impression of the destination, the more difficult it is to cast a spell. Bigger.
Ivan looked around and made sure that the Muggle hadn't seen the teleportation just now, and then walked towards King's Cross Station with the suitcase.
Ivan was about to enter the station through a pedestrian aisle , but occasionally saw a **** dog hiding in a dark corner.
"Why did you follow? Or where there are so many people? You are not afraid of being caught by the Auror of the Ministry of Magic?" Ivan walked over with the box, looked around, and said in a low voice.
"They didn't know that I was an Animagus!" Sirius was very disdainful. He never looked after the Aurors who were hunting down. As long as he didn't take the initiative to expose them, these idiots would never find him.
As for the purpose of the follow-up, naturally, I was worried about what accidents would happen to Ivan for the first time in such a long-distance teleportation. If Ivan was accidentally split, no one else would help him pick it back.
Despite this thought, Sirius raised his brow and said. "I made a special trip to see Harry off...I haven't seen him in a long time."
"Whatever you want, don't get too close then, just be seen by Peter!" Ivan shook his head, turned and walked into the station.
Passing through platform nine and three-quarters, the black and red Hogwarts train has stopped at the platform, and billowing white steam is spitting out from the chimney...

chapters.title: Chapter 281: Werewolf Lupin
chapters.content:
Ivan carried the suitcase and boarded the train. Since he arrived early, there were not many people on the train, and most of the boxes were empty.
Ivan did not randomly find an empty box to sit in, but found someone on the train. When he opened the last box, he happened to see a middle-aged wizard placing the luggage box.
The wizard wore an old patched robe with light gray hair. He looked tall and thin. The side looked pale, as if he might be blown down by the wind at any time.
Remus John Lupin!
At a glance, Ivan recognized the identity of the wizard in front of him, who would appear here at this time, and he was the only one who dressed up.
Perceiving the noise at the door, Lupin turned his head and looked at Ivan.
"Hello, Professor Lupin, may I sit here?" Ivan nodded politely.
"Ah of course, please feel free!" Lu Ping was stunned and looked a little restrained. He remembered that there were still many vacant carriages on the train.
Because of his own experience, Lupin deliberately chose the unmanned compartment at the rear of the car, but he didn't expect someone to follow him right after he came in and put his luggage in.
Lupin sat down as far as possible to the corner, watching Ivan sitting opposite, curious, and asked aloud.
"Can you tell me which college you are a student? And how do you know that I am a professor?"
"I'm Ivan Hals of Gryffindor. As for your identity, of course I saw it from your suitcase." Ivan pointed to the luggage rack above. Lupin's suitcase was printed his name.
"In addition, I think you should be the new Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor! Because this position happens to be vacant, isn't it?" Ivan talked openly, he needed Lupin's help, so naturally he wanted to impress him. some.
"Wonderful!" Lupin applauded and said appreciatively. "You are very smart. If I hadn't listened to your own introduction, I would have thought you were a Ravenclaw."
"By the way, your name is Ivan Hals? That genius little wizard who made the wolf poison potion? Winner of the Merlin Medal?"
Lupin suddenly thought of something. He took out a daily prophet from his patched robe, and when he was about to open it for confirmation, it stopped.
Because Lupin saw a shiny medal hung on Ivan's chest, it was so dazzling, he obviously didn't need to confirm it again.
"That's indeed me, Professor!" Ivan nodded reservedly. The reason why he has been so angry today is always carrying the Merlin Medal, so that Lupin can recognize himself and make contact easier.
"It's amazing, it's hard to believe that you can do things that many potions masters can't do at such a young age." Lu Ping looked at the little wizard who was only thirteen or fourteen years old in front of him, and said with emotion.
He felt that the surprise in this life might not have come so much on this day.
"It's not that they can't do it, it's just that these potion masters don't care much about the status quo of werewolf wizards in the magic world." Ivan shook his head and retorted.
"Yes, who cares about the safety of a group of werewolves?" Lu Ping smiled bitterly. After so many years of wandering life, Lu Ping has an incomparable understanding of the prejudice of normal wizards against werewolf wizards.
Whenever you go to a new place, everyone can get along well when no one knows his identity, and it is not difficult to find a job.
But because he would run out of control every night of the full moon, even if he could estimate the time to hide in no one's place, it was difficult to cover up the noise.
So every time he would reveal his identity and be forcibly expelled from each time, very few people were willing to accept a werewolf. This was also the reason why he wandered around in the Ministry. After all, he didn't stay anywhere long.
Because of this, Lupin became more and more curious about Ivan.
"Can you tell me why you want to develop this potion?" Lupin asked.
Ivan then repeated the excuses from the interview with Rita Skeeter, showing that he lived in Knock Down Alley and often came into contact with werewolves to know a lot about them, and he also had deep sympathy for them.
He understands that werewolf wizards are not as brutal as in the legend, many of them are victims of werewolf attacks, and in a normal state, they are no doubt ordinary wizards.
Ivan was very sincere, although he had a certain purpose, but more of it was sincere.
He had come into contact with the werewolves such as Walker and Furen in the dump. They honestly did odd jobs in Knockoff Alley, earning a meager salary to survive. Compared to the wicked and cunning dark wizards in Knockoff Alley Too much.
Ivan's words greatly increased Lupin's favor, he sighed and said.
"If only the other wizards think like you do, those werewolves will be better off, and there won't be so many werewolf wizards going astray."
Lu Ping recalled the werewolf wizards he had met on the way he was wandering. Because they were rejected and hated by the magic world, they could not find a job and could not support themselves. They had to rely on theft and robbery to make a living. Many people ended up The mentality was deformed and distorted, and he became a complete dark wizard.
There are more werewolves like this, and it has once again intensified the rejection of normal wizards against them, and the constant cycle has created an untieable knot.
"I think it will definitely change in the future." Ivan said comfortingly.
"Yeah, with the wolf poison potion you developed, it should be better in the future! It just takes some time." Lu Ping broke free from the memory and smiled at Ivan.
Although Lupin knows very well that it is impossible for the magical world to accept werewolf wizards only with the wolf poison potion, at least it is slowly getting better, isn't it?
Then the two talked about other things, and it was not until the train was about to start that Lupin stopped talking sleepily.
As a poor wandering werewolf, he really didn't have any extra money to stay at the Broken Cauldron Bar, so he would fall asleep in the neighborhood these days, and he was really sleepy now.
Lupin curled up and sat in the corner, nap using another shabby robe as a quilt.
Ivan didn't intend to waste time in the car, took out a sophisticated potion book from his suitcase, looked through it for himself, and made some notes from time to time.
Lu Ping squinted his eyes slightly, watching this scene in his eyes, and he had a clear understanding of Ivan's efforts, no wonder he was able to develop a potion at such an age.
Hals, if you were still alive, you would be proud of your child, right?
Someone flashed past Lupin’s mind. After a while, Lupin couldn’t resist falling asleep sleepily.

chapters.title: Chapter 282: I shouldn't be this professor!
chapters.content:
Woo...
The loud whistle echoed in Ivan's ears, and accompanied by a jitter, the train slowly moved forward.
Ivan flipped through the book on his own, and the carriage was very quiet. If it wasn't for the inconvenience to make potions here, he was ready to take out the crucible in the suitcase.
After a while, there was a sound of conversation outside the door, and the door of the compartment was pushed open the next moment.
"Ivan?" The little brown-haired witch who opened the door was holding a willow basket in her hand, and there were waves of light, snoring noises faintly heard.
Ivan turned his head, and Hermione, Ron, and Harry came in.
The three squeezed in quickly and closed the sliding door.
The space in the carriage is fairly large, and Lupin is curled up in the corner again, and there is no problem with sitting three more people.
Hermione sat down in the empty seat beside Ivan, while Ron and Harry sat down on the other side, curiously looking at Lupin who was sleeping on the corner.
"Who is he?" Ron looked at Lupin, who was wearing a patched robe, and asked.
"The new Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor, he is asleep, you better keep your voice down," Ivan reminded.
However, Ron's expression was stunned. His expression became serious, he leaned closer to signal everyone to be closer, and then carefully glanced at Lupin, before speaking softly.
"Then Ivan, have you confirmed just now? Isn't he a dark wizard or a liar?"
Ron's words made Ivan stunned, his face turned a little weird.
"Ron, how can you say that?" Hermione scolded angrily.
"I'm just asking, you don't know what happened in the past few semesters..." Ron whispered, and then he defended.
"Professor Chino the year before was a dark wizard related to a mysterious man. Last year Lockhart was a pretending liar. He attacked so many people in the school. Thanks to Ivan, I was able to get them out."
"Before getting into the car, George and Fred were speculating about the new Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor, who could last for a few months this time..."
Ron whispered, but didn't notice Lupin, who was curled up in the corner, trembled.
The sound of Harry and others pushing the door and talking just now awakened Lupin who had just fallen asleep.
Just because he was too sleepy, Lupin didn't get up to say hello to Harry and the others, instead he was going to stay asleep for a while.
However, he never expected that he would overhear such news.
Lupin didn't dare to open his eyes and move, and smiled bitterly in his heart.
Originally, Ivan had a good impression on him, he did not discriminate against werewolf wizards, and he was the son of his comrades-in-arms. Lupin still thought that he could get in touch with him more in the future, but now Ivan has become his object of avoidance.
When Dumbledore invited him to be a Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor, he never mentioned this to him...
Lu Ping couldn't help wondering if he shouldn't be the professor. Is it too late to get off the train?
Ivan, who was flipping through the potions books, didn't know that he had finally improved some good feelings for Lupin, but now he avoided him.
After making complaints, Ron did not mention the miserable experiences of the previous professors. Instead, he told the three of them about their family's experience in Egypt.
Ron's pet mouse, Scabious, got into Ron's pocket the moment he entered the carriage and refused to come out again.
Ivan has also been distracted by the strange behavior.
At first Ivan thought that he had been exposed somewhere, and he was hesitant to lock up Shaban to prevent him from escaping, but then realized that Shaban was afraid of Lupin when he thought about it.
Now that Sirius can recognize Peter in the form of Animagus in the photo at a glance, Lupin, who is also a friend, should also be able to recognize him.
Of course, maybe Hermione's new pet, a Persian longhair cat-Crookshanks!
Ivan looked at the willow basket next to the table and chair, and the spiritual cat was inside.
"Ivan..."
Ivan, who was thinking about something, was interrupted by Hermione's words, and when he returned to his thoughts, she saw Hermione looking at him with a grimace.
"Hermione, what did you just say? I didn't hear it." Ivan looked confused.
"Obviously you promised to send me a letter before, but I didn't see a single letter throughout the summer vacation! You never responded to the letter I sent you..." Hermione was a little bit savory. Repeated the previous words, a pair of brown eyes fixed on Ivan.
"Sorry, Hermione, I was busy with other things during the summer vacation, so I forgot it for a while." Ivan said apologetically.
Thinking of what happened during the summer vacation, Ivan’s face was a bit more gloomy. He was busy tracking down the attacker, so naturally he didn't have much energy to write or reply.
He didn't even receive a letter from Hermione at all, because the letters were usually sent home.
Only the Hogwarts Owl was more special, and he found his stronghold directly. I don't know if Dobby often teleports back and forth between Hogwarts and the temporary stronghold, so the location is exposed.
forgotten?
The little witch's eyes widened, her white cheeks became puffed up,
This is the second time!
During the summer vacation of the first grade, Ivan was busy developing the wolf poison potion and forgot to send her the letter, so before this summer vacation, she also specially reminded it, but I did not expect Ivan to forget it.
"I heard George and Fred say that they also sent you a letter to Ivan during the summer vacation, but they didn't see you reply for a long time, and they were all anxious. If it weren't for their mother, they would all plan to knock you down in the alley. . "Ron also spit out.
Of course, Ron didn't think anything would happen to Ivan, he hadn't seen a time when Ivan was at a loss.
Hermione didn't think so, she was keenly aware that Ivan's face was not so good-looking, and the anger that had flowed up had subsided.
When I remembered that Ivan just said that there were other things to be busy during the summer vacation, the clever little witch suddenly worried about whether Ivan would encounter any trouble during the summer vacation.
"IvanDid something happen to you during the summer vacation?" Hermione asked worriedly.
Harry and Ron were reminded of this by Hermione, and realized that there was something wrong with this situation, so they looked at Ivan one after another.
"No, no, I just encountered some problems while improving a potion." Ivan rejected Hermione's guess, shook his head, and said again.
"You know, as long as I learn, I can't take care of other things."
With that said, Ivan shook the "How to Improve Potions" in his hand.
Harry and Ron remembered the wolf poison potion developed by Ivan, and quickly dispelled their doubts. Ron also jokingly said that Ivan might be able to get another Merlin Medal this year.
"It's impossible for the same person to get two Merlin Medals, Ron!" Hermione corrected the error in Ron's words, but was still a little doubtful about Ivan's words.
After all, even if the improvement potion is busy, there will be no time to reply to a letter...

chapters.title: Chapter 283: You bother me thinking...
chapters.content:
"Of course I know they won't issue two Merlin medals, but they can be replaced with a higher grade, can't they?" Ron curled his lips, dissatisfied with Hermione's dismantling of the stage.
Just as Ron turned his head and looked at Ivan, planning to say something, there was a sudden jitter in the train.
Then the train got slower and slower, and it seemed that it was about to stop.
"Are we there? So soon this time?" Ron touched his stomach, he couldn't wait to have dinner in the auditorium.
"Not yet." Hermione shook her head and turned to look out the window.
When I got in the car before, it was still sunny, but now the outside world is dark, black clouds and fog covering the sky, big raindrops falling down, even the visual range is affected.
"Then why did it stop? Is it because the train broke down halfway and needs repairs?" Harry guessed.
"I've never heard George and the others say that there will be such a situation, should we not be still here?" Ron murmured.
After the train moved slowly for a while, it came to a halt with a chuckle.
Outside the carriage, there was also a burst of noise, and the other little wizards also found that the situation was not right.
Harry and Ron wondered what happened.
