Hermione turned her head to ask Ivan's opinion, but found that Ivan didn't care about the abnormality of the train at all. She flipped through the book to herself, frowning, as if thinking about something.
Suddenly, the magic light in the carriage flashed and then went out suddenly, and the surrounding area was plunged into a burst of darkness, only a little light was projected from the window.
Harry stretched his head out of the carriage and looked at it. The corridor was also black. Something seemed to be floating in the darkness, and it was a little frighteningly quiet, except for the sound of sliding doors reverberating incessantly.
"It looks like something is outside!" Harry swallowed, then retracted his head back into the compartment, whispering.
"What's that? Did you see it?" Ron became even more frightened when Harry said this.
Ivan's movement of flipping through the book also stopped. The dim environment had already affected his reading. After thinking about it, Ivan guessed that the outside world was a dementor.
But Ivan ignored it, because the other party was ordered to search Sirius, and he couldn't summon the patron saint for the time being. Lupin would always take action anyway.
Ivan took out his magic wand and tapped it upwards, the magic lamp that had been turned off turned on again, and then continued to turn the book, operated Occlumency, and sank into his own world.
The light reappeared, but Harry and Ron didn't feel the slightest sense of security, because the whole carriage seemed to become more gloomy, the biting chill gradually permeating the body from the soles of the feet, and Hermione was also fidgeting.
The next moment, the three of them couldn't help holding their breath, and a black shadow was printed on the window of the compartment, and they couldn't see what it was through the window.
The deep cold air penetrated through the gap of the door, and something was pulled out.
Ron and Hermione just felt a little uncomfortable, and Harry was much more serious. His head was dizzy and his thoughts seemed to be disturbed.
Click...
The sliding door was opened a little bit, and a withered, crusted hand rested on the door extension, and the biting cold wind was blowing in from outside the door.
Click...
With a nasty push of the door, the sliding door was completely opened, and Ron looked at the tall, weird figure in a ruined cloak in horror.
It seems to be floating in the air, with a face completely hidden under the hood, and the exposed body is rotten.
This reminded Ron of the mummy he had seen in Egypt, which might have been the way the bandage was removed.
Hermione couldn't help but leaned against Ivan.
Harry also wanted to stay away from the ghost, but his body seemed to be frozen and could not move at all. Harry's heart seemed to be held by someone, and someone in his mind was screaming... There was panic and pleading in that voice, but he wanted to do something but was helpless.
The illusory and intangible things were continuously drawn out of Harry, and the dementor was inhaling, making a gurgling noise, and squeezing in through the outside door lightly.
Lupin didn’t know when he had opened his eyes and put his hand into the wizard’s robe.
At this moment, a voice sounded.
"Get out, you interrupted my thinking..."
Ivan's tone was very blunt, turning his head to look at the rotten, dilapidated figure, all his thoughts were interrupted by the appearance of the dementor.
Although Ivan used Occlumency, what he didn't expect was that closing the brain could not completely isolate the dementors from the influence.
The scene of witnessing the death of Aisia two months ago constantly emerged from the depths of Ivan's memory, and the anger gradually came to his heart, and Ivan's eyes were faintly transformed into orange-yellow vertical pupils.
The dementor's movements paused, and the face under the brim of the hat turned to face Ivan.
The dementor has no eyes, and is naturally not affected by the direct death effect. Instead, it feels that Ivan's suppressed emotions are delicious, and can't help but get close to the body.
The tattered and wide cloak was shrouded in the small carriage, the magic lamp could not bear the pressure and went out, and the darkness pressed in step by step...
Hermione next to her felt all her happiness disappeared, leaving only her empty body.
All the things that Ivan had been trying to forget for a while were all remembered, and the anger had been condensed to the extreme, and a system prompt sounded in his mind.
Then Ivan stretched out his magic wand, a dazzling light lit up in the compartment, and the darkness melted in the light...
Countless white fog continued to impact the broken body of the dementor like ocean waves, slamming it into the aisle.
The dementor’s black hood was peeled off directly, revealing its disgusting long face, and its hollow mouth wailed silently in the white lightThe body was dismembered as if corroded. ...
"What is that thing? You...you killed it?" Ron stammered.
"It's just a dementor! It intends to enter the carriage and do something to me, and no one will care if it kills it..." Ivan closed the book in his hand and his face was very ugly.
Under the influence of the Dementor, Ivan's mind came up with countless scenes where he used the time converter to try to save Aysia after returning, but failed.
This is also the reason why he didn't control the power of Hushen's guard...
Not to mention that the wizarding world has always been the supremacy of wizards, and the statues erected in the lobby of the Ministry of Magic speak this philosophy without any cover.
With a valid reason, a little wizard fights back and kills the dementor, a creature that everyone hates, and he won't be punished.
"No, I mean, what should we do now? It seems that more of that stuff is coming..." Ron pointed to the dark shadows floating outside the window, and said in horror.

chapters.title: Chapter 284: They are not the only ones who hold grudges...
chapters.content:
Now it's just in the evening, the outside world is like late at night, erratic black shadows passing by the window, the cabin is becoming more and more depressed...
Harry froze stiffly, in a cold sweat.
Hermione was also a little frightened, she suddenly remembered that the new Defence Against the Dark Arts professor was in the carriage, and hurriedly turned her head to look over.
Lu Ping was no longer pretending to be sleeping, he had already stood up, his eyes looked out the window, he noticed the black shadows gathered around, and said helplessly to Ivan.
"You are too reckless, Hals, there are a lot of dementors here, but they will hold grudges!"
"They are not the only ones who hold grudges..." Ivan threw the potions books aside, and as the dementors gathered more and more, only the things that made him feel angry and painful were left in his mind.
"What do you want to do?" Lupin frowned.
"Of course, let them roll away!" Ivan's tone was sharp.
Under the pressure of the Dementor, he forcibly released the Hushen Guard, which made his proficiency soar. The Guardian God spell has been upgraded from level four to level five, which means that emotional fluctuations will not affect his use of blood magic.
The large number of dementors who have been entrenched in the sky are a little uncontrollable. They can feel that there is delicious food underneath. In addition, they have just been killed by a similar species. Now they are very angry. The rules of the Ministry of Magic are also Can't manage it anymore.
A large number of dementors rushed down from the air, and the darkness was crushed. The surrounding temperature was getting lower and lower, and there was a faint cry from outside. It was obvious that a little wizard could not bear the pressure and collapsed...
The dementor at the front came in directly through the window, but before he had time to take a breath, he was bounced out by a white light.
"Call God to guard!"
As Ivan chanted the spell, more white mist drifted out, forming a huge light shield that enveloped the entire carriage, and it continued to spread out for a moment.
Several dementors directly slammed into the mask and rippled. The mask formed by the white mist was very strong, and there was no sign of cracking. On the contrary, the white mist was corroding the body of the dementor.
The dementors were not afraid. They gathered more and more, and the relatively scattered white mist couldn't support it.
Lupin held his magic wand tightly, and if Ivan couldn’t hold on, he would help, even though he didn’t want to be seen as his patron saint...
Ron and Hermione both looked at the sky nervously, for fear that the dementors would tear the mask and rush over.
Ivan waved his magic wand unhurriedly, and nearly half of the white fog got out of the mask and gathered together. Accompanied by a neighing sound, the swooping dementors fled in horror...
Although the number of dementors who came to inspect is huge, Ivan’s Unicorn Shadow is not an ordinary patron saint. To the dementors, it is like a natural enemy. Once hit by a unicorn or trampled on, it will be It hits into a black mist and dissipates in the air...
Ivan drove these dementors away from the Hogwarts train, and didn't mean to kill them deliberately. After all, these dementors were employees of the Ministry of Magic, and if they killed too much, they were beating the Ministry of Magic in the face.
So a white light and shadow appeared in the sky, chasing the spectacle of a large group of dementors running around.
However, because it is not clear to see through the white mask, only a little outline can be seen...this is also what Ivan deliberately did.
Seeing this scene, Hermione breathed a sigh of relief, but Lupin said with emotion.
"I didn't expect you to be able to summon your patron saint at this age."
The strength of Ivan's guarding was beyond his imagination. Lupin estimated that although his shots could also expel these dementors, it would never be as easy as Ivan's.
"This is not too hard to learn magic." Ivan shook his head.
Harry in the original time and space learned this magic in the third grade and successfully summoned the patron saint.
In the fifth grade, many students in Harry's da, did this after a period of practice.
Suddenly, Ron's eager voice rang in the carriage.
"Harry, what's the matter with you? Harry?"
Ivan turned his head and looked over, only to find that Harry, who was sitting on the opposite corner, lost consciousness and fell to the side, his face looked very pale.
Lu Ping's expression also changed slightly. After checking, he slowly breathed a sigh of relief and said to the worried Hermione and Ron.
"Harry has nothing to do with him, but was temporarily unconscious under the influence of the Dementor. Let him rest for a while..."
"But why didn't we faint?" Hermione asked strangely, in her impression that Harry was not such a vulnerable person.
"Dementors can **** away happiness and recall all the painful things, so those with painful experiences have to bear more pressure than ordinary people when facing dementors..." Ivan explained. Tao.
"Yes, as Hals said, Harry was in a coma because he had experienced some bad things. It is not shameful..." Lupin looked at Harry's pain in his sleep and sighed. Sighed.
Ron nodded, and Hermione glanced at Ivan thoughtfully, thinking of Ivan's excessive reaction to the dementor just now.
At this moment, there was a rush of footsteps outside the door,
After a while, two middle-aged wizards in uniform appeared in front of the door with ugly expressions. The leading one glanced in the carriage, his gaze stayed on Lupin, and he asked.
"Who released the patron saint just now?"
"The two Mr. Aurors are me!" Ivan looked at them fearlessly. He understood that these two wizards should be the accompanying Aurors, responsible for supervising those law enforcement dementors.
After all, dementors are evil and chaotic creatures. For large-scale operations, it is impossible for the Ministry of Magic not to send people to restrain them to prevent them from losing control.
"You?" The chunky Captain Auror looked at Ivan suspiciously, and then at Lupin with a weird look.
It was really hard for him to believe that he was a thirteen or four-year-old little wizard who had expelled so many dementors. He immediately doubted whether Lupin wanted to escape the blame and let a little wizard take the responsibility.
Lupin smiled helplessly in the two weird eyes, which was really not what he did.
Ivan didn't reply, waved his magic wand to bring up a white mist, and a quiet and peaceful breath surged into everyone's hearts.
The two Aurors now looked squarely at the little wizard in front of him. Although Ivan did not show his patron saint, it was enough to have this hand...

chapters.title: Chapter 285: We have to thank you for saying that?
chapters.content:
After a brief surprise, the chunky Captain Auror asked aloud.
"These dementors were ordered to investigate the Hogwarts train and search for fugitives here. What are you doing to expel and kill them? You are obstructing the Ministry of Magic's search operations!"
The faces of the two Aurors were very ugly. As the accompanying law enforcement officers, they were responsible for supervising the dementors to complete the search task.
Now not only the mission is not completed, but conflicts have also arisen. After returning, he said he must not be punished by the ministry.
Hermione and Ron looked at Ivan with some worry. They thought it was a dementor who attacked the train, and they were still happy that Ivan had defeated so many monsters. They did not expect that these dementors were sent by the Ministry of Magic. of....
Facing the questioning of the two Aurors, Ivan said with his expression unchanged.
"Sir, I'm about to report to you that we were attacked by dementors just now. Harry Potter was injured as a result and passed out into a coma. I had no choice but to use the guards of the gods to repel them."
Having said this, Ivan stepped aside so that the two Aurors could see Harry who had passed out of a coma.
Hearing that someone was injured, the short and chubby Captain Auror's face changed slightly, and he turned his head and looked over and noticed Harry who was pale behind Ivan.
He hurried forward to investigate and found that it was because of the Dementor. At the same time, the Auror Captain also noticed the lightning scar on Harry's forehead, he shook his heart, and asked aloud with a hint of expectation.
"You said his name is Harry Potter? Isn't it the Harry Potter who destroyed the mysterious man?"
"Yes, it's the Harry Potter! The dementor who came in just now attacked Harry, so I killed it with my hands. I didn't expect other dementors to gather around like crazy."
Ivan explained, then looked at the little wizards gathered around the door to watch the excitement, and said to them.
"If you don't believe me, you can ask everyone!"
Ivan directly used Harry's coma to make a fuss, characterizing the matter as a dementor out of control and intending to attack the students, and then he promptly rescued him.
As long as these little wizards are willing to believe and write a letter to inform the family, there will naturally be many wizard parents to put pressure on the Ministry of Magic.
Not only can the Ministry of Magic not blame him, it must also praise...
The little wizards who had just been frightened by the dementors were naturally excited. No one would like this evil creature that **** happiness, so they all supported Ivan and vented their anger.
"Halse is right! Those dementors are simply too damn..."
"The dementor who searched our car has been lingering. It must be thinking about whether or not to attack us. Fortunately, Hals drove them away..."
"I want to tell my dad to listen and let him put these dementors into Azkaban..."
"Be locked into Azkaban? Do they lock themselves?"
......
The two Aurors looked at the agitated crowd, and suddenly laughed bitterly. They used to come to Xingshi to inquire about the crime, but now they have been inquired by Xingshi.
The chunky Captain Auror scolded the ashes dementor in his heart.
Before carrying out this task, he especially warned these unintelligible things, let them converge a little, and must not do anything to the students on the train!
Unexpectedly, this happened. Even if the Dementor attacked an ordinary student, it was easier to handle, but it was the famous Harry Potter!
If the dementors attacked Harry Potter because of their negligence, they would be overwhelmed by the overwhelming letter of complaint tomorrow.
"Two gentlemen, do you have anything else to ask?" Ivan said aloud.
The chunky Captain Auror stopped talking, and finally said very aggrieved. "No, no, you did a good job and expelled these out-of-control dementors in time..."
"I just did some small work." Ivan said reservedly, and the medal on his chest seemed to be brighter...
The two Aurors also saw Ivan's medal at this time and recognized his identity, no wonder this little wizard was able to expel so many dementors.
Thinking of this, the two Aurors smiled bitterly at each other, and after understanding the cause and effect, they planned to gather the dementors who fled, and then returned to the Ministry of Magic to explain the situation.
Having made such a big mistake, it would be light to get a scolding...
The two of them were about to leave with a change of shape, but unexpectedly heard Ivan's voice ringing behind them.
"Two Aurors, I think this attack was entirely due to the chaos and evil of the Dementors group. I will write a letter to the Ministry of Magic at that time to explain the situation."
The chunky Captain Auror looked back at Ivan in surprise, and said gratefully.
"Then trouble you, Hals..."
After Ivan's reminder, the two also realized that they could shift the responsibility to those dementors as much as possible.
What do the dementors think?
They can't speak, they can only express some simple meanings at best, and no one will care about the complaints of a group of dementors...
With an idea in their minds, the two Aurors quickly apparated and disappeared in front of everyone.
As the new professor, Lupin took up the responsibilities, soothing the little wizards blocking the door, and getting them all to return to their cars.
Then Lupin looked at sitting in the original position and quietly flipped through the book, as if nothing happened to Ivan, with a strange expression on his face.
Lu Ping had witnessed the whole thing with his own eyes just now, and when the two Aurors came to inquire about it, he was a little worried that Ivan would not handle it well and was taken away for investigation.
Unexpectedly, Ivan said in a few words. Not only did I dismiss the two Aurors who were about to inquire, but the other party had to thank him in turn...
Lupin suddenly had a new understanding of Ivan’s dexterity Thinking of the first two Defence Against the Dark Arts professors who were identified by Ivan, Lupin had a headache, and he doubted his werewolves very much. How long can the identity of a wizard be hidden...
Without the dementor, the stopped train quickly started to move, the bright whistle sounded through my ears, and the thick white mist gushed out from the chimney.
While continuing to look at the potions books, Ivan also took a look at the system bar with a trace of mind.
He thought he would get the achievement of being an enemy of the dementors by driving away the hordes of dementors in front of so many people, but unfortunately there was nothing...
I don't know what the criteria of achievement are. Is he not enough?
Ivan pondered for a while, and then left it behind him. Although it was crucial to get the five legendary values, it was not the most important thing right now.
Get the time converter and complete the improvement of the potion is the top priority...

chapters.title: Chapter 286: Why can't it be seen only by me?
chapters.content:
The Hogwarts train moved forward quickly, and encountered no other troubles along the way.
As the dementor's search was delayed for some time, when the train entered the station, the sky was completely dark, and only the scattered street lights were pointing the way.
Harry in the carriage was really unconscious all the way, and he was not able to wake up. Hermione and Ron were very worried, and Ivan was a little strange.
He remembered that Harry hadn't been in a coma for so long in the original time.
But Ivan quickly thought that Harry in the original time and space was on the train, but he had not been surrounded by a group of dementors as before.
At that time, even he couldn't restrain his emotions, and started to expel those monsters that absorbed pleasure and caused pain, and Harry was even more affected.
When the train stopped and Ivan packed up his luggage, Lupin took the initiative to carry Harry who had passed out in a coma, and the group got off the train together.
As soon as Malfoy got off the train with his two attendants, he saw Harry lying on Lupin's shoulders. He suddenly felt his eyes light up and leaned forward.
"Oh, our poor Potter, I heard that he was fainted by a group of dementors. Is that true? Isn't he okay?" Malfoy pretended to be concerned and exclaimed. .
His two followers, Bangor and Clark, smirked at the right time, and the air was suddenly full of joy.
"Do you want to fight? Malfoy? Harry was attacked by a dementor! Do you know if it was an attack?" Ron said angrily.
"Assault, how did it happen? Did Potter be kissed by a dementor? I heard my dad say that they treat prisoners like this." Malfoy pulled his wizard robes on his head, learning those dementors. The strange appearance threatened Ron, and he teased.
"Malfoy, right? The Dementor's kiss is far more horrible than you think! That's no joke," Lupin interrupted Malfoy's words with a frown, and continued solemnly. "It can **** your soul away! Turn your body into an empty shell!"
"Who are you again?" Malfoy was taken aback, and then looked at him a little annoyed.
"I am the new Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor!" Lu Ping said calmly.
"Oh, is it? Hello, Professor! I really look forward to your staying longer this semester." Malfoy's face wore a nasty smile, but he didn't dare to say too obvious.
After leaving this sentence, Malfoy greeted Gore and Clark to take the lead and gave Ivan a fierce look before leaving.
Ivan snatched away his house-elf last school year, so that his mother Narcissa cooked the food during the summer vacation.
However, an aristocratic woman who has never cooked before suddenly starts to cook something that can be imagined with her toes.
So he was forced to eat dark dishes for several weeks, until his father couldn’t accept it, and finding a servant who knew how to cook and magic would end his miserable life.
"Why did that Malfoy target Harry so much?" Lupin watched Malfoy leave, then looked at Ivan and asked curiously.
how could I know? Ivan shook his head helplessly, but still tried to combine Malfoy's performance in the original time and space and analyzed.
"I heard that some children always like to use this strange way to hide their kindness, care! What do Muggles call this term? Tsundere?"
Was it so? Lu Ping had never heard of the new term Tsundere, but he was still able to accurately understand what Ivan meant.
"Ivan doesn't seem to be what you said?" Ron stammered, and Hermione looked at Ivan with a weird expression.
"Don't you think that Malfoy reacts fiercely every time Harry is injured or achieved something?" Ivan said nonsense.
Ron thought about it carefully, and shuddered for a while, it turned out to be like this? That's horrible
While talking, several people came to a carriage.
Lupin laid the drowsy Harry on the bench at the back of the carriage so that he could sleep more comfortably. He sat on the opposite side, and he turned his head and said to several people.
"There can be another person, who of you wants to come up!"
Hermione glanced at Ivan and hesitated. Ron got into the car carelessly, sat next to Lupin, and took care of Harry with him.
Although Harry occupies two positions by himself, the carriage started slowly, and it seemed that it was not necessary to take a four-person start.
Ron, sitting in the carriage, was also surprised that the carriage would act on its own. He wondered if any advanced magic had been applied to it, just like the car he and Harry drove last school year.
The remaining two people turned to the next carriage.
Ivan walked in a few steps, but didn't get in the carriage immediately, silently watching the two Yeqi standing in front of the carriage.
They looked skinny, with a dragon-like head, and no flesh on their bodies. The black fur was tightly attached to the skeleton, and the gaps between the bones could even be clearly seen.
The most eye-catching thing is the large and black wings on both sides, which look like enlarged bat wings, blending into the black night sky, looking weird and unlucky.
He can see Ye Qi
That's right, he thought of killing four people with his own hands within two months, and witnessing the corpses of more than a dozen wizards, and he understood death.
Ivan was not happy, but rather sad. He obviously hoped that he could look directly at this creature last school year.
Hermione wondered why Ivan stopped. When she was about to ask, a melodious and ethereal voice rang from the carriage.
"They look cool, don't they?"
Ivan was interrupted and noticed the little witch who was sitting alone in the carriage with a newspaper in her hand.
"Why are you here alone, Luna? Where's your roommate?" Ivan asked strangely.
"They don't want to sit in a carriage with me" Luna whispered softly without any dissatisfaction on her face.
"But I'm fine by myselfThe carriage will always move anyway."
"Do you want to sit up?" Luna suddenly patted the position next to her and invited.
"Of course, that's exactly three people!" Ivan nodded, boarded the carriage and sat opposite Luna.
Hermione followed, and hesitated to sit next to Ivan.
Ye Qi drove the carriage slowly, driving towards Hogwarts Castle in the dim night
Ivan looked at the night skies pulling carts. It was a very magical creature. Looking directly at it can always keep people quiet.
Luna tilted her head and looked
Hermione's eyes widened, and she looked in the direction of the two of them, and there was nothing empty.
Hermione was a little discouraged to think that she had touched this creature last school year, which means that Ye Qi is real.
But why can't it be seen only by her?

chapters.title: Chapter 287: You are lucky not to see it
chapters.content:
In this weird silence, Hermione finally couldn't help but asked out loud.
"Are you watching Yeqi?"
"Yeah..." Luna turned her gaze to Hermione and said suddenly as she looked at her. "You are lucky not to see it..."
lucky?
Hermione's face flushed, and she thought Luna must be laughing at her.
"That's not necessarily! How do you know what I can't see? It looks like a horse, it's very tall and big, it has two wings like bats, and the thin one can see the bones..."
Hermione talked endlessly according to her personal experience last school year and the descriptions she read in the books.
Luna and Ivan glanced at each other, and smiled tacitly, without piercing Hermione's words.
"Furthermore, Ye Qi is a very magical creature, and usually only people who directly witness the death can see it..." Hermione rummaged through the memory in her mind, so that she seemed to have seen Ye Qi with her own eyes.
But when it came to her death, Hermione stopped and did not continue. She suddenly understood why Luna said she was lucky...
Hermione stared at Luna and Ivan blankly. Have they already witnessed death?
Hermione hesitated to ask if she should ask. She remembered that Ivan couldn't see Ye Qi last school year. At the same time, she wondered why Luna, who was a year younger than her, experienced this...
Luna looked at Hermione's expression in her eyes, she thought for a while, then looked at Ivan and whispered softly.
"My mother is a person who likes doing experiments. She has always wanted to create some interesting magic! Until one time her spell went wrong and the explosion swallowed her, in an experiment, before my eyes. .."
Luna's voice is very soft and soft, but also very calm, only a little sadness can be seen in those eyes.
"Sorry, I don't know..." Hermione said apologetically.
Luna's words also evoked the memories Ivan buried in his heart, and his face became gloomy.
Although Ivan had a perfect idea in his mind to rescue Aixia, the difficulty of improving the compound decoction far exceeded his expectations.
Ivan was even a little afraid that after returning to the past, he would find that all preparations were in vain...
"Harassment fly..." Luna said suddenly.
"What?" Ivan regained consciousness and looked at Luna strangely.
"I told you, harassing the horsefly!" Luna looked at Ivan with a pair of eyes, with a dazed expression, imitating the buzzing sound of the harassment horse.
"It's a creature that is invisible to the eyes. It will float into the ears and confuse people's brains and cause trouble... I think you have them around, but unfortunately, I can't see them."
Harassing horseflies? what is that?
Hermione was a little confused, she had never seen anything like that in a book.
But Ivan knows that harassing the horsefly is just a creature Luna contrived. Perhaps Luna thinks that people's troubles are all due to the harassment of the horsefly.
"Then do you know how to get rid of these harassing flies?" Ivan said helplessly.
Luna tilted her head for a moment, pondered for a while, and frowned slightly, as if she was really thinking about ways to drive off the harassing fly.
Ivan shook his head and was about to say that he was just joking.
At this moment, the blond little witch suddenly stood up and moved a few steps forward, embracing Ivan in his bewildered expression...
A faint scent of jasmine floated into his nose, and there was also a smell of airship plum.
Ivan was stunned. He didn't expect Luna to hug him suddenly.
Luna's hug was not warm, but it interrupted Ivan's thoughts and made him think of nothing.
Hermione opened her eyes in amazement to watch all this, and opened her mouth, but in the end she didn't say anything...
After a while, Luna let go of her hand and sat in the original position, everything returned to its original state.
"Is it better?" Luna asked aloud.
"This is how you get rid of the harassing fly?" Ivan didn't know what to say.
Luna nodded, her eyes erratic. "The day my mother died, my father comforted me like that... I hope it helps..."
"I'm not as fragile as you think." Ivan said dubiously.
"I know... I know..." Luna smiled softly, speaking in a singing tone. "I told him the same thing that day, but I don't think this method is bad, is it?"
"Yeah, it works..." Ivan looked at Luna for a while.
Luna's actions always exceeded his expectations, and he would never understand what the little witch would do next.
It's like a mystery...
Remembering that Luna seemed to be able to understand owls and decipher the snake language before, Ivan became even more confused and couldn't help asking.
"Can you tell me how do you know that I am in a bad mood? And you can understand owls? Is it because of dementia?"
"I don't know such a high level of magic, I can just feel the emotions, and then guess what you are thinking..." Luna shook her head, and the airship Li hanging on her ears swayed with her movements. "It's a very special feeling, but it won't work if there are too many people..."
Feel the emotions? Ivan really didn't know that Luna still had such an ability, and there was no mention of it in the original time and space.
Ivan couldn't help wondering if this peculiar ability might have something to do with blood. After all, Luna and his father are a bit... peculiar?
Ivan didn't dare to continue thinking, he was a little worried that Luna would perceive it, so he glanced at Luna subconsciously, and the little witch just smiled at him. UU reading www.uukANAnshu.com
Ye Qi drove the carriage, calm again in the carriage, Ivan did not speak any more, Hermione also sat quietly on the side, not knowing what she was thinking...
Looking at the newspaper, Luna hummed her own tune, and the sound of wheels rolling across the road seemed to have become a soundtrack.
After passing a long uphill lane, the carriage finally stopped on one side. Not far away was Hogwarts’s, and we could still vaguely see dark and terrifying black shadows on the castle. Over...
That's the dementor who guards.
Ivan got off the carriage. There were hundreds of carriages parked here. Many little wizards were getting off the carriage, walking towards the gate of the castle in groups of three or five.
On the side steps, Ron was beckoning to them, and Harry was also there, apparently unconscious all the way, awake.
"Aren't they waiting for you? I won't bother you." Luna said, before waiting for Ivan's reply, she turned and joined Ravenclaw's queue and followed the flow of people into the tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 288: You can always bring me different kinds of surprises
chapters.content:
"Has she always been like this?" Hermione couldn't help but said as she looked at Luna's distant back.
"Yeah, she's a little weird, she has always been." Ivan nodded.
Hermione pursed her lips. Compared to Luna's case, she actually wanted to ask Ivan what happened during the summer vacation. Did someone close to him pass away?
But Hermione was also a little worried and asked if it would remind Ivan of some sad things.
Just as Hermione hesitated, Harry and Ron saw that they hadn't moved, so they walked over.
"Harry, are you okay?" Ivan looked at Harry and asked aloud.
Harry, who had recently awakened, was still a little pale, and he complained. "It feels terrible..."
Just now Professor Lupin took him to the school hospital specially, and Mrs. Pomfrey also made a fuss and had to give him a full-body examination, as if the dementor just leaned on him a little bit, and he contracted some serious illness.
"I guess there must be someone on the train that had the same experience as mine, right?" Harry said with a smirk, and said with a guilty conscience after seeing everyone being silent. "Isn't there even one person?"
"Come on, Harry, everyone knows you were attacked by a dementor, that's no big deal." Ron patted his shoulder and comforted.
But I was obviously not attacked...
Harry thought a little depressed, not understanding why he was the only one who passed out.
He remembered very clearly that the Dementor never touched him.
Harry didn't want to admit that he was too timid, but there seemed to be no other explanation.
Ivan saw Harry's thoughts and said aloud. "The dementor creature affects everyone differently. The more painful the past experience, the greater the impact."
"But there is a way to keep me unaffected, isn't it? I heard Ron say that you used a kind of magic to drive away dozens of dementors!" Harry said a little excitedly, and he was really hard to accept himself. Will be frightened by the dementor and pass out.
"That is the patron saint curse, remember? We saw a blue and white phoenix in the auditorium when we were in the first grade. That was Dumbledore's patron saint!" Ivan explained.
"Of course I remember, and you defeated Kino with that magic!" Harry quickly remembered.
"Can you teach me? Ivan?" Harry asked nervously, he was a little worried that Ivan would teach himself, after all, that should be very powerful magic.
"Sorry, Harry, I may not have much time lately." Ivan groaned. He felt that he had to take more than ten courses at the same time to accumulate grade points, and he needed to complete the potion improvement as soon as possible. He should not spare time. Come teach Harry.
Harry was a little disappointed, but Ivan quickly told him that he could learn from Lupin.
Although Hushen Guarding is a high-level spell, it is not very difficult to learn, as long as you spend time and use it, you can master it.
Talking all the way and walking into the auditorium, Ivan found that they were a bit late. The long table of the four major colleges was already full of people. The sorting hat just stopped its newly compiled ballad. Professor McGonagall holding the sorting hat Standing on the stage.
Several people didn't dare to neglect them, and while Professor McGonagall didn't notice them, they hurriedly found a seat and sat down.
"You are really amazing today, Ivan!" George leaned forward as soon as Ivan sat down and said excitedly.
Fred also echoed.
"Yeah, we all saw you driving away those pesky dementors on the train. I bet many adult wizards can't do this. By the way, what is your patron saint? A white horse? It's so beautiful, but unfortunately we didn't see it clearly."
"Hmm.. Almost." Ivan said vaguely. If he could, he didn't want to be known about the particularity of his patron saint.
In addition to George and Fred, the little lions on Gryffindor’s long table also cast their gazes. Ivan’s fame is so great, coupled with his recent popularity, so many people are Talking privately about the scene that happened on the train.
Their voices grew louder and louder, until Professor McGonagall, who was in the process of sorting, turned his head and stared at them, and the little wizards stopped.
The sorting ceremony ended soon.
As the last freshman walked down the steps, there was enthusiastic applause in the auditorium, and they couldn't wait to have dinner.
Only then, Dumbledore stood up and walked to the front of the stage. He looked around every student in the auditorium and gave a welcome speech.
Immediately before the little wizards in the audience complained, Dumbledore cleared his throat and continued.
"I have a very important thing to remind you before you enjoy a delicious meal and become confused."
"Our school is currently ushering in some dementors from Azkaban. They were sent by the Ministry of Magic to perform official duties. You must have known this because they searched the Hogwarts Express train... ."
Having said that, Dumbledore turned his gaze to Ivan. He had already heard of what happened on the train.
As he thought before, every time I meet Ivan always brings him different surprises...or trouble?
Ivan was also looking at Dumbledore, remembering that Sirius had told him that his father was once a member of the Order of the Phoenix, and from the default attitude of Sirius when he inquired, his father’s death was very serious. It may be related to the old professor.
Ivan felt like he was in a cloud of mist,
What role did Dumbledore play in it? Why does Aisia hate Dumbledore so much?
If you really hate him, what will Aysia send him to Hogwarts for?
Countless questions shrouded Ivan’s heart,
The two looked at each other in mid-air, and Dumbledore nodded slightly, but Ivan turned on Occlumency for the first time and moved his gaze away.
Even if Ivan didn't feel any signs of brain invasion, he was used to it a long time ago.
Dumbledore's eyes didn't stay on Ivan for too long and soon returned. His expression became serious, and his tone made anyone who heard it remember.
"These dementors will be at every entrance of the school, and I have to remind you. No one is allowed to leave the school without authorization while they are there. Any tricks, tricks, and disguise can't fool the dementors—even Including the invisibility cloak!"
"In particular, remember not to have any kind of conflict with dementors! They are very dangerous, and there are a lot of them that can't be dealt with by a little wizard who has learned to call God to protect!"
Dumbledore looked around at the crowd, saw that they were sitting awkwardly, hearing the words just now in his heart, and nodded in satisfaction.
He deliberately didn't mention Ivan's feat on the train, nor did he give Ivan any extra points for his "brave save" attack on the dementor. I just don't want anyone to think that it is something to be encouraged and imitate it.
Although the things Ivan did before were dangerous, they were all special cases. Those little wizards couldn't find their targets if they wanted to imitate them.
This time is different, there are really many dementors in the school...

chapters.title: Chapter 289: Elective
chapters.content:
There was silence in the auditorium, and many little wizards were frightened by Dumbledore's serious expression. This expression was only shown by the white beard principal when things were urgent.
Perhaps noticing that his tone was a little heavy, Dumbledore's brows stretched out, he smiled faintly, and continued to speak.
"Well, that's what I should remind you of. Let's change the topic a little more pleasantly. Two new professors will join our lineup this academic year!"
"First of all, it is Professor Lupin. He readily agreed to fill the vacancy in the Defence Against the Dark Arts class." Dumbledore stepped aside, motioned everyone to look at the teacher's bench, and took the lead in applauding.
Lupin nodded to the crowd. He actually wanted to say that he was not as happy as Dumbledore said he was in this "dangerous" position.
There was a wave of sparse applause in the auditorium, and the little wizards in the audience looked at Lupin with scrutiny.
After all, Lu Ping's shabby dress was in sharp contrast with the other well-dressed professors, and it was hard to believe that he was a capable person.
Dumbledore waited for the little wizards to accept the last news before continuing.
"As for our second new professor is Rubeus Hagrid!"
Hagrid stood up with a brush, and his huge body moved the long table in front of him several centimeters.
Noting that everyone turned their gazes, Hagrid's cheeks were flushed, and a pair of rough hands were pressed on the table, and then lifted up again, always feeling that it was a little inappropriate to put it anywhere.
Dumbledore added immediately.
"Because your original teacher of the magical animal protection class, Professor Keitelburn retired at the end of last semester, so I hired Rubeus Hagrid to replace this position. He agreed to accept the responsibility of the hunting field This teaching position!"
Many little wizards looked at Hagrid on the teacher's bench in surprise, always feeling a little unbelievable. Even Harry and Ron were surprised, but this did not prevent them from expressing their excitement with warm applause.
Ivan was also applauding. He knew very well that the attack on the secret room last semester had cleared Hagrid of suspicion, and Hagrid had this opportunity to become a professor.
It’s a coincidence that Professor Keitelburn retired at the end of the term, which made Ivan wonder if Dumbledore was operating in the dark.
After listening to Dumbledore's babbling words, it was finally time for dinner.
The white-bearded old principal waved his magic wand with a single tap. The next moment, a golden plate full of food was placed on the long table of the four colleges, and the empty goblet was filled with all kinds of drinks.
The little wizards who had been waiting for a long time feasted, talking in twos and threes about the two newly appointed professors and the purpose of the dementors coming to Hogwarts.
When the dinner was over, the prefects led the freshmen to their respective lounges. The little wizards of the third grade stayed, and Professor McGonagall took a list and distributed it to everyone.
After Ivan took it, he found that it was a third grade class schedule.
In addition to the main courses of the previous school year, there are also several courses that you can freely choose to study, such as divination, ancient runes, Muggle studies, etc.
Before Professor McGonagall leaves, let everyone think about it tonight. They only have one night to make a decision, because she will collect all the class schedules tomorrow morning!
"It looks like we are going to be busy again this school year." Ron stared at the timetable and couldn't help complaining.
For Ron, whose grades are not high enough, adding a few more courses means that he will suffer more tortures at the end of the semester.
Harry also deeply agreed, and then the two of them figured out which courses would be relatively easy.
First of all, Hagrid's magical animal protection class is definitely to be taken, and because of their relationship with Hagrid, it is impossible to ask if this class gets a high score.
The remaining courses are more difficult to choose. Harry prefers to take Muggle Studies courses because he grew up in the Muggle world, and Ron wants to choose a divination course.
The two discussed for a while, and then turned their heads to ask Ivan's opinion, but to their surprise, Ivan had already started to tick the class schedule.
"Ivan, did you choose so soon?" Ron asked in surprise.
"Choose? Isn't it all right? Professor McGonagall didn't say that you can't choose all of them." Ivan shook his head and said casually.
Harry and Ron glanced at Ivan's timetable and stopped talking.
Professor McGonagall only said that it is recommended that each person choose two to three courses. He did not say that they cannot choose all of them, but normally no one would do that, right?
The two immediately looked at Ivan with weird eyes, and felt that only Ivan in the whole year would do this.
Just as they were thinking like this, Hermione's voice rang behind them.
"Ivan is right! There is always no harm in taking one more class!"
Harry and Ron turned their heads and looked over. Hermione was holding the class schedule and ticking on it. It seemed that she was planning to choose all the courses just like Ivan.
The two were speechless, and they even thought with shame whether they should take a few more courses, but this idea only appeared in their minds for a while before they were thrown behind.
Campus life is so beautiful, how can we just think about learning in our hearts?
This is horrible!
"By the way, you have chosen so many classes, and there are always some conflicts in class time, right? What will you do then?" Harry asked strangely.
Hermione was stunned and realized this problem After pondering for a while, she was about to speak, and heard Ivan say.
"I think the professors will have a solution!"
"Yeah! Otherwise Professor McGonagall would have reminded us just now!" Hermione nodded and gave Ivan a quiet glance, somewhat happy that Ivan thought the same as herself.
Harry and Ron looked at the two with helplessness, then looked down at the class schedule. In the end, although they didn't check all of them like Ivan, they still chose three elective courses.
After finishing the difficult course selection, Ivan and the others, who had been exhausted along the way, returned to the dormitory with them. After hurriedly washing, they felt heavy when they touched the bed and never wanted to get up again.
Ivan was lying on the bed, thinking about the time converter that was about to arrive,
In the original time and space, it seems that Professor McGonagall took the initiative to apply for Hermione. I don’t know if Professor McGonagall will help her apply too.
If not, he can only ask Lupin to vouch for himself

chapters.title: Chapter 290: Do you still want it now?
chapters.content:
Two days later, in the early morning, Ivan had breakfast in the large exhibition hall early. What made him a little confused was that the first elective course was about to begin, but the time converter he was thinking about was not delivered to him. in.
At the end of breakfast, Gryffindor's prefect Percy suddenly walked over and told Ivan with a weird look that Dumbledore asked him to go to the principal's office.
Ivan frowned slightly. What did Dumbledore look for at this time? Ivan suddenly had a hunch, and getting the time converter might not be as easy as he thought.
With such thoughts in mind, Ivan got up and walked towards the principal's room, and after speaking the password Percy had told him, he entered the principal's room along the spiral staircase.
The principal’s room looks the same as before. The round room looks very spacious. There is a long table in the center with some letters scattered on it. Dumbledore is sitting on a chair, looking through it. One.
When the portraits hanging on the wall saw Ivan coming in, Qi Qi looked over, and looked at him curiously. Fox, who was dozing on a branch, also opened his eyes.
"Good morning, Professor Dumbledore!" Ivan said politely, and then asked tentatively. "Is there anything you are looking for me?"
Dumbledore's mind seemed to be placed in this letter, and when Ivan spoke, he realized that he had come in.
Dumbledore turned the letter upside down and covered it on the table, took a class schedule from the side, turned it over, and placed it in front of Ivan's eyes.
"Minerva already handed in your course schedule here last night. I was a little surprised. You seem to be planning to choose all courses? Can you tell me why you want to do this?"
"There is always no harm in taking one more course, isn't it? Besides, I think there must be a reason for Hogwarts to choose these courses!" Ivan said openly.
Dumbledore’s expression was a little helpless, "I’m very happy to see you so keen on learning, but I want to remind you that everyone’s time is limited, and the time of many courses conflicts with each other. I hope You can learn how to choose!"
"This is not something that cannot be solved, is it? Professor McGonagall didn't tell me that I couldn't choose all courses when he asked us to choose courses." Ivan interrupted Dumbledore's words and continued seriously.
"You can't stop a student's desire for knowledge!"
Dumbledore was not talking, his slender fingers came together slowly, and the blue eyes under the half-moon glasses looked at Ivan.
The latter did not back down. The time converter is something Ivan must get this school year. That is the core of all plans. He said it is impossible to give up.
Ivan also understood. Dumbledore didn’t seem to want this thing.
The two sides faced each other for a while, and Ivan had been working hard to maintain Occlumency.
But in the middle of the journey, Ivan did not feel the trace of the brain being invaded. I don’t know if Dumbledore’s level of dementia is too high, he can’t perceive it, or the other party didn’t use dementia.
Dumbledore was silent for a while before speaking at last. "Of course, no principal will stop a student's pursuit of knowledge."
Ivan slowly breathed a sigh of relief. He was very worried that Dumbledore would rebuff it so hard that he would not have a chance to get the time converter again.
Immediately afterwards, Ivan saw Dumbledore open the drawer and took out a long, thin gold chain. Below that chain, there was a gleaming timer.
Ivan's gaze was immediately attracted to him, he knew that was what he had been eager to get.
"What's that, Professor?" Ivan suppressed the excitement, and asked in a calm tone.
"Time converter, something that can make people go back, or witness the future!" Dumbledore said meaningfully.
"Very powerful, isn't it?" Dumbledore asked suddenly.
Ivan nodded, reversing time and space is an extremely powerful ability no matter where it is.
He can even think of hundreds of ways to use the time converter to make a profit, which is not disadvantageous in battle.
With proper calculations, countless selves can be placed at the same time node to create an Ivan Hals army!
Of course, for Ivan, the most important thing is that the time converter can return him to the time when nothing happened, and then reverse the result of the attack on Aisia!
Perhaps seeing some of Ivan's thoughts, Dumbledore reminded him. "But if you use it with the idea of ​​changing the past, you will get nothing!"
The hope that ignited in Ivan's heart was like being poured with cold water,
Dumbledore crossed his hands, fixed his blue eyes on Ivan, and continued.
"I hope you can understand that the ability of the time converter is also limited and extremely dangerous, otherwise the Ministry of Magic will not put it on the shelf!"
"Among the impressive stories I know, there are people who have tried to change the past."
"That person tried every means to get an extremely powerful time converter, and went back to a year ago trying to stop something that made him extremely sad. His wife died in a conflict!"
At this point, Dumbledore paused.
"What then?" Ivan frowned and asked.
"Then the man successfully returned to a year ago, waiting at the place where his wife died, waiting for a drunk who tried to follow his wife. The two had a fight, and the drunk was angry and used a wide range of blasting magic."
"His wife was just killed, right?" Ivan guessed the follow-up.
Dumbledore nodded, and informed Ivan that the person had returned to the original point in time afterwards and told some people about the matter.
He regretted it and told everyone that he would make enough preparations, and then use the time converter to go back a second time, go back to a long time ago, and kill the drunk in advance!
"He also failed the second time?" Ivan was very strange, as long as he had the first experience, logically speaking, there should be no more problems.
"He is missing!" Dumbledore's answer was beyond Ivan's expectation, and he said without stopping, with signs of extremely fast speech.
"But more than half a year later, someone found his body and a damaged time converter in a place. After some people's identification, that person had been dead for almost two years when he was found. No one knew that he had returned. What have you experienced in the past?"
"Some people speculate that he encountered someone killed while looking for the drunk. Others suspected that after his second failure, he kept using the time converter, but failed again and again, and eventually his mind collapsed. The time converter was destroyed and then committed suicide!"
After speaking, Dumbledore looked at Ivan expressionlessly, as if saying in those blue eyes.
Do you still want it now?

chapters.title: Chapter 291: Time Converter [Happy New Year everyone! 】
chapters.content:
Ivan fell silent, and the story Dumbledore told made him feel a trace of fear!
In other words, a year and a half ago, when the protagonist of that story was still alive, his corpse and the time converter were already there.
"Playing with time is extremely dangerous! Any sober wizard shouldn't have this idea in mind!" Seeing that Ivan seemed to understand a little bit, Dumbledore said again.
However, Ivan did not dispel the idea of ​​getting a time converter as Dumbledore expected. No matter how dangerous it is to use this thing, Ivan is willing to give it a try.
And he quickly found the loophole in Dumbledore's words, Ivan regained his confidence and retorted.
"But I think the time converter is not as bad as you said, isn't it? Otherwise the Ministry of Magic won't hand it over to a student!"
Ivan pointed to the time converter on the table. Since this thing appeared here, it meant that the Ministry of Magic approved it to be used by him.
"You are always smarter than I thought, Hals!" Dumbledore said with emotion and helplessness.
"Yes, it is controllable to a certain extent. If we can use it cautiously and understand some rules, this is why we applied for a time converter!"
"In order to get it, your dean, Professor McGonagall, wrote a letter to the Ministry of Magic, telling them that you are a model student and promised that you will never use it for anything other than learning..."
"Throughout the history of Hogwarts, there are not many such exceptions!" Dumbledore explained to Ivan.
Few people would make such a choice when taking elective subjects in the third grade. Not to mention that the applicant had to make the dean of the academy extremely relieved that only when these two points were met, the Ministry of Magic would issue a time converter.
Ivan nodded, keeping his eyes on the golden time converter, wondering how long Dumbledore would have to say before he would give it to himself.
"Professor, the divination class will start soon." Ivan tried to remind him.
"Don't worry, Hals, Miss Granger hasn't arrived yet." Dumbledore said slowly.
Click...
At this moment, the door of the principal's office was opened, and the little brunette witch walked in from outside.
Hermione took a curious look at Ivan, who was surprised that he was also here, then looked at Dumbledore and asked.
"Professor Dumbledore, Professor McGonagall said you are looking for me?"
"Yes, I came here because of course selection." Dumbledore nodded.
"I'm sorry, Professor! Did I choose too many courses? I have always wanted to learn a little more, if it bothers you..."
Hermione said apologetically, but Dumbledore interrupted Hermione's words.
"No, Miss Granger, I didn't mean that! No teacher would refuse a student's desire for knowledge!"
"We have a way to give you a little more time and be able to learn all the courses at the same time!" Dumbledore said with a smile.
Hermione is a little confused, can she make time more?
She has seen the course timetable issued. Today, there are three courses that are taught at the same time. Unless she will be separated, there are two courses that are not destined to be taken.
Hermione prepared herself to learn in private, or else these three courses would take turns.
Dumbledore didn't conceal it, and explained to Hermione the function of the time converter and the method used.
"Go back in time?" Hermione's eyes widened, her face full of surprise.
She didn't expect that something that looked like a timer could actually have the ability to reverse time and space.
"Professor, is this the only time converter?" Ivan couldn't help but interjected. He realized that Dumbledore seemed to have the intention of letting him use the same time converter as Hermione.
But there should be a lot of this stuff in the Ministry of Magic...
"Yes, the Ministry of Magic only approved this one. They think that too many time converters will increase the risk of losing control, but you can use it together." Dumbledore nodded and continued.
"In addition, I hope that you can supervise each other, and it is best not to look back too long each time, it is best to wait until necessary before using..."
Dumbledore talked about the limitations and taboos of time converters, such as not having too much contact with other people after returning to the past, especially not being seen by the past self.
Hermione worked hard to keep this in mind.
Yifan was a little disappointed. He hoped to have a time converter by himself, so that he could have more time to study the improvement of the compound decoction.
After Dumbledore explained the various taboos, he suddenly spoke. "This time converter will be kept by Miss Granger!"
Hermione didn't expect Dumbledore to let her take care of such an important thing, and she was at a loss for a while, after all, she could see that Ivan seemed to want this time converter very much.
"Professor Dumbledore, where should I put it in Ivan?" Hermione glanced at Ivan quietly, noticed that his face was not pretty, and proactively proposed.
"Miss Granger, let you keep it to ensure that the ability of the time converter will not be abused. I don't think you will refuse Mr. Hals's legitimate use request, will you?" Dumbledore shook his head.
Hermione hesitated for a while, then picked up the time converter on the table and hung it around her neck.
......
The two left the principal's room together and walked on the way to the divination classroom.
Ivan was silent. Dumbledore's attitude exceeded his expectations. Ivan even wondered if the other party had guessed something but it shouldn't be right!
Ivan frowned. He blocked the unidentified news of the attack on Esiah. One of the concerns was that once more people knew about this matter, it would inevitably affect his access to the time converter.
Because the Ministry of Magic will not allow anyone to try to go back in time and reverse time and space!
And few people pay attention to what happened in Knockoff Alley. Where did Dumbledore get the news? How much do you know?
Sirius is now a fugitive, it is impossible to contact Dumbledore actively.
unless...
Ivan suddenly remembered the letters in the principal's office. During the summer vacation, he had contacted a Dumbledore friend, Bohan, the dean of the St. Mungo Hospital for Magical Injuries...
Will it be him?
(Ps: Angels are here to wish you all a happy new year, all the best, and your wishes come true!)

chapters.title: Chapter 292: You cannot change the past, you are just completing a piece of history!
chapters.content:
Ivan thought all the way, walking through the corridors and stairs towards the top floor of the North Tower. When he was about to reach the top floor, Hermione's voice suddenly interrupted Ivan's thoughts.
"Ivan!"
"What's the matter?" Ivan turned his head strangely, and unexpectedly saw Hermione reach out and remove the time converter from her neck.
The golden chain shimmered in the sun, and she hesitated and passed it over.
Ivan reached out and took it, and said with some surprise. "Didn't Professor Dumbledore let you keep it? What are you doing for me?"
"But sometimes it can be worked around, right? I think the professor just doesn't want us to abuse its power." Hermione stuck out her tongue, then continued.
"So we can exchange it and let you keep it, and then I will be responsible for supervising you!"
Hermione could see clearly Ivan's reaction in the principal's room, and naturally knew that Ivan wanted this thing very much.
"But you have to assure me that you have to take me with you every time you use the time converter!" Hermione said seriously.
This time converter was handed over to them by Professor McGonagall's guarantee to the Ministry of Magic. Hermione didn't want to disappoint Professor McGonagall's trust in them.
More importantly, Dumbledore said that the abuse of the power of time can cause unpredictable risks.
Hermione didn't know how Ivan was going to use this time converter, but she felt that since she agreed to Professor Dumbledore to supervise Ivan, she must do it...
Ivan looked at the serious look of the little witch and shook his head secretly. Even if I use it secretly, can you still find out?
Thinking of this, Ivan opened the magic inventory of the system and checked it.
【Magic Items: Time Converter
Magic: powerful
Effect: Every time you turn the pointer, the time will go back by one hour, and the risk will increase by one minute...
Explanation: This is an exquisite magical product with a powerful ability that can affect time. You need to use it carefully.
Note: Time will not increase or decrease! You cannot change the past, you are just completing a piece of history! 】
Can't change the past, but can it complement history?
Ivan silently looked at the time converter in his hand, and it seemed that the power of time was far more miraculous or...horrible than he had imagined!
The other item in the remarks made Ivan a little incomprehensible for a while.
Why is it said that time will not increase or decrease?
If you use the time converter, you can add a few hours of learning time every day, and even one day can be used as two days.
Does the time here refer to the total length of time...lifespan?
Ivan suddenly realized this. What if a dying old man used the time converter to go back to the past?
I'm afraid that the old man will still get old and die soon after returning to the past, so the time converter is not so much about adding a person's time, it is more about moving the time in the future to the present.
Nevertheless, this magic item is still extremely powerful, because what he lacks now is time, even if he wants to overdraw the future for this.
After a period of contemplation, Ivan soon recovered.
Just when Ivan was lost in thought, Hermione was a little nervous. She thought that Ivan was hesitating the suggestion just now, and she didn't want to have another gesticulating supervisor.
Otherwise, when you use the time converter, you can tell yourself... Hermione quietly lowered her bottom line, but she soon felt that she was sorry for Professor Dumbledore's trust.
Thinking of this, the little witch's cheeks flushed red, and she immediately made up her mind to stick to her bottom line, her face puffed up, and the fierce one would argue with Ivan.
Fortunately, Ivan regained consciousness, noticed Hermione's entangled expression, and somewhat guessed what she was thinking. Before she spoke, he hung the gold chain of the time converter in her hand on Hermione's neck again.
Hermione's thoughts of all the rhetoric that she had originally thought were stuck in her mouth, and her whole person was stunned, as if she had been petrified. She looked at Ivan in surprise and stammered. "Aren't you going to want this time converter?"
"It's the same with you. You won't refuse me when I want to use it, don't you?" Ivan shook his head and asked.
Hermione looked down at the golden timer, held it tightly in her hands, smiled and nodded solemnly.
"Of course not, as long as you want to use it, you can do it anytime!"
This time Hermione stopped talking about proper use.
Trust is always mutual,
Hermione knew that Ivan wanted this thing very much, but now she gave up the opportunity to get the time converter and gave it back to herself. This is undoubtedly a great trust...
However, what Hermione didn't know was that Ivan was thinking about the scenes in the principal's room just now.
What do you mean? Albus Dumbledore?
If she is really ready to do something, Hermione can't stop it...
There is a big difference between his and Hermione's strengths, and Hermione trusts him very much. If necessary, Ivan can even make Hermione fall asleep without knowing it. Dumbledore's so-called mutual supervision is useless at all.
Ivan believes that Dumbledore knows this as well, but why the other party still wants to make such arrangements.
Or did the white wizard just wait to see what choice he would make?
Ivan couldn't guess the idea of ​​this Dumbledore, and because of this, he would give up this opportunity to obtain a time converter and instead gain Hermione's trust.
After all, his most important thing in the near future is to improve the potion. There is nothing to hide about this. He has ample reasons to persuade Hermione to use the time converter generously.
"Yeah! It's been so long, I wish we weren't late..." Hermione suddenly realized this and said anxiously.
"Don't we have a time converter?" Ivan shook his head What's to worry about.
"That thing is not used for these trivial things, we have to look back several times today!" Hermione said dissatisfiedly, and ran towards the fortune-telling classroom while pulling Ivan.
......
Ten minutes later, the panting two finally arrived at the platform in front of the fortune-telling classroom before the class. The place was already full of people, and it seemed that they were the latest to arrive.
The trap door to the classroom has been opened, and the little wizards are lining up and entering the classroom down the ladder.
"It looks like we came just right!" Ivan smiled.
Hermione glanced at him angrily, and if it hadn't been running all the way, she would have been late.
"Where did you go?" Ron said strangely as he watched the two people running hurriedly all the way.
"We accidentally got lost..." Hermione replied casually. Naturally, she wouldn't talk about the time converter, but they had promised not to tell anyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 293: Prophecy and Prophecy
chapters.content:
Ivan followed the silver ladder all the way to the divination classroom.
The space inside is very closed. At least twenty small round tables are placed. The big red curtains are tightly drawn to block the outside sunlight. Only a small amount of light diffuses in through the curtains and diffuses the entire classroom. It's glowing red.
There are many shelves on the round wall behind, on which are placed dirty quill pens, candle heads, and tattered playing cards and a lot of tea cups.
It looks like a venue for some kind of mysterious ritual...
A group of little wizards each found a place to sit down, and Ivan and others naturally sat together.
"Where is the professor? Hasn't he come yet?" Ron said in surprise.
"No, Trelawney has arrived..." Ivan shook his head and motioned for Ron to look behind the curtain cloth on the right.
A witch with a thin figure and thick round glasses was standing there, looking at them through a transparent gauze.
Ron was startled at once, and Sybil Trelawney's erratic, ambiguous voice rang in the classroom.
"welcome!"
"It's great to finally see you in the material world..." Trelawney walked out from behind the curtain.
She is not very tall. She is wearing a dark green silk robe, with countless chains hanging around her thin and long neck. Her pale blond hair is unkempt and looks messy, and she looks like a crazy mystery. Vigor.
As soon as she appeared, the little wizards who came to the class were calmed, and her words were far more shocking than her appearance.
In just a few minutes, Trelawney greeted Neville’s grandmother intimidatingly, warned Lavender that her most worried thing would happen on October 16th, and threatened to be present around Easter this year. Among the people, there will be one who will leave everyone forever.
The little wizards present were taken aback when they heard it, and they were so frightened. At the end of the hearing, they all cast their gazes at Harry.
They suspected that it was Harry in Trelawney's prophecy, because many people had read about Sirius in the newspaper.
And Neville tremblingly worried about whether his grandma would have anything...
There are also some little wizards who are dubious, thinking that Trelawney is talking nonsense.
Because many senior students secretly told them that Professor Trelawney likes to curse a student to death every year, but everyone is alive and kicking in the end.
Ivan looked at Trelawney with interest. He knew very well that Trelawney’s predictions had been verified in the original time and space, even the predictions made under normal conditions.
For example, this time, Trelawney's threatening prediction, except for the fact that Neville's grandma is unsure whether there was an accident, everything else was confirmed in the original time and space.
Lavender was most afraid of hearing the news that her rabbit had died, which was confirmed on October 16.
Around Easter, someone will leave everyone, this sentence may refer to Hermione.
Because she was really fed up with Trelawney's nonsense and there were too many courses to learn, she gave up the fortune-telling class and never came again. Naturally, there would be one less person in the fortune-telling class.
What makes Ivan a little curious is whether these predictions will be fulfilled now.
Because he could kill Lavender’s rabbit before October 16th if he wanted to, let her hear the most scared news in advance.
Or maybe cancel the divination class with Hermione around Easter, then two people will leave...
Afterwards, Ivan shook his head amusedly. He would not kill a little witch's pet in order to verify the truth of a prediction.
As for whether to cancel the divination class, it depends on whether he can keep the time converter next school year.
But Ivan soon thought that there is another way to interpret Trelawney's prophecy, which could also mean that Pettigrew-Peter will leave everyone.
Ivan glanced at the pocket of Ron's wizard robe, and the mouse stayed there, so it seemed that Trelawney's prediction was not so accurate!
Thinking of this, Ivan became more interested in divination. Immediately I opened the book "Pull the Fog and See the Future" in the divination class, and looked at it at random.
The contents of the various signs and predictions in the book are so eloquent that Ivan feels a little bit painful when he sees it.
From the direction of the clouds in the sky to the sight of a crow, a black dog, and even a strange-shaped stone, there are different indications.
If interpreting according to this, Ivan feels that he can find all kinds of interpretable things around him every day.
Professor Trelawney quickly asked everyone to take a teacup on the shelf, pair them in pairs, and interpret them according to the divination skills she taught.
With a hint of hope, Ivan experimented again. I made a cup of tea, then drank it all in one breath, and shook the cup three times.
Ivan checked his tea dregs along the mouth of the cup, and Hermione took the tea cup before she could see it clearly.
"Professor Trelawney made us look at each other!" Hermione gave Ivan a blank look, and then handed her cup to Ivan.
The latter shrugged and didn't care. Ivan didn't expect to see anything, so he began to observe Hermione's teacup.
The tea leaves at the bottom of the cup seem to be scattered and messy, and there is nothing special. Ivan then turned to "Pull the Mist and See the Future" to page five and checked it. It showed that this was a bad omen, but he didn't say anything more. specific.
"God! This is an unknown omen!"
Behind him, a voice rang.
Ivan, who focused on reading the book, was startled and turned to find that Sybil Trelawney had been standing behind him for some time. Trelawney was covering her mouth with a horrified expression, and she trembled slightly. Screamed. "You... a... killing! Blood... hell!"
All the little wizards looked at Ivan with a surprised expression.
Trelawney couldn't help but stepped back a few steps and accidentally bumped into the table behind. Neville's hand shook, and the tea cup in her hand fell to the ground and shattered...
Ivan was surprised, not sure if Trelawney was making a real prediction.
What does this sentence mean?
Will you make a killing? Blood on the ground.. Like hell?
Ivan did kill a lot of dark wizards when he thought of the summer vacation, and maybe even more kills afterwards... It would be possible to interpret it in this way.
"Ivan, I think Professor Trelawney is just talking nonsense. She actually thinks that she can see the future with a few shakes of the teacup, which is too strange." Hermione was far away from Professor Trelawney. After a few moments, he couldn't help but comforted.
"Who knows this prophecy?" Ivan shook his head and said half-jokingly.
"But the teacup you were holding before was obviously my teacup!" Hermione rolled her eyes and said, vomiting.

chapters.title: Chapter 294: Lookback time
chapters.content:
It seems so...
Ivan suddenly realized this, and suddenly looked at Hermione with a weird expression.
So what is the situation, if Professor Trelawney's prediction comes true, is it possible that Hermione will cause a killing?
Or what dangers will Hermione encounter this school year?
Ivan looked at Hermione with some worry.
Hermione gave Ivan a blank look, and she didn't believe Professor Trelawney's nonsense!
Even so, the little witch continued to search for "Pull the Fog and See the Future" in the next class, trying to find some evidence from it to refute Professor Trelawney's prediction...
[Ding, after a period of study, your proficiency in divination has improved...Current progress (3/100) level 0]
When get out of class was about to end, a system prompt sounded through Ivan's mind.
Divination?
Ivan was stunned, and was very pleasantly surprised. He took this divination class entirely for grade points, and he did not expect that he would actually gain the ability to divination in the class.
However, when Ivan opened the system column, he discovered that the divination he obtained was not a magic, but was classified in the column of theory of knowledge, and he didn't know how to use it.
Observe the shape of the tea dregs?
Ivan tried to observe his teacup, trying to see some omen from it. After watching it for a long time, he couldn't see anything...
Professor Trelawney sent unknown predictions to more little wizards during the entire divination class, especially when facing Harry, he made the prediction of death again...
Harry was still a little worried after class was over. Ron comforted him and told Harry to learn from Ivan and calm down.
Professor Trelawney's prediction of Ivan is more terrifying than his... words like killing and **** appeared...
Harry turned his head and looked at Ivan, only to find that Ivan and Hermione hadn't known where they were going.
"Weird, how about them? Ron, did you see it? We're about to take the Transfiguration class soon..." Harry asked strangely.
"How do I know?" Ron shook his head. "Let's go to the classroom first, but Professor McGonagall's class later, they can't help but come!"
......
On the other side, Ivan and Hermione had already hid in the unmanned top floor, ready to use the time converter, and went back to the Muggle study class two hours ago.
Hermione fumbled around the collar of her robe, and quickly pulled out a long, thin gold chain.
"Get closer! We have to wear this thing together! This chain may not be long enough..." Hermione looked at Ivan and said.
Ivan nodded and took a few steps forward.
Hermione pulled the golden chain and hung it around Ivan's neck. The two were so close that they could even hear each other's breathing.
"You are ready to use it!" Hermione handed the time converter to Ivan.
Ivan held it with his left hand, and started to flip the hourglass on the timer with his right hand...
One circle...Two circles...
As the hourglass began to turn, Ivan felt the surrounding scenes become blurred, everything seemed to be retreating rapidly, and he in the center seemed to be suspended in the air and isolated by the world, isolated.
Fortunately, Ivan can still feel the presence of Hermione, which makes him a little relieved...
After a while, Ivan noticed that the changes around him seemed to have stopped, and his feet felt like they were on the ground.
finished? Now is two hours ago?
Ivan looked left and right, and the rooftop on the top of the building was still the same as before, except that the angle of the shadow under the sunlight had changed a bit compared to before.
"Let's go, let's go out and have a look!" Ivan took off the gold chain from his neck and asked Hermione to put it away, then proposed.
Hermione nodded, and then the two left the roof together and walked towards the Muggle Studies classroom.
Both were sneaky along the way, consciously avoiding the crowd.
"It's better for us to be more natural. Generally speaking, we won't be discovered." Ivan shook his head, always feeling like a thief suddenly.
"But Professor Dumbledore asked us to avoid them as much as possible." Hermione said hesitantly.
"This is just to prevent them from discovering that there are two of us at the same time, thus causing some unnecessary trouble." Ivan guessed.
Since I was going to class, I was destined to be seen by students and professors in the same classroom.
Hiding in this way is more likely to arouse others' suspicion...
Hermione quickly thought of this and adjusted her mindset. But as she walked through the tower, Hermione suddenly reached out and pulled Ivan's sleeve, and pointed to the stairs below.
Ivan looked down strangely, and suddenly saw another Hermione and herself walking up the ladder. After thinking about it, Ivan realized that at this point in time, she just came out of the principal’s office and was about to go to the divination classroom. .
"It feels so strange, seeing the other self with my own eyes..." Ivan felt awkward. He wondered if two systems were running at the same time, and how would he determine if he had completed a system task now.
"Ivan, let's think about how to avoid it!" Hermione said eagerly. The first taboo of using the time converter is to be seen by herself.
