Although Dumbledore didn't tell her what would happen if she saw it, there was definitely nothing good...
"Don't worry, can you just use the phantom spell?" Ivan drew out his wand and tapped his chest. The magic immediately enveloped his body, and the whole person quickly disappeared from Hermione's sight.
Immediately afterwards, Ivan blessed Hermione with the phantom spell, and then pulled her to walk as close to the wall as possible.
"Be careful hold your breath!" Ivan reminded.
Although it has the invisibility effect of the phantom curse, it is only a magic after all. It does not have the ability to isolate like the deathly hallows-the invisibility cloak. The action is larger, and it may be perceived by the past self.
Hermione covered her mouth and followed Ivan carefully, not daring to make a sound.
Ivan walked over slowly, and the two of them had lightened their steps as much as possible, but they would still make a slight noise when they stepped on the stairs.
Ivan's brows frowned slightly. This was not enough. He was extremely sure that he hadn't heard anything wrong when he was going upstairs.
If it were to pass this way, the self two hours ago would definitely have noticed something wrong.
The two sides got closer and closer, Ivan hesitated whether he should stop and wait for the other party to pass, and some wanted to test whether the past really cannot be changed...
What would happen if I just walked past it? This idea suddenly emerged in Ivan's heart...

chapters.title: Chapter 295: Muggles and the strengths of the magic world
chapters.content:
Ivan's footsteps kept going, and the distance between the two sides was getting closer...
At this moment, the two people on the opposite side suddenly stopped, and Ivan stared at the past Hermione and called the past self, and then took off the time converter hanging from his neck.
Witnessing everything that happened two hours ago from the onlooker's perspective, this intertwined feeling of time and space made Ivan feel the magical power of time.
The two went smoothly and were not found...
Was it because I was distracted at that time, so I didn't notice it?
Ivan thought in his heart, so it seems that everything he is doing now is still in the closed loop of time.
What if I showed up now? This will never be the same as in the past, right?
A thought came into Ivan's mind, and then he shook his head.
Forget it, don't do these dangerous temptations...
......
Everything went smoothly on the next journey, without any accidents, the two came to the classroom of Muggle Studies together.
There was still a while before the class, and it was already full of people. Ivan was a little surprised that so many people were so interested in studying Muggle courses.
Ivan glanced curiously. Judging from the costumes, most of the little wizards who chose to take this course were students from Hufflepuff, and students from Slytherin were the least.
It seems that, with the exception of a few pure-blooded wizards who are curious about Muggles, most of the people taking this course are from Muggle families, or are mixed...
But this is normal. The entire magical world still discriminates against ordinary people.
Especially those pure-blood wizards, usually when talking about Muggles, they are used to putting some contemptuous words on their lips, so as to show the nobility of their blood!
Before long, the door of the classroom was opened from the outside, and Professor Keridi Bubagi, who was wearing a light-colored wizard robe, walked in. She looked around the crowd and said in a gentle tone.
"Welcome everyone to my Muggle Studies class!"
"I will not teach you all kinds of magical magic here, but I can expand your horizons and let you understand the vastness of the outside world, instead of confining your vision to a small magical world..."
Having said that, Professor Keridi Bubbaji's words suddenly became very serious, and she continued to speak.
"In addition, I always think that wizards and Muggles are equal... they are not different from us."
"Professor!" Just after Professor Keridi Bubbaji finished speaking, a Slytherin witch suddenly raised her hand and said aloud. "But I heard that Muggles are very stupid, they can't learn even the simplest magic!"
"It's just that they don't have the talent for magic. It doesn't mean that they are stupid. On the contrary, Muggles can't do magic, but they can't do many magics by virtue of their ingenuity." Keridi Bubage The professor emphasized.
"That's why we need to offer this course!"
"In the magical world, there has been almost no qualitative change in hundreds of years, but the outside is different. It is not an exaggeration to describe it as turned upside down... If we continue to stand still, one day we will be completely surpassed by Muggles! "
Professor Keridi Bubaji talked freely, telling everyone about the great achievements of Muggles in recent years, as well as the changes in their travel and lifestyle.
Many little wizards in the audience showed disapproval expressions, and Keridi Bubbaji did not expect them to immediately understand, so they opened the textbook and started the first lesson.
Ivan looked through the textbook in his hand, and then recalled what Professor Bubbaji had just said. It seemed that the magical world did not have any research on the development of Muggle technology.
The knight bus, Hagrid’s flying motorcycle, and the Weasley’s magic car are all products of the combination of Muggle technology and magic.
However, this kind of understanding and research is likely to be limited to transforming some scientific and technological items to facilitate oneself, and does not involve the fundamentals. This can be seen from the education system at Hogwarts that has not changed for a century.
Hogwarts, as one of the three major magic schools in Europe, has offered only one Muggle studies course for so many years.
Still elective!
It is not mandatory for all little wizards to learn, which shows that the magic world pays far more attention to the Muggle world...
Ivan was very clear that with the further development of science and technology outside, the power balance between the magical world and the Muggle world was tilting towards the latter.
Once the information age is fully entered, the existence of the magic world cannot be concealed forever.
Compared with Muggles, wizards have the advantage that they can use all kinds of magical supernatural magic!
Especially the magic spells or potions that can cause major damage to the Muggle world as long as they are used in place, such as Imperius Curse, Compound Decoction, Copy Curse, Phantom Transformation, and Elixir...
For example, copying a huge amount of gold that Muggles cannot distinguish, and other important substances to disrupt and impact the Muggle financial market.
For example, the temptation of immortality is enough to turn a large number of greedy Muggles. The camouflage of the compound decoction and the Apparition can be enough to enter and leave any place at will. With the Imperius Curse, you can completely control the Muggles who hold important positions...
It is true that the destructive power of wizards is far inferior to the technological weapons that can be mass-produced by Muggles, but no matter how powerful the technology is, it is only ordinary people who give orders. Only idiots will fight and kill face-to-face, using their own advantages to increase the strength of the opponent Use is the right way.
More importantly, wizards can master the knowledge of Muggles through learning. In turn, Muggles want to rely on the power of technology to crack the magic but don’t know how long it will take...
Of course, the disadvantages of wizards are also extremely obvious. They are scarce in number, fight each other, and conservative in their thinking.
The latter is the most critical. Many wizards still have ideas in the last century They don’t want to know if there is something new in the Muggle world, so they live in their own small circle to fight for power, which makes The magic world further lost the initiative.
Coupled with the fact that half-blood wizards and wizards from Muggle families occupy the majority, this makes some people want to do things, and when wizards and Muggle wars are triggered, wizards will fight first without even Muggle provocation.
The last changemaker was so finished...
"This magic world is about to end..." Ivan sighed, he suddenly found that the magic world could only watch the rapid development of Muggles, but he stepped in place and couldn't help but sigh with emotion.
Is this the meaning of that sentence?
With a thought, Ivan opened the taskbar of the system and looked at the task activated last school year—becoming a legion of house elves. The note below was impressively written.
[A new era is coming, the magic world is about to change! ——Ivan Hals. 】
The words in the remarks had left him confused before, but now Ivan understands a bit.

chapters.title: Chapter 296: 2 things to fear
chapters.content:
Forget it, what does this have to do with a third-year student like him?
Ivan thought for a long time and finally shook his head. The solution was not without, but that was something that Dumbledore and Minister of Magic Fudge should consider.
Moreover, the Ministry of Magic and the Muggle Prime Minister are closely connected, which shows that things are far more complicated than he thought...
Ivan quickly put this system task behind him. He didn't plan to touch this kind of deadly task...
"Ivan, what did you just say?" Hermione asked strangely. Isn't the Ministry of Magic good? Why is it all over suddenly?
"No...you must have heard it wrong just now, I didn't say anything." Ivan returned to his senses, looked at Hermione, and shook his head.
Hermione glanced at Ivan with a weird look, but didn't care.
A Muggle studies class was quickly spent in the lecture by Professor Keridi Bubbaji.
In order to get more grade points, Ivan naturally used the spirit of answering the questions in the first two academic years. As long as Professor Bubagi asked questions in class, Ivan would stand up and answer as soon as possible.
Professor Bubbaji was also extremely satisfied with Ivan. It was the first time she saw a little wizard who had such a deep understanding of the conflict between the magical world and the Muggle world, and she did not hesitate to give Ivan a lesson. Added more than 30 points.
After class, Ivan left the Muggle Studies classroom very contentedly.
It would be great if every class could be like this. In that case, Ivan believed that he could earn more than two hundred grade points in one day.
Hermione looked at him depressed, as long as Ivan was in the classroom, there was no room for other people to express themselves.
Just as Hermione was about to say something, she heard a voice behind her.
"This is the most boring class I have ever taken! Why do we need to understand the cars and airplanes made by Muggles? Obviously we can get anywhere we want to go with just a wave of our magic wand!"
Ivan and Hermione turned their heads and found that they were talking about a girl in a Slytherin robe. She looked very arrogant, and the little wizards beside her nodded while listening to her words.
Hermione listened for a while and couldn't help asking. "Since you are not interested in Muggle Studies, what do you choose to do with this course?"
The haughty Slytherin girl looked at Hermione in surprise, and then said disdainfully. "I took this course to understand why Muggles are so stupid that they can't even learn magic!"
These words immediately aroused the laughter of some little wizards.
In the corridor, many students from Muggle families glared at them...
"If it weren't for the Muggle Protection Law, we only need a little magic to turn Muggles around." The Slytherin girl didn't mean to stop. She didn't think about the theory of Professor Bubage. Don't catch a cold, this is just crazy talk in the magic world...
"Also, what do you do to protect Muggles? Or are you actually a mudblood? I think Hogwarts should be more rigorous when recruiting students. It's best to recruit only us talented pure-blood wizards. "The Slytherin girl sneered.
Ivan frowned, but Hermione scolded first.
"enough!"
"It is true that my parents are Muggles, but most of my courses were outstanding when I took the exam in the school year. How about you? Did you do it?"
"And as far as I know, many famous wizards are of mixed blood or Muggle family origin. Blood does not determine a person's talents! Pure blood is not smarter than Muggles!"
Hermione said sharply, the proud Slytherin girl hesitated and didn't know what to say, and finally said angrily.
"So what? My father is the director of the Department of Magical Transportation, and I will be better than you, a mudblood in the future!"
"Then you continue to rely on your father..." Hermione snorted softly.
The Slytherin girl was so angry that she gritted her teeth and pulled out her wand to cast a spell.
But Hermione moved faster, pointing her wand at the opponent first.
A brilliant red light flew from the top of the magic wand and hit the girl in Slytherin. The girl let out a piercing scream, was knocked and fell to the ground, and the wand in her hand also came out with her. ..
"Let's go!" Hermione reached out and took the wand that was flying in the air, threw it in front of the opponent, and then took Ivan and left.
Hermione grabbed Ivan's wrist and walked aimlessly all the way, before she was relieved, and then she began to regret again, and said in annoyance.
"Professor Dumbledore clearly told me not to have too much contact with others when using the time converter. I would have known it a long time ago and would not do it to her. Now, many people will surely guess that we are there at the same time. Places!"
They are going to take three classes at the same time this morning, and there will always be little wizards who will discover this.
"Don't worry about this rule, we have to go to classes like this for the entire school year, unless everyone is stupid, or someone will guess something."
Ivan always felt that the taboos Dumbledore said were not reliable at all, and they were probably used to fool them so that they would not abuse the power of the time converter.
There are only two things that make Ivan a little afraid.
The first is to deliberately change the past, such as appearing in front of yourself in the past.
The second is that the time for a single backtracking is too long.
Ivan has not forgotten that the magic item bar of the system clearly states that every time the time converter rotates one turn the time goes back by one hour, and the risk increases by one point...
What exactly does this risk refer to?
Ivan felt that he had better find an opportunity to confirm, but he expected to go back dozens of days ago. If something unexpected happened during such a long retrospective time, it would undoubtedly affect his plan.
Thinking of this, Ivan's face was filled with haze, but soon Ivan's face returned to normal, and he didn't want Hermione to see anything.
"By the way, Hermione, your magic is more powerful than I thought!" Ivan turned to jokingly asked. From his eyes, it was natural to see that the level of the disarming spell Hermione just released was not low, it was almost close to three. Grade...that is, the average level of graduates.
This is much better than her in the original time and space...
"You are nothing compared to Ivan..." Hermione shook her head, watching Ivan's inexplicable frustration.
She has worked hard to practice various spells in the past few school years, but every time she can feel that the gap between herself and Ivan seems to be getting bigger and bigger.

chapters.title: Chapter 297: Potion improvement
chapters.content:
You are different from me...
Ivan secretly said in his heart that the reason why he can achieve his current achievements is that on the one hand, he can use the thinking acceleration mode of the experience card to assist learning, and on the other hand, it is two dangerous blood fusion rituals.
But Hermione achieved this completely by her own talent and hard work, which is why Ivan was amazed, no wonder the little witch in the original time and space was finally able to assume the post of Minister of Magic.
Hermione didn't know this, and walking on the way to the arithmetic divination class, remembering that the Slytherin girl had thought of Malfoy just now, she couldn't help but asked curiously.
"Ivan, are those pure-blood wizards so arrogant and annoying?"
"If you say this, Ron would be unhappy... Weasley's family is also pure blood!" Ivan shook his head funny.
"Sorry, I don't know..." Hermione stuck out her tongue and said with some embarrassment. She had met the Weasleys.
Ron's parents are very kind people, not only do not have the slightest prejudice against her, they have invited her to visit the Burrow when they are free.
Compared to the arrogant Malfoy father and son, their family is a world apart.
"By the way, Ivan, are you also a pureblood wizard?" Hermione suddenly thought of this and said.
"How do I know? Shouldn't it?" Ivan hesitated for a moment. He still doesn't know about his parents' family, and Aysia has never told him.
However, in the magical world, only the Holy Twenty-Eight Clan is widely recognized as pure blood, and there is no Hals family there.
"And strictly speaking, there is probably no complete pure-blood family in the magic world now." Ivan couldn't help but smile after thinking of something.
Hermione was a little surprised, why did you say that?
"According to some secret records, many pure-blood families have intermarried with wizards born in Muggle families. Otherwise, the number of pure-blood families is so small that they would not deal with each other. If they just marry each other, they would be dead."
Ivan explained that the disadvantages of intermarriage between close relatives are known to all modern people, but among the offspring of a pure-blood family, there are few mental disorders except for a few. This shows that the pure-blood family should not be so disciplined.
Of course, even so, in order to maintain the reputation of pure blood, intermarriage between major families is still very frequent. For example, Malfoy's mother is a member of the Black family.
"The next time I see Malfoy, I'll use this to refute him." Hermione said with a smile.
"I don't think Malfoy would believe anything..." Ivan shrugged, and then was a little sad, because such a conservative pure-blood wizard holds the power, so the magical world will remain unchanged for hundreds of years.
The two of them just talked and laughed and walked into the arithmetic divination classroom.
Setima Victor, a professor of arithmetic and divination, is a very strict person, very different from the mysterious Trelawney.
Even Setima Victor is extremely disdainful of Trelawney, who also teaches divination.
As soon as the class started, she said straightforwardly that only by relying on rigorous and thorough reasoning and calculations can we glimpse the future!
Most of the students who came to the class were Ravenclaw students. Hermione was also very enthusiastic in class. When the get out of class was over, the little witch couldn’t help sighing that Professor Victor wanted to be more reliable than Ravenclaw. This is what The divination she wants to learn...
Ivan gained a grade point again, and the two continued to rush to the next classroom.
In one day, the two spent more than ten hours in nine courses.
In the evening, Ivan again used the time converter to go back five hours to test the potion improvement.
These days, although Ivan had the potion research notes left by Snape, the research on potion improvement was not progressing smoothly. He needed more time and related books.
Fortunately, the time problem can be solved by the time converter, and related books can be found in the ** area.
As a result, Ivan took some time to persuade Lupin to sign him a loan note in the name of developing a potion.
Lu Ping had been hiding from Ivan these days because of some rumors he had heard before. Now seeing Ivan come to look for him, he was almost taken aback, thinking that his identity had been exposed.
Fortunately, Ivan quickly explained his intentions, and Lupin had almost no hesitation, and readily agreed.
After all, he knew that Ivan was the developer of the wolf poison potion, and it was normal to want to borrow a few advanced potions books. He also hoped that one day Ivan would be able to research a way to completely cure the werewolves.
Ivan, who walked out of the Defence Against the Dark Arts office, vaguely felt that Lupin seemed a little afraid of himself, but couldn't understand what was going on.
Is he so scary?
Ivan remembers that he is still very handsome, especially after fusing the blood of the unicorn...
Ivan, who couldn’t understand, took the slip given by Lupin and lent the books of "Advanced Potions Materials", "Advanced Potions Making", and "Potion Improvements" from the ** area. .
Finally, I found a secluded classroom and began to study the feasible plan for potion improvement.
As for why not in the library?
Of course, because the library is a place where he often goes to check materials, Ivan feels that he shouldn't stay there all the time and cause trouble for his future self.
The only thing that made Ivan a little helpless was that although Hermione did not prevent him from using the time converter for additional research work, but went back five hours with him.
"Hermione, you have been in class for almost 20 hours today, and you should go back to the dormitory to take a good rest." Ivan looked at Hermione, who was obviously tired, and said helplessly.
Hermione shook her head firmly. She felt that Ivan didn't need to rest, and she was still working **** the knowledge of potions, so she would need to work harder.
"And I have read a lot of books, knowing how to make most potions, it will definitely help!" said the little witch confidently.
After speaking, Hermione looked at Ivan with some anxiety. Of course, she could feel how much Ivan attached to this potion improvement, so Hermione also hoped that she could help Ivan.
Ivan thought for a while, and didn't refuse anymore. It would be good to have one more person to help study the improvement of the potion.
Hermione was very happy, but when she really joined the potion research work, the little witch discovered that Ivan's research topics were far beyond her imagination.
In addition, she had never been in contact with the potion improvement before, which resulted in Ivan's research materials that she could not understand at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 298: What did you guys do? How could it be like this...
chapters.content:
Hermione's white cheeks flushed with embarrassment. She didn't expect that she wouldn't be able to help even a little help...
When communicating with Ivan about the improvement plan, Hermione was even more faltering, and the blush spread from her cheeks to the base of her ears.
Ivan also slowly realized this, and when he thought about it, he didn't feel surprised.
During the summer vacation, he had finished reading the Black family's collection of books and had Snape's research notes. Hermione could not even keep up with his progress.
Ivan thought for a moment, then snapped his fingers suddenly.
"Sir, do you have any instructions?" An ugly house elf suddenly appeared in front of the two.
"Dobby, get the book I asked you to buy before!" Ivan said.
"Yes, sir!" Dobby nodded.
Then, in Hermione's puzzled eyes, Dobby cast an Apparition and disappeared in front of the two of them. When he came back, he already had more than a dozen potions books in his hand.
Ivan is very satisfied with Dobby, who is on call, no wonder many wizard families like to raise a house elf.
But Ivan didn't dare to let Dobby stay for too long. After reading the book, Ivan indicated that Dobby could leave.
Because there may be other time periods when I want to summon it...
"If you want to help, just read these books first..." Ivan took out Snape's "Advanced Potions" and handed it to Hermione.
The research notes left by Snape had long been ripped up by him, and for the current Ivan, it was no longer useful.
But Ivan felt that this book should be of great help to Hermione.
Hermione looked at these books, gently held the time converter on her chest, and nodded seriously.
After Ivan arranged a learning task for the little witch, he plunged into the research of the potion.
Now he didn't expect Hermione to be able to help him, he just found something for her, don't disturb his research.
But Hermione didn't give up on herself. She quietly sat aside with these books and read them, holding a stack of parchment, taking notes seriously, and soon filled with pages of reading notes.
This kind of life lasted for three days, and Ivan was stunned to find that Hermione had read all the books, and while he was studying the potion improvement plan, he was able to make some useful suggestions.
It's like changing someone...
Did you hang up too?
Ivan was confused, but soon noticed the tired look on Hermione's face.
Almost instantly, Ivan thought of the time converter, only feeling cold sweat from behind, and asked seriously.
"How long have you looked back these days?"
"Ask what does this do?" Hermione said with a guilty conscience while holding the book. "Roughly ninety hours in total, right?"
"Are you sure there is only this point?" Ivan frowned. To master the contents of so many potions books, 90 hours is far from enough.
Hermione nodded, but she didn't tell Ivan that the ninety hours did not include the time the two went back together.
"Although the power of the time converter is powerful, it is also dangerous. It is a force we don't understand at all. If it is used frequently in a short period of time, it may cause some harm to the body. And Dumbledore should tell you Too long after a single retrospective may lead to loss of control." Ivan warned.
"I have noticed it. You can use it for up to five hours each time." Hermione retorted softly.
Ivan was still a little worried, and finally took Hermione to the school hospital, intending to let Madam Pomfrey to see if there were any sequelae.
In the school hospital,
Madam Pomfrey was treating a Hufflepuff player for a fall. After hearing Ivan's request, she seriously checked Hermione.
"Miss Granger, how did you make yourself like this?" Madam Pomfrey scolded, frowning.
"Is it serious?" Hermione was a little scared.
Ivan was also nervous, he didn't want anything to happen to Hermione because of his own affairs.
"That's not the case, it's just that because of being in a state of mental tension for a long time, and tired, it will be fine for a period of cultivation." Madam Pomfrey shook her head and explained.
Then, without waiting for the two of them to breathe a sigh of relief, Madam Pomfrey looked at Ivan again.
"It's the same with you, Hals! You are much worse than Miss Granger. You'd better tell me honestly, how long have you not slept well?"
Madam Pomfrey really couldn't understand why the two 13th and 4th children were so exhausted and lacking energy.
They are right at their age when they are most energetic...
It's not a few days since school starts now, what have they done?
Ivan was a little embarrassed. He didn't expect that he would bring Hermione, but in the end he implicated himself in it.
However, Ivan is fortunate that the problem is not serious, just need more rest and drink some energy tonics should be able to solve it.
It seems that using the time converter will not cause any irreparable serious consequences to the body.
That's right, otherwise the Ministry of Magic wouldn't give them this thing.
A few thoughts flashed through Ivan's mind, and he had to face the black-faced Pomfrey.
Obviously, if you don't give a suitable reason, Pomfrey would not let them go so easily.
"Sorry, Madam Pomfrey, we have too many school tasks recently, so we have less time to rest. This may be the reason, we will pay attention to it in the future..." Ivan said half-truth.
"This is the first time I have seen learning to learn this way." Madam Pomfrey couldn't laugh or cry.
If this is to be said by a little wizard, she would definitely not believe it.
But Mrs. Pomfrey has also heard of Ivan's deeds in the past two academic years, so hard work is worthy of his current achievements.
Hermione is also a top student in all subjects, so this reason is still valid.
Madam Pomfrey quickly boiled two bowls of black potions and brought them over. There were many unknown objects floating in the turbid potion, which made people want to drink at first glance.
Can I not drink it? Ivan was rather helpless. He felt that after he returned, he could just make two bottles of energy tonics by himself, so he didn't have to be so troublesome.
Madam Pomfrey shook her head firmly.
Reluctantly, Yifan could only pick up a bowl of potion and pour it down. The entrance was very bitter, and it felt like a traditional Chinese medicine that had been drunk in a previous life.
After drinking, Ivan felt cold in his brain, and he was much more awake.
Ivan turned her head and looked at Hermione who was opposite. The little witch was holding another bowl of potion, sipping her mouthful, her brows frowned...

chapters.title: Chapter 299: Scab, you are my savior!
chapters.content:
When they returned to the original unmanned classroom, the two of them stared with big eyes, and the atmosphere was very embarrassing for a while.
Ivan also put out the thought of reprimanding Hermione, after all, Madam Pomfrey said that her condition was much worse than Hermione's.
"It looks like we are going to have a detailed timetable!" Ivan sighed helplessly, as if the restless work and rest for a long time like before will cause problems.
Then Ivan began to rework a new schedule, the most important of which was to restrict the use of the time converter.
Go back up to 30 hours a day, try to avoid going back to the past several times at the same time, drink a bottle of tonic every three days, etc...
After strictly stipulating the schedule of work and rest, both of them felt a lot more relaxed in the next few days, but the progress of the potion research and development also slowed down a lot.
Even if Ivan put all the grade points earned in class every day into it, there is still a core problem that cannot be solved.
That's why the effect of the compound decoction suddenly disappeared when the black-robed wizards were used in the experiment.
Thinking of this, Ivan frowned deeply.
After hesitating, he picked up the compound decoction prepared on the table, randomly added a hair collected in school these days, drank it in one sip, and soon his body deformed.
Ivan looked at the mirror next to him, and he had become a thin little wizard.
"Shen Feng Wuying!"
When the effect of the medicine stabilized, Ivan used his wand against his arm to lightly chant the spell, releasing the spell.
The invisible magic blade pierced his skin, blood flowed down the wound, and the table suddenly became bright red.
Hermione turned her head when she heard the noise, and she was shocked when she saw a long wound on the arm of a strange little wizard.
Hermione instantly guessed that the person in front of him was Ivan who had drunk the compound soup, because she and Ivan were the only people here just now.
Seeing a lot of blood flow from Ivan's wrist, the little witch panicked.
Fortunately, she remembered that she had seen in the book "Advanced Potion Making" that Bai Xian could heal her injuries, so she hurriedly searched for it, grabbed a stick of Bai Xian, and ran over like crazy. Pulling Ivan's injured arm, he dripped fresh juice onto the wound.
However, the wound was still bleeding, and the fresh juice did not have the slightest effect.
"It's impossible! Why is it useless?" Hermione said eagerly with a hint of crying.
Ivan also didn't expect Hermione to have such a big reaction, and hurriedly explained.
"Don't worry, Hermione, I'm just doing an experiment... this is just part of an experiment."
While speaking, Ivan put his wand into the wound, and he whispered a curse like singing in his mouth, and the wound on his arm healed immediately.
He was just testing the stability of the compound decoction, especially when the drinker was severely injured and treated, would it suddenly change back to the original state, or affect the potion's effect.
experiment?
Hermione stared blankly at Ivan's arm slowly recovering, even the blood stained on the table returned to the wound, without replying for a long time.
Ivan was a little worried. When she was about to ask, she saw Hermione gritted her teeth, swung her fist, and hit his stomach with a punch.
Under the compound decoction, Ivan suddenly staggered and almost bumped into the cauldron behind him. When he stood up holding his stomach, he saw Hermione's eye circles a little red.
"Who would cut his arm to do the experiment? Can't you use other things to do the experiment?" Hermione was very angry, "and you won't notify me in advance!"
Seeing Hermione who was trembling with anger, Ivan opened her mouth, wanting to explain, but didn't know where to start, scratching her head helplessly.
He didn't think so much when he was studying potions, he tried it out of his own intention. When he cast the spell, he deliberately controlled the power of the Shenfeng Shadowless Curse, and there was no danger.
Who makes the compound decoction only useful to people? He can never catch a few little wizards at Hogwarts to use as experiments, right?
Ivan was not cruel to such a degree, and it would be bad if it caused casualties, Dumbledore would definitely tear him alive...
If only one could find a guilt-covered, tenacious vitality, even if he accidentally died in the experiment, no one would care about the "guinea pig"...
Ivan sighed in his heart. In this way, not only would his potion improvement efficiency increase a lot, he wouldn't have to always experiment on himself.
Wait...it seems like there is such a person!
Ivan suddenly thought of something, with a little surprise on his face.
Shaban, you are simply my savior!
"Ivan, did you think of the potion improvement plan?" Hermione looked at Ivan's face suddenly became happy, and the anger that had been surging in her heart was temporarily suppressed, and asked concerned.
"No, I just thought that some experiments can be done with a mouse..." Ivan explained, but he would forget everything, with a coma spell, to ensure that Peter will feel nothing afterwards.
"So you just thought of using a mouse as a guinea pig?" Hermione glared, looking like a lioness.
Ivan smiled bitterly, the experiment he was talking about was not an ordinary mouse.
That is to say, Animagus like Peter Pettigrew can meet his experimental needs!
He had to find a way to get that man from Ron, the mouse!
But this is destined to be impossible to tell Hermione, Ivan only apologized for a while and promised never to conduct such dangerous experiments on himself Hermione stopped pursuing this matter.
I had known that if there was an experiment, Ivan would be foolish to use his body to do experiments.
But Hermione still had a stern face in the end, apparently still not calm, and ignored him all morning, flipping through the potions book on her own.
Ivan shook his head without paying attention, and continued to devote himself to the research of the potion.
After waiting for about an hour, Yifan clearly felt that the effect of the compound decoction began to slowly disappear.
It seems that the damage to the compound decoction caused by the previous injury should be small, and it will not interrupt the effect of the potion.
"Why are there no books devoted to the study of potions on dead people? What changes will there be?"
At noon, Ivan, who returned to the auditorium for lunch, sighed with a headache. He felt that the fragrant steak in front of him seemed not so fragrant...
He rummaged through the potions books he could find these days, and found that there seemed to be no corresponding research records.

chapters.title: Chapter 300: Zebra is hungry and thin, not as good as us...
chapters.content:
Hermione rolled her eyes, no wizard would study such a boring thing, but seeing Ivan frowning and thinking deeply, she couldn't help but ask.
"Ivan, what do you ask this for?"
"Nothing, just a little curious." Ivan said casually.
Although he agreed that Hermione had joined the ranks of the potion improvement research, Ivan still felt that it was his own business and didn't want Hermione to be involved too deeply.
Maybe Snape will understand... Ivan's thoughts move, he can ask about it in tomorrow's potions class.
Hermione didn't believe Ivan's perfunctory remarks at all, but knew that he would definitely not tell herself, so she secretly remembered Ivan's previous words.
It's just that Ivan can't think of things, can you really think of it?
Hermione held the time converter on her chest and couldn't help but shake...
The two ate lunch with their own minds.
After a while, Harry and Ron, who had just finished the transformation class, walked over from the main entrance of the auditorium.
"Ivan, Hermione, why are you so fast?" Ron asked strangely.
"Yeah, I just saw you behind..." Harry also nodded.
These days, Harry keenly sensed that Ivan and Hermione had some problems, as if they might appear anywhere in Hogwarts at any time.
A few days ago, I heard that Hermione had beaten a Slytherin girl in the hallway of the arithmetic divination class.
However, Hermione was clearly with them at the time, coming out of Professor Trelawney's divination classroom in the tower. The two places were clearly far apart.
But after he and Ron heard the news, they agreed that it was a rumor, because how could Hermione take the initiative to act on others?
That's against school rules!
Ivan said calmly. "Of course we came here by the secret path...you don't know it. We have a lot of courses, and we can't do it in the usual way."
It’s too late to walk the secret road, right? Harry complained in his heart, but you have to take several courses at the same time...
Harry and Ron didn’t ask any questions after all, because Hermione told them fiercely that unless they were ready to take all the courses, it’s better not to know so much...
Hearing this, Harry and Ron's heads were shaking like a rattle, and they didn't dare to ask any more.
"By the way, Ron, where's your mouse? I think it doesn't seem to be very well recently." Ivan turned his head to look at Ron abruptly, and said. .
"Is there?" Ron took Scab out of his pocket in confusion. This gray-black mouse was raised round, and its black fur was glistening...
After finally being able to come out of the closed pocket, the breathable Mottled, I was very happy, just turning his head, I saw that Ivan was looking at him with an evil look, and Mottled’s mouth suddenly let out a horrified scream. , The little paw held Ron's thumb.
Although it was a summer vacation, Shaban did not forget how the demon treated himself in the first two school years...
"It looks like it is not only in poor health, but also a bit manic. It may be sick!" Ivan immediately came to a conclusion.
Are you sure you are not scared by you? Hermione and Harry's expressions were very weird, and Ron's streaks on his palm shook his head like crazy, indicating that his body is very good, not manic at all!
Ivan saw the thoughts of several people and retorted. "Ron, if I didn't guess wrong, since this semester, it will be abnormal when I am not only around me, right?"
Ron thought for a while, that's the case. Shaban has indeed been agitated and restless recently, and even once he met Professor Lupin in the corridor, Shaban went crazy and drilled into his trouser pocket... .
Thinking of this, Ron became a little worried. Isn't he really sick?
"What should I do then? Does Mrs. Pomfrey still work as a part-time veterinarian?" Ron thought he should go take a look.
"I think Hagrid should be! He has raised so many and is still a professor of magical biology!" Harry reminded.
"Come on, don't look at the monsters that Hagrid keeps. The fire dragon and the three-headed dog are enough to bother us." Ron murmured.
"Ron, I can brew some calming potions for Shaban to drink, maybe this will make it a little better." Ivan said with a "caring" look at Shaban.
Do not! I do not need! Shaban shook his head tremblingly. He didn't think Ivan would be so kind.
Shaban remembers that when he was on the train at the end of the first grade, Ivan used his body to experiment with a kind of magic, and now he must want to let himself experiment with potions or something...
But when Ron saw Scabbard like this, he felt that it might be uncomfortable, so he looked at Ivan gratefully and said.
"Is that so? That really troubles you, Ivan!"
"No trouble, it just so happens that I like this mouse very much!" Ivan used a fork to fork a meatball and put it next to Dappled's mouth.
The latter was very uncomfortable, stubbornly pushing the meatballs by his mouth with two small paws, trying to reject Ivan's kindness.
"Sorry, Ivan, Shaban is not always like this. He may be too full today." Ron was a little embarrassed. In his opinion, Ivan has always been very good with Shaban, and often buys some multi-flavored beans to feed him. it.
It can be said that it is thanks to Ivan that Zebra can grow so black and fat.
Now that Baba is so uncomfortable, even Ron can't stand it anymore as the owner.
Ivan said at the right moment that he didn't care.
He knew how much Ron valued Shaban, so he didn't worry about letting Ron give Shaban to himself.
It was just one of the purposes, and the other was to move some hands and feet on Peter's body, lest it be the same as the original time and space, because he was afraid of Sirius and ran outside to hide.
Ron was very happy that Ivan was able to like his rat pet and excitedly shared with him some interesting things about the summer vacation.
For example, during the summer vacation, George and Fred, because Zebra ate a lot and did not exercise, they specially made a beautiful mouse wheel for him. The full magic brake can force Zebra to exercise in the wheel. body...
"No wonder I always feel hungry and thin..." Ivan shook his head. It seems that the fattening plan he had prepared since the first grade was a failure...
It is obviously not thin at all! Harry looked at his plump and plump body, and wanted to vomit.
Hermione noticed that Ivan seemed to be a little too concerned about Scabbers.
I also remembered that Ivan said before that he wanted to find some "little mice" to do experiments, and the little witch looked a little strange.
But Scab is Ron’s pet, and Hogwarts is not without other rats.
Thinking of this, Hermione gave up her previous thoughts again.
Ivan is not such a person!

chapters.title: Chapter 301: Quidditch team
chapters.content:
The four of them ate lunch in the auditorium and discussed Hagrid’s magical biology lesson in the afternoon.
Harry was a little worried that Hagrid would mess up the course, and he had this hunch when he bought the "Monster Book of Monsters" in the bookstore.
Several people are discussing to be more active in Hagrid’s class so as not to embarrass Hagrid too much.
Harry suddenly remembered something, turned his head and said. "By the way, Ivan, Wood asked me to inform you that this Friday evening we are going to have our first Quidditch training of the school year!"
Ivan's fiddling with the knife and fork stopped, but quickly and slowly tore off a large piece of steak, and replied casually. "I don't plan to participate in this training. I'm going to quit the Quidditch team this year. You can tell Wood for me when that happens.
"What? Ivan, you want to quit the Quidditch team?" Harry exclaimed in surprise, he couldn't believe his ears.
Harry's voice attracted the attention of the little wizards at the Gryffindor long table. George, who was chewing on chicken legs not far away, was surprised and couldn't help but leaned forward.
"Why? Ivan? Our Gryffindor team can't do without you, and we are still looking forward to winning this year's Quidditch Trophy!"
Harry and Ron also nodded, and they didn't want to see Ivan withdraw from the Quidditch team!
"I need to take too many courses this school year, I really can't spare the time." Ivan said helplessly.
Although there is such a thing as a time converter, previous experience clearly tells Ivan that if this thing is abused, it is likely to die because of exhaustion of energy.
This is also the reason why he and Hermione made the schedule. Given this, Ivan certainly wouldn't spread his little energy on Quidditch.
After all, the same achievement is unlikely to get a second time, and the grade points for getting the Quidditch trophy are not as fast as the usual class.
George and others were unwilling to persuade them for a while, but Ivan was very determined.
"The Gryffindor team is already full. It doesn't matter if I retire or not. Besides, with Harry, the best seeker, the Gryffindor team can win as well!" Ivan rebuffed.
"Ivan has had enough things to do lately, don't bother him with Quidditch!" Hermione also stared at them and said with help.
Harry and others had to give up.
It didn't take long for Wood to get the news, and he hurried over. With a straight face, he wanted to forcefully persuade Ivan to participate in Friday's training camp.
But before that, Ivan took out his timetable for this year and handed it to Wood.
After the latter saw it, he was speechless for a long time, almost thinking whether he had read it wrong.
Wood didn't believe it until Ivan said he could ask Professor McGonagall to confirm, and Hermione also took out his class schedule.
Ivan was already busy enough to take several classes at the same time, so naturally he didn't have the face to let Ivan come to play Quidditch anymore, and finally had to pat Ivan pity on the shoulder and walked away.
After solving a troublesome thing, Ivan also slowly breathed a sigh of relief. He had been worried that Wood would reluctantly force him to participate in this year's Quidditch, and that would be more troublesome.
After lunch, a few people took their books and walked out of the castle, preparing for the first lesson of protecting magical animals.
Due to the interference of the dementors before, the sky above Hogwarts always looked gloomy, but today is a rare weather, and the dense clouds have dispersed.
Halfway through, Harry and Ron complained about the noisy monster book in their hands. Even though they had tied the book tightly with a rope, they couldn't keep them quiet all the time.
Hermione had long used magic tape to seal the big mouth of the monster book that would bite people, and then wrapped it in a cloth and hugged it on her chest, but the book was still irritable and wanted to break free from her embrace.
"Ivan, why is your book so obedient?" Hermione looked at Ivan a little puzzled. He also held the same book in his hand, but stayed quietly in his hand.
"As long as you know how to deal with their weaknesses, they will be obedient by touching the spine of the book." Ivan looked at Hermione and others who were in a hurry and explained.
Hermione did it again, suspiciously, and stroked her finger down the back of the book. The irritable monster book trembled abruptly, and the fuss stopped immediately.
"It's great, really useful!" Ron also gave it a half-hearted try, and then said in surprise, even if he opened the book, the book didn't mean to bite him.
"Ivan, how did you know this method?" Ron asked curiously. He bet that even the salespeople at Liheng Bookstore didn't know this method.
Because when he and Harry claimed to buy two monster books, the clerk there almost cried. It is said that some people were bitten when they bought the goods.
"Someone has solidified magic such as item activation on this book. As long as you find the node with the weakest magic power, you can temporarily interrupt the effect of this magic!" Ivan said aloud.
Since the two blood fusions, Ivan's perception ability is much sharper than before, and his alchemy level is very high, so it is easy to see the production principle of this monster book.
Obviously the creator of this book is also very funny
"Really, I don't know which **** would use this method to make magic books," Ron said cursingly.
While chatting like this, Ivan and the others quickly saw Hagrid’s cabin, which was rare and very lively. About forty or fifty people came. It seemed that this kind of extracurricular courses was still very popular.
It's just that the students of Slytherin are also here Harry even saw Malfoy, which made his good mood a bit bad.
The tall Hagrid stood upright at the door of the hut. He was wearing that mole-skin coat and counted the heads with excitement. When everyone was there, he waved his hand to the little wizards. Go to the Forbidden Forest.
The little wizards were a little worried and a little expectant, because Dumbledore emphasized the danger of the Forbidden Forest every school year.
The big hound sticked his tongue out and followed them all the way.
Fortunately, Hagrid still knew it in his heart. He didn't really take them on a day trip to the Forbidden Forest. Instead, he walked forward around the edge of the forest. A few minutes later, he came to the outside of a small paddock.
"Everyone get together a little bit!" Hagrid's loud voice shook the little wizards nearby to poke their ears.
After seeing everyone getting closer, Hagrid yelled again.
"Yes, that's it! First you need to open your textbook to show me who of you has subdued these little cuties"

chapters.title: Chapter 302: A book that even bites me when I get crazy
chapters.content:
Hagrid glanced around the crowd, and was disappointed to see that most of them had **** the books tightly.
"Cute? You mean this book that is so crazy that you even bite yourself?" Malfoy said sarcastically, then said mockingly.
"If my dad knew, he would be surprised that the new professor at Hogwarts would let us buy such dangerous books! I never knew that even such things could be used as textbooks!"
"Gosh, what if we accidentally broke our arms by it? You must think it's so cute, right?" Malfoy said loudly.
Hagrid seemed a little at a loss, he couldn't say anything. Isn't the way they bite their hands cute enough?
Malfoy was about to say two more words, but was interrupted by a sudden sound.
"Your father can't teach all of you, Malfoy!"
Ivan walked out of the crowd, holding the biting book in his hand, but to everyone's expectation, the book was not bound but stayed quietly in his hand.
"If you are smart enough, you can figure out a little bit about "The Book of Monsters" since it is a book for teaching magic, naturally there will be a way to comfort it. I think this should be the one left by Professor Hagrid. Isn't it a small test?"
"Hagrid wants to see us find a way to appease him with our own ingenuity. I think this must be a rare experience in life!" Ivan looked at the little wizards around and talked freely.
"Experience? Do you mean being bit off by this book?" Malfoy smiled disdainfully.
"I don't think it's that cruel," Ivan shook his head.
Although "The Book of Monsters" looks terrifying, it is only a book after all, and it is a little bit shattered at most.
Thinking of this, Ivan looked around the crowd and asked.
"Who among you spent some time studying how to appease this book, or to check the information on some magic books, instead of just putting it in the corner and accumulating dust after you bought it?"
Under Ivan's gaze, all the little wizards shook their heads.
Hermione was even more upset. She was so busy this semester that she didn't have time to search for relevant information.
"Why are we going to study how to appease this book? It's totally meaningless!" Malfoy said loudly.
Ivan ignored him at all, but continued to speak to the little wizards.
"What I want to warn you is that many advanced magic book producers in the magic world will set some small magic on the book to detect whether the viewer meets the requirements of reading the book, and if you can’t crack the magic. Then you will be destined to not see the contents of the book!"
"I believe if anyone of you has ever borrowed some advanced books in the restricted book zone, you should be able to understand this." Ivan added.
Some of the little wizards in Slytherin nodded after hearing Ivan's words. This is most likely to happen in books related to black magic.
Ivan also remembered the "Cutting-edge Black Magic" that impressed him when he was in the first grade. The black misty face and the screams that hit the soul in the book seemed to prevent some little wizards with insufficient level from watching.
If he is now, he can crack that magic easily.
"The creator of this book may be in this kind of thinking, and made the book look like this. You must know that many magical creatures are quite dangerous. You need a calm mind and enough patience to appease those fierce ones. Creatures, get along well with them." Ivan finally concluded.
Bang bang bang
After a brief silence, there was a burst of applause on the court.
Most of the little wizards were surprised by Ivan's speech and thanked Ivan for teaching them a valuable lesson.
Was it so? Hagrid nodded uncontrollably.
Ivan turned his head and looked at Malfoy pityingly, "You can't count on your dad to help you do these things every time, I thought you've grown up, Malfoy!"
Malfoy's face flushed red, he drew out his wand and wanted to fight Ivan, but after thinking about the power gap between the two sides, he was aggrieved to dispel the idea.
"Professor Hagrid, I should have clearly conveyed what you wanted to express, didn't you?" Ivan ignored him, turned his head to look at Hagrid, and said.
"Ah! That's right! That's right! That's what I thought!" Hagrid was stunned at first, and then quickly reacted. He slapped his callous palm with a muffled sound, and he shouted Tao. "I want to add fifty points to your wonderful speech!"
Immediately, Hagrid turned his head to look at Harry and the others, and continued.
"Of course, there are also Harry, Ron, and Hermione! You have already mastered the techniques of appeasing the monster book before class, and each of you three will add ten points!"
Harry and Ron were very happy. It was great to have a good professor. They thought someone could finally balance Snape's random deductions.
Hermione couldn't be happy, after all, Ivan taught them the way to appease the monster book, and she felt that such extra points would be unfair to other colleges.
After helping Hagrid to clear the siege, Ivan did not continue to stand in the middle and returned to his original position.
Hagrid was showing other little wizards how to appease the monster book.
With the explanation given by Ivan just now, most people listened very seriously, and Hagrid had a good sense of being a professor.
"Ivan, we almost thought you were the professor." Harry couldn't help but joked after seeing Ivan coming over.
"Yeah what you said is really great!" Hermione was also surprised, "I didn't know that the magic attached to the magic book could actually perform this kind of effect."
Of course you don’t know, I was just talking nonsense just now
Ivan shrugged, thinking silently in his heart.
However, he has seen similar conclusions in a book, and indeed there are some smart wizards who will set similar tests, and more of them are the evil tastes of the producers.
For example, "The Invisible Book of Invisibility" in the Liheng Bookstore. The author of that book is Real Pi
I actually have to use the anti-curse to read it, otherwise the entire book will be transparent and invisible, and most of the wizards who read this book have not even mastered the phantom spell, otherwise they would not buy this book, let alone the corresponding The anti-curse.
Therefore, the sales volume of this book in Liheng Bookstore is extremely poor, and it has been kept in the corner without anyone interested in it, so that even the owner there forgot where to put the book.
When I was reading a book in Liheng Bookstore, Yifan accidentally kicked on an invisible book, and then curiously figured out how to read the book.

chapters.title: Chapter 303: Eagle head horse body winged beast
chapters.content:
While Ivan and the others were whispering, Hagrid excitedly guided the little wizards to master the method of opening the monster book.
Even Malfoy, with a disgusting expression on his face, opened the book of success, because Hagrid said in great detail, if he didn't follow it, others would only think he had a problem with his IQ.
Seeing this, Hagrid nodded in satisfaction, and a loud voice rang in everyone's ears.
"Okay, now the formal class begins! You guys stay here for me first, I will go and bring the magical creatures here, I believe you will love these little cute ones!"
After speaking, Hagrid strode into the forbidden forest, and Hound Fang was left by Hagrid to take care of their safety.
"I don't know what the big stupid guy will bring over." Malfoy curled his lips in dissatisfaction, then looked at Harry again. "I guess Potter must be looking forward to not being a dementor... he will be terrified!"
"Malfoy!" Harry was so angry that he wanted to rush to argue with Malfoy, but was held back by Hermione and Ron.
This was Hagrid's first class, and it would be better for them not to have a violent conflict with Malfoy.
After a while, Hagrid led a dozen animals toward them.
These creatures are tall and strong, but they look weird. They have the head and wings of an eagle, but their body is no different from a horse, just like a monster made up of two creatures.
But in front of the taller and mightier Hagrid, these eagle-headed horse-winged beasts looked particularly helpless, and leather collars were hung on their necks, and they were tied together with chains.
"Hurry up, hurry up!" Hagrid gripped one end of the chain tightly with his thick palm, while shaking the chain, urging the monsters to walk towards the fence where the classmates stood.
A group of little wizards stepped back together, looking at these eagle-headed monsters in horror.
Ivan also sighed in his heart that Hagrid was so courageous that he dared to bring such dangerous creatures in the first class to teach them these little wizards who were not in the third grade.
The most important thing is that these eagle-headed horse-winged beasts seem to have not been specially domesticated. From their rebellious orange eyes, it can be seen that they are all wild!
But Ivan shook his head again thinking about the monsters that Hagrid had raised. Perhaps for Hagrid, the eagle-headed horse-body winged beast was already a safe baby.
At least Hagrid didn't bring a three-headed dog in the first class to show everyone to the world...
"Look! They are beautiful, aren't they?" Hagrid tied the dozen or so eagle-headed horse-winged beasts to the fence, and then turned his head to look at the crowd. "I guess you must have never seen such creatures before. They are eagle-headed horse-body winged beasts!"
"If you want to see more clearly, you can get closer!" Hagrid said happily, and he promised with a pat on his chest as he looked at the feared crowd.
"You can rest assured that eagle-headed horse-winged beasts generally don't hurt people! I mean if you don't lose your temper...so don't anger it!"
Hearing what Hagrid said, the students were even more reluctant to approach. They originally thought that these eagle-headed horse-winged beasts were just looking at horror, but they did not expect that they might actually hurt people...
"Well, then who wants to come first!" Hegla passed a eagle-headed horse-winged beast called Buckbeak, and said enthusiastically.
However, no one was willing to move, and when the game was about to be cold, Harry mustered the courage to take the initiative to free Hagrid.
Ivan is not very interested in these big guys, because the eagle-headed horse-winged beast is not dangerous enough in his opinion, and has no specialties. In the Ministry of Magic's danger rating, it only has xxx, compared with the basilisk and The fire dragon is not a star or a half away, so this creature is not on the list of fusions he expected.
But for Harry, facing such a weird-looking big guy is not an easy task. He followed Hagrid’s instructions to look at the eagle-headed horse-winged beast, and acquire each other step by step. Trust.
In the end, Harry dared to stroke its head lightly under Hagrid's repeated urging, and rode it around in the sky.
Harry's success undoubtedly inspired the other little wizards, and Hagrid saw that everyone was already interested, so he pulled a few eagle-headed horse-winged beasts over.
Soon, in the entire paddock, some daring students also learned what Harry had just done, and carefully approached these weird-looking beasts.
Ivan and Hermione picked a red-brown eagle-headed horse-winged beast. It looked particularly beautiful, with its head raised high, and its red-brown hair gleaming in the sunlight.
Ivan took a few steps forward, and was about to look at each other and bow according to the steps. Unexpectedly, before he could move, the eagle-headed horse-winged beast leaned forward on its own initiative.
Hermione was taken aback, thinking that the other party was going to attack them, but then found that the eagle-headed horse and the winged beast was approaching, instead, it touched Ivan intimately.
It was also very unexpected, and Ivan.
He is ready to counterattack, the protection ring is already in a semi-activated state, and only needs to resist for a moment, he can use the Shenfeng Shadowless Curse to cut off this guy's head.
But doing so may cause a chain reaction, but fortunately, things are not so bad.
Looking at the big head close at hand Ivan thought, stretched out his hand and stroked the opponent's reddish brown hair, the eagle-headed horse-winged beast lazily closed its eyes, revealing a look of enjoyment.
Hermione also curiously tried to get closer, learning Ivan's movements, reaching out to pet the eagle-headed horse-winged beast, but the latter opened his eyes and stared at her with orange eyes, and there was a burst of sharpness in her mouth. Scream.
Hermione was a little dissatisfied with the different treatment of this big red-brown guy, but she had no choice but to look at Ivan and ask aloud. "It seems to like you very much! Ivan, how did you do it?"
"How do I know..." Ivan shook his head. He suspected that it might be because the affinity talent of Unicorn Blood was still working. He thought it was gone after the snake blood was fused... .
By the way, Malfoy!
Ivan vaguely remembered that Malfoy had angered a eagle-headed horse-winged beast in this class and suffered a serious injury. Something happened later and wanted to execute the monster that hurt him.
Ivan, who didn't want anything beyond his control in the near future, turned his head and looked towards Malfoy...

chapters.title: Chapter 304: consult
chapters.content:
Not far away, Malfoy also noticed that Ivan had easily tamed a eagle-headed horse-winged beast. He turned his head and looked at Buckbeak with an arrogant expression with an unhappy expression.
Malfoy stepped forward immediately and wanted to stroke Buckbeak's feathers directly.
"Malfoy, you haven't bowed yet!" Gore and Clark hurriedly reminded them next to them.
"Who said you must bow?" Malfoy curled his lips in disdain. He just saw that Ivan had not bowed at all and was recognized by the eagle-headed horse-winged beast. He felt that he could not be worse than Ivan!
Buckbeak grabbed his paws nervously, but Malfoy didn't even notice.
Although there was some fear in his heart, for the sake of face, Malfoy bit his head and slowly approached Buckbeak.
Buckbeak was soothed by Harry for a while. Although he was very dissatisfied with Malfoy's aggressive behavior, it did not happen immediately.
"It doesn't seem to be difficult..." Malfoy saw that Buckbeak hadn't done any extreme behavior, and he was slowly relieved, but on the surface he looked calm and calm, even Turned his head and said to his two followers.
"Look, it's easy to make it surrender, right? I won't bow to an ugly beast like Potter!"
Gore and Clark didn't reply, they looked horrified, and trembled back a few steps.
Malfoy realized that it was wrong. Turning his head, he saw Buckbeak’s orange, angry eyes staring straight at him, his forelimbs raised high, his sharp claws shining coldly in the air. , Swipe down at him!
Malfoy below only felt a chill rushing all over his body, and there was a harsh scream in his mouth...
Hagrid, who was demonstrating to a little wizard, heard the sound, and rushed forward to grab Buckbeak’s chain, but it was too late.
Just as Malfoy felt that he might be killed here, a red light that flew from nowhere hit him.
Malfoy's body was like a kite with a broken wire. He was knocked out, rolled and hit the ground, falling into mud...
At the same time, he was lucky to escape Buckbeak's claws.
"Be honest with me, Buckbeak!" Hagrid had already bound Buckbeak with his brute force at this time, forcibly controlling the angry eagle-headed horse-winged beast, and tied it to the fence.
Then Hagrid ran to Malfoy to check, and he was relieved to see that he was not injured.
"It almost killed me! That **** beast, it wants my life!" Malfoy got up from the ground, still a little frightened, he yelled in anger.
Hagrid seemed a little overwhelmed. He didn't expect to encounter such a bad thing in his first class.
"Enough, Malfoy! We've all seen it, you didn't bow as Hagrid said, or Buckbeak wouldn't attack you!" Harry couldn't help but yelled.
"I would have been killed by that monster if it hadn't been for the curse to save me!" Malfoy yelled loudly, stroking his neck, then he turned his head to look at Gore and Clark.
"You did a great job, who saved me just now?"
From Malfoy's point of view, they are the only ones who will save themselves. Although his two followers are a bit stupid, they are still useful in critical situations.
However, Gore and Clark shook their heads quickly, indicating that they had done nothing.
Malfoy was at a loss. If it weren't for them, who else would it be?
"It was Ivan, Malfoy who saved you!" Ron said with a sneer.
"It's impossible!" Malfoy's face suddenly turned blue and red, and he couldn't help shouting.
He looked at other people, and many little wizards nodded. They also saw Ivan draw out his wand to cast a spell.
Malfoy turned his gaze to Ivan's side, flushed, and tried to say something several times, but he never said it.
What made Malfoy most uncomfortable was that Ivan didn't even glance here, nor stepped forward to mock him, it looked like he had done a trivial thing casually.
......
Due to Malfoy's attack, the entire lesson on the protection of magical animals was forced to end hastily.
After class, Ivan and others returned to the castle together.
"You shouldn't have saved Malfoy! He didn't even have a word of thanks!" Ron mumbled dissatisfiedly on the way, feeling worthless for Ivan's behavior.
Harry also nodded, agreeing with Ron's point of view.
"Or Ivan would watch Malfoy being eaten by Buckbeak? Then Hagrid might be caught in Azkaban!" Hermione retorted.
That’s right.. The two of them only thought of this, and they stopped talking angrily.
Ivan didn't care at all. He saved Malfoy just hoping that the other party would be a little safer this school year, so that Buckbeak would not be executed. Hagrid was heartbroken and involved him again, consuming his time.
Facts proved that Ivan's strategy was still very effective, and Malfoy walked around them for a while, and didn't even mention the Dementors.
This made Harry's mood much better, but such a good mood only lasted until the next day's Potions class, and was completely destroyed by Snape's various deductions.
"Miss Granger, I'll say it one last time. Longbottom must complete the configuration of the reduction potion by himself, because Gryffindor has been deducted five points for your behavior!"
"Potter! You must think Mr. Longbottom's ugliness is very interesting, right? Gryffindor deducts another five points!"
"And Mr. Longbottom! If you can't finish the configuration of the shrinking potion by yourself before get out of class is over I will deduct 10 points for Gryffindor!"
.....
Throughout the potions class, Snape kept walking around a few people, and most of the points Hagrid added yesterday were deducted by him.
Harry and Ron were so angry that they thought Snape must be deliberate...
After class, Ivan didn't use the time converter to go back to the next class a few hours ago as usual, but blocked Snape who was about to leave.
"Professor Snape! I have a few questions about potions and I want to ask you."
"I thought I was clear enough in class." Snape stopped, looking a little impatient.
Ivan didn't care about Snape's attitude, but asked aloud. "That's not a problem in the book, Professor! I want to know what happens if the person taking a continuous potion suddenly dies while the potion is maintained?"

chapters.title: Chapter 305: Answering students' questions is the responsibility of the professor!
chapters.content:
"What are you asking about this?" Snape squinted.
"I was studying how to improve a potion recently, and I suddenly thought of this question, so I was more curious." Ivan hesitated for a moment, and then spoke.
"It seems that our amazing Mr. Hals thinks that his current level of potions has reached the point where he has surpassed those potion masters." There was a sarcasm on Snape's face.
Ivan frowned, but he didn't mean to be angry. "I have always felt that many of the current potion formulas were developed in the last century or longer, and there is still a lot of room for improvement in efficacy."
"And if you don't try, how can you know that you won't succeed? I think those potions masters might have the same idea when I was my age." Ivan looked at him seriously.
Snape's expression was a little moved, watching Ivan remained silent for a while, and then he said abruptly. "No one will think about such stupid questions. Potions are not for dead people!"
Ivan did not give up but continued. "Then what should I do if I want to improve the stability of a potion?"
"I think adding black stone powder might have some effect, otherwise, how about valerian? I mean potions like compound decoctions." Ivan tried to talk about several improvements that he had figured out.
"If you are going to improve a poison, blackstone powder is a good choice..." Snape left a cold sentence, then crossed Ivan and walked towards his office.
Ivan touched his chin and muttered to himself. "That means adding blackstone powder will turn into poison, but maybe valerian can do it?"
Thinking of this, Ivan once again caught up with Snape in front of him.
"Professor, among the materials that make up the compound decoction, are there any materials that conflict with valerian? Which ones are related to the stability of the potion..."
"You should think about these questions for yourself instead of asking me! If you harass me like this, I will have to deduct 10 points for Gryffindor!"
"It is the duty of the professor to answer students' questions...Professor Snape!"
"If I remember correctly, it was a textbook problem!"
......
After harassing inquiries, Yifan finally understood most of the problems that could not be solved by searching information. He already had a general idea about the final improvement plan of the compound decoction. The rest is to make it out and look for it. Let's experiment with a "little mouse".
While thinking about the plan in his mind, Ivan walked towards the potions classroom, where Hermione, who was holding the next class book, was still waiting there.
"Ivan, did you go to Professor Snape just now?" Hermione guessed suddenly, and she saw Ivan chasing Snape right after class.
"Well, I asked him some questions about potions." Ivan nodded, and at the same time felt that Snape's level of potions was much higher than him!
It seems that when Snape's potion level is converted into a level, I am afraid it is not the sixth level he expected, but the seventh!
Ivan didn't talk much about this issue, but urged Hermione to use the time converter as soon as possible. He wanted to finish the class quickly and then experiment to see if his improvement plan worked.
So in the next Muggle research class, Ivan seemed a little absent-minded. Except for the first time he stood up to answer questions and brush his grade points, the rest of the time was spent on a piece of parchment, wondering if he had it. Omissions.
Hermione watched silently, occasionally discussing the medicinal properties of several potion materials with Ivan in a low voice.
Ivan has also taken Hermione admiringly over the past few days. The Little Witch is a living encyclopedia. As long as it is a regular question, Hermione can basically answer it, which greatly saves him the time to search for information.
However, Hermione could not provide much help on some key issues of the improvement plan.
The only book she had ever read about potions improvement was the book "Advanced Potions Making" left by the half-blood prince.
"By the way, Ivan, do you know who that half-blood prince is?" Hermione asked curiously.
When she flipped through the book, she had a very bad impression of the half-blood prince, because the book was full of scribble marks, which was a bit unacceptable to Hermione who cherished the book.
Not to mention that the half-blood prince arrogantly modified the contents of the potion making in the book and refuted some theories in the book.
However, in view of her trust in Ivan, Hermione tried it personally, only to find that using the method taught by the Half-Blood Prince to brew the potion, the effect was actually improved compared to the original one!
This made Hermione curious about the half-blood prince.
"If you think about it, you should be able to guess it..." Ivan said with a glance at Hermione.
Hermione frowned and pondered for a while. Since Ivan said that, it proved that the half-blood prince was probably someone she knew and had extraordinary achievements in potions.
In her impression, there are only two people who meet the conditions.
One is Ivan himself, but judging from the age of the "Advanced Potions Making", it shouldn't be possible, and the other is...
"You mean Snape?! He is the Half-Blood Prince?" Hermione was surprised, the beautiful brown-eyed boss.
"Yes!" Ivan nodded, knowing that Hermione was smart enough to guess it. "So don't use the spells you learned from it, or Snape will trouble you!"
Hermione stuck out her tongue, even if Ivan didn't say anything, she wouldn't dare to use it casually.
The curse called Shenfeng Wuying is too powerful You can easily cut the wooden tables and chairs with a light wave of the wand, and you can see what it would look like when hitting a person. result.
It was the first time Hermione saw a spell with such a strong penetrating power.
Then the little witch suddenly thought of something and asked with a weird look. "So last school year you released the Magic Shadowless Curse in Lockhart's office?"
"At that time he wanted to use the Forgetting Curse on me, so I had to warn him a little bit!" Ivan said afterwards.
Hermione gave Ivan a blank look, which meant that Ivan had known Lockhart was a liar, but looked at her stupidly admiring Lockhart...
"Mr. Hals, and Miss Granger! If you have any whispers to say, I suggest that you choose it at the end of get out of class..."
Just as Hermione was about to say something, Professor Keridi Bubbaji's voice came over on the stage.
The little wizards all around also looked over. Ivan continued to write and draw on the parchment without changing his face. Hermione's face was a little red, and she turned her head and looked through the textbook honestly.. .

chapters.title: Chapter 306: Shaban: I'm so difficult!
chapters.content:
After a day’s course, I have been working on potions for most of the day. When I returned to the bedroom, Ivan was exhausted physically and mentally.
Harry and Ron laid down the wizard flag leisurely in the dormitory. For the thirteen or four-year-old wizard, life is so carefree.
Ivan looked at them with admiration, and then turned his gaze to the side, eating a multi-flavored bean.
Shaban shuddered under Ivan's "evil" gaze. He hadn't forgotten the potion that Ivan had said before that he was going to experiment with him.
No, this place can't be stayed anymore.
He is leaving tonight!
......
At midnight, in Gryffindor's bedroom, a gray-black mouse suddenly opened his eyes. After carefully scanning the surroundings and seeing that everyone was asleep, he was relieved in his heart.
Then Baba slowly moved his short legs to climb down from Ron's bed, but he was so fat, it was very difficult to get off the bed, and he almost rolled all the way down.
Finally, he climbed to the door of the dormitory. Peter looked at the high doorknob very embarrassedly. He was considering whether to change back to the original appearance. The little wizards in the dormitory should sleep soundly and would not wake up suddenly. ...
Just taking this step, it means that he will be far away from the current life of eating and waiting for death every day...
Peter suddenly felt that he was too difficult!
These days, even being a rat is uneasy, there are always people thinking of embarrassing themselves...
Peter glanced sullenly in the direction of Ivan's bed. Before meeting Ivan, he had been pretending to be a mouse for more than a decade...
Had it not been for fear that killing Ivan would cause a lot of trouble at Hogwarts and expose himself, he would have done it a long time ago...
A few thoughts flashed through Peter's mind, but Peter soon noticed that Ivan's bed seemed to be empty and the quilt looked shriveled...
People?
A chill rushed into Peter's heart, and a low voice rang behind him.
"Great, I was just thinking about how to get you out of Ron's quilt..."
Peter turned his head abruptly, but only saw a dazzling light of the spell, and then he noticed that his body had become very weak, as if he hadn't eaten for several days and nights, and he couldn't speak.
Peter watched in horror as Ivan approached step by step, and then felt his tail being lifted up, and he could only wave his paw weakly.
Click...
Ivan opened the door of the dormitory and walked out of the dormitory with this gray-black mouse and walked towards the room on the eighth floor.
Peter struggled for a while, and found that there was no effect at all, he had no choice but to give up the idea of ​​struggling, and stayed obediently in Ivan’s hands and looked around tremblingly, wondering if the little wizard in front of him was going to bring himself to it so late Where to go...
After walking back and forth three times in the wide corridor with many portraits on the eighth floor, Ivan muttered in his heart.
I need a room for making potions!
The next moment, a beautifully decorated door appeared out of thin air on the flat wall, and Ivan opened the door familiarly, and walked into the responsive house.
Peter's eyes widened. Behind the door is a huge space, which looks a bit similar to the potions classroom. Every rectangular mahogany table is placed with a cauldron, and some potions are being boiled. Stopped steam coming out of the crucible...
