Without this time travel, Ivan could not predict whether something worse would happen.
Thinking of this, Ivan remembered the causes and consequences of the attack, and said apologetically.
"Sorry mom."
"What's the matter?" Aysia was stunned, and asked with some worry.
"Those black-robed wizards should be the fish that slipped through the net when the Ministry of Magic attacked black magic items last year. If I hadn't made a protective ring and anti-cursive gloves, you would not cooperate with the Ministry of Magic, let alone provoke them."
Ivan regretted it very much. He felt that he had crossed over and replaced Aisia's child. Not only did it not bring her any benefit, but it caused her to suffer a life-and-death crisis.
You know, in his memory, the mother and son Aisia had stayed in Knockoff Alley for more than ten years.
When I was thinking about it, Ivan's head suddenly hurt and was flicked by someone with his index finger. Ivan raised his head innocently, and Aysia was looking at him with a dumbfounded expression.
"Why do you think that? Just because we might offend them, we won't make money and can't make money? There is no risk of making money here," Aysia rubbed Ivan's hair and continued amusedly. "How do you think our previous business came from?"
The magic world is so big, the market for the sale of black devil items is even smaller, and there is a need to contact some dangerous people. It is impossible to do such a business without sinners.
When she first came here to open this dark magic shop, she was suppressed by various forces, especially the owner of the blogging blog, who was a colleague, who made trouble for her all the time.
Fortunately, her own strength is not bad, she has withstood the other party's successive temptations, and because of some reasons, she has met Dougt, which is considered to be completely stable in Knockdown Alley.
Therefore, Aysia didn't mean to blame Ivan, and she would only be annoyed that she hadn't noticed these people's changes in advance.
"So don't think too much about it. Without those protective rings you made, when the black magic items were inspected last year, the store might have to be forced to close. We might have a hard time." Aysia saw that Yi Fan seemed to blame himself a little, so he said jokingly.
How can it be so exaggerated? Ivan curled his lips. He still remembered that Aysia spent hundreds of Jin Jialong in order to get Dougte to get him a dementor to practice calling the gods.
Aysia stretched out her hand again and hugged Ivan in her arms, whispering softly in his ear. "You have done enough, good enough! Mom is proud of you!"
"If your friends hadn't told me that you would have solved those black-robed wizards alone, I wouldn't believe such an exaggeration."
Ivan's guilt eased a little, and then he noticed that Hermione was already standing aside and watched silently for a long time.
Ivan broke away from Aysia's arms a bit, looked at Hermione, and spoke.
"Mom, let me introduce to you, this is Hermione Granger! One of my best friends at Hogwarts, and the best and brightest student in the year! I can do it this time These are thanks to her help."
"Hermione Granger? Very good name. My performance was a bit out of control just now. Didn't you scare you?" Aysia also turned his gaze away from Ivan and said gently.
"No, Mrs. Hals! I know, you are also worried that Ivan would be like this." Hermione shook her head quickly, and then said with some embarrassment. "Actually I didn't help much"
"Anyway, I want to thank you for your willingness to accompany Ivan to do such a dangerous thing," Aysia said gratefully.
"We are friends, this is what I should do." Hermione glanced at Ivan subconsciously and said.
Noting the look in Hermione's eyes, Aysia's face had a teasing smile, and there was an inexplicable look in her purple eyes, she said half-jokingly. "My friend? That's your relationship? Isn't there anything more special?"
Hermione's cheeks flushed and she was about to speak in defense, but she couldn't open her mouth under Aysia's gaze, and she didn't know where to put her hands.
Ivan rolled his eyes and was about to say something when a voice suddenly rang.
"What's wrong? Why am I here? Is it raining?"
The three of them all turned their heads and looked over, Doug sat up with a blank look, his clothes were a little wet from the rain, and the smell of strong wine exuded from all over his body.
He clearly remembered that he was drinking in the living room of the mansion. Why did he come here in a blink of an eye?
This inexplicable state of absence continued for a while, and Dougte soon noticed that Aysia and others were standing by and looking at him.
Dougt's face suddenly changed. He hurriedly flipped through his wizard's robe to find a magic wand and clicked on his robe.
"Clean up!"
Under the action of magic, the stains on the wizard's robe and the rain were immediately separated, and the whole person became more energetic.
At this time Dougert stood up Shishiran, coughed slightly, and asked aloud. "Why are you all here, did I miss something important?"
"Come and tell him!" Aysia said, looking at Ivan.
Ivan nodded and explained. "Dean Dougte, a group of black-robed wizards attacked the magic shop just now."
"What?" Before Ivan could finish speaking, Dougt frowned and suddenly realized the seriousness of the matter.
He secretly regretted that he shouldn't have drunk so much before
Otherwise, his house is not too far away from the shop, he will definitely notice something wrong there, and rush to help.
"You and Aysia are not hurt?" Dougter looked at Ivan and Aysia worriedly and he was relieved to see that they were in good condition, and then he was very angry. Said. "Do you know the identity of the attackers? Where are they now?"
"Those black-robed wizards are all dead. As for the owner of Bojinbok, who instigated them," Ivan said truthfully.
Hearing that the attackers had been wiped out, Dougt was not surprised. After all, he knew the strengths of Aisia and Ivan, and the store was originally their home ground, so it was normal to solve a few dark wizards.
But when he heard the identity of the messenger behind the scenes, Dougte scolded angrily. "So it's him? I knew that old thing was hiding evil intentions"
Ivan watched Dougt's reaction silently, and it didn't seem to be disguised.
But Ivan couldn't be sure of his own judgment. If one thing was not clear, he wouldn't let Dougert participate in the rest of the matter.
Thinking of this, Ivan held the wand calmly and asked suddenly. "By the way, Dean Dougert, you used to be a Death Eater?"
Hogwarts Blood Wizard

chapters.title: Chapter 330: Do you believe Voldemort?
chapters.content:
"In these eleven years, Dumbledore has been hiding in Hogwarts to protect his students, making it a paradise, the only place Voldemort dared not enter." Dougter's words are half admiration and half admiration. It's ironic.
Because at that time the parents of countless students died in the hands of Death Eaters, or they simply joined the Death Eaters. Those students were happy when they were in school, but not necessarily when they returned home.
"As far as I know, he still did some things, such as the Order of the Phoenix"
Ivan said that Dumbledore established a secret resistance organization, the Order of the Phoenix, when Voldemort's power began to show his ugliness, and called the rebels to fight the Death Eaters, not just sitting by and watching Voldemort's rise.
And he had been in contact with Sirius, so naturally he didn't have to worry about others asking about his sources of intelligence.
However, it is true that Dumbledore spent most of his time as his headmaster in Hogwarts. Most of the members of the Order of the Phoenix were resisters organized spontaneously by the people, not the regular army.
Ivan guessed that maybe like the Second Wizarding War, the Minister of Magic was unwilling to hand over the command of the Auror to Dumbledore. There were constant conflicts between the two sides, so the old principal could only start anew.
"I should be clear about the Order of the Phoenix, after all, my father is one of Dumbledore's friends." Dougart curled his lips in disdain, and continued.
"But everyone in the magic world knows that Voldemort is the core of the Death Eaters. If you don't kill him, the power of the Death Eaters will only grow!"
"So the best way is to create an ambush, or force the Dark Lord to fight head-on to kill him! The Ministry of Magic once planned a siege and dispatched a full fifty for the Auror. As a result, no one came back alive. !"
"Where was Dumbledore at that time? Don't tell me that he couldn't find Voldemort in the past eleven years." Dougt's face was very sordid. Among those who died, there was his best friend.
He thinks this is largely due to Dumbledore's inaction.
It is not even necessary for Dumbledore to kill Voldemort, as long as Voldemort is defeated a few times in a fair manner, the cohesion of the Death Eaters will be greatly reduced.
If Voldemort is no longer invincible, the power of the Death Eaters will not swell to the point of rampant invincibility.
Doug sighed again.
"But that's right. Dumbledore is the most famous wizard in the magical world. Naturally, he will not risk his life in a desperate duel with Voldemort."
"Perhaps he plans to wait for everyone to be powerless, and then save everything as the savior. After all, he did the same when he defeated Greenward last time.
Yes, great Dumbledore, the greatest white wizard in the wizarding world! "
Hermione opened her mouth. She felt that Professor Dumbledore would not be such a person, but she didn't know how to refute it.
Ivan knew a little bit more, and understood that Dumbledore had delayed the final battle with Greenward for five years because the blood curses of non-confrontation between the two sides restrained them.
But it was indeed strange that Dumbledore had been watching Voldemort's growth for eleven years.
Decades ago, Dumbledore dared to fight to the death with Greenward holding the old magic wand.
At that time, Dumbledore, who had already possessed the strongest wand, could not fear the newly risen Voldemort.
This white wizard who can tell that death is nothing but a great adventure, is not a person who is afraid of death.
Could it be that Dumbledore knew at that time that Voldemort could not be killed for some reason?
Or maybe Dumbledore knew he couldn’t keep him
After all, Greenward was willing to fight to the death with Dumbledore because of their special relationship, and Voldemort had no such concerns. If a wizard of this level deliberately avoids the battle, it is difficult to be caught, and even more difficult to be killed.
This may be why Voldemort claims to be stronger than any living wizard, but many people suspect that he has always been afraid of Dumbledore.
A few thoughts flashed in Ivan's mind, but Ivan didn't say it, but kept the doubt in his heart, he shouldn't know so much.
After venting for a while, Dougert calmed down again and spoke.
"Just when Voldemort's power was at its strongest, St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Injuries was not immune to the treatment of the Auror and the resistance of the Dark Lord.
They organized seven large-scale offensives throughout the year. There were hundreds of medical staff in the hospital, and more than 400 wounded and wounded. When the seventh offensive, there were even less than 50 people who still had combat capability. personal! "
When Dougt said this, his tone was very sad. He had seen too many tragedies and life and death.
Some people are seriously injured and still fight on the front line of the battlefield. Some people may be joking yesterday, and today they have become cold names on the list of deaths.
The despair of not seeing hope almost enveloped the entire St Mungo’s Magical Injury Hospital. Everyone knew that they would probably not be able to survive the next attack.
"During that battle, I was caught by a Death Eater!" Dougt shuddered as he recalled the scene. "They tortured me all day and want me to take refuge in them and work for the Dark Lord!"
So you surrendered?
Ivan looked at Dougte without saying clearly, but his eyes revealed his thoughts.
"Of course I didn't agree!" Doug said angrily, then sighed again.
"But the Dark Lord found me in person the next day!
Tell me that the Death Eaters lost a lot of manpower to attack the St. Mungo’s Magical Injury Hospital. This makes the Dark Lord very annoyed. His patience has been exhausted, and he is ready to attack it by himself. Only a massacre can quell it. His anger!
When the time comes, he will kill all the people there, whether they are resisters or innocents, not one will be left! "
Dougt could not help but recall the scene at the timeThe St Mungo Hospital for Magical Injuries and Injuries was no longer able to withstand the next attack, let alone Voldemort himself.
And there are his friends, hundreds of wizards who have lost the ability to fight, and his father.
"The Dark Lord promised that as long as I join the Death Eaters and conquer St Mungo's Magical Injury Hospital, he will not kill anyone, and everyone in it will be at my disposal." Dougte said.
"Do you believe Voldemort's words?" Ivan frowned, and Dougter wouldn't worry about the Dark Lord's temporary repentance at that time, and he would kill the donkey.
Dougt shook his head and explained.
"He has no choice! In the war against the Resistance and the Auror, the Death Eaters suffered heavy casualties. The Dark Lord needs a large number of wizards who can use healing magic, and no one else can control the Holy Spirit. Mungo Hospital for Magical Injuries! That's why the Death Eaters didn't kill me."
(PS: Dougt didn’t know that wizards of the rank Voldemort were difficult to deal with. In his opinion, Dumbledore could defeat Greenward and end the Wizarding War with this, and could also deal with Voldemort and Death Eaters in the same way. Complaining about Dumbledore's inaction)

chapters.title: Chapter 331: Who knows that when I surrendered that day, the Dark Lord died..
chapters.content:
Ivan had been silent for a long time when he heard this, but he didn't expect that Douglet would become a Death Eater because of this reason.
"The Dark Lord only gave me ten minutes to think about it, and finally I agreed, and he carved the Dark Mark on my left wrist."
Dougtra opened the sleeve of his left hand. The pale black skull mark on it was clearly visible, and his face was an indescribable complex color.
After a pause, Dougt continued.
"After I took refuge, the Dark Lord planned to launch a general attack that night!
But at night, the Dark Lord missed his appointment and did not participate in the battle himself, because he temporarily received news that he had more important things to do. Before leaving, the Dark Lord ordered the attacking Death Eaters to temporarily obey my command. . "
"So in order to avoid heavy casualties in the battle between the two sides, I found a few good friends to explain the situation and persuaded them, and then took the control of the entire St. Mungo Hospital for Magical Injuries and Diseases without bloodshed."
"You didn't find a chance to speak to Dean Bohan?" Ivan was a little strange. Since Dougte has the ability to contact his friends, why not convince his father directly.
"You don't know my father, he is a stubborn man who will never surrender!" Dougt shook his head, and then said, seemingly mockingly, self-deprecating.
"You must not have imagined that when we met again, his first sentence actually asked me why I was still alive?"
"Yeah! He must have wished that I was tortured to death by the Death Eaters. It would be better to be chopped into several pieces and transported back!
In this way, he can point to the corpse and proudly say that his son is a respectable soldier! Is a fearless hero! "
At this point, Dougt's emotions were a little out of control, he roared loudly. "But not! I came back alive and became a Death Eater! This will make him look up in front of others, and it will make the Bohan family face a big loss.
He only cares about the justice and glory in his eyes! He felt that it was more important than anything else, more important than my life, his life, and the lives of more than a hundred people in the St. Mungo’s Magical Injury Hospital! "
"He likes to be a saint himself, so he thinks everyone is a saint like him!" Doug said gritted his teeth, his muddy eyes covered with bloodshot eyes.
Dougt knew his father very well, that man would force everyone to act according to his beliefs, whether they wanted it or not!
But when he recalled the shocked and unbelievable look on his face when he walked to Bohan alive, Dougert was very pleased.
From childhood to adulthood, he was forced to do things that met the expectations of the other party, but this time he made a completely opposite decision to his father's expectations!
Dougte wants to prove his choice is right!
It was myself who protected the lives of so many people, otherwise everyone present would die in extremely painful circumstances!
But fate was like a joke with him, and not long after he fully occupied the St. Mungo’s Magical Injury Hospital, a bad news came.
Voldemort, the most powerful dark wizard in the magical world, is dead!
Died in the hands of a child who was just born not long ago!
When he heard the news, Dougte even thought he had misheard him. He only saw the Dark Lord tomorrow morning. He was so powerful and alive!
How could a child destroy such a powerful Dark Lord!
But the Aurors quickly rushed in and arrested the Death Eaters who were in panic, including him!
What makes Dougt unimaginable most is that in the trial court, he thought his father would stand up and say a word for himself, but there was nothing!
If he hadn't insisted on claiming that he was controlled by the Imperius Curse released by the Dark Lord himself, and some friends helped to operate it, I am afraid he would have been thrown into Azkaban to be the company of those dementors!
After coming out of the trial court, although Dougt escaped the Ministry of Magic's punishment, his father did not let him go. Not only did he exempt him from the position of vice-president, he also expelled him from the Bohan family.
In one night, he lost everything, was knocked down from the peak to the bottom, and became a betrayer and coward who was spurned by others.
"After that, I came to Knock Down Alley by myself and met your mother, Aisia, and your mother in the back should be clear. This is probably what I want to say." Dougter touched his waist subconsciously, but found him He didn't bring a hip flask at all, and he couldn't help but smile.
Ivan and others, who were listening to the story, looked at Dougte, who was paralyzed by the side, with different expressions.
Hermione was the most touched, her eyes full of sympathy.
When she knew that Dougt was a Death Eater, she thought that he would be like the description in the book, a vicious thug who likes to murder, but she did not expect that Dougt was being used to protect relatives and friends. Forced to become a Death Eater.
Ivan stared at the decadent and alcoholic middle-aged man in front of him, and for some reason he thought of the photos he had seen on the walls around the mansion.
It was a handsome wizard with thick brown hair, always holding a trophy and smiling. It was Dougert from more than ten years ago.
Ivan has never understood that in more than ten years, Dougt will have such a big change.
I don't even understand why this man, who had been the deputy director of the St. Mungo's Magical Injury Hospital at a young age, fell to the point of drinking in Knockout Alley.
Now, Ivan finally understands a little bit. At that time, Dougt may have been heartbroken under the successive blows, so he will hide in Knockoff Alley, a place where he is not concerned, to escape reality, so that some people cannot find him. .
But Ivan can’t comment on anything Although Dean Pohan may not be a good father, he has problems of this kind.
But it is with such a stubborn and steadfast righteous person that in that dark age, the wounded Auror and the persistent resistance can have a place to heal their wounds and continue the fire for the cause of the anti-dark demon.
The St. Mungo’s Hospital for Magical Injuries and Injuries will survive the day when Voldemort’s forces are destroyed.
The same Ivan could not refute Dougert's choice, because not everyone can leave everything that is cherished, and many people who go to death generously with their relatives and friends will abandon some bottom lines and temporarily compromise in order to protect the cherished people.
To put it bluntly, this is a difference in the concepts of the two parties.
In addition, Dougte was really bad luck, just in time for the prediction to kill, so he could only play GG in despair.
If Voldemort’s rule continues for a while, and Dougt’s choice saves these people’s lives, perhaps the result will be much better than it was at the beginning. Even though Dougt made a statement in the court, his defense would appear pale and weak.

chapters.title: Chapter 332: So how did he die?
chapters.content:
While Dougt was telling, Aysia listened to her complex expression silently.
Ivan remembered the scene when he met Dean Bohan last time, and couldn't help asking.
"Have you never thought of explaining clearly to Dean Bohan? He seems to have a deep misunderstanding of you!"
"Misunderstanding? There has never been any misunderstanding. Since he removed me from the Bohan family, we have nothing to do." Dougt sneered, his face full of anger.
Ivan opened his mouth, but did not say anything. The contradiction between their father and son might not only be resolved by clarifying the misunderstanding.
Dougt was breathing heavily, and it took a long time to calm down.
Ivan waited until he calmed down a bit, and then took the initiative to apologize.
"I'm sorry, Dean Dougert, I was too extreme before. Please forgive me for those extreme behaviors."
After listening to Dougert's story, Ivan combined with some of the information he learned from Dean Bohan and believed that Dougert should have no possibility of lying.
Because Dean Bohan had personally told him that after conquering the St. Mungo’s Hospital for Magical Injuries, Dougt did not carry out the killing, but instead imprisoned all the rebels.
This proves that Dougte is indeed restraining those Death Eaters! After all, the Dark Lord’s men suffered heavy casualties in the previous attacks, and there is no reason not to carry out retaliatory massacres.
"I understand! Your father died in the hands of Death Eaters. It's normal to do some extreme things after knowing my identity." Dougt closed his eyes and shook his head, saying that he didn't care.
What's more, Ivan said before that it was Bohan who revealed his affairs. Dougter thought it must be his father's comfort that he could not see him in Knockdown Alley, and he was deliberately blocking him.
Seeing Dougt, Ivan seemed to have misunderstood something, but he did not explain it out loud.
From Dougt's words, Ivan extracted an important message, that the Death Eater killed his father!
Ivan looked at Aysia, saw her silent, did not refute, and confirmed the authenticity.
Isn't it said that his father's death has something to do with Dumbledore?
Ivan frowned, a little confused.
He always thought that Dumbledore might have killed his father by mistake, and Acia would hate Dumbledore so much, but he didn't expect that things seemed different from what he had guessed.
Doug patted the dust on his body and got up from the ground. He didn't want to mention the unpleasant things anymore, so he turned to speak.
"Okay, I should have said everything. We have more important things now. Now that you have figured out that it was the old Bok who organized this attack, you can't just leave it alone."
"Of course!" Ivan also came back to his senses immediately, he nodded, he didn't plan to let Bok, who was behind the scenes, continued speaking.
"When I came, I saw that the Bokem Bock store is still open, and we can completely reverse it and surprise there! If the Boke store owner has not received the news to escape!"
Ivan felt that the attack of the black-robed wizard had just ended, and it was unlikely that Bok would go so simply.
Even if Bok arranged a manual inspection near the magic shop, he would only see that soon after he and Aysia returned home, the black-robed wizards broke into the shop, and then the fighting broke out and the shop was destroyed.
Then another thirteen-year-old wizard rushed in and brought out the body of "Asia" with an anxious look!
People who see such a scene will most likely feel that Aysia and the black-robed wizards they sent have died together, and now only one little devil is still alive.
At most, I wonder if this little devil has a twin brother who looks very similar, or if they are simply dazzled.
After all, his and Hermione actions afterwards were in invisible cloaks, and were not seen by others.
If Bok received such news, maybe the meeting would have been celebrated, and now he was killed, just by catching him by surprise.
"Will it be too rushed? We have limited manpower. If in a few days, I can ask some trusted friends to come and help. And it is not wise to fight against a shopkeeper in a dark magic shop. "Lift" Dougt retorted, frowning.
"No! They just lost so many manpower, now is the weakest time, if a few days later, Bock either has escaped or is ready to fight!" Ivan shook his head.
There is another thing Ivan didn't say clearly, that is, his residence time is limited. If Bok does not die for a day, he cannot return with peace of mind.
While you are still here, you'd better be able to kill all the enemies at once!
Thinking of this, Ivan turned his head and looked at Aysia. "Is there any anti-shifting magic in Mama's blog shop?"
"Yes!" Aysia nodded and said.
"Then don't worry that Bok will run away in the middle of the battle." Ivan was relieved. The thing he worried most was that he could not keep Bok. Once he escaped, it would be extremely difficult to catch him.
Dougert was still a little worried, and the three of them were a bit too risky to raid the Bokimbock store.
After thinking for a while, Aysia reminded her aloud. "As for the manpower issue, Ivan, aren't you a group of werewolf friends in Knockdown Alley? They should be able to help!"
Those werewolf wizards?
Ivan hesitated a little. He didn't forget that he was in the Broken Cauldron Bar when he heard the owner Tom talk about a battle in the Bokimbock store Many dark wizards died, among them Some werewolves!
This means that if he allows those werewolf wizards to join the battle, some of them are likely to die there!
Aysia was surprised by Ivan's hesitation, as far as she knew those werewolf wizards should still be trustworthy.
However, Aysia didn't say much. She knew that Ivan returned to the present from the future through the time converter, and knew a lot of things she didn't know.
At the same time, Esiah also expressed emotion for Ivan's growth. Unconsciously, the child who relied on her in memory has exceeded her expectations and has her own thoughts and considerations.
After hesitating many times, Ivan finally made up his mind to find the werewolf wizards!
From the dictation of Tom, the owner of the Broken Cauldron, Ivan can hear that the scale of the battle is certainly not small. No matter how strong the three of them are, they cannot be comprehensive. They really need some reliable helpers.
However, Ivan will explain the danger with Fren and others, and let them decide whether they want to help.

chapters.title: Chapter 333: I really don’t know how you mastered so much advanced magic?
chapters.content:
After Ivan agreed, Dougt had no worries. With the help of those werewolf wizards, there would be enough manpower!
"It shouldn't be too late. Let's go now, and use Apparition to go to the rocky ruins to the east. Those werewolves should be where they are." Dougter suggested, and then turned to look at Hermione. , Speak again.
"Asiah, you come and take this little girl, and I will do the little Ivan!"
Aysia nodded and took Hermione's hand. The little witch seemed a little uncomfortable, but Aysia was still obediently led by her.
When Dougte was about to step forward, Ivan shook his head at this moment.
"No, I will use Apparition myself!"
Dougt and Aysia showed surprises on their faces. If they were not mistaken, Hogwarts would not teach the Phantom Transformation course until at least the sixth grade, and Ivan wouldn’t be able to teach it during the summer vacation of last school year. magic.
"Are you sure? Apparition is in danger of splitting once the cast fails. Don't use it indiscriminately when you read about the method of using Apparition from the book." Dougt reminded.
Phantom Shift is different from other magics. It is very dangerous. It requires the magical power and psychological quality of the operator to reach the standard. It is usually limited to students aged 17 and above, and usually requires someone to take care of it during practice, so as not to cause inability. The consequences of salvation.
"Apparition!" Ivan didn't explain much, and waved his magic wand at random, and his body was drawn into the vortex of time and space.
The next moment, Ivan’s figure appeared in the open space not far away, and the whole process was completed in one go, extremely quickly.
"I really don't know how you mastered so many advanced magics" Dougt was stunned for a moment, then shook his head with a wry smile, and muttered.
He remembers that when he was in the second and third grades, he would also have some basic spells such as floating spells, transformation spells, and lock-opening spells. How can he easily control the explosion of thunderbolt, the guarding of the gods, the phantom shift, etc. like Ivan? Advanced magic.
Aysia was also very surprised, but after Ivan's return this time, she had been shocked enough, and the addition of a Phantom Transformation was nothing.
Dougt only put out his previous thoughts, and Asia took Hermione, and the three of them cast spells at the same time and disappeared into the dilapidated house.
It was another familiar space replacement. When Ivan came back to his senses, he had already arrived in the rubble of the werewolf's residence.
Before Ivan acted, I saw Fren, Walker and others eagerly coming out of the station, everyone holding their magic wands tightly in their hands.
"Fren! Where are you going?" Ivan stepped forward quickly and asked aloud.
At this time, Fren and others also noticed the arrival of Ivan, but before he could speak, Walker ran over first, patted Ivan on the shoulder and said happily.
"Halse, great, it looks like you are all right!"
"I heard an explosion just now when I was out. I was curious to check it and found out that your magic shop was attacked. It was full of blood and corpses. I didn't find you after I ran in, so I came back and took this one. I told Fren and them, we are going out to find you!" Walker gushed.
When Walker's voice fell, Fren also asked.
"Yeah, what the **** happened to Hals? When we heard Walker talk about it, we almost thought something unexpected happened to you."
Only then did Ivan understand why they were all going out to fight. It turned out that they had received the news of the magic shop being attacked.
But what makes Ivan a little puzzled is why Walker, who has been to the magic shop, didn’t collide with the original self.
Is it because it happened to be staggered with yourself?
Thinking of things in his mind, Ivan did not stop talking about what had happened before.
"Just half an hour ago, our place was attacked by ten wizards in black robes, but those attackers have now been wiped out by me, and I got the exact news that the owner of Bogimbok ordered them to come."
At this point, Ivan's words paused, and then he continued murderously. "So I plan to call the door directly before Bok has received the exact news, but I still lack some manpower, and I want to ask for your help."
Ivan had thought it was such a dangerous thing, no matter what, he had to think about it, but he didn't expect these werewolf wizards to be aggrieved after hearing his words, and agreed without hesitation.
"Haha~ I have been idle for several months, it just happened to loosen my muscles and bones," Walker said excitedly, eagerly gearing his hands.
"Don't you think about it? This time the action is very dangerous. It is to fight with the owner in a dark magic shop. Maybe you need to deal with other difficult dark wizards." Ivan was somewhat moved and said.
Although Ivan needs their help very much, he will not hide the danger when he knows that someone will die.
"Don't worry, we have considered very clearly, and we also know the dangers of this." Fren smiled.
Ivan's behavior that he had developed the wolf poison potion before and was willing to sell it at a low price made Fren and the others very touched. They had never seen a wizard think of them as spurned werewolves.
So when Ivan is in trouble this time, they will naturally not stand by and watch. Besides, this battle is dangerous, but it is not inevitable. They still have some confidence in their own strength!
"Speaking of it, I violated the agreement with you I originally promised you to help you keep an eye on the situation in Knockdown Alley, but this kind of thing happened!" Fren said with ashamed.
In recent months, there have been a lot of strange faces in Turnover Alley. They knew this, and Fren also mentioned it to Aysia at the beginning.
They thought that the black wizards who flowed in were all mobs without much threat, but they didn't expect to be unified by someone.
Naturally, Ivan would not blame Fren for this incident. It was only Fren who listened to the news to do him a favor. Usually, these werewolf wizards still need to be busy with their livelihoods, and it is normal that they cannot cover everything.
But Fren said it was for this reason, and Ivan was not rejecting their kindness either, turned his head and said to Dougt.
"Dean Dougt, is there a safer temporary shelter in Knockdown Alley?"
Ivan remembered that his past self would come here to find Fran and the others in the near future, so he shouldn't stay in this place for too long. It's better to find a safer place to discuss the next raid plan.

chapters.title: Chapter 334: So many dark wizards are solved by you alone?
chapters.content:
Dougter wanted to say that it's safe to go to his house, and there is enough space there!
But thinking that Aisia's magic shop was attacked, and his residence might also be exposed, Dougt swallowed the words he had received, and then said instead.
"Temporary residence? Of course there is, you can come with me!"
Ten minutes later, Dougter took Ivan and others to a mansion in the northwest, knocked on the door, and a middle-aged shaman in his forties came out.
"Old friend! It's been a long time!" Dougt embraced him enthusiastically for the first time, and chatted with each other intimately for a while.
Without a few chattering words, Dougt took out a bag containing Jin Jialong from the pocket of the wizard's robe and forced it to the other party.
The middle-aged wizard gave a false pretense, and finally accepted it. After greeted them with a smile, Jianshe left.
Dougt turned his head and explained to Ivan and the others.
"That was a friend I met during a poker gambling. Recently, I was short of money and was willing to temporarily vacate the house for us to use.
Don't worry, his mouth is still very strict. Apart from laziness, good wine and good gambling, there are no shortcomings. The money I gave him is enough for him to be cool outside for a while."
So what are these strange things about your friends?
Ivan shook his head with a weird look, and followed Dougt into the room. There was a lot of space inside, but it seemed a little messy, with some old photos hanging on the walls.
In the top photo is an old witch. After seeing Ivan and others walk into the house, she couldn’t help but yelled at her unfilial grandson for nothing, and even rented out her ancestral house again. Someone else
However, no one paid any attention to her. Dougt waved his wand casually, cleaned up the house with a dust-removing charm, and sealed the photos so as not to influence or eavesdrop on their conversation.
After finishing all this, Dougt turned his head, looked at Ivan, and asked very seriously. "Have you thought about what we should do next?"
Ivan nodded, "I have explored the situation in the Bojinbok Magic Shop, and I know the layout there. It's probably like this!"
With that said, Ivan pulled out his wand and stirred it gently on the table. The strands of magic power were connected into a line and drawn into a clear map, which marked each important location and the opponent's possible escape route during the battle.
"How did you detect these locations?"
Dougter looked at Ivan in surprise, and even wondered if Ivan was drawn blindly, because even the layout of the top floor and the location of the basement were clearly marked on the map!
Aysia was also very surprised. She had been dealing with Bojinbok's shop owner for so many years, and she didn't know the overall layout of the magic shop.
"I naturally have my way!" Ivan didn't explain much.
This magic map was drawn based on his memories when he searched the bloggers shop before school started.
At that time, the Bockin Bock store was already empty. No one could stop his behavior. Of course he could search the dark magic store up and down.
Dougt and others looked at Ivan's immature face, but couldn't say anything to doubt. After all, they all knew that Ivan was not an ordinary wizard, so the credibility of this map was still very high!
Ivan continued speaking after seeing them approved. "After a while, I will sneak in with the invisibility cloak first, investigate the distribution of internal personnel, wait for mobile hands, and try to reduce their staff.
As for you, wait until I send a signal before launching an attack from these weak places to block all of Bok's escape routes! "
"Wait this is not good! Too risky!" Aixia couldn't help interrupting Ivan's words.
If Ivan hadn't knocked her out before, she wouldn't let Ivan go on the adventure alone, now it's even more impossible!
Fren and others also nodded,
Dougart even more painstakingly tried to persuade Ivan to give up this dangerous idea.
Although the Invisibility Cloak is difficult to make, it is not a big deal. The effect is similar to the Phantom Curse, and the figure will be detected by some anti-curses.
If you want to go deep into a dark magic shop wearing this kind of thing, it is easy to be seen through by the other party.
"Don't worry! The invisibility cloak in my hand is very special, it's not easy to see through. If you don't believe it, you can try it!" Ivan said helplessly.
He is so adventurous because he wants to reproduce the scene he did in his store before. An enhanced version of Thunderbolt blasts in a crowded place, allowing Bok and his men to ascend to the sky together, reducing as much as possible the casualties in the battle behind .
At the time, the owner of the Broken Cauldron only told him that many dark wizards and some werewolves died in that battle. The dark wizard here may refer to Bok's subordinates or everyone here, including Aisia!
Douglas was dubious, and after Ivan put on the invisibility cloak, he waved his wand and used the anti-curse.
Sure enough, the anti-curse had no effect, and Aysia also tentatively released a few exploration magics, but also couldn't find Ivan's position.
It's as if he disappeared out of thin air!
"How?" Ivan let them toss for a while before opening the invisibility cloak and appearing in front of everyone.
Dougte smiled bitterly, speechless, this invisibility cloak is indeed very special!
Aisia curiously took the invisibility cloak in Ivan's hand and took a look.
The whole invisibility cloak is completely integrated, and feels very smooth, as if woven with water.
The more I looked at Aixia, the more she was amazed, and then she sighed in disappointment. She understood that the level of this magical creation was too high and her level was not enough to crack the secret of this invisible cloak.
"Where did you get this thing?" Aysia returned the invisibility cloak to Ivan and asked strangely.
"Borrowed from a friend!" Ivan then replied. What surprised him was that Aysia didn't even recognize it as the Deathly Hallows.
But yes, the Deathly Hallows is still a secret to wizards of their level! Only a few wizard families have relevant records
"It seems that you have made some very good friends in school Aisia said with emotion.
Knowing the power of this invisibility cloak, Esiah was surprised that the other party was willing to lend such a powerful magic item to Ivan.
Immediately, Aysia looked at Hermione again, and I have to say that Ivan's vision for making friends is great!
"Of course!" Ivan nodded solemnly, as he always thought.
Then Ivan continued to speak to Aysia. "Now you should be relieved?"
"That won't work!" Aysia did not compromise. She felt that even with the invisibility cloak, it would be impossible for Ivan to take the risk at all, and it would be the same for them to execute the effect.
"Mom, did you forget? I was the one person who destroyed the black-robed wizards who attacked the store not long ago. Even if they were discovered, they would not be able to help me for a while." Ivan said helplessly.
Ivan's words fell, Dougt said in shock before Aysia could reply.
"What? You solved those black-robed wizards alone?"

chapters.title: Chapter 335: Where is my house? What a big house for me!
chapters.content:
When Dougte heard Ivan talk about the annihilation of the attackers, he thought it was Asiah and Ivan who did it together.
After all, judging from Ivan's previous description, the number of these dark wizards is quite large, and they are all desperadoes.
Thinking of this, Dougt glanced at Aysia suspiciously, and wanted to confirm with her.
Aysia nodded helplessly, "That's right, he knocked me out before, so I can do such a dangerous thing by myself."
Only then did Dougte completely believe it, and when he looked at Ivan, his face was very strange, even ridiculous.
Also shocked were Fren and others. When Walker came back, he told them about the misery in the magic shop.
There were eight or nine corpses of black wizards inside, and their deaths were so tragic. It is hard to imagine that it was a young wizard like Ivan who did it. This is too exaggerated.
Noting everyone's horrified eyes, Ivan shook his head secretly in his heart.
He knew very well that he was able to kill the ten black-robed wizards who invaded the magic shop, largely because their leader Adrian was too arrogant and chose to search the magic shop separately, and he was attacked by him or It is broken by traps.
However, Ivan did not explain it out loud. At this time, he needed Aysia and the others to overestimate his own strength, so that they could agree to some risky plans.
In the end, under Ivan's efforts to persuade, Aysia finally agreed, but he was not allowed to go too deeply, and he needed to carry the magic props for communication with him so that he could report the situation at any time.
The action time was also postponed to a few hours later, and Ivan needed to wait for the enhanced magic text on the wand to recover to the point where it could be used.
In order to prevent any changes to Bock during this period, Ivan asked the werewolf wizards to monitor the situation of Bockin Bock’s magic shop at all times during this period.
He and Aysia are planning to go home. Ivan remembers that there are many useful magic items in the basement, which can be used by Fren and the others to reduce casualties as much as possible!
"It's just right, I also have to go back to get some things!" Dougt suddenly remembered something, patted his head and said.
"President Dougert! That" Ivan opened his mouth, with a tangled expression trying to tell Dougert that he doesn't need to go back.
Because that house has been blown up! The one that was so thoroughly bombed that even repairs can't come back!
But before Ivan could finish speaking, Dougte had already used Apparition and disappeared in place, leaving only a word.
"Don't worry about my safety, I will meet you nearby there later!"
No, I'm worried that you can't stand such a big blow!
Ivan sighed uncontrollably when he watched Dougt cast his apparition to leave.
It seems that I can only explain it when Doug comes back.
Ivan shook his head with a headache and turned to Aysia. "Mom, it's not too late, let's go back soon!"
Aysia nodded with a weird face, but she also knew what was going on, so she could only hope that Dougte would calm down a little bit by then!
at the same time,
When he returned home, Dougter looked at the ruins all over the floor blankly, almost thinking whether he was in the wrong place.
No, where is my house? !
I am such a big house!
Dougte was trembling with anger. Which **** was so nasty who blew up his house!
He swung his wand vigorously to release the restoration curse. Under the action of the magic, the stone bricks and wooden blocks on the ground quickly returned to their original positions, and the outline of the mansion was clearly visible after a while.
But in the next second, some houses that had been repaired collapsed again!
Doug breathed heavily, the house was destroyed too thoroughly, and he couldn't repair it with his own magic alone!
Doug simply gave up the idea of ​​restoring the mansion, thinking about the **** who might do this kind of thing in his mind.
Soon, Doug had a clue, gritted his teeth and roared.
"Bock!!"
That old **** must have found someone to do it!
Dougt automatically made up for the cause and effect.
No one in Knockdown Alley knows that he and Aysia have a good relationship, and if you want to deal with Aysia, you must even deal with him.
So Bok must have sent someone to attack the magic shop at the same time!
Thinking of this, Dougt was a little afraid.
He was so drunk that he didn't have the ability to resist the attack at all. If Ivan hadn't taken him away from this mansion, maybe he would have died in a coma!
"No wonder I will be there after waking up!" Doug had already figured out everything, and was very grateful to Ivan at the moment.
He felt that after Ivan killed all the invaders in the magic shop, he realized this for the first time and worried about his safety, so he rushed to his mansion as soon as possible and transferred him to Somewhere else.
Then those bloggers couldn't find where the others were, so they simply used his house to vent their anger!
That must be the case!
"Damn it! It was a drunk mistake!" Dougt couldn't help but regret, secretly reminding himself that he should drink less in the future!
What makes Dougt feel gratified is that it seems that the kid Ivan still cares about him.
Even if he noticed the black magic mark on his left wrist, he did not leave him alone in this place and waited to die, but chose to take him to find a safe place to ask questions.
It's not in vain of his unremitting efforts over the years!
Dougte was a little moved for a while, but then he saw the broken bottle and wine box in the ruins, and he was heartbroken.
"The wine I just bought yesterday! It's all gone now!"
On the other side, Ivan and Aysia, who were performing Apparition, returned to the magic shop.
This place has changed a lot from before. The large broken hole has been repaired intact the blood stains and corpses on the ground have been cleaned up.
Except for the empty shelves, this is almost the same as before the attack.
Ivan was not surprised either, he certainly knew that this was the result of his restoration using the repair spell.
I also remember that my past self couldn't find Fren and the others at this time, and consumed too much magic power, so I had already hid in an abandoned house, so there was no one inside.
Of course, only tonight!
Tomorrow afternoon Dobby will start monitoring this magic shop, and he will definitely be spotted if he comes back then.
While thinking about it, Ivan opened the hidden trap door, walked into the basement, and took a few protective rings and improved telescopic ears on the workbench and put them into the pocket of the wizard robe.
Then Ivan turned her head to look at Aisia and found that she was holding a small fluffy ball in her hand, and asked strangely.
"Mom what do you do with that?"

chapters.title: Chapter 336: That's right, your brain is all right!
chapters.content:
Aysia didn't reply, she just smiled casually, and placed the black stuffed ball-like creature on her shoulder.
Of course Ivan recognized that it was the alchemy creature Purongrong sent by George and Fred during the last summer vacation!
Because of this, Ivan felt weird. If he remembered correctly, this thing was an alchemy creature based on the magical beast of the same name. It had no other use besides being cute.
But after being remodeled by Esiah, the Purongrong looks even more adorable, with a pair of big watery eyes.
Ivan shook his head, very helpless. We went to fight. What do we bring with this stuff?
But maybe Aysia has made any special modifications to this thing.
Thinking of this, Ivan didn't delve into it anymore, took some magic items he used, and took some Jin Jialong and returned to the agreed place with Aysia.
Pushing the door open, the first thing Ivan saw was the angry Dougte, he was talking angrily to Fren and the others.
Hermione stood by and listened, with an indescribable weird look on her face. She seemed to be holding a smile forcibly, but she wanted to pretend to be serious.
"Dean Dougte!" Ivan was a little guilty for some reason, but he bit his head and walked in and said.
Seeing Ivan's eyes brighten, Dougter hurried over, and before Ivan could continue to speak, he patted his shoulder excitedly and said.
"Thank you so much, Ivan! Fortunately, you saved me in time, otherwise, I am afraid I am dead now!"
Yep? what?
Ben was also worried that Ivan, who was also worried about Dougt looking for a duel with him, was stunned for a while, and he couldn't turn his mind a little, and could not help interrupting Dougt's words.
"Wait Dean Dougert! What did you just say?"
Ivan looked at Dougt with a weird look, and didn't understand his brain well. He vaguely felt that Dougt had misunderstood something.
Sure enough, Ivan soon heard Dougt curse angrily.
"When I went back, I found out that Bok, an old bastard, actually sent someone to blow up my house."
Dougt quickly swears and recounts the content of his previous brain supplements.
Ivan was a little dumbfounded,
Is the matter like this?
Ivan even wondered if he had traveled to another parallel time and space, because Dougt's guess seemed quite logical.
If he hadn't known that the house was blown up by himself, Ivan would have almost believed it!
After listening to Dougt's brain replenishment, Ivan hesitated whether to tell the truth, and he couldn't help turning his head to look at Aysia.
Aysia's face was also full of weird colors, and she didn't expect Dougte to guess that Bok sent someone to blow up his house.
Noting the gaze Ivan was looking at, Aysia shook her head, indicating that it would be better for Ivan to conceal the matter.
Ivan also thinks about it, the war is imminent, it's better not to let Dougert feel grievances.
And besides him, there were only three insiders, and Aysia would definitely not say anything about it, and Hermione would not betray herself.
The only thing that needs to be guarded is Bok. It seems that when the time comes, he will have to be a little harder, don't give him a chance to explain!
Thinking of this, Ivan uttered a few words to comfort Dougte, and by the way scolded Bok for being frantic and not doing human affairs!
After cursing, Ivan took out the protective ring and the modified version of the retractable ear from the pocket of the wizard robe and distributed it to Fren and others.
"This is a protection ring. As long as you inject magic power, you can release a magic barrier to protect the whole body. It looks like an iron curse. Of course, the protection effect is limited and can only resist some ordinary magic."
"As for the telescopic ear, it can be used to transmit information, just hang it on the edge of the ear!" Ivan pointed to these things one by one and explained.
After the improvement of him and Aysia, the telescopic ear has long been free of the rope restriction, and it can transmit conversations in real time just like Muggle communication equipment.
It's just that the coverage area is still a bit small, and the communication distance between the two parties is more than a few kilometers.
So Ivan is still not satisfied with this thing. He has always wanted to transform this thing into a Muggle-like phone and mobile phone. If it succeeds, it will surely sell very well.
Although Ivan is still a little dissatisfied with these magic props, the effect of these magic props is already amazing for Fren and others.
Especially the protective ring is a good thing that can save their lives for them who are about to participate in a dangerous battle!
Although the Iron Armor Curse is not a high-end magic, many of them are able to release this spell proficiently.
But the protection ring can be used by injecting magic power, which is more convenient. You must know that in battle, this two-second effort can sometimes determine life and death!
After making perfect preparations, Ivan glanced at the clock hung on the wall. It has been six hours since the last time he used the enhanced magic text.
Ivan quickly put on the invisibility cloak, and at this moment, Aysia said worriedly.
"Be careful! Remember to notify us as soon as possible if you have any circumstances!"
Ivan nodded, completely concealed his body, and walked towards the Bojinbok Magic Shop not far away.
At this time it was approaching late night, and the sky outside was completely dark.
Most of the shops in Knock Down Alley had already closed their business, except for the dim light in the Bokimbock Magic Shop, and the door was ajar.
Ivan had also imagined whether Bok could die in his sleep, but now it seems unlikely.
The moment I stepped into the shop, Ivan immediately increased his vigilance, and then felt a wave of magical power sweep over him.
Ivan is not surprised. Generally speaking, the magic shop will set up a probe-like gadget at the entrance and exit.
Just like their detection prop is the wind chime hanging on the door whenever someone enters the wind chime, it will automatically remind you.
What Ivan relied on was the Deathly Hallows Invisibility Cloak he wore on his body. General exploration magic would not be effective on him. Unless he reveals his horse's feet, or the opponent has a targeted prop such as the magic eye, he is still very safe.
As he expected, after the magic wave swept through, no alarm was triggered, and no one came out to check the situation.
Ivan finally breathed a sigh of relief, and let go of the heart he had been holding, and slowly walked into the store.
The inside of the Bogimbok store is darker than it looks outside. The only light source is a strong flame in the fireplace on the right.
The shelves around are filled with all kinds of dark magic items. In one of the huge glass cabinets, there is even a long noose hanging, and the rope is still stained with traces of blood. Ivan can't imagine anything. Of people would buy this kind of thing.
After a few glances, Ivan didn’t stay here much. He moved a few steps closer to the inner room, and faintly heard the voice of a conversation.

chapters.title: Chapter 337: He can't hide for long!
chapters.content:
Ivan held his breath and moved a few steps forward and walked into the living room behind the front desk.
The space inside is very large, with dark blue candlelights all around, and a black-gray round table in the center. Several figures faintly appear in the candlelight.
Ivan glanced around and found that there were eleven people in the living room! This is a lot more than he had previously expected.
Bok, who hadn't seen him for a long time, crouched and sat in a large chair.
He doesn't look much different from a year ago. His greasy hair is neatly combed behind his head, and his old face has an unusually kind smile. He looks directly at the wizards on the opposite side, withered and withered. On his slender left hand, he was holding the round, eyeball-like probing eye and playing with it casually.
From Ivan's perspective, the two dark black rings pinned to Bok's ring finger and little finger were still shining with a strange dark light.
Two wizards in old wizard robes stood behind Bok, and the remaining people divided into two factions to face the blog.
Not long after Ivan came in, he happened to hear a middle-aged wizard opposite Bok speak with a ugly face.
"Mr. Borkin, you have promised us nothing wrong before! Are you telling us that the goal is unclear?"
"Don't say that, Hines!" Facing the middle-aged wizard's question, Bok's expression remained unchanged, he waved his hand to show the other party to calm down, and then continued.
"The news I got was that Aysia was already dead in this attack. Someone saw a little wizard hurriedly escaping with Aysia's body after the incident. This shows that our plan was successful."
"How do we know if what you said is true? And your spies saw this scene, why not just bring back the witch's body and her child!" Hines sneered.
Hines is very dissatisfied with Bok's statement. He can't see the body, who knows if Bok is lying and deceiving himself.
And they sent so many people, and now none of them have come back. They all died in the magic shop, which is different from what they had discussed before!
So after Hines spoke, the rest of the people also condemned together and asked Bok to give an explanation!
Bok, who was sitting on the main seat, had a headache. In fact, the entire manpower sent by him was completely wiped out, which was beyond his expectation.
Bok thinks that he has been dealing with Aisia for so many years and has a deep understanding of her level of strength. In addition to the fact that the other party is carrying a child with an oil bottle, there should be no possibility of surviving in this sudden attack!
So originally, Bok was very relieved, thinking that he would get good news soon. Who would have thought that after a long time, apart from seeing the explosion and the fire, he didn't wait for anyone to return.
The news of Aisia’s death was discovered by his spies later from nearby residents, and even the true or false has yet to be determined.
What is even more weird is that when his people went to the magic shop again, they accidentally discovered that someone had used a healing spell to repair the damage caused by the previous battle, and the blood stains of the corpses all over the ground disappeared.
Not far away, I don’t know who bombed the house of Aysia’s friend Dougt.
So many weird things happened in a row, which made Bok faintly feel that something was wrong, so Hines and others were invited over to discuss what should be done next.
However, facing the aggressive questioning from Hines and others, Bok's heart was also a little angry. He pulled down his face, looked around the crowd, and said in a deep voice.
"Okay, did you say enough? This time I did make a mistake in my judgment, but don’t forget that there was someone with me who died there! And I have reminded you a long time ago to deal with the owner in a magic shop. It’s not a good idea."
Hearing Bok's words, several dark wizards are not good-looking, and they are not easy to refute. Indeed, three of the ten people sent in the past are Bok's subordinates. It is unlikely that Bok will even cheat himself.
More importantly, Hines and others heard the threat in Bok's words, and then remembered that they were sitting in the living room of a dark magic shop now, and no one knew whether Bok had any arrangement here.
So even if they have more people here, they don't dare to push blog too much, otherwise they may not be able to win if they really fight!
Seeing that everyone was calmer, Bok cleared his throat and talked about the future arrangement.
The top priority now is to continue to send more people to find out exactly what happened before and to confirm whether Asiah really died and where her child Ivan Hals is now.
The empty magic shop also needs to send a few people to search it to see if we can find any useful clues.
The Bok and others who were discussing did not know that one of the targets they were looking for was listening to their conversation quietly not far away.
Ivan, who was hiding in the dark, listened for a while, and found that the dark wizards in front of him were not monolithic, but more inclined to temporary cooperation.
Even arguing over which side contributes more, it’s a pity that they don’t have the consciousness of fighting
This made Ivan a little disappointed, he still wondered if he could take advantage of the fisherman's profit.
After observing for a while, according to the positions and words of these people, Ivan quickly divided the camps of the eleven wizards.
Naturally, Bojin and his two subordinates needless to say. The remaining eight wizards at are faintly divided into two factions, the middle-aged wizard named Hines and several dark wizards with gloomy faces. Probably belonged to the same camp, it is very likely that it was the fish that escaped the Auror's blow last year.
The last three of them are sturdy, with a faintly mad look in their eyes. This temperament reminds Ivan of Yadean who died in his hands. The other person was also like this when he was dying in a rage. .
Under the gaze of Ivan's gaze, one of the leaders among them spoke impatiently after arguing with Bok for a while.
"Mr. Borkin, what about the things you promised me? You told us before that as long as we help you get rid of your old opponent, you can get the formula of the wolf poison potion! According to you, that woman is probably now Is it dead, what about things?"
Bok grinned, rotating the probing eye with his left hand, and said comfortingly.
"Don't be too anxious, Wright! You should read the newspaper carefully. Ivan Hals, Asia's child, is the creator of the wolf poison potion. Now his mother is dead and there is no one to protect him. He is falling down alone You won’t be able to hide in the alley for long"

chapters.title: Chapter 338: War
chapters.content:
"Just leave the task of finding this kid to us. As for the rest, we won't participate in it."
Wright nodded when he heard Bok's words, and a bloodthirsty smile appeared on his face. His favorite game is this cat and mouse game.
Now there are two weeks before the next full moon night, they have time to have a good time
Bok frowned, but didn't say anything. He and Wright and others were only in a cooperative relationship and could not interfere with the other party's decision.
Wright quickly stood up and prepared to leave with his two subordinates, and Bok did not do much to stay.
Ivan, who had been listening for a long time, did not wait any longer, holding the wand tightly, activated the enhanced magic text, and began to charge the magic spell.
Just as Wright was about to leave the table, Bok suddenly yelled.
"and so on!"
"What's the matter?" Wright turned his head in confusion, and asked a little impatiently.
Bock's eyes were fixed in the direction where Wright was, doubts appeared on his face, and the probing eye held by his left hand looked around uneasy.
Ivan, who was hiding in the invisibility cloak, couldn't help but become nervous, with some doubts in his heart. Could it be that he was discovered?
But why is this time? Is it because of the magic fluctuations that occur when you charge up a spell? But that should be cut off by the invisibility cloak
Ivan followed Bok’s gaze, and the color of the bricks on the ground at the entrance turned into a conspicuous red.
When he noticed this, Ivan's face changed. Obviously, this is also a type of exploration magic. He remembers walking through that place when he came in, and the invisibility cloak couldn't protect him!
Perceiving this, Ivan knew that he couldn't wait any longer! After launching the command of the general attack through the retractable ears, he no longer gathers momentum and is the first to do it!
A magic wand appeared out of nowhere in the void, and a fiery flame gradually ignited at the top, which soon expanded into the wind.
Wright still didn’t know what had happened. Seeing that Bok hadn’t replied for a long time, he was very dissatisfied and prepared to leave.
At this moment, a feeling of heart palpitations surged from Wright's heart.
Wright, who was experienced in combat, trusted his intuition very much, and turned his head subconsciously, and saw a giant orange-red fireball with a diameter of one meter rushing towards him.
Wright's complexion changed suddenly, his hair exploded, his pupils shrank slightly, and he even felt the approach of death!
"There are many obstacles!" Wright drew out his wand at the fastest speed in his life and shouted loudly.
The reactions of Bok and others were not unpleasant either. Except for a few people who messed up their positions, the moment they saw the fireball, they all cast their spells together.
The joint defense of several wizards, even in haste, built a magical barrier visible to the naked eye.
The closest Wright was the most unlucky. The magic barrier he built hastily resisted only for a while before being defeated, only to watch the fireball getting closer and closer, and finally slammed on himself!
The hot flames burned Wright’s body. As the most proud of the life force of the werewolf wizard, it has now become a torture. He can clearly perceive the hot tongue of fire licking his body, and then being pushed by the solid fireball. All the way back, he hit the magic barrier behind him.
"No! Save me!" Wright, who was squeezed in the middle, broke down and let out a desperate roar.
However, his roar was ignored. Everyone knew that he was out of help. Bok and others had to work harder to maintain the defense behind Wright.
Click
Gradually, cracks appeared on the barrier constructed by many wizards.
The two stood in a stalemate for a while, the fireball expanded and exploded, hot flames and violent shock waves raged in the living room, and the glass doors and windows were bursting.
After resisting for a while, the solid magic barrier finally shattered.
The two wizards who were close could not resist the aftermath and were lifted off.
Fortunately, the existence of the magic barrier and Wright successfully absorbed most of the damage. These people only received some minor injuries, and the people behind Bok and others still stood in place, but mostly looked ashamed.
The only Wright who was hit by the frontal explosion of the thunderbolt had no good skin on his body. One arm and half of his leg were broken, and he fell to the ground without a sound.
Seeing that his thunderbolt only killed one person, Ivan was somewhat disappointed, but not surprised.
When he saw so many wizards gathered together, he knew that this raid was a failure.
After all, when the magic with a wide range of kills like Thunderbolt Explosion is released, he himself must be far away, otherwise it will easily affect himself.
This casting distance is long enough for Bok and the others to react and build a defense, to resist this magic, so Ivan will simply aim the target at the front Wright, and immediately kill one first!
In addition to killing people, the biggest effect of this thunderbolt explosion is also a signal to start war, allowing Aisia and others waiting outside to lock the position of the battlefield!
By the way, restrain the energy of Bok and others, otherwise these people will swarm Ivan, no matter how strong they are, they cannot be opponents!
Bok, who just breathed a sigh of relief, looked at the meeting hall that had been blown up for a quarter, his heart was bleeding, and he didn’t know how many precious magic items were destroyed in this way.
In the gust of wind caused by the explosion, the figure of Ivan hiding under the invisibility cloak appeared vaguely in the eyes of Bok and others.
"Damn you!" Bok looked at Ivan with anger and fright.
When he noticed that someone had sneaked in , he had wondered if Aasia had escaped by chance and sneaked in, but he never thought it would be that young kid.
What he didn't even expect was that Ivan could release such a powerful magic!
But Ivan didn't give them time to froze. The wand waved, and the white mist rose up and turned into a white behemoth. In the neighing sound, like a white lightning, it rushed towards Bok and the others.
Several wizards once again joined forces to cast various spells and flew towards the shadow of the unicorn, but the magic did not play any role.
Seeing this white shadow approaching, the black-robed wizards who were pregnant with ghosts suddenly panicked. After seeing Ivan's powerful magic, they didn't think this white light and shadow were really so harmless.
"Use the patron saint curse!" Bok was so experienced that he quickly roared loudly, and at the same time released his patron saint in the first place.
It was a dexterous weasel, bravely facing the white light and shadow in mid-air, blocking it in front of it!
But the shadow of the unicorn kicked out in the next second

chapters.title: Chapter 339: You really are not dead!
chapters.content:
The ordinary guardian **** is not the opponent of the shadow of the unicorn at all, but this is indeed a reminder to other black-robed wizards that the guardian of the gods can affect this white light and shadow!
After realizing this, the rest of the black-robed wizards also cast spells together.
It’s just that people whose minds have been corrupted by black magic cannot use the Guardian of God, so among the ten people present, only Bock and the three black-robed wizards summoned the patron saint...
A few lights and shadows floated out from the top of the magic wand, transformed into a big turkey and two foxes,
Patron saints of different appearances rushed forward, and the weasel, who was kicked almost into a haze, followed close behind.
The shadow of the powerful unicorn can knock a patron saint into a cloud of light with just a kick, but it won’t take long for the patron saints that have been shattered to regroup and rush up again without fear of death. ...
Seeing that the four patron saints contained the white behemoth for a short time, Bok was a little relieved in his heart, but at the same time he was very angry. Only a 13-year-old kid, he turned the place upside down, and he was still in front of them. Everyone killed Wright on the spot!
Bok felt that his face was ashamed, and viciously scanned the place where Ivan was standing, only to find that there was already no one there.
However, Ivan at this time had already taken advantage of the chaos to hide in the invisibility cloak and disappeared in front of them.
Ivan did not expect that his bloodline magic would be restrained in this way, and he took a deep look at Bok. He was able to find a way to deal with it in such a short period of time. Bok looked better than he thought. It's even more tricky!
"That kid must still be here, do everything to find him out!" Bok turned his head and shouted at the black-robed wizards who were still at a loss.
After finishing talking, Bock released the probing magic, and the powerful magic wave swept through the whole reception hall, but found nothing...
Ivan, wearing an invisibility cloak, wandered freely in the chaotic battlefield. He saw a black-robed sorcerer concentrate on the over-controlling patron saint, he immediately approached a few steps, and a curse was suddenly thrown on it!
"Shen Feng Wuying!"
The invisible blade of magic power shot out, and instantly cut off the right arm of the black-robed wizard holding the wand.
The next moment, a screaming scream resounded in the meeting room.
The black-robed wizard painfully clutched his right arm and knocked down a cabinet behind him, then tumbled and fell to the ground.
The reaction of Bok and others was not unpleasant. The moment Ivan made a sound, he locked his position. Without any hesitation, the colorful spell light had already hit him.
Ivan under the invisibility cloak also has a warning sign in his heart. Of course, the protective ring is not enough to resist so many curses at the same time!
But fortunately, he still has a magic ring!
Ivan almost unreservedly released the power stored in the circle of magic power, a powerful wave of magic power spread in all directions, and the curse that had not been close was annihilated, and a dark wizard who was closer It was even knocked out.
Ivan fled from the previous position in a tumble, and disappeared in front of them again with the help of the invisibility cloak.
Bock is almost going to be blown up with anger. To him, Ivan is like a mouse running around, making people disgusting.
However, the failure of the previous exploration magic has also made Bok vigilant, knowing that Ivan is not wearing an ordinary invisibility cloak, otherwise it would never be as powerful.
"I'm going to see when you can hide!" Although Bok was angry, he was not swallowed up by the anger, and soon found a solution. The blue candlelight in the corner around the wand was immediately extinguished, and the hall suddenly Plunged into the darkness.
Everyone looked at Bok inexplicably, wondering if he was ignorant, Bok pointed his magic wand again, and a white light hit the ceiling.
Under the shock, dots of powder sprinkled from the sky, exuding fluorescence, and shrouded everyone in the living room, reflecting the interior blue.
The powder also fell on the invisibility cloak worn by Ivan, marking the outline of his figure, and Bok immediately locked Ivan's position, and a strange green light cut through the darkness.
Avada Kedavra!
Ivan's complexion changed suddenly, and when he picked up his wand, the solid cabinet was lifted up to block him, and the green light hit it and exploded a pile of sawdust.
The other black-robed wizards did not respond slowly, and a few more spells shot out, and the cabinet was blown into pieces in a moment!
Ivan encouraged to construct two or three magical barriers, but they were broken one by one, and finally relied on the protective ring to barely resist this wave of attack!
In an instant, a few more curses came over.
I was teased fiercely by Ivan before, and everyone's heart was full of resentment. Now I finally discovered that Ivan's figure naturally vented out.
Facing round after round of uninterrupted attacks, Ivan was also a little weak. Faced with several powerful wizards, it was extremely difficult for him now.
Fortunately, at this moment, an orange-red fireball rammed into the hole on the left flocked to a crowd of black-robed wizards...
Bock and others had no choice but to separate a part of their hands to show off the fireball and block the fireball.
The pressure on Ivan's body was suddenly reduced, and he couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief. The support has finally arrived!
Although it was only a few tens of seconds from the time he used the first enchantment.
But for Ivan, it seemed extremely long, especially after the invisibility cloak failed, every second made him frightened!
After 　　 teamed up to cast a spell to easily block the thunderbolt explosion, Bok suddenly turned his head and looked at the breach on the right, his face turned very ugly.
In the smoke of gunpowder, Aysia's figure emerged. She was wearing a light blue wizard robe dedicated to battle. She looked very capable. On her shoulders was a cute velvet velvet. This little cute creature has two glows. With blue eyes, they look dazzling in the dim drawing room...
After rushing in, Esiah breathed a sigh of relief watching Ivan's safety, and then swept towards the messy reception hall and the scorched corpse in the underground. She was very surprised. She didn't expect Ivan to be alone. Can beat Bok and others like this.
"Asia! You really are not dead!" Bok looked at Asia's figure, gritted his teeth and said, it seemed that his spies were also deceived.
But after a brief surprise, Bok grinned again. If Aysia and Ivan were wearing that strange invisibility cloak and attacked in the dark, maybe it would cause them some trouble.
It’s undoubtedly a lunacy to appear so openly now. It just so happens that when he kills this kid today, he can get rid of it together with Aysia...

chapters.title: Chapter 340: Mixed doubles
chapters.content:
Ivan is a little strange how only Aysia is here,
Just when the attention of Bok and others were attracted to the two of them, the window not far above their heads suddenly burst, and a brown-gray werewolf jumped in from the window and ran into the crowd directly. A riot.
Then the brown-gray werewolf dragged one of the black-robed wizards to the side with a few spells.
Dougert, Fren and others also rushed over quickly, and several magic blasts were blasted out. The defensive black-robed wizard was defeated for a time.
"Shenfeng Wuying!" Of course, Ivan would not let go of this great opportunity, and a Shenfeng Wuying curse directly aimed at Bok, hitting his chest.
Aisia also stared at the other dark wizard, and the eyes of the puffed velvet on her shoulders burst out with blue light, and the mind of the dark wizard was sucked in.
At the moment he lost his senses, Esiah’s wand lightly tapped, and the magic talisman on the black silk glove that wrapped his right hand lit up one after another, and a series of two spells slammed on the black wizard’s body in a flash, and the latter was hit hard. He fell into the ruins and couldn't stand up for a long time.
Immediately afterwards, Esiah focused on the next target, but this time it was not so smooth. The opponent's influence was limited, and he quickly recovered, but looking at Esiah again was a little afraid.
"Bone to pieces!"
Without waiting for Aysia to continue to shoot, a dazzling light flew from the side, Aysia barely dodged, and turned his head to see Bok rising from the ground.
Bok clutched his chest, first gave Ivan a vicious look, then looked at Aisia, and said to the black-robed wizard who was not far away.
"Avoid the things on her shoulders, the eyes of that thing can affect the mind!"
Seeing Bok standing up again, Ivan was also a little surprised. A spell blasted the black wizard who was entangled with him out. After looking at Bok carefully, he noticed a ring on the finger of the opponent's left hand. There was a crack on it.
What kind of protective magic props are most likely to prevent him...
Bok's gaze swept over the mother and son in front of him, and he heard several screams from time to time. He didn't dare to delay any longer. With a flick of his magic wand, two huge black pythons of eight or nine meters long emerged from the black mist and ejected out. ,
"Drill your heart out!" Another black wizard blessed himself with the iron armor curse, and then chanted the curse again.
As early as when Bok started his hand, Ivan cast a Transfiguration Curse to turn the nearest counter into a bull, and hurriedly pressed against Bok and the others.
The two giant pythons bitten on Manniu's body but did not have much impact. The Heart Drilling spell made Manniu even more crazy. Bock and others only fought and retreated, from the living room to the store at the front desk. in.
