Aysia's pervasive killing intent, and the black light on the top of the wand, made Bok keenly aware of what was wrong. He stopped what he said and turned to look at Aysia with a little fear, and asked.
"What do you want to do?"
"Sorry, Bok, I think you know too much!" Aisia said with a sullen face, looking at Bok, slowly.
Bok's mind was stunned, but with his cleverness, he quickly realized that Aysia was jealous of himself, and he couldn't help but said in a hurry.
"Asiah, you have to believe me, I will never reveal this secret! Otherwise you can set up a secret magic for me"
"Really? I don't think it's rare to break such a contract to kill you!" Aysia interrupted Bok's words with a sneer.
As a master alchemist, Bok is naturally proficient in all kinds of contract magic, and he also knows how to get around the restrictions. Isiah can't be trusted!

chapters.title: Chapter 352: Recruit Werewolves
chapters.content:
Facing Aysia's question, Bok didn't know how to defend him for a while. He never thought that his identity as a master alchemist would one day become a hindrance!
Seeing Aysia lift up his wand, Bok couldn't help but smile horribly.
He suddenly thought that maybe he shouldn't be smart, if he didn't know Ivan's plan for the Ministry of Magic, maybe he still had a chance to survive.
However, after Aysia hesitated for a while, she temporarily put down her wand, then took out the Veritaserum, and forcibly poured it down on Bok.
Before killing Bok, Aysia wants to find out if the other party’s previous words are still hidden.
If possible, she is also going to let Bok reveal all the core alchemy knowledge
At the same time, in the empty ruins on the side of Knockdown Alley.
Ivan, who taught Hermione and Walker, didn't know that Bok was being treated inhumanely. He was still concentrating on the areas that they had missed during the practice.
"Walker, don't show me anything, concentrate!"
"And Hermione! Your emotions are not intense enough, know that the effect of this magic is blasting! You can imagine the feeling of destroying everything as much as possible! Slowly shake the wand down, pick it up again, and now say the spell !"
"A thunderbolt exploded!" Hermione muttered loudly. A tiny flame floated from the top of the wand, and then slowly expanded into a fist-sized orange-red fireball, then crashed into the ruins ahead.
boom!
With a roar and smoke, a huge boulder in the ruins was blown out of a pit the size of a human head.
"Very good! It looks like you have successfully learned it!" Ivan turned to look at Hermione, and said with a smile.
Hermione happily closed her mouth from ear to ear, but still reservedly said that she was still far away and needed to continue practicing.
She clearly remembered that the thunderbolt released by Ivan could easily blow up a wall. In comparison, her magical power was too weak.
Ivan shook her head amusedly, and Hermione was undoubtedly asking for trouble for comparing him.
But Ivan didn't mean to persuade Hermione. It is good to set a higher goal. At least the little witch is much better than her in the original time and space.
If the magical world becomes chaotic in the future, Hermione can also protect herself.
"Miss Granger, did you learn so soon?" Walker was also attracted by the sound of the explosion. He looked at the blasted hole in the boulder and said in a speechless voice.
He has just figured out some clues, and he doesn't know how long it will take to master the explosion.
"Well, I'm going to miss you now!" Ivan knew Walker's temperament, so he deliberately stimulated.
"Look at it, I'm fast too, at most twenty minutes!" Walker gritted his teeth and worked harder while admiring Hermione.
Ivan stood by and corrected Walker's mistakes while casting spells, while Hermione continued to review.
With Walker's hard work, he finally mastered this difficult magic before the sky was completely dark, and the ruins of stone piles were once again devastated.
Because Walker was five or six years older than Hermione, and had much more magical power than her, the power of the thunderbolt explosion was amazing, and it instantly blasted a large rock into pieces!
After seeing the destruction he had caused, Walker's previously defeated confidence was regained. Then he let himself go, one after another thunderbolt exploded towards the rubble, causing rubble to splash everywhere, and it was a great time to play.
"Okay, don't play anymore! Time is almost up, let's go back first!" Yifan interrupted aloud after looking at the dim sky.
Walker stopped unfinished, and Ivan then called Hermione again, and the three of them walked along the path towards the makeshift mansion.
Halfway through, Ivan remembered that when he had eaten before, seeing Fren's expression seemed a little gloomy, he asked aloud.
"Walker, are you having any troubles lately? I think Fren doesn't seem to be happy these days."
The happy look on Walker's face suddenly drooped, and he pours bitterness towards Ivan.
Since the Ministry of Magic found the corpses of several werewolf wizards in the Bojinbok Magic Store some time ago, it is already well known that the lives of these werewolves in Knockdown Alley became more and more difficult.
Many shops are reluctant to provide them with jobs. They feel that the werewolf wizards are a group of thugs, and even suspect that they participated in the attack on the magic shop. No matter how Fren and others explain it, it will not help.
If they hadn't been able to eat meals in the temporary mansion these days, they might have been hungry.
"Then why didn't you tell me earlier?" Ivan didn't expect that his raid on the Bogembock Magic Shop would cause such a big dilemma for Fren and others.
"Fren said he was going to try another day or two. If I can't persuade those stores, I will trouble you again." Walker scratched his head and said embarrassedly.
"What's the trouble with this? You risked your life before and helped me catch Bok. Speaking of it, I haven't had time to thank you." Ivan smiled, and then continued to speak.
"When you go back, you can talk to Fren and ask him if he is willing to work for me. As for the salary, it will be paid according to the salary of the general staff in Diagon Alley!"
"Really? That's great!" Walker said excitedly, and Fren had been worried about working for them for several days.
Not to mention that sometimes even if they find a suitable job, the salaries offered by those businesses are extremely low is not enough for their monthly daily expenses
In contrast, Ivan is simply too generous! Actually preparing to pay them the same salary as normal wizards, or according to the standards of Diagon Alley, this makes Walker feel like a dream!
But while excited, Walker also became a little worried, because in his opinion, Ivan didn't seem to need so much manpower.
But if he doesn't do anything with such a high salary, Walker always feels very awkward, thinking of this, Walker tentatively asked.
"Hals, I don't know what you are going to let us do?"
Ivan pondered for a moment, thinking that he had learned some interesting alchemy knowledge from Bok, and said.
"I will probably open a branch in Diagon Alley next year. It will definitely need someone to take care of it, and you will have to take care of extra security work!"
"Before that, you will help me with one more thing. I heard from Bok that he originally arranged some spies to go out to inquire about the news. Your task is to find them all!"

chapters.title: Chapter 353: Did you kill him? why?
chapters.content:
Of course, isn't it just looking for someone? There is no problem! "Hearing Ivan's request, Walker promised with a careless pat on his chest.
"Then this is my test for you!" Ivan smiled and said casually.
Walker nodded solemnly.
While chatting like this, the three quickly returned to the temporary mansion.
Ivan just opened the door and found that Aysia was sitting in the hall, flipping through a thick notebook.
"You are back" noticed the movement at the door, and Aysia raised her head.
Noting the dust and exhaustion on their bodies, Aysia took out her magic wand and ordered a bit on the round table. A plate of delicious desserts and a few glasses of milk juice were placed on the table.
"How is it? Is it going well? Would you like to have some supper?" Aixia asked with a smile.
"Very smoothly! Hermione learned this spell much faster than I expected. There is also Walker. The thunderbolt he used to explode is very powerful. It seems that this spell is very suitable for him!" Ivan looked at it. Glancing at Hermione and Walker, she said in praise.
Hermione pursed her mouth restrainedly, her eyes filled with joy, and Walker touched the back of her head and smiled triumphantly.
After practicing outside for so long, the three of them were a little hungry. Ivan picked up a piece of pastry and stuffed it into his mouth, and then drank half a glass of juice into it.
Although he didn't need to practice spelling, he was tired after explaining it for several hours.
"By the way, there is one thing I haven't told you that Bok is dead!" Aysia said suddenly.
what?
Ivan, who was drinking the juice, almost squirted the juice out in one sip. Didn't he remember that Bok wanted to open it recently? Obviously, I had a very happy chat with him in the afternoon.
Could it be that she suddenly became autistic again?
It's a pity for Ivan. In his opinion, Bok has a lot of crooked ideas, and he hasn't learned all Bok's alchemy knowledge yet, so he originally wanted Bok to live for a while.
"Anyway, you come with me first!" Aysia put down her notebook and stood up, her expression very serious.
Ivan nodded, and followed Aysia to the room where Bok was held.
After seeing Bok's body, Ivan realized that the situation was different from what he had imagined.
Bok didn't commit suicide at all, but was killed by some powerful black magic, and there was a faint black mist infiltrating the corpse.
Ivan frowned, subconsciously thinking that someone had sneaked in and killed Bok for some purpose, but then dismissed the idea because Ivan noticed that an empty reagent bottle was being dropped on the ground.
Ivan remembered that it was used to hold Veritaserum. After making it and using it once, he threw it into the storage room and put it together with the other potions. It was not very conspicuous.
If someone sneaks in, it’s impossible to know where the veritaserum is stored, let alone take the veritaserum for use in an upright manner. It is true that the others in the mansion are blind.
Therefore, there is only one possibility, and that is Aesia's hands!
"Mom, you killed him? Why?" Ivan looked at Esiah in confusion.
Although he knows that Aysia and Bok have been fighting for many years, he has been annoyed, but since he has not done anything before, it proves that Aysia can still tolerate Bok alive.
"Do you dare to ask me why? It's not because you told him so many things that shouldn't be said. Why don't you think about what if Bok didn't spread the door around? How much impact would it have on us? "Aysia squeezed Ivan's cheek angrily, and rebuked a little angrily.
Ivan was stunned for a moment, but after another thought, he quickly understood what Aysia was talking about.
Because of self-confidence, Ivan did not dare to refute. Indeed, without consent, he privately shared and discussed the core alchemy knowledge of Professor Aisia with Bok.
However, Ivan did not intend to let Bok go out alive, so he rashly determined that Bok could not have a chance to leak.
Now think about it wrongly.
After all, the people who had the opportunity to come into contact with Bok, in addition to him and Aysia, there were also those werewolf wizards, they should be more or less guarded.
Thinking of this, Ivan assured Esiah again and again that he would make a decision after discussing it with her next time.
After finally letting Esia calm down, Ivan then brought up another matter.
"Mom, Fren and the others lost their jobs because of our previous attack on the Bokimbock store, so I just agreed to recruit them to work for us.
As for wages, don’t worry. I made a lot of money at Hogwarts last year. If I put out a part of it, it will be enough for a long time."
It is inevitable that Aisia disagreed, and Ivan directly took Fren and others' wages. Anyway, it doesn't cost much to add up to a month. After the branch in Diagon Alley opens, it won't be long before you can make it back!
Aysia had already guessed that Ivan wanted to win over Fren and the others, and used these werewolf wizards as the core team to develop forces, so she agreed.
Fren and others have been watching the performance of Fren and others in the past two years. She has investigated the details of the werewolf wizard some time ago. There is nothing doubtful about it, and it can be trusted!
But thinking of this, Aysia hesitated for a moment, and couldn't help rubbing Ivan's hair to raise it. "There are some things you don't need to worry about, it's never too late to do it in a few years!"
Aisia felt that Ivan seemed a little too anxious. Even if he had the ideal of transforming the magic world and was ready to target Dumbledore, it would take one step at a time, and it would be better to wait until he became an adult to arrange it slowly.
"How can it work?" Ivan shook his head firmly For him, of course, the sooner the better!
Don’t look at Bok’s death now, and those dark wizards who need to be vigilant have also been killed completely, but Knockover Alley is not safe after all, it is better to open the magic shop to Diagon Alley!
"Ah, do it with you!" Looking at the stubborn Ivan, Aysia sighed.
Now that Ivan insisted on doing so, Aysia stopped persuading him, and instead gave him the notebook she had been carrying before.
"This is what I asked from Bok using Veritaserum. It should be something he has kept without teaching you."
Ivan took this thick notebook over and looked at it, and found that the contents recorded in it were all advanced alchemy and dark magic knowledge, which should be the things that Bok really pressed at the bottom of the box.
Ivan was very pleasantly surprised. He was a pity that he lacked a mentor who could help him quickly improve alchemy after Bok died, but he didn't expect that Aysia would actually use Veritaserum to record this knowledge.

chapters.title: Chapter 354: Ivan: What? My ambition swelled again?
chapters.content:
After getting this alchemy note, Ivan couldn't wait to go back and study it.
Aisia waved her magic wand, releasing a few wisps of fierce fire, which slowly landed on Bok's chest, and then the fierce fire became more and more vigorous, and the tongue of fire gradually licked the entire corpse.
After a while, the fierce fire gradually extinguished under the control of Aysia, and Bok's body also turned to ashes, floating in the air...
After the corpse was destroyed, Aysia turned and left. She was shocked too much today, and she had to digest it. It just so happens that she also needs to think about how to help Ivan complete such a huge plan...
...
On the other side, Ivan, who returned to the room, was flipping through the alchemy notes, and a system prompt sounded in his mind.
[Ding, the task: Become the King of Knock Down Alley (first ring) has been completed...]
Ivan stopped reading the pages of the book. After a while, he remembered that this task was received during the summer vacation of the first grade.
Thinking of this, Ivan opened the taskbar and checked it.
【Become the King of Knock Down Alley (1st Ring)
Mission objective: conquer the werewolf wizard in Knockdown Alley
Mission period: two years
Task status: Completed
Task reward: powerful wolf poison potion formula (not received)]
"Is it because I officially hired those werewolf wizards?" Ivan muttered to himself while looking at the task panel, touching his chin.
During last summer vacation, he had a very good relationship with Fren and others, and he was even able to ask them to help himself with some things.
However, Ivan was still very strange that this task was not completed for a long time, so I temporarily left it behind. I didn't expect that a reminder of task completion was automatically popped up today.
It looks like it should be related to telling Walker that he is willing to hire them...
"Receive the reward!" After thinking about it, Ivan said silently in his heart.
The next moment, the formula of the powerful wolf poison potion was displayed in the system bar.
【Strong Wolf Poison Potion (Potion Formula)
Required materials: werewolf blood, soothing flower, sage rhizome, wolf-shaped aconite, lovage, moonstone powder...
Description: This is a special improved potion. The werewolf wizard who drinks it will have the ability to freely control the transformation within 50 days and stay awake at all times in the transformation state.
Note: Werewolves in this state no longer have the ability to infect. 】
After checking the effect of the powerful wolf poison potion, Ivan was very surprised.
Although this is somewhat different from what he had previously expected, it does not have the function to completely heal the werewolf wizard, but in a certain way, it is more powerful than the cure for the werewolf wizard!
Because this can greatly increase the combat effectiveness of Furen and others!
After all, the physical fitness of the wizard in the werewolf state will be enhanced a lot, and he has a certain magic resistance and extraordinary recovery ability.
If you are sane, it will definitely be a nightmare for most wizards!
It can be clearly seen from the previous raid on the Bojinbok Magic Shop that Walker was able to withstand several spells and rushed into the crowd at the time, causing panic and riots, and easily defeated them for Dougte and others. The black robe wizard provides convenience.
A werewolf wizard who can freely control his transformation, even so terrifying, let alone a group!
Ivan can even predict how Fren’s opponents will collapse when they find a group of werewolves who use various tactics rushing towards them!
"It seems that I promised them before, and I have something to deal with!" Ivan couldn't help but let out a sigh of relief.
He knows that Fren and others are so partial to him, part of the factor is that he hopes that he can develop a potion to cure werewolves.
Although the powerful wolf poison potion can't do this, it is still one step closer to the goal.
【The new mission has been activated! 】
While Ivan was thinking about it, the system prompt sounded in his mind again.
Ivan was not too surprised. Since the previous task was the first ring, there must be a second ring and a third ring, so I looked through it.
【Become the King of Knock Down Alley
Mission goal: Unified Knockdown Alley (Second Ring Road)
Task progress: 9%
Quest reward: Courageous Loyalty Mantra
Task description: After having the first minion composed of werewolf wizards, your ambition gradually expands! However, before achieving the more ambitious goals, you decide to form your own forces first...
Note: Cunning hunters usually hide their bodies in the dark before launching an offensive. The chaotic and unattended Knockout Alley is your best target. 】
system, you are here again!
Ivan looked at the task description and remarks displayed on the taskbar, and was really powerless to complain.
He just wants to be a salted fish wizard, study magic every day, earn a little gold and live a life of leisure, instead of thinking about how to do things all day long!
Look at the first two dark kings who are doing things. One is worse than the other. Ivan feels that his life is going well and he has no lofty ambitions. It's better not to die!
The most important thing is that the reward for this task is really mediocre. It is an extremely powerful magic that he can't use at all-the loyalty spell!
The effect of this magic is very single, and its function is to hide a secret in the soul of a living person forever.
For example, in the original time and space, in order to protect the safety of James and Lily, Dumbledore imposed a loyalty curse on their house, turning the existence of this house into a secret and hiding it in the keeper In the soul of Peter Pettigrew.
After the spell came into effect, the house was protected by powerful magic, and other insiders could never tell the location of the house.
As long as the secretaries don’t betray, even if Voldemort puts his nose on the glass in the living room of James’s house, they can’t find where they are!
And there is only one known way to crack the Curse of Courageous Loyalty, that is, the confidential person actively leaks information to let others know. That was what Peter Pettigrew did. He told Voldemort where James and Lily were, making this powerful curse. Invalidate.
If the confidential person dies halfway, all the insiders that still exist will be transformed into new confidential persons. The increase in the number of confidential people means that as long as there is a traitor among them, the hidden secret will be revealed.
This kind of magic is usually used to avoid chasing and killing, or to build a secret army station.
System means obviously the latter...
However, Ivan does not intend to do this kind of thing!
It’s not fragrant to earn some money in the magic world safely and steadily these years, then find a place to fish all day, and do something that interests you?
Why should I be forced to take the risk of being chased by the Ministry of Magic and the Order of the Phoenix, and keep making troubles...

chapters.title: Chapter 355: This task will not be completed by yourself, right?
chapters.content:
Thinking of this, Ivan even wondered if the system was bound to the wrong person.
If you change to an ambitious traveler who wants to do a big business, you will be ecstatic to get this system, because you only need to follow the system's prompts to complete the task step by step, and you will be able to successfully reach the top of the magic world!
Although Ivan often complains about the system's unreliability, but in my heart he understands that if he wants to recruit people to do a big business, Knockdown Alley is indeed a good choice.
The magical world has just experienced a turmoil more than ten years ago. If anyone dares to follow the old path of the two dark kings, publicize their ideas and win over wizards to form forces, they will definitely arouse the attention and fear of the Ministry of Magic, and they may not grow up yet. Getting up was strangled in advance.
But Knock Down Alley is different. It is far away from the sight of the Ministry of Magic. It is not so easy to attract attention. It is a hidden dragon and a tiger. There are a large number of dangerous dark wizards. If it can be integrated, it is definitely a force that cannot be ignored!
"Unfortunately, I am not the piece of the Dark Lord..." Ivan shook his head mockingly.
I know my family's affairs, and Ivan knows very well that he has no management skills. If he has a lot of dark wizards, it will be just plain guilt for himself.
Therefore, even if this system task is arranged, Ivan is not going to touch it, anyway, there is no task penalty, just let it go.
It can't be done by itself, right?
Ivan smiled, he remembered the last time the Dark Lord wished that this task was done by Tom for him. Now that it is a coincidence...
Since it was determined that the newly appeared task was unlikely to be completed, Ivan threw it aside and continued to study Bok's alchemy notes, and did not fall asleep until late at night.
......
The next day, early.
After eating breakfast in a hurry, Ivan entered the hall, planning to ask Fren and others for some wolf blood to make the latest type of wolf poison potion.
I didn't expect to stroll around, but Ivan unexpectedly discovered that the werewolf wizards weren't here.
Ivan asked Esiah very strangely, only to learn that they had gone out at night last night and have not come back yet.
waited until the afternoon, when Fren and the others walked in from the door with a look of exhaustion, several werewolves carrying two strange wizards on their shoulders.
"Fren, what are you guys..." Ivan had some guesses in his heart when he saw their dusty appearance, but he wasn't sure yet.
Before Fren could answer, Walker said with a grin. "Didn't you let us catch the spies sent by Bok? No, we've already caught you!"
"So fast? You didn't sleep all night, right?" Ivan confirmed the previous guess, and combined with Aysia's previous rhetoric, he knew that they must have started the action last night.
"Hey, I told everyone about your willingness to hire us to work last night, but they couldn't sleep with excitement, so everyone discussed and planned to finish the test you gave us before we talked!" Walker scratched his head. , Said with a smile.
Ivan shook his head helplessly. Although he wanted these werewolf wizards to help him deal with these potential troubles, he was not so anxious. It would be fine for a few days later.
"It should be sooner rather than later to catch these spies. Once they are alert to escape, it won't be so easy to find them again..." Fren explained aloud.
Other werewolf wizards also said that they were too idle lately and had nothing to do, so they went out to catch a few spies at night, just to move their bones...
And with the clues Ivan got from Bok, and the exchange codes, it was relatively simple to find someone.
Fren put the black wizard down on his shoulders, then his expression became more serious, and he continued to speak.
"We have only caught two people for the time being, and four others have not been found for the time being. Judging from the information we found out, they may have escaped from Knockout Alley... I am afraid that we want to capture these people for some time."
four people?
Ivan's heart moved, remembering that he and Sirius had eliminated Bok's four men in Knockturn Alley, and said with a smile.
"Don't worry about those four people, they should be dead by now."
Fren was stunned, and didn't quite understand why Ivan was so sure.
But Furen didn't ask too much. Ivan is not an ordinary little wizard. Since that's what he said, he has his own reason. Maybe he got some definite news.
Since this incident involved a time converter, it was too troublesome to say. Ivan didn't explain the meaning carefully, so he skipped it, and instead told the news that he had improved a new type of wolf poison potion.
"What?" Hearing that Ivan had new results so soon, Fren and others became excited.
"Of course, this improved wolf's poison potion cannot completely cure your disease. It can only be regarded as an enhanced version of the ordinary wolf's poison potion. You will know the specific effect when I make it." Misunderstanding, and finally disappointed, he added.
There was no disappointed expression on Furen's face. He didn't think that the problems that had troubled him for decades would be solved so quickly, but he said gratefully.
"This is already very good! I really don't know how to thank you, Hals! I didn't expect you to keep thinking about the wolf poison potion!"
Walker and others are also very touched In their opinion, Ivan has paid too much for their werewolf wizards to live a normal life as soon as possible!
Although they don’t know how difficult it is to improve the potion, it is definitely not easy to do. It usually takes a lot of time and energy to try.
No wonder Ivan is always holding a book or note, it must be researching the improvement method of the wolf poison potion.
After trying to understand, many werewolf wizards hurriedly spoke out to persuade Ivan not to be too eager, and to pay more attention to rest. The time in the future is still very long, they can afford to wait!
Ivan was a little embarrassed. In fact, he didn't spend much time on the wolf poison potion. Both formulas were still given by the system.
But in the gratitude and encouragement of everyone, Ivan could not slap himself in the face, but had to accept it cheeky...
"By the way, my improved potion still needs someone to test the medicine, who of you would like to help?" Thinking of the purpose of looking for them, Ivan asked.
Although drinking a modified potion would accompany many unknown risks, the werewolf wizards present did not care and all expressed their willingness to be his tester.
After all, Ivan, an outsider, has worked so hard, how can these werewolf wizards fear the risk to hinder Ivan?

chapters.title: Chapter 356: This is the side effect you are talking about?
chapters.content:
"Don't fight, let me do it!" Fren interrupted Walker and the others, and directly took over the task of testing the medicine.
"How can that work?" Walker shook his head. He felt that he had the ability to transform into a werewolf freely. It would be better for him to test the dangerous work of medicine. In case something goes wrong, his survival rate is also good. Higher.
However, the other werewolf wizards disagreed with this, because Walker came to try the medicine last time, so this time it's hard to let him take the risk again.
Seeing these werewolf wizards you quarreled with me, and even planned to quarrel, Ivan was speechless and stopped speaking.
"Okay, you guys stop for a while!"
After Ivan spoke, Fren and others stopped talking and turned to look at him.
"Are you so unconfident in the potion I made?" Ivan shook his head helplessly, then cleared his throat and continued.
"I just want to find someone to experiment with the specific effects of the potion. I can assure you that there is no danger in this process. Anyone can come!"
Ivan is all about it, Walker and others are not fighting, and finally Fren insists that he drink the improved wolf poison potion.
Ivan again asked the werewolf wizards for some wolf blood, then went back to the room to make potions, and told them that if nothing else, the new wolf poison potion could be finished tomorrow morning. .
Fren, Walker and others are both looking forward to and embarrassed, that is, they hope to get a surprise, and they are also worried about whether Ivan's potion improvement will succeed.
Fren has even thought out some comforting words in advance. In case there is something unexpected with the improved version of the wolf poison potion or the effect is not ideal, he will give a few words of comfort, so that Ivan will not lose confidence because of it. .
spent the night like this. The next morning, when Ivan came out of the room with the boiled wolf poison potion, Fren and others were already waiting in the hall.
Isiah and Dougte, who heard about this, are also here.
Especially Doug's look at Ivan was very strange. He remembered that Isiah told him that after Ivan's return this time, the level of alchemy had been greatly improved, and it had already surpassed her.
As far as he knows, Ivan’s strength has also improved a lot during this time, and now he can still spare time to improve the potion...
Even a genius is too exaggerated, right? Doug sighed inwardly.
At this time, Fren has already taken the potion that Ivan handed over, and poured it down sharply!
gurgling...
The icy cold potion flowed from the throat to the stomach, and then gradually spread to the whole body. Fren closed his eyes and felt it, and always felt that it was no different from the original version of the wolf's poison potion.
Did it fail? Or does the improved version of the Wolf Poison Potion only extend the duration of the potion? So he can't feel it?
Just as Fren was thinking this way, he heard Ivan's voice coming over.
"Now you can try to see if you can become a werewolf!"
Become a werewolf?
Fren was stunned, and everyone else present also showed doubts. It is not the night of the full moon, unless...
Thinking of this, Fren tried hard, recalling the feeling of transforming on the night of the full moon.
After a while, Fren’s figure began to swell rapidly, his limbs quickly elongated and became strong and powerful, and silver-white hair also crazily extended from the body...
嗷嗷...
Along with the howling of a wolf, a silver-white werewolf with a strong physique more than two meters tall appeared in front of everyone, and the brown eyes on the big head showed an unbelievable look.
He turned into a werewolf without a full moon?
Fren looked down at his furry, very sturdy hands. It was indeed a werewolf form.
"Is this the effect of improving the wolf poison potion?" Fran asked with a big mouth full of fangs, with a hint of excitement.
The other werewolf wizards turned their heads one after another and turned their eyes to Ivan's body. They were also shocked when they saw Fren turned into a werewolf.
It should be known that except for the aliens like Walker, werewolf wizards cannot transform unless the moon is full. This makes them no different from ordinary wizards except for stronger vitality most of the time. .
not only does not enjoy the bonus of combat power in the form of werewolves, but also suffers from the discriminatory eyes of others...
"Yes!" Under everyone's gaze, Ivan nodded.
"So we can all be the same as Walker? How long can the effect of this potion last?" Fren shook his fist and felt the power that was constantly emerging in his body.
He felt that if he could keep fighting in this form, his combat power would definitely double...
"This potion can last about fifty days." Ivan explained.
"That is to say, during the whole fifty days, we can switch back and forth between the two forms of werewolf and wizard at will?" Furen was very surprised. The improved potion Ivan developed was beyond him. Imagination.
He originally thought that the wolf poison potion improved by Ivan would extend the duration and reduce the cost, but he did not expect that the effect would be so powerful.
"That's right!" Ivan smiled, and then continued. "But this improved potion has another effect, um...I don't know if this is considered a side effect."
Hearing Ivan's words, Walker and the others suddenly became nervous, but Fren felt normal After all, this potion has such a strong effect, and some side effects are not unacceptable.
But if the side effects are too strong, such as life loss, you need to weigh whether the situation is urgent or not.
Fren's brows were frowning, but Ivan had guessed what he was thinking, and spoke to dispel the doubts in their hearts.
"Don't worry, it's not that serious, it just temporarily loses the ability to infect other wizards."
In Ivan's view, the biggest threat to a werewolf is not the outstanding recovery ability and physical fitness, but the ability to infect the enemy into the same kind through teeth and claws!
This makes the wizards who are fighting against them have to put up 12 points of energy, so as not to be scratched or bitten by the opponent, and thus restrain their hands and feet, greatly reducing their combat power.
"That's it?" Furen couldn't laugh or cry for a while, what a side effect.
Walker and others also breathed a sigh of relief, and then some people gradually realized that Ivan seemed to have said something extraordinary.
A werewolf wizard took the lead to react, eagerly grasping Ivan's wrist, and asked with trembling lips.
"Halse...you just said that this potion can make us lose the ability to infect other wizards?"

chapters.title: Chapter 357: Dougt: I had guessed that he had a big picture!
chapters.content:
"is this real?"
The werewolves cast their eyes on Ivan, their eyes full of expectation.
After seeing Ivan nodding again, the werewolf wizards could no longer restrain their emotions, and suddenly burst into tears.
Although Ivan also knew that the effects of the new potion would be helpful to these werewolf wizards, he didn't quite understand why they were so excited.
"Thank you, Hals! You show us the hope of being truly accepted by the magical world!"
At this time, Fren, who had changed from a werewolf form back to his original appearance, came up with emotion and patted Ivan on the shoulder and spoke.
Noting the puzzled look on Ivan's face, Fren quickly explained it to him.
The reason why wizards in the magical world fear werewolf wizards so much, in addition to losing their minds and running away every full moon night, more importantly, they are afraid of being bitten by themselves
After all, there is no cure in the magical world today. Once attacked, it will inevitably be infected and transformed into a new werewolf!
And the werewolf wizard in normal form is not absolutely safe, and still has a slight transmission ability, so few wizards are willing to be friends with werewolves.
The improved potion that Ivan has developed now undoubtedly allows them to see the possibility of being accepted by the magic world... If all werewolves can take this potion regularly, then it will take a few years for the magic world to have an attitude towards werewolves. Greatly changed!
After a while of collective excitement, Furen and others soon realized a very important question, that is, how much does this improved potion cost?
Can they afford it?
The werewolf wizards once again looked at Ivan eagerly, waiting for his answer.
"I still need to continue to study and improve this version of the wolf poison potion, so I won't sell it for the time being." Ivan shook his head and explained.
The modified wolf poison potion is different from the original version of the wolf poison potion. It can greatly enhance the combat effectiveness of the werewolf wizard. Of course, it is impossible for Ivan to let it flow into the market.
Just like this time, a werewolf wizard chose to collude with Bok to attack Esiah in order to obtain the recipe of the wolf poison potion. After Voldemort's resurrection in the original time and space, he also attracted a large number of werewolves to join the Death Eater army, so Ivan would not add obstacles to himself. Potential enemies increase their combat power!
But for Fren and others, of course Ivan will not restrict them from obtaining improved wolf poison potions, so I plan to provide them with a bottle every fifty days, which is regarded as a welfare for their employees.
"No! Hals, you have done too much for us, and researching potions always requires funding. Let's buy them at the normal price!" Fren said sincerely.
He didn't agree with Ivan's idea of ​​providing wolf poison potions for free. He felt that Ivan had helped them a lot, and Fran was really embarrassed to accept Ivan's kindness with the shame.
Walker and others have the same idea. Since Ivan provides them with a stable job, they are more willing to use their own salary to buy it!
Seeing Fren and the others insist on being so persistent, Ivan's face is a little weird, but he can't say anything.
A potion of improved wolf poison is not cheap.
Although he promised to pay Fren and others with the treatment of Dijiao Alley employees, in fact, the salary of Dijiao Alley employees is generally not high. Compared with Knock Down Alley, it appears to be more. Buy a bottle of modified wolf poison. The medicine will cost 60 to 70% of their salary.
In other words, he only needs to spend some time every fifty days to boil a few bottles of potions for them, and give them some money to eat, so that they can work for themselves, and Fren and others have to thank themselves in turn...
Thinking of this, Ivan inevitably feels that he is an evil capitalist desperately squeezing employees.
But soon, Ivan put this illusion behind in the gratitude of the werewolf wizards...
Evil capitalists and exploiters can't get the compliments from employees...
At the same time, Dougert, who was watching this scene silently, couldn't help but exclaimed with emotion. "Little Ivan really surpassed my expectations... he was able to develop such a powerful potion for improvement!"
Aisia also nodded secretly in his heart. In this way, Fren and others not only increased their strength, but also expressed gratitude to Ivan.
What surprised Esiah even more was that Ivan did not covet the small profit to sell the improved wolf poison potion, but chose to hold this potion tightly in his hand, becoming a bargaining chip to attract many werewolf wizards to come and take refuge. Control their foundation.
This method is not smart, but it is extremely effective.
If you get used to the power and convenience of taking the wolf poison potion regularly, those werewolves might say that they are reluctant to leave...
"Dougt, do you remember what you told me last time?" As he thought, Acia turned her head to look at Dougt, and said.
"You mean?" Dougt was stunned, then looked at Esiah in surprise.
Of course he knows what Asiah is talking about,
As early as the summer vacation of the last school year, Dougte keenly noticed that Ivan's plan was very big, and even saw that person's shadow in Ivan's body!
So he discussed it with Aysia privately, but Aysia didn't really believe his rhetoric at the time, saying that he would consider it after Ivan became an adult.
"Now I understand that you are right! If I hadn't used Veritaserum to learn a lot from Bok I am afraid he has been kept in the dark." Aisia sighed. , Spoke out.
"Little Ivan has always had his own thoughts. If he deliberately conceals one thing, it is normal that you can't find out..." Speaking of this, Doug shook his head. Many of Ivan's recent behaviors are even somewhat elusive for him I can't see through.
For example, this time the improvement of the wolf's poison potion, Dougter doubted whether Ivan had already developed the perfect wolf's poison potion last year, which could completely cure the werewolves.
just kept secret, and deliberately made some defective products, but they are taking them out one by one...
used the lowest-end wolf poison potion for sale to earn gold gallons and increase fame, gaining the favor of most werewolf wizards.
The improved version of the wolf poison potion is used to improve the combat power of the werewolves who are loyal to him.
The remaining ones are used as bait, and one of them is taken out every few years. In short, these werewolf wizards have been hanging around so that they can't betray the idea.
If it weren't like that, how could Ivan be able to make the effect of the wolf poison potion qualitatively improved in just one year?
You must know that Ivan spends most of his time in class, and he has not lost his strength and alchemy.
So... this is the only possibility!

chapters.title: Chapter 358: Give him another "surprise" when he comes back!
chapters.content:
Wanting to understand this, Dougte is more certain of his guess, and can't help feeling that Ivan has such deep thoughts at a young age.
But Ivan's so good performance also made Dougte move some thoughts, he thought this might be an opportunity for him!
A chance to recapture everything that was lost!
Thinking over and over again, Dougt's deadly heart can't help but agitated. Over the years, he has been hiding in Knockout Alley, drunk and dreaming, just because he can't see any hope.
But it is different now. With Ivan's talent and potential, it will take a few years to grow up to the level of the previous Dark Lord.
Such power, coupled with Ivan's meticulous mind and his assistant, it is not difficult to dominate the entire magical world!
Just thinking about it, Dougt is a burst of enthusiasm...
He had anticipated the scene when he returned to St Mungo’s Magical Injury Hospital with a large number of people in a few years... How surprised Bohan’s face would be.
Then he will let his father know whose choice is right!
Aisia saw Dougert’s reaction in her eyes, and a smile was drawn at the corner of her mouth. She understood that Dougert had taken the bait, and once Dougert’s extensive contacts were available to help, many things would become much easier.
Ivan on the other side knows nothing about it.
After experimenting with the effect of the improved wolf poison potion, and confirming that it was not different from the one shown on the system, Ivan acted as a hand shaker and sent Fren and others to Esiah, and asked her to arrange to be responsible for these werewolf wizards. For his work, he can study other topics with peace of mind.
He didn't forget that there is one last thing to do, which is to study the improved compound decoction, and then ask Hermione at that time to give medicine to the past self to complete the final time loop.
Some time ago, because Bok performed well and taught himself alchemy, Ivan was not embarrassed to use Bok as a guinea mouse, and the development of the potion temporarily stopped.
Now Furen has just brought back two spies who can be used as new testers, so the research can be resumed...
A few days passed in a flash.
The research progress of the improved compound decoction is much faster than Ivan expected, because he found a large number of evil human experiments in the precious black magic books he obtained from the Bojinbok magic shop, saving a lot of research time .
Rao is so, the two "little mice" have also been tortured horribly in the past few days. Without the forgetting curse to eliminate the memory, they are a little mentally disordered.
So after the potion was boiled, Ivan kindly ended their lives, incidentally, using the repaired ring of fierce fire, burned their bodies to ashes...
Everything went smoothly and couldn't go smoothly. The only thing that made Ivan a little puzzled was why he hadn't been teleported back to his original time and space.
Is this time staying so long?
Ivan frowned involuntarily. Before officially using the time converter to reverse time and space, he had done a test, which proved that as long as the time of a single retrospect exceeds five hours, it will be kicked back to the original time at any time. point.
However, the specific residence time has not been calculated, it seems to be completely random, and there is no rule at all.
"Forget it, anyway, I've done everything that I should do, so I just return to Hogwarts tomorrow..." Ivan picked up the improved compound soup and put it in the pocket of the wizard's robe, muttering to himself .
He has been in Turn Down Alley for two full months, and the day after tomorrow is the day when school starts on September 1.
In addition, Ivan did not forget that he was riding a eagle-headed horse with a winged beast. If this big guy is still waiting for him in the jungle, he will have to bring the other back home again.
Ivan made a decision secretly in his heart, so in the afternoon, Ivan went to Esiah to talk about his plan to go to Hogwarts tomorrow.
"Tomorrow? But didn't you start school the day after tomorrow?" Dougert asked strangely.
Ivan also didn't explain, he arbitrarily prevaricates the past, he didn't talk to Dougter about the time converter, lest he should be guessed by Dougter that he bombed his home!
Dougert didn't mean to ask any more. After Ivan left, he asked Aysia.
"Should we discuss that matter with Ivan in advance?"
"No..." Esiah hesitated for a moment, and shook her head.
Since Ivan intends to return to Hogwarts, it is better not to mention it, lest he be distracted while studying.
Anyway, Fren and others are now greatly increasing their combat power, and Dougte has also summoned many friends to help. This is already an extremely powerful force in Knockdown Alley.
So it's better to wait for Ivan to surprise him when he comes back!
Doug nodded, and did not refute, but continued to ask another important question. "What about the funding? Have you thought about it?"
"Don't worry about this. I asked Bok about the location of the store vault. There are tens of thousands of thousands of people in it. Even if we recruit some more people, I don't have to worry about funding in a short time." Aysia explained.
It’s a pity that she can’t get the large sums of money the Bok family has saved in Gringotts but she can still find a way to take over the business of Bok, and then take over the wizarding market in the future. There is no need to worry about the shortage of funds.
"That's good!" Dougt was relieved immediately. Although his friends were all good at it, the asking price was not cheap.
"By the way, Dougt, do you have a way to get it from the Bokimberk Magic Shop?" Aysia thought of the title deed that Ivan had brought back.
She hadn't paid attention to Bojinbok Magic Shop before, because she didn't want to cause trouble. After all, Bok was killed by them. If she participated in the fight for the ownership of the Magic Shop, she might be found out by the Ministry of Magic.
But since Ivan has such ambitious ambitions, she can take a bit more aggressive risk in acting.
After all, the location of the Bojinbok Magic Shop is very good, and it is also a transit point in Knockdown Alley. It is very suitable for transforming into a power station and gathering base.
"Bock’s magic shop?" Dougter frowned. As far as he knew, the Bogin Bock magic shop was spotted by a few difficult characters, and it was not easy to take it down.
But when Aysia took out the title deed, Dougert's frowning brow eased again. He didn't expect Aysia to get this, it would indeed work.
It happened that his house was blown up by the people of Bok, and there was still a place to stay!

chapters.title: Chapter 359: Return to Hogwarts
chapters.content:
The next morning, Ivan, who had had breakfast, took Hermione out to return to Hogwarts.
Before leaving, Ivan turned his head and said to Aisia and the others who had come to send him.
"Mom... Dean Dougert, then I'll go back to school first! And Fren, Walker... If you have anything, remember to write to me!"
A group of werewolf wizards patted their chests and promised Ivan that they can rest assured!
Ivan nodded. A group of werewolf wizards who can transform freely are an extremely powerful force in Knockdown Alley, enough to deal with most of the troubles.
And Bok is dead, the black wizards who slipped through the net were killed completely, and no one else in Knockdown Alley would deliberately target Esiah.
Thinking of this, Ivan no longer cared, and said to Hermione beside him.
"Let's go, Hermione!"
"Hmm!" Hermione replied, holding Ivan's wrist tightly.
"Apparition!"
Ivan chanted the spell and waved his wand, accompanied by a burst of light and shadow, the two figures seemed to be sucked into the whirlpool, and disappeared before everyone's eyes in an instant.
Hermione only felt the world spin, and when she opened her eyes, she found herself in an unfamiliar wood. A retro station can be seen in the distance, which is vaguely familiar. It seems that they travel to the Wizarding Station of Hogwarts every year.
"Where is this? Aren't we going to Hogwarts?" the little witch asked aloud in confusion.
"Hogwarts is equipped with anti-phantom shifting magic, we can't go there directly... and we have to take a big guy back with us, if it's still here." Ivan explained casually. In a word, he looked around, sensing the tracking magic previously set.
Since two full months have passed, Ivan found that the magic he had set had become very vague, and he could only sense the opponent's general direction. After a day or two, this magic would probably be completely ineffective.
Hermione was confused, and she didn't understand what Ivan meant. When she was about to ask, Ivan suddenly looked towards the sky and spoke.
"It's coming!"
Who? Who is coming? Hermione followed Ivan's gaze, then her eyes widened.
In the sky, a reddish-brown behemoth was swooping down towards them with its wide wings stretched out, and the beautiful feathers shimmered in the sun, appearing extremely dazzling.
"This is the eagle-headed horse-winged beast? But why is it here?" Hermione's brown eyes were full of surprise, and she quickly recognized that this big guy was probably in Hagrid's class. The one I saw above.
"Of course I brought it from the forbidden forest, so now I have to take it back with me!" Ivan said with a smile.
The two of them chatted about this time, the red-brown eagle-headed horse-winged beast had already shaken its wings and landed in front of Ivan, actively leaning over the huge head, and licking Ivan with his tongue. On his cheek, he leaned into the pocket of Ivan the wizard's robe and sniffed for something.
"Good buddy, it seems that you have a good memory!" Ivan stretched out his hand and stroked the eagle-headed horse-winged beast's head, but immediately noticed the opponent's movements and continued with some helplessness.
"Don't look for it, this time I don't have the vitality potion."
Perhaps after he understood Ivan's words, the reddish-brown behemoth raised his head with disappointment in his eyes, but soon his attention was attracted by Hermione again, and looked at her with a little caution.
Noting the closeness of the eagle-headed horse-winged beast to Ivan, the clever little witch quickly understood that Ivan had already tamed this behemoth.
It's no wonder that in the magical animal protection class, the other party would take the initiative to lean in.
"Are we going to ride it back to Hogwarts this time?" Hermione was a little worried. She had never tried riding a eagle-headed horse with a winged beast to school.
"Yes! But you have to get its approval before that..." Ivan said with a smile. "You haven't forgotten what Hagrid taught during class?"
"Of course! You need to bow to it and wait for the other person's response. In the process, you need to stare at the eyes of the eagle-headed horse and winged beasts. This helps to gain their trust..."
Hermione gushed and repeated what Hagrid had said in class, but she was a little nervous when she really faced the behemoth.
She suddenly remembered that in Hagrid's class, this big guy didn't seem to like herself very much, so she was worried that she would not be recognized by the eagle-headed horse-winged beast.
However, under Ivan's encouraging gaze, Hermione remained calm, staring at the red-brown behemoth in front of him, and bent down and bowed.
The eagle-headed horse-winged beast slapped its nose and let out a crisp eagle cry from time to time, examining the weak witch in front of him, unwilling to lower the proud head.
Hermione didn't give up, looked at her with her slightly sour eyes, and bowed again later.
Perhaps it was the sense of Hermione’s sincere attitude that the eagle-headed horse-winged beast’s attitude softened, and Ivan was soothing by the side, and it didn’t take long to bend its scaly front knee to face Hermione Bowed.
The little witch was so happy cautiously approaching a few steps, seeing that the eagle-headed horse-winged beast did not react too much, she stretched out her hand and stroked the red-brown feathers.
The eagle-headed horse-winged beast also responded positively, enjoying Hermione's petting, and licking Hermione's palm with his tongue.
Ivan was a little surprised to see that the eagle-headed horse-winged beast was so close to Hermione.
He also remembered that this red-brown behemoth was not friendly to Hermione when he was in the magical animal protection class, so Ivan even managed to appease the eagle-headed horse-winged beast by himself, allowing it to temporarily allow Hermione and himself The idea of ​​riding together.
Just like Harry in the original time and space as a rider, he can take Hermione and Sirius to fly together.
But things went smoother than he expected, or it was beyond his expectations...
"Come on!" Ivan didn't think much, and quickly leaped to the back of the eagle-headed horse-winged beast, and then stretched out her hand to pull Hermione up and let her sit in front of her.
After the little witch sat down, the eagle-headed horse-winged beast flapped its wings spiritually, brought up a cloud of smoke, and flew straight into the sky!
Hermione was taken aback, holding the feathers on the back of the eagle-headed horse with winged beasts in both hands. This was the first time she rode this behemoth. When Malfoy was almost attacked in class, Hermione did not There was no chance to ride a eagle-headed horse-winged beast into the air like everyone else.

chapters.title: Chapter 360: Annoying Dementors
chapters.content:
The strong wind blew Hermione's face, making her a little bit unable to open her eyes, and the upward momentum shook her figure a little, as if she was about to fall.
"Don't worry.. Just hold it firmly, it won't fall off." Ivan noticed that Hermione was very nervous, so he smiled comfortingly, and then teased.
"And don't forget that we are wizards and know how to use magic. Even if we fall, we only need to release a slow falling or floating curse on ourselves in time!"
"What if I don't release the magic in time?" Hermione asked nervously.
"Then there is still me, isn't it? You should always have some confidence in me?" Ivan replied with a smile.
"Hmm..." Hermione nodded, thinking that Ivan was right behind her, she couldn't help but feel relieved a lot.
After 　　's tight mind relaxed, the little witch soon experienced the fun of flying on a ride, which was completely different from the feeling of flying in the air with a broomstick. There was no need for distracted control and you could admire the scenery along the way.
At this time, the eagle-headed horse-winged beast began to glide smoothly in the air. Hermione looked over, and the towering mountains shrouded in clouds and mist in the distance were greeted by a large area of ​​lush woods.
Hermione really enjoys such a peaceful feeling,
But after the short-term novelty faded away, the long-distance trip became a bit boring. For several hours, I couldn’t see any people, sitting on a eagle-headed horse with a winged beast, and far away from a train. Comfortable inside.
Fortunately, the two can still pass the time with small talk, talking to each other some interesting things, and soon, the Hogwarts Castle in the distance is in sight.
In order to avoid being seen, Ivan cast a spell on the eagle-headed horse-winged beast underneath him to bless the illusion spell, and then put on the invisibility cloak together with Hermione, and then directed the eagle-headed horse-winged beast towards the forbidden forest. Fly away.
Just then, a scorching sensation came from his chest.
Ivan frowned, stretched out his hand to take out the time converter hanging on his chest, this golden hourglass pendant has become more and more hot.
This situation means that he will soon be kicked back to the original time.
"Ivan, what's the matter?" Hermione noticed Ivan's movement behind her, turned her head, and asked.
"It's nothing, but I should go back soon." Ivan put the time converter back in and replied casually.
Hermione was stunned first, and then quickly realized that Ivan was back to the original point in time, and suddenly asked in a flustered manner.
"Then what should we do? Are we still in the sky now? Let's land quickly!"
Speaking, Hermione was directing the eagle-headed horse-winged beast to land, but Ivan stopped it.
"Don't worry about it, it's not that fast. Generally speaking, I still have more than ten minutes of residence time, enough to fly to the Forbidden Forest!" Ivan explained.
The time converter started to get hot, obviously an early warning mechanism specially set up by the producer.
Judging from his previous experience using the time converter several times, after the time converter gives an obvious reminder, a short period of time will be reserved for the holder to prepare calmly, so that some embarrassing things will not happen. .
Even if there is an accident, he is still a powerful wizard. He will not fall from the sky to death. Ivan is a little worried about Hermione being here alone, so it is better to take her back with him.
Fortunately, it is very close to Hogwarts Castle, and it can be reached within a few minutes at most.
The smooth journey made Ivan couldn’t help feeling that his luck was good this time, but he remembers that when he came to London from Hogwarts on a eagle-headed horse and winged beast, it rained heavily on the way. The feeling of being wet is terrible.
However, just as Ivan was thinking this way, he saw that the originally clear sky slowly dimmed. In the distance, there seemed to be a large group of black clouds drifting towards this side, and there was something faintly inside. The entanglement surged.
The originally clear sky was covered by clouds and mist, and the deep cold air gradually spread. Hermione couldn't help but shudder, and Ivan suddenly realized that something was wrong.
The eagle-headed horse and the winged beast made an uneasy eagle cry, and tried to deflect and flew higher to avoid it, but the black clouds and mist seemed to be conscious, and quickly followed.
When the black clouds got closer, Ivan realized that it was not a cloud at all, but a large group of corrupt figures in tattered cloaks...
"It's a dementor!" Hermione shuddered, shaking her body.
Ivan hurriedly hugged her, covered her mouth with his right hand, signaled her not to speak, try to hide her body in an invisibility cloak, and at the same time let the eagle-headed horse-winged beast speed up.
It’s just that there are too many dementors, and they quickly dispersed and blocked Ivan and others in the air.
Ivan shook his head helplessly, it seemed that Dumbledore was right! Even the invisibility cloak can't hide these disgusting monsters...
Dozens of dementors float around in a gathering, forming a space composed of darkness and cold. Here, as if all the light and heat have been deprived of it, the happy things in my mind gradually fade away The pain buried deep in my heart and the things that I don't want to recall all come to my heart...
Flame... Kill... Blood!
Hermione's face turned pale, her hands tightly pulled the feathers of the eagle-headed horse and the winged beast, and scenes of killings continued to flow in her mind, and the voices of wailing and pain continued to echo in her ears.
Looking at the dementors who got closer and closer, Ivan was also affected a lot, and the Occlumency was activated for the first time, which made it easier.
At the same time, Ivan was also a little upset. He didn't expect the Ministry of Magic to send these dementors to Hogwarts before school started.
Are you planning to conduct a full search of Hogwarts while the students are away?
If I knew it, I should come back a few days earlier, instead of crashing into the defensive net built by the dementors.
Because these dementors are employed by the Ministry of Magic, Ivan doesn't have a valid reason, and it is not easy to deal with them.
After all, the situation this time is a little different from last time. The dementors are responsible for intercepting a person trying to break into the castle. On the contrary, he can't explain why he rode into Hogwarts with a winged beast on a eagle in.
In this short period of time, the dementors have floated in front of them, staring directly at Ivan's direction with their hollow eyes, as if they were sensing something...

chapters.title: Chapter 361: Although there is no evidence, I suspect that you are Sirius!
chapters.content:
The invisibility cloak on Ivan hindered their perception. The dementors could only vaguely feel that there were various thoughts floating in the direction of Ivan, which was very delicious.
Ivan was hesitating whether to take action to drive away these annoying monsters.
Once the war starts, there will be a lot of noise, unless he can kill all these dementors, otherwise this matter will definitely be reported, and it is impossible to hide it from Dumbledore.
The Ministry of Magic will certainly respond to this!
Ivan hadn't heard the slightest sound of wind before, so he was worried that if he acted rashly, it would change history.
However, Hermione couldn't hold it anymore at this time, and she was extremely nervous. The memory that emerged in her mind impacted her consciousness, and her body was also shaky.
Noting that Hermione’s state was a bit wrong, Ivan was very anxious, coupled with the burning of the time converter in his chest, he was no longer silent.
"Go away, there is no one you are looking for here!" Ivan murmured with a hoarse voice.
The dementors are getting closer, don’t believe Ivan’s words at all, and most people won’t fly to Hogwarts at this time!
Although there is no evidence, they suspect that the person in front of them is the wanted criminal Sirius!
Dementors can’t speak, but they still convey their thoughts in some way.
Ivan hesitated, and didn't want to conflict with them, so he said casually. "I'm an employee at Hogwarts. I found a missing eagle-headed horse-winged beast outside, so I plan to take it to the Forbidden Forest!"
The dementors did not disperse, their IQs were not high, but they would not be fooled by Ivan.
The most important thing is that they are used by the unscrupulous Ministry of Magic as a search tool. They have not had a full meal for many days. Now they have finally caught a guy who is suspected to be Sirius. Of course, it is impossible to let it go easily.
A large number of dementors are ready to move. They are not patient creatures, and the rules of the Ministry of Magic are gradually forgotten. They only know that they are hungry.
very hungry, very hungry...
A dementor soon drifted to Ivan’s side, and stretched out the withered, crusted palms to take off Ivan’s body that could affect their perception, so that they could absorb more delicious emotions. ...
Just when the scabded hand stretched out in front of him, a burst of white light was ignited from the invisibility cloak, and the dementor was shot and flew out instantly, hitting a few of the same kind behind him.
Originally wandering nearby, the dementors who still had some consideration were immediately enraged. They swarmed towards Ivan, covering the sky and the sun like a black wave, swallowing down...
"Hushen guard!" Ivan waved his wand and the vast white mist gathered into a strong shield and stood in front of him.
A large number of dementors hit the shield made up of white mist, rippling waves, making a sound of corroding, but unable to break through the defense.
Angrily, the nearest dementors even took off their hoods, revealing the weird faces under the brim of their hats.
Their heads are dry and thin. The only place where they should have eyes is the thin skin with gray scabs, and underneath is a big hollow mouth, sucking something with big mouths, the white mist shield gradually becomes thinner, and the surrounding area becomes more and more. The cold.
Hermione leaned back hard, shivering in Ivan's arms, cold sweat on her forehead, and a lot of illusory things with various colors were constantly being stripped from her body.
Ivan, who was still scrupulous, is not keeping his hands,
Although Ivan could not summon the shadow of the unicorn in order to conceal his identity, so as not to be approached by the Ministry of Magic, his patron saint curse has improved a lot during this period, and he can play many tricks.
Under the wave of the magic wand, the white mist surging in mid-air condensed in a short period of time, and turned into a light group consisting of white mist and rolled directly forward.
The few unprepared dementors couldn't dodge at all. They were smashed into pieces, and their bodies were a little loose.
More dementors from the rear gathered angrily, the light ball exploded suddenly, the white mist spread to the surroundings, and the dementors who were trying to approach were quickly blown out.
Although there are a large number of dementors in Hogwarts, the white fog created by Ivan’s patron saint curse is related to the special bloodline magic, which is much stronger than that released by normal wizards, and it is even more important for dementors. A full-fledged nemesis.
But Ivan didn't want to make things too much. He just used the patron saint curse to knock the dementors in front of him into the air, and then drove the eagle-headed horse-winged beast into a rampage, rushing out of the encirclement abruptly.
"Quick! Go to the forbidden forest!" The long-lost sunlight re-spreads on his body. While he was relieved, Ivan did not dare to stay too much. He directed the eagle-headed horse-winged beast to fly to the forbidden forest at the fastest speed. .
Behind 　　, a large number of unwilling dementors tried to catch up again.
Ivan expelled them again and again.
After several times, these monsters who learned the lesson gave up the idea of ​​approaching. Some of them separated or reported the situation, and the remaining part only dared to hover in the air far away.
Ivan ignored them. The time converter on his neck was getting hotter and hotter. Fortunately, the eagle-headed horse-winged beast flew very quickly and flew into the forbidden forest in a few moments and landed successfully.
Ivan turned over and leaped off the back of the eagle-headed horse-winged beast, turned his head, looked at Hermione who was slightly pale, helped her down, and asked aloud.
"Hermione, are you okay?"
Hermione shook her head, so that Ivan didn't have to worry, and she was much better now without the disgusting dementors.
At this time, the eagle-headed horse-winged beast on the side suddenly let out an eagle cry, and its big orange eyes stared at Hermione angrily.
Ivan was a little strange at first, and then noticed that some reddish brown feathers seemed to be stuck on Hermione's hands.
"I was a bit too nervous just now, I always wanted to grab something, so... I'm sorry!" Hermione stuck out her tongue embarrassedly, and said apologetically at the eagle-headed horse with winged beasts.
The eagle-headed horse-winged beast didn't buy it. He raised his neck proudly. Finally, under Ivan's comfort, it was considered that he had let go of the hostility to Hermione, but still did not allow Hermione to touch it anymore.
The little witch looked very disappointed,
Ivan smiled, and when he was about to say a few words of comfort, the time and space around him suddenly froze.
"Damn it, so fast, why can't you wait a little longer!" Ivan wanted to yell, but he couldn't make a sound at all. He could only watch time go by...

chapters.title: Chapter 362: Cycle of fate
chapters.content:
Vague colors and shapes fill the entire space, and everything around is changing rapidly.
Ivan’s wide-eyed eyes, he desperately wanted to know what happened to this place after he left, whether Hermione had reached Hogwarts Castle safely, and whether the dementors had caught up.
But the speed of the surrounding changes was too fast, and Ivan could only see a large number of black shadows falling from the sky at a certain moment, and then scattered.
Occasionally, a few fuzzy-shaped animals pass by, more often the day and night alternate.
I don't know how long it took, and everything finally stabilized, and Ivan regained his ability to act.
raised his eyes to look at the sky. It was already evening. Ivan knew that he should have returned to the normal time. He remembered that it was in the evening when he used the time converter.
"I don't know what happened to Hermione?" Ivan sighed.
The dark shadows I saw before, Ivan guessed that the dementors were searching for him and Hermione in the forbidden forest. I hope that the little witch has already left by then.
Otherwise... Ivan glanced at the time converter in his hand, hesitated for a moment, and still didn't use it.
He decided to go to the castle to see the situation first. If everything goes well, Hermione should have already returned.
Thinking of this, Ivan took out the live map, tapped his magic wand, and muttered.
"I solemnly swear that I did nothing good!"
On a piece of blank parchment, many delicate ink lines suddenly appeared, spreading like spider web lines, connecting and spreading to every corner of the parchment, drawing a map clearly marked with names.
Peter Pettigrew was sleeping in the dormitory, Ron and Harry stayed in the common room, and Dumbledore stayed peacefully in his principal's room.
As for Hermione...
Ivan searched for a circle, and successfully found the name of the little witch, which seemed to be moving fast, maybe somewhere to go.
Ivan was holding the map and counting Hermione's movement trajectory, while walking quickly towards Hogwarts Castle, easily blocking her in the corridor.
"Hermione!" Ivan greeted.
The little witch who rushed around in the castle hurriedly turned her head suddenly after hearing Ivan's voice, and said angrily while holding a book.
"Finally found you, Ivan! You used a coma spell on me just now... it's too much!"
The angry words of the little witch made Ivan stunned, but when he noticed the beads of sweat on Hermione's forehead and the thick books in her hands, she quickly understood what was going on.
Before Ivan could respond, Hermione stuffed the book in Ivan's arms. "I found some records in this book, you can take a look at it, it should be able to help..."
Ivan lowered his head and glanced, this is exactly the "Black Magic Uncensored".
"Thank you, Hermione!" Ivan did not open the book, but said with emotion.
"Don't talk about this now..." The little witch shook her head eagerly, and signaled Ivan to turn the book quickly. The content is on page 125 of this book!
Ivan only turned a few pages. Since he had read all the contents, he only turned it over later.
Seeing that there are a large number of cruel black magic experimental analysis in the book "Black Magic Decryption", I remembered the previous puzzles, but had not had time to ask.
"By the way...Hermione! How did you think of looking for this book, don't you usually never read black magic books?"
Hermione hesitated for a while, and when she woke up, she found an extra note on the bedside. Then she took out the folded note from the pocket of the wizard's robe and punched it. Open.
Ivan clearly sees that it says: Forbidden Book Area...The bookshelf in the thirteenth row and the ninth column... "Black Magic Decryption"!
The most important thing is that Ivan recognizes that it is Hermione's handwriting!
"Remember the question you asked me? What happens when the potion is used on the dead wizard..." Hermione said very quickly, and then continued to explain.
"I'm not as smart as you, so I checked a lot of books and thought about it for a long time without a clue. But since the time converter can go back to the past, why can't the future self tell us the answer?"
"Why? You are much smarter than me... Hermione! Such a good method, even I can't even think of it!" Ivan couldn't help but look at the talking little witch in front of him. .
When the potion research was in trouble before, he had never thought of such a novel method. Just like Hermione said, as long as the calculation is right, he can completely help his future self to solve some headaches.
In addition, Ivan was relieved that since Hermione got the note, it proved that she avoided the dementor's search in the future and returned to the castle safely.
was praised by Ivan, Hermione raised the corner of her mouth slightly, very happy, she felt that her hard work these days was finally in vain. But in the end, he still reservedly stated that he was just studying hard and was a little clever.
"How about? Is the content of this book useful?" Hermione looked forward to watching IvanWell, it's very useful! "Ivan nodded in response.
"I said I would definitely be able to help! Then we will start to study now..." the little witch said confidently.
However, Ivan did not respond. He hesitated to explain to Hermione...
Ivan’s silence made Hermione faintly aware of something wrong.
The happy expression on the little witch's face slowly dimmed, and she suddenly thought that Ivan might have ended this time travel, and her previous efforts might have been in vain...
"Have you done what you want to do?" Hermione pursed her lips, and said depressedly.
"Yes!" Ivan nodded, then smiled at Hermione who was unhappy. "That's why I just wanted to thank you... Hermione! This time, you really helped a lot!"
"You mean..." Hermione's brown eyes turned round, and she looked at Ivan blankly. Of course she could understand the consciousness in Ivan's words.
The little witch reacted after a long time, and then said in a flustered manner. "But... But, I haven't done anything yet?"
"So, do you want to take an adventure now? But it might be a bit dangerous..." Ivan took off the time converter from her body, hung it on Hermione's neck, and asked.
Ivan has realized that if she doesn't send away the current little witch, she will never be able to touch her in the future.
Because the time of departure is also the time of return after the stay time arrives...

chapters.title: Chapter 363: New legend event
chapters.content:
"Of course!" Hermione nodded without hesitation. She didn't forget that Ivan had promised her that she would take her with her every time she used the time converter.
And when Professor Dumbledore gave them the time converter, they also asked them to supervise each other!
Thinking of this, Hermione’s cheeks were slightly red, because she found that she didn’t seem to be playing a supervisory role at all...
After Hermione agreed, Ivan wondered how to get her back to Knockdown Alley three months ago.
I can’t just sit with a eagle-headed horse and a winged beast like I did before, right? That's too painful!
Ivan thought a little, and soon got an idea, snapped his fingers, and said hello.
"More than!"
The next moment, an ugly house-elf with big eyes flashed in front of the two of them.
"Do you have any orders? Sir!" Dobby asked in a shrill voice.
"Take us to Knock Down Alley!" Ivan took Hermione's hand and said to Dobby.
Although Hogwarts has the magic of anti-shifting and shadow-changing, house elves do not have this restriction.
Dobby’s magic is enough to transport the two of them from here to Knock Down Alley!
"Yes, sir!" After receiving the order, Dobby immediately carried it out, holding out Ivan's wrist with his left hand, and snapping a finger with his right hand.
There was a shift in space, and when Ivan came back to his senses, what attracted his eyes was a small alley that was both unfamiliar and familiar.
If he remembers correctly, this place seems to be the place where Hermione stopped the two black-robed wizards in the first place.
Such a coincidence? Ivan was a little surprised, but he didn't care too much.
Ivan took out the invisibility cloak and handed it to Hermione, and explained.
"If you want to help me, you have to go back more than three months ago, that is, two thousand four hundred revolutions! Of course, I spent a lot of money from Hogwarts to London riding a griffin and winged beast. Time, so you make five more turns and it's almost the same."
Hermione was a little bit stunned. For more than two thousand laps, she was a little worried that she might make a mistake.
"If nothing else, if you wait there for a while, you will see two wizards in black robes passing by. At that time, I would want to kill them. You only need to stop me... here. Remember to wear the invisibility cloak during the process!" Yifan added.
Hermione tried hard to remember all Ivan's words in her heart, and said with some doubts. "Did you wear an invisible cloak? How should I find you?"
"Just pay attention to the magic wand that pops up suddenly, I don't think it will trouble you, right?" Ivan said with a smile.
Hermione nodded, and then began to verbally inquire. "What else? What should I do after that? Is there anything that needs special attention?"
While talking, the little witch took out the magic quill from the pocket of the wizard robe, and unfolded the wrinkled note. She looked at Ivan seriously, as if she wanted to write down what Ivan said next. .
"No! Hermione... I have nothing to remind you, and there is nothing to pay special attention to." Seeing this posture, Ivan shook his head, not crying or laughing for a while.
He thought that he had imagined that he could get a clearance strategy and acted according to the instructions above. He didn't expect Hermione to have the same idea.
