"But I still don't know what you want to do?" Hermione said flusteredly.
Ivan had been researching potions day and night, but she saw that there must be a very important thing to accomplish. She didn't want to cause anything wrong because of her negligence.
"Then you need to understand it yourself!" Ivan said casually, and comforted her a few more words to let her not worry, and then handed the compound decoction made before to Hermione so that she could pass it on to herself when that time comes.
Since Ivan said that, it meant that everything should go smoothly on this trip. After trying to understand this, Hermione relaxed a little.
Then, Hermione took the reagent bottle containing the compound decoction, put it in place, and put on the invisibility cloak, ready to use the time converter.
At this time, Ivan suddenly remembered one thing and said.
"By the way, after you passed, I should ask you some questions at that time. You just need to tell him not to try to change the past, but to learn to follow the context of history, for example, think about what you have seen... "
"Is it all right to say that?" Hermione was confused, not able to understand Ivan's meaning, is this too general?
"Well, that's enough! But now he definitely doesn't understand, so he doesn't want to think about anything..." Ivan said with some emotion.
He can be regarded as understanding why he failed to get the so-called clearance strategy, because there is no need to intervene at all, and destiny will lead everything to the desired result.
Everything just goes with the flow!
Hermione looked at Ivan with a weird look, silently remembered these words in her heart, converged her mind, and began to turn the time converter.
Ivan couldn't see Hermione in the invisibility cloak, but seeing that she hadn't responded for a long time, she knew that the little witch should have left.
"Let's go, Dobby, let's go back!" Ivan looked at the house elf on the side and said Okay, sir! "Dobby replied, and returned to Hogwarts with Ivan.
Two consecutive ultra-long-distance teleportations, Dobby was too tired, his pointed ears drooped, and his wrinkled face was full of exhaustion.
Ivan saw these in his eyes, and couldn't help speaking. "Thanks for your hard work these days, Dobby! I should have nothing important for the next two days. You can take a good rest and treat it as your vacation!"
"Take a rest?!" Dobby's exhaustion was swept away. It raised its head in surprise, blinked its bulb-sized eyes, hesitated for a while, and then screamed in surprise.
"You mean... my God! Dobby has a vacation!"
The sharp high pitch almost broke Ivan's eardrum.
Ivan rubbed his ears. He didn't expect it was just a vacation. Dobby would have such a big reaction. Before he had time to say anything, Dobby choked himself.
"Sir, you are so kind. Not only are you willing to pay Dobby a salary, but you are also willing to give Dobby a vacation... You are simply the greatest person in the wizarding world... Greater than Harry Potter!"
Tears accumulated in Dobby’s eyes, and he seemed to want to hold his thigh and cry.
Ivan was very speechless. It seemed that Harry's name as the savior was only worth Sikor's salary every Monday and two days of vacation.
【Ding, a new legendary event has been generated! 】
When Ivan was about to comfort Dobby, the system prompt sounded in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 364: Damaged time converter
chapters.content:
Ivan’s attention was immediately drawn to him. Since the prompt appeared at this time, it was probably related to his time travel, so he opened the system bar to check it.
【Legendary Title: Ouroboros
Legend event: You use the power of the time converter to go back to the past, complete the history, and direct the result in the expected direction. Although the process is rarely known, it is still worthy of reward...
Legend: 1
Special reward: stable time and space node (already issued in advance)
Note: Are you playing with time, or time playing with you? 】
"Ouroboros?" Ivan muttered to himself silently, looking at the legendary title this time.
Ouroboros refers to a snake that devours its tail. It can consume itself as a nourishment, and then grow and be consumed forever. A fantasy creature or state is often used to symbolize time and space and the universe, representing an infinite loop...
It is also very appropriate to use this to describe his experience these days.
If he takes the day he goes home during the school year as a time node, and when he uses the time converter as another node, then the two are indeed in a constant loop...
After all, the self who has no future returns to set up the scene three months ago, so he will not see the death of "Asia", and then get the time converter and start planning to return to three months ago to do all this, so that the past self I can see the "Death" of Esiah trying to get the time converter and plan how to arrange the scene...
Just thinking about it, Ivan felt a bit headache. He immediately felt that he must be more cautious when using the time converter in the future. It is best not to have things like this time again, and to find his own guilt. .
As stated in the remarks, it is not so much that he played with time, it is better to be teased by time...
Ivan shook his head, sighed, and then focused on the special reward given by the legendary title.
You must know that when I was awarded the title of legend, I had never been rewarded by the system. This time was obviously an accident.
Is the space-time node stable?
Ivan groaned, the system did not give any explanation. But just looking at the literal meaning, Ivan can also guess something, this time he stayed for a full two months, it is probably related to the system.
Otherwise, it would not be a coincidence that he had just brought the eagle-headed horse-body winged beast back and was kicked back to the original time and space.
It was obvious that what he was going to do had already been done, so there was no need to stay any longer... Hermione was still stuck because there was still something to be done.
"Sir, what's the matter with you?"
Ivan stayed on the spot for a long time, his expression constantly changing, which made Dobby feel a little strange on the side, and asked suspiciously.
"Ah? It's nothing, just thinking about something." Ivan was stunned for a short time, and quickly reacted, said something, and then sent Dobby to rest sooner!
When Dobby left, Ivan took out the map to look at. Just as he had expected, Hermione’s name appeared again in Hogwarts Castle, near an unmanned classroom. Stand still.
Ivan found the nearest underpass and walked over. He desperately wanted to know what happened after he was kicked back to the original time in the forbidden forest, and how Hermione got rid of those conspirators. weird.
Walking out of the dark tunnel, Ivan soon saw the sad little witch standing in front of the classroom.
"Hermione!" Ivan said hello.
"Ivan?!" Hermione was taken aback, and she subconsciously hid her right hand behind her, her expression a little flustered.
"Well... you are in a normal time period, right?" Ivan hesitated for a moment, feeling that Hermione's reaction was a bit wrong.
With the previous oolong, Ivan also became suspicious, suspecting that the little witch in front of him might have come back from another time period.
"Hmm!" Hermione nodded sadly.
"What's wrong? Did something happen before?" Ivan asked with some worry.
"That...it...it cracked!" Hermione pursed her mouth, said in a vague way, and then took the right hand that was behind her back to her and opened it.
Ivan clearly saw that in Hermione's white palm, a long thin gold chain was placed, and a small golden hourglass hung under the chain.
Compared to before, there are many more fine cracks on the hourglass. Although the fine sand inside does not leak out, it looks like it may burst at any time.
"When was it damaged?" Ivan frowned, and suddenly realized the seriousness of the matter.
"Just now!" Hermione pursed her lips, quite annoyed. She felt it was her fault.
The previous stay time arrived. After returning to the normal time and space, the time converter was fine, but she temporarily remembered the matter of sending a note to herself, so she used it again, returning to a few days ago.
So Hermione felt that if she hadn't considered the endurance limit of the time converter, this thing would not be damaged.
"What should we do now? Do you have a way to fix it?" Hermione looked at Ivan in a panic and asked with a hint of anticipation.
Ivan thought for a while, took the time converter in Hermione's hand, and opened the magic item bar of the system to check the status of the time converter.
[Magic Item: Time Converter
Magic power: weak (strong)
Special status: damaged
Effect: Every time you turn the pointer, the time will go back by one hour, and the risk will increase by one point (unavailable)
Description: This is an exquisite magical product with a powerful ability that can affect time, but due to multiple high-intensity uses, it has exceeded its tolerance.
Note: It felt that it had had enough, so it cracked! 】
I noticed the words damaged on the special status, and Ivan had a headache. After reading the instructions, I thought of the special rewards given by the legendary title. I didn't know that the system was messing up.
The power of the time converter itself is obviously impossible for him and Hermione to stay in that time and space for such a long time. It was only because of the systematic influence that it lasted for a few months.
Now that the legendary event has been completed and the influence of the system has disappeared, the time converter is naturally unable to withstand it and is broken!
"How is it? Can it be fixed?" Hermione looked at Ivan very nervously.
"No! It's completely broken, and I can't do anything..." Ivan shook his head helplessly. When he got the time converter, he thought about studying it.
However, the power of time is too profound, he has no way of starting, let alone repairing it...

chapters.title: Chapter 365: We won't be caught by the Ministry of Magic in Azkaban, will we?
chapters.content:
"I accidentally broke it, Professor Dumbledore won't expel me for that?" Hearing that even Ivan couldn't find a way, Hermione was completely broken.
Thinking of having to pay a large sum of Jin Jialong to the Ministry of Magic after she was expelled, she might even be burdened by Professor McGonagall who helped her guarantee her. Hermione almost cried...
"Don't worry, it won't!" Ivan hurriedly comforted, and then said again.
"Besides, they should punish me as well! This matter has nothing to do with you... You use the time converter too much to help me. I will explain this to them then!"
Since I understand that the time converter is damaged due to system reasons, Ivan certainly wouldn't let Hermione, an unaware little witch, take this responsibility.
However, Hermione was not very grateful, and stared at Ivan angrily. She felt that since the time converter was broken in her own hands, she was very responsible!
Only quickly, Hermione's anger slowly turned to worry again, she pursed her mouth, and asked in fear. "If we broke such an important thing, we won't be caught by the Ministry of Magic in Azkaban, will we?"
"How is that possible?" Ivan shook his head and continued to pretend to be relaxed.
"It's a big deal to compensate some Jin Jialong. You don't know that I made thousands of Jialong from Lockhart last year, and it should be enough to pay it!"
"And I am still a Merlin Medal winner, and a minor wizard, the Ministry of Magic will not do anything to us."
Even though I said so, Ivan had no bottom in his heart.
We must know that the production method of the time converter seems to have been lost, that is to say, every time converter is extremely precious, and the bad one is one less. He does not know how much it is worth, and he does not know the gold Jialong he saved. Is it enough...
However, it is impossible for the Ministry of Magic to capture two minor wizards to Azkaban because of a time converter. Ivan can still confirm this.
"Anyway, let's go to the principal's office now and ask Professor Dumbledore." Ivan said helplessly.
If possible, Ivan would not really want to see Dumbledore. After all, he has a lot of secrets, and there is always some anxiety in meeting this master of mind-trapping.
But the time converter can’t be left alone like that. They still have class tomorrow.
If you miss a few consecutive classes, there will definitely be a professor who will report their absence to Dumbledore, so you can't hide it at all. It's better to honestly admit your mistakes.
Maybe his confession was sincere, so Dumbledore wouldn't be held accountable?
Of course, Hermione has no opinion, and finding Professor Dumbledore is the only choice now!
On the way to the principal’s office, Ivan did not forget to tell Hermione, and remember to kill her by then, saying that it was because the two of them were too passionate about learning, so they used the time converter too frequently, which eventually caused the time converter to be damaged. .
After all, using the time converter privately to go back to the past is not a small matter. He will definitely be held accountable by the Ministry of Magic and questioned what he did when he went back to the past.
Maybe people from the Ministry of Magic would think of the Bogimbok store being attacked, conduct an in-depth investigation, and then fire him or arrest him in Azkaban...
"But if we say that, do the people at the Ministry of Magic really believe it? What if they use Veritaserum on us?" Hermione was very skeptical, and said that she really loves learning too much... She couldn't say it anyway.
"Reassure, the Ministry of Magic will not use Veritaserum indiscriminately, and we are not prisoners, um... Actually, even prisoners won't use it easily! So we can convince them by showing something beyond our peers! Ivan explained.
In fact, Ivan has always felt that some methods of the Ministry of Magic are fascinating. For example, Veritaserum is a weapon of interrogation, but the Ministry of Magic rarely uses it.
Just like the last Wizarding War, a large number of Death Eaters only need to insist that they are controlled by the Imperius Curse to be able to successfully exonerate, and the Ministry of Magic has no intention of using Veritaserum from beginning to end.
The same was true when Voldemort returned. A few drops of Veritaserum can tell what Harry said is true, and Fudge and the Ministry of Magic just don’t use it!
Although there may be some political factors in this, for example, many Death Eaters who have escaped sanctions have a prominent life experience, and the imprisoned pure-blood wizards are some diehards who died by themselves.
Another example is that Fudge wants to pretend to be an ostrich and he does not want to believe the fact that Voldemort has returned, but it is obvious that Veritaserum cannot be used at will.
Since I don’t need to drink Veritaserum, Ivan certainly does not worry about his words being broken. The production method of the time converter has been lost for hundreds of years. No one in the Ministry of Magic should be able to see the specific use of this time converter before it was damaged. .
With his sixth-level alchemy level, he can only make a preliminary judgment that this time converter was damaged due to overuse. specifically how to overuse it, and how long ago it was impossible to detect at all. Come out, let alone those from the Ministry of Magic...
On the way to the principal's office, Ivan and Hermione colluded with a confession. By the time he arrived at the door, the lie had been made up by him.
Considering Hermione is not good at telling lies, Ivan asked her not to speak casually after letting her in. The Ministry of Magic and Dumbledore just let him deal with it.
made all preparations, and when they arrived in front of the principal's office, the two of them were dumbfounded, and they were dumbfounded in front of the huge stone beast guarding the gate.
"It's over, we haven't had time to ask what the password of the principal's office is?" Ivan patted his head, he patronized to make up the reason, but forgot to find a professor to ask about the password.
"Sweet honey candy?"
"Toffee finger pancakes?"
"Cockroach pile?"
......
Ivan tried one by one at the huge stone beasts. When it came to the pile of cockroaches, the stone beasts shook abruptly, whirled slowly upwards with a dull sound, and finally hidden behind the stairs. It was revealed.
"Evan, how did you guess it?" Hermione looked at Ivan in surprise.
"I have been to the principal's office several times before and found that Professor Dumbledore usually uses some sweets and drinks that he usually likes as his password, so I tried it. It seems that my luck is good!" Ivan explained with a smile. , And then strode in.
Hermione realized this, and then became a little annoyed. Why didn't she think of this before...

chapters.title: Chapter 366: You will be even more surprised this time!
chapters.content:
Ivan winded up the stairs, and the subconscious operation in the brain started Occlumency.
But then Ivan thought that Hermione didn't know Occlumency, and Dumbledore had nothing to do with it.
entered the principal's room with a nervous heart, and Ivan saw Dumbledore wearing a gray wizard robe, standing with his back to him, teasing Phoenix Fox.
Ivan looked a little greedy. After receiving the legendary title of Ouroboros, his legendary value has once again made up five points, and he can already merge the next bloodline, and the blood of the Phoenix has always been his first choice!
"Halse? Miss Granger? Is there anything you came to see me for?" Dumbledore noticed the movement behind him, turned his head to look at the two of them, and asked a little surprised.
"Yes... Professor, we came to you because of an important thing." Ivan organized the language and hesitated where to start.
"Sit down and talk!" Dumbledore stepped and sat behind the desk. With a light wave of his wand, there were two more stools beside Ivan and Hermione.
"I still remember that every time you came to me, you brought some unexpected news to me. It seems that this time is no exception..."
Dumbledore’s long slender fingers were facing each other, and the blue eyes under the half-moon glasses stared at Ivan closely, and there was a hint of teasing in his words.
It's usually you who come to me...
Ivan murmured to himself in his heart, and then said with embarrassment.
"Then you will be even more surprised this time!"
Ivan prepared Dumbledore mentally, then put the damaged time converter on the table and spoke again.
"Do you remember the time converter that you gave us before? Now it...broken!"
Seeing the time converter that is full of cracks and may burst open at any time, Dumbledore's face was stunned, and it took a long time before he raised his head and looked at Ivan and Hermione in a weird voice, and said in a deep voice.
"I think you need to explain to me what is going on? How did you break it!"
Ivan explained with a hint of apology.
"Professor, I'm sorry! I was researching the improvement plan of the compound decoction before, and I was too fascinated for a while. I frequently used the power of the time converter and miscalculated its limit, which led to this result..."
Ivan said all the rhetoric he had already thought of, and even actively threw out his own research and development of improved compound decoction during this period.
Because Dumbledore can learn from Snape that he has asked for some knowledge about potion improvement with a little investigation. This matter cannot be concealed, and there is no need to conceal it!
He can say that since he developed the wolf poison potion by himself last school year and gained the glory and attention, he was a little addicted to it. This semester is going to make persistent efforts to make big news or something...
"Professor, I am also responsible for this matter. The time converter broke in my hand..." Hermione hurriedly said.
Ivan gave Hermione a helpless look.
girl... isn't it time to grab responsibility?
The reason why he took all the responsibilities was to keep Dumbledore's attention all on himself, so that Dumbledore would not see if Hermione's disguise was not in place.
Hermione also stared at Ivan dissatisfiedly. They had previously agreed to take responsibility together, but Ivan threw her aside again.
The eye contact between the two did not last long, and was interrupted by Dumbledore's words.
"I think I warned you that the power of the time converter needs to be used with caution! You also promised me not to use its power outside of class!"
Dumbledore's face was full of seriousness, and his deep eyes slowly swept across the two of them. After a short stay on Hermione's body, he quickly turned to Ivan's body.
"And...I think it's not as simple as you said, isn't it? Hals!" Dumbledore took out a few letters from the drawer, turned it over, and continued.
"About a month ago, the day before school started! The dementors sent by the Ministry of Magic to guard Hogwarts stopped a suspected Sirius Bright not far from the castle and planned to enter from the air. The people at Hogwarts...
of course! The interception of these dementors finally failed. For this reason, the Minister of Magic Fudge wrote several letters to me, wanting to send more dementors into Hogwarts for a full search...but I turned it down! "
Dumbledore said while watching Ivan's reaction. As far as he knew, there were not many wizards capable of breaking through dozens of dementors.
Especially from the news from the Ministry of Magic, the other party seemed to have defeated the dementors in order to conceal their identity without even releasing the patron saint. Sirius Black could never do this.
was sent along with this news, and the news that Ivan had "saved" his classmates by expelling a large number of dementors on the Hogwarts train the next day.
At that time, he had some doubts, and coupled with the timetable that Ivan handed in, Dumbledore had a certainty of six or seven points Since he could think of it, other people were certainly not fools.
So he stopped the application that McGonagall had written for Ivan, and only applied for a time converter in the name of Hermione, so that it would not be easy for the Ministry of Magic to think of this.
Hearing Dumbledore’s words, Ivan’s pupils shrank slightly. He did not expect that he had exposed so early, but he remembered seeing Dumbledore reading these letters when he came to the principal’s office at the beginning of school.
Before Ivan thought these letters were sent by Dean Bohan, but now it seems that he has misunderstood him. No wonder Dumbledore was not very happy to give the time converter to himself at that time, and even specifically mentioned the danger of using the time converter to himself.
Hermione's face turned pale, and she couldn't help casting a questioning look at Ivan, wanting to know what to do now?
Dumbledore saw the reaction of the two of them, and immediately confirmed his previous guess.
Ivan quickly eased off, his face unchanged and said apologetically again.
"Sorry Professor, and please forgive me for using the power of the time converter privately, which caused its damage..."
Ivan didn't fabricate any reason. Under the circumstances that Dumbledore had determined, fabricating a lie would not do any good.
Because Dumbledore only needs to use Contemplation on Hermione to know everything, and even with his full strength, Ivan suspects that his Occlumency cannot be resisted.
It just depends on whether Dumbledore wants to do this...
(PS: ask for monthly ticket, ask for recommendation, ask for subscription...)

chapters.title: Chapter 367: Why don't you hang them from the roof and whip them fiercely...
chapters.content:
Because of this, Ivan has been reluctant to meet Dumbledore. This powerlessness makes him very uncomfortable.
But what makes Ivan a little strange is that since entering the door, he hasn't noticed that Dumbledore has used Dementia. I don't know if it has been used on Hermione and he didn't notice it... .
"Can you tell me what you did with the time converter?" Dumbledore asked.
"This is something private, it is not convenient for me to tell you...Professor!" Ivan hesitated and shook his head.
What can he say? Said that he went back to Knock Down Alley in order to save Aysia and killed a group of vicious dark wizards?
Although some thugs died, he is only a thirteen-year-old wizard, with so many lives in his hands, it is hard to say what Dumbledore would think after hearing the news.
Ivan's words disappointed Dumbledore, but he didn't mean to continue to ask. Ivan insisted that he didn't want to say it, so I can't ask anything if I ask again...
"In that case, I must punish you for your violation of the rules this time!" Dumbledore said in a deep voice.
Ivan's heart touched her throat, Hermione pursed her mouth in fear...
Dumbledore's fingers were crossed together, his blue eyes looked at Ivan, and he spoke.
"It's you first! Hals! You used the time converter to go back in private and violated the regulations of the Ministry of Magic. Gryffindor Academy will be deducted 100 points for your actions!"
"And you...Miss Granger!" Dumbledore's gaze turned to Hermione again, "You have not played your due supervisory responsibility, so I will deduct Gryffindor College again. Fifty points! This time converter will be confiscated because you do not have the ability to keep it."
After Dumbledore finished speaking, he waited silently for the two to digest the news.
Hermione lowered her head and was very sad, but Ivan was a little surprised.
just... that's it? Points deducted?
Ivan was confused and said after thinking about it.
"Professor, what about the compensation? I broke the time converter. How much do I need to compensate the Ministry of Magic?"
Ivan asked Dumbledore about the approximate price of the time converter. At the same time, he was a little distressed. Although most of the Jin Jialong he saved was exploited from Lockhart, it was hard money!
It's just how long Dumbled did not continue to speak, Ivan's heart sank, and he asked tentatively.
"Is three thousand gallons enough?"
"Five thousand gallons?" Ivan felt his heart clenched together, and Dumbledore was silent.
"Ten thousand gallons?!" Ivan was desperate, he could only take out ten thousand gallons...
Where did you get so much money? Dumbledore gave Ivan a surprised look. He wondered if Ivan did something shameful after returning to the past...
"There is no need for compensation. You have good luck this time. I happen to know a master alchemist who should be able to repair this time converter." Dumbledore explained.
Ivan slowly breathed a sigh of relief, and his tight expression relaxed. In this case, they don't have to worry about the Ministry of Magic making trouble for them.
Hermione is a little strange. She clearly read in the book that the production method of the time converter has been lost for hundreds of years. It is said that no one now knows how to make and repair a time converter.
Ivan remembers that Bok had told him that Nick Lemay may still retain the method of making time converters.
And Nick LeMay happened to be one of Dumbledore’s friends, so the alchemist in the old professor’s mouth could only be him!
Thinking of this, Ivan is somewhat moved. It is not easy to improve his current alchemy level. Nick Le May is one of the few people in the magical world who can teach himself.
Ivan opened his mouth, but in the end he didn't speak. He just broke a time converter. He really didn't have the face to ask Dumbledore to meet with Nick LeMay.
Besides, he and Nick Le May have no relatives, and the other party has no reason to teach him alchemy.
"Professor Dumbledore, what about our class?" Hermione suddenly thought of the schedule scheduled for tomorrow morning. Now that there is no time converter, she no longer has the ability to take several courses at the same time.
"Then you need to cancel several conflicting courses, and you personally apologize and explain to the professors of each subject!" Dumbledore's words paused, and then he said solemnly.
"So I hope you can remember this profound lesson..."
Seeing the two nodded solemnly and remembered these words, Dumbledore waved his hand. "Well... if nothing else, you can leave!"
"Thank you, professor!" Before leaving, Ivan said gratefully.
Ivan knew that if Dumbledore didn’t find someone to help repair the time converter, they would be held accountable by the Ministry of Magic, and it wouldn’t be possible to deduct points at that time...
After the two left the principal’s office peace was restored here again.
Dumbledore stared at the badly damaged time converter in his hand, lost in thought.
On the portrait behind 　　, an old man with a long beard chattered.
"Albus, you are so kind to these students who made mistakes. They broke a precious time converter and planned to lie to conceal what they did.
If I were replaced by me as the principal, I would definitely hang them from the roof and whip them fiercely! Go into the little black room again until they are willing to tell the truth! "
"Mr. Black, I need to remind you that the bad habit of corporal punishment of students was abolished decades ago! I must act in accordance with school rules..." Dumbledore explained casually.
In the existing school regulations, it is not without punishment.
Just considering that there are too many lessons for Ivan and Hermione and there is little time, these small punishments can't do much, so Dumbledore didn't mention it.
As for Ivan deliberately concealing what he did in the past, Dumbledore is also somewhat helpless, unless necessary, he does not want to use the mind to learn everything.
Especially he has sensed that Ivan is prepared for this, and even learned to make some false memories to fool himself with his brain closed.
In this case, the forceful use of dementia will only have a counterproductive effect, making Ivan even more dissatisfied and wary of himself...
"Fox! Take me to Nick!" Dumbledore thought for a while, held the time converter, stood up and turned to look at Fox, and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 368: Nick Lemay
chapters.content:
The phoenix who was dozing on the olive branch opened his eyes, and the beautiful wings flew to Dumbledore's shoulder, and he let out a low cry like a song, and a hot flame ignited all over his body.
The flames spread to Dumbledore in a short while, and he almost turned into a fire man, but Dumbledore's face was still calm and calm without any pain, and his robe was intact.
The next moment, the flames swelled up, then collapsed suddenly and disappeared, and the figures of Dumbledore and Phoenix also disappeared in the principal's office...
When the flames obstructing the view disappeared, Dumbledore had come to a remote suburb, where there was nothing but dirt, gravel, bushes and shrubs.
Dumbledore looked around, determined the direction, and walked toward the open grass.
Vaguely he felt something obstructing his actions, and then took a few steps forward, the surrounding space suddenly changed, and a vast courtyard appeared in front of him.
In the center of the courtyard, there is a strange, as if alive house. Several eye-like windows looked over Dumbledore's body, shaking his huge body from time to time, and thick white smoke constantly emerging from the chimney made it look full of vitality.
After Dumbledore approached, there was an extra square channel right in front of him, with jagged spikes on both sides of the channel.
But the weird big courtyard opened its big mouth so that the old wizard with white beard could enter its body.
Dumbledore was not here for the first time. He walked in without fear, and vaguely felt a rush of heat. The flames beside him were burning in the stove, and the rising heat warmed the interior of the house. of...
The right side of the entire hall is full of bookshelves, densely placed with a large number of books, some parchment with symbols or patterns scattered on the ground in a mess.
A group of small, chirping alchemy creatures, who did not know when they got close to his feet, Dumbledore had to carefully confirm the location of his feet while walking, so as not to step on them...
"Albus? Why are you suddenly free to see me?"
At this time, an old voice sounded.
Dumbledore turned his head and looked over. It was Nick LeMay who came out of the back room.
Compared to the last time we met, Dumbledore keenly discovered that Nick's condition was much worse.
The wrinkled face was pale and almost invisible. The thin body made people worry about whether it would be blown down by the wind. Only a pair of bright and intelligent eyes were still dazzling.
"Long time no see, Nick!" Dumbledore said aloud.
"Yeah, it should be more than a year?" Nick waved away the alchemy creatures gathered around Dumbledore's feet, and said jokingly.
"I think there is nothing important, you may not think of coming to me, so let's talk about it inside!"
"You know, my work has always been busy, and I have to deal with some troublesome children...Of course, sometimes there are some troubles that need to be dealt with outside of work..."
Dumbledore's face was surprisingly thick, and there was no change in Nick's color under Nick's jokes, as he spoke casually, he walked towards the back room.
After entering the back room, Dumbledore was surprised to find that this place was very different from the last time he came. It looked more like a Muggle's living room.
TV sets, refrigerators, ovens and other home appliances are all available, but it seems that they have been magicalized. Dumbledore can easily feel that these are alchemy items.
"Unexpected?" Nick LeMay saw the startled look on Dumbledore's face and smiled.
"Yes!" Dumbledore nodded.
Nick LeMay said with emotion.
"These Muggle-made things are very interesting and always give me a lot of inspiration...
It seems that living a long time still has some advantages, especially since the world has suddenly become more interesting in the past 100 years, not as monotonous as before..."
Speaking of this, it is a pity for Nick LeMay. He can no longer see a more distant future...
"By the way, Albus, did you come to me this time because of that person's business?" Nick LeMay quickly recovered his emotions and asked about business.
"No! Voldemort is fairly safe lately, I don't know where he is hiding, and no news has come." Dumbledore shook his head, then placed a broken time converter on the table and said again.
"Can you fix it?"
Nick LeMay glanced around, noticed the fine cracks on the time converter, and said unexpectedly.
"It was so damaged... Thoroughly! How did you do it?"
"I just want to know..." Dumbledore raised his eyebrows.
"Well... let me take a closer look!" Nick LeMay picked up the time converter and looked at it carefully.
Although there is no tool to detect, but with experience, Nick LeMay can roughly confirm the state of this thing.
"The specific reason for the damage is that the frequency and intensity of use exceed the limit it can withstand..." Nick Lemay said, and used his wand against the time converter to cast an unknown spell.
The golden hourglass turned over, and the fine sand slowly flowed down It took nearly a third of the dust and sand before it stopped. After a long time, the hourglass turned upside down again and returned to its original shape.
"It seems that the user used it to go back three months ago and stayed there for a long time." Nick said with certainty. When he was about to continue the analysis, his face showed an unbelievable look because the golden hourglass was once again. Moved.
"How is this possible?!"
"What's wrong? Nick?" Dumbledore asked strangely.
"No wonder... no wonder the damage was so thorough." Nick LeMay said to himself before explaining it.
Because the power of time is too amazing, in order to avoid accidents when the holder of the time converter is in use, there is a protection mechanism on the time converter.
The safe time limit is five hours. Once this time limit is exceeded, the thing will become unstable, and it is easy to trigger the protection mechanism to send the user back to the original time and space.
Generally speaking, the longer the backtracking time, the more unstable the time converter will be, and it is difficult to stay for long...
However, the holder stayed for two months!
Nick LeMay did not know how the other party did this, the only thing that is certain is that the time converter should have been damaged after that.
But the holder used a certain method to make this time converter continue to perform high-intensity work, draining its last trace of magic...
"Albus, can you tell me who owns this time converter before?" Nick LeMay looked at Dumbledore with interest and asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 369: What are you worried about?
chapters.content:
Dumbledore was also surprised after listening to Nick's explanation.
When he saw the time converter, although he was surprised by the damage of this thing, he did not expect that Ivan would have the ability to affect the operation of the time converter.
But soon, Dumbledore recovered from his surprise and said to Nick.
"His name is Ivan Hals, a little wizard who just entered the third grade, I think you should have some reflections of this name!"
"Halse? Was it the one who protected the Philosopher's Stone last time?" Nick Lemay pondered for a while before thinking of who Dumbledore was talking about, and immediately had some good feelings for Ivan.
"Yes!" Dumbledore nodded.
"That's a coincidence. When I was reading the newspaper, I often saw him in the Daily Prophet..." Nick LeMay said with a smile.
Dumbledore noticed that there were many newspapers on the side table, the top ones were reports about Ivan, and then he remembered that Nick had always read every issue of the newspaper.
"I remember he should be a potion genius. Does he still know some alchemy?" Nick Lemay was a little confused. It is not easy to affect the operation of the time converter, and that requires extremely high alchemy.
"He is probably an extremely rare all-rounder... In the past two years, he has produced some very useful magic items. I heard that the Ministry of Magic has purchased a lot." Dumbledore praised.
"That's really an interesting little wizard..." Nick LeMay laughed. Even in his long career, he has never seen someone as good as Ivan at the age of twelve or thirteen. people.
This made Nick Le May interested in this little wizard who had never met before.
"Albus, since you are familiar with Hals, what do you think of his character?" Nick LeMay asked suddenly.
"What? Are you interested in taking another student?" Dumbledore laughed.
"Then you have to see if it fits or not, my wealth is always bad, and it will be cheaper for the Ministry of Magic..." Nick LeMay curled his lips.
has lived for more than six hundred years, and Nick LeMay has seen a lot of things. So he originally planned to donate all the books in his collection to Hogwarts after his death, and the rest will be handed over to the Ministry of Magic, leaving only this house and some memorable things for his funeral.
After all, he has no heirs at all, and none of the students he received in his early years can survive him. It can be said that he has nothing to worry about.
But the appearance of Ivan rekindled Nick Le May's interest in accepting disciples. He felt that this might be an arrangement of fate, otherwise it would not be such a coincidence.
"Halse? It's hard to tell..." Dumbledore groaned for a while, frowning, and did not give a clear response for a long time.
"Oh, don't even you can't figure it out? Feel embarrassed?" Nick Le May was very surprised. No matter how genius Ivan Hals was, he was nothing more than a twelve or thirteen-year-old wizard.
"He is a very complicated little wizard, and please forgive me for using these words to a child!" Dumbledore said, with a hint of memory on his face.
Dumbledore did not directly talk about his views to Nick LeMay, but as far as possible to explain to Nick LeMay from the perspective of an observer, what Ivan has done in recent years, and let Nick make his own judgment.
Among all the students he has taught, Ivan is undoubtedly the most special one. He has seen many beautiful qualities in Ivan, such as bravery, intelligence, loyalty to friends, and ability to resist temptation (return the old magic wand) and so on...
But at the same time, I also know that Ivan is eager to improve his strength, even risking his life for it, he is very good at lying and concealing, and he does not care about the Ministry of Magic and Hogwarts rules...
After speaking, Dumbledore looked at Nick LeMay quietly, looking forward to his evaluation.
"Wonderful...really wonderful!" Nick Lemey clapped his hands and couldn't help asking.
"Albus, are you sure you are talking about what happened, not a fairy tale from somewhere?"
Nick LeMay can hardly imagine that the little wizard named Ivan Hals had such a magical experience! Fighting monsters, riding dragons and flying, confronting mysterious people twice and defeating them, seeing through and driving away two professors of Defense Against the Dark Arts, this experience is legendary!
"It seems my luck is good!" Nick LeMay said with emotion.
Dumbledore laughed bitterly. He felt that Nick LeMay was too optimistic. In his opinion, Ivan was a little wizard who could easily go astray without guidance.
It is precisely because Ivan is so good that he needs to be vigilant and pay attention to guide him in the right direction...
"Can you imagine? Nick? After defeating the legendary Dark Lord, the first reaction of an eleven-year-old kid was to hide himself as much as possible, trying to push this glory off his friends, and his mind Make up reasons to fool me."
Thinking of the conversation he had with Ivan at the end of the first grade, Dumbledore felt a bit of a headache. He couldn't figure out what the other party was thinking about. You should know that he never felt like this when facing Tom when he was a child~www .mtlnovel.com~ You just feel that Hals' growth is beyond your control... so I feel uneasy! "Nick LeMay said indifferently, didn't care about Dumbledore's previous words, and then continued.
"Then I ask you...Does Hals hate Muggles? Want to kill them all?"
"No! He doesn't have any bad feelings about Muggles... and he has a close relationship with a child born in a Muggle family." Dumbledore shook his head.
"Or is he arrogant, vicious, arrogant, obsessed with the study of black magic?" Nick asked every word.
"Not really!" Dumbledore shook his head again.
"Then what are you still worried about?" Nick LeMay asked puzzledly. "You can't impose your standards on him, Albus! Not everyone is a saint, a capable little wizard. Isn’t it normal to have your own thoughts?
What if he wants to do something? There is nothing wrong with changing someone to be the Minister of Magic! It's better than some incompetent fools coming to power..."
Nick LeMay doesn't care about the small shortcomings of Ivan that Dumbledore said. Compared with Ivan's outstanding ability, these can be ignored.
And in his impression of those with great talents and amazing talents, no one is safe and guarded, and it is normal to want to do things.
The progress of the world is also driven by these people...
"Or, you saw your own shadow on him, so you keep on it?" Nick LeMay suddenly realized something and looked at Dumbledore and asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 370: Come on, professor! We have no college points to deduct...
chapters.content:
"Sure!" Dumbledore closed his eyes and said solemnly.
The more contact Ivan is, the more Dumbledore feels that Ivan is different from Tom Riddle!
Although they all have a dedication and desire for power, Ivan knows what love is... what is friendship! But Tom will never understand...
So in comparison, Ivan is more like himself when he was young, ambitious and thoughtful... and has some bottom lines!
It is precisely because of seeing his own shadow in Ivan that Dumbledore pays more attention to Ivan. He doesn't want him to be the same as himself, waiting for him to do something irreparable before he wakes up.
Having strong power is sometimes not a good thing, especially if it is so strong that other people can't fight you at all. Such people usually become arrogant, feel that they are superior and have the ability to control everything...
So it’s very important to learn how to restrain one's power, so as to ensure that the power can be used in the right place instead of causing damage...
Thinking of this, Dumbledore sighed. He didn't realize this until Ariana's death. This is undoubtedly a painful and profound lesson...
"But Hals is much better than I was at that time!" Dumbledore immediately said again, and he could not miss the deathly hallows like the old wand, even when he was a young man, he couldn't do it.
"I agree with this point!" Nick LeMay nodded in agreement.
Dumbledore was speechless.
"So you are a bit too wide, Albus!" Nick LeMay smiled and continued.
"I told you at the beginning that we are old. We only need to do our own business and let the young people handle the rest. Don’t you think it’s good now? Even if the mysterious person is resurrected, there will be some in the future. To deal with him..."
"Maybe," Dumbledore said non-committal.
He doesn't think so. It turns out that the lawful wizards in the magical world have too serious a fault.
Whether it was Grindelwald decades ago or the rising Voldemort, the entire European magical world could not find a wizard to fight against them besides himself. How could he be relieved?
If possible, he just wants to be his principal at Hogwarts quietly, but the burden on his body is too heavy, so he can't be free...
Nick LeMay saw that Dumbledore did not approve of his words, but Nick did not say much to persuade him. People like them have long been entrenched in their thinking, and they cannot be easily changed with a few words.
"When are you going to bring him to see me?" Nick LeMay said instead.
"We better wait...I think it's too early!" Dumbledore hesitated and persuaded. "Those alchemy knowledge is too dangerous, especially about the Philosopher's Stone! You should know the consequences of letting a child who is mentally retarded and still growing up master these..."
"I can teach him step by step, starting from the simplest!"
Nick LeMay did not agree with Dumbledore's statement, but he still felt the persistence of the old principal, and finally had no choice but to compromise.
"Well, I can wait, but you need to know that my time is running out... you better as soon as possible!"
Nick LeMay would like to meet Dumbledore's little wizard with such a legendary experience in person, but with his current physical condition, it is not easy to go out.
What's more, there is still Voldemort who covets the Sorcerer's Stone.
Now the Philosopher’s Stone has been completely destroyed by them, but the problem is that Voldemort may not be willing to believe it!
"I understand, it won't be too long!" Dumbledore assured him, then set his eyes on the damaged time converter on the table.
"By the way, what about this time converter? Can you fix it?"
"Of course, no problem! But recently I was working on a very interesting thing. I don't have time to fix it for the time being. You can pick it up later!" Nick LeMay waved his hand with lack of interest.
Dumbledore nodded, and after putting down the time converter, he called in Phoenix and left the alchemy hut...
......
At the same time, in the Hogwarts dean's office, Professor McGonagall was stern, angrily reprimanding the two little wizards in front of him.
"Mr. Hals, Miss Granger, I think Principal Dumbledore should have reminded you that the power of the time converter needs to be used with caution!"
"I'm sorry, Professor! I have been thinking about a potion improvement these days. I was too anxious, so I accidentally overused it and broke it... Fortunately, Professor Dumbledore told me that he has a Friends can fix this!" Ivan said apologetically.
Hearing that the damaged time converter can be repaired, Professor McGonagall breathed a sigh of relief, and then complained again.
"How can you think like this? Hals? Even for learning and research, there must be a limit! You still have time when you are young now, there is no need to be so anxious..."
If someone told her that she had broken a time converter because she was too active in studying, McGonagall would not believe it, but Hermione and Ivan are different.
The little witch usually performs very well and keeps the rules. Ivan is even more powerful than his peers, especially in transformation skills, much better than some adult wizardsPresumably on weekdays Do some hard practice in private...
More importantly, Yifan took out his research results-an improved version of the compound decoction, which greatly increased the duration of the potion compared with the original version, and the effect became more stable.
Of course, this is far less shocking than Ivan's development of the wolf poison potion last school year, but it is already a pretty good research result.
Professor McGonagall felt a little distressed when he thought of this, and seriously asked about the physical condition of Ivan and Hermione, how hard it would be to damage a time converter!
If it is not for frequent and high-intensity use in a short period of time, the time converter is not that easy to damage.
Ivan and Hermione shook their heads quickly, indicating that they are in good physical condition, and they have taken care to take a good rest when using the time converter.
Professor McGonagall felt more relieved, and then felt that this matter could not be forgotten, so he sternly said.
"Gryffindor was deducted 50 points for your actions! I hope you can remember this lesson!"
"But professor, now Gryffindor has no points to deduct..." Hermione replied weakly.
Professor McGonagall looked at them in surprise.
"Our college points have been deducted by Professor Dumbledore a long time ago!" Ivan explained indifferently, anyway, if you have more debt, can you deduct it as a negative number?
Professor McGonagall saw Ivan's expression in his eyes, guessed his thoughts, and raised his eyebrows and said to the two.
"Then I will save these fifty points for the next deduction!"

chapters.title: Chapter 371: Get it.. We've long been used to it!
chapters.content:
"Professor McGonagall is too serious? Actually intends to deduct a negative score..." Ivan, who came out of the dean's office, said with a headache.
He knows Professor McGonagall’s temperament very well, and he has always said that he can do it. Since he says that points will be deducted in the future, he will definitely be deducted!
"That's not true! Professor McGonagall is right... after all, we broke such a precious thing!" Hermione retorted, then turned her head worriedly to look at Ivan and spoke again.
"Right... Ivan! Is it really okay for us to say that before?"
"Of course it's okay, I believe even Professor Dumbledore doesn't want too many people to know about that thing!" Ivan nodded.
The less people know about his use of the time converter to go back to the past, the better, so Ivan has always fooled the professors of various subjects with the reason that he was too busy studying and was busy developing improved compound decoctions.
Because of this, all the professors except Professor McGonagall understood this and let them pass the test easily.
By the way, he also canceled the two courses of arithmetic, divination and Muggle studies, so that they would not have conflicting courses every day...
Walking on the way to the auditorium, Ivan, who was a little confused about Hermione's choice, couldn't help but ask.
"I remember that you don't really hate Professor Trelawney. Do you think she is babbling all day long? Why don't you just cancel the divination class?"
"That was before! I don't think so now!" Hermione gave Ivan a blank look. "Have you forgotten? Professor Trelawney successfully predicted our experience!"
Then the little witch was excited, speaking of her analysis in a puzzle-solving tone, and completed the predictions given to them by Professor Trelawney.
【You will (make) witness a killing! Blood on the ground is like hell! 】
"According to the above statement, the moment you picked up my teacup, the fate of the two of us were linked together! So Professor Trelawney must have seen the fate of both of us at the same time when interpreting it!"
Hermione opened the book "Pull Away the Confusion and See the Future" she had been holding, pointed to a certain page and analyzed it, not forgetting to read it twice when she walked.
She feels that as long as she works hard, one day she can predict the future like Professor Trelawney and avoid risks in advance.
Ivan agreed perfunctorily, but he understood that Trelawney's predictive ability was entirely due to talent, and it was impossible to become a prophet just by reading a book.
And he and Hermione didn't have the talent to be oracles.
Ivan thinks that among the people he knows, Luna’s temperament and excellent intuition are more suitable for learning this.
The two walked and talked, and soon arrived at the auditorium.
As it happened to be dinner, it seemed very lively. Several little wizards nearby were talking about the Quidditch game in a few days and some interesting things in class.
This relaxed atmosphere made Ivan, who had just returned from Knockturn Alley, somewhat uncomfortable. Occasionally, his eyes swept across the empty Gryffindor scoring pool that was placed aside, and Ivan felt a guilty conscience inexplicably.
After all, I can say that I deducted the Gryffindor academy all at once...
The little witch lowered her head all the way.
But when the two of them sneaked over to the long table at Gryffindor College and sat down, they discovered that no one was discussing the emptying of the credit pool.
Ivan was very surprised. He thought that such a big thing had happened. These Gryffindor little lions would definitely eagerly discuss who did it, and even isolate him and Hermione for this reason.
The little witch couldn't help but asked in a whisper.
"Harry, Ron, haven't you noticed that our Gryffindor college points are all deducted?"
"I've seen it a long time ago! When someone passed by the dean's office just now, I heard Professor McGonagall furious, as if he was still calling your name... so you really did it?" Harry said casually, then immediately Guessed the truth from Hermione's reaction.
Ron also looked at the two with a weird look, what did they do? Can you deduct more than a hundred points?
"It's just a little accident..." Ivan didn't give much explanation, and then continued to speak curiously. "Why don't you seem to care very much?"
"Come on.. We are used to it. It's not the first time that the college points have been emptied..." At this time, George, who was eating a steak, approached him and said indifferently.
"And you will always find a way to add it back at the end of the semester... right?" Fred joked with a grin.
In the first two academic years, Gryffindor successfully won the Academy Cup with Ivan and other talents. Usually, Ivan and Hermione have the most extra points. This time, they only deducted more than 100 points. Of course not. Someone will complain about them.
Ivan glanced around and found that, as George and Fred had said, the little lions in Gryffindor were calm.
It’s a habit of deducting points, which is no one...
Ivan shook his head secretly, looked at the Weasley brothers who made fun of him and said funny. "Since you all said that, of course I can't disappoint you, am I?"
George and Fred looked at each other. They were just joking, but they didn't expect Ivan to look confident, so they immediately asked curiously.
Ivan kept silent and looked secret. He naturally had to rely on Peter for extra points this time!
As long as he uncovered this traitor who was regarded as a hero by the Ministry of Magic, and by the way, allowed Sirius Bright, a core member of the Order of the Phoenix, to be unjustified, Dumbledore would be happy to add a few hundred points to him, that would not be easy. ..
Just as Ivan was thinking this way, a familiar voice rang in front of him.
"Halse, I heard that you committed something stupid and was scolded severely by your dean, isn't it? I thought you were always a good baby to the professors!"
Hearing this sound, Ivan frowned, turned his head and looked over, and saw the proud Malfoy walking over with his two stunned attendants.
"Malfoy, haven't you been so scared that you are hiding under the covers and crying these days? Why are you taking care of my business?" Ivan didn't even mean to be angry, raised his eyebrows, and said unexpectedly. .
It was obvious that Malfoy feared him like a tiger some time ago, and would hide away from him every time he met, but today he took the initiative to approach him rather abnormally.
You suddenly became very brave...boy!
Ivan gave Malfoy a surprised look. "Also, Malfoy, if I remember correctly, you still owe me a thank you. How about speaking out loud now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 372: Are you playing Harry right like this? !
chapters.content:
Malfoy's pale cheeks flushed suddenly, he gritted his teeth.
"Don't forget Hals! That stupid big silly bird almost killed me!
If my father knew about this, he would definitely let the Ministry of Magic put that stupid man and his stupid bird into Azkaban! So we are even! "
Malfoy said loudly on purpose so that everyone could understand that he had actually paid his favor.
These days, he has been brooding about Ivan saving him, but it is impossible to thank you. It is impossible in this life!
Fortunately, he racked his brains and finally thought of such a way. Isn't that stupid Hagrid a friend of Ivan? I let him go, which just offset Ivan's kindness.
This is why he came to Ivan today!
"Forget it! If you say it is even, then it will be even!" Ivan waved his hand uninterestedly. He originally wanted to use this thing to tease Malfoy from time to time. It would be very interesting.. .
But now it seems impossible. For things like saviour, as long as the other party is cheeky and improper, you can't help it, right?
Ivan's casual attitude made Malfoy a bit awkward.
He had imagined Ivan’s various reactions, and even thought about the following words. However, Ivan’s attitude made him hit the cotton with a heavy punch. All his previous preparations were lost and he was really suffocated. Very contorted.
"Malfoy, even if you tell your dad about that, Hagrid will not be imprisoned in Azkaban!" Harry couldn't help correcting the loophole in Malfoy's words.
He felt that the reason Buckbeak almost hurt Malfoy was because Malfoy did not act according to Hagrid's instructions. This incident was not Hagrid's fault!
And Professor Dumbledore can't let Hagrid be imprisoned!
"Shut up, Potter, there is nothing to do with you!" Malfoy gave Harry a vicious look, startled him, then looked at Ivan and said with a throat.
"Since you think we have evened, then I won't keep my hands in the next Quidditch match, I will beat you personally on the field!"
Having said that, Malfoy glanced at the empty Gryffindor scoring pool and grinned. "Of course there is this year's Academy Cup! It looks like it will belong to our Slytherin too!"
"Sorry, haven't you heard? I stopped playing long ago!" Ivan shook his head, then sighed and continued. "The Quidditch game at school is really boring! There is not even a decent opponent..."
Although Ivan was not in the mood to participate in the Quidditch competition because of his busy studies and worrying about the safety of Isiah, it does not prevent him from sighing so much, isn't it?
After hearing Ivan’s words, the Quidditch players from the surrounding academies turned their heads and glared at him, but no one retorted them.
Last year, Ivan’s performance in the Quidditch competition was so amazing that it left an indelible impression on them, so that the first reaction to learning that Ivan would not compete this year was a sigh of relief and felt that this year’s championship is hopeful. ...The anger that follows is precisely because of this.
Malfoy had a surprised expression. He had been avoiding Ivan before without asking for news, so he didn't know about Ivan's withdrawal from Quidditch.
"Malfoy, don't even think about this year's Academy Cup, but Hals promised us that these points will be added back sooner or later!" George and Fred sneered and wanted Malfoy to dispel his unrealistic ideas.
"Really?" Malfoy had eyes on Wei Mi, and soon realized that Ivan was so indifferent, maybe he had discovered some important secret that could allow Dumbledore to give them extra points.
It's just that the conclusive evidence may not be found yet, so there is no action.
In the previous two academic years, Ivan discovered the anomaly of two Defence Against the Dark Arts professors and won the Academy Cup for Gryffindor College.
Thinking of this, Malfoy's heart moved. He felt that this year's new professor might also have a problem, so he said to Ivan enthusiastically.
"Then wait and see! I will expose him before you!"
After a provocation, Malfoy took Gore and Clark away...
Ivan is at a loss. I don't quite understand why Malfoy is always targeting himself recently. Isn't it possible to take the wrong medicine?
Are you playing Harry right like this? !
Ivan turned his head and glanced at Harry. Sure enough, Harry also had an angry expression on his face. He was telling Malfoy with Ron that it was not...
But Ivan did not participate, and these little conflicts with Malfoy were not in his mind. He still has a lot of important things to do.
For example, find out where Sirius is, or for example fusion of the blood of the third kind of magical creature!
As early as the end of the last school year, the legendary points he had accumulated had reached four points. With this legendary incident, there was already enough to redeem the protection mode.
As for which kind of magical creature to integrate this semester, Ivan hasn't figured out yet.
There are many magical creatures in Hogwarts,
Horsemen, elves, merfolk, eagle-headed horse-winged beasts, phoenixes, night skies, and other magical creatures hidden in the forbidden forest and unknown to Ivan can be said to be rich in species.
But Ivan is not much interested!
First of all, the horseman and the mermaid Ivan are not prepared to merge. The horseman has no special place except for his strong body and wisdom. The mermaid can increase his underwater combat ability with a high probability, and the effect is really limited.
Elf is a good choice. The fact that some magic can be released without a wand is very exciting for Ivan. He can also ask Dobby to draw some blood at any time, which is very convenient!
It is a pity that the magic of the elf and the wizard overlap too much, and the blood fusion object is a more important characteristic. After all, after the fusion, usually only a part of the opponent's power can be obtained, so it is an alternative.
Eagle head horses with wings can also be eliminated, because this kind of magical creature has no characteristics. It is not as good as fusing the blood of the night qi. At least the night qi has a special ability, that is, only those who understand death can See it.
This trait related to the concept of death may be able to combine with some magic to evolve a good ability.
Ivan’s best fusion object is the natural phoenix!
From what I have learned before, the Phoenix has at least three powerful qualities: controlling flames, teleporting, and rebirth from the ashes!
However, Fox stayed in the principal’s room all day, so Ivan didn’t dare to start...
Other than that, none of his favorite creatures such as thunderbirds, snails, birds and snakes can be touched now...
Ivan was absent-mindedly eating dinner, thinking about which kind of magical creature he could come into contact with could bring him even greater improvement.

chapters.title: Chapter 373: When are you going to let us change to a new professor?
chapters.content:
After dinner in such a hurry, Ivan returned to the Gryffindor lounge with everyone.
entered the bedroom, Ivan slapped his head and remembered something, and then took out the invisibility cloak that had been coming back from Hermione.
"Harry, your invisibility cloak! Thank you, this thing helped me a lot!"
Speaking of this, Ivan is also a little emotional.
If it were not for the help of the invisibility cloak, it would not be so easy for him to solve the group of invading dark wizards and Bok and others.
It seems that he had underestimated the power of this Deathly Hallows before. When the other party did not specially prepare targeted props, few people could prevent them from sneak attacks and assassinations wearing invisible cloaks.
"So what you have to do is done, so fast?" Harry took the Invisibility Cloak over by accident. He remembered Ivan only borrowed it from him last night, and there seems to be no sign of going out today.
"Well, it's just to deal with some small things." Ivan didn't want to mention the time converter, so he said vaguely.
Harry saw that Ivan was unwilling to say that, although he was still a little curious, he finally shook his head and didn't ask any more questions.
At this time, Ivan put his gaze on Scabbard's body, and the gray-black mouse was still dozing off Ron's bedside.
Perhaps he felt some malice. Peter Pettigrew suddenly woke up from his sleep. He looked around suspiciously and found nothing unusual, but he felt a little uneasy in his heart.
can't do it, I want to...
When Peter Pettigrew was thinking about it, the whole mouse was suddenly stunned.
咦... Have you already said this sentence yourself?
In the middle of the night, Peter Peter, who was secretly trying to sneak out, was caught upright again.
Ivan pinched the gray-black mouse that had passed out and touched his chin. It was strange. He clearly didn't need the "little mouse" to do the experiment now. Why did Peter run out so actively?
Isn't he addicted to being a guinea pig?
......
The next day, in the afternoon,
After finishing a potion class, Ivan and others walked towards the classroom of Defence Against the Dark Arts class.
Along the way, Harry and Ron were discussing the college points Snape had deducted in class, and they were a little bit happy for some reason.
"I guess when Snape was deducting points, he must have not thought that we had no credits to deduct." Harry said with a smile. He was deducted by Snape today by twenty points.
Ron was grinning too, he wanted to know what Snape would look like when he saw the empty scoring pool in Gryffindor.
Ivan looked weird and looked at the happy appearance of the two of them. Is this still something to be thankful for?
After everyone arrived in the classroom and sat down, it took a long time for Lupin, who was the teaching professor, to arrive late and walked in from outside.
I haven't seen him for half a month, Lupin's complexion is much better than before, but he is still in that ragged clothes. After raising his hand and placing the tattered old box on the podium, he smiled and said.
"Good afternoon, everyone! I am your new Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor, you can call me Professor Lupin!"
At this point, Luping paused. He looked around and saw that all the little wizards were holding thick textbooks in their hands, and then said again.
"Today we are going to take a practical class, so please put the textbooks back in your schoolbags, you only need to bring your magic wands!"
"Come with me now, let's go to a wider venue!" Lupin picked up the old suitcase on the table and motioned for everyone to follow.
The little wizards underneath are expecting and worrying. If they can wave their wands, no one wants to sit in the classroom and listen to the class.
But Lockhart really had a very bad start last school year, and it messed up everything, leaving everyone with a psychological shadow.
"I hope he doesn't be like Lockhart..." Seamus whispered to the little wizard next to him.
However, Lupin turned his head abruptly as if he had heard it, and Seamus was taken aback and his face turned pale.
Lupin just smiled at him without saying anything, and then led a group of little wizards through the empty corridor, around a corner, and arrived at the door of a classroom.
But Pippi, who likes to play pranks, is blocking the door, hanging upside down in the air, and stuffing chewing gum into the keyhole closest to him.
It wasn't until everyone was very close that Pepigui realized that it was wrong. He raised his head and looked at Lupin, who was close at hand. The smile on his face became worse. It floated into the air, clapping his hands and singing loudly.
"Fuzzy Lupin, crazy fool..."
Seeing that Pippi had the guts to provoke the new professor, everyone was very surprised. They all looked forward to Professor Lupin's reaction and wanted to see how he would deal with the annoying Pippi!
"Pippy! If I were you, I would take the gum out of the keyhole!" Lupin was still smiling, and he said happily, "You are like this, Mr. Filch can't get in and get the broomstick. Up."
Pippi ghost pulled out a grimace regardless, it and Filch were already at a loss.
The reason why Filch’s attention is drawn to Filch when he occasionally catches students who violate the rules is only because he prefers to tease the little ghosts Seeing them panicked, And enjoy a game of peekaboo.
Pippi glanced in the crowd, and when he saw Ivan's figure, his eyes suddenly lit up, and he yelled loudly while pulling his throat.
"And you, Hals! Can you tell me something? When are you going to let us change to a new professor this time?"
Lupin's face changed slightly, and he looked at Ivan subconsciously.
Ivan is also a little tired of Pippi, so he suggested.
"Professor, I think your first lesson, how about teaching us how to deal with a troublemaker? I believe everyone should be very interested!"
Hearing Ivan’s words, a group of little wizards looked at Peppy ghosts unkindly. Most of Gryffindor’s little lions have been tricked by Peppy ghosts.
"Of course, no problem!" Pippi's previous words made a gentleman like Lupin also a little angry, so he followed Ivan's words and said to everyone. "I know a very useful little spell that can be used specifically for this situation."
The triumphant Pippi's face became very ugly at once, it yelled, and then hurriedly flew outside.
But it was too late, Lupin quickly raised his wand with his right hand, pointed it at Pippi, and shouted loudly.
"Wadi Wasi!"
The gum in the keyhole flew out with a swish, and with a "swish", it stuffed it into Pepigui's left nostril, staggered it, and ran around the corridor in a panic.
The rest of the students also learned the same way, raising their wands aloft and making a sound
"Wadi Wasi!"

chapters.title: Chapter 374: The corridor is full of joy
chapters.content:
Although these little wizards released this spell for the first time, fortunately, this magic is not difficult to learn. Nearly 40% of the students successfully released this spell!
For a while, a large number of buttons, multi-flavored beans, candy bags and other small objects smashed towards Pipigui.
Pippi was so scared that he let out a harsh scream, quickly got into a pair of armor at the end of the corridor, and never dared to come out again...
All the little wizards laughed at the appearance of Pippi ghosts running away in a hurry, and the hallway was suddenly full of joy...
At this time, Lupin turned his head and looked at everyone, with a smile on his face. "The people who successfully released the curse just now raised their hands, let me see who has learned this little magic?"
Hermione raised her hand high, Harry was only one step slower than her, and besides the two of them, three Gryffindor wizards raised their hands.
As for Ivan, of course, this magic is easy for him.
"Very good! There are six people. Because of your outstanding performance, I will add five points to each of you!" Lupin applauded and said with appreciation, and then he did not forget to comfort the little wizards who failed to successfully cast the spell. Explain the technique of using this magic patiently to them.
In just a few minutes, the little wizards who were still questioning Lupin’s ability have all changed their minds, and their affection for him has greatly increased!
Ivan can easily win the favor of these little wizards by watching Lupin, and he is somewhat emotional. If Lupin is a werewolf, he would definitely be able to mix well in the magical world...
"Okay, let's go in!" Lupin opened the door of the staff lounge, and then smiled mysteriously. "Tackling Pippi is just an appetizer for this lesson, you have to be mentally prepared!"
Harry and the others were nervous and expectant and followed Lupin into the door.
"I can accept everything else, I hope it's not just a spider!" Ron even quietly complained to Ivan.
"This is not necessarily true. I heard that there is an eight-eyed giant spider the size of a car in the Forbidden Forest. Maybe Professor Lupin will catch it and let us see the world!" Ivan said jokingly, and Ron was scared to face. Up...
Ivan certainly knew that Lupin's lesson would allow them to deal with Bogut, but for Ron it was no different from dealing with Big Spider, so let him prepare in advance.
stepped into this long classroom, Ivan looked around, the decoration inside the classroom looks a bit old, the walls around are inlaid with wooden boards, and the room is full of old chairs that don't match.
Lupin, who was walking in front, tapped his magic wand, the tables and chairs were swept to the corner, leaving a large open space, and then he planned to swing his magic wand to close the door.
Just then, a gloomy voice came.
"Don't close the door, Lupin! I think it's better not to witness your bad teaching methods..."
Lupin raised his eyebrows and stopped his movements.
Ivan heard that the reputation passed, and Snape was walking over from the right, holding a reagent bottle in his hand.
Ron and others were very angry by Snape’s words. After experiencing the previous Pippi, they had a very good sense of Lupin.
Harry retorted angrily.
"We all think that Professor Lu Ping taught very well, at least better than..."
"Shut up, Potter!" Snape interrupted Harry's follow-up words, staring at him with eagle-like eyes, "Whoever insults a professor, Gryffindor deducts thirty points!"
Harry's pupils stared big, and the other Gryffindor cubs were glaring at Snape. Snape would have been riddled with holes if his eyes could kill.
They knew that Snape must have heard what Professor Lupin said to them outside the door, because Lupin had just added 30 points to them before.
"Severus, I'm in class now!" Professor Lu Ping frowned and reminded him in a tone of voice.
But just as Lupin was about to say something again, Snape revealed the dark brown potion in his hand and dangled it in the air deliberately before handing it to Lupin and speaking.
"This is your medicine, I have already prepared it in advance, so don't bother me again when that time comes!"
Lupin faintly felt something was wrong, but he accepted it silently, and put it away for the first time. Snape didn't stay much, and walked away neatly.
"Okay...let's forget this episode and continue to class!" Lu Ping watched the little wizards change the subject, and then said.
"Also I just decided to give the student who performed the best this time an extra 30 points! So you have to work hard!"
After Lupin's voice fell, the sound of a heavy door slamming came from behind, and Harry and the others laughed cheerfully. They could guess that Snape's face must be ugly when he closed the door without looking back.
Lupin also smiled with everyone, but after staring at Ivan, the smile on his face gradually disappeared.
He suddenly realized why Snape had to give him the wolf poison potion at this time because Ivan, as the developer of the wolf poison potion, could definitely recognize what this potion was, so he guessed Out of his identity.
Thinking of this, Lu Ping felt uneasy, staying in the same place for a long time without moving, which made the little wizards very strange.
At this time, Ivan, who seemed to be chatting with Hermione, turned his head, looked at Lupin who had been stunned for a long time, and said aloud.
"Professor Lupin, what's the matter? Are we not in class?"
"Oh, no, it's nothing!" Lu Ping quickly reacted, and after observing Ivan's expression, he couldn't find anything unusual and he was relieved. He thought that Ivan should have been chatting with that Miss Granger just now, and did not notice the bottle of potion.
But what Lupin didn't know was that these were all deliberately pretended by Ivan.
When Snape took out the bottle of wolf poison potion, Ivan guessed that Snape wanted to use his "defence against the dark arts class professor killer" to drive Lupin away.
After all, Dumbledore should have asked Snape to guarantee that he would not reveal the identity of Lupin's werewolves, but because of Snape's aversion to Lupin, it was inevitable to engage in small actions in private.
The original time-space Risnep introduced to Harry and the others the habits of werewolves and how to distinguish a werewolf during a short substitute lesson, hoping which student would be smarter and proactively discover Lupin’s identity.
This time it caught his attention...
Unfortunately, Snape probably didn’t expect that Lupin’s identity as a werewolf wizard had long been known, and Ivan had no intention of dealing with Lupin. Apart from the identity of a werewolf, Lupin was still very qualified as a professor.

chapters.title: Chapter 375: The most scared thing
chapters.content:
"Come here, all come here!" Lu Ping quickly adjusted his emotions and brought a group of little wizards to the side of an old closet.
As everyone approached, the closet suddenly shook violently, and the door of the cabinet was banged and banged, as if something was about to come out of it.
Nawei and others were taken aback at once, stepped back a few steps frightenedly, and looked at the cabinet suspiciously.
Lupin smiled when he saw this scene, stretched out his hand to pat the old closet, and said. "Don't worry, this is what you need to deal with in this class, a Bogut!"
"Bogut likes dark and enclosed spaces! He usually hides in the old closet, in the void under the bed, or in the cupboard under the sink... I once ran into a master clock. "Professor Lu Ping explained to the little wizards, and then continued.
"This Bogut just moved in yesterday afternoon. I asked the principal to let the professors keep it for us to use in class!"
"Then who knows what Bogut is?" Lu Ping looked around the crowd and asked.
Hermione raised her hand high on her toes. Lupin was trying to get her to answer a question when a voice rang from the crowd.
"Professor! Bogut is a magical creature that can transform! It can see through your heart and become the thing you fear most."
"If you want to deal with them, the best way to deal with it is to laugh! But few people can laugh in the face of fear, so this usually requires a spell to assist-funny! This spell can make Borg It becomes what you think is the most funny!"
