"It's also worth mentioning that Bogut is not aggressive, just for the purpose of scaring people, so if you have a good psychological quality, you can completely ignore its existence... And if there are many people around, Bogut can fall into chaos. , Let it not know what it should become."
Ivan talked endlessly about Bogut's characteristics, and finally looked at Lupin and spoke out. "Am I right? Professor? I think there is nothing to add, right?"
"Ah! That's right... you're good! Gryffindor adds 10 points!" Lupin was taken aback for a while, his expression strange.
Ivan has finished all the content he is going to talk about in this lesson, so what should he talk about later?
"But I need to remind you, Hals! Please remember to raise your hand first when answering the question next time." Lu Ping said helplessly.
"I don't think you can stop a student's eagerness to answer questions!" Ivan looked at Lupin very seriously, without giving in the slightest.
Lupin was very speechless. When he was about to say something, he heard Ivan suddenly apologize.
"I'm sorry, Professor! You should know that I accidentally deducted all of Gryffindor's college points yesterday, so I want to work harder and earn back all the lost college points..."
After Ivan finished speaking, Lu Ping abruptly suffocated the words that had arrived. He looked at Ivan with a little bit of understanding in his eyes. It turned out to be like this, no wonder...
Harry and the others rolled their eyes. Regardless of whether Ivan had any points deducted before class, he could always think of a way to answer questions as soon as possible, and let the teachers of all subjects have nothing to do with him...
"Ahem.. In that case, you will be the first to deal with Bogut and give you a demonstration! If you can make a good start, I will consider adding ten more to you!" Lupin cleared his throat and said to Ivan.
Ivan nodded happily. He didn't expect that he would have unexpected gains by talking nonsense. It seemed that he could increase a lot of grade points in this class.
Thinking like this, Ivan walked to the old closet, seeming to notice someone outside the door, and the old closet shook more violently.
The little wizards on the sidelines looked forward to this scene. Since Ivan has been so popular in school in recent years, it seems that there is nothing he can't do, so many little wizards want to see Ivan the most feared. What is the thing.
It’s hard for Hermione to imagine that there will be something Ivan is afraid of in this world...
"You said the spell against Bogut just now, but I want to remind you that it is funny again!"
Lupin waved his wand to show Ivan the gestures when casting a spell, and then waved his hand to let everyone move away from the field. He was also very interested in what Bogut was about to change.
At this time, Ivan has already started Occlumency, and I want to try whether Occlumency can affect Bogut's judgment!
More importantly, Ivan suddenly remembered that what he feared was not easy to expose.
If Bogut turns into Acia in a pool of blood in front of everyone, then Dumbledore may have guessed something.
Ivan’s calm guilty conscience is beginning to become a little messy, but on the surface it still looks calm and calm So, let’s start now! "Lupin didn't give Ivan too much time to think, a string of sparks shot from the wand held in his right hand, and it shot directly at the door handle of the old wardrobe.
The closet door suddenly opened, and a group of black, constantly distorting things rushed out, frightening everyone, and several little witches screamed in fear.
"Don't panic! Let's step back a bit, Bogut just hasn't figured out what to change yet. It seems that he is a little confused and can't find what Hals is afraid of!" Lupin comforted the crowd loudly. There was a puzzled expression on his face. It was the first time he had seen this situation.
Ivan secretly breathed a sigh of relief, Occlumency is more useful than he thought!
However, Ivan soon discovered that as Bogut got closer and closer to him, his body shape was also changing. The speed was very slow, and it seemed to be disturbed by something.
The figure gradually changed from a weird sphere to a humanoid appearance. Bogut imitated and became more and more similar to Ivan, but within a moment of effort, another Ivan Hals appeared in the crowd. In front of.
Everyone present showed a stunned look. They didn't understand why the person Ivan feared the most was himself.
The little blond wizard that Bogut turned into stood opposite Ivan, his face full of apologetic expressions.
"Sorry, actually I..." It opened its mouth and opened its mouth. It was a little unstable, and it was faintly about to change again.
However, Ivan, who had guessed what it was going to say next, did not give Bogut a chance to continue talking and transform, so he took the first shot.
"Funny and funny!"

chapters.title: Chapter 376: Don't pretend, I'm showing off! actually, I....
chapters.content:
The blond little wizard who was opposed to Ivan banged on and put on a flower top hat and lace skirt, with a look of horror on his face.
The students behind suddenly burst into bursts of laughter,
Ivan was stunned when he saw this scene, right? Why has it become like this? Do I subconsciously think that I look funny in women's clothing?
"Funny!" Ivan could only make another shot, actively thinking about the changes in his heart.
The 　　 women's version of the blond little wizard suddenly turned into a short circus clown, dressed in a strange way, wearing a pair of roller shoes, holding a few colorful **** in his hand and constantly tossing, he couldn't stop in a hurry.
"Very good presentation! Gryffindor adds very much!" Lupin applauded and spoke with satisfaction, and then asked aloud: "Bogut seems to have become like you just now? Can you tell me why? ?"
Lupin looked at Bogut's abnormal situation before, and he clearly saw that Bogut was interrupted by Ivan when he was about to say something, so he was very curious.
Maybe I think this is a bit of an invasion of personal privacy, and Lu Ping deliberately added: "Of course, it's okay if you don't want to say it, I just think some people are afraid that they are strange.
All the little wizards also looked at Ivan one after another.
"No, there is nothing to say!" Hearing everyone's gaze, Ivan shrugged indifferently, coughed a few times, and continued with a serious face.
"I'm sorry, I have to show you something!"
Ivan's serious expression made everyone more curious, but Ivan heard it with emotion.
"Actually, I am not a genius, I just spend all your playing time on studying, so I have always been afraid of being discovered by you!"
Hearing this, Harry and the others rolled their eyes together, they didn't even know where to complain!
Lupin also shook his head helplessly. He remembered that when he first arrived, because of the chance encounter on the train, he had asked several teaching professors about the past of the little wizard Ivan.
I learned from them that besides learning well and being motivated, what impressed their professors the most was that they liked to do strange things and say strange things, which seems to be the case now.
Thinking of this, Lupin stopped struggling with this question. Turning to look around, put his eyes on Neville, the worst performer after Bogut rushed out just now, and beckoned him to come forward to replace Ivan.
"Me?" Neville shrank into the crowd with a surprised expression. He couldn't believe that Lupin would touch him.
After repeated confirmations, Neville tremblingly approached Bogut.
At this point of delay, the magic applied to Bogut has become extremely weak, so when Neville walked in front of him, Bogut began to change again.
After a while, Professor Snape, wearing a black robe with a gloomy face, appeared in front of everyone, staring at Neville with eagle-like eyes, and walked towards him step by step.
"Ah!" Neville was so frightened that his face became pale and blue, and he backed away again and again.
"Quick! Spell!" Lupin reminded him from the side.
At this moment "Snape" had already walked to the front of Neville, a face almost stuck in front of him, Neville screamed in fear, and raised his hand tremblingly. "Snape" was poked with his wand. Face.
"Slip-funny!"
With a crisp sound, "Snape" lifted his head and flew out, fell into a dog, and finally got up from the ground but his body changed.
The black robe on 　　 has turned into a lace-up dress, with a tall hat on top of his head, a vulture that has been eaten by insects on the hat, and a big red handbag in his hand.
Snape turned into Bogut seemed to have discovered this too, awkwardly covering his lace skirt with a big handbag.
The little wizards all around laughed. They had never seen a gloomy Snape dressed up like this, making such a twisted movement.
Nawei's magic really made them sulking, so all the little wizards looked at him with admiration.
Nawei relieved his fear at this time and smiled happily.
Ivan shook his head secretly in the back. Poor Neville might have to suffer for the next potions class...
But looking at the women's version of Snape, Ivan also found it interesting. Although it's boring to look at his own women's clothing, it's interesting to see others.
Next, Lupin asked the little wizards to face Bogut one by one, casting spells to overcome the fear in his heart. Poor Bogut was played with by everyone, and the tossing was enough, and finally he was on the spot with loud laughter. The explosion turned into scattered smoke!
Of course, for some special reason, Lupin didn't let Harry deal with that Bogut.
So even if Lupin casually found a reason to add 10 points to Harry at the end of the course, Harry was still a bit aggrieved!
At the end of the course, Lupin clapped his hands and attracted everyone's attention and said:
"Okay, let's stop here for our first class! Each of you did a great job! This far exceeded my expectations. As for your homework, please read the textbook about Borg The special chapter, let’s summarize it in simple words... due on Monday!"
While speaking, Lupin remembered his previous promise again, and continued to speak.
"In addition, the best performer in this class is Mr. Hals! He not only released the spell most calmly, but also helped other students overcome their fear... Then I will honor my promise and give him an extra 30 points!"
At the same time, the system prompt sounded in Ivan's mind.
【Ding, the course of Defence Against the Dark Arts is over
This comprehensive class evaluation: satisfied
Evaluator: Lupin
Reward: academic points*0
Additional bonus points: academic points *40]
Seeing the course evaluation in the system column, Ivan was very satisfied. He got a full 50 grade points for one class, which is the most rewarding one for him!
When other little wizards heard Lu Ping say that the course was over, they were still a little bit unsatisfied. They thought this was the best Defense Against the Dark Arts class they had ever taken. It was novel and interesting.
So that after leaving the classroom, he was still discussing interesting things in the class in twos and threes. In the corridor, Seamus kept trying to tell everyone how he subdued the horror ghost girl Bogut became...
Ivan recalled Bogut’s performance in class, and suddenly realized that the abilities of this magical creature seemed pretty good...

chapters.title: Chapter 377: The idea of ​​merging with new blood
chapters.content:
Thinking of this, Ivan had some thoughts and included Bogut in the list of options for integration.
Don’t look at Bogut, this magical creature is very weak and non-aggressive, but this ever-changing ability looks very good to Ivan, and it can be used in many situations.
After all, Bogut can become too many things!
From dead objects such as tables, chairs, pots and pans, to living objects such as wizards and small animals, even magical creatures can be transformed!
For example, in the original time and space, when Harry used Bogut's ability to practice calling the gods, Bogut turned into a dementor. For a time, Harry realized that he was facing a real dementor. There was a sense of fear, and he passed out again in a coma!
This means that Bogut’s transformation is not a simple blind trick or illusion, but a real change of body shape, and the camouflage is extremely high, it is difficult to be seen!
Of course, Ivan knows very well that Bogut’s deformed things cannot have the power of the original version, and they are bound to be accompanied by various restrictions, such as the weakness of being broken after hearing a lot of laughter!
Otherwise, Bogut’s hazard rating would not be so low, even a junior wizard can handle it...
But even so, it is enough to make Ivan tempted!
Not to mention that Bogut was able to sense what the other party feared the most. Even his Level 5 Occlumency cannot block this perception.
This is a kind of magical creature with weak strength and very special ability!
is very suitable to be his next fusion target!
Just don’t know if Bogut has blood?
Ivan touched his chin and recalled what he had read in the book about Bogut. After this creature died, it would usually explode into wisps of smoke and dissipate. It seemed that there was no such thing as blood.
But this will not cause much hindrance. Ivan has once seen from Slytherin's research notes that some key things on the opponent's body can be used as substitutes for magical creatures without blood.
Ivan became more and more interested in thinking about it, gradually increasing Bogut's priority, using it as the first sequence target of this blood fusion together with the night qi and the elf.
Which one to choose, Yifan hasn't made a decision yet, and is ready to wait for the blood fusion potion to complete before making any plans.
Unknowingly, a few people walked all the way from the classroom to the auditorium.
While eating dinner, Ron was still excitedly discussing his previous Defence Against the Dark Arts class. "Professor Lupin is amazing! This is the Defence Against the Dark Arts class I've been looking forward to! I don't know what we will deal with in the next class... Three-headed dog? Giant? Or the murloc in the lake? "
"How is it possible? It's not Hagrid who is in class...it should be Red Hat or Kabbah!" Hermione opened the textbook, and after the chapter introducing Bogut, there were the two magical creatures, Red Hat and Kabbah.
"That's also very interesting. It's better than sitting in a classroom and reading a textbook!" Ron's expression was not diminished in excitement. Unfortunately, the next Defence Against the Dark Arts class was several days later. Some can't wait.
Then Ron remembered that Bogut had turned into a silver-white ball when he approached Lupin in class, and curiously said, "Why do you say Professor Lupin is afraid of a crystal ball?"
But this time no one answered him. Hermione vaguely thought of some quick flipping through the book in her hand, and Harry thought about things sullenly.
Ivan brandished a knife and fork and cut a small piece of cattle into his mouth. He was silent. He knew that Lupin was not afraid of the crystal ball but the full moon.
Because the night of the full moon will cause the werewolf to transform and lose his mind, it will usually cause great damage, thereby exposing the identity of the werewolf as a wizard and being driven out by other wizards.
Lupin must have experienced similar things many times before he was afraid of the full moon!
It's just that Ivan didn't want Ron and the others to know so quickly, lest they accidentally leak or be heard by others.
At the same time, Ivan noticed something wrong with Harry's expression, and after swallowing the steak, he looked at Harry and asked aloud. "Harry, what's the matter with you? Are you okay?"
Hermione and Ron looked over together, with a worried look on their faces.
"It's nothing," Harry shook his head, then hesitated, and said depressed: "I just don't understand why Professor Lupin prevented me from fighting Bogut..."
"Perhaps he is worried about you..." Ron comforted, but Harry interrupted before he could finish his words.
"Obviously I can deal with it! It's not difficult, isn't it? Everyone did it!"
Harry vented his emotions loudly, his face was very ugly.
He thinks that Professor Lupin may have underestimated himself because he was on the train and he fainted after seeing the Dementor. He thought he had no ability, how to face Bogut would reproduce the original scene.
Ron was taken aback by Harry's extreme reaction and looked at him suspiciously. Hermione opened her mouth to say something, but didn't know how to comfort Harry...
"Oh, sorry, I was a little too excited just now!" Harry quickly realized that his tone was too aggressive said apologetically.
"Don't think too much, Professor Lupin should be worried about scaring others! You know, in the eyes of ordinary people, you are the enemy of a mysterious person!" Ivan noticed that Harry seemed to be a bit tricky and explained.
"Are you saying that Professor Lupin is worried about the mysterious people appearing in the class?" Hermione said in a speechless voice. She looked at Harry, and it was indeed possible.
"Well, that's probably it!" Ivan nodded, confirming Hermione's guess.
Harry also thought of this, and he felt better...
Because of the fact that he was "scared" by the dementors when he fainted at the beginning of school, he was publicized by Malfoy at Hogwarts. In the past few weeks, Harry always felt that the look in his eyes was a little wrong. Up.
Although Malfoy has disappeared a lot recently, Harry is still brooding about the incident, trying to prove that he doesn't want to fall as soon as Malfoy said.
"By the way, Ivan! Can you tell us why Bogut became like you in class?" Hermione deliberately changed the subject so as not to continue talking about the things that made Harry unhappy.
"Didn't I talk about it in class? Apart from this, there is nothing to be afraid of in this world!" Ivan's face didn't change as he ate dinner slowly, and said casually.
Hermione is reluctant to believe the reason for such nonsense, but nothing can be seen in Ivan's expression.
Harry looked at Ivan quite enviously. He thought that Bogut had become like Ivan, probably because Ivan had nothing to fear, so he confused Bogut!

chapters.title: Chapter 378: Sirius who sneaked into the castle
chapters.content:
After dinner, Ivan did not return to the Gryffindor lounge with Harry and others, but found a reason to walk towards the responsive room on the eighth floor, preparing to brew a new blood fusion potion.
With the two previous experiences of brewing potions, Ivan is already familiar with the road. He took the potion materials that Dobby bought back and processed them one by one before putting them into the cauldron.
Potions and his level six, he no longer needs to use grade points to temporarily improve his level of pharmacy when he makes blood fusion potions.
But within half an hour, the mixed liquid in the cauldron began to boil under the action of magic power. Ivan saw that it was almost done, so he closed the lid of the pot to prevent any debris from falling in and affecting the effect of the potion. .
Considering that the fusion and precipitation of the potion materials need to last for several days, Ivan did not stay in the responsive house all the time. After asking Dobby to look after this place, he looked for Bogut in the entire castle.
The Bogut that was in the faculty lounge before has been blew up by the little wizards, so Ivan had to find another target.
If he remembers correctly, there are other Boguts in the school, and that is the one Lupin used to practice calling for God to protect Harry, but Ivan has long forgotten the exact location.
After all, after many years, Ivan couldn't remember such details that he didn't pay attention to at first.
If it doesn’t work, he will have to write a letter asking Fren or Esiah to buy one for himself or grab one, and send it back...
In the next few days, Ivan was making potions and looking for the traces of Bogut. The former went very smoothly, and it was getting closer and closer to the official completion of the fusion potion.
But the latter made it difficult for Ivan. He walked around the entire Hogwarts convenient place, leaving the offices and staff rooms of the professors, but Bogut was unable to find it. .
"Is it really going to search in the offices of the professors?" Ivan has a headache. This is not a good idea. There is no other place to look for besides this place. It is impossible for Bogut to hide in any place. Secret Road...
Another thing that makes Ivan feel strange is that since he exchanged the damaged time converter to Dumbledore, the old professor seemed to have disappeared from the school. He hadn't seen Deng on the map for many days. Blido’s name is gone.
Ivan was thinking about things in his mind, until he went all the way back to the dorm when he was interrupted by Ron and Harry talking about Quidditch games.
Seeing Ivan push the door in, Harry turned his head and asked.
"Ivan, when practicing Quidditch this morning, Captain Wood asked me to give you a message and ask if you would like to participate in this year's Quidditch. It’s too late to sign up!
Wood said he will leave school next year, so he didn't want to leave any regrets in the last Quidditch match..."
"I should have told you that I would not participate this year, and if I were to be added, the Gryffindor team would have one more person!" Ivan rolled his eyes.
He still feels that there is not enough time these days. In addition to the full course every day, he has to spend a few hours to find Bogut. How can he have time to practice Quidditch on the court?
Harry shrugged and didn't care, he just passed a message to Wood.
After a busy day, Ivan, who was already a little tired, didn't talk to Harry and the others any more, and soon fell asleep in the bed.
But before going to bed, Ivan faintly felt that he had forgotten something recently?
......
At midnight, in front of the silent Gryffindor lounge,
The fat lady is facing the mirror in the painting, humming a little song, and caressing her hair leisurely.
At this moment, a steady and magnetic male voice sounded.
"Excuse me, how about opening the door and letting me in?"
"Password!" The fat lady who didn't hear too clearly stopped the action in her hand, ready to see which little wizard who went out at night in the middle of the night was so annoying.
But when she turned her head to see the appearance of the person, a pair of squinted Doudou eyes stared at the boss, her body was shaking and she shouted...
However, Sirius moved faster. He quickly raised his hand, and a white light hit the portrait. The horrified expression on the fat lady's face disappeared without a trace, and she suddenly became very confused.
After hesitating for a while, the fat lady returned to normal. Under the influence of the Confusion Curse, Sirius in front of her had become a little wizard.
"Why are you still hanging out so late? If you don't have a password, don't think I will let you in!" The fat lady scowled and scolded with her brows.
"Well... let me see, today's password is the Light of Wonderland!" Sirius pulled out a note from the wizard's robe, looked at it, found the corresponding item, and replied.
"Okay! Go in! Remember to rest early..." The fat lady nodded, and the door to the Gryffindor bedroom opened a gap.
"Of course, Madam! You too..." Sirius nodded slightly, opened the door and walked in, calmly like a tourist.
However, after entering the dormitory, Sirius speeds up Even if he sneaks in through a secret road, he cannot completely hide his figure. On the way here, he may be seen by some portraits.
This adventure sneaked in completely because he couldn't wait!
He wandered around Hogwarts for a whole month without waiting for Ivan to come to him, so Sirius was a little worried whether Ivan was encountering any difficulties, or he simply forgot about it.
Sirius felt he had to remind him!
also thanks to him when he was stepping on the spot a few days ago, he met a funny big **** cat, willing to look out for him.
Recently, the big cat even took a note to him. It was filled with a note with the password of the Gryffindor lounge for a whole week, which made his actions a lot easier today.
Although he can fool the fat lady with the confusion curse, the password in front of the lounge door must be answered, otherwise the door cannot be opened at all!
"This should be it, right?" Sirius strayed surreptitiously, and finally found the bedroom where Ivan was.
"Araho Cave is open!" Sirius pressed his wand against the door and muttered softly.
With a soft creak, Sirius entered the door smoothly, his dark gray eyes swept across the audience. He wanted to find the location of Ivan's bed, but in the end he was frozen on Ron's bed!
Sirius's face gradually became distorted, even though the night was dim, he still saw the big gray mouse lying on the bedside sleeping loudly...
That's what he thinks day and night, he can't wait to cramp it... Peter Pettigrew!

chapters.title: Chapter 379: Peter the little dwarf who was shocked
chapters.content:
The moment Sirius saw this mouse, Sirius’s sanity was shocked, and he wanted to rush to tear the opponent into pieces...
Fortunately, in the end, Sirius remembered that Ivan had spoken to him, and it was very difficult to endure it, and it was too cheap to die like this, Peter...
He felt that Peter had to be tortured, experiencing pain in Azkaban, and finally accepting a kiss from a dementor is what Peter did!
Thinking of this, Sirius extinguished the idea of ​​killing Peter immediately. After giving him a vicious look, he walked quickly to the front of Ivan's bed, ready to put the note in his hand on the side of Ivan's bed.
But unexpectedly, when he leaned down, Ivan, who was asleep, suddenly opened his eyes.
Almost instantly, the magic wand in Ivan's hand was already on Sirius's neck, and the white light flickered at the top of the wand.
A sense of crisis deep into his bones suddenly rushed into Sirius' mind, as if he would be killed in the next second, he hurriedly stopped.
"Hals... it's me!"
"Sirius?" Ivan was relieved to see the appearance of the person in front of him.
Ivan just opened his eyes and saw a thin figure with a disheveled hair standing next to his bed. He almost thought it was someone who wanted to assassinate himself, so he subconsciously moved his hand.
"Yes, it's me! I haven't waited until you come to me for this period of time, so I came to you by myself!" Sirius raised his eyebrows and his voice was low, even though Ivan was so close. Able to hear clearly.
Ivan was very embarrassed, and he realized what he had forgotten these days. It turned out that he had forgotten Sirius who was wandering near the school.
But this can’t be entirely blamed on him, after all, after school started, his affairs were one after another, first he was busy improving the compound decoction, and then he went back to three months ago and fought twice with Bok’s men.
Now, after finally coming back, I have to think about the fusion of the third bloodline. The castle is full of Bogut, so I forgot to go out and meet Sirius.
Sirius can naturally see what's going on from Ivan's expression, but it's not the time to talk such nonsense.
"Time is running out, let's make a long story short! I stayed in Knockdown Alley for a while after you left, to help you inquire about the news, you will never think who I met in Knockoff Alley..." Sirius said quickly Said hurriedly.
Who? Isia? Ivan thought in his heart...
At this moment, an unusually harsh sound came from the other side!
Squeak!
By the head of Ron's bed, the gray mouse had opened his eyes, looked at the figure standing in front of Ivan's bed in fear, and let out a horrified cry.
Harry, Neville and others who were fast asleep were awakened, and Ron yawned and cursed angrily. "Scaly.. Stop calling? Scaly!"
However, the screaming did not stop, Ron did not speak again, his eyes were instantly attracted by the tall figure in the bedroom, a chill rushed into his heart, and he immediately thought of himself. The newspaper I read at school...
That crazy man who always wanted to kill Harry!
and only he will sneak in at this time...
"what!!!"
Ron's scream quickly echoed in the dormitory, causing a chain reaction. Harry, Neville and others in the same dormitory also screamed in shock.
Sirius' complexion changed drastically, he knew his current identity as a fugitive, and he must not be caught until the truth is revealed!
So when Ron found him, Sirius had already moved. Taking advantage of the chaos and dim night, he threw a small note into Ivan's hand, turned his head and rushed out quickly...
Before escaping, Sirius didn't forget to take another look at the **** mouse, his fierce gaze plunged Scab into great fear!
It screamed frantically, and ran around out of Ron’s control, turning the messy bedroom into a mess...
"Scaly, where are you going! Scaly!" Even though Ron was frightened in a cold sweat, he did not forget to care about his beloved mouse.
It's just that Peter Pettigrew, who was terrified, didn't dare to stay in the dormitory anymore. Because Sirius had just gone out of the door, Peter didn't dare to go there, and finally jumped from the vent of the window dazedly!
"No, Shaban, come back!" Ron, who saw this scene, was heartbroken and yelled heartbreakingly...
Peter, the dwarf who jumped out of the window, was awakened by the midnight cold wind, but he was not very worried.
In his current rat form, he can't fall to death at this height. At most, he suffers some injuries.
In comparison, Peter was even more afraid to stay in that dormitory, because he clearly remembered that when he just woke up, he vaguely saw Sirius seem to be talking to the little wizard named Ivan Hals.
Although he didn't hear the specific content, this situation is enough to make him feel uneasy So I would rather risk a fall and choose freedom!
Unfortunately, just as Peter was enjoying freedom in the wind, a voice faintly came from above.
"Spots fly here!"
Pettigrew Peter was flustered to find that the speed of his fall stopped, and then he was pulled by some kind of force and flew upwards at a faster speed.
is a flying curse! When Peter Pettigrew realized that it was too late, it flew all the way back to the dormitory, and reached out a hand and grabbed his tail severely.
Pettigrew Peter raised his head with difficulty, but Ivan's delicate face looked like a devil's face in his eyes, and a sense of fear came to his heart.
"A forgetting is empty!" Ivan whispered softly with his wand against the gray-black mouse.
Ivan’s voice and movements were not obvious in the dark and chaotic bedroom, because Neville’s screams did not stop from beginning to end, and the cluttered noise outside the door was also one after another, covering his voice.
Peter, the dwarf star close at hand, could hear clearly, and an inexplicable sense of familiarity came to his heart.
again... again?
Before falling asleep, this thought flashed in Peter's heart, and he soon realized that he might not have been hit by the Forgotten Curse for the first time.
How many things did I forget? !
Thinking of this, Peter took a deep breath. The biting cold wind at night couldn't compare to the chill from the bottom of his heart.
Along with a white light flashing, the gray-black mouse's body was shaking and unconscious, and a drop of tears slowly slipped from its eye sockets...

chapters.title: Chapter 380: Who is the prefect of Gryffindor?
chapters.content:
Ron, who was on the side, saw that the pet he couldn't imagine was about to jump was rescued by Ivan with a flying curse. He slowly breathed a sigh of relief, and hurried forward to take Shaban from Ivan.
"What's going on with it?" Ron noticed that the fat mouse in his hand seemed to be unconscious, and no matter how he swayed, he didn't have a clear consciousness. He immediately asked with some worry.
"It's okay, it's just too excited. I'm worried that it can't think about it, so I think it's better to let Shaban go to sleep first!" Ivan casually explained.
"Thank you so much, Ivan!" Ron said very moved.
Ron feels that Ivan is the person who treats Zebra best besides himself. Not only does he often feed and care about his current situation, he even considers the mental health of Zebra. You must know that even his own master can't do it. at this point!
Ivan waved his hand and said that this was what he should do. He looked at the mouse in Ron's hand, but his frown did not let go.
Although he has already imposed an oblivion curse on Peter Pettigrew to make Peter forget what happened tonight, Peter will always hear the news of Sirius sneaking in from other places.
Peter’s frequency of planning to escape will definitely rise sharply!
Ivan knew that he might have to resolve the splattered matter as soon as possible and vindicate Sirius, otherwise it would be no good if something happened with such delay.
Just as Ivan was thinking about it, the various noisy sounds outside the door kept getting louder and louder.
"What's the matter? What happened?"
"Who hit me? Who is he? Someone rushed out!"
"Which **** doesn't sleep in the middle of the night? What is the name of the ghost?"
...
Because Ron and others’ screams were so violent that the little wizards in the entire Gryffindor bedroom were awakened. A large number of courageous little lions went out to check the movement, and soon gathered to Harry’s place. In front of the bedroom door.
"Quiet! Quiet!"
Among the crowd, Percy Weasley, as the prefect, squeezed into the chaotic crowd, trying to maintain order, but it was too messy here. Everyone was guessing about what happened just now, and no one listened at all. his words.
Ivan, whose thoughts were disturbed, saw this, and used his magic wand to bless himself with a loud and loud curse, and said loudly.
"be quiet!"
blessed more than ten times the sound and instantly overwhelmed those noisy sounds, shocked a group of little wizards covering their ears, and looked towards Ivan...
Ivan lowered the volume and explained, "It's like this, a stranger sneaked into our bedroom just now..."
"It must be Sirius, he's here to kill Harry!" Ron interrupted eagerly before Ivan could finish.
The little lions in Gryffindor were in an uproar and panicked. All eyes were placed on Harry, looking at him with a worried and worried look, as if Harry was about to die soon. same.
Everyone looked at Harry, confused.
Although he saw from the Daily Prophet that Sirius was chasing him, Harry still doesn't know why Sirius did it.
"Cough cough..." Ivan coughed slightly, re-attracting the attention of the little wizards, and said comfortingly.
"Don't worry, everyone, Sirius who sneaked in has been taken away just now, as long as you don't stand alone, there should be no possibility of being attacked again!"
Ivan knew very well that Sirius would not attack anyone, but other people would definitely not believe it. At this time, it was inconvenient for him to help Sirius say good things.
Noting the panic and horrified look on everyone's faces, Ivan sighed and continued.
"As for now... we can go to the Gryffindor lounge together to wait for the professors to come over. It is more spacious and can accommodate all of us!"
Ivan's words were accurately conveyed to everyone's ears under the effect of the loud curse. Because of the sudden incident of Sirius attack, the little wizards who were at a loss suddenly calmed down.
It’s better to have someone directing what to do now than flying around like a headless fly.
What's more, Ivan has done a lot of things that even adult wizards can't do over the years, so they are still very convinced, not to mention that Ivan's suggestions sound quite reasonable.
"Strange, where's the prefect?" After seeing everyone calm down, Yifan looked at the crowd in confusion. These things should have been done by the prefect.
Gryffindor's little lions stepped away, letting in Percy Weasley who was blocked in the doorway.
"Percy, why are you here now? Forget it... You take a few senior students to find Professor McGonagall and Professor Dumbledore! Remember to be safe!" Ivan remembered the need to find Someone informed the professor and simply threw this task to Percy. As the prefect, of course, he would do the most dangerous thing.
恩.. At least it’s dangerous to go out to find a professor at this time when others are watching...
"Me?!" Percy pointed to herself in a daze and looked at Ivan strangely.
No, who is the prefect of Gryffindor?
Just as he wanted to confirm his authority, he suddenly grabbed his shoulders with one left hand and one right hand, dragging him away.
"George, Fred...I order you to let me go in the name of the prefect!" Percy reprimanded loudly, but George and Fred didn't care at all, but said to Ivan with a smile.
"Come on, Hals! Let us take Percy there! Remember to protect Harry..."
Ivan nodded, and then took the students of Gryffindor to the lounge.
When he arrived at the destination, Ivan waved his wand to point at the fireplace, and the hot flames suddenly burned in the fireplace.
The cold of the night, when the billowing heat dissipated, calmed the chaotic mood of the students a little, and they discussed in twos and threes in a low voice.
After a while, the door of the Gryffindor lounge was opened with a "bang", and Professor McGonagall, with an anxious face, walked in with Percy and the others.
After looking around, she set her eyes on Harry, and when she saw that he was okay, she was really relieved and turned to Ivan, asking very worriedly.
"Hals, George and the others just came over and told me that Sirius had just sneaked in, was that right? No one was hurt because of it, right?"
"Everyone is here, everyone is fine!" Ivan said aloud first, and then continued.
"In addition, we did see a stranger sneaking in in the bedroom, but he has escaped now..."

chapters.title: Chapter 381: To treat a child, the words should be more tactful
chapters.content:
Professor McGonagall nodded, and then asked some detailed questions, such as how they discovered and scared Sirius away, and how did the other party sneak in...
Ivan simply said that he heard the movement in his sleep, and he saw a tall figure appearing in the bedroom when he opened his eyes. Then Ron’s pet mouse screamed, awakened everyone, and Sirius panicked. Ran away.
"It looks like your luck is good..." Professor McGonagall said in fear.
After a desperado is discovered, he can do anything in a hurry. The bombed street and more than a dozen dead Muggles are proof!
Fortunately, Sirius took his life very much and ran away in a hurry as soon as he was spotted. It should be because he was afraid of being surrounded by their professors in the lounge.
Just as McGonagall interrogated, the rest of the teaching professors who got the news rushed over.
"Where is Sirius? Has any child been injured?" Professor Flitwick asked anxiously.
Lupin looked at Harry in the crowd for the first time to confirm his safety.
McGonagall said the whole story to several professors, and then discussed with them to arrange all the students in the auditorium for protection, and then sent people to search the entire castle to see if he could catch the escaped Sirius.
Last but not least, make sure that Sirius does not continue to hide somewhere in the castle waiting for an opportunity...
At this moment, Hermione on the side suddenly asked suspiciously. "Professor, how did Sirius sneak into the Gryffindor dormitory? He shouldn't know the password?"
"Let's just ask the fat lady at the door!" Professor McGonagall raised his eyebrows and suddenly realized that this was an important clue.
She was worried about the safety of Harry and others before, but couldn't notice this...
When they arrived at the door, they discovered the strangeness of the fat lady in the portrait. Such a big thing happened, but the fat lady looked relaxed and contented.
When McGonagall asked why she wanted to let Sirius in, the fat lady looked dazed and said strangely. "Sirius? Has he come in? Why don't I know?"
"It seems that the castle's defenses need to be strengthened..." Snape said gloomily, then raised his wand, a dazzling light flashed, and the confusion curse of the fat lady was instantly lifted.
After recalling everything, the fat lady's face turned pale, her lips trembled constantly, ashamed and shameless, she screamed in shock:
"Gosh! How could I do such a thing? I actually put Sirius in it as a student..."
"It's not to blame you, you are just under the Confusion Curse." Professor McGonagall uttered an explanation, and then continued to inquire. "Can you tell us what happened? It's best not to miss any details!"
"Oh... of course, how can this help you catch him!" The fat lady wiped the tears from the corner of her eyes, and told her all about the meeting with Sirius.
When they learned that Sirius who had escaped from Azkaban already possessed a magic wand and was able to speak accurately, several professors were extremely surprised.
"Are you sure you are not mistaken? Fat lady? Did you really see him take out a note and found the password on it?" Professor McGonagall pursed his mouth, his face very ugly.
"Yes! I'm pretty sure!" The fat lady remembered hard, and finally nodded sharply.
"It looks like a traitor has appeared among us and helped Sirius Black sneak in! It just so happens that our new Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor is one of Black's best friends."
Snape sneered, staring at Lupin with a pair of hollow eyes, his meaning was obvious.
For a while, everyone's eyes were on Lupin's body, and he looked at him suspiciously.
Fortunately, because Lupin's Defence Against the Dark Arts class won the recognition of most of the students, the little wizards present were all dubious, waiting for Lupin's explanation.
In the slightly dim night, Lupin smiled bitterly and said helplessly.
"Severus, I understand you have some bad opinions about me, but you should know that since Blake betrayed James..."
When Lupin said, things stopped abruptly. He glanced at Harry and changed his words in time. "In short, after that incident, Sirius and I were cut off. I want to send him back to Azkaban more than you!"
Before Snape could reply this time, Harry said eagerly.
"Professor Lupin! You just said my father's name, right? And you mentioned betrayal! What happened? Sirius once betrayed my father?"
"Shut up, Potter!" Snape yelled, interrupting Harry's questioning.
Then Snape leaned down again and stared at Harry viciously, reminding him word by word.
"If I were you, I wouldn't ask these stupid questions and add confusion to everyone! Don't forget who caused the whole school to gather here tonight without sleeping most of the night!
So the most important thing you need to do now is to shut your mouth and stay under the nose of every professor at all times, so as not to be caught by the mad dog running around in the castle! He wouldn't be particularly kind to you just because you are the great savior of the magic world..."
Snape's mocking tone made Harry almost mad, but in the cold weather, he felt a hot flame burning in his heart, always inflating and bursting!
Harry raised his wand and wanted to give Snape a grimace to prove that he didn't need anyone's protection!
Luckily, Lupin stopped Harry’s death in a timely manner, and said with a headache Calm down, Harry! I will explain this to you clearly if I have time in the future..."
The professors on the side gave Snape a dissatisfied look.
Although they admitted that Snape was right, and Harry had better stay in front of them at all times, lest Sirius find a chance to catch him, but he should be more tactful with a child!
However, Snape didn't mean to stop, his eyes were still on Lupin, and he said with a sneer.
"Remus! I think you'd better stay away from our Mr. Potter before clearing your suspicion. There is nothing to believe in what you just said!"
"If it weren't for you to help him, it would be impossible for Black to get a magic wand and the note filled with recent passwords, and sneak into the tightly guarded castle!"
"So...I suggest that Lupin be detained immediately until we catch Black!" Snape looked at McGonagall, Flitwick and others, and said in a deep voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 382: Poor Neville
chapters.content:
After all, Lupin was the Defence Against the Dark Arts professor appointed by Albus himself. I think he should be trusted..." Professor McGonagall frowned, disagreeing with Snape's way of imprisoning Lupin.
"That's not necessarily the case. You must know that Lockhart and Chino were also appointed by Dumbledore himself. It's not the first time he has glanced at him..." Snape raised his eyebrows and reminded everyone. Recalling how incompetent the two Defence Against the Dark Arts class professors were.
Snape's words made McGonagall not know how to refute it, and the other professors also hesitated.
I have to say that Snape's analysis is still very reasonable. All signs indicate that there is a person in the castle helping Sirius Black, and Lupin, who was originally Black’s friend, is the most suspected person!
Lu Ping keenly noticed everyone's gazes, he wanted to explain, but in the end he sighed. He knew that no matter what he said, he could not clear his suspicion.
"I believe Professor Lupin didn't do this!" Harry suddenly said loudly.
Everyone turned their heads and looked at him in surprise, but Harry repeated it again, willing to believe that Lupin did not help Sirius.
"Potter! You better think about it before you speak! All of us are busy for your safety..." Snape said with a black face.
"You also said it was for my safety, right?" Harry interrupted Snape's words directly, "Then I would trust Professor Lupin, so you can't lock him up!"
Snape was trembling with anger. He was just about to make a rebuke for Harry's remarks, but the rest of the little wizards in Gryffindor were inspired by Harry, and they began to support them.
"Yes! I also don't think Professor Lupin would do this!"
"I want to trust Professor Lupin!"
"It's the same with us!"
......
"Thank you, thank you!" Lu Ping looked at the students who were willing to believe in themselves and stood up to speak for themselves, and he was very moved for a while.
Ivan was no longer silent, he knew very well that Sirius' infiltration had nothing to do with Lupin, and of course he could not be allowed to carry the pot, so he spoke to McGonagall.
"Professor McGonagall, we cannot arbitrarily make a conclusion without evidence. Gryffindor's password is clear to every student, so it may not be the one given to Black by Professor Lupin...
As for why Black got a magic wand..."
Need to ask? Of course I gave it to him!
Ivan murmured silently in his heart, but on the surface he was calm and continued to analyze. "I think it's been a while since Black escaped from Azkaban. Maybe it was a wizard who snatched it from the outside world..."
"I think Professor Lupin's wand is not lost, right?" Ivan looked at Lupin, who nodded and took out his wand.
It was a cherry wood wand about twelve inches long. The upper part was orange-yellow, the lower part was dark brown and straight, and the end was oval...
After seeing this magic wand, the fat lady shook her head, saying that what she had seen before was not this magic wand in Bright's hand, but a wand with a slightly curved chassis, which was easy to identify...
Immediately afterwards, Ivan asked all the little wizards to take out their wands, confirming that none of their wands were lost, and let the fat lady identify them one by one.
After the fat lady shook her head for the last time, Snape said impatiently. "That doesn't mean anything! Maybe Lupin accidentally got the second wand from somewhere and gave him to Black. Otherwise, how should I explain the note?"
"You don't want to say which Gryffindor student wanted to kill Potter, so you handed Black a note?" Snape said with a sneer.
However, at this time, a weak voice suddenly came out from the crowd.
"Yes... it's me, that note may be mine, professor!"
Everyone turned their heads and looked over, and they saw Neville trembling, slowly raising his hands, looking at his expression as if he was ready to cry at any time.
"Mr. Neville Longbottom..." Snape looked at Neville incredulously, his eyes narrowed. "You said you gave the note to Black?"
McGonagall and the others looked at Neville with a stunned look. No one can believe that Neville, who is usually timid and inflated, would dare to do such a thing!
Harry is also very strange. Will Neville help Black? why? He remembered that he had never offended Neville. When Blake slipped into the bedroom and was found, Neville was still the loudest one...
"No... not so... yes..." Poor Neville stammered speechless under everyone's attention...
"That piece of paper should have been left by you accidentally, right?" Ivan helplessly explained, he guessed this when he heard the fat lady say that Black was holding a piece of paper when he entered the bedroom.
Because in the original time and space, it was Crookshanks that took away Neville's note, which caused Sirius to get the password smoothly.
"Yes...Yes!" Poor Neville nodded quickly, expressing that he was just as Ivan said, but was accidentally left out.
The little wizards suddenly realized that Neville’s poor memory has long been known to everyone, so they didn’t doubt it...
Snape's face was very ugly, and his plan to imprison Lupin would be ruined. Snape could only cast his anger on Neville, and said with a dark face.
"Mr. Longbottom! Because of your mistake, Black almost succeeded! All of us are going to gather here late at night to deal with this matter. You must find it interesting, right?"
"Gryffindor was deducted fifty points!" Snape gave the trial ruthlesslyNeville's body trembled and he almost cried. He saw Gryffindor this morning. In the pool of points, a total of only sixty to seventy points...
Professor McGonagall shook his head when he saw this scene and didn't say anything. Although Neville could not be blamed for Sirius sneaking into the dormitory, he still had a part of the responsibility after all, and it was not excessive to deduct 50 points for warning.
After Lupin's suspicion was temporarily lifted, all the teaching professors searched the entire castle according to the previous plan.
The tasks of the three deans are heavier, and they are also responsible for notifying students from other colleges to go to the auditorium.
McGonagall brought the students here to the auditorium to meet. This time the search is likely to last all night, so they have to rest there today.
What puzzles Ivan is that after such a long time, Dumbledore, the principal, hasn’t been seen...
