chapters.title: Chapter 383: Techniques for batch deformation
chapters.content:
"Professor McGonagall, where's Principal Dumbledore? Has he not come yet?" Ivan asked strangely. It is impossible for Dumbledore not to come forward with such a big event.
"Albus, he had something to go out in recent days..." McGonagall explained aloud. At the same time, he was a little helpless. Sirius just sneaked in at this time. Coincidence made her wonder if Sirius was from Where did I hear the news.
Hearing this, Ivan confirmed his previous guess, but in this case things would be more troublesome.
Ivan originally wanted to go to Dumbledore with Scabbers. He said that when he was looking at this map accidentally last school year, he found Ron Mouse with a person's name on his head, and happened to meet Sirius during the summer vacation and figured out the truth. ...
In the end, he can easily throw this troublesome thing to Dumbledore to deal with, and stay aside to watch the show at ease, just waiting for the extra points!
Only Dumbledore has enough prestige to convince everyone that Sirius is innocent, and vindicates Sirius under the pressure of the Ministry of Magic!
"Then do you know when Professor Dumbledore will be back?" Ivan sighed and asked.
"It should be soon. I have sent an owl to inform him...Don't worry too much. Although Albus is not there, there are professors in various subjects who can protect your safety, if something happens. You can tell me!" Professor McGonagall comforted.
Ivan shrugged. He was actually not worried about safety, but hesitated to explain Sirius to Professor McGonagall.
In the end, he stopped talking and decided to meet Sirius first and discuss it.
Ivan hadn't read the note that Sirius handed him, but he thought it should have clearly stated the time and place of the meeting.
After all, it is impossible for Sirius to explain to him in the dormitory about many things. It is too dangerous and easy to be heard by others, so finding a place outside to discuss slowly is the right choice!
Ivan kept thinking in his mind, and unknowingly followed the crowd to the auditorium.
McGonagall swept the obstructive table aside with his magic wand, vacating a large area in the middle.
However, McGonagall couldn't wave his hand like Dumbledore and turned into hundreds of sleeping bags. In order to save a certain amount of magic power against the possible attack on Sirius Black, McGonagall turned his head after thinking about it and faced Ivan. Said.
"Hals, come and help me, we need hundreds of sleeping bags..."
Ivan nodded, walked forward and took out his wand and nodded. Some small objects such as cups and saucers flew over from the long table in the corner and landed on the clearing.
Then, Ivan thought of the sleeping bag in his mind, and these small objects twisted and changed one after another, elongated, extended, and expanded. In a short while, a dozen blue sleeping bags appeared on the open space.
At the same time, Ivan was also exhausted, and it was the first time he tried to deform so many objects at the same time.
"Very good, your recent transformation spell level has improved a lot..." Professor McGonagall looked at Ivan's deformed sleeping bag with a very surprised expression.
She asked Ivan to assist herself, but she did not use this opportunity to teach Ivan.
However, Ivan's growth has far exceeded McGonagall's expectations. It can be said that every school year has undergone some earth-shaking changes.
She has never heard of such a speed of progress, it's too fast...
Professor McGonagall couldn't help sighing that if one or two years passed, he might have nothing to teach him.
But soon, Professor McGonagall sorted out his emotions and said to Ivan:
"Halse, it seems that you have no experience in batch deforming items before, and there are still some lacks in this aspect. This is actually skillful.
Your mind only needs to focus on one of the items that needs to be deformed, and then separate a trace of mind to use magic to drive the others. You will find that it is not difficult to practice a few times..."
Professor McGonagall waved some small objects, explaining the details that need to be paid attention to when deforming the batch, and demonstrated it to Ivan. In a short while, seventy or eighty crimson sleeping bags appeared on the field.
After doing all this, McGonagall is still calm and relaxed, not at all tired, not to mention the exhaustion like Ivan's...
It's just that Ivan can sense the delicate surface of these sleeping bags, but he doesn't really care, and he will be beaten back to his original shape if he lasts for at most one day.
Obviously, this was done by Professor McGonagall deliberately. This kind of temporary deformation does not need to be made too fine, and the magic is wasted.
Wanting to understand this, Ivan tried again following the instructions given by Professor McGonagall, this time deforming fifty objects at once!
A large number of dishes, candlesticks and other objects quickly deformed into sleeping bags under the action of magic...
Although the number of deformed objects has tripled this time, since Ivan doesn’t need to do as much as the first time, he only makes inferior products that can only last for more than ten hours. No matter, the consumption of magic power is basically the same as before.
At the same time, the prompt sound of the system also appeared in Ivan's mind.
[Ding, after a period of practice, your transfiguration level has improved, the current level is 6]
Ivan was very pleased. It has been a long time since his Transfiguration technique was promoted to the sixth level. He did not expect to increase his proficiency so much after some guidance from Professor McGonagall.
It seems that McGonagall's polymorphism is higher than he thought...
When Professor McGonagall saw that Ivan was able to integrate the knowledge he taught so quickly, nodded with satisfaction.
For such a student who is active in studying and can understand with just a little bit, which professor would not like it?
Then, under the joint efforts of the two, hundreds of sleeping bags were neatly placed on the open space for half an hour. After all these were fixed, a mess of footsteps came from the entrance of the auditorium.
Ivan turned around and found that students from several other colleges had arrived.
"Professor McGonagall, what happened?" After seeing McGonagall, the prefects of several colleges hurried forward to ask about the situation.
When they received the notice, they ran over and informed their dean to save time and only talked to them about it, and asked them to pay attention to safety when they came, and did not say too many details.
"It was Sirius who sneaked in..." Professor McGonagall explained the process in detail to the little wizards, and then comforted them so that they don't have to worry too much. The professors will take this matter. Dealt with!

chapters.title: Chapter 384: is that so? Why can't I remember anything?
chapters.content:
After explaining to the new little wizards, McGonagall gathered the others together, and then spoke.
"Okay, kids, I think you are all sleepy, right? Go to sleep! But the prefects need to work harder, you have to be responsible for the management and guarding tasks..."
Several prefects nodded. Although they were tired, they still forced their spirits up. Percy was even more like a chicken blood. He regarded this as his responsibility and right as a prefect. !
Just as a group of little wizards were preparing to get into their sleeping bags and sleep, McGonagall thought of one more thing and stopped Ivan alone.
"Halse! You did a good job this time. It calmed everyone's emotions for the first time and brought everyone to the lounge to stop a possible riot..."
"Professor, this is what I should do!" Ivan said modestly.
"So as a professor, I also need to do what I should do, such as... add 50 points to you!" Professor McGonagall smiled, then patted him on the shoulder, and continued.
"That's all I want to say, go to bed, I have to go to class tomorrow!"
"En!" Ivan nodded, turned around and found a sleeping bag in the divided area, and got into it. At the same time, he quietly took the note that Sirius handed him out of his pocket and placed it in the sleeping bag. Opened and glanced at it.
As he thought, the message left to him by Sirius was written on the back, and the specific content was to let him meet in the tunnel under the beating willow tomorrow evening.
After reading the content written in the note, Ivan hurriedly put away, lest he be found out, and fell asleep deeply after the sleepiness struck.
One night passed in a flash...
At six or seven o’clock the next morning, Professor McGonagall called out all the little wizards who were sleeping in a daze. While cleaning the venue, they also searched Hogwarts for the professors but could not find the little wizards. The result of Sirius was spoken.
The little wizards who heard the news were so worried that even when they went to the toilet, they were accompanied by a large group of people, for fear that they would encounter accidents when they were alone.
Although Sirius had come against Harry, everyone knew that he was a vicious criminal. Maybe he would attack others if he killed him.
This caused Hogwarts to be shrouded in a tense atmosphere throughout the day. Everyone was writing about Sirius, guessing how he sneaked into Hogwarts Castle, all kinds of The argument is getting more and more bizarre.
For example, Hufflepuff’s Hannah Abbot boldly guessed that Black would become a flowering bush, but when others asked how a bush came to school with long legs, Hannah supported it. The vacillating answer can't come out.
On the contrary, Seamer’s remarks have been recognized by most people. He thinks that Black is an unsentimental killing machine, a complete lunatic, so the dementors do not perceive his existence...
In his spare time, Ron enthusiastically told interested little wizards how terrifying the infiltrating Sirius was and how they were taken away by them.
In Ron's story, the greatest hero is naturally his baby rat Scabs, and its terrible cry awakened everyone in the dormitory, which made Sirius's evil assassination plan fail.
For a time, this gray-black mouse almost became a hero of Gryffindor in Ron's mouth...
The little wizards of Gryffindor still listened with gusto at first, but when Ron told the story the seventh time and changed and exaggerated it, when he said that his mouse scared Sirius away by staring. Everyone just heard it as a joke...
Peter the dwarf is even more confused.
what? Did you scare Black away? But why doesn't he remember anything?
Even the news of Sirius’ invasion, Peter only heard from the conversations of the little wizards in the morning.
Ron’s exaggerated remarks made Peter think that Ron was just making up stories, but he soon realized that something was wrong. There was such a big thing last night, and he shouldn’t have slept so badly...
Peter thought more and more deeply, but did not notice that a pair of orange eyes were staring at it. After a while, a cat's paw slowly stretched out and slammed its tail...
Scared, Peter turned his head and saw a fluffy cat face. He didn't have time to think about the messy things. He let out a scream and hurriedly tried to escape.
But Crookshanks's cat's claws pressed its tail firmly, making Peter unable to move. His orange-yellow eyes looked at his streaked body, as if he was wondering where to put his mouth down!
"Hey...you **** cat!" Fortunately, Ron discovered this in time, and quickly slapped Crookshanks' cat's claws and rescued his mouse.
Crookshanks reluctantly wanted to rush up, and just jumped up, she was hugged by Hermione in her arms, and she could only wave her limbs weakly in the air...
"Stop it, Crookshanks!" Hermione patted Crookshanks on the head angrily, and then looked at Ron's mouse. When he was worried about asking, Ron became angry. Burning scolded.
"Hurry up and take care of your stupid cat! It almost killed Scabbers just now... you'd better keep it away from me!"
"Crookshanks is just doing what it is supposed to do, you know... cats like to catch mice!" Hermione snorted softly.
Seeing that the two were about to quarrel Harry hurriedly uttered a word of consolation, Ron finally let out his temper, but still kept a straight face.
Hermione was even more reluctant to bother him!
Hermione was originally dissatisfied with Ron's promotion of his pet mouse as a hero who scared away Sirius. From what she learned from Harry, Ron and his mouse did nothing but scream. !
And Ivan was awake long before Scabbard yelled. She felt that the reason Sirius escaped in panic was probably related to Ivan.
Otherwise, just a few barking little wizards can't help the cruel Sirius Black, who has spent so much effort sneaking in and can kill Harry before running away.
"Strange, where's Ivan?" Hermione looked around but unexpectedly didn't see Ivan.
"I don't know, maybe he went to the library?" Harry shook his head, guessing.
The puzzled two did not notice that a gray-white owl was passing by the window, glanced at them, and then flew towards the big banyan tree not far from the lake.

chapters.title: Chapter 385: Meeting with Sirius
chapters.content:
Over Hogwarts, Ivan, transformed into an owl shape, was flapping his wings and flying out of the castle quickly.
The dementors scattered around the school flicked in mid-air from time to time, but turned a blind eye to this weird owl.
Because the Ministry of Magic gave them an order to catch a wizard who escaped from prison, not to catch some flying animal...
Not to mention that there are too many owls in and out of the castle every day, no dementors will pay attention to this...
This makes Ivan's actions much more convenient. After flying only a short time, the beating willow erected not far from the lake is already in sight. From afar, Ivan can still see a black one. The big dog was crouching silently beside the tree trunk.
When Ivan approached, the **** dog also noticed the gray-white owl in the sky.
Having seen the shape of Ivan Animagus, it naturally recognized it at a glance, with a humane expression of joy on its face, yelled a few words in a low voice, and then got into the one below the beating willow. In the big hole, and motioned Ivan to follow.
Ivan nodded, waved his wings and followed.
Inside the big cave is a very deep and long passage that continues to extend forward...
At the end of the passage is a messy room that seems to have been abandoned. The walls on all sides are pitted, the white wallpaper is peeled off, the bricks and stones underground are covered with stains, the furniture is all broken, and you can vaguely see what has been damaged. The bite marks...
Before Ivan could take a closer look, Sirius, who had turned back into a human form, walked over.
"Halse! It seems that you didn't let me wait too long this time..." Sirius said jokingly.
"You know, when I first started school, I was busy with a lot of things. I really can't get away, and I can't spare time to see you..." Ivan was embarrassed to explain, and he let Sirius wait near. January is indeed a bit unauthentic.
Fortunately, Sirius didn't care about this, and after a casual joke before, he turned serious. "Okay, let's not talk about this! Last time I was pressed for time, I didn't have time to tell you some things! I guess you must not have thought of who I saw in Knockdown Alley!"
"Is it my mother Aisia, right?" Ivan guessed.
"You know?" Sirius was stunned, with a very surprised expression. He originally wanted to tell Ivan about this incident as a surprise.
In order to confirm the authenticity, he was almost beaten by a group of werewolves who didn't know where he came from. Fortunately, his Animagus form ran so fast and slipped away in time before being blocked.
At the same time Sirius also noticed that today Ivan looked much calmer than he was a few months ago, and there is no such gloomy air on his face.
"I said earlier, I will have a way..." Ivan didn't give too much explanation, but simply mentioned.
Sirius took a deep look at him. He did hear Ivan say this, but at that time he felt that these words were just Ivan's self-comforting words, so he didn't care...
But I didn't expect that Ivan seemed to have really done the incredible thing to bring the dead back to life!
Sirius was puzzled. In the months before school, Ivan had a gloomy appearance, and that expression could never be a disguise!
Based on this, Sirius combined the confessions of the four black-robed wizards to confirm that Aysia was dead.
So after Ivan went to Hogwarts for class, he was still investigating the cause of Asiah's death in private, but he accidentally met Asiah himself during an investigation.
Had it not been for the small changes in Aysia’s appearance in the past ten years, he would almost think that he had admitted the wrong person...
Sirius wanted to ask how Ivan rescued a person who was deemed dead within a month.
After all, Ivan's attitude just now undoubtedly shows that Aisia's "resurrection" is related to him.
But seeing Ivan shut up and didn't want to say more, Sirius didn't ask any more.
Ivan also moved the topic along with Sirius and learned about Aysia's current situation. He still wanted to know what happened in Knockout Alley after he left, and what happened to Aysia and Furen.
"Your mother looks good, and your magic shop reopened soon after you left..." Sirius briefly said to Ivan.
He actually didn’t know much. After learning that Aysia was still alive, Sirius could not wait to sneak up to Hogwarts to find Ivan to explain the situation, but he did not wait until Ivan took the initiative to contact him...
Then, Sirius suddenly remembered something and said again. "By the way, do you remember the Bojinbok store we searched for? The brand of that store was recently taken off, as if it had changed the owner!"
"Do you know who the new boss is?" Ivan asked aloud with a thought.
"I'm not familiar with that person, but the sign that I hung up is quite interesting called St. Mungo's Magic Hospital..."
Speaking of this, Sirius was also very speechless. It was the first time he saw someone delete the two words of St. Mungo’s Magical Injury Hospital and he dared to put up a sign upright, and the other party was not worried about being troubled...
"Dougt!" Ivan heard the name of the sign and instantly guessed who the new boss is, and said with gritted teeth.
If he remembers correctly, the old man clearly told him three months ago that Bojinbok Magic Shop was being spotted by many tricky people, so he had better not be bothered by it.
I didn't expect this **** to do it himself now...
"What's wrong? That person is one of your enemies?" Sirius looked at Ivan's angry look very curious No, nothing, just being cheated! Ivan shook his head, and soon adjusted his mood.
The location of Bojinbok Magic Shop is very good, and it is also a transit point in Knockdown Alley. It is better to be taken by Dougt than by others.
Besides, he accidentally blown up Dougert’s house before, so it’s not good to go to Xingshi to inquire...
Sirius raised his eyebrows, he skipped the topic without knowing the inside story, and continued. "In that case, let's talk about Peter!
I remember you told me at the beginning, as long as I help you solve your mother's affairs with Aisia, you will bring Peter here! "
"Of course, I am not wrong in saying that, but now I have a little trouble...I can give you that mouse at any time, but I want to clean up you and live in the magical world with integrity. It's more difficult!" Ivan said helplessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 386: We must do something!
chapters.content:
why? "Sirius frowned deeply and asked in a puzzled voice.
"Perhaps you don't know that Professor Dumbledore is not at Hogwarts recently! You should be very clear that no one except him has the ability to help you out of crime!"
Having said that, Ivan paused, and then continued to explain. "The Ministry of Magic and the Inquisition will not easily admit their mistakes, telling everyone that because of their mistakes, a war hero was imprisoned in Azkaban as a vicious Death Eater for more than ten years!"
And he also promoted betrayers like Peter as a hero, Ivan silently added in his heart.
This is definitely a shocking scandal. If the senior officials of the Ministry of Magic do not want to be sprayed to death by the roaring letters written by those angry wizards, they will definitely try their best to cover up this news!
Sirius was fidgeting and pacing in this small house. Naturally, he knew it very well, but this is not the way to wait. Who knows when Dumbledore will come back, in case it will take a month or two. Longer?
Anything can happen during this period! What if Peter finds a chance to escape?
The most important thing is that he sneaked into Gryffindor's bedroom yesterday and saw the **** mouse, and has been holding back the killing intent in his heart. Now he is almost at his limit.
"How about this, you bring Peter here at this time tomorrow and let me kill him!" After a while, Sirius stopped and said viciously.
"You better calm down! Don't try to get rid of sin by killing Peter!" Ivan noticed that Sirius' mood was a bit wrong, and said with comfort.
"How can you calm me down? I've waited long enough!" Sirius shouted angrily.
Compared to killing Peter, Sirius feels that his affairs can be put aside for a while, and he doesn't even care whether he can get rid of the crime....
"Do you want to live in the shadows for the rest of your life? Make Harry hate you so consistently, treating you as a mean betrayer?" Ivan asked aloud.
"It was Peter who betrayed James, not me!" Sirius said word by word.
"Who knows?" Ivan looked at him and asked mercilessly. "I ask you who knows you are innocent? If Peter Pettigrew is dead, who can prove it to you?!"
Sirius stared at Ivan fiercely, and the latter did not back down. After a long stalemate, Sirius finally sighed and said bitterly.
"Anyway, we have to do something, and we must not wait like this forever!"
Ivan was not forcing him either. Instead, he pondered for a while and said: "In a while, it will be Halloween. Students in third grade and above will go to Hogsmeade Village. Where will Peter and Harry be, we can first Find an opportunity to take Harry to a secluded place and explain the situation to him..."
"In addition, I will try to contact Lupin during this period. He is now a professor at Hogwarts and a friend of yours. Just use the live point map to let him know that Peter, who has died, is still alive. I believe Professor Lupin will be willing. Listen to your explanation..."
Ivan remembered that Professor Lupin had clearly chosen to stand on Sirius' side after seeing the map of the point of life in the original time and space, and then he wanted to win him over.
Now that Dumbledore is not at Hogwarts, it really doesn't matter if he speaks to Sirius. If you add the testimony of Harry and Lupin, the credibility is much higher!
In this case, before Dumbledore returns, something accidentally made a mistake in the middle, and it will not face the worst result...
"Okay, then I'll wait a few more days!" Sirius hesitated for a long time, but still agreed. Before killing Peter, he at least needs to explain clearly to Harry and Lupin.
Ivan breathed a sigh of relief. He was worried that Sirius would act privately, and then sneaked into Hogwarts to kill Peter. That would be really bad.
Although Peter's death had no effect on him, Sirius himself could only be wanted by the Ministry of Magic like the original time and space, and could only hide and live in the shadows.
Before in Knock Down Alley, Sirius helped him a lot. If possible, Ivan certainly hoped that Sirius would be able to clear his grievances.
Later, the two discussed the details of the operation in this dilapidated room.
Ivan did not dare to stay here for too long, fearing that he would be found out of school for a long time, so after discussing the countermeasures, he ended this short meeting.
Before leaving, Sirius suddenly said as if thinking of something. "Halse, do you know what kind of gifts Harry likes? I accidentally scared him on Harry's birthday, so I wanted to make up a birthday gift as an alms."
"Harry? Hmm... he prefers to play Quidditch, maybe you can start from this aspect!" Ivan thought for a while and suggested.
"Quidditch? I should have thought of it. After all, James was an excellent Quidditch player when he was in school! It seems that Harry has inherited his father's talent very well!" Sirius said a little. The look of nostalgia.
"Of course, he is now Gryffindor's best seeker!" Ivan said with a smile.
"In this case, give him a flying broom. If I remember correctly, a good new broomstick called the rocket crossbow has just been released recently... Harry will definitely like it!" Sirius immediately decided. Tao.
Rocket crossbow? The corners of Ivan's mouth twitched...
Local tyrant! If he remembers correctly, the price is negotiable as a concept broom just launched!
It must be amazingly expensive!
Although he can't afford it with his current financial resources, Ivan has never used Jin Jialong in such a place, anyway, he doesn't play Quidditch.
Hmm...what was the gift Sirius gave to Harry in the original time and space, it seems to be a rocket crossbow?
Ivan was thinking about things in his mind The action did not stop, using Animagus to become an owl, under Sirius’s gaze, he flew all the way through the circular channel back to Hogg. Watts Castle.
After finding a remote classroom with no one, Ivan turned back into a human form, and at the same time looked at the clock next to him.
"It's only been more than half an hour, shouldn't you be discovered?" Ivan muttered secretly, looking for the nearest underpass and preparing to take a shortcut to the library to pretend, so as not to arouse people's suspicion.
Thinking about this, Ivan walked out of the classroom and lit the groove on the side wall, and opened an underpass entrance.
At this moment, the faintly blue Pepy Ghost happened to float over from the other side of the corridor. He saw a little wizard in a Gryffindor uniform about to get into the dark tunnel. His eyes glowed and he clapped his hands and shouted. Yelled.
"Aha! Look what I found? A student opened the secret tunnel, but at this moment, let me guess you must go to see Black, right? Tell him today's password... right?"
Pippi giggled while raping, but when he got closer, he suddenly felt that this figure was so familiar...

chapters.title: Chapter 387: Harris...you lie to me!
chapters.content:
Pippi had a vague premonition, and when the little wizard in front of him turned his head, this vague premonition turned into reality!
"Pippi, hasn't anyone told you that too much talk can easily cause trouble?" Ivan frowned and warned.
At the moment when he saw Ivan's face, Pepigui instantly remembered his miserable appearance during the previous meetings, and suddenly let out a scream, turned sharply and ran away.
However, it was too late. Ivan threw a button and raised his wand and pointed it lightly.
Under the action of Transfiguration, the button stretched into a long rope under the influence of magical power, which automatically wrapped the body of Pippi ghost as if possessing life, and bound it up...
Pippi is different from other ghosts wandering in the school. Although he has some ghost characteristics, he is a special kind of prank ghost. It has a physical body and can pick up lighter things. Naturally, he cannot escape Ivan's transformation. rope.
"Halse...I actually don't know anything, I don't see anything..." Pippi said in a flustered manner as Ivan got closer and closer.
Ivan doesn't believe Pippi's remarks. If he has listened to the nonsense of the other party for a while, the news of where he is going to open the secret tunnel alone the next day will definitely spread throughout the school!
Although this does not prove that he has been in contact with Sirius, it may have a certain impact on his next actions, so of course Ivan cannot easily let go of this annoying prank ghost.
So Ivan waved his magic wand at Pippi, ready to give it a forgettable. Since he used the fear spell to affect Pippi, then the forgetting spell that eliminates memories should also work. .
"No! Don't do that, Hals! I can assure you that I won't say anything to the outside..." Pipigui shook his head quickly and said tremblingly as he watched the magical rainbow light on the top of the wand.
Perhaps it was Pippi's pleading that worked, and Ivan slowly put down his wand, and hesitated while touching his chin. "Why don't you answer me a question and I will help you untie the rope and let you go?"
Pippi was overjoyed and nodded sharply.
"You wander around the school every day, do you know where there is Bogut in the school?" Ivan asked.
"Bogut, what are you doing with that stuff?" Pepigui was very surprised, and then felt that Ivan might be teasing someone, and immediately became interested, so he didn't mean to conceal it, and continued carelessly.
"I saw one in Filch's filing cabinet before. You can go there and find..."
Ivan thought for a while, and felt that Pepi Ghost was not deceiving himself. After all, in Hogwarts, apart from some secret passages he didn't know, there were only a few professors and Fei that hadn't searched. Erqi's office is gone.
If Pippy wanted to trouble himself, he might as well lie to himself that Bogut was with Snape...
"Okay, I have already answered all the questions you have to ask, so don't let me go." Pepigui twisted his body uncomfortably and yelled. It was very worried that Ivan would not keep his promise.
"Of course, I'm a trustworthy person! But I will visit Filch's place. You'd better not deceive me, or if I think you should understand..." Ivan waved his wand and bound the skin. The leather ghost's ropes were taken back, and they were turned back into buttons and put them in his pockets.
"If that Bogut hasn't been dealt with yet, then it must still be there..." Pepi Ghost seemed very happy after regaining her freedom, giggling weirdly.
However, Pippi Ghost is a prank ghost after all. Even if I have promised Ivan that I will not say anything to the outside world, but the previous few contacts with Ivan have been deflated, and this time I finally grasped Ivan’s handle. Of course, I won't let go of this opportunity to make things happen.
Pippi’s blue eyes turned grunting, and his mind was full of crooked ideas.
As for Ivan’s follow-up revenge, it doesn’t care, it’s a big deal, it finds a place to hide for ten and a half days, and it will just go around when I see Ivan...
Just as Pepy Ghost thought about it and happier, a familiar voice rang behind him.
"Forget it all!"
"Halse, you lied to me!" Pepy Ghost only had time to let out a sharp yell, and was hit by a white light, and then dazed and stayed still...
"This is not a breach of contract... I only promised to help you untie the rope and let you go, but I didn't promise other things." Ivan put away the wand and murmured secretly.
At the same time, the reminder of the system in my mind also rang.
[After a period of practice, your forgetting spell has been upgraded, the current level 5 (2/1600)]
Ivan was a little surprised. Unknowingly, his Forgetting Curse had risen to Level 5. No wonder he has recently felt that this spell has become more and more handy...
After cleaning part of Pepi Ghost's memory, Ivan took out the map of the point of life to find Filch's movements.
After noticing that Filch was patrolling on the other side of the castle and would not return to the office for a short time, Ivan walked directly towards that side, ready to confirm whether Bogut was still there...
As soon as Ivan walked out of the corridor, Pepy Ghost came back sober, looking around in a daze, wondering why he appeared here.
It’s just that this bit of doubt was quickly forgotten by Pippi and turned to think about which college kid to toss about today is better...
Ivan on the other side had sneaked into Filch's office quietly.
It looks a little messy here, with an oil lamp hanging from the dark ceiling, and rows of cabinets on the surrounding walls.
On the right side of the room is an original wooden table for office use. There is a small iron basin not far away. A messy grilled fish is left in the basin, and a faint smell is passed on.
Due to time constraints, Ivan walked directly to the filing cabinet and opened the cabinets one by one to find them. Most of the cabinets contained parchment papers for recording student violations, as well as strange small objects that were confiscated.
Ivan also saw many familiar pranks such as big dung eggs, booming fireworks, and quick-acting skipping candy in one of the cabinets that said "confiscation of supplies, high danger". Obviously, it was George and Fred who turned over when they were engaged in something. I got the car and was caught by Filch...
Finally, when Ivan opened the cabinet on the far right, there was no longer any portfolio or mischievous goods in it, but a flat human head, looking at him with his eyes open...

chapters.title: Chapter 388: Fusion of the third bloodline
chapters.content:
As soon as I opened the cabinet, I saw such a horrible scene. Although Ivan was not scared, the corners of his mouth still twitched.
Because it is his head in the cabinet!
Obviously this thing was made by Bogut. Perhaps because the cabinet was so big, Bogut couldn't convert his whole body, so he simply showed a head, as if it had been run over by a roller. Same, it looks flat...
The head of the person in the cabinet blinked at him with an apologetic look on his face, and then said: "Sorry, I have been hiding something from you. The real Hals is dead. I'm just a It's just a counterfeit..."
"It's useless to tell me these things..." Ivan curled his lips. He had guessed that Bogut would say that when he heard the first half of the lesson.
After all, one of the things he fears most is the exposure of the identity of the traverser, so that he will immediately lose everything he has now!
"Funny!" Ivan sighed, tapped the head with his magic wand, turning it into a Halloween pumpkin lantern, and left Filch's office just like that with his hand.
All the way to the eighth floor of the castle smoothly,
Since it's Halloween soon, Ivan is eye-catching with a pumpkin lantern, but no one doubts it.
I need a place to make potions!
After Ivan walked back and forth three times on the opposite wall of the tapestry, he meditated in his heart.
The door to the responsive house was opened.
Ivan walked into this potion storage room, and at a glance saw that the crucible on the central round table was blowing bubbles, and the blood fusion potion could be finished in a while!
But when he looked at the "pumpkin lantern" in his hand, Ivan was in trouble, wondering how to start.
How about cutting a knife or two to see if it will bleed?
Ivan picked up a knife from the table and tried to cut a knife on the skin of the pumpkin lantern. The thick, light-yellow sap flowed down the gap in the skin.
Just when Ivan was holding the reagent bottle and preparing to collect it, the dripping juice was sucked back along the wound again.
Ivan angrily used a knife to pierce the pumpkin lantern into a few holes. This time more juice came out, but he tried all kinds of methods to collect it. In the end, Ivan could only guess that these juices were also Boss. Grid deformed.
After so long delay, the magic that was originally imposed on Bogut has been broken over time.
Bogut quickly changed from a jack-o-lantern to a little wizard who looked like Ivan, trying to use this method to stop the little wizard in front of him from tossing himself.
After all, very few people will be cruel to a creature that looks exactly like themselves.
Even if they did, they would definitely hesitate again and again when they started.
But Ivan didn't eat this set at all. Not only did he not intend to keep his hands, but he even intensified, brandishing a knife and insisting on cutting off something from Bogut!
It is a pity that after trying to turn Bogut into his own broken hand, broken foot, and even cut his waist into two pieces, Ivan still has nothing to gain.
Because no matter how much you toss, even if it is cut into several pieces, the injured part of Bogut will quickly turn into smoke and return to its original state!
Ivan is very helpless. It seems that Bogut cannot be harmed by conventional things. Only laughter can affect them.
Why don't you give it a try?
"Haha..." Just do as he thinks of it, and Ivan tried his best to brew feelings and smile.
Just after Ivan made the sound, the miserable Bogut he was playing with suddenly shook his body violently. After a while, it exploded with a "bang" and turned into puffs of smoke floating in the air!
Seeing that Ivan’s face turned black,
Are you kidding me, is my laughter so scary?
Obviously the last Bogut suffered the laughter of more than a dozen little wizards, and was tossed for a whole class before he collapsed. Why is this Bogut so poorly able to bear it?
Ivan couldn't help but spit out in his heart, but when he saw the scattered blue smoke, he thought about it. He tried to use the magic wand to collect the smoke into the reagent bottle, and then tried to open the magic inventory of the system. Check it out.
【Magic Items: Bogut's Remnants
Explanation: This is the wreck left by Bogut after his death. It contains some kind of magical power...]
"This thing should be able to replace blood?" Ivan said hesitantly. He remembered that Slytherin's research notes stated that some key things from magical creatures could be used as blood substitutes.
Now the Bogut residue in the reagent bottle is not critical, but it definitely contains Bogut's power. After all, this thing is considered Bogut's "corpse"...
Gululu...
At this moment, the cauldron in the center bubbling and boiling, Ivan turned his head and took a look, and found that the fusion potion in the brewing turned into chaos, which proved that the brewing was completed.
Ivan walked to the cauldron without hesitation and tried to blend the cyan mist in the reagent into the potion.
If it doesn't work, he has to give up fusing Bogut, find other magical creatures, and make a new fusion potion, but it will cost a lot of Jin Jialong.
Fortunately, the situation was not so bad. The mist was absorbed soon after it came into contact with the fusion potion. The two sides continued to blend, and the chaotic fusion potion seemed to be infested by the fog, slowly turning into a light blue color. ...
[Magic Item: Improved Fusion Potion (Bogut)
Features: unknown (depending on the fusion effect)
Explanation: This is a unique potion researched by Salazar Slytherin which allows wizards to gain powers that belong to magical creatures. But if the user lacks the corresponding protection, there will be a great probability of dying because of the magic runaway...]
After seeing the properties of the fusion potion, Ivan was relieved, and his method of replacing the blood with the remains of Bogut was indeed correct.
As for the death reminder in the description, Ivan did not care. The protection mode that consumes five legendary value exchanges is to eliminate the risk!
Thinking about this, Ivan filled the potion in the cauldron into a bottle, ready to drink it.
The reason why he chose Bogut as the target of blood fusion, rather than other more powerful and dangerous magical creatures, is because Ivan has realized that he is different from ordinary wizards, and the power he possesses may be able to bring Bogut The ability to deform is strengthened!
In that case, Bogut's deformation is more than just a fancy...

chapters.title: Chapter 389: Bogut deformation
chapters.content:
"System, exchange protection mode!" Ivan said.
[Five legendary points have been deducted, the current legendary points remain 0...]
Accompanied by the system prompt in his mind, the world in Yifan's eyes suddenly changed, and the magic in his body became extremely active, and he had an inexplicable feeling of controlling everything.
Ivan, who was no longer the first experience, was not immersed in this feeling, and immediately drank the fusion potion.
The cyan liquid flows into the esophagus along the mouth, it is very mild, and it is almost like plain water when it is drunk, without any taste.
However, it was only a moment of effort, sour, sweet, bitter... all kinds of tastes burst out all at once, and Ivan's face was a little distorted while holding his stomach, so he didn't directly spit it out.
What made Ivan even more shocked was that after the liquid was poured, under the protective mode of internal vision, Ivan clearly saw that the liquid gradually turned into a blue mist, spreading from his stomach to the whole body, and finally caught the brain. Got into his skin!
The numb and itchy feeling passed from every part of his body to his mind, making Ivan unbearable, but at the same time he was extremely worried about whether he would turn into something strange after fusing Bogut's blood.
Because his body suddenly became limp, as if he had lost the support of his bones, under the influence of gravity, his head felt that it might sink into the body at any time...
At this moment, the other powers in the body were also awakened, which represented the magic of the unicorn escaping from the blood, defeating the cyan mist steadily.
The magic power of the basilisk in the brain is also at work, expelling the cyan fog from the brain. Under the three-way battle, his body is gradually returning to normal...
But Ivan was not happy at all.
If this continues, his plan to integrate Bogut's blood will probably fail, so Ivan quickly adjusted the magic power that can be mobilized within the group, and forcibly suppressed the power of unicorns and basilisks.
After getting rid of the suppressed situation, the cyan fog made a comeback.
There was no interference this time, and all the mist smoothly merged into the skin and bones. Ivan faintly felt that he was about to become a slime with a Q bomb, and his body was constantly changing...
Time just passed by every minute, and every once in a while, news of the magical power increased sharply in Ivan's mind.
It’s just a little bit different from the previous two times that the interval period suggested this time is longer. I don’t know if Bogut’s power is far less powerful than that of basilisks and unicorns, or because of multiple times. Fusion causes the effect of increasing magic power to diminish...
About a minute later, a few seconds before the protection mode disappeared, this transformation finally came to an end, everything returned to normal again, and the body was no longer soft as if it was about to collapse into a pie.
Ivan moved his hands and feet to get used to it a bit, and then immediately waved his wand to create a full-length mirror, carefully observing whether his appearance would change.
It would be bad if fusing a Bogut disfigured oneself...
"Very good, looks as handsome as before!" Ivan said with a sigh of relief as he looked at himself in the mirror and said with certainty.
In the end, he had the time to open the status bar of the system to see what changes would happen to his own third bloodline.
【Ivan Hals
Occupation: Blood Wizard
Blood Fusion: 3/7
Magic scale: 124
Magic Bar: Transfiguration Curse, Level 6, Occupational Brain, Level 6, Thunderbolt, Explosion, Level 5, Calling God, Guarding, Level 5, Shen Feng Wuying, Level 5...
Blood Magic: Unicorn Shadow, Basilisk Eye, Bogut Transformation
......
Legendary value: 0/10
Grade point: 296】
"Sure enough, it's the ability to transform!" Ivan was not surprised to see the extra Bogut deformed in the bloodline magic column.
After all, Bogut's most obvious ability is to detect fear and transform at will.
In contrast, the latter is obviously better, because just perceiving fear is not as good as learning by yourself...
At the same time, Ivan discovered that his Animagus Polymorphism had disappeared in the status bar.
This shows that the bloodline magic he obtained this time is likely to be the same as the shadow of the unicorn, which is integrated into a kind of magic and greatly enhances the ability of this kind of magic.
And this time the enhanced magic is the transformation of Animagus!
Another major change is that the total amount of magic power has increased a lot. From the display on the status bar, the magic power scale has increased by more than 20 points, and the total value has surpassed the magic power possessed by ordinary adult wizards.
But compared with the professors of various subjects and the elite Aurors of the Ministry of Magic, there is still a significant gap, and it is even more incomparable with Dumbledore.
Thinking of this, Yifan couldn't help feeling when he would live a life with sufficient magic power and big moves casually.
If he had the magic power of Dumbledore, he wouldn't be able to stare at him to death!
After fantasizing, Ivan quickly adjusted his mentality and returned to reality, and began to explore his new ability to transform.
Ivan tried to construct in his mind the creature he needed to transform, and finally chose that he had seen a giant monster!
After the confirmation, the magic power began to flow all over the body, and Ivan felt that his body was like plasticine, constantly stretched and expanded, becoming higher and higher, and his body became stronger and stronger.
This feeling is as if Animagus deformed...
No, it's more magical than that!
After the transformation was over, Ivan stared at the waiting mirror that had just been transformed.
What the mirror reflects is a behemoth 12 feet tall The skin on the whole body is off-white, and the figure is very burly and sturdy, but the small head on the head looks a little funny.
"Gurulu~ Wukhaka..." Ivan's urn sounded out some weird notes, and then he was confused for a long time before he found out how to pronounce it.
"Very well, this transformation looks perfect!" Ivan spit out these characters very hard, raised his arm to hold it, and he could feel the full sense of power.
And with his current sixth-level transformation technique, he couldn't see any flaws in his transformation.
As for why it was transformed into an ugly creature like a giant?
It's just that he wants to confirm one thing!
Thinking of this, Ivan raised his fist the size of a sandbag and slammed into the cabinet on the side...
The cabinet that was more than two meters high was directly smashed out of a hole, and amid a sour sound, it swayed and collapsed, raising a cloud of smoke...

chapters.title: Chapter 390: Advantages and limitations of new capabilities
chapters.content:
Seeing the power of his punch, Ivan nodded with satisfaction, his tendon flesh is not an ornament.
Immediately afterwards, Ivan tried to move a taller locker that was erected not far away, wanting to test how powerful he is now!
Only this time it seemed a little strenuous, and it was very difficult for Ivan to lift this thing up.
If it is replaced by a real monster, it should be easier to move a locker.
After all, according to the description in the book, and personal experience with him in the first grade, the power of the giant monster is quite terrifying, and it can be said to be a strange power...
Obviously, although his transformation into a giant monster will greatly increase his strength, it still does not reach the level of the original version.
When he noticed this, Ivan wasn't very discouraged. This was what he expected, but he was only slightly disappointed.
After turning back to his original shape and resting for a while, Ivan turned to try to transform into other things, such as powerful creatures such as phoenix, thunderbird, and night sky...
Finally found that he can rely on Bogut's transformation to make these creatures vivid, and even restore the power of the deformed creatures to a certain extent, but this power is too weak.
For example, the phoenix he turned into can expel a fist-sized flame with a certain amount of magic power, and it can ignite a few books. Other than that, it is no different from a Scottish red-haired long-tail chicken...
Even so, being able to retain the ability of the transformed magical creature is enough to make Ivan full of joy.
After all, besides Bogut, his body also has the power of basilisk and unicorn!
If Ivan remembers correctly, when he first used Animagus Transfiguration, the unicorn bloodline contained in his blood had been activated, but it quickly fell silent.
If he could directly become a unicorn and a basilisk, he might be able to reactivate this bloodline power!
Because the characteristics of the basilisk are more obvious, after careful consideration, Ivan began to construct the image of the basilisk in his mind.
The difference is that at the moment Ivan started to deform this thought, the magic power in his body was suddenly drawn out, and it continuously penetrated into all parts of the body.
Ivan was immediately taken aback. Although he needed to consume mana when transforming other creatures, he didn't look like he would be drained as he is now.
Fortunately, the worst case did not happen. When his magic power was about to bottom out, he finally calmed down slowly. After that, Ivan's figure began to swell and grow uncontrollably, and was pulled more and more like gluten. It's getting longer.
The skin has also become extremely hard, the dark green thick scale armor is faintly glowing with magic power, the head has become extremely hideous, and the blood basin mouth is full of long and sharp fangs...
The most important thing is that Ivan found that the scene he saw had changed. The gray black and white world was all around him. Although it did not prevent him from judging the surrounding objects based on the shape of the objects, he still felt a little twisted!
Is this the world in the eyes of the basilisk?
This kind of special vision made Ivan very tickled. He wanted to try whether he had the ability to kill by looking directly at the opponent.
It's a pity that there is no living thing here for him to experiment. Ivan can only experiment with other data first, and with a light wave of his tail, the wooden table next to him is immediately shot and flew out.
Then Ivan rushed to the cabinets, bookshelves, tables and chairs in the potion storage room to vent his destructive power...
After some experiments, Ivan was quite sure that his transformation retained most of the power and characteristics of the basilisk.
For example, the scales covering the epidermis are extremely hard. Even if he swings his tail with the greatest strength to make a hole in the wall, he doesn't feel any pain.
In terms of magic resistance, Ivan can’t release magic, so he can’t try, but from what he knows before, the basilisk’s magic resistance is definitely not low. Only a powerful spell such as Shenfeng Wuying can hit him. Cause a certain amount of damage.
But this does not mean that after he is transformed, he will be able to rampage unscrupulously...
After all, the powerful black wizards are familiar with Avada's life curse. The size of the basilisk is simply a living target, no matter how high his magic resistance is, it is impossible to be unscathed by a frontal hit.
At the same time, Ivan also discovered that the basilisk is different from the normal snake, and has no heat-sensing ability, otherwise the blinded basilisk in the original time and space will not find Harry's accurate position.
Instead, perception and hearing have been greatly enhanced. He can clearly perceive the vibrations that come when the wooden table hits a distant wall and the debris falls on the ground, and he can also hear very subtle sounds!
As for the shortcomings, of course, it is not without it. It is much slower to transform into a basilisk than other creatures. If you can't find a way to increase the speed of transformation, you may be caught in the battle.
And in the state of basilisk, you can't use magic, which means he can only fight melee or stare at each other to death!
What worries Ivan the most is that his deformed basilisk is almost the same as the original, and I don't know if it will be affected by the sound of chickens.
While thinking in his mind, Ivan slowly changed back into a human form.
During this process, part of the magic power consumed by the previous transformation returned to the body, and Ivan secretly breathed a sigh of relief in his heart, so that at least he did not have to worry about getting into an embarrassing situation where there was no magic power available after one transformation.
Next, he needs to experiment to see whether laughter can affect his deformation and the flaws of the basilisk are still there.
However, when Ivan turned his head and looked at the clock above the wall, he noticed that unknowingly, it was almost ten o'clock in the evening.
Considering that he had been missing for a long time, it would have been noticed by others that something was wrong, so Ivan put out the idea of ​​staying in the responsive room to test new abilities.
Anyway, experimenting and mastering the newly acquired abilities is not something that can be accomplished in a day or two, nor is it in a hurry.
Thinking of this, Ivan took some time to clean up the messed up potion storage room with magic, and then left straight away and walked towards the Gryffindor lounge.
Along the way, Hogwarts looked a little empty, and there was no half-person figure at all. Ivan realized what was going on after thinking about it.
Sirius sneaked into Gryffindor’s bedroom just yesterday, so few wizards will stay outside at night...

chapters.title: Chapter 391: Why are you still outside so late?
chapters.content:
Just as Ivan was about to return to the Gryffindor lounge, he accidentally ran into Professor McGonagall in the corridor who was in charge of patrolling tonight.
"Hals, why are you still outside so late? I remember Professor Flitwick should have reminded you during dinner that it is best for you to stay in your dormitory at night..."
Seeing Ivan running around alone in the castle, Professor McGonagall's face was very serious, and he asked aloud with dissatisfaction.
But I haven't eaten dinner yet... Ivan silently complained in his heart.
Except for a meeting with Sirius this afternoon and one night, he spent the rest of the time testing his newly acquired abilities in the responsive room. He had no idea what Flitwick had said in the auditorium during dinner.. .
It's just that these things are not convenient to tell Professor McGonagall, so after Ivan hesitated for a while, he apologized and said:
"I'm sorry, Professor McGonagall! I'm more used to finding an open place to practice magic after dinner. I was so fascinated today that I didn't notice the time..."
Listening to Ivan's words, Professor McGonagall's serious face suddenly eased a lot.
"Halse, although it's a good habit to take time to practice magic every day, it's more dangerous outside recently. You'd better pause for a while. What if Black is still hiding in the castle and you accidentally hit it?"
Professor McGonagall spoke earnestly and consoled, and then emphasized the danger of Black, worried that Ivan would take it lightly because of his superior strength.
After all, in her opinion, even if Ivan’s magic level is far superior to that of his peers, or even comparable to adult wizards, in the final analysis he is still a thirteen-year-old child with inexperienced combat, it is difficult to face the vicious Sirius Black There is a chance of winning.
Ivan didn't mean to refute, he was very humble and promised to pay attention next time...
Professor McGonagall nodded in satisfaction, let go of Ivan after a few simple words, and was about to continue patrolling the castle, but before leaving, he suddenly remembered something and hesitated and said:
"By the way, Hals, remember to persuade Harry more after returning to the dormitory so that he should not be too impulsive..."
Harry? What's up with him?
Ivan was confused and wanted to ask what happened to Professor McGonagall.
When he opened his mouth, Ivan stopped again, because he didn't know if this matter was also mentioned in the auditorium. By the way, if he asked, he might reveal most of his disappearance.
Thinking of this, Ivan replied casually, and he knew it by going back to the bedroom and asking Ron and Harry.
"Hey, kid, password!" When he walked to the door of Gryffindor's dorm room, a voice rang out.
Ivan looked up and saw that the portrait of the fat lady hung in the doorway was gone, replaced by a portrait of Sir Cadogan and his fat gray horse.
Previously, Blake used a confusing spell to easily sneak into Gryffindor. It hit the fat lady a great deal. Although no one blamed her, the fat lady was very self-blaming and insisted that she could not bear the responsibility of a goalkeeper.
After the professors failed to persuade them, they had to give the fat lady some time to calm down and replace him with Sir Cadogan, the only one willing to serve as a goalkeeper.
Compared with the conscientious fat lady, the newly appointed Sir Cadogan is not so likable, often teasing others to fight him without saying, and changing the password is very diligent.
"It's a cunning liar, right? If you haven't had time to change your password..." Ivan said helplessly.
He could only pray that his luck would be better, or else he would have to learn Blake to cast a confusion spell on the opponent.
"Yes, you are right! Remember to be wary of this, and go in!" Sir Cadogan mounted his fat horse and wielded his sword to open the door.
Ivan breathed a sigh of relief and walked straight into the Gryffindor lounge. The raging flames burned vigorously in the fireplace, the billowing heat quenched the cold of the night, and a few sleepless little wizards could still be heard laughing and chasing in the lounge.
Ivan deliberately moved a few steps closer so that he could hear clearly.
All kinds of playful laughter continued to reach his ears, and soon, Ivan confirmed that, at least in the non-transformed state, the laughter did not affect him...
This discovery made Ivan very happy and returned to the bedroom happily. He just opened the door and heard the quarrel between Harry and Ron.
"Calm down, Harry! The Ministry of Magic will catch him sooner or later, you don't have to die for it!" Ron looked at Harry beside him worriedly, and said.
But Harry's face was very ugly, he didn't appreciate it at all, and said hysterically.
"How can you calm me down? They knew why Black was chasing me, but they kept hiding from me for so long! Do you know what I saw and heard when I met a dementor on the train?
I heard my mother screaming and begged Voldemort again, begging him to spare my life! If you hear your mother screaming like before she was killed, you will also want to find the betrayer... to revenge yourself! "
Ron had a helpless expression, but at this moment he heard the movement at the door, turned his head to look at Ivan, and greeted with joy. "Ivan, you just came here, please persuade Harry!"
"What happened?" Ivan was very surprised. From the words of the two, he guessed a general idea, but he didn't know if it was right.
Ron did not hide the cause and effect and explained it again.
Ivan then learned that since Lupin accidentally missed his mouth last night, Harry had always been concerned about it. Today, in his spare time today, he kept pestering the professors of various subjects to inquire about the situation although The mouths of McGonagall and others were very strict. However, it was not only the professors who understood the situation. In the end, Harry got the news from Malfoy's mouth.
The price was being mocked by Malfoy, saying that he was a coward who only dared to hide in Hogwarts and didn't dare to find Black for revenge...
Naturally, Harry was so angry that he would go to Sirius-Black to fight to the death when his mind got hot! Fortunately, Ron stopped him in time, and Hermione even quietly notified Professor McGonagall to stop him.
"Are you planning to prevent me from going to Black for revenge?" Harry said with a cold face, really angry.
However, Ivan shook his head slightly and said, "No, I don't plan to do this!"
Harry was stunned for a moment. He didn't expect Ivan to say that.
Ron even stared at Ivan. He suddenly felt that it was a mistake to let Ivan come to comfort Harry...

chapters.title: Chapter 392: 1 forget everything
chapters.content:
Shaban, who had been hiding in Ron's pocket, poked out his head quietly, listening to the conversations of several people.
"So you support me to find Black for revenge?" Harry also recovered from his surprise, and said happily.
Ivan didn't nod or shook his head, but asked seriously. "Then are you really ready to fight the opponent?
Let's not mention failure for the time being. Assuming you successfully defeated him, what would you do if the betrayer was standing in front of you now? "
Harry fantasized about this scene, with a hint of delight flashing across his face, and when he was about to speak, he heard Ivan continue to speak.
"Cut off his hands and feet, and then cut them into pieces? Or use a heart-cutting curse to watch him wailing in pain until he died..."
Ivan talked about the cruel punishment one by one, and Harry was stunned, looking at Ivan in fear.
Scabbard hiding in Ron's pocket, his two paws pulled hard at the mouth of the bag, and was trembling with fright. Would you like to be so cruel?
"I... Of course I wouldn't do this... I'll catch Black and send it to Azkaban... Let the Dementors deal with him!" After a long while, Harry ended. Baba said.
Ivan couldn't help sighing that there was no meeting with Tom Riddle in the second grade and the experience of facing the basilisk. Now Harry is more naive than him in the original time and space, so he couldn't help but reminded him.
"But you should be very clear that if you lose in the battle with the other party, it is possible for the other party to treat you this way, isn't it?"
"So what? As long as I have a chance to kill Black, I have to try it!" Harry gritted his teeth.
"But what are you going to rely on for fighting? Disarming Curse? Stupefying Curse? Petrifying Curse? Be sober...you have no chance of winning at all!" Ivan shook his head.
Reality is not a fairy tale drama, just like in the original time and space, if Voldemort was not obsessed with the content of the prophecy, he insisted on killing Harry himself every time, and because of the protagonist’s halo, all sorts of sorrows continued, Harry would even be Ten lives are not enough to die!
Harry fell silent. He wanted to retort, but in his heart he knew that Ivan was right. He couldn't be Sirius Black's opponent with his own strength.
But it was impossible for him to sit back and watch Black, who had betrayed his parents and caused them to be killed by Voldemort, was so free, but he did nothing, which Harry couldn't bear.
After learning what happened from Malfoy before, the thought of revenge eroded his heart like a poisonous snake.
Obviously his father, James, trusted Blake so much, regarded him as his best friend, and chose to make Blake the secret of his hiding place.
However, this shameful betrayer did not hesitate to betray his parents and fell into the arms of Voldemort!
Harry couldn't imagine that his parents thought they were safe hiding in the refuge, only to be attacked by Voldemort, and how disappointed they would be when they figured out that their most trusted friend betrayed him. ..
Ivan saw the change in Harry's expression in his eyes, and roughly guessed what he was thinking, and then he thought of the sentence and said.
"Harry, I've said that I didn't mean to stop you from taking revenge, but we must at least have a plan instead of going to death excitedly, not to mention that you don't even know where Black is, don't you?"
Speaking of this, Ivan was also a little helpless. He didn't expect Harry to learn about these things at this time. With the preconceived impression, it would be more troublesome for him to defend Black again.
The questions he asked just now, in addition to encouraging Harry to stay in school well recently, waiting for his own plan, also had a sense of temptation.
It turned out that Harry had no intention of killing his father and enemies indirectly because of his age and kindness, but his prejudice against Sirius Black was already deep.
Ivan even suspected that he was able to quickly gain Harry’s trust by revealing the identity of Peter Pettigrew. Ron would definitely protect his mice, and refused to admit that the pets he had raised were actually a bald old man who became a bald old man. ...
And in everyone’s impression, Peter Pettigrew is now an out-and-out hero, the winner of the Merlin Medal of the First Class!
Even if he reveals the identity of Peter Pettigrew, this guy will most likely pretend to be a victim and find a chance to bite him back.
At that time, there will definitely be a riot that will attract many students and professors. Even if he can talk to the Confucianists and convince everyone with the black mark on Peter Pettigrew, this matter cannot be hidden!
Then the next day, people from the Ministry of Magic rushed to imprison Peter, and on one night, Peter Pettigrew died unexpectedly because of the “out of control” behavior of a dementor. Even a little harder might even make the corpse inexplicable. Missing...
So it's better to find a secluded place in Hogsmeade Village, gather Harry, Sirius, Lupin, Peter and others together, put the facts in front of them, and then slowly explain them.
After getting Lupin, Harry and the others, consider whether to try to persuade McGonagall and others...
While Ivan was thinking about things in his mind, Ron, who had listened for so long, finally realized that Ivan was persuading Harry not to act rashly, and hurriedly agreed.
"Ivan is right. You can't fight Black! Remember what we saw in the Daily Prophet? Black used a spell to blow up a whole street, killing ten Many Muggles! Even if we are tied together, we can't beat him!
In addition, tomorrow is the first game of Quidditch. Think about these normal things. Wood and the others are still waiting for you to catch the Snitch and get this year's trophy together! "
Ron was very witty to think of Harry's favorite Quidditch game, and emphasized that Harry, as a seeker, has assumed the hope of the entire Gryffindor Academy and must not lose the chain!
Although Harry has no intention of playing, as Ron said, the Quidditch game is not his work alone. If Gryffindor loses the game because of his personal problems, then he is the sinner of the academy. !
I'm even more sorry for the other players who have worked so hard during this time...
Thinking of this Harry stopped thinking about finding Black for a duel. Instead, he devoted part of his energy to the upcoming Quidditch match, working hard to adjust his state so that he could play tomorrow. Time will not affect performance because of distraction.
Ivan and Ron were relieved to notice that Harry finally stopped being stubborn, and after a while deliberately deflecting the subject, they went to bed and prepared to go to bed.
Lying in the bed in a daze, Ivan always felt as if he had forgotten something today. He tilted his head just to see a mouse with his eyes open and motionless by the window, as if lost in thought, and then he remembered what he was going to do.
After waiting until late at night, after confirming that everyone was asleep, Ivan slipped out of the bed quietly, came to the window, and raised his wand.
"You know too much today... forget it all!"
After Ivan finished speaking, there was only a light "squeak" in the silent bedroom...

chapters.title: Chapter 393: What did you do last night?
chapters.content:
The next morning, Ivan woke up from the bed with a yawn, and the first thing to do was to observe the movement of Scab and confirm its state.
This gray-black mouse is lying by the window blankly at the moment, dumbfounded as if his brain is not bright...
Seeing this, Ivan couldn’t help but feel a little worried. If he used the Forgetting Charm on Peter too frequently, it would hurt his brain. It would be bad if he accidentally caused Peter to be insanity...
While thinking, Ivan gets up and washes routinely.
Harry on the other side changed into Gryffindor's uniform early, but his mental head looked a little bad. He vaguely heard a slight scream in his sleep yesterday.
Harry felt that this might be some kind of prediction from his mother, and the voice still echoed in his ears, as if his parents were constantly questioning himself why he didn't seek revenge on Sirius.
Just as Harry was thinking about things, Ivan stepped forward and patted him on the shoulder, exhorting. "Don't think so much, let's go, there are many people on the field waiting to give you cheers and applause!"
Harry reluctantly nodded, Ron grabbed Scabble and stuffed it into the wizard's robe, and then several people went out together to the Quidditch match.
Strolling in the corridor and looking through the windows outside, Ivan realized that the weather today seemed not so good. The wind was strong outside, the sky looked gray, and the dark clouds were constantly surging and showed signs of increasing.
Obviously a storm is coming...
Harry was also keenly aware of this, and silently prayed in his heart that it would never rain...at least not to rain during this time!
However, the matter is willing to do, just as they were about to leave the castle, a thunder pierced the sky, the majestic heavy rain fell one after another, and there was a trend of getting worse...
"This **** weather... it's terrible!" Harry looked helplessly at the sky and said aloud, he felt as if everything was against him these days.
Playing in a storm is not a good choice. Heavy rain and wind will affect the line of sight and make the Golden Snitch harder to find.
Although the opponent will also be affected by the heavy rain, he is wearing glasses after all. If the rain wets the frame during the game, it will be more troublesome...
Harry sighed and complained to his two friends. Ivan thought about a countermeasure, and when he was about to say something, a voice rang behind him.
"In fact, this situation is easy to solve. Just add a waterproof magic to the glasses, isn't it?"
Ivan turned his head and looked over. The little brown-haired witch holding a big **** cat was walking from behind them.
Ron subconsciously covered his pocket, and Scabbard, who had just poked his head out to let the wind, also consciously got into his pocket and hid.
"No, that's all right!" Hermione didn't bother to pay attention to Ron, and walked to Harry on her own, stretched out her wand and tapped Harry's glasses, adding a waterproof magic to them.
Ivan turned Harry’s glasses into windshield mirrors, so that during the game there is no need to worry that this thing will fall off because of the excessive movements.
"This is really great!" Harry touched the new glasses that had been blessed with magic, and said happily. In this way, his glasses would no longer be a burden, but a magic item that blocks storm and rain from getting into his eyes.
"By the way, Harry, there is one more thing I need to remind you. It is best not to fly too high during the game!" Ivan suddenly thought that Harry would be interfered by dementors in the original time and space. When he fell from the sky, he reminded him.
"Why?" Harry was a little strange.
"Because those dementors often patrol in mid-air, if you accidentally touch them, it may affect your state of the game..." Ivan said vaguely.
"It should be impossible? How dare those dementors run into the school and interfere with the game openly? The professors won't allow them to do so!" Hermione couldn't help but interrupted.
"Yeah... and my ability to endure is not that bad. I will insist on finishing the game when I meet those dementors." Harry felt Ivan underestimated his abilities, and he was not a good one. Touch it and fall, not so fragile.
Seeing the disapproval of everyone, Ivan shook his head and said, "You better not overestimate their endurance!"
After the reminder, Ivan no longer persuaded him. Now it is not certain whether things will develop like the original time and space. It is possible that those dementors will learn a little better after being taught twice by him.
Coupled with the fact that there are professors on the field, even if the dementors really can’t think about it, Harry’s life is not in danger, at best he is frightened, and it can force him to work hard and learn to talk to Lupin. Escort.
When Ivan and the others were chatting all the way to the arena, Wood was already waiting there, and when he saw Harry, he hurried to greet him and said with some dissatisfaction.
"Harry, why are you here so late? Everyone is waiting in the locker room, you are the only one!"
"I didn't sleep well last night, I got up a bit late today..." Harry didn't explain much, saying those unhappy things, but just casually replied, and then said to Ivan and the others.
"Then I'll go prepare first, and see you later!"
Ivan nodded, and Ron said encouragingly. "Go, Harry, I believe you will be able to catch the Snitch and finish the game as soon as possible!"
"Of course, Harry is the best seeker at Hogwarts, I never doubted that!" Wood said with a smile, then turned to look at Ivan and said.
"Hals, have you really decided not to participate in this year's Quidditch?"
"I've said it many times, right? I'm very busy this year, I don't have time to practice, and the Gryffindor team is already full?" Ivan shook his head helplessly.
"Then you are going to miss this year's trophy!" Wood joked, but a look of disappointment flashed in his eyes.
Ivan is the best chaser he has ever seen The last time he played against the Slytherin team, he even set a record for scoring goals in a Quidditch match!
If Ivan is willing to participate, the Gryffindor team will win this year!
But Wood quickly adjusted his mood. He was still very optimistic about the players he trained. Even without Ivan, there is no problem in winning this year's game!
"Harry, let's go, it's about to start!" Wood took Harry by the arm and led him into the lounge.
Ivan and others sat down in the stands where they could not see the rain, and were ready to watch the game.
Hermione looked around and saw that no one was looking to this side, she leaned forward and asked quietly. "Ivan, what did you do yesterday? We looked for you for a long time and didn't find you. You didn't even come after dinner in the evening..."
(PS: Some people may not be able to see what is written in this chapter. Let me mention it again. It is not difficult for the protagonist to debunk Peter, but he can’t do it now. Peter is imprisoned, and find another reason to secretly die, so as to cover up his mistake.)

chapters.title: Chapter 394: Elf in the rain
chapters.content:
"If it weren't for Harry and Ron to help you cover, the professors would have discovered that you were not in the castle yesterday!" Hermione added.
"Is that so? Thank you very much, Hermione!" Ivan said gratefully. No wonder Professor McGonagall didn't know that he didn't go to the auditorium last night. It turned out that it was Hermione and others who helped him cover.
"So where did you go?" Hermione looked at Ivan very dissatisfied. Yesterday, Ivan hadn't come back for a long time. She almost thought that Ivan had encountered Sirius, and suffered an accident...
If she hadn't seen how powerful Ivan was, and easily dealt with a large number of dementors and those dark wizards, she almost couldn't help but want to tell the professors about Ivan's disappearance.
"Wait...you won't go to Sirius, are you?" Hermione suddenly thought of something, lowered her voice, and asked.
Hearing Hermione's guess, Ivan's pupils tightened. Fortunately, he had experienced strong winds and waves, and his acting skills were trained in front of Dumbledore, so even if he was surprised, his face remained the same.
"Why do you think that?" Ivan asked, pretending to be puzzled.
"I remember you told George and Fred a few days ago that you would find a way to earn back all the college points we deducted, so I think you must have gone to Sirius and wanted to catch him alone. Isn't it right?" Hermione stared at Ivan closely, analyzing it endlessly.
Ivan couldn't laugh or cry for a while, he didn't expect Hermione to doubt himself because of those few words.
After thinking about it, Ivan shook his head and vetoed. "I just went to find a place to practice magic yesterday, don't think too much..."
"Really?" Hermione suspiciously wanted to see something from Ivan's expression, but Ivan was very disguised. She didn't notice anything, so Hermione had to give up and stop asking.
Ivan sighed in secretly. The thing about Sirius and Peter was not that he didn't want to disclose it to Hermione, but that she was worried that Hermione would not be able to hide after learning that Ron’s pet mouse Scab was actually a vicious thug. Staying in the emotions and being seen by Peter, it will be troublesome...
Thinking of this, Ivan turned his head and glanced at Ron again.
Because Crookshanks had been thinking about his dappled body, Ron deliberately took his baby mouse to sit far away from them, and it should be impossible to hear him and Hermione's deliberately low voice dialogue.
When Ivan looked back again, the Quidditch match had already begun.
The players of the two teams flew out of the passage on broomsticks, and there was enthusiastic applause around the stands. Numerous colored flags fluttered in the wind and rain, and the little wizards shouted to cheer for their college team. Encouragement, even no matter how hard it is, the enthusiasm of everyone can't be quenched.
"Gryffindor come on!"
"Harry Potter will win!"
"Diggory, you are the best!"
......
There were constant shouts on the field and even overwhelming the thundering lightning. Ivan was stunned no matter how many times he watched it. As a traverser, he simply couldn't understand why the wizards were so passionate about Quidditch.
It's about to catch up with the Muggles football game...
However, it is normal to think about it carefully, because the entire magical world seems to have only such a large-scale magic movement, and wizards have no other choice...
"Hey, why did someone cheer me up? I didn't participate in the competition..."
Ivan glanced over, and suddenly found that one of the wooden boards held high actually read [Ivan Hals, come on], with some strange pictures on it...
Ifan squinted his eyes, looked in the direction where the wooden sign was, and found a familiar figure.
"Luna?" Ivan said unexpectedly.
Luna, who hadn't seen her for a long time, was sitting on a high platform without a baffle, and she was not wearing a raincoat or hat.
The endless raindrops flowed from the tips of her hair and the top of her head over her delicate side face, and then dripped onto her clothes. The little witch was soggy but completely indifferent, holding the big wooden sign in a leisurely manner. The torrential rain raged by the squally wind, it looked like an elf in the rain.
Ivan didn't know what to look at for a while, Luna's behavior was always so unexpected...
But Ivan soon discovered that Luna was not unprepared. Her clothes looked thick and warm, and most likely they were waterproof, but who would take the initiative to sit on a high platform to get wet in a stormy day?
