Perhaps she realized that Ivan was not in the Gryffindor team, Luna quickly put down the sign she was holding high, and hugged her in her arms, her bright eyes scanned the stands curiously. Then, after a while, they looked at each other with Ivan...
Because it was so far apart, Ivan had to try to use her mouth to try to get Luna to go to shelter from the rain, but don't catch a cold!
Immediately afterwards, Ivan thought it was impossible for Luna to see what he was trying to express at such a distance, so she stood up and went over there to remind her.
However, before Ivan acted, she saw that Luna had left the original position holding the sign and waved at him before she left. She should have been sheltering from the rain.
"Ivan, what's the matter?" Hermione noticed Ivan's movements and looked at him strangely, but saw nothing.
"I happened to see an acquaintance, just say hello!" Ivan said casually.
acquaintance? That weird Ravenclaw girl?
Noting that the place Ivan was looking at was the area where the Ravenclaw students were, Hermione instantly thought of who the acquaintance was referring to in Ivan's words.
That second-year girl named Luna really impressed her when she first started...
At this moment, Ron on the side suddenly yelled with excitement.
"Quick...look! Harry found the Golden Snitch!"
Ron's voice attracted Hermione's attention Ivan also looked up to the sky.
A golden light leaped in mid-air, wandering in the field, Harry followed closely behind, galloping through the storm, and everyone's eyes were on the golden thief and Harry.
Because of the strong wind and heavy rain blocking the view, the golden light appeared from time to time in everyone's sight... They need to concentrate hard to see where the golden snitch is vaguely. If they are distracted, they will not be able to find it .
Ron even noticed that a Gryffindor player nearly hit the wall while wiping because of rain water seeping into his eyes, and he complained loudly.
"Damn Slytherin! No wonder they temporarily switched games with Hufflepuff. They must have expected the weather today!"
"No matter what, Harry will definitely be able to catch the Snitch!" Hermione said confidently.
But Ivan was faintly disturbed, because in the distance Harry's figure kept rising as he chased the Golden Snitch, but the sky was strangely dim like night, and something seemed to be surging in the dark clouds. ..

chapters.title: Chapter 395: That day the dementor recalled the fear of being dominated by the patron saint
chapters.content:
"Do you think the sky seems to be getting darker?" Not far away, a little wizard in Gryffindor looked at the sky and asked with some confusion.
Hermione thought about it, and suddenly remembered the scene that she and Ivan had seen in the sky above Hogwarts, which was very similar to now.
Thinking of this, Hermione felt a chill in her heart. She already understood what those things were surging in the dark clouds.
"It's dementors! They are in the sky! Harry is in danger... let him come back!" Hermione shouted loudly.
"What?" Ron was still at a loss to understand what was going on, but the next moment he saw Harry's figure trembling high in the sky, and then suddenly fell from the sky.
Hundreds of little wizards throughout the Quidditch arena watched this scene in horror, and what made them panic was that a large number of dementors suddenly floated down from the sky, and the darkness was heavy, like a dark cloud...
That dilapidated and rotten body caused countless little wizards to scream harshly.
"It's really a dementor!"
"How dare they come in?!"
"Harry... Harry fell from the sky, who will save him!"
......
For a while, the Quidditch arena became very chaotic, and various shouts and screams continued.
Ivan stood up all of a sudden and looked at the dementor floating in the sky, not surprised.
He knew very well that the dementors broke into the school. In the final analysis, it was the negligence of the Ministry of Magic. They did not consider the food of these dementors at all, and put the dementors in Hogwarts, where there is "food" everywhere It’s strange if nothing happens!
Suddenly smelling so much happiness in the Quidditch arena today, these dementors naturally couldn't help it.
But Ivan doesn’t worry much about the dementor, because this farce will soon be ended by angry Dumbledore...
Huh? Dumbledore?
Ivan suddenly realized a problem, and that was that Dumbledore didn't seem to be in school at all!
Thinking of this, Ivan's face changed drastically, and he drew out his wand as quickly as possible to use the slow fall technique to save Harry.
It was just that before he could do anything, Harry's rate of falling from the sky had slowed down.
Ivan glanced around and saw that Snape, with a gloomy face, was wearing a raincoat and standing on the Slytherin stand. It was obvious that the slow fall technique was released by him just now.
Quidditch is of course impossible without a professor taking care of the order...
Ms. Hooch, who was the referee, rushed to Harry as soon as she recovered, and picked him up and flew towards the ground...
The dementors who lost their target were very angry, but fortunately, they soon had a new target-all the students in the Quidditch arena!
Snape frowned and raised his wand in disgust to cast a spell, but in the end he hesitated for a while and didn't do it...
At this point of delay, the dementors are getting closer and panic is spreading.
Several senior students shouted loudly and released their patron saint. A buffalo, a few moles, a crow and other fluorescent creatures bucked the trend, trying to stop the dementors from moving forward. pace...
But the number of dementors is too much, there are hundreds of them, and the defenses built by these patron saints can't play any role at all.
Seeing Snape standing still, Ron was suddenly furious, and he cursed loudly.
"Why didn't Snape get rid of these **** dementors? Do you want to watch us get attacked by dementors to be happy!"
"Maybe Professor Snape wouldn't call God's guard, maybe!" Hermione guessed. Of course she didn't believe Snape dared to make any small actions in the public.
Besides, there are Slytherin students here. Snape would never stand idly by if he could handle it...
Hermione once saw in the book that people whose minds were corrupted by black magic could not be protected by the gods. She thought this might be the reason why Snape was unable to expel these dementors.
But how could Professor Dumbledore let a person whose mind was corrupted by black magic come to teach them potions lessons?
Ivan also set his eyes on Snape, knowing that Snape could summon the patron saint, so he was even more puzzled as to why Snape was so reluctant to do it.
The puzzled Ivan keenly noticed the struggling color on Snape's face, and suddenly remembered something, and realized that Snape probably didn't want to reveal his patron saint curse, let alone reveal his patron saint!
After all, most Death Eaters cannot release the patron saint. At the beginning, Dumbledore was willing to trust Snape's words. One of the important reasons was that Snape summoned his patron saint, the deer... The patron saint exactly like his beloved Lily...
If the patron saint's appearance is rashly exposed to everyone's sight, it might make someone think of something, which will have a certain impact on the possible future espionage work and increase the risk of death.
"Ivan, you can get rid of these dementors, right?" Seeing that the dementors were about to rush down, Ron panicked thinking of Ivan who had expelled a large number of dementors on the train, and hurried. Asked aloud.
The rest of the little wizards of Gryffindor also seemed to have grasped the last straw, looking at Ivan expectantly, no one wanted to have a close contact with those disgusting dementors...
"Of course it's okay!" Ivan nodded, knowing that the emergency is not a time of concealment, so he held up his wand and shouted loudly.
"Hushen... guard!"
The next moment the dazzling light spread across the dim Quidditch arena, and the little wizards who had been flustered and at a loss all cast their eyes in the direction of the light.
Not long after, an invigorating neighing sound rang in everyone's ears, and the light and white fog spreading in the air gathered together in a short period of time and turned into a unicorn.
Everyone's eyes were attracted by this sacred and proud unicorn. The fear of just looking at the bottom of my heart gradually faded, and a calm and peaceful mood gradually poured into my heart...
It screamed again and stepped on the white fog, behind which was flickering light and shadow, rushing straight to the dementors gathered in the sky...
There are so many dementors like a black wave, but when the two sides touch the battle, the battle is completely one-sided. The powerful and terrifying dementors are no different from the paper in front of the shadow of the unicorn...
The shadow of the unicorn rushed all the way, dispersing the body of a large number of dementors, and fleeing wildly. The weird cries were constantly resounding in the air. It was the angry and helpless wailing of the dementors... .

chapters.title: Chapter 396: Dementor's Nemesis
chapters.content:
Although the brains of dementors are not easy to use, they still have memory.
This powerful and unique white behemoth quickly reminded them of the tragic situation of being hanged twice before, and immediately lost the idea of ​​resistance. Anyway, they can't be beaten...
Realizing this, countless dementors fled hurriedly under the pursuit of the shadow of the unicorn, afraid to stay on the court for a moment...
The patron saints who were originally suppressed by the dementors have regrouped, and the fox followed the shadow of the unicorn and beat down the dog...
Snape was secretly relieved when he saw this scene. If Ivan takes a few seconds later, then he can only choose to expose his patron saint.
After all, there are a large number of students who are unable to resist the Dementors in the Quidditch Stadium. No matter how he is a professor at Hogwarts, it is impossible to sit back and watch...
Just staring at the patron saint who looked like a unicorn, Snape was a little surprised.
He is still quite familiar with the magic of the patron saint curse, and he knows that the patron saint summoned by the wizard will show different animal forms according to the heart and spirit of the summoner.
Although strong emotions can also change the form of the patron saint, generally speaking, no matter how it changes, it is impossible to look like a ready-made magical creature.
The only exception he had seen before was Dumbledore’s phoenix patron...
Snape didn't expect Ivan's patron saint to be so special, and it seemed that the patron saint of this magical creature form was much stronger than normal, otherwise he would not be able to expel hundreds of dementors so easily!
On the other side, Ms. Hooch, who had just rescued Harry, slowly put down her wand, and her eyes were full of emotion when she looked at Ivan.
The little wizard who was inspiring to become a Quidditch champion in class was already so powerful unconsciously.
You know that in the face of hundreds of dementors gathered together, Ms. Huo Qi thinks that she is not sure to drive them away...
The little wizards of Gryffindor looked at the dementors who were eager to attack them just now, but now they were defeated by Ivan’s patron saint. They suddenly gathered here, cheering loudly, and even Even people from other colleges are no exception.
"You are amazing, Hals! You are our savior..."
"The hero of Gryffindor!"
"No, it's the hero of the entire Hogwarts!"
......
As soon as Ivan put down his wand, several senior Gryffindor wizards put it up and threw it into the air.
Listening to the cheers coming from my ears, Ivan was somewhat helpless. Didn't he just drive away a group of dementors? It's not a big deal.
[Ding, a new legendary event has been generated! 】
When Ivan was thinking about it, a system system sounded in his mind.
Ivan looked at it unexpectedly.
[Legendary Title: Dementor’s Nemesis
Legend: 1
Legendary event: You used a powerful patron saint to defeat a large number of dementors several times in a row, so that they will be remembered and feared...
Note: Your appearance and unique patron saint will circulate among dementors, and they will never want to see you again! 】
That's not bad, it just so happens that I don't want to see these evil guys again!
Ivan curled his lips and murmured silently in his heart. He unexpectedly got a little legend and made him feel very happy.
However, these happy moods didn't last long before they were interrupted by another reminder to activate the task.
When I heard the name of the mission, Ivan had an unfamiliar hunch. After opening the mission interface, it turned out to be the same as he guessed.
[Task: Dark Minions
Mission Objective: Have a Dementor Army Mission Reward: Three Legendary Points
Mission description: After teaching these dementors who dared to offend you, the kind you decided to forgive their ignorance and foolishness and give them a precious opportunity to swear allegiance!
You need to form an army of dementors. They are dark minions, the embodiment of fear, and can help you punish your enemies and spread fear...
Note: Think about it, idiots, tell me who is your allegiance? ——Ivan Hals. 】
After a simple glance, Ivan closed the task bar blankly, leaving this task behind with other unreliable tasks.
Are you kidding me? He hates dementors and doesn't want to spread fear...
Just after Ivan was distracted, a patron saint with the appearance of a tabby cat suddenly flew towards this side from the castle in the distance, and disappeared after wandering in mid-air for a while.
Before long, Professor McGonagall appeared at the gate of Quidditch Stadium.
Seeing the little wizards gathered together and Ivan who was thrown high in the sky by the crowd, McGonagall had some guesses in his heart, but he said in a deep voice.
"Someone came over just now to inform me that the dementors guarding the school have rioted. Is it true? What about those dementors?"
Seeing Professor McGonagall approaching, the enthusiastic little wizards finally let go of Ivan and stepped aside.
Ivan sorted out some messy clothes, and then briefly talked about what happened just now to Professor McGonagall.
When it was learned that a group of dementors took advantage of the Quidditch game to break into here to attack the students and caused Harry to fall from a high altitude, McGonagall's face was full of anger.
"They...how do they have the courage to do such a thing?!" Professor McGonagall was furious, and immediately promised Ivan and others that he would explain to the Ministry of Magic what happened today and ask for an explanation for everyone.
At the same time, some of the little wizards in Gryffindor remembered the bad behavior of the dementors just now when they rioted Snape was clearly on the court but didn't make a move, so they enthusiastically beat Professor McGonagall. Small report.
"You said Severus didn't save him and didn't care about you? It's impossible!" Professor McGonagall shook her head categorically. She didn't believe Snape would do it!
"Professor! That was what we all saw with our own eyes! If Ivan hadn't driven off the dementors, then we would have been killed by those dementors!" Ron angrily told Snape's black shape.
Since the fallen Harry had attracted all the attention, Ron didn't know that Snape had saved Harry. He only saw Ms. Huoqi riding up on the broom to hug Harry down.
Ron thought Snape had been watching the Quidditch stadium, letting Harry fall off his broom, and witnessing them being attacked by dementors!
While talking, Ron looked around, seeking support from other students, so that Professor McGonagall could understand that he was not lying.
However, no one of the surrounding little wizards responded, instead they looked behind him with a little fear, and George quietly gave him a self-seeking look.

chapters.title: Chapter 397: You definitely think this is interesting, right?
chapters.content:
"What's wrong with you?" Ron didn't understand at first, but he shivered quickly because Snape's gloomy voice came from behind him.
"You must have mistakenly thought that defamation of professors is a very interesting thing without any punishment, right? Weasley!"
Hearing this sound, Ron swallowed, feeling a chill behind his back, and turning his head tremblingly, he saw Snape's gloomy face.
"Professor Snape..." Ron stammered with a stiff face.
He just remembered that Snape had always been in the Quidditch arena, and that what he said before was almost in front of Snape...
Ivan on the side couldn’t help but mourned for Ron’s encounter for a second. He even wondered if Snape had any special abilities, such as being able to automatically appear behind the person who spoke badly about him...
Ron always gets caught upright every time he speaks badly about him behind his back...
However, Ivan then remembered that there seemed to be exceptions. For example, when Ron and Harry in the first grade filed a complaint in the principal’s office, Snape was not there and could not hear it, so it should be purely Ron’s bad luck. That's it...
Fortunately, at this time, Professor McGonagall made a sound to relieve Ron in time, and he didn't embarrass him too much.
"Severus, are things like Mr. Weasley said?"
Professor McGonagall didn't believe that Snape, who had been a colleague for many years, would be a person who ignored the lives of students.
But when Ron spoke just now, even the Slytherin students didn't mean to defend Snape. Instead, they acquiesced to Ron's words, which also made her a little suspicious.
"No, that's just because Mr. Hals, who likes to be pushy, is one step faster than me!" Snape said casually, his gaze rested on Ivan's body, and then continued.
"But I can't use the Hushen Guardian. If I do it, it may be a little more troublesome to solve..."
"You can't use the protection of the gods? Why? As far as I know, only...only those people will have this situation." Professor McGonagall looked at Snape suspiciously.
Snape's answer went far beyond her expectation. After all, in McGonagall's impression, only the dark wizards with evil thoughts in their hearts would be unable to use the guard of the gods.
"Whatever you think..." Snape said coldly, and stared at Harry who was pale in Ms. Hooch's arms.
After confirming that he was not injured, Snape flicked his sleeves and left, not caring about the little wizards who pointed him.
Professor McGonagall pursed his lips and looked at Snape's leaving back for a long time. She felt that after Dumbledore came back, she had to tell him about it.
There are not many people who can understand the conversation between the two professors, but this does not prevent them from guessing in private. Almost no one wants to believe that Snape is powerless to drive away dementors, most of the little wizards in Gryffindor. We all thought Snape did it on purpose.
Ron even suspected that Snape left in such a hurry, he must have absconded in fear of sin...
Ivan couldn't help shaking his head when listening to their remarks. Snape was really good enough to conceal the appearance of the patron saint...
"Harry, you finally woke up! How are you feeling, how are you?"
Ms. Hooch's excited voice resounded, attracting everyone's attention.
"What's the matter? Why am I here?" Harry opened his eyes blankly, lying in her arms, and looking around, there was a muddle in his mind, he asked suspiciously. .
Harry only vaguely remembered that he was flying high in the air, feeling colder and colder, as if he heard someone's screams, and then he didn't remember anything.
But this feeling, Harry is very familiar with, have he experienced...
"It's a dementor! There are more than a hundred of them. You must have fallen if they attacked you in the sky!" Ron answered Harry's doubts.
Dementor again? Harry's heart was cold, and she couldn't feel the warmth when being held by Ms. Hooch...
"Come on, we've all seen it, the Dementor just got close to Potter, he was so scared that he fell..." Malfoy pulled the crowd and walked out, jokingly at Harry lying on the ground. .
"Faced with so many dementors, it's impossible for anyone else to be unaffected!" Ivan explained, and then looked at Malfoy. "I remember when those dementors rushed down, Malfoy, you ran very fast!"
Malfoy choked instantly, his face turned red and white, and he was not the only one who ran...
But Malfoy couldn't refute this, because Ivan, who was also a third grader, couldn't help but didn't run away. Instead, he cleaned up all the dementors who made trouble...
"What about the game? How was the game? We didn't lose, right?" Harry ignored Malfoy's mockery, but broke free from Ms. Hooch's arms and asked anxiously.
"Of course not..." Ron shook his head and was about to say that he would definitely pass the comparison again, but a few Hufflepuff wizards in the crowd retorted and shouted.
"No, you have already lost, Diggory has caught the Snitch! Just when Potter fell from the sky, many people saw it!"
Harry and the others looked over, and Hufflepuff's Seeker Cedric Diggory walked out from the other side and stretched out his right hand.
A golden ball with wings lay in the palm of Cedric Diggory, cleverly trying to fly away, but it was firmly grasped by a few fingers.
"You caught it..." Harry stared at the scene blankly, his mind was a little dizzy but he knew the game was over...
"If it weren't for those dementors, Harry wouldn't have fallen from the sky! He would have caught the Snitch! It's not fair...we need to compare it again!" Ron said angrily, very much for Harry And feel worthless.
Some of the Gryffindor wizards also supported Ron's statement, clamoring that they wanted to compare...
"Unfair? Diggory was brave to catch the Golden Snitch surrounded by dementors! This proves that not everyone is as vulnerable as Potter... Weasley! It's impossible for the next game. Potter was blown down by a gust of wind, so let everyone compare it again, right?"
Malfoy dragged his weird tone and looked at Harry mockingly.
Ron glared at Malfoy.
Harry opened his mouth stiffly, trying to say something, but in the end he couldn't speak.
Because he felt that Malfoy was right. Diggory was a seeker like himself. The opponent was able to overcome the influence of the Dementor to catch the Golden Snitch, but he could not. What face does he have to question the opponent's courage? ?

chapters.title: Chapter 398: In fact, it is just a deformed horse with horns!
chapters.content:
Under everyone's attention, Cedric Diggory was a little embarrassed.
After thinking about it for a while, as the captain of Hufflepuff, he proactively proposed to Ms. Hooch that this result should be invalidated, and Gryffindor and Hufflepuff could be compared again in a few days.
Cedric Diggory's generous actions made Harry, Wood, George and others faceless to answer.
Although they were eager to win, they still had their own pride, so they refused Cedric's proposal with little hesitation.
After confirming the wishes of both parties, Ms. Hooch as the referee announced on the spot that Cedric Diggory had caught the Snitch and ended the game. The results were real and effective. Hufflepuff won...
Although everyone was very hard-hearted when they gave up, when Ms. Hooch really announced the result, Fred, George and others became frustrated one by one.
Wood turned away in despair, even ignoring the shouts of everyone behind him. He wanted to be quiet...
Looking at Wood's back, Harry blamed himself incomparably. It was the first time he lost the game.
What's more, he passed out in a coma on the court very badly. The other Quidditch players besides him were all fine, and Harry couldn't help wondering if he was really as vulnerable as Malfoy said.
"It's over! We are behind by more than a hundred points this time. Unless Hufflepuff loses to Ravenclaw next, we can beat Ravenclaw and Slytherin in succession to have some chances of winning..." Angely Na sighed and calculated, feeling that the probability of winning this year is very slim.
It is not a good choice to pin the odds of winning on the opponent's mistakes, and Ravenclaw and Slytherin are very strong, it is not easy to play a beautiful winning streak.
Fredela pulled on Angelina's sleeves and shook her head at her, beckoning her to stop saying this and put pressure on Harry.
"All right, Harry! You have never missed a snitch before, this time it was just an accident. When anyone made a mistake, no one will blame you!" George grinned reluctantly and patted Harry. Said comfortingly on his shoulder.
"Yes! It's not a big deal to win or lose once, are there two more matches next? I believe you can win in the end!" Ivan also said to cheer them up.
If he remembers correctly, it is the Gryffindor team that won the Quidditch trophy this year in the original time and space!
Although Ivan can't remember the specific process anymore, it is impossible for them to be defeated by this setback, and they will soon regain their strength and win the final victory!
With the comfort of everyone, Harry's mood improved a little, but he was still a little bit brooding about what he had fallen from the sky.
George and Fred suddenly remembered something after Ivan finished speaking. The two looked at each other, and a light of hope suddenly burst out of their dim eyes.
Both of them thought of Ivan's incredible flying skills and pitching skills. Not to mention the more than one hundred points lost in a game, even if I add a hundred with Ivan's ability, it can easily be done!
However, neither George nor Fred spoke, because Ivan has repeatedly expressed his refusal to participate.
Asking now, Ivan is highly likely to refuse, so they think it's better to wait for Wood and others to discuss privately how to persuade them.
"Okay, everyone stay quiet, I have one more thing to say."
At this time, Professor McGonagall's voice sounded on the Quidditch court, attracting everyone's attention.
Professor McGonagall cleared his throat and looked at Ivan and said to everyone.
"This time the Dementor's riot, thanks to Hals' timely action in times of crisis, prevented possible personnel damage, so I will add 100 points to Gryffindor Academy!"
After Professor McGonagall finished speaking, the audience fell into a brief silence. Everyone's eyes were on Ivan.
The next moment, thunderous applause resounded on the Quidditch pitch.
The little wizards from any academy all clapped together!
Hundreds of dementors wandered over the Quidditch Stadium before, and the impact on them was not negligible. All the happiness seemed to have been deprived at that time, and only the painful memories were left.
And Ivan's powerful patron saint curse was like the sun breaking through dawn, saving them from pain and despair, so even the Slytherins gave Ivan applause.
The happiest thing is the little wizards of Gryffindor. They swept away the depressed mood just now, their palms were red, and Ivan saved the whole school's behavior and made them feel proud.
More people gathered around enthusiastically and asked questions.
"Halse! What is your magic to defeat those monsters? I saw a glowing unicorn. Did you summon it? God! That's so beautiful!"
"That's a patron saint curse! A deep curse that only a few wizards can master! Many adult wizards can't..." a senior Slytherin said proudly.
He released the patron saint of the crow who fought against the dementors on the field before, but the patron saint in the form of the crow is far less handsome than the unicorn of Ivan, and the power is not worth mentioning...
Professor McGonagall also asked curiously about Ivan's unique unicorn patron saint. Among the many wizards he has seen, only Dumbledore's patron saint can show the appearance of magical creatures.
Of course, it is impossible for Ivan to tell the secret of his blood fusion, shrugged indifferently.
"Professor, I don't know why this happens, so I always suspect that it might just be a deformed horse with horns!"
If possible, Ivan didn't want to expose his patron saint.
It was just an emergency, and there were many friends on the Quidditch pitch that he cared about.
As Quidditch players, George and Fred were very close to the dementors who swooped down. More people were injured and a large-scale riot was caused. Ivan had to take the initiative.
And this time is different from the previous one. He can't ride a eagle-headed horse with a winged beast to teach those evil creatures in the sky, so if you want to drive these dementors, you can only show the shadow of a unicorn...
Fortunately, the current situation is very different from the previous two school years, and it is not a big deal to expose it.
There are not many wizards who know the fusion of blood, and coupled with their young age, in the eyes of some insiders, at most, they feel that their talents are exploding, and the ancestors have awakened some blood power.

chapters.title: Chapter 399: Because we are friends!
chapters.content:
Ivan knew that with the increase in the number of times he used the Shadow of the Unicorn, there would be more and more people who knew that his patron saint was special, and it was impossible to hide it completely.
He deliberately hid it before, mainly because he routinely likes to keep one hand for the convenience of the yin person in the future...
Listening to Ivan’s explanation, Professor McGonagall’s expression was very strange. According to Ivan’s words, isn’t Dumbledore’s phoenix-like patron saint a Scottish long-tailed chicken with golden red feathers?
Professor McGonagall shook his head helplessly, knowing that Ivan didn't want to say it, so he didn't have the idea of ​​continuing to ask.
Seeing a group of little wizards gather around Ivan, McGonagall did not disturb the noise of the people, and instead left silently to deal with the matter, she also went to the Ministry of Magic to ask for an explanation...
Ivan was squeezed in by a large number of enthusiastic little wizards. He was a little tired to deal with, and answered various questions with a headache. In the end, he could only sneak away with the excuse of going to the toilet, avoiding the crowd and walking into the trail... .
"I knew I should be low-key..." Ivan couldn't help but reflect, but soon felt that he was low-key enough.
I can only say that excellent people are so dazzling no matter how they hide themselves!
"Ivan~ Why are you here? Don't you celebrate with them?"
Behind him, a ethereal voice rang, and Ivan turned his head to look over, but saw Luna, who was holding a wooden sign, walking over from the corner on one side.
As the distance got closer, Ivan could see that Luna was wearing a thick coat with Ravenclaw's robe inside.
Because of the rain, the little witch's body was wet, and water was dripping on her pale blonde hair, but she didn't seem to feel uncomfortable at all.
"Celebrate? What to celebrate? We Gryffindor lost the game..." Ivan said helplessly.
"But you saved everyone, didn't you? Without you, we would have been annoyed by those dementors... They always remind people of some unpleasant things..." Luna looked in a trance, as if Thinking back to the previous scene.
Then, before Ivan could answer, Luna continued with some chagrin. "I wanted to thank you for driving them away, but too many people have done so... I think you may not lack my share..."
"No, why? We are friends..." Ivan shook his head and said with certainty.
"Yeah... my friend!" Luna pursed her lips and laughed when she heard Ivan say this, as if humming some kind of ballad in her brisk tone.
Ivan didn't quite understand why Luna was so happy.
But soon, he thought that the little witch did not seem to have any friends in the school. It was only two years later in the original time and space that he and Harry and the others met, which means that he is probably her only friend now...
Thinking of this, Ivan looked at Luna with pity, and at the same time noticed that the little witch was still dripping with water, so he drew out his wand and touched Luna's clothes.
"Clean up!"
As the spell was spoken, the storm of magic power blew the thick coat that Luna was wearing, and the remaining rainwater was drawn out as if there was life, and gathered into a ball of water, and then turned into a mist of water. In the wind...
"Is this a clean-up spell? I still can't?" Luna looked at the dried clothes and whispered softly. She hadn't learned this kind of spell now in her second grade.
However, noticing that Ivan's clothes were also stained with some dust, Luna also took off the wand that was behind her ears with great interest, and released the spell just like Ivan just now.
"Clean up!"
There was a breeze of magic, and nothing else happened. Luna tilted her head and looked at Ivan in confusion.
"You need to adjust your gesture just now, so I'll show it to you in slow motion..." Ivan smiled and waved his wand to show Luna.
The two of them were learning magic while walking on the way back to the bedroom.
Halfway through, Luna also showed the wooden sign she was holding in her arms.
Ivan found that in addition to the slogans he had seen before, there were two little people holding hands painted on the wooden sign.
Although it is in the style of simple strokes, it is very good. Ivan can even easily recognize that the two villains are himself and Luna.
"How... Do you like it?" Luna asked gently, holding the magic wand in her right hand and drew a circle between the two villains, and the light golden magic connected together to form a word-friend (friend) !
After Luna showed it for a while, she took the wooden sign back into her arms and sighed. "It's just a pity that it's useless... It took me a long time to find a suitable piece of wood in the Forbidden Forest to make it..."
Ivan was a little lost looking at the picture on the wooden sign, and was even more surprised that Luna would go to the Forbidden Forest specifically to make this.
Perhaps she was aware of some of Ivan's thoughts, and Luna quickly said that she had gone to the Forbidden Forest to find the horned snoring beast. She just made this wooden sign by the way, and she could also exercise her transfiguration skills by the way.
Even if it is not used in the end, it can be hung as a decoration in the bedroom, so Ivan doesn’t need to care...
"But there might be a chance to use it next year... right?" Luna said suddenly.
"Well, there will always be this chance!" Ivan smiled and nodded, but he knew in his heart that the Triwizard Tournament will be held next year, and there will be no Quidditch competition. I am afraid I will have to wait for this thing to be used. Two years...
Just chatting all the way, it didn't take long to get to Ravenclaw's lounge.
The eagle-shaped bronze knocker on the door opened its mouth, and a mysterious sound rang.
"Which is fire or phoenix first?"
Of course, Luna couldn't help but think about it, she said. "Um... this is a cycle, there is no beginning!"
"It makes sense the answer is correct..."
The sound of the eagle-shaped knocker came out again, and the door to the Ravenclaw lounge opened automatically.
Ivan looked at the **** knocker quite speechlessly. He remembered that when he answered the question, it wasn't this kind of brain teasing question. Is there such a difference?
"It will always be stricter to outsiders..." Luna chuckled lightly and said jokingly.
"Forget it, I don't care about knockers." Ivan shook his head, feeling that he didn't need to be angry with a dead object.
"Okay! Let's talk about it today, I have to go back." Luna said while looking at the open door.
Then Luna seemed to think of something again, turned her head, stared at Ivan's eyes with bright eyes, and said again.
"Also...Congratulations on running away those harassing horseflies, I wish I had this day..."
(PS: I have something to do today, so it will be updated! Please forgive me...)

chapters.title: Chapter 400: Nasty bronze door knocker and damaged broomstick
chapters.content:
Luna's tone was a little sad, but she quickly adjusted her mood and stepped into Ravenclaw's lounge.
The open bronze door slowly closed...
Seeing Luna's back disappear in front of him, Ivan was stunned for a long time, and finally smiled bitterly. Of course he understood what Luna was talking about, but did his emotional changes be so obvious?
Ivan always thought that he had a good disguise. Harry, Ron, and Neville in the same bedroom as him never noticed anything wrong...
Ivan, who had stayed in front of the door for a long time, made the eagle-shaped bronze door knocker mistakenly think he wanted to go in. The eagle's mouth opened and closed, and a mysterious voice rang.
"Excuse me... what is the nature of magic?"
The sound of the bronze knocker interrupted Ivan's thinking.
Hearing this familiar question, Ivan rolled his eyes, took out the magic wand and put it down again, resisting the idea of ​​removing the door knocker, and decisively turned and left...
All the way back to Gryffindor's lounge, Ivan opened the door of the bedroom, and everyone except him had returned.
Ron, Neville, and others gathered around Harry and were talking.
"Ivan, where did you go? We waited on the court for a long time and didn't wait for you to come back..." Hearing the movement outside the door, Ron turned his head and said.
"You know, I always don't like lively, they are so enthusiastic." Ivan shook his head, explained casually, then closed the door and walked into the bedroom, saying curiously. "By the way, what are you all here doing?"
"We're looking at Harry's broom... When he fell from the sky, the broom was blown away by the wind, and it happened to hit the beating willow by the lake, and the beating willow has never liked being hit by things. Body...so this broomstick becomes like this!"
Ron said helplessly and stepped aside.
Only then did Ivan see that the broom wreckage that had been beaten into pieces was placed on the table next to Harry's bed. It was obviously impossible to use it with such a degree of damage.
Harry also had an expression of disintegration. This Light Wheel 2000 was a gift given to him by Professor McGonagall when he entered the Quidditch team in the first year. He has been with him for more than two years and has experienced countless ups and downs.
Harry even remembered every time he caught the Golden Snitch on a broomstick, but it was a pity that this broomstick could no longer accompany him!
More importantly, everyone in their mortal enemy Slytherin team has a smooth wheel 2001. If he rode an old comet broomstick, he would be at an absolute disadvantage in speed when he competed with Malfoy for the Golden Snitch. It's even harder to win the Quidditch trophy!
In response, Ivan had to shook his head and said that he was powerless, and he wouldn't be able to repair the flying broomstick technology.
In addition, the firebolt that Sirius, a local tyrant sold to Harry, should have arrived in a couple of days, so after Ivan casually comforted Harry with a few words, he didn't care any more, and turned his eyes to Scattered body.
This fat mouse is still very moisturized, does not seem to be endangered, or can't remember anything, it will be lying on Ron’s bedside eating a piece of multi-flavored beans, nothing like the original Time and space ran around in panic like that.
Ivan nodded in satisfaction, but recently he was indeed trying to solve Peter's matter. After all, it was not a problem to wait for Dumbledore to come back after such a delay.
He thought he might be able to wait for tomorrow's Defence Against the Dark Arts class to finish, and talk to Lupin...
Try to persuade Lupin to speak first.
......
The next day, in the morning, in Defense Against the Dark Arts class,
Lupin, who was a little pale, pointed a few ugly creatures in the cage to explain to everyone.
"In this lesson, I will tell you how to deal with red hats!"
"As you can see, they look a bit like elves! But I need to remind you that they don't have the wisdom of elves, and they are cruel by nature. They especially like to lurk in places where blood has shed.
For example, staying in the dungeons of the castle and the tunnels of the abandoned battlefield waiting for an opportunity to attack those passing by..."
Lu Ping talked freely to a group of little wizards about how to deal with the red hats. From time to time, they were mixed with one or two interesting legends or short stories, which aroused everyone's interest.
Then Lupin opened the cage and grabbed a red hat out, asking every little wizard to try to deal with this creature, either by chanting the spell to expel them, or stunned by the coma spell.
"In short, the secret to dealing with them is not to be afraid. As long as you can overcome the fear, you will find that the red hats are actually very easy to deal with!" Lupin reminded aloud.
For a prepared wizard, most magical creatures in the magic world are not a threat, otherwise the wizard will not be the master of the magic world...
Although the young wizards here are all third-grade little wizards, the Red Hats do not have weapons in their hands, and the threat level is not high, so they are suitable for actual combat practice.
"Halse, it's up to you to demonstrate for everyone this time!" Lupin looked at Ivan and said.
Ivan nodded and walked to the center.
Lupin yelled to make everyone back, then waved his wand to untie the rope that bound the red hat.
After this ugly, strange creature like a goblin broke free from its restraints, it screamed and screamed, rushing towards the nearest Ivan.
For Ivan, such a small scene is naturally to be dealt with calmly. After waiting for the red cap to get closer, Ivan raised his hand freely as the movement of the red cap was correct.
"All petrochemicals!"
The light of the spell immediately hit the red cap's body, setting it in place, and even the red cap's face still retains a twisted and hideous look...
"Great petrification spell! Gryffindor adds five points!" Lupin walked out with a clap and said to the people behind him. "Did you see it? As long as you stay calm, this thing is not that difficult to deal with!"
The little wizards who have seen Ivan easily subdue the red hat are immediately eager to try, and can't wait to deal with this magical creature personally.
Considering that the two colleges are attending classes together this time, the number of people is relatively large, I am afraid that there will be no rounds of one-to-one sessions until the end of the get out of class.
Lupin asked Ivan to temporarily serve as his assistant, and was responsible for supervising the little wizards of Gryffindor against the Red Hat, so that two people could be on board at the same time.
Lupin is still very relieved of Ivan’s strength. Yesterday evening he heard that Ivan had driven away hundreds of dementors who had broken into the school and saved the entire school. You must know that many adult wizards Can't do this.
"Harry, Malfoy, it's your turn now." Lupin said.
The two who were spotted stepped forward together. Harry looked a little nervous, staring at the petrified red hat, while Malfoy looked confident.

chapters.title: Chapter 401: Lu Ping: It's over, I may not be able to survive today!
chapters.content:
"Are you all ready?" Lupin asked loudly. After seeing Harry and Malfoy nodding, Lupin put a red hat out of the cage.
Ivan also lifted the petrification spell he had imposed at the same time, allowing the other red hat to regain his mobility.
These red hats who have been cast the confusion curse have completely lost their minds, and can't notice the surrounding wizards at all, and will only follow the instinct to attack the closest person.
Harry and Malfoy saw that Ivan was so easy to cast spells before, but when they faced them in person, they realized that this creature was not so easy to deal with.
Although the red hats were not tall enough to hit them on the shoulders when they jumped up, the crazy, as if not afraid of death, aura on their faces made the two of them a little scared.
"Faint!" Harry nervously learned the way Ivan had just released the spell.
A magical beam quickly flew out, but deviated and hit the wall behind the red cap.
For Harry, who lacks combat experience, it is not easy to hit a fast-moving target, not to mention that the red cap is smaller and farther apart, making it even more difficult to hit.
"Harry! Don't panic, calculate the distance... wait for the red cap to get closer before using magic! Yes, that's right... just now, calm down... cast spells!" Ivan pointed out Harry should How to find the right time.
Harry carefully remembered it in his heart, and patiently followed the nervousness in his heart, calmly waiting for the red cap to approach before releasing the coma spell again.
A brilliant red light was ignited from the top of the magic wand. This time it hit the target, and the red cap in the running staggered to the ground. After struggling twice, he fainted.
Malfoy on the other side was frantic.
Although Lupin pointed to him to use the curse to expel the red hat, Malfoy, who originally had an opinion on Lupin, was obviously not prepared to respond according to the method given by Lupin.
He directly used a black magic that he learned from nowhere, and with good luck, he hit the red hat in the chest.
However, Malfoy had obviously overestimated his magic level. The cursed red hat was not immediately knocked down, but instead rushed in fiercely.
Malfoy was a little panicked, and he released two spells, one missed out, and the other blew off the red cap's right arm.
But at this moment, the red hat with his broken arm rushed forward, his face grim, and his mouth was yelling, Malfoy was panicked and didn't know what to do, so he could only yell in horror.
"Save me... Save me..."
"All petrification!" Along with Lupin's gentle voice, a burst of light hit the red cap, and the red cap, which was maintaining an offensive posture, was fixed in front of Malfoy.
The red hat's right arm was dripping with blood, and the claws on the left arm would catch Malfoy's arm only ten centimeters away.
Malfoy's face turned red and white, and he looked at Lupin angrily, thinking that Lupin must have seen him make a fool of himself, so he would deliberately wait until the last minute to rescue him.
Lupin didn't care much about Malfoy's attitude. He pointed out Malfoy's mistakes in the battle and encouraged him to try again.
Malfoy stood impatiently and returned to his original position. This time he didn't dare to mess around, and honestly followed Lupin's command to release the curse. Using a kind of magic to expel the red hat, this guy was confused.
Seeing that the previous "powerful enemy" Red Hat lost his goal and hurried around in a panic, and finally hit the wall with his head, Malfoy also sighed fiercely, and felt a sense of accomplishment in his heart.
Malfoy was a little awkward just thinking that he had done it under Lupin's teachings.
After Harry and Malfoy defeated the Red Hats, more and more little wizards volunteered to try.
Unlike dealing with Bogut, which is only scary creatures, the red hat looks fierce, but it is a real magical creature that can cause harm to people!
This kind of excitement is still very new to these little wizards who have never experienced life and death battles. Some little wizards even mistakenly believe that this is a real battle, and after winning, proudly boast that what they are fighting is very calm. Not afraid at all!
However, about one-third of the little wizards encountered various situations when they faced the Red Hat for the first time.
When it was Seamus’s turn, he was even more anxious and cast a spell on Neville’s body not far away. If Ivan hadn’t reacted in time to bless poor Neville with an iron curse, he would have to Hidden...
Fortunately, when the get out of class was about to end, every little wizard had successfully mastered the skills to deal with red hats, and there was no initial panic in the fight.
This makes after this Defence Against the Dark Arts class, most of the little wizards feel that they have become a lot stronger all at once, and they are full of praise for Lupin. The two consecutive interesting and exciting courses have been completely conquered. Up them.
"Professor Lupin's class is really great! Last time it was Bogut, this time it was Red Hat, I don't know what it will be next time?"
"He is the best Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor I have ever seen!"
......
The little wizards were talking about each other, these words were naturally heard by Lu Ping, and he smiled faintly, but also a little emotional.
These months at Hogwarts can be regarded as his most relaxing and happiest days in these years.
There is no discrimination, you can enjoy delicious meals, and have a considerable salary.
Even teaching is not a task for him, because it is a very happy thing for him to communicate with these naughty and interesting studentsLupin expects his identity It's best to never be discovered.
After returning from the classroom all the way to his office, Lupin took out the wolf's poison potion with him from the pocket of the wizard robe and prepared to drink it.
Calculate the time, the night of the full moon should be in these few days, if you can drink it in advance...
But at this moment, there was a knock on the door outside.
Lupin stopped the movement in his hand immediately, put the wolf poison potion into the drawer in a panic, and then adjusted his emotions before speaking.
"come in!"
"Hello, Professor Lupin!" Ivan opened the door and walked in. After nodding, he closed the door with his backhand.
After thinking about it, Ivan felt that it was not safe again, so he simply locked the door directly so that no one would come in and overheard during the conversation.
Lupin saw Ivan's door-locking action in his eyes, and a chill suddenly surged in his heart. He felt that he...may not be able to survive today...

chapters.title: Chapter 402: I didn't expect my identity to be seen through by you so quickly!
chapters.content:
Since learning about Ivan’s deeds at Hogwarts, Lupin has been in anxiety for a long time, for fear that one day Ivan will come to the door to expose his identity as a werewolf and drive himself out of school. .
Especially after Snape calculated himself a few days ago and showed the wolf poison potion in front of Ivan, Lupin became even more disturbed.
After experiencing such a relaxed and happy teaching life, he naturally did not want to return to the old days of having no fixed place and food.
Fortunately, after these few days, Ivan didn't bother him. This discovery made Lupin really relieved, thinking that Ivan had not discovered his identity and acted naturally.
It’s a pity that it turns out that the one who should come is coming. From the action of locking the door, it is not difficult to see that the little wizard in front of you is obviously bad.
Lupin smiled bitterly, but with the last glimmer of hope, he asked nervously.
"Halse, is there anything you came to see me for?"
"Professor Lupin, there are some things I want to talk to you alone, oh...or I should change my name...Mr. Moonface!" Ivan felt that since he wanted to talk about the map and Peter, It’s better to use this name.
After hearing this familiar name, Lu Ping was like falling into the ice cellar. He didn't expect that Ivan would even investigate this.
Lu Ping had no chance of luck anymore, after all, the title of Moon Face was based on his werewolf characteristics.
Since Ivan had thrown out this hidden identity, and obviously wanted to express his knowledge of himself, the door was locked naturally to prevent himself from escaping.
Thinking of this, Lupin sighed and said.
"Halse! I didn't expect my identity to be discovered so quickly by you. As everyone said, you are the best student ever at Hogwarts. It's a pity... I'm afraid I can't give it again because of this. You got extra points!"
After Ivan's identity was discovered, Lupin didn't mean to hate Ivan.
A werewolf is indeed a little inappropriate as a professor, not to mention those students who are afraid and parents who are worried, even he himself sometimes can't help but worry about whether he will hurt others due to loss of control one day.
So even if he knew that he would lose his current job, Lupin would not blame Ivan. After all, the little wizard was just doing what he was supposed to do.
But there is one thing that Lupin can't understand. That is, Ivan Ming knows his identity as a werewolf, how dare he come to his werewolf professor's office alone? Isn't he worried that he suddenly violently wounds?
Fighting against a werewolf in this kind of enclosed space is not a good choice!
Is it absolute confidence in your own strength?
Lupin couldn't help thinking of the former two Defence Against the Dark Arts professors who had been driven away.
Although I don't know if they will have the same experience as themselves, it is obviously impossible for everyone to catch it like him.
Judging from the fate of these people, Ivan does have this proud capital. If he really starts his hands, he may not be able to beat this little wizard...
"What are you talking about, Professor?" Ivan said puzzledly, looking at Lupin, who was holding the large suitcase and seemed to be ready to pack his bags and leave.
Soon, Ivan guessed some of his thoughts, and continued to talk dumbfounded. "If you are referring to the issue of werewolf identity, then you can rest assured, I am not talking about that!"
Lupin's packing up his luggage stopped. He looked at Ivan dumbfounded, and didn't quite understand what Ivan meant.
If you are not here to expose your identity and drive yourself away, why are you locking the door?
And from Ivan's words, Lupin even heard a message that the little wizard in front of him had already known his identity as a werewolf wizard.
"Professor Lupin, if you have read the Daily Prophet of the past year, you should understand that I don’t have any bad views on werewolf wizards. On the contrary, I have many werewolf friends who have been born because they understand their difficulties in life. The idea of ​​making a wolf poison potion..."
As Ivan talked freely, Lupin was shocked every time he saw him. He thought it would be better to make it clear now.
Hearing this, the heart that Lupin had been holding finally let go.
Before assuming the position of professor at Hogwarts, he even needed to plan carefully every day for lodging and eating. How can he have the money to order each issue of the Daily Prophet?
Dumbledore told him about the wolf poison potion through a letter.
Coupled with the various encounters in the magic world over the years, and Ivan's "records" of driving away two Defence Against the Dark Arts professors, Lupin will be so on guard against Ivan.
Remembering that he had deliberately avoided Ivan in order to conceal the identity of the werewolf wizard, Lupin laughed bitterly. He didn't expect that Ivan would have known his identity a long time ago, but he never said it.
"Halse, since it's not my identity problem, what else did you come to see me for today? And how do you know the name moon face?" Lupin adjusted his emotions and became curious. Asked.
Ivan did not answer directly, but took a piece of parchment that looked a little shabby from the pocket of the wizard's robe and put it on the table.
Lupin's gaze was attracted by the parchment, and his eyes flashed with surprise and nostalgia. After a long time, he looked at Ivan again with a smile.
"What a coincidence! You didn't expect this thing to be given to you. No wonder you know the name moon face. It looks like you have cracked its secret!"
"No, it's not me! George and Fred cracked it!" Ivan shook his head without claiming credit.
"George and Fred? The Weasley twins? Their performance in class really impressed me..."
Lupin smiled and said that for George and Fred, who are often naughty in class, Lupin still has a good impression, because it usually reminds him of the days when he was exploring together with James and Peter in school.
Ivan did not stop, and then added. "As for the meaning of several titles, I also learned from its creators."
Lupin's smile instantly froze, and he frowned and looked at Ivan. "You said you learned from other producers... Sirius? What did he tell you that night?"
"No, I questioned these secrets from the mouth of another producer!" Ivan didn't dare to push these things to Sirius's head, otherwise he would be able to easily judge himself by checking with Lupin one day. I was lying, so I just threw it to Peter.
Anyway, this guy doesn't remember anything... He just needs to say that after the cross-examination, he had to impose the Forgetting Curse on Peter...

chapters.title: Chapter 403: Do you want to hear another story?
chapters.content:
"Another producer? Who? James? No, it can't be him...that's Peter! He's not dead yet?!" After Ivan finished speaking, Lupin's face appeared astonished. Asked very excitedly.
There are only four producers of the live map, and since Ivan said that the news was not obtained from Sirius, then only James and Peter are left!
As far as he knew, James died under the Avadaso curse of the mysterious man.
After the fall of Mysterious Man, Lupin also attended the funeral of James and Lily and saw their bodies, so it is impossible for James to come back from the dead...
Then the only person who might still be alive is Peter, who was rumored to have been "killed" by Sirius and could not find the corpse again!
"Halse, do you have any evidence to prove that Peter is still alive?" Despite some speculation in his heart, Lupin still couldn't believe this fact.
After all, why should Peter keep hiding if he is alive? Over the years, where did he hide from everyone's sight?
Lupin even wondered if Ivan had lied, or that he was also deceived!
"Evidence! It's on this map!" Ivan pointed to the map of Live Point, took out his magic wand and clicked on the blank parchment page, and read the code.
"I solemnly swear that I did nothing good!"
Delicate ink lines emerged from the blank parchment paper, spreading like spider web lines, connecting and spreading to every corner of the parchment paper, and finally formed a dynamic map, with names appearing one after another on the map.
After many years, when he heard this familiar signal Lupin again, he couldn't care about it. His eyes were fixed on the map, and soon he saw an extremely familiar name on it.
Peter the dwarf!
"He's really alive, but... how could he be alive! And still staying with Harry?" Lupin was completely confused. As one of the creators of the live map, he knew this thing very well. Vaillant.
Now that the name appears there, it proves that Peter is now in Gryffindor's bedroom and is alive and well with Harry!
"I think you should have some understanding of the original thing, then should you listen to another version of the story? The story I tortured from Peter and confirmed with Sirius Black!" Ivan said.
Lu Ping pondered for a while and solemnly nodded. When he confirmed that Peter was still alive, he knew that what happened back then must be more complicated than he thought!
Ivan was a little surprised when he saw Lupin's cooperation like this. He thought he would need to spend more time talking, and he even said it slowly after he subdued Lupin.
But it was also right. Lupin knew much more about Sirius and Peter than he did. In the original time and space, Lupin didn't even need anyone to tell him. He just guessed the general idea by himself based on Peter's name on the map.
Thinking of this, Ivan had no worries, and told the story of Peter Pettigrew's leak to Voldemort that led to the death of the Potters.
"Wait, you just said that Peter revealed the location of James' house to the mysterious man? But if I remember correctly, Sirius is the secret person. James and Sirius told me this personally!" Lupin Frowning interrupted Ivan's words, and said in confusion.
"Yes, it was like this at the beginning! But Black felt that he was too conspicuous, so he thought of an idea!
Let him act as a target on the bright side to attract the attention of Death Eaters and the Dark Lord, and then choose another trustworthy friend to be the true secretive! "Ivan explained.
"That person is Peter Pettigrew?" Lupin sighed, he already understood.
No wonder Sirius would chase Peter after James was killed by a mysterious man.
It's just that Lupin has some doubts here, so why didn't Sirius say a word or even a word of excuse when he was arrested by the Aurors of the Ministry of Magic?
Facing Lupin's doubts, Ivan thought about Sirius's performance in the original time and space, and then guessed.
"He should feel that he believed the wrong person and indirectly killed his best friend, so he was discouraged and thought he had a certain responsibility, and he was willing to enter Azkaban to accept punishment... and the Ministry of Magic did not have it. Give him a chance to explain, don’t you?"
Lupin nodded thoughtfully. At that time, Sirius should have thought that Peter was dead. Coupled with the downfall of the mysterious man, then only Sirius himself remained the three related people who contributed to James' death.
Judging from what he knows about Black, it is normal that Black, who is under extreme self-blame, is willing to be punished...
"By the way, Professor Lupin, why didn't you let Professor Dumbledore be the secret guard in the first place?" Ivan spoke out the question that had been holding back for a long time.
Ivan has never understood this. Since the effect of the Courageous Faithfulness Curse is so powerful, and there is only one weakness of the secret, why not just ask Dumbledore to keep the secret?
In this case, Harry's parents don't have to die...
"Because the secrets that a wizard can assume are limited, otherwise it is easy to cause conflicts, and your Principal Dumbledore already had a secret that needs to be kept...In addition, the loyalty curse also has some additional magic. Restrictions." Lupin explained vaguely.
Is it because Dumbledore wants to keep the Order of the Phoenix’s residence secret?
Ivan thought of this, and suddenly realized that it was like this...
"Okay, let's not talk about this! Now that we have found the real betrayer, we can clean up Sirius. Without further ado, we'd better act now!" Lu Ping seemed very excited~www. mtlnovel.com~Since James died, Lupin thought he had lost three of his best friends in a row, two died, and one betrayed!
But I didn't expect Black to be innocent, and Peter, the man who killed James, is still alive. How can this keep Lupin not angry?
"Professor Lupin, you better calm down!" Ivan had to interrupt Lupin's fantasy aloud. "Sirius's imprisonment is very involved, most of the Ministry of Magic will obstruct it, we better wait until Professor Dumbledore returns to make plans!"
Regardless of the original misjudgment of Sirius, it seems that Fudge, a minister who has just come to power for a few years, has nothing to do with it, but the Ministry of Magic has never been made by Fudge alone... This minister is at best an interest group. Introduced representatives.
More importantly, once this matter goes out, the reputation of the entire Ministry of Magic will be affected, and the angry wizards will ignore Fudge's explanation.
Ivan clearly remembers the end of Barty Crouch Jr. in the original time and space. In order to cover up the Ministry of Magic scandal and news of Voldemort’s return, Fudge did not hesitate to let the Dementor end Barty Crouch Jr. with a kiss. Strange life.

chapters.title: Chapter 404: Coach.. No, captain, I don’t play anymore!
chapters.content:
It is precisely because Ivan knows this that he will be so cautious. I just don’t want Peter Pettigrew as the only witness to become the second Barty Crouch Jr...
After listening to Ivan's words, Lupin paced back and forth in the small office, his frowning brows were never loosened, and after a while, he stopped and sighed.
"Well, as you said, we really need to be careful. But even if it is, we should catch Peter first. It is too dangerous to keep him by Harry's side!"
After learning that Peter is now working as a pet with Ron in the form of a mouse, Lupin was very worried.
There is Gryffindor’s bedroom, which is filled with young wizards. If Peter gets angry, the consequences will be disastrous... the street that was blown up is the proof!
"I used the Forgetting Curse on Peter to make him forget some things that he shouldn't remember. In addition, Peter has been a rat for more than ten years. Unless he is in a hurry, or his life is in danger, it is unlikely. Suddenly furious."
Ivan shook his head and explained that as long as Peter still wants to live, it is impossible to actively expose himself.
Then Ivan continued to speak.
"As for the placement of Peter before Professor Dumbledore returns, I already have a plan. I have already made a special cage to detain Peter, but it will only take a few days!"
How cunning and forbearing Peter Ivan couldn’t be clearer. Once Peter was wary, it was not easy to take care of him.
Unless Peter is insured with a coma spell several times a day, Ivan is a little worried after all that Peter will starve to death.
So he still prefers to be like the original time-space young Barty Crouch imprisoning Mad-Eye Moody, making a special cage for imprisonment, and then looking for someone to stare at, or simply take it with him!
Ivan has asked Dobby to buy the materials needed to make the cage, and he can make them in a few days.
According to Ivan's estimation, it should be available right after Harry and Sirius met, and then he would be able to put Peter in a cage and leave it to Sirius to take care of.
Ivan told Lupin about his follow-up plan, and Lupin spoke after thinking for a while.
"Hals, since you have your own plan, follow this one. If you need help, just tell me!"
Ivan’s plan has been considered thoroughly, and Lupin can’t think of a better way to deal with it. Temporary changes may make mistakes.
But looking at the thirteen-year-old little wizard in front of him, Lupin was very emotional. Ivan was even better than he had originally expected.
He was able to discover Peter, who had been hiding for many years with a live map, and boldly contacted Sirius to crack the truth of the matter.
It is even possible to consider the next actions of the Ministry of Magic and give corresponding plans. It is difficult for Lu Ping to imagine such wisdom and action ability in a minor wizard.
The two discussed for a while, and after agreeing on some details, Ivan left.
Lupin was persuaded very smoothly, and Ivan immediately felt refreshed, and it was not easy to find someone to talk about the secrets he had held for so long.
All the way from the professor's office back to Gryffindor's lounge, Ivan was startled by the scene as soon as he opened the door.
Wood, George and others were wearing gold and red Quidditch costumes, and Harry was among them.
They all had broomsticks in their hands and looked like they were going to march. After seeing Ivan who opened the door, George and Fred greeted him happily, patted his shoulder and said.
"Halse! We have been waiting for you for a long time, and you are finally back!"
"En...Professor Lupin suddenly asked me something, so I came back a bit late." Ivan then explained, and then looked at their neat costumes, he couldn't help but vomit.
"What's wrong with you? Planning to play Quidditch in the break room?"
"No, we just think this is more ritual!" George shook his head and said solemnly.
"Yes! This will remind you of the feeling of fighting with everyone last year!" Fred tried hard to put on a serious expression.
Harry and the others in team uniforms were very embarrassed. They felt that they shouldn't agree with George and Fred's obvious nonsense suggestion, but it was obviously too late to quit.
So they can only bite the bullet and speak to Ivan with the lively eyes of many little wizards in the lounge.
"Hals... come back and play with us! Only you can save this game!"
"Yeah, you don't want to see us lose this year's Quidditch trophy, do you?"
......
A group of Gryffindor players offered their words of consolation. Ivan's expression was very weird. He wanted to vomit, but seeing everyone's serious appearance, he swallowed the words again.
"Ivan, we have said so much, don't you have the feeling that your blood is boiling and your body is about to burn?" George looked at Ivan, who hadn't expressed his opinion, and said with a heartache.
He and Fred thought for a long time before they thought of such a "sensational" method of persuasion, and spent a long time reluctantly persuading everyone to implement the plan, but unexpectedly the result did not seem to meet their previous expectations.
At this time, Captain Wood pulled George and the others away, walked straight to Ivan, put his hands on Ivan's shoulders, and said excitedly.
"Halse! Now is the most critical moment, the Gryffindor team needs you!
You can mention it if you have any conditions! As long as we can get this year's Quidditch trophy... I can also give you the position of captain! "
Wood’s tone is very sincere This year is his last year at Hogwarts, he really doesn’t want to leave any regrets...
"Sorry... Captain! You should know that I don't play anymore!" Ivan sighed helplessly. He is currently thinking about how to deal with Peter Pettigrew. How can he be in the mood to play Quidditch? odd!
What's more, Ivan is very clear that in the original time and space, Gryffindor successfully won this year's Quidditch trophy, whether he is the same or not!
However, after being rejected by Ivan, Wood did not give up, but tirelessly persuaded like cowhide sugar.
George and the others also followed suit, exaggerating the seriousness of the matter, as if Ivan would not participate in the competition, the magical world would have a major crisis the next day...
For a time, Ivan had the illusion that he was going out to save the world instead of playing a Quidditch game..

chapters.title: Chapter 405: This must be from Dumbledore!
chapters.content:
Fred shamelessly hugged Ivan’s thigh and cried pretendingly, claiming that if Ivan didn’t agree to come down, Wood would jump into the black lake and drown tomorrow...
"Well, you guys stop and stop first... I have to think about this for a few days before I talk about it!" Ivan was so annoyed that he could only say helplessly.
George, Wood and others did not dare to push too hard, and after seeing that Ivan was willing to give in and consider, they temporarily stopped.
It's just that Wood kept hinting to Harry before leaving, asking him to do more of Ivan's thought work.
"Oh...it's really troublesome, I don't have time to play any Quidditch game..." Ivan sighed and returned to the bedroom with a headache.
Ron next to him was envious, and he didn't understand why Ivan was upset.
If Wood and George were able to invite him to join the Quidditch team like this, he would jump up happily. Even if he was not in class, he would have to get the Quidditch trophy. What a great honor. what!
Ron imagined in his heart, after opening the door and walking into the bedroom, his attention was drawn to the package by the window.
"What is this? Who sent the package? Is it a Halloween gift sent in advance?" Ron took a few steps forward quickly.
It was a very beautiful package, which looked more than a meter long, and was tied in circles with a gold-red ribbon. There was a card hanging underneath, and it was written in black ink and sent to Harry Potter. Mr.
"Harry, this thing seems to be sent to you! It looks strange, it doesn't even have the signature of the mailer!" Ron turned his head and greeted him.
Harry was at a loss as to who would send something to himself at this time, but the packaging was quite expensive.
Harry unpacked the package curiously and opened the box. He was stunned for a moment, staring at the contents of the box with his eyes, like a demon.
Ron was surprised at his reaction, glanced into the box, and took a breath...
A gleaming, exquisite flying broom was placed in the box like this, and it looked a little dazzling under the reflection of the sun.
Ron knew very well, that was the light piled up with Jin Jialong...
"I'm not mistaken? This is Firebolt? Who gave it to you?" Ron recovered after a long time, swallowed and asked.
"How do I know?" Harry was also a little stunned. While surprised, he kept wondering in his heart who would give him such a valuable thing.
Dursley's? That's absolutely impossible, they hate that it's too late...
Professor McGonagall? His last broom was given by Professor McGonagall, but Harry knew that Professor McGonagall was unlikely to sell him an over-spec item like Firebolt...
The only one who knew Ivan didn't speak. Of course he knew that this Firebolt was the handwriting of Sirius, but he didn't expect this gift to be delivered in advance.
Ivan originally thought that Sirius would give it as a Christmas gift like Original Time and Space, or wait until the two met before giving Harry a surprise.
Scabbard, who was hiding in Ron's pocket, sneaked out to look at them when he heard the movement.
Although Peter didn't know what the Firebolt was and how expensive it was, he heard from Ron's words that someone had sent a broom to Harry anonymously, which made him think of something, a heart. On the mentioned throat...
Just then, another owl flew in from the window, clutching a large package in its paws, which looked exactly like the package of the Firebolt...
However, clutching such a large object and flying so high, even if a weight reduction spell was imposed on the package, the owl as a messenger was tired enough, flapped its wings and flew slowly towards a few people.
"This.. Isn't this the second Firebolt?!" Ron stammered.
Ivan was also surprised. Did Sirius accidentally fill in the wrong amount when buying the broomstick and sent Harry two Firebolts?
"It seems to be for you this time, Ivan!" The sharp-eyed Harri first saw the name on the package and said.
Sure enough, the owl took the package and threw it in front of Ivan, then turned his head and flew away.
Ivan was extremely confused and opened the package. The difference from Harry's was that in addition to a firebolt, there was a letter in the box.
Ivan opened the envelope and read it, only to realize that this firebolt was purchased by Sirius in order to thank him for doing these things for him.
In the words of Sirius, he was ready to buy a Firebolt for Harry anyway, and he didn't care about buying one more...
In the letter, Sirius also asked him whether he liked the gift of broomsticks, and if he had no interest in Quidditch, he could change something else next time.
After reading the entire letter, Ivan was shocked by Sirius’s behavior. This is too rich... In the face of firebolt, he can say "I don’t care about buying more".
Harry and Ron leaned forward to check the contents of the envelope, but Ivan put the envelope away first.
Although this letter sent over only mentioned the words of thanks to him, it did not say too much specific content. But if the person watching the letter is smart enough and knows Sirius very well, he might be able to guess something.
After all, there are not many people who are so rich and still have connections with Harry...
"Ivan, who the **** sent these two packages?" Harry said. He got a Firebolt somehow. He was delighted but also very upset. Of course he wanted to understand this.
"Yeah, what did the letter say?" Ron was also curious.
Ivan glanced blindly at Scabbers, who was eavesdropping while pulling Ron's pocket, and said.
"This letter was sent by Professor Dumbledore. He learned that Harry accidentally fell from mid-air while playing and broke his broomstick. Now he is very worried about Harry's safety...
In addition, the professor also knew that Harry was troubled by the Dementor thing recently, so he sent this Firebolt in the hope that Harry can cheer up soon! "
Ivan pretended to be emotional, and he almost believed it as he spoke.
No way, who made Sirius buy two Firebolts on a whim, and he insisted on sending a letter, he could only explain that.
Originally, Ivan wanted to say that the things were sent by Lupin, so it would be convenient to lie and not easy to wear.
But Lupin's daily performance was too poor, even wearing patched clothes, it seemed impossible to afford Firebolt, so Dumbledore was the only one to carry the pot.
And only Dumbledore can easily take out so much Jin Jialong to buy two Firebolts...

chapters.title: Chapter 406: Ron: I don't believe it! Professor Dumbledore could not be so partial...
chapters.content:
Ivan’s words silenced Harry, and he felt the heavy weight in it as he touched the sparkling firebolt in the package.
He did not expect Professor Dumbledore to be far away, so he cared and missed himself so much!
Harry was very moved, tears rolled in his eyes, and he secretly made a decision in his heart, not to be able to live up to Professor Dumbledore's expectations.
He must overcome his fear of the Dementors and win this year's Quidditch Trophy!
Ron looked at Harry enviously, plus the invisibility cloak back, which had been given to Harry anonymously by Professor Dumbledore for the second time.
But looking at the broomstick in front of Ivan, Ron asked strangely. "Then why did Professor Dumbledore send you a Firebolt?"
Before Ivan could speak, Harry guessed and said:
"This should be Professor Dumbledore's reward for Ivan! After all, he saved so many people on the Quidditch pitch... In addition, the professor probably doesn't want Ivan's Quidditch talent to be buried in this way. Up."
Harry said this and turned his head to look at Ivan. He felt that Ivan's flying talent was much better than himself.
Harry was a pity when I heard that Ivan had quit the Quidditch team. He believed that Professor Dumbledore’s gift of Firebolt to Ivan must have such a profound meaning!
"Well, that's right! That's what Harry said!"
Under the gazes of Harry and Ron, Ivan nodded with a weird look.
All the words he just said were made up temporarily, and he didn't expect that Harry would not only make up a lie from him and continue it, it sounded inexplicably reasonable.
This makes Ivan want to vomit, you can actually make up more than me?
After that, Ivan continued to add as if thinking of something. "By the way, Professor Dumbledore doesn't want this to be known to others, otherwise other teams would say he is partial!"
Harry and Ron nodded. Of course, they understood this truth. They all stated that they would be tight-lipped and would never tell them!
Seeing that they had promised readily, Yifan stopped talking, and instead parted a part of his mind to check the situation.
The gray-black mouse changed its nervous appearance and slipped back into Ron's pocket with a lack of interest.
From the words of Harry and others, it only heard the message that "Dumbledore bought two seemingly expensive broomsticks to Harry who was hit, and Ivan who performed well." It was not worth paying attention to.
It's just that Ron is still a little unwilling to give up. He looked at the two Firebolts on the table and said with envy. "Harry, Ivan! Do you think Professor Dumbledore might have bought a Firebolt for each of us?"
Harry was speechless for a while, not knowing how to reply, fearing that Ron's self-confidence would be hit...
Ivan rolled his eyes, you want to be beautiful!
