However, Harry didn't mean to move. He was more worried about Lupin's situation than being punished by Snape.
"Gryffindor was deducted ten points! If you don't sit down within three seconds, I will deduct another fifty points!" Snape said word by word.
Harry was very angry, but there was nothing he could do. He sat down aggrieved, because Snape had already started counting on his own, and he knew very well that Snape had always done it on the issue of demerit points.
"Relax, Harry, Professor Lupin is okay..." Ivan, who was sitting on the side, couldn't help expressing comfort when he saw Harry's aggrieved and worried appearance.
Lupin’s situation, Ivan, couldn’t be more clear, it was all due to the fact that he took the wolf poison potion on the night of the full moon that caused his physical weakness and discomfort.
What puzzled Yifan was that he remembered that the wolf poison potion he made according to the formula given by the system did not have this defect.
I don't know if it is because Snape's reverse cracking is not thorough enough, which leads to the existence of this flaw, or he deliberately wants to rectify Lupin.
"Have you seen Professor Lupin these past two days? How is he?" Harry lowered his voice and asked anxiously. He wondered if Lupin was seriously ill, or was targeted by Snape. Otherwise, it won't be too high to be able to come to class.
Ivan couldn't tell him that Lupin was a werewolf, so he had no choice but to say that he had met Lupin yesterday. There was nothing wrong with him, it was really just that he was a little uncomfortable.
Harry then let go of his worries.
Snape's Defence Against the Dark Arts class was very different from Lupin's. It was not so fun and laughable, but only cold knowledge, and the sound of deducting Gryffindor points from time to time.
Not only that, Snape directly ignored the progress of the course and asked everyone to turn the book to page 394 and learn how to identify and kill a werewolf!
"Potter, tell me, how do you spot a werewolf wizard hiding in the crowd?"
On the way to class, Snape suddenly asked.
"I don't know, Professor! We haven't learned this yet. According to the course flow, we should learn now..." Harry started to explain.
"I'm in class now! I don't need you to teach me how to do it!" Snape interrupted Harry's words directly, and then turned to glance around in the classroom, and said disappointedly.
"I really didn't expect that a group of third-grade students would not be able to distinguish werewolves.
It seems that when your Principal Dumbledore returns, I must emphasize to him that our new Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor is not as competent as he thought! "
The little wizards of Gryffindor present all had an angry expression, and even a few Slytherin students disagreed with Snape's statement.
Their slow course learning is not the fault of Professor Lupin.
This was entirely because their first two Defence Against the Dark Arts class professors were too bad, and Lupin had to make up for the previous lessons.
And the knowledge about werewolves is clearly on the last page of the book, according to the plan, it will be learned at the end of this semester.
Ivan shook his head secretly in his heart. Snape really spared no effort in addressing Lupin. Learning this first was nothing more than hoping that someone could use this knowledge to break Lupin's identity as a werewolf.
"Quiet!" Looking at the little wizards whispering underneath, Snape increased the volume to stop their behavior.
After that, Snape ignored Hermione's raised hands and taught everyone how to distinguish a werewolf wizard through some facial features.
It also emphasizes the brutality of werewolves, and even bluntly said that the magical world will have several werewolf attacks every once in a while. Some courageous little wizards almost thought they were listening to some horror story...
"In addition... an important feature of werewolf wizards that distinguishes them from ordinary wizards is that on every full moon night, they will be forced to transform into an irrational werewolf, causing a lot of damage."
Speaking of this, Snape paused, then continued: "And some werewolves regularly drink a potion called wolf poison potion in order to hide themselves, so that they can have a certain amount in their deformed state. Sanity..."
Potion of wolf poison?
Hearing this name, many little wizards turned their heads and looked at Ivan. If they remember correctly, last year Ivan was awarded a second-level Merlin Medal because of the development of the wolf poison potion.
"Oh, it seems that I almost forgot. We also have an expert in werewolf research..." Snape's gaze was also placed on Ivan's body, with a slightly disappointed expression on his face.
"Unfortunately, UU reading www.uukanshu.com, our experts don't seem to know the werewolves as reported in the report..."
Snape was extremely dissatisfied with Ivan's failure to reveal Lupin's identity for months. He suspected that Ivan had actually seen Lupin's identity, but he didn't say it for some purpose.
The little wizards underneath didn’t understand what Snape said any more.
Only Ivan knew what Snape wanted to express, but he didn't intend to do that.
Even he didn't mean to stand up and answer in this class, just because he was worried that speaking too much might increase the possibility of Lupin's exposure.
A Defence Against the Dark Arts class soon ended in Snape's gloomy voice.
After class, coming out of the classroom, Harry walking in the aisle couldn't help but vent his anger for the entire class.
"Why do we have to learn to distinguish the difference between a normal wizard and a werewolf wizard? This is obviously not the course we should learn now. Does Snape think there will be a werewolf lurking next to us, this is really ridiculous!"

chapters.title: Chapter 419: Welcome to Hogsmeade Village!
chapters.content:
Facing Harry's complaint, Ron immediately agreed, feeling that the level of the courses taught by Snape was far worse than that of Professor Lupin!
Ivan didn't reply, because Harry was trying to guess correctly, and Hermione was also silent, seeming to be thinking about something...
At this moment, another voice suddenly rang in the corridor.
"That's not necessarily, Potter! I guess you must have not listened to Professor Snape's lecture seriously... Maybe there is a werewolf lurking in the school... Maybe it's the person closest to you!"
Everyone turned their heads to look over, but Malfoy arrogantly brought two of his followers over.
Malfoy glanced at Harry with disdain, then spoke to Ivan confidently. "Wait, Hals, I will find evidence before you!"
Malfoy had a smug expression on his face, and the words he said made Harry and Ron even more confused, but Malfoy ignored them and left Ivan with this sentence and went away...
"Does Malfoy think any of us is a werewolf? This idea is ridiculous!" Ron murmured.
Harry nodded. He was pretty sure that his friends weren't werewolf wizards, because no one regularly took some wolf poison potions, or suddenly played and disappeared on the night of the full moon...
Hermione thought of something, but stopped talking, turned her head to look at Ivan, only to find that Ivan shook her head at her.
The little witch immediately understood that Ivan had already known the identity of Lupin's werewolf wizard, so she swallowed the words that had come to her mouth.
Ivan was not surprised that Hermione was able to discover Lupin's identity. In the original time and space, Hermione guessed Lupin's identity by herself based on various clues, let alone the present.
But Malfoy was able to guess it, which surprised Ivan.
Could it be that his own reasons have caused Malfoy to work hard and become shrewd?
Ivan remembered what Malfoy had said to him some time ago. He didn't quite understand what Malfoy meant at the time, but now he knew it better.
Fortunately, it seemed that Malfoy had not found decisive evidence. He just suspected that Lupin was a werewolf. Otherwise, he should have told the professors long ago.
Thinking of this, Ivan also had a headache. He didn't want Lu Ping to be exposed and expelled from the position of professor like Yuan Shikong.
However, Ivan couldn't think of any way to target Malfoy for a while and let him stop investigating Lupin.
Malfoy is not Peter Pettigrew, and using the Forgetting Curse on him is extremely risky.
Because Ivan didn't know when Malfoy began to doubt Lupin, if he directly washed away the memory of the other person over the past few months, even a fool would be able to see the problem!
Even if Ivan is sure that what he can do is very secretive, so that others cannot suspect him, but who knows if Malfoy has told others about his guess.
If the identity of Lupin's werewolf is found and no other murderer can be found, he will definitely become the first suspect in attacking Malfoy.
At that time, Lucius will probably use his influence to characterize the matter when he is angry, and Lupin will be imprisoned in Azkaban for assaulting students.
Ivan thought for a long time, and felt that he could only provide Lupin with some genuine wolf poison potions in the future, so that Lupin would not need to ask for leave once a month. It should be able to effectively reduce the probability of being discovered and how long it can delay. How long is it...
Just thinking about things like this, a few people went to the auditorium for lunch.
After complaining for a long time, considering that Harry, who was going to Hogsmeade Village later, quickly put aside the unpleasantness in class, and after hurriedly finished eating, he returned to the dormitory to take him. The invisibility cloak was taken out.
Ron also found the pocket money in his suitcase. Although there were only a few silver Sicos, he still solemnly took half of it and put it in the pocket of the wizard's robe.
Of course Ron did not forget his most cherished rat Scab!
It is worth mentioning that Shaban did not want to leave the safe Gryffindor dormitory and wandered outside. A pair of small paws clung to the pillow to protest, and the screams were earth-shattering.
Ron was very embarrassed when he saw this state, feeling a little at a loss, thinking about whether to leave Scab in the bedroom.
"Faint!"
A red light galloped past and hit the gray-black mouse, his eyes widened, and he fainted with a squeak!
"Okay, isn't this done?" Ivan slowly put away his wand, and said with satisfaction.
He was worried about running away halfway, and now this problem is solved perfectly!
Ron opened his mouth and looked at Ivan with a weird face, but in the end he didn't say anything. He also felt that his pet mouse was a bit nervous lately, and it would be good to get some sleep when going out.
"Let's go quickly, I can't wait!" Harry had changed his clothes at this time, grabbed a handful of Jin Jialong, looked at Ivan, and said expectantly.
Ivan nodded, and the three of them walked out of Gryffindor's lounge together. Hermione was already waiting outside. She was still a little unwilling, and tried to persuade Harry to stay in school for the last time.
"We always have to go outside. Harry can't hide in Hogwarts Castle all his life. A truly brave Gryffindor shouldn't be afraid of anything!" Ron vowed.
Hermione stared at him very dissatisfied. Being brave and reckless is not the same, not to mention going to die...
In this noisy atmosphere, Ivan led everyone to a remote corridor on the fourth floor of the castle, and stopped in front of a statue of a humpback witch.
"Separate left and right!" Ivan stretched out his wand and tapped lightly on the statue.
With a soft sound of "rumbling", the statue's hunchback automatically opened to both sides , revealing a long and narrow dark channel, which can accommodate a thinner person to penetrate into it.
"Come in!" Ivan said, and then the first one got in and jumped into the dark space below.
"I always feel that we are doing something bad!" Harry looked at the entrance of the black hole and couldn't help but spit out.
"Originally, if you were caught out of the house, Professor McGonagall would deduct 100 points for us!" Hermione rolled her eyes, but still followed in the first time.
Harry and the others followed Ivan all the way, walking through the stars under the light curse.
I don't know how long he has been walking, just when Harry felt a little sore in his legs and was about to ask, Ivan suddenly stopped, tapped the sky with his magic wand, and a trap door was pushed open.
The dazzling light shone in through the opening, causing Harry and the others to squint their eyes a little uncomfortably. Ivan jumped directly on the lead, turned his head and said to them.
"Come on, this is it...Welcome to Hogsmeade Village!"

chapters.title: Chapter 420: Encounter at the Duke of Honey
chapters.content:
Harry, Ron, and Hermione climbed up the steps one by one.
"Where is this?" Harry patted the dust on his body and looked left and right. It looked like a cellar, surrounded by crates and other wooden boxes, with various date-written notes on it. .
"The basement! To be precise, we are in the basement of the Honey Duke's shop!" Ivan explained.
Hermione looked at Harry and reminded him. "Harry, hurry up and put on the invisibility cloak! Don't be seen by others..."
"En..." Harry nodded, put on the invisibility cloak, and disappeared before everyone's eyes.
Then Ivan led them out of the basement quietly.
Originally, Ron and others were still very nervous, for fear of being discovered.
After all, they sneaked out of someone else's basement, and it would be over if they were caught directly.
But after they really came out, Ron realized that no one would even notice where they came from.
Because it was so lively here, it was crowded with senior students from Hogwarts, and all kinds of laughter and noise were endless.
All kinds of delicious candies are placed on the shelves on Thursdays and Mondays. The large custard nougat, the sparkling pink coconut sorbet, the honey-colored toffee, and dozens of hundreds of flavors of chocolate are dazzling.
Especially a few shelves against the wall, there are magic candies with special effects placed on them.
For example, the pepper urchin who can spew a ball of flame after eating, the explosive filling gummy that will explode after a bite, the lollipop with a thick **** taste...
The variety and novelty made Harry and Hermione who came for the first time couldn't look away.
Harry never knew that candy can make so many tricks. Looking at the above introduction, he was very excited. He was ready to buy each one and taste it.
Except for the local tyrant Harry, Hermione and Ron are entangled in making choices. They have limited pocket money and can only buy a few to try.
Looking at their excited and tangled appearance, Ivan couldn't help but shook his head secretly. Candy is really attractive to children, even the little wizard who knows magic.
Considering that there is no shortage of time to see Sirius, Ivan is not good at forcing them to leave here, so I just let them be happy for a while...
"The **** lollipop looks terrible. No one likes vampires like this... Can Pepper Naughty really spew out a fire after eating it? How does the mint ice cream taste?" Min picked out a few candies, hesitated to put back some uninterested ones, and turned to Ivan and wanted to ask him his opinion.
Ivan shook his head. He hadn't eaten this stuff before, and when he was thinking about what to say, he felt a pat on his shoulder.
"Are you looking for candy that can breathe fire if you eat it? We have it here!" George and Fred joked together, their hands still holding an unbranded candy.
"This is our latest research result. It's definitely more interesting than the candy here! How about it, do you want to try it? It's free!"
Seeing the two of them, Ivan felt a little surprised, but he didn't expect such a coincidence.
However, Ivan always thanked Bumin for the Weasley brothers' mischievous candy, and shrugged and refused.
"We don't want to be your little guinea pigs...you should keep the tricky others to go!"
"That's really a shame! If you want to buy it next time, you will have to pay..." George shook his head disappointedly, then glanced at Ivan and the others, and said unexpectedly.
"By the way, where's Harry? Didn't he come with you? Still trapped in the castle?"
"Oh, what a poor boy. Didn't you tell Harry about the secret road? We see that he is quite unhappy lately, so you should take him out and stroll around!" Fred also sighed. His expression, tut out his voice.
"Harry is safe to stay in school, you know..." Hermione glared at them dissatisfiedly and said in a high tone, but soon realized that this might be heard by a fugitive. He lowered his voice and said word by word. "Know that Sirius Black is still chasing him!"
"What are you afraid of, isn't Ivan still here? I think his level of magic is no worse than some Aurors. If Black dares to come and catch him... Hahaha, maybe Ivan can still give him the Merlin Medal. It’s one more level."
As George said with a grin, he tore open the candy wrapper in his hand and threw it into his mouth.
However, this square candy stopped automatically beside George's mouth in horror. It just hovered in the air, moved slowly, and disappeared in front of them bit by bit...
The sound of "crack craze" chewing candies came from a place with no one nearby...
Damn it?
George was taken aback at once, and Fred's face also showed a look of uncertainty.
No, ordinary ghosts can't do this.
Hermione and Ron were holding back a smile, of course they knew what was going on.
Harry, who was hiding in the Invisibility Cloak, swallowed this candy, and soon felt that his throat was so hot as if he had been burned by fire, it was very choking!
Harry couldn't help but raised his head and sneezed. A scorching flame spewed out of his mouth and almost burned to the next shelf.
In the seemingly empty place, a few coughs soon rang, and then Harry complained.
"This thing smells too bad, you should improve it!"
George and Fred listened to the sound from nowhere, and stepped back uncertainly until they heard Harry's voice. They were relieved.
They couldn't understand that Harry was tricking them, but they were even more curious about how Harry did it.
"Is it a phantom spell?! Harry, you actually mastered this!" George suddenly thought of the phantom spell, guessing in surprise.
"We have always wanted to learn, but we haven't mastered this spell yet!" Fred also couldn't believe it.
"No, I don't know how to use such advanced spells, this is the effect of the invisibility cloak!" Harry lifted the invisibility cloak a little bit, exposing his face, and then put it on again.
"Cool! That's so convenient!" George and Fred exclaimed. The price of an invisibility cloak is not cheap. If they had this thing in the first place, it would be much easier to go out for a stroll.
Maybe they can still go to some places they have always wanted to go but dare not go...
Thinking of this, the faces of George and Fred showed envy.
Hermione broke the cheerful atmosphere seriously, and said, "Harry, you shouldn't do this. If someone sees you, it will be over!"
"Don't worry, no one was looking here just now. George and Fred won't talk about it!" Harry shook his head nonchalantly. He didn't think there would be such a coincidence.
"Yes, yes! Our mouths are very strict!" The Weasley brothers made a shut-up gesture together and promised never to speak out.
The people laughed and talked for a long time, and then George and Fred separated from them. Ron and others also selected the candies. Because it was inconvenient to show up, Ivan had to pay for the bill instead of Harry.
Immediately afterwards, the enthusiastic Harry, Ron and Hermione took Ivan to the Zoke joke shop to buy many interesting prank goods...
After more than two hours of playing like this, Ivan found that he would take them to a place that was said to be very interesting.
At first, Harry and the others didn't doubt their trust in Ivan. As the road went more and more remote, they felt something was wrong...
"Ivan, what are we doing here? It just looks like there is nothing..."
After walking through a small forest and entering a long-abandoned house, Hermione finally couldn't help but asked.
Harry and Ron also looked at Ivan suspiciously.

chapters.title: Chapter 421: Spotted flying!
chapters.content:
"This is the screaming shack, which is considered a very famous place in Hogsmeade Village..." Ivan opened his mouth to explain, and was about to continue, but was interrupted by Ron's words.
"I've heard of it! Some senior students said that it used to be haunted, and it would make a screaming scream in the middle of the night...that's why it was called a shack."
Harry shuddered as he listened to Ron's words, and he wondered why Ivan would bring them to this place.
"That's just a rumor. There is no haunting in the screaming hut. The howl is due to other reasons..." Ivan casually explained, then turned his head and looked around, looking for Harry, solemnly Said.
"I brought you here this time to solve Harry's problems!"
"Me?" Harry lifted his invisibility cloak and pointed at himself confusedly. Ron and Hermione didn't quite understand what Ivan was talking about.
"Yes, to be precise to solve a misunderstanding. In fact, betrayal..." Ivan opened his mouth and was about to explain to them in detail. When he saw a gray-black thing sharply, he suddenly got out of Ron's pocket. Turned it out.
Ron felt that something was wrong for the first time, and when he lowered his head, he saw his beloved mouse crawling outside like crazy.
"Scaly...Where are you going, Scaly!" Ron shouted aloud, a swoop trying to catch the frantically fleeing Scaly, but he rushed into the air.
After avoiding Ron, the gray-black mouse fleeed even harder, and all four paws ran out of afterimages.
Peter was terrified in his heart. After being knocked out by Ivan before, he was finally awakened by the sloshing and noise along the way. Before he could figure out what happened, he heard Ivan's voice.
Harry and the others couldn’t understand what Ivan wanted to express, but Peter knew it better. Although I don’t know how Ivan learned about it, have he ever been in contact with Sirius, it’s always right to escape now. !
Seeing the exit right in front of him, and the bright sunlight shining from the outside, Peter had a long-lost smile on his face, and the big rock in his heart slowly dropped.
"Spots fly here!"
However, a voice directly broke Peter's illusion, and Ivan waved his magic wand very calmly.
Peter, who was only one step away from successfully escaping from the screaming shed, desperately felt that his body was being pulled by some kind of force.
Not reconciled, Peter buckled the decayed wooden plank with his claws, scratching traces on it, and piercing screams broke through the sky...
It's a pity that the power of magic is not something a mouse can resist. No matter how unwilling Peter is, it won't help. He soon flies backwards and returns...
Ivan squeezed its tail skillfully and lifted Scabs in the air. He couldn't help but sigh in his heart. Using a flying curse to summon a wizard in the form of Animagus cost a lot.
This should be related to the abundance of magic power in the body,
Thanks to Peter's small size now, otherwise Ivan suspects that his magic is not working...
Of course, even if he didn't make a move, Peter couldn't escape.
In order to prevent accidents like the original time and space, Ivan has arranged Dobby to follow at any time in secret. With this layer of insurance, there is almost no possibility of mistakes...
The speckled reaction of being caught by the tail was fierce, and he wanted to scratch and bite Ivan's fingers to let him let him down.
But Ivan didn't give it this opportunity. With a slight trembling of his wrist, he shook the mouse in the air. Even if he tried hard to twist, he couldn't touch his wrist.
After many attempts to no avail, Peter suddenly fell into deep despair.
It's just that he doesn't have a magic wand in his hand, and Peter has no plans to turn back into a wizard. When the opponent is defensive, his chance of attacking is almost zero. It's better to keep the mouse form and continue to linger.
Peter still has unrealistic expectations in his heart, maybe they still don't know who they are...
"Ivan, thank you so much... Shaban doesn't know what's wrong recently, and has always been irritable!" Ron walked up, and while complaining, he reached out to grab Shaban.
Ivan stepped back directly, avoiding Ron's hand, and reminded. "For your safety, it is better for this mouse to be in my hand for the time being..."
"Safe? What are you talking about? Scabbers won't bite me." Ron's face was ugly.
"You better listen to him, Peter has been lurking by your side for so many years, and you are still alive now, but luck is better!"
The husky and low voice suddenly sounded in the screaming hut. Harry and the others shuddered. Turning to look over, a **** dog jumped directly from the high platform.
dog? A talking black dog?
Ron's mind was a little confused, and he backed away a few steps suspiciously.
Harry wanted more. He had seen this big dog many times, and often wandered by his side. According to Professor Trelawney's prediction, it was a sign of death and unknown.
"You shouldn't have come out at this time, at least you have to wait for me to explain it clearly to them!" Ivan said helplessly to the black dog.
"Did you not tell them before? Anyway, I have been waiting for too long..." The **** dog shook his head humanely, his gaze stayed on Harry for a moment, and then quickly turned to Ivan's hand. On the gray-black mouse.
When Peter saw the **** dog, he knew that he was dead, so he was hanging upside down in the air, limp.
And Sirius was also under the gaze of everyone, gradually deforming and distorting from a black dog back to the form of a wizard...
With the help of Ivan Sirius will no longer recover the sloppy appearance of time and space.
Wearing a decent gown, his black hair has obviously been taken care of. It was his ten-year prison life that made him look a little haggard, with sunken eye sockets, but still did not damage his handsome face.
"Little... Sirius-Black!" After seeing the opponent's appearance, Harry's pupils tightened and he stammered, and a chill came from the soles of his feet.
"Harry, we finally met officially!" Sirius said with emotion.
After a brief consternation, Harry's rage dazzled his head. He held up his wand and pointed it at Sirius and said angrily.
"Yeah, we finally met! You betrayed my father, are you here to kill me again? I'm not afraid of you!"
Having said that, Harry turned his head to look at Ivan again, his eyes full of disappointment and incomprehension, and his whole body was trembling slightly. He never thought that he would be betrayed by his best friend like his father.

chapters.title: Chapter 422: Harry, Ron: We beat Black!
chapters.content:
When the two sides confronted each other, Ron suddenly pulled Harry back aside, drew out his wand and pointed it at Sirius, yelling.
"Harry, go quickly, put on the invisibility cloak, and I will hold them!"
Afterwards, Ron looked at Ivan in anger and cursed.
"I really believed you wrong, Ivan! I didn't expect you to be in a gang with Black and trick us here!"
"I said before, I'm here to correct a misunderstanding!" Ivan explained helplessly.
"Misunderstanding? No misunderstanding! Black killed my parents! And you...my best friend brought me to him!" Harry completely lost control, completely giving up his intention to escape, angrily Swallowed his heart.
Now this scene seemed to Harry like a repeat of the original scene...
"I didn't! Harry, things are not what you think..." Sirius hurriedly approached a few steps, trying to explain.
Harry shot suddenly and waved his wand.
"Except for your weapons!"
A red light flew out from the top of the wand, and Sirius backhanded subconsciously to bless himself with the Iron Armor Curse, but he was afraid of harming Harry and causing even greater misunderstandings. The red light had already hit the moment of hesitation. On him.
Sirius took a few steps back in pain, and the wand in his hand spun out, swirling in the air, and finally fell into Harry's hand.
The moment he caught the wand, Harry was stunned. He looked at Sirius easily disarmed by himself, with an inexplicable sense of absurdity.
"You beat him, Harry!" Ron said in shock.
He also didn't expect that the rumored brutal Black would be defeated by Harry, but there was an excitement that could not be concealed. They defeated a major enemy, and now they only need to solve the other!
Thinking of this, Ron turned his head to look at Ivan and shouted loudly.
"Except for your weapons!"
The red beam rushed towards Ivan not far away.
But Ivan didn't mean to be beaten, and immediately activated the effect of the protective ring. After the beam collided with the magic barrier, it returned to the original path and hit Ron's body at a faster speed.
Ron was knocked out and fell into a pile of decayed logs. He couldn't get up for a long time...
"Ron!" Harry was immediately anxious when he saw Ron's miserable condition, waved his wand to cast a spell against Ivan, and was shot out immediately.
Both wands fell into Ivan's hands.
Seeing the scene getting chaotic, Hermione couldn't help screaming next to her. "Enough! Don't fight anymore!"
"Hermione, come here, stay away from them!" Harry got up from the ground with difficulty and said to Hermione anxiously.
"Don't be silly, Ivan had already started to kill us! We can't beat him together..." Hermione yelled hysterically.
Although she didn't know why Ivan would be mingling with Sirius, she was very clear about the strength of the two sides.
If Ivan colluded with Sirius and brought them to this remote place to kill Harry, there is no need to explain at all, just do it!
In addition, Hermione felt that Ivan had no reason to murder Harry...
"Yes! You should calm down and use your brains to think about it. Until now, Sirius and I have not attacked you, but you did it first. Isn't that obvious enough?" Ivan looked at Harry and the others. Shrugged.
Ron, who crawled out of the rubble, wanted to refute, he had just been attacked. He just choked quickly, because he remembered that Ivan had just bounced the spell he had released. In a sense, Ivan hadn't attacked himself.
Harry was even more completely confused. He looked at Sirius, but the opponent didn't rush to kill him, his eyes still had the excitement of a long-lost reunion.
"Ivan, what the **** is going on..." Hermione asked first.
She is willing to believe in Ivan, but she is also very puzzled, there are too many things to ask.
"I was just about to explain to you... if you didn't interrupt me." Ivan said helplessly, and then explained it to the three of them.
"You may know what happened back then and I won't repeat it, but one thing that needs to be corrected is that he betrayed Harry's father and the person who caused Harry's parents to be killed was not Sirius... but Harry's father. Another friend of his, Peter Pettigrew!"
"Peter Pettigrew? The hero who went to chase Black but was killed alone?" Harry couldn't help interrupting Ivan's words again, and roared in retort.
"Malfoy told me everything, and I also asked Professor McGonagall to confirm the authenticity, and she clearly told me that Black had betrayed my father!
And there were many, many witnesses, and Muggles all over the street gave similar testimonies. Pettigrew stopped Black and cried and called my parents' names. Then the two of them fought and Peter Pettigrew was killed on the spot! "
Harry kept remembering, tears dripping into his eyes, and he almost looked at Sirius with hatred.
In addition to the Muggles, Hagrid was also a witness. He had a lot of confidence from Hagrid before. Hagrid said that he saw Sirius appear near the sanctuary, which is what Harry did. the reason.
After all, Hagrid would never deceive himself.
Seeing Harry's hateful gaze, Sirius was very painful, but he still tried to explain.
"No, it's not like that. Peter Pettigrew and I changed our identities temporarily, and he will serve as the confidential person! In order to ensure the privacy This matter is only known to me, your father and Peter. .. That's why it caused a misunderstanding!"
"Three people? Now that my father and Peter Pettigrew are dead, who can prove this?" Harry was very skeptical, and didn't think there would be such a coincidence. .
"You are wrong, Peter is not dead!" Sirius said word by word, then turned his head and stared at the mouse in Ivan's hand with a cannibalistic look, and said again.
"We have caught him now!"
Harry and the others also turned their gazes on Scabble. The gray-black mouse had limped down, motionless as if it were dead.
Ron immediately understood what Sirius wanted to express, and shouted in disbelief.
"Don't you say that my Streaky is Peter? It's impossible! It's just a pet. I have kept it for many years...
We even ate together, took a bath together, and even went to the toilet. I took it with me. No one knows Shaban better than me. It cannot be a wizard. This is ridiculous! "

chapters.title: Chapter 423: Does anyone care about how blotchy feels?
chapters.content:
Ron was trembling with anger.
Can this world be better? Why should everyone target his mouse!
Zebra is pitiful enough. When he is at home, he was tricked by George and Fred. This semester was also targeted by the **** cat raised by Hermione. Now he is going to be regarded as the culprit for betraying Harry's parents. ..
Does anyone care about how blotchy feels?
No! Obviously it is just an ordinary pet mouse...
"In general, the life span of mice is very short, only about one to three years. Do you remember how long Shaban stayed in your house?" Ivan broke Ron's illusion and forced to ask.
Ron was sluggish for a while. His rat Scabbard was inherited from Percy. It has been for many years, and it must be far longer than the life span of an ordinary rat...
But even so, Ron was still very stubborn or unwilling to believe it.
"It's different, maybe Shaban is a magic mouse... It's time to return to his master now, give it back to me soon! I can't lose it!" Ron said almost choked up. With.
Ron can't accept the fact that his mouse is Peter Pettigrew. Shaban is not only his pet, but also a partner who grows up with him...
Since childhood, he has never been taken seriously, most of the things on his body are not wanted by his brothers, even wizard robes, wands and pets.
Whenever others talk about him, they always think that he is the savior Harry's follower, and a good friend of the rising star Ivan Hals...
Two great friends can always show up on any occasion, and he can only be used as a background board, humble like a mouse!
And these emotions he can't talk to anyone, only his pet mouse, because it is absolutely confidential, it will not disclose these things, nor will he refute his words...
Not to mention that Blob is almost his reflection, just as small, unobtrusive, and unflattering...
Ron couldn't even imagine what a miserable life Shaban would lead if he left him. Only his master can provide him with shelter.
So Ron rushed towards Ivan like a dash, trying to save Shaban, then hit the protection of the Iron Armor Curse and was bounced away again.
Ivan really couldn't understand why Ron was more excited than Harry. Isn't he just a pet rat? As for?
Ron lost control again, Ivan waved his wand, and the wooden chair next to him turned into a long rope to tie Ron quietly.
"You need to calm down! I can show you the evidence right now!" Looking at Ron who was still struggling on the ground, Ivan shook his head and said something, then pointed his magic wand at Shaban and entered the magic power in. .
The mouse that was grabbed by Ivan uttered the worst scream since it was alive. It waved its limbs frantically and tried to bite Ivan's wand with its teeth, but to no avail.
The magic power penetrated the whole body, and quickly touched the protective mechanism of the brain, and the gray-black mouse began to deform in front of everyone.
Its limbs are constantly stretching and becoming thicker, its head is getting bigger and bigger, and its tail is retracted...
Ivan couldn't hold it, so he simply threw it into the corner. Peter rolled on the ground in pain, and the deformation continued, but a short, fat, and bald middle-aged man appeared in front of everyone in a moment.
Ron stared blankly at the dirty and bald old man in front of him, his mind went down.
He thought about eating and washing with Scab, and talking about his inner memories. All these beautiful scenes, but now it makes him feel sick...
"He... he is Peter Pettigrew? Why can he become a mouse?" Harry, who also watched the transformation process all the way, was shocked and stammered.
When he was in school, he could see this mouse almost every day. Whoever imagined that Shaban turned out to be a wizard, and maybe the culprit who betrayed his parents...
"It's Animagus!" Hermione said suddenly.
"What?" Harry and Ron looked at her suspiciously.
"Animagus Transformation! That is an extremely powerful transformation magic, almost without any flaws, the effect is to turn a wizard into a specific animal!
Professor McGonagall mentioned it once when we were in transfiguration class. Have you forgotten it? "Hermione spoke extremely fast.
Have it? Why don’t I remember?
Harry looked blank, but if Hermione said so, she must have been...
"But I remember that the Ministry of Magic made a record of all wizards who can become animals. There is a special register showing what animals they can become, as well as markers and the like..." Hermione looked at Sirius and asked suspiciously. Peter, obviously they are both Animagus.
"That's good! But you overlooked one point. Not everyone will abide by the Ministry of Magic's regulations!" Sirius looked at Hermione appreciatively and explained.
"It's clear now, isn't it? I don't think I need to explain it anymore, right?" Ivan pointed to Peter Peter, who was curled up on the ground and trembling.
Harry nodded and was about to respond when Peter Pettigrew, lying on the ground, suddenly screamed.
"No, that's not the case! You are all fooled, you were fooled by Black!
He is a murderer, a dark wizard through and through! You don’t believe what a murderer says, do you? I can tell you that the entire Black family are extremely pure blood, without exception! "
"His brother Regulus Black is a Death Eater, and his cousin Bellatrix Black is the most loyal servant of the mysterious man... the entire Black family is a supporter of the mysterious man!"
Speaking of which Peter looked at Sirius with a grim look and questioned him.
"Dare you deny this?"
Except Ivan, everyone looked at Sirius in surprise, waiting for his response.
"Of course I don't deny this! My brothers and sisters are indeed scum..." Sirius confessed generously, looked at the suspicion in everyone's eyes, and continued.
"However, because I am a maverick and always hate their pure-blood ideas, I have long been removed from the family tree by my mother."
"Who knows if you deliberately lurked down, gained James's trust and became a traitor!" Pettigrew Peter retorted quickly.
He looked at Harry and the others with pity, and finally turned to Ivan. He knew that he wanted to escape, and the key was whether he could convince Ivan to trust him.
After all, Black has lost his wand, and now Ivan is the strongest here!

chapters.title: Chapter 424: Even the Dark Lord is not as cruel as you
chapters.content:
The words of Peter Pettigrew plunged Harry and the others into the mist again, and things that were completely certain seemed to become uncertain again.
"It seems that you only have this ability to slander people! Why didn't you explain why you had to pretend to be a mouse and hide for more than ten years?" Sirius sneered.
"It's Lupin, Lupin has been chasing me down! I must hide... I must hide!" Peter Pettigrew shouted madly.
"Professor Lupin?" Harry and the others said in astonishment.
"Yes, that's right, it's Lupin... He is actually a werewolf! It was not only Black and Lupin who had betrayed James back then!"
Peter Pettigrew broke another shocking news, and then he continued to speak more and more smoothly, tearfully speaking.
"Do you know why Lupin is so poor all these years? He always suspected that I was still alive, so he planned to kill me and even gave up his job for this, preferring to be hungry!
Lupin has been looking for me all over the world for the past few years, because only I know their evil faces...He must have known that I am here when he came to Hogwarts this year as a professor..."
Peter Pettigrew was crying like a man of tears. He looked at Harry and said.
"Moreover, I want to stay by your side to protect you, Harry! You must not have imagined how happy I was when I saw you at Hogwarts for the first time."
The face of Ivan who knew the truth became very strange. He knew that Peter Pettigrew was very cunning, but he never expected that this guy could make up so much.
Fortunately, he was more cautious and didn't expose Peter's identity in the public. Otherwise, if nothing else, the identity of Lupin's werewolf would be leaked...
"How dare you... Peter, you filthy bug, you are not enough to slander me, and you intend to involve Lupin?" Sirius angrily grabbed Peter by the collar and punched directly. Hit him on the nose.
Peter screamed in pain, the bridge of his nose was beaten crooked, nosebleeds and nasal mucus mixed together, and all kinds of red and white spouted out of his nose.
Sirius didn't stop, but punched again, and Peter cried madly.
"Help, he wants to kill me so no one knows the truth! Stop him..."
Harry and the others who were watching were a little at a loss. Ivan was a little worried that Peter would be killed directly, so he wanted to offer some comfort.
At this moment, the door of the screaming hut was suddenly opened, and a voice followed.
"Peter...Unexpectedly, you would say this to me secretly, your ability to make stories is much higher than before!"
Everyone turned their heads and looked over. Lupin, wearing a patched robe, walked in from the door, his face looked a little sickly pale, and he held a magic wand in his hand.
Sirius was not surprised when he saw Lupin, because he had invited him, but he keenly noticed that Lupin's state was a bit wrong.
"What's the matter with you, Lupin? Are you okay?" Sirius put aside Peter with a swollen nose, frowned, and asked puzzledly.
"I just took the wolf's poison potion. I'm in a bad state these days!" Lu Ping shook his head, saying that he was fine.
Ivan interrupted their words at this moment and said emphatically. "The genuine wolf poison potion does not have this debilitating effect. You may have been cheated by Snape..."
"Perhaps! After all, he hasn't liked me very much, anyway, it will be effective..." Lupin said with a wry smile.
He had to transform once a month. Although the potion Snape gave him would have side effects that would make him weak, at least it could restrain the ferocity after the transformation, which was enough for him.
You must know that the price of genuine wolf poison potions is not cheap. He has just become a professor and has little money. After years of wandering life, he has developed the habit of saving money.
Then, Lupin turned to look at Harry and the others and said apologetically. "I'm sorry, but I kept hiding from you for so long. I was worried that my werewolf identity would cause some panic, so I chose to keep it secret."
Despite the pain, Peter Pettigrew suddenly showed excitement on his twisted face. He pointed to Lupin and said loudly. "Have you seen it, he admits it, he admits that he is a werewolf!"
"Even if Professor Lupin is a werewolf, that can't prove anything. There are good people and bad people in any race. The saying that a werewolf is evil is just the prejudice of many wizards. I believe Professor Lupin is a good person!"
Hermione interrupted Peter's words and spoke to Harry and the others.
"Right, Harry, Ron!"
"Yes, Lupin is the best Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor I have ever seen!"
Harry remembered Lupin's dedicated teaching course during this time, and he also cared about himself, so he quickly made a choice.
After all, his best friend and most trusted professor stood up and told him Sirius was innocent, and Peter was the real murderer who betrayed his parents!
This made Harry's original wobbly balance now completely fall to Sirius's side.
Ron also nodded dumbly. He looked at Peter in a daze. He still didn't believe that his beloved mouse would become a bald old man...
The excitement on Peter Pettigrew's face stagnated, and seeing the people present turning one by one, despair gradually spread in his heart.
Peter tried hard to climb to Ivan's feet, grabbed Ivan's thigh, and asked with the last glimmer of hope.
"Halse! You are so smart, you will believe me, right?"
"Save itPeter...Why are you doing this every time, there is nothing new, but the story you make up is getting better and better!" Peter Pettigrew kicked aside.
After thinking about it, Ivan waved his magic wand again and turned into a rope to bind him tightly, and added a magic that made people weak.
Although Peter, who doesn't have a magic wand in his hand, has no threats, it is better to guard against some. After all, there are little wizards like Harry, Hermione, and Ron.
Peter, who fell down the corner, fell into a deeper despair after hearing Ivan's words. The pain in his body couldn't conceal the chill from the soles of his feet...
He is not stupid, combined with his intermittent memories of the past few days, he quickly thought of something extraordinary, and he took a breath of breath. No wonder he always felt that there was something that he couldn't remember these days.. .
Peter looked at Ivan again, trembling like he was looking at a demon. He felt that even the Dark Lord would not be so cruel...

chapters.title: Chapter 425: Poor innocent and bad peter
chapters.content:
Peter's tragic situation did not arouse everyone's sympathy, and Sirius still managed to endure the murder before leaving Peter's life.
Lupin looked at Harry and the others in touch. He didn't expect that he had revealed his identity as a werewolf and they were still willing to trust him.
In order to completely solve this misunderstanding, Lupin and Sirius told Harry the causes and consequences of the whole thing in detail. Except for the inconvenience of the Order of the Phoenix, they have almost no reservations...
Harry almost cried and listened to it all. It took him a long time to stabilize his emotions. He looked angrily at Peter, who was bound to the ground and still had a nosebleed, and asked in a puzzled voice.
"Why did you suddenly choose him to be the secret guard at the time?"
In the descriptions of Sirius and Lupin, Peter is timid, cowardly and incompetent, and it is useless. Even if the secretaries need to be changed, Lupin should be the one who should take care of him!
"You should have heard what Peter said just now. At that time, a traitor appeared in the camp against Voldemort and sent a lot of information to the mysterious man.
Because of Lupin's identity as a werewolf wizard, I once doubted him, so I excluded him when selecting the secretaries..." Sirius explained, and looked at Lupin apologetically.
"Please forgive me, Remus."
"It doesn't matter, I doubted you at the beginning! We are even..." Lupin shook his head.
After that, the two smiled bitterly at each other. It is this level of suspicion that the identity of the confidential person will fall to Peter. Among James' friends, Peter is the least suspect...
Usually undercover agents need to have a high degree of courage and a good mentality, and Peter does not meet any of them.
This was originally the safest move, but who knew it would push James and Lily to hell.
"Anyway, it's all my fault... Harry! I'm sorry, but I took the initiative to suggest that James change the candidate that caused it all." Sirius looked at Harry very reproachfully and said.
"No, you are not wrong!" Harry shook his head and said with certainty. "The mistake is Peter Pettigrew, who has betrayed the trust of you and my father and betrayed his friends!"
All the people present were silent for a moment, only Hermione thought of the most important thing to do now and reminded him.
"Now that everything is clear, let's go and tell Professor McGonagall now, let her notify the people at the Ministry of Magic and clear Mr. Black of suspicion!"
Harry nodded hastily, he didn't want to wait for a moment.
"This can't be done! It's not the time yet." Ivan stopped them.
"Why?" Harry looked at Ivan in surprise, with a puzzled look on his face. "Also I've always wanted to ask, since you already knew it, why didn't you say it earlier?"
"Of course I am worried that the people from the Ministry of Magic will get in the way..." Ivan sighed, and then explained to Harry and the others, emphatically explaining the stakes.
The Ministry of Magic will not slap themselves. If they face such a major scandal without external factors, they will only choose to conceal it as much as possible, and they will be wrong, and they will never take the initiative to admit it.
"It shouldn't be it? That's the Ministry of Magic... and we've caught Peter Pettigrew. The evidence is solid. Just give him a little Veritaserum to make everything clear?" Hermione pursed her lips, hesitating. Said.
All of what Ivan just said was impacting her three views, which made Hermione, who had always been accustomed to observing the rules, a little unacceptable for a while.
"The Ministry of Magic is not as fair as you think, Hermione! For many politicians, the truth of the matter is not important, they only care which result is in their favor! What they do best!"
Ivan cruelly shredded Hermione's fantasy and placed the cold facts in front of the thirteen-year-old witch.
Harry and Ron were also reshaped of the Three Views, and they could hardly imagine that the Ministry of Magic would reverse black and white.
"Ahem..."
Sirius coughed slightly and attracted the attention of Harry and the others. He felt that this kind of thing is not something that a child of Harry's age should understand, so he spoke.
"We have made a decision on this matter. Just wait for Dumbledore to come back and leave this matter to him to solve it."
"Then when are we going to wait? What if Professor Dumbledore doesn't come back for months?" Harry frowned and said with some concern.
Ivan shrugged, and he couldn't answer. Generally speaking, Dumbledore, as the principal of Hogwarts, shouldn't have been out of school for several months.
"Soon!" Lupin said aloud.
Everyone turned their heads to look at him in surprise, and Lupin said truthfully without concealing it.
"I just received the news today that Professor Dumbledore should be back tonight! Be safe, we just have to wait here for one night, and we can see him early tomorrow morning!"
"Really? That's great!" Harry said happily.
Hermione, Ron, and even Sirius breathed a sigh of relief when they heard the news, as if some big rock had dropped in their hearts.
The same is true for Ivan. Although he has always been reluctant to meet with Dumbledore, he still has to admit that Dumbledore can always bring people a wonderful sense of security.
As long as he is there, there is no need to worry about anything...
Thinking of this, Ivan looked at Peter Pettigrew, remembered something that needed to be confirmed, and said to everyone.
"Peter has taken refuge in a mysterious person. There should be a Dark Mark on his body. If Veritaserum cannot be used in the court by then, this will be enough to prove it!"
If he remembers correctly the first thing after Voldemort's resurrection in the original time and space is to use the Dark Mark on Peter to summon the Death Eaters.
But before his resurrection, Voldemort, who had lost his power, had a high probability of not giving Peter the ability to imprint the Dark Mark.
It is only possible that Peter had been inscribed when he took refuge in Voldemort thirteen years ago!
Sirius soon thought of the Death Eater logo, with a grin on his face, and walked towards Peter Pettigrew step by step...
Peter's face was full of horror. His body was squeezed into the corner, and his mouth kept crying and praying, like a weakness who could not resist the invasion...
He naturally has the mark of the Dark Demon that Ivan said!
This is the commendation that he won after completing the undercover work and betraying James and Lily, and it is the proof that he has gained the trust of the Dark Lord!
But the things that took so much hard work in exchange for him have now become his urging talisman!

chapters.title: Chapter 426: Peter: It's so difficult for me! (2 in 1 4,000 words)
chapters.content:
Sirius strode to Peter's body and forcibly opened his sleeves, only to see that there was nothing on Peter's fat wrist.
"Not here!" Sirius was not surprised. As an undercover, it was of course impossible for Peter to engrave the Dark Mark in such an obvious place.
Immediately afterwards, he violently opened Peter's shirt, ready to check his chest and arms, the latter struggling desperately and let out a stern cry.
As if breaking through a certain threshold, Peter's body suddenly began to shrink, transforming into a mouse, and the rope tied to his body automatically fell off...
"Change it back to me, Peter, if you don't want to die yet!" Sirius said viciously, before reaching out to grab the gray-black mouse by the tail.
Peter wanted to evade in horror, but the weak magic that Ivan exerted on him was still working, making him much slower than ordinary mice.
At this moment, a red light flashed, and the defenseless Sirius was shot out and hit the low wall next to it...
"Who?"
The sudden abnormality surprised everyone. Ivan waved his magic wand for the first time, hitting a magical beam and shooting towards the door. The red light just flew in from there...
A transparent magic barrier slowly rose up at the empty door, blocking the beam of light.
However, the fluctuation caused by the magical power also caused the effect of the phantom spell to be destroyed by the way, and Snape wearing a black robe appeared in front of everyone.
"S...Professor Snape?" Hermione stammered and screamed.
"Very well, come and see what I found!" Snape ignored Hermione's meaning. He glanced around the scene, his gaze stayed on Sirius for a while, and then turned to Luo who was tied up. Hmm, and Harry who just cried.
"Lupin! I didn't guess wrong before, but you have been helping Black sneak into the castle, but I didn't expect you to be so bold and dare to use this old place as your shelter... But it really gave me a good meal. Find."
"But you are very smart, and the timing was good! If Malfoy hadn't discovered your werewolf's identity quickly, and ran over to me and told me where you were going to be suspicious, you might really have to succeed today. !"
Snape's face was full of uncontrollable triumph. After enduring half a school year, he finally caught Lupin's handle!
Not surprisingly, Lupin and Sirius will be sent to Azkaban together today, and the Dementors may be happy to give them a kiss!
Nothing makes him more happy than this!
Listening to Snape's words, Lupin's face suddenly changed. He didn't expect Snape to follow him all the time.
It's that bottle of wolf poison potion!
Lupin quickly realized this. The wolf poison potion Snape had drunk before weakened his perception ability and made him very weak.
So much so that he didn't find anyone following him during the whole process.
"Severus, you misunderstood! I guess you must have just arrived and didn't hear what we were talking about. Sirius didn't come to kill Harry, Peter did everything..."
There was an eager look on Lupin's face, but before he could finish his words, he was interrupted by Snape.
"Don't try to trick me, Peter is dead long ago, and so is James! Now you two are left. When I solve the two of you, there will be no more messy things!" Nep scolded loudly.
"Professor, Professor Lupin didn't lie to you, Peter is the real betrayer..." Harry said with courage.
"Shut up! Potter! I remember you should stay in Hogwarts Castle right now, under the noses of all the professors!"
I think it’s time for you to grow your mind. You would believe what a werewolf and a murderer said. Now if something goes wrong, you only know how to cry! "
Snape gritted his teeth and looked at Harry, disappointed in him. Harry violated the school rules again and again, and now he ran outside in private, knowing that he should cast a spell to lock him in the school.
Harry was so angry that he couldn't speak for a long time. He had his own thoughts and judgments. He could go wherever he wanted. He didn't need to be closely guarded like a baby!
"Professor Snape, didn't you hear Peter's voice outside just now? He is an Animagus, now a mouse..." Ivan said anxiously, unlike the others. His eyes were fixed on Peter's movements.
The gray-black mouse was supporting his weak body and slowly crawling to the exit position. Ivan raised his wand and was ready to shoot.
However, this touched Snape's fragile nerve, because he was standing at the exit, and Ivan's wand was vaguely pointed at him.
"Enough! Do you think I will believe this trick of fooling people? It's better not to move me at will! After I tie you all up, I will consider listening to your slow explanation..."
Snape said sharply, holding his wand and pointing at Ivan and Lupin. He didn't dare to be distracted at all. His attention was focused on them. Of course he didn't dare to look down at some mice...
Although he knocked down Sirius for the first time, the threat of the two in front of him was not small, and even if he didn't pay attention, he might be caught.
With this in mind, Snape took the lead without warning, and a white beam hit Lupin directly.
Lupin's condition was very poor, his reaction was slow, and he had only time to construct a magical barrier and blocked it a little bit before he was hit by a beam of light and hit the ground.
Seeing Lupin being attacked by Ivan, Peter slipped to the gate, and immediately stopped hesitating.
"A flock of birds!" Ivan waved his wand. Since it was Snape and Peter that he was dealing with, he didn't use a lethal spell.
The debris and wooden planks piled around quickly transformed and transformed under the action of magical power, but within a moment of effort, swarms of birds had already gathered, like flying arrows, rushing towards the door...
Half of it was used to contain Snape, and the other half was for Peter!
It was just that Ivan’s plan fell through. Snape gently shook his wand, and a black glow exploded in mid-air. The swarms of birds were corroded before they even approached...
After absorbing the nutrients, black flames emerged from the corroded bird wreckage, which grew wildly out of thin air and swept forward...
And Peter was walking in the middle of the fierce battlefield, his heart was mentioned in his throat, and the dangerous light beams passed over his head one by one, and from time to time, several curses fell beside him.
Peter can only try his best to avoid, praying that he can escape successfully.
On the battlefield at this meeting, a spell hit Snape, but was deflected and flew towards Peter by the bullet's reflected beam.
He jumped up in a thrilling manner and avoided the past, but only the aftermath took him into the air, crashed into the air, and then fell heavily on the door.
Peter screamed, his whole body was wounded and his face was gray, but his face was full of excitement that could not be concealed, because the exit was in front, and he would be able to escape soon!
Thinking of this, Peter, regardless of his physical weakness, climbed over the threshold and ran towards the evening sun...
The joy of life and death filled Peter's mind...
Then a thin, thin hand suddenly stretched out from the dark, grabbed its tail, and lifted it up...
......
In the room, fierce fighting continued.
"Halse, I didn't expect you to collude with Black. It looks like you brought Potter and Weasley these two idiots here!"
Snape said sharply, his hand movement did not stop, he played a few curses with his backhand, and even hesitated whether to use some high-intensity curses!
After all, Ivan's strength far exceeded his expectations.
He originally thought that even though Ivan had a good talent and strength far surpassed his peers, he was not that big after all.
Unexpectedly, if he kept his hand for a while, he would still be unable to hold him for a while!
Ivan used a magic wand to drag a round table to block Snape’s attack.
Ivan was watching Peter hurriedly slipping out of the door before, and Ivan watched it all the way, so seeing Snape in front of him was both eager and helpless.
Although he made Dobby stare in secret, it was not 100% insurance.
Like Snape sneaking in under the phantom spell this time, Dobby couldn't find out...
Thinking of this, Ivan was cruel, and regardless of the risk of exposure, he had to use blood magic to solve the battle, and he must not drag on!
Ivan closed his eyes, and when he opened them again, his eyes had turned into orange snake pupils.
Snape didn't have any defense at all. As his eyes met, a chill deep into his bones surged into his heart, his body froze suddenly, his consciousness seemed to be sucked in...
However, Ivan on the opposite side was not in a good state. Snape's magic power was more than three times higher than him. The difference in the total amount made the consumption extremely intense, and the magic power poured out like a flood of gate opening!
This made Ivan scream secretly in his heart. He used the basilisk pupil to quickly solve the battle, but unexpectedly fell into a dilemma of competition magic...
"Except for your weapons!"
At this moment, Lupin, who was lying on the ground, seized the opportunity slowly and waved his wand to stimulate a beam of light to hit Snape.
Snape, who could not be avoided, was hit frontally, and the light of the Iron Armor Curse was lit up, blocking the magic.
However, since the protection of the Iron Armor Curse had been reduced almost in the previous battle, it quickly shattered after absorbing the power of the Disarming Curse.
Snape was shaken back a few steps, and at the same time he got out of the control of the Basilisk's pupils.
Feeling his stiff body, Snape was very jealous. This kind of magic that can make people petrify by looking at each other was unheard of!
Ivan on the other side had closed the snake eyes and was breathing heavily.
This time using Basilisk's pupils on Snape, Ivan once again saw one of the shortcomings of the Basilisk's pupils, that is, it is best not to use it on people whose magic power far exceeds him!
In less than a second of opening, he had already lost one-third of his magic power, and Snape didn't seem to lose his combat power completely...
Snape moved his stiff wrist and confirmed Ivan's state through the reflection of the broken glass on the ground, and slowly heaved a sigh of relief when he noticed that Ivan was consumed a lot.
It would be terrifying if that kind of magic could be used unlimitedly!
Fortunately, it seems that there are some restrictions...
At this point of delay, Lupin has stood up, and the field has returned to a two-on-one situation.
"Stop it, Severus! This is just a misunderstanding, we have no reason to fight...and there is no need to waste time here..." Lupin finally persuaded.
"waste time?"
Snape's face became ugly, he frowned first, then said disdainfully.
"Very well, it seems that I left your hands before giving you the illusion that you can easily defeat me? Remus, now is different from the past, the crowd is not so effective!"
As Snape was talking, he didn't know what he was thinking of, and his expression became a little sullen. He raised a somewhat stiff wrist, and the invisible blade gradually condensed on the top of the wand.
"Today is the death date of you and Black, no one can save you!" Snape roared.
"That's not necessarily? Sir!"
At the door frame behind him, a squeaky and weird sound suddenly rang.
Snape's face changed drastically, and he suddenly felt that his waist was hit violently. The wand suddenly got out of his hand, and his body fell straight to the side of the decaying cabinet...
Then, a small house elf walked in from outside, holding a miserable gray-black mouse in his hand.
"Good job, Dobby!" Ivan was really relieved to see this scene, and for the first time he waved his wand and deformed a rope to tie up Snape.
Upon seeing this, Lupin put away his wand and hurried to check Sirius's condition.
"Professor Snape! If you can put aside the prejudice against Professor Lupin and SiriusIf you think about it, you should know that we didn't lie to you..." Ivan shrugged and explained. One sentence.
Snape didn't reply. Although he couldn't move, he still looked at Ivan and the others fiercely.
"I think he needs to fix him before he can be honest!" Sirius stood up with Lupin's support, thinking that he was accidentally knocked out by Snape in a sneak attack, and he was immediately angrily.
"Save the time, don't make any mess, if it weren't for the bad jokes you made before, it wouldn't cause today's misunderstanding!" Ivan said grimly.
Did you even tell him that?
Sirius looked at Lupin suspiciously, but saw that Lupin was also confused.
After thinking about it, the two simultaneously turned their heads to look at the gray-black mouse in Dobby's hand.
That must be what Peter said!
Peter, who was caught by Dobby, mistakenly thought that Sirius and Lupin wanted to settle accounts with him, and his heart was cold...

chapters.title: Chapter 427: Ivan: Malfoy, how many people did you call? (2 go...
chapters.content:
In fact, Sirius was indeed going to settle accounts with Peter, who just took advantage of the chaos that Peter wanted to escape made him very angry.
Ivan suddenly remembered something, and hurriedly looked at Snape and asked.
"By the way, Professor Snape, where is the Malfoy now? Didn't he come with you?"
After Ivan's reminder, Lu Ping realized that there was still a problem that had not been resolved.
Sirius' attention was also drawn to the past, so that the punishment of Peter was temporarily put on hold.
Snape looked at everyone with a sneer, and didn't mean to speak.
"If you don't want me to use some special methods...better tell me honestly!" Sirius grabbed Snape by the collar and pressed his wand against his forehead. He was worried that he had no reason to retaliate before Snape. The act of stunning yourself.
"Calm down, Sirius, we have had enough trouble..." Lupin stopped Sirius's excessive behavior, and then said to Snape.
"Severus, we really have no malice. We just don't want to widen the misunderstanding. If possible, please tell us how Malfoy told you in the first place, and who did he tell this news?"
"Don't be hypocritical, Lupin!" Snape said sarcastically.
Although he has guessed from the follow-up words of Ivan and others that these people may not lie, in front of two dead opponents, he can't be subdued anyway!
Sirius was about to punch him viciously, and Lupin stopped him again.
At this moment, Snape stared at Sirius, half reminding and half laughing.
"It's okay to tell you. When Malfoy came over to inform me that Lupin was going to go out suspiciously, I guessed that Lupin would come to see you!
Just in case, I had already asked Malfoy to notify the other teaching professors and let them follow the marks I left, and those who counted the rest of the time should have arrived! "
As soon as Snape's voice fell, there was a noise outside.
The faces of Sirius and Lupin suddenly changed, and Ivan frowned.
The professors who can work in Hogwarts usually have extremely high magic standards, which are not easy to deal with, let alone get together this time!
If Snape waits and talks gibberish again, so that they can't explain it, it will probably be a fierce battle!
The corners of Snape's mouth curled slightly, but he was hesitant to wait for McGonagall, Flitwick and others to arrive, whether he wanted to remind...
However, his eyes turned to the open door, and the expression on Snape's face suddenly changed, because only one person or a goblin had broken in...
"Severus?!" Flitwick looked around at the fastest speed.
At first sight, Snape was tied up, and Ron and Hermione hid in the corner tremblingly because they avoided the fight.
Black, the wanted man in the Ministry of Magic, was standing with Lupin, seemingly ready to do something to Snape.
Reminiscing about what Malfoy had told him, Flitwick made a judgment immediately, he was late!
After he heard Snape talking with Lupin, Sirius and others outside, he rushed over as quickly as possible, in order to be able to support Snape in time.
Unexpectedly, Snape had long been defeated, and he was tied up...
The extremely rich duel experience made Flitwick understand that in the case of great disparity in combat power, he must give priority to the shot, reduce the number of enemies, and it is best to save Snape first.
"Faint!" Flitwick simulated several combat plans in his mind, and resolutely took the lead in attacking Lupin and Black.
The beams of the spell flashed intertwined in a small room...
After a fight, Flitwick was **** and tied to Snape.
"So why did you come alone? McGonagall and the others?" Snape said angrily while looking at Flitwick with a hatred of iron and steel.
Flitwick’s expression was very embarrassing. He was outstanding and worried that Snape would not be able to handle it alone, so he took the first step...
"Don't worry too much, Severus! I have asked Malfoy to notify the other professors, and they will be there soon!" Flitwick said comfortingly.
Snape's face is very strange, why do these words sound so familiar? I seem to have said the same just now...
Ivan looked at the **** Flitwick, feeling helpless. What are these things?
It seems that there is one more object that needs a good explanation.
More importantly, if other professors saw this scene, the misunderstanding would be even greater!
"Harry, come and explain to Professor Flitwick!" Ivan said to Harry, who was a little bewildered by standing aside the whole time.
It’s better to let Harry, the client, explain than outsiders like them...
Flitwick noticed that Harry was here, and he was alive and well. He faintly realized whether there was any misunderstanding. He turned to look at Snape, but saw that Snape was closing his eyes and rested. Yourself.
Harry nodded, but he felt a little uneasy. They actually **** the professor. Is this really okay?
Ivan didn't care about this, as long as he clarified the misunderstanding clearly, the professors at Hogwarts were not so careful.
After all, it was too troublesome to explain while typing, especially since they didn't know when the next professor would arrive, and Snape's attitude was open to question.
On the contrary, it is better to disarm the opponent first in a four-to-one situation with an absolute advantage, and then let Harry slowly explain it to be more convenient.
Based on this concept, in just over ten minutes, the professors rushed over and were arrested one after another.
Hooch and Trelawney came together, but even so they couldn’t escape, because Sirius directly used the invisibility cloak that Harry had brought, making the battle process extremely smooth, and it didn’t cost much. Kung Fu is done.
The captured professors finally formed a half circle and listened to Harry telling stories together...
"So who can tell me what happened?" The newly arrived Mrs. Hodge was confused.
She had just received the news from Malfoy, and followed the clues left along the way to find this place, and then Ivan, Lupin, Black, and Dobby were overwhelmed by the forces of Ivan, Lupin, Black and Dobby.
After seeing Snape, Flitwick, Trelawney and others who were also arrested, Hodge couldn't hide the shock in his heart, almost thinking that Hogwarts would be finished tomorrow...
But something strange is that everyone doesn't seem to be very nervous.
"That's it, Mrs. Hooch, Sirius wanted by the Ministry of Magic is actually innocent. I have to talk about it from thirteen years ago..."
Harry had forgotten that he had said this for the first time, just to help Sirius clear his grievances, he still held back his boredom.
"Potter! I suggest you skip the previous words and start directly from the important points! I have listened to it several times, and you can't start from the beginning every time someone comes!" Flitwick couldn't help but interrupt. After Harry's words, he said unhappily.
At the beginning of this story, Flitwick was tired of hearing it, but until now he has not fully figured out what happened that year...
Because Harry often hasn't said a few words, when he gets interested in a key place, someone will suddenly come in and be caught in a few seconds, and then Harry has to say it again from the beginning...
Harry naturally had no opinion, but the other professors obviously didn't think so.
"Filius...you can't just look at yourself! I just came here...you have to figure out what happened!" Madam Hooch retorted Flitwick's words, and then asked a little strangely.
"By the way, who made Malfoy notify us?"
"I asked Malfoy to inform you, but I didn't ask you to come in batches!" Snape couldn't help the anger rising in his heart, which was completely different from what he expected!
At this time, Trelawney, who had not participated in the discussion, suddenly said mysteriously.
"Shhh~ don't make any noise, why don't we guess who will come in next? I saw a sign from the gap in the wall, our savior will be the fourth person to cross the threshold..."
"Then why didn't you expect that you would be arrested?" Snape mocked.
Trelawney choked suddenly, she stared and mumbled for a long time. "How do you know that I didn't predict it? I'll be arrested, maybe it's also a sign of fate..."
Ivan looked at the professors who were chatting together and sighed. He wondered if Malfoy would invite all the professors he could find.
After all, most of the professors in the school are here...
Thinking of this, Ivan even wondered if Malfoy was the legendary leader. If he and Sirius really had a plot, wouldn't he be able to kill Hogwarts in one go?
But it is also right. Two elites from the Order of the Phoenix, a house elf who is different from a wizard, a deathly hallow, plus oneself, such a lineup has mental arithmetic and unintentional, few people in the magical world can escape. ...
Harry on the other side was talking endlessly. He had already talked about how Sirius had planned to change someone to serve as the Secret Guardian, so as to confuse Voldemort...
When Hooch and Trelawney were in a trance, someone broke into the screaming shed again, and Flitwick was speechless. He knew he was going to listen again!
Everyone turned their heads and looked over. This time it was Ravenclaw’s Dean Pomona Sprout. Before she could do anything, Sirius, who was hiding in the shadows in an invisibility cloak, held her with a magic wand. The neck...
"Relax, don't think about resisting, what will I do to you?"
Sirius confiscated Sprout's wand very skillfully, and finally did not tie her up. He just motioned to Sprout, who had lost his weapon, to accompany Snape and the others. Listen to Harry's explanation...
Flitwick sighed helplessly and moved to the side to make room for it...
Sprout couldn't figure out the situation for a while, but when he saw that Snape and the others were disarmed, he was a little bit horrified.
Click...
The proficient Sirius put on his invisibility cloak and was waiting for the next visitor. At this time, there was some noise outside.
"Anyone else?" Sirius looked at Sprout sharply and asked.
Sprout pursed his lips, trying to shake his head, but Malfoy's panicked voice rang not far from the door.
Sprout suddenly turned his head and shouted loudly.
"Malfoy! Run... Go and invite Professor Dumbledore!"
She had already realized that there might be other people lying in ambush in the screaming hut, and Malfoy who had come with her must have been found.
However, Malfoy could not escape and he was quickly caught by Dobby.
"Dobby, you dare to do something to me, I should have let my father kill you!" Malfoy crossed the threshold cursingly, and was pushed into the room by Dobby.
But seeing the professors in a circle in the room, Malfoy was dumbfounded.
Snape, Flitwick, Hooch and others stared at Malfoy. If it weren't for Malfoy's information, they would not have gathered here today.
"The people you notified are here, right? Malfoy! How many people did you find?" Seeing that the master was finally caught, Ivan asked silently.
"I...I also notified the people at the Ministry of Magic that there will be a large number of Aurors coming soon... you better let us go right away!" Malfoy's eyes rolled and said sharply. .
"Tell me the truth! Or are you tired of living?" Ivan drew out his wand, deliberately frightening and condensing a black glow.
Malfoy mistakenly thought that Ivan was going to cast a curse on himself, so scared that he didn't care about anything, he shook his head repeatedly. "No more... no one else, all here!"
Ivan forced the question several times and confirmed that Malfoy had not lied. Then he put away his wand, waved his hand, and told him to stay there and listen to the story.
"It looks like it's finally over!" Lupin listened to the conversation between Ivan and Malfoy, secretly relieved.
When dealing with Hogwarts' colleagues, Lupin's heart pressure was not small, and more importantly, he had been worried that Malfoy would promote his identity as a werewolf wizard everywhere and make everyone known.
Fortunately, things weren't that bad. Apart from Malfoy, those who knew about it were limited to the professors.
"Well Then just wait for Harry to explain clearly to the professors, there should be no problem!"
Ivan nodded, and after tossing for so long, he could finally relax.
"You may need to explain to me, Hals!"
The sound behind him frightened Ivan, and he subconsciously released a coma spell with his backhand.
The visitor stretched out his wand and tapped it lightly, and the crimson light beam disappeared.
"Professor Dumbledore?" Ivan then saw clearly the appearance of the incoming person, and said a little excitedly, and then some worried that his subconscious attack might cause the other party to misunderstand him.
After a long time no see, the centenarian still looks the same, wearing a purple-red robe casually, and the lack of care of the white beard looks a bit messy...
He strode across the threshold. Even when he saw the disarmed professors and Sirius who had escaped from prison, he didn't make any moves. It seems that these are not worthy of moving him...

chapters.title: Chapter 428: Dumbledore the weird
chapters.content:
"Albus?"
"Professor Dumbledore?!"
.....
When everyone present saw Dumbledore's figure, they all exclaimed.
It's just that while being pleasantly surprised, the professors couldn't help showing a little shame on their faces. So many of them were notified to arrest Sirius, but they were disarmed and arrested one by one...
Lupin, Harry and others hurriedly spoke, preparing to explain to Dumbledore what happened here, so as not to cause unnecessary misunderstandings.
But before they could speak, Malfoy ran to Dumbledore, pointing at Ivan and the others and yelled.
