"Professor Dumbledore! Lupin is actually a werewolf. He also colluded with the fugitive Black of the Ministry of Magic and arrested everyone here... and Hals, all of this must have been planned by him. He was in the same group as Lupin and Black, and he planned to kill me just now..."
Although Malfoy hated the principal at ordinary times, at such a special moment, he had long forgotten the complaints of the past, and Dumbledore immediately became a savior in his heart.
While talking, Malfoy stared at Ivan and the others fiercely, his face was full of rejoicing for his escape, and some excitement that was indescribable.
He felt that his rival Ivan would definitely be expelled this time, and even be imprisoned in Azkaban!
"You are done, Hals!" Malfoy yelled.
It's a pity that Dumbledore heard what he said, but just nodded and nodded, indicating that he knew that he had not been furious as Malfoy expected, and cast a spell to bind Ivan and the others.
Ivan was a little surprised at Dumbledore's attitude, but didn't dare to neglect, and quickly defended.
"Professor Dumbledore, this is how things are. I accidentally discovered that Ron's pet mouse is actually an Animagus. I investigated it when I was curious and worried, and forced him to return to his original form..."
Ivan put out all the rhetoric he had thought of long ago and explained it to Dumbledore.
However, as soon as Ivan said a few words, Dumbledore interrupted.
"Stop for a while, Hals! I do intend to hear you explain, but not here, nor now..."
"You and Lupin, Black, and Harry will come to the principal's office in about an hour. I will be there waiting for you. Then we will have a lot of time to talk slowly..." Dumbledore increased his tone and emphasized With.
Ivan looked at the old principal in front of him strangely, and couldn't understand what he meant.
Why do you want to talk in the principal's office? Isn't it appropriate here? Is it because some things are inconvenient to be heard by children like Ron and Malfoy?
But they have already participated, so they can't let this misunderstanding continue...
Dumbledore didn't answer Ivan's doubts. He turned his head to look at the professors who were disarmed and bound, raised his hand and waved his wand to untie everyone, and said to them.
"Professors, when you return to the castle, remember to call all the students to the auditorium and manage the order. I will have some important things to announce!
In addition, if you have any questions, please wait for a while and ask again! "
Flitwick, Hooch and others looked at each other.
Not long after he was arrested, Sprout, who hadn't figured out anything, was even more confused.
However, Dumbledore has already made arrangements. Out of trust, they can only resist the doubts in their hearts...
"Very good! So that's it. Let's see you at Hogwarts Castle in an hour!" Dumbledore looked at the reaction of the crowd and nodded.
After speaking, Dumbledore waved his wand to cast a spell and disappeared into the screaming hut.
A piece of golden light swayed slightly, and Ivan saw that Dumbledore had something gleaming on his right hand before he left.
He vaguely realized what it was, but he was not sure...
"Albus just left? What shall we do now?" Sprout frowned, watching Sirius and the others warily.
"Go back to school and do what he says!" Flitwick also didn't expect Dumbledore to leave, so he had no choice but to say.
Then Flitwick looked back at Harry. "If you don't mind, when I'm on the road, I hope to hear the follow-up of that story again!"
"Of course!" Harry nodded quickly.
Sirius and Lupin returned the seized wands and apologized unanimously, except for Snape's stinking face, everyone else gladly accepted.
Ivan took Peter, who had turned into a mouse, from Dobby's hand, and returned to Hogwarts from the secret passage of the Screaming Shack with everyone.
Along the way, Harry told everyone the cause and effect of the incident. This time it went well and no one came out to make trouble...
"Oh my god, is this true? How could the Ministry of Magic do this? They even took a hero who resisted the mysterious man into Azkaban as a betrayer? Didn't you defend yourself in the court?"
Madam Hooch looked at Sirius and said in astonishment. She couldn't believe what Harry said was true. It was crazy!
"Then they must be willing to give me this opportunity! After the Ministry of Magic caught me, they threw me directly to the dementors, without going through the court..." Sirius said sarcastically.
"This is absolutely the negligence of the Ministry of Magic! According to the regulations, every prisoner should be tried before being convicted!" Professor Sprout said angrily.
The others looked at Sirius sympathetically, because the Ministry of Magic had been imprisoned in Azkaban for more than ten years, which was absolutely uncomfortable, and it was already mentally tough not to go crazy. U U Reading www.uukanshu.com
Sirius didn't struggle with this much. The torture he experienced in Azkaban could be regarded as his self-punishment, which would make him feel a little better in his heart, and he would feel less guilty when he recalled that incident.
After communicating all the way, the professors who understood the truth slowly let go of their previous guards.
At this moment, Ivan suddenly said. "We're almost there, please stop first! The front exit was planted with a lesson of beating willow. If you just go out like this, you may be attacked..."
"Does the secret road lead to here?" Professor Sprout thought for a while. There was only one beating willow in the entire Hogwarts, and she naturally easily guessed where the entrances and exits were at the two ends of the secret road.
Seeing that, Ivan waved his magic wand and struck the scar on the body of the beating willow tree, which made the tree stand still and lost the ability to attack. The professors were very moved.
They have been professors here for decades, and I am afraid they have not learned as much about this castle as Ivan...
No wonder Sirius could sneak in easily before!

chapters.title: Chapter : Go to bed early, 1 more today!
chapters.content:
In fact, the second one is almost the same, but the angel struggled for a long time, feeling that the logic was not straightened out, and I felt a little circumstance, worried that you would not understand it.
For the obsessive-compulsive disorder of angels, this kind of result is really unacceptable, let me change it, try to be simple, and post tomorrow...

chapters.title: Chapter 429: Schrödinger's principal
chapters.content:
When they returned to the castle together, everyone split up.
According to the instructions given by Dumbledore, the professors of the major universities informed the students, and Ivan and others walked towards the principal's office.
In order to prevent any panic, Sirius has transformed into the form of a **** dog.
Although a **** dog walking in the castle seemed a little weird, but with Lupin and Ivan by his side, the little wizards encountered along the way did not come up to inquire, so they reached the front of the principal's office unimpeded. .
"Professor Lupin, do you know the password for entering and exiting?" Ivan turned to see Lupin and asked.
"I know one, but Dumbledore hasn't returned for a while, and I don't know if the original password will work..." Lupin hesitated and tried to speak.
"Pile of cockroaches!"
Click...
The heavy guardian statue slowly turned up, slowly rising to let out the passageway it entered.
Lupin breathed a sigh of relief, and it seemed that Dumbledore hadn't changed his password.
Ivan took the lead and walked into the principal's room with the mouse. Compared with the last time, it was a lot more empty, which seemed indirect and refined.
The most eye-catching thing is that there is a thick letter on the table in the center, and the glittering time converter presses the envelope.
The wall behind is covered by a piece of cloth. Fox with beautiful feathers usually stops on the olive branch, squinting his eyes and dozing...
Dumbledore was sitting behind the table at the moment, his eyes under the half-moon round glasses looked at the two things in front of him, seeming a little lost, and did not notice their arrival...
"Professor Dumbledore!" Ivan reminded.
The old wizard with white beard nodded slightly, glanced at the crowd, and stretched out his hand to indicate that it was time to speak.
Ivan nodded, and started talking about the name of Peter Pettigrew on the map of the point of life last school year, and talked about how he found out the truth based on various clues...
Ivan has practiced this statement countless times in his heart, and there are basically no loopholes. Those things that are really unclear, he dumped on Peter.
Sirius reverted to the form of a wizard, and occasionally made some additions when Ivan explained.
Harry, Lu Ping and others also opened their mouths to testify for them.
Dumbledore listened quietly, nodding his head from time to time, there was no change in his expression, as if he had expected it, and even a hint of impatience.
Ivan keenly noticed Dumbledore's strangeness, and doubts arose in his heart. Could it be that the old principal has been monitoring what happened in the school during this time?
And unlike the previous contact, Ivan did not have the urgency that he had before when he met Dumbledore this time, but felt a little familiar and kind.
Ivan frowned. He didn't quite understand if this was his own illusion, because Phoenix Fox was here, and the old magic wand was in the other's hand.
A few thoughts only flashed through Ivan's mind, and he kept talking on the bright side, and quickly explained the matter clearly.
After listening, Dumbledore showed a slightly sentimental expression on his face. He looked at Sirius and said in a deep voice.
"Sirius, I'm sorry, this was my mistake... If I trusted you more then, after that happened, I would go to Azkaban to meet you, maybe I won't let this misunderstanding. Continue to this day."
"Don't say that, Professor, it's not your fault!" Sirius didn't mean to blame Dumbledore.
At the beginning, he made his own claim to let James temporarily replace the candidate, without telling anyone, and indirectly killed James and Lily, so the result today is completely self-inflicted.
"Thank you for your understanding..." Dumbledore sighed, stood up, and said to the crowd.
"Then, I think it's time to solve this misunderstanding, and go to the auditorium with me!"
"Great, Sirius, you finally don't have to hide anymore!" Harry suddenly turned his head to look at Sirius, his face full of joy.
Sirius was also very happy. He was tracked by the Ministry of Magic before, and it was difficult to worry about being afraid every day.
More importantly, after getting rid of the status of the fugitive, he can meet Harry with integrity!
He heard from Ivan that the uncle's family who adopted Harry was not good to Harry, and he might be able to let Harry move in to live with him at that time...
The only one who was unhappy was Peter. Although he was still in the form of a mouse, his body was already weakened. The whole mouse looked sluggish. He knew he was completely finished...
Afterwards, Dumbledore greeted everyone to go to the auditorium, but when he was about to go out, he suddenly looked at Ivan.
"Hals, you stay here. The letters and things on the table are for you. After you finish reading the letters, you will come to the auditorium to gather..."
"I think you should understand what's going on!" Dumbledore added, blinking at him before leaving.
Ivan watched the crowd go away, confused.
He looked at the letter and the time converter on the table, thought for a while, first picked up the time converter and put it in the pocket of the wizard's robe, and then opened the envelope.
Inside the envelope, there is a list, a few letters, and a small bottle with a pinch of white hair...
Ivan became even more puzzled. After checking one by one, some names were written in the list, and the titles were specially marked below. They were all high-ranking officials of the court and the Ministry of Magic who had a good relationship with Dumbledore.
And those letters only signed Dumbledore's name at the end, the content was blank, only one letter was written...
Ivan had read the contents of the letter in a temper His complexion became more and more ugly, and he almost slapped the table and scolded his mother with anger!
Dumbledore stated in the letter that he had known what happened here through the time converter, but now he was doing a very important thing and could not get out of it for the time being.
In view of the fact that Ivan has done very well before, Dumbledore is very pleased, so he said that Ivan will be asked to deal with school matters temporarily, and he believes that Ivan can handle it properly.
When necessary, Ivan can borrow his identity to act.
The old professor applied magic on the remaining few letters. Putting the magic wand on the blank envelope could convert the contents of his mind into words, and he had already signed the names in advance.
During this period, Fox will obey the command and use it to send letters to those old friends and get some help.
Finally, at the end, Dumbledore bluntly said that he would come back to see when the court started.
By the way, Ivan will bring a surprise...

chapters.title: Chapter 430: Ivan: Dumbledore, your uncle!
chapters.content:
I am pleasantly surprised by your uncle! "Ivan patted the table and scolded angrily.
He tossed for so long just to throw this pot to Dumbledore, and he was a salted fish in the back, but he didn't expect that the pot would be thrown back after going around!
As for how Dumbledore knew what was happening here, Ivan guessed that it might have something to do with the time converter.
With a time converter, he couldn't even determine in which time period the letter was sent by Dumbledore...
How much did the other party know.
As for the surprise that Dumbledore said in the letter, Ivan didn't catch a cold at all.
He has done so many great things in the past few years, and as a result, Dumbledore adds points every time except for extra points. There is really nothing new in Dumbledore!
If Dumbledore could give Phoenix Fox to himself, or reward himself with a Philosopher’s Stone, it would be almost the same.
Thinking of this, Ivan sighed, then grabbed the small bottle on the table and opened it.
"This is... Dumbledore's beard?" Ivan pinched a piece of white hair and looked at it, and said with certainty.
Dumbledore sent this here, probably to facilitate the use of the compound decoction.
However, it seems that the old principal is not all-knowing and omnipotent. He miscalculated this time. He doesn't need a compound decoction to be like him...
Ivan touched his chin, suddenly thought of something, and suddenly understood.
No wonder he felt that Dumbledore was weird just now. It turned out to be disguised by himself using the blood magic Bogut transformation in the future.
Wait, if I am Dumbledore, can I give myself extra points?
Ivan realized this right away. Although he didn't know what the surprise Dumbledore was talking about, he could give himself benefits and add hundreds to thousands of points!
The grade point is not going up...
In addition, Phoenix is ​​now his own!
Ivan turned his head abruptly to look at Phoenix Fox, who was dormantly resting on the olive branch. He always wanted to get Phoenix's blood, only because Dumbledore hadn't had a chance.
Now Dumbledore actually brought the Phoenix to the door...
Perhaps I felt something wrong in Ivan's eyes when he was looking at him. Fox, who was combing his golden red feathers with his beak, suddenly exploded, and a bluff of flames appeared on his body, expressing a warning.
Ivan shook his head helplessly. It seemed that this phoenix still had a temper, and it had to be considered long-term.
"But what about Sirius?"
Compared with the benefits brought by the principal's status, Ivan is even more troublesome.
Dumbledore left him with a list of obvious meanings, implying that he could bypass the Ministry of Magic by writing to persuade the court to reverse the case.
However, no matter how fast the action of the trial court is, it will never be held for a retrial tomorrow. It must go through procedures.
During this period, the Ministry of Magic will definitely get news, so he still has to find a way to put pressure on the people of the Ministry, so as not to make any small actions in private.
The more Ivan thought about it, the more headaches he got, and Dumbledore was so heartbroken that he actually threw all the things he had to rehabilitate Sirius to him.
What kind of things are more important than this?
Ivan thought worriedly, and then shook his head again. Dumbledore, as the strongest man in the magic world today, is unlikely to have any problems. Instead, it is more troublesome that he is right here...
While thinking about the plan, Ivan packed up the letters on the table, and then left the principal's room straight to the auditorium.
At this time wasted, the professors of various subjects had already followed the instructions and called the little wizards from the four major colleges to the auditorium.
It seemed very lively here for a while, and the students talked about what happened. When they learned that it was Principal Dumbledore who called them here, everyone was relieved.
A few days ago, Sirius sneaked into the Gryffindor dormitory, and the dementors rioted collectively. Coupled with the fact that Dumbledore, who was the mainstay, had not returned, the whole Hogwarts was panicked.
Now that they know that the principal has returned, the heart that they have been holding is finally let go...
Ivan who entered the auditorium heard these remarks and immediately felt pressured. Now only he in Hogwarts knows that Dumbledore on stage is a fake!
"Halse, here!"
At Gryffindor's seat, George and Fred were waving at him. After Ivan walked over, they couldn't wait to get up and asked.
"I heard that Sirius was caught, is this true?"
"Why do you think so?" Ivan said strangely.
"Because someone saw many professors rushing to the same place, and now they are all coming back together, so we suspect that the professors must have caught Sirius!" George said swearingly.
Sorry, they weren't going to arrest people, they were arrested!
Ivan shook his head with a weird face, and did not answer their doubts, only to shirk what Professor Dumbledore would say later.
George and Fred didn't want to reveal anything about Ivan, so they had to give up.
Not long after, "Dumbledore", who was talking to the professors on the stage, walked up to the stage, pointed his magic wand to his throat, and spoke under the blessing of a loud curse.
"quiet!"
The loud voice spread throughout the auditorium, attracting the attention of the little wizards below, condensing countless eyes on the stands.
Dumbledore cleared his throat and continued.
"I believe everyone should have read the announcement issued by the Ministry of Magic and learned about Blake, the Azkaban fugitive, but I think what you know may not be comprehensive enough! Things need to start with the Wizarding War more than ten years ago. Speaking..."
Dumbledore’s voice suddenly changed to tell the story of the Wizarding War It made the little wizards feel strange, but they were quickly attracted by the story Dumbledore told and were immersed in Up among them.
When it was learned that Harry's parents were being hunted down for resisting the Dark Lord, the little wizards of the four major colleges were all talking, with a worried look on their faces.
It wasn't until Dumbledore opened his mouth that the James and Wife used a powerful magic to protect the residence, that everyone was relieved.
"Professor, if this is the case, how did Harry's parents die?" Several brave little Gryffindor wizards plucked up the courage to ask.
Other people also cast doubtful glances. Many people in the magic world knew that Harry's parents had died at the hands of mysterious people.
If the magic is as powerful as Dumbledore said, it can make the mysterious people not be able to find a trace, then how did they die?
"Because someone became a betrayer and told Voldemort where James was hiding!" Dumbledore said without hesitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 431: Debunking Peter Pettigrew
chapters.content:
Hearing Dumbledore directly naming the man's name, the little wizards on the court suddenly panicked.
But thinking that the person the Dark Lord feared the most was standing in the stands at this moment, they felt a lot more relieved, and turned to discuss who the shameful betrayer was.
"It must be Black!" Percy immediately thought of Black who was running away, and suddenly said loudly.
More and more people have guessed this, and they are angrily speaking against Black, all thinking that he is a shameful villain...
"Yes, many people thought so in the past, including me!" Dumbledore paused when he said, and his tone became elevated, he continued.
"However, after my investigation, the betrayer was someone else. The Ministry of Magic made a very wrong decision. They imprisoned Black directly in Azkaban without trial!"
"Based on this, I need to apologize to Mr. Black, because this is also part of my mistake!" Dumbledore added at last.
After Dumbledore's words were over, there was a dead silence on the court. All the little wizards were surprised and speechless. They even wondered if they had heard it wrong?
Is Sirius wanted by the Ministry of Magic actually innocent?
How is this possible?
Obviously Blake sneaked into the castle a few days ago, intending to kill Harry...
Countless questions shrouded in my heart, and the students present were all talking about it, even if this was from Dumbledore's mouth, there were not a few people who questioned it.
After all, the notice issued by the Ministry of Magic had brainwashed them for several months, and this inherent impression would be difficult to change for a while.
"quiet!"
Seeing the scene getting more chaotic, Dumbledore cleared his throat and once again attracted everyone's attention.
"I know this news is too shocking, and you may have a lot of doubts, but it is a bit inappropriate to explain it to me, so I think it is better to let the person concerned come up and explain it!"
As he said, Dumbledore clapped his hands, and the closed door of the auditorium was suddenly opened!
Shi Shiran, Sirius wearing a black robe, walked in from the door and walked step by step from the aisle in front of the long table of the four colleges to the front, still holding a frantically struggling mouse in his right hand.
Harry followed him nervously.
Although Sirius at this time was different from the embarrassed appearance on the notice, but combined with Dumbledore's previous words, there were still many clever little wizards who guessed it all at once.
"He's the fugitive Black!" Seamus who was sitting in the front row couldn't help screaming in surprise.
The walking Sirius couldn't help turning his head and glanced at him. Seamus suddenly shivered, but Seamus soon realized that Sirius just smiled gently at him, and didn't say anything...
Seamus was relieved now.
The rest of the students were also afraid of the sudden appearance of Sirius.
Fortunately, many interested people also noticed Harry's existence, and a series of voices soon sounded underneath.
"That Black was with Harry. It seems that what Professor Dumbledore said should be true..."
"Is the Ministry of Magic really wrong? They actually imprisoned an innocent person in Azkaban for more than ten years? He is wanted now?"
.......
In the midst of everyone's discussion, Sirius and Harry were already on the stands, Dumbledore leaned to the side and gave up the center position.
Harry stepped forward nervously, and said courageously in front of everyone.
"What Professor Dumbledore said just now is true! I used to be the same as you. I thought Blake was an out-and-out murderer and hated him for revealing the whereabouts of my parents to Voldemort..."
Harry spoke more and more smoothly, and the words revealed by his true feelings were very contagious and won the approval of many people.
"So... Sirius is not only not a murderer, but a hero who has resisted Voldemort and Death Eaters! The real betrayer is Peter Pettigrew, another friend of my father's.
In order to confuse Voldemort, Sirius is willing to act as a decoy on the surface to attract the attention of the Death Eaters, but privately, he agreed with Peter to replace the secret person's identity! "
Harry told everything he knew in one go.
"But Peter Pettigrew is dead!" A little Hufflepuff wizard stood up suddenly, retorted, and continued.
"My mother once told me that he was very incompetent but brave at the critical moment. After that happened, he went to chase Black by himself, and was killed by Black!"
"No, it's not like that... kid!"
Sirius, who had been silent for a long time, finally spoke. He looked at the little Hufflepuff wizard and felt that the other party was probably the heir of an old friend, so that he could understand the past in this way.
But this is not the time to think about it, so Sirius quickly replied. "Peter Pettigrew did not die, but hid silently. Now I have caught him, he is here!"
Sirius threw the mouse in his hand, and then waved his magic wand, and a dazzling light hit the spotted body.
The rat screamed wildly, and then quickly transformed into a short and bald middle-aged wizard in front of everyone.
The little wizards sitting nearby squeezed behind in fear...
Dumbledore waved his magic wand to tie Peter up and said, pointing at him.
"As you can see Peter Pettigrew is an undocumented Animagus. He concealed himself from the sky by transforming into a mouse, confusing the Ministry of Magic and all of us! And hiding in one In the wizard’s family for more than ten years, he eventually became Mr. Weasley’s pet..."
When some knowledgeable little wizards heard this, they turned their heads to look at Ron. Many of Gryffindor’s little wizards have seen Ron playing with his big mouse on different occasions, even when taking a bath. With.
Ron stood up with a tired expression, nodded, confirming this.
On the other side, Percy Weasley suddenly changed his face, and Zebra followed him for a while as a pet. Fortunately, he threw this nasty mouse to Ron a few years ago...
"Oh my god, this is so disgusting!" George looked at Peter, who was dirty and short and fat, and felt a chill in his heart when he thought that Peter had been at home for so long without being noticed.
"Yes! Mom will be scared to death if she learns this news!"
Fred was even more frightened. You must know that they had teased Peter and used it to do various interesting experiments. It is really not easy for him to live till now...

chapters.title: Chapter 432: Ivan: Stop pretending, I am the best Hogwarts ever...
chapters.content:
No, not so! Black is lying! They are liars...I am innocent! "
Peter trembling slightly in the middle of the aisle, facing everyone's disgust, suspicion, and contempt, he opened his mouth to try to explain.
Sirius sneered and lifted Peter up, and then he took off his clothes directly!
"Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!
"This is the Dark Mark, the proof of Death Eaters!" Black said, pointing to the skull mark on Peter's left arm.
The shape of the black mark is very peculiar, like a serpentine snake crawling out of the big mouth of the skull, forming an inner ring of eight characters on the arm, lifelike, just looking at it makes people cold.
A little wizard in the front row even fell from his seat in horror, and the other students were too scared to speak.
"Mr. Black is right. This is the Dark Mark! Maybe you have never seen this before, but I think your parents must remember this! This is why I am so sure that Peter is a betrayer!"
Dumbledore said in a deep voice, then looked at Sirius and continued. "Mr. Black, please also fix Peter's clothes. Don't scare the children..."
Sirius nodded, then violently pulled Peter's clothes back, and spit on the way!
At the same time that Peter's identity was revealed, Ivan quietly watched the drama below, feeling the mystery of time in his heart.
He had just thought out a specific plan for a public opinion offensive against the Ministry of Magic in the principal's office.
Now that I walk into the auditorium and sit down, my future self will use the identity of Dumbledore to realize all of this envisioned...
But according to the script, that time will come soon, right?
Thinking of this, Ivan straightened his clothes and made preparations, lest he couldn't help but laugh later...
Sure enough, after condemning Peter for a while, Dumbledore suddenly changed his voice and said solemnly.
"This matter can be resolved satisfactorily, thanks to one person! He is the best student ever at Hogwarts and the youngest Merlin Medal recipient!
It was he who discovered the abnormality of the mouse and found out the truth through clues. It can be said that without him, the entire magical world would be kept in the dark, and Mr. Black would not be able to get rid of it! "
Although Dumbledore did not directly name the person, as far as they knew, only one person met these conditions.
Everyone cast their eyes on Ivan, and Dumbledore shouted loudly at this time.
"Ivan Hals!"
Ivan stood up in the eyes of everyone looking up, bowed slightly, looked at Dumbledore very modestly, and spoke.
"Professor Dumbledore, in fact, I just did some small work and fulfilled my obligation as an excellent student!"
Having said this, Ivan turned his gaze to Peter and continued righteously.
"In addition, as a member of the Merlin Knights, I will never tolerate the honor of a shameful traitor receiving the Merlin Medal because of suspended animation, and enjoy the praise of everyone! So I must make his true face public!"
Under the influence of the powerful curse, Ivan's words spread throughout the auditorium, and also to the ears of every little wizard, and thunderous applause soon rang out on the court.
Malfoy sitting in Slytherin College was angry and jealous.
I originally discovered the identity of Lupin's werewolf wizard, and caught Ivan and others secretly having a private meeting with the fugitive Black from the Ministry of Magic, and now I stand up and accept the applause. It should be my own right! ????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????
But how could things suddenly become like this?
Sirius was so whitewashed, Ivan became a hero even more, and he was busy for a long time not only did not get anything, but was scolded by Snape for passing on misinformation...
Dumbledore applauded on the stage, and when everyone had stopped a little, he spoke. "In view of Hals' contribution, I want to add three hundred points to Gryffindor!"
Three hundred points? !
The little wizards sitting in the audience were speechless. This was definitely the highest single bonus in Hogwarts' history!
A joyful smile appeared on Ivan's face, because he had just heard the system's prompt, and his grade point also increased by 300 points!
This proves that it is possible to add points to yourself!
The only thing that disappointed Ivan was that he didn't get the title of legend as an outstanding student. He brags to himself for so long in vain...
However, Ivan quickly adjusted and gave Dumbledore on stage a wink, indicating that the extra points were successful and hurry up to make persistent efforts...
There was a helpless expression on Dumbledore's face.
Ivan curled his lips. What kind of costume would you add to yourself? You are the principal, can you just find any reason?
Dumbledore then continued to face everyone and said.
"I have to apologize to Mr. Hals here! I believe everyone still remembers that I once penalized Hals for some things. Only now have I realized that it was a complete misunderstanding, so...Glan Fendor adds one hundred points!"
While talking, Dumbledore used the old magic wand to point lightly at the scoring pool placed in the large exhibition hall, which represented that Gryffindor's had risen again by a bit, and it was almost overflowing.
The little wizards of the three major colleges saw Gryffindor’s soaring points, and they were a little desperate for a while It seems that this year’s Academy Cup was taken over by Gryffindor again...
Several professors on the stage frowned, looked at Dumbledore and stopped talking. They thought if the points were added too much this time...
Ivan also had a dark face, because this time when the points were added, there was no movement in the system, which also meant that it was invalid...
Ivan hurriedly looked at the old professor on the stage in confusion, and asked what was going on with his eyes.
Dumbledore shook his head slightly. This is why he felt helpless before. Knowing that the extra points were useless, he even had to deal with the professors’ suspicions after a while, but he had to do...
After the communication was fruitless, Ivan sighed and sat down, wondering what the reward mechanism of the system was...
Dumbledore didn't pay attention to him anymore, and turned to Harry, Ron, and Hermione, and began to commend them one by one for their achievements, each adding a ten and twenty points to fool.
Strictly speaking, after all, Harry and the others just walked through the scene and did nothing. If you give a high score, the little wizards of other colleges are afraid that they will raise the table collectively to protest the injustice...

chapters.title: Chapter 433: Thanks for the firebolt sent by fugitive Black?
chapters.content:
So, that's all I need to say tonight! If you have any doubts, you can write to your parents and ask about related matters..."
After all the things to be said were clearly explained, Dumbledore signaled that the meeting was disbanded and they could go back to rest.
Several prefects immediately stood up and greeted the little wizards of their respective academies to return to the lounge.
Along the way, almost all the little wizards were talking about Sirius and Peter, and it didn't work for the prefects to scold them, and finally joined the discussion together.
No way, the news that Dumbledore just announced was amazing!
"Do you really believe what Professor Dumbledore said? Black is not a fugitive but a hero?"
"Why don't you believe it, Professor Dumbledore has made it very clear, and even Harry has come forward to explain, he will never even make a mistake for his enemy? And the mark of the Dark Demon, it is really scary! "
"But how could the Ministry of Magic make a mistake? Before I came to school, my mother told me to be careful not to run around so as to avoid encountering Black..."
......
Under the tremendous shock and controversy, after returning to the dormitory, many little wizards spontaneously wrote letters, wrote down this amazing thing and sent home, soliciting opinions...
Ever since owls flew out of Hogwarts with letters...
And at this moment in Gryffindor's lounge, Ivan, who was standing by the window watching all this, nodded secretly, which was no different from what he had expected before.
He publicly announced Sirius at Hogwarts, hoping to win the attention of the parents of the students.
Of course, this is not enough, he has to be caught off guard by the Ministry of Magic!
It's best to wait for Fudge to get up to work tomorrow morning, the Sirius matter has spread throughout the magical world!
To achieve this, the help of the Daily Prophet is indispensable!
But this newspaper has always been the mouthpiece of the Ministry of Magic, and the original time and space has caused Harry and others a lot of trouble...
While Ivan was leaning against the bed and thinking about his ideas, there was laughter in the Gryffindor lounge.
Sirius, who had been cleared of suspicion in the auditorium before, came to the Gryffindor lounge as a guest at Harry's invitation and the acquiescence of "Dumbledore".
It's just that many young lions are still a little afraid of Black because of the rumors, only Harry and others are closer to him.
"Mr. Black, can you tell us how you defeated the mysterious man and his army?" Hermione suddenly thought of this and asked curiously.
"If you want to listen, of course it's okay!" Sirius nodded, thinking this is a good opportunity to get closer.
Dumbledore once told him when he was in the auditorium, let him gain the trust of these students as much as possible, so as to influence the parents of these students.
In short, the more people pay attention to the trial, the less the Ministry of Magic dared to engage in small moves, which is why he came here.
Thinking of this, Sirius cleared his throat and organized the language to begin to tell the story of the year.
Of course, since the existence of the Order of the Phoenix is ​​a secret, these little wizards don’t need to know it, so in the story of Sirius it was changed to a spontaneous civil resistance group...
Although there are some minor changes, all the stories are true. Coupled with Sirius's fairly good eloquence, Harry and the others listened with gusto for a while and were immersed in it.
At the same time, a large number of little wizards of Gryffindor were also attracted by the story.
At first they dared to sit far and listen. As Sirius spoke deeper and deeper, they soon got closer and closer, and finally squeezed to the side with a small stool.
For a while, everyone forgot that Black was still a murderous fugitive in their minds yesterday.
No way, the intense and exciting adventures in Sirius’s mouth are really in line with their appetite. The story is against powerful and evil mysterious people who have almost no resistance.
Especially after hearing Sirius talk about the evil acts of the Death Eaters wanton killing and destroying, everyone's emotions were aroused. They are very angry, and they want to jump into the story and teach those Death Eaters severely!
Sirius just smiled on his face, but in his heart he shook his head secretly. Only living in that era can understand how difficult those Death Eaters are to deal with, but having this intention is good after all!
"I heard my grandma say that my parents also participated in the fight against the Death Eaters. Is this true?" Neville asked weakly, sitting in the corner.
"Yes, that's right! They are all great heroes! They are the most steadfast resisters!" Sirius looked at Neville and sighed silently and continued.
"Unfortunately, after the fall of the mysterious man, some crazy Death Eaters caught your parents in order to learn about the whereabouts of the mysterious man, and tortured them with the piercing curse! Your parents were very strong, no matter Nothing was revealed, but the mind was greatly affected..."
Listening to Sirius, Neville was already curled up in the corner and sobbed silently. Many Gryffindor wizards comforted him sympathetically and gave him spiritual encouragement.
The story of Sirius also slowly came to the end. He began to talk about what happened before and after Harry was born. It also mentioned that he was negotiating with James. After Harry was born, he would be Harry's godfather...
"Wait, you just said that you are still my godfather?" Harry heard this and interrupted Sirius's words, looking at him with some surprises and surprises.
"Yeah! This was agreed with James before you were born!" Sirius nodded solemnly, and then asked again as if thinking of something.
"By the way, Harry, do you still like the Firebolt I gave you before?"
"That Firebolt was actually given by you!" Harry was surprised, he looked at Ivan suddenly, "but I thought Professor Dumbledore gave it?"
"Dumbledore? Why do you think so? Didn't you tell him the truth? Ivan?" Sirius turned his head to look at Ivan, and said a little unhappy.
"Then what can I say? Azkaban's fugitive Sirius Black sent two broomsticks? You know you didn't have a good image in Harry's heart at that time..."
Ivan, who was leaning against the window, was interrupted by his thoughts. He turned his head helplessly, but he managed to get rid of the lie.

chapters.title: Chapter 434: Phoenix Messenger
chapters.content:
Sirius whispered for a while, he didn't think so much when he was shopping, just wondering if Harry would be happy.
"It's great..." Harry said suddenly.
"What?" Before Sirius could react, Harry rushed forward and hugged him.
"I mean I like the Firebolt you gave it so much. It's great! That's the best gift I have ever received!" Harry said with his arms around Sirius, both excited and choked.
In just one day, Harry's emotions were like riding a roller coaster, constantly ups and downs, and just after solving the misunderstanding, he found that he still had a godfather! One more family member!
Harry was overjoyed, which meant that he could leave his annoying uncle's family in the future and move out to live.
This is almost something he dreams about in his dreams at night...
Sirius also smiled and hugged Harry, and the two soon talked about the parents from the past, mainly because Harry complained about the unfair treatment he received at Dursley's house!
For example, Vernon and Petunia let him live in a storage room, wear old clothes, occasionally punished him for not having dinner, and repeatedly prevented him from entering Hogwarts to learn magic.
There is also the annoying little fat Dun Dudley. When he was in Muggle school, he often bullied him with some friends and friends...
"How dare they do this to you? Didn't Dumbledore pay attention to your life after sending you there?"
Sirius, who learned of Harry's life experience, was very angry, and immediately threatened to teach them a lesson after he reversed the case and returned to freedom!
Harry didn't care much about what happened back then, but when he heard Sirius's remarks, his heart was still warm.
"By the way, Sirius! When this summer vacation, can I move in to live with you?"
Harry asked expectantly, and then quickly thought of something, then quickly added.
"Oh, I almost forgot. You just escaped from Azkaban and you were removed from your family again. Maybe you don't have your own house yet. But it doesn't matter, we can rent a house..."
In Harry’s view, even wandering outside is better than living at Dursley’s, not to mention that he still has the assets left behind by his parents. Sirius can live with him in the Broken Cauldron Bar. As for starving and freezing.
"No...no need to do this, Harry! I have my own residence, a very big house, and I don't lack money, otherwise, how could I buy you Firebolt." Sirius laughed Got up.
Although he was expelled from the Black family list, as the other living members of Black were all witches, and either married or imprisoned in Azkaban, he was still the first heir of the Black family and had the right to dominate the family’s ownership. the property of!
That's money he and Harry can't spend all their lives...
"That's great!" Harry jumped in excitement.
Sirius is also very happy. He is also thinking about a better life in the future. The suffering he has experienced before seems not so unacceptable...
Ivan, who was watching from the side, understood that Harry and Sirius' ideas might be frustrated, and Dumbledore would not be able to let Harry move.
Because Harry can strengthen Lily's protective magic as long as he stays with his relatives, so that Voldemort can't hurt him.
Ivan was not disappointed and said it now. It would be nice to please Harry and Sirius for a few days...
After a bit of conversation, seeing that it was getting late, Harry and the others, who were still thinking about it, even planned to invite Sirius to sleep in their dormitory for one night.
"That won't work, Sirius went to the staff lounge and looked at Peter so that he wouldn't run away!" Before Sirius could answer, Ivan shook his head and interrupted Harry's thoughts.
"Sorry, Harry! Your Professor Dumbledore asked me to follow Hals' instructions when I was in the lounge..." Sirius shrugged helplessly.
Sirius didn't feel surprised about Dumbledore's order, because he suspected that Dumbledore might deliberately want to cultivate Ivan as his heir.
After all, Ivan's magical talent and adaptability, Sirius, are impressive. This is not like a thirteen-year-old wizard should have... even he is ashamed of it.
Even Dumbledore and the mysterious man may not be so good when they were young...
Sirius sighed silently in his heart,
Harry looked a little disappointed. He still wanted to talk to Sirius in the dormitory tonight before going to bed. He had a lot to say...
"The day will be long, Harry!" Sirius laughed happily, seeing Harry's reluctance. "It's never too late to say anything tomorrow, we can meet every day!"
Harry nodded. He also understood that the most important thing was to take care of Peter, so he didn't say anything.
Ivan heaved a sigh of relief when he saw the two of them so familiar.
It was only his excuse to let Sirius watch Peter. Ivan had arranged for Dobby to watch Peter all the time.
And considering that Dobby's limited IQ might be fooled, Ivan even ordered Dobby to give Peter a coma spell every two hours to ensure that Peter would not wake up anyway.
So Peter is impossible to escape. He left Sirius because he might have to do something these days and nights. Sirius is not as foolish as Harry, Ron and the others!
When Sirius left the Gryffindor lounge, Ivan, who had already figured out a follow-up plan, used Dumbledore to find something to do, said goodbye to Harry and others, and went to the principal's office alone.
"Pile of cockroaches!"
As Ivan pronounced the password to enter the principal's room the door of the passage slowly opened.
Ivan strode out of the principal’s room, took out the magic letter sent by Dumbledore from the drawer of the central desk, put his wand on the blank letter, and typed it slowly. magic.
Faint ink began to emerge from the parchment paper, and the lines connected together to form individual words.
That was Dumbledore's handwriting, and even the content on it was automatically polished, and it was explained in Dumbledore's usual tone.
"It's really convenient and dangerous magic..." Ivan looked at this magical scene and couldn't help but sigh. If the letter is accidentally obtained by someone else, wouldn't the other party also use Dumbledore's Acting on your identity...
However, some amazing news and very outrageous suggestions must be sent by Phoenix Fox, so that people can be 100% convinced that this is from Dumbledore...
After all, in the entire magical world, only Dumbledore can use a phoenix as a messenger!

chapters.title: Chapter 435: Give Dumbledore a "surprise"!
chapters.content:
"Fox, come here!" After finishing the letter, Ivan packed the envelopes one by one and folded them aside, then beckoned to the phoenix on the olive branch.
Fox flapped his wings and flew to the table in front of Ivan, looking at the envelopes curiously.
"Did you see this list? Send the letters in the order above, understand?" Ivan pointed to the list that Dumbledore had left him, and said.
Fox nodded and held a letter, and then a golden-red flame appeared all over his body, and the bird and the letter disappeared into the principal's room in the next moment.
It didn't take long for Fox to come back again, to write the next letter again, and the cycle repeated.
"It's really efficient!" Seeing that in just ten minutes, Fox used the teleport feature to send half of the letters, and Ivan became more and more interested in Phoenix's blood.
But now is not the time to take blood, because the legendary value he has now only has two points. Even if he is given enough Phoenix blood, he cannot complete the fourth blood fusion ceremony.
And if the blood of a magical creature is not preserved by special means, its activity will be greatly reduced if it is left for more than three days, and the effect of fusion will be greatly reduced...
Thinking of this, Ivan had to sigh and temporarily put the plan of fusion of Phoenix blood aside, concentrated on doing business, took out the time converter from his pocket, and started to gently turn the golden hourglass on it.
Along with the turning of the hourglass of time,
The surrounding scenes froze directly, and then quickly began to change, everything seemed to be going away...
For the sake of safety, avoid triggering the protection mechanism when doing important things, and being forcibly kicked back to the original time and space, Ivan stuck at the upper limit of the safety range and only turned five times...
Since the time to look back was not long this time, Ivan was not affected much. When the surroundings returned to normal, Ivan immediately turned his head and glanced at the clock hanging in the principal's room.
It's about four o'clock in the afternoon, and the evening sun is shining through the windows in the principal's office. The desk in the center is also empty, there is nothing...
"Wait, then, the letter and the time converter have not been sent over at this time?"
Ivan was keenly aware of this, and he suddenly realized that if he stayed here for a while, wouldn't he be able to catch Dumbledore who placed these things?
Evanton, who was dissatisfied with the old professor's throwing the pot, gave him a bright light, and immediately ignored other things, and hung in an ambush in the principal's office.
Anyway, if time is wasted, just look back again. The most important thing he lacks is time!
However, it took more than half an hour to wait like this. Just as Ivan was a little impatient, a fire suddenly appeared in the fireplace in the principal's room, and a group of golden-red flames rose high...
There was a hint of excitement in Ivan's heart, but what made him a little dumbfounded was that only golden-red birds came out of the flames.
It was holding a thick letter on its feet, and the time converter with faint fluorescence was hung on its neck, with an elderberry wand in its mouth...
After seeing Ivan, Fox hurriedly flew over, screamed happily in his mouth, and the wand he was holding fell directly.
Ivan subconsciously held the wand in his hand, and the corners of his mouth twitched. Dumbledore was too cruel. All these important things were thrown to Fox, and he didn't show up at all...
"You are not benevolent, don't blame me for being unrighteous..." Ivan pondered inwardly.
Since Dumbledore said in his letter that he would bring himself a surprise when he returns, then he can also prepare a surprise for the other party!
Ivan raised his hand to untie the time converter and letter on Fox, and threw it on the desk.
Then Ivan took out an envelope with the content already written from the pocket of the wizard robe and stuffed it into Fox's mouth.
"Help me send a letter to Rita Skeeter of the Daily Prophet, asking her to immediately and immediately put down all of her work and come to see me at the Broken Cauldron Bar!" Ivan said.
......
In the evening, the cauldron bar was very noisy, and there was a smell of alcohol everywhere.
As the boss, Tom enthusiastically entertained every customer. The bar was filled with empty beer bottles, laughing, and the atmosphere seemed very harmonious.
Rita Skeeter, who entered it, looked at all this in disgust. As a cultivated lady, she had never liked this chaotic place.
"Damn kid!" Rita Skeeter cursed secretly in her heart. If the other party threatened her with that thing, she wouldn't have to leave her work and come to this place without finishing her work.
"Would you like a butterbeer? Ms. Skeeter?" The boss Tom seemed to be a little drunk, and he looked at Rita with a big smile and greeted him.
"No need." Rita Skeeter arrogantly rejected Tom's proposal, and then asked again. "Where is Room 7? Someone asked me to discuss something..."
"Well... go upstairs and turn right to the second room!" Tom shrugged and replied Rita Sky nodded and walked up to the second floor to find the corresponding house number. No., complained while opening the door to enter.
"Halse, what do you want me to do, don't expect to threaten me with that thing..."
But waiting to see the people waiting inside, Rita Skeeter's pupils shrank slightly, and she stammered.
"Albus Dumbledore?"
At this time, Ivan had already disguised himself as Dumbledore, and it was a bit funny to see Rita Skeeter startled.
On the surface, Ivan still had that calm expression, he looked at Rita Skeeter and nodded slightly. "Yes, I asked Hals to write to you to come here to talk about things..."
Rita Skeeter only remembered at this time. Although the previous letter was written by Ivan’s little devil’s head, when she saw the envelope, there was a golden red feather on it...
She can't help but panic, can't imagine what it is like, so big people like Dumbledore need to be so careful...
Why did the other party go around such a big circle to meet him?
Rita Skeeter didn’t know that Ivan did this purely to save Dumbledore’s magic letter to him...
"So... did you ask me for something that you need me to help?" Rita Skeeter was very aware of current affairs, and quickly adjusted her mood, smirking and sat opposite Ivan.
"Everything I need to tell you is written on it, let's take a look!" Ivan turned the parchment on the table over and pushed it in front of Rita Skeeter.

chapters.title: Chapter 436: what? Dumbledore is going to be Minister of Magic!
chapters.content:
Rita Skeeter picked up the parchment and scanned it a few times with a look of confusion, the expression on her face instantly solidified, and then turned into a shocking color.
"This...is it true?" Rita Skeeter's tone was weird, she couldn't tell whether it was excitement or panic, or both.
"I can assure you, it's true! We have caught Peter Pettigrew and found the Dark Mark on his left arm."
Ivan nodded, then chuckled and teased again. "I think this should be good news material, right? Tomorrow's Daily Prophet may need to print a few more copies..."
Rita Skeeter's hands holding the parchment were shaking. Out of the intuition of a news editor, she could imagine how big a sensation would be if such news spread!
But then Rita Skeeter seemed to be aware of something again, and her excited expression suddenly cooled down.
"What's the matter?" Ivan keenly noticed the change in Rita Skeeter's expression, and asked suspiciously.
"You should know that. I'm just a small newspaper reporter. Although I can write an article and publish it in the Daily Prophet, it must be reviewed by the editor-in-chief... They won't let me publish it. What the Ministry of Magic said..." Rita Skeeter raised her eyes and replied disappointedly.
As a reporter, Rita Skeeter is very interested in this kind of heavyweight news material, but she knows what she can and cannot write after she has been working for many years.
Like the gossip news of some well-known wizards, the chaotic private life of a senior official is part of the content that can be reported.
And if the Sirius incident is reported this time, it will attack the entire Ministry of Magic, and it will easily get into unnecessary trouble.
She doesn't want to lose her current newspaper job...
Rita Skeeter's attitude made Ivan somewhat surprised. After thinking about it carefully, he quickly understood the other's concerns.
Ivan put his hands on the table and followed Dumbledore's way of staring at Rita Skeeter with the blue eyes under the half moon glasses.
Rita Skeeter suddenly felt a great deal of pressure.
She was worried that the Ministry of Magic might liquidate herself, but now she suddenly realized that the character in front of her was not a simple character, but the strongest and most prestigious wizard in the magic world.
The other party pinched himself to death like a bug...
Just when Rita Skeeter was in a dilemma, Ivan suddenly said something. "Do you think Fudge can stay in that position safely after this incident?"
"What?" Rita Skeeter didn't react for a while.
"I have notified some old friends in the trial court to hear this case. Even without your report, I can relay it to many wizard families through Hogwarts students. Now this news should have spread... ." Ivan continued on his own.
Ivan’s smooth tone passed through Rita Skeeter’s ears, but she set off a huge wave, her pupils shrunk, and she looked at the kind-looking centenarian in front of her in disbelief with a chill. The soles of the feet went straight to my heart...
She keenly felt that she was in a whirlpool, and she even regretted coming here today.
Of course Rita Skeeter knows what the other party said.
That is telling myself plainly that the other party intends to use this incident to oust Minister of Magic Fudge, and has a very complete plan.
Whether the Daily Prophet is willing to help will not affect the overall situation, but if they do not satisfy the strongest white wizard this time, they will probably be liquidated in the future...
It took several minutes for Rita Skeeter to completely digest the information. She swallowed and couldn't help asking.
"Do you really intend to take up the post of Minister of Magic?"
Ivan did not answer positively, but rather stated that he was very dissatisfied with the recent performance of the Ministry of Magic...
In fact, Ivan did not tell lies, this is exactly his attitude towards the Ministry of Magic.
Both the original time and space and the current Ministry of Magic are the same decadent and incompetent. Some clues can be seen from the fact that the dementors broke into the Quidditch stadium out of control.
The officials sent by the Ministry of Magic did not want to deal with it, but used various inexplicable reasons to prevaricate, trying to deny the dementor’s uncontrollable attack on the students...
Such repeated self-deception and deception made Ivan very tired.
There is no need for a messy Ministry of Magic to exist, so he wanted to try to see if he could use this opportunity to blast Fudge down and replace Dumbledore as the Minister of Magic.
This is not impossible!
In the original time and space, Dumbledore was so passive in the face of the suppression of the Ministry of Magic. One of the important reasons is that after confirming that Voldemort has been resurrected, the old principal did not want to engage in internal friction with the Ministry...
In addition, he is a rule-abiding person, facing the Ministry of Magic's natural weakness, he will be forced to leave school temporarily.
I don’t have so many appointments now...
Even though Ivan didn’t say much , Rita Skeeter already knew what he meant. After a period of hesitation, she gritted her teeth and said.
"Okay! I can write a report on this!"
Rita Skeeter made a judgment immediately. The Sirius who was mistakenly imprisoned in Azkaban was of course not enough to affect the position of Minister Fudge, but if Dumbledore was behind it, it would not necessarily be the case. .
And Rita Skeeter did not forget that the other party was still holding her own handle, so she had no choice from beginning to end!
Thinking of this, Rita Skeeter hated that nasty little devil head. The other party had promised her not to tell others that she was illegal Animagus...
"A wise choice!" Ivan said appreciatively.
As the two people reached an agreement, the atmosphere in the room was no longer so depressing, on the contrary, it was very harmonious. Rita Skeeter took the initiative to ask Ying to find the editor-in-chief of the Daily Prophet, and worked with Ivan to persuade the other party to agree. Issued remarks against the Ministry of Magic.
After more than an hour, Ivan looked at the two people leaving the guest room, and slowly heaved a sigh of relief in his heart.
Obtaining the support of the Daily Prophet is a very important part of Ivan’s plan, not as insignificant as he said earlier.
The remarks threatening to become Minister of Magic are not because of his own evil tastes, but entirely to appease Rita Skeeter and the editor-in-chief of the Daily Prophet. Only in this way will the other party be willing to stand on his side.
And the surprise he was going to give Dumbledore was exactly this. If the old professor comes back late, get ready to be the new Minister of Magic...

chapters.title: Chapter 437: Why do you want to apologize to the British Isles of 3!
chapters.content:
"Forgive me, professor, who told you to throw this mess to me..." Ivan sighed, after all, he made this decision out of helplessness.
Then, Ivan looked at the clock and felt that the time was almost the same, so he waved his magic wand to change his shape.
Accompanied by a shift in space, Ivan stared around again. He had arrived at the screaming shed, and bursts of noise were constantly being transmitted from one of the rooms.
Ivan sorted his clothes, then Shi Shiran walked in and spoke out.
"You may need to explain to me, Hals!"
......
After tossing with dual identities for a night, Ivan yawned and woke up from bed early the next morning. After a brief wash, he went to the auditorium to enjoy today's breakfast as usual.
It’s just that today’s situation is slightly different. As soon as Ivan sat down, he saw a large swath of owls rushing into the auditorium, flying towards their respective targets, and sending letters to the long table of the four major colleges.
One of the owls flew towards Ivan accurately and landed on his shoulder.
Ivan was not surprised, and reached out and took down the newspaper tied to the owl's foot.
Yesterday, he deliberately ordered an updated daily prophet for himself, in order to see if the other party had done things according to the agreement.
【Shock! The big mistake of the Ministry of Magic? Azkaban fugitive Black cleared his grievances today? The murderous petit peter Peter was caught in Hogwarts? 】
Ivan opened the newspaper, and what caught his eye was the eye-catching headline, which occupies a quarter of the paper.
The content written in it was also very satisfactory to Ivan. Not only did he elaborate on the temporary replacement of the secretaries back then, but also attacked the Ministry of Magic’s act of imprisoning Sirius in Azkaban without trial, and suspected something like Things like Sirius Black are probably not alone!
The words and sentences of the whole article are very sarcastic and ironic. Although the editor's signature is not written below, Ivan recognizes that this is Rita Skeeter's usual style at a glance.
At the end of the whole report, Rita Skeeter wrote.
【Even if the vicious mysterious man was arrested by the Auror back then, he must pass a legal justice trial before he could be convicted. The Ministry of Magic abused power like this. As a minister, he wanted to apologize to the entire British magical world! 】
"It's really the right choice to choose Rita Skeeter to write this manuscript!" Ivan muttered secretly, just wondering if Fudge will be **** off seeing this report...
It's no wonder Rita Skeeter has the guts to write articles and not sign them...
While Ivan was reading the newspaper, Harry, Ron and others squeezed over curiously. After seeing the information on the newspaper page, Harry shouted in surprise.
"Sirius, come and see! The Daily Prophet reported on you and Peter Pettigrew!"
At this time, Sirius was talking to Lupin on the teacher's bench. After hearing Harry's shout, he raised his eyebrows and stood up and walked over here.
Most of the Gryffindor students are naturally very welcome. After listening to the story for a night, they have changed a lot about Sirius, and they squeezed out a seat specially.
And the little wizards of the other three academies were still a little wary when Sirius passed by, and they moved a little farther away.
Sirius didn't care about this. He knew very well that once the inherent impression was formed, it would be difficult to eliminate, and it could not be changed in a short time.
After sitting down on Sirius, Ivan handed over the newspaper in his hand.
"Thank you!" Sirius was also a little surprised after seeing the news on the page of the Daily Prophet. The Daily Prophet received the news so quickly and reported it without an interview.
But Sirius certainly knows more than Harry and the others, so I guessed at once that Dumbledore must have used his influence to operate, and he was immediately moved.
He knows very well the virtues of the Daily Prophet, and it is not easy to ask them to help...
"There is also a second page that mentions your affairs. It says that the trial court has decided to reverse the case for you. It should be the matter of the past few days..." Hermione also reminded Sirius.
"Doesn't it mean that in a few days, Sirius will be completely cleared of charges?" Harry said happily.
"Yes...it looks like this!" Sirius laughed loudly.
"It just happens that we are resting today, so how about going to Hogsmeade Village to celebrate together? We didn't have fun there yesterday..." Ron suggested with some resentment.
"Of course it's okay, and I will bear all the expenses this time. It's the compensation that I accidentally scared you yesterday!"
Sirius also thought this was a good idea, so he readily agreed, and by the way, he planned to buy Ron a new pet.
After all, Peter Pettigrew will either stay in Azkaban all his life, or be executed by the Ministry of Magic It is impossible to be a pet for Ron.
Considering that part of Peter's affairs was his fault after all, so Sirius asked Ron what kind of pet he wanted.
"How about a white and fat mouse? I can buy one that is about the size of a spot..." Sirius thought that Ron seemed to have a soft spot for mice, so he tentatively said.
"No, I don't want mice!" Ron shook his head frantically. Since discovering that he was actually a bald, middle-aged wizard, the list of things he feared most was mice besides spiders.
"Either an owl?" Sirius didn't expect Ron's reaction to be so big, so he asked instead.
Ron thought for a while, felt that there should be no wizard disguised as a letter-delivery owl, so he nodded and agreed...
Of course, Ron did not forget to say thank you. If Sirius was not willing to pay, he might not have his own pet for a long time.
Because his mother will definitely let him wait for a few years, and then throw the pet that George or Fred doesn’t want after graduation to himself...
While the excited Harry and the others were discussing how to celebrate with Sirius, Ivan turned his head and looked out the window. A phoenix with golden and red feathers hovered in the sky, making three beeps, and went straight. Flew over here.
Before I went back to the dormitory to go to bed yesterday, Ivan asked Fox to patrol the sky over Hogwarts today. If he saw someone from the Ministry of Magic appearing at Hogwarts, he would immediately come over and notify him.
And the three tweets mean that it is Minister of Magic Fudge!

chapters.title: Chapter 438: Ivan: Fudge! How dare you taint people's innocence out of thin air? !
chapters.content:
The Ministry of Magic arrived much faster than Ivan expected. He had only had breakfast here, and Fudge arrived on his feet.
Calculate the time, the Ministry of Magic should have just started work soon. The current minister hurried over, showing how much the Ministry of Magic attaches importance to this matter.
Ivan shook his head and sighed in his heart, if he could do other things with this efficiency, how could it be where he is today.
"Ivan, did something happen?" Hermione also heard Fox's tweet, and of course she recognized Dumbledore's phoenix flying over here.
Sirius, Harry, and Ron also stopped talking and looked at Ivan together.
"No, it's nothing, Professor Dumbledore is looking for something to do with me, it should be someone from the Ministry of Magic who can't bear to come here early!"
Ivan stood up and stretched out his hand. Fox, who flew in through the window, stayed on his arm.
Then, Ivan looked at Sirius again and said to them.
"In addition, I think it is better to postpone your celebration until after the trial. Before the trial, Sirius's suspicion has not been completely cleared. It is best not to leave the school at will, lest you be found to criticize Professor Dumbledore. reason"
Hearing Ivan's words, Harry and the others suddenly stopped.
Sirius was also aware of this. He was patronizing just now and was happy, but he had forgotten his identity as a fugitive. If he went outside in an upright manner, he might cause some riots.
Seeing that they all understood the necessity of staying at Hogwarts, Ivan didn't say much, walked out of the auditorium, found a place where there was no one, and changed to Dumbledore's appearance.
"Well, yes, it looks alike! It shouldn't be dismantled, right?"
When the changing state stabilized, Yifan used a transformation technique to get a full-length mirror and checked it carefully.
After all, the wait is going to meet the Minister of Magic Fudge. It's no better than fooling the professors at the school. This time, if you wear a gang, it will be all over.
In order to match Dumbledore’s taste, Ivan even specially made a set of sulky purple robes to wear on him, so that he looked in line with the old principal’s temperament.
"What do you think? Fox?" Ivan tilted his head and looked at the phoenix with golden red feathers on his shoulders.
Fox stared at the mirror for a while, then nodded. From the outside, it couldn't see any flaws.
Ivan was completely relieved, but when he had just stepped out of the gate of the castle, he saw Minister of Magic Fudge approaching aggressively with a group of Aurors.
Ivan frowned slightly, knowing in his heart that Fudge was afraid that the person would be bad this time, but he quickly adjusted his expression and stepped forward to greet him.
"Connelly, it's been a long time since we count!" Ivan pretended not to see the hostility on their faces and greeted them enthusiastically.
Fudge was not appreciative at all. He came to Ivan in three steps and two steps, his eyes were full of unconcealable anger, he approached him, and questioned every word.
"Albus, what do you want to do?"
"Of course I am doing something that should be done, such as finding the culprit of this turmoil" Ivan raised his eyebrows and said nonchalantly.
"That's the work of the Auror of the Ministry of Magic!" Fudge interrupted Ivan's words very angrily.
"Don't say that, Connelly! This incident also threatens the safety of all students. As the principal of Hogwarts, how can I ignore it? And I am very willing to contribute to the magic world. , Do some small tasks within your capacity." Ivan looked at him calmly and explained.
"Then you should also discuss with me first, instead of doing those little tricks by yourself" Fudge said angrily.
Fudge knew very well that the news published by the Daily Prophet today must have nothing to do with Dumbledore, otherwise how dare they publish such things without their consent.
"How could I forget you? Old friend! In fact, I have already sent an owl with my handwritten letter to explain all this to you" Ivan explained in a gentle tone.
"What about your owl? I didn't see it!" Fudge asked, as if he had endured to the limit, the string in his mind could break at any time.
You must know that when he arrived at the Ministry of Magic early this morning, he received hundreds of letters asking him whether the contents of the Daily Prophet were true or false, including a large number of roaring letters, which seriously disrupted the normal operation of the Ministry!
Fudge even had to send a commissioner to deal with it, intercept the owl trying to rush into the Ministry of Magic, and select those important letters to his office.
But there is no letter from Dumbledore!
In addition, the latest issue of the Daily Prophet almost didn't make him angry, so he hurriedly left all his work and brought the Aurors here for the first time!
Facing Fudge's question, Ivan said with regret.
"Maybe Hogwarts is too far away from the Ministry of Magic. The owl I sent will take a while to fly. If you haven't come to me here, you might already be reading that letter."
Ivan, who has always been cautious, would not give Fudge an excuse to target himself, so he really sent a letter to the Ministry of Magic!
It’s just that the owl responsible for delivering the letter just set off from Hogwarts ten minutes ago
Listening to Ivan’s remarks, Fudge laughed directly. No one in the magical world knew that Dumbledore had a phoenix. It takes almost a moment to deliver important messages.
And even if you use an owl to send a letter, it’s impossible to fly for a night without reaching the other party. Obviously, you are deliberately targeting yourself!
Thinking of this, Fudge put aside the little consideration before and said with a sneer. "I heard the editor of the Daily Prophet mention that you threatened them to publish these news?"
"Did he actually tell you that? We had a very pleasant conversation at the beginning," Ivan opened his eyes wide, looked at Fudge in surprise, and continued.
"The former editor-in-chief of the Daily Prophet told me that he was very willing to let everyone know the truth."
Ivan is very dissatisfied with Fudge’s remarks just now. How can such a pleasant conversation in his mouth become a threat
How can he taint people's innocence out of thin air?
(PS: Seeing someone who doesn't understand Fudge's behavior, the angel will explain a little bit here. In fact, it's clear if you change the scene.
A certain British nation misunderstood the war hero as a spy from the cross country and tortured for more than ten years. The real spy who suspended his death has instead acquired the title of hero. Now the spy is captured by the agent and found that it was a misjudgment. Do you think the above is to choose to kill a hundred people directly, or choose to announce it directly?
So this is not a question of who is in power, but a scandal of the entire Ministry of Magic. Of course it is fine to throw the pot, but it is only used when there is no other way. For Western politicians who only pay attention to interests, if you have the opportunity, you can directly eliminate the insiders and pretend that nothing happened is the first choice. This is much simpler than public relations after the fact. )

chapters.title: Chapter 439: Sirius caught again
chapters.content:
"Really? Then you'd better pray that you didn't make a mistake..." Fudge said through gritted teeth, very angry, but he knew he didn't have enough excuses to target Dumbledore.
"Of course, I am very sure of my judgment. I can take you to see Peter now!" Ivan ignored Fudge's incompetent rage and made an invitation gesture.
Fudge snorted coldly, and walked towards the entrance of the castle. The other Aurors also followed Ivan.
Ivan was boring, but he was always generous, so he didn't take it seriously.
A group of people just walked into the noisy auditorium.
Since today is a day off, there are still a large number of little wizards staying here after breakfast.
Sirius is also here, talking and laughing with some Gryffindor wizards, seeming to be telling stories about his adventures with James and Lupin in his school days.
"Black!"
The Aurors behind Fudge saw that the wanted man they were pursuing appeared in the Hogwarts Auditorium in an upright manner, and subconsciously pulled out their wands and pointed at each other.
Such a big battle frightened the little wizards in the auditorium for a while. Seeing this, Ivan turned his head to look at Fudge, and said in a deep voice.
"Connelly, I think you should have read the news. Mr. Black is not only a murderer and a betrayer, but he has also played a role in many battles against the Death Eaters. I think he should be removed from the wanted list now. That's right."
"Who knows that what it says is true or false? Maybe it's a lie made up by Black. In short, he's still a suspect now, isn't he? Buckle it up!" Fudge sneered and said, he waved his hand to the arrogant people behind him. Luo gave a look.
The Aurors immediately understood, and they took out the magic shackles from behind and they were about to put on Black.
Ivan frowned, hesitated for a moment, and said nothing to stop it.
Because Sirius was indeed suspected before the trial, Fudge's method of detaining the opponent is reasonable and legal. If he forcibly stops him, Fudge will use the pretext of obstructing the Ministry of Magic's law enforcement to attack him.
From the original time and space, the iron Fudge brought people to capture Dumbledore eagerly, it can be seen that this idiot who has been fooled by power will not consider the issue of strength gap at all, and his fake and powerful methods may not be useful. !
So sometimes fools are harder to deal with than smart people...
Ivan couldn't predict what stupid things Fudge would do, so I could only bear it for the time being.
Sirius did not resist facing the Aurors who had captured him. He remained silent throughout the entire process without Dumbledore giving orders to avoid causing Dumbledore's trouble by saying something wrong.
The surrounding Aurors were relieved to see Sirius so cooperative, but they still put magic shackles on him.
This is a special kind of magic item. After wearing it, it can limit the magic power of the wizard, so that the prisoner cannot use any magic...
"You can't take him like this, Sirius is innocent!" When the Aurors were about to take Sirius away, Harry and the others suddenly squeezed up to stop them.
The law enforcement Aurors looked at the little ghosts in front of them, looking at a loss, no matter how they scolded Harry and the others, they were determined not to let them leave.
"Oh, isn't this Potter?"
Fudge pushed an Auror away and walked in front of them, speaking to Harry impatiently.
"Please don't disturb the normal law enforcement of the Aurors. You must know that we are trying to find justice for your parents..."
"Minister Fudge, if you really intend to seek justice for my parents, then you should release Sirius and catch Peter Pettigrew..." Harry looked at him stubbornly, not at all. The meaning of concession.
"I'll catch Peter, go away now, don't mess with us..." The stubborn Harry made the impatient Fudge completely lose his patience. He waved his hand and commanded the Aurors to force them to chase them away. go.
Just then Sirius suddenly spoke.
"Harry, get out of the way, it's just a routine for them to catch me, nothing will happen!"
Although he was in shackles on his hands, Sirius didn't have any worry on his face, as if he hadn't been arrested, but had been invited to somewhere.
Harry looked at him hesitantly, then looked at "Dumbledore" standing aside, and saw the old professor shook his head at him, and Harry took a few steps unwillingly.
Fudge looked at all this coldly. Harry's ignorance of his words and Sirius's indifferent attitude made him very annoyed. Fudge felt that his authority had been challenged...
"Connelly, aren't you going to see that petty star Peter, we can go now!" Ivan said suddenly.
