Fudge nodded, and ordered the other Aurors to take Sirius and walk towards the staff lounge.
Opening the door, everyone saw a short and fat middle-aged wizard curled up in a corner, bound by a slender rope round and round, just lying there motionless, not knowing his life or death.
"What's going on?" Fudge turned his head and looked at Ivan Pettigrew Peter is an unregistered Animagus, can transform into a rat, and the general supervision methods treat him But it is of no use. To be on the safe side, I can only ask someone to impose a coma spell on him every two hours..."
Ivan explained to Fudge in detail, he didn't want to hand over Peter to the Ministry of Magic, because their management negligence caused Peter to find a chance to escape.
When the accompanying Auror heard about Ivan's method of restricting Peter, he secretly beat the drum in his heart, and looked at Peter with a little pity, which was too cruel!
has been continuously applied multiple coma spells in a short period of time, no one knows if there will be any sequelae...
"How about? Is he Peter Pettigrew?" Fudge looked at a tall and thin Auror beside him with a trace of expectation.
He was expecting that Dumbledore had made a mistake in this matter, so that he would not have a headache for the next thing, and it would also make Dumbledore’s reputation discredited...
"Yes, Minister! I have met Peter a few times, and I have some impressions of him. I am 80% sure that this is Peter Pettigrew!" The tall and thin Auror looked at Peter carefully for a while. Said with certainty.
Although he hasn't seen each other for more than ten years, there are not many people who look like Peter, so he can easily recognize it.
Fudge looked a little disappointed, and then he remembered the dark mark on the report, and personally stretched out Peter's clothes.
Sure enough, Peter's left arm has a clear snake-shaped skull mark, which is lifelike, as if alive...

chapters.title: Chapter 440: Fudge
chapters.content:
No one, including Fudge, would doubt the authenticity of the Dark Mark's mark, because just looking at it would make them chill.
"I don't think I need to explain too much, right?" Ivan asked.
"Well, things are probably already clear," Fudge said unwillingly, and then said to the Aurors.
"Take him and Blake, let's go back to the Ministry of Magic!"
A few Aurors nodded, and violently pulled Peter Peter, who was in a coma, up, and untied the ropes around him.
The dizzy little dwarf Peter also woke up from the coma spell, but as soon as he opened his eyes, he saw two wizards in Auror costumes menacingly handcuffed him, and then dragged him to prepare to leave.
"Wait, Connelly! Are you planning to bring them all back to the Ministry of Magic?" Ivan suddenly interrupted their actions.
"Of course, they will be kept in a special prison until the court begins!" Fudge said.
"That won't work!" Ivan shook his head.
If Peter and Black were brought back to the Ministry of Magic, he would completely lose control of them.
More importantly, Sirius’ escape from prison caused a lot of trouble for the Ministry of Magic. Who knows if Fudge will use lynching in anger.
Even though this possibility is very small, Ivan really doesn't trust the Ministry of Magic, and he prefers to keep things under his own control.
"It's the duty of Auror to take criminals in, Albus! Are you planning to stop us from enforcing the law?" Fudge's eyes narrowed, his words were a little bit of disbelief and a trace of expectation.
Fudge waited for "Dumbledore" to make a statement. As long as the other party nodded, he would have reason to arrest "Dumbledore".
"Of course not! I just want to remind you, Connelly! The trial of Peter's case is now very concerned by the entire magical world. It is best not to make any mistakes."
Ivan said in a gentle tone, and then continued.
"In fact, I have certain doubts about the Ministry of Magic's level of supervision of prisoners. Even places like Azkaban are not absolutely safe. Therefore, I suggest that the place of detention should be changed to the Observatory at Hogwarts. Or let the people of the trial court cooperate with the supervision of law enforcement"
"In addition, this is not what I meant alone, but the result of my discussions with you in the trial court, so as to avoid any accidents before the formal hearing," Ivan emphasized.
As a counterfeit, Ivan didn't dare to confront Fudge head-on, because once he fought, he was sure to expose himself, even if he held the old wand in his hand, he could not be so many Auror opponents.
So I can only take advantage of the pressure to change the place of detention to Hogwarts, or allow him to send someone to supervise the Auror's law enforcement.
However, Fudge was very tough, and he refused without hesitation.
He doesn’t care what Ivan thinks. In his opinion, the other party is nakedly challenging his authority, and the “recommendations” of the trial court can’t impose any substantial restrictions on him.
Facing such an iron Fudge, Ivan realized Dumbledore's helplessness in the original time and space. The other party's advantage as the Minister of Magic is really too great.
Unless he doesn't hesitate to be in the magic world, under normal circumstances he really has nothing to do with the opponent.
Playing politics is not what Ivan is good at. He suddenly felt that he underestimated Fudge. It might not be easy to get him out of office. This matter has to be considered for a long time.
Thinking of this, Yifan changed his voice and said kindly.
"You misunderstood, Connelly! We are not enemies, are we? My previous proposal was just to add a layer of insurance. You don't want to be known that the Aurors of the Ministry of Magic have been busy for a long time, but only finished some finishing touches Let's work?"
Although Fudge was angry with Ivan's repeated challenges to his authority, he still understood the cues in Ivan's words.
As a qualified politician, Fudge quickly discarded his personal feelings and calculated the benefits and losses.
The trouble he faces now is nothing more than two points. The first point is that the Ministry of Magic caught the wrong person back then, and he regarded the real murderer Peter as a war hero and applied for the Merlin Medal.
This incident has a great impact on the credibility of the Ministry of Magic, but it has little to do with him personally. It is a matter of becoming a minister and does not affect his position as a minister.
The most important thing is that after the report of the Daily Prophet, everyone knows that there is no way to conceal it. Apart from passing the responsibility to the predecessor, there are not many places to operate.
The second point is that after Sirius escaped from prison, the Ministry of Magic abandoned all efforts to search, and even arranged dementors to surround Hogwarts.
But the final result was not satisfactory, nothing was achieved, and a scandal involving dementors attacking students and commissioners of the Ministry of Magic!
Even Sirius turned the case, he waited until this morning to hear the news.
Don't think that the impact of this incident is not as great as the former, but it is closely related to him. If it is not handled well, he is likely to be labeled as incompetent.
If Dumbledore is willing to cooperate, it proves that the Aurors of the Ministry of Magic have exerted great efforts in the investigation process, rather than doing useless work, then this matter can probably be fooled.
A few thoughts flashed in his mind, after a little thought, Fudge finally began to let go, saying that it would not be impossible to change the place where Peter and Sirius were held to Hogwarts.
Then the two thoughtful two changed their previous appearances Maintaining the apparent harmony, while taking Sirius and Peter to the observatory, they made verbal negotiations.
Fudge really hopes that Ivan can completely deny the scandals of the Ministry of Magic, including several attacks by the Dementors.
Of course, Ivan just rightly refused. He will not cooperate with the Ministry of Magic to fool the people, unless Fudge is willing to jointly apply for a Merlin Medal with his name as Ivan Hals.
Since he had to give in, Ivan had no choice but to give up his previous idea of ​​hard-working the Ministry of Magic for the time being, and instead worked hard to fight for his own interests, to see if he could get the legend point.
"Ivan Hals?" Fudge muttered softly, feeling that the name seemed a bit familiar. He looked at Dumbledore suspiciously, not understanding why Dumbledore did it.
"I thought you should have some impression of him, after all, such an excellent little wizard is rare." Ivan looked at Fudge with regret, and then continued.
"The person who discovered Peter's anomaly this time is also him, so I think this is the honor he deserves"
"Is it the little wizard who developed the wolf poison potion? The last time I met, I knew he would definitely bring me more surprises." Fudge also remembered this time, and couldn't help but sigh.
In his heart, Fudge cursed secretly, it turned out to be this **** kid!
If it weren’t for the other party, why would he be so passive now?

chapters.title: Chapter 441: Ivan: Severus, how could you run to me and tell me...
chapters.content:
Although Fudge was very angry, all Dumbledore needed was a nomination, and there was no loss for him.
The support in exchange for this was real, and it could make him less passive in the face of blame. For this reason, Fudge agreed without hesitation.
After discussing for a long time, the two finally reached an agreement. During the formal court sessions, Sirius Black and Peter Pettigrew will be held at the Observatory at Hogwarts, guarded by the Auror of the Ministry of Magic.
Ivan originally hoped to persuade Fudge to allow him to send someone to supervise him, but Fudge resolutely disagrees. He is very disgusted with people's criticism of the Ministry's behavior.
In order not to provoke Fudge's sensitive nerves, Ivan had to give up for the time being. Anyway, the place of detention was in Hogwarts, and it was not a matter of his word to supervise or not.
While chatting like this, the group soon arrived at an observatory at the top of the castle.
"You two stay and watch them, and the others follow me back to the Ministry of Magic!"
Bundled Blake and Peter and locked them in the observatory, Fudge followed the two Aurors to guard, and then hurriedly returned to the Ministry of Magic with the remaining Aurors.
Due to the news of the Daily Prophet, Fudge, as the Minister of Magic, has too many things to deal with today. The reason why he got to Hogwarts in the first place was completely dizzy and wanted Confirm the authenticity of the matter.
"By the way, what about the dementors who surrounded Hogwarts before?" Fudge was about to step out of the gate of Hogwarts. He suddenly thought of this and turned to look at a female Auror next to him. Asked.
"Your Excellency, the dementors violated the Ministry of Magic's regulations and intended to attack students. They have been dispatched back. Ms. Umbridge handed you the report." The female Auror explained.
Fudge nodded, recalling that he had indeed signed this document, and said again. "Before the court begins, Black and Peter must not be lost. You will go to Azkaban later and let some dementors come over to assist the guards..."
Now that the Ministry of Magic has enough trouble, Fudge doesn't want to have any trouble again, so strengthening protection is especially important.
In addition, he asked the dementors to assist the guards, which might not mean punishment.
Whether it's the escaped Sirius or the **** petty peter, Fudge is very annoyed.
Fudge was suffocated at Hogwarts in the early morning, and he had nowhere to vent. He couldn't fix Dumbledore, but it was okay to let the two prisoners suffer a little bit!
"I will send someone to ask the ins and outs of this matter from their mouths tonight, and I will see this report on my desk tomorrow morning at the latest!" Fudge ordered a few words before he stepped on. Out of the range of Hogwarts Castle, he cast his shadow and disappeared in place.
......
"It's finally over!"
Ivan returned to the principal's room, and he was relieved watching Fudge lead the people away from Hogwarts through the window.
The biggest difficulty has been passed, just wait for the formal hearing...
But what should I do with the Daily Prophet?
Thinking of this, Ivan suddenly felt a little embarrassed, he seemed to accidentally pit them...
Forget it, when the time comes to find a reason to fool the past... Can a promise made by a politician be called a breach of contract?
Or let Dumbledore take care of it...
Ivan quickly put this annoying thing aside, sat down at his desk, took out Dumbledore’s magic letter from the drawer, and prepared to write a nomination letter to Sir Merlin to make it for himself. The merits of applying for the Merlin Medal...
With Fudge’s promise, two consecutive magnates in the magic world initiated nominations, and Ivan felt that this matter was still very stable.
Besides, I have made so many achievements in recent years. I beat Voldemort's remnant soul and destroyed two Horcruxes in a row...
Ivan thought that even Dumbledore would definitely recognize his achievements here. In order to share the worries of the old professor, he decided to come by himself and not bother the other party...
Phoenix Fox, who was resting on the olive branch, flew over from the branch, his eyes scanned the contents of the letter, his eyes faintly shining with contempt...
"Help me send this letter to the head of the Merlin Knights!" Ivan stuffed the envelope directly into Fox's mouth, and then stroked the feathers under Phoenix's neck with his hand.
A hot flame suddenly appeared on Fox's body, and the flame splashed on his fingers, which frightened Ivan. Fortunately, the flame did not hurt him...
Ivan then realized that Fox was deliberately teasing himself, just as he was preparing to fight back with his teeth and claws, Fox's figure had disappeared in the principal's room.
Ivan put away the expression on his face. After a period of time, Fox has not repelled himself so much, so he made these little jokes with him.
Although there is still a long way to go before the goodwill of blood draw, what makes Ivan even think of baldness is the legendary problem.
It takes five legendary points to redeem the protection mode of the system once, and he only has two points now.
If you can successfully obtain the Merlin Medal, you should be able to add a little more, even so, it's still a lot worse.
But where should I get some legends?
Ivan thought about the things he did when he got the legend points several times before. They can be roughly divided into two kinds, one is the werewolf savior and the dragon knight, which spread widely.
Another kind is the little-known but quite legendary experience like the Slytherin heir and Ouroboros.
It is obviously easier to make big news in comparison.
Or else tomorrow I will run a lap in Hogwarts shirtless like Dumbledore?
That kind of thing will definitely cause a sensation in the magic world!
Ivan was thinking of all kinds of crooked ideas in his mind, but he didn't have the guts to implement it If he really dared to do this, Dumbledore would probably kill him immediately, even if he had an urgent matter of importance Come and find him to settle accounts...
alas... I'm so hard!
Ivan sighed in his heart.
rumbling...
At this moment, there was a sound of stones turning and rubbing outside the door, and Ivan's expression went up. He understood that this was a sign that someone was about to enter the principal's room.
As expected, a familiar figure soon appeared at the door of the principal's office.
"Severus? Are you coming to me at this time, is there something important to report?" Ivan raised his eyebrows as he looked at the visitor, looking a little surprised.
"Yes, I think there is one thing you should know about. It is about our talented student Ivan Hals..." Snape in a black robe stepped into the principal's room and said. I don't know whether it is praise or mockery.

chapters.title: Chapter 442: Ivan: We have to believe that Hals is a good comrade!
chapters.content:
About me?
Ivan was a little dazed for a while, and looked at Snape with a strange look. It was the first time that he had met someone coming to sue him, disguised as Dumbledore. This feeling was very strange...
"What's the matter? Albus?" Snape squinted his eyes, vaguely feeling that Dumbledore in front of him seemed a little wrong, and then remembered that the password in the principal's room had not been changed for a long time, and he couldn't help but become suspicious.
"No, nothing, I'm just a little curious about what the kid did? I need you to come and report to me..." Ivan shook his head and said in a deep voice.
Snape was silent for a while. He looked at "Dumbledore" but couldn't see any flaws, so he didn't know if he was too focused.
Normally, no one would dare to use the compound decoction to pretend to be Dumbledore and sit in the principal's room.
Besides, Phoenix Fox was still hovering above Hogwarts this morning, but he saw it with his own eyes, and the other party was holding the elderberry wand that Dumbledore used to do.
Thinking of this, Snape dispelled the doubts in his heart, and instead recalled explaining what happened last night.
especially emphasized that he had a conflict with Black and others, and then Ivan used a special pupil magic to petrify his body...
"To tell the truth, those eyes gave me a very bad premonition...a bit like that person..." Snape was still a little scared when he recalled the situation.
At that time, he and Ivan stared at each other for only a moment, and there was a petrochemical reaction in his body that could affect his actions. He even felt death at that instant. If he stared at him for a while, the consequences would be disastrous.
Listening to Snape's words, Ivan suddenly realized that it was his snake eyes that scared the opponent, so he ran over to file a complaint.
But Ivan is also a little helpless about this. He has done so many things so hard that Snape actually doubted himself because of this little thing, which is really chilling...
Despite thinking like this, Ivan didn't forget his current identity, so when he spoke again, he changed into a different tone.
"This is indeed worth watching, Severus!"
"Hals's body is full of many mysteries, and sometimes even I can't figure it out..." Ivan tried his best to think about Dumbledore's possible reaction, and said with a voice of emotion.
It's just that Ivan didn't mean to criticize himself, so he changed his voice, indicating that the power of magic can not be seen in a lifetime. A special pupil magic that can petrify is rare, but it is not necessary for it. This fuss.
Hals has always been a good boy with both good character and learning. He has contributed a lot to the peace of the magical world. We should not be biased against this outstanding student just because of the other's unique ability...
Ivan talked freely, trying to get Snape to dispel those doubtful thoughts, and promised that he would have a chat with Mr. Hals himself when he had time.
Snape saw that Dumbledore didn't seem to care much about this special pupil magic, so he stopped talking and said coldly.
"I just came to remind you of this. If you really trust him so much, it's up to you..."
"In addition, the Ministry of Magic has asked to send some dementors to guard Black and Peter..." Snape thought of the business here and added.
Dementor?
Hearing this news, Ivan couldn’t help frowning. He didn’t understand what Fudge was doing. He had spent so much work to get the Dementor away. He didn’t expect that Fudge would now give the Dementor to him. Get it back.
After the Daily Prophet reported the incident, there was no conflict between him and Fudge over dealing with Sirius and Peter.
Both parties need to ensure that they can live safely to the court, so Ivan is not very worried about Fudge's small actions in private.
Snape looked at "Dumbledore" who seemed to be lost in thought, and suddenly spoke. "I hope you remember our agreement!"
"Of course, our agreement has always been valid!" Ivan was awakened suddenly, and he understood what Snape was talking about after another thought, and nodded very cooperatively.
"That's good!" Snape stared at Ivan's expression and reaction the whole time. He could not see the hesitation and confusion on Ivan's face. He finally dispelled the last doubt, turned and left the principal's room.
Seeing Snape's figure disappear into the principal's room, Ivan wiped the cold sweat from his head, and he didn't expect Snape to use this to test himself suddenly.
If he weren’t a traverser, I would understand that Dumbledore had promised Snape that he would shelter Harry, and I’m afraid he would just wear it...
After Snape's temptation, Ivan did not dare to stay in the principal's room, lest he meet other professors and quickly changed back to his original appearance.
Just as Ivan walked out of the principal's room to go to the Gryffindor lounge, he bumped into Harry and the others.
"Ivan! Did Professor Dumbledore tell you anything? We saw Sirius being captured by the Ministry of Magic!" Harry saw Ivan coming out of the principal's room~www.mtlnovel. com~ immediately greeted him, and asked worriedly.
"Yeah, he won't be put in Azkaban again, will he?" Ron also looked worried, and he still wondered if Sirius had promised his new pet.
Ivan was about to answer, Hermione retorted anxiously.
"I have analyzed with you before, it should not be! Sirius has been cleared of suspicion, and will not go to Azkaban again, I guess the Ministry of Magic must take them back for interrogation!"
While talking, Hermione turned her head to look at Ivan and confirmed.
"Right, Ivan!"
"No, you all guessed wrong, Sirius and Peter are now being held in Hogwarts!" Ivan shook his head and said.
"They're still at Hogwarts? Really? Where are they?" Harry swept away his previously worried expression and looked very excited. He couldn't wait to see how Sirius was going.
"Forgive me for not telling you, Harry!" Ivan directly rejected Harry's inquiry cruelly, and then continued to explain.
"Sirius is currently being watched by the Aurors of the Ministry of Magic and cannot see you. You had better not bother him, lest you cause trouble to Professor Dumbledore!"
Ivan is very aware of Harry's ability to kill, if the other party knows that the Ministry of Magic has sent some dementors to help guard Sirius, it will probably cause trouble again.
Therefore, Ivan is resolutely unwilling to reveal the specific location of Sirius' detention, lest they have something to do, and finally have to deal with it himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 443: Isn't going back to Azkabanna the same as going home?
chapters.content:
Harry and the others seemed very disappointed. No matter how hard they were, Ivan would never reveal any news.
Considering that there are still two or three days before the court, Ivan was a little worried about the pain of their idle eggs, secretly looking for the location of Sirius' detention, and said.
"Harry, if you have this leisurely mind, it is better to think about how to make a statement in the court at the time. Your testimony is very important and may affect the final trial result!"
Under Ivan's reminder, Harry remembered this, and suddenly became a little nervous. He had never been to court before, and he didn't know what to do.
"We can go to the library to find out the specific process of handling cases in the trial court, can we not know about the major cases that have been recorded in the past 100 years?" Hermione suggested.
"Good idea!" Harry nodded.
After having directions, Harry hurriedly pulled Ron and Hermione to the library.
Of course, Ivan didn't follow him. He found a reason to say that he would still have something to do, so he refused Harry's invitation.
In fact, there are so many twists and turns to be a witness, and it is not to be a lawyer or to give false testimony, just tell the truth.
The reason why Ivan wanted to take the initiative to mention this was to find something to do for Harry and the others to distract them.
When I was thinking about it, Ivan suddenly sensed something, turned his head abruptly, and looked out the window. The sky was gray and there seemed to be creatures surging in the clouds.
"Dementors? Did they come so fast?" Ivan immediately thought of Snape having told him that the Ministry of Magic was planning to send some dementors to assist the Auror in guarding.
Ivan has always distrusted such evil creatures. It is a fantasy to expect dementors to have some self-control, so he plans to see what the Ministry of Magic people are doing at night.
......
As night gradually fell, on the top of Hogwarts Castle, on an abandoned observatory, dozens of weird figures in cloaks were floating around the top of the tower...
At this time, Ivan has changed into the appearance of an owl, passed through the dementor's inspection, flew to the vent and stopped.
Dementor’s eyesight is almost zero. Under his special senses, he doesn’t seem to be interested in animals, so he didn’t notice the existence of owls at all...
This also allows Ivan to easily see the scene inside the observatory.
It looks like a small prison, the wall that has been in disrepair is pitted by time, and the cracks are full of moss and vines.
Sirius and Peter were tied face-to-face at both ends, not only were handcuffed on their hands, but their bodies were tied and sturdy...
In addition to them, there is also an Auror standing in the observatory, holding a few pieces of parchment in his hand, recording something with a quill pen.
"Little Dwarf-Peter, do you have anything else to say? You haven't told me how you were discovered..." Auror wrote Peter Dwarf's confession on the parchment, and then continued to speak. Asked.
"I really forgot, I don't remember anything. He used the oblivion spell on me, which made me forget a lot..." Peter shook his head tremblingly.
"Someone used the Forgetting Curse on you? Who? Albus Dumbledore? Why did he do it to you? Is it because you know some secret information?"
Auror suddenly became very excited. He was ordered to come here to figure out the whole story, but unexpectedly it seemed that there was an unexpected gain.
He knows that Minister of Magic Fudge is very dissatisfied with Dumbledore recently. If he can find the other party's report, he may be appreciated by the Minister.
"No, it's not Dumbledore, it's Ivan Hals, the demon!" Peter replied in horror.
As long as Peter thinks of that experience, he can't help but feel cold. He doesn't know how many things he has forgotten, or whether his memories have been modified...
"Ivan Hals?" Auror felt vaguely that he had heard of the name, but couldn't remember it for a moment.
said Sirius who had not spoken next to him suddenly. "That's a very good little wizard, that is, he found Peter's trail... As for why he used the Forgotten Curse on Peter, I think it should be during the investigation process, worried about what Peter did.
Auror frowned. It is illegal to delete or modify the wizard's memory by using the Forgetting Curse.
But he didn't say much, because this time the situation was special. The victim Peter was a criminal, and the other party also had a reason to use the Forgetting Curse, so he just recorded the incident on paper.
After repeatedly questioning and confirming that Peter had said everything, the Auror turned his head to look at Black, and said with some expectation.
"Mr. Black, how did you consider my previous suggestion?"
"You are expecting me to say that after the trial results came out, I was very comfortable in Azkaban? Being put in a cell is the same as going home?" Black said with a sneer.
"I didn't ask you to say that, Mr. Black... You just need to state that you have not suffered any abuse or other unfair treatment in Azkaban..."
Auror’s expression was very embarrassing, and he also understood that this was not very authentic, but this was an order given above, and he could only negotiate as best as he could, so he continued to say with all his heart.
"If you are willing to cooperate with us, after you are released from prison, the Ministry of Magic will give you enough compensation!"
"Compensation? Do you mean some Jin Jialong?" Sirius curled his lips in disdain The most important thing he lacks is Jin Jialong. The Ministry of Magic is counting on using some Jin Jialong to buy himself. Got the wrong idea.
More importantly, Sirius despised the Ministry of Magic's behavior, looked at the Auror very contemptuously, and said.
"Anyway, I will tell the truth when it comes to the trial court!"
Seeing that Sirius was so stubborn, Auror's face was a little uncontrollable. In his opinion, the Ministry of Magic had already given enough sincerity. He even put down his face and low-pitched request, but the other party still didn't know how to praise.
Thinking of this, the Auror couldn't help but threatened.
"Mr. Black! I advise you to think more about it. It is not a wise choice to work against the Ministry of Magic! You have not yet cleared your charge..."
However, Sirius didn’t take this set at all, and he didn’t care about the other party. He knew very well that unless the Ministry of Magic had nothing to do, he would not send someone to beg himself to say good things or mention any compensation...

chapters.title: Chapter 444: Crazy Peter
chapters.content:
"Very well, you guys will stay here with the dementors for two days, think about it..."
Sirius, who is hard and soft, made the Auror very annoyed. He glared at the two of them, then turned away angrily.
"That's not bad, I haven't got along with those monsters for a while..." Sirius said without fear as he looked at the Auror's leaving figure.
He has survived over the past ten years in Azkaban. What's up in the two days?
"No...please! I said everything just now, don't let them come..." Peter Pettigrew shouted in tears.
He was very spineless and slumped on the ground, squirming and leaning towards the door, but because he was tied to the foot by an iron chain, he could only struggle on the ground weakly.
Before this Auror arrived, he had already experienced the feeling of being surrounded by those dementors.
That is simply hell. All the beautiful and happy things seem to have been forcibly pulled out of my mind, leaving only the ugliest and darkest memories...
"Peter, the way you look right now is really disgusting! Why did James and Lupin faint and become friends with someone like you..." Sirius looked at Peter in disgust and spit. .
"Lupin... by the way, Lupin!" Peter ignored him, but muttered to himself.
After Sirius' reminder, Peter suddenly remembered something and screamed at the Auror who had already walked to the door in surprise.
"Wait... Sir! I have a very important thing to say..."
"What's the matter? I remember you just told me that you have nothing to hide..." The Auror, who was about to leave, turned his head when Peter said that, and said impatiently.
"Yes, I swear to you, I have absolutely nothing to hide from you about the experience of hiding in these years!" Peter hurriedly explained, and then continued cautiously.
"What I want to say has nothing to do with this, but it should be of some use to the Ministry of Magic. If you can keep the dementors away from me, I can tell you the news!"
"Enough, Peter! You are still thinking about nonsense. Do you think someone will believe you as a dirty betrayer?" Sirius also realized that Peter was probably about to say Lupin’s identity as a werewolf wizard. , Hurriedly interrupted Peter's words with a beating.
"It's okay to listen. If the news you tell is really useful, I will consider making your life more comfortable!" Auror looked at Peter with interest and said.
"Of course, I am sure you will be very interested!" Peter said very kindly.
He was keenly aware from the conversation between the other party and Sirius just now that the Ministry of Magic seems to want to deal with Dumbledore, so the identity of Lupin would be a good entry point.
"Hogwarts's new anti ... ah ah ah?!"
Just as Peter was about to sell his friends again for glory, a needle-like pain was immediately fed back from his waist to his mind. Peter's body like a dead fish twitched abruptly, and the words in his mouth suddenly changed into There was a violent wailing.
"What's wrong?" The Auror drew out his wand, nervously pointing at Peter, not sure what he was up to.
"Someone! The demon must have sneaked in with the phantom spell!" Peter looked around nervously. Although there was no evidence, he felt that the little wizard must be making trouble.
"Appearing in a hurry~" The Auror waved his wand doubtfully.
A wave of magical power extended along the top of the wand in all directions, and passed to every corner of the room, but nothing happened.
"There is no one here at all!" The Auror looked at Peter with a dangerous look.
"Someone used it just now..." Peter stammered about to explain, but keenly noticed something got into his sleeve, and a sharp pain soon came from his arm.
"There's a bug, a bug got into my clothes! It's biting me... It's a snake, it must be a snake! No, it's changed into something else... It's so itchy, please get rid of mine. The rope, loosen me, please!" Peter rolled frantically on the ground, yelling indiscriminately.
The Auror who was watching was confused, not sure what he was doing.
"Are you performing any drama? Peter? Or do you think that by pretending this way, our Mr. Auror will kindly untie the rope for you?" Sirius said with a sneer.
Peter hit the corner and tried hard to refute, but someone vaguely stuffed a bunch of stinky socks into his mouth, and the smell almost didn't faint him...
In the darkness, the Auror couldn't see Peter clearly. Seeing him rolling around staggeringly, he didn't know for a moment whether Peter pretended to be, or really had some hysteria.
"Are you okay? Tell me if you need a medical staff..." Auror asked tentatively, but Peter just kept squirming.
The Auror who didn't get a reply frowned. Peter's weird behavior inevitably gave him a feeling of being teased. He simply didn't bother to pay attention to it anymore. As long as the opponent is not dead, Peter's condition is not in his consideration. in.
was tied up, Peter, who couldn't speak at all, just watched as his only reliance on leaving the observatory step by step.
After a while, on the empty ground beside Peter, a childish female voice rang.
"Harry! You were too risky just now, what if you were spotted accidentally?"
"Then what can I do? Do you want to watch Peter reveal the identity of Professor Lupin?" Harry took off the invisibility cloak he was wearingSuddenly in the empty observatory. Three little wizards came out.
"Sirius, are you okay?" Harry turned his head to look at the sturdy and bound Sirius, and asked worriedly.
"Why are you here..." Sirius was a little surprised.
"In the evening we accidentally saw a lot of dementors gathered around here, so I guessed you would be here, after all, there is no one else in the school who needs these monsters to look after." Hermione spoke extremely fast. Talking about his own analysis.
"Yes! We sneaked up with the invisibility cloak! Fortunately, those dementors were far away and didn't perceive us..." Harry also nodded.
"Really smart!" Sirius said in admiration, then looked at Peter who was tossing beside him and asked curiously. "Then what happened to his crazy appearance just now, how did you do it?"
"No, that wasn't what we did, he seemed to be like that all of a sudden. I just poked him in the waist, and then let Ron take off his socks and put them in his mouth..." Harry shook his head and said I don't know.

chapters.title: Chapter 445: Gryffindor engages with the three giants
chapters.content:
Is there anyone else here?
Sirius looked around for a while, and he didn't see any figures, but it's not like Peter himself is convulsed!
Just when Sirius hesitated, the wind was loud outside the window, and the biting cold gradually invaded from all directions...
"Why do you suddenly become so cold?" Ron trembled, and Sirius's face changed drastically.
"No, those dementors are coming, hurry up!" Sirius looked at Harry and the others and hurriedly urged.
"But... what do you do?" Harry said hesitantly.
"Don't worry about me, I have been in Azkaban for more than ten years, and I am familiar with them..." Sirius pretended to be relaxed, waved his hand to let them leave.
Harry wanted to say something, Hermione pulled him by the arm and ran him, Ron picked up the invisibility cloak that fell on the ground and threw it on everyone.
It’s just that they acted a little bit late. At this point of delay, a group of hungry dementors have floated from the door...
They can’t wait to get ready to enjoy the food, but their keen senses easily perceive the strangeness in the rooftop. In the world of gray tones, various emotions are constantly emanating from three places.
And in their memory, there should only be two criminals in the rooftop!
Harry and the others in the invisibility cloak held their breath nervously and moved cautiously towards the door, but unfortunately the dementors had already surrounded them.
The long-lost sense of fear came to his mind again. Harry seemed to hear Voldemort’s laugh again and the painful wailing of a witch before his death. He gritted his teeth, sweating on his head but was not in a coma like before. past.
A dementor quickly floated in front of them, and the panic gradually spread in the hearts of the three of them. Harry desperately recalled the scenes of learning the patron saint in his mind, and remembered the words Ivan once said. ...
The mystery of the Guardian God spell is to condense the positive emotions with magic and transform them into power!
Dementors are nothing to be afraid of. They are like intelligent creatures, and they are afraid of powers stronger than themselves...
......
Although the ugly face of the dementor got closer, Harry's mood calmed down. He tried to find the feeling of releasing the patron saint curse at the beginning, raised his wand high, and shouted loudly.
"Call God to guard!"
Stars of light flashed at the top of the magic wand, and a white mist gushed out, and a huge silver creature rushed out, using its tine-shaped horns to directly fly out the approaching dementors.
"The patron saint...I made it!" Harry looked at the white light and shadow driving the dementors in mid-air with surprise, it looked like a majestic stag.
"God, Harry! You beat them!" Ron said incredulously. If he remembers correctly, Harry fell from the sky because of a dementor a week ago.
"This is... the patron saint spell? When did you learn this?" Hermione was also a little surprised, looking at Harry suspiciously.
"Just after the Quidditch game, I went to find Ivan to learn..." Harry commanded the Stag Patron to repel a dementor who tried to lean in, and casually explained.
Hermione pursed her mouth and was a little bit stunned. She had also consulted Ivan for the patron saint curse because of her encounter with a dementor, but at that time Ivan temporarily put it aside on the grounds of being too busy recently, so she only Have your own reading and learning...
The little witch snorted, took out the magic wand, and muttered a spell. The hazy white mist suddenly floated out, blocking the dementor in the other direction.
At this time, it was not only Harry and the others who encountered the dementor attack. Some lazy monsters did not gather in the past, but chose two other targets that were better to deal with.
"Go away... Get away from me, don't get close to me... When the Dark Lord comes back, he will kill you all!"
Peter seemed to be a little lunatic under the successive blows, and he kept shouting some crazy words, or the large number of dementors reminded him of the days under Voldemort 13 years ago.
Sirius surrounded by a few dementors, this will not be easy, he frowned tightly and his face showed pain from time to time.
And more dementors are constantly squeezing in from the airy window...
Harry heard Peter's call and noticed the situation here, and hurriedly swept his wand swept across, the silver-white stag, like a white lightning, knocked out the dementors near Sirius.
Sirius slowed down, staring at the white shadow blankly, muttering something in his mouth, his dark eyes turned to look at Harry but it seemed as if he was looking at another person.
After Harry helped Sirius relieve the danger, he hesitated for a while, and let his patron saint help disperse the dementors near Peter.
"What are you doing for him? What if he is killed by a dementor..." Ron asked very puzzled.
"These dementors are already crazy, what if they kill Peter?" Harry explained.
The fact is just as Harry said, the dementors who were already lacking control rioted and became more and more radical.
Harry and the others feel that they have been in a big disaster and don’t know what to do now...
Sirius came back to his senses at this time, so that they didn't need to worry about themselves anymore and rushed out directly after wearing the invisibility cloak.
Harry was still hesitating, he was worried that after he left, these dementors would vent their anger on Sirius.
"The Dementor doesn't have the guts to do anything to me, but if you don't leave, the Auroma guarding below is coming up! Go!" Sirius shouted again.
Harry just nodded He gritted his teeth and summoned the patron saint of the stag back, drove his way ahead, and rushed out of the observatory with Ron and Hermione.
Dozens of dementors gathered from all directions, and Harry was exhausted while maintaining his patron saint.
Fortunately, Hermione would also have a patron saint. Although she could not summon her patron saint yet, she could share part of the pressure for him, allowing Harry to persist.
"Hu... God... Hushen guard! Isn't that correct?" Seeing his two friends are so powerful, Ron also wanted to make a contribution and learn how to cast spells like the two of them. .
But such a high-level spell can't be mastered for a while, no matter how hard Ron tried, the wand did not respond.
The dementors drifting around from nowhere, even slapped Ron's wand to the ground, rolling to the side.
"No! My wand!" Ron yelled, wanting to run back to pick it up, but what broke him even more was that a dementor who happened to pass by picked up his wand directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 446: Stupid peter
chapters.content:
Ron wailed helplessly, his voice seemed so heartbreaking, but Harry directly covered his mouth tightly, lowered his voice, and said in his ear.
"Don't worry, there is an Auror coming up, let's go!"
Downstairs, the sound of rapid footsteps has been heard.
Ron once again looked at the place where the wand fell. The dementor had already taken his wand and flew to nowhere. In view of this, Ron had to run with Harry without tears. .
In the observatory at this time, Sirius looked worriedly at the movement outside the door, hoping that Harry and the others could escape successfully.
But he also keenly noticed that the dementors seemed to be a little different from before, and they became less irritable.
Even during this time, there was no dementor approaching him. Most of the dementors gathered around Peter, seeming to be discussing something...
The whistling wind echoed in my ears, Sirius didn't know the language of dementors, and naturally he couldn't understand what they were saying.
In the dark space created by a large group of dementors, a special dementor with a magic wand is trying to persuade the rioting fellows to calm down.
"Don’t forget what happened before, this is a conspiracy carefully planned by the Ministry of Magic! Those cunning wizards are testing whether we are truly obedient, so that we can decide what to do with us in the future..."
"Now we need patience... patience... patience again! Wait for the moment to complete the great cause!"
"Only a dementor who squats down can stand up!"
......
After Ivan’s brainwashing, the dementors in the observatory finally settled down a lot and stopped being noisy.
Ivan secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
Harry, Ron, and Hermione can really do things. He didn't expect that he had concealed the location of Sirius. They were able to find Sirius all the way, and even stabbed such a big basket!
If it weren't for them, they would have been caught by the Auror of the Ministry of Magic, and would have to be punished the last time. Maybe they needed to become Dumbledore to negotiate with the Auror of the Ministry.
That would be troublesome, but fortunately I handled it in time...
Thinking of this, Ivan looked at Peter again, and now it seems that there is still one trouble left to deal with.
If the Auror from the Ministry of Magic comes in and asks, Peter may get out all the news about Harry and others, and even reveal the identity of Lupin's werewolf wizard...
"Can the dementor use magic?" Ivan muttered to himself, and raised his right hand. In the blurred vision, the rotten and shriveled flesh of his arm was almost stuck to the bones, crusted. A magic wand was tightly held on five fingers.
"Forget it all!" Ivan shook his arm and aimed at Peter.
As the spell was pronounced, the magic power in Ivan's body was quickly mobilized, but when it was passed to the wand, it encountered obstacles. The magic power became intermittent. Fortunately, it sprayed out smoothly according to the guide of the wand. Hit Peter.
Peter would have been weakly curled up in the corner under the torture of the dementors. After being hit by the white light, his whole body trembled like a convulsive wind. It lasted for a while before Peter fell into a coma...
Ivan looked at Peter’s unusual reaction after being hit by the Forgotten Curse, and thought of the obscurity when casting the spell just now. He felt a bad feeling in his heart. He also didn’t know what it would be like to use magic in the form of a Dementor. The change.
And Ron’s wand is the same as his. The core of the wand is full of unicorn feathers. It is innately charged with evil creatures such as dementors. Perhaps it is because of this that caused those anomalies.
"It seems that in this form, it is better not to cast spells casually..." Ivan couldn't help but mourn for Peter for a second, and sighed silently in his heart.
At this point of delay, the two Aurors who were in charge of guarding the observatory heard the movement and caught up.
They were looking at Peter, who was lying on the ground, who didn’t know his life or death.
"It's okay, I just fainted..." An Auror sniffed Peter's nose, slowly breathed a sigh of relief, and turned to look at the dementors around him, frowning and asking.
"What's going on? What is going on here?"
"Someone came in... Save Peter... ran away!" Ivan leaned forward on his own initiative, learning the tone of a dementor, and replied intermittently.
The dementors floating around did not refute. For creatures without vision, they only knew that someone had slipped into the observatory and attacked themselves with a patron saint, and then slipped away.
"What? Someone wants to save Peter Pettigrew?" The two Aurors thought of the identity of Peter Death Eater, and suddenly realized the seriousness of the matter. It seems that the person who sneaked into the observatory was probably also a Death Eater.
Sirius next to 　　 was confused. When the Aurors asked the dementors just now, he was still worried, but unexpectedly, the Aurors would come to such a conclusion after the inquiry.
But dementors have always been synonymous with chaos, and Sirius is not surprised. Generally speaking, people try their best to sneak in, aren't they here to save people?
He is about to clear the suspicion, there is no need to rescue him, the only object of rescue is Peter.
The Aurors also thought of this, so they didn't doubt Ivan's words, and turned their attention to Peter who had passed out of a coma.
"Clear water is like a spring!" One of the Aurors waved his magic wand and summoned a basin of clear water to pour down, intending to wake Peter and inquire carefully about the matter.
Ivan and Sirius suddenly became nervous when they saw this.
Ivan is not sure whether the Forgetting Curse he previously released can achieve the desired effect.
Sirius didn't even know that Peter was under the Forgotten Curse and worried that Peter would reveal the news that Harry and others had come.
Just in the midst of everyone's attention, the gray-headed Peter slowly woke up, but his expression was very strange, his face looked a little gloomy in the night, he glanced around the few people in the room, and said with a sneer.
"The ignorant fool, the Dark Lord will return!"
Peter's sudden words changed the expressions of the two Auror Qiqi present, as if a kind of chill was coming from the soles of their feet.
Then the two woke up suddenly, and one of the angry people punched Peter to make him sober...
After all, the mysterious man has been "dead" for more than ten years, and it is impossible to return!
After two punches, Peter's face with a blue nose and swollen face became very dazed. He looked at the Aurors in front of him nervously, and muttered incomprehensibly.
"Who am I? Where am I? Why am I here?"

chapters.title: Chapter 447: Peter the little dwarf with amnesia?
chapters.content:
"And who are you? Why do you want to tie me up?" Peter's expression became more and more confused. He tried to struggle, but he couldn't get away from the ropes on his body.
Peter's words made the two Aurors stunned, they looked at Peter suspiciously, and sternly questioned.
"Don't pretend to me! You'd better tell us honestly, who is the one who came to save you before?"
Faced with the questions of the two, Peter was at a loss. He didn't quite understand what they were talking about. Some fragmentary memories flashed in his mind, but the scattered ones could not be connected...
However, the Aurors unanimously believed that Peter was pretending to be. After all, how could there be such a coincidence. Just when something went wrong, the insider had such amnesia?
"Hurry up and be honest! Or do you want us to have something hard?" Auror said threateningly with a sullen face.
The other Auror had no patience. He swung his wand directly, and a black beam hit Peter's thigh.
"Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!
But no matter how tortured by the two Aurors, Peter still asked three questions, and they only believed a little.
"Peter Pettigrew must have known some important information about the mysterious person or the remnants of the Death Eaters before someone came to rescue him." One of the Aurors was silent for a while, and then guessed.
"Probably, that person should have found that he could not save Peter, so he cast the Forgetting Curse to make Peter forget everything..." The other Auror nodded in agreement.
Thinking of this, the expressions of the two of them were as ugly as if they had eaten a fly, but they understood how important Peter was being held here.
The above three orders and five applications made them pay special attention. They didn't expect that there was an error in just a few hours, and it was estimated that they didn't run away with the punishment.
I blame the **** Daily Prophet. If it hadn't been for them to report Peter's affairs, those Death Eaters remnants would not have known that Peter was in Hogwarts so soon.
"You are here to guard Peter, I will report the situation!"
After discussing the two Aurors, they made a decision to report the matter and apply for additional manpower. They also need some professional people to see if Peter is really under the Forgotten Curse.
Ivan, disguised as a dementor floating around, listened to their conclusions and frowned, feeling a little tricky.
If Peter really loses his memory, it may cause a lot of trouble in the subsequent judgment process.
Ivan didn't expect things to develop to this point, he accidentally beat the opponent to amnesia.
But the black mark on Peter should be able to prove it, and the Ministry of Magic has also finished recording the confession. Ivan only hopes that the court will go smoothly.
While thinking about things in his mind, Ivan flickered the dementors next to him, telling them that he would hide secretly in the dark, fight for the great cause of the race, and then slip away as fast as possible.
......
At the same time, in the Gryffindor lounge, the three kids who just had a catastrophe were hiding in the corner tremblingly and quietly discussing what had just happened.
"Fortunately those dementors didn't chase us all the time, or we would be caught..." Harry recalled the thrilling experience of being chased by the dementors, and his face was still pale.
"So you should have listened to me a long time ago, where you shouldn't go!" Hermione looked at Harry dissatisfied.
Although she guessed the location of Sirius' detention, she didn't let Harry and Ron take risks. If she couldn't persuade her, she would not follow her to supervise it.
Harry pursed his mouth and did not answer. Seeing so many dementors gathered around the observatory, how could he be assured that Sirius was being held there...
Among the three, Ron, the most bitter one, crumbled and covered his head, his expression uglier than crying. "It's over, my wand is gone! If my mother knew about this, she would definitely kill me!"
"Otherwise, how about I buy you a magic wand?" Harry scratched his head, and said in embarrassment.
Seeing Sirius’ plan was proposed by him, but Ron’s righteous company lost his wand, which made Harry very sad.
"It's not a question of buying a magic wand, Harry! Ron's wand was picked up by a dementor. If the monster hands the wand to the Aurors, they must be able to find out where we have been! "Hermione said angrily.
"What should I do then?" Harry thought of this at Hermione's reminder, and asked nervously.
Ron was even more broken, because it was his wand that was dropped, Ron even wondered if he would be caught in Azkaban.
Just as the three of them were distressed, a slightly helpless voice rang behind them.
"What should I do? Keep your memory well next time, I reminded you not to see Sirius recently!"
Harry and the others were taken aback. They turned their heads abruptly, only to find that Ivan had been standing behind them for some time...
"Ivan! You heard it just now? And when did you run behind us...Why didn't I see you?" Harry's expression was a little embarrassed. He had promised Ivan not to look for Sirius. Yes, now it is breaking his promise.
"It can only be said that your vigilance is too weak. If I were your enemy, you would have died long ago!" Ivan shook his head, avoided Harry's question, and then looked at Ron again. The wand in his hand was thrown away.
"No, Ron, your wand!"
Ron took it in a hurry, glanced at it, and found that this was really the wand he had lost before, and he looked at Ivan with excitement.
"Oh my god, did you find it back? Thank you so much! You are my savior!" The lost Ron ignored the dust on the wand and kissed the wand body, feeling that he was alive again. .
"Ivan, how did you find this wand? Didn't I remember it was picked up by a dementor?" Harry asked curiously.
"I picked it up near the observatory, maybe that dementor had enough of it!" Ivan explained casually.
"So you were on the observatory at the time? When Peter wanted to reveal the identity of Professor Lupin, he suddenly yelled like crazy because of what magic you did on him?" The smart Hermione suddenly Want to understand those abnormal things.
She even suspected that the dementors were summoned back in the process of hunting them down, and it was also Ivan's handwriting.

chapters.title: Chapter 448: Dumbledore Returning
chapters.content:
Harry and Ron also realized this, and turned their heads to look at Ivan in surprise. When they were at the observatory, they didn't even notice Ivan's existence.
"Ivan, how did you do this?" Hermione looked at Ivan and asked curiously.
"It only takes a few special magics to do it. Those dementors are really not very smart. It is not that difficult to hide them..." Ivan said vaguely and planned to fool him. Then quickly changed the subject.
"By the way, Harry! You guys have been a little safe lately, don't look for Sirius anymore! Although I covered the past for you this time, the Aurors did not give up looking for someone who sneaked into the observatory."
Harry and the others hurriedly nodded. Although there were many questions, they did not dare to ask more because of their guilty conscience.
Hermione threw a few books in her arms onto the table with a snap, clapped her hands, and spoke. "Since that matter has been resolved, then it should be time to do business!"
Ivan glanced at the thick books on the table and couldn't help but be speechless.
"Modern Major Case Trial Collection", "Super Defense Skills-How to Overwhelm Your Opponent in Court", "1983 Law Amendments in England (Magic World, "The Defender's Self-cultivation"...
"I'm just going to court to be a testimony, I shouldn't have to read so many books?" Harry looked at the thickness of these books, and had an inexplicable urge to run away.
"But do you know how to be a qualified witness?" Hermione glared at him, opened the book of Super Defense Skills, flipped through the pages of the book and pointed at the content.
"I have watched the defense process of more than one hundred major cases. I bet that in the trial court, Peter's defender will definitely try to make things difficult for you. He will pick out the loopholes in your words and even use words to seduce you. Draw the wrong conclusion."
"So you have to be prepared before the court session! Even if it can increase the odds a little!" Hermione added.
"But who would find a defender for Peter Pettigrew?" Ron curled his lips and murmured.
But as soon as he finished speaking, she heard Hermione retort.
"Peter's mother is still alive. After I found out that Peter disappeared in the memorabilia of the magical world, the Ministry of Magic awarded him a first-class Merlin Medal, which Peter's mother went to receive. And even if no one wants to ask Peter Defender, the trial court will also find one for him!"
Harry looked at the books piled on the table with a bitter face. He was not interested in reading at all, let alone these boring extracurricular books.
But in order to be able to help Sirius, Harry took one of the books and turned it over.
Ivan glanced at the thickness of the books on the table, and couldn't help but mourn for Harry for a second, thinking he might be busy these days...
Just as Ivan was sighing, she turned her head and saw Hermione staring straight at him.
"What's wrong? Hermione!" Ivan asked strangely.
"If I remember correctly, Ivan, you caught Peter Pettigrew, it should be a very important witness!" Hermione stuffed the book on the revision of the laws of the British magical world into Ivan's hands. Yes, he said affirmatively.
"Wait... I don't have to watch it, right?" Ivan's mouth twitched, and he didn't expect Hermione to point the finger at himself.
There are so many things he has to be busy recently, and he is really not in the mood to learn the laws and regulations of the magic world, and Ivan does not think that he will be embarrassed by the opponent's defender.
"Then do you know the operation process of the trial court, do you know exactly what kind of crimes Peter has put down?" Hermione questioned one by one.
Ivan opened his mouth to answer, but he has no understanding of the Western judgment process, let alone the wizarding world.
"Well, I see it!" Ivan finally sighed, resignedly opened the book in his hand and read it.
He suddenly remembered that Dumbledore was not there, and Sirius’s defender might have to find him himself. It doesn’t hurt to know more about the laws.
Hermione sat aside, and intimately explained to Ivan the legal terms related to this case, and pointed out the details that need attention.
It is obvious that the little witch has taken time to read the entire book...
Seeing that Hermione was so serious, Ivan changed his perfunctory appearance before cheering up and started studying hard.
After learning about Ivan, I discovered that the current trial process of the Ministry of Magic is quite similar to that of Muggles, but the process is much simpler than that.
But this is also normal, the entire British magical world, there is just such a small number of people over and over, there is no need to make so many corners.
In the past few days when the wizarding world's laws have been maliciously supplemented, Ivan has also not forgotten to pay attention to Peter's state, and takes the time to change into an owl to secretly visit once a day.
Peter, who was detained in the observatory, seemed very pitiful. He seemed to be tortured by dementors The whole person looked a little silly, and a few words of the Dark Lord eventually appeared in his mouth. Whispers of return.
And the investigators of the Ministry of Magic have thoroughly confirmed that there is indeed something wrong with Peter's memory, and this appearance is not pretended.
Ivan looked at Peter who looked like this, and then remembered the other party's betrayal of his friend. I wonder if it counts as retribution...
After sighing for a while, Ivan did not stay here much, and soon returned to the castle and walked towards the principal's office.
If he didn't count the time wrongly, today should be the time for those members of the Merlin Knights to reply to himself, but I don't know if the other party will agree to his application.
"Cockroach pile!"
Ivan proficiently pronounced the password to enter the principal's room, and the heavy guardian statue slowly turned, letting out the entrance passage.
Ivan stepped into it routinely, and then his expression froze and stopped.
There were some trivial things in the central office, and what he didn't expect was that Dumbledore, who had disappeared for a long time, was sitting on a chair, looking at the letter in his hand.
Phoenix Fox with golden and red feathers stayed affectionately on his shoulder, humming like singing from time to time, as if he was telling something.
"Professor Dumbledore?" Ivan asked tentatively. The experience over the past few days made him uncertain whether he was the real old professor in front of him.
But I think it should be true, because Fox has never been so affectionate to him...
"It's me, Hals!" Dumbledore stopped, turned his head and glanced at him, then nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 449: Dumbledore: What? I want to run for Minister of Magic?
chapters.content:
"You finally came back..." Ivan slowly breathed a sigh of relief.
These days when Dumbledore was absent, he was frightened every day, for fear of something wrong.
"It seems that a lot of things have happened these days when I was away. Although I learned the whole story from the Daily Prophet, they are probably not accurate enough..." Dumbledore scanned the letters and newspapers on the table. , Said meaningfully.
Ivan doesn't know how much information Dumbledore knows, so I just start from the beginning.
"Professor, it's like this... I got a magic map from George and Fred that can show people's names. During one inspection, I accidentally discovered that Ron's mouse showed a name on its head. ......"
Ivan half-true and half-fake the process of discovering Peter's identity. Of course, Ivan also gave a rough overview of what happened recently and how he coped.
Dumbledore applauded when he heard that Ivan was able to uncover Peter's identity by relying on only a name on the map and his knowledge of Animagus Transfiguration.
"What a wonderful reasoning, Hals! If Minerva knew that you discovered Peter's identity by using the knowledge of transfiguration she taught, she would be proud of it!"
"Severus was right, you really are a genius!" Dumbledore looked at Ivan with emotion. He hadn't encountered such a talented little wizard in years.
Among the students he has taught, only Tom can match him.
No... Thinking of this, Dumbledore shook his head secretly in his heart. Even when Tom was the same age, his strength and temperament were far inferior to Ivan.
Even though Tom had his own ideas and liked to be clever, he could still guess some of the other's ideas.
But now when facing Ivan, Dumbledore feels more tired. This little wizard is like a fog that is unpredictable.
Sometimes Ivan’s actions made him feel that this little wizard seemed to be very keen on fame and power.
But at other times, Ivan showed disdain for it again, as if he just wanted to study at ease and didn't want to do things...
Summarizing the various behaviors of Ivan in recent years, it can only be described by the annual wizard confusing behavior award...
Facing the old professor’s praise, Ivan did not dare to accept it, and said very modestly that he had only done some small work, which was really not worth mentioning.
From this incident, Ivan deeply understood a truth, as the saying goes, the greater the ability, the greater the back!
I'm still a child! Dumbledore actually slammed such an important thing as Sirius' overturn to himself. Wouldn't his conscience hurt?
Ivan's gaze at Dumbledore was full of resentment.
However, Dumbledore's face was surprisingly thick. He didn't seem to see the resentment in Ivan's eyes, and continued to ask some detailed questions.
Dumbledore was particularly curious about how Ivan persuaded the Daily Prophet to report on Peter Pettigrew on a large scale, thereby putting pressure on the Ministry of Magic in public opinion.
You must know that the Daily Prophet has always been the mouthpiece of the Ministry of Magic. It is impossible for them to discuss such heavy breaking news with people from the Ministry.
Seeing Dumbledore mentioned the Daily Prophet, Ivan was a little embarrassed, and he said embarrassedly.
"Professor, you may not believe it... the editor-in-chief of the Daily Prophet thought you were running for the post of Minister of Magic because of some misunderstandings, so they all expressed their willingness to support you!"
what? I want to run for Minister of Magic?
Dumbledore was a little dazed, and his expression on Ivan suddenly became very strange.
He really couldn't understand what Ivan said to the other party, that would cause such a misunderstanding?
No wonder he saw that the Prophet’s Daily reported a lot of dark materials from the Ministry of Magic, such as the unfavorable supervision of the Ministry of Magic leading to frequent dementors riots, a senior official suspected of corruption, etc...
At the time, he still felt strange, but now he understands what is going on...
Dumbledore couldn't help having a headache thinking of Ivan's stabbing basket.
He began to wonder if he was right or wrong in throwing this to Ivan...
Although on the surface it seems that Ivan has handled it very well, even better than he had originally thought, the troubles secretly caused are not small.
The Minister of Magic Fudge was jealous of himself, but now that Ivan does this, the gap between the two sides has become even greater!
And the Daily Prophet also needs to explain himself, after all, he has too many things to worry about, and he really doesn't have much energy to be the Minister of Magic.
Thinking like this, Dumbledore was suddenly a little grateful that he was back in time, otherwise, he might not know what would happen.
Ivan knew that he was wrong, and before the old professor asked, he was a bit bitter first, saying that it was not easy for him to be naive!
Not only must we try to persuade the people of the Daily Prophet, but also have to fight with the Minister of Magic Fudge, and have to get rid of the troublesome Harry and others...If Dumbledore comes back a few days later, he will be killed on the spot!
"Is that so?" Listening to Ivan complaining Dumbledore's face showed a surprised expression, he pushed a letter on the table to Ivan's face, and then watched Ivan continue Said.
"I thought you were very comfortable with this kind of life. After all, I don't remember when I sent a nomination letter to the Merlin Knights..."
"Ah... Then you have to ask Minister Fudge. He thinks it is necessary to recognize my contribution to the magic world, so he suggested to apply for me a Merlin Medal with you!"
Ivan glanced at the letters on the table, his expression unchanged, and he threw the pot to Fudge very neatly. How dare he refuse Minister Fudge’s kindness as a counterfeit?
Dumbledore was very skeptical. He didn't think that Fudge would be so kind, especially since Ivan recently made Fudge, the Minister of Magic, scorched.
However, in the reply letter from the Merlin Knights, Fudge was indeed mentioned. This is also the most puzzled part of him...
"Professor Dumbledore, did the Merlin Knights agree to the nomination application?" Ivan asked cautiously because of the legend.
"There is no conclusion yet. They need to wait until the result of the trial comes out and Peter Pettigrew is guilty of the charges. They will consider whether to issue it." Dumbledore replied casually, without questioning the bottom line on this matter.
Ivan fraudulently used his identity to apply for the Merlin Medal, which is still within his tolerance.
When he sent the magic letter to Ivan before, he guessed that the other party might credit the book somewhere else.
It’s just that I didn’t expect Ivan to use it...

chapters.title: Chapter 450: Letter from Nick LeMay and 6 Horcruxes!
chapters.content:
Knowing that the Merlin Knights were still considering nomination, Ivan was a little disappointed.
But since there is no rejection, it means that this matter is still very interesting. It is estimated that when the dust on Peter Pettigrew settles, his Merlin Medal will be available.
Just as Ivan was thinking about it, he unexpectedly saw Dumbledore hand over another letter.
Ivan is at a loss. Is there anything else he has been caught out?
Or which **** wrote to complain to himself?
Several possibilities flashed in Ivan's mind. He picked up the envelope and looked at it, only to find that the letter was signed by the letter underneath.
"Nick LeMay?" Ivan read the gilded characters written on the end of the envelope, then raised his head and looked at Dumbledore in surprise.
Of course he understands who Nick Le May is, but because of this, he feels a little bit incredulous. He and this world-renowned alchemist have nothing to do with each other. Why did the other party send a letter to himself?
"Remember the time converter that you broke?" Dumbledore asked.
Ivan nodded, vaguely thought of his previous guess, and said confidently. "Mr. Nick LeMay fixed it?"
"Yes! I specifically found my old friend Nick and asked for his help." Dumbledore nodded, then smiled and continued to speak.
"You can destroy the time converter to this extent, but it surprised him for a while"
Ivan scratched his head awkwardly. The time converter is so badly broken because of the power of the system. However, the existence of the system is still an absolute secret, so this pot is afraid of betrayal.
"So I talked a lot about you with him. After learning that you also have an outstanding talent in alchemy, this old friend of mine has always wanted to see you. If you say that you are willing to see him too. One side!" Dumbledore's blue eyes under his half-moon glasses stared at Ivan, waiting for his reply.
"Of course! I am honored!" Ivan was overjoyed and agreed without hesitation.
He is worried that his alchemy has reached a bottleneck, and it is difficult to grow without anyone teaching him. Now that Nick LeMay wants to meet himself, it is tantamount to dozing off and giving a pillow.
"Then when can we meet my teacher?" Ivan hurriedly asked.
The speed at which Ivan changed his mouth surprised Dumbledore. He hadn’t said that Nick planned to accept him as a disciple.
Dumbledore shook his head helplessly.
"Not now, Hals! You still need to complete your studies during this period, so you have to wait for the summer vacation, and we may have to go for a long time. You have to convince your mother and do a good job. Be prepared!" Dumbledore said in a deep voice.
Ivan then calmed down. Although he felt that with his current level of magic, the third-year course was unnecessary for him, but considering the grade point issue, Ivan could only be patient and wait until the summer vacation.
Dumbledore saw Ivan's reaction in his eyes and nodded secretly. He thought Ivan would be more anxious, but he didn't expect the child to be more patient than he expected.
"Anyway, the rest is in the letter Nick wrote to you. If there is nothing else, you can go back first!" Dumbledore waved his hand and said.
"Then I won't bother you, Professor!" Ivan put the old magic wand on the table and took out the time converter after thinking about it.
After all, this time converter is something of the Ministry of Magic, and he doesn’t need to force Dumbledore to stay
Now that Nick LeMay can repair this time converter, he probably also knows how time is made.
He deliberately tentatively called Nick Le May a teacher, but Dumbledore did not refute it. It can be seen that Nick Le May wanted to accept himself as his disciple when he met him this time.
While thinking, Ivan walked toward the principal outside.
Dumbledore glanced at what Ivan put on the table and watched Ivan disappear into the principal’s room.
Accompanied by the rumbling sound of the door, the principal's room once again restored tranquility.
Dumbledore was silent for a while, his palm flicked across the desk, and a diary with a few holes in the middle appeared on the table, with a dim crown beside it.
"The third one!" Dumbledore whispered, and stretched out the other hand that had been hidden in his sleeve.
The weird thing is that this palm is scorched black, faintly exuding black air, and a ring inlaid with black gems is also worn on the thumb.
Dumbledore reached out and took the ring off, placed it next to the crown, staring at these three things silently.
Since Ivan destroyed the diary and the crown last school year, he has noticed the mystery of Voldemort's immortality, that is, making Horcruxes!
Since there are two of these things at the same time, there is likely to be a third, fourth, or even more!
When he realized this, Dumbledore couldn't help feeling a bit chilly.
Splitting a complete soul is not an easy task. Therefore, the production of Horcruxes is extremely evil. It is necessary to break and split one's soul through evil means such as murder, and then separate a part of the soul from the body and seal it in the vessel. .
After the split of the complete soul, it becomes extremely unstable. The production of plural Horcruxes not only has to endure the pain of multiple split souls, but also affects the mood of the producer.
It can be said that Voldemort, in order to avoid death, has been almost crazy to do such a thing.
Dumbledore muttered to himself with pity or emotion, but the plural Horcrux also meant that Voldemort was difficult to kill completely.
After all, as long as there is still a Horcrux, Tom can survive no matter what kind of blow he receives!
Fortunately, the two Horcruxes chosen by Voldemort gave him some hints, which made his search for the remaining Horcrux a lot easier!
Ravenclaw's crown is one of the relics left by the founding Big Four, and the diary is the vehicle for recording Tom’s life as a student.
Since Tom chose these two things as Horcruxes, it means that other Horcruxes may not be randomly selected, but rather expensive or commemorative items.
Except for the Gryffindor Sword, Dumbledore suspected that several other relics were also made into Horcruxes.
He has not forgotten that Tom once returned to Hogwarts and wanted to apply for the position of professor of Defence Against the Dark Arts. He felt a little surprised at the time. Now when he wants to come to Tom, he probably coveted the Sword of Gryffindor. Store the Ravenclaw crown.
"If this is the case, then there will be at least five Horcruxes" Dumbledore muttered to himself after closing his eyes and pondering for a while.
Then Dumbledore seemed to have thought of something suddenly, and opened his eyes suddenly. There was an inexplicable light gleaming in those azure blue eyes, he said tremblingly.
"No, maybe six!"

chapters.title: Chapter 451: Death 3 Hallows-Resurrection Stone [Thanks to dsf twenty-three d...
chapters.content:
Thinking of that possibility, Dumbledore's brows frowned, and his slender index finger kept tapping on the desk, making a dull noise.
Although he didn't want to believe it, he told him sensibly that Harry was probably also one of the Horcruxes!
Dumbledore sighed slowly, his face seemed to be getting older for a while, the magic in his body was unconsciously dissipating everywhere, and the surrounding space seemed a bit depressed.
But soon, the melodious singing sounded in the silent office.
Phoenix Fox, standing on his shoulders, had noticed Dumbledore's scorched palm, so he flapped his wings anxiously and quickly flew to the table, leaned his head, and blinked his eyes.
A drop of tears slowly slipped down, dripping onto the scorched skin
The corrosive sound continued one after another, and strange black air escaped from the palm of the hand, and they shrank back as if they had been suppressed, but the scorched black traces showed no signs of disappearing.
Fox became more and more sad, and more tears fell, but to no avail.
"It's okay, Fox!" Dumbledore calmed the golden red phoenix with his intact hand.
This situation had long been his expectation. The magic that Voldemort had set on this Horcrux was extraordinary and could not be removed by conventional means.
"Go and inform Severus, bring him here, Fox!" Dumbledore said suddenly, he could only start with the potion now to see if he could find a solution.
The golden red phoenix nodded, and disappeared into the principal’s office as quickly as possible.
It didn't take long for a flame to explode in the open space on the side, and the flame rapidly expanded into a human shape.
Then the flames gradually subsided, and Snape in a black robe appeared in the principal's room.
What made Dumbledore feel a little surprised was that Snape, who had been teleported over, maintained the action of boiling the potion, and there were still a few scratches on his clothes.
"What is it that you are so anxious to let this red bird come to me?" Snape asked with a sullen face, throwing the remnants of the potion in his hand onto the table, and asked in dissatisfaction.
He was brewing a very precious potion in the basement, but the phoenix suddenly appeared in front of him. Without asking, he pulled his clothes and forcibly teleported him over.
Dumbledore didn’t reply, just raised the scorched palm
"Are you hurt?" Snape's pupils tightened.
"Yes, as you see!" Dumbledore nodded.
Snape ignored the previous episode for a while, and hurriedly stepped forward, grabbed Dumbledore's arm, and looked at it carefully.
"How is the injury?" Dumbledore asked.
"It's difficult to do. This is a very special black magic that can become stronger by corroding your magic power and is difficult to eradicate. I remember that there is a potion that may be useful, but it can only be contained at most!" Snape After probing for a while, he slowly shook his head.
