"Use Kreacher's blood!" The old house elf stood up excitedly, grabbed a sharp gravel from the ground, and was about to cut his wrist.
But just then Lupin reached out his hand to stop Kreacher's behavior.
"Stop, Kreacher! You have consumed enough just now, and you will have to take us out with Dobby later. You need to maintain enough magic and physical strength!" Lupin said.
"Then use me..." Sirius stepped forward, but was interrupted by Lupin before he finished speaking.
"No! Sirius, neither can you. The magic you want to use later also requires a lot of blood, so I'll do it this time! Don't forget, my recovery ability is better than yours!" Lupin was very positive. Speaking firmly, then he put the wand against his wrist.
The next moment, a dim light lit up on the tip of the wand.
Sirius had no time to stop it, and a large amount of scarlet blood flowed out of Lupin's wrist, as if guided by magic, it followed the dark stone wall upstream and dyed it bright red.
"Remus! This is my business from beginning to end, you don't need to do it like this!" Sirius sighed, and looked at Lupin, who had lost too much blood and his face became paler, and felt very uncomfortable.
Kreacher sobbed in a low voice, now Lupin reminded him of Regulus...
That day more than ten years ago, it was here that he kept begging Master Regulus to use his own blood to open the stone gate, but it was rejected by the young master...
Ivan watched the steady flow of blood, and was drawn out by magic from the wound on Lupin's wrist, frowning involuntarily.
When Dumbledore cracked this level in the original time and space, he probably didn't use so much blood...
Still referring to the sacrifices Voldemort requested, not only blood, but the magic contained in blood. Lupin's blood quality is far inferior to Dumbledore, so he needs to consume more?
But it’s right to think so.
If it weren’t, Voldemort wouldn’t sacrifice his subordinates when he hid the Horcrux, just grab a Muggle, why not risk exposure and ask Regulus for a house elf as a victim.
The blood transfusion lasted for a while, and a dazzling white light suddenly appeared on the stone wall, and the white light was vaguely visible in the shape of an arch.
The remaining blood was gradually absorbed in, and the entire cave was slowly shaking. The secret door in front was opened, revealing a doorway, which was very dark and couldn't see anything.
Ivan immediately stepped forward to cast a healing spell and healed the wound on Lupin's wrist.
But due to a lot of blood loss, Lupin's face was pale and scary, and his body swayed before standing still.
"Are you okay? Lupin?" Sirius hurried up to support him, and asked worriedly.
Lupin shook his head, saying that he had nothing to do.
"Let's leave now... I'm not sure how long this door will be open!" Lupin reminded.
Sirius became more guilty, patted Lupin's shoulder solemnly, and then strode into the open door with his wand.
Ivan followed behind Sirius and walked in. There was another cave behind the cave. The whole mountain seemed to have been hollowed out, and the interior space was amazing.
In front of them was an extremely wide black lake, and they couldn't see the opposite shore at a glance. They were standing on the shore now.
Ivan couldn't help but approached a few steps forward, crouched down and brought the luminous wand close to the lake. The white light was reflected in the dead lake below, but it could not penetrate, only a dark patch underneath could be seen. ...
"The water quality here is terrible, I am afraid it will be difficult to see things if we go down..." Ivan stood up anxiously, lowered his voice as much as possible, and said softly.
To be honest, knowing that there are countless corpses underneath, you have to sneak in to fish for corpses That's what a fool can do, but unfortunately, he has to take it this time. Fool.
Sirius also felt deeply worried, which was more difficult than he had originally imagined.
gurgling...
The quiet lake surface suddenly heard the sound of gurgling water. In the faint fluorescence from the extension of the magic wand, pale and rotting hands stretched out from the dark bottom of the lake, covering the entire lake...
Ivan and the others who saw this scene shuddered in chills. They all knew that there were definitely a lot of corpses, but they didn't know how many corpses were.
"How many people did Voldemort kill?" Ivan looked at the pale arms densely distributed like lotus roots in a pond wherever he could see, wondering if Voldemort had killed a Muggle town, otherwise it would be impossible to make such a huge one. Legion of corpses.
"Quick, drink it! This kind of potion can hide our vitality and make us look like the dead in a short time." Sirius's face changed, and he hurriedly took out a few bottles of dark green potion from the pocket of the wizard robe. Distributed to everyone.
Lupin, Kreacher, and Dobby did not hesitate to follow the order and took it. Ivan also took a bottle, opened the stopper of the potion, and poured it in one mouthful.
The entrance of the dark green potion is very bitter, as if it was expired and forgot to put the sugar in the coffee. After swallowing it, the stomach was burned by flames, and it was painful.
After a while, the pain gradually disappeared, and a icy feeling spread throughout his body. Ivan felt the blood in his body as if frozen, and even the heartbeat became very weak...

chapters.title: Chapter 503: Black Lake and the corpse
chapters.content:
Ivan tried to raise his hand, his movements were much stiffer than usual, and he waved his magic wand again, only to find that there was no hindrance to the operation of magic power, and then he turned his head to look at Sirius and the others with confidence.
At this time, Sirius and Lupin have both drunk the potion, their faces turned blue, their expressions dull, they didn't look like a living person at all.
"It's great, they retreat, it seems that this medicine is useful!" Lupin said in a hoarse voice looking at the lake with a stiff expression.
Ivan also looked over. In the faint fluorescence of the magic wand, the pale arm that stretched out on the lake slowly fell silent.
Soon, the black lake surface returned to its previous calm.
But whether it's Ivan, Sirius or Lupin, looking at the calm and waveless lake in front of them, they are a little bit shy.
Judging from the number of arms that emerged just now, there are probably hundreds of corpses in the fluorescent-covered area...
While the whole lake is too big to see, Ivan eagerly hopes that most of the corpses in the entire lake will be attracted here, otherwise, the number of corpses will be more terrifying than he thought...
hundreds...thousands...thousands?
or...
Ivan didn't dare to think about it any more, it was a number he couldn't accept.
calmed down for a while, Ivan remembered something, turned to Sirius and Lupin, and said apologetically.
"I'm sorry, it seems that I was careless just now, and I rashly lit up the lake and disturbed them..."
"No, don't blame you! It's not a matter of light. We still maintain the effect of the lighting spell, but they haven't approached it. This shows that it's not the light that attracted their attention." Sirius shook his head stiffly, calmly. Analysis Road.
"We should have too many people coming in!"
Lupin's voice rang, and he took Sirius' words and continued. "Kreacher told us that he had accompanied Voldemort and Regulus in, and the corpses at the bottom of the lake did not move."
"So two people are safe. This is the limit set by Voldemort. An intruder carries a victim!" Ivan said with a guess from his mind, mobilizing his memory.
Voldemort certainly does not want anyone to steal his Horcrux, but considering the possibility of transferring the Horcrux in the future, some restrictions must be relaxed, such as allowing two people to come in!
If the number of intruders breaks through this limit, the huge tide of corpses will overwhelm all the intruders.
But thanks to Kreacher, they knew the situation in advance, prepared the corresponding potion, shielded their own vitality, and made the underwater corpses sense that the number of living creatures on the shore was zero, and then they fell silent again.
"Yes, that's probably it!" Sirius nodded, but he hesitated again when he remembered what happened to Regulus.
"I think it’s not safe even if two people come in, because Regulus was dragged into the water. That means that once someone drinks the potion placed in the center, the corpses will become restless and attack all approaching. Water creatures, and overturn their ships!"
On an isolated island in the middle of the lake, with a drag of drinking potions, facing hundreds or even thousands of corpses, what a desperate sight, let alone normal intruders have to row out in a boat , Fight against the corpses on the lake!
Thinking of this, Ivan was not so thankful that he didn't have to do such a dangerous thing.
Although what they are doing now may be more dangerous than this...
Just as the three of them analyzed the various restrictions in the cave, Kreacher was also trying hard to recall how to raise the boat.
The old house elf went around, and finally stopped on the bank on the right side, looking around blankly.
"That ship should be near here, gentlemen! The chain may be invisible, Kreacher can’t see it!" Kreacher reached out and grabbed it in the void, but it might be that it was too short and it was enough. Less than.
"Aparecium~" Sirius lifted his wand and waved it. The wave of magic power spread from the tip of the wand to all directions. The water waves on the lake were slightly rippling, but nothing happened.
"The magic set by Voldemort himself must not be so easy to break! Let's look for it carefully!" Lupin shook his head, raised his hand and paddled in the air, looking for the chain hidden in the void.
Ivan also stepped forward to help, but he found nothing, which made him frown, wondering if the method they were thinking about was right.
What did Dumbledore do in the original time and space? Grab the chain in the void and pull it out?
How should I catch it?
After many years, Yifan's memory in this area has become a bit fragmented. If he hadn't practiced Occlumency, he could organize his memory by himself, I am afraid he would have forgotten about it.
And Dumbledore's magic level is very high, what he can do, he may not be able to do it.
No, it's wrong! How did Na Regulus raise the boat?
Ivan thought for a while, and felt that it shouldn't be that difficult. Regulus could not be stronger than them, it should be because he had neglected something.
Ivan's heart moved, tried to attach magic power to his hand, and continued to explore as before. After a while, his palm touched a cold, long, and very hard object.
"Found it!" Ivan called out Sirius and Lupin who were still looking for, and then pulled his hands vigorously.
Suddenly there was a dingling sound in the void. It was the sound of the chain crossing the surface and the last straightening, and then a thick green copper chain suddenly emerged from the depths of the lake and wrapped around Ivan’s arm like a snake. .
Ivan struggled to step back and prepared to pull the boat out. His expression was very difficult, his face changed, and he almost let go, because he sensed that his magic power was being swallowed quickly.
Sirius and Lupin hurriedly followed Ivan's appearance, attached magic to their hands, and tried to pull the chain to help, but they soon discovered that they couldn't pull it at all, and no matter how hard they were, it would not help.
"Don't waste your time, it will only absorb the magic of my own person!" Ivan sighed and guessed how the ship works.
Since he has lost so much magic power, he can't give up all his previous efforts. Ivan simply pulls the chain hard again, and a lot of magic power is poured into the rusty copper chain from the place where his palm touches.
When the magic power was nearly half consumed, the chain shook abruptly, pulling something up from the dark bottom of the lake.
It was a small boat. The bow suddenly appeared to the surface like a ghost, and the hull also floated out like a chain, glowing green light, floating towards them.
The strange thing is that the Black Lake is still calm, as if the ship doesn't exist, it's just an illusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 504: The limits of crossing the lake and the evil taste of the Dark Lord
chapters.content:
Seeing the ship finally rise, Ivan sighed in relief and loosened the chain, but then he felt the magic in his body and his face turned black again.
"How is it? Are you okay, Ivan?" Sirius said worriedly.
"I'm fine, I just consumed half of my magic power!" Ivan shook his head and explained.
In the original time and space, Dumbledore was right. Voldemort expected the intruder to make corresponding sacrifices in every aspect, weakening like a frog boiled in warm water, until he was unable to resist and drowned in the lake.
first opened the door to draw blood, consuming a lot of physical energy and a small amount of magic.
Immediately after he raised the boat, he needed to consume half of his magic power again, and finally rowed all the way to the small island in the center, and had to face the problem of whether to drink medicine or not.
Ivan can only sigh that Voldemort's evil taste is really extraordinary, so it is better to give the intruder a happy one...
The three of them and two elves came in, sharing with each other, and they were all in a bad state. It was hard to imagine how Regulus persisted in the process.
"Is this the ship? It doesn't look sturdy, shouldn't it sink halfway?" Lupin took a few steps forward, tapping lightly with his wand.
"It shouldn't be! Voldemort is definitely counting on himself to come again in the future, I believe he doesn't want to fall into the lake halfway!" Ivan said.
Lupin and Sirius both nodded, feeling relieved.
Ivan continued to speak. "As for the operating mechanism of this ship, I have already guessed a bit. It absorbs half of my magic power for operation. According to our previous judgment, I can probably get two of me to sit on it!"
"Two of you? This is not good news, how heavy are you?" Sirius frowned.
"I mean magic power!" Ivan rolled his eyes irritably, "Voldemort doesn't think about weight! He only considers how much magic power has crossed the Black Lake! And my magic power is not less than that of an adult wizard, so this ship The boat can accommodate two adult wizards crossing the lake together..."
Ivan thinks that the copper chain just absorbed his magic power and supplied the ship to run, but at the same time it was measuring how much magic power he had!
According to the rules, one person will bring one victim, so there must be two summons in exchange, so that Regulus can board the ship with his equivalent Kreacher with magic power.
And this amount of magic power may have a limit, if it is changed to Dumbledore, it will definitely not be taken away by half of the magic power.
But correspondingly, the boat can't hold two of them, so the old professor misjudged that the boat was for one person.
In the end, Dumbledore was able to take Harry on the boat, simply because Harry’s magic power was not worth mentioning compared to the magic power he sacrificed.
"That is to say, only two people can get on the boat, and the other people must stay here?" Sirius's expression was not very attractive.
"It should be like this... Anyway, let me go with you! Professor Lu Ping put a lot of blood just now. It would be difficult to do it if he was physically weak when he went down to the lake. It would be better to stay on the shore to support us." Fan explained.
Even if he loses a lot of magic power, it will not affect the combat effectiveness. It can only be said that the battery life is worse.
But Lupin is different. The amount of blood consumed when opening the door is probably thousands of milliliters. In this state, it is not necessary to salvage the corpse.
"Is there no other way to cross the lake?" Lupin is also very aware of his physical condition, but he is not assured that Ivan will do this dangerous thing.
He looked at the black lake in front of him unwillingly, wondering if he could transform another boat.
"Ordinary ships may not be able to sail on it, but we can try this!" Ivan thought for a while, and waved his magic wand against a black rock on the shore.
The hard rock suddenly softened, changing its shape as if being kneaded by an invisible big hand.
After a while, a sturdy eagle appeared in front of everyone. It let out a low call, and then fluttered its wings vigorously and flew towards the center of the black lake.
Sirius who had seen the form of Ivan Animagus immediately guessed what he meant. If he could fly over the lake, then Ivan could completely change into the form of an owl and follow the ship, leaving a space with one more person!
The majestic eagle flew over the lake, and there seemed to be no danger in the sky.
But before everyone was happy, I saw the eagle suddenly plunged into the water. After a few difficult flutters, it was grabbed by several hands protruding from the water and dragged into the black lake.
Watching this scene, the corners of Ivan's mouth twitched.
He was pretty sure that the forbidden air magic was applied there insidiously in the second half of the lake. If anyone thought that they could slip past with a flying broom without taking a boat, they would fall into the lake halfway.
"Well, it seems that Voldemort didn't leave any loopholes for us to drill..." Sirius sighed helplessly, and then stepped onto the boat.
The ship sank nearly halfway immediately, and after Ivan got on the ship, it sank again, but it seemed that there was still a little space left.
Ivan was keenly aware of this, and when he thought about it, he realized that it was because he had consumed half of his magic power just now, so he had vacated some places Thinking of this, he looked at the old housekeeper on the bank. The elf said. "Kreacher, how much magic power you still have, if it's less than half, you can try it!"
"This is too risky, isn't it?" Lupin tried to stop, but Kreacher had already climbed up, the ship swayed a few times, and did not sink.
"Just as I thought!" Ivan was not surprised at all. Kreacher had used Apparition several times before, still carrying two people. It would be nice if he had one third of the magic left. .
Lupin shook his head and did not agree with Ivan's adventurous behavior, but before they set off, he still reminded him.
"Ivan, as your former Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor, I must take a test on you. What should we do if we encounter a corpse?"
"Curse with flames!" Ivan thought for a while and replied.
"Yes, you have always been smart, Hals! The corpse is afraid of light and heat!" Lupin laughed.
"But I don't think it will help. You can't expect me to summon flames under the water..." Ivan vomited.
Lupin's expression became a little embarrassed.
The boat carrying two people and one elf already moved slowly and headed towards the middle of the lake. At this time, Ivan found out that he had something forgotten to Lupin, and immediately shouted at him. With a sound, the reagent bottle was thrown away.
Lupin quickly reached out and took it. He looked down and saw a bottle of brown potion. While he was puzzled, he heard Ivan's voice coming from a distance.
"If you are in danger, drink this potion and transform into a werewolf!"

chapters.title: Chapter 505: Scavenging dead bodies at the bottom of the lake (2 in 1 4,000 words)
chapters.content:
Lu Ping was confused. Of course he could recognize that Ivan gave him a potion of wolf poison, but today is not the full moon, how can he become a wolf?
But he didn't have time to ask, because there was a shallow mist on the lake, and Sirius and Ivan in the boat had disappeared in front of him.
......
At the same time, the boat was quietly moving on the lake, as if being pulled by an invisible rope, and slowly moved closer to the center of the lake without paddling.
No one dared to speak all the way, everyone was worried that they would disturb the corpses in the lake. The surroundings were dim and scary, and only a ray of green light could be seen flickering in the distance.
Sirius stood on the ship holding his wand high, illuminating the way forward.
Ivan next to 　　 was very interested in this small boat. Sitting on the bow of the boat slowly stroking the hull, the touch was wet and very slick.
Even with his current alchemy level, he can’t see how the ship works. Perhaps Voldemort didn’t use alchemy to make it, but instead used powerful magic power to enchant the ship to some extent.
While Ivan was studying, the speed of the boat suddenly became slower and slower.
"We are here!" Sirius said in a low voice.
Ivan looked ahead, and through the fog he found a smooth rocky island in the middle of the lake.
It seems to be about the size of a classroom, empty above it, only a base over one meter high is very conspicuous. On the base is a stone basin, and the green fluorescence is transmitted from the stone basin.
Ivan's figure flickered, but the boat under him slowly stopped.
Sirius took the lead and stepped onto the island, walking towards the stone basin in the center. Ivan thought about it, and quickly followed.
"Did Regulus drink this kind of thing?" Sirius murmured and asked. He looked at the stone basin, staring at the emerald green liquid glowing with phosphorescence.
You can tell that this thing is poisonous just by looking at it, and drinking it will never feel uncomfortable!
"Yes... Master Regulus ordered Kreacher to supervise him to drink up these potions..." The old house elf sobbed lowly, recalling the scene in his mind.
Sirius was silent for a while, his eyes fixed on another locket located in the basin. "Since Regulus took the Horcrux out, why did he make the same thing and put it back."
"Probably want to confuse Voldemort? Let him mistakenly think that his Horcrux still exists, so that Voldemort will not make more Horcruxes and die in a certain battle." Ivan combined the original time and space. Regulus analyzed the note left in the fake locket.
It's a pity that Regulus's plan fell through. Kreacher has no ability to destroy Voldemort's Horcrux. If he does not appear, the fake Horcrux placed here will pit Dumbledore.
Thinking of this, Ivan couldn't help but shook his head. Regulus used his life to arrange all this but accidentally pit his friendly army. The old professor was miserable enough. After so much torture, he got a Xibei goods. ..
Sirius took a deep look at the stone basin, without touching it, turned his head to look at the house elf who was still sobbing and said.
"Kreacher, take me to the place where Regulus was dragged down the lake."
Kreacher nodded fiercely, and walked towards the left side of the island with Sirius.
Ivan did not rush to follow, hesitated for a moment, and gently waved his magic wand. A slight fluorescence appeared on the floor of the stone basin base, which connected to each other into a line of words, and soon fell silent again.
He released a trigger-type magic there, as long as someone approaches the text, it will show up to remind those who come.
lest Dumbledore find here all the way after they leave.
Of course, it might be seen by Voldemort, and that would be interesting.
Ivan smiled and turned away without hesitation.
At this time, Sirius was squatting on the ground, with a serious expression, his left wrist was scratched, and a large amount of blood dripped on the ground, which was drawn into a strange pattern.
Ivan stood quietly watching this scene, not surprised.
Sirius told him before that there is a blood connection between his brothers, and he can use a kind of magic to strengthen this connection in a short time to locate Regulus.
But this is obviously a kind of black magic, and I don't know which book Sirius looks from. It seems to be quite restrictive, otherwise Sirius would not have to go to this island to complete the ritual.
After about two minutes, Sirius drew a pattern, pressed his right hand on it, and muttered an obscure spell.
The blood on the ground immediately reacted, climbing all the way along the palm of his hand as if he was alive, and gathered the same pattern on the back of Sirius's hand, which looked like a blood-colored tattoo, glowing red.
"Great, he's still here!" Sirius said excitedly, shaking his body.
The success of the magic proves that Regulus' corpse is still there and well preserved. It has not been torn to pieces by the corpses and merged into the lake, otherwise it will not be sensed.
Sirius couldn't help feeling the excitement in Nai's heart. He imposed a head-foaming curse on himself, and then squeezed his wand and plunged into the black lake.
Ivan didn't even have time to stop, so he patted his forehead helplessly.
In his opinion, before going down to the lake, he must at least discuss the coping strategies for various crises, and then check if there are any problems with the lake... instead of going so rashly...
But at this time Kreacher had also jumped out of the lake. He was pulled too far and no one could be found, so Ivan had to follow along.
"It's cold!"
When he submerged in the lake, Ivan immediately felt something was wrong. It was summer, and the water in the Black Lake was as cold as winter.
and it was dark all around, and only vaguely saw something lying in front of him.
"Lumos~" Ivan waved the wand lightly, and a ray of light lit up from the top of the wand and spread out in all directions.
I was taken aback when he saw the surrounding Ivan clearly. The corpse in front of him was a corpse, to be precise, a male corpse with open eyes.
Ivan can clearly see the soaked and swollen face and the protruding eyes compared to ordinary people. Those eyes are staring at him.
Ivan almost launched an attack. Fortunately, he remembered that after drinking the potion, his physical characteristics were similar to that of a corpse. The opponent shouldn't attack him, otherwise he would have rushed over.
Thinking of this, Ivan felt more at ease. He tried to get closer, but the latter did not move, as if he was really dead.
Until he got close, the corpse didn't move, trembled, and then sank directly.
Ivan thought a little bit. It seems that Lupin was right. The corpse couldn't help but fear the heat and the light.
After confirming this, Ivan didn't pay attention to the other party, and tried to swim towards another dark spot in the black lake. The corpse could not use magic. This light must have been made by Sirius.
The closer, the more and more corpses around.
There are all kinds of corpses for men, women, old people, and children. Obviously, he was right before. Voldemort must have slaughtered a Muggle town, otherwise the British magical world would simply not have so many corpses.
And these corpses just float in the lake either scattered or densely, motionless.
Ivan was swimming forward while carefully watching the surrounding corpses. Sometimes he even had to push away some of the corpses in the way, or pass through several corpses.
I don’t know how long it took. When Ivan's hands and feet were a little numb, he finally saw Sirius.
He is not far ahead, and the mark on the back of his right hand is emitting a blood-red light, which means that Regulus's body is nearby.
But this kind of magic is obviously unable to locate accurately, so Sirius was forced to swim in front of the corpses one by one, checking their faces.
Ivan also helped to find, holding his wand and relying on the faint light, distinguishing every face where he could see.
While looking at them, Ivan found that all the corpses seemed to be staring at him and Sirius. The swollen faces and sunken eyes were very crippled.
He understood that it was because of the light curse that attracted the attention of these corpses, but their IQ was so low that they could not determine that they were alive, so they fell into such a downtime.
Ivan couldn't determine when these corpses would find something wrong, and then rushed forward, and it was impossible to stop releasing the curse of lighting, so he could only choose to speed up the action.
Before he came, Sirius had shown him a portrait of Regulus. If the opponent was not so disfigured by the lake, he would still be able to tell it.
"Master Regulus!"
Just as Ivan was recognizing it carefully, a faint, indistinct voice came into his ears. Ivan turned his head abruptly and looked over. It was Kreacher who made the sound.
This old house elf doesn't know what magic it uses. It can stay underwater for so long without using the bubble head curse, and can even speak with its mouth open.
But Ivan is not paying attention to this now, because Kreacher obviously discovered something, and swims forward with excitement at this moment.
Ivan followed without hesitation, and saw Kreacher hugging a corpse at the bottom of the lake from a distance.
It was a young male corpse lying quietly at the bottom of the lake, motionless, wearing a dark green robe, and a conspicuous black badge on his chest.
got closer to Ivan before he could see that it was Black’s family crest. It was made up of a shield with a five-pointed star and a dagger embedded in it, and there were two greyhounds standing next to it.
Based on this alone, Ivan can confirm that this is Regulus!
Although he found someone, he didn't have any happy mood. Sirius next to him was not happy at all, because Regulus, like the corpses, had his eyes open, staring at them, staring at the light!
Ivan suddenly understood that the scene they least wanted to see had happened. Regulus was converted into a corpse!
Sirius' body was trembling slightly, whether it was angry or unbelievable, but fortunately, to the extent that he lost his mind without anger, he opened his mouth and wanted to let Kreacher loosen quickly.
It's just that they took a step slower. Regulus, who had been motionless like a corpse, suddenly moved after being hugged by Kreacher. The swollen white Sensen's hands clamped the neck of the house elf like iron tongs.
Kreacher patronized with excitement, completely unprepared for Regulus, even after being pinched, he didn't resist. Instead, he felt that this was Master Regulus' punishment to him.
But in these decades, Regulus, who had been completely transformed into a corpse, didn't know what keeping hands was.
Kreacher was quickly pinched and rolled his eyes, and the magic that had been blessed on his body couldn't be sustained and collapsed, and a large amount of lake water poured in directly from his mouth and nose.
"PetrificusTotalus!" Seeing that the situation is critical, Sirius immediately suspended the release of the Light Curse, and then quickly waved his wand.
A white beam of light passed through the water and hit Regulus.
Regulus's originally white, soaked and swollen skin suddenly became gray, maintaining his original posture, and the movement of his hands stopped.
Ivan seized the opportunity to grab Kreacher and rescued it from Regulus's hands, and promptly imposed a head-foaming spell on it to prevent it from being drowned.
However, the situation did not get better. Sirius’s attack on Regulus was like triggering a taboo. The dead corpses around him suddenly became agitated.
The few corpses that were very close to Sirius stretched out their hands and grabbed his clothes and arms. More corpses swam toward Ivan with hideous faces.
Ivan is very anxious. He understands that Sirius's magic attack on the corpse must be a certain limitation triggered, and now the corpses no longer regard them as the same kind.
"Sectumsempra..." Ivan waved his wand to cast a spell to save Sirius, but the latter shook his head at him, and the mouth under the bubble curse was saying something.
Close your eyes! Ivan read this word from Sirius's mouth, and he immediately reacted and closed his eyes.
The next moment, an extremely dazzling light shone from the top of Sirius’ wand, like a supernova shining in the dark universe, Ivan could feel how strong this light was when he closed his eyes.
The corpses that bound Sirius loosened him, and hundreds of corpses that had flowed toward them also fled in the opposite direction in fear.
After the light faded away, Ivan opened his eyes and found that apart from the petrified Regulus, there were no other corpses in sight.
Ivan couldn't help feeling that Sirius was reckless and reckless. After all, he was still a bit wise. He couldn't cast a flame curse under the water, but the greatly enhanced fluorescent flashing could also dispel the corpse.

chapters.title: Chapter 506: No matter how much he splits the soul, he won't be so stupid...
chapters.content:
Sirius dispelled the corpse with only an enhanced version of the light curse, and Ivan was amazed by his quick wit.
It is extremely difficult to dispose of hundreds of corpses underwater. Ivan estimates that he can only do this if he transforms into a basilisk, but he does not have so much magic power now.
But the bright curse is a cure for the symptoms but not the root cause, and the corpses who have been expelled may come back at any time.
In addition, the black lake water greatly reduced the scope of the bright curse. It takes more magic power to dispel these corpses than usual, so it won't be used a few times at all.
Sirius knew very well that he was not out of danger, so he pulled up the petrified Regulus, greeted Ivan, and swam forward vigorously.
Ivan also dragged his stomach into the lake, and Kreacher, who was still a little dizzy, followed.
They are far away from the island now, so no one has to swim back, they can only walk one way to the dark, hoping to swim directly to the shore.
It’s just that there are too many corpses along the way. Sirius and Ivan can only alternately use the light curse to disperse the corpses that are constantly gathering.
The cold lake water is constantly consuming their stamina. Ivan doesn’t know how long he swims. There is not much magic power left in his body, and his body is almost numb.
Ivan stared at the surroundings except for darkness or darkness, and even wondered if Sirius had lost his way. They might drown in the lake today.
Fortunately, it turns out that Sirius has a good sense of direction. After a while, Ivan keenly realized that he could see the bottom of the lake, and the shore of the reef in front of him also came into his sight.
Sirius, who was swimming ahead, once again released an intensified light curse. He swam all the way to the shore, grabbed the groove of a rock, climbed up neatly, and then, with the help of Ivan, brought Regulus down. Kreacher pulled it up.
"Quick, give me your hand!" Sirius settled Regulus and Kreacher, and hurriedly went to Raifan and brought him up with him.
At this time, a wet, pale hand suddenly stretched out from the lake and grabbed Ivan's thigh tightly, trying to drag him down the lake.
Ivan looked down, and it was a female corpse who grabbed her. Her mouth was wide open, her complexion was ferocious, and her eyes were full of madness.
"Setusepra!" Ivan waved his wand without hesitation.
The invisible and shadowless blade of magic power cut directly from her open mouth, cut off half of her body, and the stumps and internal organs fell straight to the lake, but no blood flowed out strangely.
Without the hindrance of the corpse, Sirius successfully pulled Ivan ashore, watching his pale and bloodless face, Sirius asked with some worry. "Are you all right? Ivan?"
"I'm fine, but I think we need to be faster!" Ivan shook his head and turned to look at the black lake. In the shallow mist, more and more corpses crawled out of the lake.
"Kreacher, can you teleport the three of us away at once?" Sirius asked.
Kreacher hesitated for a while, and finally gritted his teeth and said that he could send two people at most at once!
Ivan and Sirius are a little disappointed, unless they are willing to give up Regulus, otherwise Kreacher alone will not work.
Because Kreacher said very clearly before entering that it could not sense the inside of the cave, which meant that there was no chance of a second teleportation.
Unless they are willing to swim in through the cracks in the rock as they did when they came, but these time delays, the corpse would have swallowed the person who remained.
"It seems we have to find Professor Lupin and Dobby quickly!" Ivan said, two house elves should be able to transport the four of them together.
Although they are now on the shore, they are not located at the same place where they used to take the boat, but on one side of this huge black lake. The mist spreading around is also blocking the connection between each other.
"We try our best to make some movement and let Lupin know that we have gone ashore!" Sirius quickly thought of a solution, and he waved his wand at the corpses that were gradually surrounding him.
"Inendi!"
A flame burst out from the top of Sirius’ wand and hit one of the corpses, but in the end only a small flame ignited, and it went out automatically before it ignited the opponent.
"Have all your magic power been used up? Sirius?" Ivan couldn't help laughing.
"No, I just used a lot of magic power to perform this magic!" Sirius's expression was very serious, and he didn't mean to be joking at all.
The smile on Ivan's face stopped, and he tried to use the Flame Curse once. The magic that was originally enough to create a sea of ​​fire has now turned into a faint flame.
He immediately realized that Voldemort had restricted the Flame Curse!
Just like Harry couldn't create a stream of water out of thin air in the middle of the island anywayPresumably, the flame magic has also been restricted and weakened.
The corpse was afraid of fire and light, even they knew that, how could Voldemort neglect this?
The light curse can be cast freely and can be explained by the need for lighting in the dark caves, but without limiting the flame curse, this weapon against the corpse is somewhat unreasonable.
No matter how Voldemort splits the soul, he won't be so stupid...
In the original time and space, Dumbledore was able to release this magic smoothly, mostly because of his superb level of magic and his holding an old wand, Voldemort's meticulous arrangement naturally did not have much effect on him.
"Blood to pieces! Fainted!" Sirius knocked down a large number of corpses with several consecutive spells.
Ivan released a very strong light, intending to force these corpses back, by the way, to indicate his location to Lupin.
It's just that the form has not improved, countless corpses are constantly climbing up the rocks from the black lake, stumbling towards them step by step, dying to death with the hollow eyes full of desire and madness. Staring at the two of them.
Ivan doesn't think their magic power can solve such a huge group of corpses.
He tried hard to think about the way to break the game, and suddenly realized that he had a chance to bless magic, which might allow him to break through the limit.
But there is only one opportunity like this. The blessing on the flame curse is a bit worthless, and it is impossible to solve so many corpses in one breath.
Ivan couldn't help thinking that he had seen the fierce fire curse in "The Decryption of Advanced Black Magic"!
The kind of black magic that uses everything that can be burned as fuel to achieve continuous expansion and self-growth!

chapters.title: Chapter 507: Fierce? Fierce!
chapters.content:
Thinking of this, Ivan no longer hesitated, and according to the method given in the book, the emotions of destruction and destruction were turned into flames!
To Ivan’s a little surprise, it was easier than he thought. As the enhanced magic texts engraved on the wand lit up one by one, a heart-pounding magic fire wafted out from the top of the wand. , Swelled up again quickly...
"Reducto!" Sirius waved his magic wand and flew several corpses that were trying to get close, then panting hard, witnessing those corpses with missing arms, legs, and even their heads climbing up from the ground again.
It's no way to go on like this. Just as Sirius was in a hurry, he suddenly felt a fire light from behind.
He tilted his head, and saw a large patch of scarlet flame sweeping by his side not far away, hitting the group of corpses, and then exploding!
Like a rain of fire, the dashes of fierce flames spread quickly, and after being contaminated with the corpses, the flames rose quickly, and the corpses were lighted into a human-shaped torch!
An astonishing number of corpses have no ability to resist the fierce fire. For a while, they have become the best fuel. They have repeatedly contributed to the fire, and soon the dots of flames spread into a sea of ​​fire...
A large number of fierce fires gathered together spontaneously and turned into the appearance of a phoenix, and made a joyous call, which sounded like the crackling sound of the corpse being burnt and exploded.
"Is this a fierce fire?" Sirius recognized it all at once. When he fought the Death Eaters back then, he didn't deal with this kind of fire less.
Because of this, Sirius looked at Ivan suspiciously, not understanding how Ivan could be so dangerous with magic.
"I happened to see it in that book when I was looking for the Horcrux information before. I didn't expect this to be useful!" Ivan casually explained, with a particularly relaxed tone, summoning the corpses around Li Huo. It's not a threat to him.
Ivan waved his magic wand gently, and the fierce phoenix followed his movements and waved its wings, rushing to the large number of corpses entrenched behind him.
The flame-fearing corpses showed distorted and horrified expressions, but there was no time to escape, and they collided with the phoenix composed of fierce fire.
The sound of sizzling barbecue reverberated on the bank of the blazing lake, and a large number of corpses were thrown into a furnace, and the flames hot enough to burn their souls covered their bodies.
When the Lihuo Phoenix passed by, hundreds of corpses fell to the ground with fire and wailing, and then they were swallowed up by Lihuo...
Sirius saw all this in his eyes, but he didn't feel any joy on his face. He solemnly looked at Ivan and reminded him.
"Fighting fire is a very dangerous and easily out of control black magic. You'd better not use it. I have seen a dark wizard killed by the powerful fire he released. It can be seen that it is classified as cutting-edge black magic. The reason!"
Reading the book can learn the fierce fire curse, which shows that Ivan's talent for black magic is very high, so Sirius is very worried that Ivan will indulge in the powerful destructive power of black magic.
Ivan's expression became more serious. Although he didn't reply, in the process of directing Li Huo to destroy the corpse, he realized that Li Huo was not like the gentle and obedient of other magics, but was unusually irritable.
Especially after turning hundreds of corpses into nourishment, the fiercely transformed phoenix has swelled to a length of tens of meters. Without his order, it split into small phoenixes that actively attacked nearby ones. The corpse continues to grow by itself.
It's not that Ivan has not used Lihuo before, but that is with the help of magic props, and the Lihuo summoned has no chance to expand to this point.
He is not sure if this is the effect of the enhanced magic blessing, but if he didn't do that before, he would not be able to release a fierce fire curse in this place where flame magic is restricted!
woo...
Just when Ivan was barely overcontrolling his fierce fire so that it would not lose control, a low, long wolf howl came from not far away.
"It's great, it's Professor Lupin!" Ivan turned his head and looked over, a surprise suddenly appeared on his face, and they could finally leave.
After a while, a tall werewolf with gray-black fur rushed over from the left vacancy that had not yet been covered by fierce fire.
A few corpses with short eyes stopped in front of him, but they were slapped flying with two slaps. They rolled around on the ground like a gourd, and couldn't stand up for quite a while.
And the tall werewolf didn't even bother to these corpses. A few high jumps leaped in front of the two of them. He glanced at Regulus, who was carried by Sirius, and his mouth full of fangs snapped together. Opened his mouth and said.
"It looks like your actions are going well?"
"Yes, the process will be a little harder than you think!" Ivan shrugged, and said helplessly.
"Wait... Lupin?! How did you become a werewolf? I remember that today should not be a full moon?" Sirius was very surprised. For the first time, he knew that a werewolf can change when the moon is not full. body.
"I have to ask Ivan. I don't know the specific reason." Lu Ping was also at a loss. He just drank the potion according to the instructions and then tried to transform. He didn't expect it to succeed. , And still keep your sense.
Sirius turned his gaze to Ivan curiously.
"I think it's not the time to chatWe'd better leave soon!" Ivan did not answer, but looked at the increasingly huge Fiery Phoenix.
After devouring thousands of corpses, Lihuo Phoenix has expanded to a length of tens of meters, splitting more flames and spreading to the surroundings, which is very difficult to control.
What worries Ivan even more is that the nearby corpses have been burned to ashes, and more corpses are hiding in the lake in fear of flames. Apart from them, there seems to be nothing to burn around here.
"Where is Dobby?" Ivan looked around anxiously.
"Dobby...Dobby is here, sir!"
Just after Ivan’s words fell, a green-skinned house elf ran out from behind Lupin panting. It was obviously not easy to catch up with a werewolf with its short legs.
"It's okay if you're fine!" Ivan couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief. While letting go, his control over Li Huo weakened again.
A large flame has spread to this side, surrounded by them.
Ivan quickly ordered Dobby to take him and Lupin to teleport, while Sirius and Regulus would be in charge of Kreacher.
"Don't hesitate, hurry up!" Ivan grabbed Dobby and then Lupin's dewclaws. Kreacher and Sirius on the opposite side were also ready.
Seeing the flames getting closer and closer, the two house elves fired teleporting magic almost at the same time, and the two vortexes engulfed everyone in.
Just a second after Ivan disappeared in place, the phoenix turned into a fierce fire completely lost control, and it burst and broke into a large sea of ​​fire, devouring everything around...

chapters.title: Chapter 508: A fighter against the Dark Lord, a well-deserved hero! (2…
chapters.content:
12 Grimmauld Place, London,
Along with the interlacing of space, several figures appeared out of thin air in the living room of the old Black House.
"It's very dangerous, it's just a bit, we probably won't be able to come back..." Ivan's forehead was sweating coldly. In the few seconds before he left, Lihuo Phoenix completely got rid of his control. If the teleportation is too late Then, the consequences will be disastrous.
"Just know, you better stop using this dangerous black magic in the future..." Sirius reminded him earnestly.
Sirius felt that this loss of control of the magic might not be a good thing, because it probably taught Ivan a sufficiently profound lesson.
Ivan nodded solemnly.
But unlike Sirius’s imagination, Ivan noticed the danger of Li Huo at the same time, but also saw Li Huo’s unparalleled destructive ability.
The fiery phoenix, which used thousands of corpses as fuel in the cave, swelled to tens of meters in length, is the most powerful magic he has ever seen!
Aside from using the shape to change shadows to run away, Ivan couldn't find a way to suppress it at all.
If he can master this power proficiently and apply it to actual combat, then his strength can be upgraded to a new level. It is not impossible to rely on the fierce characteristics to fight against a dozen wizards at once!
Of course, under normal circumstances, Li Huo cannot expand to this point without sufficient nutrients.
Before mastering the counter-curse that could restrain Li Huo, Ivan didn’t have the guts to use Li Huo on a large scale, otherwise he would die with his opponent if he rashly releases this curse.
When Ivan was thinking about it, the sound of rapid footsteps came from the back room, followed by a familiar voice.
"Sirius, Ivan, Professor Lupin, great, you are finally back!" Harry was very excited and hugged Sirius.
He spent a long time in Black’s old mansion alone, and after hearing the movement, he ran out as fast as he could.
Harry couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief when he saw that everyone was doing well, but Lupin, who had transformed into a werewolf form, really surprised him.
Although Harry knew that Professor Lupin was a werewolf wizard, it was the first time he saw Lupin transforming himself.
Lupin also realized that there was something wrong with keeping his transformed form, looked at his two paws uncomfortably, and asked awkwardly.
"Ivan, how should I change back now?"
Ivan scratched his head. How could he know that he is not a werewolf, but thinking that it is easy for Fren and the others to switch back and forth between the two forms, he asked Lupin to think about the feeling of returning to his original form every time a full moon night.
Lu Ping tried it. When this thought came to his mind, his body began to react. The two pointed claws slowly retracted, the tall body quickly shrank, and the hideous head was also transformed into the original one. Looks like.
"This is amazing!" Lu Ping couldn't help sighing. He realized that as long as he thought about it, he could turn back into a werewolf again, so he looked at Ivan eagerly and asked again.
"What is the potion that you gave me before? Is the wolf's poison potion? I remember that the wolf's poison potions on the market should not have this effect."
"That is the improved wolf poison potion I just developed not long ago! The werewolf wizard who drank it has the ability to freely control the transformation within 50 days, and stay awake at all times in the transformation state." Ivan said. Explaining, then suddenly remembered something, and continued to speak.
"Oh, yes, one thing I forgot to say, after drinking the potion, the werewolf wizard will no longer have the ability to infect others during this time!"
"In other words, not only can I transform at will, and I don't have to worry about hurting others by accident?" Lu Ping stepped forward and grabbed Ivan's wrist, and asked excitedly.
"Yes! But the effect is only for fifty days. After this time, you have to drink the medicine again." Ivan nodded affirmatively.
"Enough...enough!" Lu Ping muttered to himself, suddenly stepped back and bowed deeply to Ivan.
"Professor Lupin, what are you doing?" Ivan didn't expect Lupin's behavior at all, and hurriedly backed down.
"Thank you for your help to us werewolf wizards... If this potion can be popularized, I think the werewolves in the magic world will definitely be better off." Lupin looked at Ivan with emotion.
If he remembers correctly, Ivan had only developed a wolf poison potion the year before, and it took a long time to develop an improved wolf poison potion. It can be seen that Ivan is very interested in changing the living conditions of these werewolf wizards.
The reason why wizards in the magical world hate werewolf wizards so much, in addition to losing their minds when they transform every month, the more important thing is the infection ability of werewolves.
The improved wolf poison potion directly solves these two problems. If there is no time limit, Ivan can already declare that the group of werewolves has been cured.
Sirius beside 　　 was also happy about this, and even jokingly said that if this kind of potion becomes popular one day, the werewolves might be admired by a group of fanatics.
Because there must be a large number of power-seeking wizards who are eager to convert themselves into werewolves.
Harry didn't quite understand the importance of the modified wolf poison potion to Lupin, but it didn't prevent him from being happy with him.
However, Ivan poured cold water on them. "Professor Lu Ping, this new type of improved potion requires a lot of precious materials to be produced, and I am afraid it will not be popular in a short time!"
Ivan would not sell the improved wolf poison potion just because of Lupin’s few words.
He is very aware that there are kind and lawful werewolves like Fren and Lupin in the group of werewolf wizards, but more are werewolf wizards who have fallen into dark wizards and rely on robbery, murder, and petty theft to survive.
You must know that in the two wizarding wars in the original time and space, most werewolf wizards stood firmly on the side of the Dark Lord, and all they did was to spread fear and create chaos. Ivan didn't want to increase the strength of his enemies.
Hearing Ivan say this, Lupin was somewhat disappointed, but he didn't care too much. It is normal that the new potion cannot be popularized in a short time.
The speed at which Ivan improved the potion also made Lupin full of confidence. Maybe soon Ivan will be able to develop a potion that can completely cure the werewolves.
"We will wait for some time to talk about the wolf poison potion. Now the most urgent thing is to place Regulus first!" Ivan turned the subject away and turned his gaze to Regulus, who was carrying Sirius.
Lupin immediately looked at Sirius apologetically. He had forgotten the matter of patronizing the wolf poison potion just now.
Sirius certainly didn't care. He asked Ivan and Lupin to wait here for a while, went to the basement alone to take out a coffin, and then took them to a wasteland by apparition.
Many tombs have been erected here, and they seem to have not been taken care of for a long time. The tombstones are full of mud and fallen leaves, but from the inscription above, it can be vaguely seen that those buried here are members of the Black family.
Ivan turned his head and happened to see a familiar name written on a tombstone next to him-Phineas Nigelus Black.
He once saw his portrait in the portrait of the principal's office. It was the most unpopular principal in Hogwarts history. According to rumors, all the students and teachers in the school hated him very much.
But members of the Black family obviously don’t think so, so in the column of honors at the bottom of the inscription, it says-Phineas Nigelus Black, Hogwarts’ most outstanding principal, first class Merlin Medal. He has made outstanding contributions to the magical world during his lifetime.
Sirius didn't look at these tombstones, and paid homage to anyone here. Instead, he took a shovel and dug in a clearing on his own.
Lupin and Ivan stepped forward to help, but he refused.
Sirius worked so hard from the evening to the morning of the next day. He did not use any magic. He digs the pit with a shovel with all his strength. He also engraved Regulus's name on a blank tombstone, and then follow the usual practice. Began to write Regulus' honor.
Sirius wrote a lot, and even wrote about such trivial things that he was praised by Dean Slytherin when Regulus was in the fourth grade.
This is not worth mentioning compared to the great achievements of other Black members on the tombstone, but Sirius does not care about these rules.
It is not so much that he is writing about the honors that Regulus has won, but rather that he is slowly recalling some of the past of this younger brother.
I couldn’t write it any more, Sirius solemnly stated in the last line that Regulus was a fighter against the Dark Lord, a well-deserved hero!
After the inscription was written, Sirius stood up, turned his gaze to the side, lifted his petrified state and was tied to Regulus.
A person who has been transformed into a corpse will have his soul trapped in his body, so there is only one way to free Regulus.
"!" After hesitating for a long time, Sirius gritted his teeth and waved his wand.
A tongue of flame sprayed out from the top of the wand and hit Regulus directly, lighting him into a torch.
Regulus, who had been transformed into a corpse, struggled hard, opening his mouth wide and letting out painful wailing, but to no avail.
Kreacher knelt on the ground feebly, covering his face and wept bitterly, chanting Regulus's name over and over again.
Regulus struggling in the flames became smaller and smaller, and the wailing voice gradually disappeared. Vaguely, Ivan seemed to be calmer when he saw Regulus' painful and hideous face.
Sirius stood still on the spot, with his back facing everyone, making it difficult to see his current expression.
When the flames gradually extinguished, Sirius stepped forward and began to collect Regulus' remains, and put many relics from the house into the coffin, and finally buried them in the dust.
After handling all this, the depressed Sirius took them back to the Black’s mansion.
Everyone present stayed up all night, especially Ivan and Sirius, who even dived into the cold bottom of the lake to collect corpses. Their physical strength and magic power were almost consumed, and they were able to survive until now by their own willpower.
So after returning to the mansion and simply eating a few pieces of bread to fill the hunger, everyone was not in the mood to talk more, so they all went back to the room to rest. As soon as they fell asleep, they slept until the next morning.
While eating breakfast, Harry curiously asked about the corpse removal process yesterday. Sirius didn't want Harry to worry about it, but just understated their experience of dealing with the corpses.
Even if he ignored the most thrilling scenes, the process of fighting with the corpses in the dark lake caused Harry to be frightened. He doubted whether he would be able to come back alive if he insisted on following it before.
Lupin made some supplements at the right time, telling him about the corpse attack when he and Dobby were waiting on the shore of the lake.
Probably because Sirius hit Regulus with a petrification curse at the bottom of the lake, a certain restriction was triggered, and they were also attacked by corpses on the shore.
With the flame curse being greatly weakened, he and Dobby could only alternately fluoresce to disperse the corpses. When the magic power was almost exhausted, they remembered the bottle of potion Ivan gave him.
"After I drank the potion, I tried to become a werewolf. I defeated the corpses that stood in the way and then followed the flames to find you." Lu Ping recounted the story roughly. Again.
"So, Ivan summoned a flaming phoenix in that cave and burned thousands of corpses?" After listening to all of them, Harry was most interested in this, what a powerful magical talent that must be. make it happen.
"That's a fierce fire curse. When I was looking for information on the Horcruxes, I accidentally saw it in the "Decrypted Cutting-Edge Black Magic". I thought this special magic might be effective for Voldemort's Horcruxes, so I wrote it down." Ivan He gave an explanation to avoid Lupin's misunderstanding.
Then Ivan looked at Harry again and warned. "Li Huo is a very dangerous black magic. It is easy to get out of control. Even some powerful wizards can't fully control it. This time, if we didn't transmit it in time, I am afraid that Li Huo would have been burned to death by the out of control Li Huo! "
Harry nodded hesitantly.
Ivan didn't say much. For a little wizard like Harry, who was 13 or 4 years old and didn't like to learn, it was almost impossible to take the initiative to learn magic in the library, so he was very relieved.
After having breakfast in a hurry, Ivan greeted Sirius, entered the Black family library, re-extracted the "Cutting-edge Black Magic Decipherment", and successfully found the corresponding Lihuo Curse Anti-curse!
This is also the reason why Li Huo is not listed as an unforgivable curse, because as long as he knows how to reverse the curse, sorcerers can use magic to restrain Li Huo and destroy it!
However, this kind of anti-curse is only useful for small-scale fiery fires. If the huge fiery phoenix in the cave is formed, even the anti-curse will be completely useless.

chapters.title: Chapter 509: In such a big magic world, there is no room for a small shop that can make money safely...
chapters.content:
There is only one method that can limit large-scale fierce fire, and there is only one in Ivan's impression that all curses are the end!
If multiple people work together to cast it, they can even suppress the fierce fire that swells enough to destroy a city, and if he remembers correctly, Nick Lemay should know how to cast this kind of magic.
Thinking of this, Ivan breathed out slowly, closed the book in his hand and put it back on the shelf.
He is very interested in the Black family's book collection, but he has been here for four full days in order to destroy the Horcrux, so now is the time to leave!
At noon, after having a great lunch with Sirius, Lupin, and Harry, Ivan said that he was going to return home this afternoon.
"So soon? Don't you stay here for a few more days? Regulus, I haven't had time to thank you." Sirius was a little surprised, and said with a word.
Ivan shook his head, and declined Sirius's kindness.
A few days later, it’s time to meet with Nick LeMay. He had not been able to stay at home to spend much time with Aysia, and it wouldn't be nice to delay it like this.
Seeing Ivan's persistence, Sirius didn't keep him anymore, anyway, it was easy for them and wizards to meet each other.
"So, do you want to use the fireplace here? Floo fans, I remember, there are still some left... I looked for where I put it." Sirius thought for a while, then knelt down and opened a cabinet in the living room. Up.
"Forget it! My mother set up magic on the fireplace at home, and it can't be transmitted directly. I'll apparate by myself!" Ivan stopped Sirius, shrugged helplessly, and then waved his wand. Point to the stairs.
"The suitcase is coming!"
After a while, a small suitcase dangled and flew down from upstairs, and fell into Ivan's hands.
After checking that there was nothing missing, Ivan turned his head to look at Dobby, and said. "Let's go, Dobby! Just to introduce you to my mother..."
Dobby nodded fiercely, looking very happy, because it meant that it would formally integrate into the owner's family.
"Apparition!"
After a simple goodbye, one person and one spirit cast their magic and disappeared in place.
Waiting for Ivan to stand firmly and stare around him again, he has appeared in a corner of the street in Knock Down Alley, not far from his magic shop.
But the store door there is closed, it looks like Aysia is not at home.
What makes Ivan feel that something is wrong is that the whole street is empty, and the doors and windows of nearby houses are also tightly closed.
Ivan frowned. This situation reminded him of his experience when he returned to Knockout Alley last summer vacation.
But this shouldn't be right, Ivan is very sure that he has dealt with all the potential threats, and Fren and others are responsible for protecting the magic shop.
A large group of werewolf wizards who can transform freely are a huge force in Knockdown Alley. Normally, no one should provoke them without opening their eyes.
Ivan quickly walked to the front of the shop, waving his magic wand and opening the door.
Click!
The sound of sliding the door bolt slowly sounded. After the door was pushed open, several black light beams suddenly flew out from behind the door.
Ivan subconsciously activated the protective ring, an invisible magic barrier blocked him, deflected the black beam of light, and hit the open space nearby, corroding a large hole.
"A trap for me? No, it's not right!" Ivan walked in and noticed that there was no trace of a war in the dark magic shop. All the items were neatly arranged, and several trigger-type magics were set up on the shelves. , Then overturned his own guess.
This should be set up to warn uninvited guests before Aysia leaves, because he is very familiar with this method of arranging traps, which is exactly Aysia's style.
In addition, if there is really an ambush, it should be a bunch of people rushing out to surround yourself, it is impossible to do anything with this little magic.
But where did Aisia go? Why should we leave this kind of warning magic in the magic shop?
Ivan vaguely felt a little strange, and then suddenly thought of something, opened the system task bar and took a look.
【Task: Become the King of Knock Down Alley
Mission objective: Unify Knockdown Alley
Task progress: 44%
Quest reward: Courageous Loyalty Curse
Task description:......】
Just as Ivan watched the task progress, it jumped again, from 44% to 45%.
Seeing that the task progress has increased again, even halfway through, Ivan suddenly understood that during the time he spent in school, I was afraid that it was not peaceful in the alley.
He guessed that it was probably because he led people to destroy a group of dark wizards such as Bok, and the fact that his power expanded too rapidly, caused some people's jealousy.
Aisia may fight against the opponent and have a certain advantage in order to protect himself, so the progress bar of the task will increase so much.
After thinking about it, Ivan couldn’t help feeling a little bored. Originally, this summer vacation he was planning to move away from the dangerous Knockdown Alley with Aisia to the relatively safe Diagon Alley to live, but it was unexpected that someone would be looking for them at this point. Trouble.
Is it so big that the magic world can’t accommodate a small shop that makes money with peace of mind?
Ivan was very annoyed, and threw the suitcase in his hand to the house elf beside him, and said. "Dobby, hold the box for me! I want to see who it will be this time?!"
Dobby took the box in a hurry and glanced at Ivan with a little fear. It was the first time he saw Ivan so angry.
......
"Reducto!"
"Stupefy!"
On the west side of Knock Down Alley, in an unmanned alley, a law enforcement officer in gray costume is directing several dark wizards to surround Walker who has become a werewolf.
However, the various spells did not work very well.
After transforming into a werewolf, Walker's physical fitness has risen a bit and he has become extremely agile, and he can avoid most of the spells by speed alone.
Even if he was hit by one or two spells once in a while, he could resist it with a protective ring, or rely on the werewolf's recovery ability to resist.
So after a few minutes, Walker persisted despite his injuries.
The law enforcement officer couldn't help being a little annoyed when he saw this situation. He had heard from his colleagues before that these werewolf wizards could keep their sane transformation freely, but only when they really faced it did they know how difficult it was to deal with.
But this is also because they want to capture Walker alive and ask for information from his mouth, otherwise it would not take such a long time.
Considering that the other party's support will arrive soon after dragging it down like this, the gray-robed law enforcer no longer keeps his hand, raised his finger to Walker, waved his wand, and a green light beam flew out.
"AvadaKedavra!"
Walker, who was rushing in front of him, changed his complexion. He swooped on the ground and rolled several times. The dark green light beam almost rubbed his body and hit the ground, exploding a hole, and the gravel splashed. Beginning, several blood stains were scratched on his face.
Walker endured the pain and stood up, but his heart had sunk to the bottom. No matter how strong the werewolf's magic resistance and recovery ability, he could not resist the Killing Curse.
These dark wizards who besieged him have obviously lost patience and no longer have the idea of ​​catching him alive.
Walker thought desperately that he might not be able to hold on until Fren and the others discovered that it was wrong, and it was time to come back and support him.
Just as he imagined, after the gray-robed law enforcer took the lead in using the Killing Curse, the black wizards who were originally restrained because of the alive grab command released their hands and feet and began to use high-intensity black magic.
Walker couldn't dodge, and was hit by a black beam. The protective ring blocked him, but it couldn't eliminate all the damage. The impact still lifted his body and fell into the ruins behind.
Just when the gray-robed law enforcement officer was relieved and was about to let one of his men go down to confirm Walker's life and death, a long neighing sound suddenly resounded in this deserted alley.
The several dark wizards present were all taken aback. Before they could react, the street wall on the side suddenly exploded with the violent explosion and roar. Two dark wizards were close to each other. It was directly shaken out by the aftermath.
Amidst the splashing rubble and the smoke and dust, a horse-shaped light and shadow flew in from the gap.
The frightened dark wizards waved their wands to point at the blurry light and shadow. Various spell beams lased out, but they didn't play any role, and they walked directly through the light and shadow.
After a short delay, the lightning-fast unicorn shadow has rushed to a panicked dark wizard, and stepped heavily on the opponent's face with his hooves raised.
A crisp bone crack sounded in the alley, and the hapless dark wizard rolled and slammed into the wall behind him, and he could no longer survive.
"Don't use ordinary magic, limit it with the patron saint curse!" The gray-robed law enforcer shouted loudly.
After experiencing the initial chaos, the gray-robed law enforcer has already remembered that when he and several colleagues pursued Dougert two years ago, the other party used such magic!
Although the five of them were taken care of by Dougt alone, after the war, they also carried out some analysis and believed that it should be this very special guardian **** curse.
is illusory under normal circumstances, and it is no different from ordinary guardian **** spells. It only materializes when you are close.
While reminding him, the gray-robed law enforcer did not dare to delay. He waved his wand and summoned an illusory patron saint of cheetah, rushing towards the shadow of the unicorn, but he was caught by the shadow of the unicorn not long after he got up It was blown away into a haze.
But this also reminded the other dark wizards, allowing them to find a way to deal with this weird light and shadow, and soon two more people summoned the patron saint.
Others are staring at the gap in the street wall. Everyone knows that the powerful is never magic, but wizards who perform magic.
Ivan under the phantom body curse didn't expect that he would meet acquaintances by coincidence, and finally caused chaos. Of course, it was impossible for them to suppress it so easily.
He raised his wand slightly, and the bricks scattered around when the street wall was blown up floated like a kind of traction, twisted and transformed into sharp cone-shaped spikes under the action of the Transformation Curse, forming a semi-circular shape. Scattered forward.
The dark wizards who had prepared for a long time have constructed a strong magical barrier to block this powerful range of magic.
But the two have not touched yet, a shadowless magical blade has already arrived first, like a sharp knife, it has smashed through a dozen magical barriers before it disappears and is invisible.
The penetration speed of Shenfeng Wuying was too fast and too urgent, and the black wizards had no time to rebuild the protective spell. A large number of magically blessed cone spikes faintly flashed in the air, screaming like breaking through the air, and flew towards the face. Come here.
The next moment, in the small alley, there were waves of screams!
A black wizard in front of him was directly penetrated by the sharp cone-shaped spikes through his throat and eyes. He opened his mouth in pain and said silently. After struggling for a few times, he lost his voice.
Although the other black wizards didn't hurt them, they were also pierced by several spikes through their chest, arms and thighs. They fell to the ground and wailed in pain, blood shed all over the ground.
Only the gray-robed law enforcer and the two black wizards who are proficient in the iron armor curse successfully resisted this magic After casting two powerful magics in a row, the phantom curse blessed by Ivan was also automatically broken. , Appeared in front of everyone so generously.
Seeing the appearance of the attacker, the few people who were still standing almost thought they were dazzled, and the gray-robed law enforcer's pupils contracted, unable to restrain the inner shock, and couldn't help but speak out.
"It turned out to be you!"
After only two years, although Ivan has grown a lot taller, his appearance has not changed much. The gray-robed law enforcers naturally recognized it for the first time. Ivan was the one who made a noise in the wizarding market behind Dougt. That kid.
Combined with the situation just now, he realized that it was not Dougtzang who defeated them with his hole cards two years ago, but the 13 or 14-year-old wizard in front of him who provided assistance to Dougt!
It’s no wonder that Doug had never used this kind of special magic in the course of the battle for more than six months...
But while realizing this, the gray-robed law enforcer couldn't believe it.
He stared at Ivan's immature face, more willing to believe that the other party was actually disguised by Dougte using the compound decoction, otherwise how could he have mastered such a powerful magic at the age of the other party.
Ivan, no matter what the other person thinks, his face still has unfavorable anger, and he approaches several people step by step.
The wailing still reverberating in the empty alley, the scarlet blood stained his shoes.
The gray-robed law enforcer and the remaining two black wizards moved backward in fear, until they hit the wall behind them, and then they waved their wands hideously at Ivan...

chapters.title: Chapter 510: We are willing to be your most loyal servants!
chapters.content:
"Redut!"
"llprtus!"
......
Several spells struck him, blocking all the directions of Ivan's evasion.
Ivan had never thought of avoiding, nor was he ready to use the magic ring, his body changed rapidly before the beam arrived.
A large amount of black mist kept pouring out of his body, and the surrounding light seemed to be attracted.
In the next second, before the curse came, a pale, decayed arm suddenly stretched out from the black mist and blocked it in front. The magical beam hit the bone arm but it didn't have a slight effect.
Waiting for the black mist to appear tall, cloaked and weird in front of them.
"Photo... Dementor?!" The gray-robed law enforcer's eyes were staring, and he wondered if he was still alive in a dream. A young wizard turned into a little wizard in front of him. A dementor?
Ivan ignored them and adapted himself to his new body. As he expected, after transforming into a dementor, his body was also immune to most of the spells.
He had long planned to use Bogut's transformation in actual combat, but he never had this opportunity. Now these dark wizards in front of him have almost lost their fighting spirit. As a backhand, Dobby doesn't have to worry about overturning, just can experiment. Some of his thoughts.
The two black wizards behind the law enforcer completely collapsed. They could feel that this was not some kind of illusion, because the courage and happiness in their hearts disappeared in an instant, leaving only endless pain. Memories,
"What kind of monster is this?" One of them yelled frantically, stepped back and fell to the ground, then crawled and fled in the opposite direction.
The other dark wizard ignored him, waving his wand frantically at Ivan, and shouted sharply.
"AvadaKedavra!"
The green light beams flying by...
Ivan dodged his body for a while, his light and fluttering body was easy to control, and he was much more flexible than usual.
Although the Killing Curse does not work on the Dementor in his impression, he is not a real dementor after all, and he does not intend to try his life.
After a simple adjustment to the body, Ivan controlled this grotesque body to unfold the wide cloak, like an arrow from the string, and quickly flew towards the two who were still in place.
"ExpetPatrnu!" The gray-robed law enforcer did not lose his mind like the two subordinates. He waved his wand vigorously, summoned the remaining courage, and re-summoned the guardian of the cheetah who was defeated by the shadow of the unicorn. God stood in front of him.
The black mist spread to the entire alley, and the grotesque figure quickly began to swell and deform as it approached.
The withered, crusted arm that can see deep white bones stretched out from the fog, and in less than a second it became as thick as a waist, passed straight through the illusory patron saint, and easily crushed the blessing. The iron armor curse on the gray-robed law enforcer slapped his body heavily on the rear street wall.
A violent crash sounded from this small alley, and the street wall made of stone bricks persisted for a while before it collapsed.
The poor gray-robed law enforcer was as miserable as a rag doll. Ivan's big hand was held in his palm, his breast bones were broken, and scarlet blood continuously poured out of his mouth and fell on Ivan's fingers.
Ivan released his palm in disgust, and the law enforcement officer he was holding slipped from his hand and fell to the ground, losing his voice.
died? I obviously only tried a little bit...
Ivan was a little surprised. For the first time he used Bogut's transformation into real combat. When he was close, he transformed from a dementor into a giant. He wanted to try the melee ability of this form, but he didn't want to fail. Be careful to kill this enforcer...
Ivan shook his head. The other party was a commander anyway. He wanted to keep torture about the information.
The narrow alley suddenly became very quiet, and even the wailing stopped. Several dark wizards lying on the ground struggling stared at this scene blankly, forgetting the pain for a moment.
The only standing black wizard raised his head and looked at the huge giant six or seven meters high in front of him. His body was trembling. The crazy color in his eyes had disappeared. Fear and despair gradually climbed into his heart. The wand in his hand fell to the ground without noticing it.
哐当...
The slight noise made by the wand when it touched the ground was clearly visible in the quiet alley, which also attracted Ivan's attention.
He turned his head and stared at the opponent with eyes that were the size of adult fists. When he was thinking about what to do, the dark wizard knelt down directly.
This completely exceeded Ivan's expectations, but the discarded wand and the body that was shaking when he was kneeling made Ivan fully feel the fear in the other's heart.
Realizing that he didn’t need to waste any more magic power, Ivan cancelled the Bogut Transfiguration technique, his huge body shrank quickly, and the magic power that filled his body gradually returned to its original position Ivan felt a little bit. In just such a moment of transformation, his magic power was consumed by one-third, plus the previous unicorn shadow and two powerful spells, and the magic power in his body was only half left.
