"By the way, I always forgot to introduce to you... Dobby!" Ivan suddenly remembered one thing before saying something, so he stretched out his hand and snapped his fingers.
The crisp voice sounded in the conference hall, which shocked Dougt. He didn't forget that Ivan just killed Reese Nott with a snap of his fingers.
Fortunately, snapping his fingers this time didn't seem to exert the corresponding power. Instead, a short, wrinkled house elf appeared in front of them.
"Sir!" Dobby blinked his eyes and bowed to Ivan in tribute, then looked at Aysia, and greeted a little nervously. "Hello, Mrs. Hals!"
"What is it?" Aysia glanced at Dobby curiously, then looked at Ivan again.
When she saw this house elf in that small alley before, she wanted to ask, but too many people were there and it was delayed.
"It's called Dobby. It was originally a house-elf in the Malfoy family, but now it's free..." Ivan opened the mouth to tell Aysia about the things that happened last school year.
Due to the existence of Dougt and the fact that I don’t want Esiah to worry too much, Ivan directly omitted the experience of the Basilisk and the Slytherin Chamber, and only mentioned that it was sold to Lucius Malfoy during the first-year summer vacation I wrote a dangerous diary for myself.
And this black magic item is very special, with his own ideas, he is waiting for the opportunity to control the new magic defense teaching professor, wanting to "cleanse" the whole Hogwarts and kill those low-blooded Muggle seeds.
"Lucius Malfoy! How dare he cheat you like this?!" Hearing this, Aysia was very annoyed.
She is proficient in alchemy, even if she doesn't know the related knowledge of Horcrux, she can understand how powerful a thinking black magic item is.
Thinking like this, Aysia couldn't help but feel a little scared, she said rather complaining. "Why haven't you mentioned such a dangerous thing to me before, what if something goes wrong?"
"I know there is a problem with it, so I just want to study it!" Ivan explained in an awkward way, and then pretended to lightly say that the thing had been destroyed by himself.
"So you asked me to teach you Lihuo in order to destroy it?" Aysia suddenly remembered that Ivan had suddenly asked her about the release method of Lihuo. Now I think it should be used to destroy this one. Of magic items.
"Yes! I tried many methods but couldn't cause damage to it, so I thought of the Lihuo Curse!" Ivan nodded, because he has Level 5 Occlumency and the Lihuo Ring. Dare to hold Horcrux for such a long time.
Although he almost overturned the car in the end, the benefits were obvious. During that semester, his magic level could only be described by leaps and bounds, and he successfully found a way to integrate multiple bloodlines.
If other factors are aside, Ivan also has to admit that Tom is a great teacher, or the kind that can be carried with him.
"Okay, Aisia, I think little Ivan has his own ideas, didn't he always deal with it well?" Dougter also said to help, he doesn't want Ivan and Aisia to make things happen because of this little thing. It's very stiff.
For Ivan's various legendary experiences in school, Dougter was also very surprised. No wonder Ivan's strength has increased substantially every time he comes back. This campus career is also a bit exciting.
Esiah had also died down at this time, she was just a little angry at Ivan's adventurous behavior.
Ivan continued to speak, and Dolby was worried about Harry’s safety and secretly informed him in violation of the order, and finally revealed what Lucius found and punished.
"After I destroyed the diary, I set up a game, put a glove in the diary and gave it to Lucius. He threw the damaged diary to Dobby as I thought. ..." Ivan added.
Aisia and Dougt understood this immediately.
House elves are servants of wizards. The only way to be free is to receive a piece of clothing handed to them by the master.
But this is a shame for the normal house elves, because once they are expelled from the family by their owner, it means that they lose the meaning of existence.
But the house elf in front of him is obviously a freak, Dobby said proudly. "Yes, the great Lord Hals liberated Dobby and made Dobby a free house elf..."
Dobby gets more excited as he speaks, especially when Ivan is willing to use one silver silver per week as a salary to hire himself, the bulb-sized eyes are filled with moving tears, and his nose twitches...
Dougert and Aysia looked at Ivan with weird gazes, and Ivan hurriedly interrupted the house elf's words.
"Dobby! If there is no order from me in the future, please stop mentioning employment matters!"
He finally created an image of caring for his subordinates in front of the wizards. Ivan didn't want it to be ruined because of this!
"Dobby understands, sir, must not want people to know how kind he is to a house elf..." Dobby said sobbing.
Dobby's peculiar brain circuit made Ivan very speechless. He shook his head and didn't say anything. He turned to Aysia and asked if Dobby could stay at home in the future.
Esiah naturally has no opinion. She has been busy dealing with the wizarding market recently and has not had much time to take care of the housework. Dobby's existence just makes up for this vacancy.
Dougt frowned, doubting Dobby's loyalty issues. A house elf who betrayed the original owner was not very likable.
But thinking that Ivan had fooled so many wizards in just one hour, he wouldn't be able to deal with a house elf, so he was relieved again.
After persuading Esiah to accept Dobby, Ivan turned to curiously asked the two of the things that happened in Knockdown Alley in the past few months, and how they contradicted the Wizarding Market.
"After you left, Aysia and I felt that it was necessary to clean up Knockout Alley before you come back. This is one of the few things we can do for you!" Dougt was very proud to explain this to Ivan. Achievements over the past few months.
They gathered enough people to get rid of some disobedient thorns. As for the large number of ordinary wizards, they did not care, because those people are easy to deal with, and they will automatically attach themselves after they win the final victory. come.
"I wanted to persuade the Knot family to join us at the beginning. If he knows the current affairs, I don't want to embarrass him, but the old guy doesn't know what is good or bad, so he blasted the person I sent out..." Grid said with a sneer. He had given the other party a chance, but it was a pity that the other party didn't cherish it.
"Wait, Dean Dougert... shouldn't the cause of the matter be that we made a big noise in the wizarding market two years ago, and the Knott family deliberately retaliated against us?" Ivan interrupted Dougt, confused. 'S words, couldn't help but asked.
"This is indeed a good saying..." Doug Tat suddenly felt his eyes light up. Why didn't he think of using this as a reason before?
Fortunately, it is too late to remedy it. Dougte immediately said that he had not considered it well before and did not notice the influence of public opinion. Tomorrow he will order someone to collect the crimes of the Nott family.
Aisia saw something, and couldn't help but remind Ivan that in order to achieve a more ambitious ideal, I don't need to be constrained by the means to be just...If you want to do a big cause, it's not too kind!
Listening to the words of the two, Ivan fell into confusion.
what? I have more ambitious ideals and want to do a big business?
Why did I never know?
"Who did you listen to?" Ivan was very suspicious that Aysia might have misunderstood something, and couldn't help but ask.
"Of course it's from Bok! If he hadn't told me about your arrangement, I'm afraid I would have been kept in the dark by you..." Aysia sighed, said with emotion, and then she stared in dissatisfaction. After taking a look at Ivan, he continued.
"You shouldn't tell Bok about such a secret plan. If he passes it directly, it would be bad!"
"But I only talked to him about alchemy, and asked him how to lay out secret doors on magic items." Ivan looked dazed and completely confused. Is there any connection between these two things? ?
"So I have always said that the old boy is very clever. He guessed that you are planning to apply the secret door technology to the protection ring sold to the Auror. Fortunately, when the right time is right, you can eliminate the strongest of the Ministry of Magic in one fell swoop. Power!" Dougt began to explain.
When mentioning Bock, Dougte still tickles his teeth with hatred. He still remembers the old guy blowing up his house.
Ivan was stunned. He recalled the scene when he was chatting with Bok.
It seems...probably...maybe I said that before?
But he did it just to keep an eye out, so as not to be pitted by the magic items he sold!
is just to protect yourself! It has nothing to do with the ambitious want to rule Knockdown Alley!
After all, he and Aysia have done a lot of things that violated the laws of the magical world, and there is no guarantee that a large number of Aurors will come to arrest them one day.
Ivan can’t wait to use the time converter to go back in time and twist Boke’s head off, so that he will not make up some weird things in his brain, and pass on the things that the brain has made to Aysia and others.
It’s no wonder that when he was at Hogwarts, the task of Unifying Knockdown Alley increased some progress every once in a while. It turned out that Aysia was fooled by Bock...
Thinking of this, Ivan was ready to explain.
However, before he could even speak, Doug said admiringly. "Neither I nor Esiah thought that you had planned such a meticulous plan without knowing it!"
"Yes, when Bok told me about it, I almost thought it was him who made a mistake...It's not like a layout that a child can come up with." Aysia also said with a smile.
is indeed a mistake!
Ivan smiled bitterly to himself However, looking at Dougt's admiring gaze and the smile on Aysia's face, he swallowed again.
Ivan can’t imagine how embarrassing it would be if I told the truth now that Isia and Dougt understood that they had worked hard for a few months and had an oolong scene...
All previous efforts will become meaningless!
And those wizards who have spent a lot of money to summon up with great difficulty have all become enthusiastic under his speech, ready to attack at any time.
If you go out now and tell them that everything is a misunderstanding, and then disband on the spot, go back to each house, maybe what a mess will happen!
Not to mention that the beams they have formed with the Wizard Market have already reached a point where they cannot be eased. Even if they are willing to stop now, the Knot family cannot let them go!
So now there is only one way to go to the dark, according to the original plan to solve the wizard market in order to eliminate the threat, so that a lot of spent Jin Jialong will not be in vain!
The most important thing is that Ivan remembered Trelawney’s prophecy,
As Peter Pettigrew escapes from Azkaban, part of the prophecy has now been fulfilled, and Ivan feels that he must prepare for the worst.
At this time, a group of strong and loyal subordinates is very important!
In view of this, Ivan really didn't know how to explain to Aysia.
Can it be said that although he is content with the status quo and has no big ambitions, he still needs some loyal hands to guard against the resurrection of the previous Dark Lord for some special reason?
It might as well not explain!

chapters.title: Chapter 519: Ivan: This is really a surprise! (2 in 1)
chapters.content:
Ivan was very worried that after he explained it, his brain would make up another strange appearance.
Thinking of this, Ivan looked at the two and said helplessly. "Why don't you discuss with me before doing these things..."
"Didn't you happen to be going back to Hogwarts to study at that time? Isiah didn't think you should be disturbing you, so we were going to wait for you to come back this time and give you a surprise!" Doug said with a smile.
"Surprised...surprise?!" Ivan twitched the corners of his mouth, which seemed to him almost as shocked!
"What's the matter?" Aysia saw that Ivan's expression seemed something wrong, and couldn't help but ask.
"No, it's nothing, I just felt that there was a little surprise... The surprise you prepared was really..." Ivan pulled out a smiling face very hard, and then looked at the expectant gazes of Aisia and Doug, contrary to their intentions. Continue to say.
"It's amazing!"
"We can only help you with this little thing..." Aysia smiled, and then told Ivan that he had planned to clean Knockdown Alley before he came back, but he didn't expect the wizard. The resistance of the market is more difficult to deal with than she imagined.
So if I come back later, you guys have finished playing?
Ivan was very speechless. After Ti Jin and Aysia learned more inside stories, he was tired to say that he had experienced too many things today, and now he wants to go back and be alone...
"Then you have a good rest!" Esiah noticed Ivan's tired cheeks, unavoidably a little distressed, and said comfortingly. "Don't put too much pressure on yourself, you are still young... we have a lot of time to arrange slowly!"
Ivan opened his mouth and wanted to say something, but in the end he didn't say anything. With a headache, he walked out of the conference hall and returned to the room of his magic shop.
After closing the door, Ivan's face suddenly turned black. He suddenly thought of something, and subconsciously opened the system's taskbar and took a look.
"Seventy-one percent?" Ivan looked at the display on the progress bar and couldn't help but let out a surprised voice.
Why did it suddenly increase so much?
If he remembers correctly, when he inspected the Black Mansion at noon, the task progress was only fixed at 45%.
is the reason for the previous shock and speech?
Or is it because he solved the law enforcement and seven dark wizards sent by the opponent to hunt down Walker, and even recruited four people, causing the balance of victory to tilt again?
Ivan thinks that there should be both. Eight well-trained wizards are brought out by themselves in Knockdown Alley. They are all a powerful force, enough to change the balance of power in a battle!
Not to mention this time the Knot family also lost a core member-Reese Knot!
When I think of this, Ivan can't help but feel a little crazy.
This is not because of the murder. Ivan is very clear that since the two sides are already enemies and the contradiction has intensified to the point of irreversibility, no matter what the cause, he can't be merciless!
After all, it is too costly to imprison an Animagus, and Reese Knott is unwilling to surrender, so death is his only attribution.
What really made Ivan feel mad was that he had always thought that the Knott family deliberately retaliated, and Isiah was forced to organize a passive counterattack because of helplessness, so that he repeatedly questioned the origins of Reese Knott in the conference hall. Now It was awkward to want to come to the scene at that time.
No one was there to remind myself...
Or did they add something amazing to their brains?
"No, I have to deal with what is going on from beginning to end..." Ivan quickly put all his thoughts behind, thinking about asking from Aysia and Doug. The news that came out slowly connected everything together.
At first, I was probably cautious. His attempt to leave a back door on the items sold to the Ministry of Magic caused Bock to misunderstand him, thinking that he was ambitious and wanted to get rid of the Auror in order to rule the entire British magical world.
After learning everything that Bok’s brain had made up, Aysia thought he was not cautious enough to let Bok know about such a secret plan.
This is probably also the cause of Bok’s death. He “knows” too much!
"I knew I shouldn't have left Bok for life!" Ivan shook his head regretfully. If he hadn't stopped Asiah in the Bokimbok shop, Bok would have died a long time ago. There are so many messy things.
But Ivan also has to admit that Bok is really old and cunning, and the imaginary plan is indeed possible to be implemented.
If you can unify the Knock Alley, summon hundreds of wizards, and rely on the secret door left on the protective ring and anti-cursive gloves to carry out a raid, occupying the Ministry of Magic will not be a problem!
But the key is what will happen after they destroy the Ministry of Magic? The wizards of England would never approve of their rule!
let alone Dumbledore!
The strongest white wizard on the side of this order is extraordinary, and he has an old magic wand in his hand. It’s not a problem to hit a group of them alone...
Wait... Dumbledore? !
Ivan suddenly remembered something. The old professor was caught by Voldemort's Horcrux, and it seemed that he could not live long.
So the biggest obstacle does not actually exist. Can I be Minister of Magic? !
Ivan took a deep breath, and lay on the bed tossing around and couldn't sleep. Tension, depression, confusion, confusion and other emotions surged into my heart...
He is a third-grade little wizard, how come he suddenly wants to rule the British magical world?
......
The next morning, after Ivan got up to wash, he yawned and went downstairs with sleepy eyes to prepare for dinner.
He thought about it all night yesterday, tangled up, and finally felt that he was not the material for the Minister of Magic.
In contrast, he prefers to study and study magic leisurely by himself, rather than sitting in the office every day dealing with a lot of government affairs and intrigue with his political opponents.
You can't get a puppet minister after occupying the Ministry of Magic, right?
Thinking like this, Ivan couldn't help laughing.
The so-called rule of the magical world is nothing more than those people who blindly make up for it. There is no spectrum of things. He first entangled with the problem of being the Minister of Magic, and was completely asking for trouble...
"Sir! Come here, please!"
As soon as Ivan walked downstairs to the lobby, he heard Dobby's voice rang.
He looked up, the house-elf graciously pulled the chair beside the dining table aside, and Aysia and Doug had already sat down and were waiting for him.
"Did you sleep well last night?" Aysia noticed that Ivan seemed a little sleepy, so she asked with concern.
"Well, thinking about something... go to bed a little later." Ivan yawned and walked to the position where he was pulled away and sat down.
Dobby brought a rich breakfast to the table in front of Ivan at the right time, and then he was very diligent and busy with the rag, looking very energetic, ready to wipe the whole room again.
Ivan glanced at it, realizing that Dobby wanted to perform well in front of Aysia, so he looked at Aysia and asked with a smile.
"Mom, what do you think of Dobby? Is it okay?"
"Of course, I'm very satisfied..." Esiah praised her without hesitation, but for a while she was really not used to such a life.
When she got up this morning routinely to cook, she was stopped by Dobby.
The house elf said that she didn’t want to let her do these chores. She was still very excited. If it weren’t for her to stop Dobby, she even planned to hit the wall with her head...
Aisia, who has a certain understanding of house elves, naturally understands that this is Dobby’s "competent" performance, so I just leave it...
Hearing the praise of Aysia, Dobby suddenly became harder, wiped the whole hall spotlessly with a rag, and then cleaned the other rooms with enthusiasm.
"With a house elf, you Hals can be regarded as a wizard family with a solid foundation." After Dobby left the hall, Dougte said both jokingly and enviously.
Don't look at the house elves in the eyes of wizards, they are no different from slaves. But they are loyal, proficient in all life skills, and their magic level is not weaker than that of an adult wizard. They are definitely an excellent helper.
Generally speaking, only those powerful pure-blood families can have a house elf as a slave...
"Dobby and I are just an employment relationship. If it wants to pursue true freedom one day, I will not force it. Moreover, the way to determine a family's heritage should be the inheritance of knowledge they possess!" Ivan shook. Shaking his head, he retorted that he did not approve of such a statement.
The life of this kind of clothes to stretch out your hands and open your mouth is too rotten!
It's easy to kill people's fighting spirit...
No wonder Malfoy is so arrogant and squeamish, he must have been used to it.
Ivan sighed in his heart, took a sip of the oatmeal that Dobby had brought up with him, and ate a few pieces of sausage and roasted tomatoes.
Dougt curled his lips, saying that is correct, but he still wants a house-elf, who can be taken care of who is willing to take care of these trivial matters by himself...
Dougert was not arguing with Ivan, his face became a little serious, and he asked about business as soon as he changed his voice. "By the way, I forgot to ask yesterday, Ivan, do you hate those pure-blood wizards?"
"No!" Ivan shook his head and continued. "I don't think there is any difference between pure blood, mixed blood and Muggle wizards!"
He didn't mean to blindly oppose pure blood, and he wouldn't be as radical as Voldemort that some wizards he couldn't understand should die.
According to Ivan’s understanding, some pure-blood families are actually no different from ordinary wizards. They all rely on a craft and their own abilities to make money.
The Lovegood family, like Luna, relied on operating a newspaper to earn living expenses, and even had a relatively tight life due to the problem of newspaper sales.
"That's good!" Dougert breathed a sigh of relief. Of course he could understand the meaning of Ivan's words. Ivan was not pure blood but privilege!
This means that some pure-blood families are still friends, not enemies!
"Dean Dougte, what do you ask this for?"
Ivan, who has seen Bock’s brain-replenishing ability, understands a truth, and try to ask clearly everything that can be asked clearly, so as not to know when he is pitted.
"I should have told you before that the wizarding market is controlled by six pure-blood families. Although the Knot family is the most powerful, it is only one of them..." Dougt began to explain to Ivan. He wanted to persuade a pure-blood family to act as an internal response, so that they would attack the wizarding market more smoothly.
"Are you sure it will be useful?" Ivan frowned.
"Of course! You don't understand those pure blood, it's a bit ugly, they are no different from the wall grass! Before they tried to resist with a large number of people, but now it is different!" Doug said with a sneer.
"Then which family do you plan to choose for lobbying?" Ivan asked.
"The Rozier family! I have contacted their Patriarch before, trying to persuade him to join us in the rebellious camp. Although that time ultimately failed, the old Rozier hesitated for a while before replying to me. Realizing that he didn't have the slightest chance of winning, then he must surrender faster than anyone else!" Dougt explained.
There are such two and five boys? Ivan took a surprised look at Dougt After getting his confirmation, he continued.
"How long do you probably need to persuade him? How sure are you?"
"I'm 80% sure. You can meet him in two days at most." Dougter said confidently. This time the wizard market suddenly lost nine wizards. The balance of power has been completely out of balance. He Be confident that you can persuade each other.
"Okay! Then I'll meet him!" Ivan nodded and agreed. It would be better to be able to occupy the wizarding market with as little damage as possible.
There is an insider, maybe they can catch the other party all at once, so as not to have some fish that slip through the net and frequently harass them in the future.
After getting Ivan's permission, Dougt seemed very happy. He ate breakfast in a hurry, and then left the magic shop.
Ivan cherished the time he spent with Aysia, and spent the whole morning chatting with Aysia basically without doing anything.
Until the afternoon, Ivan remembered the need to hold a funeral for Elfer Grint, which made Dobby prepare the corresponding things, and used communication magic props to gather everyone back together.
Ivan stood at the door and waited, the space in front of him was constantly twisting, and a group of figures appeared in front of him.
When the last person arrived, Ivan looked at the time, ten minutes had passed...
Ivan can't help but frown at such a speed. It's not the time to eat or sleep!
According to his understanding, wizards can directly use Apparition to teleport instantly. Except for some emergencies, everyone should arrive at the scene immediately after he informs them!

chapters.title: Chapter 520: what? I actually have the mighty power comparable to the Dark Lord? (2 in 1…
chapters.content:
Ivan's gaze slowly swept across the audience, very dissatisfied with this efficiency, but he used the communication magic props to notify everyone at the same time!
The wizards who rushed over looked a little at a loss under Ivan's gaze, and didn't quite understand where they angered each other.
"Ten minutes!" Ivan once again glanced at the clock hanging in the room, then turned his head and spoke to everyone. "It took ten minutes from when I sent the signal... to when you came here using Apparition! I have to say that your incompetence is far beyond my expectations!"
"Even a group of Muggles, after receiving the order, rushed here from any side of Knockdown Alley, I am afraid it will not take such a long time!"
Ivan’s words were very sharp, and the wizards he was staring at lowered their heads tremblingly, not daring to look at him.
Yesterday, the scenes of Ivan's finger killing were still imprinted in their hearts, so even if Ivan scolded no matter how harsh they were, they didn't dare to refute it.
"Who was the last to arrive? Stand up!" Ivan said blankly.
"Yes...it was me, I...I was in the bathroom, sir!" A witch in his thirties walked out tremblingly. He looked at Ivan in fear and stammered. Explained.
"To go to the toilet? What a good reason..." Ivan sneered. He didn't ask any more, but turned his eyes to the second-to-last witch who arrived and said.
"Then what about you? Grace!"
"I...I'm taking a shower, sir..." the witch said embarrassedly.
"I hate someone lying...Grace! Or are you going to tell me to roll around in the sand after taking a shower?" Ivan glanced at each other, keenly aware of the presence of the other's wizard robes Less dust, it's not like new clothes.
"Yes... I'm sorry... Your Excellency Hals! Please... Please forgive my offense!"
was exposed to the lie by Ivan on the spot, and stared with indifferent eyes. Grace's scared face turned white. She knelt down on the spot and squatted on the ground, begging Ivan to forgive her life.
Yesterday in the conference hall, I witnessed Ivan turning black and white, forcing Reese Nott to "confess his guilt", and killing Reese Nott instantaneously with weird means, the seeds of fear were deeply rooted in Grace’s heart. I'm afraid that the other party will torture or even kill myself if they disagree.
Grace's response so much made Ivan stunned. He just wanted to beat the opponent and make some small punishments to let these wizards understand the importance of discipline, but she didn't expect Grace to be so frightened and knelt down.
Am I that scary? Ivan was very depressed, and then he felt that this must be because the other party's psychological quality was too bad. He thought that the wizards in Knock Down Alley were all ruthless characters, and it seemed that this was not necessarily the case.
Ivan shook his head secretly, and had to put off his plan to punish the two on the spot, but he still had a stern face, looked at everyone with sharp eyes and continued to speak.
"Then you guys, why do you have any other reasons? I remember I told you during the rally yesterday that you were going to meet here this afternoon!"
All the wizards did not dare to reply, they just silently accepted Ivan's reprimand, some people complained in their hearts, thinking that Ivan was making a fuss. They just came a little late and didn't delay any important things. .
Ivan has been paying attention to the looks on the faces of the people, and he can naturally guess their thoughts easily, and he can't help but increase his tone.
"I hope you haven't forgotten that we are in a life-and-death dispute, facing danger all the time!
If you are notified this time because one of you has been attacked in Knockturn Alley, you'd better pray that you are lucky enough to be able to wait for your companions to take care of all kinds of affairs. Then come to rescue you! "
Ivan’s words hit the hearts of Grace and others like an alarm bell.
The coffin containing Elfer's body was placed in front of them, telling them with **** facts that this was not alarmist. If they reacted faster after receiving the notice yesterday, maybe Elfer would survive.
"Grace, Joseph..." Ivan looked at the last two who arrived again and asked. "If you are attacked by a wizard squad dispatched by the Knot family, when do you think the support should arrive?"
Naturally, the sooner the better! Can't delay a second!
Grace thought so, but didn't say it immediately, because she understood that Ivan was not asking this, but asked herself to give a time limit for the collection.
"One minute!" Grace calculated, gritted her teeth, and spoke out.
She felt that even if she was going to the bathroom or taking a bath, she could deal with it urgently in one minute. After all, it only takes one Apparition to arrive at the venue, which doesn't take much time.
"Thirty seconds!" Joseph was more ruthless than Grace, in order to not be punished, he shortened the time by half.
"Very good! According to what you said, usually one minute is the limit, 30 seconds after receiving an emergency notice! Next time I will start the timer, and latecomers will be severely punished, no exceptions and no reason!" Ivan said very strongly.
The wizards present glared at Grace and Joseph, and complained in their hearts why they didn’t speak longer. What if they were too deep asleep after receiving instructions late at night?
Or maybe halfway through the bath, dry the body and put on the clothes for more than 30 seconds.
Joseph and Grace didn't care about everyone's gaze. They were fortunate that Ivan had let go of them generously. Just now, they were even ready to get a heartbreak.
Ivan paid attention to the reactions of the wizards present, and was unavoidably disappointed. These wizards were too casual, they were just a group of stragglers gathered together. They obviously lacked training and discipline!
But now is not the time to think about this. After the rebuke, Ivan asked Fran to take Elfer's coffin and head to the cemetery together to find a suitable place for burial.
When the funeral was held, Ivan personally read out the prayers to commend Elfer Grint for his deeds during his lifetime.
part is for show, and the other part is sincere.
Although he did not have any intersection with this victim before this, Elfer Grint was a subordinate recruited by Aesya in his name, and lost his life for this. Of course Ivan will not be perfunctory. thing.
In the process, Ivan also met Elfer's mother, Mrs. Grint.
The gray-haired witch was full of tears in her eyes and looked very pitiful. Her husband and daughter died in the last wizarding war, and now they have lost their last child. The sudden blow really made her a little bit pitiful. hard to accept.
Ivan sighed, feeling a little confused in his heart, but he also understood that such a thing cannot be avoided. Which wizard living in Knockdown Alley has a happy family?
Ivan took the purse full of Jin Jialong, walked to the old witch, and said apologetically.
"Mrs. Grint, I'm sorry, we were a step late and failed to save your son. He has been very brave, fighting to the last minute, is a well-deserved hero!"
"In addition, this is three hundred gallons, please accept it...other than that, there is nothing we can do!" Ivan handed over the purse with Jin Jialong and finished it. Prepare to be scolded.
It is normal for a mother who has lost her child, no matter how angry.
However, none of this happened, Mrs. Grint sobbed deep, took the bag Ivan handed over, and choked with thanks.
She knew very well that her child was doing money-for-life work, and the least valuable in Knockdown Alley was human life. Ivan could hold a funeral for Elfer after his death and give him three hundred gallons. The pension is exhausted.
If he changes to another employer, Elfer will probably end up throwing dead bodies in the wilderness without control...
So even though she was heartbroken, Mrs. Grint did not blame Ivan for Elfer's death.
The funeral lasted for more than an hour, and Ivan took everyone back to the Bojinbok shop in the evening.
Just as Ivan was thinking about whether to take this opportunity to have a training session, Dougert brought him good news.
"Old Rozier has agreed to meet you...now he is waiting. He said that he has something to tell you, and he has to wait until you arrive."
"So fast?" Ivan couldn't help being a little surprised. He remembered that Dougt only mentioned this matter to himself in the morning. He thought he would have to wait a few days.
"Oh, I just mentioned a few words to him casually, and that guy was frightened..." Doug said with a sneer.
Ivan glanced at him, a little curious as to what Dougt said to the other person, as to scare them like this.
But considering that the other party may have to wait for too long to cause trouble, Ivan didn't ask more about it, using Phantom Shift and Dougt to go to the agreed place together.
Anyway, I'll know when I meet...
Accompanied by a burst of space replacement, when he came back to his senses again, Ivan found that he was located near a dilapidated house.
It is very desolate here, probably in the corner on the east side of Knockdown Alley, and in the distance you can see the ruins where the law enforcement officers were fighting.
"Come out, Mr. Rozier, who is hiding in hiding has the demeanor of your pure-blood family, isn't it?" Ivan looked around and there was no one nearby, but he was sure that the other party was still nearby.
Ivan’s words passed around on the empty rooftop, and it took ten seconds for another voice to sound.
"Please forgive me for my rudeness, Your Excellency Hals. After all, I came alone, so be careful."
A middle-aged wizard in his fifties wearing a gorgeous robe appeared not far away out of thin air, with a slightly apologetic look on his face, and a house elf followed by him.
Ivan frowned. Of course, he understood that the other party must have been hiding in the dark just now to check the situation. Once there were too many people on his side, or if he noticed that the situation was not right, the guy fled.
Sure enough, it was the same as Dougt said, but I can’t do it...
While Ivan was observing the opponent, Old Rozier was also looking at him.
After a while, old Rozier suddenly said with emotion.
"You are younger than I thought, Sir Hals! If it hadn't been for Dougt, I couldn't believe that you have a power comparable to the Dark Lord at this age..."
Although he has learned a lot of information from Dougt, the old Rozier is still a little unbelievable looking at Ivan's immature face.
A little wizard up to thirteen or fourteen years old should still go to school at Hogwarts. Even if he starts practicing magic from the moment the magic bursts, he can never learn more than ten years!
Such a kid is really so powerful, is it really comparable to the Dark Demon?
Old Rozier doubted whether Dougert was playing mystery.
I have a mighty power comparable to Voldemort? Ivan glanced sideways at Dougter, thinking about whether he should switch to another person to do this kind of diplomatic work next time, or there will be more outrageous rumors in the Knock Alley in the near future.
Dougert doesn't change his face, so it's normal to brag appropriately when negotiating and putting pressure on him.
And he thought that even Voldemort would not be able to do such weird things as finger killing, so it is not a lie to some extent...
Even though Ivan kept making complaints in his heart, but on the surface he was calm and said impatiently.
"I heard Dougter say that you have a very important piece of information to tell me, but you have to meet me in person before you can reveal it?"
"YesYour Excellency Hals! The Rozier family is willing to surrender to you... But I also ask you to be magnanimous and consider two small conditions." Old Rozier hunched slightly, looking very It was humble, without the arrogance of a pure-blood wizard at all.
"Tell me..." Ivan raised his eyebrows, not surprising, his side did have an advantage, but the other side was not incapable of resisting. He wanted to persuade the old Rozier to betray the original camp and not pay some. The price is definitely not enough.
"First, I hope you can allow our Rozier family to retain the corresponding share in the wizarding market." Old Rozier proposed.
"Yes!" Ivan agreed without hesitation.
For the first pure-blood family to rebel, some preferential treatment is still necessary.
The Rozier family doesn't occupy much share in the wizarding market. In fact, it has no effect. If all this is taken away, no pureblood family will be willing to surrender in the future.
After Ivan agreed, Old Rozier sighed in relief. What he cares most is the interests of the family, as long as this can preserve everything else.
"What about the second condition?" Ivan had no intention of spending time with the other party here, and asked directly.
"The second condition..." Old Rozier hesitated for a long time, seeming to be entangled in whether to say or not, and finally gritted his teeth and tried to speak.
"Your Excellency Hals may not know. I have been obsessed with powerful magic since I was a child. Fifteen years ago, I was fortunate to have seen Lord Dark Lord use his own power against dozens of Aurors. Unforgettable..."

chapters.title: Chapter 521: Conquer the Rozier family (2 in 1, 4,000 words)
chapters.content:
Ivan looked at old Rozier playfully, and he was naturally clear about his plan.
The so-called obsession with powerful magic is just an excuse, the other party's real intention is probably to verify their own strength. Obviously Doug had bragged before and Rozier was skeptical...
Although I knew this, Ivan didn't move while holding the wand, and his gaze at the old Rozier became worse.
"Your Excellency Hals, I know that my request is abrupt, so in order to apologize, I am willing to offer some apocalypse!" Old Rozier still looked humble and turned his head to look at the house elf next to him. .
Under the motion of his eyes, the house elf took out a heavy bag and walked towards Ivan step by step. The bag shook and made a sound of metal crashing. It was obvious that it contained Jin Jialong.
Old Rozier’s face was full of apology, but his eyes were staring at Ivan, observing each other's every move.
He asked Ivan to show magic naturally because he wanted to see the strength of this little wizard with his own eyes. After all, he was not a fool, and he could not just listen to a few words from Dougt, and he was believed by Fudge.
Besides, he has been watching the actions of Dougert and others over the past few months. Old Rozier guessed that the other party’s purpose is not only to control the wizarding market, but there may be even greater plans!
Once the opponent's goal of rectifying Knockout Alley is achieved, the Ministry of Magic will never sit back and watch, so it becomes very important to confirm Ivan's strength.
If Dougt had not deceived himself before, and Ivan’s strength is indeed comparable to the Dark Lord, then the magic world must usher in a major reshuffle. Their Rozier family, as the first batch of veteran members to join the opposing party’s subordinates, would definitely be able to So profitable.
If Ivan is not as strong as Dougt said, but is just a little talented wizard, he will not be able to accompany him. Even those industries that lose the wizarding market will be better than the life of the future!
Of course, this temptation is not without risk, it is very likely to anger the little wizard in front of him...
This is also the reason why he put down his face and negotiated with a low profile. Coupled with the apocalypse and the intelligence in his mind, he is more than 70% sure that the other party will not kill him!
If he is unlucky and hits the remaining 30% probability, then he has no choice but to run away!
Only for this, the old Rozier is extremely confident. His apparition is very good, and he can perform smoothly in various extreme situations.
And he was prepared with both hands from the beginning. While observing the rules, he came to show his sincerity by himself, and he also brought a house elf with him!
In the concept of the general wizard, the house elves are just slaves, they are not human heads, and they will not cause ill feelings, which is regarded as a loophole in the rules.
In a crisis situation, this house elf can resist him for a while, allowing him enough time to cast spells.
Old Rozier had an abacus in his heart, calculating everything clearly and complacently.
However, things would not develop as he expected. The house elf held the purse and walked a few steps, and Ivan's indifferent voice suddenly rang.
"Mr. Rozier, I think you may have forgotten a little. Not everything can be measured with money... But if you want to see it, I can't satisfy you..."
Ivan's face turned cold, and he wondered if the other party was dizzy, or was it pure blood thinking that money could solve everything?
Have the guts to try it in front of Voldemort? Take a sum of money to let the Dark Lord cast a spell on you?
I've lifted my head for you!
From this point, he was sure that the old Rozier had never seen Voldemort, otherwise he would not have said such stupid things.
Ivan is not so cruel, nor does he care about using high-intensity magic to deter, but he understands that he must take the initiative, not act according to the other party's requirements...
While speaking, Ivan has quietly activated the enhanced magic text sequence in the magic wand, holding the magic wand in his right hand and slamming across the air!
An invisible and shadowless blade of magic power stretched forward like a broad scimitar.
Ivan didn't chant a spell, because he didn't need it. After years of practice, Shen Feng Wuying had already reached the sixth level, and it was easy for Ivan to cast spells silently.
tear...
accompanied by a slight sound,
Not far from the front, the bag that the house elf had been holding in his hand was cut open by something. The Jin Jialong inside was scattered all around, and some of the gold coins could be vaguely cut into two pieces...
Before these heavy Jin Jialong landed, the magical blade reached the old Rozier's body over a distance of several meters.
As early as Ivan said those words, the old Rozier's face changed. He knew that he was self-defeating, and immediately wanted to use Apparition to leave here.
But he obviously overestimated his ability to escape. When the old Rozier raised his wand, the magic blade had already swept past him, and there was a burst of tingling in his abdomen, as if he had been pricked by a needle. general.
"Apparition!" Old Rozier yelled, waving his wand recklessly and chanting the spell at the fastest speed.
However, nothing happened. Old Rozier still stood on the spot, only the sound of Jing Jialong strewn on the ground echoing in his ears.
He lowered his head and glanced sluggishly, only to realize that the wand in his hand had been chopped into two pieces at some unknown time. The cut was smooth and round, as if it had been cut by a sharp blade, and it was finely polished.
Click...
At this time, there was another sour sound of cutting behind him. Old Rozier subconsciously turned his head and looked over. A large piece of tall bushes was cut off, and a thick tree next to it was also cut off. After a while, he swayed and fell to the ground, bringing up a cloud of smoke.
Where his eyes can reach, about a fan-shaped area, the height of all objects are surprisingly the same, and the flatness is a little scary.
Old Rozier swallowed hard. He understood that Ivan was not hitting the wrong way, but deliberately letting himself go. If this attack was against him, he would fight against him before he could react. The tree was cut into two pieces.
What made Old Rozier even more shocked was that such an attack could not be seen or touched at all, and the penetrating power was extremely wide. He was sure that even if he prepared protective measures in advance, he would be penetrated instantly, and he could not resist it !
With only this blow, Old Rozier confirmed that Dougert's words were true. He had never seen the Dark Lord cast a spell, but I am afraid that he would not be far behind.
Thinking of this, the old Rozier was ready to admit counsel. If Ivan didn’t kill himself immediately, it means there is still a chance for things to ease. The question is how much it will cost...
But when he turned his head, he saw that the house elves he had brought brazenly attacked Ivan.
"Stop! You idiot!" Old Rozier was stunned and let out a heart-piercing cry.
His wand had just been severed by Ivan, which meant that he had completely lost the ability to resist. If the house elves he brought with him accidentally injured the little wizard in front of him, he would be dead!
There is no possibility of escape.
But the old Rozier was obviously a step slower. The house elf had already stretched out his hand, and a dazzling beam of light flew out from his fingers and struck straight towards Ivan.
Ivan’s expression remained unchanged, and he instantly activated the protective ring he was wearing on his right hand. Without seeing any movement, the curse beam returned to its original path, knocking the house elf standing in place.
Before Ivan could continue to punish him, Old Rozier swooped up, pinching the house elf's neck with his hands, and furiously.
"You humble bastard, who on earth gave you the courage to attack Lord Hals?!"
Old Rozier's face was extremely ferocious, he didn't save the least, he wanted to choke the house elf to death and calm Ivan's anger.
Without the magic wand, he can only use this most primitive method!
Although the old Rozier is old and physically weak, he still has strength. The house elf had been bounced back by his own curse, and now he was pinched by his neck. His face was blue and purple, and his light bulb-sized eyes were about to stare. Out.
And that ugly, wrinkled face was filled with confusion and confusion.
The house elf obviously didn’t understand what he did wrong. It followed the old Rozier’s instructions. Before coming, the old Rozier ordered it to attack the enemy in times of crisis, so as to fight for the master’s escape. some time.
At this time, the old Rozier obviously forgot his original instructions, or he didn't want to think about it at all, and blamed all the blame on the house elves.
Just when the house elf was about to lose his voice, Ivan’s voice came over again.
"Stop it! What a clumsy trick!"
Old Rozier's hands trembled, and he did not dare to violate Ivan's instructions, let go of the house elf who had fainted, and then he did not dare to stand up and knelt in front of Ivan, begging to say.
"Your Excellency Hals, please give me a chance. I am willing to pay enough price in exchange for your understanding..."
"No more nonsense...what information do I want?" Ivan interrupted the old Rozier's words. This kind of person has too many thoughts and is not easy to control.
If that information is useless, there is no need for old Rozier to survive...
Old Rozier's body trembled, and he hurriedly continued.
"Tomorrow at three o'clock in the afternoon, there will be a secret meeting in the underground secret room of the wizard market. At that time, all of us will be there, where anti-phantom shifting magic has been applied. As long as you can block the entrance and exit, no one can run. !"
"Are you sure?" Ivan raised his eyebrows. If it was true, it would be a good piece of information.
The ability of the wizard to apparate is a headache for him, because it means it is difficult to capture, even if he finds where the opponent is, they may have escaped before he invades.
Forcibly invading the wizarding market, it is not impossible to occupy there, but it may cause some damage, and secondly, if the members of the pure-blood family are not completely resolved, it may cause some trouble in the future.
"Tell me...what is the purpose of your gathering this time? Why did you choose that place?" Ivan asked.
Although the old Rozier seemed to be scared, there should be no possibility of lying, but Ivan had to act cautiously. What if this is a trap?
No matter how small the possibility is, he has to be on guard.
"This rally was proposed by the Knott family. We lost too many manpower in the past two days, which completely exceeded our expectations. So this time, Knott wanted to gather us all together to discuss the next response strategy.
was chosen in the basement secret room of the wizard market because it is safe enough, with heavy protection, plus anti-ghosting magic, so there is no need to worry about being suddenly intruded. "
Facing Ivan’s question, the old Rozier did not dare to conceal the slightest bit. He told everything he knew like a bamboo tube poured into beans. He also tremblingly took out a map from his arms, trembling slightly. Pass it up...
"This is the map of the underground secret room. It was funded and built by several of our families back then. All secret passages and entrances were drawn on it." Old Rozier added.
Ivan took the map and looked at it, and found that this underground secret room was quite large. The lounge, meeting room, and residence were very complete. There were also many gates set up, just like a small fortress. No wonder Will choose to rally here.
If there is no old Rozier as a traitor as an internal response, it will not be easy to attack It is a fantasy to capture everyone without fail.
"Very good, yes, I feel your sincerity." Ivan put the map away, and his gaze at the old Rozier became a little softer.
What he lacks most now is time, and soon he will leave Knockoff Alley to meet with Nick LeMay. It is impossible to expect to be here for a long time. Old Rozier has now given him a solution to completely solve those pure-blood families. A great opportunity, and there is no need to worry about subsequent troubles.
When Ivan said that, the old Rozier was finally relieved, he knew his life was saved.
However, Ivan didn't intend to spare him so easily, and forced Old Rozier to make a magic contract to ensure that the other party would not suddenly repent or make any small actions.
For this kind of cunning cowardice, Ivan felt that only the magic contract could make the other party more reliable.
Old Rozier didn't have the guts to refuse. Now his life is pinched in Ivan's hands, and he doesn't have the ability to bargain at all.
After confessing some things and arranging a time for the raid, Ivan glanced at Jin Jialong scattered on the ground indefinitely.
It looks like there are at least five hundred pieces, and it is very dazzling in the sun...
Ivan had never thought that Old Rozier would be willing to spend five hundred gallons to see him perform a magic once, which is really "sincere".
In theory, he has already met the second condition of the old Rozier, the money is already his own, but in order to maintain his cold image, Ivan can only give up this plan sadly.
There is no way...who makes him unable to pull the bottom to pick it up!

chapters.title: Chapter 522: What kind of magic is this? (2 in 1)
chapters.content:
"Let's go!" Ivan glanced at Jin Jialong on the ground for the last time, and then cast an Apparition with Dougt and disappeared in place.
After waiting for Ivan to leave for a while, the old Rozier raised his head tremblingly, looked around in a circle, slowly heaved a sigh of relief, and then planned to stand up.
When he really got up, Old Rozier suddenly felt a tingling pain in his waist.
"hiss~"
He lowered his head and glanced with a grin, and found a small opening on the side waist of the wizard's robe, and blood was constantly oozing outward.
Because of fear and anger, he hadn't noticed this at all. Now he relaxed and pulled the wound a lot, and the tingling sensation came to his heart again.
Old Rozier clutched the wound and endured the pain and walked to the house elf, kicked it, and said angrily.
"Did you die? Lar? Get up if you're not dead!"
Old Rozier's foot was very heavy, and he awakened the dazed house elf and ordered it to heal his wounds.
The poor servant was almost killed but didn't dare to complain. He tremblingly pressed his hand against the old Rozier's wound and began to perform magic, but when his finger ran through the wound, it didn't work. Any effect.
"Are you kidding me?" Old Rozier stared at it fiercely, and the anger that he had accumulated for a long time would burst out.
The house elf shook his head in horror, and hurriedly explained. "Master, Lal... Lal really did his best!"
Old Rozier stared at it for a while, and saw Lal's tears and nose flow down, and he looked terrified, and he should have no guts to deceive himself. This was a bit of faith.
He glanced at the still bleeding wound again, could not help but think of something, and turned his gaze to Jin Jialong scattered on the ground.
"Lal, I order you to restore Jin Jialong with a repair spell!" Old Rozier said tentatively.
The house elf did not dare to disobey the owner's instructions, sobbing, while extending the index finger of his right hand again, a ray of white light lit up at the fingertips.
The damaged Jin Jialong on the ground seemed to be wrapped in some inexplicable force, slowly floating up and joining together.
But the strange thing is that the cracks in the middle have not recovered. When the power of magic gradually disappears, they fall to the ground and break into two again.
"I'm sorry...Master...Lal can't do it...Lal can't do it!" The house elf said tremblingly, and then, like other elf who did something wrong, picked it up on the ground. One of the small wooden bars whipped his head to punish his incompetence.
"Bad Lar...Bad elf!" The house elf shouted frantically while beating.
Old Rozier ignored it at all, squatted down and picked up one of the two-half Jin Jialong, and carefully looked at the incision.
"What kind of magic is this?" Old Rozier's face changed, and he felt cold behind his back, muttering to himself.
The magic that Ivan cast just now looks more terrifying than he thought. It has a wide range and strong penetrating ability. It also has inexplicable blocking power that can inhibit wound healing!
This means that once injured by this kind of magic without the corresponding curse, the wound will never be repaired. Even if the cursed person is not dead on the spot, he will bleed and die in the next few days.. .
Thinking of this, Old Rozier couldn't help shivering, and hurriedly wanted to go to Ivan, asking him to unlock this weird magic.
But the old Rozier stopped quickly again. He suddenly realized that with the strong strength and control ability shown by the opponent, it is impossible to cause accidental injury. If he is willing to solve the curse for himself, I am afraid it will be solved long ago!
Then there is only one possibility, leaving this wound is the other party deliberately, the purpose is to punish his previous offensive behavior!
After all, the wound is not big. If you do emergency treatment, you won't lose blood and die in one day.
Waiting for the conquest of the wizarding market tomorrow afternoon, if you have done your own merits and demerits, I am afraid it will be the time to solve the curse!
Old Rozier smiled bitterly and shook his head, and had to order the house elves to collect Jin Jialong from the ground and take him back to the manor.
He needs to give emergency treatment to the wound as soon as possible.
Lal’s brain wasn’t very good, but his actions were still very neat. He dropped the wooden stick that punishes him, pulled the rags on his body into a pocket, and pulled Jin Jialong into it, full of it. It's dazzling.
Old Rozier looked around, but shook his head and sighed.
He originally thought that no one could stop the charm of money, so he made such a tentative move, but he did not expect that Ivan was not very interested in money.
But that's right, such a little wizard must have a higher level of pursuit, how can he be as vulgar as himself...
"It doesn't seem that everyone likes money! I have to try something else next time." Old Rozier sighed and dragged the house elf Lal and left here with him.
......
At the same time, Dougte, who returned to the black magic shop, looked at Ivan with a look of admiration. "You did a good job just now! That old thing was so scared, I must be honest..."
"Hope..." Ivan rolled his eyes and said casually.
If it weren’t for Doug to brag too much and put his image too high to be equal to the Dark Lord, he would not be guilty of pretending to improve his style, so that he could not pull his face and squat on the ground to pick up money...
That is five hundred Jin Jialong...not a small sum!
Thinking about it this way, Ivan felt a pity that the old Rozier was too ignorant. If he begged him to accept the tribute, would he still refuse it?
Dougert didn't understand what Ivan was thinking, nor did he put the five hundred gallons in his eyes, but continued to talk about business.
"The information provided by the old Rozier should be no problem. When do you plan to attack the wizarding market tomorrow, do I need to inform Fren and them about this matter now?"
"No, no need! The less people know about this, the better!" Ivan shook his head and rejected Dougert's suggestion.
Don’t look at him for both deterrence and grace to obey the more than 30 wizards, but the contact time is really too short, and there will be no ghosts in it, just in case. It's hard to get rid of the wind.
So he thinks that only Aisia, Dougt, and himself are enough to know. It just so happens that tomorrow they will need to divide into three teams to block the entrances and exits and secret passages.
As for the other members, it’s not too late to set aside ten minutes before the battle begins...
"Is that so?" Dougt's mind turned around and he quickly understood what he meant. It is better to be cautious and not easy to make mistakes.
Ivan asked Dougte to call to Esiah, took out the map of the secret room, and after understanding the whole story, the three together discussed the course of action for tomorrow's attack on the wizarding market and their respective areas of responsibility.
Now that there is such a good opportunity, no one hopes that some evasive mistakes will lead to abandonment of all previous efforts...
One day passed in a flash.
At noon the next day, Ivan, who was ready, issued an emergency assembly order at 2:30!
According to the previous requirement, all members must be present within 30 seconds after the emergency order is issued. Ivan keeps an eye on the clock to see how many people violate the order today.
Seven seconds later, the first figure appeared not far ahead.
What surprised Ivan was that the first one to arrive turned out to be Joseph, who was the latest to come back. It seems that he has had enough lessons last time.
After three seconds, Fren, Walker and other werewolf wizards have all arrived on the scene, and then every second there will be a few more figures on the field.
Until the 30th second, the last Grace arrived at the scene with a pinch, perhaps because of the rush, she was very embarrassed, her hair was messy, and she didn't even apply her makeup.
Ivan wondered if she had been sleeping until this point...
Facing Ivan's gaze, Grace shrank her neck like a frightened little beast, because she was not sure if she was late.
Fortunately, Ivan's eyes didn't stay on her for long, and he quickly turned to other wizards on the field.
"Yes, you guys came very timely today... did not disappoint me!" Ivan said with satisfaction as he looked around the crowd.
He originally thought that basic training like this would need to be done several times before these wizards could learn the importance of punctuality. He didn't expect these people to be more obedient than he thought.
Hearing Ivan's words, the wizards present heaved a sigh of relief.
They don't want to try the severe punishment that Ivan said, so they have been wearing uniforms even to sleep these days, just to be able to arrive as soon as they receive the notice.
"Your Excellency Hals, is there something urgent for you to summon us with an emergency order?" Fren asked.
Ivan nodded and said.
"I got an information. At three o'clock this afternoon, the Knot family will hold a meeting in the secret room of the wizarding market. Everyone from the pure-blood families will be there. Your task is to conquer there, capture or Kill all personnel..."
Fren and others were very surprised, guessing where Ivan got such important information. Generally speaking, secret gatherings are almost impossible to leak.
They are even more worried that this information is deliberately released by the Knot family, because the underground secret room of the wizard market, they have attacked there is no different from a small fortress, once trapped, I am afraid that they will suffer heavy losses.
"The Rozier family, one of the six pure bloods, has taken refuge in us, and has handed over the map and established a magic contract. This time there is absolutely no possibility of failure!" Ivan saw their worries and threw out again Sent an intelligence.
Now, of course, he won't have any more concealment. Even if the wizards present have an internal response from the other side, they will not have the opportunity to make a report under the supervision of everyone.
And now it has another important meaning, to prevent accidental injury, lest old Rozier die unluckily in his own hands.
"The Rozier family surrendered?"
After hearing the news, Joseph, Grace and others couldn't believe it. The battle hadn't started yet, and one of the opponent's leaders surrendered and became his own. Wouldn't it be a win?
After Ivan nodded his head to confirm, everyone's morale suddenly rose, and they clamored to enter the wizarding market immediately and arrest the old Knot...
Ivan did not take it lightly. His goal this time was not only to win, but more importantly, not to die!
After all, a person’s pension costs three hundred gallons, which is unacceptable for Ivan, who has just lost five hundred gallons!
So for more than twenty minutes before departure, Ivan patiently explained to them the traps distributed in the underground secret room, lest they get caught.
"If you need to scatter and search for the target after entering, each group should not be less than three people, and you need to ensure mutual support, understand?" Ivan said emphatically.
The wizards present nodded one after another, feeling a little moved in their hearts.
Although the little wizard in front of him is more brutal and harsh, he still cares about their lives. You can see from raising the pension yesterday, holding the funeral in person, and repeatedly emphasizing safety measures today.
After finishing everything, Ivan no longer hesitated, so that the wizards were divided into three teams and went to the entrance and exit of the wizard market to stand by.
After receiving the order, the wizards all performed apparitions, and the figures disappeared in place as they came. The last Ivan waved his magic wand, and in a staggered space, he landed on a high platform. On, there were only 13 wizards including Fren, and everyone else followed Acia and Dougt to block the remaining two exits.
"Your Excellency Hals, there is the wizard market in front of them, and their secret rooms are built underground..." Fren pointed to the front and said.
Ivan turned his head and looked over, somewhat emotional.
Two years ago, he and Doug came here once, but the lively scene of the wizarding market at that time was like a large bazaar.
Now here is a different look, it is very deserted, there are no people in sight, only four law enforcement officers are still on duty at the door.
"We'll start at three ten ten!" Ivan took out the stopwatch from the wizard's robe and looked at the time. It is now two to fifty. Considering that someone might be late, he delayed the time to do it. Some.
Fren and others are also holding their wands tightly, while hiding themselves, they are also ready to do it at any time.
The waiting time is not long, Ivan also saw a gorgeously dressed middle-aged wizard walk into the wizard market with some of his men.
This is undoubtedly corroborating the old Rozier's statement.
Ivan waited for a while, confirmed that no one would come again in a short time, and waved his wand to point at the law enforcement officers in the wizard market.
"Confringo!"
After a few seconds of gaining momentum, Ivan chanted the spell, and a fiery flame gradually ignited at the tip of the wand, and then quickly expanded into the wind, and slammed into the direction of the wizard market.

chapters.title: Chapter 523: alliance? nonexistent! (2 in 1)
chapters.content:
The fierce flames and powerful magical fluctuations instantly attracted the attention of the law enforcement officials. Seeing the large fireball that swelled to more than two meters high rushed towards him, the four law enforcement officials were a little panicked.
"Enemy attack!" Fortunately, years of training played a role at this moment. Someone soon reacted and issued a stern shout. Others also hurriedly waved their wands at the attacking fireball, building a protective barrier.
"ImpedimentJinx!"
"Protegos!"
......
The flying fireball in the next second slammed into the magic barrier. After only a moment of resistance, the magic barrier was crushed. The orange fireball disintegrated, and endless light and heat spread in all directions.
The two law enforcement officers in front were directly blasted out, and hit the pillar behind them heavily, breaking the iron armor curse they were holding on them.
A law enforcement officer vomited blood in ragged clothes. Because the iron armor curse had prevented him from doing anything, there was nothing serious about it.
But another law enforcement officer not far away was not so lucky. He was blown to **** blood before he could cast the protective spell, and he was silent.
The law enforcement officers who are still alive have no time to rejoice, because everyone knows that the danger is not over!
Before the smoke from the explosion dissipated completely, dozens of beams of spells of various colors rushed in from the smoke, followed by a few low wolf howls.
"It's those **** werewolves...retreat quickly and notify the others!" The leader of the law enforcer immediately issued an order to retreat after noticing the large number of enemies and obviously unable to stand the enemy, and planned to use Apparition. go away.
However, his movements were obviously a step slower. Ivan and the others, who had been lurking for a long time, would not let him go. A gray-black werewolf had already rushed in front of him, biting the arm of the law enforcement officer, and interrupted it. His spellcasting.
Other law enforcement agents were also attacked to varying degrees in the first time...
With mental arithmetic and unintentional, in just a few seconds, all four law enforcement officers fell to the ground, unable to make any decent resistance at all.
The few merchants in the Wizarding Market saw this cruel scene, they were directly shocked, and even ignored the items in the stall, and fled in panic.
Ivan also ignored them. His goal this time was to target the wizard market, and had nothing to do with these poor wizards.
"Your Excellency Hals, what should these two people do to kill?" Fren and Walker came over with a surviving caster and asked.
"Let's take care of it first!" Ivan glanced at the two law enforcement officers who had lost their combat effectiveness, waved his hands and said.
If he can, he doesn't want to kill people. There are already enough wizards in the magical world, not to mention that these law enforcers are all commissioned guys. They may not have any loyalty to the Knot family. You should wait for torture and confirm in the future. Disposal.
Just as Ivan was thinking this way, there was an explosion in the distance, accompanied by a little screaming, Ivan suddenly understood that Esiah and Dougert had done it.
"Leave four guards, and the rest will follow me in!" Ivan did not dare to delay any more, and then ordered.
In order to prevent the other party's follow-up support, so as not to be blocked in the urn, it is necessary to ensure that the exit is unimpeded.
Fren and others nodded. This was discussed before, so they quickly arranged the candidates to stay. The remaining nine wizards followed Ivan and rushed into the wizard market.
After knocking out the two guards inside, Ivan smoothly came to a wide room and turned an oil lamp next to him according to the directions on the map.
Click, click...
A wall behind it cracked, shaking to give way to a passage, which was very narrow and only allowed two people to walk side by side.
The end of the passage looks like a hall, but because of the limited vision, it is impossible to see the whole picture, and it is not sure whether there is anyone guarding it.
Ivan grabbed a piece of masonry without any hesitation, and rushed in immediately, followed by Fren and others.
When they were halfway there, six heavily armed black wizards suddenly appeared at the end of the empty passage. Obviously, they heard the explosion outside, and then deliberately ambushed here.
If it were in a more open area, these dark wizards would not have time to run, and would never come to die, but now it is different. In this narrow terrain, Ivan and others have no way to escape.
"Reducto!"
"AvadaKedavra"
"!"
......
Colorful spell beams struck one after another, and there were also several green rays that made people sweat.
Fren and others' complexions changed suddenly, but they were in a dilemma for a while. The obstacle curse and iron armor curse they cast could not stop the killing curse.
Ivan hurriedly threw out the masonry in his hand, and then pointed his magic wand.
Under the combined action of the magnifying spell and the transforming spell, the masonry quickly swelled, and the surface gradually became shiny with a metallic color, as if you were looking at a wall in front of you...
Boom!
Several spells collided with the brick wall. After all, the latter is a magical creation, not as hard as the real wall. It exploded immediately, and countless fragments galloped in all directions.
"Oppugno!"
All of this was naturally expected by Ivan. He waved his wand once again, and all the bricks and stones were dragged and smashed towards the dark wizards at the end of the passage.
Fren and others behind Ivan were not idle either, and they took out their wands to fight back, venting their anger.
Faced with such a wide range of magical attacks, the dark wizards who did not have the slightest spirit of sacrifice after the first wave of offensive failure, really chose to back down and left the passage to avoid this attack, but it also meant that they lost the first wave. Opportunity for a second shot!
The extremely fast Ivan crossed a distance of tens of meters in just two seconds and entered the hall.
The walls of the tables and chairs in front were all pitted by a large number of broken stones and bricks. A total of six black wizards had already run halfway in two seconds.
A dark wizard who hadn't had time to run turned his head and saw Ivan who suddenly broke in, and waved his magic wand without saying a word.
"Diffindo!"
The crimson beam hit Ivan, then went back the same way, knocking him out.
Ivan did not hesitate to make up a coma spell to stun the black wizard.
At the same time, Fren and the others, who had been behind Ivan, rushed in. Several spells blasted over, leaving two black wizards lying on the ground in a tragic manner.
Ivan turned his head and glanced, intending to let them catch them alive as much as possible, but after thinking about it, he closed his mouth again. In such a fierce battle, asking Fran and the others to keep their hands was irresponsible for their lives!
"The two roads ahead, according to the previous plan, we will take the lead. Fren, you are responsible for bringing some people to the left to search!" Ivan took out the map and took a look, and after confirming that the meeting room was on the right, he faced it. Fren said.
"Yes, Sir Hals..." Forren has turned into a werewolf form, and the huge and ferocious head paused, and then rushed towards the left passage with his four men.
Ivan did not act immediately. He stretched out his right hand and tapped a wand on a cabinet in the hall. Under the action of magic, the wooden cabinet quickly softened, and the continuous stretch and extension became a huge giant. python.
All the passages in the secret room under 　　 are very narrow. Once blocked, it is almost impossible to avoid the opponent's magic, so he needs a large enough meat shield to resist these magic for him.
Although Ivan can become a basilisk by himself and kill the Quartet, it might be dangerous. What if he accidentally hits an Avadasuo Curse in front of him?
He doesn't want to personally experience whether the basilisk's anti-magic skin can resist the killing curse!
"Act now!" Ivan witnessed the giant snake snaking into the passage, and then summoned his patron saint as insurance, and finally gave the action order.
......
A few minutes ago, in the underground conference room,
Six wizards are sitting around a round mahogany table, discussing vigorously.
"We have lost too many manpower in the past few months, and the wizarding market has become more and more deserted day by day. It won't work anymore!"
"Then what do we do? Surrender? You think it's all for now, and the other party will let us go?"
"Yes! You must not admit defeat. If you bow your head to those hybrids and Muggle species, don't you want to face it? We can recruit more people, or seek help from the Ministry of Magic..."
......
Everyone was talking about it, full of gunpowder.
Looking at the form, no one knows that he is already at an absolute disadvantage. The other party is pressing on every step of the way. Failure is only a matter of time.
Originally according to their usual style, at this time they should start compromise negotiations, and try to make some concessions to prevent the other party from targeting the wizarding market. After all, if they continue to fight like this, their losses will only be greater.
But the problem is that this time is different from the past. Their enemies are not equal. It is not a pure-blood wizard family, but a magic shop owner in Knockdown Alley. They are a bit embarrassed to compromise with such an unremarkable lowly mixed-blood. ..
When the argument gradually fell into a stalemate, one of the wizards in black robes turned his head and looked at Nott, who had not spoken, and suggested.
"Old Knott, isn't the Executive Director of the Ministry of Magic your good friend? If the Ministry is willing to interfere, then things will be easy."
"How easy is it? The Ministry of Magic doesn't have time to pay attention to us now..." Nott shook his head and sighed.
Naturally, he knew much more information in his capacity than ordinary wizards. Recently Azkaban seemed to have lost a very important fugitive, and a large number of Aurors were secretly dispatched.
In addition to the recent dementor riots, the executive director was going crazy. The last time I met, he seemed to be a few years old suddenly. How can I be in the mood to take care of the incident in Knock Down Alley?
And Old Knot was very clear that in the eyes of many senior officials of the Ministry of Magic, one wizard in Knockdown Alley was not a good thing.
Because this often means that there will be a lot less vicious things in the magical world in the next period of time...
Listening to Nott’s words, everyone present fell into a short silence. Without the intervention of the Ministry of Magic, it would be a foolish dream to let the other party settle down.
The chunky witch sitting on the corner hesitated, gritted her teeth, and suggested.
"I feel that Aisia is not just trying to compete for the wizarding market. In the past few months, she has not only been working on our wizarding market. She must have a bigger plan! If you can convince the executive director to believe this. , The Ministry of Magic will never let it go!"
"Want to make those people believe that a magic shop owner in Knockdown Alley would threaten their rule? Heh...difficult!" Old Rozier shook his head with a sneer, and poured cold water on everyone.
"No, we can collect or forge some evidence... as long as the people at the Ministry of Magic realize that they have gathered a lot of dark wizards with intent to be unruly!" the chunky witch said viciously.
"Then as you said, let's vote, and more than half of the people agree to start the implementation!" Knott's index finger tapped the table lightly, and after hesitating for a while, finally made a decision.
"Seconded!"
Several other wizards have no opinion agreed, because this is the last resort. If it doesn't work, they can only consider surrender or compromise.
Old Rozier looked around at the crowd, pretending to be sad and nodded slowly to agree, but he couldn't help sighing in the bottom of his heart. It was too late to discuss now to seek help from the Ministry of Magic.
I am afraid that none of them can get out of here today...
But while sighing, the old Rozier was also fortunate. He was on the side of the winner. This time he was not only fine, but also rewarding!
As for the psychological pressure caused by betraying an ally?
nonexistent!
Old Rozier knew very well that if there were enough benefits, anyone in front of him would not hesitate to betray him. The so-called alliance is just a joke.
boom...
Just as the old Rozier was thinking this way, there was a sudden violent noise above them, an explosion could be faintly heard, and the tables and chairs in the meeting room shook crazily.
"What's wrong? What happened?" The squat witch held the table with a panicked look so that she would not fall.
"Looking at the movement, someone may have entered from the outside!" Nott's face was very ugly. He squinted his eyes and scanned the people in the conference room one by one.
"What?! How could it be so coincidental?" Old Rozier frowned, with a look of stunned expression.
The other people also looked at each other, with inexplicable brilliance in their eyes. The secret meeting held here today, but only they themselves know...

chapters.title: Chapter 524: Old Rozier: It's ridiculous that you think I'm an undercover agent...
chapters.content:
Just a few seconds after the explosion sounded, the door of the meeting room was knocked open, and a spellcaster in a black robe hurriedly looked at several people and said while panting.
"Your Excellency Nott! Werewolves and a large number of wizards broke in from outside!"
