"I know! Gather some people, let's go out from the secret path now!" Nott's words were full of strong anger, but his reason made him understand that now is not the time to investigate whether there is a traitor inside, the most important thing is to leave quickly Here.
However, the black-robed law enforcement officer did not move, stammering the news that both the entrance and exit and the secret road were attacked at the same time.
"What?! Are you sure?!" Nott rushed forward eagerly and grabbed the collar of the law enforcement officer and asked.
"Yes, Lord Knott..." the law enforcement officer swallowed and said tremblingly.
After the confirmation, Knott's figure shook, and he almost didn't faint.
If all the exits were blocked, wouldn't all of them be trapped here to die?
"Who betrayed us!" Nott turned his head, and stared at Old Rozier and the others with red eyes fiercely.
The pure-blood wizards present also took a few steps back and looked at their colleagues cautiously.
If there were only speculations just now, then everyone is sure that a traitor must have appeared among them!
After all, only a few of them knew the time of the secret meeting here, and not many people knew the specific location of the secret road. Without an undercover report, Aysia would never have chosen to attack at this time by coincidence.
Old Rozier’s face remained unchanged, but he was very flustered. He knew very well that now is his most dangerous moment. If he is identified, he may not wait for Ivan and others to attack and he will die. Here.
Only delay as much as possible and stir the muddy water!
"It must be you, right?! Foley! I thought you were wrong for a long time! Everyone knows that you have a contradiction with Old Norte, maybe you want to kill us!" Old Rozier suddenly waved his wand and pointed to one of them. The middle-aged wizard said righteously.
Nott and others also looked at Foley suspiciously, with a skeptical look in their eyes.
"You fart! What good does surrender do to me?!" Foley patted the table excitedly, glaring at old Rozier, and then he asked gloomily as if thinking of something. "On the contrary, it is you, Rozier...None of us said anything. What are you doing so quickly? I heard that you often go out these two days and you can't see anyone..."
Hearing this, old Rozier's pupils suddenly dilated, and he really didn't understand how Foley knew the news.
It is impossible for the house elf Lal not to betray him, and if it were him, there would not be this rally. Then it is only possible that one of the two servants in the family had a problem and was bought by Foley. , Or this guy secretly sent someone to monitor him.
The only thing to be thankful for is that the other party doesn't know much, otherwise they would have already started it.
"You said I'm an undercover agent? A joke!" Old Rozier was very angry, but on the surface he said with a sneer.
"Then how do you explain your going out, Rozier? If you don't say it clearly, then don't blame me! I don't want to wait for the enemy to guard against sneak attacks by traitors!" Foley is not forgiving. Inquired, the wand in his hand had been pointed at the old Rozier.
The other wizards on the field didn't speak, and their eyes wandered between the two. In the end, most of them stretched out their wands and pointed at Old Rozier.
Everyone has been in friendship for decades, and they know each other well, and they know the character of the old Rozier. If there must be a betrayer here, his possibility is the greatest!
Old Rozier was in a cold sweat on his forehead, muttering in his heart why Ivan and the others weren't coming, and finally he was heartbroken and reached out and untied his wizard robe.
Foley and the others were all startled. The top of the magic wand in their hands was already lit up with various beams. They were worried that Old Rozier would take out powerful magic items from his clothes and die with them.
But no, old Rozier just showed them that he was wrapped in gauze around his waist.
"Originally this was my personal matter, there was no need to tell you, but since you want to know, it's not impossible!" Old Rozier looked around at several people and directly lifted the gauze out, revealing that it was still flowing inside. Point to the **** wound and continue to speak.
"Did you see? The last time Isiah took that werewolf to attack the manor, I was accidentally hit by a very special magic.
In the past few days, I have tried many methods and found many friends, and finally found that no matter what method I can't heal it! "
"This kind of wound is like a curse. Maybe I will bleed to death in one or two days. You guys think I'm an undercover agent. It's so ridiculous!" Old Rozier shook his head sadly and murmured. The self-talking.
Nott and the others, who pointed the magic wand at Old Rozier, were immediately embarrassed. From the pale to scary complexion of Old Rozier, and the bleeding wound on his waist, it could be seen that the other party was not lying.
Foley frowned. He somewhat suspected that the old Rozier had betrayed them just to heal this bleeding wound.
But thinking about it carefully, Foley felt that this possibility was very low. If that was the case, the other party would have healed his wounds long ago in order to reassure Old Rozier.
After all, no one else knows about this injury, and even if it is cured, there is no possibility of exposure, and there is no need to suffer for nothing.
As for the credibility of both parties, it is enough to establish a magic contract leaving this wound will cause dissatisfaction.
"Sorry, Rozier, it seems that we misunderstood you..." Nott said apologetically, waved his hand and asked everyone to put down their wands.
"Hmph, if it weren't for the situation now, I wouldn't just let it go!" Old Rozier straightened his clothes angrily, the expression on his face was very upset, as if he had been wronged.
When Nott and the others saw the old Rozier's reaction, the vigilance in their hearts was once again put down a bit, and he was removed from the list of suspicions, and then they blamed each other.
Old Rozier secretly breathed a sigh of relief. The wizard's robe behind him was soaked with sweat, and he was even a little lucky that the fatal wound on his waist and abdomen was still there. Otherwise, it would not be easy to fool Nott.
Did he think of today?
Suddenly, an idea flashed in the old Rozier's mind.
He is very suspicious that Ivan Hals used magic to injure himself yesterday, which is not only a punishment for the previous offense, but more importantly, that he can perform a bitter trick to get away under the suspicion!

chapters.title: Chapter 525: Don't do it, everyone is your own!
chapters.content:
The old Rozier, who had seen Ivan’s magic control ability, thought about it, the more he thought it was possible!
Since the opponent can cast his powerful spell while cutting his wand into two with precise predictive actions, it is absolutely impossible to accidentally be injured!
So there must be some deep meaning!
Old Rozier couldn't help taking a breath. He didn't expect that this little wizard was not only powerful, but his mind was also unfathomable. If it weren't for the current situation, he would never have thought of such a meaning.
Just as several pure-blood wizards were arguing with each other, the explosion and wailing outside were getting closer and closer to them.
"Enough, stop arguing. It’s not the time to argue about this. It’s not too late to fight the enemy first!" The chunky witch interrupted the quarrel. Fight yourself first.
Foley and the others stopped, but when they looked at each other, there was still a bit of distrust.
"Go and gather all the remaining wizards in the vicinity, let's kill them from the exit!" Knott swept his eyes to the law enforcement officer who had just entered and said.
Since Aysia chose to attack from three directions, it would necessarily represent a dispersion of combat power. They only need to concentrate their manpower and break through from one direction, and there is still a high probability that they can escape.
The only thing that worries him a little is that their previous argument undoubtedly delayed the best escape time. Fortunately, this underground secret room is very tightly protected. For a while, the opponent should not be able to fight in...
Bang! !
Nott was thinking, a violent impact sounded in front of him.
In the next second, the door of the conference room was directly knocked open, and a tall and thin black wizard flew in directly from the door, and hit the conference table directly.
The seven people present were all taken aback. They raised their wands and pointed at the door nervously. Everyone knew that they could only fight their backs, otherwise they would have to explain it here.
In the dim and narrow passage, there was gradually a chilling commotion, and then a serpentine giant snake rushed in from the door. The hideous snake head was covered with wounds, and its body was covered with pits and pits. trace.
There was a chill in everyone's hearts, but the movements of their hands did not stop, and a series of spells were directly thrown out.
"Confringo (Thunderbolt explosion)!"
"Diffindo! (torn apart
......
One after another, the spell beam hit the giant snake's body, aggravating its injuries.
The giant snake struggled desperately and squeezed into the meeting room, but before he opened his mouth to attack anyone, he was hit by an orange fireball, and his body couldn't bear it and burst out.
The flesh and blood were reduced to pieces of wood, and a large amount of debris was sprinkled from the sky... but it hadn't touched the ground and seemed to be guided by some kind of guidance, and flew towards them.
Then there was an immature voice.
"Oppugno! (Ten Thousand Bullets
Knott and the others did not care to think about why the voice of the comer was like a child, waving their magic wands and using the Iron Armor Curse and Obstacle Curse to resist the second round of attack.
Hundreds of wooden fragments hit the thin magical barrier at a rate of arrow-like speed, sending out a burst of sour screams, but they really couldn't break through this barrier and hurt Nott and others.
However, Ivan's target was not them at all, but the magic lights placed around them. There was no protection on them. They were blown up in a few seconds, and the originally bright meeting room instantly became dark.
At the moment when it was dark all around, Nott screamed in his heart secretly, he already understood what the other party wanted to do.
"Lumos! (Fluorescence blinking Foley's brain not far away didn't turn around for a while, waving his magic wand to use the light curse to illuminate it.
But as soon as the dim fluorescence lighted up from the top of the wand, another crimson beam flew from behind, hitting Foley directly and knocking him out.
"Avery did it! He was an undercover agent!" Old Rozier's voice rang in the darkness.
Relying on memory, everyone present subconsciously launched an attack on Avery's so-called location. The colorful spell beams found Avery's daunting face in the dim meeting room.
"It's not me, it's..." Avery didn't know that he had been cheated by the old Rozier, and immediately wanted to explain. However, before he could finish his words, a bunch of magic spells blasted over, and the iron armor curse was blessed on his body and he broke into pieces in less than a second, and then his body was blown out.
However, Nott soon realized that he had hit the wrong person, because after flying to Avery, the sneak attack from the inside did not stop.
The old Rozier constantly changed the position to release the spell, plus Ivan outside the door, from time to time to cast a few spells, under the attack of the two parties, the minds of the few people who were blocked in the meeting room were already tight. Crazy, they waved their magic wands and attacked everyone except themselves.
"Reducto! (Bone to pieces
"Stupefy! (fainted
......
Various spells were flying in the wide conference room, and the only sane Knott smiled sorrowfully. He knew that he was finished.
If we say that everyone is united to resist foreign enemies, there is still a slight possibility of escape, and the trouble is to this level, it is not bad not to die in the hands of teammates...
"Rozier!" Nott gritted his teeth. Now he can't guess who the betrayer is, but at this time the chaos on the court has risen, and he has nothing to do.
In the chaos, a few tall werewolves rushed in from the door like a tiger into a flock of sheep With their excellent sense of smell, the darkness will not hinder them, but has become The best boost.
So in just ten seconds, the chaotic conference room was much calmer, leaving only the wailing and cursing sounds.
"Reparo! (Restore as before Ivan slowly walked into the meeting room at this time, his wand lightly tapped in the air, and the huge magic power immediately covered the entire meeting room.
Under the action of the repair spell, the magic lamp that fell on the ground slowly floated and returned to its original position, and the pits and holes on the wall that were hit by the spell were slowly repaired.
Before long, the dark conference room became bright again.
Only then did Ivan see the scene clearly. Several pure-blood wizards had been imprisoned by the werewolves. Avery was beaten to death by the allies. The wizard's robe was in tatters and wailed. The strength is gone.
On the other side, Old Rozier was pushing the two werewolves who had bound him, struggling to shout.
"Let go, you made a mistake, everyone is your own! Your own!"

chapters.title: Chapter 526: When I was talking and laughing with the Minister of Magic, you didn’t even know it was...
chapters.content:
The werewolves ignored Old Rozier and turned to look at Ivan. After seeing Ivan nodding in agreement, they let him go.
Old Rozier patted the dust on his body, then bent down and trot all the way to Ivan's side.
"You did a great job, Rozier! It saved me a lot of time..." Ivan patted the old Rozier on the shoulder and said with satisfaction.
He deliberately broke the magic lamp in the conference room, just thinking about the internal and external cooperation to avoid the personnel damage caused by the storm.
Before the release of the magic, Ivan was still a little worried about whether the old Rozier could understand what he meant. He did not expect that the other party did better than he expected. It directly set off a civil turmoil and made the arrest of the werewolves become. A lot easier.
Facing Ivan's praise, the old Rozier didn't mean to take credit at all.
He knows very well that his greatest value is gone now, and his future treatment will depend on the face of the little wizard, so the old Rozier is very humble and said that the smooth success of this operation is due to the guidance of Your Excellency Hals. , I just did what I was told to do.
Just as the old Rozier was flattering, Foley and others, who were tightly bound, yelled.
"Rozier, you **** bastard! Shameful traitor!"
"I knew you were a downright villain. Do you think we're done, they will let you go?"
......
Foley and the others became more and more unpleasant, but the old Rozier had a nonchalant expression. In his opinion, those were the wailing of defeated dogs, and they were totally meaningless.
Nott, who was also tied up, didn't rant like the others. He quietly looked at Ivan's immature face and suddenly asked.
"What about Aisia? If I didn't guess wrong, you should be her child Ivan Hals? She just assured you to do such a dangerous thing and not come to see me in person?"
Although Nott has never seen Ivan, it does not prevent him from guessing the identity of Ivan from his age and the name of the old Rozier.
Ivan turned his head and glanced at Nott, but did not reply.
Old Rozier looked at Nott contemptuously, his ignorance was really funny.
"No, that's not right! Isiah is just a pretense, you are the real messenger behind the scenes!" Nott is not stupid after all, and he quickly realized something from the reaction of the two. He looked at Ivan in amazement, a little unbelievable. Own guess.
But this is obviously the only possibility!
If not, how could the old Rozier behave so humble in front of the opponent, humble like a domestic dog...
You should know that when he mentioned Aisia before, the old Rozier didn't have any obvious reaction.
The transformation of the giant snake just now and the subsequent combination magic are not like those that ordinary wizards can display, even if they use their full strength, they can't do it to that extent.
It can be seen that the strength of the little wizard in front of him exceeds that of his peers, and even higher than many adult wizards!
But even so, letting a thirteen or four-year-old wizard take the lead is still a bit ridiculous.
"You betrayed us just to take refuge in this kid? Did you play with him? Rozier, you really go back alive!" Nott sneered.
Ivan frowned, and he knew that his age would always cause some unnecessary troubles.
But before he could move this time, the loyal old Rozier rushed forward without hesitation and kicked Nott a few feet. He didn't save any energy. One of the kicks directly hit Nott's nose, red. The blood and white nasal mucus came out from his nose together.
"Presumptuous! You dare to insult the great Lord Hals!" Old Rozier kicked a few feet and was not enough to relieve his breath. He would give Nott a heart-piercing spell as soon as he pulled out his wand.
"Enough...Stop it!" Ivan waved his hand and stopped Old Rozier's movements. He still had something to ask. It would be good if Knott was tortured to death.
After the old Rozier stopped, Nott slowly straightened his body, with some blood still remaining on his face, he coughed hard and said sullenly.
"You won, kid! From today onwards, the wizard market in Knockdown Alley is yours. If you are willing to put my nephew back, I can assure you that our Knott family will no longer oppose you..."
Nephew?
Ivan thought of the dead Reese Nott, but he didn't intend to tell the news, but sneered and said.
"Did you make a mistake? Mr. Nott? Now the wizard market is in my hands. Whether you like it or not, is it too late for you to use this as a bargaining chip?"
In the chaotic Knockdown Alley, everyone is doing ugly work, and whoever has the biggest fist always has the final say.
The wizarding market has never been recognized by the Ministry of Magic. It is a semi-illegal underground black market. There is no such thing as land deeds. Whoever owns it belongs to whoever owns it!
So Knott's statement is especially ridiculous to Ivan!
Nott ignored Ivan's ridicule, and said to himself. "Anyway, you dare not kill me, don't you? I can give you whatever you want. We are not enemies, and there is no need to work hard!"
"That's not necessarily true, Mr. Nott! Are you so sure that I won't kill you?" Ivan shook his head, he didn't have the idea of ​​letting the tiger go back to the mountain.
The wizard market in Knockdown Alley has become the biggest black market in the magical world after several generations of hard work. He has taken all of this hard work now, and no one can stand it.
Not to mention that he killed his nephew a few days ago. This enmity is probably the kind that cannot be resolved...
What makes Ivan a little strange is that Nott seems to have an inexplicable confidence that he dare not kill him.
Nott looked up at Ivan, with an arrogant look on his face, and explained.
"I am pure blood, unlike the lowly wizards who were killed by you! If I die, or have been missing for a long time, the Ministry of Magic will definitely launch a corresponding investigation. You don't want to be targeted by the Auror, do you?"
Nott's words made the werewolves next to him very angry, and even the black-robed law enforcement officers who were **** showed a slight dissatisfaction in their eyes, because he was the lowly wizard Nott said.
Perhaps I felt that this was not enough insurance, Knott went on to add. "There is one thing you may not know. I and Pierce, the executive director of the Ministry of Magic, are close friends! You kill me and you are in big trouble!"
"Executive Director?" Ivan raised an eyebrow.
What did he remember, Pierce Sinkenis?
In this way, he really didn't have any impression of the marginal character in the original time and space. He can still remember that it was completely because the first big business of his magic shop was taken care of by the Executive Department of the Ministry of Magic.
Nott saw Ivan's contemplative expression, and his face showed a little joy. What he was most worried about was that the little wizard in front of him wanted to kill himself without knowing what was good or bad, and in the end he was hurt by both sides.
Now that Ivan is willing to consider it carefully, it proves that his life is worry-free.
Nott's mind suddenly became active, as long as he keeps this life, he will always have a chance to recapture what he lost!
But before he could even think about it, Ivan's slightly disappointed words reached his ears.
"In other words, your biggest reliance is the Executive Director of the Ministry of Magic, that's it?"
Hearing Ivan's words, Nott was stunned.
Ivan was rather disappointed and shook his head. He saw Nott so arrogant just now that he almost thought this guy was a relative of the Minister of Magic, but he didn't expect to only know the Executive Director.
As for how good this best friend is, no one knows. Maybe he just met a few times, and after drinking a few cups, it’s not necessarily because of this relationship...
If it is true, I still often chat and laugh with the Minister of Magic, and have correspondence with many high-ranking officials and the Merlin Knights. I don't know where it is, how can I be intimidated by an executive director.
But Nott's words are not unreasonable. It takes a long time to trace a wizard who dies in peaceful times, not to mention the death of the Patriarch of the pure-blooded family.
It would be very troublesome to be targeted by the Auror because of this...
He happens to be someone who is afraid of trouble!
Even so, Ivan will not be subdued under the attention of everyone, otherwise the hearts of the people will be scattered and the team will be difficult to lead.
In particular, Knott just scorned the words of mixed blood and Muggle species, and he was slapped in the face, and Ivan would not let Knot be happy in public or private.
"So your backing is Pierce Sinknis? The current executive director of the Ministry of Magic?" Ivan asked again.
"What do you mean? Do you know Pierce?" Nott frowned. He didn't quite understand what the little wizard in front of him was doing.
"You misunderstood, I haven't met him..." Ivan shook his head, and then continued.
"But when I asked Fudge to be my nominee a few days ago, I happened to hear him complain that Pierce was not doing well recently and couldn't stop the dementor riots, and the Auror under him couldn't even look down on a death row prisoner. Such an executive director makes Fudge very dissatisfied..."
Combining the information he knew, Ivan said half-truths and half-truths.
Seeing Nott's uncertain face, Ivan's mouth couldn't help but evoke a smile, and he knew that he had guessed it right. Pierce may have been troublesome lately, so he kept on speaking.
"Your best friend is too busy to take care of himself now, but he may not take care of you, and he may not work for a dead man..."
Nott's face turned black all of a sudden, which is why he has been at a disadvantage in the dispute with Aysia, but he didn't ask for help.
Moreover, his friendship with Pierce did not reach the level of "best", it was just that he deliberately said it in order to frighten Ivan.
What shocked Nott even more was the information hidden in Ivan's words...
"Do you know Minister of Magic Cornelius Oswald Fudge?" Knott couldn't help but asked.
This is the only one who can complain about the poor performance of the Executive Director, who is also called Fudge!
But Knott really couldn't figure out how such a big man would have an intersection with the 13 or 14-year-old little wizard, and complained about the work of the executive director in front of the other party, so he doubted whether Ivan was fooling himself!
Of course Ivan could see the distrust in Knott's eyes. He shook his head and exclaimed. "I thought you would investigate the information a little bit before dealing with my mother..."
Nott opened his mouth and wanted to refute it, because it was clearly that Asiah did it first, so he just passively counterattacked...
However, Ivan did not give him a chance to speak.
"You don’t seem to know that I recently received a Merlin Medal for my outstanding contribution to the magical world, and my nominees were Albus Dumbledore and Cornelius Oss. Wald Fudge..."
Ivan said casually, and at the same time it was very strange. He remembered that this incident was on the headlines of the Prophet’s Daily, but Knott didn’t even know. Could it be that the other party doesn’t like reading newspapers?
"It's impossible!" Nott looked at Ivan incredulously.
He had collected the information about Aisia, but they were not up to date, so he only knew that the other party had a child with a high potion talent, and he was awarded the second-level Merlin Medal for developing the wolf poison potion.
This is why he was able to call out Ivan's name in the first place.
As for the recent events, Knott, who was struggling to deal with the attacks of Aysia and the werewolves, didn't have much thought to understand.
And he knows very well that Dumbledore and Fudge have had a bad relationship recently, and wanting to be nominated by these two bigwigs at the same time is nothing short of a fantasy!
Seeing Knott's unbelief, Ivan shook his head and lazily explained that he couldn't take out the Merlin Medal to let Knott check the authenticity, and find another newspaper to let Knott take a good look, right?
Ivan didn't intend to take the Merlin Medal with him to show off. These were all false names. If it weren't for the sake of legend, he wouldn't have to spend so much tossing and tossing.
"What he said is true, Nott... the newspaper I read, he arrested Peter Pettigrew, but with this feat he couldn't get the Merlin Medal, Dumbledore and Fudge. I'm afraid the effort is not small..." A middle-aged wizard who was **** next to him suddenly sighed and said.
After getting confirmation from his companion, Knott's face was completely ashamed This situation was worse than he thought.
In other words, the Merlin Medal was forcibly secured by Dumbledore and Minister of Magic Fudge, and Knott really couldn't imagine what kind of people could enjoy such treatment.
Could it be that he is actually a relative of the Minister of Magic? A long-lost bastard? Or a secret member of the Dumbledore family?
Knott just thought about it and broke into a cold sweat. He regarded himself as a life-saving talisman, and the other party probably didn't care at all!
That means that he has lost his last support, and life and death are only between the little wizard's thoughts.
Old Rozier, who was beside Ivan, was also secretly surprised.
He originally thought that Ivan was a reformer who wanted to overthrow the old system, and the road ahead was very difficult, but now it seems that this may not be the case. Maybe it was the secret permission of the Minister of Magic Fudge and Dumbledore...
It’s just that the old Rozier really can’t figure it out. If this is the case, Ivan is more suitable for politics. He should spend twenty years step by step, and successfully become the next Minister of Magic with the support of the two bigwigs, and then carry out reforms. Correct...

chapters.title: Chapter 527: Ivan: Can you surrender? That is obviously greedy for my body...
chapters.content:
Or does it mean that the big guys actually have other plans?
Old Rozier thought secretly, and he became more grateful that he had been on this promising train, otherwise it would be him who was tied to the ground awaiting trial.
"Your Excellency Hals, our Parkinson family is willing to offer your forgiveness for a switch! Please also give us a chance..."
Knowing that the backstage of the little wizard in front of them was harder than they thought, Fiona Parkinson suddenly gave up the unrealistic idea of ​​resistance, and instead struggled to rush to Ivan’s feet, but the two werewolves Stopped her tightly, not letting her pass.
"Parkinson?" Ivan looked at the pudgy middle-aged witch in front of him, thinking about where he had heard of this surname.
"Who is Pansy Parkinson?" Ivan asked suddenly.
"She is my daughter, Lord Hals!" Fiona Parkinson looked excited. She noticed that Ivan seemed to know her daughter, and hurriedly got close. "Do you know her? She is at Slytherin College...in fourth grade next year!"
What a coincidence? Ivan raised his eyebrows, and he didn't expect to catch the mother of the same grade student here.
But that's right. There are only so many pure-blood wizards in the magic world. He has caught six at once, and it is normal to meet a few related people.
Before, Dougte had introduced him one by one the pure-blood wizard who was in charge of Knockdown Alley, but he didn't expect to go here at the time.
After all, Pansy Parkinson was not an important person in the original time and space, and he had no contact with each other when he was at Hogwarts.
Ivan turned his gaze to the tied pure-blood wizards again. If he remembers correctly, there should be an acquaintance's father here.
"Hannah Abbot..." Ivan said while looking at several people.
One of the middle-aged wizards suddenly stood up excitedly, "Hannah is my daughter, do you know her too? But she was at Hufflepuff College, never..."
Abbot almost told the truth, but fortunately he quickly realized something and reluctantly turned the words around. "No, I mean, she often mentioned you to me, saying that you are the best student ever at Hogwarts...her best friend of the opposite sex!"
Hearing this, Ivan rolled his eyes. He and Hannah didn't know each other at all, and they hadn't seen each other a few times. Where's the best friend...
He can remember Hannah-Alber completely because Hannah was the first to sort out the hospital, and he was very impressed by the name that he could often see when he saw her colleagues in the previous life.
When I first read the book, I didn't realize that this little witch is also pure blood...
Ivan called out two names one after another, which undoubtedly caused some misunderstandings.
The pure-blooded wizards who were still struggling to surrender saw their two companions turn to each other, and immediately turned aside their faces, shouting one by one that their nieces or daughters are also going to school at Hogwarts, and said They all admired the most handsome and talented little wizard in the school, and all of them were all hints.
Compared to survival and family continuity, what is morality?
How much gold can this thing be worth?
More importantly, the strength of the little wizard in front of them was obvious to all, and it was a bit abnormal.
Generally speaking, no matter how hard a thirteen or four-year-old little wizard works hard, he only has seven or eight years to learn magic from the moment his magic power bursts, and his strength can never be improved to this level!
Unless this strength is inherited!
As pure-blood wizards, Knott, Ibo, and others know more than mixed-blood and Muggle species. It has been mentioned in many ancient magic books-the blood of wizards is powerful!
It's a pity that this doesn't seem to be reflected in them. Apart from their accumulated wealth and power, they only have some family inheritance magic, other than that, they are no different from other wizards.
Aibo even doubted whether this statement was true or not. After all, when it comes to blood, no one has the nobility of pure-blooded wizards like them!
But the facts are often like this, and the theory of blood inheritance power has been confirmed in the mixed Dumbledore family.
Because Albus Dumbledore, the current principal of Hogwarts, is not the first wizard to have Phoenix help!
According to some records, the ancestors of the Dumbledore family often have powerful wizards who can summon the phoenix, and they have extraordinary talents in some specific magic. This has almost become a proof of the genius members of the family!
Every pure-blood wizard who knows this is both jealous and envious. To some extent, this is more like what a pure-blood family should have.
The appearance of Ivan undoubtedly reminded them of this sentence again, maybe this little wizard is a member of a special family.
Aibo and others are eager to sell their daughters and nieces for this reason.
To put it more bluntly, it is their talent and blood that greedy Ivan...
It doesn’t matter if the guess is wrong anyway, the married daughter will be changed to the husband’s surname, even if the other party is not pure blood, it will not hinder the purity of the family’s blood.
These enthusiastic pure-blood wizards directly confused Ivan, almost thinking that they were on a blind date show.
Obviously you just beat you to death, but now you want to introduce your daughter and niece to yourself one by one. Is there any mistake?
Ivan didn't expect these people to be so shameless to survive...
Funny, could he be this kind of person?
Ivan shook his head secretly...
On the side, McMillan is anxious like an ant on a hot pot. The existing female members of their McMillan family are either too old or married, and there is no suitable object at all.
But watching Aibo and the others one after another, he couldn't help but express himself, McMillan gritted his teeth and tentatively spoke.
"Your Excellency Hals, my nephew Ernie is also at Hogwarts, a little older than you, that's a great young man... if you don't mind..."
"Go!" Ivan glared at McMillan and interrupted his words.
McMillan's face turned pale, and he dared not speak immediately.
Ivan didn't bother to look at him either, his eyes turned to Aibo, Parkinson and others, raised his hand to stop their subsequent words, and said indifferently.
"It seems that you have misunderstood something. I don't know Pansy and Hannah... let alone the witches in your mouth. I only happen to see them a few times... If you plan to beg for mercy by friendship, or forgive me. Got it!"
The meeting room suddenly became very quiet, and Aibo opened his mouth to say something, but in the end he closed his mouth.
However, they were dubious about Ivan's words. If they really didn't know him and didn't have any friendship, the other party didn't need to mention it deliberately, and they still called out the names of two people in a row, specifically asking who were their family members.
Ivan looked at these thoughtful pure-blood wizards with a headache.
He hadn't expected such a situation before he came.
Moreover, in order to ensure the purity of the blood, the pure-blood families often marry each other, and they often affect each other. It is no wonder that Knott did not dare to kill him before. There should be other reasons besides knowing the executive director. .
If you kill them, there will definitely be a lot of unnecessary trouble.
Ivan shook his head in disappointment. It seems that simple and violent methods cannot be used to solve the problem...
Then Ivan stunned again, then his face became ugly, why did he have such thoughts? Relying on killing to solve the problem?
There was a cold sweat on Ivan's forehead. If it hadn't been for killing too many people this time, and now he needed to stop suddenly, the contrast was so obvious that he would not have noticed these subtle changes.
Ivan frowned. If Chino and Horcrux were not counted, he remembered that the first person he killed was a dark wizard under Bok. He killed him instantly with snake eyes!
Since he had witnessed the body of "Asia" at that time, he didn't feel any discomfort. After that, he repeatedly killed several dark wizards without hesitation.
Even if it is supported by hatred, it is really weird...
Is it the effect of snake eyes...or is it because of black magic?
Ivan silently thought that every time he opened the eyes of the snake, he needed to mobilize his killing intent, the stronger the killing intent, the more powerful... and killing is very convenient, he will die with a glance!
The black magic that he learned may also have some influence, otherwise mainstream wizards would not keep it secret, not to mention that his black magic was taught to him by Tom Riddle when he was in the second grade. Who knows what this guy is pregnant. Kind of form...
Although knowing that he might be affected, Ivan has nothing to do. The only thing I can do is to temporarily stop the black magic research and use snake eyes less...
Damn...I have to be a little more peaceful in the future and be a good person...
Bah baah baah... I am a good person!
......
Ivan's changing complexion immediately scared Parkinson, Foley and others. They didn't know what Ivan was thinking, and they all felt that the little wizard in front of them was thinking about how to deal with them!
So when Ivan's face turned gloomy, their hearts were also lifted up, until Ivan's expression returned to calm, they were relieved, but they were still a little uneasy.
"Walker, you take people to lock them up, pay attention, there may be Animagus among them, don't let them run away!" Ivan waved his hand and motioned to the werewolves to take these prisoners back.
He couldn't think of how to treat these prisoners at all now, so he should shut up and think about it slowly.
"Yes, Sir Hals!" Walker nodded, and then led a few wizards to drag them away regardless of the struggle of Nott and others.
Before they left, these pure-blood wizards were still making their final efforts, and Ibo even threatened that their clan would become an affiliated family of the Hals family, but Ivan was unmoved.
Who knows whether these people are true or false, he doesn't believe a word, first catch them and cross-examine them one by one before speaking!
Old Rozier looked at the colleagues who were taken away with a sorrowful expression on his face.
But he also saw that Ivan did not intend to kill these people.
Old Rozier faintly worried that he would be squeezed out by Foley and the others who surrendered in the future. Thinking about it this way, Old Rozier was a little guilty, but from another perspective, if the operation is good, this may not be his own opportunity!
If he joins Ivan's camp alone, I am afraid he will not be taken seriously, plus Foley and others are different!
Old Rozier felt that he could pull up a group of people, so that he could become an indispensable figure in the camp, and his status would be greatly improved!
When Ivan becomes Minister of Magic in the future, he can also get a good position...
While the old Rozier was secretly planning, Ivan was arranging the rest of the work.
"You two tidy up this place, and the others will come with me!" Ivan followed the two wizards to let them stay here, and then summoned the others who rushed over to arrest the remaining resisters in the basement chamber.
Seeing that Ivan was about to leave, the old Rozier immediately ignored the plan, and suddenly became a little anxious. His injury has not yet been cured, and he wonders if Ivan has forgotten something.
However, the old Rozier didn't dare to speak directly to question, so he had to try his best to remind me in a roundabout way, begging Ivanzhi to heal the trauma of his waist, otherwise he would bleed and die...
Wound...what wound? Ivan looked at old Rozier confusedly, and didn't quite understand what he was talking about.
Could it be that he accidentally injured himself when he released the Shenfeng Shadowless Curse yesterday?
Ivan quickly thought of this, and it was indeed possible. After all, it was a spell blessed by enhanced magic texts, and his magic control ability was not enough to control it completely.
For example, when he did it yesterday, he just wanted to intimidate the old Rozier, but he did not expect that the old Rozier's reaction was very quick, and finally he accidentally cut the opponent's wand out of control.
Fortunately, the wand is not expensive, only a few gallons, and he does not intend to pay...
If there is an accidental injury, it should be right at that time!
Thinking of this Ivan put his gaze on Old Rozier's right waist.
As he expected, old Rozier had a piece of gauze tied around his waist, and blood was oozing outward.
No wonder when he met with old Rozier just now, he always felt that the other person's face was too pale...
The only thing that makes Ivan strange is that the old Rozier doesn't seem to mind his accidental injury, on the contrary, he looks very grateful...
I don't know if it was pretended!
Despite the many questions in his heart, Ivan was still ready to apologize. Old Rozier had just made merit, and he would not make the other party dissatisfied because of the so-called facial problems.
However, Old Rozier did not wait for Ivan to speak, and continued with emotion. "This time, thanks to the wound you left on my body, otherwise I'm afraid I will die if you don't come in..."
"At first, I mistakenly thought that this wound was your punishment for my previous offense. I didn't understand until just now... This is clearly to prevent my identity from being exposed!"

chapters.title: Chapter 528: what? Did I think so?
chapters.content:
Yep? what? Did I think so?
Ivan looked dumbfounded and couldn't turn the corner for a while. He didn't expect that his accidental mistake would be misunderstood like this...
Fortunately, his reaction was quick, and he swallowed the original apology abruptly.
At this point, Ivan would certainly not take the initiative to expose the truth. It was a thankless behavior, which would damage his image of being tall in the eyes of everyone, and would make old Rozier feel unhappy.
Therefore, Ivan had to bite the bullet and follow the old Rozier's words to continue speaking.
"Cough...very good, it seems that you understand my intention!" Ivan coughed lightly, spoke slowly, and then continued to play with the spirit, pretending to be dissatisfied.
"But I thought you would be more clever, not to reveal your identity. Most of you don't need this back hand, and I didn't expect to be caught by them."
"I'm sorry, Sir Hals, I have been as careful as possible... It is true that Foley was too wicked and bought my domestic servant. I only became suspicious when I knew that I went out more frequently these days..." Old Rozier explained very upset.
Before, he was a little puzzled that Ivan had such an arrangement, why didn't he just say directly, if he didn't think of this at all, and even had resentment in his heart, wouldn't it be a waste of all this effort?
Only now did the old Rozier realize that it was the other party who thought he was too smart!
And the facts proved that he was obviously unworthy!
Thinking of this, Old Rozier was very ashamed. He only thought of the first and second meanings and secretly delighted in his heart, but he didn't realize that there was actually a third meaning. It seemed that he was not good enough. far away!
Faced with such a brain supplement master, Ivan didn't dare to pretend to be too much, and hurriedly said a few words to comfort him, and even unscrupulously appreciated the wit of old Rozier in the meeting room.
Without prior notice, the old Rozier was able to instantly realize the meaning of turning off the lights, and directly took action to set off the chaos. This performance made Ivan very satisfied.
After a verbal compliment, Ivan took out his magic wand and cast an anti-curse to remove the scars on the waist and abdomen of the old Rozier.
Seeing this scar that had troubled him for a long time gradually healed, the old Rozier was really relieved. In the past two days, he was really worried that he would bleed to death, so that he was not at ease when sleeping.
"Anyway, you did a good job this time. Do you have anything you want?" Ivan looked at the old Rozier and asked casually.
In terms of his experience in watching TV series for many years, the other party just surrendered and made meritorious services. It is always not good not to reward him.
After speaking, Ivan regretted it again, because he found that he didn't seem to have anything to reward him.
Or send a hundred gallons?
Is that too little? Plus one hundred?
Ivan was entangled, and worried that the old Rozier would say some conditions that he could not meet, and that would be embarrassing.
"I want to ask Your Excellency Hals to forgive Foley and the others!" Old Rozier hesitated for a while and said.
"Are you sure?" Ivan was stunned, somewhat surprised.
He remembered that when the old Rozier betrayed the pure-blood wizards before, he was simply very, and now he would actually come to intercede, Ivan really couldn't understand what he was doing.
"Although we usually have some small conflicts, we are old friends for decades after all, so I want to try to persuade them to work for you together, and please give me this opportunity!" Old Rozier looked sad. Expression, said with emotion.
Ivan raised his eyebrows. He didn't believe that the old Rozier was doing this thankless work for the so-called friendship.
Because with his knees, you can think of Foley and others getting rid of the status of prisoners, most of them are looking for the old Rozier, the betrayer, to settle accounts.
However, the handling of these pure-blood wizards caused him a headache, so if the old Rozier could persuade these people to surrender, he wouldn't mind.
The only question is whether the old Rozier can do this, and whether the pure-blood wizards are really willing to submit, instead of pretending to surrender and secretly stumbling.
"Do you know Reese Knott?" Ivan asked suddenly.
Old Roziton took a moment, and didn't quite understand why Ivan said this suddenly, but he hurriedly replied. "Of course I know that he is the nephew of the old Knott, who was taken away by your werewolf wizard in the first battle at the manor two days ago."
"Then how is his relationship with Old Knott?" Ivan asked again.
"Old Knott has no sons. If not surprisingly, Reese Knott will be his successor after he dies!" Old Rozier explained to Ivan.
The Knot family are very few. Several brothers joined the Death Eaters in the last Wizarding War. They either died in the hands of Aurors or squatted in Azkaban. The only member of the existing direct line is Reese. And the old Knott too.
Old Rozier also vaguely reminded Ivan that using Reese to intimidate Old Nott might be a good way.
"Is that so?" Ivan nodded, indicating that he had understood, and then added.
"Reese Knott died two days ago!"
"Dead? How did you die?" Old Rozier asked suspiciously at first, and quickly guessed something. He hurriedly changed his mouth to pretend to be abhorrent and shouted loudly.
"Good death! Reese Nott dared to offend Your Excellency, it is more than deadly!"
Ivan rolled his eyes, he really didn't know what to say to this flatterer.
At the same time, Ivan also keenly noticed that the old Rozier seemed very happy after learning about the death of Reese Knott, but his expression was not so pretentious.
Is there any enmity between them?
Ivan frowned, really couldn't understand.
After guessing that Reese Nott died at the hands of Ivan, the old Rozier was indeed very happy.
Because Nott has a lot of prestige in their small group, if this thing doesn't happen, it is not certain who will listen to Foley, Aibo and others after surrendering.
Old Rozier didn't want to put so much effort into himself, but in the end the results were stolen by others.
Now it's different. Once Reese Nott died, the contradiction between the two sides was almost irreconcilable. Even if Old Nott was willing to compromise, Ivan would always remember this in his heart.
This means that his biggest obstacle no longer exists, how can old Rozier not be happy?
"Your Excellency Hals, Knott is actually very easy to handle, we might as well..." Old Rozier cleared his throat and planned to give Ivan some advice, but before he could finish his words, Esiah was in a hurry. A large group of people came in from outside the door.
Ivan gave the old Rozier a look and told him to talk later.
Old Rozier thought that Ivan didn't want Aysia to know too much, so he nodded and closed his mouth.
Xiaoxiong...That's it, even your relatives must be on guard, he understands!
Ivan secretly breathed a sigh of relief. He knew too little now to make a judgment on the old Rozier's proposal. Who knows if this old boy is cheating himself.
It's better to delay for a while, and it's not too late to make a decision when he learns more from Dougt or Aysia!
"It looks like we were a little late, and the fight is over here..." Aisia looked around, looked at the meeting room that had been restored after the fight, and said with a smile.
"Well, it's easier than I thought..." Ivan spread his hands.
Before coming, he thought it was a Dragon Lake and Tiger Den. It would take some twists and turns to be able to win with difficulty, but he didn't expect to get in all the way without encountering any obstacles.
With that said, Ivan turned his head and looked at the old Rozier again, and exclaimed in front of everyone. "Of course, it was so smooth, thanks to Mr. Rozier's help!"
"Your Excellency Hals praised, I just did some small work in accordance with your instructions." Old Rozier said very flatteringly.
Old Rozier understands from past experience that the fastest way to get promoted is often not a good job, but flattering and flattering!
He knows this truth well, so he is determined to be a capable dogleg!
Ivan didn't pay attention to him at all, looked at Esiah strangely, and asked. "Where's Dougt? He should have come in from the secret road, right? There shouldn't be many guards there. It hasn't been done yet?"
"It's been done a long time ago, he is now guarding the prisoners outside!" Aisia said.
Ivan nodded, and then asked about casualties.
"A total of four people were slightly injured and two were seriously injured. One of the werewolves was caught in the trap and almost died. Fortunately, Dougt rushed over in time to give him some temporary treatment." Aysia explained, and then solemnly. Said. "No one died!"
"That's good!" Ivan felt more relieved.
He said so much before the war, and gave everyone a protective ring in order to reduce casualties as much as possible.
This is not only to save that little pension, but more importantly, he does not want to see those who follow him die...
When the funeral was held for Elfer, Mrs. Grint's eyes are still unforgettable.
As for whether the enemy is alive or dead, Ivan can't control whether a close relative is sad for him. After all, the kindness to the enemy is often cruel to himself.
Since eating this bowl of rice and earning a relatively high salary, we must be prepared for death!
"Rozier, where is the vault in this underground secret room?" Ivan quickly cleared up his emotions and asked expectantly.
He felt that what was built here was like a small fortress, and it was located underground in the wizarding market. There should be a small vault, maybe there would be something good.
"Please also come with me, Sir Hals!" Old Rozier was not surprised by this, he stretched out his hand and said with a bow.
Ivan nodded and walked in the direction pointed by the old Rozier, and after a round of twists and turns, he arrived in a hidden small room.
In the middle of the room hung a large landscape painting, which seemed to be firmly nailed to the wall. Old Rozier walked up quickly, tapped the painting lightly with a magic wand, and read. A string of spells.
The landscape painting opened with a click, and behind it was a hollow secret room, which looked square and square. Inside it was placed a lot of Jin Jialong, Yinxi Ke, and Tong Nath, as well as Some strange-looking magic items.
The werewolf wizards who had never seen the world together with them were dazzled by the glittering golden light.
Ivan was very dissatisfied when he saw this small vault, which is too little!
He raised his wand and waved it in the air. The Jin Jialong, Yinxi Ke and Tong Nath in the vault all flew up, spinning in mid-air, and they were piled together in a regular arrangement.
After a while, Ivan calculated the exact amount.
"Nine thousand six hundred and thirty-seven gallons, eight thousand four hundred and thirteen silver sikes, and thirty-two thousand four bronze nats!"
All converted to Jin Jialong is just over 20,000, which is not in line with his expectations. The wizard market has been running in Knockturn Alley for hundreds of years, and it is impossible to have such a small amount of wealth.
Ivan looked at Old Rozier in surprise, waiting for his answer.
"It's not very safe here recently. Nott and the others are worried about being breached. They have moved most of their wealth back. The rest is to ensure that the wizard market can operate normally." Old Rozier replied to Ivan for the first time. doubt.
Ivan now understands, no wonder only this is left.
"How many Jin Jialong was there before then?" Ivan continued to ask, broodingly.
"About fifty thousand gallons!" Old Rozier hesitated for a moment, and finally said truthfully.
Usually at the end of each year, they will gather together to divide the benefits.
This year, they fell blood mold and were targeted for no reason, and their income plummeted, so they were divided in advance. These were left to hire a large number of wizard guards to ensure the normal operation of the wizard market.
Ivan felt that his heart was bleeding, and 30,000 gallons disappeared all of a sudden! Normal wizards can't make so much money in their lifetime!
After all, he does not intend to kill those pure-blood wizards, and he is not as embarrassed to force them to take out the money, otherwise these pure-blood wizards may be dissatisfied. It seems that the 30,000 gallons will not come back...
On the side, the old Rozier secretly watched Ivan's words and deeds, faintly feeling that the little wizard in front of him seemed to be a money fan.
No, it is impossible!
Old Rozier shook his head and rejected this. He used five hundred gallons to make Ivan perform magic once and was regarded as an insult by the other party. How could such a little wizard be a greedy person.
Now there is only one explanation, that is, the other party is short of money!
And it's a hole that 20,000 Jin Jialong can't fill!
There are not many places to use so much Jin Jialong!
Are you preparing to expand the manpower a lot to deal with the Ministry of Magic?
Old Rozier can only make such a guess, but this does not prevent him from giving birth to some different thoughts.
These pure-blood families are not short of money and are also very good at making investments.
If you can spend tens of thousands of gallons in exchange for Ivan's favor and favor, it is not a loss. As long as this little wizard can take control of the magic world in the future, they can earn it back several times or even dozens of times!
When the Dark Lord emerged, many pure-blood wizards who supported him played with this idea, and even bankrupted their families to make bets, and it was no longer a minority of them who lost their family members...

chapters.title: Chapter 529: We have to use brain patching to defeat the brain patching! (2 in 1)
chapters.content:
High risk often means high returns, and Rozier knows this well.
What's more, Ivan's strength, potential and wisdom are all in his eyes. This is a business that makes a profit without losing money. It is impossible to repeat the same mistakes!
"With these things, let's go back..."
Ivan didn't know the old Rozier's thoughts. After feeling distressed for the disappeared Jin Jialong, he ordered the wizards who came with him to empty out the money and belongings here and prepare to return to the Bojinbok shop.
Before leaving, Ivan deliberately left a few people here for them to stay here temporarily, and by the way repair the damaged walls of tables and chairs.
This underground secret room is very large, with complete supporting facilities, and very secretive. It is very suitable as a backup base!
By the time Ivan returned to the Bogimbok shop with the wizards who had returned with loads of loads, the sky was already dark.
Ivan gave a speech outside the store in high spirits, commending those who fought bravely in the battle.
Every wizard who participated in the battle was very happy, not only because they had just won a big victory, and no one died.
More importantly, Ivan generously gave them a bonus to celebrate this victory, and the wizards who were injured in the battle received additional subsidies.
No matter how much Ivan feels distressed about the cost, there will be no ambiguity about this. They risked death to win this victory and deserve the corresponding reward!
After finishing his speech at Ivan and disbanding the crowd gathered here, Fren walked up quickly and handed over a list and a thick book.
"Your Excellency Hals, this is the list of the prisoners in this battle, and we found a ledger from the financial room!" Fren said.
Ivan nodded, took the two things, and glanced at the list before reading the ledger.
While recording the names and general information of the captured persons, it also recorded the enemies killed in the battle.
Excluding a few pure-blood wizards, there were a total of 29 guards in the wizard market and underground secret rooms. Eleven of them died. The others were arrested or simply surrendered...
"Why have so many people been arrested?" Seeing this, Ivan turned his head to look at Fren, and asked strangely.
Although he hopes to reduce the killings, he also understands that death in such a fierce battle is inevitable, and it shouldn't happen that most of the enemy's personnel are captured.
"Except for the law enforcement officers, the other guards were temporarily recruited by the Wizard Market with money and have no loyalty to the Knot family.
When we went in, some guards didn't even think we could resist, so they dropped their wands and surrendered..." Fren explained.
The corners of Ivan's mouth twitched, and he said that he led a group of untrained wizards into the wizarding market so easily. No one died. It turned out that the enemy was even more useless...
"Your Excellency Hals, what do these prisoners do? They seem to want to take refuge in us..." Fren asked hesitantly.
Ivan hesitated, preparing to use the Forgetting Curse to wash away the memories of these people for a while, and then let them go.
After all, he doesn't need so many manpower, and it's hard to get rid of them all, let alone stay in jail and eat plain rice!
However, Ivan quickly rejected this idea. Most of the captured prisoners were dark wizards from Knockout Alley. When the Knot family recruited people, they would not necessarily be screened like Esiah.
This means that among those people, there may be extremely vicious thugs, and if they are let out like this, they will disrupt the public order of Knockturn Alley, and they will need to be managed by themselves at that time.
"Be detained first, and send someone to see if they don't let people run away. I will cross-examine them one by one. I need to know all their details and use Veritaserum if necessary!" Ivan said to Fren.
He decided to check. Those thugs didn't need to be alive anymore. Others would consider whether to let them go according to the situation.
"By the way, those pure-blood wizards remember to find another place to imprison them, especially that Knott needs to be locked up alone, understand?" Ivan suddenly remembered the old Rozier's proposal and added.
"Yes, Sir Hals!" Furen bowed slightly.
"Close those prisoners, you call Dougt again, I have something to ask him!" Ivan waved his hand to indicate that Fren can leave.
Fren nodded and nodded, after asking some precautions, he turned and left as instructed.
Ivan put down the list, walked into the inner room of the Bogimbok shop, sat by the stove, checked the ledger of the wizard market, and after a cursory glance at it several times, he couldn't help but take a breath. .
"A year of profit of seven hundred thousand gallons?" Ivan looked at the record on the ledger and wondered if there was an extra zero on it.
Because no matter how you look at it, the wizarding market doesn't look like it can make so much money.
Knockdown Alley is too poor to find so much oil!
However, after Ivan took a closer look, he discovered that the real profit of the wizarding market is smuggling and buying and selling all kinds of contraband!
The scope of business is the entire European magic world!
"No wonder you can make so much...it turned out to be doing these businesses!" Ivan muttered to himself.
He also found that this ledger was incomplete, and a lot of money was not directly written out of the source. It is likely that some of the more serious black income was not recorded.
Even so, the things recorded in the ledger alone would be enough for Foley, Knott and others to stay in Azkaban for a lifetime.
Of course, under normal circumstances, even if the wizard market is checked by the Auror of the Ministry of Magic, it doesn't matter. These pure-blood families still have a layer of white gloves that can be exonerated.
They did not directly manage the wizarding market before, but used an agent to remotely control it behind the scenes. The ledger did not record anything that was unfavorable to them. In a sense, it was “clean”!
Coupled with their influence and network in the magic world, it is impossible to squat in Azkaban. It is estimated that the agent will be pushed out to stand trial, and another sum of money will be exonerated.
Ivan shook his head and sighed. It seems that no matter whether it is the Muggle world or the wizarding world, some things are always so similar.
Those pure-blooded wizards who are superficial gentlemen may be doing some shameful deeds secretly, but you can't help them because they are the best at exploiting the loopholes of the law...
"No, my 500,000 gallons became 50,000!" Ivan suddenly realized that the old Rozier **** might have lied to himself. The wizard market is so profitable, even if it only operates for half a year this year. , More than fifty thousand gallons!
But when he turned to the last few pages of the account angrily, he was dumbfounded. The amount shown on the account was really only so much.
In the first half of this year, due to the impact of this small war, they did not make a few big business at all, and the income of the wizard market naturally dropped sharply.
Even the evil agent was killed by Esiah. If it weren't for this, these pure-blood wizard families wouldn't have to end up personally.
Fortunately, the general plate of the wizarding market is still there. As long as it is reorganized and continues to operate, it will not be long before the previous income can be restored.
With half a million gallons a year, from today onwards he is considered a rich man in the magical world...
Ivan was a little bit happy thinking about it!
However, realizing that this is all gray income, Ivan hesitated a bit. He considered himself a good law-abiding wizard. Although sometimes forced to cross the line "a little" because of helplessness, this did not prevent him from being a good person!
Ivan flipped through the ledger, and finally merged. He felt that it was necessary to carry out certain rectifications on the business of the wizard market, and stopped doing some dirty work that was too bad!
As an alternative, he can use the wizard market to sell the alchemy items and potions he has produced to the whole of Europe. In that case, his income will not decrease, but may increase a lot!
As for part of the smuggling work, he still has to do it. This may help him get some rare and magical creatures so that he can get blood!
For example, five years ago, the wizard market bought a baby bird and snake, and finally sold it to an anonymous old witch. The specific price was not recorded on the book, and it would not be cheap if it wanted to...
It is worth mentioning that the dementors bought by the Doug Tetor were also obtained from the Wizarding Market. He can successfully train into the guardian of the gods, and I really want to thank the black market.
Click...
While Ivan was thinking about it, the door of the Bogembock store was opened, but Dougt came in from the outside.
"Little Ivan, I just heard Fren say that you are looking for me?" Doug said with a smile. Even though Ivan's current identity is different, he still wants to maintain this close relationship in private.
"Well, I have something I want to ask..." Ivan threw the ledger aside and asked. "How much do you know about those wizard families?"
Dougt was stunned for a moment, and then he explained to Ivan in detail.
He has a very wide network of contacts in the magic world. He has also investigated these wizard families because of conflicts with the wizard market, so he has a very detailed understanding.
The first is the leader of the Knot family, Dougte suspects that they have a tendency to extreme pure bloodism.
Because several of the older Knott’s brothers and sisters joined the Death Eaters camp more than ten years ago, and they have a good relationship with another Black family who admires pure blood.
Not long after Voldemort's debut, the old Knott also funded Voldemort some funds.
In the end, it is natural that there is no need to say more, it is completely a loss-making business, which directly caused the Knot family, which was originally very prestigious in the magic world, to suddenly weaken.
After the death of Reese Knott, only the old Knott was left among the direct members of the family.
"In short, the Knott family are the real managers behind the wizarding market, occupying at least half of the share, and the old Knott is also the most involved in daily operations!"
Dougte explained to Ivan, and after talking about the Knot family, he then took out the details of the three pure-blood families of Foley, Rozier, and Roll.
These families are not big or small. In addition to the wizarding market, they also have their own businesses. They have a certain influence in the magic world. They are relatively neutral families and rarely get involved in disputes.
According to Dougert, they remain neutral and just want to stand on the side of the winner!
The Parkinson family has a certain pure-blood tendency and relatively conservative. They usually bet on both sides. They once supported Voldemort's pure-blood policy, but did not contribute money, so Voldemort did not lose much when he fell.
"The Abbot family is slightly different. They are pure blood, but they are closer to Muggles. I heard that they have invested in the Muggle industry in London. Well... I heard that the Broken Cauldron Bar is somewhat related to the Abbot family! "
Dougte shook everything he knew, then commented. "It's a relatively law-abiding family!"
"Are you sure!" Ivan tapped the ledger on the table with his hand.
If this is the case, why should they become one of the founding families of the Wizarding Market, where they are doing gray and even illegal businesses.
"I mean, at least in recent generations, people have this tendency!" Dougt shrugged.
The wizarding market was established a long time ago, and the concept of the family may change with each generation.
The Abbot family is more law-abiding, but they are not stupid. Why don't they make money when they are rich?
Anyway, there are agents who will not dirty their hands. They just open one eye and close the other to get dividends every year...
Hearing what Doug said said, Ivan suddenly became clear, and he no longer knew nothing about these six pure-blood wizard families.
It's just that he still didn't understand what Old Rozier wanted to do. Ivan looked at Dougte and said suddenly. "Rozier just wanted to plead with Foley and the others... begging me to let them go! Except for the old Knott..."
"Rozier?" Dougt raised his eyebrows, thought for a while, and then sneered. "He must be thinking of pulling up a group of people to improve his status!"
Speaking of this, Dougte is also a little impatient, the resources and money owned by the five pure-blood families should not be underestimated!
If Rozier really persuades them to join the camp and become the new leader, then the importance of this guy will soar, and the status may catch up with him, which is not good!
Ivan lightly tapped on the desktop but he was secretly gratifying. He had realized the way to deal with brain patching, that is, using one brain patching to deal with another brain patching!
As long as there are enough brain supplements, conflicts with each other, no collusion of intelligence with each other, and a smarter questioning, he will immediately know what these people are supplementing.
It would not reappear the embarrassing scene of doing nothing before, but someone ran to him to claim credit, saying that the last arrangement had been done.
He has experienced this kind of things a lot, no matter how good his acting skills are, one day he will wear help...
Thinking like this, Ivan was somewhat difficult to judge whether he wanted to agree to Old Rozier's plea, so he looked at Dougte again and asked.
"Do you think old Rozier has this ability?"
