chapters.title: Chapter 530: Contemplation!
chapters.content:
Listening to Ivan's words, Dougt was very disappointed.
Since Ivan asked this, it proved that he really wanted to surrender those pure-blood wizards, and it was basically inevitable for Rozier and others to form an alliance.
At this point, it is hard for Dougt to express his objection clearly.
Because this is not all bad. With the help of these pure-blood wizards, many things will be easier in the future, so Dougte said after thinking about it for a while.
"Rozier must have this ability. If you agree to his plea, he can use this as a bargaining chip in front of the pure-blood wizards to alleviate the previous conflicts.
If he was smarter, it would not be impossible to persuade the captured pure-blood wizards to surrender and pull up a faction. As for he wants to get rid of the old Knott? That may be because Nott has a certain prestige among those pure-blood wizards, which will become an obstacle to him. "
Dougt talked freely and guessed Rozier's thoughts seven or eighty eight.
Having said that, Dougt hesitated for a moment, and then continued to make suggestions. "No matter how Rozier is a rebel after all, he may not be able to convince the crowd! You can put a nail in them so that these people will be under your control at any time."
Ivan nodded, as Doug said, some precautions are still needed.
Especially Rozier and those pure-blood wizards have just joined in, and they were enemies before. If they collude with each other and do something secretly, it won't be good.
Ivan, who has seen many tactical dramas in his previous life, is also very aware of the importance of checks and balances.
However, Ivan did not agree to Dougert's proposal on the spot, and instead asked Dougert's views on the old Knott and how to deal with the old Knott's problems.
Ivan let this guy leave after Dougt answered one by one. He needs someone to think about it.
Although he didn't get an accurate answer from Ivan, Dougt looked happy when he left. He knew very well that Ivan should have approved his proposal, and his original urgency was immediately relieved.
As long as the pure-blood wizards cannot truly unite, Rozier's threat to his status will be greatly reduced.
"It's really hard for me!" Ivan muttered to himself with a headache when Dougt left the room.
He has never been very interested in things like managing his subordinates and conspiracy struggles, and he is completely half-hearted, relying on a few words in the book to act.
So that every time I sit on the main seat and arrange things, I am afraid of saying something wrong.
If the system can quantify favorability and loyalty, let him know who is loyal and who is plotting bad luck.
It doesn't help to let yourself know what everyone is thinking...
Ivan thought very greedily, and yelled a few words in his heart, but the system ignored his meaning.
Fortunately, Ivan soon realized another substitute, the magic that is comparable to mind-reading-dementia!
As long as you learn this, you can easily see through other people's thoughts and thoughts. In Ivan's eyes, it is simply a curse that the upper class must learn, and a cheat tool for managing complex interpersonal relationships!
Of course, Sensational Mind is not without its weaknesses. Under normal circumstances, only the superficial thoughts of the other party can be read. If you dig deeper into the memory, it is easy to be noticed by the person involved.
And there is a corresponding defense method, that is Occlumency!
Ivan is deeply impressed by the fact that Occlumency can not only lay a protective layer in the depths of the soul to resist the invasion of dementia, but also create some false memories to confuse the opponent.
Relying on the superb occlusion technique, the original space-time Risnep jumped repeatedly in front of the two masters of the mind and mind, and became a double-sided undercover agent!
This proves that if a person is too superstitious about the intelligence obtained by the mind, then when he meets a master of Occlumency, he will be miserable!
However, there are not many wizards in the British magical world who can master these two kinds of magic, and it is likely that they need some talents.
Otherwise, such a practical magic would not be available to so few people, so there is no need to worry about rollovers when dealing with ordinary wizards.
Thinking of this, Ivan left the Bojinbok store without hesitation and went straight to his library.
Since the last time I moved all the books in the Bojinbok Magic Shop, the amount of books here has been comparable to that of some pure-blood family library.
It took more than an hour before Ivan picked up a few books about Sensationalism from the vast pile of books, and then sat in the pile of books and read them one by one.
It was like returning to the days of hard study. For three days in a row, besides eating and sleeping, and meeting with Rozier on the way, Ivan agreed to his request. The rest of the time was devoted to the study of Sensation. on.
This kind of magic to pry into the hearts of others is much more difficult than the practice of Occlumency!
There are a lot of high-end knowledge involved, and the relevant books are basically compiled by old antiques hundreds of years ago, and they are not professionally cut and refined like textbooks. As a result, there is a lot of nonsense, and it is very esoteric and difficult to understand!
Maybe those old antiques think it is more high-end to put things in a more convoluted way?
Ivan really didn't understand it, but waited for the book "Cathensing Mind-The Magic of Prying the Mind!" in his hand! 》Close, and the system prompt sounds.
[Ding, after a period of careful reading, the proficiency of Sensation Mind increased slightly. 】
[Scenery has been upgraded to level 1, the current proficiency (1200). 】
Ivan glanced at the extra spells in the magic bar. According to the usual practice, upgrading to one level meant that he could use this kind of magic initially, but the degree of mastery was not high.
The ability to achieve this within three days is largely due to his superb Occlumency level. These two magics have many similarities, both of which are related to memory and mind.
The difference is that one is for yourself and the other is for others!
However, it is not so easy for such a special magic to continue to improve. Just reading the book has little effect, and it takes a lot of practice!
Ivan eagerly put down the books in his hand, ready to try this magical effect. When he turned his head, he saw a thin mouse sneaking through the library.
Squeak...
This black-haired mouse was very keenly aware of Ivan's gaze, and its hair exploded, and it quickly turned around to try to escape.
"The mouse is coming!" Ivan slowly drew out his wand and tapped it in the air.
The fleeing black mouse soon discovered that he was running and suddenly flying up, and then the surrounding scenes quickly moved backwards.
It uttered a harsh scream, and its limbs were constantly scratching in mid-air, but it didn't help. After a while, a big face appeared in front of it.
Ivan maintained the magical power and suspended the mouse in mid-air. In order to avoid being infected with germs, he did not touch it with his hands. He slowly rotated its body with magical power, maintaining the attitude of looking at him.
Contemplation!
Ivan stared at the mouse with his eyes and activated the magic, and slowly some messy emotions surfaced in Ivan's mind.
Fear, nervousness, fear, loss...
Although these Ivans can be analyzed from the mouse's curled and trembling body, this time is different, as if he truly felt the emotions of the other party.
"Legilimency! (Legilimency
Ivan chanted the spell directly, increasing the intensity of the magic, and these emotions became clearer.
Unfortunately, it was limited to this. He couldn't directly see what the mouse was thinking through his eyes, nor could he browse the other party's memory.
Ivan didn't know if it was related to the person he chose, or because of his insufficient level.
To confirm this, Ivan tried to wave his wand and shouted again.
"Legilimency! (Legilimency
The moment Ivan chanted the spell again, the black mouse's eyes widened suddenly, his eyes became extremely dull, and some incoherent memory fragments appeared in Ivan's mind.
No, he even felt like he had become the mouse, coming out of a dark, damp hole, hungry in his stomach, he crawled out to look for food...
Ivan staggered suddenly and bumped into the cabinet behind. The magic was interrupted immediately, only some memories remained.
Ivan pressed his forehead, a little strange. According to the book's record, the general sensational mind is to look at a memory from the perspective of a bystander, which has minimal impact on himself, not like himself.
Is it because you are very talented?
Ivan thinks so, that the mind-sensing mind possesses the ability to perceive emotions and detect memory. When the two are mixed together, they can obtain information from the perspective of the subjective in the scene of memory construction.
But this is not a good thing. If the memory you explore is too frequent, it can easily affect your emotions. If you have poor willpower, you may not be able to tell which memory is yours.
Ivan sighed, and the magic of dementia might be more difficult to control than he thought.
What also made him disappointed was that from the test just now, when the level of Sensation Mind was not high, he had to use a magic wand and chant a spell if he wanted to explore the opponent's thoughts and memories!
This is completely different from what he expected to be able to know what the other party is thinking at a glance...
But it was also right. He remembered that in the original time and space, Voldemort and Dumbledore were the only two people who could really use the mind of the mind at will.
A novice like him is far from able to do this.
Ivan shook his head, and it seemed that he couldn't rely on it to judge what Rozier and the others were thinking before the contemplation was achieved.
He doesn't want to wave his magic wand and recite spells at them openly, right?
That's stupid!
No wizard would want his thoughts to be spied on, and all his secrets would be exposed to others. Even Voldemort's use of panic on his subordinates would not be noticed, lest the other party would be dissatisfied.
The only thing Ivan was grateful for was that they captured a lot of prisoners when they captured the wizarding market. After torture, a few of them were extremely wicked people, just enough for him to practice his new magic!
......
In the evening, in the basement of the Bokimbock store, Old Rozier, led by two werewolf wizards, walked deeper.
In the past few days, in order to meet the needs, the basement here has been remodeled and turned into a temporary prison for more than 20 prisoners.
And important pure-blood wizards such as Parkinson and Abbot are imprisoned in the deepest part of the basement.
One of the werewolf wizards led Old Rozier to a converted storage room, and then opened the door lock, while the other werewolf wizard said to the old Rozier.
"They're locked here, go in!"
"Yeah! Two hard work! Thanks to two friends who took care of me during this time..."
Old Rozier smiled and said a few words, and then took out a small bag from his pocket, covered it with his sleeve, and continued speaking in a low voice. "I want to talk to a few old friends alone. I don't know if it can be convenient, it will be fine in a while!"
"We must listen!" The werewolf wizard did not take it, but looked at him coldly, unmoved.
They are living well now, and they are very grateful to Ivan, but they will not violate orders for some money.
If Fren knew about the money they received, they would be severely punished, or kicked out.
Old Rozier's face twitched. He didn't expect these werewolf wizards to refuse him so stiffly. Didn't they mean that werewolves and poor ghosts are very greedy for money?
"Ah...you may have misunderstood what I mean. Your Excellency Hals asked me to persuade me to surrender. From now on, everyone will be your own. If you go in, it may affect my work!"
Old Rozier consoled with all his heart, and did not dare to say too sharp words. After all, it hadn't been long since he had just returned, and there was no team under his hand, so he couldn't get tough.
However, no matter what Old Rozier said, the two werewolf wizards didn't mean to let go, they were very determined!
"Rozier You traitor still has the face to come to see us!"
Just when the old Rozier was going to continue to persuade, a sharp female voice came out from the storage room.
The soundproofing here is only average, and the voice of Old Rozier talking with the werewolf wizard outside the door can be heard clearly.
Old Rozier shrugged helplessly, and no longer persuaded the two werewolves, but opened the door of the storage room, walked in, and explained.
"Don't say that, Fiona, you know I'm here to help you!"
Under the gaze of the old Rozier, Fiona and others were shackled to restrict magic. Although they did not seem to be tortured, they looked a little wilting.
For those pure-blood wizards who are used to living a good life, it’s not very pleasant to be a prisoner...
Fiona Parkinson and Foley looked at Old Rozier with hatred. If it weren't for the other's betrayal, they wouldn't have fallen to this point.

chapters.title: Chapter 531: His mighty power is simply unimaginable!
chapters.content:
For unknown reasons, Sogou suddenly couldn't search this site today. Please remember the domain name of this site (Shuhaige Quanpin) to find your way home! You can search for "Hogwarts Blood Wizard ( in Baidu to find the latest chapter!
Listening to Old Rozier's words, Abbott could not help but sneered. "You look so disgusting! Come to help us? Are you here to help us go to hell?"
"Rozier, you despicable traitor!" Foley was struggling with excitement, his eyes were red, and if his hands and feet were not bound, he would like to rush to tear the old Rozier to pieces.
"I was really blind at the beginning, because we believe in you so much..." Parkinson also said viciously.
In the small storage room, various swearing sounds soon sounded, and the more swearing, the more unpleasant. Old Rozier just smiled without any reaction, as if the person being reprimanded was not himself.
It wasn't until these people got tired of cursing and slowly stopped, that Old Rozier put away the expression on his face, replaced it with a depressed look, and sighed.
"Oh...you really misunderstood me! Everyone is old friends for decades, and I really want to help you!"
"In order to save your lives, for these three days, I have worked so hard to plead with Your Excellency Hals to let you make a living. I didn't expect that you would look at me like this!" Old Rozier shook his head sighfully.
The people of Aibo were imprisoned here for three days, and they didn't wait until anyone came to see them. They had no hope of living, but now they are a little excited to hear what Old Rozier said.
The only person who came to inform them was the old Rozier, who was regarded as a traitor, which made Aibo and the others really unhappy.
In particular, the other party also appeared here as a savior, which made them feel even more awkward.
If it hadn't been for this **** to whisper the news before, they wouldn't have been arrested even if they were lost. Now that the culprit has worked so hard to beg for them, he wants them to be grateful?
What a joke!
Because their lives are still in the hands of the other party, Aibo and others looked at Old Rozier with such a sneer without words, but Fiona Parkinson couldn’t bear it. This short and fat witch quickly sneered. Said.
"Don't be pretentious here, Rozier! If you still care about a little friendship, you won't betray us, and now you come to surrender us, you are only trying to please your little master!"
"I really didn't expect that you betrayed us just to take refuge in a 13-year-old kid. Are you planning to play with him?" Foley also sneered and said.
Old Rozier's complexion suddenly changed, and a face was pulled down directly, he looked at the two of them, and said coldly. "Fiona, Foley...I advise you to think through your head when you speak! The consequences of insulting Your Excellency Hals are not something you can bear..."
"Insult? Rozier, you are really a good dog. You have maintained your new owner so quickly... but you're just a kid. What if I insulted him..." Foley is very vicious Speaking.
However, before he could finish speaking, Old Rozier directly drew out his wand, pointed it at Foley, and cast a spell without hesitation.
"! (heart-cutting bones
"Ahhhh~!"
The pain that went deep into the bone marrow immediately interrupted Foley's words, and he fell to the ground with painful head, rolling hard, with a harsh scream in his mouth.
"Rozier, what are you doing? Stop it! Do you want to kill Foley?" Fiona, Aibo and others never thought that the old Rozier would suddenly attack him and panicked for a while. .
Old Rozier ignored them and insisted on maintaining the magic for thirty seconds. Foley stopped his hand when he was about to pass out, then turned his head and apologized to the two werewolves behind him.
"I'm sorry, two, this friend of mine offended Your Excellency Hals just now without a word, but I have already punished him..."
"We will report everything that happens here!" The werewolf wizard said indifferently.
Old Rozier shrugged helplessly, he could only hope that Ivan would not care too much about this matter, otherwise Foley was afraid that he would suffer.
When looking at Aibo and the others, the old Rozier changed his amiable appearance and spoke with disdain.
"It seems that you haven't figured out your identities. You don't want to kill you, just because of the kindness of Your Excellency Hals! I advise you not to regard yourself as important..."
Folly, who was tortured by the Drilling Curse, curled up and fell to the ground. After a long while, the pure-blood wizards didn't reply again, for fear that he would follow in his footsteps.
More importantly, they are not stupid. You can see some clues from the old Rozier interceding with the guards for Foley. The curse might not be punishment but it might be kidding...
Thinking about it this way, Aibo and others felt a chill in their hearts.
"Rozier, that little wizard... I mean, what kind of person is your Lord Hals? You want to persuade us to surrender. You have to let us know?" Fiona Parkinson asked suddenly Tao.
"What should I say?" Old Rozier frowned, hesitated and sighed. "I can't see through...unfathomable!"
"Can't see through?" Aibo looked at Rozier unexpectedly, it is hard to imagine that he would make such an evaluation of a little wizard.
"Yes... I can't see through!" Old Rozier said with certainty. "But I will tell you what I know, you can judge for yourself!"
"Just five days ago, after the wizards we sent to capture Walker lost the news, Dougt suddenly found me and wanted to persuade me to submit to them... Then I realized that Aysia was just a cover, we The real opponent is someone else!"
Old Rozier slowly explained in detail the experience of his first meeting with Ivan, including the temptation he did to find out Ivan's strength and did not conceal it.
Old Rozier knew that these people must be made to understand what they were facing before they could put down their arrogance as a pure-blood wizard and recognize reality.
Therefore, in the process of telling the experience, they even exaggerated the scene "slightly" so that these people know that they are not greedy for life and fear of death but worship the other side's mighty power!
When he heard that Old Rozier talked about Ivan’s release of Shenfeng Wuying, he cut everything in his field of vision into two pieces, including a dozen trees, an abandoned house, and hundreds of Jin Jialong. , Abbot couldn't help but ask.
"That magic is really as powerful as you said?"
This is too exaggerated!
Fiona Parkinson is also dubious.
Old Rozier nodded with emotion and confirmed.
"Yes! I saw Your Excellency Hals neatly cut an old abandoned house into two. It is definitely the most powerful magic I have ever seen!"

chapters.title: Chapter 532: Is there any misunderstanding in this? (2 in 1)
chapters.content:
()You can search for "Hogwarts Blood Wizard( in Baidu to find the latest chapter!
"Such a powerful magical Lord Hals can control it freely, and even cut off the wand I hold with precision. Such a powerful force is simply unimaginable!"
As the old Rozier added, he took a broken wand and dozens of Jin Jialong cut in half from the pocket of the wizard's robe and scattered them on the ground.
These are the proof!
Abbot stretched out his hand and picked up a section of the wand and looked at it carefully, and found that the cut of the wand was flat and a little scary, even if it was cut with a high-speed sharp blade, it might not be possible to do so.
Fiona Parkinson and others picked up a few Jin Jialong and checked them.
Old Rozier also specially used the restoration spell to demonstrate to them that once the Shenfeng Shadowless Curse was hit, it would not be able to rely on normal means to heal and repair it.
Seeing this, Aibo's face changed, and he couldn't help being speechless. "This is a new unforgivable curse?"
"No, it has an anti-curse!" Old Rozier shook his head, "Remember the wound I showed you before? Your Excellency Hals used the anti-curse to eliminate its influence!"
Everyone present fell silent for a while. The evidence provided by Old Rozier undoubtedly proved the authenticity of his words. Ivan Hals may be far more powerful than they thought.
If it weren't for such a thirteenth or fourteenth kid, it would be impossible to dominate so many wizards, and made old Rozier fear to such a degree.
Old Rozier saw that Aibo and others no longer spoke to refute, so he continued to speak comfortingly while the iron was hot.
"So my old friends, I just made the right choice, not to betray you! Because we have no chance of victory from beginning to end... It's just that I know more, and I realized it first. , That's all!"
Fiona Parkinson opened her mouth and wanted to refute, but she didn't know where to start. In the comparison of power, they had obviously lost a mess, and they had no advantage in the power they were proud of.
After all, Ivan is closely related to the Minister of Magic and Albus Dumbledore, the strongest white wizard in England. In contrast, their relationship network is not on the table.
Aibo and others are also depressed,
Old Rozier laughed at this moment, reminding him. "If you are willing to think about it from another angle, this may not be a bad thing, but it may be a chance!"
"Your Excellency Hals' ambition is by no means limited to a small Knockdown Alley, but intends to encroach on the entire magic world!
"Think about it, my friends! If Hals succeeds in taking control of the magic world, how much benefit will we get! Maybe you and I will be the next executive director, council president, and presiding judge!"
"Although we are also pure blood, we are not as good as those top pure blood families. Compared with those of mixed blood and Muggle species, there is not much advantage at all. Are you willing to watch your family weaken after a few generations?"
"This is the best time. If we miss it, we won't have a chance to stand up again!"
The old Rozier impassionedly portrayed the bright future for Abe and the others. As a pure blood, he knew very well what his old friends wanted.
The four pure-blood wizards present hesitated after hearing this.
As the old Rozier said, they are not the top pure-blood family. It is embarrassing that the high is not good, but everyone wants to go further if there is a chance!
"It may not be as good as you said? Rozier! What does it have to do with us even if the Lord Hals is in charge of the magical world? How much status can I have as a loser even if I surrender in the past?" Fiona-Pa Jin Sen questioned it.
Aibo and others are also aware of this problem. The biggest reliance of these pure-blood families is nothing more than their own huge network of relationships, but the other party may not be able to see it.
If they can't make enough achievements, even if the opponent succeeds in taking control of the magic world, they won't get much benefit!
"No, you are wrong, Fiona! Your Excellency Hals is lacking something you and I both have!" Old Rozier said mysteriously.
"You mean Jin Jialong?" Foley, who had been silent on the ground, straightened up weakly and suddenly said.
"Yes! It's Jin Jialong!" Old Rozier nodded, "Whether it is hiring people or developing forces can't do without this. Your Excellency is just short of sufficient funds now, this is our opportunity!"
Hearing this, Fiona and others were a little moved, but Ibo hesitated. After all, this is a matter of life and death for the family. If you accidentally stand on the wrong team, it will be over.
Old Rozier naturally saw their concerns and said with a sneer.
"Don’t you think you have a choice? Don’t be mistaken, you need to take concrete actions to get the understanding of Your Excellency Hals... Otherwise, you will have only one end, and that is to be executed and discarded. In the corpses of Knockdown Alley!"
"There are many rich and capable wizards in the magic world. There are countless people who can take your place at any time. Think about it. You only have one chance to choose!"
Old Rozier did not speak in harmony, but presented the facts in front of everyone with almost cruel words.
He looked around at the crowd, and after waiting for about fifteen minutes, he slowly pulled out the newly purchased wand and pointed at the few people in front of him.
"I think these events are enough for you to think clearly, don't you? Tell me now, your decision!" Old Rozier asked word by word.
Fiona and Abbot looked at each other, and after a second of silence, they said with a wry smile.
"You won, Rozier, we surrender!"
The front is probably heaven, and the back must be hell. A normal person knows how to choose!
"That's right, my friends! I believe you will definitely be very grateful for today's choice in the past few years!"
Old Rozier laughed and put down his wand, walked forward and hugged Fiona, Ibo, and Roll before finally walking towards Foley.
Although Foley was worried about what old Rozier had just tortured him, he understood the current situation and had to abandon his previous suspicions and hug the old Rozier to show his friendship.
"By the way, Rozier, where's Knott? How is he?" Foley hesitated for a while after letting go of the old Rozier, and asked strangely.
They haven't seen Knott's shadow in the past few days in detention, and Foley doubted whether Knott is dead.
"He is still alive and can't die for the time being, but it's no different from being dead! To blame, he can only blame his nephew for offending Your Excellency Hals indefinitely!" Old Rozier said with a sneer.
He did not hide it, and directly told the inside story he had heard from other wizards these days, and said that Reese Knott became an Animagus in the form of a brown bear in the conference room. He had bad intentions and was finally killed. Ivan, who had become a giant, was pinched in his hands.
"According to their description, the giant Hals turned into is probably forty feet tall. It is as easy as squeezing an ant for him to squeeze Res Knot to death!"
"However, the benevolent Lord Hals didn't let Reese Nott experience the sensation of crushing bones all over his body. Instead, he used an unknown magic, and a snap of his fingers instantly deprived Reese Nott’s. Life." Old Rozier added.
When Fiona heard this, they were secretly shocked, but they couldn’t believe it. Not to mention the weird magic of killing with a finger, it’s strange enough to transform a little wizard into a giant more than ten meters high. Up.
The only related magic they can think of is Animagus Transfiguration, but Animagus’s inability to transform magical creatures is a well-known consensus in the entire magical world!
"Nothing is impossible! Remember how those law enforcement officers reported to us two years ago?" Old Rozier reminded.
"You mean that special patron saint in the form of a unicorn? But isn't that Doug's magic?" Abbot frowned.
"Dougt? Huh, he's just a guise! If he could have such magic, do you think he would use it in the previous battle? Two years ago, Lord Hals secretly saved his life!" Old Rozier curled his lips and explained.
"Two years ago? How old was he then?" Fiona said in a speechless voice.
Judging from Ivan's immature face, it is likely that he is the same age as his own daughter, which means that Ivan was only eleven years old two years ago, and he has mastered such a powerful magic, it is hard to imagine!
More importantly, a little wizard is superb but not arrogant, and cleverly hides himself in the dark, leaving Dougt and Aysia to be responsible for attracting attention. It is only now that his strength has increased to a level comparable to that of the Dark Lord. Formally came to the bright side, it can be seen that the other party's picture is very big!
Fiona finally understood why the old Rozier would use unfathomable to describe a thirteen or four-year-old wizard. Now it seems that this evaluation is not exaggerated!
Foley and Rohr also thought of this incident. When they received the news, they didn't believe it. Generally speaking, the patron saints of wizards are ordinary creatures. Now it can be seen that their law enforcement officers did not deceive themselves.
Since Ivan's patron saint can be a unicorn, it doesn't seem to be completely impossible to become a giant.
Foley and Roll could only sigh that the abilities of this little wizard surpassed their imagination.
"I hope you haven't forgotten who the other person with a special patron saint is!" Old Rozier said in a deep voice.
Albus Dumbledore!
This name popped up in everyone's minds. Many people in the magic world knew that the principal of Hogwarts had a phoenix pet, and even the patron saint was in the form of a phoenix!
Is it possible that Hals is also a special magic family? But why is it not famous in the British magic world?
A few people in Aibo can't understand, they can only attribute it to the Hals family is not a native British magic family, and the conditions for blood inheritance are harsh, until such a talented little wizard began to emerge!
The more they thought about it, the more they felt that it was possible, and unanimously believed that Ivan Hals had such a powerful magic talent, he must also be a pure-blood wizard.
In that case, everyone will be their own...
Old Rozier did not participate in their discussion. He turned to look at the two werewolf wizards, begging them to unlock the magic shackles of Aibo and others.
This time, the werewolves did not refuse, but after lifting the restrictions on several pure-blood wizards, they did not leave and did not intend to return the wand.
"Let's go, let's see Lord Hals!"
Old Rozier spoke to several people, and then led them out of the dark basement to the room where Ivan was. Two werewolf wizards followed them all the time, monitoring their every move.
"After entering, don't talk nonsense, otherwise I won't be able to save you!" Old Rozier reminded very seriously.
"Don't worry, we know the severity!" Aibo and the others nodded solemnly, but they were a little uneasy at the thought that they would meet with the unfathomable little wizard of the Dark Lord and the unfathomable city.
After knocking on the door, the old Rozier took a deep breath and slowly opened the door of the room and walked in with Aibo and Foley.
The whole room looked very big, the curtains around it were half drawn, and the light looked a little dim, all illuminated by the burning fire in the room.
At this time, Ivan was sitting on the sofa on the right side of the room, flipping through a book, and several wizards were lying down in front of him.
Although it seems that these wizards have not been tortured, they seem to be a little sluggish. They don't even have the strength to speak or move. You can imagine how cruel they were tortured!
"Your Excellency Hals!" Old Rozier's voice was faintly trembling. He didn't expect that he was so unlucky that he would have been delayed for another day if he knew it!
The little wizard in front of him slowly closed the book and glanced at them. The black eyes seemed to have magical powers, and Ibo and others suddenly felt that their thoughts had been seen through, and their hearts were overwhelmed, and they quickly lowered their heads. Dare to look at Ivan.
Perhaps it was because the emotions were too strong, and in that moment, Ivan had vaguely read their escaping emotions.
Panic, fear, nervousness... all kinds of strong emotions surfaced in Ivan's mind After practicing with those condemned prisoners for an afternoon, Ivan had already raised the level of panic-mind to two levels. If the other party's mood swings are obvious enough, he can know the other party's current mood by looking at each other.
But what made Ivan feel a little depressed was that he had experimented several times, and the wizards who stared at him would become very nervous and fearful, and for a time he wondered if there was something wrong with his mind.
Is he so scary? Why it seems that everyone is afraid of themselves...
Thinking of this, Ivan frowned. Is there any misunderstanding in it?
He really wants to rely on strength as a deterrent to make up for his age defects, but this does not mean that he will engage in a terror reign like Voldemort, and he can be kind and friendly with his subordinates...

chapters.title: Chapter 533: Ivan: Is there such a good thing to give money?
chapters.content:
()You can search for "Hogwarts Blood Wizard( in Baidu to find the latest chapter!
Despite this thought, Ivan also understands that trying to make these people think about themselves is not something they can do in a day or two. Only after getting along for a long time, they will gradually realize that they are actually a peaceful and friendly person. Little wizard!
The old Rozier, Foley, Aibo and others on the side are carefully watching Ivan's expression.
When they saw the little wizard frowning in dissatisfaction, everyone's hearts shook, and they really didn't understand where they angered each other, or did they come at the wrong time?
But all came, and now he couldn't go back, Old Rozier had to gritted his teeth and said. "Your Excellency Hals, I have brought them here according to your previous instructions!"
Old Rozier said, and winked at Foley and Abbot behind him.
"Your Excellency Hals, please forgive me for my dullness and ignorance. In order to make up for my previous mistakes, our Parkinson family is willing to offer two...no, thirty thousand gallons in exchange for your understanding!
"Your Excellency Hals, everything is the **** Knott cheating on me. We didn't mean to offend you. Our Abbot family is also willing to donate thirty thousand gallons..."
......
Under the sign of the old Rozier, these pure-blood wizards loudly denounced their previous dullness and ignorance, and said that they have changed their past and are willing to surrender, only begging Ivan to accept the tribute to give them a chance to redeem their sins. !
Seeing Foley and others who were constantly condemning themselves and planning to spend tens of thousands of gallons to redeem their sins, Ivan always felt a little weird.
After all, strictly speaking, it seems to be my first hand...
Ivan was embarrassed to look at the pure-blood wizards, waved his hand, and said kindly.
"Let him go over the past... my friends! The little contradictions of the past are nothing but dust on the table. We don't need to take it to heart, don't we?"
"As for Gongjin, it is not necessary, I have seen your sincerity!"
While comforting them, Ivan also directly rejected the so-called tribute.
Although he could get more than 100,000 gold gallons by nodding, Ivan still refused this temptation without hesitation. He knew that nothing was for nothing!
I had clearly agreed to the old Rozier's request and forgave their lives, but the six big families are still willing to donate 30,000 tributes to each, which is obviously a plot!
You must know that 180,000 gold gallons is not a small sum. If you really accept it, it is equivalent to owing a favor to yourself!
However, what went beyond Ivan's expectation was that when he clearly refused, the faces of the old Rozier and others showed a look of sincerity and fear.
"Your Excellency Hals, these tributes are just a little bit of our heart. I hope you will give us a chance to redeem our sins!" Fiona Parkinson said very excitedly.
Foley, Abbott, and Rohr also cautiously spoke out, as if Ivan would not accept the money, and their hearts would be uneasy.
Ivan was speechless in his heart, and he was really puzzled. It was the first time that he had encountered a situation in which someone forced a large sum of money into himself.
After Fiona and others insisted repeatedly, Ivan couldn't help but reluctantly agreed.
Because he found that if he didn't accept it, it would make them feel grieved.
Of course, in return, Ivan allowed them to retain a certain share of the wizarding market, and most of these hundreds of thousands of Jin Jialong will also be invested in the operation of the black market.
"Thank you for your magnanimity!" Aibo said gratefully.
Although Ivan only returned part of the previously deprived share, Aibo and others were very grateful, and even a little ecstatic.
Originally, they were only expecting to exchange some Jin Jialong for Ivan's goodwill, and by the way to reflect their own value, but they did not expect that Ivan would be willing to return part of the wizarding market share.
From now on, they will be in the same interest group, and the wizarding market will become a bridge between each other.
However, before they were happy, Ivan turned his voice and spoke.
"Since everyone is one's own right now, there are some things that might be clarified!"
"For those friends who are willing to support me, I will give him honor, money and...everything he wants!"
"As for those who sneak in with bad intentions..." Ivan slowly said, watching the trembling pure-blood wizards with his black eyes. "I don't think you would want to know their consequences! Would you?"
The relaxed hearts of Foley, Aibo and others suddenly rose up, kneeling in fear and bowing to the ground.
"Your Excellency Hals, our Parkinson family is truly willing to surrender!"
"Our Abbots family has nothing to do with each other!"
......
Several pure-blood wizards shouted in unison, expressing their heartfelt excitement.
"Really? Time will tell!" Ivan said non-committal, slowly placing the book he was holding on the wooden table next to him.
Although he hadn't noticed hatred or other emotions when he read his emotions with the mind just now, it didn't mean that he could completely trust these people.
According to the statement in this book, some proper tapping is necessary to make these people understand what awe is!
Foley, Aibo and others dared not reply on the ground, but the only old Rozier standing still glanced sharply at the book Ivan was holding. The cover read "From Little Clerk to Minister of Magic ——How the Wizard Goes to the Peak of Power"!
Old Rozier's pupils dilated suddenly.
Sure enough, just as he thought, the little wizard in front of him was really seeking the post of Minister of Magic...
The old Rozier didn't dare to look more quickly lowered his head, maintaining his original humble appearance.
Ivan didn't notice the old Rozier's small movements, he looked around at the crowd, and once again used his mind.
Since the mood fluctuations of the Aibo people are more intense this time, Ivan can clearly perceive their emotions without having to look at each other.
After confirming that his words were indeed effective, Ivan nodded with satisfaction, and then helped the pure-blood wizards kneeling on the ground according to Huairou's statement in the book, and stated that he was willing to believe in their sincerity. , And the punishment is only for those shameful betrayers!
This afternoon, in addition to constantly practicing the techniques of contemplation, he spent the rest of the time watching management books, so that he would not be too passive when facing these people.
The effect seems to be good now, but the reaction of these people is a little overdone...

chapters.title: Chapter 534: Rectify Knock Down Alley
chapters.content:
()You can search for "Hogwarts Blood Wizard( in Baidu to find the latest chapter!
Is it because I did something wrong?
Ivan couldn't help falling into contemplation...
For the old Rozier and others, this period of time is suffering.
From stepping into this small room, their emotions are like riding a roller coaster up and down, and they are under tremendous pressure at every moment. They are simply living like a year, and no one wants to stay here for even a second!
But it was precisely this pressure that made Foley and Abbott even unable to speak, and did not dare to interrupt Ivan's contemplation.
It took several minutes before the old Rozier mustered up the courage to speak and broke the calm, and said softly. "Your Excellency Hals, if there is nothing else to order, please allow us to prepare the tribute now!"
"Huh? Ah... go!" Ivan finally recovered his mind. He nodded and nodded, waving his hand to indicate that they can leave...
The pure-blood wizards who received the order tremblingly withdrew from the room.
Click...
The moment the door was closed, Foley, Ibo and others outside the door all heaved a sigh of relief, with cold sweat on their foreheads, as if they had just experienced a battle of life and death.
"Rozier, why didn't you tell us that Lord Hals's character is so... weird?" Foley looked at old Rozier somewhat complaining.
After the contact just now, in Foley's opinion, the little wizard can only be described as moody, and his behavior is extremely domineering.
After seeing each other for a while, Foley faintly faced the feeling of the Dark Lord.
"Hmph, I have reminded you a long time ago, you must be careful when meeting Your Excellency Hals!" Old Rozier lowered his voice, reminding him, and then turned his head to see Foley.
"Also... Foley! Show me a little bit next time, don't let me know that you are arguing about your Lord Hals!"
......
On the other side, Ivan, who watched the old Rozier and others leave, also breathed a sigh of relief. His tight heart immediately relaxed, and his body fell heavily and leaned against the sofa behind, rubbing comfortably on it. It's a rub.
After relaxing for a while, Ivan straightened up again. The conversation with the old Rozier and others just now made him exhausted.
But it won't work if you don't do this. These pure-blood wizards are very slippery one by one. If you don't calm them, they may make small actions in private.
As for the nail that Dougt said, he already had some ideas. For example, Foley was a good candidate. He and Rozier didn't seem to be able to deal with it, and it was easy to provoke their previous conflicts.
While Ivan was thinking about it, a system prompt sounded suddenly.
[Ding, the mission: Become the King of Turnover Alley (Second Ring) is complete...
Mission: Unified Knockdown Alley (Second Ring Road)
Task progress: 100% (completed)
Task Reward: Red Courageous Faithful Curse (whether to receive it)
Task description:......】
"Finally finished?" Ivan was stunned, then muttered to himself.
As early as three days ago, when I captured the Wizarding Market, the progress of this task increased to 95%, and for unknown reasons, it would increase a little every once in a while, until now it finally reached its full value.
Thinking of this, Ivan was very moved.
When I received this task last year, I had no plans to do it at all, but unexpectedly, this time I went home and completed it by mistake!
"Receive the reward!" Ivan said silently in his heart.
The next moment, a lot of knowledge poured into Ivan's mind, his figure swayed, his eyes closed, leaning on the sofa and slowly sorting out. About half a minute later, Ivan opened his eyes again.
As he had predicted before, the Curse of Courageous Faith is an extremely special magic, both powerful and tasteless!
The strength lies in the successful casting of this spell to create a safe shelter. As long as the secretaries do not die or betray, even wizards like Voldemort and Dumbledore will not be able to find that place.
But the Courageous Loyalty Curse is more tasteless for Ivan now, because now he has unified Turnover Alley, there is no need to hide.
If he got it two years earlier, maybe he would be happier. After all, they were in a bad situation in Knockturn Alley....
Ivan shook his head secretly, and it was a pity that he suddenly thought that the magic world would be in danger in the future, because according to the prophecy the Dark Lord would come out to stir the situation in the near future...
At that time, there might be places where you need to use this spell.
Even if this prediction is inaccurate, Voldemort will not return for a while, and the Ministry of Magic will become a second threat!
Ivan knew very well that the trouble he had caused in Turnover Alley would not be concealed for long.
There is no official force to intervene now, and it is entirely because the Ministry of Magic is being overwhelmed by the dementor riots and the escape of Peter Pettigrew, and it doesn't even care about the mess that happened in Knockturn Alley.
But once the Ministry of Magic takes time out, it will inevitably notice the changes here. As long as one investigates, it is impossible to hide many things!
Ivan thinks that he has no special ideas, so he is satisfied with this one-third of acre, but he is afraid that the Ministry of Magic will think more!
For the mighty and invincible Voldemort, Fudge may only retreat and retreat, but against a small Knockdown Alley, it is very possible to strike hard!
Thinking of this, Ivan couldn't help but be wary.
Regardless of the fact that friendship is only possible, but I have to guard against it, Ivan immediately decided to install hidden doors on all the recovered protective rings this year, so that he can protect himself when the situation deteriorates in the future!
The Courageous Faithfulness Curse happens to be the final hole card. With this powerful protection spell, at least you don't have to worry too much about safety!
Gou went to the library to read books, and waited until his strength surpassed Voldemort before he came out!
Ivan made a secret decision in his heart, when another system prompt sounded in his mind.
【Ding! A new mission has been generated! 】
"Hey, there are tasks? The third ring?" Ivan was very puzzled and opened the task of the system and found that it was exactly the same as he had expected.
[Become the King of Knock Down Alley
Mission objective: rectify the Knockdown Alley (third ring road)
Task progress: 39%
Mission Reward: Mark of Magic
Legendary value: 3 (achievement of the king of Knockturn Alley)
Mission description: After careful planning, you successfully dominated the entire Knockdown Alley and drove the enemies who dared to question and block you into the abyss, but ignorant fools are always inexhaustible, and not everyone is willing to accept you The reign...
Note: Only power and fear can make the ignorant fool recognize reality and show your supreme power. Everyone will worship under your feet...]

chapters.title: Chapter 535: Magic Mark and Falsified Memory
chapters.content:
()You can search for "Hogwarts Blood Wizard( in Baidu to find the latest chapter!
After taking a glance at the newly activated mission, Yifan couldn't help sighing that the system's nonsense skill was getting higher and higher, and the description of the mission made him want to hit someone even more.
Fortunately, with more such tasks, Ivan gradually developed a habit of only analyzing the difficulty and rewards of the tasks.
As for the others?
Just ignore it as if you didn't see it!
Compared with the previous task, the task reward for rectifying Knockdown Alley is undoubtedly richer, and the three legendary points make Ivan very greedy.
If you can get him, you can do another blood fusion!
For the other bonus magic mark shown above, Ivan didn't know much about it, and could only guess that it might be something similar to the Dark Devil mark.
Although it is not clear whether it is used, Ivan thinks it is good to learn this kind of knowledge.
Maybe you can find a way to eliminate the magic mark!
After all, Dougte had been a Death Eater before, and he left a mark of the Dark Demon on his wrist. When Voldemort is really resurrected, this mark will become a time bomb. If he has the ability, he should eliminate it as soon as possible. It’s safer.
But how to complete the task made Ivan difficult again.
From the mission objectives and mission description in the system bar, it can be seen that the focus this time is to let the wizards of Knockdown Alley recognize his rule.
You can think of it with your toes, this is obviously not an easy job!
There are probably more than 300 wizards in Knapped Alley, a small part of them live in the neighborhood, and most of the others are scattered in the suburbs or in ruined ruins.
The composition of the personnel is also very complicated. There are poor wizards who can't get along in the magical world, and those who have committed crimes and come here to hide from the limelight. The biggest feature is that the folk style is sturdy and no longer disciplined.
Even the Ministry of Magic doesn't pay much attention to it, and the difficulty of management is evident.
The only way Ivan could think of was to let people call the door one by one, force each other to surrender, and then drive out all the troublemakers!
But the impact of this is too great, even if it is really implemented, these people will at best surrender on the surface, and maybe they will secretly smash them in secret, who knows if it counts as completing the task...
As for the prompts in the task notes, Ivan is also really rare to complain. He knows exactly how many catties he has. Where is the supreme power?
Even if you count the blessings of the enhanced magic text, his magic is still far from Dumbledore.
It is almost impossible to subdue everyone with strength alone!
So after thinking about it for a long time, Ivan still plans to use gentle measures, such as setting up a law enforcement team to turn Knappou Alley into a civilized neighborhood with simple folk customs and untouched roads!
In that case, most people should recognize their control of Knockturn Alley, and then expel all the troublemakers during this period, and they should be able to achieve certain results in a few years!
Although this method takes a long time, Ivan will not think of a better method for a while.
Bang~
Just as Ivan was thinking about it, a muffled noise suddenly resounded in the wide room.
Ivan turned his head and looked over and found that a condemned prisoner who had fainted had awakened. The sound just now was the sound of the opponent's body hitting the corner of the table.
"Ah! I almost forgot you!" Ivan patted his forehead, said embarrassedly, and walked towards the man.
"Devil... Devil!" Seeing Ivan approaching, the dark wizard yelled in horror, his bound body moved backwards weakly.
"Shut up!" Ivan's face darkened, and a forbidden curse on his backhand made the guy shut his mouth, "Seeing that you are so energetic, you should have rested, then let's continue!"
"Uuuuu..." The black wizard shook his head frantically, his mouth wide open but he couldn't speak at all.
When the little wizard in front of him pointed his wand at him, his heart was cold, and he even faintly regretted that he had agreed to the other party's request.
Being continuously contemplated for a short period of time, it felt as if someone had stuffed a stick into his brain and was madly agitated. In contrast, he was even more willing to suffer a piercing curse, which might feel better.
"Desperate Mind!" Ivan waved his magic wand and once again entered the other's memory.
The pupils of the dark wizard suddenly dilated, his body tightened, frantically trying to expel Ivan's magic from his brain.
Ivan increased the intensity of magic without any mercy. Each of these death row prisoners were scumbags, either carrying several lives on their backs or committing various bad crimes repeatedly.
For example, the black wizard in front of him is a wizarding supremacist who hates Muggles extremely and even takes pleasure in torturing Muggles. Before he was wanted by the Ministry of Magic, he had already brutally killed more than a dozen Muggles.
When looking at the memory, Ivan almost couldn't help being angry, so of course he would not be merciful. He completely treated these wizards as experimental mice, constantly testing the limits of the mind-consciousness.
Even combined with the related knowledge of forgetting spell and Occlumency, trying to modify the memory of a wizard...
After playing for more than ten minutes, Ivan stopped the magic exhaustedly. The black wizard's body seemed to be convulsed, and it took a long time to limp on the ground like a dead fish.
"Do you remember who you are?" Ivan tried to ask, then waved his wand to unlock the forbidden spell.
"I am your undercover agent in the wizard market!" The dark wizard was silent for a while, seeming to be thinking of something, and said blankly.
"No, it's not right..." But after a while, the Kung Fu Black Wizard's face became more and more wrong, he muttered to himself, and finally looked at the little wizard in front of him in horror and screamed.
"What did you do to me? You devil! You promised to let me go!"
"No, UU read www.uukanshu.com, I just promised that you would forgive your life if you obediently cooperate with me in practicing magic, that's all!" Ivan waved his hand and explained.
He has always been a person who keeps his promises, and he needs to stop killing recently, so even if these dark wizards are stigmatizing, Ivan at best will wash away all their memories and send him a hard labor to atone for his past actions.
Of course, the premise is that they can survive the magic experiments of the past few days without breaking down and committing suicide or becoming fools.
"Forget it, I will explain so much to you what to do, anyway, you will forget everything after a while! I will explain it again tomorrow." Ivan shook his head funny.
Hearing these words, the black wizard suddenly realized something, and there was a chill behind him, because he found that he could not remember what happened in the last three days...

chapters.title: Chapter 536: Control Knot
chapters.content:
()You can search for "Hogwarts Blood Wizard( in Baidu to find the latest chapter!
Is it possible?
The black wizard suddenly thought of a possibility, a heart fell to the bottom, and just about to shout, a white light hit him.
"Obliviate! (Obliviate
Ivan looked at the dark wizard who had passed out in a coma, and was disappointed to put down his wand.
After several days of experimentation, he found that it is very difficult to completely modify the memory of a wizard. Even if it is used in conjunction with the forgetting spell, the effect is not so satisfactory.
Because the implanted memory is false after all, no matter how hard he weaves the memory, the other party will quickly perceive the sense of violation after he wakes up.
I'm afraid it will only be possible to wait for these two magics to reach a higher level.
It's a pity that he doesn't have much time to experiment, and in three days he will have to go to an appointment to go to the residence of Nick Le May, and if everything goes well, he may stay there until school starts.
咚咚咚...
There was a knock on the door outside.
"Come in!" Ivan was not surprised, and said casually.
Three wizards in golden and red wizard robes opened the door cautiously and walked in. Like the old Rozier and the others, they felt a great pressure covering their hearts as soon as they entered the door.
Especially seeing those black wizards who are lying on the ground like dead dogs, not knowing how to live or die, I feel even more terrified...
"Like before, take these people down!" Ivan glanced at them briefly and waved.
"Yes... Your Excellency!" The wizards nodded quickly, and tremblingly pulled the black wizards out of the ground.
Ivan keenly sensed the fear in their hearts and shook his head secretly in his heart.
Sure enough, these new wizards still have too little contact with them. If they take a little longer, they might realize that he is actually a very kind person!
Ivan sighed, and had to put aside the long-term thing of changing his mind and wait until next year when he comes back to make plans.
As for now, he has the last thing to do, and that is to control Nott!
This guy is the head of the pure-blood family. If he goes missing for a long time, he might be investigated.
So Nott can't die yet, and Ivan still needs him to temporarily stabilize the Ministry of Magic, cooperate with him to create the appearance that Knockdown Alley is still chaotic, and delay the time as much as possible.
Before Ivan was on those dark wizards, he experimented with the mind-trapping mind and the oblivion curse on whether they could tamper with the memory.
It's a pity that this experiment failed. Modifying a person's memory is not so easy...
Fortunately, there is no way to make up for it. Washing off part of Nott's memory, coupled with the Imperius Curse can achieve the same effect.
The only trouble is that some people need to be sent to monitor, lest Nott break free of control.
Thinking of this, Ivan got up and walked outside the door.
.......
One day passed in a flash.
The process of controlling Nott with the Imperius Curse was very easy. Considering the level of his Imperius Curse was not high, Ivan did not do it personally, but let Dougt perform the magic.
I am only responsible for washing Knott’s memory with the Forgetting Curse, and implanting some new memories as insurance. In this way, even if the Imperius Curse is broken by someone, Knott’s memory will be disordered for a long time, and the situation will be confused .
In addition to the daily practice of magic, Ivan also asked Fran to form a new group of law enforcers, consisting of seven werewolf wizards, who were responsible for patrolling the streets and fighting against those illegal activities.
In the Wizarding Market, another guard was arranged, and with the cooperation of the old Rozier and others, it was okay to fool the Ministry of Magic.
The main purpose is to make the officials mistakenly believe that the previous struggles were all personal grievances, gang fires, and no threat to the Ministry of Magic's rule.
In the evening, Ivan called all the wizards together again, and he still had some things to explain before leaving.
One of the most important is to find something to do for these wizards during the time I am away!
After conquering the Wizarding Market, they had no enemies in Knock Down Alley.
This means that these wizards no longer need to spare their lives to fight, and they can also get high wages.
This is something Ivan absolutely cannot accept!
He wouldn't allow these people to be so idle and get paid for nothing!
So Ivan is going to make them all move and receive high-intensity training in the next year, from a group of skirmishers to real fighters!
Especially after having a rough understanding of the strength of these wizards, Ivan has strengthened this belief, because their magic level can only be described as terrible.
In addition to the captives who had just surrendered, only half of the fifty wizards were able to successfully cast the Iron Armor Curse, and only nine of them could be killed by Avadaso!
Standing on the stage, Ivan looked disappointedly at the wizards underneath. Under their attention, he blessed himself with a powerful curse and spoke slowly.
"I have to say that you guys really disappointed me!"
"As an adult wizard, some people can't even use the iron armor curse freely. You must know that such a basic curse can be mastered by even some newly enrolled little devil heads!"
Listening to Ivan's words, the wizards in the audience lowered their heads in shame or fear, and a few wanted to refute them, because the iron armor curse was not a basic curse, but rather a difficult high-level magic.
Even the Aurors of the Ministry of Magic are not everyone, and it is absolutely impossible that a young wizard who has just entered school can learn it.
But before they could say it, they swallowed their rebuttal words abruptly, because there was a living example in front of them, and no one would doubt whether Ivan could master the Iron Armor Curse when he first entered school.
Seeing that no one refuted, Ivan immediately ordered these wizards to split into groups to practice the battle!
Unlike the duel club hosted by Hogwarts Ivan’s rule is that the wizards in the battle can use all magic except the death curse. There is only one goal, and that is to defeat the enemy in front of you!
Anyway, there is Dougte here, as long as he doesn't use the death curse or intentionally kills, he can be rescued even if he suffers a serious injury!
As a reward, the person who wins the most duels each month can join the law enforcement team, and the salary will be increased to 60 gallons in January!
After Ivan announced the news in a high-profile manner, the wizards who had suffered from a face became excited, and sixty gallons were considered a high salary in the entire British magical world.
For these poor wizards living in Knockturn Alley, joining the law enforcement team can undoubtedly greatly improve their lives. They used to do this kind of hard work in order to be able to feed themselves. Now they feel that they can have it. More pursuit...

Knock Down Alley, in the underground secret room of the Wizard Market, dozens of wizards are engaged in one-on-one battles on the wide training ground.
Various spells fly everywhere, and from time to time, several defeated wizards fall to the ground and wailing or simply become unconscious.
This is so busy that Dougte, who is in charge of the treatment on the field, is the only wizard who is proficient in healing magic. He can only fight the fire without stopping for a moment.
Of course, Ivan on the side was not idle, walking alone on the training ground, pointing out the mistakes made by the wizards in battle and some problems when casting spells from time to time.
Although he is not old, relying on these three years of legendary experience and hard study, he is much higher than the average adult wizard in terms of curse attainments.
The most adept at Transfiguration Curse is even capable of being qualified for the position of Professor Hogwarts, pointing out that these average wizards are still fine.
Ivan walked to the center of the training ground and happened to see Grace was fighting a tall and thin wizard, and knocked out his opponent in just a few rounds.
Ivan, who had watched the entire battle, walked towards the two slowly.
After being cursed, the tall and thin wizard bumped into the wall behind in embarrassment, clutching his chest and climbing up from the ground with difficulty.
But when he stood up again, he was shocked to see that Ivan was already standing in front of him, and he was immediately taken aback and stammered.
"Ha... Your Excellency Hals!"
The wizard lowered his head, his expression was a little nervous, he was obviously worried that he would be punished for being too bad.
"En..." Ivan stepped forward and patted him on the shoulder, swept away the dust, and said with a smile. "Relax. It's normal to lose in a battle. The important thing is to learn from the practice and avoid the same dilemma in a real battle."
"Do you know where you lost?" Ivan asked.
"It's because my strength is too weak, and the magic I master can't break the protection of the Iron Armor Curse!" The tall and thin wizard hesitated for a while, and replied very frustrated.
He believes that the biggest reason for the loss is that Grace has mastered the Iron Armor Curse, but he hasn't, so he widened the gap.
In the duel of ordinary wizards, wizards who can bless themselves with iron armor curses can often have the advantage. After all, this protective curse can resist most of the magic and bounce it back.
So when he was in the fight just now, he fought so hard that he couldn't see the possibility of victory at all.
Ivan shook his head, reminding him. "No, it has nothing to do with whether you have mastered powerful magic, it is simply that your mind is too solid! As long as you use it well, some seemingly innocent little magic can also play a big role!"
The tall and thin wizard nodded and looked like he had been taught, but he didn't agree with him in his heart.
Facing the Iron Armor Curse, there were only two ways he could think of to crack it.
Either use high-strength magic, such as the Blasting Curse to instantly break through the protective upper limit of the Iron Armor Curse to destroy it, or use the Killing Curse to defeat the enemy with one blow.
As for the other magics, they are not very good, and they will bounce back and hurt themselves...
The little emotions in the wizard's heart could not be concealed from Ivan, who had already practiced dementia, but he didn't mean to refute, but smiled and turned his head and spoke to Grace on the other side.
"Grace, since you have defeated your opponent, how about we play a game?"
"Ah? This..." Grace's face turned pale suddenly, thinking of the little wizard in front of him who turned into a giant and slapped Reese Notte in her hand, and then killed him with her fingers. I was about to cry for a while.
"Can I admit defeat? Lord Hals?" Grace asked weakly.
"You have to have a little confidence in yourself, Grace! Let's do this, in the next battle, I will only use some of the most basic spells..." Ivan shook his head speechlessly, comfortingly said .
Grace shrank her head and had no guts to refuse, so she had to complain a few words in her heart. Even the magic that is so difficult to learn the Iron Armor Curse is a basic spell in Ivan's impression, so she has no hope of Ivan's promise.
"Protego! (Armor Bodyguard
Despite beating the drum secretly in her heart, Grace still cheered up and quickly blessed herself with an iron armor curse.
If you think about it in a good place, this matchup is also an opportunity. If you perform well, you might be able to break into the law enforcement team.
The salary of sixty gallons a month makes Grace very greedy. After joining the law enforcement team, she doesn’t have to be so restrained. Maybe she will be able to own her own house outside of Knockdown Alley in a few years. house.
The conversation between Ivan and Grace was not obscured, and everyone on the training ground could hear it clearly.
The wizards who hadn't finished the battle stopped tacitly and turned their eyes to the two of them curiously.
They wanted to see this asymmetrical battle more than they could practice at any time. Some wizards who had just surrendered secretly guessed how long Grace could last under Ivan's hands.
"Are you ready?" Ivan asked casually.
Grace held the wand firmly in her right hand and nodded very nervously, but she did not dare to take the initiative to attack. She only hoped that she could resist a few more rounds and show her strength.
On the other side, Ivan also didn't have the idea of ​​doing it immediately, but turned his gaze to the onlookers, especially the tall and thin wizard who stopped for a while, and said.
"The Iron Armor Curse is a very practical protective magic that can erect an invisible magic barrier around it to protect the caster in all directions."
"But its protection is limited, and it can only bounce a specified magic beam! We can crack it against this!"
While explaining to everyone , Ivan quickly raised his wand and pointed it at Grace.
"There are many obstacles!" Grace has been staring at Ivan nervously. Seeing him raise the wand, she suddenly seemed to be stimulated, and quickly built a strong wall in front of her.
Under this double protection, Grace felt that even some high-level spells could be resisted!
However, to her expectations, Ivan's wand did not shoot out the spell beam, instead, the violent wind sound came from behind her.
At the same time, Ivan's voice sounded.
"Chairs are flying!"
The square chair placed not far behind Grace was summoned when Ivan raised his wand, and flew at high speed like an arrow from a string.

chapters.title: Chapter 538: Casting like clouds and flowing water
chapters.content:
()You can search for "Hogwarts Blood Wizard( in Baidu to find the latest chapter!
When Ivan uttered the last word, the chair slammed into the magic barrier constructed by the Iron Armor Curse at an astonishing speed.
The Iron Armor Curse was not very good at physical protection. After being hit hard, it lasted for less than half a second before it slammed into pieces.
Grace, who had just reacted, couldn't avoid it at all, and was hit in the back. Although she didn't lose her combat effectiveness, she rolled on the ground a few times in embarrassment.
"You are so nervous, Grace! You put all your attention on me, and didn't notice the possible risks around me. This is a big taboo in the battle!" Ivan did not hesitate to generalize. Grace pointed out her mistake in the battle.
When watching her fight with the wizard before, Ivan had already seen that Grace's spell level was good, but she lacked combat experience.
If you switch to Sirius, it is absolutely impossible to make such a low-level mistake.
But this is not a fault of Grace alone, but most wizards in the magical world lack combat experience!
To put it bluntly, as the only school in England, Hogwarts' main task is to teach students how to use magic to facilitate their lives. At most, they learn how to crack black magic and deal with dark creatures in the Defense Against the Dark Arts class!
As for the battle between wizards, it is rarely involved in the classroom.
This is why when Lockhart held the duel club, almost all the little wizards from the school came to participate.
Because there are not many opportunities for pair training at all!
Although Grace and the others stayed in Knock Down Alley and experienced some battles to some extent, they were born in the wild after all, and their fighting skills were basically crafted in battle.
Maybe it's still enough in normal times. If you deal with some powerful wizards, it will be easy to be caught.
Thinking of this, Ivan shook his head secretly. This may be what the Ministry of Magic wanted to see. The weaker the combat power of civilian wizards, the better they can manage.
It's just that Ivan didn't want his subordinates to do the same, so he swept his gaze to the onlookers and explained.
"As I said earlier, the iron armor curse is actually not difficult to deal with. It can only bounce off specific types of spells. If it is replaced by a physical attack of the magic trend, it will be difficult to perform its due effect!"
"So if the time to release the curse is well grasped, even a flying curse can defeat the enemy!"
"I believe no one even knows the flying curse?" Ivan added.
Listening to Ivan's words, the wizards who were watching laughed. The Flying Curse was one of the most basic spells. It was not difficult to learn, and those minor wizards could use it freely.
However, using the impact effect of the flying curse to drive the object to crack the iron armor curse is indeed a very novel idea, and few people usually think of using this magic in battle.
While Ivan was explaining, Grace had risen from the ground, her face glowing red.
She originally wanted to take this opportunity to perform well in front of Ivan, but she didn't expect that she would be easily defeated by a flying curse.
This made Grace very reconciled, it was just a momentary error, and her strength was not shown at all.
But soon Grace remembered that she didn't seem to surrender, that is to say, the battle was still going on. She looked at Ivan, who was still explaining in front of her. She gritted her teeth and waved her heart fiercely and quickly. Magic wand.
"Expelliarmus! (Except your weapon
A crimson light beam flashed in the air.
When Ivan heard the sound, he turned his head and waved his magic wand lightly. The crimson light beam that was close at hand disappeared and became invisible, and finally looked at Grace.
The young witch was afraid that the wand was almost unsteady. She made a sneak attack just now, but she was dizzy for a while, anxiously trying to get back a round. Now that she calmed down, she realized that what she had done was very good. Serious offense.
Ivan's reaction was beyond Grace's expectation. Instead of hesitating, he even praised it.
"Grace... did a good job! Since one party hasn't surrendered, the battle is naturally not over, as long as it can win the sneak attack is a good choice!"
Of course, Ivan will not blame Grace for the sudden attack. Any method is allowed in the battle, and the enemy will not greet you when attacking.
"Go ahead!" Ivan said.
Grace slowly breathed a sigh of relief. After adjusting her state, she again blessed herself with an iron armor curse, and then took the lead in launching an attack.
Ivan fulfilled his previous promise and didn't use any unconventional magic throughout the entire process. Even if he counterattacked, he used some basic spells.
But this does not mean that Grace can deal with it easily, because Ivan combines many small magics together, and the power that bursts out is not much weaker than those high-level spells.
With gestures, she can also use the magic she has cast and counteract it back.
Grace feels that her ability to support up to now is entirely the result of the other party's deliberate retention of hands, because the iron armor curse on her body has been broken several times, and every time Ivan waited until she re-blessed her protection magic before continuing to attack.
What made Grace even more desperate was that when Ivan was fighting against her, she was still doing various explanations, explaining the characteristics of each curse and the way to deal with it, completely absent-minded.
The mood swings made Grace even more frantic, and soon a flaw was revealed.
"Diffindo! (torn apart Ivan seized the opportunity keenly and quickly waved his wand.
A magical beam instantly hit Grace but was resisted by her iron curse.
However, before the spell was bounced back, another crimson light beam came one after another, instantly piercing the protective limit of the iron armor curse, and hitting Grace directly.
Grace felt her body hit by a bull, and was directly knocked out. The magic wand in her hand came out and fell into Ivan's hand in a whirlpool.
The wizards watching Ivan clapped enthusiastically when they saw Ivan's victory.
Although Ivan did not use those powerful and suffocating magics in the battle, the cooperation and application of some basic magic really opened their eyes. The stance of flowing clouds and flowing water when casting spells is even more artistic.
Everyone knows that to do this is not as easy as Ivan has shown, that requires a very powerful magic control ability...
