"Good morning, teacher!" Ivan walked to the chair by the dining table and said hello.
"Well... Did you get used to sleeping last night?" Nick LeMay put down his teacup gently, and asked with a smile.
"Very used!" Ivan nodded and nodded. Although Nick Lemay was a wizard from centuries ago, this house is not outdated at all. Both the living room and the bed look modern, and he doesn't recognize it. The bed naturally sleeps peacefully.
But Ivan was very curious about what he saw outside the window, so he couldn't help but inquire.
"You can see the city because it is very close to the city of Paris..." Nick LeMay didn't mean to hide it, but explained it to Ivan.
In order to avoid unnecessary interruptions, he used magic to hide an area, forming an independent space, usually isolated from the inside and outside, and no outside scenes can be seen.
Only the person who has the coordinates has caused the magic wave to move in and out through the phantom shift, which will affect the protection and can see the outside world in a short time.
"Did any guests come just now?" Ivan asked.
Nick LeMay shook his head and explained that he went out to purchase some supplies.
This mansion can't be self-sufficient yet. He needs to go out every once in a while, and by the way, see what new things the Muggles have made.
Ivan then understands, and at the same time keenly aware that Nick LeMay seems to be very interested in Muggle creations. There is even a TV and a refrigerator in the living room.
"This morning, you can read some books in the library. The books on the third row of bookshelves should be of some help to you. If you have any questions, I will answer your questions in the afternoon..." Nick LeMay Arrange today's affairs for Ivan.
Before, he learned from Dumbledore that Ivan is a very self-disciplined child, so he did not strictly demand what Ivan must do when, but only gave some suggestions.
Ivan nodded in response, then turned to the refrigerator, TV, and microwave in the living room, and asked tentatively. "Teacher, I see a lot of Muggle stuff here, can they work properly?"
When I first entered the door, Ivan wanted to ask. It was a bit strange to find a bunch of Muggle products in the home of a several-hundred-year-old alchemist.
"I have made some enchantments and improvements to them so that they can operate normally even without electricity. If you are tired from reading, you can watch TV, but you must pay attention to control your time!" Nick LeMay mistakenly thought that Ivan was a childish mind and was curious. These Muggle products reminded with a smile.
Ivan curled his lips. He was not very interested in French dramas in the past nine years, but it was beyond his expectation that Nick Lemay could enchant such electrical appliances.
Although Ivan has long known that some Muggle technology can be transformed through alchemy and turned into magic items, such as Hagrid’s flying motorcycle and the magic car of the Weasley family are similar products.
But TV is different. He is curious how exactly Nick LeMay solved the signal reception problem?
And can make such a magic TV, then why is it not popular in the magic world?
For wizards who lack entertainment, they should not be able to resist this temptation!
"Teacher, since many Muggle electrical appliances are convenient for our lives, why not popularize it?" Ivan said the question in his heart, which is something he has never understood.
"It is not so easy to transform such an alchemy item! The ordinary wizard family simply can't afford it," Nick LeMay shook his head, gave an explanation, and then continued.
"In addition, the European magic world is generally conservative, and has a certain prejudice against these Muggle creations. It is believed that the introduction of a large number of Muggle equipment will impact the normal order of the magic world..."
Don’t look at the growing number of half-blood wizards and Muggle-born wizards nowadays The magic world has gradually changed in subtle ways, and many wizards’ daily life and dressing habits are gradually moving closer to Muggles.
But there are still some people in the magical world who still follow the ancient etiquette and living habits, and are extremely repulsive of Muggle items, and even adopt a hostile attitude.
These people are mostly pure-blooded wizards, forming a huge conservative force. On the one hand, it stems from the discrimination of wizards against Muggles, and on the other hand, it is to prevent new ideas and new things from shaking their status.
After listening to Nick Lemay’s explanation, Ivan has some understanding of the current state of the magic world. Simply put, it is a collision between new ideas and old ideas, and this contradiction is likely to change over time. Getting bigger and bigger...
As for the management of Muggle items in the magical world, Ivan has also heard about it. For example, the United Kingdom established a special Muggle item prohibition department to prevent wizards from illegally modifying Muggle technology items.
It is worth mentioning that the leader of this department is Ron's father Arthur Weasley.
And for his own convenience, Arthur also specially left a loophole when writing a law prohibiting the abuse of Muggle items. In order to improve travel, wizards can use magic to transform Muggle transportation.
After breakfast, Nick LeMay took Ivan to the library on the first floor.
The space here is a bit smaller than the Blake’s underground library, but the books are placed closer together. A cursory sweep over, the overlapping bookshelves make Ivan a little dizzy...
There is also a high platform in front of the library. There are a lot of incomprehensible magic texts burned around. I don’t know what it is used for...

chapters.title: Chapter 548: "Modern Alchemy Addendum"
chapters.content:
"This is a device for organizing and searching books. You only need to put a magic wand on the table and say the name or type of the book, and the magic will be activated to select those books." Nick LeMay pointed to the high platform. Introduced.
so convenient?
Ivan was very surprised, and felt that this magic high platform was a bit like a Muggle search engine.
When he was at the Black House before, he was still worried about the collection of books that were too difficult to find. He didn't expect that Nick Le May had solved this problem.
At this time, Nick Le already May drew out the magic wand, put it on the table of the high platform, demonstrated it to Ivan, and slowly muttered.
"Type: Advanced Alchemy..."
With the sound of Nick LeMay's voice, a bookshelf on the right front suddenly vibrated.
After a while, Ivan saw hundreds of books being pulled from the shelf and flying towards this side. Finally, they were neatly divided into five groups and quickly landed on the high platform with a muffled noise.
"Modern Alchemy Appendix", "Advanced Enchanting Magic", "Study and Application of Runic"...
Ivan glanced around and found that most of these books hadn't been read by himself. He picked up the "Modern Alchemy Appendix" curiously and flipped through it. The pages were very new, and the author on the cover read impressively-- Nick LeMay.
"Teacher, are these books the result of your research?" Ivan looked at Nick Le May, no wonder he could not find it elsewhere. It seems that this should be written by Nick Le May over the years, so it was not. Rumored.
"Most of it!" Nick LeMay nodded, confirming Ivan's guess, and then waved his wand again and said. "return!"
Except for the "Modern Alchemy Appendix" in Ivan's hand, the rest of the books slowly floated up and flew back to their original positions.
"Choose the books you want, and put the rest back like this! But remember that this magic is only effective if you place the books on a high platform." Nick Lemec turned his head and introduced Ivan The usefulness and disadvantages of the magic high platform.
Ivan listened very carefully, and asked about the meaning of the runes burned on the magic platform from time to time. Such a useful "search engine", he was going to install one in his home.
After teaching Ivan to use the high-level search function, Nick Lemay didn't stay any more, and after a few orders, he left.
Ivan Ivan, who was left alone, didn't care too much, because he knew very well that Nick Lemay was probably studying the resurrection stone.
How attractive is a Deathly Hallows to the alchemist. It’s not necessary to say much about nature. It’s pretty good that Nick LeMay can take some out every day to answer questions for himself.
Ivan is very self-aware. He and Nick Lemay are not yet a formal mentor-student relationship, and the other party has no obligation to teach themselves.
Thinking like this, Ivan moved a chair, sat beside a bookshelf, and slowly opened the "Modern Alchemy Appendix" in his hand, flipping through the pages.
......
In the next few days, Ivan continued to live in this alchemy hut, eating, communicating and sleeping at four o’clock.
Although there is almost no room for activities on weekdays, Ivan feels very fulfilling and comfortable.
There is no need to pretend to be in front of a group of brain patching, and there is no need to intrigue with the group of dark wizards. Compared with the previous life, it is simply not too perfect!
Especially after getting acquainted with the new environment, the place where Ivan changed his previous constraints gradually moved from the library to the living room.
finally sat comfortably by the fire, sipping iced lemon juice, slowly turning the pages of the book, feeling the coolness from the blue fire.
In the summer, Ivan felt that few wizards in the entire magical world could receive his treatment...
But when it comes to worrying things, it is not without it, that is, the alchemy books in the library are very difficult to understand, even with Ivan's current level of alchemy, it is very difficult to study.
If he hadn't deliberately left a large number of student registration points before, he could use the experience card to increase the learning speed when it was critical. After a few days, I am afraid that even a book cannot be thoroughly studied.
Until the afternoon a week later, Ivan finally turned to the last page and completed the knowledge on the alchemy manuscript placed on the table, and then slowly closed the "Modern Alchemy Appendix" in his hand.
Ivan put down the book, and subconsciously wanted to pick up the cup on the side and take a cold drink, but when he held the cup to his mouth, he suddenly realized that it was empty.
"Wu Ka Ka... Pour me another cold drink!" Ivan put the glass aside and said.
Hearing that, a group of small alchemy creatures immediately gathered around, like ants moving house. They moved a jar full of lemon juice very laboriously, and then several more grouped together to dump the jar together. Come down and fill the cup slowly.
"Good job!" Ivan smiled and praised, and took a sip from the cup.
Ice-cold lemon juice poured in from the mouth, flowed down the throat into the stomach, and then gradually spread, a chill suddenly rushed into my mind, and Ivan's involuntary spirit was liftedlook Tired, drinking some cold drinks is simply not good...
I was praised by IvanThe little alchemy creatures seemed very happy, yelling "Ulala" indiscriminately, and eagerly moved the jar back to the dark blue stove.
Obviously, this cold drink was roasted over a fire!
In the first few days, Ivan was also very puzzled by this weird magic stove, but after reading the alchemy books for such a day, he finally managed to figure out the principle of this stove.
To put it bluntly, Nick Le May used some kind of alchemy magic text to reverse the temperature of the flame, and it became like this.
However, the conversion efficiency is obviously not ideal. He has tried to get closer, and the temperature of the flame is about a few degrees below zero.
Even so, the function of this kind of alchemy array is enough to surprise Ivan. After all, he also learned some physics in high school, so it is really difficult to understand how to reverse the temperature.
However, most magic is difficult to analyze with existing theories.
For example, Peter, a small dwarf of more than two hundred catties, can be transformed into a mouse weighing a few catties by Animagus Transfiguration, which has a weight gap of several dozen times, and the excess mass disappears inexplicably, or It was directly condensed into the rat's body by the magic power and unreasonable.
"Well... Ideal... Ideal! I think it's cold, it's cold, I think it's hot, it's hot!" Ivan tried another method to explain the problem. He stretched out his wand and clicked on the cup. After a while, he wanted to see if he could turn a cold drink into a hot drink.
However, the cup exploded without giving any face, and the cold lemonade splashed all around, spilling Ivan's face...

chapters.title: Chapter 549: Crescent Moon Pendant
chapters.content:
"Sure enough..." Ivan wiped the water stains on his face, looked at the shards of glass on the table, and sighed in disappointment.
It's easy to say that what I want to do is easy, but when I was actually experimenting, Ivan found that it was impossible to do it.
Because there is no assistance of spells and gestures, the magic in the body cannot understand his commands, and will not obey his commands.
Ivan shook his head, and had to give up this thought for a while, and instead waved his magic wand to start cleaning up the mess.
"Repair as before!"
Under the action of magic, the glass fragments broken into more than a dozen pieces vibrated and regrouped, just like time reversing, and put together an intact glass.
Even the scattered lemon juice was collected again...
Of course, Ivan was not interested in drinking this glass of lemon juice anymore. He turned around and poured it into the trash can.
Those small alchemy creatures that looked like a turnip head were taken aback by the sudden bursting of the cup, panicking everywhere, until Ivan repaired the cup, the alchemy creatures stopped. Seeing that the cup was empty, they worked tirelessly. Started the handling work.
Ivan watched these little guys busy, and didn't mean to help. Observing the actions of these alchemy creatures was his rare entertainment in the alchemy hut.
And if they really help, not only will they not be grateful, but they will also become very frustrated, because doing these chores is the meaning of their existence.
Ivan is also very curious about the high intelligence displayed by these "little turnip heads". He has not seen similar alchemy creatures. The alchemy puddings made by George and Fred are similar things. .
But generally speaking, the IQ of magical creations is not high. They only have some simple judgments, their expressions are dull, and they are far less clever.
Ivan couldn't help but reached out and grabbed one of the "radish heads", curiously grasping it, ignoring the struggle of this little thing, and looked around.
Finally found that the appearance of this thing was silvery white, it looked smooth and clean, and there was no magic text on it. It may belong to the category of enchanting magic, but it does not rule out that it is an alchemy method that he does not know.
I have to say that after entering this alchemy hut, Ivan gradually realized how ignorant he was.
The more I study those high-end alchemy books, the more Ivan understands how shallow his knowledge is.
A few days ago, he still felt complacent about his sixth-level alchemy. Now it seems that his alchemy at that time was just getting started, and now he has begun to really come into contact with the mystery of alchemy.
Ivan silently sighed in his heart, and his movements didn't stop, and he began to sort out the messy alchemy notes on the table.
Nick Lemay’s "Modern Alchemy Appendix" covers a wide range of topics. It is not so much a guide book, but rather a categorized summary of many alchemy theories, like a general outline.
The one that interests Ivan the most is a special enchantment magic.
"Strong and pure emotions can often explode unimaginable power...A clever wizard can store this power in a specific device through magic guidance, and make it into an extremely powerful magic item." Ivan looked at one. On the piece of parchment, staring at the content recorded on it, muttered to himself softly.
He has seen this kind of emotional power twice, one is the protective spell on Harry, and the other is the crescent moon pendant that Asiah gave him...
Thinking of this, Ivan reached into his clothes and grabbed a silver chain.
There is a crescent-shaped pendant hanging from the end of the chain, but it looks a little dim under the sunlight. Several deep cracks are clearly visible on the pendant, and you can vaguely see him engraved on it when you turn over the back. name.
[Magic Item: Crescent Moon Pendant
Magic: Low
Description: This is a magical item made with a lot of precious metals that can withstand a deadly attack for the bearer. It has been damaged.
Note: It contains more than just magic power...]
"It's not just the power of magic... but also love?" Ivan held the pendant in his hand and whispered in a low voice.
Combined with what is said in the "Modern Alchemy Appendix", Esiah used a certain method to guide this emotion into this alchemy item, in order to activate the protective magic text above, so that it can be strong enough to resist death. Sexual harm!
We must know that lethal spells are not so easy to resist, and it seems that there is no restriction on the type, which means that even if Voldemort uses Avada on himself in the system's judgment, there is a high probability that he will be safe. thing.
As for the "different" magic rating, Ivan felt normal after thinking about it. It is not easy for a disposable item to get such a rating.
If it can be used multiple times, the evaluation will increase by at least one more level!
At the same time, Ivan also carefully noticed that some changes have taken place in the notes of the Pendant Moon Pendant, which is different from the last time when I checked it. The sentence "Your level of alchemy is not enough to repair it..." has disappeared without a trace~www .mtlnovel.com~ This means that I have the ability to repair it.
"But, how should I fix this thing?" Ivan turned the pendant over with a headache, staring at the cracked lines.
There is nothing wrong with using his current knowledge to heal these cracks, but the key is that the core inside-that is, the emotional power has long been dissipated, and even if it is repaired, it can no longer play the role of resisting death magic.
Although the "Modern Alchemy Appendix" mentioned emotional magic, it didn't give any guidance, so Ivan had no idea how to fix it.
Forget it, I'll just ask Nick LeMay directly...
Ivan thought so, and after sorting out the scattered notes on the table, after checking the time, he got up and walked towards the studio where Nick LeMay was.
咚咚咚...
Ivan knocked on the door lightly, and after a response sounded inside the door, he opened the door and walked in.
At this time, Nick LeMay is sitting at the front table, staring at a drawing on the table in a daze, his face looks a little tired, but his spirit is very excited.
Ivan is not surprised, because he was in the same state when he stayed up late to play games in his previous life. He was familiar with the feeling of being physically tired but still wanting to fight another game in spirit.
This also worries Ivan a little. Nick LeMay is so old and so exhausting, he doesn't know whether he can eat it or not.
Hearing the sound of Ivan pushing the door in, Nick LeMay seemed to be aware of it, slowly raised his head, and turned his gaze to Ivan...

chapters.title: Chapter 550: Ivan: This is due to official damage. Do you have to fix it for me...
chapters.content:
"Halse, did you encounter something you didn't understand while reading?" Nick LeMay put down his work and asked.
"Yes, teacher! I have read this "Modern Alchemy Appendix" to the end, but I still don't understand the alchemy theory explained in it."
Ivan nodded, and did not rush to ask about emotional magic, but took out the alchemy notes he had compiled and handed it to Nick LeMay.
"You finished reading so soon?" Nick LeMay reached out and took the notes, looking very surprised.
You must know that this "Appendix to Modern Alchemy" was compiled by him for seven years. It is a summary of the various alchemy doctrines, and the alchemy knowledge contained in it is complicated and profound.
According to Nick LeMay, Ivan is already very good to finish reading this book this summer and have a general understanding of these alchemy subjects.
"Forget it, you're finished..." Ivan scratched his head and said uncertainly.
Nick LeMay slowly flipped through the alchemy notes that Ivan handed over in doubt.
In the last three days, his research has reached a critical point. During this period of time, he has inevitably neglected to give instructions to Ivan. Therefore, his understanding of Ivan’s learning progress is still three days ago before he reads Ivan. Surprised after finishing the "Modern Alchemy Appendix".
"Very good, faster than I thought!" Nick LeMay spent a few minutes, and after going through the notes, he gave Ivan a surprised look.
Judging from these notes alone, Ivan's learning progress has exceeded his expectations. It seems that Ivan has worked hard in the past few days.
Nick LeMay has taught many apprentices for hundreds of years, and many of them are talented wizards, but in terms of learning ability alone, none of them can compare to the other.
It is no wonder that Ivan was able to achieve such achievements in multiple subjects at a young age...
Nico LeMay looked at Ivan's immature face, and felt very emotional. In front of this little wizard, the other so-called geniuses would be eclipsed.
"It's all thanks to you for answering my doubts." Ivan replied very humbly, which also contained a bit of sincerity.
Although he can use the Xueba experience card to improve his thinking speed and obtain an extraordinary learning speed, this state is not omnipotent.
Questions arising from lack of knowledge cannot be solved even in the experience card mode.
At this time, the role of an alchemist who is willing to answer questions for him is revealed, and a few words from the other party can clear the obstacles ahead for him.
Nick LeMay smiled and shook his head, not taking Ivan's compliment seriously.
In fact, since coming to this alchemy hut, Ivan has been in a semi-self-study state, and he can only find time occasionally to give pointers or two.
can have such a fast learning progress, most of which is the result of Ivan's own hard work.
Thinking of this, Nick LeMay couldn't help feeling a little ashamed, so he settled and took a few pages to explain the alchemy knowledge to Ivan.
Ivan also explained the problems he encountered in the learning process one by one.
After more than an hour of question and answer, Ivan suddenly asked.
"Teacher, I saw this "Modern Alchemy Appendix" saying that smart wizards can increase the power of magic through guidance and use strong emotions, and even incorporate will into it to make extremely powerful alchemical items."
"Yes! But it is not easy to do this." Nick LeMay nodded and then wondered why Yu Ivan suddenly asked about this.
"Do you have a way to repair such an alchemy prop?" Ivan hurriedly asked.
"Oh? I have to let me see it..." Nick LeMay showed some interest. An alchemy item that incorporates the will of the producer is quite rare.
Ivan hesitated for a moment, then took the meniscus pendant hanging on his neck and put it on the table.
"Is that this?" Nick LeMay looked at the silver-white crescent-shaped pendant on the table with interest, swiped it gently with his thin, wrinkled index finger, and muttered something in his mouth. The surface of the meniscus pendant suddenly glowed with a faint luster.
"The main material is Mithril, and some dragon scale fragments and black stone powder are mixed in order to increase the hardness. Hmm... In addition, there are some more special things..." Nick Le May murmured Now, he could feel some emotions remaining in the pendant of the crescent moon.
love... shelter... pray...
Combined with the time it was made from the wear and tear of the material, Nick LeMay quickly came to a conclusion and understood how this thing was made.
"It's really smart! I can actually think of using the emotions gathered in that special period to increase the effect of magic...no wonder." Nick Le May exclaimed.
From his perspective, the alchemy level of the maker of this pendant is not high, and it is logically impossible to pin his emotions on this alchemy item.
But the other party did this in a tricky way!
Of course, the difficulty of this trick is not low at all...and only the other party can do itNick LeMay flipped the pendant and saw the name engraved on it, confirming the guess in his heart. He turned to look at Ivan.
"Halse, did your mother give you this pendant?"
"It seems that she once saved your life!" Nick LeMay has already seen the effect of this pendant and understands what damage means.
"Right!" Ivan shrugged helplessly, and did not hide the fact that he was forced to fight Voldemort three years ago to protect the Sorcerer's Stone.
"During the fight, a lot of black mist gushed out of Voldemort's body. He wanted to corrode my body. The crescent moon pendant protected me and kept me awake!"
Speaking of this, Ivan is also a little afraid.
At first, he just wanted to make soy sauce and use the plot to kill Voldemort in order to complete the task, but he didn't want Harry, who was the absolute main force, to be so ineffective. He fainted as soon as he started the fight, and finally became dangerous.
If it hadn’t been for the shelter of this crescent moon pendant to gain some time, coupled with the sudden awakening of blood magic, my corpse would have been cold...
He has made such a great achievement, but the stingy Dumbledore is only willing to add a little college points to him as compensation...
Ivan was full of resentment and emphasized that this precious crescent moon pendant was damaged in the battle to protect the Philosopher’s Stone. It should be regarded as damaged by official duties...
As the owner of the Philosopher’s Stone, do you have to fix it for me?
Ivan looked at Nick LeMay eagerly. Although he didn't say it clearly, the meaning couldn't be more obvious.

chapters.title: Chapter 551: Learn alchemy
chapters.content:
Nick LeMay naturally heard Ivan's potential lines and was a little bit dumbfounded for a while.
It is no problem for him to repair an alchemy item.
But the key is that he injects emotions into this pendant to fill the vacancy. After all, it is a little inappropriate, so Nick LeMay shook his head and rejected Ivan's request.
"I will teach you the relevant guide magic these days. Whether it can be fixed is up to you." Nick LeMay said.
Ivan couldn't help but brighten up. If he can learn the magic that guides his emotions, he can not only fix this crescent moon pendant, but he may also be able to make some powerful magic props to take his alchemy to the next level.
"By the way, teacher! Can you see when this pendant was made?" Ivan suddenly thought of something and asked.
"Judging from the degree of wear and tear of the mithril, it should have been fourteen years ago..." Nick Lemay hesitated to answer Ivan, then turned the pendant over and looked at the name engraved on it. , Continue to speak. "As for this name later, it was engraved more than three years ago."
Fourteen years ago...
Ivan's thoughts moved, from the time point of view, it should be before and after his birth...
And the name on the pendant was engraved three years ago, exactly when he entered Hogwarts.
This made Ivan a little doubtful in his heart. If this crescent moon pendant was prepared for himself, then after he was born, this thing should be engraved and hung on his neck.
In his memory, Aysia has never carried this pendant herself.
Why has a magic item with the function of resisting death curses been sealed for so many years after it was made?
Ivan frowned, really wondering.
"Since there is a question, why don't you just ask her?" Nick LeMay looked at Ivan's contemplation and couldn't help but suggest.
Ivan shrugged helplessly, he wanted to ask.
But if Aysia saw that this crescent moon was broken, he would immediately know that he almost died in Hogwarts.
Because of Aysia's character, he would be furious, not to mention, it is possible to go to Dumbledore to settle the account, so Ivan kept dragging it down.
Nick LeMay saw that Ivan hadn't answered for a long time, so he understood that Ivan had concerns, and stopped asking more, and instead continued to explain the advanced alchemy knowledge.
Ivan did not mention this matter tacitly, and temporarily set aside all the doubts before, and concentrated on studying.
......
Unknowingly, the time of January passed in a flash, and under the guidance of Nick LeMay, Ivan's alchemy level can be said to have improved by leaps and bounds.
Although there is still a long way to go to level seven, the long proficiency has been filled in half.
It takes more than a month to make such a big improvement, Ivan is already very content, because according to Nick LeMay's description and his own guess, level 6 to level 7 may be a huge change!
What makes Ivan even more happy is that Nick LeMay finally let go of his apprenticeship, promising to accept him as his apprentice when he repairs the meniscus pendant!
After having a clear goal, Ivan worked harder and hesitated to use grade points to speed up his learning progress. A week ago, Ivan read several books recommended by Nick LeMay.
In the following time, Ivan spent time in the studio experimenting with the alchemy knowledge he had learned, especially considering how to repair the meniscus pendant.
A few days ago, Ivan learned how to use emotional power from Nick LeMay, which can be roughly divided into two types.
The first method is to use a specific magic spell to help inject strong and pure emotions into alchemy items.
The advantage is that it takes a short time and is very convenient, but the disadvantage is that it is difficult. Once it fails, this alchemy item will become extremely unstable and may be accompanied by certain risks.
The second method is more troublesome and takes a long time, so he doesn't even consider it.
Ivan was thinking silently in his mind, but the movement in his hand didn't stop, waving the carving knife in his hand and burning the magic text on a talisman little by little.
Focus... guide emotions!
Ivan tried his best to follow the method given by Nick LeMay, and it took several hours to engrave the last magic text.
"I hope it works!"
Ivan glanced at the talisman he had made with a guilty conscience. After thinking about it, he felt a little uneasy. Then he blessed himself with an iron armor curse. Then he closed his eyes and began to think about the situation when he was in danger.
This magic is similar to the patron saint curse that condenses happiness, both are the power to condense emotions...
Ivan tried hard to recall, his heart full of willingness to protect himself, and then drew out his wand and put the talisman on the tip of the wand, trying to enter some magic power in.
Strands of silver "silk thread" drifted along the tip of the stick into the talisman The magic inscriptions on the surface of the talisman lit up one after another.
If Ivan opened his eyes, he could see that the silver "silk thread" was not pure, it was still mixed with a little black and red light, and because of this, the color of the amulet became deeper and deeper, and it gradually became hot.
A feeling of palpitation suddenly rushed to my heart, interrupting Ivan's thoughts, he opened his eyes and noticed the abnormality of the amulet.
Ivan's face suddenly changed, and with a wave of his wand, a wave of air lifted off the talisman and flew out, and fell directly into a pool of water.
嘭~
The next moment, a silent explosion sounded, and the violent magic power in the talisman was completely out of control, and the pool water was blown up everywhere, and the whole studio was like a light rain.
"Unfortunately... I failed again!" Ivan looked at this scene, sighed, and a thin magic barrier flashed across his body, blocking the water droplets outside, and then waved his wand again and began to cast the healing spell to clean up the mess.
A few seconds later, under the action of magic power, everything seemed to be back to the original state. Ivan took out the badly damaged talisman from the pool, shook his head, and threw it into a box of discarded items.
[Ding, after a period of practice, your alchemy level has improved slightly, the current level is six]
In his mind, the system prompt sounded, but Ivan didn't pay any attention at all, and looked a little frustrated.
In this week, he has conducted similar experiments many times, but all failed without exception. He only accumulated a lot of failure experience, and there was no successful example.
It seems that condensing strong and pure emotions is more difficult than he thought!

chapters.title: Chapter 552: Hogwarts is a very suitable place, isn't it?
chapters.content:
Ivan thought that he was full of confidence some time ago, and told Nick LeMay that he would soon learn this magic scene, his face became a little embarrassed.
No wonder Nick LeMay just smiled and said nothing. Now it seems that the other party clearly knows that this special alchemy method is not so easy to succeed.
Ivan looked at the discarded items scattered on the workbench, shook his head helplessly, glanced at the darkening sky outside the window, touched the empty stomach, and put down the carving knife in his hand.
Troubles belong to troubles, but Ivan still knows the principle of the combination of work and rest.
After cleaning up the messy studio, Ivan took the book all the way to the living room to enjoy today’s dinner.
And Nick LeMay has already been waiting there.
"How is it? Do you have a clue?" Seeing Ivan walking over with a sad face, Nick LeMay, who was eating the pastry, turned his head and asked.
Ivan walked straight to the other side and sat down, grabbed a piece of pumpkin pie, took a few bites, and said in a vague tone.
"I've tried it many times, but it still doesn't work, I always feel that something is missing..."
"Ah...Is that so?" Nick LeMay said with a smile, not surprisingly at all.
To guide and use one's own emotions to inject a certain will into alchemy items is a very high-end alchemy. Alchemists who can do this in the entire magical world can count it with one hand.
If Ivan can master it in more than a month, then other alchemists who have been studying for decades and have no access to it will not be ashamed to commit suicide.
In fact, when Ivan was in trouble, Nick LeMay felt calmer, because the learning speed of this little wizard was so fast!
Ordinary wizards need to learn several months of knowledge, and Ivan can often master it within a week.
If this alchemy knowledge had not been sorted out by him over the years, and had never been passed on, Nick LeMay could not help but wonder if Ivan had learned it in advance, and then pretended to deliberately fool himself.
"Teacher, is there no trickery?" Ivan didn't know what Nick LeMay was thinking, but frowned and asked.
Nick raised his brows and his expression became serious. "Halse, I need to remind you that alchemy is an extremely delicate subject, and you can't make real progress by specializing in tricks."
Ivan’s heart slammed, and he immediately understood that he had said something wrong, and immediately wanted to apologize, but Nick LeMay waved his hand at this moment and interrupted his words.
"You are a little too eager these days... At your age, there is still a lot of time to learn slowly. The improvement of alchemy requires years of accumulation, and it is not possible to do it overnight!" Nick- Le May reminded me earnestly.
In the past month or so, while surprised by Ivan’s ability to learn, Nick LeMay has also been a little puzzled by Ivan’s hard work.
In theory, shouldn't a little wizard of this age be more keen to play around?
When Ivan asked about the Magic TV before, he was a little worried that Ivan would be addicted to the cartoons produced by Muggles. As a result, the Magic TV has not been turned on for so long...
Nicole Lemay can’t understand the reason, but he can only attribute it to Ivan’s precociousness and his ability to restrain his desires.
"I see, teacher!" Listening to Nick LeMay's words, Ivan nodded and quickly adjusted it. In the past few days, he was indeed a little too anxious.
However, he can't be blamed for this. After all, whether it is the pressure caused by the prophecy, or the restless dark wizards in Knockdown Alley, they are forcing Ivan to improve his strength as soon as possible.
Otherwise, once you encounter a powerful enemy that is difficult to solve in a short period of time, the combat power disguised by the bloodline magic that consumes a lot of mana and the blessing of the strengthened magic text will be instantly dismantled!
By that time, who knows whether these dark wizards will be obedient, if it is a collective backlash or some small actions in private, it will be troublesome.
Therefore, the improvement of strength is urgent in Ivan's view!
is only the transformation technique he is best at in terms of magic. After reaching the sixth level, the increase in proficiency has become slower and slower. Recently, it has reached a point of near stagnation and can't find the way forward.
It just so happened that Nick LeMay was willing to teach him alchemy, and he was ready to find a breakthrough in this regard.
After all, alchemy, like magic, is a method of using magic power. The two final forms have the same goal in different ways, both for the wizard to become a **** of "what the heart thinks is reality"!
Injecting self-will into alchemy items to achieve a certain effect is somewhat similar to the casting state of what you want to happen. Ivan thinks that if he can improve alchemy to level 7, it will definitely improve other magic. s help.
Of course, Ivan did not say these thoughts, but hid them in his heart. The various experiences in Knockturn Alley taught Ivan to shut up in timeSometimes I said in front of smart people. Too much is not a good thing, and maybe something extraordinary will be made up by the brain.
Nick LeMay did not say much after reminding him a few words. Instead, he took out a letter and placed it in front of Ivan.
Ivan picked up the envelope and glanced curiously, noticed the Hogwarts school badge on it, and suddenly guessed the contents of the envelope.
"This was sent by Phoenix Fox. I think Albus wanted to remind you not to delay the start of school. You have lived here for a month and a half, and Hogwarts is about to start even if you count the time." Nick- Le May said with a smile.
"So fast?" Ivan muttered to himself, opened the envelope and took a look.
The content in 　　 is the same as in the past. It was told that he would go to London's King's Cross Station on the train to go to school on September 1, and attached the book list for this school year at the end.
School is about to start, but Ivan is not very happy. With his current level of magic, Hogwarts has not much to teach him.
The most important thing is that without Nick LeMay’s guidance, the growth of alchemy proficiency will probably become very slow, and you will have to wait another year to break through your bottleneck.
"Hals, blindly mechanical learning can't provide you much help, let alone let you experience this kind of strong and pure power. If you have never experienced it, how can you talk about using it?" Nick Le May asked.
Hearing this, Ivan suddenly fell into contemplation.
Nick LeMay pointed to the envelope in his hand and continued. "Hogwarts is a very suitable place, isn't it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 553: Actually... we have no plans at all!
chapters.content:
"Injecting will into alchemy items is an extremely special alchemy technique, and no one can help you in this process."
"But your talent is very good. Experience more things, I think you will experience it!"
Nick LeMay looked at Ivan and made the final summary.
Hearing this, Ivan fell into deep thought, and he gradually understood what he lacked.
Unlike what Nick Le May imagined, he is not without any experience.
If it were changed to a year ago, Ivan felt that he might be able to use the power of hatred to try to make a powerful black magic item.
However, since I got the time converter and understood the causes and consequences of everything, this powerful negative emotion has become a lot weaker, and some memories have been buried deep in my heart.
Ivan doesn't want to recall those painful scenes at all. It is obviously impossible to use this to break through the bottleneck.
"I understand, teacher, I will go back to school on time!" Ivan quickly adjusted his mood.
Although the Hogwarts course has not given him much help, he still needs to take the course.
Just staying here can't cause emotional fluctuations, not to mention that you can get grade points in class, which can be used to speed up the progress of learning, but it is not a loss.
Seeing Ivan finally figured it out, Nick LeMay smiled and nodded.
He emphatically reminded this point. In addition to making Ivan aware of his shortcomings, he also did not want Ivan to devote himself to learning. At such an age, he wanted to improve his strength, thus ignoring some more important things. .
After making the decision, in the next few days, in addition to daily study and experimentation, Ivan took some time to return to Diagon Alley to buy this year's school equipment.
Originally, Ivan wanted to experience the French style. He went to the magical world of Paris to purchase supplies, but the books he bought were all in French, and they were not the same set of Hogwarts textbooks. That was why he put out this idea.
On the last day before school started, Ivante took a trip back to Knockoff Alley, and changed into an owl form to look at the status quo of the wizards, and then bid farewell to Aysia privately.
There is no way, he is already scared by those brain remedies, and it is better to hide before the mind can be read at will.
"It's hard to come back once, why don't you stay for a while...I have lost so much weight and dark circles are coming out. Are you not used to living with your new teacher?" Aysia gently squeezed Ivan's On his cheeks, he looked at Ivan's eyes with some distress, because of the faint dark circles formed by staying up all night for a long time.
"No, I am used to living there, and I have learned a lot..." Ivan shook his head quickly, telling his own experience these days.
From the alchemy creatures and magic potted plants that he saw after entering the door, to the later analysis of alchemy, Ivan said in great detail, but selectively omitted the existence of Dumbledore and the related topics of the crescent moon pendant.
As for whether this will affect the reclusive Nick LeMay?
Ivan was not worried, because Aisia knew that he had been visiting the alchemist master in the past two months, and if he wanted to get to this residence, he must have the corresponding coordinates, so it would not cause any hindrance.
The only thing to worry about is the spread of some secret knowledge.
Fortunately, after these days of understanding, Ivan found out that Nick Lemay has no doorway, nor is it the kind of wizard who hides knowledge and teaches others.
So Ivan tried his tone a few days ago, and now he dared to tell Aysia the conversation between him and Nick LeMay.
Under Ivan’s slow narration, Esiah quickly sank into it, especially when he heard Nick Lemay’s explanation of the nature of magic and alchemy, his face was even more shocked.
"What the heart thinks is reality..." Aisia muttered.
"Well, the teacher told me this is the end of magic!" Ivan said.
Aisia would naturally not question Nick LeMay’s explanation of magic, but this kind of statement is so strange that she can't help but wonder, can there really be wizards that can do this?
It is impossible to be called a person anymore, omnipotence and omnipotence?
"By the way, did you just say that Mr. Nick LeMay has not officially accepted you as a disciple?" Aisia thought of Ivan's previous words and asked strangely.
"That's right, the teacher gave me a test, saying that I would consider accepting an apprentice when I passed it." Ivan shrugged helplessly.
"Really? Then you have to work hard...what is the test?" Aysia said with a smile, not too worried.
In her opinion, since Nick LeMay is willing to teach Ivan so much core knowledge, it proves that the other party intends to accept his child as a disciple.
"Hmm... it's repairing a very special alchemy item..." Ivan vaguely fooled the past, and was scolded, and didn't intend to talk about the crescent moon pendant.
Aixia didn't ask much, but thought it was a non-disclosure. She believed that with Ivan's cleverness, she would definitely not be stumped by a small test.
Ivan also hurriedly changed the subject to understand the current situation of Knockdown Alley, especially to know if the restless dark wizards have made any moths.
"The training is going very smoothly, it looks a little bit already, and the number of law enforcement teams has also increased to ten..." Aisia talked eloquently, and within a few minutes he would talk about what happened in Knockdown Alley for nearly two months All over again.
The work of transforming and recycling the protective ring is also steadily proceeding. It is estimated that within one year, the protective props originally ordered by the Ministry of Magic can be replaced by seven or eight.
Ivan nodded, as long as there are no problems.
Then Ivan handed over the alchemy notes he compiled and summarized during this period to Aysia, which recorded a lot of tricks for setting up secret doors, all of which he asked about from Nick Lemay. .
Unless there is a careful verification by an alchemist of the same level, it is impossible to see that these protective items have been passive.
"With this knowledge, we will be more secretive when we implement the plan." Aysia took the alchemy notes and opened a few glances, and her eyes suddenly brightened.
There are also many capable people in the Department of Mystery Affairs of the Ministry of Magic. The secret door they figured out by themselves may not be sufficiently secretive and may be discovered.
Don't worry about it now, because there is no alchemist who can match Nick LeMay in the Ministry of Magic.
No, in fact, we have no plans at all!
Ivan rolled his eyes, trying to explain, but before he could speak, Aysia suddenly spoke as if he had remembered something.
"You wait here first, I almost forgot to give you something!"

chapters.title: Chapter 554: Manifesto of the Dark Lord in the New Century
chapters.content:
Ivan waited in place curiously.
A few minutes later, Aysia walked out of the house with a book in her hand.
"Gleason asked me to pass it on to you a few days ago. I think it's pretty good. If you have time, take time to see if it works..." Esiah handed the book in her hand to Ivan.
Gleason? Ivan thought for a while. He didn't have any impression of this name. He only remembered that he had seen it on the list of personnel given to him by Dougte, who was one of his subordinates.
Ivan took it over and glanced at it. On the cover, the "New Century Declaration" was engraved with gold and red lines.
The background is a painting, which looks like a hand-painted style. It outlines the scene with only black and white lines. It can be vaguely seen that it is a small wizard surrounded by a group of people, standing in the center, raising his left hand, doing What is the action.
The pure black scenery around has left a strip of white lines, extending from the man's left hand, which seems to represent endless light...There are also several wizards who knelt at his feet and confessed as if they had been inspired.
Ivan frowned, suspecting that this book was a brochure for a certain cult, but how did he feel that the scene was so familiar?
However, I opened it from the middle and found out that it seemed to be a philosophical book with some religious thoughts.
[He was born with knowledge, has great wisdom...]
[He is the only light in the darkness, and will surely lead us to prosperity...]
After scanning a few lines, Ivan curled his lips. He had never been interested in such books. He even suspected that Gleason was a fanatical religious man and planned to draw him into religion...
In view of the special title and Aysia's suggestion, Ivan closed his backhand and decided to take some time to read it when he went back.
If it is the same as he thought, then he has to consider kicking Gleason out of Knockout Alley, so as not to fool other wizards.
"Mom, it's not early, I'm afraid I have to go back." Ivan put away the book, looked at the clock hanging on the wall and said.
Aisia rubbed Ivan's hair a little bit reluctantly, but didn't say anything to keep it, just reminding Ivan not to forget to send her regular letters when he arrived at school.
"Of course...I will remember! A month...not once a week!" Ivan replied vowedly.
"It would be strange if you can remember! How many letters have you voluntarily sent me in the past few years? And you promised me every Christmas. Which time did you come back?"
Esiah stretched out his hand and flicked Ivan's forehead, and told Ivan to write it down and hang it in a conspicuous place, otherwise he would forget it after turning his head.
Ivan shrugged helplessly, how could he be to blame?
Every year at Hogwarts, there will be a lot of messy things that need to be dealt with. In the past two years around Christmas, he was either embarking on a new blood fusion, or was pitted by Dumbledore and was helping him with his tail. How could he get it back?
And this year Hogwarts will host the Triwizard Tournament, and Voldemort is secretly planning the resurrection. Ivan does not have a bottom line about whether he can come back at Christmas, and he dare not give any guarantees at all. past...
After bidding farewell to Aisia, Ivan cast an Apparition and returned to Nick LeMay’s mansion.
Such a long-distance spatial displacement twice a day, even if Ivan's magic power reserves have surpassed that of ordinary adult wizards, it is still somewhat overwhelming.
Fortunately, London is not too far from Paris, otherwise he must be drained!
Ivan shook his head and walked into the house all the way from the courtyard. A group of small alchemists screamed and screamed, and the weird green plants on the side shook without wind, seeming to welcome him home.
Ivan is not surprised, he has been familiar with the alchemy creatures and magic plants here for more than a month, and the relationship is very close.
"Wu Ka Ka... Where's the teacher?" Ivan looked left and right without seeing Nick LeMay, before looking at the "little carrot heads".
The latter pointed him in the direction of the studio. Ivan suddenly understood that it seemed that Nick Lemay was a little fascinated by his research, and did not come out for afternoon tea as usual.
"What is the teacher studying..." Ivan looked at the closed door of the studio on the first floor, and secretly guessed.
He thought that Nick Lemay was repairing the Deathly Hallows-the Resurrection Stone during this period, but when he entered the studio for advice yesterday, he unexpectedly saw the alchemist drawing a drawing.
Even though I only had time to look at it a few times, Ivan turned his eyes away, but because the impression was too deep, he clearly remembered that a strange device was drawn on the drawing.
The whole thing is drawn with the magic text that guides the magic power, with a groove in the center, inlaid with a bright red irregular stone, which looks exactly like the magic stone he has seen before.
Obviously, what Nick Le May has concentrated on is related to the Sorcerer's Stone, not the resurrection stone he expected!
But if he remembers correctly, the Philosopher’s Stone has already been destroyed. What use is there to study this?
Still saying... the destruction of the Philosopher’s Stone was actually a fake news?
Even if this is the case, Ivan feels a little strange.
Because Dumbledore once clearly said to ask Nick LeMay to "repair" an item, he guessed that it had something to do with the Resurrection Stone.
Other things simply don’t correspond.
Ivan touched his chin I suspected that Nick Lemay might be studying multiple things at the same time, but after thinking about it, I think it’s impossible.
Dumbledore was very anxious at the time. He wanted to shorten the "repair" time as much as possible. With the friendly relationship between the two, Nick LeMay shouldn't share his energy by fishing and researching other topics.
alas... forget it!
After thinking about it for a long time, I didn't understand, Ivan had to shook his head and left it behind. Anyway, he couldn't control the affairs between these big guys.
After teasing the alchemy creatures and watering the weird green plants, Ivan went straight back to his room, curiously opened the "New Century Manifesto" and read it.
Turning to the first page, Ivan was stunned when he saw the golden-red preface that was magnified several times.
[We should measure the value of a wizard by his level of magic rather than his blood. The theory of blood is just the humble opinion of the ignorant... This is the magic world, and magic is the power! 】
"Wait, isn't this what I said before? Why is it in this book?" Ivan was very surprised, looking at the signature below, it turned out to be his own name.
That cover... Ivan suddenly thought of something, turned back and took a look, only to remember that it was the scene where he killed Reese Nott in the conference hall more than a month ago.
"No way?" Seeing this, Ivan already had a bad feeling. He hurriedly turned the pages of the book and continued reading a few pages, his expression unpredictable.
"Yep?"
"what?"
"what?!"
......

chapters.title: Chapter 555: You~ You can always come up with something new for me!
chapters.content:
After reading for more than an hour, Ivan finally turned over the two-finger-thick booklet, and his face became extremely exciting.
This "New Century Declaration" is divided into three parts.
The first part is to summarize and analyze the content of his previous speech. Each sentence is divided into a separate page, and at least a thousand words of annotations will be marked below.
Just looking at Ivan, I felt my scalp numb and embarrassed. Even his understanding in his previous life was not so exaggerated... It was similar to the magical version of the Bible or the Analects.
The second part is about his legendary experience in recent years.
However, this part of the words and sentences has a certain deification meaning, and even it has been so magically changed that Ivan can’t recognize the born-knowledge, great wisdom, and great magic power, Ivan Hals, who will lead the wizard to create a new era. You mean yourself...
too exaggerated...
The third part is based on his theory to explain the future changes in the magical world, which is slightly normal in Ivan's view.
The book also specifically pointed out that if you want to liberate the wizard’s productivity, you need to change those old ideas, free the wizard from the meaningless and boring work, and invest in more meaningful magic research...
"Gleason?!" Ivan turned to the last page and snapped the "New Century Declaration" together, muttering to himself with a headache.
These people can do things like this?
He hid in the safe house in Paris, and he didn't plan to let him go...
If possible, Ivan would like to drag the wizard named Gleason over to teach him a lesson, lest this guy think about how to make new tricks all day long to claim credit.
Ivan was a little itchy with anger. After calming down, he looked at the book again, but didn't know what to do for a while.
Putting aside those prejudices, Ivan also has to admit that the "New Century Manifesto" is indeed a book with progressive ideas, and it sums up some of his ideas very well.
The content is simple, easy to understand and thought-provoking. It presents the shortcomings and predicaments of the current magical world in front of the readers, and also puts forward some practical solutions in the analysis and summary.
Even Ivan also benefited a lot after reading it. From time to time, he would suddenly have a feeling of "I used to think so, I have such a foresight".
As for the deliberate or unintentional deification in the second part of the legendary experience, Ivan thought about it carefully and understood the deep meaning.
Obviously, Gleason thought he wanted to engage in personality cultism.
Ivan has read history books. Of course, it is clear that in some extreme cases, propaganda in this way can greatly increase the cohesion of a team in a short period of time and cultivate a group of subordinates who are fanatical and enthusiastic.
But history also proves that personality cultism is a double-edged sword. Almost all the extreme examples Ivan can think of are wrong!
The reason is very simple. Followers usually believe that "God" is perfect and cannot make mistakes. This leads to "God" having absolute authority. No one dares to deny the words of "God".
It is a pity that all those who are sublimated into gods and thus supported by everyone are still human beings...
As long as you are an individual, it is impossible not to make mistakes forever, and to make absolutely correct choices in everything!
Once an error occurs, the blind obedience of a large number of supporters can easily magnify this wrong behavior infinitely, and eventually become difficult to deal with.
Ivan reached out and took a piece of parchment from the side, holding a quill in his hand, but hesitated for a long time without falling.
According to his original idea, he should write a severely worded letter, scolding Gleason for his self-assertion, so that he could restrain himself and burn the book or seal it up.
Because according to Gleason's idea, he handed out a copy to the wizards of Knockdown Alley, so I would definitely feel very uncomfortable in the future.
Being deified is not a good thing. It means that every word and deed of oneself needs to be careful and maintain one's own image.
When I first went back to Knockout Alley, Ivan deliberately pretended to be a strong and vicious look and couldn't stand it in just a week in order to calm the dark wizards, and was forced to hide in this safe house.
If it lasts for a few years or more than ten years, then he won’t be crazy!
In addition, Ivan is a little worried that this "New Century Manifesto" renders him too powerful, and if he can't help it, accidentally wears it, it is likely to cause the collapse of his faith.
The wizards who realize they have been deceived may do something crazy.
This is also the reason why Ivan feels that this new century manifesto needs to be sealed, and it is too easy to cause some trouble for himself.
If it was accidentally spread out and spread on a large scale, and attracted the attention of the Ministry of Magic, it would be even worse.
According to the information he has learned through many contacts with Fudge, the Minister of Magic is a real conservative. His ruling philosophy is mainly to maintain stability. It is impossible to support such radical ideas, and may even be resisted and traced to the source. .
In the end, he will definitely be found on his head, because the "New Century Manifesto" was written around him, and his name is clearly written on itOf course, based on his age and in the magic world In terms of popularity, publishing such a book that promotes radical reforms and self-deification can only be regarded as very out of the ordinary. There is no clear violation of the law. Fudge cannot help him at all, and at most explicitly prohibits the spread of the book.
But if he raised a large number of dark wizards in Knockdown Alley, and trained day and night to capture the wizarding market, it is not necessarily the case!
Fudge will never allow such an army of wizards to threaten the Ministry of Magic!
This Minister of Magic might still think that he is the next Voldemort, because this kind of gathering people, propagating ideas, and engaging in personality cultism is very similar to the various actions taken when Voldemort emerged.
So an Azkaban will be his final destination...
As for disbanding the subordinates of the wizards and proactively show to the Ministry of Magic to prove their harmlessness?
Ivan didn’t even think about it, only a fool would do that!
The original time and space has repeatedly proved how unreliable the Ministry of Magic is.
In the turbulent days that Voldemort is about to return and Dumbledore’s life is not long before, it would be nice if Fudge can stabilize the situation without adding chaos.
wants to protect himself, he has only two options.
Either leave all of your friends dingy and leave the British magical world, find a place to hide. Either increase your own strength as much as possible, fight in groups if you do not win heads-up, at least don't be squeezed as a soft persimmon by the resurrected Voldemort...
The third option of surrender does not exist. Ivan knows very well that Voldemort, the enemy of the two bombs, must have a deep memory. This is also the reason why he actively destroyed the Horcrux...

chapters.title: Chapter 556: Forgotten book
chapters.content:
After excluding the options of escape and surrender, there is only one road ahead!
That is to increase one's strength as much as possible. Once the situation is critical, use the Courageous Loyalty Curse to hold back. As long as he raises the level of magic, and integrates several bloodlines, Ivan thinks that it is no problem to successfully kill Voldemort...
Because of this, Ivan hesitated how to deal with this "New Century Declaration."
It is not difficult to see how much effort Gleason, as the editor of this booklet, is two-finger-wide and the depth of the content.
Also, only those who think hard every day and are not afraid of staying up late to bald the strong can complete it in less than two months...
If I write a letter directly to refuse and request the burning of the book, it will undoubtedly make Gleason feel chilly, and even feel resentful...
If the hearts of the people are scattered, the team will not be able to lead... Ivan deeply understands this truth, so this matter must be handled carefully!
"Then it can only be modified!" Ivan thought for a long time, and finally made a decision!
After pondering for a while, Ivan slowly began to write, and first praised Gleason's progressive ideas expounded in the book in a complimentary tone, and said that Gleason's understanding and summary of his own words were very good.
But at the same time, Ivan also mentioned in his letter that he was not satisfied with the contents of the first and second parts of the "New Century Declaration" and needed to be revised, and hinted that Gleason should focus on elaborating the concept and weaken the content Personality cult thought.
That's right... it's a weakening, not a complete removal!
Although personal cultism has many disadvantages, if it is well controlled, it is not unusable.
For example, during the Muggle World War, both belligerent countries used this method. The difference is the difference in degree. The most extreme example is the mustache...
Ivan does not want to be deified, but as a pioneer, he can use this identity and the ideas promoted in the "New Century Manifesto" to improve the team's sense of identity.
No way, compared to forces that have operated for decades like the Order of the Phoenix and Death Eaters, the wizards on his side were all temporarily pulled up in Knockdown Alley. If you want to ensure loyalty, you have to think more about crooked ideas. Row.
In a sense, Gleason is indeed an individual talent. The idea of ​​brainwashing with brochures is very good, but it is a pity that talent is used in the wrong place.
If the other party is a Death Eater and changes this pamphlet to a pure blood theory, then Voldemort will definitely be ecstatic and introduce him as a confidant...
But he doesn't need such extreme concepts here, so these contents must be modified to some extent!
"It's really troublesome..." Ivan threw the book aside, muttering to himself in distress.
He is a person who is not very good at management. Compared to being surrounded by a large number of people, he is more accustomed to fighting alone, so he has no worries.
If it hadn't been for Esiah to recruit people in Knockturn Alley because of some misunderstanding, he would really not consider developing power.
At the beginning, I made good friends with werewolf wizards such as Fren and Walker only to test the effect of the wolf poison potion, and by the way to prevent the malicious dark wizards in Knockdown Alley.
But now that's the end of the matter, Ivan can only go on so black.
After all, with his current strength, there is a big gap with Voldemort, far from being able to protect himself by fighting alone.
In the original time and space, McGonagall, Slughorn, and Kingsley briefly contained Voldemort in the First Battle of Hogwarts, which shows that in the wizard's battle, the number is not completely useless.
It is still necessary to have more trusted helpers, at least to help contain the large number of Death Eaters.
Ivan lay exhausted on the bed, thinking about the Goblet of Fire to be held this year and the strange snake face after Voldemort's resurrection.
......
the next morning.
Ivan was awakened by a loud noise. When he opened his eyes, he saw a large number of small alchemy creatures beating on the bedside table. Obviously the sound he heard just now was caused by these little guys.
Ivan frowned and was about to complain a few words when he saw these "little carrot heads" pushing a large clock over.
The time above points to ten twenty...
"It's actually so late!" Ivan's face changed, only to realize that this group of alchemy creatures kindly wanted to remind themselves.
"Thanks, Wu Ka Ka..." Ivan said apologetically, and a carp quickly sat up.
quickly got dressed, and after washing in the bathroom, Ivan grabbed his suitcase as quickly as possible, lifted the owl's cage, and rushed downstairs.
It’s okay if he doesn’t hurry up. The Hogwarts train departs at eleven o'clock, and he has been delayed for several minutes just getting dressed and washed.
Thanks to him, he had prepared everything he was going to bring a few days earlier.
"See you next year, Wu Ka Ka!" Ivan went out hurriedly. When the door closed, he did not forget to say goodbye.
The alchemy creatures in the room waved their hands at Ivan, yelling goodbye in their mouths After the door was closed, they piled up and assembled into a small robot 70 cm tall. , The routine began to make the bed and clean the room.
After stacking the beds and putting everything in place, the alchemy creatures unexpectedly noticed a book that was thrown into the corner, and gathered curiously...
At the same time, Ivan walked downstairs, passing by the living room, and happened to see Nick LeMay coming out of the studio.
"Hals, if I hadn't asked Ukhaka to call you, you might have missed this year's train..." Nick LeMay looked at the clock on the wall and said jokingly.
"I'm sorry, teacher, it was a little late yesterday!" Ivan awkwardly scratched his hair, because last night he thought about Voldemort's things before going to bed, and in his sleep there was the snake without a nose. The face... was so ugly that he almost woke him up.
"Then you have to hurry up... No, I'll save breakfast for you, let's eat a little bit later!" Nick LeMay smiled and pointed to the polenta and a few slices of bread on the table. Said.
Ivan nodded, took the bowl of polenta and drank it cleanly, grabbed a piece of bread and stuffed it in his mouth, ran out, and said goodbye to Nick LeMay without a word.
"Teacher... see you next year!"
Nick LeMay looked at the back of Ivan hurriedly leaving, shook his head amusedly and said nothing.
ran all the way to the courtyard outside the hut, Ivan thought of Kingdom Cross Station in his mind, waved his wand vigorously, and recited the spell.
"Apparition!"
A vortex of space engulfed Ivan in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 557: Nick: If it weren't for this book, I don't even know you are doing this again...
chapters.content:
After bidding farewell to Ivan, Nick Lemay took the drawing and sat on the sofa in the living room, drinking morning tea while pondering the idea of ​​improving the device.
At this moment, there was a sudden "boom boom" down the stairs on the stairs not far away, which sounded very hurried.
Nick LeMay turned his head strangely and looked over, and he saw a 70 cm tall little robot holding a book and quickly jumping down the stairs.
Perhaps because of his short height and being too anxious, the little robot suddenly failed to step on the right steps, his body suddenly lost his balance, and fell heavily on the next step, just like a “thump-thump-thump” obedience all the way. It rolled down.
The alchemy creatures that make up the robot screamed in panic, clutching their companions with both hands, but due to inertia, many alchemy creatures outside were thrown out, and finally hit the ground. At that time, it just fell apart and broke into one place...
Seeing this scene, Nick LeMay shook his head. It seemed that these alchemy creatures had to be improved a little bit.
The "little turnip heads" scattered on the ground quickly regrouped after a few seconds of panic.
But they weren't grouped together, but like an ant moving house, he lifted up the thick booklet and moved it slowly in front of Nick LeMay.
"What is this?" Nick LeMay picked up the pamphlet curiously, and was fascinated by the picture on the cover.
"New Century Declaration"?
Nick LeMay looked at the name of the booklet and couldn't help frowning.
The little alchemy creatures are talking about something. Although it sounds like meaningless words like "Ullara", Nick LeMay can accurately hear what they want to express.
"You found it in the corner of Hals' room..." Nick LeMay nodded. It should be something Ivan forgot to bring...
Nick LeMay drew out his wand and wanted to cast a spell to notify Dumbledore, asking Fox to pick it up, and return it to him when Ivan arrived at the school.
Just looking at the picture on the cover of the booklet, Nick LeMay hesitated.
This kind of thing that is easy to carry around and painted with weird patterns always reminds him of the catastrophe that spread across Europe decades ago.
When Grindelwald emerged in the European magic world, he often promoted his ideas through speeches and distributing brochures.
This "New Century Proclamation" seems to him to be the same thing, and Nick LeMay can't help but worry about whether Ivan will be fooled by others.
After all, a 14-five-year-old little wizard is in the process of shaping the Three Views, and he is very easily affected by some extreme concepts, leading to an evil path. Nick Lemay originally intended to accept Ivan as a disciple, and it is even more impossible to let it go. Up.
Thinking of this, Nick LeMay tried to turn the pages of the book, and then he saw the preface above.
[We should measure the value of a wizard by his level of magic rather than bloodliness...——Ivan Hals]
Seeing the content of the preface and the final signature, Nick LeMay's face changed slightly, and he looked a little surprised.
Nick LeMay thought that this "Declaration of New Century" was given to Ivan by someone who wanted to confuse him, but he didn't expect the situation to be the opposite. The content in this booklet was written by Ivan himself. I intend to use this to explain a certain kind of thought...
"Anti-blood theory?"
Nick LeMay raised his eyebrows, guessed something from the prologue, after hesitating for a moment, he continued to look through it.
The more I look at Nick LeMay's expression, the more serious it becomes, but it quickly turns into a thoughtful look.
Because he discovered that the content written in the "New Century Manifesto" is not purely opposed to pure blood, and does not mean to beat the pure blood wizard to death, but advocates equality and weakens the advantage and influence of pure blood wizards as much as possible.
Some of the ideas explained in 　　 also made Nick Le May very interested. They are all aimed at the shortcomings of the current magical world, and seem to incorporate a part of Muggle ideas.
As for the length of Ivan’s deification of himself, Nick LeMay ignored it. Personality cultism is regarded as the most commonly used method by emerging forces.
"I didn't expect Hals to have such deep thoughts at this age..." At the end, Nick LeMay slowly put down the booklet and couldn't help but sigh with emotion.
It's normal for a little wizard to have the idea of ​​changing the magic world on a whim. What is really rare is that Ivan can analyze the reasons for it and give some plans.
"Genius?" Nick Le May muttered to himself.
He remembered the conversation he had with Dumbledore last year. It is no wonder that the strongest white wizard in England paid so much attention to Ivan Hals, even a little jealous.
Now he understands...
During the one and a half months in this mansion, Ivan has been gentle and polite, like a precocious big boy. If it weren’t for this "New Century Proclamation," Nick Le May would never have thought that Ivan would have hidden this. Such a big ambition!
This skill of disguise and forbearance is really shocking!
"No, it's not right shouldn't be pretended." Nick LeMay shook his head and rejected the idea. He lived more than six hundred years old. Naturally, he has a way of seeing people. No matter how old the little wizard pretends, there is no reason to hide it from him.
There is no conflict between being ambitious and being gentle and polite...
"Unfortunately, it's still a little tender..." Nick LeMay looked at the booklet placed on the table and said with a sigh.
The concept of ignoring ancestry and that all people are equal based on ability is too idealistic. It is okay to shout slogans. If you want to really implement it in the magical world, there is a lot of resistance, and it will inevitably meet opposition from all parties.
Of course, in the eyes of Nick LeMay, these are all small things. With Ivan's talent, the magical world will have no rivals in ten years, and it will be a big deal.
The important thing is that Ivan wants to completely reform the magic world and promote communication between Muggles and wizards. This will touch the bottom line of many people, break the hundreds of years of tacit understanding between Muggles and wizards, and make it unpredictable. s consequence.
You must know that signing a secrecy law to isolate the wizarding world from Muggles is not just a move by England or a region in Europe, but the consensus of the entire wizarding world!
In these hundreds of years, many smart people can see that the power balance of wizards and Muggles is gradually tilting toward the latter.
There are not a few wizards who want to fight and break the tradition, and Grindelwald is only one of the most radical in the past 100 years!
But these people failed without exception...
Those in power who put out the flames of reform are certainly not fools, because isolating the Muggle world from the wizarding world is precisely the gentlest they can think of... and the only feasible move!

chapters.title: Chapter 558: Let fate make the decision! (2 in 1)
chapters.content:
Thinking of this, Nick Le May unavoidably felt a little powerless.
Don't look at the existence of wizards as a secret to ordinary Muggles, but the top Muggles know it.
The two sides usually establish a certain cooperative relationship. As for whether the status is equal, it depends on the balance of power between the Muggle government and the magical world.
For example, in France, the Muggle government has weak control over the wizarding world. The Ministry of Magic is nominally a department of the country, but it has a high degree of freedom and tends to complement each other. It also has corresponding seats in the Muggle parliament.
In addition, the Muggle government will help conceal the existence of the magical world and allow the magic academy to recruit students in the local area... It can be said that the magical world can smoothly conceal it with the help of the top Muggle leaders. Indispensable.
In exchange, the Ministry of Magic will supervise the wizards in the country, regulate their behavior, and send a powerful Auror to protect the president and important officials to prevent the Muggle head from being controlled by some malicious wizards, or even spy wizards sent from other countries. .
occasionally deals with things that the Muggle government does not handle.
Therefore, the attitudes of various countries towards the group of wizards are very contradictory. To put it briefly, it is necessary to win and be guarded!
The wooing is to resist the wizards of other countries and guarantee the interests of the country.
Defense is the magical ability of fear wizards to modify memories, read thoughts, and teleport!
Anyone in power does not want to become a puppet in the hands of others one day.
The two worlds have always maintained a delicate balance in this contradictory relationship!
Until now, there has been no major trouble. The "International Wizarding Union Confidentiality Act" signed in 1689 and officially promulgated in 1692 is absolutely indispensable!
The basis for the birth of this law is that Muggle witch hunts began to intensify in the 15th century.
At that time, Muggle's persecution of witches and wizards had reached an extreme point.
Although wizards are born with magical powers, they are too few.
At that time, the total number of wizards in Europe was probably less than 10,000, and they were scattered in various countries and regions. Most of them had not been systematically studied. They could only release some weak magic by instinct. The strength was very weak and difficult. Resist the persecution of Muggles!
The implementation of the "International Wizarding Federation Confidentiality Act" has created shelters for wizards, isolating the magical world from the Muggle world, uniting scattered compatriots, and gathering strength to learn magic. Melon dare not act rashly.
It can be said that this law has greatly eased the most intense low-level conflict between wizards and Muggles, turning it into high-level communication.
But this also caused a lot of hidden dangers, making most wizards forced to be out of touch with the times.
Since then, the Muggle world has made fewer and fewer actions against wizards, and after the Industrial Revolution, it has completely turned to Huairou.
Because the Muggle elite knows who will benefit from this delay, this method of boiling frogs in warm water also avoids the war between wizards and Muggles. It is perfect!
The wizards who took the initiative to hide are bound by their cocoons, and they can’t say anything.
Who would have thought that in just a few hundred years, the Muggle world would have undergone earth-shaking changes!
In comparison, the speed of magic changes is far less than that of technology, and the wizards are all trapped in a small circle, and the ideology is obsolete, which causes the gap to widen.
