When they finally made up their minds to make changes, they found that this state has been going on for hundreds of years, and it has become the consensus of the world. Change means facing greater obstacles!
Not everyone has this courage and is willing to bear the consequences!
Turn a blind eye, maintain the status quo and wait for the successor to deal with it, becoming the first choice of most people in power in the magical world!
Nick LeMay sighed slowly, opened the "New Century Declaration" again, and looked at the beautiful imagination of wizards and Muggles in the book, and felt more naive.
But there is also a trace of yearning...
"Peace, communication... new era..." Nick Le May muttered to himself, can such a vision really be realized?
Vaguely, Nick LeMay remembered the previous conversation with Dumbledore, and suddenly felt that Dumbledore might be right. This should be the best opportunity!
Nick LeMay flipped through the book, revisited the content of the "New Century Declaration", and said with a smile when he saw the words calling for change at the end.
"Oh, the writing is pretty good!"
Although Ivan’s idea is somewhat idealistic, it is such a pure thing that is often the most attractive and contagious.
If it can be released on a large scale in the magic world, Nico Lemay believes that "New Century Proclamation" will definitely be recognized and even sought after by a large number of young wizards!
"So don't you help that kid?"
In the silent, empty living room, a faint voice suddenly rang.
"I'm too old, two hundred years ago, my old bone might still want to move..." Nick LeMay shook his head and looked at a clearing beside him.
An old witch in a loose robe is standing there, her face is peaceful, wrinkles all over her face tell the traces of the years, and more importantly, her body is illusory, with a faint mist spreading like a ghost. general.
The old witch looked at Nick LeMay with her eyes full of love, but then a little blame appeared on her face, and pointed to Nick LeMay's left hand, saying something in her mouth.
There is no sound around, and only Nick Leme can hear the faint sound.
"No, I can't return this thing to Albus..." Nick LeMay shook his head and rejected the old witch's proposal, gently stroking the ring on his left hand. The black gems on it were very dazzling.
If Dumbledore were here, I would be surprised to find that the ring was intact, and it would not take two years to fix it, as Nick LeMay said.
But the resurrection stone did not hurt the core. For an alchemist like Nick Lemay, eliminating those minor effects is naturally easy, and it doesn't take much time.
I said that deliberately because after a period of research, Nick LeMay found that the energy contained in this Deathly Hallows was amazing, and it was not inferior to the Philosopher's Stone.
The more he studied, the more shocked he became.
In addition, Dumbledore's enthusiasm for the Deathly Hallows also made him very worried.
Nick LeMay once read the collection of English fairy tales. He is very clear about the story of the Deathly Hallows. Coupled with the research these days, he does not think that collecting the Three Hallows can relieve Dumbledore's dilemma.
The resurrection stone does not have the ability to truly resurrect people. Instead, it may become the fuse to destroy the fragile balance of the moment, so he prefers to let this deathly sacred instrument be buried along with his own death.
However, the "New Century Manifesto" written by Ivan has shaken Nick LeMay's original idea.
A powerful and unconstrained force usually stirs up chaos, but it may not be able to turn into a sword overcoming obstacles...
"Forget it, let fate make the decision!" Nick LeMay hesitated, and finally sighed. Anyway, he won't live long. The magic world can't handle things, so he can only leave it to the reserves to toss.
Thinking about this, Nick Lemey frowned and gradually loosened, looking at the old witch in front of him, his face became more and more peaceful, he took off the ring from his hand, and talked one by one in his mouth.
When I finish the last thing, I will accompany you!
The old witch's figure slowly faded, before disappearing, she smiled and nodded, and responded to Nick LeMay's words.
......
At the same time, London’s Kingdom Cross Station,
Along with a shift in space, Ivan's figure appeared out of thin air in an alley near the station.
[Ding, after practice, Apparition/Apparition has been upgraded, the current level is 6]
"Has the Phantom Shift upgraded? It's pretty fast!" Ivan glanced at the system's skill bar and said with emotion.
It seems that the frequent ultra-long-distance teleportation these days can still achieve the effect of exercise... No wonder he has recently felt that the consumption of this magic has been reduced a lot, and it has become more comfortable to use.
If you have time to practice for a while, maybe you can try to practice teleportation in battle.
Ivan thought as he walked towards Kingdom Cross Station with his small suitcase and owl cage.
I was in a hurry when I came just now, and now there is a full 15 minutes before the start, so there is plenty of time.
In fact, even if you accidentally be late and miss the Hogwarts train, it will not have any effect.
He is not Harry or Ron, so he will apparate directly to Hogsmeade Village, and then go back to school through the secret road, which is much faster than taking the train!
Stepping into the station, Ivan went straight to platform nine and three-quarters. When he approached, he was surprised to find that he was here. Harry, Hermione, and the Weasley family were all waiting here, seeming to say something.
Because of her sight, Hermione was the first to see Ivan.
The little witch's face first showed a happy expression, she wanted to step forward, but she soon thought of something, she paused, and her mouth was closed, her face was very ugly.
"Hey, Ivan! This way!" Harry and the others quickly noticed the existence of Ivan and waved their hands.
"Long time no see, Harry!" Ivan smiled and opened his hand, and hugged Harry as he walked forward.
George and Fred also hugged him, jokingly squeezing him and Harry in between.
Ivan reluctantly broke free, looked helplessly at the two Weasley brothers who had escaped, and asked casually. "George and Fred, how is your research recently?"
"It’s superb! Our skipping candy and automatic quill pens are very popular. We received a lot of orders during the summer vacation. We have been busy for a long time before we got enough goods...
There is also the portable swamp that I told you last time. We have also improved it. That thing can turn the entire auditorium into a swamp! If Filch confiscates our inventory this time, I will sneak one and go to his office..."
Speaking of the joke toy, George was very excited and talked endlessly.
"Ahem..." Fred next to him hurriedly coughed a few times and reminded him.
George felt cold behind him, and turned his head slightly trembling, Mrs. Weasley was staring at him with her waist in the dark.
"George... I remember you promised me that your toys won't bother the professors in school!" Mrs. Weasley said angrily.
Although she reluctantly agreed with the Weasley brothers to study joke products because of the previous agreement, it was not without conditions! George promised her that the toys they made were harmless and purely for fun.
"Mom, George promised you that, I'm Fred... He never told me about this, you should scold him!" George played with the usual identity swap with a guilty conscience. Without hesitation, he sold Fred in an attempt to confuse him.
Fred looked at him angrily, and the two soon started fighting.
In the end, neither of them escaped a catastrophe, and Mrs. Weasley was severely taught by Mrs. Weasley, which attracted the attention of a group of passing Muggles.
Ivan looked at the scolded George and Fred, a little embarrassed, he thought that Mrs. Weasley had accepted the magic items they had made before asking!
"Okay, Molly! It's late now, the kids should get on the train!" Arthur Weasley looked at the time, and quickly persuaded Molly, who was still very angry, to save George and Frey. De's ears are about to be deafened.
Immediately afterwards, everyone lined up and prepared to enter the nine and three-quarters platform in twos and threes.
Ivan wanted to enter ~ with Hermione and Harry, but when he approached, he was frightened by Hermione's fierce eyes.
Ivan, confused, had to go in with George and Fred instead.
"Get ready, time is limited, you better hurry up, three... two... one... punch!" Mrs. Weasley issued a command.
Ivan took the lead, holding his suitcase and owl cage, and hurriedly ran into it according to the instructions, and passed through the wall to the Wizard Station.
As the departure time was approaching, the wizard station was very lively and there were noisy noises everywhere. Seven or eight little wizards crowded in front of the train and waved goodbye to their parents. A timid freshman even cried on the spot because of leaving home for the first time.
Two or three seconds later, George and Fred also passed through the wall behind.
"I'm sorry, George, I shouldn't have asked that before..." Ivan said apologetically.
"It's okay, it's not your fault, it's because mom managed to be too wide..." George waved his hand indifferently.
Fred also smiled and said, "It seems we have to make up a communication code next time!"
"Yes! Then mother won't find out." George patted Fred on the shoulder and said very excitedly. "Fred, you are such a genius!"
"Does that still need to be said?! Could it be that you only know today?" Fred raised his eyebrows.
The two laughed happily, and the slaps and anger at each other just now didn't seem to affect their relationship.
Or they just pretended to fool Mrs. Weasley, but it was a pity that they didn't succeed this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 559: What are you hiding from us?
chapters.content:
Looking at the two people like living treasures, Ivan shook his head helplessly.
The three of them waited for a while at the entrance. Harry, Hermione and others entered through the wall one after another, followed by Bill, Charlie, and Weasley.
Everyone was saying their final farewell in front of the train, and Mrs. Weasley kindly hugged everyone.
Charlie smiled while hugging Ginny to say goodbye to her. "I don't think we will be apart for too long... Maybe I will see you again soon!"
"Why do you say that?" Fred asked strangely.
"You'll know when you get to school!" Charlie shrugged, and then added. "By the way, don't tell Percy that I mentioned this... You know, this is'top secret information, and it will not be released until the Ministry of Magic considers it appropriate.'"
"If there is a choice, I really hope I can go back to Hogwarts school this year." Bill on the side also looked at the Hogwarts train in front of him with emotion, with a melancholy expression.
The mysterious appearance of the two of them dangled everyone's interest, and made George, Harry and others very curious.
"What are you hiding from us?" George glared at the two angrily, and asked reluctantly.
However, no matter what he asked, Charlie and Bill were secretive and inconvenient to disclose, making George and the others very depressed.
Ivan did not participate, because he knew that what Charlie and Bill were hiding was the Triwizard Tournament to be held this year!
Although "activities" such as fire fighting dragons, mermaid fighting, and mazes can only be regarded as small scenes in Ivan's eyes, for other wizards, they are indeed thrilling and worthwhile events!
woo...
Just when Bill and Charlie were about to be annoyed by George and the others, a loud whistle sounded, and billowing steam drifted into the sky along the train chimney. Mrs. Weasley quickly interrupted the conversation and drove them away. Get in the car.
"Really, they must know something, but they just want to hide it from us." Ron dragged his luggage along the aisle of the train, grumbling in his mouth.
"Yes, it's not fair!" Fred also agreed with dissatisfaction. Charlie and Bill picked up his curiosity, and half-talked him.
Harry was not too curious about this, but turned to look at Ivan and asked. "Ivan, where did you go during your summer vacation? Why didn't you come to the Burrow, Sirius even bought you Quidditch tickets, but it was a waste..."
"Yeah, you missed this year's Quidditch World Cup! That game was simply amazing! You should really come and see..."
Ron heard Harry mention the Quidditch game, and hurriedly got together, talking endlessly about the wonderful contest between Ireland and Bulgaria in the World Cup!
Especially when talking about Krum, Ron seemed very excited. He talked loudly about how Krum used Ronsky fake moves on the court, and successfully deceived Irish seeker Aidan Lin. Qi, let the opponent fall heavily to the ground...
"After that, Krum successfully won the Snitch and ended the game!" Ron finally concluded, enthusiastically like he himself caught the Snitch in the World Cup.
"But I heard that the Irish team won, didn't you?" Ivan replied casually, wanting to test whether his butterfly has affected the progress of the game.
If he remembers correctly, the Bulgarian team's Krum succeeded in catching the Snitch, but still lost the game because the score was lower than the Irish team.
"That's not to blame Krum, is it? He has done well... it's all other Bulgarian players who didn't cooperate well!"
Ron yelled for Krum, what at the end of the game, the score gap was very small, the Bulgarian batsman scored two more goals Krum can turn defeat into victory, etc...
Ivan rolled his eyes, not wanting to hear Krum’s glorious record, looked straight at Harry, and explained. "Professor Dumbledore gave me a special training this summer. I really don't have time to watch the Quidditch game."
It was not convenient for Ivan to disclose the matter related to Nick LeMay, so I had to throw the pot to Dumbledore.
Anyway, the old professor won't explain it even if he knows it, so there is no need to worry about the risk of being dismantled.
"It turned out to be like this, no wonder you didn't reply to us during the whole summer vacation!" Harry nodded.
"Reply?!" Ivan was startled.
"Yes! We didn't wait for you during the Quidditch game, so we sent you a few letters, but after waiting for a long time, we didn't wait for your reply!"
Harry gave an explanation, then smiled and told Ivan about the funny things that happened when they were a guest in the Burrow.
For example, once, they finally waited for an owl. Hermione mistakenly thought it was Ivan’s letter and was happy to fetch it. But when she opened it, she discovered that Sirius had given it to herself...
Harry talked endlessly, but before she could finish her words, she was so scared that Hermione's fierce eyes shut up.
Ivan's mind was stunned, and he finally remembered what he had forgotten. It turned out that he had forgotten to write to Hermione during the summer vacation!
But this can't be entirely blamed on him.
Everything was fine originally, after all, who knew that so many messy things happened once home.
He was a little wizard who had just entered the fourth grade and became the king of Knock Down Alley somehow. He was forced to fight with those restless subordinates every day, and his head became bigger. How could he remember writing letters?
"I'm sorry, Hermione, Professor Dumbledore took me to a very special place, so I can't receive your letters at all, and my owl can't fly out..." Ivan said with a guilty conscience.
"Then you should inform me before where you are going...I mean, inform us!" Hermione looked very upset, her brown eyes fixed on Ivan and retorted.
Ivan was speechless for a while, he forgot the incident directly, of course it was impossible to inform Hermione.
Without Ivan's response, Hermione couldn't figure out what was going on.
"So you forgot again, didn't you? You do this every time..." The little witch snorted angrily, turned aside her face, holding her luggage, and walked towards the empty box in front of him. He slammed his shoulder hard.
"God, Hals, you forgot all of us!" George pretended to be angrily and stepped up and scolded Ivan fiercely.
Fred did the same. The two sang Ivan out loud, deliberately speaking very loudly so that Hermione could hear it.
But Hermione didn't even look at them, went straight into the box, and closed the door heavily.
The Weasley brothers stopped then, and gave him a helpless, self-seeking look.
They did this just now. In addition to scolding Ivan to calm Hermione, they also wanted to let Hermione know that Ivan didn’t deliberately target her. Even their friends didn’t wait to reply. It was probably delayed by something. .
But it doesn't seem to have any effect now...
"Oh...we can only do so much, please persuade me!" Fred patted Ivan on the shoulder with the appearance of a person, and then pulled George to find a place.
Of course, Ivan can understand the kindness of George and Fred. Looking at the closed door of Hermione's carriage, it is also a headache. How could he forget about writing?
Harry and Ron also hesitated to step forward. They had seen Hermione’s face just now, and neither of them wanted to go in and get in trouble.
"Ivan, should we go in anyway?" Harry asked when he noticed that the train was honking again and was about to start.
"How about we find another empty box?" Ron suggested.
Ivan shook his head and stretched out his hand to push the box door open. He looked around. At this moment, Hermione was sitting in the corner on the right, quietly flipping through a thick book.
Although she heard the door pushing, Hermione didn't mean to raise her head.
Ivan hesitated, then sat down beside the little witch.
Harry and Ron also came in behind them, and sat down opposite Ivan and Hermione tremblingly. I wonder if it was an illusion, they always felt an indescribable pressure spreading in the car...
The weird silence lasted for a long time, the slightly crowded box echoed with the rattling sound of the train when it was running, and the sound of Hermione turning the pages of the book from time to time.
It's just that Ivan, Harry, and Ron didn't notice. Hermione turned the pages of the book much faster than usual. Sometimes the pages were clipped together and turned over without noticing.
"Sorry, Hermione, I promised to write to you during the summer vacation this year, but I forgot about it!" Ivan hesitated to break the calm and spoke again.
Since this incident was caused by his mistake, Ivan would naturally not take into account the face problem, and apologized very sincerely.
"So what... and then?" Hermione stopped turning the pages of the book, a slight annoyance appeared on her faceApologize? that's it?
During this summer vacation, she thought Ivan would be watching the Quidditch World Cup, so she waited happily, but Ivan did not show up on the day of departure.
Hermione was very disappointed, wanting to know why Ivan didn't come, and expected that Ivan would abide by the agreement and send her a letter telling her all this.
As a result, she waited for two months, nothing!
Ivan opened his mouth, intending to explain, but the words got stuck in his mouth and couldn't speak.
Normally, he can always find countless reasons to flick the other party for a while, but today he doesn't know why it failed here.
"Yeah, you always do this, the year before last, last year, this year...every time you forget!" Hermione said sarcastically.
"Well, it was my fault the year before last...but didn't we stay together during the summer vacation last year? Besides, you know, I was not in the mood to write a letter in that situation." Ivan was helpless. Replied.
"What?! Did you stay together for the summer vacation last year?" Ron looked at the two in shock.
Harry was constantly scanning back and forth between Ivan and Hermione with weird eyes.
"Can't it?" The little witch's cheeks flushed, and angrily threw the book in her hand onto them, staring at them fiercely with her brown eyes.
"Okay... OK!" Harry and Ron nodded like chickens pecking rice, swallowed the words they wanted to ask again, and muttered with dissatisfaction.
It was Ivan who clearly irritated her, so why did she get angry at them?
apex

chapters.title: Chapter 560: Ivan: It's so difficult for me!
chapters.content:
Seeing the "tragic situation" of Harry and Ron, Ivan suddenly realized that he had said something wrong, and quickly closed his mouth, pretending to look at the owl cage hanging on the side.
Hermione snorted softly and took the book she threw out from Harry again. Then she glanced at Ivan, and was annoyed that Ivan had not covered up the things of last summer vacation. Come.
Especially seeing that Ivan is completely unresponsive now, the little witch is even more angry...
Ivan looked helpless, he couldn't speak by himself, nor could he not speak.
is really troublesome...
Ivan has a headache. Although he lived for 18 years in his previous life, he spent a large part of his time in hospital beds in the next few years. A sick person like him really has no experience in coaxing people.
Can't coax people by relying on the vulgar bridges seen in the film and television drama, right? Then he will definitely be killed!
Just as the carriage was about to fall into a long silence again, a familiar, dragging voice floated in from the open door.
"...Do you know? Dad really thought about sending me to Durmstrang instead of Hogwarts. He knew the principal of that school.
Alas, you know what he thinks of Dumbledore-that man likes Mudblood too much-Durmstrang doesn't allow those who are indiscriminate to go to school. But my mother doesn't want me to go so far...
My dad also told me that Durmstrang’s attitude towards black magic is much more reasonable than Hogwarts. Durmstrang’s students are really learning black magic, unlike us, learning some tattered defenses..."
Ivan turned his head and looked out of the car.
Malfoy, wearing a Slytherin robe, raised his head proudly, and was walking through the aisles of the train with his two attendants, lashing out at Hogwarts' shortcomings and injustices. A proud look.
When passing by this car, Malfoy deliberately increased his voice and said in a strange tone. "Oh, of course! For some people, Hogwarts is probably the best place, because they can only go to school here!"
His two followers, Ben Gor and Clark, smirked at the right time, and they responded.
"Malfoy!" Ivan frowned. Of course he could tell who Malfoy was taunting, but when he pulled out his wand, he was caught by a hand.
"Do it here, do you want Gryffindor to be deducted?" Hermione glared at Ivan dissatisfied, walked to the door of the box on tiptoe, and gently closed the door to prevent Malfoy's voice from spreading. Come in.
But this time Malfoy has gone away with Gore and Krall. He also saw Ivan pulling out his wand just now, and of course he didn't want to stay where he was and be beaten.
"If he likes Durmstrand so much, let him go. We wish he could transfer!" Hermione returned to her position, smashing the book in her hand on the table, looking angrily. I don't know if the anger just poured on here.
Although Harry was reluctant to stand up as a target when Hermione was breathing, after holding back for a while, he couldn't help looking at Ivan and Ron, and asked.
"What is Durmstrand, is it also a magic school? Why does Malfoy want to go there?"
"Well, I seem to have heard of this place somewhere." Ron said vaguely.
Ivan started to explain to Harry, "Dermstrang is one of the three major magic academies in Europe. It is established in Northern Europe. The specific location is very mysterious. I heard that only the students and employees there know it."
"In addition, that place is most famous for learning black magic with an open mind!" Ivan added.
"You mean they teach black magic in class?" Harry looked surprised. He couldn't imagine that there would be a place where black magic would be taught. "Isn't Nadam Strong a gathering place for dark wizards?"
"I can't say that. Learning black magic does not mean that you are a dark wizard... It depends on how you use it. You must know that when the wizard wars, the Aurors were also allowed to use Unforgivable in the battle with the Death Eaters. Curse!" Ivan corrected Harry's notion.
Some powerful wizards know some black magic, it's just a matter of using it or not.
Of course, Hogwarts prohibits little wizards from learning black magic for a certain reason. Many black magic requires users to gather some negative emotions, and the powerful destructive power is easy to indulge in!
In order to change the subject and ease the atmosphere, Ivan said a lot about the three major academies, and then inadvertently asked about Harry and the others at the Quidditch Stadium in the middle.
Harry and Ron didn't mean to hide, they retelled to Ivan their thrilling encounter after watching the Quidditch Cup.
Just like Yuan Shikong, when they slept in the tent at night, a riot broke out on the field.
A large number of wizards dressed in black robes and top hats and masks on their faces sprang out from nowhere, unscrupulously lit the venue tents, and used magic to tease and torture nearby Muggles Ivan knew the inside story, It was clear that it was an operation carried out by Lucius Malfoy and those Death Eaters who hated Muggles.
"Sirius said that those people must be Death Eaters, so he asked them to trouble... Ron and Hermione and I ran all the way to take refuge in the woods, and we also encountered a strange house elf..."
While Harry was talking, he could still see a little bit of fear on his face. There were a lot of thugs, and they were unscrupulous in casting spells. If they accidentally ran into them, they might not have the ability to resist.
"You said Sirius troubled them?" Ivan raised his eyebrows, which he hadn't expected.
"Yes!" Harry nodded, but he was staying in the woods and didn't see the specific passing, only the light flickering when the spell was flying.
Then I don’t know who chanted a weird spell, and a huge green gleaming thing flew into the sky, and a huge skeleton appeared, and a serpentine snake emerged from the skull’s mouth. .
Recalling the horror scene, neither Harry nor Ron shrank their minds. Hermione didn't care about getting angry at this time, so she added solemnly.
"According to Mr. Bagman, it was the Dark Mark! In the last Wizarding War, the Death Eaters caused chaos and killed wizards. After Muggles, they usually launch this sign in the sky..."
Listening to Hermione and the others, Ivan touched his chin and fell into contemplation.
The Dark Mark should have been released by Barty Crouch Jr. It seems that some things have not been affected by the flapping wings of this butterfly!

chapters.title: Chapter 561: Poor Sirius
chapters.content:
While Ivan was thinking about it, Harry kept talking about the rest of the story.
Soon after the Dark Mark rose to the sky, Barty Crouch, the director of the International Magic Exchange and Cooperation Department of the Ministry of Magic, and Bagman, the host of the Quidditch World Cup, rushed over with a crowd.
What makes Harry most angry is that these people mistakenly believed that the Dark Mark was released by themselves, because his wand was accidentally lost and happened to be nearby again.
Some Aurors who maintained order in the arena also arrested Sirius, trying to accuse Sirius of creating chaos with the masked black wizards.
"How can they wrong us so much? Sirius just wanted to catch a troublemaker and ask what was going on, but those Aurors didn't care about the black-robed wizard who ran away, and caught him first!" Li's body was trembling, looking very angry.
Ivan’s expression became a little weird, it seems that poor Sirius was almost caught in Azkaban again...
But this strange Sirius appeared too coincidentally.
As a heavily wanted criminal of the original Ministry of Magic, how long did Sirius clear his suspicion? Run to the World Cup stadium to watch the stadium like a okay person.
It happened that a large-scale riot broke out there, and it was suspected that the Death Eaters did it. The Aurors who came to see Sirius nearby, of course they would doubt him.
"What happened later? Sirius is okay?" Ivan asked curiously.
Harry shook his head. They explained for a long time. Those Aurors checked Sirius' wand carefully and confirmed that he had not set fire or cast any Muggle spells.
In addition, Ron’s father, Arthur Weasley, is willing to give Sirius a guarantee, and the Wizards of Barty Crowe let go of Sirius...
Hearing this, Ivan shook his head secretly.
Barty Crouch should know that the things marked by the Dark Demon are related to his child Crouch, but he still wants to put the matter on Harry and Sirius.
I have to say that this upright and hateful former executive director, in order to protect his children in order to comply with his beloved wife's last wish, has become what he once hated the most.
Ivan couldn't help but sighed in his heart, and continued to ask for more details.
Talking all the way, the train keeps going north, and the rain is getting heavier and harder. The sky was pitch black and the car windows were covered with moisture, so the magic lights were also lit during the day.
When I just started school, I ran into such bad weather and destroyed the good mood of many little wizards. Ivan looked out the window faintly, big raindrops fell from the sky, and lightning struck from time to time in the dark clouds, and there was a burst There was a violent roar.
Harry, Ron, and Hermione also stopped mentioning the bad past at this time, and instead wondered what Bill and Charlie were hiding mysteriously.
Several people guessed, but they all felt wrong, and Harry turned his head to look at Ivan, who had not been involved in the discussion.
"Ivan, what do you think?"
"Guess what this is for? Don't you know when you go to school? The joy of life lies in the unknown!" Ivan yawned and replied casually.
He had known for a long time that the Triwizard Tournament was going to be held this year, but he didn't have a suitable source to tell Harry and others, but he couldn't pretend to be ignorant and guess.
Harry and Ron looked at each other. Hermione looked at Ivan suspiciously. She felt that Ivan must know something and was deliberately hiding it from them.
woo...
The Hogwarts train made a long cry, interrupting everyone's thoughts. The speed of the train under him gradually slowed down, and the towering castle in the distance was faintly visible.
Obviously, they are coming soon!
"Let's go!" Ivan got up and packed his luggage and walked out of the carriage with Harry and the others. When it reached the exit, the train stopped just in time.
The rain outside was heavy, Ron got out of the car first, and covered the owl's cage with the hem of the wizard robe so that the rain would not drip on his new pet.
"This weather is terrible!" Ron said in a complaint.
Ivan stopped Hermione who was about to get out of the car, jumped out of the car first, drew out her wand and deformed a big umbrella, then looked at the little witch and said.
"Now you can come down!"
"Transfiguration, how did I forget this!" Hermione muttered to herself in annoyance, and did not reject Ivan's kindness, got out of the car and shrank into Ivan's umbrella.
After such a long interval just now, coupled with the actions of a gentleman like Ivan, her anger has disappeared a bit.
"Wait, what should I do?" Harry couldn't help but reminded him that Ivan and Hermione were about to leave together like this.
Ron, who was still in the rain, was even more bewildered. He had known that Ivan could change the umbrella, so he got down late.
Ivan turned his head, only to realize that he had forgotten Harry and Ron, and patted his forehead with his free right hand. He wanted to expand the umbrella a bit so that Harry and Ron could be together. Come in.
But, before Ivan could do anything, Hermione glared at Harry and Ron and spoke. "Professor McGonagall has taught you transfiguration for three years, can't you become an umbrella yourself?"
After speaking, Hermione grabbed Ivan by the wrist and pulled him away with him.
Harry and Ron who stayed trembling in the cold wind and heavy rain.
"Did Hermione make a mistake? It's not that we forgot to send her the letter..." Ron was very dissatisfied and vomited.
"Forget it, let's do it ourselves!"
Harry shook his head, contributed a coat, and performed Transfiguration with Ron. After a while of tinkering, he finally turned into an irregular umbrella. The color was divided into several large pieces, which looked like branches. Supporting a rag.
But Harry and Ron didn't dislike it, as long as this thing can shelter them from the rain, they would be satisfied.
The two held their umbrellas with difficulty, and ran along the path of Hogwarts Station to the carriage parked on the side of the road. They finally caught up with Ivan and Hermione and rode back to school together.
The carriage passed through the gates with winged boar sculptures on both sides, and drove along the spacious lane.
Ivan stared at the front through a thin rain curtain. The quaint castle was getting closer and closer, and many illuminated windows could be seen faintly shining behind the thick rain curtain...
About ten minutes later, the carriage stopped under the stone steps in front of the two oak gates. Ivan and the others got out of the carriage one by one, and walked towards the entrance of the castle, vaguely heard the strange noise and noise coming from the front. ...

chapters.title: Chapter 562: stop! I surrender!
chapters.content:
Stepping up the steps to the door, Ivan saw some little wizards crowded at the entrance to the castle, they cursed loudly, and then rushed towards the castle with their heads in twos and threes.
"What are they doing?" Hermione couldn't help but wonder, but then she saw a big red balloon full of water fall from the ceiling and hit the head of a hapless little wizard.
"Boom", the water ball exploded directly, drenching the hapless little wizard soaked, even the few little wizards on the side were inevitably affected.
"Damn Pipi, get out of here!"
There was a sound of cursing in the crowd, but they were greeted by more balloons filled with water and the funny laughter.
Ivan raised his head and looked up. The small leather ghost wearing a hat with bells was floating twenty feet above their heads, holding many water-filled balloons in his arms.
"Hey, go on!" Pippi ghost giggled, grabbing a green balloon with his right hand and smashing it directly onto the head of another unlucky ghost, causing a small range of chaos again.
Some of the lower-grade little wizards who had finally braved the heavy rain and were soaked again almost cried out of anger, but Pepigui didn’t mean to stop at all, and stared at Yifan who had just entered the door. There is Hermione.
Among the students present, Hermione and Ivan were the most special. Both of them were dry. Only the corners of the robes and the shoes could see traces of water.
Pipigui's eyes turned grunting, remembering the tragedy of being teased by Ivan last semester, and suddenly screamed, grabbing a water ball with his left hand and throwing it towards Ivan.
Of course, Ivan also saw this scene, and immediately became a little bit dumbfounded. Pippi really remembered whether to eat or not, so he drew out his wand and pointed it casually.
A red magical beam flew out and exploded in mid-air, and also detonated two water balls.
The witches below screamed and hid to the side so as not to be poured water.
However, those scattered currents did not fall under the influence of gravity. Instead, they gathered into a stream of water under the drive of magic, and slammed into the location of Pipi ghost like a water cannon.
For ordinary ghosts, such a physical attack does not have much effect, it will only pass through them.
But Pippi ghost is an exception. It can touch entities and pick up things. Strictly speaking, it is not a ghost, but a special kind of spirit body.
So of course, the water cannon smashed directly on Pippi Ghost and staggered him.
Angry Pipigui tried to resist throwing more water **** at first, but it turned out that this was just to provide "ammunition" to Ivan. It didn't take long for Pipigui to be beaten up by a series of water cannons.
Hermione remembered the spell Lupin had taught in the Defense Against the Dark Arts class last semester, so she held her wand high and pointed it at Pepi Ghost.
"Wadi Wasi!"
Several balloon bags that were broken underground suddenly trembled, flew up with a whistle and stuck to Pepy Ghost's face, and Pepy Ghost, who couldn't see clearly, hit the wall with one head.
Several little wizards in grades third and fourth grades also followed suit in the same way, and others quickly joined in.
"Ahhhh~stop...stop! I surrender!" Pepigui couldn't stand it anymore, let out a piercing scream in embarrassment, and rushed directly into the auditorium, although these attacks did not cause any harm to it. , It can be uncomfortable to be beaten too much.
"Okay, stop for a while, kids!"
Just as some of the little wizards were still interested, Professor McGonagall’s voice came from the auditorium. While everyone was distracted, Pippi squeaked out of the window.
Professor McGonagall glanced at the Pippi who was escaping in a hurry, did not care about it, turned his gaze to Ivan, and said with appreciation.
"Good job, Hals! I think with this lesson, Pippi will be willing to stop for a while!"
"I just solved some small troubles easily!" Ivan replied very modestly.
"Very good, Gryffindor plus five points!" Professor McGonagall nodded in satisfaction, shouted loudly, and then looked at the other people.
Although it didn’t feel good to be in the rain all the way, I was harassed by Pipi again when I entered the door, but most of the little wizards are still very interested because they just drove away the pesky naughty ghost with their own hands. .
Professor McGonagall didn't hesitate to praise him. After a few words of praise, he asked the prefect to take everyone to the auditorium.
Perhaps in response to the upcoming Triwizard Tournament, the interior of the auditorium has been specially decorated, making it more sounding than ever before. Hundreds of candles floated above the table, shining golden plates and goblets gleaming. bright.
Under the leadership of the prefect, the little wizards of the second grade and above sat on the chairs of the long table in an orderly manner. The ghosts floating around greeted them politely and welcomed them back to school Nearly headless Nick came out directly from under the dining table, his swaying head startled the little wizards nearby, and then floated in front of them and said with a smile.
"Good evening, everyone!"
"What's so good? It's terrible. I wish I could be sorted soon... so that I could go back and change my clothes." Harry complained. He and Ron were not as lucky as Hermione, they were probably half wet. , The shoes are filled with water, it is very uncomfortable to wear on the feet.
Ivan looked at the staff desk at this time, looking for Barty Crouch, who pretended to be Moody, but did not see him.
"Is the Defence Against the Dark Arts professor this year not here yet?" Hermione also looked over there, and said a little strangely.
"Maybe they will come later, of course, it's also possible that they can't find the right person." Ron murmured.
The Defence Against the Dark Arts professor at Hogwarts usually insists that he resign in less than a year. This is not a secret in the British magical world. Ron doubts whether it is because of this that no one is willing to apply for this. The position of a professor.
"It would be great if Sirius could come here to teach! Lupin is the best Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor I have ever seen, and I believe Sirius is the same!" Harry said expectantly.
"I advise you not to think like this, Harry! This is not a safe job!" Hearing Harry say this, Ivan rolled his eyes. You are trying to push Sirius into the fire pit!
Not to mention Sirius was officially acquitted a few months ago. Neither the parents nor the school manager would allow him to teach!

chapters.title: Chapter 563: Back to school and new semester
chapters.content:
Harry opened his mouth and wanted to explain. He felt that Sirius would not be knocked down by a curse, but he thought of what happened to Chino and Lockhart in the first or second year, and Lupin inexplicably resigned at the end of the semester in the third grade. He closed his mouth again.
At this time of delay, the sorting ceremony has already begun. Professor McGonagall led a long row of first-year students to the top of the auditorium, placed a triangular stool on the ground in front of the freshmen, and put another stool on the stool. The shabby, dirty, patched wizard hat.
The first-year freshmen stared at the weird hat, and everyone else stared at it.
For a while, there was silence in the auditorium.
Then a crack near the brim of the hat opened like a mouth, and the hat suddenly sang:
"That was more than a thousand years ago, I was just woven into shape,
There are four famous wizards whose names have been passed down to this day:
The brave Gryffindor, from a barren swamp,
The beautiful Ravenclaw, from the peaceful riverside,
The benevolent Hufflepuff, from the open valley,
The shrewd Slytherin came from that quagmire.
......"
The weird singing of the branch courtyard hatguli resounded throughout the auditorium.
When I heard the phrase "The Big Four have injected my thoughts into me, I will choose and evaluate from now on!" Ivan's heart moved.
According to Nick LeMay, injecting one's own mind and will into magic items is a very advanced alchemy technique, and it is also the bottleneck of his current alchemy learning.
Just as Ivan was thinking about it, the singing of the Sorting House had stopped, and there was warm applause in the auditorium.
McGonagall unfolded a large roll of parchment and read it according to the name on it. The new students who were read stepped forward and picked up the sorting hat, sat on the stool, and waited for the hat to make a decision.
Ivan took a few glances and then withdrew his gaze, but unfortunately he was not a new student and couldn't touch the sorting hat, otherwise he could use the system identification function to see the reality of the hat.
Harry was not as laid back as Ivan, and was constantly harassed by his little brother Colin, who was one year below him. Although he was very impatient, Harry responded perfunctorily.
About ten minutes later, as a freshman named Kevin Whitby was assigned to Hufflepuff, the sorting ceremony finally ended.
Professor McGonagall picked up the sorting hat and small stool and moved them away.
Professor Dumbledore on the bench stood up slowly. He looked at all his classmates with a smile, opened his arms and made a welcome gesture.
"I only have two words to tell you," Dumbledore's deep voice echoed in the auditorium, and he stretched out his wand and tapped it in the air, speaking loudly.
"Eat!"
As Dumbledore's words fell, the empty plates on the long table were suddenly and magically filled with various foods.
"At last it's time!" Ron hurriedly grabbed the spoon placed on the side, dug a spoonful of mashed potatoes and stuffed it into his mouth. After sitting on the train all afternoon, he was already hungry.
Ivan also put aside the complicated thoughts, and started to enjoy the meal in front of him intently, cutting off a juicy piece of steak and slowly chewing in his mouth.
Nearly headless Nick wandered around them. Seeing them feasting, he was a little greedy, but the ghost couldn't eat the food of living people, so he could only watch it like that.
"Hey...you are really lucky today, you know that the banquet of the evening almost broke up." Nearly headless Nick said sourly.
"What's wrong? Did something happen?" Ivan squinted at the ghost and swallowed the steak in his mouth.
"Earlier, there was a mess in the kitchen. It was Pepy Ghost who was deliberately making trouble and arguing about it again. You know, Pepy Ghost has always wanted to participate in the banquet!"
Nick, who was almost headless, shook his head and sighed. His neck with skin didn't look very stable, and he almost threw his head off. Ivan and others were worried about him.
Fortunately, his head didn't fall off in the end. After a pause, Nick, who was almost headless, continued.
"You should be aware of Pepigui's virtues. He has no education at all. When he sees food, he throws it everywhere. We held a ghost meeting to discuss this matter. The fat monk advocated giving him this opportunity-but blood. Ren Barrow firmly disagrees. I think he is very wise to do so."
"No wonder Peppies are making trouble at the door..." Ron slapped his mouth, usually Peppies didn't have the guts to block outside the auditorium to tease them when school just started.
"Then, Nick, what did Pippy do in the kitchen?" Harry asked curiously.
"It's not the same old thing," Nick shrugged. "It's just ruining it. Peppy ghost messed up everything. Pots and pans were thrown everywhere, and the entire kitchen was flooded with soup.
The poor house elves were so scared by it, they drove away Pippi together, and had to make a new dinner again, almost delaying today's banquet! "
"That's really bad! Fortunately, Pippi was kicked out..." Ron said with pleasure. If Pippi succeeded, everyone would have to be hungry all night!
When...
Listening to the words of Nick and Ron, Hermione inadvertently knocked over the gin glass in front of her. Pumpkin juice was poured on the tablecloth continuously, dyeing the white linen into an orange for several times. Feet, but Hermione ignored it at all.
Harry and Ron looked at Hermione in surprise, Ivan also turned his head, vaguely remembering something, and couldn't help but scream in his heart.
"You just said... there are house elves here too?" Hermione didn't look at Ivan and the others, but stared at Nick and said in a high tone.
"That's right? Isn't that necessary?" Nick, who was almost headless, looked at Hermione strangely. He didn't understand why she had such a big reaction, but he replied truthfully, with a hint of pride in his words.
"There are not as many house elves in any house in the UK here. There are more than one hundred house elves in Hogwarts!"
"Then why don't I usually see it?" Hermione frowned. She had only seen one house elf at Hogwarts a few years ago-that was Dobby.
"Ahem..." This time, Nick, who was almost headless, didn't wait for a reply Ivan coughed slightly, attracted everyone's attention, and then helped explain.
"Hermione, house elves are the best "helpers" for wizards. They can be said to be almighty in housekeeping. There are so many little wizards in Hogwarts, and they always need some house elves..."
"Then they get paid, do they have holidays?" Hermione continued to say seriously without being fooled by Ivan. "There are sick days... allowances, do they have them?"
When I saw Dobby before, Hermione didn't realize the low status of the house elves, and thought she was similar to a housekeeper.
But she had come into contact with Shining and Kreacher during this summer vacation, only to realize that the lives of these poor little guys were harder than slaves!
"Sick leave and allowance? Hahaha..." The floating ghost seemed to have heard some funny news. He almost lost his breath with a smile. The wheel-shaped ruffled collar crooked, his head rolled down, and he was still attached to his neck by an inch or two. The dead skin and muscles of her were hanging, dangling in the air.
"They don't need that, Granger!" Nick put his head hanging in mid-air on his neck again, and fixed it with a round wrinkle collar. "House elves don't need sick leave and allowance!"
"That means they have to work hard every day because they have nothing? Isn't that slave labor?" Hermione said angrily, then turned to look at Ivan, and continued to ask.
"Na Dobi..."
"Yes! Of course!" Ivan nodded hurriedly, interrupting Hermione's words, "Dobby gets a salary every month. I gave it a vacation last year to give it a good rest. A few days!"

chapters.title: Chapter 564: Kill me, I won't eat this shortbread either!
chapters.content:
After Ivan explained, Hermione nodded in satisfaction.
Harry was holding back a laugh, but he knew Ivan's treatment to Dobby, which meant it was better than nothing.
"How is this possible!" Nick's almost headless eyes widened, and his body trembling in the air, he didn't want to believe Ivan's rhetoric at all.
"For house elves, wages and holidays are an insult to them...they just love to work!" Nick added.
"No creature is born to like to work!" Hermione glared at Nick, and then went on with a vow.
"They must have been forced by wizards to do that. Isn't Ivan's house-elf Dobby just got a salary and a vacation? What if we..."
"Dobby is a very special house elf, Hermione!" Ivan interrupted Hermione's words, looked at her seriously, and continued to speak.
"I always respect Dobby's wishes. It wants wages and vacations, so I gave it to it! Similarly, I also respect the ideas of other house elves!"
Hermione choked on her words, and after a while she stammered in retort. "But that...that's not what they really think...who doesn't like a freer life?"
She has seen Shining and Kreacher before, and of course she knows the morbid concept of "servant" in house elves, but she thinks it is the result of long-term enslavement by the master and should be corrected!
"Freedom?" Ron chuckled, and while eating the cream pudding, he didn't forget to interrupt. "If you really talk about freedom with those house elves, they will be terrified!"
While talking, Ron took another gulp of orange juice, smashed his mouth, and said again. "Also, Hermione...what are you bothering about? Isn't it good like this?"
"Of course not! I didn't expect that our convenient life at Hogwarts was built on the pain of house-raising elves!" Hermione said angrily, putting all the knives, forks and spoons in her hands. Down.
Thinking that dinner was made by an exploited house-elf, Hermione couldn't eat a bite.
Seeing that the little witch seemed to be going to be hungry all night, Ivan reluctantly persuaded. "It doesn't have to be this way? Hermione? Just like you want to make some changes, you have to do it step by step, right?"
"This is the first step I did!" The little witch said firmly.
Ivan shrugged, and didn't persuade him any more, but slowly picked up a piece of fragrant syrupy fruit pie, put it in his mouth, and took a bite.
The pie is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, with a tangy aroma, and a thick syrup on the inside. The sweetness is just right without being too greasy.
"I haven't seen it one summer vacation, their craftsmanship is still so good!" Ivan ate with greasy mouth, and exclaimed inexplicably, then used a fork to fork a shortbread cookie and put it on Hermione's plate. "Are you sure you won't come here?"
Hermione pursed her mouth and went on a train all afternoon. Her stomach was empty.
But in the end the little witch endured it, pushed away the plate in front of him, and then stared at Ivan angrily, as if anyone who ate a bite of shortbread betrayed the anti-discrimination house elves revolution. -The same fate.
"Okay, I think you should all have enough food and drink!" About an hour later, Dumbledore stood up again. He waved his wand as he did at the beginning, and removed the plates on the table and the rest. The food was swept away.
"It seems that you are really going to be hungry all night!" Ivan whispered.
"I would rather starve to death than eat things made with the labor of elf slaves!" Hermione glanced at him angrily.
On the stage, Dumbledore's mouth twitched a few times. He obviously heard Hermione's words, but he pretended to be unaware of what he said.
is mainly to remind freshmen not to go to the forbidden forest, and to prohibit the use of some dangerous magic "toys" in the castle.
Speaking of here, Dumbledore glanced at George and Fred before the edge. In the past two years, he had received many complaints from Filch.
George and Fred looked guilty under Dumbledore’s gaze. They glanced at each other and immediately decided that they must be more concealed when selling "toys" in the future, and they must never be caught!
Dumbledore glanced, then turned his gaze back, looked at the little wizards in the auditorium, and announced a heavy news.
"Besides, I also regret to tell everyone that there will be no more Quidditch competitions at Hogwarts this year!"
"Why?" Harry widened his eyes in surprise, and almost knocked over the candle holder beside him with excitement.
Other Quidditch players also performed similarly. There was a burst of discussion on the long table of the four colleges, and many people looked at Dumbledore anxiously, waiting for his answer.
Dumbledore raised his hand and pressed it down, signaled everyone to be quiet for a while, cleared his throat and spoke again. "That's because there is a large-scale event that will start in October and will continue throughout the school year, occupying a lot of teachers' time and energy... Therefore, we have to make some adjustments!
"But I believe that you can all have a lot of fun from it. I am very happy to announce to everyone that this year at Hogwarts..."
Dumbledore’s loud voice echoed throughout the auditorium, but at this moment, a quick knock on the door interrupted his words.
The little wizards in the auditorium all turned their gazes, even Ivan was no exception.
Under the gaze of everyone, an old wizard is standing at the door, holding a long cane in his hand and a black traveling cloak on his body.
His legs and feet didn't seem to be good, he just limped forward, the crutches in his hand stopped on the ground, making a deep noise, the entire auditorium became silent because of his arrival, except for the heavy rain and the rain outside the window. The thunder resounded in my ears.
In an instant, another lightning flashed across the sky.
Under the dazzling flash, the old wizard lifted the hood he was wearing, and shook out a sparse gray long hair, and presented the horrible, scarred face in front of everyone.
is the most eye-catching thing about his two eyes, one big and one small looking very uncoordinated.
The normal black eyeball stared at Dumbledore on the stage, while the other weird blue eye kept spinning in all directions, scanning everyone on the field.
As the man got closer and closer, there was an inhalation sound in the auditorium. Harry and Ron couldn't help but shrink their necks. The little wizards before sitting also dragged their chairs back.

chapters.title: Chapter 565: Top 3 Tournament
chapters.content:
The panic and disgust of the little wizards were very obvious, but Aristo Moody, who was on the crutches, did not restrain his momentum at all. The magic eye looked around the audience unscrupulously, and unexpectedly saw a person who dared to look at him. Little wizard.
was stared straight at by a strange magic eye, Ivan didn't feel anything, but looked at each other with interest.
If he is not mistaken, the "Moody" in front of him should be a guy disguised by Barty Crouch Jr. with compound decoction.
Ivan had to sigh, Barty Crouch Jr. is really bold!
You know, Dumbledore is a master of mind-seeking, and he can read some of the other's thoughts just by looking at each other.
This means that Barty Crouch Jr.'s disguise will be exposed in minutes as long as the old professor is on a whim!
Of course, Ivan also knew that the old professor would not spy on other people's thoughts at will, unless it was about important layouts or major events related to Voldemort.
Not to mention that Moody is still an experienced legendary Auror, and he may be noticed by the opponent if he uses the intent of dementia, so it is unlikely that Dumbled can invade unless Moody's feet are unreasonable. The brain of this old friend.
Batti Crouch Jr. may have taken this point accurately, coupled with his trust in his acting skills, made such a risky plan!
When Ivan was looking at Moody, the other party had already closed his eyes back and walked all the way to the high platform.
Dumbledore stretched out his left hand and shook Moody's hand, talked a few words in a low voice, and then invited him to sit in an empty seat on his right.
Moody was not at all polite, and after sitting down, he pulled over the plates of delicacies that he had deliberately left him on the table.
He first sniffed it nervously, then took out a knife that he carried with him and prodded it a few times, and finally poked it in from one end of a sausage and ate it with big mouthfuls.
Dumbledore seemed to have been accustomed to Moody's neurotic appearance, and soon faced the crowd, happily telling them that this was the new Defence Against the Dark Arts teacher—Alastor Moody!
There were only sporadic applause from the audience. Everyone was stunned by Moody's appearance and behavior. Even though he was staring at him intently, few people agreed.
Maybe it was found that everyone was not in high spirits, Dumbledore said as soon as he turned his voice.
"Ah... let's continue the topic! This school year will no longer hold the Quidditch Cup, instead we will be honored to host another very exciting event!"
"This event has not been held for more than a century. I am very honored to tell you that the Triwizard Tournament will be held at Hogwarts this year!"
Dumbledore’s tone was not high, but it was like throwing a boulder into the lake, causing a huge wave in everyone’s hearts.
No one even paid attention to the new professor Moody, Fred Weasley stood up excitedly and said in surprise.
"Gosh! Are you kidding me? This is impossible!"
Some knowledgeable little wizards, both excited and a little unbelievable, Dumbledore once again confirmed this statement and explained the origin of the Triwizard Tournament.
To put it simply, this kind of competition was founded more than 700 years ago to promote exchanges among the three major magic schools in Europe!
used to be held every five years. The rule is that each magic school chooses a brave. The competition is dangerous and exciting. The final score is the most. The brave who succeeds will get a great honor for himself and his school!
But this kind of event was finally interrupted due to too many deaths. Finally this year, with the efforts of many parties, the Triwizard Tournament was resumed!
"Triwizard Tournament..." Ivan touched his chin and whispered in a low voice.
In his opinion, this is an opportunity to get legendary points, but he hasn't figured out whether to participate in it or not. He is not the same as Harry. There is no little Crouch to help. Even if he finds a way to put his name in, the Goblet of Fire may not choose him.
While Ivan was meditating, Dumbledore had already finished his description of the Triwizard Tournament.
The atmosphere in the entire auditorium became eager. Many little wizards were ready to move. Everyone wanted to be Dumbledore’s hero who represented the glory of the entire Academy!
"We are going to participate!" George and Fred looked very excited, especially when they heard Dumbledore say that the winner of the game could get a thousand gallons prize money, their eyes came out!
"I don't know how the Warriors will be selected, do you draw lots by luck?" Ron was also a little moved, whether it was glory or Jin Jialong, he was very tempted.
But Ron is still a little self-aware, if he is judged by his academic performance, he will definitely be useless!
Only by drawing lots is there such a possibility...
"Come on, Ron, such an important game will not use such a perfunctory method! Professor Dumbledore can not allow a bad warrior to represent Hogwarts, shame the school!" George hit without hesitation Shattered Ron's fantasy.
"Maybe it's a duel to come out to see who can play the best!" Fred proposed a slightly more reasonable conjecture, after all, Professor Gu Dumbledore said this kind of game seems dangerous.
"Then we have no chance?" George looked at Ivan sitting on the side in distress. He had seen Ivan cast spells before, and he really wanted to go against him. I'm afraid no one in the school is his opponent!
"Ivan, will you participate in the Triwizard Tournament?" Fred hurriedly asked.
"If I can be selected!" Ivan shrugged casually replied.
"Then we have no chance?" George and Fred said with a sigh. They both felt that if Ivan were going to run for the election, then they would probably be out of play.
What made them even more desperate was that Dumbledore quickly announced the selection conditions of the contestants!
"I know you are all eager to win the Triwizard Trophy for Hogwarts, but for safety reasons, participating schools and the Ministry of Magic agreed that an age limit should be set for this year's competitors!"
"We will only allow students over the age of seventeen to sign up!" Dumbledore's expression was serious.
"It's not fair!" George and Fred shouted in unison, Dumbledore's words undoubtedly cut off their last hope, because they were only a year away and only seventeen.
Dumbledore ignored the protests of George and Fred at all, and raised his tone. He said that this measure was set to protect the warriors, and the Ministry of Magic did not think that wizards under the age of seventeen could deal with it. Those dangerous games!
Ivan remained calm throughout. He knew the rules of the competition for a long time, and of course there would be no mood swings.
Dumbledore declared the end of the banquet after talking about the precautions, and ordered the prefects of the major colleges to return to the dormitory with freshmen and students of all grades.
Along the way, everyone was talking about the Triwizard Tournament, and Ivan also echoed a few words.
When he returned to the lounge, Ivan directly intercepted Hermione who was about to go back to the bedroom, pulled the little witch aside, hesitated and spoke in a low voice.
"Hermione, remember to come out by 10 o'clock in the evening!"

chapters.title: Chapter 566: Ways to crack the age limit
chapters.content:
Hermione looked at Ivan in surprise, opened her mouth and asked.
At this moment, George and Fred squeezed in uninterestingly.
Of course, they didn't come to Hermione, but carefully looked around, and then quietly said to Ivan.
"Ivan, you must have some way to avoid the age limit, right?"
When he was in the auditorium just now, Fred was keenly aware that Ivan's expression was unusually calm.
Even when he heard the limitations of the candidates for the Warriors, there was no change in expression, and he looked confident.
This is also the reason why they came here for advice!
"Professor Dumbledore has just decided on the age limit for selecting the Warriors. I haven't said what the specific selection and who will be selected? How can I do it? You are too high to look at me!" Ivan shook helplessly. Shaking his head, he retorted.
George and Fred glanced at each other, somewhat suspicious.
But it’s right to think about it. Even the rules for selecting people have not been formally determined. If Ivan could come up with a specific method immediately, it would be too bad!
"I just don't know who the fair referee who selects the Warriors will be..." George thought distressedly about Dumbledore's words, and felt a little angry when he thought of this.
"Why did they set an age limit of seventeen? We will turn seventeen in April next year. This is clearly aimed at us!"
"That's right! This is not fair, we are not worse than those graduates!" Fred also complained.
Hermione, who had been listening, couldn't help it at this time, she couldn't help but retorted. "Professor Dumbledore's arrangement is definitely to ensure our safety. You must know that in the past Triwizard Tournament, many people died!"
"That was years ago, didn't it?" Fred said nonchalantly. "Professor Dumbledore also said that this year's Quidditch Cup will be very safe. They spent a whole summer preparing to make sure that every warrior will not be in danger of life!"
"Yeah, I can't die! But that's for contestants of the right age! The professor didn't guarantee that you won't miss your arms or legs, or get hurt all over!" Hermione scolded angrily, especially Looking at Ivan with some worry.
Because she discovered that Ivan seems to be keen to participate in the Triwizard Tournament!
"Oh! That's great!" Hermione's words didn't scare George and Fred, they slapped their palms in excitement!
For wizards, such injuries will not cause much hindrance as long as they are treated in time...
George and Fred even had a fantasy in their minds. After they became the warriors of Hogwarts, they broke through many obstacles with their wounds and resolutely, amidst the screams of the audience, they won the scene of victory!
Just thinking about it makes people excited!
The two can't wait to discuss with Yifan a way to break through the age limit, and come up with a seemingly reliable plan, that is, an age-enhancing agent!
Like its name, after drinking the ageing agent, the appearance of the wizard will become much older than the real age. George and Fred think that they only need to drink one or two drops of the ageing agent to become seventeen. The appearance of eight years old!
"I don't think it will work. Whether it is judging people or some magic, it is unlikely that you will be deceived by this little trick!" Ivan shook his head and said persuasively.
In the original time and space, George and Fred tried to use the ageing agent to fool through the level. The final result was obvious. Not only did they fail to succeed, they were also attacked by magic.
This road is absolutely unworkable. No one in Hogwarts can break through the magic set by Dumbledore himself. Even Ivan doesn't think he can do it. After all, the gap is too big!
That's why Dumbledore firmly emphasized when he was in the auditorium that there will never be students under age who will become the warriors of the Triwizard Tournament!
But Ivan felt that Dumbledore was definitely going to be slapped in the face this time, and he couldn't make a frontal breakthrough. He still had all kinds of tricks, and he thought of three in a while!
The first plan is to grow up to seventeen years old in the past few months!
This is not impossible, provided that you have a time converter.
Like last school year, he spent more than half a year in the "past". Strictly speaking, he is almost fifteen years old this year.
The second solution is the cracking method Dumbledore said himself. Find a little wizard over the age of seventeen to vote instead!
This is the easiest one, just find a reliable senior student to say it!
It’s just not very insurance.
Although Ivan is very confident and thinks he is definitely the best student at Hogwarts, but who knows how to choose the Goblet of Goblet, what if Goblet of Goblet likes Cedric?
As for the third option, it is more risky. You need to threaten or control Barty Crouch with an Imperius Curse, let him impose a Confusion Curse on the Goblet of Fire, add a spot, and get yourself in!
Just like Harry in the original time and space!
The advantage is to become a 100% warrior, but the disadvantage is that it is very riskyBatti Crouch Jr is not a good role to deal with!
While thinking in his mind, on the surface, Ivan continued to discuss ways to break the age limit with George and Fred on the surface, and wanted to see if he could get some inspiration from them.
"Huh, Professor Dumbledore won't let you succeed!" Hermione watched Ivan and the others continue to discuss, could not help but snorted, turned her head and ignored them, turned and walked towards the girls' bedroom.
Ivan then remembered that Hermione seemed to have not promised to be there for the evening, so she hurriedly reminded. "Hermione, don't forget to come out tonight..."
In order for Hermione to hear her, Ivan’s voice was loud.
Some of the little wizards who were still stranded in the lounge looked at them gossiping.
"Got it!" Hermione, who had already reached the entrance of the girls' dormitory, turned her head back and glared at him a little shame. a bit.
"Ahem...we didn't disturb you just now?" George looked at Hermione's leaving back, then looked at Ivan, coughed slightly, and said with a guilty conscience.
"Of course not. I saw Hermione didn't eat anything at the party, so I planned to bring her some snacks tonight!" Ivan shook his head and explained.
"Ah... we all understand, you don't have to explain so much..." Fred looked like a person came over.
Even in order to make up for the fault that disturbed the two before, Fred also introduced Ivan to the places in the castle suitable for the night with a strange smile, and taught Ivan some tricks to make girls happy.

chapters.title: Chapter 567: It's so late, what are you calling me out for?
chapters.content:
"Come on, Ivan, if you can do it, we won't bother you!" George patted Ivan on the shoulder and left with Fred on his shoulders.
Ivan was a little bit dumbfounded for a while, but was too lazy to stop them to explain, and just let them think about it, and went straight back to the bedroom.
As soon as he opened the door, Ivan heard a sound of discussion inside before he even entered.
It was closer to discover that Ron, Harry, Seamer and others were discussing the Warriors candidates for the Triwizard Tournament, and even Neville said a few words weakly.
It seemed that there would be more little wizards expecting this honor than he had imagined.
Ivan shook his head secretly. Everyone except Hermione probably forgot the danger mentioned by Dumbledore. If they knew that the first event in the Triwizard Tournament was Dragon Fighting, they wouldn’t know. Can you afford such interest?
"Ivan, have you and George figured out a way to break the age limit?" Ron hurriedly approached and asked after seeing Ivan coming in.
Harry, Seamus and others also looked at Ivan expectantly.
"It's not yet, how can it be that easy?" Ivan hesitated for a moment, and panicked freely.
Although he has some clues, he does not intend to reveal it.
The Triwizard Tournament was too dangerous, and it was also related to Voldemort's resurrection plan. Even the leader of the graduates, Cedric, was killed. It was really not something that a fourth-grade wizard could handle.
Secondly, he felt that Ron's big mouth was really unreliable, and Seamus was a bard who ran a train with his mouth full, and many of his legendary deeds were blown out by Seamus abruptly!
If they know how to break the age limit, then it goes without saying that this method will spread throughout the school in a few days!
When it reaches Dumbledore’s ears, he will definitely plug this loophole. In this case, Ivan feels like he’s going to be blinded!
So he just fooled around, and incidentally mentioned that George and Fred seemed to be going to try an ageing agent to divert the attention of Harry and others...
"Ageing agent? This is a good way!" Ron couldn't help but his eyes lit up, and he immediately said that if George can succeed, he plans to do the same!
Ivan did not participate in the discussion with Harry and the others, but went to his suitcase and took out a piece of parchment full of amendments.
This was written by him last night, because I got up too late today, I didn't have enough time to personally give this thing to Aysia.
"Dobby!" Ivan clapped his hands and shouted.
The next moment, Dobby, the house elf, summoned and appeared in the open space nearby.
Ivan put the parchment paper in the envelope and handed it in. "Give this to my mother, and prepare some food, and bring it to me at ten o'clock in the evening!"
"Yes, sir!" Dobby nodded vowingly, took the thing, snapped his fingers, and disappeared in place.
...
At 9:50, there was silence in the boys' bedroom in Gryffindor.
The exhaustion accumulated after sitting on the train for a day makes the energetic little wizards have to go to bed early.
Ivan got out of bed lightly, so as not to wake Harry and the others who were already asleep, slowly opened the door and walked towards the Gryffindor common room.
There was loud thunder outside the window, and heavy raindrops hit the glass and made a rattling noise.
With good eyesight, Ivan can see clearly in the dark. After entering the lounge, he accurately waved his wand and lit the fireplace.
"!"
The orange flame rose up, driving out the cold and darkness of the rainy night. Ivan walked to the armchair in front of the fireplace and sat down. Dobby also took the plates one by one and put them on the table in front of Ivan in time.
"Weird, it's ten o'clock, is Hermione not here yet?" Ivan muttered to himself somewhat confused as he looked at the clock.
Just as Ivan wondered if Hermione had forgotten about it, he heard a sound from the stairs above.
About a few seconds later, Hermione in her nightgown walked down the stairs, her face flushed under the reflection of the fireplace flame.
"It's so late, what are you calling me out for?" Hermione looked around and saw that there were only two people in the lounge, she and Ivan, and asked softly.
"You haven't eaten anything all night, aren't you hungry now?" Ivan smiled and pointed to some snacks on the table, and said. "Here! This is for you!"
After Ivan's reminder, Hermione noticed that there were several dessert plates on the table.
As Ivan said, after being hungry for one afternoon and one night, the little witch was already hungry, she just kept on holding her breath.
But even so, Hermione didn't do it immediately, but hesitated and asked in a low voice. "Did these snacks come from the kitchen?"
Obviously the little witch still minds some food made through "slave labor."
"I asked Dobby to do it specially. Isn't it a slave labor? I paid for it!" Of course, Ivan knew what Hermione was thinking, so he spread his hands and said.
"Of course it doesn't count!" Hermione smiled slightly, her brown eyes stared at Ivan for a while, and then whispered "Thank you".
"Quickly eat, will be cold after a while!" Ivan also smiled and replied.
"En!" Hermione nodded, sat down beside Ivan happily, picked up a fork and forked a piece of syrup fruit pie and ate it slowly, not at all like usual.
Ivan sat next to him, just watching, and occasionally eating a few pieces with him.
The little witch seemed to have just taken a shower, and a nice fragrance spread on her body, which made Ivan's nose a little itchy.
Hermione looked a little bewildered by Ivan's gaze, her cheeks being hot by the warm air from the stove.
She turned her face slightly, busy changing the subject, complaining to Ivan that after she returned to the bedroom, she explained to Parvati and the others the idea of ​​anti-discrimination house elves but was laughed at.
Although she was talking about some unhappy things, Hermione's face always had a sweet smile. Ivan had forgotten to write to her before, and she had long been tossed aside.
Ivan was able to take into account that she might be hungry, and the act of preparing snacks specially in the big evening made Hersen so warm.
She even thought that Ivan must be in a hurry during the summer vacation, not deliberately forgot to send the letter, just like last time...
"Sir! Your snacks!" Dobby put the last two snacks on the table, and then picked up the empty plates.
Dobby's arrival interrupted Hermione's thoughts.
The little witch remembered the anti-discrimination "great cause" again. She looked at Dobby, then looked at Ivan, and said with emotion. "If only all wizards could treat the house elves like you did to Dobby!"

chapters.title: Chapter 568: There is no cruelty, this is just the **** of the winner over the loser!
chapters.content:
It's hard... madam! "Dobby shook his head shrillly, and then continued proudly. "Only a great wizard like Lord Hals would be willing to pay us!" "
"That's not necessarily, Dobby! I believe that as long as we actively speak up, there will definitely be more people willing to agree with this concept!" Hermione said firmly. She believes that the current abuse of house elves by wizards is completely a remnant of feudalism. The old ideas that come with it.
Then the little witch asked Dobby curiously, how much salary does it get every month, and how many days off?
Dobby wanted to answer with excitement, so as to show his master's greatness, but when he opened his mouth, he thought that Ivan had ordered himself not to disclose the details of the salary to others, so he drooped his ears and said vaguely.
"Your Excellency Hals gave Dobby a lot of money, as well as vacations... My God, sir is such a noble man!"
"Okay, don't praise me anymore, go on!" Ivan didn't dare to ask Hermione too much to avoid revealing the stuff, so he waved back Dobby.
Hermione glanced suspiciously at Ivan, but didn't say anything.
In her opinion, since Dobby is so grateful, then Ivan’s salary must be quite a lot, perhaps lower than a normal wizard.
"Why did you suddenly think of liberating the house elves? Hermione?" Ivan asked curiously, and he was always puzzled.
"Why not?"
The little witch looked at Ivan very seriously, and then talked endlessly. "House elves have paid so much for their owners...not only need to undertake all the housework, but also to ensure absolute loyalty and obey the master's commands, but what does their hard work get in return?"
"In exchange for discrimination and wanton beatings! I even read in the book that when the power of mysterious people was at its peak, some wizards treated house elves as pests!"
At this point, the little witch was very angry. She had contacted Kreacher and Shining and asked about their lives.
In her opinion, the house elves are a group of hardworking and loyal groups, and they can become family partners of wizards, not slaves to be beaten and scolded!
Listening to Hermione's angry words, Ivan didn't seem to be moved, and he spoke calmly.
"Since you have read the book, you should be clear about the origin of the house-elf wizards. They are creatures created by wizards and must serve the wizards from generation to generation. This is the meaning of their lives..."
"Do you really think so? The wizard created the house elves? They are obviously so similar to the elves!" Hermione retorted, after a pause, then guessed.
"Maybe some wizards deliberately tampered with history in order to enslave them, so that the house elves will perish forever!"
"Also...they are intelligent creatures just like us, they also think, shouldn't be treated like this!" Hermione added finally.
Ivan looked at Hermione in surprise. He didn't expect that the little witch would question the contents of the book one day.
"What's wrong? Did I say something wrong?" Hermione looked a little uncomfortable seeing Ivan not replying for a long time. She nervously stuck a fork in a piece of cake in front of her, and the cream splashed on the table.
"No, it's nothing, it's just surprising that you could have thought of this!" Ivan laughed.
He had read that book, and of course he knew what was going on.
The group of house elves is indeed not the creation of wizards, but a kind of magical creatures enslaved by wizards in the process of controlling the magical world.
After all, wizards are not strong enough to create a group of magical creatures with human-like intelligence and natural ability to cast spells.
That is already the category of God!
Ivan thinks that this may be the reason why the wizard group has always been defensive against house elves and has been committed to cultivating servility for thousands of years.
But the practice of those wizards is not a problem in Ivan's view.
