After successfully putting his name into the Goblet of Fire, Ivan did not forget to remind the young wizard to keep it secret. If this method is spread, a large number of young wizards will follow suit one after another, causing chaos in the auditorium.
In that case, Professor Dumbledore will surely trouble them!
[Ding, a new mission has been generated! 】
Just as Ivan was thinking about it, the system prompt sounded through his mind.
Ivan hurriedly opened the task list and looked at it, as he thought, this time it was about the Goblet of Fire!
[Task: Defeat Goblet of Fire
Mission: Participate in the Triwizard Tournament and win the championship!
Task reward: legendary value*3
Mission description: This is a major event jointly organized by the three major magic schools in Europe. The selected warriors will go through many tests until they win the final victory!
Task Remarks: You are keenly aware that this is an excellent opportunity to become famous throughout Europe...]
Seeing the new mission, Ivan couldn't help but feel a little moved.
How long?
Finally there is a task that looks normal!
Not to mention that this time the reward is still very rich, with three legendary points!
As long as it is completed, plus the legendary points left over from last school year, he can immediately perform the fourth blood fusion.
...
The next day, Saturday morning, Ivan took a good sleep and woke up from bed until ten o'clock. After a brief wash, he walked slowly towards the auditorium.
Before stepping into the hall, Ivan heard a loud noise coming from inside, and then two familiar figures flew from the front and fell heavily on the floor in front of him.
The dull sound of landing made it hurt even when I heard it.
"George, Fred... Good morning, the way you say hello today is really special!" Ivan looked at the Weasley brothers who were lying on the ground and moaning in pain. He immediately understood what was going on and laughed. Jokingly said.
"Hi, Ivan, good morning!" George got up from the ground with difficulty, touched his still aching shoulder, and grinned in response.
Fred on the other side was also ready to speak, but before he could speak, a burst of green smoke appeared from his chin, and a large thick white beard suddenly grew.
"My God, Fred, you have a beard!" George witnessed this magical scene with his own eyes, and curiously stretched out his hand and grabbed it, and then discovered that this should be a real beard, not a blindfold.
"Hey~ can't you be lighter? You are the same?" Fred patted George's hand angrily, and saw that George had grown a beard just like himself, so he immediately reached out and grabbed it, wanting to get back.
The two quickly became a group.
"I should have reminded you, gentlemen Weasley!"
At this moment, a deep, amused voice came from behind them.
Ivan turned his head and looked over, Dumbled was walking out of the auditorium.
George and Fred, who were arguing, stopped quickly, appearing a little guilty.
Dumbledore didn't mean to punish them, he looked at the new look of the two with interest, his eyes gleaming.
"I suggest you both go to Ms. Pomfrey. She is already taking care of Miss Fawcett in Ravenclaw and Mr. Summers in Hufflepuff. They are as determined as you My own age has increased a little bit."
"But I must say that their beards are far less beautiful than yours!" Dumbledore said jokingly and then looked at Ivan again.
At the banquet in the auditorium last night, he saw that Ivan intends to become a warrior of Hogwarts and participate in this year's Triple Finals.
For this, Dumbledore did not object.
As a principal, he naturally hopes that the warrior representing Hogwarts can beat the other two magic schools in the game and win honor for Hogwarts.
Therefore, when laying out the age line, he deliberately left a flaw that was difficult to find. He planned to wait for Ivan to think and meditate to no avail, and when he asked McGonagall for help, he would relay it to the other party through McGonagall and let Ivan crack it in public .
This not only convinced the crowd, made the little wizards who are not enough age speechless, but also blocked the mouths of Maxim and Karkaroff.
But now that the plan hasn't been implemented, Dumbledore is surprised to find that Ivan's face is not half of the confusion and distress he had imagined, but rather a relaxed and confident look.
(ps: Generally, two shifts are sent before eight o'clock, and one shift is sent after ten o'clock.)

chapters.title: Chapter 592: You are late, Professor McGonagall!
chapters.content:
This surprised Dumbledore. When he was in the auditorium, he saw the age line on the ground, and there was no sign of being cracked, so he was very curious about how Ivan successfully signed up for the competition...
But doubts turned to doubts, Dumbledore did not have the idea of ​​public inquiry. After urging George and Fred to go to the school hospital for treatment as soon as possible, he left the hall directly.
The two Weasley brothers, who were warned, did not dare to be negligent, and with a bitter face, they helped each other to the infirmary.
Ivan comforted them a few words, then crossed the threshold and entered the auditorium.
Harry, Ron, and Hermione were already sitting at the long table in Gryffindor, enjoying today's breakfast while chatting about the Triwizard Tournament.
When they saw Ivan coming in from the door, several people hurriedly waved and greeted.
"Ivan, here!"
Ivan, who had been hungry for a long time, stepped forward and sat down in the space specially reserved for her beside Hermione. He picked up a piece of pastry and stuffed it in his mouth, and asked about the registration status of the participants in the morning.
"The students from Durmstrand and Boothbarton have already been here, and I just saw Cedric from Hufflepuff cast his name in!" Harry said.
Ron on the side also added. "Our Gryffindor only had Angelina signed up all morning. George and Fred wanted to fool around with ageing agents, but they failed in the end..."
Ivan nodded, and it seemed that his method of signing up for the competition had not been leaked out. The senior who happened to meet last night was still very trustworthy.
"I told you a long time ago that these little tricks can't affect the magic set by Professor Dumbledore..." Hermione took the opportunity to preach, trying to dispel the idea of ​​them becoming warriors.
Harry and Ron couldn't listen at all, and after a few perfunctory responses, they turned the topic to Ivan.
They are very curious how Ivan would wake up so late today, and in the morning they can't wake up no matter how...
"Isn't it Saturday off today? You have to let me sleep more!" Ivan yawned and replied casually.
Hermione looked at Ivan suspiciously, always feeling that something was wrong, and then suddenly asked something as if she had suddenly thought of it. "Surely you came here to crack Professor Dumbledore's age line last night?"
Harry and Ron immediately realized this possibility, and stared at Ivan together.
Ivan hesitated for a moment. He wanted to find a reason to fool it, but when he thought of waiting for the banquet, he would definitely read his name. He couldn't hide it, so he said vaguely.
"You can say the same too!"
"God, you didn't call us for such an important thing!" Ron leaned forward excitedly, and then asked excitedly. "What happened in the end? Did it succeed?"
Ivan didn’t know if he should answer. Although Harry and the others would not have any impact on him when they signed up for the competition, there were many little wizards who were watching the Goblet of Fire during the day, and it was almost impossible to avoid the sight of others. .
Telling Ron and Harry is equivalent to the whole school knowing...
When Ivan was having a headache, Professor McGonagall walked in from the other side of the hall and waved at him.
"Halse! Come with me..."
"I'm sorry, Ron, I have to go first, Professor McGonagall find me! I'll tell you when I come back..." Ivan ran away as if he had seen a savior, eating two desserts indiscriminately. .
Harry and Ron who remained behind looked at each other and felt that Ivan had found a way to break the age limit.
Hermione gave them a blank look. "It's impossible. Professor Dumbledore said that no one can cross that age line!"
...
At the same time, McGonagall took Ivan away from the lively auditorium and walked towards the deserted tower.
Along the way, McGonagall explained the release principle of restricted magic to Ivan from time to time.
"The age line set by Albus is also a kind of restricted magic. It is difficult to crack it head-on with your current level of magic, but it is not without tricks!
As long as you find the magic node and destroy it, you can make it temporarily invalid. "
McGonagall talked freely and gave Ivan an analysis.
This magic node was naturally reserved by Dumbledore, in order to facilitate Ivan's cracking!
But McGonagall didn't tell the specific location of the node, but planned to use it as a test for Ivan to find it on his own.
Having said this, McGonagall took out a pocket watch from the pocket of the wizard's robe and opened it to take a look. "It's ten thirty in the morning, and you have almost eight hours to find it before the dinner begins!"
"Hals, I have already told you the way to cross the age line. Whether it can be done depends on your own efforts!" McGonagall said with a smile.
"Professor, you should have told me earlier!" Ivan's expression was strange.
"I don't think it's too late, right?" McGonagall thought Ivan was worried about running out of time, so he comforted. "You have to have confidence in yourself, Hals, with your ability, eight hours are enough to find the magic node..."
"No, professor! I mean... I put my name in the goblet of fire last night!" Ivan spread his hands, his face was full of innocence, but the words clearly revealed a meaning ——You are late, Professor!
"What? You signed up for the competition last night?" Professor McGonagall stopped walking and looked at Ivan in astonishment.
Ivan didn't intend to conceal it, so he directly stated the method he used.
After listening to McGonagall the corners of her mouth twitched, she did not expect that Ivan would use such a "special" means to bypass the age line set by Dumbledore.
Thinking of her own words just now, McGonagall was even more embarrassed. After a while, she shook her head with a wry smile and said with emotion.
"It looks like I'm worrying about it for nothing, Hals!"
"Professor, this method was unexpectedly thought of by me, otherwise I would have to ask you for help..."
Ivan would not feel complacent because he had put his name in the Goblet of Fire in advance, he knew that McGonagall said so much just to help himself.
Even though I said it a little late and didn't make much difference, Ivan still understood it.
After explaining this little misunderstanding clearly, Ivan had no plans to return to the auditorium. He didn’t want to be asked questions by Ron and others after going back. So he and Professor McGonagall used Transfiguration Curses to decorate the castle to welcome Halloween in the evening banquet……
Only in the evening, thinking that the banquet was about to begin, did Ivan slowly walk towards the auditorium.

chapters.title: Chapter 593: Warriors Candidates
chapters.content:
In order to welcome Halloween, the entire auditorium was decorated with a dark and terrifying look.
A large group of black bats wandered in mid-air with pumpkin lanterns in their mouths, and the bright candlelights became much dimmed. Ghosts that are usually hard to meet appeared one after another and played with the little wizards passing by. call.
The long tables of the four colleges were already full of people, and the goblet of fire that was originally placed in the middle of the high platform was moved to a place not far from the faculty seat.
The little wizards in the audience were fidgeting one by one, whispering something, their eyes constantly turned to Dumbledore sitting on the teacher's bench, anxiously waiting for the moment when the candidate of the warrior was announced.
After Ivan sat down, Hermione asked curiously.
"Ivan, what does Professor McGonagall do with you?"
"Let me help decorate the castle!" Ivan replied casually.
Harry and Ron on the side also came over, wondering if they had crossed the age line set by Professor Dumbledore.
"How should I put it, I signed up last night!" Considering that the result will be announced soon, Ivan said it truthfully, and then he continued without waiting for the excited two to speak.
"You sleep too hard in the middle of the night, I can't wake you up. The Goblet of Fire requires you to vote in person. I can't do it even if I want to help you..."
Ivan's explanation successfully blocked Ron's mouth, but Ron still complained in his heart that Ivan was really not friends enough, and even if such an important thing was deadlifted, he had to pull them over.
Harry was also somewhat disappointed, but he quickly adjusted his mindset.
These days, although he often imagines in his heart the scene where he will become the Warriors and finally win the championship, he also knows that his abilities are not enough, and becoming a Warrior will probably only humiliate Hogwarts.
As they were talking, the noisy hall suddenly became quiet. Ivan looked at the stage and found that Dumbledore had stood up from the position of the teacher's seat.
This means that it is time to announce the results!
The little wizards in the audience looked around, and even Ivan was a little nervous.
Dumbledore walked to the table where the goblet of fire was placed, looked at the clock on the wall, looked around the crowd and said.
"Probably there is still a short time! Before the official announcement of the results, I have to say one more thing-after the names of the warriors are announced, I hope they will walk to the top of the auditorium, walk along the staff desk, and enter the next room. ...They will get initial guidance there!"
Dumbledore pointed to the door behind the instructor's desk, motioned for a moment, and nodded with satisfaction, seeing that everyone was listening, and took his wand out of his arms and waved it widely.
In an instant, the surroundings became dark. Except for the candles in the pumpkin lanterns, the rest of the candles went out one after another, and the auditorium suddenly fell into a half-bright and half-dark state.
Correspondingly, the flames of the goblet of fire quickly strung together, turning into a dazzling crimson color, and crackling sparks splashed out, spewing out a piece of scorched parchment.
Dumbledore stretched out his hand to take it, took a look, and pronounced the above forcefully.
"Warrior of Durmstrand-Victor Krum!"
Slytherin's seat rang out with a particularly warm cheers, and many people on the long tables of other academies also clapped. They are all loyal Krum fans.
For example, Ron seemed very excited. He was so excited when he heard Dumbledore say Krum, as if he had read his own name.
Dumbledore raised his palm and pressed it down. When the applause and conversation subsided, another piece of parchment flew out under the thrust of the flame and fell into Dumbledore's hand.
"Warrior of Boothbarton-Fleur Delacour!" Dumbledore shouted.
With a smile on her face, Furong gracefully stood up from the long table at Ravenclaw, and the boys in the auditorium warmly applauded and congratulated.
After a few seconds, the goblet of fire fireworks turned red again, and sparks burst out.
The little wizards in the audience looked at the goblet nervously and excitedly. They all knew that it was the warrior of Hogwarts next!
The third parchment quickly flew out.
"The warrior of Hogwarts--" Dumbledore said loudly, his face was just right with a look of surprise, his eyes turned to Gryffindor's long table, and he said word by word.
"Ivan Hals!"
Under the attention of everyone, Ivan Shiran stood up and nodded to the surroundings.
The noisy auditorium suddenly became silent, and the little wizards present stared at Ivan with wonder, doubt, and admiration.
Furong and Krum, who hadn't walked out of the auditorium, stopped and turned their heads.
"Wait..." Karkaroff patted the table and got up from his seat, looked at Ivan and then glared at Dumbledore. "Albus, if I remember correctly, according to the regulations, the candidate for the warrior should be an adult wizard over the age of seventeen, not a fourteen-year-old kid!"
"Be calm, Karkaroff, you remember correctly... As for why this is the case, then I have to ask Mr. Hals!" Dumbledore said with interest.
Although he knew that McGonagall had already approached Ivan and should know how Ivan crossed the age line, Dumbledore had no intention of asking.
The unknown is sometimes a pleasure.
Ivan couldn't see the slightest panic on his face, he replied with an expression of ease.
"That's because I wrote my name and the school I represented on a piece of parchment, and put it into the goblet of fire within the specified time.
Obviously, the Goblet of Fire recognized me as the best student among all the candidates, and I deserve to be a warrior of Hogwarts! "
Ivan's words are undoubtedly a bit arrogant made many senior students glared at them, but they couldn't refute them, and they were aggrieved for a while.
"We're not asking about this, Mr. Hals, you haven't answered how you crossed that age line!" Karkaroff frowned and asked reluctantly. He suspected that Dumbledore secretly gave it. Ivan opened the back door.
The little wizards in the auditorium were equally curious, all staring at Ivan, waiting for his answer.
"No, you are misunderstood, I can't crack Professor Dumbledore's magic!" Ivan shook his head and replied truthfully.
There was an uproar on the court. This time not only Karkaroff, but also Maxim stood up and questioned Ivan’s cheating to obtain the place of the Warriors. Many of the little wizards who failed the election were afraid to cancel it. The identity of Van's warrior!
Facing everyone's doubts, Ivan remained calm and composed, and he pointed to the goblet of fire on the high platform and said.
"Who said that you must crack the age line to put the name in? Just ask a student who meets the conditions to take out the goblet of fire?"

chapters.title: Chapter 594: Harry who is hard to argue with
chapters.content:
"Professor, you told us that those who want to participate must write their name and school on a piece of parchment and put them in the Goblet of Fire. I have done it!"
Ivan looked at Dumbledore, and finally added. "At the banquet last night, you didn't say that you can't take out the Goblet of Fire, did you? I personally signed up according to the entry method you gave, should this count?"
This... this also works?
The little wizards who heard these words couldn't help feeling a bit ridiculous. They thought for a whole day and used various methods but there was nothing to do with the age line. Unexpectedly, Ivan was so simple to bypass it!
George and Fred thumped their chests even more, annoyed that they hadn't thought of this method in the first place.
Both Karkaroff and Maxim are a little hard to accept, but upon thinking about it, they have to admit that Ivan's method can indeed avoid restrictions.
They extremely suspected that this obvious loophole was specially reserved by Dumbledore for Ivan's competition.
But when the two looked at Dumbledore, they found that the centenarian's face was also full of consternation, and it didn't look like it was pretending.
It took a long time for Dumbledore to react, speaking annoyedly. "This is indeed my omission..."
"Professor, my level of magic is far inferior to yours, so I can only play a little clever!" Ivan humbly replied.
"This is not a shameful thing, Hals! Wisdom is also important to wizards! By the way, you have taught us all... Sometimes the strength of strength is not the key to victory or defeat. "Dumbledore said with emotion, looking at the little wizards in the audience.
Karkaroff and Maxim looked at the two singing as if they were acting, and they were furious, but even if they were not happy, they could only hold them in their hearts.
Because the method was thought of by Ivan himself, it can be regarded as breaking the restriction set by Dumbledore in a sense.
Coupled with the rules that cannot be changed after the Warriors of the Goblet of Fire are confirmed, they are clear, so no matter how much refutation is made, there is no point.
Bang bang bang...
When everyone was silent, a round of applause came from the Ravenclaw table, Ivan turned his head, and suddenly found that it was Luna who was applauding.
The little witch is still so maverick today. There is a large chain of wine stopper necklaces around her neck. The wand is so casually pinned behind her ears, it looks strange, so that the people next to her are deliberately separated from her. A distance.
Just after Luna Liao's sudden applause, like an infection, sparse applause quickly sounded everywhere in the auditorium.
First Hermione, then Dumbledore, Harry, Seamus...the applause in the auditorium grew louder and louder, and finally everyone applauded.
Most of the students put aside their prejudices and recognized the identity of the Warrior Ivan, many of them shouted booingly.
"Awesome, Hals, I knew that age line must not be difficult for you!"
"Warrior of Hogwarts, hero of Gryffindor!"
...
The applause and cheers in the auditorium made Ivan breathe a sigh of relief. He knew that he had gained everyone's approval.
This is also the reason why he deliberately asked questions in the auditorium yesterday, to build momentum so that everyone knows that he intends to participate, when he becomes a warrior, he will not be as abrupt as Harry in the original time and space, and can minimize the voice of opposition.
After making a noise for a while, Dumbledore coughed a few times, interrupting the harmonious atmosphere, he said loudly.
"Well, it's not too late to celebrate later. Now that our three warriors have been selected, please follow the previous arrangements..."
Before Dumbledore finished speaking, there was a sudden movement in the goblet of fire next to him. The long tongue of flame rose up to a height of half a meter, and a piece of parchment with charred corners slowly fell from the air.
The sudden change attracted the attention of the little wizards to the past.
Isn’t the selection of the Warriors over? Why is there still paper coming out.
Ivan immediately thought of something and swept his gaze to the teacher's bench, staring at Moody and Barty Crouch, but he couldn't find any flaws in their faces.
Dumbledore subconsciously grabbed the parchment and glanced at it, his face became very serious, he looked at it carefully, confirmed that it was correct, and then read it out loud.
"The fourth warrior—Harry Potter!"
After Dumbledore said his name, everyone was stunned. The auditorium was quieter than when Ivan was elected just now, and everyone didn't understand why a fourth warrior appeared.
As the person involved, Harry was even more stunned. His brain was blank. He wondered if he had misheard, or was simply dreaming...
"This is not fair. This is cheating. Only one contestant is allowed in a school!" Karkaroff was completely angry. He hit the table in front of him with a punch, and the violent voice recalled in the auditorium.
"I need an explanation, Dumbledore!" Maxim said angrily with a grimace.
If Ivan is not old enough to forcefully participate in the Triwizard Tournament and is still within their tolerance, then the appearance of two warriors at Hogwarts is unacceptable to them!
Dumbledore ignored the questioning of the two, but calmly looked at Harry and asked. "Did you put your name in the Goblet of Fire? Harry?"
"No, Professor, I didn't put my name in, and I don't know why this happened..." Harry shook his head quickly, explaining anxiously.
But Harry's explanation was too pale, and almost no one wanted to believe it, and all kinds of questioning eyes made him very uncomfortable.
He turned his head in a panic and asked his friends for help, "Ron, Hermione, you should know that I stayed with you all the time last night, and the whole day today, I don't have time to put my name in! "
Hermione nodded and explained a few words to testify to Harry, but unfortunately not many people listened.
Ron was a little absent-minded and kept pursing his lips without speaking.
"Enough, don't explain! Who knows if you are in collusion..." Karkaroff yelled and interrupted Harry and the others, and then looked at Ivan with chills in his eyes.
"And there is another person here who can compete against the rules, isn't it? Who knows if he has thrown someone's name in!"
"I wouldn't do this. The previous Triwizard Tournaments are very dangerous. I can't let friends who are not strong enough take the risk!" Ivan retorted.
Afterwards, Ivan looked at Karkaroff sarcastically, without any mercy.
"In addition, please use your mind to think about it. There are many students who have put their names in the Goblet of Fire, but the candidates for the Warriors are fixed. It doesn't make sense to choose four Warriors. It should be someone who has moved something to this thing. Hands and feet..."
"The Goblet of Fire is a very powerful magic item. Don't you think two fourteen-year-old children can do this?"

chapters.title: Chapter 595: Unhappy banquet
chapters.content:
Ivan's unceremonious words made Karkaroff angry enough.
Dumbledore on the side made a round and spoke.
"Well, Karkaroff, what Hals said is reasonable. The Goblet of Fire cannot elect four warriors for no reason, and we should not blame these on the two children!"
"Who should be to blame? Are you to blame? Dumbledore?" Karkaroff demanded.
He even suspected that Dumbledore had moved something on the Goblet of Fire that caused this result.
After all, the current situation is beneficial to Hogwarts!
The participation of the two Warriors can greatly increase Hogwarts' winning rate and become famous in the Three Finals. Dumbledore also has this ability to cast a spell on the Goblet of Fire.
"If you insist on thinking so, it is indeed my negligence and I didn't take good care of it. But please believe that this result is also not what I want to see..."
Dumbledore said calmly, not being annoyed by Karkaroff's questioning, he paused, then continued.
"We are all aware of the dangers of the Three Finals Cup. I have no reason to put my mind and effort into getting a child who is not strong enough to participate in the competition. If I want to choose a second warrior, Hogwarts has more and more suitable candidates! "
"Who knows what you think? I only know that there are two people participating in Hogwarts now. This is a serious violation!" Karkaroff said patiently.
"Mr. Crouch...Mr. Bagman!" Maxim also turned his head angrily to look at the two Ministry of Magic officials who were frowning, and said.
"You are the organizers and fair referees of this game. What should you do now? Should you re-register or ban a warrior from Hogwarts from participating..."
"Ah... Objectively speaking, it is not up to the specifications for a school to select two warriors, but the problem is that now the contract has been established. According to the regulations, each of them must participate!" Bagman wiped his handkerchief. His round baby face was full of embarrassment.
"Bagman is right! In addition, this matter has not yet been fully understood. We can't hold someone accountable without evidence, maybe this is just an accident!" Crouch began to persuade.
"You made me treat this incident as an accident? Don't even think about it!" Karkaroff's face was very ugly. In his opinion, Bagman and Crouch were favoring Hogwarts and bullying them. These foreigners.
Maxim also echoed. "Since there are two warriors at Hogwarts, to be fair, we have to re-display the Goblet of Fire and increase the number of places until each school has two warriors!"
"No, I'm afraid this won't happen, Ms. Maxim, the Goblet of Fire has just been extinguished, and it will not reignite until the next tournament as usual." Bagman shook his head and said helplessly.
"There is no next year! Durmstrang will never participate in such an unfair competition again, and I will take my students to leave tonight!" Karkaroff was angrily crowned and pulled up angrily Krum left.
The rest of Durmstrang's students also got up from their seats angrily, and followed Kakarov out of the auditorium.
The same was true for Maxim, taking Boothbatten's students out of the scene midway in protest.
Harry stood there watching the two leaving figures, looking a little at a loss. He felt that this year's Triple Finals must be over before it even started.
"Don't worry, Harry, they didn't have the guts to go! When that Krum and Fleur put their names into the Goblet of Fire, the magic contract was already established. If they didn't compete in the end, the backlash would be very serious!" Mu Di limped down from the platform, his face heavy, but he still spoke to comfort Harry.
Ivan looked at Moody and suddenly asked. "Professor, why didn't Mr. Bagman suggest canceling a person's score? Even if it is necessary to participate, as long as the result of a warrior at Hogwarts is invalidated, wouldn't it be relatively fair?"
Having said that, Ivan looked at Harry again, his face full of apologetics. "Oh, Harry, don't mind, I'm not targeting you!"
Harry nodded blankly. He was still wondering why he became a warrior. He didn't even hear what Ivan was talking about.
"We can't do this, Hals!" Moody sighed, glanced at Harry, and explained to Ivan. "This is too cruel to Harry. He has done nothing wrong but has to face those dangerous projects like you. We can't make him work hard without getting a fair evaluation."
"Also, the Triwizard Tournament is a very important event. There are many wizards all over Europe paying attention to it. In case Harry performed well in the game and eventually won the championship, we canceled his result. , Then the referees will be overwhelmed by yelling letters!"
"Of course, you can use your method. We can replace the Hogwarts Warrior with the lowest score. The final result is invalid! However, I guess Karkaroff and Maxim will definitely not agree with this. Fair!" Moody grinned and laughed.
Only then did Ivan understand.
After explaining it to Ivan, Moody turned his head to look at Dumbledore, "How about I track down the Goblet of Fire incident? Albus? I think Hals’s speculation just now makes sense, maybe Someone moved their hands and feet on the cup and wanted to target Harry..."
"It would be best if you are willing to take over! After all, you are more experienced in this area..." Dumbledore agreed without hesitation Ivan frowned insignificantly, but Didn't say anything.
On the face of it, Moody's is indeed the best candidate for the investigation, and he is not sure whether there is any problem with Moody's, and retorting it will only startle.
In case he is mistaken, next time he wants to find a chance to reveal some information, such as when the Horcrux is down, the credibility of the words will be greatly reduced.
Dumbledore talked with the two high-ranking officials of the Ministry of Magic for a while, and soon reached a consensus. He raised his wand and blessed himself with a magnificent curse, and then spoke to the noisy little wizards below.
"Well, it's not too early now. I think you need a good rest. This is the end of today's dinner!
As for the guidance and advice to the warriors, we will arrange it until tomorrow. I will inform Mr. Karkaroff and Ms. Maxim! "
After Dumbledore finished speaking, he left the auditorium with the professors and Crouch of the Ministry of Magic and others. The other little wizards returned to their respective lounges unwillingly under the prefect's scolding.

chapters.title: Chapter 596: Pot King Snape
chapters.content:
"Let's go, don't think so much, Harry!" Ivan patted Harry, who was still frozen, and said.
Harry nodded, his expression tangled.
Along the way, he opened his mouth several times to say something, but each time he was held back in the end.
"Just say what you want!" Ivan glanced at him and said casually.
"Ivan, you will believe me, right? I didn't put my name into the goblet of fire at all, and I don't know why that note came out of the goblet of fire..."
Harry, who had been holding back for a long time, had a somewhat unstoppable posture when he opened his mouth. He talked about it for a long time, and made his two-day itinerary clear, so that Ivan knew that he had no chance to touch the Goblet of Fire.
"Of course I believe you! Harry!" Ivan interrupted Harry's words comfortingly, and then added. "It's not easy to fool the Goblet of Fire. Only a powerful wizard can do this. Based on this, you have no suspicion..."
Seeing Ivan's willingness to believe in his own words, Harry's depressed mood eased a lot, but he really didn't think anyone would specifically want to make himself a warrior.
The two of them went back to the lounge all the way while chatting.
When they read the order and opened the entrance passage, the noise from inside almost deafened Ivan's ears.
More than a dozen hands stretched out from inside and dragged the two in together, almost making Ivan think he was attacked.
Gryffindor’s lounge was obviously decorated, the surrounding walls were hung with brilliant colored lights, and crimson lion flags were floating in the air.
A little wizard even took out his torn sheets and wrote the names of the two warriors on it with a large pen.
"Ivan, Harry, you are amazing! I didn't expect the two warriors of Hogwarts to be in Gryffindor!" George said excitedly, hugging Ivan.
"But you should have told me you signed up sooner!" Fred hammered Ivan on the shoulder.
"Why didn't we think that we could take out that cup?" George also said annoyedly, and then looked at Harry on the side and asked. "By the way, Harry, how did you add the name? Like Ivan?"
"Or some other, newer method?" Seamus also got together at this meeting.
The other little wizards looked at Harry one after another, all curious about this question.
"Enough! I swear I didn't do that! I don't even know why it became like this!" Harry shouted angrily, his voice loud enough to startle everyone.
For a while, the noisy lounge became a little silent, and George, Seamus, and others were frightened by the sudden explosion of Harry.
"Well, if you didn't vote by yourself, who would be helping you?" Angelina murmured, and finally turned to look at Ivan.
"Don't! Don't throw this mess to me. I explained the specific reason when I was in the auditorium." Ivan shook his head, but he didn't carry the pot.
"Come on, we all know how good you are! What is the difficulty for you to fool a broken cup?" George said with a grin, "Now we are all our own people, we are just curious... absolutely not Someone said it!"
Ivan rolled his eyes and didn't believe a word.
Doesn't he know what kind of temper these people are? All of them didn't keep the door open. If he talks nonsense tonight, it will be spread throughout the school tomorrow...not to mention that this matter has nothing to do with him in the first place.
"Since there are no outsiders here, why did I lie to you? And there are two warriors at Hogwarts participating. Even if we win, we will definitely be gossiped. I won't take that effort!" Ivan explained with all his heart, but Seeing the expressions of everyone, he understood that not many people wanted to believe it.
Simply, Ivan didn't bother to explain.
He is used to some misunderstandings. Compared with the group of brains in Knock Down Alley, this can only be regarded as a trivial...
Alas...Excellent people are like this, and they always cause unnecessary misunderstandings!
Ivan thought distressed, and perfunctorily celebrated with everyone about becoming a warrior.
Harry looked absent-minded all the time.
After the short celebration, Hermione pulled the two directly to the corner.
Unlike the others, Hermione didn't ask how Harry actually competed, but looked worried.
"Remember your dream? Harry?" Hermione asked solemnly.
"Of course, remember! What's the matter?" Harry replied hesitantly.
"Don't you understand? It must be the mysterious man who wants to take the opportunity to get rid of you, or is preparing some plan in secret! Even if he didn't do it himself, it is possible that he secretly instructed someone to do it!" Hermione quizzed. While talking, his expression was very serious.
Ivan looked at Hermione unexpectedly, but didn't expect the little witch to deduce the cause and effect so quickly.
Harry also felt that Hermione's guess was very possible, and after thinking hard for a while, he said suddenly. "I thought of who it might be!"
"Who?" Ivan asked hurriedly.
He almost forgot that Harry was also a good breakthrough. If Barty Crouch Jr. got in, he would probably try to contact Harry and gain his trust.
"It must be Snape!" Harry shouted loudly.
Except for Snape, he couldn't think of anyone else. Only Snape and Malfoy had treated him badly this semester.
If anyone wants him to die, Harry thinks it must be one of the two!
Ivan almost didn't draw it up in one breath. He looked at Harry with a weird look. Can you not stare at someone every time and wonder if Snape has carried enough pots these years.
Just thinking that Snape always likes to stare at Harry alone In a sense, the two sides are even.
Although Ivan disagreed with Harry's words, Hermione agreed very much, and even suggested that Harry could tell Moody to let him stare at Snape, or write to Sirius to ask his opinion.
If it doesn't work, go to Dumbledore!
Hermione said a lot, and Ivan couldn't help but mention a few words to make Harry be more careful. If someone is suddenly good or bad to him, it means that there is probably something wrong with this person.
The support of the two best friends made Harry forget the questioning words, and he realized that someone still wanted to believe and cared about himself.
"Wait... Ron? Where did he go?" Harry looked around, but didn't see his other friend.
"Um... Ron said he was a little tired and went back to the dormitory to rest. More specifically, you should ask him yourself." Hermione hesitated for a moment, and didn't say what Ron had complained in private.
She felt that everyone was friends, and Ron might just be unable to think about it for a while.

chapters.title: Chapter 597: The crack of friendship
chapters.content:
"Where is Ron uncomfortable? When I was in the auditorium, I saw that his face was a bit wrong..." Harry asked worriedly.
Hermione didn't answer, just told them to go back to the dormitory to rest soon. It's better to ignore Ron for now, he will figure it out after a night's sleep.
Harry was at a loss, wondering what was going on.
Ivan had noticed something from Hermione's attitude, but he didn't care. He had too many things to consider recently, and he didn't have the time to pay attention to Ron.
After bidding farewell to Hermione, the two went back to the bedroom.
Pushing the door open, Harry saw at a glance that Ron was lying on the bed in his shirt, with his back facing them and covering his head with a pillow.
Ron was the only person in the entire dormitory, and Neville and the others did not come back in the lounge.
"Ron, are you okay?" Harry felt a little strange, so he stepped forward and shook him.
"I'm fine, Harry! It's just a little uncomfortable, so I don't have time to celebrate for you..." Ron removed the pillow from his head and pulled out a smile, looking reluctantly.
"Celebrate, what to celebrate?" Harry frowned, feeling that something was wrong with Ron.
"Of course it's to celebrate that you have all become warriors!" Ron sat up, his tone a little heavy, he looked at Ivan and then at Harry, and asked.
"Ivan was selected after taking out the goblet of fire and putting his name in, so what about you? Harry? How did you do it, using the invisibility cloak?"
"Ron! Do you think I put my name in that goblet just like them?" Harry laughed angrily, and he gasped and explained in annoyance. "I said very clearly when I was in the auditorium, I didn't do that! And I stayed with you for these two days, you know I didn't have that opportunity!"
Ron didn't pay attention to Harry's explanation, but guessed for himself.
"Not during the day. What about when I go to bed at night? Ivan went in the second half of the night, maybe you did it in the first half of the night? Or did you go together?"
"You all have a way to become a warrior, only I was a little bit close, I can't think of a way...I don't blame you, really! But you should at least tell me, so I can prepare to celebrate for you in advance..."
At this point, Ron's expression became a little depressed, his voice getting lower and lower, and finally so small that he couldn't hear him at all.
"Don't be silly, Ron, why do you think that? Didn't Hermione tell you? This Triwizard Tournament is likely to be Voldemort's conspiracy. He must have wanted me to die in that game! Remember that Dreamland? I told you!" Harry was furious.
He thought that Ron, as one of his best friends, would support and believe in himself like Ivan and Hermione, but he didn't expect Ron to doubt himself.
"Ah...mysterious..." Ron looked a little shaken, but under the control of his jealousy, he still insisted on his own ideas, and quickly found the loopholes in Harry's words, the questioning sound was like a cannon. general.
"But why did he do this? The mysterious man is not in school, how can he guarantee that you will be selected? And Professor Dumbledore was there during the game, no one dared to take you like... or Say the mysterious man just wants to watch you win the championship?"
"Are you crazy? Now someone is going to kill me, you are still wondering if there is something or not. Will you wait until Voldemort kills me before you believe it?" Harry thought Ron was unreasonable.
"Yes! I'm crazy! I thought we were best friends! The result? Each of you has a way to break through that line, but you keep hiding it from me and throw me aside. You know that I want too. Become a warrior!" Ron shouted loudly, jealousy eroding his reason.
Ron couldn't help but think of the words Ivan asked him last night, and he became more certain of his thoughts.
He thought that it must be Ivan who needed a qualified helper in order to ensure the victory of the Triwizard Tournament, so he first approached himself and asked his own opinion on the side.
After learning that he insisted on playing fair with everyone, Ivan thought it would threaten him to win the championship, so he chose Harry in the end!
The more Ron thought about it, the more he felt it was possible, and he spoke out his guess without reservation.
Harry was choked immediately. He didn't expect Ron to have such a vicious idea.
"I have to say, you have a lot of imagination, Ron...you should write a story book!" Ivan was also very speechless.
"But I guessed it right?" Ron asked nonchalantly.
"I say something you don't like, Ron! I have never regarded Krum and Fleur as a threat... From the moment I competed, there was no suspense about the victory of the top three cups." Ivan was endlessly questioned by Ron. Getting bored, after a pause, he continued to speak, his words were not merciful.
"And you think you are too high! Your magic level can't help me at all. I told you that last night because of curiosity."
Ron's face flushed red, his fists under the quilt clenched and loosened.
What he disliked most was Ivan's self-esteem and indifferent appearance.
Whether it was the honor he wanted to get, or the people he admired and liked, Ivan dismissed it, as if they were all things at his fingertips.
The more he came into contact with Ivan, the more awkward Ron was, and he felt as small as dust in the ground, without any sense of existence.
Even if he brags about his adventures with others on weekdays, he will be considered lucky to follow Ivan and Harry!
"Yeah You are the hero of our Gryffindor. It's amazing. You don't need anyone's help!" Ron became more and more angry, said annoyedly, and suddenly pulled the curtain over. Covering his four-poster bed, he put his head under the quilt.
Ron's attitude made Harry angry, and he tried to pull Ron out of the quilt after two steps, to make it clear.
Ivan next to him stopped him in time.
"Forget it, Harry, let Ron think about it!" Ivan shook his head at Harry.
Combining what happened in the original time and space, Ivan could probably understand why Ron suddenly became like this.
To put it bluntly, all these years of life experience has developed his over-sensitive and over-inferior temperament, and Ron always compares Harry as the savior, and it is inevitable that his mentality will be out of balance.
Not choosing the Warriors was just a flashpoint, releasing the emotions that had always been backlogged.
But this is obviously not the reason why others have to get used to him...

chapters.title: Chapter 598: I wish you weren't so good
chapters.content:
Harry glanced at Ron hesitantly, saw him buried himself in the quilt like a dead body, and knew that he could not be persuaded, so he ignored him.
Due to the cold war in the triple room, the dormitory no longer had the cheerful atmosphere at night, so that when Neville came back, he almost thought whether he had entered the wrong dormitory and hesitated at the door for a long time before daring to come in.
Ivan had been busy all day, and lay on the bed early after washing, but he kept tossing about and couldn't sleep.
Harry became a warrior to prove that Voldemort was still secretly working on his resurrection plan, but he had no clue now, and he couldn't even tell who was suspected.
This passive feeling made Ivan very uncomfortable. He tilted his head and looked at the squirrel cage placed on the table. Several white mice were lying in the cage.
Ivan believes that this knot can only be solved by grasping the mind of sanctuary as soon as possible!
It's a pity that the mouse's thinking is too simple after all. Since his invigorating mind has been upgraded to level three, the growth of his experience has come to a near stagnation.
He needs a new experimental subject...
Thinking of this, Ivan turned his head and glanced at Harry's bed, but soon dispelled the idea of ​​Harry helping him.
After all, this goal was too big. Dumbledore, Moody, and Voldemort's potential subordinates all stared at Harry all the time, and if he was accidentally talked about by someone, then the things that he would be seduced by would be exposed.
The most taboo of this kind of memory-reading magic is to be deliberately guarded against, especially if his spellcasting level is not high. If the opponent practices Occlumency, he may get completely wrong information.
Relatively speaking, Hermione would be a better choice than Harry.
The little witch is clever enough and knows how to keep secrets, but I don’t know if she wants to...
Ivan kept thinking in his mind, not knowing how long it took before he fell asleep.
......
On Sunday’s breakfast, Ivan woke up from the bed with a yawn and fed the mice in the cage that had lost their usefulness to Maca, as today’s breakfast.
After a while, Harry also woke up. The first thing he did after getting out of bed was to look at Ron's bed. After finding that there was no one on it, he looked at Ivan curiously and asked.
"Where is Ron?"
"I don't know, I probably wanted to avoid us, so I went out? Why, are you still going to explain to him?" Ivan put the empty mouse cage away and replied casually.
Harry hesitated and nodded. He thought about it for half the night last night. With a very good reason, he was ready to go to the line with Ron again. He felt that this time he would be able to convince Ron to believe him.
"Go if you want! But it's better not to have any hope!" Ivan shrugged, thinking that no matter how Harry explained Ron, he wouldn't listen.
Only when the tri-wizard battle for hegemony begins and Ron realizes the danger of the game can this matter make sense.
In the original time and space, Harry was able to barely win the championship with someone helping him to cheat. It was a question of whether he could pass the fire dragon for Ron. He did not have Harry's super flying talent.
The two chatted like this, while walking towards the auditorium.
Along the way, people greeted them from time to time, especially the little wizards in Gryffindor, who seemed to regard them as heroes.
"Come on, Hals, Potter! Let the people of Boothbatten and Durmstrang take a good look, we are the best school at Hogwarts!" A senior Gryffindor rushed to them Shouted.
"Of course, rest assured! You will see me win the championship!" Ivan responded with a smile.
Harry on the side seemed a little restrained. Whenever someone cheered him, Harry always seemed very flustered and didn't know how to respond.
He was worried that he was not capable enough to meet the expectations of these people.
After arriving in the auditorium, Harry realized that the situation was worse than he thought. Compared with the Gryffindor students who welcomed them unusually, the little wizards of the other three academies gave them mixed praises and criticisms.
Ivan is okay. Although there is a suspicion of trickery in the registration method, after all, he cracked the age line with wisdom, and expounded the specific method openly. Even if someone is dissatisfied, he will not say anything.
Harry was different, he heard someone talking about himself as soon as he reached the threshold.
When passing by the Slytherin long table, he even heard a student guess that he forcibly asked Ivan to cheat for him and became a warrior.
These sounds made Harry feel very uncomfortable.
"Be confident, Harry! Now that you have been selected by the Goblet of Fire, then you are the Warriors of Hogwarts! Just ignore those oppositional voices. As long as you perform well during the game, they will recognize you!" Ivan said comfortingly.
"Hope..." Harry said dullly.
At the same time, Hermione at the long Gryffindor table also saw the two people coming in from the door, and hurriedly waved to them, and then made some space for them.
"Ivan, Harry, how did you sleep last night?" Hermione asked very tactfully, because she saw Ron this morning and he was obviously not in a good mood.
"It's terrible. Ron didn't know what was going on. He had to suspect that I had secretly signed up from him!" Harry became a little angry when he thought of it, and then he looked around, but he couldn't find where Ron was. .
"He just got out of the side door and might want to hide from you..." Hermione knew what Harry wanted to ask, and said.
Harry was a little confused, why did Ron hide wherever he went?
"Don't you understand, Harry? Ron doesn't want to hear you explain, he is just jealous...so he doesn't want to see us." Ivan slowly stuffed a piece of butter cake into his mouth, his tone vague. Said.
"Jealous? Why? Just because we became warriors?" Harry still didn't understand.
"It's not just that Harry! Ron has always been jealous of you, not just because of this!" Hermione sighed, then explained to Harry.
"You can think about it. If you have two very famous friends and everyone likes them very much, you will be ignored every time. No one wants to take care of them. Even if your parents are, what will you think in the long run? "
"I will be very happy, very happy! So that no one will stare at my forehead stupidly everywhere!" Harry said excitedly. "If my childhood was spent in the Burrow, with my parents, then I would die of happiness!"
"And you, Hermione, don't you also have two famous friends? You are different from Ron!" Harry turned to look at Hermione again and added.
"No, you are wrong, and sometimes I will be jealous of you... I hope you won't be so good..." Hermione quietly glanced at Ivan and said.
Harry's eyes widened and looked a little surprised, even Ivan couldn't believe it.
"But usually only a little bit of jealousy! It's gone after a while!" Hermione blinked and laughed.

chapters.title: Chapter 599: I have never heard of that kind of magic!
chapters.content:
Hermione’s words calmed Harry a lot and made him realize that jealousy is an emotion that everyone has. For example, he occasionally jealous of Ivan’s privileges in class and that he can get good grades without much study. .
Ron may just be weak in self-control.
"Then I'll go find him!" Thinking about this, Harry was not so angry, and after eating a few mouthfuls, he stood up and said.
Ivan didn't stop seeing Harry's look firm.
After he left, Ivan turned to look at the little witch next to him, and asked. "Hermione, are you free lately? I want you to do a favor and practice a magic."
Hermione hesitated, she had a lot to do in the near future.
For example, studying the book sent by Ivan, or looking up the history of house elves, the most important study can't be pulled down, and can't stop all day long.
But even so, the little witch quickly nodded and agreed, but just asked curiously. "What kind of magic is it related to the top three cups?"
"No, it has nothing to do with the game..." Ivan shook his head, and then hesitated again. He hesitated for a while before asking.
"Also, this magic may be a little special... I don't know if you mind."
In Ivan’s view, memory is the most private and important thing for a person. Most people always have some embarrassment in their lives, and it is inevitable that some dark and inconvenient thoughts will arise...
Comparing the heart to the heart, Ivan would never agree if someone asked him to practice the mindfulness of the mind, even if the factors such as the crossing and the system were eliminated.
"Special? Is it dangerous?" Hermione was surprised by Yu Ivan's hesitant attitude.
"No, there is no danger, that is, you may see some of your privacy when you cast the spell..." Ivan cautiously tentatively said.
privacy? Hermione's mind was stunned, and the spoon she was holding accidentally fell to the ground, almost thinking she had heard it wrong.
After a while, the little witch reacted, bends down in a panic to pick up the spoon, but bumped her head on the corner of the table...
At this time, Ivan also realized that there seemed to be some ambiguity in his words, coughed lightly, and wanted to make it clear, but was interrupted before he could even speak.
"I've never heard of that kind of magic!" Hermione shouted loudly, and the blush spread from her cheeks to the base of her ears. She looked around in a panic, and noticed that more people were looking at her because of her yelling. After being attracted, the little witch's face became even more red.
"I'm going to the library!" Hermione didn't give Ivan a chance to explain at all. She clasped the book on the table in her arms, and hurriedly turned and left.
Ivan was confused, wondering why Hermione reacted so strongly.
As for? Even if you disagree, just say it directly...
"Halse!"
Just when Ivan couldn't laugh or cry, a gentle voice came from not far away.
As soon as Ivan turned his head, he saw a large group of little wizards approaching here. From their school robes, it could be distinguished that they should be Hufflepuff students.
Cedric is the leader!
Hermione, who was about to leave, also stopped at this time, ignoring the episode just now, because these people were obviously unkind.
"Cedric, are you looking for me?" Ivan asked calmly when he looked at the students surrounding him, with some guesses in his heart.
"Yes! It's about the warriors!" Cedric nodded, the expression on his face looked a little embarrassed, but he continued helplessly under the instigation of the students behind him.
"I want to understand where our gap lies, why the Goblet of Fire chose you who are not enough age to become the Warriors of Hogwarts, so... please also try a game with me, Hals!"
After Cedric finished speaking, the Hufflepuff students behind him roared enthusiastically.
"Yes! Who wins, who is a warrior!"
"A fair match, Cedric will not lose!"
"Cedric is our true warrior at Hogwarts!"
......
When the selection of the Warriors was announced at the banquet yesterday, those who were most dissatisfied with the results were the little wizards of Hufflepuff.
You know, they have always believed that Cedric would become a warrior at Hogwarts before this!
After all, among the graduates of the same period, Cedric had the best grades, and he was the prefect of Hufflepuff in his usual manners, and none of the students over the age of 17 in the school could compete with him. of.
And Hufflepuff Academy has been low-key for too long, desperately needing the honor of the Warriors!
But who would have thought that the two Warriors selected by the Goblet of Fire in the end were both from Gryffindor, and both were fourth graders under the age of seventeen.
This made them suspect that Ivan and Harry had moved something and grabbed the place of the Warriors who belonged to Cedric!
It is precisely because of this kind of thinking that the Hufflepuff students, who have never liked making noise, come to the auditorium to attack.
They wanted to find the weaker Harry as a challenge, so that it would be more secure.
Who would have thought that Harry had heard some wind from nowhere, and ran away in fear without even eating!
This kind of fleeing behavior is contemptuous!
So they had to temporarily change the target to Ivan.
But even so, they believe that Cedric will definitely win!
"Didn't you hear what Professor Dumbledore said? Once the candidate of the Warriors is determined, you can't change it... And with so many of you around here, if the professor sees it, Hufflepuff will definitely be deducted!" Hermione stepped forward and stopped between Ivan and Cedric, persuading in a hurry.
But the little wizards of Hufflepuff didn't mean to retreat, all of them looked firm as if Ivan disagrees, don't even think about leaving today.
The harassment in the auditorium attracted more and more attention, and many little wizards joined in the excitement and formed a larger circle on the periphery.
The little wizards of Gryffindor didn't think it was a big deal, and they expressed their support for Ivan to teach Cedric a good lesson, so that everyone knows that Gryffindor's warriors are well deserved.
Cedric was not affected by these people's words, his eyes were only fixed on Ivan. "How about it, okay? Hals?"
"Okay! No problem!" Ivan didn't hesitate much, so he directly agreed, and then asked intimately. "Do you need to go to a place where no one is, and do it alone?"
Public duels are glorious for winners, but losers can be ashamed.
Of course, Ivan is not worried that he will lose, but takes care of Cedric's face!
"No, right here!" Cedric shook his head and rejected Ivan's proposal.
(PS: One more today)

chapters.title: Chapter 600: A duel that ended in a flash!
chapters.content:
"Excuse me, please spread out!" Cedric turned his head and said to the little wizard gathered nearby.
Everyone retreated very wisely, and no one wanted to be affected by the battle between the two.
But none of them left, and they were all curious about who could win this duel.
"Hermione, you will be the referee!" Ivan said.
The little witch looked a little worried. The professors would deduct points for a duel in the auditorium, but at Ivan’s request, Hermione walked to the side and started to command the two to bow according to the duel process, and then read it out loud. Countdown.
"Three...two...one...start!"
Hermione waved her right arm.
Cedric on the field immediately took a few steps back at the fastest speed, and at the same time tapped his chest with his magic wand, and said.
"Protegos~ (Armor Bodyguard
An invisible magic shield surrounded his body, protecting Cedric.
This is the iron armor curse that he mastered after hard practice last year. It allows people to take advantage of the duel in a duel!
It was just different from what Cedric had imagined. Ivan didn't launch an attack immediately. He just stood still and looked at him, holding the wand lightly in his right hand without any movement.
Shocked?
This was the first reaction that came out of Cedric's mind, but he quickly forsook this thought. He had heard a lot of rumors about Ivan in school, and the other party would never be so embarrassed!
In addition to this, it is only possible to despise it!
Maybe the opponent didn't put himself in the eyes at all, so he seemed so sloppy in the battle...
Thinking of this, Cedric couldn't help being a little angry, for the first time he was looked down upon like this!
"Expelliarmus~ (except your weapon Cedric quickly drew out his wand, pointed it at Ivan, and shouted loudly. The crimson light beam flew out from the top of the wand.
The distance between the two sides was less than four meters, and the light beam almost jumped!
At this time, Ivan slowly pointed the wand at him, and he did not see him chanting the spell. The red light beam bounced back at a faster speed. Cedric's body had already made an evasive action, but he could not dodge it.
Fortunately, the Iron Armor Curse that was released earlier worked at this time and resisted this attack.
But Cedric didn't relax at all, his heart directly mentioned his throat, because the second spell beam was already in front of his eyes, directly breaking open the weakened magic shield, and hitting him firmly.
Doesn't he need to chant a spell?
At the critical moment, Cedric's face suddenly changed, and he was very puzzled. He didn't hear Ivan's curse from the beginning to the end, only vaguely saw Ivan wave his wand twice.
The thoughts in his mind flashed by, and the next moment Cedric felt his body fly out, embarrassedly bumped into the long table of Hufflepuff College in the rear, and swept the empty plates and candlesticks on the table. Ground.
At the same time, the magic wand in Cedric's hand also slipped out, swirling in the air, and finally fell into Ivan's hands.
The students onlookers were shocked and watched this scene in disbelief.
They might have thought that Cedric would eventually be defeated by losing to Ivan, but they didn't expect the battle to end so quickly, and Cedric was knocked out immediately after the official engagement!
In the crowd, Krum and Fleur also looked at Cedric who fell on the long table in amazement. Compared with most unseen little wizards, they saw too much from this short battle.
In particular, Ivan's silent and instant magic twice made them feel extremely shocked.
Silently cast spells? !
Furong thought so, she could do it by chanting the spell silently in her heart and releasing the magic, but she usually needs to maintain a very focused state, and the preparation time is longer than the spelling!
However, it was obviously not the case when Ivan cast the spell just now. It was very easy and freehand, and after releasing the protective spell, he silently cast the disarming spell again for a while, which was not in line with the characteristics of silent casting that required preparation in advance.
Unless, the opponent uses a more high-end non-spell casting technique!
But how is this possible?
If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, Furong would never believe that this is what a fourth-grade little wizard can do...
"Cedric, are you okay?" Hufflepuff's little wizards stepped forward anxiously to help Cedric up after a brief stupefaction.
Several people still stood in front of Ivan, seemingly to prevent Ivan from doing anything to Cedric.
Ivan scratched his head, feeling that he was too heavy to start, but he really had to keep his hand, and gave Cedric a chance to shoot first, so that the other party would not be too embarrassed.
At this moment, Cedric stood up with the support of everyone, but his face looked very pale, and his eyes towards Ivan were full of complex colors.
He didn't expect that he would lose so thoroughly, he couldn't even make a little resistance!
More excited than Cedric are the little wizards of Hufflepuff. They came to surround Ivan with enthusiasm just to prove that Cedric is the real warrior candidate!
Now that their pride in Hufflepuff is so easily defeated, most people find it difficult to accept this result.
Some people even thought that Ivan was playing tricks, or Cedric didn't play well. They clamored to compare it again!
Listening to these people's words, Ivan frowned, then looked at Cedric. "Why, do you plan to compete with me again?"
"No, no need to compare, I lost! I don't think there will be any change in the result even if you try it a few more times..." Cedric rubbed his still aching chest and shook his head with a wry smile.
"By the way, I didn't hear you chanting a curse just now Are you able to cast spells without a curse?" Cedric asked with a solemn expression. He was as afraid as Fleur and Krum. I believe that a fourth-grade little wizard can have such high-end skills.
"So, you didn't come at the right time, I just practiced this time!" Ivan nodded.
Since learning about the mystery of magic from Nico Lemay, he has been trying the technique of spellless casting during this period of time.
Now those frequently used magic, Ivan has been able to smoothly release without cursing, that is, the power of magic will be weakened a lot, at most it will be used to abuse vegetables, or beat opponents unexpectedly in formal battles.
"Amazing!" After getting Ivan's confirmation, Cedric was completely convinced, sighed and praised, then turned around and looked at the students gathered around.
"It's all gone, you should see that I am inferior to others! Ivan Hals is indeed more suitable than me to be a warrior at Hogwarts!"
(PS: I recommend a book "Hogwarts in Other Worlds" here. The setting is very novel. It is a Harry Potter of another timeline (Grindelwald defeated Dumbledore and became the principal), interested You can take a look.)

chapters.title: Chapter 601: Is that magic that important?
chapters.content:
After Cedric spoke, the little wizard of Hufflepuff was unhappy and had no choice.
Seeing that there was no excitement to watch, Fleur and Krum turned around and left, but both seemed a little worried, because they found that Ivan's magic level was higher than they expected.
"I'm sorry, it took you some time, Hals!" Cedric said apologetically.
"It's okay, I also benefited a lot from playing against you just now..." Ivan shook his head. Cedric generously admitted that he was a little surprised by the defeat, so he casually said something polite.
It was only after speaking that Ivan realized that his words were not right, and seemed to be a little mocking of the other party.
After all, the battle is over in an instant, there is no benefit at all...
"In short... I hope you can successfully win the championship on behalf of our Hogwarts!" Cedric said with a wry smile, and then greeted the little wizards of Hufflepuff to leave together.
At this time, the little wizards around Gryffindor gathered in excitement, and George patted Ivan on the shoulder again, looking very excited.
"Ivan, you are so amazing, you defeated Cedric so easily! I want to see who dares to question our Gryffindor warrior now!" George said admiringly.
Ivan was also a little happy, but not because he defeated Cedric, but because he found that the number of his followers in the taskbar had changed from four to fourteen...
This means that after the battle just now, his strength and tolerance have successfully convinced some people.
Ivan had always had a headache before how to complete this task, but now he has found a way, as long as he performs as a multitude.
The Triwizard Tournament in the near future will be a good platform, which means that you may be able to complete your two tasks at the same time!
"What happened here? What are you all doing around here?"
Just as Ivan was thinking about getting happier, Professor McGonagall who received the news rushed over. As soon as she entered the hall, she saw the mess around Hufflepuff’s long table, and the Gryffindor children gathered together. Wizards.
"Professor, it's like this. Just now, Cedric in Hufflepuff insisted on fighting Ivan in the auditorium..." Seamus hurriedly explained.
Of course, he was on Ivan's side, all kinds of fueling and jealousy wanted to push the responsibility to Cedric.
Although this is indeed the case...
"Even so, you shouldn't agree to a duel with him, Hals! Especially if you can't fight in the auditorium and you have broken so many things... Hufflepuff and Gryffindor deduct points!" Professor McGonagall said very dissatisfied, and waved his magic wand to repair the broken candlestick and round basin.
The little wizards in Gryffindor were a bit aggrieved, and it was Hufflepuff who was clearly instigating the matter. Why did they even deduct points?
Ivan didn't care, he could see that Professor McGonagall was already merciful, and it was the most basic to change to the usual 20 deductions!
After restoring the broken objects, Professor McGonagall stopped mentioning the duel, but looked at Ivan and spoke.
"Halse, Principal Dumbledore asked me to tell you that Mr. Crouch and Mr. Bagman will give the Warriors preliminary guidance in the next cubicle in the afternoon... Don't miss the time!"
"I will go, professor!" Ivan replied.
McGonagall nodded, then looked away from Ivan and turned to the others. "Well, what are you still gathering here to do, don't you have anything else to do today?"
Under McGonagall's scolding, the little wizards who watched the excitement dispersed one after another, and Ivan was able to calm down.
He turned his head and looked at the little witch who hadn't left yet, thinking of his plan to practice sensationalism, he bit the bullet and asked again. "Hermione, what I said before... don't know if you agree with it?"
"Is that magic that important?" Hermione pursed her lips, her expression a little disturbed.
"Yes! It's more important!" Ivan said helplessly. If it weren't for this, he wouldn't ask Hermione for help.
"What about the time? When do you need to practice...practice that magic?" Hermione stammered.
"How about the evening? Wait for me on the roof of the tower!" Ivan said after thinking about it.
Hermione hesitated for a while, but nodded in agreement.
......
In the afternoon, after dinner, Ivan counted the time and arrived in a compartment not far from the auditorium according to Professor McGonagall's instructions.
Pushing the door open, Ivan found that he was the latest one to come, and Furong, Krum and others had already arrived.
Harry was also standing aside, but his expression was not so good. Ivan knew for a moment that he must have hit a wall with Ron, and this time he didn't win the match.
But this was also in his expectation. If Ron was very caring after learning that they became the Warriors, he would instead investigate whether Ron was controlled by someone...
After a while, Bagman and Crouch opened the curtain and walked out of the back room.
"Now that everyone has arrived, let's officially start!" Bagman glanced at a few people and said. "The first game will be held on November 24. You need to complete a certain task in front of all the students and referees!
What I can reveal now is that this level tests your guts! I hope you can show enough courage when facing it..."
Bagman looked at the warriors in front of him with a little playfulness, talking endlessly about the various precautions of the game, but he did not disclose the specific content at all, and the curiosity of Harry and others Hook it up It's up to you to say, Barty! Bagman continued speaking for ten minutes, consciously speaking, he looked back at Crouch.
"Ah? Oh! Good!" Crouch looked a little absent-minded, as if he had just awakened from a dream, nodded hastily, and stunned again. "Where did you just say? Bagman?"
"What the **** is going on with you? Barty? I've been absent-minded these days?" Bagman frowned and asked very dissatisfied.
"It's not that you don't know, there are too many things to be busy recently...I haven't slept well these days! Otherwise, it's up to you!" Crouch sighed and explained.
Bagman nodded in understanding. Crouch not only has to deal with the Goblet of Fire affairs, but also has to take care of the troublesome affairs of the Cooperation Department. It is indeed very busy.
Thinking of this, Bagman no longer had trouble for Crouch, and he accounted for the rest of the matter by himself.
On the side, Ivan secretly remembered Crouch's a little abnormality in his heart, and decided to start the investigation with Crouch after he had practiced the pantheon!

chapters.title: Chapter 602: Hermione's memory
chapters.content:
The guidance to the Warriors lasted an afternoon, and they were not returned until the evening.
On the way to the auditorium for dinner, Harry kept complaining that Ron would not listen to persuasion at all.
After a fierce quarrel in the morning, their relationship has risen from an awkward friend to the point where it is now close to breaking up.
Ivan looked helpless, and he had no choice but to expect Ron to calm down for a few days and wake up to himself.
After having dinner in a hurry, Ivan found an excuse to push Harry away, and then took Hermione to the roof of the tower, preparing to practice magic.
As he had imagined before, there was no one here, and it was very quiet. At this point in time, there is no need to worry that someone will come in and disturb you suddenly while casting the spell.
"Is there anything I need to do?" Hermione looked a little nervous, her hands and feet cramped not knowing where to put them.
"No, don't... Just stay where you are, stay relaxed, try not to resist, my technique may not be too proficient..." Ivan said soothingly.
Hearing Ivan's words, Hermione became even more flustered. She looked around anxiously, looking for a way out.
She thought, if Ivan had to do something to herself after a while, she would immediately run towards the door!
But Ivan's position happened to be facing the door, and her own strength was far inferior to that of Ivan. Hermione thought about it for a while and found that the possibility of her leaving was slim.
In addition, you can only jump directly from the tower by surprise!
However, it is very high here. I am afraid that it is tens of meters away from the ground. If she can't accurately grasp the time of releasing the slow fall technique, then she will definitely die!
Thinking of this, Hermione became entangled. Will she run or not?
Ivan didn't even know the weird thoughts that popped up in the little witch's mind, but he explained it to himself.
"The spell I'm going to use on you later is called pantheon. It can read your current thoughts or past memories...
If you feel uncomfortable in the process of casting the spell, or if there is something you don't want me to see, resist it and I will stop immediately! "
Immediately he was about to cast magic, and Ivan no longer kept it secretly, and explained the specific situation.
"Memory?" Hermione's expression was a little weird. Only then did I realize that she just wanted to cross. Ivan's previous privacy statement meant this, and she was ashamed to find a place to sew in...
"What's the matter?" Ivan was a little surprised at Hermione's reaction.
"Nothing..." The little witch shook her head hurriedly. Seeing that Ivan didn't seem to notice what she was thinking, she couldn't help but secretly relieved in her heart.
Only soon, Hermione thought of the curse Ivan was about to cast, her face became a little hesitant, and she couldn't help but ask. "What do you do with this memory-reading magic?"
"Do you still remember the guess made yesterday? Like you thought, I felt that the mysterious man might have sneaked in and planned something by our side, just like Chino did!" Ivan was half-truth and half-truth. The words explained.
"So you want to learn to seize the mind and tell who is sent by the mysterious person?" Hermione understood Ivan's purpose at once, and her original desire to reject Ivan was much weaker.
"Yes, that's right!" Ivan said with a smile, then gently raised her wand, keeping her eyes facing Hermione. "Are you ready?"
Hermione took a deep breath and nodded.
She once saw some related explanations about the magic of Shenzhang Nian in a book, and she felt that she would only need to think about some things from her childhood when she waited for a while.
"Then I'm coming!" Ivan whispered to Hermione while waving his wand. "Legilimency~ (Legilimency
Ivan's erratic voice seemed to have some magical power, Hermione's brain became a little confused, her eyes kept facing each other with Ivan, and memories came up like a tide.
At the same time, Ivan also felt that his thoughts were sucked into the body of the little witch, and scenes of fragmented memories appeared before his eyes.
The first thing that catches the eye is a very cozy little room, with pink curtains and beds, and various plush dolls and toys around it.
And what attracted Ivan's attention most was Hermione lying on the bed with a quilt, or Hermione as a child.
She looked only about eight or nine years old, with a pair of brown eyes very agile, and she was listening to Mrs. Granger next to her reading a Muggle fairy tale book.
When Mrs. Granger talked about the princess, she was persecuted by her stepmother and locked up in the little black room. Little Hermione’s face was full of worries and fears. She held the corners of the quilt with her hands tightly and curled her body as far as possible In the quilt.
Ivan couldn't help but laughed. From the point of view of an onlooker, Hermione looked so cute at this time!
But as a bystander, Ivan didn't act as if anything did not exist, and Mrs. Granger still told the story in the book softly.
In the end, a kind old witch rescued the princess from the small black house by casting a spell. The princess who fled met the prince of the neighboring country, and the two lived a happy life.
"Mom...is there really magic in this world?" Little Hermione asked curiously and enviously.
Mrs. Granger smiled and teased the usual "coaxing" Hermione to have magic in the world, but in fact everyone is a wizard.
Little Hermione may have really believed it, so she also learned the wizard in the story and chanted spells indiscriminately, looking serious.
Mrs. Granger covered her mouth and smiled.
But when Little Hermione finished reciting the spell, some stuffed dolls and small objects such as cups and teapots seemed to be guided by the place where she pointed her finger. They were suddenly thrown into the air and hit the ceiling uncontrollably. , And scattered on the ground.
One of the teapots almost hit Mrs. Granger’s head Little Hermione was shocked directly. Mrs. Granger also stared wide-eyed and frightened, but she still hugged He for the first time. Min comforted her, and Mr. Granger quickly broke in from outside...
"Is it the magic burst of the little wizard?" Ivan muttered to himself, no wonder Hermione could remember it all the time, it was indeed impressive.
This memory came to an abrupt end here, and the memories after that were all very short memory fragments, all things that made Hyeok very happy or very sad in life.
Ivan and Hermione review these memories together, sharing her joy and sadness. This feeling is very wonderful, like watching Hermione grow up slowly, experiencing the slightest joy and anger in her heart. funeral music.
Until the day when she was eleven in her memory, Hermione received the admission notice from Hogwarts...
Ivan raised his mind and was very interested. He knew that Hermione would meet him soon, so he was a little curious to see what he would be like from another angle...

chapters.title: Chapter 603: Past memories
chapters.content:
