Hermione was dazed, feeling as if she was having a dream, recalling many past events.
From the panic of the magical explosion when I was a child, to the joy when I received the admission notice when I was eleven...
It turns out that there is magic in this world!
Soon after, the professor at Hogwarts even came to the house deliberately, persuaded her parents to agree to her admission, and told them that they could lead to Diagon Alley in the magic world through the broken cauldron bar-there is a market for wizards .
Upon hearing the news, Hermione specifically begged her father to take herself to Diagon Alley in advance. While buying all the learning items on the list, she also bought a lot of extracurricular magic books in the Lihen Bookstore.
First, I hope to learn more about this magical world.
Secondly, Hermione was a little worried that she would not be able to keep up with the progress of others after she went to school.
She thinks that those peers from the wizarding family must have learned a lot of magic early, and she can't accept that she will be the one with the worst magic level in the class by then!
However, after she really entered Hogwarts, Hermione realized that she had thought too much before, and that the little wizards from wizard families were not much better than her.
On the contrary, in most classes, I can always complete the tasks assigned by the professor at the first time. The homework that makes many people headaches, in Hermione’s eyes, is very easy. She even has a lot of time to watch outside of class every day. Of magic books to enhance your knowledge!
The learning progress far surpassing her peers also made Hermione become a little proud and complacent.
It was not until a few days after enrolling in school that she encountered her first setback outside the library. She was frustrated by a peer!
"I think everyone has their own learning method!"
She kept the words of the little blond wizard in her heart.
After the opponent showed her level of transformation spell, he arrogantly turned and left, leaving her alone!
Hermione was very angry, but she was more competitive. She didn't believe that she would be worse than others. In the next few days, she worked harder and harder. Unfortunately, the gap did not narrow at all, but instead tended to expand.
The class is no longer hers alone. The hateful Ivan can always stand up and answer before she thinks of the answer and raises her hand to answer the question, as if she was deliberately targeting herself.
This makes Hermione even more irritated!
However, because of this, she became more and more concerned about the blond wizard, and noticed that Ivan secretly hooked up the broomstick with his feet in the first flight lesson, which was praised by Ms. Hooch...
Hermione was very disdainful of this way of cheating to get the professor's approval.
Afterwards, the small conflict between Ivan and Malfoy made her very dissatisfied. What if Malfoy really fell and injured her if she failed to release the Levitating Charm at the time?
Gryffindor will definitely get a lot of points deducted!
While Ivan was angry here, the little witch and the other students were not getting along well. The little wizards of Gryffindor were very skinny, and there were always people who didn't take the school rules seriously!
This is undoubtedly something Hermione cannot tolerate. If they are caught in violation of the rules, Gryffindor won't even want to win the Academy Cup this school year!
It's a pity that everyone doesn't seem to like to listen to her preaching, and her persuasion always ends without disease.
Even, Hermione vaguely felt that she was isolated, and the only ones who could barely count as friends were Harry, Ron, Ivan, and the girls in the same bedroom.
However, things backfired!
Within a few days, she accidentally heard Ron's complaints behind her back, and then she realized that her last few friends were probably just what she wished to think.
This made Hermione no longer stretched out, hiding in the girls' bathroom and crying for several hours, and even missed the Halloween party.
After crying for an unknown period of time, Hermione heard a violent noise in the corridor outside, and it didn't stop for a long time. She wiped away her tears and went out, and at first glance she saw it standing on the other side of the corridor. Trolls!
Before that, she had only seen this disgusting and huge monster in books, but now it appeared in front of her alive. Fear made her forget to run away, and she could only watch the monster step by step in a daze. near.
At that moment, Hermione thought she was going to die...but Ivan didn't know where she came out, holding her stick that escaped the trolls... The iron thorns acted as a trap and successfully killed this huge monster!
Tension, hesitation, fear, gratitude, and a little inexplicable emotion filled Hermione's mind.
The little witch wants to keep thinking about it, looking back at the scenes of her and Ivan after that, but her subconscious mind is urging her to wake up quickly...
Ivan, who watched all this simultaneously, was full of emotion. He didn't expect that he had such an image in Hermione's heart at the beginning.
Thinking about it carefully, I really meant to bully the little girl a bit, and suppressed Hermione enough.
Of course, he didn't do it intentionally. In the final analysis, he wanted to earn grade points to improve his strength.
I can get rid of the trolls within half a year of enrollment, and all of them are indispensable for advance preparation, usual practice and reserved academic points!
Ivan still remembers the thrilling battle at the time. If the experience card mode is not enough, I am afraid that he can only flee in a hurry.
But after looking back through Hermione's memory, Ivan discovered that from the perspective of an onlooker, he was so handsome at the time!
Whether it’s a quick counterattack after tumbling and dodge or an accurate calculation of the impact of the iron thorns, the action of limiting the trolls seems so perfect, in one go, a few seconds after the front and back fights, the trolls have already fallen. At his feet.
Ivan was thinking very narcissistically, and at the same time experiencing the complicated emotional changes of the little witch at that time.
However, just as Ivan was looking forward to the follow-up, the dream world suddenly became very unstable, swaying like an earthquake, and finally the whole world shattered...Ivan's consciousness was also kicked out.
When Ivan recovered from the sway, the system's prompt sound had already resounded in his mind.
[Ding, after a period of practice, the proficiency of Sensation Mind has been greatly improved, the current level is three (781/800)! 】
On the side Hermione was panting heavily with cold sweat on her forehead. It is not so easy to force her will to resist the idea of ​​detention. This is still when Ivan did not force magic, otherwise her resistance would be fundamental. Meaningless.
"Hermione, are you okay?" Ivan hurriedly asked concerned about the increase in proficiency in taking pleasure in mindfulness.

chapters.title: Chapter 604: Your love is so vast!
chapters.content:
In order to practice pantheonism, Ivan has consulted many books and has a deep understanding of this magic, not to mention using it for the first time.
He was very sure that the mind of the mind would not cause mental damage to the subject, so he dared to use Hermione to practice.
But seeing the exhausted look of the little witch, Ivan was still a little worried.
"I'm fine, but suddenly tired..." Hermione shook her head, looking evasive at Ivan.
She understands that the key to the mind is to look at each other, so she does not dare to respond to Ivan's gaze, for fear that Ivan will read her thoughts at the moment.
Hermione tried hard to calm the thoughts in her mind, but somehow the memories that were brought back to her mind kept popping up...
She remembered the shyness of being dragged by Ivan to the library after the first-year troll incident...
The secret room incident, the worry and hesitation when I learned that Ivan was chasing the murderer alone...
On the day when the third grade started, on the carriage pulled by Ye Qi, she witnessed Luna talking and embracing Ivan, and the jealousy in her heart...
Hermione shook her head and wanted to forget these things and avoid being seen by Ivan, but the more she thought about it, the clearer those memories became... as if someone was forcing her to reveal the deepest secrets in her heart. Come out the same.
"Enough! Stop it and stop using medicinal thoughts on me!"
Finally, Hermione couldn't bear to burst out completely. She yelled hysterically, punched Ivan's shoulders and chest angrily, venting her accumulated emotions again and again.
Unsuspecting Ivan suffered several times in a row, grabbed Hermione by the wrist, barely controlled her, and then explained.
"Wait, Hermione, calm down... I didn't do anything just now! Without your consent, I wouldn't be tempting you!"
At this time, Ivan also wanted to understand. Hermione was probably evoked some private memories by the magic she had previously released, and then mistakenly thought that she was still using her mind to check her thoughts.
"Really...really not?" Hermione was half-believing, her brown eyes staring at Ivan, not sure if Ivan was fooling herself.
Otherwise, why would I suddenly think of so many things related to Ivan just now...
Hermione's face burned like fire when I thought that what I had just thought might be seen by Ivan.
Compared to this, she would rather jump off this rooftop...
After seeing Ivan's face as usual, with little change in the beginning, Hermione believed a little and she was relieved secretly.
"Or we take a day off and come back tomorrow!" Seeing that Hermione's mood was not very stable, Ivan suggested.
"En! Then...I'll go back now!" Hermione stammered, avoiding Ivan's sight as much as possible, turning around almost as if fleeing, and quickly opened the door to the tower roof. .
Ivan looked at the back of Hermione leaving in a hurry, very curious, what kind of memory was so scared to let himself know.
Could it be the picture of taking a shower in the bathroom? But most people will not be impressed by this, right?
When he looked through Knott's memory before, he didn't see daily life scenes like eating, sleeping, bathing, etc., and most people would not deliberately remember these.
That's why he didn't hesitate to go directly to Hermione to practice sanctuary, because the possibility of seeing some embarrassing scenes is very low.
However, Ivan didn't pay much attention to the abnormality that Hermione showed. He felt that this might be the first time the little witch was explored and remembered, so he was a little uncomfortable, and it would be fine after a while.
However, Ivan soon found that he had underestimated the impact of this exercise.
In the next few days, Hermione deliberately avoided him, and her plan to practice sanctimonious thoughts fell through.
The relationship between them seemed to be back to what it was at the beginning of the conflict, and only when Harry was there, Hermione dared to meet herself.
And every time he wanted to inquire about the reason, the little witch was hesitant to talk to him, or simply pretended not to hear it.
If there is any change, Hermione ran to the library more diligently every day, and often disappeared after class.
Ivan was confused, but it was not easy to force Hermione to practice magic with her.
This makes the growth of the proficiency of the mind-trapping mind once again stagnated...
"Did you have a conflict with Hermione? Why does she always avoid you?" Harry couldn't help but ask after a Defence Against the Dark Arts get out of class.
"How do I know? It was fine the other day!" Ivan shrugged.
"That might be a misunderstanding, you'd better ask her and make it clear..." Harry suggested, and he didn't want to see conflicts between his remaining friends.
"I want to explain, but Hermione must be willing to listen..." Ivan said helplessly.
Harry suddenly thought of Ron, and sighed.
The two of them felt sorry for the same illness for a while.
On the way to the auditorium for dinner, Ivan and Harry were suddenly stopped by a fifteen- or six-year-old Gryffindor girl. The other party was holding a satchel and looked very nervous.
"Halse! Excuse me... can you sign me?" She handed her bag over and asked nervously, for fear that Ivan would disagree.
"Of course, no problem!" Ivan smiled and took the bag, took out the quill he carried with him, and wrote his name in a conspicuous place.
Perhaps I think that Ivan is as easy to talk as the rumors, the Gryffindor girl is more courageous, begging Ivan to write a few more words of encouragement or blessing.
Ivan readily agreed With a stroke of a big pen, he wrote a sentence on his bag-study hard and make progress every day!
The Gryffindor girl pursed her mouth, her expression turned very resentful, and she even hoped that Ivan would write something else!
The dozen or so girls who had been watching from a distance, saw that she had successfully signed her, they gathered around one after another, handed over some of their belongings, and asked Ivan to sign on them.
Ivan never refused to come. Since he became a warrior, someone has come to sign this kind of thing, and it has happened more than once.
Taking into account the needs of the task, he tried his best to meet the requirements of each of them, and the signing hands were sour.
But what puzzles Ivan is that the progress of the task has not improved much, only a few followers have been added.
It wasn't until Ivan was signing an autograph for a Ravenclaw girl that he found some clues. The other party's backpack still had Krum's signature on it.
Seeing this, the corners of Ivan's mouth twitched slightly...
Their love is really vast!

chapters.title: Chapter 605: Can't you see it? She likes you!
chapters.content:
Harry on the side looked enviously at Ivan surrounded by girls.
Krum and Fleur, who are both warriors, also have the same treatment, and are sought after by men and women in various colleges at Hogwarts.
Only he was not treated much. Except for the students of Gryffindor, the people in other academies didn't recognize his identity as a warrior, and he was tired of the cynicism secretly.
Just as Harry laughed at himself, he saw a familiar girl walking towards him.
"Ginny? Did you come to Ivan for an autograph?" Harry asked curiously, but then he felt something was wrong. If this is the case, Ginny should go around Ivan.
Ginny didn't reply, her body trembled slightly, she seemed to have taken a lot of courage to pass her bag over.
Harry was completely stunned. He pointed to the satchel and pointed to himself, speaking a bit uncomfortably. "Do you want me...let me sign? On this?"
Ginny stared at Harry and nodded, and it took a long time before she vomited an "en" in her mouth.
Harry couldn't tell whether he was nervous or excited. He panicked the pocket of the wizard's robe and wanted to find a quill to satisfy Ginny's wish, but his pocket had nothing but some Jin Jialong and candy. No.
"Hug... I'm sorry... I didn't seem to have a pen... The last session was Professor Moody's class, we usually don't bring books and pens." Harry explained embarrassingly.
Ginny was dumbfounded, she didn't bring a pen, and even asking Harry to sign it was a temporary motive. She saw a girl looking for Ivan to sign while Harry was waiting alone, which made her mind hot. Walked up.
The young girl stared at each other awkwardly,
"No! Harry, here you..." Ivan, who had just gotten rid of a few clingy girls, quickly noticed Harry's predicament and handed him his quill pen.
Harry thanked him gratefully, and took it in relief, and wrote his name on Ginny's shoulder bag.
However, his signature is not so good compared to the characters Ivan has specially practiced, and he even wrote a little crookedly because of nervousness.
Fortunately, Ginny didn't care about this. If the treasurer held the bag with Harry's signature in his arms, he ran away without waiting for Harry to say anything.
Harry didn't have time to stop it, he had planned to ask Ginny to help persuade Ron.
"How do you feel?" Ivan asked suddenly.
"What?" Harry looked at Ivan strangely.
"Of course it is Ginny! Can't you tell? She likes you!" Ivan rolled his eyes, feeling Harry a little confused, no wonder he was a warrior, but he was lonely at the party.
So that in the second level of the Goblet of Fire, the competition can only put Ron as Harry's most precious treasure in the lake-obviously they had such a big conflict not long ago.
"No...no?" Harry was stunned, squatting. Ginny is Ron's sister. He had never thought of this possibility.
And he already has someone he likes-Qiu Zhang, a girl from Ravenclaw College, so even if Ginny really likes herself, he can't respond.
Ivan saw Harry's thoughts and shook his head involuntarily.
Qiu Zhang has always liked Cedric. Now Cedric hasn't participated in the top three, and it is estimated that he will not die. Harry is obviously useless as a third player...
But Harry didn't think so, he still remembered the goddess Qiu Zhang in his dream, and forgot Ginny's kindness aside.
In the afternoon, in the potions class, Snape habitually began to ridicule, publicly complimenting Harry that he could cross Dumbledore to set the age line by cheating. This was far beyond his expectation. It was amazing!
"It seems that our savior in the magical world will have another honor this year-the first champion of the Goblet of Fire who relied on cheating to stand for election. What do you think of this title? Potter?" Snape said sarcastically. .
Malfoy and others in the audience turned their heads to look at Harry and sneered.
Harry was trembling with anger. He felt that it must be Snape who threw his name into the Goblet of Fire. Only he would want to make a fool of himself!
Snape admired Harry’s angry expression and felt his mood relieved a lot. In the past few days, the continuous bad news and the hot black mark on his arm made him feel bored. Only then can he relieve the pressure and find Have fun.
Thinking of this, Snape cleared his throat and wanted to say a few more words. At this moment, the door of the classroom was pushed open.
Snape frowned in dissatisfaction, trying to see who was interrupting his interest, and when he turned his head, he saw third-grade Colin walk in.
"I hope you can understand that it's class time, Mr. Crevey! You better have a good reason!" Snape stared at Colin coldly.
"Professor, Mr. Bagman asked the warriors to go upstairs!" Colin swallowed hard under Snape's indifferent gaze, but still spoke out under pressure.
"Now there is still an hour before class ends. When get out of class is over, I will let them go!" Snape frowned very dissatisfied, before he raised some interest, and was not prepared to let Harry's punching bag so easily.
"But Mr. Bagman said he is going now, the other warriors have already arrived." Colin was not scared back, and insisted.
Snape stared at Colin sternly, only to utter a word or two in his mouth for a long while. "well!"
"Do you want me to invite you out? Potter?" Snape suddenly turned his eyes to Harry and said coldly, then glanced at Ivan again. "Ah, and our true warrior, Mr. Hals... I think Mr. Bagman is probably just calling you alone..."
Snape's instigation didn't go as he wanted. Harry didn't pay attention to his words at all. He packed his things and walked out of the professor. He looked at Colin as if he had seen a savior.
Staying in the classroom, Harry could hardly imagine how vicious words would come out of Snape's mouth.
Ivan also took a look at Colin, patted him on the shoulder, and admired his courage. Not everyone would dare to slap Snape directly.
"If you want to thank me, please take a group photo with me later! I knew you would become warriors a long time ago. Who else but you... can anyone else?" Colin said very happily , Completely looks like a little fan.
Neither Ivan nor Harry refused Colin this time, and generously accompanied him to take a picture, which fulfilled his little wish.
Colin was so excited that if he took this photo home, his parents would be shocked!

chapters.title: Chapter 606: I am always good at boasting myself!
chapters.content:
After taking the photo, Colin took Ivan and Harry to a classroom upstairs.
"That's it! Go in quickly!" Colin said.
Ivan nodded, opened the door and walked in. Inside was a classroom, which seemed quite spacious. The desks, chairs and podium were all pushed to the back of the classroom, leaving a large open space in the middle.
Fleur and Krum arrived early, and they were talking to Ludo Bagman. Rita Skeeter, who hadn't seen them for many days, was also sitting here, dressed as before.
Perhaps after hearing the sound of pushing the door, several people turned their heads, and Bagman even stepped forward and pulled Ivan and Harry in.
"You are finally here! Come in quickly, relax, don't start the game so soon, this time I am looking for you to check whether the wand can be used normally, and avoid unnecessary accidents at that time..." Bagman shot He patted the two on the shoulders, said kindly, then pointed at Rita Skeeter next to him, and spoke again.
"Also, I almost forgot to introduce it to you. This is Rita Skeeter. She is the column editor of the "Daily Prophet" and is writing a short article about the competition..."
"This is not a small article, Mr. Bagman, I believe this will be the headlines of tomorrow!" Rita Skeeter quickly got up from her seat and walked to Ivan's body. , With an unnatural smile on his face.
"We met Mr. Hals again!" Rita Skeeter's tone sounded strange, as if she was holding back her anger.
"You know?" Bagman looked at Rita Skeeter and Ivan curiously.
"Because of receiving the Merlin Medal a few years ago, Ms. Skeeter once did a special report for me." Ivan explained with ease.
Rita Skeeter's face became a little ugly, and Ivan's words reminded her of the scene when Ivan was holding a handle and threatened.
But soon, Rita Skeeter adjusted the expression on her face so as not to be noticed by others. She cleared her throat, looked at Ludo Bagman, and asked.
"Mr. Bagman, I want to interview Hals alone. I don't know where is there to be quiet and not to be disturbed?"
"You can go to the cubicle, it's quieter." Ludo Bagman pointed to the right.
"Then let's go quickly, Mr. Hals!" With a false smile on Rita Skeeter's face, she pulled Ivan's arm with her hand, and took him to go there.
Ivan frowned in dissatisfaction. He felt that such a pull was really offensive.
After Rita Skeeter pulled Ivan into the cubicle, she locked the door, and the smile on her face disappeared instantly, replaced by a strong look of anger.
"Should you give me an explanation, Hals!" Rita Skeeter lowered her voice and gritted her teeth.
"Explain? Explain what?" Ivan looked puzzled.
"Of course it is that. Do you need me to recall it for you? About the Ministry of Magic!" Rita Skeeter's mouth twitched, and the whole person was extremely angry.
Last time she was fooled and wrote a lot of news that discredited Fudge. As a result, it was expected that Dumbledore would stand up to boycott Fudge, announcing that the election for Minister of Magic did not happen at all, and she was almost expelled by the "Daily Prophet"!
"You should go to Dumbledore, why are you looking for me? I'm just responsible for delivering instructions! Think about it, as a student, what can I do when facing the principal's orders?" Ivan is very innocent. He spreads out his hands, he doesn't carry the pot.
Who made Dumbledore throw a lot of mess to himself in the first place, and that the matter can be resolved satisfactorily in the end, the old professor should solve this small sequelae by himself.
"I'll go find him!" Rita Skeeter's words were very blunt, and then she asked with a dark face why Ivan told Dumbledore that she was Animagus.
"How do you think I knew your identity? Lady Beetle!" Ivan looked at Rita Skeeter playfully.
"It wasn't you who told him, but Dumbledore told you?" Rita Skeeter was taken aback for a moment, and then quickly reacted, her face full of disbelief.
But after thinking about it carefully, I felt that it was indeed possible, and even solved some of her doubts.
Before that interview with the Merlin Medal, she and Yifan didn't know each other at all, and there was no conflict before, and the other party had no reason to investigate themselves.
Dumbledore is different. She wrote several reports about the other party in the early years, and dug up some fierce materials. It is possible for the other party to hate herself. The most important thing is that the other party has the ability to investigate herself...
But the doubts are not without them, such as why Dumbledore told a little demon about his identity as Animagus.
Rita Skeeter has always suspected that Ivan was fooling herself from start to finish, but she didn't know where she heard some gossip, and there was no evidence in her hand to prove that she was Animagus, so she kept beating on the side. Inquired.
However, Ivan's answer was not leaking, which made Rita Skeeter very aggrieved.
Ivan said this deliberately, pushing the discovery of Rita Skeeter's identity to Dumbledore, of course, to help the old professor relieve some of the pressure.
With Dumbledore's shrewdness, Ivan was not worried about wearing a gang.
If this old professor still can't handle the gossip editor, then he shouldn't be the principal...
"Okay, don't you want to give me an interview? Should we say something serious?" Ivan was a little annoyed by Rita Skeeter's question directly interrupted the other person's inquiry Words.
Although Rita Skeeter was still a little uncomfortable, she still moved a chair, picked up a pen and prepared to ask questions.
"Wait... the format of this interview has to be changed!" Ivan suddenly thought of something and interrupted Rita Skeeter's actions.
"What?" Rita Skeeter looked at him suspiciously.
"It's up to me to write it!" Ivan was very worried about the gossip editor, considering that Rita Skeeter added all sorts of enthusiasm during the last interview, and said emphatically. "You are not allowed to change a word this time, do you understand?"
Rita Skeeter was so angry that she almost squeezed the quill in her hand. What was an interview?
This is a blasphemy against her identity as a reporter, writer and editor!
"Halse, I must remind you that it is not so easy to write a qualified manuscript..." Rita Skeeter suppressed his anger, and said comfortingly.
"That's not necessarily!" Ivan raised his eyebrows, boasting that he was always good at it.

chapters.title: Chapter 607: Low-key Hals
chapters.content:
Ivan ignored Rita Skeeter's angry gaze, cleared his throat, and said to himself.
"Just write it like this... Hogwarts warrior Ivan Hals is a good character, enthusiastic and kind-hearted person. He was kindly called the hero of Gryffindor by his classmates and friends in school. The Star of Hogwarts!
He has been praised for countless deeds, such as defeating trolls when he first entered school, using his extraordinary wisdom to see through the disguise of several Defence Against the Dark Arts professors, and developing the wolf poison potion, etc., but he himself is very humble. Said that these past deeds have long been forgotten in the back of his head, it is really not worth mentioning!
According to a student who cannot be named, every professor in the school praised him, and his enthusiasm for learning may be an important reason for his remarkable achievements..."
Ivan talked eloquently and described his excellent qualities and low-key personality as objectively as possible.
If it weren't for the fact that this interview could increase his reputation, it might constitute a legendary incident, he wouldn't be too lazy to say so much.
Rita Skeeter, who was listening next to her, was completely blindfolded. She looked at Ivan with a weird look. She had never seen someone like this...shameless!
No, think about it carefully, Rita Skeeter still found a similar scene in his memory—when he interviewed Lockhart, the other party was also talking about it like this.
"Although the Hogwarts warrior is unwilling to disclose more information, the few words he has learned are enough to see his excellent character, but he is relatively low-key! Well... that's almost it!" Ivan Smashed his mouth, thought for a while, and felt that there was nothing left, then turned his head to look at Rita Skeeter.
When he noticed that the other party was stunned and there was no word written on the parchment, Ivan frowned and said dissatisfied. "Have you not written it down yet?"
Rita Skeeter reluctantly reluctantly wrote on the parchment.
Ivan kept staring at her until Rita Skye finished writing.
I have to say that this gossip black-hearted reporter still has two tricks, and accurately recorded every sentence he said before, without the slightest error or omission.
After writing the last word extremely awkwardly, Rita Skittlesso put away the pages and planned to leave. She didn't want to stay here for a moment!
"Wait, Ms. Skeeter!" Ivan stopped her.
"What else do you have?" Rita Skeeter said angrily. She felt that she shouldn't have come to Hogwarts to interview any warriors.
"I hope you will be fair and objective when you interview Harry, do you understand?" Ivan reminded him.
He remembered that in the original time and space, Rita Skeeter made up a mess when interviewing Harry, and arranged the relationship between Hermione and Krum to win attention, which made Ivan very uncomfortable. , He warned Rita Skeeter not to mention her friends casually in the article.
"Otherwise, I think your readers would rather listen to your story!" Ivan threatened.
...
After a "friendly" conversation, Ivan and Rita Skeeter walked out of the cubicle.
"It looks like you guys have a good conversation?" Bagman, who was waiting in the classroom, leaned forward and said with a very weak eyesight.
He knows very well the virtue of Rita Skeeter, a woman who digs hard like a mad dog, everyone in the magic world can't avoid it. Now he sees Rita Skeeter as if he has suffered a big loss and is suppressing his anger. , Suddenly a little curious.
Rita Skeeter smiled reluctantly, but Ivan on the side took the initiative to express that he and Ms. Skeeter had a very happy conversation.
Bagman didn't believe a word, but he knew that he might not be able to ask anything, so he could only start talking about business. "Halse, since the interview is over, let's go over there! Mr. Ollivander is testing the wands of the warriors, you are the only one!"
Ivan nodded and turned to look at the podium, where several tables had already been set up. Dumbledore, Karkaroff, Maxim, and Crouch were all sitting on the chairs behind it.
In addition to them, there was an unimpressed old wizard standing in the room. The other party was holding Harry’s wand and saying something, and then waved it again. The top of the wand suddenly spewed with burgundy liquid, filling the front. Of several cups.
"It's in good condition, Mr. Potter!" After experimenting, the old wizard returned the wand to Harry.
Harry put his wand away, then looked at Ivan, and said hello. "Ivan, it's you!"
Ivan stepped forward and passed the wand up as Harry did.
The old wizard took the wand, but his light-colored eyes had been staring at Ivan, and his eyes showed admiration and nostalgia.
"It's been a long time since I saw you, Mr. Hals! I remember the last time I saw you, you were so young..." The old wizard gestured with his hands, and then said with emotion. "But then I knew that your future must be extraordinary. I gave you this magic wand by myself!"
"You have a good reputation, Mr. Ollivander!" Ivan said modestly, and he had recognized the identity of the old wizard in front of him.
But Ollivander's words, Ivan did not take it seriously.
He rummaged through his memories and found that when "Ivan Hals" went to the magic wand shop to buy a wand, the wand master was obviously very perfunctory, treating him no differently from other little wizards.
And apart from a few exceptions, the magic wands in the hands of the British wizards were basically from Ollivander's hands, and of course they were all handed over by him personally!
Ollivander is very satisfied with Ivan The happiest moment in his life is to witness a talented wizard using his wand to shine in the magical world. .
This not only played a good role in publicity, but also gave Ollivander a feeling of personal participation.
While thinking in his mind, Ollivander did not forget what was going on, and quickly raised the wand in his hand to his eyes and looked at it carefully.
"Yew, unicorn hair, eleven inches and three-quarters long..."
Ollivander routinely analyzed the composition of the magic wand and determined that this was the one he gave to Ivan, but at the same time he also noticed the magic texts that were burned on the magic wand.
"Well, did you make some post-improvements to it?" Ollivander raised an eyebrow.
"Yes, Mr. Ollivander!" Ivan said cautiously. He knew whether he would make the transformation on his wand privately would cause the other party's unhappiness.
In fact, Ivan didn't want to hand over his wand, but it was necessary for every warrior to check the wand, and he didn't bring the spare wand.

chapters.title: Chapter 608: Are you having any trouble? Ivan?
chapters.content:
Ollivander took the wand and looked at it carefully for a long time, a gleam of light flashed on his light-colored eyes.
"It seems that there are two magic text circuits on this, one is to reduce the movement when casting spells, the other is to strengthen the power of magic?" Ollivander looked at it for a while, and then roughly analyzed the role of these magic texts. Turned his head to look at Ivan and confirmed.
"Is this your mother's handwriting?"
"No, I personally modified it!" Ivan shook his head.
"Very good...remarkable! When I was as old as you, I couldn't transform a magic wand by myself." Ollivander said appreciatively.
He doesn't reject Ivan's behavior in improving the wand. He generally only sells standard wands here. It is normal for a capable wizard to improve his wand later.
As long as the other party can take good care of it and treat his wand well...
"By the way, Mr. Ollivander, you mentioned my mother just now, do you know her?" Ivan asked curiously.
"There are only a few capable alchemists in England. Diagon Alley and Knockdown Alley are not far away. I have met her several times..." Ollivander said with a smile, and then Experimented with a few small magic tricks with Ivan's wand, and returned it after confirming that there was no problem.
Ivan didn't ask much, and reached out his hand to take the wand.
Karkaroff stood up hurriedly and asked.
"Wait, Mr. Ollivander, you just said that Mr. Hals’ wand has been modified to increase the power of magic? I think this is extremely unfair to other warriors. We should prohibit him from using it in the game. This magic wand!"
"I remember that the Three Finals Cup did not stipulate that the Warriors cannot use the improved wand? Principal Karkaroff?" Ivan frowned and said in dissatisfaction.
"But the regulations mention that it is forbidden to use super-standard magic items. In my opinion, your magic wand should belong to this category!" Karkaroff defended.
A few days ago, Ivan easily defeated the graduate Cedric. Karkaroff has already heard from Krum.
He knew Ivan's strength was extraordinary, and if Ivan were to hold this magic wand again, then Hogwarts' advantage would be too great.
Maxim also agreed with Karkaroff, but before she could agree, Dumbledore retorted.
"Every warrior should give full play to his strengths, Karkaroff! Hals is proficient in alchemy, and it is not impossible to use it in the game."
Dumbledore's voice was as loud as Hong Zhong, he looked at Karkaroff, and then at Krum. "Could it be that we should ban Krum from flying in the game because Krum is a Quidditch player? Or forcing him to use only the oldest comet broomstick?
As for Miss Furong, her temperament is not available to other warriors. I may need to suggest that her face be covered during the game, so as not to affect the judgment of the referee and the performance of other players! "
Karkaroff was choked by Dumbledore's words.
As Durmstrang's warrior, Krum's biggest advantage is the super flying skills he has cultivated over the years. The specific events of the game have not been announced yet, and he is not sure if it will be useful at that time.
Once banned, it is definitely a very big loss.
Maxim's heart moved, covering his face had no effect on Furong's strength. It would be worthwhile to limit the advantages of Ivan and Krum.
"Several gentlemen and ladies, please let me say something." Ollivander stood up at this time, he looked at Ivan, and helped to speak justice.
"Hals' wand was remodeled a few years ago. I didn't think it was a special preparation for this game. In addition, a handy wand is particularly important for the Warriors' strength. If you change it temporarily, It's too unfair for Hals!"
"Or, do you prefer to give every warrior a wand that doesn't fit your hand?" Ollivander asked.
Karkaroff and Maxim had no excuses for rebuttal, and they had no choice but to accept the fact that Ivan could use a powerful wand in the game.
Otherwise, Dumbledore will definitely put many restrictions on the other Warriors. If this causes the Warriors to have any accidents in the game, it will be more than the loss.
Ivan looked at a few people, very depressed. He wondered why Karkaroff and Maxim always wanted to limit themselves?
According to the normal process, shouldn't he be underestimated because he is too young, all kinds of cynicism, and then be beaten one by one by himself?
"Well, now that the warriors' wands have been tested, what are we waiting for? Come and take pictures!" Standing not far away, Bagman saw that the atmosphere on the court was a little stiff, and hurriedly rounded the field.
Under Bagman's urging, Karkaroff and Maxim temporarily suppressed the unhappiness in their hearts, walked to Dumbledore's side, and took a few photos with the warriors in the front row.
After taking the photo, Rita Skeeter intercepted Harry, Krum, and Fleur who were about to leave. She hadn't found any material from Ivan, so she could only start from other warriors.
Ivan gave Harry a self-seeking look at the dragged Harry, which could help warn that Rita Skeeter was already at the limit of what he could do.
Leaving the classroom, Ivan walked alone in the aisle of the castle, thinking about the next action in his mind.
Soon, the first game of the Goblet of Fire will officially begin.
If nothing changes, this level should require the warriors to seize the dragon eggs that are tightly protected by the fire dragon.
For other warriors, this is undoubtedly an extremely dangerous task, and a little carelessness may be injured or even killed.
Ivan is not very worried. He has many ways to subdue the Fire Dragon. The key lies in how to play more excitingly, so that more people can spontaneously become their own clusters and complete the tasks of the system.
What really made Ivan feel the headache was that the practice of mind-consciousness had once again stalled. Without Hermione's help, he desperately needed to find a target for the next practice.
Even if he didn't catch the inner ghost, he could tell Dumbledore about the replacement of the trophy with the door key in the third game to destroy Voldemort's resurrection plan.
But doing so is likely to irritate the internal correspondent sent by Voldemort. When the other party is angry, he may attack the students in the school, and even affect his friends.
Therefore, we must find out this inner should before the third game!
"Who else can help me practice this magic?" Ivan muttered to himself.
He can't just find someone to practice, right?
Ivan wouldn't do it as a last resort, even if he could use the Forgetting Curse to finish off after the fact, what if he accidentally beats someone stupid?
Not to mention that Moody's is investigating the Goblet of Fire incident at the school recently. If he finds the student's anomaly and traces it to his head, it will be difficult to explain.
Ivan lowered his head and walked slowly in the castle, excluding options one by one in his mind, a gentle breeze was blowing along the corridor, and a melodious and ethereal voice suddenly came from the front.
"Are you having any trouble? Ivan?"

chapters.title: Chapter 609: Painful memory
chapters.content:
(PS: Hermione, the single heroine of this book, has said it many times! Luna will be a very important help to enhance the relationship between the two...)
Thinking Ivan subconsciously raised his head and looked over.
A familiar figure stood by the window at the end of the corridor, slightly raised his hand, several blue birds were falling on her forearms, and the chirps one after another were like a symphony.
"Luna? Why are you here?" Ivan stepped forward and said in greeting.
"There is no class in the afternoon, so I just wandered around in the castle..." Luna said casually, shaking her wrist slightly, and the blue birds spread their wings and disappeared into the sky.
After doing this, Luna turned her head, looked at Ivan with bright eyes, and said happily. "Congratulations on becoming a warrior!"
"Thank you, I received your blessing that night!" Ivan laughed. He remembered that Luna was the first person to applaud and congratulate him when Dumbledore announced the candidate for the Warriors.
"Um... Then, are our warriors at Hogwarts willing to walk with me?" Luna saw that Ivan seemed to have something on his mind, so she proactively suggested.
Ivan readily agreed, and he thought Luna might be a good candidate.
The two of them wandered around the castle wantonly as a group, without a clear destination, and no one talked about the annoying things wherever they went, and each chatted about some interesting things that happened after school.
Ivan hasn't been so relaxed for a long time, and all kinds of troubles one after another on weekdays make him feel a little breathless.
But thinking of business affairs, he still took Luna to lean as far as possible to a remote place, lest the conversation be heard by others.
"Can you tell me now?" Luna looked around, seeing that no one else could be seen around, she asked curiously.
"It's hard to imagine anything that can stump you..." Luna added.
"Don't praise me like that, you don't know, there are too many troublesome facts that can stump me in the past few years." Ivan shrugged helplessly.
"But you can always solve them every time, can't you?" Luna said with a chuckle.
"It's true, although sometimes the results are not perfect..." Ivan has regained some confidence, but the recent chaos still gave him a bit of a headache. After thinking about it, he needed to practice Sensation. Let me talk about the lack of a helper.
"Patient mind? Is it the magic that can read memory?" Luna pondered for a while. Ivan once told her about this spell.
"Yes, so when you practice, you will see some of your past memories... I don't know if you mind?" Ivan asked cautiously.
He thought Hermione avoided him because of this, and Ivan was worried that Luna would refuse.
Unexpectedly, the little witch agreed directly and swiftly. It was almost surprising to him.
"We are friends, aren't we? If this can help you!" Luna said briskly, as if being read by the memory would not cause her any trouble.
"Also, when can we start?" she asked again.
"Now, right here!" Ivan looked around, and they had already reached the eighth floor of the castle, where no one would usually come.
Luna nodded and turned to face Ivan, waiting for him to release the magic.
"Legilimency~" Ivan kept looking at each other, took out his magic wand and lightly tapped it on Luna's forehead, and said.
The erratic spell connected the two people's thinking together, and scenes flashed in their minds.
Ivan was sure that this was the easiest time for him to cast spells. Luna hardly had the idea of ​​resisting him, and he was able to see the scene where Luna was hidden deepest in his heart.
It was an exceptionally desolate green area, and a lonely-looking house was erected not far from it. At first glance, it looked like a huge black cylinder, covered with branches and vines, and the billowing white mist steam was coming from the top of the cylinder. Constantly gushing out.
"This is my house...Novgood's mansion."
Suddenly, an ethereal voice came from behind, shocking Ivan. He turned his head abruptly and found Luna standing behind him.
"Can you appear in your own memory?" Ivan asked suspiciously.
"Should I be here?" Luna said strangely, thinking that Ivan's magic was like this.
Ivan was confused. It was the first time he had encountered this situation since he learned how to seize the mind.
"Let's go in!" Luna didn't mean to delve into it. She took Ivan's hand, stepped up the steps, and walked towards the open door.
Ivan also temporarily put this question aside, and followed Luna into the mansion.
Unlike the quaint and dilapidated appearance of the outside world, the mansion is very spacious and tidy, not at all as cluttered as it appeared in the original time and space.
However, the overall decoration style is eccentric. Everything here is round, whether it is a table, chair, room or kitchen. There are also various cut newspapers on the wall. There are a few family portraits. The following are reports of some rare and magical creatures.
Ivan looked around, then led Luna to a studio.
"That's me." Luna pointed to the small figure sitting on the round chair, her expression a little nostalgic.
Ivan followed Luna's direction and looked over. It was an eight or nine-year-old blonde girl who was pestering a 30-year-old wizard at the moment, not as quiet as it is now.
"That is my father Xenofilius Lovegood." Luna pointed to the wizard again, explaining.
Ivan suddenly understood.
In his youth, Xenophylius looked handsome, and he was not sloppy at all. It was only visible from the manuscripts on the table and the words in the conversation with Luna. At this time, he already liked researching. Those weird things.
In addition to the father and daughter in the studio there is also a witch who concentrates on research. Luna pursed her mouth and did not introduce it, but Ivan guessed that it should be Luna's mother.
From the looks of it, she was a very beautiful witch in her early thirties, no wonder she gave birth to a spiritual girl like Luna.
"She is my mother..." Luna said quietly, confirming Ivan's guess.
At this moment, the witch suddenly called Luna when she was a child, stood up and was about to go out.
When passing by the two of them, Luna stretched out her hand as if she wanted to stop each other, but she passed directly through the witch.
The ending is already doomed, everything here only exists in her memory...
Ivan looked at Luna apologetically, and he understood that the dementia he released had caused the other party to experience the most painful memory again.
But before Ivan apologized, Luna shook her head, stopped his words, and then spoke.
"Let's go, let's go outside too!"

chapters.title: Chapter 610: There are already 2 people in this memory...
chapters.content:
Luna took Ivan out of the door while slowly telling him about this experience.
Ivan, who was listening, learned some of Luna's childhood.
The Novgood family are all workaholics and research mads through and through.
Xenophylius' main business is an editor-in-chief of the magazine "The Singing Tune". In his leisure time, he likes to study some weird rumors, and he also studies insects in the magical world.
The little witch's mother is keen on the study and improvement of spells. In addition to doing housework and teaching Luna, she usually spends the rest of her time on it.
"During that time, the newspaper business was not very good. For this reason, my father had a headache. He worries about finding hot news materials every day... But his readers always don't buy it very much. If this continues, the family will I'm struggling to make ends meet."
"It just so happens that my mother is developing a new type of blasting spell. If she can succeed, it must be big news!"
Luna's ethereal voice passed along the breeze to his ears, and Ivan looked at the mother and daughter leaving the hut, and then at Xenofilius, who remained in the studio and wrote the manuscript.
"Then your father doesn't know about this?" Ivan asked curiously.
"She won't let me and Dad talk..." Luna shook her head. This spell is very dangerous. There were some small mistakes during the previous experiment. Her mother was almost injured. For this reason, her parents rarely quarreled. One.
Xenofilius did not agree with his wife doing such dangerous research.
However, Ivan was puzzled. Why did Luna's mother bring her own daughter when she was doing the experiment, so she didn't worry about the curse spreading out of control?
Is it possible to record some data as an assistant? But Luna's age is too young, right?
The doubts in Ivan's heart were quickly answered.
The witch took Luna when she was a child into the dense forest not too far from home, and after casting an iron armor curse on herself, she took out a package and handed it to her daughter, and told her to stand farther away. .
The sharp-eyed Ivan noticed some green potions in the package, and he knew at a glance that it was specifically used to treat burns with his potion awareness.
By this inference, the other party regards Luna as the last insurance.
Obviously, the witch also understands the dangers of the experiment and is always vigilant.
Generally speaking, the protection of the iron armor curse and the potion for special treatment are enough to cope with most emergencies, not to mention that Luna in her childhood is staring at the side. If there is an emergency, she can run back and notify Xie at any time. Nofilius comes over.
"Mother said, this is the last experiment, and her curse is about to be completed..." Luna stared at the scene in a daze, sighing sadly.
Ivan didn’t know how to comfort him,
As Ivan expected, when the last word was read, the blasting spell released by the witch was completely out of control!
The magic that was supposed to be aimed at the enemy finally swallowed itself, and the burst of fire light brightened the dense forest, and the huge explosion sounded through the sky.
The defense of the iron armor curse failed to play its due role in front of this force. It was easily torn apart. The witch's body was like a flying catkins. It was thrown up, and it was completely dead when it fell to the ground. .
The corpse was muddy and fuzzy, and Ivan estimated that this was because Luna's mind was shocked, so she forced the picture of her mother's death in her memory to be blurred.
He could imagine the psychological shadow that would be left behind for a nine-year-old girl who witnessed the death of her mother in the explosion.
Thinking of this, Ivan turned her head and looked over. Young Luna's face was full of horror and sluggishness. She staggered to the witch's body and stood there, shouting something lowly in her mouth. , Stretched out his hands, but did not dare to touch.
Poor Ivan was a little worried.
A few seconds later, Xenofilius, who heard the explosion, appeared here, knelt down in front of the witch's body madly, crying out loud, shouting something loudly in his mouth.
Ivan couldn't hear clearly, but Luna couldn't remember when she was young.
"I'm sorry!" Ivan said with a sigh. If he chose to do it once, he would never ask Luna to practice the magic of dementia.
"It's not to blame you, I want to see her again..." Luna pursed her lips and shook her head, even if it was only in memory.
"Dad also told me that as long as I am willing to believe, I will have the opportunity to see my mother again in the future, not only in memory or in a dream... He will not lie to me! Never..." Luna's melodious voice Reverberating in this dense forest.
Ivan stopped talking. The resurrection of the dead is not impossible in the magic world, but it is very difficult to save a witch who died in the explosion five years ago, almost zero.
Xenophylius is undoubtedly deceiving Luna, giving her a vain hope as a spiritual support, hoping that time can smooth the wound.
Ivan could see that Luna probably really believed it, or that she could only believe so...
The story in the memory continues. After Luna's mother died, there was no laughter in Lovegood's mansion.
Xenofilius devoted himself to the study of those legends in order to forget the pain. He was not good at housekeeping and messed up the mansion every time, relying on magic for simple tidying every time.
Although he still cares about Luna, he is busy with research and work and can't spend much time with his daughter.
In the absence of playmates of the same age, the jungle has become Luna's childhood destination!
Just like the elf in a Muggle story, a young witch with long pale blonde hair wanders alone in the dense forest.
She knows every animal in the dense forest can clearly call out their scientific names, and even named a deer and a few squirrels. Her greatest joy is to find those who have never seen them in the dense forest. Of creatures.
Every time a new creature is found, it is like finding a treasure for the little witch.
"Oh, yes, dad said that there are horned snorers here, but they are probably too scared of me, they have never showed up." Luna said regretfully.
Ivan looked at Luna, even though the little witch's face was very peaceful, even with a little nostalgia, he still felt the deep loneliness from it.
"Will you feel lonely at that time?" Ivan couldn't help but asked, and then he felt that his question was too stupid and a bit boring.
"Sometimes, not now..." Luna nodded, shook her head again, and said with a chuckle.
Ivan looked at her in confusion, unable to understand Luna's meaning.
The little witch's expression looked a little dazed. She turned her head and stared at Ivan with bright eyes, "There are already two people in this memory, aren't they?"

chapters.title: Chapter 611: The legend of the 3 brothers
chapters.content:
Listening to Luna's words, Ivan was stunned, and then a little bit dumbfounded. The little witch's thoughts were always so unreasonable.
Does seeing this memory mean companionship? That word is too cheap...
Ivan thought in his mind, but before he could say anything, he was attracted by a book.
That was a scene in Luna’s memory. It was in the studio in the Novgood’s mansion. Xenophylius usually sat in the corner and wrote the manuscript, but there was a ripped book next to it. Fairy tale book.
Ivan took two steps, scanned the content above, and confirmed that this is the "Story of Poetry Weng Bidou"!
"Have you heard of these stories too? Ivan?" Luna saw Ivan staring at the fairy tale book, so she walked to him and asked softly.
"Forget it!" Ivan's thoughts drifted a little, and he replied casually.
For some reason, Luna became a little happy. "When I was a child, I often heard my dad talk about them: "The Wizard and the Jumping Pot", "The Fountain of Good Luck", "The Witch's Hairy Heart", "Babiti and the Stump" "......"
Luna pointed out every story in the collection of Poetry Bidou's stories like a few treasures.
Ivan was stunned, because he had never heard of any of these. Before that, he had always thought that there was only one story in the "Story of Poetry Weng Pidou".
"Oh, I almost forgot, and the "Legend of the Three Brothers"!" Luna thought for a while and added.
"Yes, I remember this most clearly!" Ivan nodded hurriedly. This is the only story he knows.
There are also stories about the Deathly Hallows!
While the two were chatting, Xenophylius in his memory had already written the manuscript, and his eyes were also on the "Stories of Poetry Weng Pedou".
After a pause, Xenofilius turned the yellowed pages of the book with his hands and turned the storybook to the page describing the three brothers. Then he took out a wad of parchment from the drawer and brushed it on it. What was written in a brush.
From Ivan's perspective, the parchment was blank and there was nothing, as if Xenofilius was pretending to write.
He turned his head to look at Luna curiously, the blond little witch turned her head slightly and whispered in a low voice.
"After my mother left, Dad would read this collection of stories every day, but he never let me see what he wrote!"
Only then did Ivan understand why the parchment was blank.
But even if he didn't see the specific content, he could guess that Xenofilius must be planning to find some clues to the Three Hallows of Death from the few words given in the story.
Ivan recalled the father's promise to his daughter. He originally thought it was just a white lie, but now it seems that it may not be that simple.
The legendary resurrection stone that can regenerate the dead is Xenofilius's goal.
No wonder Xenophylius in the original time and space knows so much about the Deathly Hallows, and believes in the legend of Death and the Three Brothers even more.
Now it seems that this is definitely not just because the background of the pure-blood family has let him know some inside stories, the most important thing is that the wizard has pinned his resurrected wife on the resurrection stone.
It's a pity... Ivan knows that the power of the resurrection stone is limited, and it is impossible to resurrect the dead.
Xenofilius's plan is going to be frustrated!
Ivan thought silently, Luna who was standing next to her suddenly shook her body and almost fell to the ground.
"What's the matter? Luna? Are you okay?" Ivan stepped forward and helped her, asking worriedly.
Luna shook her head and said that she was fine, but a little tired.
After Ivan thought about it, he knew that he had been in Luna's memory world for a long time, and his mental burden was too great.
"Then let's stop here today!" Ivan proposed, and took the initiative to disarm the magic. With the world spinning around, the world built by memory collapsed.
When the two of them came back to their senses again, they had already returned to the unmanned corridor, the sky around them looked a little gloomy, and it seemed that a long time had passed!
[Ding, after hard practice, the level of Sensational Mind has been improved, the current level is four (116/1600)! 】
The sound of the reminder in his mind made the corners of Ivan's mouth slightly aroused. Just as he had imagined before, using a wizard to practice the mind-trapping mentality, the increase in proficiency was much faster than usual.
In addition, his Occidental Cerebral skill is very high, so there is almost no barrier to raising the mind before the sixth level. If you practice a few more times, you will soon be able to improve it.
"How is it, did I help you?" Luna noticed the smile on Ivan's mouth, but she asked with confirmation.
"Of course, you helped a lot this time!" Ivan said gratefully, and then asked Luna shamelessly if she could spare some time each week to continue practicing this magic with herself.
"I promise, it will be fine every time for a short while, and it won't delay too much time!" Ivan said swearingly.
...
After making an agreement with Luna, Ivan was content to return to the bedroom.
Solved the problem of sensational thoughts. During the next period of time, he only had to take time to pay attention to the map of the live spot, find a few suspicious candidates, and then confirm them one by one.
Entering the Gryffindor lounge, before Ivan had time to go upstairs, he saw Harry hurriedly running towards this side.
"Ivan, where did you go this afternoon? I have been looking for you for a long time, and I didn't see you during dinner." Harry gasped and asked.
"I wandered around the castle and practiced magic, what's wrong? What's the matter?" Ivan mumbled casually, but he was a little curious about what Harry was anxious to do.
Harry looked around like a thief. Seeing no one was looking here, he lowered his voice and continued to speak.
"Hagrid asked us to find him in the middle of the night! He also asked me to bring that invisibility cloak...but you should know that that garment has been lost..."
Hagrid? Ivan raised his eyebrows and recalled it, only then did he think that Hagrid was going to take them to see the fire dragon, and revealed the content of the first exam in advance.
Of course, Ivan doesn't know if there will be any changes in the project now, so it would be nice to go and see.
As for the invisibility cloak...
"It doesn't matter, we can use the phantom spell!" Ivan patted Harry on the shoulder and said soothingly.
...
At 11:30 in the night, Ivan and Harry got up from the bed in the dormitory lightly. After blessing the phantom spell, they walked through the common room quietly, avoiding a few who were still awake The senior students left the castle quickly.
"This magic is so convenient, it's even more powerful than the invisibility cloak!"
Stepping out of the door of the auditorium, Harry glanced back at the portraits that completely ignored his existence, and said with emotion.
Unlike the invisibility cloak, which is inconvenient to carry, this spell only requires a wave of the wand.

chapters.title: Chapter 612: Fire dragon!
chapters.content:
"No, this magic is not as powerful as your invisibility cloak, it can't make us completely invisible, so you'd better be careful when you need to hide, and don't make any movement!" Ivan explained.
Don’t look at the effect of the phantom curse and the Deathly Hallows Invisibility Cloak, but this curse does not have the breath-isolating function of the invisibility cloak, and it has little resistance to the corresponding anti-curse. It is easy to see through by powerful wizards. .
However, after these years of practice, his phantom spell level is very high, Ivan thinks that as long as Harry does not take the initiative to reveal the flaws, Maxim should be impossible to find.
The two chatted quietly all the way to confirm each other's location.
After crossing a large patch of grass, they saw Hagrid's hut from a distance.
Boothbarton’s resident was not far from here, and the huge carriage was brightly lit, and conversations were faintly heard in the middle of the night.
When passing by, Harry couldn't help holding his breath, and watched his feet carefully to avoid kicking the rocks. He was worried that he would be discovered. Fortunately, things were not that bad. They reached the door of Hagrid’s hut smoothly. before.
咚咚咚...
Ivan knocked on the door.
After a while, the heavy wooden door was pushed open vigorously, Hagrid's huge head poked out from behind the door, his eyes scanned the open space in front of him, and he asked in a low voice.
"Harry, Ivan, is that you?"
"Yes, it's us!" Ivan waved his magic wand to lift the curse that he and Harry had held, and his figure suddenly appeared.
Harry on the side asked anxiously. "Hagrid, what do you want us to do so late?"
"Show you something!" Hagrid whispered.
Harry became more and more puzzled. He didn't understand what had to be seen at night, couldn't it be done during the day?
"Anyway, just follow me!" Hagrid didn't mean to explain it now, he looked very mysterious, and with a hint of excitement, after speaking, he walked out of the house.
Ivan was able to see Hagrid's special dress tonight.
He is rarely wearing a brand-new fur coat, with a big red flower inserted in the buttonhole of his clothes. The beard that was originally thick and piled up like steel **** has also been slightly combed, and the whole person looks red and glowing. Same as the second spring.
"Oh my God, Hagrid, what are you going to do in this dress? Are you going on a date?" Harry looked at Hagrid in surprise, thinking of the only possibility.
But he couldn't imagine what Hagrid looked like when he was in love. He was so tall that most people looked like a short man in front of him.
"Um... of course not." Hagrid blushed, his whole body looked a little nervous, he said defensively. "We are going to do business this time!"
Ivan rolled his eyes, and Harry also had a distrustful expression on his face.
Hagrid's face was as thick as a toasted rock crust cake, and he skipped the topic stiffly, and spoke to the two of them. "You follow me invisible now, remember, don't say anything when you see it later, do you understand?"
Ivan nodded and nodded, waved his wand and disappeared with Harry.
Hagrid recognized that this was the effect of the phantom spell, and thought that the two of them were eager to save trouble without wearing the invisibility cloak, so they didn't care. After adjusting their outfits, they strode into the darkness.
Both noticed that his direction was exactly where Boothbatten was.
Sure enough, Ivan and Harry followed Hagrid all the way to the huge carriage.
Hagrid held the crucible-sized fist and knocked "lightly" on the carriage door a few times, and the dull voice made people sigh that the door was hard enough.
Maxim quickly got out of the car.
Obviously, she stayed up most of the night just to wait for Hagrid.
"Good evening, ma'am!" Hagrid smiled and stretched out his hand to help Maxime down the golden steps, looking very courteous.
Harry, who was invisible next to him, was stunned. He didn't expect that his previous jokes would unexpectedly guess the truth. Hagrid really came out on a date!
It's just that Harry had to admit that Hagrid and Maxim are still very good matches-at least in terms of height, the two are very suitable.
Looking at this scene, Ivan also thinks so, it is not easy for the hybrid giant to find a suitable target.
However, under the perception of Sensational Mind, he vaguely sensed that Maxim's interest in Hagrid was limited, and it was estimated that he would agree to this meeting in the middle of the night because of the intelligence of the game from Hagrid's mouth.
Sure enough, after a brief conversation, Maxim quickly brought the topic to the purpose of this trip. Hagrid immediately wrapped up the ticket and walked towards the Forbidden Forest with Maxim.
To avoid being spotted, Ivan and Harry dared to follow far behind.
Just walked around the edge of the Forbidden Forest for more than ten minutes. The midnight wind kept blowing. Harry couldn't help shivering. His patience was gradually exhausted. He really didn't understand Hagrid most of the night. What do you want to do with yourself and Ivan, is it possible to create opportunities for them to date?
When Harry was thinking about whether to go back home, Ivan's light voice came to his ears along the wind.
"We should be there! Come closer!"
Harry was stunned. He didn't quite understand how Ivan knew it, but he soon saw Hagrid and Maxim in front of him stop in place.
A faint light of fire appeared further away, accompanied by faint noise and shouting, as if someone was hosting a bonfire party here.
Harry's curiosity aroused and then slowly moved forward according to Ivan's words, the sound echoing in his ears became louder and louder.
After Harry could see the sight there through the gap in the dense forest, he suddenly grabbed his mind, opened his mouth wide in surprise, and almost yelled.
Fire dragon!
Harry's eyes widened, and the place in front of him was less than ten meters away from a huge field surrounded by thick planks. Several fierce-looking dragons were raising their hair and making high-decibel roars and hot tongues. Constantly spit out from the big mouth full of fangs.
There are at least thirty wizards dealing with them near the venue, and every ten people form a team to suppress a fire dragon.
Half of the people are responsible for constructing a protective spell to prevent the dragon's breath from causing large-scale damage to the enclosure, while the rest are constantly waving their wands, and the rays of various spells constantly hit the dragon scales.
The fire dragons fought fiercely, but their bodies were bound by large chains, and they couldn't move at all. The flames they breathed would also be easily resisted by the wizards, they could only let out a desperate roar, and their bodies swayed. Fell to the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 613: The dragon that can grill fish
chapters.content:
Watching this scene, Harry only felt his hairs stand up, and the billowing heat wave caused by the dragon's breath rushed over his face.
Harry was impressed by the fire dragon's strength and grumpiness.
"How come there is a fire dragon in the forbidden forest? Why did Hagrid show us to see it?" Before Harry could turn his head, he lowered his voice and said to Ivan who might be beside him.
"Obviously, isn't it? This is the first project we have to face!" Ivan's voice came from the other side.
"You mean, we're going to fight the fire dragon in the game?" Harry stammered. He swallowed hard while looking at the huge dragon with fangs in the distance that could swallow himself.
Don't look at these fire dragons now looking very miserable, falling to the ground groggy, but Harry would not underestimate them for this.
Allowing so many elite wizards to work together to deal with it is enough to prove the danger of the fire dragon!
"Don't worry, we shouldn't be asked to defeat or kill them during the game, because most warriors can't do this."
Ivan spoke to comfort Harry, but before he could breathe a sigh of relief, he continued to add.
"But it's affirmation that the warrior has to deal with them head-on. If I'm not mistaken, it's probably the old-fashioned drama of the warrior taking the treasure from under the dragon mouth. Those audiences love to watch this!"
Harry rolled his eyes, and compared to fighting, this scene was not much better, and it was not something he could handle.
Just as Harry was in anxiety, Ivan's eyes turned to the court again.
After a long fight, several fire dragons in the riot were successfully subdued, and the shaman in charge of the guards was sweating profusely to repair the damaged site.
But Ivan noticed that there was a dragon that was very special and was not attacked by the wizards. He lay down on the ground and squinted and dozed lazily throughout the whole process, completely ignoring the noise of the outside world.
There were only two or three wizards staring at him, obviously he was very relieved of it.
"Norwegian Ridgeback!" Ivan analyzed the identity of the other dragon from some of the characteristics of this dragon.
This is also attributable to the fact that he has checked many books on fire dragons in the early years, and naturally has a certain understanding of the classification of dragons.
But if he remembers correctly, in the first match of the Goblet of Fire in the original time and space, the opponents the Warriors faced should be the Hungarian hornet, the Chinese fire dragon, the Swedish short-nosed dragon and the Welsh green dragon!
Ivan carefully identified it and found that the Welsh Green Dragon had been replaced...
Replaced with this Norwegian Ridgeback!
This makes Ivan unavoidably surprised. Although he has traveled here for several years and has caused some butterfly effects, can it still affect Romania?
The number of warriors hasn't changed. It stands to reason that the dragons are the right ones.
However, the combination of Romanian and Norwegian Ridgeback made Ivan vaguely familiar.
"Oh, it's Norbert! They actually brought it too!" Hagrid in front of him suddenly shouted with excitement, his face full of excitement.
Hagrid's shout made Ivan wake up. He remembered that he had raised a Norwegian Ridgeback that had just emerged from its shell when he was in the first grade. He had taken its blood and planned to fuse.
"Unexpectedly, I haven't seen it in a few years. It has grown so big...it can take on such an important task!" Hagrid, like an old father who saw his child's achievements, stared at the man who was lying on the ground and napping. Norwegian Ridgeback said with emotion.
"What? Have you seen these dragons?" Maxim looked at Hagrid calmly and asked.
"I've seen one of the dragons to be precise! Have you seen the Norwegian Ridgeback? It was hatched by me, and I am its mother!" Hagrid said proudly, and gestured with his hands.
"When it first came out of the shell, it was probably only that small! But it grew very fast, it was as high as my shoulder in a few days. And Norbert is also very smart, and it took only two weeks to learn how to bake it himself. fish……"
Ivan, who was hiding in the dark, couldn't wait to rush up to plug Hagrid's mouth. Those who raised a dragon privately in the school would be imprisoned in Azkaban, and Hagrid stabbed it out so easily.
Fortunately, Maxim didn't care about Hagrid once raising a dragon in the Forbidden Forest. Instead, he asked how dangerous this dragon was compared to other fire dragons.
Maxim knew very well that since the British Ministry of Magic had spent so much effort to transport a group of fire dragons from Romania, it means that these fire dragons must be related to the first game and are something the warriors must face!
Thinking of this, Maxim is very worried. It is extremely dangerous for professional dragon trainers to subdue a fire dragon, not to mention the newly grown-up Furong, it is not impossible to lose his life. .
So if you have to face them, choose the gentlest one!
"I haven't seen Norbert for a long time, and I don't know much about the current situation, but I think Norbert must be the safest among them!" Hagrid hesitated for a moment, and hesitated.
"You're right, Hagrid! It's safe and smart, and it's not easy to lose control. That's why we came here!"
While Hagrid was talking with Maxim, Charlie walked over from the field with a group of dragon trainers, and he explained, with a look of helplessness on his face.
It is the decision of the Ministry of Magic to use fire dragons as a competition event. Due to the danger of this magical creature, every dragon must go through various choices.
It is best to not only reflect the danger of the game, but also keep things under their control at all times, but what makes Charlie a little strange is that the Ministry of Magic only needs to brood the female fire dragon, which undoubtedly increases the difficulty of their dragon selection!
It took more than half a month for them to finally select these four fire dragons!
Strictly speaking, Norbert does not meet the hard requirement of a female fire dragon that hatches eggs. It is still a young dragon.
However, under the strong suggestion of many dragon trainers, the commissioner of the Ministry of Magic arranged a test for Norbert, and after the test passed let him join in.
"I believe Norbert will definitely not let you down!" Hagrid slapped his chest vowedly, "Can I visit it? We haven't seen each other for a long time!"
Charlie did not reply, but turned to look at Maxim and frowned. "Why did you bring her here, Hagrid? According to the rules, the Warriors shouldn't know what they are going to face-she will definitely tell the Warriors of Boothbarton about the situation here, right?"
"Ms. Maxim is only interested in fire dragons, so I took her to take a look. We should believe her, she will not reveal it!" Hagrid defended.
Maxim also nodded, saying that his mouth was very strict and he couldn't say a word.

"Even this is dangerous enough. If the situation is not good, we will step forward to rescue at any time, chant the extinguishing spell to the fire dragon, and stun it to ensure the safety of the warriors!" On the other side, Hagrid, accompanied by Charlie, had come to Norbert's side and awakened the dozing fire dragon.
Looking at this scene, Ivan couldn't help but feel a little worried. He very much doubted that after such a long time, Nott knew Hagrid or not. It would not be a joke if the fire dragon suddenly went crazy at such a close distance.
Fortunately, the situation Ivan was worried about did not happen. After waking up, Norbert quickly recognized his "Dragon Mother", this behemoth fifty feet tall, with the size of two palms. His tongue licked Hagrid's face and almost knocked Hagrid to the ground.
Hagrid didn't care a little bit, and gave Nober a heavy embrace.

咚咚...

Perhaps he noticed the existence of Ivan, the sound of knocking on the floor stopped, and the surroundings returned to the original calm, but it was obviously too late at this moment. At the moment I heard the sound, Ivan had already pulled out his wand and pointed it. That direction.
A brilliant white light flew out from the top of the wand and escaped into the darkness of the aisle. With the help of the reflection of the light of the spell, a hideous, scarred face flashed in the aisle.

chapters.title: Chapter 615: Criteria for judging spies
chapters.content:
come out! Ivan lowered his voice and yelled, holding his wand in his hand, his expression tense to the extreme.
He guessed who the person in the aisle was, hesitated whether to do it directly, and appeared here in the middle of the night, out of all hacking, not to mention that the other party already had a lot of suspicion in his heart.
"Put down the wand, it's me, Hals!"
A hoarse, low-pitched voice came from across the corridor, followed by the muffled sound of tapping the floor lightly before - it was the sound of a wooden leg and a cane hitting the ground together.
After a while, Moody's scarred face came into Ivan's eyes again.
"It's so late, what are you doing here? Professor Moody?" Ivan didn't mean to put down his wand, but asked questioningly.
"I still want to ask you!" Moody said irritably, and then his expression suddenly condensed, and a magic eye looked straight in the other direction.
Ivan thought that Moody was ready to do it, but unexpectedly the other party suddenly made a gesture of silence, and then motioned him to look at the window over there.
This kind of inferior sound hitting West Ivan can naturally be seen, but Ivan still turned his head according to the other's instructions, and at that moment activated the protective ring he was wearing, and the magic ring on his wrist was even more powerful. Pending status.
As long as the opponent dares to act, Ivan can use this to confirm Moody's suspicion and launch a counterattack reasonably and legally.
However, the expected sneak attack did not appear. Instead, it was in the direction Moody pointed out. Through the window, one could see a figure sneaking across the lawn.
"You were so loud just now that Karkaroff almost heard it!" Moody sighed in relief.
"Really?" Ivan said dubiously. He ran the mindfulness of the whole process but didn't gain much, because Moody never looked at him with his normal eye.
"So you are tracking Karkaroff?" Ivan said tentatively.
"You can say that! But he is not the only person I have been investigating recently!" Moody said casually, and then moved his wooden legs towards the exit of the hall. "Let’s hurry up! I hope Karkaroff hasn’t gone far."
Ivan hesitated for a moment and chose to follow Moody's, but he was still half of his position behind so that Moody's could be under his watch at all times.
Moody seemed to be aware of this, but didn't say anything.
The two of them hung so far behind the figure, and the cold and hungry Ivan kept complaining in his heart, and he was following people this night.
Why do these people like to come out at night?
