The black shadow in front sneaked up behind a banyan tree, waiting for something. About a minute or so later, a tall witch came over from the other side, with an expression of impatientness on her face.
Maxim? She didn't return to the carriage?
Ivan recognized the identity of the other party at a glance. The entire witch at Hogwarts this height is Maxim alone. Calculating the time, the other party should have just separated from Hagrid. This point actually went here again with Kakalo. Meet with husband.
Ivan felt that things were getting more and more complicated, and everything was intertwined like a mess of thread.
He looked at Moody next to him suspiciously, and even suspected that everyone present was under control, and then he was ready to join forces to set up a killing round to besiege himself.
"Let's get closer so that we can hear what they are talking about!" Moody didn't know what Ivan was thinking about. He closed his eyes slightly and imposed a phantom spell on himself, and then called Ivan to go up with him. before.
Ivan gathered his mind, and walked a few steps forward with him. As the distance got closer, the voice of Karkaroff and Maxim's conversation gradually came over.
"Now that things are obvious, we must unite!"
"Do you think that if we don't do it, they won't target us? Think about it, the remaining three referees, one is the principal of Hogwarts, and the remaining two are staff from the British Ministry of Magic! Do you think they will deliberately favor the two little ghosts at Hogwarts?"
"From the selection of the Warriors, I can see that they are clearly in the same group!"
Karkaroff said angrily, his words very sharp.
Maxime seemed a little hesitant, she hesitated for a while, then looked around again, and then spoke. "Then what are you going to do? Do you trouble those Warriors before the game? I wouldn't do this kind of thing!"
"No, I didn't mean that!" Karkaroff saw Maxim's misunderstanding and quickly explained. "I mean we can find a reason to lower the score of the Hogwarts Warriors, and then give our Warriors a high score..."
"This is not so good, right?" Maxim was a little moved, but he was still a little bit hesitant.
"There are two warriors at Hogwarts, which is not fair! They fouled the rules first!" Karkaroff said comfortingly.
Maxim thought for a while, then nodded.
The two then communicated in a low voice for a while, and then pretended to be okay, separated and returned to their respective residences in opposite directions.
"What a shameful act! They actually planned to lower your scores during the game so that Hogwarts could lose this year's competition..." Moody lifted after Karkaroff and Maxim left. The effect of the phantom curse, annoyed, the cane made a weird muffled sound on the floor.
Ivan would also have a headache, he didn't expect Karkaroff to be so shameless!
In the original time and space, this guy gave Harry low scores every time, and this time he was also involved with Maxim, which was really disgusting.
In order to ensure the completion of the two tasks released by the system Ivan originally planned to get the highest score in every game, and no matter how bad he was, he had to be the first in a single game!
But if Karkaroff and Maxim deliberately target themselves when scoring, it will be difficult to win.
Moody paused after cursing a few words and turned to Ivan.
"Don't worry too much, Hals, I will tell Dumbledore about this, you just have to figure out how to get through the level!"
"I'm not worried about you, but Harry is more difficult... he is too young to have come to the game!" Moody moved his wooden legs, walking towards the castle, adding muffledly. With.
"Yes, I am also very worried for him!" Ivan also put on a worried look, "I already know the specific items of the first game, it is the fire dragon, and it is the female fire dragon that hatches the eggs! Ministry of Magic The meaning of should be obvious. Let us grab the dragon egg. Is there any way you can help him through this level?"
Ivan looked at Moody expectingly and waited for his answer to confirm whether the opponent was Voldemort's internal response. One of the important indicators was the degree to which Harry was willing to win the championship.

chapters.title: Chapter 616: 4 suspects
chapters.content:
"You shouldn't ask me, Hals! As a warrior, Harry needs to solve this problem by himself... Don't expect me to cheat for you!" Moody grinned and said playfully.
Ivan glanced at Moody, and after thinking about it, he turned to ask. "Then you said earlier that you were tracking down the person who threw Harry's name into the Goblet of Fire. Do you suspect anyone?
"Four people are suspicious!" Moody slapped his mouth, and while walking towards the Defence Against the Dark Arts class office, he answered Ivan's questions.
"The first one is the Karkaroff you just saw. You may not know it. He was a Death Eater before and did a lot of bad things. I personally sent him to Azkaban!"
"According to his crimes, the second half of his life should be spent with the dementors in Azkaban. But he reached an agreement with Crouch, who was still the executive department at the time, relying on the personnel who gave out the Death Eaters. The list has been exempted..."
"Then why did he, a former Death Eater, become the principal of Durmstrang?" Ivan was very surprised by this question.
"Because he was already notorious in the British magical world, no one was waiting to see him, so this guy fled to Northern Europe. As for how he became a principal, I don’t know. Maybe not many people there know him. Past events!" Moody shook his head and explained.
Ivan pondered for a while and sorted out the information given by Moody in his mind.
He thinks that Karkaroff is not very suspicious.
After all, this guy is an out-and-out traitor, and Voldemort may not dare to believe him when he was weak.
Moreover, Karkaroff's performance during this period is no different from the original time and space, and even plans to lower their scores and let them lose the game.
"What about the remaining three suspects?" Ivan removed Karkaroff's suspicion from the bottom of his heart, looked at Moody, and continued to ask.
"The second one is Snape!" Moody's eyes squinted, and the sound of wooden legs echoed in the corridor, his words mixed in.
"Like Karkaroff, he was once a Death Eater, but Dumbledore saved him.
In addition, I have obtained some information at school these days. Many people told me that Snape had targeted Harry in the past few school years. If anyone really wanted to kill Harry, he was the most suspicious candidate. "
No, he is the least doubtful candidate!
Ivan rolled his eyes, disagreeing with Moody's statement, but also understood that Snape was indeed the first suspect in the murder of Harry in the eyes of outsiders.
"As for the third suspect--" Moody extended the tone and looked a little hesitant.
The two walked all the way, and they had arrived in front of the professor's office in the Defense Against the Dark Arts class. Moody took out the key and opened the door of the office, striding in.
"You haven't told me yet, who is it?" Ivan secretly squeezed his wand and walked in, pretending to be relaxed.
But when I walked into the office, Ivan's brows frowned, and a faint smell filled it.
After a closer look, Ivan discovered that the entire Defence Against the Dark Arts class office was very messy, with various documents, newspapers, and all kinds of weird small objects stacked on the desk, and a few clothes that had not had time to be cleaned were also hung here. .
"Oh, it's time to clean. I have been busy with class and investigation these days, and I don't have much time to tidy up some things..." Moody looked a little embarrassed, and he walked to the side and slapped the window. Opened, then waved his wand and aimed at the room.
"Clean up!"
As Moody chanted the spell, the wind of magic swept across the office, and scattered documents and newspapers floated up and were stuffed into a drawer under the influence of an inexplicable force.
A large number of weird little creatures crawled out of the gaps between the tables and chairs, and they were swept out of the window by the wind of magic, and the strange smell was also swept away...
Taking advantage of this effort, Ivan looked around in this office.
The most eye-catching thing here is a huge mirror, which is hung on the wall opposite the door, but cannot reflect the scene in the room.
On the contrary, there are many figures dangling in the mirror, and one of them is already standing very close, as if he can walk out of the mirror after a few steps.
On the corner of the small table next to it, there is a golden thing, like an antenna, which is constantly humming.
After a few glances, Ivan found out several warning devices in a row. He couldn't help but feel fortunate that he had no brains before and broke in to investigate Moody's, otherwise he would be discovered.
Then, Ivan's gaze was focused on a few boxes placed in the office...
"The third suspect is Barty Crouch!"
When Ivan was thinking about how to find a reason to open the box and confirm, Moody's voice suddenly came over.
"What?" Ivan was stunned, turned his head abruptly, and looked at Moody with a surprised and suspicious look.
After a while, Ivan asked calmly. "Why? Isn't Mr. Crouch a high-ranking official of the Ministry of Magic? Or a former executive director. You told me just now that he tried many Death Eaters and imprisoned them in Azkaban. What reason does he have to kill? Lee?"
"I don't know this, but from the information I have learned, Crouch's recent state is very wrong!" Moody walked quickly to Ivan with a cane.
"I heard Bagman say that Crouch is not in Hogwarts Castle these days. I thought at first that he was going back to the Ministry of Magic to deal with things, but I asked the people in the Communications Department and they didn’t see him. To Crouch!"
"This is very interesting! Crouch, as the organizer of this three-final match, is nowhere to be found now, and his movements are unknown..." Moody's expression was very solemn.
Ivan nodded, so it seemed that Barty Crouch was indeed suspicious.
He has not forgotten that the two father and son have the same name and surname. If Little Batty pretends to be his father, he can successfully trick the map of the point of life, because the names shown above are exactly the same.
Of course, it does not rule out that Crouch has disappeared for a long time, and he has been killed!
"What about the last person to doubt?" Ivan asked, calmly.
"He's right here, isn't he?" Moody's words became a little erratic, and the magic eye stared at Ivan closely.
"Do you doubt me?" Ivan looked at Moody dissatisfied.
"Don't blame me for being cautious, Hals. In fact, your suspicion is no less than that of others. You successfully crossed the age line that night, didn't you? You have plenty of time to do something with the Goblet of Fire..." Moody did not Reluctantly questioned.

chapters.title: Chapter 617: Conversation with Moody
chapters.content:
"I think I explained before that it is not easy to cast a spell on a powerful magic item..." Ivan frowned.
"But you can do it, can't you?" Moody interrupted Ivan's words directly.
"I didn't do anything to the Goblet of Fire. If you insist on doubting me, I can't help it!" Ivan glanced at the "golden antenna" on the table, and did not answer directly.
Moody stared at him for a while, then moved the demon eyes away, and his words were no longer as hard as before, "Of course, I personally want to believe in you! Otherwise I won't be here to tell you That's it! Dumbledore also thinks it wasn't you who did..."
Ivan breathed a sigh of relief. He couldn't explain this matter at all. If Moody kept asking, it would be really troublesome.
"Since you have confirmed the three suspects, what do you plan to do next?" Ivan continued to ask.
Moody spoke eloquently:
"I have tried Snape and Karkaroff in the past few days, and I couldn't ask anything from them, so I plan to start directly from Crouch next time!
Although he is not in the castle now, he will definitely be back in the first match of the Three Finals Cup. I will ask him out alone to try and find out where he has been during this period of time! "
"But I always think I need to prepare for the worst. Batty Crouch is not a good guy. I understand his ability. In case of conflict, I may not be able to control him, so I need A helper..." Moody added.
"If there is a need, I can help you!" Ivan said straightforwardly. He was worried that he could not find a reason to test Crouch, but unfortunately Moody gave this opportunity directly to the door.
"It's best if you are willing to help!" Moody is very happy. Crouch's identity is extraordinary. Dumbledore will not agree with his investigation, which means he can't get other professors in this castle. help.
As for the strength of Ivan, he had already learned in the Defence Against the Dark Arts class, and even he couldn't easily overcome it.
"It's just... isn't Mr. Crouch your boss? Is it really okay for us to ask him this way?" Ivan looked at Moody hesitantly.
"I am not an Auror anymore, and he is no longer the executive director!" Moody's head slicked.
But Ivan doubted that even if Crouch was Moody’s boss, the legendary Auror had the guts to investigate him!
"By the way, I forgot to show you something!" Moody suddenly remembered something. He walked quickly to the corner of the office with wooden legs, opened one of the boxes, and took it from inside. A piece of parchment with some burnt corners came out.
"Recognize it?" Moody handed the parchment to Ivan.
"What?" Ivan stretched out his hand and took a look, and found that this was the piece of paper spit out from the Goblet of Fire, with Harry's name written on it.
"Handwriting! I mean handwriting! You should understand what I mean..." Moody said impatiently.
Ivan looked at the words on the parchment again and found that the style of the handwriting was very unique. Only then did I realize that Moody was planning to track down the inner ghost through the handwriting.
I have to say that Moody is careful enough to always detect some details that others can't notice. He hasn't noticed before and can track down the behind-the-scenes through handwriting.
"I'm sorry, I haven't seen this kind of word! It shouldn't be anyone I know..." Ivan thought about it carefully, without any impression.
Moody looked disappointed, he sighed and said. "I spent some time collecting the characters of all the students in the school, and then compared them one by one, but no one matched it!"
The character of the whole school?
Ivan looked at Moody in surprise, wondering how he collected...
Wait...could it be the homework that you receive on weekdays? !
Ivan's complexion became very strange.
The identity of the professor is really convenient. Moody's can get all the handwriting samples of all students by assigning a few classroom assignments.
But it's really a shame that Moody could think of such a good way, if it weren't for the other person's reminder, he would never have thought that his handwriting had been investigated again.
"What about Crouch's words? Have you confirmed it?" Ivan asked.
"I have seen his handwriting when he was working under him. The style is completely different from this! But it does not rule out that he had someone write it in advance, and then bring it over!" Moody said gruffly.
Ivan nodded, meaning that they couldn't do anything except expect to ask for some information from Crouch, no wonder Moody would be willing to **** his former boss, because he didn't have a choice.
"Anyway, the time to meet Crouch is set after the first game, and I will let you know the specific time!" Moody said.
The conversation between the two lasted for more than half an hour, and when Ivan came out of Moody's office, the sky was already dark.
The cold and hungry Ivan touched his empty stomach, and finally dispelled his plan to find house elves in the kitchen. It's already this point, so don't bother them and just eat breakfast.
...
Early in the morning, Ivan, who had simply made up his mind, yawned and followed everyone to the auditorium to enjoy today's breakfast.
There was Harry who was so listless as him.
As he witnessed the power and tyranny of the fire dragon with his own eyes last night, Harry was unable to sleep well all night due to the tremendous pressure in his heart. He even met the fire dragon in his dream. Went on.
Hermione next to him listened to Harry's story last night, UU read www.uukanshu. com also couldn't help screaming. "Is the Ministry crazy? They actually plan to let you deal with..."
"Deal with a fire dragon!" Hermione lowered her voice forcibly, lest it be heard by others.
"Who knows? Maybe the Ministry of Magic finds it more exciting!" Ivan gobbled up a large piece of butter muffin and stuffed it into his mouth, speaking vaguely.
"Excitement? That will kill you! Not many wizards have the ability to subdue a fire dragon alone..." Hermione looked very angry.
"What can we do? We can't change the content of the game... or think about how to deal with them."
Harry's face was full of worry, and he didn't even have an appetite for eating. He kept looking at the "How to Deal with Dangerous Creatures" in his hand, trying to find a way out of it.
"How about using a coma spell? Professor McGonagall subdued Norbert like that last time!" Hermione suggested.
"The fire dragon's magic resistance is very high. If Norbert was young, the coma spell would not have been effective! You can't expect Harry to have the magic level of Professor McGonagall..." Ivan reminded.

chapters.title: Chapter 618: I am not who I was 3 years ago!
chapters.content:
Harry nodded in agreement. He saw a bunch of wizards last night and it took several minutes to stun a fire dragon. He felt that it was impossible to do it by himself...

"I have written a letter to Sirius and asked him if he can do anything about it, but the first game will start tomorrow afternoon, and I don't know if it will be too late..." Harry said distressedly.

Hermione also looked at Ivan curiously.
"You made a mistake, Harry, the game does not require the Warriors to defeat or kill the fire dragon! What we really need to do is to take the dragon egg under the protection of the fire dragon." Ivan talked freely, and then added . "So you just need to find a way to attract the fire dragon's attention, deal with the opponent, and find a chance to succeed!"
"Then you might be able to use the Transfiguration Curse to conjure a creature to entice the fire dragon, and then go take the dragon egg!" Hermione's brain was very clever, and under Ivan's reminder, she quickly thought of a feasible plan.
But this plan was quickly rejected by Ivan.
"The Ministry of Magic brought female fire dragons in the hatching period this time. They are very vigilant. Any creatures that come close will not hesitate to use dragon breath to fight back! And they will not leave the nest easily, so it is difficult to be Temptation!" Ivan explained.
Listening to Ivan's words, Harry was somewhat disappointed, and then fell into contemplation again, thinking about how he could divert the fire dragon's attention.
"Don't forget that you have one of the things you are best at, Harry!" Seeing that he hadn't thought of the key point for a while, Ivan reminded him again.

If you learn the eye disease curse and blind the fire dragon in a short time, you can successfully get the dragon egg. !" "Good idea!" After rehearsing in his mind, Harry was absolutely feasible, and excitedly rushed to hug Ivan. "Ivan, you are amazing!"
"That's it, let go!" Ivan broke free from Harry's embrace with disgust, and then continued. "In order to be safe, you have to master the Fire Curse and the Iron Armor Curse! Oh, yes, there is also the Flying Curse, so that you can summon the Firebolt on the arena."
"But I don't know any of these spells..." Harry said awkwardly, his expression very embarrassing.
"It's okay, I can spare some time to teach you! But you only have less than a day and a half..." Ivan gave Harry a surprised look. He didn't expect Harry to be so bad.
"Then teach me the flying curse and the eye disease curse first... forget the others." Harry replied embarrassedly. He felt that if he tried his best, it would be good if he could barely learn two curses in a day and a half, at least. When facing the fire dragon, it is not helpless.
After knowing how to clear the level, Harry finally let go of his hanging heart and began to enjoy today's breakfast.
Hermione on the side was also very happy. As far as she knew, Ivan's flying talent was also very good, and both of them could easily get the dragon egg in this way.
"No! This would be very weird. If the two warriors at Hogwarts both use the same method to pass the fire dragon, Karkaroff will definitely take the opportunity to attack, saying that we cheated and learned the specific content of the project in advance!" Ivan shook his head and rejected Hermione's idea.
Although cheating is the tradition of the Triwizard Tournament, everyone still has to pretend to fool the audience!
That's why Harry had to learn the Flying Curse, because he couldn't pretend to be prepared and bring the Firebolt into the field.
"Then what are you going to do then?" Harry asked curiously. He felt that since Ivan could help him think of a plan to clear the level, he must have a better way to deal with it.
"It's very simple...Of course it is to defeat the guarding fire dragon, and then **** its dragon egg!" Ivan replied easily and freely.
"What? Are you going to fight the dragon in the game?" Harry looked at Ivan suspiciously, almost thinking that he was joking with himself.
"It can be said, I think the audience is also looking forward to a wonderful game!" Ivan nodded. If you want to make sure that you get the first place in the game, you naturally need to behave differently from others. It is best to be in the audience. And left a deep impression in the minds of referees.
At the same time, this can also effectively lower the scores of other Warriors. After all, with their own comparisons, it is not justified for the referees to give high scores to the mediocre Krum and others?
Karkaroff will also have a lot of psychological pressure when deducting points, and if you give it too low, you will be scolded by the audience!
"This is too dangerous!"
Hearing that Ivan was preparing to confront the fire dragon in the game, Hermione's face paled in shock Although she knew that Ivan's strength was stronger than that of the average adult wizard, this time the opponent was enough. A behemoth that is fifty feet tall (fifteen meters) and can breathe flames!
The oppressive feeling brought by the size alone is enough to make every wizard who faces it cautiously, no wizard will take the initiative to provoke a dragon unless necessary!
"Don't forget, I tamed a fire dragon when I was in the first grade. They are nothing terrible!" Ivan said comfortingly, knowing that Hermione was worried about herself.
"That's different! Norbert just came out of the shell three years ago..." Hermione said worriedly. She felt that Ivan was too big and didn't realize the danger of the game.
"I'm not the same I was three years ago, am I?" Ivan shrugged helplessly. It's hard for him to run into the forbidden forest to subdue a dragon on the spot to prove himself, right?
And after meeting Norbert last night, he has always had an idea. If it can be implemented, he will go to a cutscene during the game without the slightest danger.
Just don’t know if Norbert remembers himself?

chapters.title: Chapter 619: Cheating is the tradition of the top 3 competition!
chapters.content:
After eating breakfast, the three of them did not delay due to time constraints. They directly found an empty classroom and officially started teaching.
"Flying Curse is not a difficult magic to learn. The spells and gestures are easy. But to successfully make this magic work, it usually requires the caster to have sufficient will and determination!"
It’s not the first time Ivan teaches other people’s magic, and he has accumulated sufficient experience in class on weekdays. Many professors have once praised him “kindly” [you can go directly to the podium to give lectures, and you don’t have to stand up and disrupt the classroom. order! 】
Harry also listened very seriously. The danger posed by the fire dragon made him change his previously undisciplined learning attitude, and he was even more nervous than when he practiced calling God to protect him last time.
After Ivan had finished talking about some of the main points of the Flying Curse, Harry took his own Firebolt in a hurry and practiced it over and over again.
Hermione who came with her was not idle either. Although she didn't have to participate in dangerous competitions, she still learned these magics just like Harry.
In addition to the desire to increase strength and reduce the gap, the more important point is that Hermione is very worried that when she is free, Ivan will talk about practicing sanctuary.
Thinking of the scene when exploring the memory that day, the little witch was a little embarrassed. Fortunately, these days, Ivan seemed to have forgotten about it and never mentioned it again, which made her feel more at ease.
Ivan didn't know what Hermione was thinking, and he didn't have time to think about it for the time being.
He was speaking to instruct Harry to practice the spell, and at the same time perfecting the plan he thought of in his mind-persuading Norbert to cooperate with him in the match to fight the fake match!
Yes, it is a counterfeit match!
Fire dragons are not easy creatures to deal with. They are infinitely powerful and extremely resistant to magic, capable of exhaling powerful dragon breath.
Usually more than five specially trained dragon trainers are required to ensure that a violent dragon can be suppressed without casualties!
Ivan consciously wanted to do this in a short time, and he could only use the enhanced magic text to bless the shadowless, thunderbolt explosion, and even the killing curse.
But in that case, it will not only reveal that you are proficient in black magic, but it will also easily create a very **** picture, which will make people misunderstand yourself unnecessary.
If the fire dragon trampled and stomped the dragon egg after being hit hard, it would be even more worth the loss.
So in Ivan's opinion, it is better to find a suitable dragon to be an actor and fight a "extremely wonderful" exciting battle. Everyone can save snacks, and maybe they can show extremely exaggerated visual effects, causing a sensation in the audience!
It happened that he heard Charlie mention yesterday that Norbert was spotted by a Romanian juggler, and he must have received training in this area. He should be able to communicate well...
The more I think about it, the more Ivan feels that this idea is a good idea. He doesn't believe that his performance is so perfect. Karkaroff and Maxim can still find a reason for the deduction!
But soon Ivan frowned again, because there was a loophole in this plan, that is, how to ensure that Norbert can be selected during the game?
In the original time and space, when the Warriors were choosing the dragon, Hogwarts as the host, in order to experience generosity, let Fleur and Krum choose first.
If they picked Norbert, wouldn't their plan be frustrated?
After thinking about it all morning, Ivan's frowning brows were not let go, but he did not think of how to solve this problem.
The only good news is that after a whole morning of practice, Harry initially mastered the Flying Curse!
Although he was not very proficient in using it, and occasionally the Firebolt would not listen to his call, Harry was already very happy. He felt that after an hour of practicing, he could start learning the eye disease curse.
Hermione's progress was faster than Harry, and it took three hours to freely summon every item in the house.
"Stop it, Harry, Hermione! Let's have a meal first, take a break, and then continue!" Ivan looked at the time, it was lunch time, and they had been practicing for almost four hours.
No matter how important learning is, it has to be a combination of work and rest... Casting a spell for a long time is very exhausting.
Harry nodded, stopped tiredly, took his firebolt, and walked towards the auditorium with Ivan.
Along the way, the little wizards I met took the initiative to greet the two of them, and Ivan even noticed that a large badge was worn on the front of their robes.
It says [Ivan Hals will win! 】, flashes from time to time, and the badges of a few people will change again and again, turning into the words 【Support the Warriors Harry Potter】!
Harry also noticed this, and his tired spirit was immediately lifted, and an indescribable excitement appeared in his heart.
The fire dragon he is about to face doesn't seem so terrible anymore, he even can't wait to practice magic well, perform on the court, and prove that he is a qualified warrior!
"Hey, Ivan, Harry, this way!"
Several people stepped into the auditorium, and a voice suddenly came from the long table in Gryffindor.
Ivan turned his head and saw that it was the brothers George and Fred who were making noise. His footsteps paused, and he walked over there.
"The game is going to be tomorrow. Are you ready? We even bought the celebration flags!" George put his arm around Ivan's shoulder and pulled him to the seat next to him. The front badge was gleaming and looked a little dazzling.
Fred looked at Ivan with some worry, then looked at Harry...
"It's okay you guys wait and see!"
After learning the Flying Curse, Harry also had a little more confidence, and after thinking that he would be able to prove himself on the field soon, he vowed to say.
Harry's answer was beyond what George and Fred expected. The two of them glanced at each other and had some suspicions in their hearts. They swallowed what they were about to say, and then ridiculed for a while, almost celebrating them in advance. .
"By the way, George and Fred, I heard that you made a bet in the World Quidditch Cup before, and you lost your money in the end, is that right?" Ivan suddenly interrupted several people. chat.
"Who said we lost? We obviously guessed it right. We bet on 100 gold gallons and bet on Ireland to win-then Victor Krum would catch the golden snitch! But Mr. Bagman forced the Our funds have been deducted, and he now owes us a large sum of money, a full 600 gallons!" George corrected Ivan's words angrily.
Fred on the side was also very angry when Ivan talked about it.
Seeing the reaction of the two, Ivan's mouth slightly twitched. He had already thought about how to make sure that he picked Norbert during the game...

chapters.title: Chapter 620: I didn't expect you to be this kind of person!
chapters.content:
Ludo Bagman is the Director of the Sports Department of the Ministry of Magic, as well as the organizer and referee of the Triwizard Tournament.
Now another organizer, Batty Crouch, is not at the castle for a long time, and all the affairs of the game are handled by the opponent.
Among them is the way the warriors choose the fire dragon!
If Ludo Bagman is willing to help him cheat, it will naturally be easy for him to choose Norbert in the draw.
Especially this guy is now in debt, and Ivan feels confident that he can convince the director of the sports department.
Thinking of this, Ivan was not delaying. After hurriedly ate lunch, he confirmed the location of Ludo Bagman with the live map, and successfully blocked him in a hidden corner...
Originally, Ivan thought that he would need to spend a lot of talking, relying on coercion and temptation to make Ludo Bagman compromise, but the degree of cooperation between the other party completely exceeded his expectations.
"Do you want to choose a specific dragon in the first game? Of course, no problem at all!" After listening to Ivan's request, Ludo Bagman didn't hesitate at all, and immediately agreed with it. Down.
"If you need it, I can also provide you with other help!"
Speaking of this, Ludo Bagman cautiously looked around and found that there was no one around, which made him feel more relieved.
"Mr. Bagman, I always think you are an impartial referee!" Ivan looked at the sports director in front of him with a weird look, and almost doubted whether this was a game deliberately designed by the opponent... It was too smooth. Point!
"Well, yes, it is true under normal circumstances!" Ludo Bagman's expression became a bit awkward, "but I have recently encountered a little trouble..."
"Small trouble? I heard George and Fred say that you opened a bet at the World Quidditch Contest, and the bet broke down. You confiscated their principal and haven't returned it yet... You mean Is this matter?" Ivan looked at Ludo Bagman playfully and asked.
"That's you misunderstanding, Hals... I didn't confiscated their funds, but temporarily took care of them. I will return it to them when I have more money in a few days!" Ludo Bagman coughed lightly , Said defensively.
Ivan didn’t believe a word. He didn’t dare to accept the help of the opponent at all before he confirmed why the opponent was so diligent. Otherwise, Bagman would make a temporary refusal to expose his cheating during the game and he would have difficulty defending himself. Up!
Under Ivan's repeated questioning, Ludo Bagman had to reveal some information.
Ivan then learned that when the World Quidditch Cup was held this year, Ludo Bagman had opened a bet and was ready to take advantage of this excellent opportunity to make a fortune.
But who knows that the game suddenly burst into an upset. The Irish team defeated the Bulgarian team with a weak score. The super high odds and the betting by a few local tyrants made this not-so-rich sports director almost ruined. I owe a debt and haven't paid it back.
In order to fill this hole in the short term, Ludo Bagman immediately decided to take another big gamble! So I borrowed money everywhere, mortgaged houses, and put all these funds on the gambling game of the Triwizard Tournament!
Bet that Ivan will eventually win the Goblet of Fire and win the first place in all three games!
After all, Ivan is a popular candidate to win the championship, and only in this way can he have high enough odds for him to pay off all the debts he owes...
Of course, since he dares to play so big, Ludo Bagman is also somewhat dependent. He himself is the organizer of the Triwizard Tournament and can use his position to give Ivan some help.
But at first, Ludo Bagman was ready to help secretly.
According to the information he collected painstakingly, Ivan is a righteous and graceful little wizard. There is no room for sand in his eyes, and he will definitely sneer at such cheating...
Therefore, Ludo Bagman has not dared to show any intention to help, that is, he is worried that Ivan will be ostracized.
Unexpectedly, after some contact, he was surprised that the rumors were wrong!
I didn't expect you to be this kind of person!
Thinking of this, Ludo Bagman's eyes on Ivan became even more weird.
I didn't expect you to be this kind of person! After learning some inside stories, Ivan was also very speechless.
The real power director of the Ministry of Magic is actually a gambler with no lower limit, and the funds owed by the gambling game are attempted to make up for it with another gamble... even at the expense of his entire net worth!
But this also allowed Ivan to dispel his previous doubts, at least in the matter of winning the Triwizard Tournament, their goals are the same.
While secretly spitting out in his heart, Ivan still put on a look of appreciation on the surface, and said. "I have to say, you have a good eye this time, Mr. Bagman! Congratulations on your bet..."
"My vision has always been good!" Bagman said with a smile, but he went through all the reports about Ivan before finally making a decision.
Then Bagman stretched out his hand again and spoke again. "Then wish us a happy cooperation?"
"Happy cooperation!" Ivan also smiled and stretched out his hand, holding Bagman's hand together.
...
The biggest problem was solved, Ivan finally let go of the heart that I had been holding, and then took the time to sneak into the forbidden forest with the phantom spell at the time of the nap. Look at his eyes tomorrow!
But there was some noise in the middle of the accident, which attracted many dragon trainers. Ivan didn't have time to confirm whether Norbert understood what he meant, so he hurriedly left the forbidden forest.
In the afternoon, Ivan kept the promise and found an empty classroom with Harry and Hermione to continue practicing magic.
The cast of the Eye Disease Curse was much more difficult than the Flying Curse, and one afternoon was not enough. Harry practiced until late at night before reluctantly releasing the spell.
It was already late at night, and the magic power in the exhausted Harry had long been exhausted, so he had to cancel his plan to continue training and return to the lounge with Ivan.
The two slowly opened the door of the dormitory, preparing to go to bed lightly, but unexpectedly saw a figure sitting with their backs to them by the window in a daze.
Relying on the light from the moonlight, Ivan quickly noticed that the other party was wearing an old swirl pajamas.
"Ron?" Ivan confirmed the identity of the figure, but then wondered why Ron was still sitting there at this point.
"Are you waiting for us here?" Ivan frowned and continued to ask.
Harry almost laughed, he didn't understand why Ivan made such a nonsensical guess.
Of course, it's not completely impossible. After all, tomorrow is the game, and the opponent may come here to mock them...
Under the gaze of the two, Ron slowly turned around, the expression on his face looked very tangled, he opened his mouth to say something, but the words seemed to be stuck in his mouth, and he couldn't vomit. come out.
Harry ignored him at all, making the bed and getting ready to go to bed.
"Are you ready for tomorrow's game?" Ron, who was silent for a while suddenly asked nonchalantly.
Harry stopped going to bed and looked at Ron in surprise.
Ron's face flushed immediately. He realized that what he had just said was submissive, and immediately added a strange tone of Yin and Yang. "I'm still waiting for tomorrow to see how you can defeat a dragon!"
"Then you will see it!" The cold and sleepy Harry had been in a bad mood after practicing the spell all day, and now he heard Ron's yin and yang strange tone, and he got up on the bed with anger. His pillow was thrown heavily on Ron's face.
Then Harry didn't need the pillow, and pulled the curtain down, and he was stuffed into the quilt.
As for Ivan on the other side, he was already in bed when they were arguing. He was too lazy to pay attention to the quarrel between them. After a busy day, Ivan just wanted to take a good rest.
Tomorrow has to play the first game...
(PS: It will be updated today. In the second half of the month, the angel's time may be slightly looser, and we will consider adding more to make up at that time.)

chapters.title: Chapter 621: Game 1
chapters.content:
The next morning, the castle was filled with excitement and tension.
So that everyone seemed absent-minded during the class, looking out the window frequently, or talking in twos and threes in private, no matter how the professors reprimanded it, it didn't help.
At noon, Dumbledore officially announced the cancellation of the afternoon classes in the auditorium, and invited those interested students to the paddock of the Forbidden Forest after dinner to watch the Warriors' first game.
"This is awesome!"
As soon as Dumbledore's words fell, cheers broke out in the auditorium.
After lunch, many students ran towards the paddock before they even had time to pack their things. There are so many good places to watch the game up close. If they go late, they will be robbed by others...
As the Warriors, Ivan and Harry have already arrived at the competition venue ahead of schedule under the leadership of Professor McGonagall.
"Okay, that's it. Go in! The other warriors have already arrived, and Mr. Bagman is also inside. He will tell you the steps of the game later..."
McGonagall stood in front of a tent, pointed at the entrance, said to the two of them, then hesitated, then reminded.
"Remember, no matter what you see during the game, don't panic. Only by facing calmly can you grasp the chance of victory!"
Ivan nodded and nodded, and walked in through the entrance with Harry.
The space inside the tent is huge, it looks like a small living room.
Boothbaton’s warrior Fleur Delacour is sitting on a low wooden stool. Her face is pale, with cold sweat on her forehead, her right hand is holding a magic wand, and the other is tight. Pinch the corner of the wizard's robe.
Victor Krum didn't get much better either, his brows on both sides were tightly locked together, and he looked more gloomy than ever.
"Ivan, Potter, you are here just right!" Seeing the two come in, Bagman greeted him immediately, showing very enthusiasm, and gave Ivan a special wink.
Ivan immediately understood that the things he ordered Bagman yesterday have been done!
Sure enough, after briefly reminding him of a few precautions, Bagman took a large purple silk bag from the table and spoke to several people.
"What you need to do in the first game is to capture a golden egg under the protection of the fire dragon. Now there are four kinds of fire dragons on the training ground. I put all their models in this bag. 'S opponents are selected..."
Hearing this, Krum and Furong's expressions remained unchanged. Obviously they knew about the fire dragon a long time ago, but from their mouths and their faces without a trace of blood, it can be seen that their hearts are far from the surface. calm.
Harry was no exception. The hand holding the wand trembled involuntarily. Although he had made sufficient preparations in advance, he was still a little scared when he really faced the fire dragon.
"Ladies first! It's up to you to choose, Ms. Delacour!" The smile on Bagman's face contrasted sharply with the nervous expressions of Harry and the others. He reached out and unlocked the opening of the cloth bag. Handed it to Furong.
Furong took a deep breath and looked at the opening of the cloth bag, which was so black that it seemed to be blocked from light.
This discovery made Furong put out the idea of ​​choosing. She trembled and put her left hand into the cloth bag. After a few seconds, she took out a palm-sized and vivid fire dragon model. It looks like a silver-blue Swedish short-nosed dragon with a sign on its neck with the number one written on it.
Furong's face became very ugly, which meant that she had to be the first to play, and could not analyze the specific strength of the fire dragon from the performance of other players.
Then, Bagman smiled and handed the bag to Krum. The other party drew out a bright red Chinese fireball with the number three on the sign.
Harry was very unlucky. Just like the original time and space, he chose the most violent Hungarian hornet among the four dragons. He was number two.
In the end, Ivan pretended to be solemn and took out the only sculpture in the bag, the Norwegian Ridgeback-Norber!
"It seems that your luck is very bad, Mr. Hals! This dragon is the smartest and most difficult to deal with of all the fire dragons. It is not easy to get a dragon egg from under it!" Bagman sighed with emotion! Said.
Both Furong and Krum looked at Ivan with a little sympathy, but secretly gloating in their hearts is also indispensable. Of course, the higher the difficulties that competitors need to face, the better!
Harry looked worried at Ivan.
Unlike the warriors with different looks, Ivan's expression was very calm, and he quickly replied. "Mr. Bagman, the joy of life lies in the challenge, isn't it? To be honest, I'm very fortunate to have chosen the most difficult dragon to deal with!"
"Okay! This is the attitude a warrior should have! I look forward to seeing your performance..." Bagman clapped and boasted loudly.
Hearing that, Harry, Fleur, and Krum were all ashamed. Compared with Ivan's frankly facing challenges, their timidity and careful thoughts that appeared from time to time were really not worthy of the title of warrior.
Bagman used to brag about a wave. After building momentum for Ivan, he checked the time, and then quickly turned to talk about business. "Now you still have a little time to ease your emotions. When the game officially starts, you will play in the arranged order. Do you understand?"
The four people in the tent nodded together, and Bagman turned and left with confidence. In addition to the referee, he also served as the game commentator You have to prepare in advance.
After Bagman left, there were only four people left in the tent. Ivan sat patiently in the position and waited, while Harry was anxiously spinning around a table, muttering words in his mouth, about the curse of eye disease and The spell of the flying curse.
Slowly, the outside voices got louder and louder, and Ivan guessed that the audience should have arrived.
Suddenly, a piercing whistle was passed in, breaking the condensed atmosphere in the tent. Furong tremblingly stood up from the seat, smiled reluctantly at several people, and then walked towards the exit.
The first game has begun!
Ivan didn't obey the rules and meant to stay in the tent and wait. Instead, he carefully opened the exit curtain and watched Furong's performance from a distance.
Under the gaze of everyone, Furong stepped into the enclosure of the fire dragon step by step. The Swedish short-nosed dragon in the center snorted anxiously, and sparks splashed all over...
A little farther away, more than a dozen professional dragon trainers are waiting in every corner, ready to deal with unexpected situations.

chapters.title: Chapter 622: Warriors fight the fire dragon!
chapters.content:
The exaggerated size contrast of one person and one dragon made the little wizards in the audience worried. Several timid witches even screamed and closed their eyes when they saw Furong approaching the fire dragon.
However, Furong, who had been prepared for a long time, would naturally not choose to be **** the front, but instead kept spinning around the fire dragon.
The Swedish short-nosed dragon has a pretty good temper. It doesn't mean to attack actively. It just keeps roaring menacingly and keeps firmly beside the lair.
Due to the long distance and the auditorium in the middle, Ivan couldn’t see very clearly. He only vaguely saw Furong holding his wand and muttering something in his mouth, and continued to circle under his feet. After a while, the fire dragon’s body began to change. Got to wander around.
Ivan guessed that this should be some kind of special hypnotic magic.
However, the fire dragon's magic resistance was outstanding. After Furong had tossed for half an hour, the Swedish short-nosed dragon couldn't hold back his sleepiness and fell to the ground groggy.
Furong breathed a sigh of relief, and walked forward cautiously. When passing by the fire dragon, the hearts of the audience were raised for fear that the fire dragon would suddenly wake up.
Furong was also frightened, she didn't even dare to step too wide, and her eyes were constantly paying attention to her feet, avoiding stepping on the stones to make noises and awakening the sleeping dragon.
In such a short journey of over ten meters, Furong just walked for more than a minute.
At the moment when she bent down and grabbed the golden egg, Furong's tight emotions relaxed. She knew that she had succeeded!
However, before Furong was happy, the exclamation of the audience pulled her back to reality. The suddenly enlarged shadow on the ground quickly blocked the sun. When she noticed this, Furong's heart There have been warning signs.
Without turning around, she knew that the Swedish short-nosed dragon was awake behind her!
Between the lightning and flint, under the pressure of facing death, Furong made an extremely correct choice. She did not turn her head, and flew forward sharply, avoiding the falling giant claws in a thrilling manner, and splashing gravel hit her body. Make a series of openings.
The deafening dragon roar made her deaf in both ears and her brain was dizzy, so she could only get up from the ground with strong support.
As a female dragon that hatched her eggs, she witnessed her "child" being taken away with her own eyes, and her tyrannical anger spurted out even though it turned into a scorching dragon's breath, and the target was directed at the Lotus who had not yet eased up.
Fortunately, the dragon trainers who were waiting around rushed up at this time, and a dozen protective spells successfully blocked the anger of the Swedish short-nosed dragon, and then a large number of crimson light beams hit the face of the fire dragon. He stunned it again soon.
Although Furong was only slightly injured, facing death twice in a row brought her a lot of psychological shadow, and her body was still trembling when she left.
Harry and Krum, who watched the game through the curtain in the tent, were frightened. The fire dragon was much more dangerous than they expected.
Ivan silently evaluated the combat power of this top-notch magical creature, huge size, hot dragon's breath, super magic resistance...
If it is one-to-one, Ivan believes that even a professionally trained wizard can only flee in a hurry when facing a fire dragon.
This can be compared to a primitive man holding a spear facing an angry mammoth. As long as it is rubbed and touched, it is a dead end, and it can only be hunted by the advantage of the number of people.
Of course, the upper limit of wizards is relatively high.
If you switch to Dumbledore or Voldemort, then subduing the dragon is just a matter of waving a magic wand.
Most of the professors in the school also have the ability to defeat the fire dragon one-on-one, but usually it takes a lot of effort, or there is a risk of injury...
In general, this is a magical creature with extremely powerful combat power. Ivan felt that if nothing else, the four bloodlines he prepared would be fire dragons!
Just as Ivan was thinking about it, the sharp whistle sounded again.
Harry's body shook, and he pursed his mouth. He knew he was on the court.
"Go! Don't be too nervous, just play normally!" Ivan said comfortingly.
Harry nodded and walked out as if dying.
When he was on the field, watching the fire dragon in front of him that was too strong to be defeated, Harry tried his best to calm his emotions, and according to the tactics he had planned before-drew out his wand to release the flying curse, and summoned the firebolt!
Fortunately, the thousands of exercises yesterday weren't in vain, and the Firebolt flew all the way from the castle to save face.
Harry reached out and held the Firebolt in his hand and rode it up, feeling like returning to the Quidditch pitch in his heart. The golden egg is like a golden snitch fixed there, and the fire dragon is the shot of Slytherin. Hand with goalkeeper.
Thinking of this, Harry developed some confidence, biting his head and rushing directly at the Hungarian hornet amidst the exclamation of the audience.
Such a provocative behavior naturally made the already ferocious Hungarian hornet furious. The dragon's breath continued to spit out and exploded in mid-air. The flames covered the sky and the sun, but Harry was looking for a gap. Move left and right, constantly shuttle back and forth under the dragon claw.
One after another, dark brown light beams lased from Harry's wand, but they weren't very effective when hitting the dragon's face.
Harry suddenly understood that the effect of his eye disease curse was too bad, and that he had to hit the dragon's eyes to have enough effect, so he started to deal with the Hungarian hornet!
This fierce chasing battle made the little wizards onlookers screaming. At the critical moment of Harry's escape from the dragon's mouth, there was a screaming scream around him.
Krum, who was watching in the tent, saw Harry cast his Eye Curse, his entire face turned green!
Using the Eye Curse to deal with the fire dragon was a method he and Karkaroff thought of after a long discussion. Flying is what he is best at, and now both of these methods are used by Harry!
It's over, what should I do? Krum only felt cold in his hands and feet, and his brain was muddy.
Ivan looked at Krum’s sudden change of expression, and couldn’t help feeling a little sympathetic. Krum now either learned Harry’s appearance and was accused of plagiarism, or he could only find another way temporarily.
But whoever asked Karkaroff to target himself so much, he had no choice but to add obstacles to Durmstrang's warriors!
After such a delay Harry has successfully hit the dragon's eye.
The Hungarian hornet lost his sight and completely messed up the rules, only attacking everything in the body without a brain, and let out a roar of anger.
Harry took this opportunity to rush directly under the Hungarian Hornet, escaped two tramples, and snatched the golden egg with the speed of the firebolt, winning the cheers of the audience!
After Harry left the field, the dragon trainers rushed in to clean up the mess.
Along with the sound of Bagman's whistle...

chapters.title: Chapter 623: Let us invite the last warrior to come on stage!
chapters.content:
Krum walked out of the tent unconsciously, a battle between heaven and humans in his mind, hesitating whether to use the eye disease curse to confuse the dragon according to the original plan.
After all, this method has just been used by Harry!
And he didn't bring the Firebolt, and he couldn't rely on the flying broom to deal with the fire dragon like Harry, and lacked enough viewing.
By the time the two are compared, he will only get a bottom score!
This is something that Krum couldn't accept anyway!
So on the way to the arena, Krum constantly searched for the dark magic he had in his brain, and finally gritted his teeth and decided to try other methods to fight the fire dragon!
After making the decision, Krum held his wand and stepped into the paddock. The Chinese Fireball Dragon was standing in the center of the field, guarding the dragon egg, and did not intend to attack.
This made Krum breathe a sigh of relief. He immediately held up his wand, and began to chant obscure spells continuously, and dots of black light began to appear on the top of the wand...
The fireball dragon directly opposite also felt threatened, but due to the need to protect the dragon egg, it still hesitated not to step forward, and instead issued a roar to expel the pesky wizard.
The two sides held a stalemate for more than ten seconds, and Krum finished all the obscure spells, and a large amount of black fog emerged, condensed into a large ball and flew out of the magic wand, hitting the fireball dragon. Body.
Accompanied by a violent blasting sound, the fireball dragon roared in pain, and the black mist was like the strongest acid mist, corroding the dragon scales quickly...
Krum's mouth also conjured up a smile, but the smile on his face lasted only a few seconds, and then it turned into panic.
Because the roaring fireball dragon directly abandoned the dragon egg and rushed towards him frantically!
Krum was stunned, and only had time to bless himself with an iron armor curse, he was slapped and flew out by the huge dragon claws, and his body fell heavily on the ground and rolled more than a dozen times before stopping.
The sudden change scared the little wizards in the auditorium so much that they screamed endlessly, and some even suspected that Krum had been slapped to death by the fire dragon.
The dragon trainers guarding around were also taken aback, and they immediately wanted to rush to the rescue!
But it’s too late. The fire dragon, irritable because of the attack, has once again rushed to Krum’s face. Its sharp dragon teeth are as sharp as a polished dagger. It seems to want to kill Krum in one bite. Swallow it.
"Fluorescence flashes! (Bulgarian In a critical time, Krum, who was almost shot dead, clutched his chest and shouted in a nearly hoarse voice. The intense light like a scorching sun spread from the top of the wand to all directions.
The dazzling light obscured the sight of the Chinese Fireball Dragon, causing it to be blinded briefly.
Krum jumped up from the ground with strong support. The first thing he did was ran towards the dragon's nest, and then yelled at the surroundings in poor English.
"The game continues!"
The dragon trainer in charge of the guard hesitated for a moment, not knowing whether to obey or not, in their opinion, the current situation is out of control!
The short-term blindness caused by the lighting curse lasted only about a second, and the fireball dragon resumed its sight again, and rampaged through the field even more brutally.
Krum was thinking about the countermeasures desperately-he needs a broom, otherwise, let alone win the dragon egg, the whole person has to explain here!
But when he came back, he didn't bring his own Firebolt...
The roar of the fire dragon was getting closer, and Krum had a premonition of death. Fortunately, he had an idea and turned to look at the exit of the arena-there was a ready-made broom!
"Firebolts are coming!" Krum held the last hope, waved his wand and shouted loudly.
One second, two seconds...There is still nothing on the field.
At that moment, Krum thought a lot, even if he was angry and helpless, he was not willing to save a competitor by comparing his heart.
A huge fireball ejected from the dragon's mouth and hit Krum.
Under the light of the fire, Krum’s hair exploded. Just as he was about to admit defeat and apply for rescue, a long, wooden stick-like thing suddenly flew over from the sky.
It's Firebolt!
Krum was not fortunate enough, he jumped up and grabbed the firebolt's stick, rolled over and rode on it, evading the impact of the fireball explosion with extraordinary speed, and went straight to the dragon's nest!
The fire dragon furiously spit out dragon breaths behind him, but Krum avoided one by one. He turned his body upside down and picked up the golden egg and raised it high, indicating that he had finished the game!
The dragon trainers hurriedly stepped forward and cast spells to calm the female dragon's anger, and the little wizards around also breathed a sigh of relief.
"What a shameful behavior, Durmstrang's player Krum, actually reproduced Mr. Porter's way of dealing with the fire dragon... This is cheating, he must have peeped at the game!" Bagman as the commentator Without giving Krum any face, the sharp words echoed through a loudspeaker throughout the paddock.
A large number of little wizards also agree with Bagman’s statement, and they have spoken out accusing Krum of shamelessness. Only Krum’s loyal fans are still defending him... After all, there is no clear stipulation in the game, and the Warriors cannot. Use a similar method to pass!
Krum didn't have the face to stay on the court after winning the dragon egg, and soon stepped down in disgrace.
"Okay, let's invite the last warrior to come on stage!" Bagman cleared his throat and said loudly The audience on the court looked towards the entrance of the paddock, one dressed The little blond wizard in Lefender's school robe was walking in from the entrance.
Unlike the other warriors, there is no nervous or worried look on his face, but a calm and calm attitude.
The moment Ivan stepped into the paddock, cheers erupted from the surrounding audience.
Countless little wizards shouted his name, and the flags held high were floating in mid-air, with the words "Gryffindor Heroes" or "Hogwarts Stars" written in big golden letters on them!
Ivan politely looked around and nodded at the crowd. At the same time, he noticed that his friends were cheering for him on the stage, and Luna waved at him.
On the stage, Bagman's words continued. He pointed to the center of the paddock and solemnly introduced Ivan's opponent this time.
"The opponent of the fourth warrior is a Norwegian Ridgeback! I can tell you clearly that this is the smartest and most threatening dragon among the four-headed dragons! Let us look forward to Hals' performance..."

chapters.title: Chapter 624: Violation, this dragon violates the rules!
chapters.content:
Just as Bagman spoke, Norbert, who had just arrived at the scene, also stretched out his wings. The long and hideous back was covered with sharp spikes, which looked like a raised blade under the sunlight.
Perhaps it was uneasy being surrounded by so many wizards. This Norwegian Ridgeback opened its mouth full of fangs and let out a shocking roar. With a flick of its huge tail, it unconsciously smashed a huge rock next to it. Shattered.
Norbert's demonstrative actions and strong offensiveness made the little wizards on the sidelines a cold sweat for Ivan.
Especially the thrilling scene of the three warriors who escaped from Longkou is still vivid. Everyone is curious about what method Ivan will use to obtain the golden egg under the fire dragon.
What they didn't expect was that Ivan didn't make any preparations, so he walked towards the Dragon Nest in such a big stride. It was like going to accept the award instead of dealing with a fire dragon.
Even observers like them can feel the contemptuous attitude, let alone Norbert who is directly opposite!
Enraged, the fire dragon looked very violent, and the yellow-orange eyes stared at Ivan stubbornly.
As the distance between one person and one dragon gets closer and closer, the blond little wizard seems to become serious, and he lifts his wand slightly.
"Ougno~ (Ten thousand bullets are fired
The gravel debris on the ground seemed to have been guided, floating one after another, and transformed into sharp stone spears under the action of the Transformation Curse...
However, Ivan’s attack was more than that. He waved his magic wand again, this time as a magnifying spell. Nearly one-third of the stone spear quickly expanded to the size of a human head and flew towards the fire dragon at an extraordinary speed.
"Our last warrior has finally done it! Is he preparing to confront the fire dragon head-on? This is impossible! I think Krum has already demonstrated to us the consequences! No wizard can fight an adult fire dragon alone, no one !"
As the commentator, Bagman shouted heartbreakingly, mobilizing the nervousness of the students on the field.
Only Karkaroff was very dissatisfied with Bagman's words, and immediately defended Krum, but it was a pity that the people present did not pay attention to him at all, and both eyes fixed on the center of the hunting ground.
But they soon saw that it was not easy to deal with a dragon. Norber's huge dragon tail swept away, and a large number of stone spears were shot into powder.
But the number of stone spears is too much. Even the thick dragon scales can’t completely block these damages. It’s like a heavy wound. After a few steps, the huge body twisted crazily, sending out a wave. Road painful screams.
Later, perhaps because he wanted to protect the dragon egg too much, Noble did something that no one had expected. The forelimbs grabbed the golden egg directly, flapped his wings and flew!
The students around the paddock were stunned, and the dragon trainers next to them looked dumbfounded. This was the only dragon they had ever seen running away with eggs!
"Violation! This dragon violates the rules!" Bagman on the stage also stared with big eyes, and he yelled loudly, his mood tense to the extreme.
Ivan didn't tell him what he would do in the arena, and even Ivan directly attacked the fire dragon, which he didn't expect.
Thinking about this, Bagman couldn't help but regret putting all his bets on Ivan, because this kid was so bold!
He thought that Ivan chose Norbert deliberately because he discovered the opponent's weakness, and there is no trick to pass the test, but he didn't expect this kid to be head-on!
But Bagman soon discovered that this Norwegian Ridgeback had a very strong vengeance and had no intention of running away. After wandering in the sky for a while, he quickly dived, and the hot dragon's breath spread from there. The dragon's mouth spit out, and the sea of ​​fire engulfed in the heat wave was overwhelmed.
"Hurry up!" Hermione, who was sitting in the Gryffindor stand, was extremely nervous, pulling on the railing tightly with both hands, shouting loudly.
However, Ivan didn’t mean to evade. A blazing flame slowly ignited from the top of the wand. As Ivan’s direction floated out, the speed became faster and faster, and his size gradually increased, and finally swelled to the point. It was three meters wide and collided with the breath of the fire dragon in mid-air.
A huge roar resounded throughout the audience. The little wizards tightly covered their ears and made harsh screams, but their eyes were staring at the paddock tightly, not daring to deviate half a minute, for fear of missing some wonderful scenes. .
Thick black smoke rose up, a large amount of rubble fell continuously from the air, and the shock wave brought by the explosion lifted the Norwegian Ridgeback which was not far away several meters away.
Ivan used the ring of magic extravagantly to bounce all the falling rubble to one side, and then raised his hand again with a purple beam of light hitting the unstable body of Norbert.
Although the dragon scales were not broken, the Norwegian Ridgeback still seemed to have been affected. It swayed and hit a stone pillar on the side, and fell to the ground.
Karkaroff and others on the judges' stage were all at a loss, and they really couldn't understand the situation. However, with the powerful spell just now as a comparison, they subconsciously believed that it must also be a very powerful magic.
"Can you see what spell Hals is using?" Crouch turned his head to look at several learned principals, and asked curiously.
Dumbledore's face couldn't help but twitched, but he still put on a solemn gesture and said slowly. "This should be some kind of curse aimed at specialized spirits to be able to produce such an effect!"
Karkaroff and Maxim nodded hurriedly when they heard the words They said that they had seen similar magic in some partial books.
The audience on the field was also unclear. They only saw Ivan cast a spell to knock the huge flying dragon down from the sky, and the cheers that shattered the sky suddenly resounded through the audience.
However, the battle did not end because of the dragon's fall. The ferocious Norwegian Ridgeback quickly eased from the "mental influence", hunched down and assumed an offensive posture.
One person and one dragon confronted each other in a small space, and neither of them had the slightest meaning of moving for dozens of seconds.
If you change the scene, the confrontation of such a size gap will only seem particularly ridiculous, but it is different now, everyone agrees that this is a close battle!
No...Many sharp-eyed little wizards have keenly discovered that in the fight now, Ivan still looks so calm and relaxed, even his clothes are neat and tidy, but the Norwegian Ridgeback looks ashamed and stubborn. Dare to do something.
However, only Ivan knows the real situation, and that is that Norbert seems to have forgotten what to do next...

chapters.title: Chapter 625: What are you doing? Noble?
chapters.content:
According to Ivan's plan, the previous aerial battle should have been longer and more exciting, instead of waving his wand, Norbert fell from the sky and fell to the ground.
Because this is too fake!
While Ivan was thinking to himself, Norbert on the opposite side was trying very hard to remember what he should do next.
Although the blasting magic that Ivan cast just now didn't hurt it head-on, the shock of the subsequent aftermath still made his mind a little confused.
The two sides stood there for a full minute, and Ivan, who was very speechless, could only lower his voice and reminded him.
"Tail... Draw it over with your tail!"
Under Ivan’s repeated reminders, Norbert finally moved. It stretched its body and uttered a roar. The long tail of the dragon slammed its opponent quickly, pulling out afterimages in mid-air, which was ear-piercing. The sonic boom can be heard clearly even by the audience on the court.
The sudden outbreak of battle once again affected everyone's heartstrings. Everyone's eyes widened, and their emotions were strained to the extreme. Everyone was very curious about how Ivan would deal with an almost unavoidable attack while holding on to the railing!
As the dragon's tail swept like a long whip, Ivan's body disappeared in place, and when it reappeared, it had moved a few meters away.
Although the magic of Phantom Shift is very risky to use in battle, teleport can still ensure 100% success if the opponent's movements are known in advance!
"The boulder is flying!"
Under everyone's gaze, Ivan's counterattack was equally fast. He swung his wand and a boulder more than two meters high flew over from his side, bumping the huge Norwegian Ridgeback into a stagger.
"What a wonderful Apparition! Oh, and the flying curse! Hals always used the curse beyond our expectations. He has successfully suppressed the fire dragon. I believe the battle will soon be possible. Win or lose!"
As a commentator, Bagman was excited and excited to convey Ivan's performance in words, ensuring that the few little wizards who were in a bad position and blocked could also understand what was happening in the paddock.
"However, I need to remind you that it is extremely irrational to fight a dragon in a small pile of rocks. I never recommend any wizard to imitate! Again, I never recommend any wizard to imitate!"
Bagman continued to shout loudly, his voice was dumb, and he was thinking about taking a sip of water to be shocked, but then he saw that the situation on the paddock became thrilling again.
The Norwegian Ridgeback, which had been suppressed by the curse, erupted completely, and the hot dragon's breath erupted from its wide open mouth. Due to the distance, it instantly engulfed Ivan in.
"Oh, no, our warrior completely angered the dragon! It's the dragon's breath, get away!" Bagman yelled aloud, but it was too late for him to speak.
The little wizards on the field also screamed when they witnessed Ivan being engulfed in the fire.
Fortunately, the sharp-eyed Bagman soon discovered that a figure was faintly erected in the heat wave set off by the dragon's breath, and he hurriedly shouted loudly.
"Wait... great, Hals is fine!"
Hearing that, the little wizards watching on the court also quickly fixed their eyes.
As Bagman said, Ivan still maintains an upright posture in the vast sea of ​​flames.
Holding his wand high in his right hand, he shot a beam of light forward, constructing a solid shield in the air less than two meters in front of him!
The scorching dragon's breath was separated from the middle in this way, and the two seemed to be in a fierce competition, constantly consuming and confronting each other.
Ivan held on for a while, feeling that his emotions were almost mobilized, and then waved his magic wand again to begin the final closing performance!
The huge boulders that were originally scattered around and pulled by the flying curse suddenly melted at an extraordinary speed, and then turned into several huge chains that stretched around Norbert's body.
Roar~
The mighty Norwegian Ridgeback uttered a painful cry, struggling hard, the dragon's breath deflected and spewed onto the grass aside, causing a small-scale fire in an instant.
As everyone watched, the chains tightened tighter and tighter, and Norbert shook his head and smashed into the pile of stones, even wanting to roll on the ground.
"What are you doing? Norbert?"
Ivan was very helpless. He knew that Norbert must be playing. The huge chain he turned out was just what looked like he was acquainted. It is not so easy to lock a dragon. If you accidentally get rid of the **** It's not good.
So Ivan hurriedly reminded him. "Fly! Norbert, fly toward me!"
With the instructions, Norbo stopped venting his nerves, stretched his wings, and rammed into Ivan's side.
Ivan dodged it very easily, then looked at the timing, grabbed one of the chains, took advantage of his strength to turn over and rode directly on the dragon's back, and was taken by Noble to the high altitude.
"Oh my God! It's incredible! Have you all seen it? Our warrior actually rode on a dragon's back!" Bagman shouted hoarsely.
Everyone looked eagerly, the Norwegian Ridgeback was still tied with a huge chain. It struggled to go around the paddock several times, and the breath of the dragon dyed the entire sky red!
The billowing heat wave swept the audience, and whenever Norbert passed by, the little wizards below were scared enough, screaming and sitting on the ground with their heads in their hands, for fear that the flames would burn themselves.
The others are staring at the blond wizard on the dragon's back. No matter how Norbert rolls in midair to do stunts, Ivan still holds one end of the chain firmly, unaffected by any influence.
After flying for three laps, the mighty Norwegian Ridgeback became more and more ineffective, and was finally forced to fall from the sky The broad dragon wings stretched out to the greatest extent, and Noble was like a big The number's hang glider fell down beside the dragon's nest in the center of the paddock in a relatively decent posture.
The huge body seemed to be tightly bound by five chains, unable to move at all, and the dragon's claws that had been holding on to the golden egg were finally released...
The golden ball swayed slowly on the relatively flat field, and finally fell into the dragon's nest.
Ivan jumped down from the dragon's back, picked up the golden dragon egg in the eyes of everyone in awe or admiration, and raised it high...
At this moment, thunderous applause broke out in the surrounding audience, and countless little wizards screamed feverishly, expressing their emotions.
"Awesome, Hals, our hero!"
"You are a true warrior! I love you!"
"Dragon Knight Hals!"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 626: The joy of life lies in the challenge!
chapters.content:
Ivan looked around and listened to the cheers and shouts of the crowd, with a smile at the corners of his mouth. He held up the gold cup and gestured to the crowd, then patted the dust on his robe, and walked towards the exit...
On the podium, Bagman stared at Ivan's leaving back, and for a moment he even forgot to understand. He was so stunned that he inexplicably recalled what Ivan said in the tent.
[The joy of life lies in the challenge, I am very fortunate to be able to choose the most difficult dragon to deal with! 】
The confident words of the blond wizard seemed to echo in Bagman's ears.
At that time, he thought it was just someone's shameless self-bragged, and now it seems that the other party is looking for himself to cheat, maybe he really just wants to challenge the most powerful dragon!
No... I'm afraid this is not the only thing!
Bagman turned his gaze to the seemingly weak Norwegian Ridgeback lying in the middle of the paddock, but he did not dare to look down on it, because the fierce battle just now had fully demonstrated the opponent's cunning and mighty.
Bagman even suspected that even if he played in person, he might not be able to get the dragon egg under the protection of Norbert, because this dragon is really too smart!
In the same way, if other warriors face this monster, I am afraid it will only be worse. If there is any unexpected accident, the dragon trainers may not be able to restore the situation in time.
Therefore, in addition to being keen on challenging the limit, Bagman believes that Ivan must also be worried that his best friend Harry will choose this Norwegian Ridgeback, losing the game in embarrassment and even losing his life, so he knew in advance that he would pick it away. This is the hardest fire dragon to deal with!
Bagman made up his mind for a while, and found that things suddenly became clear, he secretly regretted that he had thought such an upright little wizard so gloomy before, that the other party's past achievements would never be deceiving!
While thinking about it, Bagman also picked up the quill and wrote the score on the wooden sign. Waiting for the meeting may be the time to score.
Ivan on the other side had already walked out of the paddock, and when he left, he had not forgotten to remove the giant chain that "trapped" Norbert, so as not to be seen by others.
After turning a trail, Ivan came to the resting place of the warriors.
"You're really good, Ivan!" Harry walked up very excitedly, making a fist with his right hand and hammering Ivan's shoulder.
The intensity of the battle just now was far beyond his imagination. Just looking at it from a distance, Harry felt that the blood in his body was about to ignite!
"Ha... don't praise me like that, I also watched your game, it was great!" Ivan smiled and patted him on the shoulder, and said.
Furong on the side looked at Ivan with interest, her bright eyes gleaming with a different kind of luster.
The only black face on the court was Krum. When Ivan got the golden egg, he knew that he would definitely be the bottom!
After exchanging a few words with Harry, Ivan was also exhausted. He fought a dragon for almost half an hour, from the ground to the sky, even if it was just acting, it was very tired!
Just before he sat down and had a good rest, there was a rush of footsteps outside the tent. After a few seconds, the curtain of the tent was pulled open. Ivan turned his head and looked over before he found out that he had come in. The person is Hermione.
"Ivan!" The little witch looked around after breaking in, and soon saw Ivan's figure, hurried over, and ran into him directly.
Ivan took a few steps back after being hit, and subconsciously embraced Hermione who hit him in his arms with both hands.
Around the slender waist, the two hugged each other so tightly, Ivan could even feel Hermione's sudden acceleration of heartbeat and the slight trembling of her body.
However, such an intimate act did not last long. Hermione, who was dizzy for a while, quickly realized that there were more than two people in the lounge.
Although she was still a little bit dissatisfied, she was not so thick-skinned that she could ignore other people's gazes, so after holding her for more than half a minute, Hermione gently broke free and quietly looked around.
Sure enough, Harry and Fleur were both looking at themselves with a playful look, with smiles that everyone knew at the corners of their mouths. Krum's expression was very ugly. She guessed that it might be because of the injury. reason.
The gazes of several people made Hermione look a little cramped, her brown eyes didn't know where to look for a while, and finally she continued to stare at Ivan and cast her anger on him so that she wouldn't be too embarrassed.
"You were so adventurous just now! Ivan! When the Norwegian Ridgeback breathed fire, you should avoid it in time. What if your magic was not defended and you got burned? And the dragon charge? When you come, you shouldn’t risk riding on its back..."
At first, Hermione just wanted to alleviate the awkward atmosphere, but the more she talked, her expression became angry, and there was still a little frightened panic on her face.
