This pendant looks very peculiar. It is shaped like a meniscus as a whole, strung by a long silver chain, which shines exceptionally under the reflection of moonlight.
"It's beautiful!" Hermione muttered to herself, staring at it drunkly.
However, she quickly noticed that there were many fine cracks on the surface of the crescent moon pendant, which seemed to be seriously damaged, so she looked at Ivan again suspiciously.
"This is a Christmas gift from my mother Isiah at Christmas in the first grade... a very delicate magic item that can resist a deadly injury for the carrier..." Ivan explained with an expression. Some miss.
Hermione was surprised and a little frightened. Of course, she could understand what the broken crescent moon meant. Doesn't that mean Ivan almost died once?
"Is it time to protect the Sorcerer's Stone?" Hermione thought of this at once and asked anxiously.
Although she did not see the specific battle process at the time, the battle situation was obviously very tragic.
After she rushed to Dumbledore with Dumbledore, it was full of ruined walls, and Ivan was in a coma for two days before waking up.
Ivan nodded with lingering fear, but before he could say anything, Hermione had already jumped over and hugged him abruptly.
The intermittent crying quickly reached his ears, and the robe on his chest seemed to be soaked with water.
"That's all a long time ago. It's long gone, right?" Ivan didn't expect the little witch to have such a big reaction. He awkwardly spoke to comfort him, regretting it in his heart. Something told her...
Hermione didn't reply, she just nestled in Ivan's arms, venting her panic. She wanted to scold Ivan for taking risks, but she couldn't speak anyway.
Because they went on the adventure together, Ivan didn't do anything wrong. If they didn't stop Quirrell, the mysterious man would use the resurrection of the Philosopher's Stone to wreak havoc in the magic world and set off killings.
What really made Hee sensitive and painful was her own powerlessness, and she was always unable to help when it was critical.
Ivan comforted her softly, and after a while she calmed Hermione's emotions down, and then put the crescent moon pendant on her personally, and gently wiped the tears from the corners of her eyes.
"Very suitable and beautiful!" Ivan said admiringly, looking at the girl in front of him.
The former is talking about the pendant, and the latter is describing Hermione with the pendant.
Although the little witch has cried, her eyes are a little red, but this does not affect her charm at all. On the contrary, it covers the strength of the past and highlights the unique femininity of the girl.
Hermione gently stroked the crescent moon pendant hanging on her neck. The anxiety and fear that had originally appeared in her heart was gradually filled with happiness. She did not dislike it as a damaged magic item. After she understood the reason for it , She is very aware of how precious and special this gift is.
Thinking of this Hermione wanted to say thank you, but was interrupted by Ivan.
"Wait... it's not over yet!"
Hermione looked at Ivan in confusion, not quite understanding what he meant.
"I think it's time to fix it!" Ivan said with a smile, and stretched out his hand to hold the crescent moon pendant and slowly hold it in his palm.
Then Ivan closed his eyes and concentrated on using Professor Nicol Lemay's transmission magic to inject the strong emotions in his heart into the pendant at this moment.
Hermione was so nervous that she didn't dare to move or speak, for fear of interrupting Ivan's spell.
Gradually, a dazzling golden light passed from between the fingers that Ivan was holding, with exceptional warmth, and Hermione, who was close at hand, could clearly feel the strong affection contained in that power.
It lasted for half a minute, Ivan opened his eyes again, his face was a little more tired, he spread his hand, the crescent moon pendant in the center of his palm has become perfect, and the fine cracks disappear without a trace, from time to time You can see the golden fluorescence flowing above it.

chapters.title: Chapter 652: Happy 7th Festival!
chapters.content:
Ding, after a period of practice, your alchemy level has greatly improved, the current level 6 (15999/16000)]
At the same time as the casting was completed, the system reminder sounded in his mind. Ivan was a little disappointed looking at the progress bar that could almost be upgraded.
He thought he could break through the bottleneck of alchemy by fixing the crescent moon pendant, but now it seems that something is still missing after all.
However, Ivan quickly adjusted his mood and was able to smoothly repair the meniscus pendant during the strongest mood swings in the past few days, which has met his expectations.
Then, Ivan opened the system's inventory and checked it again.
【Magic Item: Crescent Moon Pendant
Magic: strong
Explanation: This is a magical item made with a lot of precious metals, which can resist deadly attacks for the bearer until the power is exhausted.
Note: You successfully repaired this magic item and strengthened it. The secret is to inject love into it...]
The attribute of the meniscus pendant that was repaired by Ivan has been enhanced a lot, and there is no limit on the number of resistances, and the magic rating has also risen from strong to strong.
After all, his current strength and alchemy level have fully surpassed Aesia, and he also uses the high-end guidance skills taught by Nick LeMay, so he can naturally better use the power of emotions.
While paying attention to the system bar, Ivan certainly did not forget Hermione. He put the repaired crescent moon pendant back in and said.
"When I am away, it will replace me to protect you!"
Ivan was very serious. He chose to give Hermione the Crescent Moon Pendant as a Christmas gift. On the one hand, he wanted to take this rare opportunity to repair it, and on the other hand, he was worried about Hermione’s play in the second level. Time is in danger.
Although the other magic item protection ring he made can also play a certain protective effect, it needs to be actively activated. Once Hermione is in a coma, this ring is no different from an ornament.
The meniscus pendant is different, it is passively effective, as long as the carrier receives a strong attack, it will automatically launch.
The only thing that made Ivan hesitate was that repairing the crescent moon pendant was the receipt voucher agreed upon by him and Nick LeMay, which was given to Hermione, and he would not be able to come up with the second one at that time.
However, Ivan believes that the real test for this master alchemist should be whether he can apply the power of emotions to the production of magic items, which he has successfully done.
As long as you practice more, it shouldn't be a problem to make some similar magic props to prove your ability, but it may not have such a powerful effect.
"Are you really going to give me such a precious thing? Ivan?" Hermione looked at the repaired crescent pendant, panicked, and she looked at Ivan very disturbed and said. "If it can resist those dangerous spells, you should need it more than I do."
"Did you forget how I repaired it?" Ivan calmed Hermione and explained. "It will only protect you alone! If it is given to other people, it will be just an ordinary pendant..."
Listening to Ivan's words, Hermione calmed down. She didn't know much about alchemy, but she could directly observe the friendship that Ivan showed when he repaired the pendant.
Most of Ivan poured his love for her into the pendant, forming a special protective spell.
Thinking of this, Hermione was very moved, and her heart, which was originally filled with happiness and joy, was overflowing at this moment, and her brown eyes looking at Ivan became more and more hazy.
She wanted to thank Ivan, but felt that that was not enough, and the enthusiasm rising from the bottom of her heart almost swamped Hermione.
She was eager to do something, her eyes happened to see the scarf she gave to Ivan, her face flushed slightly, she stretched out her hand on one end of the scarf and pulled it lightly.
Ivan was unprepared at all, lowered her head, and then saw Hermione's delicate face getting closer. She closed her eyes nervously, her rosy lips slightly opened and printed on his lips.
There was only such a short moment when the lips met, and they separated quickly.
Before Ivan could react, Hermione jumped away, her face burning red.
Ivan didn't expect Hermione to be so proactive at all. He touched his lips, as if he was still reminiscing about the touch just now, then looked at the little witch and asked jokingly.
"Is this also the Christmas present you plan to give me?"
"No, I'll give you a scarf!" Hermione's face was flushed with crimson flushes, and her breathing was a little disturbed.
Seeing the little witch's fascinating gesture, Ivan's enthusiasm weakened by the guiding magic rekindled. He wanted to continue the kiss just now under the banner of giving another Christmas gift.
But how could Hermione let him succeed, she was completely dizzy the previous moment, and now she is too shy, and now she refuses to say anything again.
...
On the second day of Christmas, after a night of hustle and bustle, everyone got up late. The common room in Gryffindor was much quieter than before, as if they had vented all their energy yesterday. .
If it weren't for the fact that there were a few more couples walking together on campus, there were people discussing the Christmas ball held yesterday, which almost made Ivan suspect that what happened last night was an illusion.
Because Hermione was back to her usual appearance again, wearing a standard school uniform, holding a pile of books in her arms After seeing them, she walked over quickly and put the books down.
Crookshanks, the big **** cat, followed Hermione all the time, and after the little witch sat down, he jumped into her arms, acting comfortably.
"Hermione, why don't you put on a dress and take care of your hair? It was so beautiful yesterday..." Ivan asked curiously. He also hoped that he would appreciate it more when he didn't have to go to school on vacation these days.
"There is no dance party today. It's too much trouble to do that every day!" Hermione turned her head to look at Ivan, and explained distressedly.
Compared to wearing a beautiful long skirt, she has to walk carefully. She still feels more comfortable like this, and she spent more than an hour just taking care of her hair yesterday in order to participate in the prom.
"And... we still have to study!" Hermione added in a low voice, her face flushed slightly when she remembered what happened yesterday.
Ivan shrugged. He really didn't understand. What is the relationship between dressing and learning?
But thinking of the fascinating gesture of the little witch last night, he has some understanding, maybe he can't help being distracted?

chapters.title: Chapter 653: Information on Game 2
chapters.content:
Thinking of this, Ivan looked at Hermione a little more strangely.
Hermione turned her head and didn't dare to continue talking on this topic, but hurriedly asked about business. "Have you found the clue for the second game? Ivan? Harry? We'd better figure it out in two days. If it's as dangerous as the fire dragon, you might need a few more days to prepare..."
Ivan did not answer, but Harry took out his golden egg.
"Mr. Bagman said before that this golden egg can be opened, and the clues are in it. I haven't tried it before..." Harry said distractedly, while digging into the circle of the golden egg with his nails. In the groove, the golden egg was easily opened.
Ivan didn't expect Harry to be so reckless that he couldn't stop it.
The next moment, a terrifying, piercing scream resounded in the common room.
The nearest Harry and Hermione covered their ears in pain, and everyone else in the lounge heard the noise and turned their heads to look over.
"Quietus~ (No sound and no breath Ivan waved his wand for the first time, and the harsh screams quickly subsided.
Harry took the opportunity to grab the golden egg and closed it firmly.
The little wizards in the lounge breathed a sigh of relief. Ron rubbed his ears and muttered. "What the **** is this? Is the banshee's cry? What kind of clue is this? Is it possible that you need to subdue the banshee in the second level?"
Harry nodded. He thought Ron's guess was very likely. They had already dealt with a fire dragon, and he wouldn't be surprised if another banshee came.
But Hermione had a different meaning, and she vetoed it. "This can't be a banshee, their voices are definitely not like that."
"Hermione, why are you so sure? Could it be that you have heard the banshee's call?" Harry asked curiously.
"Have you forgotten? We obviously learned it in the second grade!" Hermione squinted, looking at Harry with a surprised look.
Harry and Ron looked at each other, have they studied? Why don't they remember?
Ivan quickly remembered, and said in agreement. "You're talking about Lockhart's "Break with the Female Ghost", right? I've also seen it. The description above is very detailed... The cries of the dead banshee are sharp and desolate, which usually makes the listener feel very Sadness."
"Yes! This is different from what I just heard. It was obviously not a cry, and we didn't feel sad either." Hermione talked freely, and then continued with some uncertainty. "It's like singing..."
Harry rolled his eyes, feeling that Hermione's guess was really unreliable. How could a creature sing so badly.
Ron also pouted his lips. Isn't Lockhart a liar? Whoever is okay will turn over that guy's book, who knows if Lockhart wrote it out of it...so they continued the discussion with Harry.
After yesterday's events, their relationship returned to a normal state, and no one took the initiative to bring up the previous contradiction.
Believing in her own thoughts, Hermione pulled out a book of "Fantastic Creatures" from the pile of books in front of her, and began to search for clues related to the sound.
Ivan pretended to pick up a book and read it, but the thoughts in his brain drifted to another place.
He had known the specific content of the second game a long time ago, and he also confirmed that the golden egg was placed in the water. It was indeed the same as the original time and space to rescue the hostages at the bottom of the lake.
The reason why I don't say it now is that I hope to use this thing as bait to see if I can catch the hidden little Barty Crouch.
But even if he knew the content of the game in advance, Ivan couldn't be free these days, because he had too much to do!
In addition to practicing psychic mind with Hermione regularly every afternoon, he also had to make time to fix the fish in the Black Lake in order to prepare for the second game.
He can't rest in his spare time at night. He needs to monitor the entire school with a live map to see if Barty Crouch Jr. pops up suddenly.
In addition, there is one of the most important and difficult things, and that is to make the blood fusion potion!
After these days of fermentation, he received the system task [Avid Entrepreneur] last time and was about to complete. He expects that after another wave of prestige in the second task, he will be able to get those two precious legend points, and start The next round of blood fusion.
The corresponding potion naturally had to be made in advance.
The only thing that made Ivan breathe a sigh of relief was that Luna stated in her reply to him yesterday that she had accepted her advice, and recently stayed away from the forbidden forest as much as possible, and the time to find the horned snoring beast has also been pushed to after the second game. , Probably considering that the game is approaching, I don’t want to disturb myself at this time.
This allows Ivan to focus all his energy on more urgent matters...
Looking through the information for the whole morning, Harry and Hermione were a little upset. They could not decipher the information contained in the cry. Ivan had expected this, and he casually said a few words of comfort, and then talked to everyone. Let's go to the auditorium to enjoy today's lunch.
In the afternoon, Ivan routinely practiced meditation with Hermione.
Unlike Luna's obedience, although Hermione no longer refuses to be viewed by him, her resistance is always fierce every time she sees a picture of them getting along in her memory.
She constantly uses the novice Occlumency to resist Ivan's invasion, and perhaps creates a plausible false memory in an attempt to confuse Ivan.
The two of them are like playing a game of level-breaking in a maze of thinking. Hermione desperately wants to hide the real thoughts, while Ivan quickly breaks through the layers of defense set by the little witch like a big devil~www.mtlnovel. com~ Every time Hermione failed, her blushing heartbeat ended.
Ivan was also satisfied to see that his nearly stagnant proficiency in pantographs began to grow rapidly.
In the next few days, Ivan remained in a monotonous cycle, practicing magic during the day, brewing potions at night, or using Bogut to transform and transform his form, dive into the bottom of the lake to chat with the mermaids, and listen for information by the way.
After a few days of understanding, Ivan discovered that although the mermaid looks ugly, it is also an intelligent creature with its own language and living habits. He likes to collect some wizard creations to decorate his lair.
However, they lived on the bottom of the lake all year round and didn't have a deep understanding of the cunning of wizards, so Ivan quickly provided a lot of information.
Dumbledore had already talked to them at the beginning of school and obtained their permission to use the bottom of the lake as the venue for the second game.
Before the start of the game, the people the Warriors care about the most will be placed at the bottom of the lake to wait for rescue. Their task of these merfolk is not to make the game more difficult, but to protect the safety of the hostages as much as possible to avoid unnecessary accidents.

chapters.title: Chapter 654: The singing of the mermaid and the gills
chapters.content:
In the evening a week later, Ivan turned into a mermaid he had seen before, and talked with the leader of the mermaid.
"You must have mistaken the wizard principal's instructions. Dumbledore asked us to preside over the second game...
It's the host! understand?
Your product... your fine product!
If we didn't do anything during the game, he would be very angry.
So we must do something, not just to protect the hostages, for example, to arrange the venue? Or intimidate the contestants..."
Ivan talked endlessly, spending more than an hour successfully distorting the mermaid's understanding of Dumbledore's orders.
Of course, he doesn't intend to do anything bad. The main thing is to improve the difficulty of the second game and make it more exciting, so that the Warriors can have an epic clearance experience.
After doing all this, Ivan left the Black Lake very satisfied, ready to return to the dormitory to have a good rest.
But when passing by the Gryffindor lounge, Ivan unexpectedly saw Harry, Ron, and Hermione rushing over in a hurry.
"What's wrong with you?" Ivan asked in surprise.
"We found the clue, it's a mermaid!" Harry gasped, his expression was very excited, he said very quickly. "Remember the sound we heard that day? It was the singing of a mermaid!"
"How do you know that it's a mermaid? Has anyone provided any clues to you?" Ivan's expression immediately became a little serious, and he hurriedly asked.
Harry and Ron stopped talking, Hermione pursed her lips and looked a little angry.
Ivan looked at the expressions of the three of them, not knowing why, but fortunately, Harry promptly explained. "It was Hermione who found it. In the past few days, she had at least turned through hundreds of books that had something to do with sound. Finally, she saw a similar record in "Underwater Magical Creatures."
"Yes, she even suspected that it was some kind of special signal at first, such as what special information is hidden in the sound frequency, holding Harry's golden egg and listening to it more than a dozen times..." Ron also Added.
Ivan looked at Hermione, knew that he had made a mistake, and hurried to remedy it. "Sorry, Hermione, I shouldn't have said that..."
"You suspect that the person who put Harry's name into the Goblet of Fire will secretly tell Harry the clues of the second level?" Hermione interrupted Ivan before he could finish speaking, thoughtfully. Said.
"It's impossible! It's not that the mysterious man's subordinates suddenly kindly wanted to help Harry win the championship, right?" Ron said this, he couldn't help laughing.
Harry also looked at Ivan in confusion.
Ivan shrugged, feeling helpless. He couldn't tell what hadn't happened, so he had no choice but to talk nonsense. "The events in the Triwizard Tournament are very dangerous. If someone really wants to harm you, just telling you some wrong information on purpose will be deadly!"
Harry, Ron, and Hermione thought Ivan's casual nonsense made sense.
Imagine if someone tells the participating warriors that the first level they need to face is not a fire dragon but a few red hats, then everyone will be very relaxed and will not deliberately formulate targeted strategies, then wait until the real game. It is not impossible to lose the dragon's mouth.
"Since you already know that it is the singing of a mermaid, have you figured out the specific content of the second game?" Ivan asked.
Harry nodded hesitantly, then shook his head again, indicating that he only had some guesses that were not true or false, and then repeated the song he had heard.
"We cannot sing on the ground. When you search, please think carefully:
We snatched your most beloved baby. You only have one hour to find and retake the objects we took. After an hour, there is no hope. It has completely disappeared and will never appear. "
After Harry finished speaking, Hermione went on to explain. "I think the second game should be for you to sneak into the black lake to find something stolen by the mermaids. You only have one hour. Once you exceed it, the mermaids will take that thing forever. Failed!"
Ivan nodded. Hermione was basically on the point, but didn't guess that the one hiding at the bottom of the lake would be a hostage...
"But how can we stay underwater for a long time?" Harry quickly realized this serious problem after experiencing the joy of solving the puzzle.
When they were at home in the past, the Dursleys probably expected him to fall into the water and be drowned one day, so they never let him learn to swim.
In contrast, Dudley swims very well. He often brags about this, but Harry always thinks that there is nothing remarkable, because Dudley is fat like a large lifebuoy, and it can be quickly dropped into the water. Floating up.
"Otherwise you can try the Transfiguration Curse and turn yourself into a swimming fish or something." Hermione suggested, and then looked at Harry apologetically as if thinking of something.
"Oh, I almost forgot. This kind of transformation magic is not taught until the sixth grade, and it is very difficult to master. Ivan may be able to do it, but you definitely can't..."
"Yeah." Harry said weakly, thinking of ideas constantly in his mind, but unfortunately none of them could do it.
"You can use gills, Harry!" Ivan said suddenly.
"What? Cheek grass? What is that?" Harry turned his head hurriedly looked at Ivan excitedly.
"A potion material, you can temporarily grow gills and webs after eating it, and you can breathe and move freely under the water," Ivan explained.
"Like those mermaids?" Hermione thought of the description of mermaids in the book "Fantastic Underwater Creatures".
"Almost, it's only partially deformed. It's definitely not as agile as a mermaid under water..." Ivan said, and there is another shortcoming he didn't mention, that is, the appearance will be uglier after deformation.
But Harry obviously didn't care about this. The fact that he could breathe freely underwater by eating a herb was enough to make him ecstatic-it meant he didn't have to be the first warrior ever to be drowned in a lake.
"Now there are still a few days before the start of the second game. You can find time to go to Hogsmeade Village to buy some gills, and when you are fine, go to the Black Lake to practice..."
Ivan reminded him, and then asked Harry to try to pretend that he hadn't found any clues, and try to pay attention to everyone who tried to reveal the news to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 655: Game 2
chapters.content:
A few days passed in a flash, and soon came the day when the second game was held, and the castle gradually became lively.
As the warriors, Ivan and Harry got up early on the rest day and went to the auditorium to have breakfast together.
Perhaps it was because of being too nervous, Harry had no appetite at all, but just ate a little to deal with it, holding the bottle containing the saccharomyces tightly in his hand, for fear of forgetting it during the game.
Ivan, who was eating leisurely, naturally discovered Harry's abnormality, and said comfortingly. "Relax, Harry, haven't you practiced many times these days?"
Harry nodded absent-mindedly. Although he has been swimming in the black lake a few times these days, he has overcome the problem of not knowing how to swim, but this is almost the same as in the final exam every year. I can't help but feel soft at times.
"You said, what would they let you spend so long looking for in the bottom of the lake?" Ron on the side was curiously guessing about the events of this competition.
"The lyrics are talking about our favorite things..." Harry hesitated for a moment, thought about it for a while, and then said uncertainly. "I think those merfolk will sneak into the lake when I'm away!"
That is his most valuable thing, but Harry has no bottom on whether the Firebolt can be waterproof or not. He only hopes that it will be useful when it is picked up...
Ron nodded in agreement, thinking it was possible.
"By the way, where's Hermione? Isn't she up yet?" Harry looked around. He didn't see his other good friend. He was suddenly a little strange. Normally, Hermione should have gotten up earlier than all of them. That's right.
"I don't know, I haven't seen her since last night... It seems that Professor McGonagall is looking for her for something." Ron shook his head and said.
Ivan paused while eating the meal. He was not surprised. He had long guessed that Hermione would be placed in the Black Lake as a hostage. He was probably taken away by Professor McGonagall last night and forbidden to contact him.
But to Ivan's surprise, Ron was able to sit in the auditorium for dinner. It seemed that the people Harry needed to rescue during the game had changed compared with the original time and space.
Thinking of this, Ivan glanced around in the auditorium, and as expected, he could not find Ginny, so he was even more sure of his guess.
The previous Christmas ball was to a large extent prepared to select the people the Warriors care about the most. Cedric and Krum in the original time and space are the best proof.
It's just that at that time Harry and Fleur were not very interested in their temporary dance partners, and the organizers had no choice but to make another choice.
After eating breakfast, considering that the time for the official start of the game was getting closer and closer, Ivan did not delay much, so he took Harry and Ron straight to the venue.
All the way to the lakeside of the Forbidden Forest, from a distance, Ivan saw a huge observation platform erected here, erected in a semi-circular shape on the lake shore.
Many students came earlier than them, and the rows of seats were already full of people. Ron encouraged the two of them and ran over after a few words, hoping to find another spectator. Good location.
Ivan and Harry walked towards the entrance of the arena, and Ludo Bagman, who had been waiting for a long time, greeted him immediately, with a narrow smile on their faces, showing very enthusiasm. "Ivan, Potter, you are here just right, come here now, the game will start right away, and you will have to go down to the lake together later!"
Ivan made a few polite words with him, and then walked to the center of the arena under Bagman's guidance-it has been transformed into a small pier, with a long wooden board extending from the lake shore to the Black Lake. .
At the end, the figures of Furong and Krum were clearly visible. They obviously came prepared, all wearing swimsuits, and Furong's hot figure attracted the attention of the wizards in the audience.
Seeing this posture, Harry quickly took off his robe and threw it under the tree aside, revealing the waterproof short-sleeved T-shirt and tights.
"Ivan, won't you take it off?" Harry turned his head strangely to look at Ivan, who didn't move at all-he was still wearing that black wizard robe, which would definitely be inconvenient underwater.
"No need..." Ivan shook his head without explaining much.
Harry couldn't figure out Ivan's thoughts, but he also knew that the other party definitely didn't need to worry about it by himself, so he didn't ask more. He stood on the track intently, and took out the bottle with the sacrum.
At this meeting, Yifan cast his gaze on the judges' bench.
At this time, Bagman, the referee and commentator, had already stood in front of the stage. After clearing his throat and reading out the various precautions for the second game, his expression became more serious, and he looked at Ivan on the court. Waiting for someone, then looked at the surrounding audience and shouted loudly.
"Last night, we took away the most cherished treasures of the warriors and placed them in the middle of the Black Lake this morning, and their task is to find and bring them back within the specified time!"
"I need to remind the warriors that your time is very tight, only one hour! Once the time limit is exceeded, the consequences will be very serious, and you will probably lose that treasure forever!"
The sound of Bagmana's blessed curse reverberated continuously by the lake. The little wizards in the audience were very curious about what this treasure actually meant, and they had heated discussions.
As the warriors, Fleur, Krum and Harry are also guessing. Although they have cracked the secret of the Golden Egg, they are still at a loss as to what they are looking for in this mission.
Bagman didn't mean to sell it, he turned to look at Dumbledore, and continued to speak. "As for what the treasure we took... will be revealed for us by Principal Dumbledore!"
Under everyone's attention Dumbledore stood up with a serious face, and with a strong wave of his magic wand with his left hand, five fist-sized crystal **** rose from the black lake.
Harry, Fleur, and Krum looked at those crystal **** and were a little unclear. Is it possible that their task this time is to find these balls?
Only Ivan raised the corners of his mouth slightly, because these crystal **** were made by him and rented to Bagman. As for the role...
Dumbledore, who was on the judges' bench, waved his magic wand again, and the crystal **** swelled up quickly, each of which was about ten meters in size, just floating in the air quietly.
Everyone can see clearly that some pictures are emerging on the surface of the crystal ball.
Especially the crystal ball in the middle reflects the scene at the bottom of the lake—it looks like a big mermaid village, surrounded by many stone dwellings. From time to time, you can see some ferocious fish with steel forks. People swim across the screen.
And in the center of the picture stands a mermaid statue carved from a huge stone. On the tail of the mermaid statue, four people are firmly bound...

chapters.title: Chapter 656: 4 hostages
chapters.content:
To be precise, they were a man and three women. They both closed their eyes and seemed to have passed out in a coma.
There are several fierce murloc guards standing directly in front of the statue, which is very difficult to deal with at first glance.
"Hermione? Ginny?!"
When he saw this picture, Harry couldn't help but exclaimed, and immediately recognized the two hostages **** in the middle of the lake.
"Gabriel!" Furong was even more excited than Harry. She was completely panicked and looked at the picture in the crystal ball anxiously, wishing to jump into the water to drive away the mermaids and save Gabriel.
But such sneaking behavior is not allowed, and the Aurors who are in charge of maintaining order are all staring at her at all times.
In desperation, Furong had to turn her head to look at the referee's bench, and asked anxiously.
"Principal Maxim, why did my sister Gabriel appear there? She is only nine years old this year, how can you bear to throw her into the black lake like this?"
Maxim did not answer, because Dumbledore had already answered.
"Miss Delacour, we have obtained the consent of these girls before. They agreed to become hostages voluntarily. We also trust you warriors to be able to rescue them from the bottom of the lake within the prescribed time limit. ..."
"What if we fail? What will happen to Gabriel?" Furong asked urgently. She did not forget what Bagman said before. Once the time limit is exceeded and the rescue is not successful, then they will be forever. Lost the most cherished "treasure".
"Let's put it this way, the waterproof and cold-proof magic I set on several hostages can only last for an hour!" Dumbledore's expression was very serious, and there was no joking at all.
Furong's heart was completely cold. She didn't want to believe that the competition party would be so cruel, but she didn't dare to bet on this possibility...
Harry on the side was also very flustered. After hearing Dumbledore’s indifferent words, he only felt cold in his hands and feet. Hermione was his best friend, and Ginny was Ron’s sister, no matter which one had a problem. He couldn't accept it.
Harry was worried about whether he could complete the task of rescuing the hostages with his own ability. Those murlocs didn't seem to be so easy to deal with.
In order to avoid being suspected, Ivan's face also showed a somewhat eager look, but his eyes were placed on the strange wizard on the crystal ball screen.
According to the school uniform on the other party, Ivan quickly distinguished that this should be a Durmstrang student, most likely a good friend of Krum.
Thinking of this, Ivan looked at Krum with a shifted gaze, and as expected, the other's face became very ugly.
The competition was so accurate, and did not choose the dance partner Krum invited at the prom.
After all, what they need is a hostage that can shake the faith of the Warriors!
Ivan even guessed that the real test of this game is whether the Warriors can think calmly in such a critical situation and successfully complete the rescue mission.
And Furong’s aggressive performance before, I’m afraid she has lost a lot of points...
In the judges seat, Dumbledore sat down again after the explanation, and Bagman coughed slightly, and walked forward to continue the explanation.
"Well, I think the warriors can't wait any longer! So, now I announce...The second game is officially started!" Bagman shouted, raising his wand and launching a beam of light into the sky.
As the beam exploded, Ivan, Fleur, and Krum quickly jumped into the lake, while Harry took a step slower. He frantically pulled open the bottle containing the gills, making a group like The gray-green mouse's tail stuffed it into his mouth and swallowed it, and then followed the crowd into the lake.
The little wizards in the stands stretched out their necks to see more clearly. Ron and others got up from their seats worrying about the safety of Ginny and Hermione. Unfortunately, the Black Lake is very deep. Can't see anything.
"You said, Ivan and Harry will definitely be able to save people, right?" Ron looked at George and the others next to him worriedly, and asked.
"I think Ivan will do it, but Harry is a little more suspenseful..." George said hesitantly.
With his record in the first game against the Fire Dragon, he is very confident in Ivan, but he knows Harry's magic level very well. If he has to use one sentence to describe it, he is not much better than Ron.
"But in any case, the hostages should be fine." George added, he didn't believe what Dumbledore said before.
"That's not necessarily true. It would be too risky for me to see Professor Dumbledore. Just put all the hostages in the lake without even an Auror to supervise them. In case the mermaids suddenly go crazy or they are protective demon. What should I do if there is something wrong with the curse?" Fred was furious, worried about Ginny's safety.
"Since you can think of it, the referees must be able to think of this too..." George retorted.
"Okay, stop arguing, look over there!" Charlie interrupted the argument and pointed his finger towards the center of the lake.
At this time, George and Ron discovered that the four crystal **** floating in the air were faithfully recording the performance of each warrior under the water.
After jumping into the black lake, Krum quickly used the transformation magic, his head became bigger and bigger, and black fins grew behind his back. It seemed that he wanted to become a shark.
But human transformation is the most difficult of all transformation magic. Krum's level is obviously not up to this level, so he was forced to stop when he was half transformed, becoming a humanoid monster with a shark's head.
The little wizards on the stands showed disgusting expressions. Although this hand of magic looks very powerful, it must be said that Krum's appearance at this time is really ugly.
Harry’s image is not much better than Krum He has ugly gills on his neck, and his palms and toes are similar to those of merfolk.
In contrast, Ivan and Furong are particularly pleasing to the eye.
The first time after falling into the water, Ivan waved his magic wand and touched the wizard robe on his body, adding a waterproof and moisture-proof curse to it, as if there was a transparent film between the water and him.
Then, the black robes on Ivan's body stretched into a pair of wide "wings" in the water, which could drive his body to float far away with just a light wave.
Furong's water is very good, and her speed is even comparable to that of Krum, who has turned into a half shark. She probably relied on this to only impose a head-foaming spell on herself and dived into the water, as if she planned to do so Swim over.
Thanks to book friends dsf23dd for rewarding 8000 starting coins, book friends 20190917071457184 rewarding 4000 starting coins, Pearl Jade rewarded 1100 starting coins, Yu's a little cute rewarding 1000 starting coins, Uesugi Riyas rewarded 100 starting currency.

chapters.title: Chapter 657: Heartless Hals
chapters.content:
At this time, it was the end of February, and the difficulties that the warriors had to face were far more than just facing the Murloc guards. The cold lake water was also consuming their little physical energy all the time.
Realizing this, Harry and Krum swam frantically towards the center of the lake almost as soon as they fell into the water, without daring to delay for a moment.
The scope of this black lake is very large, and one hour is very urgent, not to mention that they have to spend some time to find the location of the murloc village.
Ivan, who was behind, had a relaxed look. He had stepped on it in advance and had been here more than a dozen times. Even with his eyes closed, he could swim to the place where the hostages were held.
But now it’s a competition, so many spectators watched, Ivan was not good at cheating directly, so he waved his magic wand to transform some rocks at the bottom of the lake into fish, pretending to let them be responsible for exploring the way, and waited for about a while. Minutes to start the action.
However, within a few minutes of swimming, Ivan keenly discovered that something seemed to be following him.
At first, Ivan thought it was the group of mermaids in the lake who came to trouble him, but after looking back, I found that it was not right. It was not a mermaid at all, but the warrior of Boothbat-Fleur De Rakul...
Even though the water in the Black Lake was very deep, the visibility was not high, and the opponent was far away, Ivan still easily guessed the identity of the opponent based on his body shape.
"Are you planning to follow me through customs?"
Ivan suddenly understood the other party's plan, couldn't help but smile, wanting to take advantage of him, how easy it is!
Seven meters away from this, Furong was staring at the figure in the distance, struggling to swing his body behind him, not far or near, just hanging from so far.
After seeing the picture in the crystal ball on the lakeshore, Furong was very worried about the safety of her sister Gabriel, but her eagerness did not destroy her sanity.
The Black Lake at Hogwarts was too big, and she had never been here again. Wanting to find the village of mermaid quickly was nothing short of a fantasy, and the guards over there were not so easy to deal with.
So she came up with a bold idea to follow someone who will definitely be able to complete the game, such as Ivan Hals, who shined in the first game and cleared the game with full marks!
Before at Hogwarts, for the purpose of collecting intelligence on opponents, Fleur asked some Ravenclaw girls about their deeds, and the information obtained was shocking enough to refresh her recognition. know!
Especially when she heard that the other party killed a twelve-foot-tall monster when she just entered the first grade, and killed a Defence Against the Dark Arts professor before the end of the class, she almost thought these people were talking about it. A ridiculous and unruly fairy tale.
But the experience of the first match made Furong have to admit that these stories probably happened because the other party did something even more outrageous-defeating a fire dragon head-on!
Because of this, Furong believes that Ivan will definitely be the first warrior to find the location of the mermaid village and successfully rescue the hostages, and he only needs to follow the opponent to successfully pass the level.
It's very easy and safer...
If there is a danger ahead, you don't even need to do it yourself, because the other party will naturally solve it.
The only thing to note is that the Hogwarts warrior may attack himself, after all, this is a game, and they are now rivals!
Furong held the wand tightly, carefully keeping a distance where she could react quickly without being lost.
In this way, Ivan would waste a lot of time if he wanted to subdue himself.
In today's race against time, wasting time is tantamount to giving victory to other warriors.
So she is betting that the other party will not do anything to herself in order to ensure the victory!
Even thinking about it this way, when he noticed that Ivan stopped and looked at him, Furong couldn't help but become nervous.
Fortunately, Ivan's next reaction was just as she had imagined, she didn't mean to do anything, and stopped for a few seconds before moving on.
Furong breathed a sigh of relief and hurriedly followed, with a slight smile on her mouth, very proud of her heart.
But what made her faintly felt that something was wrong was that Ivan was walking towards the deeper part of the Black Lake, and the surroundings were getting darker and darker, the visibility was slowly decreasing, and the field of vision was reduced to less than ten feet, which made her have to draw closer. The distance between Ivan will not be thrown away.
What made Furong more uneasy was that there were some weird sounds faintly coming from the surrounding darkness, and from time to time I could see something surging in the darkness.
"Lumos~ (fluorescence flashing Furong gently waved his wand, the faint blue fluorescence spread in all directions, and saw the hideous and ugly fish faces and the steel forks faintly flashing in their hands.
It's a mermaid!
Furong almost couldn't help but exclaimed, because there were too many of them, and she was not able to contend by herself. She immediately turned her head and wanted to find Ivan's figure-she thought that the only thing she could do right now Ivan was able to escape from here by teaming up.
It's a pity that she was dumbfounded when she turned her head, because Ivan was long gone...
"He must have done it deliberately!" Furong gritted her teeth. She immediately realized that Ivan had deliberately brought herself here, and she might have already run away now.
Ivan's ruthlessness far exceeded her expectations, and she had the heart to leave her here alone. Furong cursed a few words secretly, but there was nothing to do.
After being irradiated by the light, the fish people around, as if they were irritated by some kind of irritation, launched an attack towards Furong, throwing countless black shadows over.
"Impedmenta~ (obstacles Furong waved her magic wand to release an obstacle curse a large number of stones and corals smashed on it and quickly broke it.
Furong quickly blessed herself with the phantom spell, trying to avoid the mermaid's pursuit, but she obviously underestimated the perception ability of these monsters in the lake. This magic was easily seen through, and in desperation she could only Fighting and fleeing to deal with these monsters.
At this moment, Ivan was maintaining the Phantom Body Curse from a distance, watching from the outside, his magic level was much higher than that of Furong, so naturally he would not be discovered whereabouts.
"These mermaids are too embarrassed. When fighting a wizard, they only dared to throw stones from a distance..." Ivan couldn't help but complain in his heart as he looked at the scene in front of him.
I don't know if these mermaids were so embarrassed out of fear of wizards, or because of Dumbledore's previous orders.
Maybe there are both...
After Ivan shook his head, realizing that Furong was not in danger of life, he turned around and plunged into the jungle of black aquatic plants in front of him, with the mermaid village in front.

chapters.title: Chapter 658: I'm just joking, I didn't expect you to come for real.
chapters.content:
After entering the "lake-bottom jungle", the road ahead became difficult, and the visibility around it was reduced to a minimum. You can only see the undulating and tangled black water plants in the lake water. They occupy all the sight. .
While swimming, a dark creature suddenly protruded out of the water weeds in front of him. Its sharp claws stretched out and tried to hook Ivan’s ankles, but before they even touched a dazzling red light, they banged first. Coming over, the sharp claws were blown into two pieces abruptly.
A painful, sharp howl resounded in the black lake, and then the weird creature with long horns on its head and sharp teeth fled to the water grass and disappeared.
"Another one!" Ivan shook his head helplessly, putting away his wand and lazily chasing it.
This green-skinned water monster with horns, Ivan once saw in a book describing underwater magical creatures, named Grindillo.
This kind of magical creature usually likes to lurch in dense aquatic plants. When the prey is passing by, it suddenly protrudes its paws to hook the opponent, and finally drags it into the aquatic plants to enjoy it slowly.
They can be said to be the most dangerous creatures the warriors need to face. After all, they have sharp fangs and teeth, and they are scary with low IQ. They don't know how to be merciful like murlocs.
There were constant troubles along the way. Ivan managed to solve a giant squid that was more than four meters long and stunned two mermaids who were blocking the way, before finally successfully reaching the mermaid village.
There were more and more stone dwellings around. From a distance, Ivan saw the huge mermaid statue, and the four hostages were so firmly tied to the tail of the statue.
The nearby mermaid guards started to move after seeing Ivan approaching. They held up their shiny steel forks in a semi-circular ring around Ivan, and uttered a deterrent roar.
"Stupefy~ (fainted) PetrificusTotalus~ (all petrochemicals
In the face of at least dozens of merfolk, Ivan didn't mean to flinch at all. He quickly waved his wand and turned down several murloc guards holding steel forks.
The stones that fell on him were all resisted by the Iron Armor Curse.
Just when Ivan thought it would be a big battle, he unexpectedly saw that the remaining mermaids showed horrified expressions, screamed and threw their weapons aside, and fled in embarrassment.
This made Ivan very speechless. It seemed that these mermaids had a deeper fear of wizards than he had imagined, and they would run away if the war went unfavorable.
But this also just saved him a little effort.
Ivan didn’t bother with the mermaid they ran away. He swam all the way to the huge statue, ripped off the water weeds that bound Hermione, and then stretched out his wand and nodded on her forehead to relieve Dumbledore’s coma. Curse.
Hermione's closed eyes moved, and they opened after a moment, but the brain was still a little drowsy, and the memory seemed to remain at the moment before falling asleep.
After seeing Ivan, Hermione was impatient to say something, but as soon as she spoke, the lake water poured into her mouth.
Fortunately, Ivan added a bubble curse to her in time to avoid the fate of suffocation.
"Don't worry, Hermione, we still have a lot of time, you can speak slowly..." Ivan gently patted Hermione's back and said softly.
Hermione coughed out the water that was choking in her throat painfully, and then looked around blankly, only to realize that she was now in the deep lake.
"Are we in the Black Lake?" Hermione instantly understood where she was, and looked at Ivan and asked.
"Yes, that's right!" Ivan nodded, then asked again. "Do you remember how you got here? Hermione?"
"Professor McGonagall found me last night and said that the second game was special. The Warriors needed an assistant and asked me if I would like to help. I agreed... and then I didn't know anything." Hermione was a fan. Vaguely explained.
Ivan was not surprised, this was basically the same as he had previously expected.
"Are you playing now? So what should I do?" Hermione quickly regained her senses after her head was dizzy for a while, and she hurriedly asked.
"You don't have to do anything, as long as I take you ashore, the game is over!" Ivan said with a smile, and then saw Hermione still seem a little confused, and continued to remind. "Have you forgotten the tips given in the mermaid's song? The warriors need to find their most cherished treasures at the bottom of the lake!"
Hermione naturally heard the underlying meaning of Ivan's words, her face that had been so pale in the lake water suddenly turned ruddy, she stammered. "So I am..."
"The most cherished treasure of Hogwarts warrior Ivan Hals!" Ivan replied solemnly.
While talking, Ivan also pointed to the giant statue behind. "According to the script, you were kidnapped by those mermaids, so I come here to rescue you now!"
Hermione turned her head and looked over, only to find that a man, two women and three hostages were still held on the statue of the mermaid, one of whom she knew very well.
"Ginny! Is she here too?" Hermione exclaimed.
"Ginny is Harry's "treasure"." Ivan explained, then spoke again. "Well, time is running out now, let's leave now!"
"What about Ginny and the others?" Hermione hesitated for a moment and couldn't help but said.
"That is Harry's task. If I rescue all the hostages, the others will not be able to continue the game..." Ivan has no plan to rescue everyone, because strictly speaking it is a violation of the game. According to the regulations, unless there are warriors who take the initiative to give up the game.
Hermione nodded Although she was still a little worried, she didn't say anything.
Taking into account the limited time, Ivan no longer delays, and directly stretches out his hands around the slender waist of the little witch and hugs her in his arms.
After soaking in the cold water for so long, Hermione's body was cold and frightening. Even knowing that Dumbledore's anti-cold spell was there, Ivan was still a little bit distressed.
Hermione shrank submissively in Ivan's warm arms, greedily drawing heat from him.
After that, Hermione seemed to have thought of something again, hesitated for a while, and finally blushed and quickly kissed Ivan on the side of the cheek.
The warm touch made Ivan lower his head.
And Hermione hid in his arms again like a frightened rabbit, but the trembling voice still reached his ears faithfully.
"According to the script, this is a reward for the warriors!"
Ivan touched his cheek for a while and couldn't laugh or cry. He was just joking just now, but she didn't expect Hermione to be real.

chapters.title: Chapter 659: Miserable warriors
chapters.content:
You know, it's live broadcast now...
Ivan looked at the little witch in his arms with a weird face, and didn't know how Hermione would react when she saw those crystal **** after she went ashore.
The thoughts in his brain kept flashing, and Ivan was not idle for a moment. He gently waved his wand on the wizard's robe, and the robe once again transformed into a black "wing" shape. It rushes in the direction where it came.
Passing through the mermaid village, Ivan re-enters the dangerous jungle at the bottom of the lake.
Since I had been inking with Hermione in front of the mermaid statue for a long time, half of the one-hour game time limit had passed.
But what surprised Ivan was that he hadn't been able to see the other warriors on the way back.
Are you lost? Or is it that you have withdrawn from the game?
Ivan frowned.
Don’t look at him a few days ago, he fooled the mermaids, ordered them to arrange the venue, and harassed the participating warriors as much as possible, but in Ivan’s view, these mermaids were too timid, and they were horrified after two fights. So the difficulty of the whole game is not high.
Compared with the original time and space, the change is nothing more than that the mermaid will actively attack the warriors in groups, there are more than a dozen Grindillos ambushing in the aquatic jungle, and occasionally encounter some wandering giant squids.
They are all non-magical creatures. As long as the warriors hold the wands in their hands and can deal with them calmly, it should be no problem to expel them.
"Halse!"
When Ivan was thinking about it, a faint voice suddenly reached his ears, and he subconsciously looked down at Hermione.
The little witch shook her head, pointed her finger at the aquatic grass behind her side, indicating that the sound was coming from there.
Ivan squeezed the wand tightly, thinking about whether he should go there, because it was probably a trap.
Such places with dense water and grass are the most suitable for sneak attacks, and he is now the first warrior to rescue the hostages, maybe there will be warriors hiding here to ambush him in order to win the championship.
During this delay, the shouting voice has become weaker and weaker, even to the point where it is inaudible.
"Let's take a look, Ivan... Maybe someone is in trouble." Hermione gently pulled the corner of Raivan's clothes and whispered.
Ivan hesitated for a moment, and nodded out of confidence in his own strength. After blessing Hermione with an iron armor curse, he leaned over and released a lighting magic with his wand held high.
The faint blue fluorescence gradually dissipated the surrounding darkness, and the scene ahead far exceeded the two's expectations.
"Furong?"
Hermione was very surprised to see the Boothbarton Warrior who fell into a coma in front of her. A large number of black water plants were twisting and entangled tied to Furong's body, binding her firmly, and the bare arms and waist were still faintly I could see a few bruises, as if they had been smashed out by something.
Ivan could easily see that this should be a trap set by the mermaids...
He guessed that Furong suffered some injuries when she got rid of the mermaid chase, and just happily slammed into this trap, which caused him to fail to break free at the first time. The water plants became tighter and tighter, and finally exhausted all his energy and coma. Past.
Hermione looked at Fleur who was in a coma, then turned to Ivan, and stopped talking.
She wanted to speak out and plead with Ivan to save the opponent, but she also knew that they were opponents in the game now, and Ivan didn't have any need to help each other, so it would be good if she didn't fall into trouble.
Hermione struggled for a while, but couldn't help but ask. "Will you save her? Ivan?"
"Save!" Ivan didn't hesitate much. Furong, who had passed out of a coma, no longer had the possibility of competing with him.
What's more, it's still live streaming, and saving Furong is likely to add impression points. If you don't save it, the students and referees who watched this scene off the court will most likely mistake them for being very cold-blooded.
"Diffindo~ (torn apart
As soon as he thought of it, Ivan waved his magic wand decisively to cut off the water weeds that bound Hibiscus, and then used the healing spell to help her heal her wounds, so as to prevent Hibiscus from bleeding too much and dying on the way.
But what was beyond Ivan's expectation was that as he approached him to heal his injuries, Furong's closed eyes suddenly opened and grabbed his arm.
Ivan's reaction was not unpleasant, and the wand had reached Furong's neck in just an instant, and the front end was faintly shining with red light.
The chill deep into the bone marrow made Furong feel the taste of death approaching, but despite her disregard, she still clung to Ivan's arm tightly, begging.
"Please help... Hals! I can give up this game, please, help me save Gabriel... She can't stay here..."
Furong's face was pale and a little scary, and she kept crying weakly and weakly, her face no longer the previous arrogance, full of humbleness and powerlessness.
Listening to Fleur's words, Ivan was speechless. After a little thought, I should know that it is impossible for the Ministry of Magic and Dumbledore to sit back and watch the hostages happen. Only the warriors are in danger.
It's a pity that Ivan didn't have time to explain, and Furong, who was holding on, was in a coma again. Only one of his hands was still holding his arm tightly and couldn't shake it off.
"It's really troublesome, I would leave her alone if I knew it..." Ivan sighed and muttered softly.
On the side, Hermione looked at Furong's deep pleading, somewhat unbearable. After thinking about it, she turned her head to look at Ivan and suggested.
"Or let's help her... Now there is still some time before the end of the game. The other Warriors have not arrived yet. Even if we go back to save Gabriel now, we will definitely be the first to complete the gameHow easy is it..." Ivan shook his head, plus Gabriel, he was about to take three people back, which would greatly slow down his forward speed.
Just as Ivan was thinking about it, there was another noise from the black water grass in front of him, and Ivan subconsciously waved his wand to point there.
After a while, Harry's head came out of the water weeds. His condition didn't look very good. There were a few small cuts in his arms and thighs, and his clothes were tattered.
The most striking thing was that Harry was carrying Krum, who had become half-human and half-shark on his back.
The other party seemed to have fainted like Fleur, even if Harry knocked Krum's head accidentally, he didn't mean to wake up.
"Harry, what are you doing behind Krum?" Ivan looked at him very surprised.
"He fainted with those mermaids. I can't leave him there alone." Harry panted hard, and the water kept pouring in from his mouth, and then followed the neck. The cheeks are excreted from the body.

chapters.title: Chapter 660: Dumbledore with a headache
chapters.content:
Looking at Harry who was so kind, Ivan didn't know what to say.
Saving Fleur by himself was only easy on the way back, but Harry was different. He could be regarded as actively assisting his opponent, even if he did not hesitate to delay the game.
No wonder I came here so late...
"Even if you don't care about Krum, the Aurors will come to rescue him soon!" Ivan reminded him.
"Is that so? Professor Dumbledore never said this..." Harry looked embarrassed. He didn't think so much at the time, only that he couldn't leave Krum alone in the lake.
"By the way, what happened to Fleur? Was she also attacked by a mermaid?" Harry's gaze quickly turned to the Boothbarton warrior.
"She was caught in a trap and passed out!"
Ivan briefly explained, and then exchanged information with Harry's, only then did he understand what was happening on the other side.
Not long after the start of the game, Harry and Krum, who had taken the first step, were besieged by a large group of mermaids.
Due to his weaker strength, Harry only dared to swing his wand to counterattack defensively, while Krum relied on his powerful combat power in a deformed state to fight the mermaids in close hands, wanting to break through.
At the beginning, it went smoothly, until Krum severely injured a few merfolk, those monsters became irritable, took turns to attack in groups, and knocked Krum unconscious on the spot.
"They stunned Krum and left. I don't know why those merfolk let me go..." Harry said in a daze. He just waved his wand and put some magic on the mermaids that surrounded him. They fled in horror.
Looking at Krum, who was scarred on Harry's back, Ivan's eyes were full of pity.
Due to Dumbledore’s orders, as long as the warriors did not deliberately anger the merfolk, these lake creatures would have no guts to attack too hard.
Coupled with the mermaid's fear of magic, Ivan doesn't even regard them as a threat.
It's a pity that Krum clearly doesn't know this. It's strange that he wants to be strong in front of him with his excellent transformation magic and not be beaten up.
Ivan suddenly found that he seemed to have overestimated the strength and on-the-spot adaptability of Fleur and Krum.
He went to talk to those mermaids before, to increase the difficulty of the second game, just thinking about adding a little trouble to Krum and slowing down the opponent's rescue of the hostages.
But I didn't expect it to be such a result...
Ivan glanced at Harry, who was wounded on his body, and then at Fleur and Krum who had passed out. The corners of his mouth twitched, each of them was too miserable...
"Ivan, what should we do next?" Harry asked. He had gone through a big battle before and swam so far with Krum on his back. His physical strength has been exhausted.
"What else can I do? Of course it is to bring them and the hostages together. Time should not be too late..." Ivan said helplessly.
...
Half an hour ago, over the Black Lake, five huge crystal **** were faithfully presenting the scenes at the bottom of the lake to everyone.
Ugly-looking mermaid holding a steel fork, Grindillo lurking in the jungle of aquatic plants waiting for an opportunity, a giant squid that is 15 feet long...Every thrilling scene makes the little wizards present sweat for the warriors. .
And watching Maxim on the judges' bench was also fidgeting, her eyes were staring at one of the crystal balls, watching Furong's every move.
At first, Maxim was still a little dissatisfied when she saw Fleur following behind Ivan and planning to pass the level like this. She thought that such a move by Fleur would make Bussbarton lose face.
But when he saw Furong being trapped by Ivan and besieged by a large group of mermaids, Maxim couldn't take care of so much. Her expression suddenly became tense. She turned her head hurriedly and questioned.
"Principal Dumbledore, will this game be too dangerous for the Warriors? You haven't told me that the mermaids at the bottom of the lake will attack the participating Warriors!"
Facing Maxim's doubts, Dumbledore seemed very calm, and he did not rush to explain. "Please rest assured, Ms. Maxim... If you pay close attention to it, you will find that the mermaids are very measured and won't really hurt Miss Furong..."
Maxim looked back suspiciously, and noticed that Furong had persisted in the siege of many merfolk, but only suffered some bruises, which made him a little relieved.
Dumbledore looked at this scene distractedly, and felt a little strange in his heart. According to the agreement between himself and the merfolk, it shouldn't be possible for a mermaid to attack the warrior.
Before Dumbledore could think clearly, Karkaroff suddenly jumped up angrily. He stared at the picture in one of the crystal balls, and scolded angrily.
"What the **** is going on? Dumbledore, you need to explain to all of us that those **** merfolk stunned Krum! According to the regulations, their task should be to protect the hostages and the warriors!"
Several referees around also turned their heads and stared at Dumbledore, waiting for his reply-the communication with the mermaids has always been Dumbledore's sole responsibility.
Regarding this Dumbledore has a headache. Of course, he also saw the mermaid in the picture and was knocked out of Krum, and he couldn't help but suspect that the mermaid might have misunderstood the meaning of his words.
But facing the questioning gaze of Maxim and Karkaroff, Dumbledore would naturally not take the initiative to hand out his handle. After a moment of indulging, he replied with ease.
"Everyone, I think there is nothing wrong with the regulations of the second game! The mermaids abide by the agreement with me and do not take the initiative to cause harm to the Warriors, but it does not mean that they cannot interfere with the rescue operations of the Warriors. This is also the game. One ring!"
"But they stunned Krum now, making him unable to play. This is what you said that the mermaid didn't take the initiative to cause harm to the Warriors?" Karkaroff yelled grumpily.
"Yes!" Dumbledore nodded, and continued before Karkaroff cursed. "We all know it was Mr. Krum who angered the mermaids first, didn't we? They fought back because of helplessness."
"In addition, you may have noticed that the mermaids are extremely afraid of the magic of wizards, and the warriors can easily dispel them as long as they lift up their wands and release a few deterrent spells. This is a good test, isn't it? I? I had hoped that all the warriors would discover this the first time!"

chapters.title: Chapter 661: This is the original intention of the top three competition, isn't it?
chapters.content:
After Dumbledore finished speaking, Crouch also added.
"Yes, the difficulty of the three finals is determined by the average level of the Warriors. If it is lowered, for Mr. Hals, this game will not have any challenge."
The two sang and got together, making Maksim and Karkaroff angry enough.
But they are not easy to refute, because the four warriors in the competition have all been attacked by mermaids, and everyone is treated the same...
Moreover, Krum was stunned by a group of merfolk, it was pure recklessness. Fleur and Harry, who had the same encounter with him, quickly got rid of the pursuit of a large number of merfolk by magic.
In contrast, Ivan’s performance is even more eye-catching.
On the way to the mermaid village, Ivan encountered only a lot more troubles than the other warriors.
But whether facing the sudden emergence of Grindillo or the huge giant squid, Ivan can always deal with calmly, easily solve these problems, and received a lot of praise and applause.
So in the next few minutes, Karkaroff's face has been very ugly.
Maxim wasn't much better either, especially when he saw Furong just got rid of the mermaid pursuit and hit the trap again, his entire face went black, both angry and a little distressed.
The happiest person on the court was Bagman, and he almost laughed on the spot as Ivan watched the troubles and troubles of the other warriors.
He seemed to see countless Jin Jialong beckoning to him, and Bagman even secretly regretted not buying more when he made a bet.
Dumbledore was also in a very good mood, but he took care of the emotions of Karkaroff and others. He did not express this kind of pleasure. He still frowned and looked worried about the recent situation of the Warriors.
After such a delay, Furong's situation at the bottom of the lake has become worse and worse.
She was unable to break free from the trap for the first time, and her hands and feet were **** by the entangled black waterweeds, and she was unable to escape. The harder she struggles, the tighter her body becomes entangled...
The students in the audience watching this scene were all worried, and some little witches couldn't bear to turn their heads and didn't want to watch this cruel scene.
Maxim felt even more entangled in his heart, and immediately lost face, turned his head to look at Dumbledore, and pleaded.
"Principal Dumbledore, you have won this game at Hogwarts. Please send the guard Aurors as soon as possible to bring back our Warriors and hostages from Boothbarton."
"And Krum, you have to bring him up too!" Karkaroff also hurriedly added.
Although Krum was stunned by the mermaid and was always carried on his back by Harry, there is no need to worry about safety, but if Krum completes the game in this way, Durmstrang will undoubtedly lose face.
Karkaroff has not dared to think about how the front page headline of the Daily Prophet will describe this game. He has only one idea now, and that is to immediately rush down and get this shameful thing up!
"No hurry... if the Auror is dispatched now, it may interfere with the flow of the other Warriors." Dumbledore shook his head and rejected their proposal.
Maxim stared at Dumbledore angrily.
In her opinion, Dumbledore deliberately wanted to see the warriors of Boothbatten and Durmstrang ashamed.
After all, this game has become an internal fight for the Hogwarts Warriors, and Ivan has performed extremely prominently. Winning or losing is already clear. Sending Auror to intervene to save the wounded will not have any impact on the game.
"Please be more patient, Ms. Maxim, I always think that winning or losing is not the whole of this game..." How could Dumbledore fail to see what Maxim was thinking in his heart, he said to comfort him, and said Beckon the other party to take a look at the crystal ball on the far right.
Maxim sneered at Dumbledore's ridiculous remarks, but he followed the direction and found that the situation on the court had changed again.
Ivan, who had been in the lead and had successfully rescued the hostages, stopped and rescued the trapped Furong. Then, at Furong's request, he was hesitant to return to save Gabriel.
Harry on the other side also continued to play with Krum abruptly, even if he encountered a few mermaids on the way, he didn't mean to leave Krum behind.
"This is the original intention of the Triwizard Tournament, isn't it?" Dumbledore said with emotion as he watched the scenes in the crystal ball.
The purpose of the establishment of the Triwizard Tournament was to promote friendly exchanges among the three major magic schools in Europe, but as time goes by, I don't know when this tournament has gradually evolved into a competition that can be unscrupulous in order to become famous and win.
In more than seven hundred years of competition, there are many warriors who choose to "accidentally" kill their opponents in the competition.
Even the principals of the major schools would play tricks secretly in order to compete for the name of Europe's first magic school, so that cheating has become a tradition in the game.
It can be said that the extremely high mortality rate of the Triwizard Tournament is inseparable from this bad competition atmosphere.
This also made the competition originally held for the purpose of enhancing exchanges, but in the end the gap between the three magic schools became deeper and deeper, until the conflict broke out and the exchange broke off, which had to make people feel sorry.
Today, Ivan and Harry's assistance to their opponents in the game is very rare.
Looking at the scenes presented in the crystal ball, Karkaroff and Maksim fell into a long silence I think, friendship games like this should continue, right? Dumbledore turned his head to look at the two of them, and asked.
"Well, next time we host the top three, we Busbarton will consider participating." Maksim hesitated for a moment, or let go.
Karkaroff didn't give face at all, and said sarcastically. "The premise is that Hogwarts won't suddenly have two warriors!"
Dumbledore was startled, and then smiled bitterly. This situation was also not what he wanted to see.
But Dumbledore knew very well that no matter how he explained it, Karkaroff and Maxim would not believe it.
"Well, a few, you can put the time for small talk later! We should prepare in advance, the warriors will be back soon!" Crouch interrupted the conversation of the three principals.
Dumbledore nodded and nodded. He waved his wand and turned into several thick blankets and stretchers. He also ordered the prefect of Ravenclaw to call in Madam Pomfrey, who was on standby in the tent, so that he could give him immediately The injured warriors were treated.

chapters.title: Chapter 662: You thanked the wrong person, Miss Delacour!
chapters.content:
Standing in front of the stage, Bagman stared at the crystal ball on the right, and shouted loudly when Ivan crossed the water.
"The first one to come up is Ivan Hals, the warrior of Hogwarts! Let us cheer for him!"
Accompanied by Bagman's shout, thunderous applause suddenly sounded around the stands. Everyone stood up, shouting Ivan's name in unison, and the atmosphere on the court was extremely warm.
Under the attention of everyone, a few ripples suddenly appeared on the calm lake, and then the water flow was lifted up like it was affected by some force. Ivan took the opportunity to swing the double "wings" formed by his robe, and struggling to jump from the water Rise and fall to the shore of the lake.
"Oh, let us see, our warrior didn't seem to bring up his hostages. What he held in his arms turned out to be the warrior Miss Fleur of Busbarton! God, this is really amazing!" German yelled.
Ivan glared at Bagman, then handed the Fleur in his arms to the waiting Madam Pomfrey, and then went to the lake to pull Gabriel up, and finally Hermione...
The reason for choosing this order is naturally because Fleur has been in a coma and Gabriel is too young. It is always difficult for him to pull Hermione up first and leave the two sisters Veeva below, right?
"Ivan, do we really have no problem regardless of Harry and Krum?" After getting ashore, Hermione looked at the Black Lake and asked with some worry.
"Don't worry, they will swim up!" Ivan said comfortingly, and then pointed to the crystal ball floating above. "Nuo, see for yourself!"
Hermione raised her head curiously, and saw five huge crystal **** floating above the Black Lake, faithfully recording everything that happened at the bottom of the lake. The status quo of Harry, Ginny, and Krum can be seen. Clearly.
But at this time, Hermione was no longer in the mood to care about other people's affairs. All she was thinking about was the scene when she kissed Ivan at the bottom of the lake. She turned her face very stiffly and stammered.
"So, everyone can always see what we are doing?"
"Ah, is that right?" Ivan scratched his head and said with a guilty conscience.
"Then why didn't you tell me before?" Hermione's face was burning red, and she hammered Ivan in the chest angrily.
At the thought that the scene of kissing Ivan would be seen by the whole school, Hermione was ashamed, wishing to drown in the black lake!
"I didn't expect you to come over suddenly." Ivan spread his hands helplessly, can't you blame him for this?
Hermione stared at Ivan angrily, her eyes as sharp as a blade, but helpless.
While the two were chatting, there was movement on the calm lake again. Not far from the shore, two heads suddenly appeared from the bottom of the lake.
Harry was breathing the outside air with a big mouth. After staying underwater for so long, the duration of the saccharomyces chinensis had already passed. His wateriness was amazingly bad, and it was really not easy to swim all the way back!
Fortunately, Ginny, who was on the side, was also good at swimming, and the two of them swam to the shore while supporting each other, and were finally pulled up by Ivan and Hermione.
Even worse than them is Krum, he was carried to the shore by his own hostage!
When seeing this scene, Karkaroff on the judges seat almost fainted on the spot.
"Gabri...Gabri!" Fleur woke up after being taken care of by Madam Pomfrey. She looked around the audience in a panic, ignoring even the wrapped blanket fell on the ground.
It wasn't until she saw her sister standing on the shore of the lake that Furong's tight emotions eased a little, and she moved forward and hugged her.
"Great, you're fine, that's great! I thought... I thought..."
Furong hugged Gabriel tightly, her emotions were a little out of control, and she kept shouting, but Gabriel, who was only eight or nine years old this year, was like her sister, comforting Furong gently and calming her emotions.
Seeing this scene of the sisters' affection, Ivan was also deeply moved.
Except for himself, I am afraid that the other warriors have taken the words in the golden egg seriously, mistakenly thinking that after the time limit, their most cherished people will be buried deep in the bottom of the lake.
Of course, this is not to say that the selected warriors have too low IQ, but that the organizer has grasped their psychology and suddenly broke the news on the field. There is no time for everyone to think, and no The Warriors dare to bet on the person they care about the most.
Ivan wondered if he didn't know the plot, and suddenly heard that these people had thrown Hermione into the Black Lake, and he was only willing to give himself an hour of rescue time, I'm afraid he would be panicked.
After being warm with Gabriel for a while, Furong turned her eyes to Ivan, her eyes full of gratitude.
"Thank you, Hals!" Furong enthusiastically hugged Ivan and said gratefully.
Although Ivan led her to the mermaid school when she was at the bottom of the lake, Furong did not hate it.
After all, they were opponents at that time, and Ivan would be merciful without directly attacking her.
It is precisely because of this that Ivan was able to accept his request when he was about to finish the game and turned back to save Gabriel, which moved Fleur.
However, Ivan didn't appreciate it at all, because he deeply felt the chill that was rising behind him, and hurriedly broke free of Furong's hug, did not give her a chance to kiss him at all, then shook his head and said coldly.
"No, you thanked the wrong person, Miss Delacour!"
Furong looked at Ivan at a loss and didn't quite understand what he meant.
"It was Hermione who suggested that I save you. You should thank her instead!" Ivan pointed to Hermione who was standing by and explained.
