Hermione did not expect that Ivan would give herself the credit for saving Furong and Gabriel, and waved her hand to say something, but Furong had already embraced it enthusiastically at this time, followed by a lot of thankful words. , Made Hermione a little embarrassed.
"Why are you lying to my sister?" Gabriel looked at Ivan curiously. She was awakened by Ivan when she was at the bottom of the lake, so she naturally understood more.
Ivan squatted down, stared at the small girl, and said half jokingly. "I didn't lie to her. If Hermione hadn't insisted on asking me to save you, maybe I would have chosen to leave you in the Black Lake forever and keep company with those ugly mermaids!"
However, Gabriel smiled. She didn't believe Ivan's words at all. She gave Ivan a hug like Lotus, and kissed Ivan's side face again.
"This is what my sister owes you!" Gabriel said with a smile.
Ivan reluctantly reached out and knocked on Gabrielle’s small head, and looked at Hermione subconsciously. Seeing Hermione’s face as usual, she knew that she would not eat the jealousy of an eight-year-old girl. Relieved.

chapters.title: Chapter 663: Scoring and tearful hibiscus
chapters.content:
As the four warriors returned one by one, several judges in the audience also got together and discussed. After about five minutes of arguing, Bagman, as the commentator, walked to the front of the stage and cleared his throat. Opened his mouth and said.
"Ladies and gentlemen, after careful review by the judges, we will announce the final score of each Warrior..."
"The first is Mr. Viktor Krum, who has overcome the problem of underwater breathing with incomplete polymorphism.
But it is a pity that Mr. Krum was stunned by the mermaid after the start of the game and failed to complete the rescue mission, so I can only give Mr. Krum a one point! "
As he said, Bagman shot a beam of light into the air, which exploded after a while, and the shining "one" on it was very eye-catching.
Crouch, Dumbledore, and Maxim next to him weren't as awesome as Bagman did. Instead, they gave a friendship point-four points!
Karkaroff's face was dark and scary, but he quickly raised the sign-seven points!
"This is cheating!" Hermione scolded angrily.
Not only her, but other students on the field have spoken out and accused Karkaroff of shameless cheating.
Even several referees frowned.
"I think Krum's transfiguration technique is very superb, far beyond the level of his peers! Although he was stunned by a large number of mermaids during the game, it was just an accident and it does not mean that we should Obliterate his efforts!" Karkaroff defended Krum brazenly, turning a deaf ear to everyone's doubts, just as he hadn't heard.
Considering that Krum’s score was already low, Bagman didn’t bother to argue with Karkaroff, and directly announced Krum’s final score-a total of 20 points.
Then, Bagman looked at Furong again and began to introduce her experience in the game. "Okay, next is the warrior Fleur Delacour of Boothbarton! She showed us her excellent use of the Bubble Head Curse in the game and successfully got rid of the pursuit of the mermaid..."
"Wait, Mr. Bagman!" Fleur suddenly interrupted Bagman's words.
"What's the matter? Do you have anything to say? Ms. Delacour?" Bagman looked at her in surprise.
Furong took a deep breath, turned to look at Ivan, and said in a hoarse voice. "I think you might not have noticed. I had promised Mr. Ivan Hals to give up the second game when I was at the bottom of the lake. You don't need to score for me."
Bagman's brows wrinkled. He was the first time he encountered such a situation. He didn't know how to reply for a while, so he discussed with Dumbledore and others in a low voice.
The little wizards sitting in the audience were also talking quietly.
Especially the students of Boothbarton stared at Furong with dissatisfaction. They believed that Furong took the initiative to abandon the second game without considering the consequences, which would make Bussbarton's face lost and completely lost the chance to win the championship!
Faced with all kinds of doubts and swearing voices, Furong pursed her lips, her expression a little dim, but she still insisted on her own ideas.
Ivan, who had finally gotten rid of Gabrielle, was also looking at Furong. He didn't expect that the other party would be able to keep the promise and take the initiative to request the cancellation of the score evaluation.
But this pot Ivan didn't recite it. He didn't want an extra report in the Daily Prophet tomorrow, saying that he took advantage of the danger to rescue Gabriel and forced Fleur to retire, so he said loudly.
"Miss Delacour, I am afraid you have forgotten a little bit. I have never agreed to your request, so strictly speaking it is not counted. You did not give up the game!"
"Also, if you have to score zero, what should Mr. Krum do? Doesn't he have to be the same as you? So even if you don't mind, you have to take into account Mr. Krum's feelings? "Ivan talked freely, and motioned Furong to look at Krum, who had been in a coma until now.
Ivan's words were beyond the expectations of everyone present. The entire paddock fell into a brief silence. After a while, more and more people clapped and applauded Ivan's tolerance and generosity.
Only the students of Durmstrang looked ugly-they always felt that Ivan was taking the opportunity to discredit Krum.
"Mr. Hals was right. Several principals also agreed that the difficulty of the game was too high. Even the warriors who failed to complete the game had a very good performance, so we are still willing to help Dracour Ladies' performance on the field is scored!" Bagman said with a smile.
"In addition, one thing I need to emphasize is that the Goblet of Fire does not allow the Warriors to abandon the game! No matter what happens, you must continue the game to the end!" Dumbledore also looked at Fleur seriously at this time. , Said with that Hong Zhong-like voice.
Dumbledore's words undoubtedly completely rejected the possibility of Fleur's retirement, and the next step entered the normal scoring link.
Since Fleur stayed underwater longer than Krum, and had some wonderful performances when dealing with mermaids, the score was actually higher than Krum, totaling 27 points!
"Thank you...thank you!" Furong said excitedly. She looked at the judges in the stands, and then at Ivan, tears could not stop flowing down.
Bagman did not wait for Fleur to calm down, but proceeded to announce Harry's score.
As the only Warrior who cleared the game twice, Harry's score should have been not low.
But when he came back with Ginny, it was already overtime. The second half of the game relied on Ivan to get through the dangerous aquatic jungle and Mermaid Square. Karkaroff grasped these two abrupt generals. Harry's score was reduced to thirty-nine.
When Bagman announced the scores, Hermione, Ron and others in the audience looked very angry They thought that Harry should get more than forty points!
But Harry himself feels very satisfied, because his points are more than ten points higher than Fleur and Krum!
"Finally, let us reveal the final score of Warrior Ivan Hals!" Bagman smashed his mouth, pointed his finger at Ivan on the shore of the lake, and continued impassionedly.
"Mr. Hals completed the game perfectly. It took 57 minutes and 37 seconds, and saved Miss Delacour and her hostage Gabriel. He showed us his noble morals. Demeanor!"
"After discussion, the judges agreed that Mr. Hals's performance was impeccable, and the final score was fifty points!"
Bagman shouted hoarsely, because he was worried about Karkaroff's trouble, he did not give the judges a chance to vote this time, but directly announced that Ivan passed the customs with full marks!

chapters.title: Chapter 664: Fusion of the fourth bloodline!
chapters.content:
As soon as Bagman’s voice fell, thunderous applause erupted from the audience, and the little wizards of Gryffindor rushed down from the paddock with excitement, gathered beside Ivan and raised him high. Lifting it up and throwing it into the air...
For a while, the lake shore was full of cheerful atmosphere...
Bagman looked at this scene with a smile, but Karkaroff on the judges seat behind him was very dissatisfied. He looked at Bagman and reprimanded him in a strange tone.
"Mr. Bagman, I remember that there is no provision in the game regulations that the commentator can make judgments on behalf of the referees. This is an extremely serious violation!"
"Ah, this is indeed my negligence..." Bagman patted his head, looking a little annoyed.
But he didn't even look at Karkaroff at all, but turned his head and said to the remaining referees. "But I think you should have no objection to the result of this judgment, right?"
Dumbledore said nothing, with a slight smile on his face, but Crouch next to him was the first to speak.
"Hals's performance on the court is obvious to all. I think it is not necessary to let him pass the level with a perfect score, and the Warriors' final score has now been announced, and there is no need to change it."
"As for Mr. Bagman's act of judging on my behalf..."
Crouch hesitated.
"It should be just a moment of excitement!" Dumbledore said lightly, taking the subject initiatively.
"Yes, that's right, that's it!!" Bagman nodded repeatedly, as if he was really just too excited and yelled out.
Karkaroff couldn’t understand that the three of them were in collusion, and he was immediately so angry that he could not set off any storms by himself, so Karkaroff hurriedly turned his head and planned to seek Maxi. My support.
It is a pity that Maxim considered that Ivan saved Fleur in the second game and spoke specifically for Fleur just now, which is somewhat of maintaining Busbarton's reputation, so he bluntly rejected Karkaroff's proposal.
"Okay, you are fine!" Karkaroff stared at Maxim with hatred of iron and steel, and gnashing his sleeves and left...
At the same time, the center of the field.
Ivan was dealing with the overly enthusiastic little lions with a headache, and after persuading them for a long time, did they persuade them to stop playing that kind of elevated game.
Then, Ivan took the time to look at the system’s taskbar. As he had predicted before, the task of [Familiar Enthusiast] has been successfully completed, and even exceeded a lot, but unfortunately there is no bonus bonus. It is the two legendary points.
But after receiving the reward, Ivan was still very happy, because the legendary value he possessed once again made up five points.
This means that he can start the fourth blood fusion ceremony today, thereby greatly improving his strength.
This is undoubtedly great news for Ivan, who has been worried about Voldemort's resurrection...
...
The hustle and bustle of the game lasted the whole morning, and it was not until the little lions who had made enough noise dispersed that Ivan was able to relax a bit and return to the castle with Harry and others.
After having lunch in a hurry, Ivan did not go to Gryffindor’s lounge as usual to relax, but went to the paddock of the Forbidden Forest without stopping, taking a big tube of blood while Norbert was taking a nap. Go away before being found.
Listening to the faint roar of the dragon in the forbidden forest in the distance, Ivan who stepped into the castle again satisfactorily checked his gains.
【Magic Item: Dragon Blood
Activity: high
Explanation: This is the blood extracted from the female Norwegian Ridgeback, which contains rich magic power...]
Seeing the description in the inventory, Ivan was somewhat relieved. He had been worried about whether Norbert would affect the effect of the dragon's blood when he was not an adult, but now it seems that it should not be enough.
After putting the bottle containing the dragon blood in his hand, Yifan walked all the way to the responsive room on the eighth floor. He had prepared the corresponding blood fusion potion a few days ago and is expected to complete it today.
"I need to enter my own room!" Yifan walked back and forth in front of the carpet three times, silently muttering in his heart.
After a while, a gorgeous door appeared on the wall out of thin air.
Ivan pushed the door and walked in. In front of him was an unusually wide field. The inner potion room, alchemy room and battle dummy were all available, and the surrounding walls were full of bookshelves, so he can check it out when he needs it. Related books.
The reason for putting everything together is to guard against Barty Crouch Jr. invaded by the House of Requirement.
He arranged a lot of protective magic in this room. As long as he detects the entry of unfamiliar magic power, he will immediately attack it and destroy the blood fusion potion that is being brewed to prevent the leakage of important formulas.
Fortunately, everything seems to be business as usual inside, and there is no trace of being invaded.
The cauldron placed in the potion room was bubbling with bubbles. Ivan leaned in and took a look. The liquid in the cauldron had become a pure transparent color, which meant that he came at the right time to make work. Already almost completed, just the last step.
Ivan didn’t hesitate anymore. He took out the bottle with dragon blood and poured it directly down. With the inflow of blood, the colorless and transparent potion was gradually infested into crimson, rolling in the cauldron, like it was The same as scorching magma.
"Don't drink like magma..." Yifan murmured secretly, recalling the painful experience of drinking the blood fusion potion.
After the boil is over, can I still drink it?
It's done!
Ivan frowned and picked up the whole cauldron, grunting and pouring it down as soon as he gritted his teeth!
The crimson liquid tasted like heated viscous syrup, but it didn't have the slightest sweetness, but rather jerky.
After swallowing down the throat into the stomach, UU reads www.uukanshu. Com's whole body was as if burned by fire, his bones creaked, and the magic power that had stayed honestly in his body slowly became agitated.
Ivan endured this uncomfortable feeling, and did not immediately exchange the protection mode of the system, but tried to use his own will to calm those who became irritable.
This is not the first time Ivan has done this. The previous hemolysis has accumulated a lot of relevant experience for him, which is why he dared to take the risk to exercise himself.
It was quite effective at first, and Ivan reluctantly calmed down the magic of restlessness.
But after just ten seconds, Ivan found that the situation in his body became worse and worse. The rapidly increasing magic power broke the original balance. The power belonging to the fire dragon rushed across his body, and also drove the "indigenous people there". "We woke up...

chapters.title: Chapter 665: Fusion of dragon blood and horned snorer
chapters.content:
The unicorn's neighing sounded first, and it contended with the new strength in the body, and then the cold magic power of the basilisk also joined the battlefield from his eyes all the way down, slowly evolving into a three-way battle.
Almost, Ivan thought that his own was about to explode!
But this was only the beginning. Soon, Ivan realized that his body was slowly beginning to deform.
The out-of-control situation instantly made Ivan understand that the blood pulse problem can never be solved by willpower!
Turn on protection mode!
Ivan yelled in his head as quickly as possible.
At this time, the magic power in the body was already surging like a wave. Fortunately, with the intervention of system power, the turbulent "wave" slowly calmed down and became more and more docile. Only the magic power brought by those bloodlines was still uncontrollable.
Especially the new magical power, not only tyrannical but also very aggressive. After Ivan suppressed the power of the other magical creatures, it quickly penetrated into every part of the body, and the sudden tingling sensation continued to be transmitted from everywhere. brain.
Correspondingly, the rapid growth of magic power, almost condensed into substance, is rapidly spreading from Ivan's body. The nearest mahogany table vibrated faintly, and cracks burst one after another on the desktop. ...
And the deformation of appearance is still continuing.
Ivan suddenly felt a little flustered, he thought at first that this change came from Bogut's magic.
But in the protection mode, Ivan can clearly see that Bogut’s magic power is staying in the original place without participating in the battle during the whole process, which means that the culprit of this body shape change is he just acquired. The power of the fire dragon!
Ivan didn't dare to relax, hurriedly raised his hand and took a look, then he was shocked to find that his arm was covered with a layer of red dragon scales, which looked exactly like the scales on Norbert's back, but shrunk by a factor of ten.
Am I going to become a half-dragon?
Ivan was taken aback immediately.
After careful observation for a while, Ivan quickly discovered that these dragon scales did not grow out of his own body, but a manifestation of magical power, that is, I don't know whether the protection ability can be compared with the real dragon scales.
With such a distraction, the magic in his body became restless again, and Ivan hurriedly reduced his mind and focused all his energy on stopping the magic riot.
After about a few dozen seconds, the growth rate of magic power gradually slowed down, and at the same time, he also noticed that the "dragon scales" on his arms were gradually fading, becoming transparent until disappeared.
Everything is back to normal again.
Ivan understands that the fourth blood fusion ceremony has been successful, but he has no time to check his own gains, because there is still a full twenty seconds before the end of the protection mode!
This is what he worked so hard for!
Therefore, Ivan didn't waste a second, and immediately closed his eyes to adapt. The huge magical power in his body was being stirred by the new power to be extremely active, even to the point where he could be commanded at will.
When I opened my eyes, Ivan already had an idea.
Without seeing him making any movements, the tables, chairs and benches within a distance of 100 meters were lifted up by mysterious forces, and they were quickly kneaded and stretched to change their shape like plasticine, turning them into exquisite sculptures of gold and silver. Copper and iron materials are different...
The reminder in my mind kept ringing, and the proficiency of Transfiguration was increasing crazily. In a short while, it was close to the limit of level 6, but there was no intention of breaking through it for a long time.
Obviously, it is not so easy to get over this bottleneck. If you can improve without limit, then everyone is a master of magic.
Ivan was somewhat disappointed, and then his heart moved, and all the sculptures exploded instantly.
A large number of sharp gravel flew like bullets out of the chamber, and flew in all directions, making small holes in the floor and walls, but when they flew in front of Ivan, they were blocked by invisible force. Down, it turned into dust and floated in the air.
[The reason why magic is magical is that it can make people realize their wishes! 】
For some reason, Ivan's heart suddenly recalled the words of Nico Lemay. He realized that his current state is very similar to the final form of magic described by the alchemist, "it will be everything", but not so absolute.
Ivan can clearly feel that his power is still limited to a certain extent, but even this feeling of controlling everything has deeply fascinated him.
Ivan even swelled that even if Voldemort came in person, he could beat him and flee.
However, looking at the protection mode with only seven seconds left in the prompt bar, Ivan's swelling heart shrank like a flat ball.
This kind of time-limited power is difficult to use in battle, and it is very difficult to obtain legendary points It is too wasteful to use it to support a battle.
Ivan sighed silently in his heart, but fortunately, he quickly adjusted his mentality and focused his attention on the improvement of his strength.
He wants to take advantage of the remaining few seconds of protection mode to perform a real biological transformation again to see if he can break through his bottleneck!
Just thinking of it, Ivan stretched out his hand directly, and a finger-sized piece of wood floated from the ground into the palm of his hand. Then Ivan gradually penetrated his magic power into it, and the fine wood fibers were decomposed one by one and spread out in his mind.
In the previous few transformations, Ivan attributed it to the fact that the deformed organism is too large and requires a lot of attention, so he decided to change into a smaller creature, such as fly beetle...
But it took so much effort to create a small insect that can be seen everywhere, which obviously did not meet Ivan's expectations. He even hoped to be able to create something more special.
Just as Ivan was thinking about it, the small wooden block in his palm kept changing its shape, swelling in a full circle, and the burrs on the surface gradually became longer and softer, looking like animal fur, a pair of hard The corners gradually extend from the fur.
After a while, a strange creature the size of a half palm appeared in front of Ivan.
It is like a combination of many creatures. It is a deer as a whole, but it has sturdy hooves like a bull. It has a silver-white fur covering the whole body. It has a pair of large, curved horns on the top of its head. It looks very smart and extremely flexible. Deterrence.
If there is a wizard who is proficient in magical species here, I am afraid that it is impossible to tell what it is, because it is a magical creature that has been imagined-the snoring beast!

chapters.title: Chapter 666: New blood magic
chapters.content:
[Ding, after a period of practice, your transfiguration level has been greatly improved, the current level 7 (14012800)]
[Protection mode is over! 】
After the transformation was completed, two consecutive system prompts sounded in Ivan's mind, and the active magic in the body gradually subsided, becoming inert and uncontrollable.
The sudden change made Ivan very uncomfortable, as if he was suddenly forced to brake in the middle of a drag racing and then slowly drove to the end.
Fortunately, Ivan has experienced this situation many times, and it only took a few seconds to get used to it, and then he turned into a large full-length mirror for the first time and checked it out.
Looking at the blond, black-eyed, and handsome little wizard in the mirror, Ivan nodded in satisfaction. The appearance of the melted blood was almost the same as before, just a little longer and taller...
Ivan, who was completely relieved, was able to open the status bar of the system leisurely.
【Ivan Hals
Occupation: Blood Wizard
Blood Fusion: 47 (Unicorn, Basilisk, Bogut, Norwegian Ridgeback)
Magic scale: 217
Magic Column: Transfiguration Curse Level 7 (90012800) Occupational Cerebral Level 6 (54006400) Contemplation of God 6 Level (23496400) Guardian Deity Curse Level 6 (37506400) Shenfeng Wuying Level 6 (42606400)...
Blood Magic: Unicorn Shadow, Basilisk Eye, Bogut Transformation, Dragon Transformation
......
Legendary value: 015
Grade point: 610]
"Long Hua."
Looking at the extra ability in the bloodline magic column, Ivan fell into contemplation. Could it be that just understanding it literally could make him a dragon?
But this kind of ability doesn't seem to be of much use, because Bogut's transformation can also do it...
Ivan frowned, and finally decided to experiment, and tried to mobilize the brand new power in his body.
Just as Ivan raised this idea, the magical power of laziness suddenly became active, and it flowed through his body at a very fast speed, and his abundant sense of power gradually enveloped his heart, making him want to vent a lot. feel.
This emotion was naturally suppressed by Ivan, and then he leaped slightly and found that his body had become very flexible, and he could easily jump more than a meter high, and his strength seemed to be much greater than usual. Move those heavy bookshelves.
"Just improve your physical fitness?" Ivan muttered to himself, but looking at himself in the mirror, he immediately rejected this guess.
Because the crimson dragon scales are gradually covering his exposed skin, gradually turning from transparent to solid over time.
Ivan deliberately experimented with the protective abilities of these dragon scales, then raised his hand and put his wand on the back of the hand that "grown" the dragon scales.
"Diffindo~" Ivan chanted the spell, and accompanied by a red light and muffled sound, obvious cracks appeared on the dragon scales, which broke apart after a while, and the arms hidden behind the dragon scales were intact. No damage nor the slightest pain.
"The protective ability of dragon scales is weaker than that of the iron armor curse, and is basically equivalent to the magical barrier created by the obstacle curse..."
Ivan was thinking silently in his heart, slightly disappointed, but seeing the dragon scales on his arm shattered and began to slowly recover, he improved his evaluation of the ability of dragon transformation.
In addition, if he hadn't felt wrong just now, when using the split spell, the power of the magic seemed to be much higher than usual.
Ivan didn't know if this was an illusion, so he just tried again, when he put the horned snoring beast on the table, looked at the battle dummy in the distance, and waved his magic wand.
"Reducto! (Bone to pieces
The violent magic power was excited along the magic wand, and the dazzling beam hit the battle dummy almost instantly, blasting the target's upper body to pieces.
But Ivan was not satisfied, and kept casting magic, harming the wooden dummy, experimenting with the power of the dragon's curse.
"The power of magic has increased by about 30 to 50%..." After Ivan broke all the dummies one by one, he made a rough assessment in his heart.
This discovery surprised Ivan. He is now a humanoid turret, possessing powerful spellcasting ability, excellent mobility and the extra protection provided by dragon scales.
Compared with other blood magic, Longhua has improved his strength in almost all directions!
As for the drawbacks, in addition to these visible benefits, Ivan also noticed that as the magic power increases, the magic power in his body is becoming more and more violent, and the subtle magic similar to polymorphism will change in the state of dragonization. It's hard to use.
And the magical power and the protective strength of the dragon scales are gradually increased with the passage of the dragon's transformation time, which means that the improvement in all aspects at the beginning of the battle may not be too obvious.
What makes Ivan feel a little uncomfortable most is the change in appearance After maintaining the dragonized state for more than a minute, the crimson dragon scales have spread to his neck and cheeks. Very evil.
"It looks like a big villain, that's not good..." Ivan looked at himself in the mirror and vomited, canceling this dragonized state.
Keeping this way, Ivan worried that he would eventually become a half-dragon covered in dragon scales, with dragon horns on his head and dragon wings on his back.
After roughly experimenting with the effect of Longhua, Ivan temporarily put it aside and focused on other gains.
Excluding the extra blood magic, the magic power scale in the system status bar has also increased a lot, which is more obvious than any previous melt blood upgrade.
But thinking about it, it's normal. Most of the power of the unicorn is integrated into the patron saint, and the magic of the basilisk is mostly used to strengthen the eyes, only the magic of the fire dragon is flowing throughout the body to give him all-round improvement.
Moo~
While Ivan was thinking and analyzing, a deep cry suddenly rang in his ears. Ivan turned his head and looked over and found that the sound was the horned snoring beast that was only half a palm.
The poor little guy was standing on the only intact table in the house, looking terrified, buried his head in the thick fur, shivering and shivering.
"Oh, I almost forgot you!" Ivan patted his head, stretched out **** to grab the horned snorer's fur and swept it into the air, and observed it carefully.
Such violent behavior caused the horned snoring beast to let out a miserable wailing. The four beasts' feet kicked in the air feebly, and the orange eyes were full of horror!
"Am I that scary?" Ivan mumbled dissatisfiedly. He has transformed many creatures, and now for the first time seeing a transformed creature fear the caster.

chapters.title: Chapter 667: True biological transformation and clues to Batty
chapters.content:
Generally speaking, the transformed creatures are the manifestation of the magic power of the wizard, and will obey the various commands of the spellcaster to a certain extent.
But the horned snoring beast in front of him was obviously different. Ivan found that he could not control the opponent's actions, and he could not see the slightest flaw with his current level of Transfiguration.
It's as if the creature in front of you is real and not deformed...
"The curse stops immediately!" Ivan pressed his wand against the head of the horned snoring beast, trying to release the deformation magic he had applied.
However, as a burst of white light flashed, the horned snorer still stood on the spot, looking at him with an innocent and scared look.
Ivan's face was full of joy and shock. Could it be that he really completed a biological transformation, completely turning a wooden block into a horned snoring beast? Created a whole new species?
Ivan subconsciously wanted to deny this possibility, the more he studied, the more he understood the difficulty.
The examples of complete transformation in the magic world today are legends that do not know whether they are true or false.
On the contrary, a large number of teaching books related to transfiguration art clearly mention that transfiguration magic cannot really change the nature of things.
For example, food deformed by magic can never be used to fill the stomach, because this food has no nutrition. After the magic power added by the wizard disappears, it will return to its original state, and even cause an extremely serious accident!
It is precisely this way that the magic world will have so many impoverished wizards, otherwise everyone can obtain all the resources they want with just a transformation technique.
"Could it be related to the promotion of magic to level 7?" Ivan changed his mind, thinking that it might be because of the enhancement of transformation magic that allowed him to break through a certain limit.
Thinking of this possibility, Ivan immediately tried, and once again swung his wand to aim at the crucible that was turned on the ground.
Under the action of magic, the crucible quickly melted and transformed into another horned snoring beast. It was the size of a human head and looked mighty and majestic. It was also impossible to find any flaws on the outside, but when compared Ivan always feels something is missing for the horned snoring beast above...
"Spell stop!" Ivan waved his magic wand again, and aimed at the newly transformed horned snoring beast.
Unlike the previous spellcasting, this time his transformation magic was lifted, and the horned snorer turned into a cauldron again.
"How could this be?" Ivan was very puzzled. It seems that he had thought wrong before. Even the seventh-level transformation magic can't completely change the essence of things...
Then there is only one last possibility left-the protection mode is more powerful than he thought, powerful enough to easily reverse the essence of things, and turn a sparse ordinary wood into a living horned snoring beast!
Of course, all of this was his guess. To be more specific, he would have to observe the horned snorer for a few more days to see if it would return to its original shape to be truly sure.
Thinking of this, Ivan took out a transparent jar from the drawer, poked a few holes, and applied an extension curse in it to expand the space, intending to transform it into a new home for the horned snoring beast, which is convenient for these days. Observed.
By the time he finished all this and threw the horned snoring beast in, it was almost time for dinner.
Ivan didn't stay much in the responsive house, stuffed the jar into his pocket, and used the restoration spell to restore the damaged things one by one, and then left here and walked downstairs.
Walking all the way to the third floor, Ivan unexpectedly ran into Crouch, who was about to return to the office. He changed his direction and ran after him.
"Wait, Mr. Crouch!"
"What's wrong, Hals?" Crouch turned his head and looked at Ivan in surprise.
"Nothing, I just want to ask if you found any news about Batty?" Ivan asked.
Ivan has been busy preparing for the second game these days, and can't really spare too much energy to investigate the whereabouts of Barty Jr., so he thinks that Crouch, who has been idle, might gain something.
However, after listening to Ivan's words, Crouch's face suddenly became a little embarrassed, he hesitated for a while before speaking. "Recently, Moody and I are investigating suspicious people in the castle, but there is no clue yet..."
Ivan was a little disappointed, it's been more than half a semester, but Barty Little is still missing.
Is it true that you have to guard the trophy of the three finals and wait for the opponent to replace it with the door key before you capture it?
But now anyone with a discerning eye can see that Harry's chances of winning the championship are slim, and Barty Jr. may not adopt the same method as the original space-time.
Therefore, Barty must be caught before the start of the third game.
"Mr. Crouch, do your son Barty Jr. have any obvious characteristics, preferences, or habits?" Ivan asked instead.
Crouch pondered for a while. He tried to think about Barty's little boy. Only then did he realize that he knew so little about this son that he couldn't tell Barty's hobbies and habits in one breath.
A little guilt appeared on Crouch's face, he was annoyed that he had been so busy with work that he had neglected to care about Little Barty. If he could find out that Barty and some dark wizards were close in time, maybe things would not develop to where they are today.
Although there are not many things that can be recalled, in order to help Ivan, Crouch said as much as he could.
"My son usually likes to play Quidditch the most and occasionally studies some dangerous magic. In addition, he highly respects the theory of pure blood, which may be the reason why he surrendered to mysterious people... "
"Is there anything more specific, such as a certain habit that cannot be changed, the obvious one!" Ivan interrupted Crouch's words, and it was impossible to determine the identity of Barty Jr. from these alone. Judging from the experience of the original time and space, the other party can be very disguised.
Crouch hesitated for a long time, was about to shake his head, but suddenly remembered something. "By the way, my son Barty Jr. prefers sweets. Since Azkaban came back, he has been obsessed with sweet things."
Ivan nodded. He thought this should be a good clue. If you are really addicted to something, it is not easy to quit it, and this kind of small habit may not be aware of it sometimes.
"I know so much. I'll give you another picture of him!" Crouch sighed, looked through the pocket of the wizard's robe, found a picture and handed it to Ivan.
Ivan stretched out his hand and took a look. In the photo, it was a young wizard with pale skin and light yellow hair. The eye sockets were all slightly sunken and looked very thin.

chapters.title: Chapter 668: For the sense of justice in my heart!
chapters.content:
He is my son Batty Jr. This photo was taken last year, but I think it will not change much now. "Crouch said with emotion.
"Thanks, Mr. Crouch, the information you provided should be very helpful." After a few glances, Ivan put the photo away.
"No, it's me who caused you trouble!" Crouch shook his head, said with a wry smile, then looked at Ivan, hesitated for a while, and asked again.
"Hals, take the liberty to ask, why are you so obsessed with finding my son Batty Jr.?"
Crouch was very puzzled about this.
Naturally, he didn't want to excuse Batty. On the contrary, he hoped that his son could be caught as soon as possible, so as to make up for the mistakes he had committed before.
But Crouch believes that such matters should be left to the principal and faculty members. Shouldn't children as old as Ivan focus on studying and living?
What's more, Ivan is still a Hogwarts Warrior and just won the second game. It stands to reason that it is the time to celebrate with his friends.
"Mr. Crouch, Harry is my best friend, now he is in danger, of course I can't let it go..." Ivan explained.
There is another important reason Ivan did not say, that is, Barty Crouch Jr. is planning to send Harry to Voldemort, so that the Dark Lord can be reborn.
In order to stay for a few more years, Ivan felt that it would be better to disturb Voldemort's resurrection plan. This is the reason why he is so concerned.
Is it for friends and a sense of justice in your heart? Crouch looked at Ivan with a complex expression. He had similar ideas once before...
Crouch patted Ivan on the shoulder with emotion, and after a few words of encouragement, he turned and left.
With new clues, Ivan stopped chatting with Crouchdo, and walked all the way downstairs to the auditorium.
Entering the hall, Ivan found that he was a little late. The long table of the four colleges was already full of people. Fortunately, Harry, Ron, and Hermione left a space for himself, and Ivan hurried over and took a seat. Come down.
"Ivan, where did you go? George and the others held a celebration in the lounge in the afternoon, but they never waited for you." Harry asked curiously.
"I found an empty classroom to practice magic... You know, I don't always like to attend celebrations. I might as well read two more books at that time." Ivan said vaguely, using a magic wand. Clicking on the empty plate in front of him, a delicious steak appeared in front of him.
"You should have told me in advance. I knew I wouldn't go." Harry sighed, thinking of the "enthusiastic" Gryffindors in the afternoon, he wanted to find a place to sew down.
Because of Ivan's absence, most of the little lions have transferred firepower to him, and they kept asking him to repeat the dangerous experience at the bottom of the lake, as if they didn't get tired of listening at all.
George and Fred even made up his rescue of Ginny into an epic love story, and teased Ginny as his most beloved baby...
Harry kept complaining about George and Fred's mischief, but Ivan on the side didn't hear what Harry was talking about. His attention had long been on the little wizards who like to eat sweets.
But Ivan looked around and quickly realized that it was too difficult to find Barty Crouch Jr. based on the characteristic of eating sweets.
Because most little wizards have a special preference for sweets, if you check one by one, when do you have to find out?
Ivan frowned and was very disappointed. He thought he had got a key clue that he could use to find Batty, but now it seems that this clue is of limited use.
Kang Dang~
Just as Ivan was thinking about it, a crisp sound suddenly came from the hall, interrupting his thoughts.
Ivan turned his head strangely and looked there, and found that it was the reckless Neville who accidentally ran into Moody, who was about to leave the auditorium. There was still a knocked over plate on the ground, and the pastries inside were so random. Of scattered on the ground.
"Hug...sorry, Professor Moody...I didn't mean it!" Neville stumbled and sat on the ground. As soon as he looked up, he saw Moody's scarred face, and the words were unsuccessful for a while.
"Be careful next time, kid!" Moody said irritably, and pulled Neville up, who fell to the ground, and then pierced his cane and cast a clean-up spell to clean up the broken plates and pastries into the trash. In the bag.
"Is Professor Moody's always like this?" Ivan looked at this scene from a distance, with a thought, suddenly asked.
"Of course, Professor Moody just looks fierce, but he is actually very good." Harry nodded, and after most of the semester's contact, his impression of Moody is getting better and better.
Although Moody's usually behaves very harshly in class, they can always learn a lot of new knowledge in Moody's Defence Against the Dark Arts class.
"Yeah, if Professor Moody can be a little more normal in normal times, don't always suspect that someone wants to murder him, it would be better!" Ron on the side also complained.
"I'm not asking you this." Ivan rolled his eyes. "I mean, did you notice that Professor Moody likes to eat some desserts after meals."
Harry and Ron glanced at each other, then shook their heads together. Who is okay to pay attention to this?
Ivan sighed Knowing that he could not count on them, he remembered it for himself. He vaguely remembered that he had seen Moody's take it after the meal during the first time of school. Some pastries, donuts, etc., but I don’t know if this happens often.
"Professor Moody does have a habit of eating dessert...what's wrong? What do you ask this for?" Hermione said suddenly.
"Are you sure?" Ivan put his hand on Hermione's shoulder and asked eagerly.
"I listened to those house elves in the kitchen. Professor Moody would sometimes go to the kitchen in the middle of the night to prepare them for supper." Hermione pursed her mouth and said dissatisfiedly, and then she opened the conversation box The same, continue to talk endlessly.
"Those house elves are already poor enough. They need to be busy during the day, cleaning the entire castle and preparing food for us. At night, they should have a good rest, but there are always people who will disturb them in the middle of the night!"
Having said that, Hermione also glanced at Ivan, because from the information she had learned, Ivan would occasionally go to the kitchen in the middle of the night to force the house elves to cook.

chapters.title: Chapter 669: Yeah, how could it be him?
chapters.content:
Come on, Hermione, those house elves don't need to rest, they can't wait to work all day long! "Ron said with a sneer.
Hermione stared at him angrily, about to refute, but saw Ivan standing next to him suddenly stand up, throw the knife and fork aside, and ran straight outside.
"Ivan? Where are you going?" Hermione shouted, but Ivan did not stop to explain, and quickly disappeared in the hallway.
Hermione hesitated for a while, and roughly guessed where Ivan wanted to go, and then dropped the tableware and ran after him.
"Are they not going to eat anymore?" Ron asked curiously as he looked at Ivan and Hermione who left the table one after another.
"How do I know?" Harry was also at a loss, completely confused.
...
After leaving the hall, Ivan opened the map of Huodian for the first time and checked it.
Strands of black ink gradually surfaced on the parchment paper, sketching out the plan of the entire castle and its names.
Ivan saw the name that was moving at a glance.
Alastor Moody!
Ivan frowned, and after a while, he put away the live spot map.
When he looked up again, he had already arrived in the basement of the castle. In front of him was an exceptionally wide stone corridor. The torches on both sides illuminated the surroundings very brightly. The thick stone walls were decorated with many pictures, which were all food.
Ivan walked quickly to a picture with a large fruit plate, stretched out his hand and scratched the large green pear lightly. The pear squirmed suddenly, and smiled, suddenly becoming a big one. Green door handle.
Ivan grabbed it, and when he was about to push it away, he heard a rush of footsteps behind him, and turned his head to find that it was Hermione.
"Hermione, what are you doing with you?" Ivan was very strange.
"Of course I'm here to help!" Hermione vowed. "I am very familiar with these house elves, and have dealt with them many times!"
Ivan nodded helplessly. Since they are all here, he is always difficult to drive people, so he had to grab the doorknob and push the door to the kitchen open.
Inside is a very tall room, the same size as the auditorium above. There are many gleaming copper pots and basins on the surrounding stone wall, and there is a large brick fireplace at the other end of the room.
The most eye-catching is the four long wooden tables, placed exactly the same as the tables of the four colleges in the auditorium above.
From time to time, Ivan could see short house elves busying themselves inside, placing rows of painstakingly crafted foods on the table. After a while, these foods disappeared without a trace. Obviously, they were caught by the students. We summoned up.
"Each house elves are very hardworking. They work non-stop every day. They hardly make mistakes, but they can't live a little better." Hermione said very disappointed.
Ivan didn't reply. In fact, the house elves at Hogwarts were already pretty good compared to other similar experiences. Those house elves who served the pure-blood families had a miserable life.
The arrival of the two of them naturally couldn’t hide from these careful house elves. The nearest ones immediately put aside the work at hand and surrounded Ivan’s body. As for Hermione next to them, they were completely raised by these house elves. The wizard ignored it.
Because the other party always comes here to spread some "evil" theories, the house elves are afraid to avoid them.
"Mr. Hals, do you have any needs?" the house elf in the lead said very eagerly.
Ivan squatted down, stared at the opponent as much as possible, and asked gently. "I came here to ask you something. I heard that Professor Moody often asks you to prepare a supper at night, is that right?"
"Yes! Mr. Moody told us that he needs to investigate suspicious people in the castle, usually very late, so he needs an extra midnight snack. We are happy to help!" The house elf shouted proudly. Tao.
Ivan nodded, not caring whether it was clean or not, so he sat on the floor and started thinking.
The house elves gathered around Ivan quietly, motionless, and Hermione didn't dare to disturb Ivan's thinking by a loud voice.
After a long while, Ivan seemed to have recovered and looked at the house elves again. "Have you cleaned Professor Moody's office? I have been there once, um, what should I say... It's very messy!"
"Mr. Moody never let us into his office, he said there are many dangerous collections, and each one is deadly enough." The house elf replied very frustrated.
"Is that so?" Ivan slowly stood up from the ground, patted the dust on his body, and finally said. "I suddenly want to eat a supper, please prepare it for me, just follow Professor Moody's request!"
The house elves are very happy to get busy.
...
After more than ten minutes, Ivan opened the door and left the kitchen enthusiastically by the house elves.
In comparison, Ivan had an extra dinner plate in his hand, on which was placed half a steak, a large bunch of hot dogs, a few mousse cakes and a small amount of dessert.
"Would you like to eat? Hermione?" Ivan cut off a piece of hot dog and ate it, then handed the plate to Hermione, motioning.
Hermione shook her head. Hearing what Ivan had said before, she didn't even have the heart to eat, so she hurriedly asked. "Are you suspicious of Professor Moody?"
"But... how is that possible?" Hermione felt a little unbelievable Moody is a legendary Auror, and has helped them a lot during most of the semester. She is the best she has ever seen. Great defense against the dark arts class professor!
"Yeah, how could that be possible..." Ivan nodded in agreement, picking up a piece of mousse cake and stuffing it into his mouth.
Hermione bit her lip dullly, her brown eyes fixed on Ivan, of course she could hear the perfunctory words of Ivan.
Ivan scratched his head. In fact, he didn't want Hermione to participate in this kind of thing, but he obviously couldn't hold it back now, so he pointed to the dinner plate in his hand and said.
"Do you think Professor Moody is the king of the stomach? Three meals a day, eat a lot of desserts after the meal, and then go to the kitchen to eat supper in the evening..."
Hermione looked at the plate Ivan was holding, and immediately understood what he meant. This supper was full of portions, and it was enough for both of them to eat for dinner.
"So you said it is possible that Professor Moody needs to feed another person! Otherwise, why wouldn't he eat directly in the auditorium and kitchen? He has to run around with a plate, so he won't be so anxious every time. Right?" Ivan guessed boldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 670: clue
chapters.content:
Hermione was taken aback by Ivan's guess. She was so surprised that she couldn't help but ask. "You mean Professor Moody's imprisoned another person in the castle, so he needs to prepare extra food for him?"
"If this is possible, I would prefer that person hide in his office." Ivan nodded.
"That's why he doesn't allow the elf to clean his room..." Hermione muttered to herself, she already wondered why Ivan had asked those questions before.
"But why did Professor Moody do this? I heard that he was a powerful Auror before. He has captured a lot of dark wizards and Death Eaters. It is impossible to serve the mysterious man!" Hermione was very confused.
If Ivan hadn't told Moody's all kinds of doubts, she couldn't imagine that Professor Moody might be a bad person.
"I don't know... I'm just guessing!" Ivan shook his head. He couldn't be sure whether it was true or not. There were too many doubts.
Moreover, Moody himself is a very suspicious person. It is normal not to allow house elves to enter the room. This is also the reason why he has noticed something strange before but has no doubt.
"Could it be that someone pretended to be Professor Moody with the compound decoction, and then hid the real Professor Moody?"
Hermione immediately thought of this possibility, only then "Professor Moody" must provide food to another person, lest he starve to death.
"It shouldn't be... the time effect of the compound decoction is limited, unless he can replenish it at any time, it will definitely reveal the stuff!" Ivan shook his head. He had checked this a long time ago, and Moody did not carry the wine with him. It is the habit of the gourd to not drink a certain kind of beverage from time to time during class.
"In contrast, I suspect it is the Imperius Curse!" Ivan said hesitantly.
Hermione's eyes widened. Of course, she understood what the Imperius Curse was. Moody just explained the effects of this magic in the Defense Against the Dark Arts class this year. It can control a wizard unconsciously and even more so. Listed as the three most unforgivable curses!
"Moody's is a very cautious Auror. His willpower is not weak. It is impossible for ordinary people to control him for such a long time. I guess it was a mysterious person who did it himself. In order to prevent Moody from breaking free, he must be alone. Supervise him and consolidate the effect of the Imperius Curse regularly..." Ivan spoke openly.
Ivan has also practiced such a practical black magic as the Imperius Curse, and is clear about the drawbacks of it being broken away by the strong-willed.
As for the solution to the shortcomings, it is not impossible. Just like he controlled Nott, sending someone to monitor and consolidate the Imperius Curse on a regular basis can greatly prevent the opponent from getting out of his control.
Of course, this method is not perfect.
Because it is easy to cast the Imperius Curse on the same person in a short period of time, it is easy for the other party to have corresponding resistance, which greatly weakens the power of the spell, which requires more frequent spells until it falls into an infinite loop.
Hermione’s understanding of Ivan’s curse was far less clear than Ivan’s, but she could understand the seriousness of the matter, so after Ivan finished her guess, she hurriedly pulled him to run upstairs. . "Since Professor Moody is under control, let's save him now!"
"Wait, Hermione!" Ivan helplessly stopped Hermione's movements, and then said again in the little witch's puzzled eyes.
"I'm only suspicious, there is not enough evidence to prove it! What if Professor Moody is really a big appetite, and happens to like to eat midnight snacks while working overtime at night? This is not impossible."
Hermione was dumbfounded, she stared at Ivan blankly, and after a while, she pursed her lips in distress and spoke. "Then...then what should we do?"
"Of course I go back and think about it, and see if I can find more clues in the past few days..." Ivan said hesitantly, but before he could finish this time, Hermione interrupted directly.
"Don't lie to me, you must be going to find Professor Moody alone later!"
The little witch bit her lip and stared at Ivan very angrily. How could she not guess that Ivan was going to fool herself, and then ventured on her own. She couldn't hate to say a few words for a while.
But thinking that she might not be able to help with following, Hermione swallowed the words that had arrived again, feeling depressed in her heart, and finally had to whisper aggrievedly.
"This is too dangerous, you should at least tell Professor Dumbledore about this! What if this is actually a trap, and someone deliberately reveals a flaw to lure you into being fooled?"
Ivan looked at the little witch in front of him, sighed for a long time, and said in compromise. "Well, you are right this time!"
Due to the inconvenience of revealing a lot of information, Ivan has become accustomed to solving all the problems by one person over the years, and occasionally has been tricked several times, but Hermione reminded him this time that there is indeed no need to take risks alone.
...
Half an hour later,
In the principal's room on the top floor of the tower, Ivan briefly explained his guess, while Dumbledore was pacing in the wide office with his brows frowned.
"Halse, can you be sure that Alastor was controlled by the Imperius spell?" Dumbledore asked.
Ivan shook his head. Everything he said was just guessing, and he couldn't be 100% sure.
"Professor Dumbledore, is there no way to detect this kind of black magic?" Hermione said suspiciously.
"It's a pity Miss Granger, as far as I know, there is no special counter-curse for the Imperius Curse, otherwise it would not be classified as an unforgivable curse." Dumbledore replied.
Ivan nodded. The magic of the Imperius Curse is very tricky. It once caused a lot of trouble to the Ministry of Magic. Death Eaters like Lucius used it to get rid of sin, relying on the difficulty of the Imperius Curse. Features of forensics.
Only those clever masters can find some clues by browsing the memory.
But Moody's vigilance is too high, if someone uses sanctuary on him, he will definitely be noticed.
Ivan recalled several previous contacts, and found that Moody almost used that magic eye to look at himself. Obviously, the other party was consciously guarding against this.
Dumbledore pondered for a long time. Alastor is one of his most trusted friends.
Since most of the school year, the other party has not revealed anything wrong, everything is so familiar, so he never doubted this old friend, and even entrusted the other party with the heavy task of investigating the Goblet of Fire...

chapters.title: Chapter 671: track
chapters.content:
If what Ivan said is true, then his move will undoubtedly become a joke!
But what makes him even more angry is that Moody's might be manipulated by others...
Fortunately, the anger did not affect Dumbledore's thinking, so he quickly found the doubt.
"Hals, I remember that you and Alastor together exposed Batty's mistakes more than two months ago, and it was from this that we learned about the escape of Batty...
If, according to your guess, Barty Young controlled Aristo through the Imperius Curse, why did he take the initiative to expose this matter? "Dumbledore asked questioningly.
"I haven't figured this out yet, Professor." Ivan shrugged helplessly. It was precisely because of Moody's actions last time that he could not be sure of the other party's suspicion.
"Could it be that Professor Moody wanted to gain your trust by this?" Hermione tried to analyze.
Ivan rolled his eyes. Before Crouch was found, no one but himself knew that it was Barty Jr. secretly.
The other party is not a lunatic. If you want to gain your own trust, you can use another method. There is no need to expose Crouch at the risk of identity exposure.
However, beyond Ivan's expectation, Dumbledore nodded, confirming Hermione's conjecture. "It's possible..."
Ivan looked at the old professor in surprise, and then listened to him to add.
"During the summer vacation last year, I received a message that someone broke into the courtyard of Alastor. According to the testimony of nearby residents, there should have been a small explosion..."
While talking, Dumbledore rummaged through the drawer to find a letter and turned it over and handed it to the two of them.
Ivan leaned forward and took a look. The signature on the envelope was Arthur Weasley, and the contents were the same as Dumbledore said.
The night before Moody’s departure for Hogwarts, someone heard a loud explosion from his house. Because it was in Muggle territory, the wizards who forbid the abuse of the Magic Office quickly arrived. The person in charge of this matter is Arthur Weasley.
The end of the envelope also stated the results of the investigation. The wizards who went to the investigation agreed that it was because it was too dark that Moody mistakenly regarded a trash can as a dark wizard who intended to attack him, and duel with it caused the explosion. occur.
Looking at this report, Ivan was very speechless. He was very suspicious of Arthur Weasley's professionalism. He took a bunch of people to investigate, and finally came to such a nonsense conclusion that who would be okay with a trash Box for a duel?
"This is not the first time that something like this has happened..." Dumbledore said helplessly.
Since Moody's retired, various small accidents have not happened every other time, so when he received this news, he did not pay much attention to it, let alone Moody's words and deeds for the next half of the year. It is usually the same, and there is nothing suspicious about it.
"Then Professor, what should we do now? Shall we directly confront Professor Moody?" Hermione asked.
Dumbledore shook his head and said in a deep voice. "No, there are mistakes and omissions, I think I should try it out first... It's a good opportunity tonight!"
...
After discussing the specific details, Ivan left the principal's office with Hermione, thinking about what to do tonight.
Along the way, Hermione hesitated to speak and stopped, looking worried.
The two returned to Gryffindor's lounge in silence and opened the door. The lively and cheerful atmosphere inside almost made Ivan wonder if he had entered another world. Many people greeted him enthusiastically.
It wasn't until I saw the victory flag hanging on the wall that Ivan remembered that he had just won the second game this morning.
But when I was distressed, of course Ivan didn't have the intention to celebrate. He fooled a few words at random, then went back to the bedroom tiredly, set an alarm clock for himself, and fell asleep.
In the middle of the night, in a daze, Ivan was awakened by a harsh alarm, and when he sat up from the bed and turned off the alarm, it was already a little closer.
Quietly in the dark bedroom, he set up a sound-blocking magic on the mosquito net, so that even if it was noisy inside, it would not disturb the sleeping Harry and others.
Ivan carefully took out the live spot map and put his wand on it.
"I solemnly swear that I did nothing good!"
As Ivan whispered the export order, delicate ink lines gradually emerged from the blank parchment, connecting each other to form a plan.
With the spilt moonlight by the window, Ivan probed Moody's movement, and finally found that he was staying in the staff lounge honestly.
Haven't started action yet? Or is it over?
Ivan was a little confused. According to the house elves, Moody would go to the kitchen every two or three days in the middle of the night, asking the elves to prepare him a supper, and Moody did not visit there in the past two days, so The possibility of action today is great.
Just as Ivan doubted whether Moody was planning to go out tonight, the name on the map of Huodian suddenly began to move.
Ivan was startled, staring at Moody's name, watching him all the way downstairs, passing the hall, and then into the kitchen.
Ivan no longer delayed, got up directly from the bed, blessed himself with a phantom spell, ran out of the bedroom, and chased him all the way.
When he walked downstairs and crossed a corridorMoody had just walked out of the kitchen.
Because I was too afraid of Moody's magic eyes, Ivan did not dare to get too close, only dared to hang far away, at least a little relieved between two corridors.
And Moody didn’t seem to notice that he was being followed, and the name on the map of the point of life still moved slowly and regularly. After leaving the kitchen, Moody walked straight to the office of the Defense Against the Dark Arts class and stayed there. For a while.
In about ten seconds, the "Alastor Moody" in the map of Huodian disappeared directly into this office...
"Sure enough!" Ivan muttered to himself as he watched this scene in astonishment, which confirmed his previous guess.
There must be a secret space in Moody's office that isolates the inside and outside, just like the box where Barty Crouch Jr. held Moody in the original time and space.
If you draw the isolation magic text on the box, it is not impossible to shield the exploration of the live point map.
Ivan hadn't forgotten that his isolation magic text still consulted Tom Riddle for advice, which shows that there is no technical problem with the other party.

chapters.title: Chapter 672: The secret road in the office
chapters.content:
Holding the wand, Ivan crossed a corridor to the front of the Defence Against the Dark Arts class office, hesitating whether to go directly in to catch people or stay at the door and wait for Moody to come out before launching an attack.
Ivan's own strength is outstanding. He believes that Moody and Batty are not his opponents, but he will not be blind. Choosing the latter is obviously safer.
However, what he didn't expect was that Moody, who entered the office, seemed to be lying inside, meaning that he had not seen it.
Ivan waited in place for more than ten minutes, but his little patience was gradually exhausted in the cold wind.
As a last resort, Ivan turned his gaze to the spot map again, this time not to see if Moody had come out, but to try to find the locations of Dumbledore and Hermione.
According to the previous agreement, they should have already arrived.
But to Ivan's surprise, the names of Dumbledore and Hermione also magically disappeared on this live spot map.
Ivan's brows frowned. This situation was completely beyond his expectation. In the past four years, he has solved a lot of trouble by relying on the map of the live point, but today it completely failed...
"Aren't they going in early?" Ivan muttered to himself, he somewhat suspected that Dumbledore had taken Hermione to arrest someone.
After waiting for more than ten minutes, Ivan, who was blowing a cold wind outside the door, finally made up his mind and went to Moody's office to take a look!
"Protegos~ (armor body protection Ivan first cautiously blessed himself with an iron armor curse, and then pointed to the door lock to release another.
"Alohora~ (Alaho Cave opens
With a slight noise, the door of the locked office was opened.
Ivan opened the door gently and walked in. It was dark inside, and he couldn't see his fingers. It wasn't until he cast a spell to light the fireplace on the side, and the orange fire illuminates the surroundings.
The interior layout is the same as when he came last time, it is still so messy, many documents and weird magic items are piled on the wooden table so randomly.
In the mirror directly opposite, several figures were also vaguely photographed, which looked very strange.
Ivan took a few steps forward to take a closer look, but the monster skull hanging on the wall next to it made a buzzing sound.
"Diffindo~ (torn apart
Almost instantly, Ivan hit a curse backhand, blasting the monster's skull to pieces.
Looking at the debris on the ground, Ivan was not happy at all. He didn't know how this magic prop was used for alert, whether it was a sound or something else, and whether Moody understood that he had come in.
"Forget it, I have to match it anyway..." Ivan sighed and didn't struggle with this for too long. He had known that Moody had installed a security device in his office, and he didn't expect to be able to hide it. The opponent is nothing more than a head-on fight.
Thinking about it this way, Ivan was no longer as cautious as before, and his eyes were placed directly on the seven large boxes piled in the corner.
He strode over, blasted the lock on the box with a spell, kicked the first box to the ground, and a pile of spell books and a few broken sight glasses fell on the ground.
Then, the first six boxes were opened by Ivan one by one, containing all kinds of sundries, as well as a few conspicuous black magic items.
Ivan's movements also became more cautious, but the speed was not slow at all, and soon opened the last box.
What disappointed him was that there was no secret tunnel as he had imagined in it, and a few stacks of newspapers and a pile of student homework were randomly placed in the box.
"That's weird, where would it be?" Ivan touched his chin, muttered to himself in a low voice, glanced around and looked at every part of the office.
Since Moody's disappeared out of thin air in this office, there must be another enclosed space.
Could it be that there is a passage in the fireplace? Or could it be said that Moody left here through Floo Fan Teleportation?
Ivan glanced at it and thought it was impossible.
Make a hole behind the wall?
It's also difficult... This is Hogwarts, and the entire castle is blessed with magic. It is not so easy to transform it.
Ivan's gaze wandered in the office, passing the mirror and small cabinet, and suddenly saw the mahogany table in the center of the office, and then his gaze froze.
Because this wooden table is very strange, it looks square and has no legs underneath it, to some extent it is no different from a large box.
The most important thing is that he has been to the offices of several professors and has never seen this style of desk. It is likely that Moody's brought it himself.
Ivan walked to the mahogany table and tapped gently on the table. A crisp sound was transmitted from the contact point. The corners of Ivan's mouth were slightly raised, which proved that the table was completely empty.
It would destroy the magic of the extended space inside, causing Moody's death. Ivan did not dare to blow up the table with a curse violently, but carefully studied the way to open the wooden table.
This is not a difficult task for Ivan, who is close to level 7 in alchemy. It took less than half a minute for Ivan to find the activation mechanism-a sensor with a golden antenna on the corner of the table.
After some fiddling, the golden antenna shrank, the wooden table vibrated slowly, and a gap broke open on the left and right, and the front baffle quickly sank underneath, and an open channel appeared in Ivan. In front of.
This passage is like a door, inside is a dark and narrow corridor.
At the moment of opening, a strong smell came out.
Ivan subconsciously covered his nose, stepped back, almost thinking it was some special dark magic, and then remembered that when he entered Moody's office for the first time, he seemed to smell almost a strange smell.
There should be no need for Moody and Barty to commit suicide...
Wanting to understand this, Ivan released the hand covering his nose and smelled it carefully. It vaguely felt like a mixture of feces, rotting food, and fermentation.
Thinking of the food that Moody's brings in every day and the poor ventilation of this wooden box Ivan probably understands how this smell accumulates.
I have to say that in order to successfully hide the map of the survival point, Barty Crouch Jr. is really cruel to himself!
Ivan sneered, blessed him with a bubble head curse to avoid smelling those unpleasant smells, and then followed the stairs of the passage all the way down.
The torches on both sides ignited one by one, illuminating the road ahead.
What surprised Ivan was that there were a large number of daily prophets posted on the four walls. At first glance, the conspicuous front-page headlines were all familiar faces, and they were all news related to him and Harry. Report!
Ivan was too late to look, and his gaze froze in the room at the end of the passage-Moody, whom he had been looking for, was standing there at the moment, looking at a huge speculum with his back facing him, motionless, as if he hadn't moved yet. Notice that someone came in.
But when I got closer, Ivan saw that what appeared in the looking glass was the image in the office above, and it was obvious that Moody had spotted him when he first came in.

chapters.title: Chapter 673: Just stay here and reflect on it
chapters.content:
Hearing this, Ivan squeezed his wand tightly and speeded up his pace, just like chatting in the usual way, and said in greeting.
"Good evening, Professor Moody..."
Only then did Moody's stiff body move, he slowly turned his head, and looked at Ivan with that strange magic eye, his tone was very calm. "Halse, what are you doing in my office in the middle of the night?"
"Does that still need to be said? Of course I came to you..." Ivan said casually, his eyes constantly scanning around, he was looking for the young Barty Crouch who might be hidden in the dark.
However, the neighborhood is very dim, and the light from the candlelight is very limited. Ivan can only vaguely see a bed on the corner and a large cabinet on the right side. There may be people in these two places.
"Aren't you going to explain? Professor?" Ivan looked around, and finally turned his gaze to Moody's body and asked.
Ivan was not in a hurry to do it. He had been in the office for a few minutes just now, and this period was enough time for the other party to make some preparations.
Moreover, Mo Diming knew he was going to come in and stood here so bluntly, obviously trying to lure him into attack.
"There is nothing to explain, Hals... It is indeed beyond my expectation that you can find this place today, but it just so happens that I was still thinking about how to bring you here..." Moody said slowly. At the same time, the scarred face looked extra hideous under the light of the fire.
Ivan's pupils shrank slightly, and before he thought about the meaning of this passage, a warning sign appeared in his heart, and the door of the right cabinet suddenly exploded.
"AvadaKedavra~ (Avada Kedavra
The hoarse and sharp voice echoed in the enclosed space, and a dazzling green light flashed in mid-air.
Ivan instantly used the ability of Longhua, dodged in a sharp roll, and a hole was blown out in the wall behind.
The moment Barty started, Moody also raised his cane, but before he could brew the magic, he was interrupted by an inexplicable coercion.
Even Barty Crouch Jr. on one side was also affected, and his movements were half a beat slow.
Ivan didn’t know why, but he wouldn’t miss this rare opportunity. He immediately waved his wand and pointed at the sight glass behind Moody’s. Under the action of the flying curse, the huge sight glass flew over and hit Moody’s body directly. He staggered.
Ivan won the power and didn't forgive, hitting the second curse at almost the same moment.
"Petrificus~ (all petrochemicals
Considering that Moody was only under control, not the real enemy, Ivan did not directly attack him, but used relatively mild spells to subdue him.
A brilliant beam of light flashed in the air, and Moody pulled the sight glass to block it, but before he could breathe a sigh of relief, he noticed that the effect of petrification was continuously spreading along the edge of the mirror. Moody's face changed suddenly, and he hurriedly kicked the sight glass aside.
Little Batty has adapted to the inexplicable coercion this time, a pair of bloodshot eyes staring at Ivan stubbornly, surrounded by Moody's horns, the two alternately cooperated to cast spells. The exhausting spell beams speeded and intertwined in the dimly lit room.
Yifan relied on the protection of the protective ring and dragon scales to deal with the two, and he knew very well that the two-on-one battle was extremely detrimental to him, and he had to contain one and deal with the order first.
Fortunately, this happens to be what he is best at!
"ExpectoPatronum~ (Hushen guard Ivan's wand was lightly tapped, and wisps of white mist quickly emerged from the top of the wand, condensing into a proud unicorn in less than a second.
Accompanied by a crisp neigh, the shadow of the unicorn rushed towards Little Batty under the mist.
"Reducto~ (Bone to pieces)!" Although Barty Crouch Jr. didn't understand why Ivan was casting the patron saint curse here, he wouldn't sit and watch the opponent's patron saint approaching, raised his hand and cast a spell.
However, to his expectation, the curse beam passed directly through the body of the Unicorn Shadow, bringing wisps of white mist.
Is this really just a patron saint?
Seeing that his curse had no effect, Little Batty's heart was a little doubtful, and he wondered if the other party was fooling himself, so as to distract him.
Thinking about it this way, the vain unicorn had already approached in front of him, at an astonishing speed, and stepped down with his hooves high.
The distracted young Barty Crouch couldn't dodge at all, reluctantly blessed himself with a protective spell, and was kicked out by a pair of hooves.
On the other side, Ivan has a dual purpose. While manipulating the shadow of the unicorn, he set out to deal with Moody. Several rings on his fingers were lit up, and the plural spells were like intertwined artillery fire, not at all. Give Moody a chance to breathe.
But the old Auror’s skills were unexpectedly flexible. Under the effect of the Transfiguration Curse, his wooden prosthetic legs were sharper than the real ones. After a few rolls, he escaped Ivan’s continuous casting and kicked down again. A cabinet served as a shelter, blocking a sleeping spell.
Those round and round magic eyes kept spinning, watching every movement of Ivan in his eyes, and then guessing the spell Ivan was going to use in advance through the gestures of casting spells, and finding a way to deal with it.
Ivan, who had been unable to attack for a long time, finally no longer kept his hand. Under the wave of his wand, an invisible blade of magic power flew past and cut the heavy cabinet into two directly.
Moody's hiding behind only felt his hairs stand up. He struggled to support it, and rolled sideways, and dodged dangerously and dangerously, but the wooden prosthetic leg was still wiped and broke into two immediately.
Moody didn't care to stand up, so he launched a counterattack. The cabinet that had been cut in half quickly deformed, turned into two weird cheetahs, and ran towards Ivan.
Ivan smiled. It was the first time he met someone who was competing with him for transformation magic. He raised his hand at random and the two dashing cheetahs quickly swelled up and finally violently. Explode.
A large amount of broken wood fell to the ground from mid-air, then floated up under the guidance of Ivan, and smashed towards Moody with howling.
"Impediment (huge obstacles)!" Moody's legs and feet were inconvenient to dodge, so he had to release an obstacle curse in an attempt to resist Ivan's magic.
A large number of broken pieces of wood hit the magic barrier and quickly broke it.
"Expelliarmus~ (except your weapon Ivan raised his hand to cast the spell again, and a crimson beam hit Moody's body and blasted him out.
Moody flew horizontally and hit the wall behind, and the wand in his hand also dropped out and fell to the side.
"Just stay here, take a good look...Professor!" Ivan waved his wand and stunned Moody with a coma spell, jokingly said.
There is no counter-curse for the Imperius Curse. It is very troublesome to get Moody back to normal, so it is better to stun him...
