chapters.title: Chapter 674: Wars and collapsed spaces
chapters.content:
After cooking Moody, Ivan stepped forward and picked up the magic wand on the ground, then turned around and prepared to deal with Barty Crouch Jr.
In these few minutes, Barty Crouch Jr. also found a way to deal with the shadow of the unicorn.
After being poked a blood hole in his arm, he finally seized the opportunity to take advantage of the moment when the shadow of the unicorn materialized, using powerful black magic to smash this difficult guardian **** into a mist.
The two vacated their hands almost at the same time, and their eyes quickly met each other.
Ivan was no different from when he first came in. Before his momentum was even better, pieces of dragon scales climbed up on his neck, covering a third of his face.
In contrast, Barty Crouch Jr. is much more miserable, with a sunken face, a haggard face, and thick blood stains on clothes that have not been washed for a long time.
"It seems that your master doesn't trust you that much." Ivan said with a sneer.
From the reaction of Barty Crouch Jr. to the Shadow of the Unicorn just now, Ivan can see that he has no knowledge of his own blood magic.
This shows that Voldemort did not reveal the details of his fight a few years ago to this loyal servant.
"Oh, yes, he certainly wouldn't say that he had been beaten and fled by a first-year little wizard..." Ivan suddenly thought of this and said sarcastically.
Barty Crouch Jr.'s face suddenly became gloomy, he didn't even pay attention to Ivan's "nonsense", his expression looked a little crazy, and he muttered to himself.
"Don't struggle, no one can stop the Dark Lord's plan..."
"No one!" Barty Crouch Jr. laughed madly, staring at Ivan with bloodshot eyes, and waved his wand vigorously.
"Reducto~ (Bone to pieces)!"
The weird curse beam flew past.
Ivan frowned, raised his wand lightly, and the wooden chair beside him flew horizontally, hitting the beam directly.
As soon as the two touched, the wooden chair exploded in an instant.
"~ (flaming flames! Ivan's wand pointed again, and a large amount of broken wood burned, and flew towards Little Barty howling.
Unexpectedly, Barty Crouch Jr. did not dodge, but carried it abruptly.
The hot pieces of wood hit the body and plunged into the meat, but Little Batty ignored it, and even laughed more enthusiastically.
"Come on, Ivan Hals, die here with me... Use blood and fire to commemorate the master's rebirth!"
Barty Crouch Jr. yelled and raised his blood-stained left hand, his eyes were crimson and he cut off his **** with black magic.
The extreme pain and hatred were quickly transformed into power under the action of black magic, and the wand reached the direction where Ivan and Moody were, and shouted madly.
"Confringo~ (Thunderbolt explosion)!"
Little Batty yelled hysterically, the orange-red fire light lit up at the top of the wand, and then the hot fireball spewed out, rapidly expanding in mid-air, and soon grew to the size of three meters, the billowing heat waves overwhelming the sky. .
"Crazy!" Ivan, who witnessed this scene, had a numb scalp and could not help cursing.
Of course he can see that Barty Crouch Jr. is using self-mutilation to increase the power of black magic, but this space is only the size of a classroom, and using a large-scale blasting spell here is tantamount to self-destruction!
But now is obviously not the time to consider this, Ivan is casting one after another protective magic at the fastest speed in his life.
"Protegos~ (Armor Bodyguard
"Impedimento~ (There are many obstacles
"The wooden bed is coming!" After Ivan cast several protection spells in succession, he waved his wand and pointed at the big bed as the last protection.
Barty Crouch Jr.’s crazy laughter reverberated all around. The huge fireball had swelled to the size of four meters, but the power of hatred and pain was beyond ordinary, far beyond his control, so it was not unexpected. , The fireball exploded when it flew halfway.
The hot flames and violent shock waves spread in all directions.
The protective spells elaborately laid by Ivan quickly cracked, and then crashed into pieces. As the caster, Barty Crouch was blown away by the heat wave the first time.
The deafening explosion sounded, endless light and heat poured into this small space,
It took more than half a minute before the explosion gradually subsided.
Only the tyrannical flames still swallowed all the combustibles in the room like tarsus maggots, and the wooden table standing in front was roasted into black coke.
Fortunately, multiple protections greatly weakened the power of this blasting spell, and with the protection of dragon scales, Ivan who was hiding behind did not suffer any harm.
However, the rapid increase in temperature and the lack of oxygen still caused great trouble for Ivan. Had it not been for the magic of the Bubble Head Curse, he would have passed out of a coma due to lack of oxygen.
"Oh, Professor Moody!"
Ivan's face changed abruptly. Only then did I remember that Moody was still here. The magic of Barty Crouch Jr. was too amazing just now, and he just forgotten Moody for strengthening his protection.
Ivan hurriedly turned his head to look for Moody, and unexpectedly saw a golden barrier erected on the corner of the wall, and two human figures could be vaguely seen standing inside.
The next moment, the golden barrier disintegrated, and Dumbledore, wearing a purple robe, appeared in front of Ivan.
Hermione stood beside him, holding her breath hard, her face flushed.
And Moody fell to the ground unconsciously as before.
"Hermione? Professor Dumbledore?" Ivan looked at the two of them, and said in surprise.
"You did a great jobHalse..." Dumbledore gently waved his wand, and flames from all sides floated to him, and they were all extinguished under the anti-curse.
"Professor, since you are here, why didn't you stop Barty Jr from casting spells just now?" Ivan looked at Dumbledore and said rather depressed.
"Please forgive me for the poor reaction speed of an old wizard, Hals, I have just arrived..." Dumbledore raised his eyebrows and said apologetically.
Ivan rolled his eyes. He didn't believe that Dumbledore had just arrived. There was no such a coincidence.
He even suspected that the other party was standing on the side and peeking at him fighting Moody and Barty Little, but he remained on the sidelines without moving.
Thinking of this, Ivan couldn't help being a little angry, but before he could even say something, the surrounding space shook. He looked around in a panic and was shocked to see that the surrounding wooden walls were rapidly collapsing...
"The explosion just now destroyed the magic that expands this space. It seems we need to get out of here soon." Dumbledore said in a deep voice, his expression becoming solemn.

chapters.title: Chapter 675: The horror of Master Pantheon
chapters.content:
Professor, how do we leave here now? "Hermione asked anxiously, looking at the entrance, but the entire corridor had collapsed first, leaving only a deep darkness there.
Ivan closed his eyes and felt it, he wanted to try if he could teleport it out with Apparition.
Unfortunately, the answer is no!
This place still belongs to Hogwarts, more like an extended space like the House of Request, so the wizard's teleportation magic cannot be used here.
The only exception is the Tri-Finals Cup venue, where the space blockade was lifted to facilitate the access of the Auror and the transportation of construction materials.
This is also the reason why in the original time and space, the young Batty has already gained Harry's trust, but he didn't directly give him the door key, but waited for Harry to break through to win the championship.
Damn, Barty Crouch Jr. didn't really intend to die with him...
Ivan frowned and turned to look at Dumbledore, only to find that his face was calm.
Suddenly, a misty singing sound resounded in the confined space. The golden red Phoenix Fox flew out from nowhere, and a tattered humanoid creature was still dragging on his paws and flew towards them.
"Great, it's Fox!" Hermione exclaimed happily. She knew that this strange phoenix could perform teleportation magic in Hogwarts and take them out.
At the same time, the cracks in the surrounding space became more and more serious. Even the floor they were stepping on showed several deep cracks. Ivan vaguely felt that his body was being constantly squeezed and pulled by the space.
"Don't move, get ready!" Dumbledore said in a deep voice, grabbing Moody on the ground with strength that was not his age at all.
what to prepare? Ivan was very surprised, and then he saw Fox's body ignite a golden red flame, looking from a distance as if another hot ball of fire hit this way.
Accompanied by a loud song, the golden-red fireball exploded, and the sky full of flames occupied all of Ivan's vision and quickly extended to everyone.
Then there was a whirl of heaven and earth, and when Ivan came back to his senses again, he had already appeared in the principal's office.
At this time, it was late at night. I don't know when the rainstorm started outside the window, and the cold wind continued to blow in along the open window.
A few candles were lit on the desk in the center, which provided lighting along with the roaring fireplace.
After Phoenix Fox brought a few people here, he abandoned the scorched corpse under his claws, flew to the olive branch, and leisurely combed his feathers.
Under the blowing of the cold wind, Ivan's tense emotions slowly eased, but thinking that he still had some palpitations from the experience just now, he couldn't help but looked at Dumbledore and asked.
"Professor Dumbledore, what if we didn't escape in time just now?"
"It will be torn apart along with that piece of space!" Dumbledore said cautiously, "but when the space is completely broken, we will leave Hogwarts. If the timing is good enough, we will be completely torn apart by the body. Before, there will be an opportunity to use Apparition."
"If there is no Fox, that is your only life!"
Dumbledore explained to Ivan and helped Moody, who was in a coma, onto a chair. Hermione hurried up to help. She was worried that Dumbledore’s bones would be crushed by Moody’s weight. .
Listening to Dumbledore's words, Ivan was lost in thought, so it seemed that Barty Crouch Jr. deliberately used super-large-scale blasting magic in a confined space.
No matter whether this magic can kill you, that space will inevitably collapse. This is the real ultimate move!
If he entered there alone, Ivan would not dare to say that he would be able to seize the gleam of life in a situation that threatened his life and death.
Thinking about this, Ivan couldn't help but feel a little scared.
Of course, he was forced to this point mainly because he had miscalculated the determination of Little Batty. He didn't expect that the other party would choose to die with himself, so he retained a part of his strength when he did it.
After all, he needs to capture Moody and Barty alive as much as possible, and ask for information about Voldemort.
Coupled with the desire to try the newly acquired blood magic, Ivan spent most of the time only fighting with the power of the dragon, completely ignoring the transformation of snake eyes and Bogut.
Just as Ivan was thinking about it, Dumbledore put his elderberry wand against Moody's temple, pulling the white mist out of Moody's brain.
Dumbledore got closer, his eyes under his half-moon glasses were faintly blue, and he could clearly see some impurities in the white mist.
"It seems that your guess is correct. Hals, Voldemort modified Alastor's memory and applied the Imperius Curse to him!" Dumbledore's face rarely showed a little anger.
"Then Professor Moody will be fine, right?" Ivan hurriedly asked. Moody was controlled by the Imperius Curse for more than half a year. Ivan was worried that the new Defence Against the Dark Arts professor would suffer brain damage due to this. What.
"Fortunately, in order to guarantee Alastor's autonomy to the greatest extent, Voldemort has done it very carefully, and should not leave any sequelae." Dumbledore explained as he gently waved his wand, pulling a cocoon. The impurities in the white mist peeled off.
It took more than ten minutes for Dumbledore to put the wisps of white mist back into Moody's brain.
Looking at this scene, Ivan was stunned in his heart. If Dumbledore had crooked thoughts, he could add some material to change Moody's memory unconsciously. This is also the horror of the master of Mindfulness.
"I have sorted out his memories of the last year I think Alastor will be back to normal in a while...As for now, let's let him rest for a while." Dumbledore put down He was a little tired after he lost his wand.
Finding out the modified memories and restoring them is not an easy task, and if you are not paying attention, it may cause Moody's mental confusion when he wakes up.
After Moody's settled down, Dumbledore set his sights on the human-shaped scorched corpse on the ground.
Ivan also took a look at it. It can only be described as a mass of human-shaped barbecue. The chest cavity of the corpse was blown open, and it was **** and bloody, and it was steaming under the high temperature baking. It was disgusting. Can't eat.
He could only recognize Barty Crouch Jr. from his size and palm with two broken fingers.
Why bother……
Ivan sighed and shook his head.
Barty Crouch Jr. gave everything for Voldemort. He didn’t say anything, and even wanted to die with him. However, according to Voldemort’s temperament, it is impossible to feel sad for Barty’s death, only his incompetence. And angry...

chapters.title: Chapter 676: Magic transformation
chapters.content:
Genius remembers this site address in one second: []The fastest update! No ads!
Is he dead? "Hermione muttered, covering her mouth, looking at the broken, disgusting body in front of her.
"I think so!" Dumbledore nodded, in his impression that neither Madam Pomfrey's medical magic nor Snape's potion could save a cooked wizard.
"Unfortunately, if you can catch Barty Crouch Jr. alive, you might be able to ask something." Ivan was somewhat disappointed. After so much effort this time, there was still an oversight.
"We can't expect everything to be perfect, at least now Alastor has been saved. When he wakes up, he should be able to solve some doubts for us." Dumbledore said with relief.
Although he was also on the battlefield in the previous battle, but Barty’s suicidal actions really exceeded his expectations. In addition, he had to protect Hermione and Moody, who had passed out in a coma, so he could not be timely. Stop it.
Ivan nodded, and now he can only hope to get some information from Moody's.
Dumbledore waved his magic wand and turned into a white cloth to cover the body of Barty Crouch Jr., then turned his head and looked at Ivan again, and said in a deep voice.
"I have to say that your strength and diligence are always so unexpected, Hals, I thought you might need some help to defeat Barty Jr. and Alastor..."
"That's right, professor, if you hadn't come in time, I would have almost died there..." Ivan shrugged helplessly, but before he could finish speaking, Dumbledore interrupted.
"You don't have to belittle yourself, Hals. I know Aristo's strength very well, plus Barty Crouch, a young man who is proficient in dark arts, and the two work together.
Dumbledore, who had witnessed the entire battle in person, naturally saw it clearly. Except for the last suicide attack by Barty Jr., Ivan was perfectly able to deal with the two.
This kind of strength has even surpassed Silifus. If Silifus were to do it, he might be able to subdue Batty and Moody, but it would never be as easy as Ivan.
Hermione on the side said proudly. "A few days ago, Professor McGonagall said in class that Ivan's transformation magic is better than her, and it's not far from yours."
Hermione's praise made Ivan embarrassed, and he certainly understood that Professor McGonagall had mistakenly taken him to bind Norbert with the Transfiguration Curse.
It's a pity that it was all performed, and he may not be able to do it now...
Hermione didn't know this. In her opinion, Ivan was able to defeat Moody and Barty Jr. at the same time. It was very remarkable. This was something that even professors couldn't do.
In her impression, only President Dumbledore was better than the professors.
But this would leave the dark secret room, and Hermione also keenly noticed the abnormality of Ivan's body, hesitated for a moment, and couldn't help but ask.
"Ivan, your hands and your face... is that special magic?"
Ivan was stunned for a moment and hurriedly raised his hand to take a look. Although he had been released from the dragonized state at the end of the battle, his control over this new bloodline magic was very limited.
Probably because it took too long to maintain the dragonization this time, there are still some dragon scales still remaining on his arm, which has not completely faded away.
Under Hermione's curious gaze, Ivan looked a little embarrassed. He couldn't see what he was like now, so he had to speak in a serene manner. "Almost? This is my unique magic, will it be ugly?"
Hermione stared at Ivan for a while, and shook her head with red cheeks. These crimson dragon scales were not unsightly, but they covered Ivan's neck and arms, giving him a different kind of charm.
It was the faint coercion that made Hermione very uncomfortable, as if being stared at by a three-headed dog or a fire dragon.
Regarding this, Hermione had no intention of concealing it, and truthfully stated her feelings.
Long Wei? Ivan raised his eyebrows, no wonder Barty Crouch Jr. and Moody suddenly interrupted the cast in the previous battle.
He thought that someone was helping him secretly, but he didn't expect that this coercion was actually incidental to the dragon transformation. It is no wonder that the deformed horned snoring beast would fear him so much.
Just as Ivan was thinking about it, Dumbledore suddenly spoke harshly.
"I think I need to remind you, Hals, that magical transformation is extremely dangerous, especially at your current age... it looks like this is not the first time you have done this."
Dumbledore’s expression was very serious. He had noticed Ivan’s abnormality early in that battle. Combining several fire dragons from this year’s Top Three Cup, he quickly realized that Ivan had used dragon blood to accomplish this magic. Transfiguration But if he remembers correctly, Ivan already had the blood of a unicorn when he was in the first grade, and in the second grade he finished second under the "deception" of Tom Riddle. Magic transformation.
It is incredible that a wizard can live in two bloodlines at the same time without losing control. Dumbledore can only attribute it to the fact that Slytherin's attainments in the field of potions surpassed his imagination.
Maybe... Ivan's great luck will be added.
The combination of the two together creates a miracle!
He thought this was the end, but he didn't expect Ivan to recklessly choose to fuse the third bloodline.
Although it seemed that the magic transformation was very successful this time, no one could be sure whether there would be any serious hidden dangers if the blood was merged multiple times, and Ivan's excessive thirst for power also made him a little worried.
"Professor, what is magic transformation? Is it dangerous? Ivan will be fine, right?" Before Ivan could reply, Hermione asked urgently.
Dumbledore explained in a deep voice:
"Generally speaking, a wizard who wants to improve his magic power can only rely on day-to-day spell practice and knowledge accumulation.
But there are always exceptions. Some wizards use potions, contracts, alchemy, and specific spells to transform themselves to increase their strength and break through their own upper limits. I call these magic transformations. "
Having said this, Dumbledore paused, his eyes turned to Ivan again, and continued solemnly.
"Hals, I don't know what kind of magic knowledge you got in the secret room of Slytherin. As far as I know, every ritual corresponding to magic transformation is extremely dangerous. There have been countless The wizard died as a result! So the mainstream wizards in the magic world from all over the world have all given up such a dangerous attempt..."

chapters.title: Chapter 677: Where are my feet? Where are my feet?
chapters.content:
Genius remembers this site address in one second: []The fastest update! No ads!
"In the past 100 years, there is probably only one exception in England who have successfully undergone magical transformation and survived, except you." Dumbledore's words were very sharp.
"Who?" Ivan asked subconsciously, but a figure flashed through his mind.
"Tom Riddle, or we can call him Voldemort!" Dumbledore looked at Ivan carefully and said.
Hermione was taken aback.
Ivan opened his mouth, wanting to explain a few words, and finally closed his mouth dejectedly, saying nothing.
Dumbledore saw Ivan's reaction in his eyes and continued speaking without stopping.
"Tom fears death and is fascinated by the power of magic. This is extremely dangerous. However, he himself did not realize this. After successfully graduating from Hogwarts, he is still conducting various dangerous black magic studies, and The most evil guys in the wizarding world mingled together, so that they got deeper and deeper in the quagmire of black magic.
Ten years after he graduated, he once returned to Hogwarts once, hoping to take up a position in the Defense Against the Dark Arts class..."
Having said this, Dumbledore waved his magic wand, and a strange, pale human face slowly appeared on the table, which looked like wax, very narrow and weirdly twisted, with bright red blood in the whites of his eyes.
"This is what Tom looked like at that time." Dumbledore said with a little emotion and regret. "I guessed at the time that he should have undergone many magical transformations like you, but he is not as lucky as you. Obviously His power is out of control..."
Ivan looked at the pale face on the table with a somewhat complicated expression.
Voldemort's multiple fusion of blood is not unexpected, because the book "The Origin of Blood" was found by Tom Riddle and placed in the forbidden book area.
Even he could find a way to fuse multiple bloodlines in the secret room of Slytherin, not to mention Tom Riddle, the true Slytherin heir.
It's just that the other party does not have the support of the system, can not solve the problem of blood impulse, and refuses to give up this shortcut to quickly improve strength, so that in the end it becomes human and ghost...
"Professor! Ivan is not the same as a mysterious man..." Hermione suddenly broke the calm by speaking.
Ivan turned her head in surprise, Hermione was staring at him firmly, her eyes full of trust, and she did not fear him because of Dumbledore's previous words.
"You once told us that the mysterious man is an extremely selfish person who doesn't know what love is and has no friends. But Ivan is not like that. He will help Harry practice the spell and change Ron at the ball. A new dress..." Hermione gushed about Ivan's help to everyone, and she explained every little thing in her memory clearly.
Ivan, who was listening, felt a little embarrassed, and was touched by Hermione's trust in her.
"Of course, I know this very well, Miss Granger." Dumbledore interrupted Hermione's words with a smile. "Hals and Tom are naturally different. He is much better than Tom..."
Having said that, Dumbledore probably felt that his words were a little bit ambiguous, so he looked at Ivan and added. "We might as well put it another way. No one of all the students I have taught can achieve so much at your age, even Tom Riddle."
"Your talent is undoubtedly, Hals, surpassing me, and even becoming the most powerful wizard in the history of the magical world is only a matter of time...
So what you need to do most is to understand the powers you have and tap their potential, instead of adding more uncontrollable factors..." Dumbledore said comfortingly.
In his opinion, it is incredible that Ivan can be compatible with several different bloodlines at the same time, but Ivan's use of bloodlines can only be described as crude.
"In addition, I hope you can remember one thing, Hals, the accumulation of knowledge and the power of belief are the roots of the wizard's power. If you are indulged in the power of these bloodlines, you will never be able to grasp the true mystery of magic!" Dumbledore reminded.
"I see, Professor." Ivan nodded hastily.
He knew very well that Dumbledore was not malicious and really wanted to advise himself.
He couldn't understand the disadvantages of multiple magic transformations. If it weren't for the help of the system during the fusion of bloodlines these few times, he would have been killed by the blood pulse...
And as the number of blood fusions increased, Ivan also noticed that the benefits of his blood fusion were gradually decreasing.
Now his strength is no better than before, a powerful bloodline magic is just icing on the cake for him, it is difficult to get a qualitative improvement.
It was just the news that Voldemort was about to resurrect before brought too much pressure on him, forcing him to continue to fuse blood to obtain the strength to protect himself.
After all, the fusion of the bloodline and the protection mode provided by the system is the only means that can greatly increase the strength in a short time and they happen to be matched...
While the others were talking, Moody, who had been lying on the chair behind him, suddenly jumped up from the chair. However, when he landed, his left foot was completely empty and he fell heavily to the ground.
Regarding this as another attack, Moody waved his cane nervously and yelled frantically.
"Where are my feet? Where are my feet? You bugs, get out of my mind, and if you have the courage, come and compete head-on..."
Moody's crazy behavior went beyond the expectations of everyone present. Hermione cautiously avoided being hit by Moody's stick, and asked tentatively.
"Are you okay? Professor Moody..."
After Moody waved wildly for a while, he stopped panting, his mind seemed to be a little stunned, and his strange magic eyes stared at a few people. After coming over for a while, he said dryly.
"Oh, good evening, Albus, Miss Granger... and... Hals!"
"Do you remember what happened before? Alastor?" Dumbledore stepped forward and helped Moody up, and asked.
"Of course I remember!" Moody struggled with his cane and looked very angry. "Barty Crouch Jr. and Pettigrew Peter broke into my room. I had a fight with them, deliberately using the blasting spell to make some noise."
"But they caught me before the Ministry of Magic arrived... Little Batty dressed up as me with a compound soup and fooled away the Aurors who were following it."
"A few years ago I warned them to look for every suspicious point carefully when handling the case!" Moody yelled irritably. According to the regulations of the Ministry of Magic, he cast a spell of mass destruction on the Muggle site. , Auror has the right to take him away for investigation.

chapters.title: Chapter 678: When did my live spot map become known to everyone?
chapters.content:

Moody reprimanded the Aurors for their perfunctory behavior, and after several minutes of cursing, he turned his head to look at Ivan and spoke.
"Halse, if the Aurors had your keen observation ability, the disguise of that **** would have been seen long ago."
"You praised, Professor Moody..." Ivan shrugged noncommittal.
As for Moody's violent temper, which Auror dared to question him carefully?
"What about afterwards, Alastor?" Dumbledore asked.
"Then they locked me for a while, and they seemed to be planning something. After the Aurors left, Barty Jr. let me out again, saying that they would lead me to see his master Voldemort!" Moody's expression looked on. Become very serious.
"Mysterious man?" Hermione's eyes widened, and she said in surprise. "So what Harry said is true, he has been resurrected?"
"At first I was taken aback, but luckily it didn't, at least I think so..." Moody slapped his mouth, muttering.
Hermione was completely confused and didn't quite understand what Moody meant.
Moody quickly solved her doubts. He held a cane in his right hand and knocked on the chair, transforming the chair into an oval bag with an opening at the top, like a baby swaddling.
"This is the Voldemort I saw!" Moody recalled the scene with palpitations.
Hermione leaned a few steps closer and found that a statue of a baby was actually wrapped in the bag. It was so lifelike that it looked like the real thing at first glance.
But the strange thing is that this baby has a flat snake face, the exposed skin is dark red, and it is covered with a layer of snake scales.
"It's Voldemort?" Hermione's mind was a little stunned. She really couldn't associate the terrifying Dark Lord in the story with the disgusting thing in front of him like a dead baby.
Ivan also glanced at it, and I have to say that Voldemort today is really ugly and amazing. After apparently losing most of his power, the power of the basilisk's bloodline has been out of control to the point of a severely alienated appearance.
"Hey, how? Surprised, right?" Moody grinned and said sarcastically. "When I first met, I didn't expect that the famous Dark Lord would be held in Peter's arms like a baby. When Barty pointed at him and told me that it was the Dark Lord, I almost thought they were laughing at me."
"Your guess is correct, Alastor, Voldemort has not been resurrected in the true sense." Dumbledore stared at the baby on the ground and the weird baby inside, paused, and continued solemnly.
"But compared to before, he has become stronger. He is no longer a poor ghost. He has acquired a body, which means he has the ability to cast spells again..."
Moody nodded. He uttered a few sarcasm as he did now, and then Voldemort, who was ashamed and furious, cast the Heartbreaking Charm himself and tortured him a lot.
This is enough to prove that Voldemort is not as fragile as it appears on the surface, and is still the extremely dangerous Dark Lord.
"He tortured me for a night with the Heart Drilling Curse, and then changed my memory when I was the weakest, so that I mistakenly thought that I was actually a fanatical Death Eater, but just kept lurking in the Ministry of Magic as an undercover..."
"I always knew that was wrong. How could Death Eaters catch so many dark wizards? I tried to correct this thought, but I couldn't control myself. He used the Imperius Curse on me to strengthen this belief. And use this to control my words and deeds.
I think I may be really old and my willpower is not as good as before. In short, he succeeded in turning me into an obedient puppet. "
Having said that, Moody sighed dejectedly.
"That's not your problem, Alastor, Voldemort has studied soul and black magic very deeply. No one knows exactly where he has come..." Dumbledore said with relief.
Ivan also nodded.
Even though Voldemort hasn't completely resurrected yet, his power is far inferior to his heyday, but no matter how the foundation is still there, it is simply not something ordinary wizards can contend.
You must know that in the original time and space, Voldemort unwittingly controlled Barty Crouch-the former executive director, Moody's boss could not even resist even a little resistance.
In contrast, Moody's performance was commendable, and it took Voldemort a lot of work to completely control him.
Of course, it may also be because modifying memory is a delicate word and needs to weaken Moody's will to resist as much as possible.
Ivan thought silently, while Moody on the side continued to talk about the follow-up.
"After that, Voldemort probably felt that I had succumbed, so when talking with Peter and Barty Jr., he didn't deliberately avoid it.
I heard that they were discussing a plan. Originally, Voldemort was expecting Barty Crouch Jr. to enter Hogwarts with a compound decoction pretending to be me, which is more conducive to the implementation of the plan.
After all, remote control with Imperius Curse is not very convenient after all They can only order me to do something, but they can’t know the progress of the matter in the first time. I need to report every time. Batty can give me another order. "
"Then why did they change this plan in the middle?" Ivan frowned and asked. This was also one of the two questions he hadn't figured out.
"I don't know." Moody shook his head, then thought of something, then continued. "I guess they must be worried that they will be seen through your map."
"It seems that Little Dwarf has revealed a lot about me... I thought he really didn't remember anything after he lost his memory." Ivan said with a sneer.
"In fact, even if there is no Peter, the map can't be hidden from them. Many people in the magic world know that it would be strange if Voldemort didn't notice this." Moody said.
Ivan was stunned for a moment, his face was a little weird, when did his live spot map be known to everyone?
"Have you forgotten? Ivan? When we helped Sirius overturn the case last year, you showed the live map and it was on the front page of the Daily Prophet the next day..." Hermione reminded.
She has collected every daily prophet about Ivan. After reading it many times, she naturally remembers it clearly.
Ivan patted his head, but he forgot about it.
He saw the wall of Daily Prophet in that secret room before. It is estimated that Little Batty is idle and has nothing to do on weekdays. He has studied himself very much. No wonder the chicken thieves are guarding against the map.
"You may have forgotten a little. Voldemort is a master of memory. He may have a way to help Peter retrieve some of his lost memories." Dumbledore added. "Peter was one of the creators of that map, and he must know how to avoid it."

chapters.title: Chapter 679: Wait, is there such a thing? I do not know how?
chapters.content:

Listening to Dumbledore’s words, Ivan nodded.
Before seeing the real thing, with just a few words in the Daily Prophet, even if Voldemort is a master alchemist, it is impossible to be 100% sure that the isolated space can evade the exploration of the live spot map.
So Voldemort must have found something in the memory of Peter Pettigrew.
"By the way, Professor, how did you and Hermione avoid the Marshal Map, or did you say you were in that secret room before I arrived?" Ivan asked curiously.
Dumbledore didn't mean to conceal, and immediately explained.
"Before the end of last year's schoolwork, I asked Sirius about the map of the spot. He specifically told me that they used a very interesting name magic when they made the map of the spot. I spent some time cracking it. It has found a way to temporarily hide the name."
"Actually, tonight, we have been following you all the time... But Professor Dumbledore was worried about being seen through by Professor Moody's magic eye, so he didn't dare to get too close." Hermione added from the side.
The corners of Ivan's mouth twitched. He was only tracking Moody's movements, but he didn't think that someone would follow him behind him.
As for Dumbledore’s cracking of the magic on the Live Point map, Ivan was not surprised.
After all, this thing is just a more powerful magical item, and coupled with the key information provided by the founder of Sirius, it is naturally not difficult for a master of magic like Dumbledore.
He even suspected that Voldemort could also make a curse to temporarily shield the map of the live spot, but Barty was not capable of using it, or that it was not used at all.
After all, a Moody without a name is just as suspicious. Unless Voldemort can find a way to change his name, it is more reliable to control the real Moody with the Imperius Curse.
"Well, I don't think this is the time to discuss this." Dumbledore stopped the topic and turned to look at Moody. "Alastor, you haven't told us what Voldemort's plan is..."
"Voldemort needs me to bring Harry to him." Moody said.
"Through this Triple Finals?" Dumbledore asked again.
"Yes!" Moody nodded and nodded. "Little Batty ordered me to cast an obfuscation curse on the Goblet of Fire. Modify the rules of the competition and increase the number of participating schools to four. The fourth school that comes out has only one person to register. , So that we can ensure that Harry can become a warrior!"
"But how do you promise to bring Harry to the mysterious man?" Hermione really didn't understand. She had thought that the mysterious man was planning to get rid of Harry with the help of fire dragon and mermaid.
Moody went on to explain: "Waiting for the third game, the Warriors will enter a maze, where they will find the trophies for the top three matches. Barty Jr. plans to steal the trophies into the door keys so that they can successfully bypass. Hogwarts’ protective magic."
"And it will be during the game, so you don't have to worry about someone tracking it through the traces of magic for a while..."
"All I need to do is try to get Harry to win this game and get the key to the door first!"
Moody talked a lot, dryly picked up the water glass placed on the table and took a sip, waiting for Ivan, Hermione, and Dumbledore to digest the information.
"Then they must have not expected Hals to participate suddenly. According to the results of the first two games, Harry is unlikely to win the championship, so I guess you changed your plan midway, right?" Asked thoughtfully.
"Yes, this was a big surprise to Barty Jr., because underage wizards are not allowed to participate in the Triple Finals Cup. But the situation is fortunate that Harry is the second place in the game, so just think of a way to get rid of the first place. Okay." Moody glanced at Ivan, the meaning was obvious.
"No wonder you said that you would lead me over sooner or later." Ivan muttered to himself.
It's just one thing that makes Ivan feel a little strange. Barty Young is obviously ready to die with him, but if he dies, who will complete Voldemort's mission?
Ivan curiously said his question.
"I don't know this." Moody shook his head, then guessed again.
"But Barty Jr. can lead you the day before the game so that he can put the door key into the maze first. Even if he dies in the end, Harry has a high probability of winning."
Ivan thought for a while, and felt very reasonable. Because of the special nature of the Goblet of Fire and the sudden incident, even if he suddenly disappeared on the day of the game and no one was seen, the game must continue.
As for the risks involved... If you change your plan temporarily, you will always have to take a risk By the way, Professor Moody, I have one last question, since you were taken by Barty. The curse is under control, so why take me to investigate the case and expose Mr. Crouch? "Ivan asked very confused, this is also what he has always wondered about.
"Of course it is to dispel your suspicion of me." Moody raised his eyebrows and stared at Ivan with a weird look. He looked at Ivan for a long time, and then continued to speak when Ivan was uncomfortable to ask questions.
"I have to say, your acumen is incredible, Hals! Little Batty controls everyone who has kept me from Hogwarts, and even Albus has never doubted me. You are the only exception! You started to doubt me the first time you met me, didn't you?"
When Dumbledore and Hermione heard this, they both turned their heads to look at Ivan, and they were equally puzzled by this.
Under everyone's gaze, Ivan shrugged and replied freely.
"I think I have explained to you, Professor, that is because the previous Defence Against the Dark Arts professors have problems, I will doubt you, and I am also curious, why the first day of school You will go out and wander in the middle of the night."
Moody nodded, and it became clear that on the night of school, he did go to the kitchen to let those house elves prepare meals for Barty Crouch. It is estimated that Ivan was not sleeping at night and happened to be watching. I happened to find my own anomaly because I was able to spot the map.
"No wonder you came out to follow me that night... Little Barty guessed that you must have found some clue, so I let me draw your attention to Crouch so that I can find something for you to do." Mu Di murmured.
Wait, is there such a thing? Ivan is at a loss. Except tonight, when has he been following Moody?

chapters.title: Chapter 680: Misunderstanding, that's all misunderstanding!
chapters.content:
Genius remembers this site address in one second: []The fastest update! No ads!
What, did I make a mistake? It was the night before the first game. If you didn't follow me on purpose, what would you do when you came out in the middle of the night? "Moody looked at Ivan's reaction and asked strangely.
"I think you have misunderstood, Professor Moody. I received news from Hagrid that day, so I went to see the fire dragon in the Forbidden Forest with Harry at night." Ivan shrugged and explained.
At this time, Ivan also remembered what happened that night. After returning from the Forbidden Forest, he planned to go to the kitchen to have a supper, and then accidentally ran into Moody there.
"No wonder..." Moody muttered to himself. When he first met, he felt that Ivan's reaction was a little strange, but after Ivan kept pestering him to ask various questions, he became more sure that Ivan was deliberately big. Come out to follow yourself at night.
"By the way, Professor, were you really following Karkaroff that night?" Ivan asked suddenly.
"Of course not, you should be able to think of the specific reason, don't I need to explain it?" Moody shook his head and said in a deep voice.
He went to the kitchen to prepare meals for Barty Crouch Jr. as usual that night, only to realize that Ivan was suspicious of himself, and he happened to see Karkaroff with his magic eyes, so he simply used this to get out.
Ivan also thought of this, and was speechless immediately. After a long time, everyone misunderstood that night!
The two people's guessing words sounded like Hermione was in the mist, and Dumbledore looked at them curiously and asked.
"Alastor... Hals, it seems that something interesting happened a few days ago. Is it convenient to make it clearer?"
Moody didn't mean to conceal it either, Dang Even gave a rough explanation of the whole story, and then continued.
"In short, I told Barty Crouch Jr. about this. He, like me, mistakenly thought that Hals had some key clue and was following us, so he ordered me to draw your attention to Crouch's body, so as to dispel your doubts about me."
"Then he doesn't worry that I will find more clues from Mr. Crouch?" Ivan touched his chin and said in a deep voice.
"Battie Jr. didn't expect you to be so capable. He thought you must be unable to find out anything." Moody rolled his eyes. "Know that his father Barty Crouch is not a good role to deal with. Little Batty is counting on using this to hold your energy, so let me play a detective game with you."
"Better, wait until the time is right and then take your hand to send his father to Azkaban!" Moody added.
"Working with" Barty Crouch Jr. for more than half a year, he knows how much Barty Jr. hates his father that he wants to give a tooth for a tooth and let Crouch experience entering Azkaban and a Dementor. The taste of companionship.
Listening to Moody's account, Ivan was surprised. He didn't expect Barty Little to have so many calculations secretly.
If it hadn't been for the plot hanging by himself, I had always felt that Moody had a problem, coupled with the help of a live map, maybe he would really be turned around by him.
In a sense, Barty Crouch Jr. died very aggrieved.
"It's a good idea... When Barty Jr. came to Hogwarts to go to school, I couldn't see that he actually had a talent for plotting conspiracies." Dumbledore said with interest.
"Yeah, he did have two sons." Moody nodded as well. Barty's various plans were countless in one fell swoop, but it was a pity that he encountered a monster and his plans were all in vain.
It took only ten minutes for Ivan to dig out Crouch's secret easily, and Dumbledore did not twist Crouch into Azkaban as Barty Young had imagined.
"You must not have guessed how angry Barty Young was when he heard the news..." Moody said mockingly, recalling the scene.
"No, I think we've all felt how strong this anger is tonight..." Ivan looked at the dilapidated corpse wrapped in white cloth and said, vomiting.
Only a wizard who is angry enough can cast a spell to kill himself.
Dumbledore also glanced at the remains of Barty Jr., and soon asked again. "Alastor, did Barty Jr. tell you why Voldemort wanted Harry?"
"They are probably preparing for some dark magic ritual, which requires Harry." Moody said hesitantly. Although he has been controlled by the Imperius Curse, he can only be regarded as half himself, and he can't detect too secret news. .
"Magic ritual?" Dumbledore murmured, muttered for a moment, and looked at Moody. "Help me call Barty, Alastor, I need to ask him about something, so I just have to tell him that we have found his son..."
Moody responded to and used the Transfiguration Curse to get himself a temporary prosthetic leg, and then left with his cane.
Dumbledore then looked at Ivan and Hermione and spoke gently. "Halse, Miss Granger, I think you guys have been busy all night, and it's time to go back and have a good rest."
"Then, good night, Professor Dumbledore." Ivan knew that Dumbledore was starting to drive people, so he didn't mean to stay for a long time, and even turned and left with Hermione.
After leaving the principal's room, the huge stone beast behind him slowly sank to seal the entrance with a dull sound.
Ivan was about to return directly to the dormitory, but unexpectedly, Hermione next to her leaped forward and hugged him.
"What's wrong? Hermione?" Ivan was surprised.
"Are you okay? Ivan? Are you injured, do you want to go to the school hospital to check it." Hermione asked excitedly, and then suddenly thought of it, muttering to herself in distress. "Oh, I almost forgot. The school hospital hasn't opened yet."
"I'm fine, nothing happened, but will it be too late for you to ask these?" Ivan said dumbfoundedly.
Hermione pursed her lips and didn't reply. Dumbledore and Moody were both here before, and Ivan stood there neatly, her clothes weren't torn, so she naturally didn't behave too obviously.
Ivan probably guessed the little witch's mind, so he didn't mean to study it carefully, and repeatedly emphasized that he was healthy now, and he didn't have any hidden injuries from the explosion.
After calming Hermione's worries, Ivan asked about the little witch's experience tonight. He wanted to know when Dumbledore followed him.
The two of them just walked and talked. When they arrived at the Gryffindor lounge, Hermione had already told that she and Dumbledore followed Ivan into the secret room...

chapters.title: Chapter 681: It seems that Professor Moody has finally gone crazy!
chapters.content:
"I saw you fighting with Moody and Barty Little, so I begged Professor Dumbledore for help, but he said that if you rashly intervene, it may disturb your interest, and you will be very upset." Hermione explained.
No, then I will be very happy!
Ivan really doesn't know how to complain, and he is not a war mad or witch idiot. Where is the interest in fighting?
But Ivan also understood that it was just Dumbledore's excuse. After all, what the old professor was most interested in was to "guide" his students in secret, or to say some unpredictable things to let others "understand" slowly.
I don’t know if it’s a bad problem caused by being a professor and principal for decades.
After saying goodbye to Hermione, Ivan gently returned to the boys' bedroom.
The sky was already bright at this time, but the few people in the dormitory still slept very securely. Seamus was not sleeping while holding the quilt and talking unknown dreams, and Ron's snoring continued to echo in the dormitory.
Ivan, who had been busy all night, took off his shoes and socks and lay on the bed exhaustedly, summarizing the harvest tonight.
Barty is dead, Harry is safe, Voldemort's careful planning has been completely disrupted, this series of good news made Ivan, who had been worried about the resurrection of the Dark Lord, breathed a sigh of relief.
It's just that a little haze still looms over Ivan's heart, and I once again recalled Trelawney's prophecy.
[Darkness is approaching... Shadows cover the sky, and the servants of the Dark Lord will get out of trouble... The magic world is about to usher in a big change...]
Thinking of this, Ivan frowned. According to Harry's description, this should be another true prediction.
But now that he killed Little Barty, Voldemort should not be able to resurrect, will the predicted result be changed?
Ivan was a little uneasy, but then he shook his head mockingly. He remembered that Peter Pettigrew in the original time and space said that Voldemort's resurrection ceremony did not necessarily use Harry's blood.
Voldemort has always been obsessed with this, but because he suffered a big loss on Harry, he wanted to avoid the magic that protected Harry, and planned to kill him in front of traitors on the day of his resurrection. Harry, re-establish his prestige!
But in any case, after the death of Barty Jr., Voldemort must re-plan the resurrection. At least he can buy himself some time.
This happens to be what he lacks most now!
Ivan thought in a daze, tiredness gradually came to his mind, and soon fell asleep deeply.
……
The next day, early.
Ivan, who had barely slept for three or four hours, yawned and was called by Ron. Then several people hurriedly ate breakfast and went to today's Defence Against the Dark Arts class together.
In fact, when I saw the timetable, Ivan’s first reaction was to go back to the bedroom and get a good night’s sleep.
After all, Moody had just been beaten and discussed with Dumbledore until the early hours of the morning. According to the brain circuit of a normal person, he would definitely take a day off.
However, Moody obviously has no relationship with normal people, so he appeared in class this morning as he should, pretending to be okay, and giving them a Defence Against the Dark Arts class.
Moody didn't show his hideous minions until the end of get out of class.
He forced every little wizard except Ivan and Hermione to stand up, insisting on asking them to find out within the stipulated time how he is different from the past.
If something is wrong, Moody will yell at him mercilessly, and several girls almost start to cry.
"You guys really disappointed me. There are obviously so many differences, but only Neville noticed that my clothes were dirty and torn. Couldn't anyone see a few more scars on my arm, a wooden prosthetic leg? Did you change one too?"
Moody reprimanded loudly angrily, and all the stars flew to Seamus's face.
He didn't even wash his face today and hurried over, just to keep his current state and teach them a lesson, but the reaction of these students made him very disappointed-no one really noticed his abnormality.
While talking, Moody also showed everyone his new legs, which were still made of wood, but replaced with a beautiful reddish brown.
"I hope that next time in class, everyone can submit a report of at least one thousand words, explaining the differences, do you understand?" Moody slapped the table and roared.
……
"It seems that Professor Moody has finally gone crazy!" As soon as he walked out of the Defence Against the Dark Arts classroom, Ron couldn't wait to express this emotion, and then continued to speak depressed.
"We are not Muggle detectives. Who will notice if he has a new leg today?"
Harry also nodded in agreement.
Hermione on the side really couldn't stand it, and immediately retorted. "Professor Moody is right! You really lack the ability to observe. If you can pay more attention, you will notice that there are still some blood stains on the corners of Professor Moody's robe, which shows..."
When Hermione said this, the words suddenly stopped. She didn't know if she should tell the story of last night. Although Professor Dumbledore did not keep them secret, he did not allow them to disclose it.
Hearing Hermione talk about blood stains, Harry and Ron suddenly became interested and hurriedly asked. "What does it mean?"
Hermione hesitated not to speak directly, but subconsciously glanced at Ivan. Seeing that he hadn't stopped herself, she stared at the two of them and said.
"Don't you guys see it? This shows that Professor Moody has just experienced a battle!"
"Fighting?" Harry said suspiciously Ron was also stunned for a while, and finally he suddenly said something. "Did he catch Snape last night?"
Ivan rolled his eyes, wondering why they could think of Snape every time.
"It might be Karkaroff too!" Harry said vowedly.
Apart from Snape, Karkaroff is the most suspicious. He and Ginny also happened to overheard Snape and Karkaroff during the Christmas ball. They seemed to be discussing something.
"Neither!" Hermione glared at them, vetoing their guess.
This made Harry and Ron even more puzzled, and they quickly became reluctant to question.
"Can you please stop asking, Professor Dumbledore should be able to say it in a few days." Hermione said annoyedly. She already regretted revealing this matter.
Ivan also said nothing.
Now that Barty Crouch Jr. has just come down, he is not sure whether Dumbledore is going to hide the news and confuse Voldemort, and then follow the vine to look for clues, or choose to announce the shocking news in public, so it is necessary to keep it secret .
After all, Ron is a big mouth, and Harry may leak the secret too. It's impossible to say that the two of them will stoke things out one day...

chapters.title: Chapter 682: Calm before the storm
chapters.content:
After lunch, Harry and Ron were still guessing about Professor Moody's movements last night. Ivan and Hermione, who were quiet, had to hide in the library to avoid being questioned by them all the time.
"Shall we continue to practice magic today?" Hermione sat next to Ivan with a thick book and asked.
"No, let's read a book, I just want to find some information." Ivan also got up and took a few books about biological deformation from the shelf on one side, and looked through it.
Because he was busy investigating the affairs of Barty and Moody, he almost forgot about it.
Fortunately, the poor horned snorer did not starve to death. He put some grass and leaves and the corresponding drinking water in the pot in advance, enough for the little guy to eat for a week.
After several days of observation, Ivan finally determined that the horned snoring beast would never change back to its original form-it was a real biological transformation.
He once tried to cast the Transfiguration Charm on the Horned Snorer again to turn it into a button.
The entire casting process went smoothly without encountering any obstacles. It is no different from other creatures in the past. After a period of time, the magic power disappears, and the button will revert back to the snoring beast.
After a few experiments, this poor little guy was made a little nervous by him. Ivan was very worried about accidentally killing him, so he let him go, and didn't continue to toss.
Throughout the afternoon, Ivan kept searching for information related to high-end transformation magic.
Since his Transfiguration has been upgraded to Level 7, the increase in proficiency has become like a turtle crawling, and normal magic practice has had little effect.
Therefore, he needs to find the key to biological transformation and understand the principle. If he can really solve it, his transformation technique may be raised to a certain incredible height, and the benefits it brings are self-evident. Not to mention, at least he can have endless wealth.
After all, he can create creatures out of thin air. Isn’t it easy to turn stones into gold?
Wait, turn the stone into gold...
Ivan touched his chin, pondered for a while, and quickly threw the book in his hand to one side, took an old book from the shelf on the other side, and opened it.
"Ivan? Are you looking for something?" Hermione also noticed Ivan's abnormality and asked curiously.
"Do you think it is possible for a wizard to transform a piece of wood into a completely non-existent creature, creating a new species?" Ivan flipped through the book and said casually.
"How is that possible? Professor McGonagall told us when the school first started that magic can't change the nature of things!" Hermione retorted, thinking that even Professor Dumbledore would not be able to do such a thing. That's incredible.
However, Ivan shook his head, pointed to a certain line of the page in his hand, and said with certainty. "No, it is possible! Alchemy can do similar things."
Hermione stepped forward and took a look, then read the sentence:
"Ancient alchemy involves the refining of the magic stone, which is a magical substance with amazing functions. Among them, the most commendable effect is turning stones into gold and making potions for immortality..."
"This shows that it is feasible to completely transform one thing into another... at least the Philosopher's Stone can do this." Ivan raised his eyebrows and said excitedly.
Obviously, according to the above record, the Sorcerer's Stone can transform matter, and it is completely changed, otherwise it would never be recorded in such a big book.
Because it’s not a big deal to simply conjure a piece of gold, many wizards can do this with polymorphism, but that’s only a temporary change. It may be okay to fool Muggles. If you dare to use it in the magic world, you will be caught on the spot. Ferret out.
Although this is a little different from my original biological transformation, both of them have completely changed the nature of matter. Maybe there is any connection...
After consulting these many materials, Ivan became more and more aware of how difficult it is to do this. Converting matter and creating creatures should originally belong to the realm of gods. No wonder Nicol Lemay said that the Philosopher’s Stone is alchemy The ultimate creation...
"It seems to be right, but Ivan...what are you looking for with these materials." Hermione stopped arguing with Ivan after seeing the description of the Philosopher's Stone, but said jokingly. "Are you planning to make a Philosopher's Stone?"
"That might be!" Ivan laughed.
Some time ago, his alchemy has reached the limit of level 6. After returning from this summer vacation, he just asked Nicol Lemay to find a way to break through. In that case, he might have his own magic stone next year.
Hermione thought that Ivan was joking, so she pretended to beg Ivan to turn herself into a piece of gold.
The two chatted and flipped through the books. They just stayed leisurely until the evening, and then packed up their things and headed to the auditorium to enjoy today’s dinner.
Even though I haven't been able to find too many key clues all afternoon, Ivan is still in a good mood.
Because now there is no need to worry about the dark wizards lurking in the dark, and there is no messy conspiracy and tricks, every day is to flip through books and bickering, this is the pleasant campus life he is looking forward to After having dinner, Ivan went straight back to the bedroom, took out a quill pen and started writing to Luna.
[I found some news about the Xianxian tree and the horned snoring beast. If we have time, we can meet under the willow tree the day after tomorrow—your loyal friend Ivan Hals! 】
After writing the content of the letter, Ivan glanced at it and confirmed that there were no mistakes or omissions, so he invited Maca to ask it to send the envelope to Luna.
I was able to resolve the misunderstanding with Hermione smoothly last time, and thanks to the help of the little witch, Ivan naturally remembered this favor.
It just so happened that he got a live horned snorer, he had to take care of it regularly and couldn’t find out anything. It’s better to treat it as a gift for Luna, let her help him raise it, and ask Luna when he needs it. Just borrow it.
……
After sending the letter, in the next two days, besides daily class and reading materials in the library, Ivan also went to the Forbidden Forest to find a more suitable venue for renovation.
How can there be no trace of the fairy tree with the horned snoring beast?
Although it is very difficult to create a fairy tree that only exists in the imagination and will bloom beautiful flowers, but the seventh-level Transfiguration technique is enough for Ivan to overcome various difficulties.
Of course, this fairy tree is different from the horned snoring beast. It cannot exist forever. Everything is only manifested by magic...

chapters.title: Chapter 683: A fairy tale belonging to one person alone
chapters.content:
Sunday, evening,
After the last class, Ivan did not return to the dormitory to rest as usual, but walked out of the castle towards the forbidden forest.
When they arrived at the agreed place, Ivan suddenly realized that Luna was already waiting there.
With her back to herself, she stood quietly under the beating willow tree, wearing a weird gown with many decorations on her body, and a wreath made of vines and flowers was leaning on her. On the head.
It can be foreseen that Luna who walked all the way will be stared at with weird eyes, but this attire unexpectedly fits the entire forbidden forest, as if she should have stayed in the forbidden forest.
"It looks like I'm late again this time..." Ivan stepped forward, apologizing.
"No, you came just right, I just finished talking with this willow..." Luna who heard the voice turned around, her light blue eyes staring straight at Ivan, her tone erratic. Said.
Ivan was taken aback for a moment. It was somewhat difficult to understand how Luna chatted with a beating willow. Although this thing would actively attack those who approached and touched it, wizards and scholars generally believed that it was just the instinct of beating willow. reaction.
So when I saw that Luna was standing under the tree without any protection, Ivan was really worried that the beating willow would suddenly launch an attack on the little witch.
Perhaps he had guessed Ivan’s thoughts, Luna stretched out her hand and stroked the tree body, explaining. "The beating Liu is just afraid of us hurting it. If it can feel that you are in good faith, then it will definitely not hurt you!"
Ivan was dubious, so he took a few steps curiously and entered the attack range of the beating willow, but the tree still stood there quietly, without any movement.
"Look, it's easy, isn't it?" Luna said quietly.
Ivan nodded and said with a smile. "Yeah, this is really amazing!"
Luna also showed her face and smiled, and then she said happily as if she had thought of something. "By the way, I haven't had time to congratulate you!"
"What?" Ivan asked a little puzzled.
"Congratulations on defeating the mermaid, giant squid, and Grindillo, and saving the warriors and hostages in trouble, that's really amazing!" Luna praised in an extremely exaggerated tone.
Ivan didn’t know how to answer it for a while. To be honest, he didn’t think his performance in the second game was outstanding at all. It can only be said that the opponents were too hip, so he really couldn’t mention it. Get excited.
"In addition, you also defeated a fire dragon and flew around on it, just like the dragon knight in the story!" Luna said briskly as if humming some kind of ballad.
Ivan became even more embarrassed when Luna talked about Norbert, and immediately interrupted. "Okay, don't praise me, aren't we going to find the fairy tree and the crooked snoring beast?"
"Yeah, what are we waiting for?" Luna nodded, with a slight excitement on her face, pulling Ivan's wrist and ran into the forbidden forest.
Ivan didn't expect Luna's mood to change so quickly, but she also restrained herself from running, only pointing the road beside her.
"You went wrong, you are right here!"
"Is that so? But I think I should look for it over there..."
……
It was almost six o'clock in the evening, and the sky was gradually dimming. The dense jungle obscured the afterglow of the sunset. The surroundings were dark, and only a little sunlight could fall down the gaps between the leaves.
It seems that Luna is the first time to wander in the forbidden forest so late, but she is very interested, pulling Ivan all the way to trot, until the physical exhaustion is almost exhausted, she panted and slowed down.
Before they knew it, they had already stepped into the depths of the forbidden forest. They couldn't see anything except shrubs and bushes. Luna even wondered if she was lost, but she was not worried at all and turned to look at Ivan. Asked anxiously. "Are we there yet?"
"Alright!" Ivan glanced at the completely dark sky, felt that the time should be almost time, and then pulled Luna in the opposite direction and ran to the side.
After passing through a bush, the front suddenly became wide.
"We're here, that's it!" Ivan stopped and turned to look at Luna, only to find that the little witch was completely stunned. Her beautiful blue eyes were wide and she stared at her intently. A scene that exists in the imagination.
In front of her is a deep sea of ​​flowers, countless blue-purple flowers covering every corner of the field of vision, and every petal is shining with faint fluorescence in the night like magic.
And in the center of the sea of ​​flowers stands a tall tree!
Almost three people hug it. It is more than twice as thick as the distant trees. The dense branches and leaves are like a "big umbrella". The surface of the "umbrella" is blue and purple. Upon closer inspection, Luna realized that it was. Blue and purple flowers, from time to time you can see petals falling from the sky.
It is obvious that the sea of ​​flowers on the ground is falling from the trees.
Luna stared blankly for a long time, just when Ivan thought that something went wrong and the scene did not meet expectations, the little witch suddenly moved in She carried the hem of her robe and ran straight in. In the sea of ​​flowers.
The whole land seemed to have been awakened. Countless little elves with pointed ears, hidden under the petals, flew out one after another, bright fluorescence from their wings, lighting up the entire night sky.
"Zong Xian...they are Zong Xian!" Luna recognized it at once. She stepped on the petals and shouted happily, as if someone had used a powerful happiness curse on her.
The traces of the tracers circled around her as if they were attracted by Luna.
Maybe it’s really too happy. Luna closed her eyes and was alone in a circle among the flowers. She seemed to use this as a stage for Christmas Eve, and the surrounding Xian Xian was very happy to accompany her on the beat.
Ivan did not disturb the little witch's interest, just sitting on the ground covered with petals and watching Luna's solo dance-this is a fairy tale that belongs to her alone...
It can perfectly restore Luna’s imagined scenes. In addition to the merits of seducing the mind, the transformation to the seventh level is indispensable. If it was before the fourth hemolysis, Ivan would definitely not be able to do it anyway. The vast scene is deformed!
The consumption of magic power is also a big problem. Before the Transformation Tracer Fairy Tree, he almost squeezed his magic power.
However, it is precisely because of the difficulty of casting spells that his proficiency in polymorphism has increased a lot, which is a surprise for Ivan.

chapters.title: Chapter 684: Flowers in the mirror, moon in the water
chapters.content:
After a while in the sea of ​​flowers, Luna ran to the trace of the fairy tree, raised her head and looked up at it high, muttering.
"There is really a trace fairy... and there really is a trace fairy tree. If I say it, they will not believe it!"
"How did you find this place? Ivan? This is amazing!" Luna turned her head leisurely, changing her usual cold and confused appearance, she can be seen from the outside. Happy.
"I come here often, and I found it by chance..." Ivan was a little embarrassed and panicked, feeling a little uneasy.
Because he found that Luna's joy was far beyond expectations, the little witch seemed to be really immersed in this fantasy world.
However, Ivan is very clear that this fairy tale scene is false.
When the joy of lies is pierced by the cold reality, it often brings greater disappointment.
Luna didn't doubt Ivan's statement, and then turned her gaze to the black hole under the Xianxian Tree. It was very deep at first glance, only a little fluorescent light appeared.
"This must be the home of the Horned Snorer, right?" Luna asked curiously.
Ivan nodded, although this was originally for spiders and basilisks, but he took care of it a little bit, and only here is enough empty and quiet.
The two stood in front of the cave entrance and waited. After a while, a tall and majestic creature with a pair of large corners walked out from the cave entrance slowly. The silver-white hair covering the whole body looked extra in the moonlight. Gorgeous.
It is more than a meter tall and looks very weird. It has both deer-like hooves and cow-like hooves. It is now examining the two people in front of it with its yellow-orange eyes.
"Ah, it's really a crooked snorer!" Luna shouted happily, and cautiously stepped forward, stretched out her hand to hug the crooked snorer's neck and rubbed the silver-white hair comfortably.
And this big guy didn't evade her intimacy, and stood in place very docilely, letting her touch him.
"Want to ride on it and try it?" Ivan asked with a smile.
"Can you?" Luna asked happily.
"Of course!" Ivan took a few steps forward and helped Luna ride on the back of the Horned Snorer.
At first, Ivan was still a little worried about whether Luna would fall, hesitating whether he needed to ride with the little witch, but fortunately, Luna adapted quickly and sat firmly holding the horns of the horned snoring beast.
So, Ivan gave up this plan and just watched Luna happily driving the silver-white behemoth wandering in circles in the sea of ​​flowers.
When the waning moon was high in the sky, and the magic of the Transformation Curse was about to disappear, Ivan called to Luna who was crazy and reminded.
"It's late, we should go back!"
Luna looked a little bit upset, but she nodded and jumped off the back of the horned snorer, and then seriously said goodbye to the horned snorer and the tracers.
The two walked out of the forbidden forest in the direction they had come.
Luna hummed an inexplicable tune along the way, in a very good mood, while Ivan hesitated and stopped talking. In such an atmosphere, the gate of the castle was already in front of her eyes.
Just as the two passed through the hall, Ivan suddenly stopped, turned to look at the little witch next to him, and said apologetically.
"I'm sorry, Luna..."
Although it was cruel, Ivan still decided to expose the truth, because it wouldn't last long, and he didn't have the energy to maintain the Transfiguration technique. One night was already the limit.
"Why do you want to apologize to me?" Luna looked at Ivan puzzledly, then looked at the forbidden forest in the distance, and said quietly. "The fairy tree is very beautiful, and the horned snoring beast is also very good..."
"Yes, it's just them..." Ivan started to explain, but was interrupted by Luna's words.
"They will only stay in the forbidden forest for one night, right?" the little witch said lightly.
"Did you see it?" Ivan was a little surprised. He thought that his Transfiguration technique was still very good, and it shouldn't be seen through.
Luna blinked, and did not answer Ivan's doubts.
Ivan did not intend to continue to ask, since he had been seen through, he no longer hid it, and immediately took out a transparent jar from his pocket and displayed it in front of the little witch.
Luna clearly saw a half-slap-sized crooked snorer in the jar, which looked like a reduced version of the forbidden forest.
"Is it the baby of the Horned Snorer?" Luna asked curiously.
"No, it's a real horned snorer!" Ivan shook his head and said solemnly.
In order for Luna to understand the meaning of the word "real", Ivan unscrewed the jar and lifted the crooked snoring beast with his fingers.
This poor little guy was probably frightened. He mistakenly thought that a certain demon was going to torture him again, and suddenly let out a tragic wailing.
But this time, Ivan was not here to do the experiment, so he just waved his wand gently.
"FiniteIncantatem~ (Mantra stop
A dazzling white light flashed, and the horned snoring beast remained as it was, looking at them with that pitiful and innocent look.
Luna can of course understand the meaning of this spell cast by Ivan, which means that in front of her is a real and alive horned snoring beast!
There was light in the eyes of the little witch She stared at this strange creature in fascination, until Ivan handed her the horned snoring beast, and Luna recovered her mind and gave this The poor little guy took it.
"You really found it!" Luna said in surprise.
In the palm of his palm, the restless horned snoring beast was competing with Luna's fingers with its curved horns. It was not at all as docile as the deformed similar one in the Forbidden Forest, on the contrary it was irritable.
But Luna didn't care, she tried her best to comfort the horned snoring beast, and then looked up at Ivan, her blue eyes were foggy, and she said softly in gratitude. "Thank you for finding the horned snorer for me, and thank you for showing me the Zongxian Tree and Zongxian... They are all the same as I thought..."
"We are friends, aren't we?" Ivan said seriously, "And I really want to say, it should be I want to thank you..."
He had heard Hermione talk about that day, and if Luna hadn't helped him and Hermione, I really didn't know how long it would take to untie the knot.
Not to mention the little witch who helped herself a few years in advance, Luna also had a contribution to solving the mystery of the secret room and successfully deciphering the clue of the snake language.
All these help Ivan are naturally remembered in his heart, so he has long wanted to prepare a thank you gift for the other party, but he found the opportunity today...

chapters.title: Chapter 685: Foreboding of dreams
chapters.content:
"Yeah, we are friends!" Luna nodded and said briskly, and then put the horned snoring beast into the jar, and then curiously asked Ivan about the precautions for raising this strange creature. .
"Grass and leaves are good for eating. As for the others, I haven't tried it, so you have to understand it yourself." Ivan replied with a smile.
The two of them just walked and talked, and they finally separated formally at the intersection of the tower and returned to their dormitories.
By the time Ivan walked through the door of the bedroom, it was already past ten o'clock in the evening.
The room was very dim, with only a few candles lit on the wooden table. Harry lay on the bed early, rarely, while Seamus and Neville leaned against the window and told sneer jokes.
Ivan greeted a few people who were still awake, and got ready to go to bed. After working for several days, he had been with Luna for another night today. He was already too sleepy.
However, when I happened to pass by Harry's bedside, Ivan vaguely noticed a cold wave of magical power, and he turned his head and glanced subconsciously.
On the bunk next to Harry, wrapped in a quilt, closed his eyes tightly, his face was full of pain, his mouth was whispering one by one, the lightning scar on his forehead was gleaming. It was like a nightmare.
Ivan frowned and couldn't help but moved a few steps closer, standing in front of Harry's bed, and a murmur of whispers came into his ears.
"No! You can't do this..."
"He is very angry... the servant is dead... he is coming back... and killing everyone there..."
Harry murmured unconsciously, shaking his head from time to time, his expression getting more and more painful, and the big beads of sweat kept slipping down and soaking the pillows and bedding, like a convulsion.
Ivan's face became more serious. Although he didn't know what Harry was dreaming about, the information revealed by these dreams made him a little uneasy.
Could it be that Voldemort had learned of the death of Barty Crouch Jr., so he was very angry about killing someone to vent his anger?
Some doubts surfaced in his mind, Ivan was eager to ask, but he didn't dare to wake Harry up casually, worried about interrupting the dream and missing any key information.
He couldn’t be more clear about Harry’s particularity. As one of Voldemort’s Horcruxes, Harry would unconsciously enter Voldemort’s brain at some point to browse memory fragments, or share his vision with other Horcruxes. Some secret information...
Although there is a clear mention in the original time and space that Voldemort can use this in turn, using Occlumency to construct false illusions.
But Voldemort hasn't been resurrected yet, it should be impossible to detect Harry's prying eyes, so the credibility of intelligence is still very high now.
Just as Ivan was thinking about it, Harry who was lying on the bed suddenly opened his eyes and suddenly sat up from the bed, panting heavily, swept around in panic, and yelled frantically.
"Where is Professor Dumbledore? Where is Professor Dumbledore?"
While talking, Harry felt his scars start to hurt again, as if he had been burned by fire, and immediately let out a painful wailing.
The few of Seamus who heard the shout were startled, and jumped out of the bed without wearing their shoes, and they surrounded Harry's bedside with worry.
"Are you okay? Harry?" Seamus shook Harry's shoulder vigorously to make him awake.
"Or does your scar hurt again? Do you want us to take you to the school hospital?" Ron also hurriedly asked.
"No, I'm fine, and I don't have to go to the school hospital. I'm going to find Professor Dumbledore now." Harry shook his head and hurriedly rolled off the bed.
"But it's so late now. The professor should have rested. If you have something, it's better to go to him tomorrow..." Seamus didn't quite understand why he made such a fuss, and asked suspiciously. "Did you have a nightmare? Harry?"
"That's not a dream!" Harry shouted angrily.
"Then do you see anything?" Ivan on the side asked solemnly.
"Barty Crouch is dead! Voldemort is very angry that he has been torturing someone with the drill curse... That snake... I became that snake again!" Harry said hurriedly, he was desperately desperate. I want to describe the picture in my mind more clearly, but for some reason it becomes intermittent when I reach my lips.
But Harry added diligently. "Voldemort... Voldemort also said he wants to kill more people! Use their blood to restore power, and he wants to kill everyone in a Muggle village!"
After the words fell, the whole bedroom fell into a strange silence, and Ron, Neville, and Neville were all shocked by Harry's words.
"Did you just talk about the mysterious person?" Seamus looked at Harry in horror, unconsciously stepped back two steps, and almost hit the sharp corner of the bed.
"Did you dream about that person again?" Ron knew a little bit more, so he wasn't surprised like Seamus.
Ron still doubted Harry's words. "You said that Mr. Crouch is dead? How could that be possible? I saw him staying in the castle well yesterday."
