"But I really heard Voldemort's own words!" Harry said eagerly, looked around, then turned his eyes to Ivan who was thinking about things, and said again. "Ivan, don't you have that map? Don't we know if we look at it?"
Ivan regained his consciousness and nodded solemnly, just as he wanted to see if both Crouches were dead, so he took the live map out of his pocket.
In the next moment, a plain picture of the entire castle appeared in front of everyone.
Ron glanced around on the map, and soon saw Barty Crouch on it, slowly breathed a sigh of relief, and said with a smile. "Look, Harry, Mr. Crouch is still in the staff lounge, so you are just having a nightmare."
Harry was a little confused, he looked at the name on the map for a long time without replying.
Just when several people thought that the matter could be concluded, Ivan suddenly spoke.
"No, I'm afraid that Harry is right. There is indeed a Barty Crouch dead, but it is Mr. Crouch’s son Barty Jr. He sneaked into Hogwarts before and tried Throwing Harry's name into the goblet of fire."
"So Professor Moody arrested him that day?" Harry suddenly thought of Moody's anomaly a few days ago and asked anxiously.
"You can also say the same..." Ivan gave Moody a bit of face, but he was thinking about how Voldemort learned of this information?
Was it because of what kind of incantation was put on Barty's body that could detect his life or death, or was it someone told him specifically?
There should not be many people who know this information now...

chapters.title: Chapter 686: If we can't stop him in time, everything will be done!
chapters.content:
"What the **** are you talking about? Does Mr. Crouch have a son? Why does he put Harry's name in the Goblet of Fire?" Seamus couldn't understand Ivan's words at all, and spoke confusedly. Asked.
But Ivan didn't mean to explain, his attention had been attracted by the names of the headmaster's office.
After a few glances at the map, Ivan turned his head to look at Harry, and said solemnly. "Go! Let's go to Professor Dumbledore now. He happens to be in the office. I will explain the matter about Barty Jr. on the way to you later!"
Harry nodded and didn't change his clothes, so he ran out of the bedroom with Ivan in this pajamas.
"Wait for me! I'll go with you too!" Ron hurriedly shouted, and immediately followed.
On the way to the principal's office, Ivan Shun took a brief account of what happened the other day, and now there is no need to hide it.
After listening to Ivan's story, Harry and Ron were both shocked and unable to speak for a while. After a while, Ron seemed to have recovered and stammered.
"You mean Professor Moody was controlled by the Imperius Curse before? How is this possible? He is a legendary Auror and has caught so many dark wizards!"
Harry also couldn't believe it. He had seen Moody's performance during this period of time. It is not an exaggeration to say that he is the best Defence Against the Dark Arts class professor, not to mention Moody's treatment of himself. Last time, he kindly said something to help him smash Malfoy.
"Harry, have you forgotten? The more wise the dark wizard is, the better at composing lies, such as Professor Quirrell in the first grade. Who would believe that he did so many bad things if he didn't show his feet? Reminded.
Harry and Ron were speechless, but quickly and gloomily asked why Ivan didn't tell them earlier.
Especially Harry was struggling with this. He thought that since Voldemort wanted to arrest him, he should at least have the right to know, but now that Barty Crouch Jr. is dead, he just knew it was. The other party intends to frame himself.
"In the beginning, I was just guessing, if I said it in advance, but in the end I accidentally guessed it wrong, wouldn't it be embarrassing..." Ivan shrugged and explained it in confusion.
Harry planned to ask again, but the entrance to the principal's office was already near, so he had to hold the temporary doubt in his mind.
"Chilled lemon juice!" Ivan said to the huge stone beast in front of the door.
In order to report things in an emergency, Dumbledore has informed him of the import and export orders of the principal's office in recent months.
The huge stone beast rumbling, moved slowly to give way to a passage, and Ivan and the others immediately walked up the spiral staircase.
Before they could enter the principal's room, the fierce quarrels came out first.
Harry and Ron vaguely heard the voices that seemed to be Fudge and Umbridge.
Ivan was not surprised at all, he had already seen the names of these two men and some Aurors on the map.
Walking upstairs, Ivan did not expect to see a bunch of people standing in the principal's office.
The one at the head is Cornelius Fudge, the current Minister of Magic, who will be pointing at the corpse of Barty Crouch Jr. on the ground, frowning and speaking.
"Albus, so you came to me this time, just to tell me that this scorched corpse is Mr. Crouch's son Batty Jr.? That died in Azkaban more than ten years ago. Death Eater?
And he also planned a conspiracy, put Harry's name in the Goblet of Fire, intending to use this game to send Harry to the mysterious man? "
Fudge looked at Dumbledore with a look that you seemed to be teasing me, like a patient with severe Alzheimer's.
However, Dumbledore didn't mean to be joking at all, he spoke very seriously.
"I know you might have a hard time accepting this, Connelly, so I have asked Aristo to invite Batty over, and he will tell you if all this is true!"
"I don't think you think that Batty is willing to take the risk of staying in Azkaban for a lifetime, lying and deceiving you? This is more ridiculous than the things I told you, isn't it?"
Dumbledore's words were extremely sharp, and under his gaze, a heavy pressure enveloped everyone's heart.
Fudge lost his former composure. He looked around in a panic, as if expecting someone to stand up and refute Dumbledore's words.
But all the Aurors cringed, even Umbridge, who was the most active on weekdays, didn't move. Her mouth seemed to be sewn on, and she was closed tightly, unable to speak.
Fudge stepped back anxiously, until he stood in the crowd, he seemed to feel more relieved.
But what followed was an angry mood, and Fudge took the pressure as Dumbledore's provocation to himself, and said forcefully.
"Albus... To be honest, I don't know what you are doing... Barty Jr is dead long ago, and two Aurors watched him get buried in the ground with their own eyes!
The same is true for the mysterious man. He had already died that night. Everyone in the magical world knew this. He would never come back! forever and always! "
Fudge roared hysterically, every word seemed to be forced out of his mouth.
Dumbledore's expression became more and more disappointed, and he opened his mouth to continue to persuade him, but before then a familiar voice rang first.
"No, you are wrong, Mr. Minister!"
The sudden words interrupted the conversation of several people, and everyone heard the reputation.
Harry, who was stuck in the door, struggled to get rid of the two Aurors who were blocking him and bravely stood in front of the crowd.
Ivan was helpless by his recklessness, but he still followed. He chose to be there at this time just to listen to some useful information, rather than specifically as a target.
"Oh, Mr. Potter, and... Hals, why are you here? Albus didn't tell me. He would invite you two to testify." Fudge narrowed his eyes and said flatly, Ivan The timing of waiting for someone to come was a bit too coincidental.
As for Ron at the back, he was directly ignored by Fudge, he only remembered that it was supposed to be a Weasley kid.
"Voldemort is still alive, Mr. Minister! I saw him with my own eyes!" Harry's first words shocked everyone present.
Fudge froze completely, and the Aurors also looked a little nervous.
But Harry didn't mean to stop at all, he continued eagerly. "He is coming back soon, planning to slaughter a Muggle village to restore his power. If we can't stop him in time, then everything is over!"

chapters.title: Chapter 687: Stubborn Fudge
chapters.content:
Harry's words were like dropping a depth bomb in the calm black lake, making the atmosphere in the principal's office agitated.
Dumbledore frowned, staring at Harry without speaking.
Fudge's expression on the side was almost distorted, and he interrupted Harry's words angrily. "Nonsense! You will never have seen him, you must be lying!"
"I didn't, sir..." Harry eagerly wanted to explain, but before he could say a few words, he was interrupted by Umbridge.
"You just said you knew the mysterious man's plan, Potter?" Umbridge demanded.
Harry nodded blankly.
"This is the biggest lie! If, as you said, the mysterious man is still alive and planning a secret plan, then how did you know the news?" Umbridge's words are very harsh, a pair of poisonous snakes. Normal eyes stared directly at Harry.
"Voldemort said it himself!" Harry responded loudly. "I had a dream. In the dream I became a snake and sneaked into a small room. Voldemort was staying there. He was talking to Peter Pettigrew..."
Before he could finish speaking, Umbridge laughed mockingly. "A dream?"
"Ah, it seems that things can't be clearer..." Fudge's mouth also raised a sneer smile, he turned to look at the Aurors, and said.
"Everyone heard that? Mr. Potter intends to tell us that he has had a few nightmares these days and dreams of a mysterious man trying to murder him. This may scare him so much that he has to sneak into the principal's room in the middle of the night. Seek comfort..."
Hearing this, several Aurors laughed one after another, and the solemn atmosphere in the principal's room was swept away.
"This is not the first time, Mr. Minister! I also dreamed of him last time. He wanted to send someone to catch me, and then Barty Crouch Jr. threw my name into the Goblet of Fire!" Harry stammered to excuse.
Fudge didn't even pay attention to what Harry was saying, and scolded impatiently. "Listen, kid! This is not a place to play, and I don't have so much time to listen to your ridiculous dreams. The Ministry of Magic has more important things waiting for me to deal with..."
"Also... Albus, I think you may need to take a good rest recently, lest your mind become too awake. I can't believe that you would have a nightmare of a child!" Fudge looked at Dumbledore. , Said quite dissatisfied.
"Sometimes dreams also bring some indications... Connelly!" Dumbledore's expression was still calm, but there was an unspeakable power in his eyes looking at Fudge, which made every word of him deep. Deep in everyone's mind.
"Otherwise, how do you explain the Dark Mark raised in the Quidditch Cup this year? Peter Pettigrew's escape is also a very obvious omen!
The fact is that Voldemort has got the help of Pettigrew, he has become stronger, and he is planning to become stronger! "
"Enough, don't talk to me about this!" Fudge interrupted Dumbledore's words sharply, his face rose to purple-red, and an anger rose from his heart.
"Do you still want to tell me that this kid has the gift of a prophet? And Peter Pettigrew is dead, the Dementor killed him, right in front of me, I know all this better than you! The dark mark that day was just It's just an accident. The Aurors have received some news, and they will catch the troublemakers sooner or later!"
Fudge refuted every word of Dumbledore with the sharpest words.
He simply couldn’t understand why Dumbledore wanted to arouse people’s panic. Obviously, the magic world is very peaceful now. The Dark Lord’s wreckage has been happening more than ten years ago, and those extreme Death Eaters are also Was imprisoned in Azkaban.
As the Minister of Magic, he has been painstakingly maintaining this peaceful scene over the years, and he has devoted countless efforts to this!
Fudge even suspected that Dumbledore was deliberately trying to create a crisis. After all, everyone knew that he was the only person afraid of the Dark Lord. In this way, Dumbledore could take the opportunity to raise his voice and give himself the Minister of Magic Get it down.
The atmosphere in the principal's room remained stalemate like this, no matter what Dumbledore said, Fudge's faith could not be shaken.
Ivan, who was watching, shook his head secretly. He knew very well that unless Voldemort was resurrected and appeared in front of them, Fudge would not be able to accept the reality. Instead, he would stubbornly feel that this is Dumbledore’s political trick. The purpose is to compete with oneself for power.
After the negotiation for a while, Fudge flicked his sleeves angrily and left, but at this moment, there was another sound of footsteps outside the door.
"It should be Batty here!" Dumbledore said, guessing, turning his head and looking at the door.
Fudge stopped.
As Dumbledore had expected, Crouch quickly walked in from the door, and Moody followed him with a cane.
After entering the door, Moody's blue magic eye swept around in the principal's room, noticed the expressions on the faces of Fudge and Dumbledore, and grinned and spoke.
"It seems that your talks are not going well?"
"Connelly doesn't agree with me..." Dumbledore replied, raising his brows.
"How do you want me to believe you, Albus?" Fudgefu said angrily. "The Ministry of Magic is a place for proof You can't expect me to tell those Aurors—Magic Harry Potter, the world’s savior, had a dream, so they had to spend time and effort to find the mysterious man who had been dead for more than ten years!"
"Not only that, a lot of evidence has always been placed in front of you, Connelly! It's just that you insist on not believing it!" Dumbledore said in a deep voice.
"Evidence? Where is it? Why didn't I see it?" Fudge said with a sneer, then he turned his gaze to the ground again.
"Or, do you mean this scorched corpse with a blind face? No one can prove that he is Barty Crouch Jr.!"
"I can prove it!" Crouch, who had been silent for a long time, took a few steps closer, and he was also looking at the corpse covered with white cloth, with a somewhat complicated expression.
"Connelly! He is my son. I can't make a mistake, and there is no need to lie to you... Besides, I think you should listen to Albus's advice carefully. If there is anything you don't understand , I am happy to answer for you..."
"No, I don't think it's necessary! You're arrested now, Batty!" Fudge said coldly. He waved his hand, and Umbridge immediately surrounded him with people.

chapters.title: Chapter 688: If you had a refreshing point back then, there will be so many things now...
chapters.content:
In the face of the tough law enforcement Auror, Crouch didn't mean to resist, but he was relieved, and he extended his hands to let a few people shack him, and even asked casually.
"It seems that you finally figured it out, Connelly, are you planning to arrest me on charges of favoritism?"
"It is suspected of murdering Bertha Jorkins! She has been missing for almost a year, and you are the last to see her!" Fudge said sharply.
Crouch's expression instantly froze, and he looked at Fudge in disbelief. "I think Dumbledore should have explained it to you. I just used a powerful oblivion spell on Bertha Jorkins, and then she went all the way to Romania, the mysterious man..."
"The mysterious man killed her?" Fudge first said what Crouch wanted to say, and then continued. "Who knows if you are lying? I would rather believe that you want to push all this to the mysterious person!"
"It just so happens that there is a corpse with an invisible face. I suspect that she is Bertha Jorkins!" Fudge indifferently told the Auror to take the scorched corpse away.
Dumbledore watched the movements of Fudge and the Aurors, with a little anger on his face, he knew he could not count on the help of the Ministry of Magic.
"Ah! I almost forgot..." Fudge led someone to the door, suddenly remembered something, and turned his head to look at Ivan. "Halse, if I'm not mistaken, you should have been there at the time, and you just found this corpse, right? So you should follow along and make a transcript."
Ivan laughed at Fudge's remarks. How could he fail to see that Fudge was threatening himself and wanted him to make a false testimony to completely characterize this incident as Crouch's murder of Bertha Jorkins.
Otherwise, it is not that he happened to find the corpse, but that he and Crouch were involved in the murder...
But Ivan is not scared. He is very clear about his reputation in the magical world, and because Dumbledore is here, it is not easy for Fudge to convict himself, so he speaks mercilessly. Sarcastically said.
"I think you need to make up for the relevant knowledge, Minister Fudge!"
"Little Barty died of suicide. You only need to use the flashback spell to test the wand he used to understand this. It has nothing to do with me and Mr. Crouch!"
"In addition, I also need to remind the Minister that even if you can't see your face clearly, professionals can tell the age and gender of a person based on his bones!
The difference between male and female pelvis is the most obvious feature. If you are willing to explain the dead at the scene, you will immediately know that the dead is actually a wizard, not the so-called Bertha Jorkins!
The existing genetic technology of Muggles can also help you confirm his identity. As long as you send it to be tested, the Muggles will accurately tell you that the corpse in front of you is Mr. Crouch's son Barty! "
Ivan analyzed it, then looked at Fudge with contempt and spoke. "Excuse me, do you still have any questions that I need to help answer?"
Fudge was choked directly, and couldn't reply for a long time.
"Halse is right." Moody also said in help at this time. "I heard Crouch said that Auror followed when his son was buried, and I must be able to find the exact burial site of the body. If you don't believe me, you can dig up the grave to take a look and confirm it further!"
"That was all over ten years ago, who will remember the specific location where it was buried..." Fudge shook his head and replied impatiently.
"If they happen to forget, my **** can help them remember!" Dumbledore said suddenly, blocking Fudge's last excuse.
But this also successfully angered Fudge. He looked at Dumbledore, then turned his gaze to Ivan, Moody, and Harry, his expression gradually becoming a little ugly.
"Very good...very good! It seems that you are determined to go against me, right?" Fudge said angrily.
"The only thing I want to deal with is Voldemort! It's not that difficult to find out the truth if you want, Connelly," Dumbledore said in a deep voice.
"I will send someone to investigate the whole thing! There is a meditation basin in the Ministry of Magic, and you don't need your help!" Fudge said through gritted teeth, and then looked at Umbridge and the others.
"let's go!"
Hearing that, the Aurors were relieved, they didn't want to stay here for a moment, and hurriedly brought Crouch and Barty's corpses to follow.
When this group of people walked out of the principal's room, the room suddenly became empty.
"Professor Dumbledore, shall we just let them take Mr. Crouch like this?" Ivan is worried that Fudge will kill people directly after he returns. There is a precedent in the original time and space.
"Don't worry, Hals, Batty will be fine." Dumbledore said relievedly.
"If he had the guts to kill Batty, he wouldn't be afraid to be like that!" Moody sneered.
Crouch's identity is very unusual. He is a pure-blood wizard himself. He was formerly the director of the Executive Department. He has a lot of friends at the Ministry of Magic. Fudge must go through a formal trial if he wants to convict him.
Thinking of this, Moody turned to look at Dumbledore, and suddenly asked without thinking. "Regret it? Albus?"
Dumbledore was silent. Of course he knew what Moody was asking. The current Minister of Magic Fudge was the one he had recommended...
"If you had happily accepted the position of Minister of Magic now there will be so many things..." Moody grumbled dissatisfiedly.
After the Wizarding War ended, the Ministry of Magic had sent people to Hogwarts more than a dozen times to ask Dumbledore to be the Minister of Magic, but all were rejected, so Fudge was finally elected.
"It's not the time to talk about this, Alastor!" Dumbledore didn't want to talk more on this topic. He turned the topic and looked at Harry, asking him to repeat his dream experience.
Harry nodded, remembering hard, trying to speak as carefully as possible about everything he saw through the snake's perspective.
Dumbledore pondered for a long time, and his expression became very solemn when he heard that Voldemort was preparing to slaughter the entire Muggle village to restore his strength.
"Do you think that will be true?" Harry asked nervously.
"It's possible that some advanced black magic rituals require death sacrifices." Dumbledore's brows were tightly locked together. Compared with this, what made him care more about was who Voldemort learned about Jie. The news of Batty's death...

chapters.title: Chapter 689: Voldemort really didn't stop for a moment!
chapters.content:
"Halse, did you and Miss Granger tell anyone about Barty Jr. during this time?" Dumbledore asked.
Ivan shook his head hesitantly. He was very aware of the importance of confidentiality, so he was usually cautious, and Hermione shouldn't talk about it casually.
And Harry and Ron only learned about Barty Crouch Jr. today, and they were at most half insiders before.
"Albus, it shouldn't be the problem with these kids!" Moody frowned and said in a deep voice. "Little Batty has only been dead for a week. Even if a student happens to learn this news, it will never reach that person's ears so quickly."
Today's Voldemort can be said to be a lonely person, and the source of the news is very closed, so someone must have told him this news specifically.
"Could it be revealed by the Ministry of Magic?" Ivan immediately thought of this.
In his opinion, the Ministry of Magic’s intelligence network is similar to a sieve. For example, this year’s Top Three Cup was originally a secret event. As a result, many people knew the news in advance before the start of school. From some intelligence analysis, one of the games may be related to the fire dragon...
Therefore, Ivan wondered whether it was the senior officials of that department who had taken refuge in Voldemort and became the inner support of the Dark Lord.
However, just as Ivan was thinking this way, Dumbledore vetoed his speculation. "There is no such possibility. I only told Fudge about Barty Jr. tonight."
"That's weird. According to this, we should be the only people who know the news..." Moody raised his eyebrows, glanced over Ivan and Harry, and then looked at Deng. Blido said again afterwards. "Is it Batty? Or who did he tell?"
Ivan also thinks this is possible. Only Dumbledore, Moody, Hermione, Crouch and himself knew about this before. If they hadn't revealed it, it would have been Crouch!
"I don't think Barty will speak it lightly! Perhaps it was Voldemort's warning magic on Barty Jr. that let him know all this..." Dumbledore interrupted several people's suspicions, now in form Urgently, they need to unite as much as possible instead of suspicion for no reason!
"In short, the most important thing now is to find out the location of the village and prevent the tragedy from happening." Dumbledore added.
"But when England is so big, how can we determine where the mysterious man is going to attack?" Ron asked puzzled.
Harry only knew that the mysterious man was preparing to launch an attack, but he didn't know the specific location of the village at all. He didn't even have a clue, and he couldn't find it.
"Voldemort is now inconvenient to move, and his strength has not been fully restored. He wants to kill a Muggle village but it is not so easy...so he must choose a suitable location to avoid causing a large-scale riot to interrupt the ceremony!" Ivan muttered Muttering to himself.
Muggles are not stupid, and they don't know how to resist and run away in the face of danger. Not to mention people, even if thousands of pigs are thrown into a village, they can't be killed within a few days.
Moody felt that it was reasonable, so he followed Ivan's thinking and continued to analyze it. "So Voldemort will try his best to choose small villages in remote places. There are certainly not too many Muggles living in them. It is more suitable for dozens or hundreds of people, so we can exclude most of the places!"
Dumbledore nodded and nodded, "One more thing to note, Tom is a person who likes nostalgia, so that the location he wants to attack can almost be locked!"
"Do you mean the village where Tom grew up?" Ivan was speechless, and he could naturally guess where Dumbledore was talking about.
But it is just because I know that I feel shocked. People with a little bit of conscience will not go crazy and slaughter the place where they grew up in childhood.
But Voldemort is obviously an exception.
When I was in the second grade, Ivan learned about Tom's bad childhood from the Horcrux diary. Presumably the Dark Lord had no good feelings about it.
"Yes, if Voldemort really intends to cause a massacre, this is the most likely place!" Dumbledore said in a deep voice.
When he was investigating Horcrux some time ago, he visited that village once. It was sparsely populated, facing the sea, and surrounded by mountains and cliffs. Even if something terrible happened, the Muggle government would not be able to support it for a while.
Thinking of this, Dumbledore turned to look at Moody. "Alastor, since Connelly can't count on it anymore, then I'm afraid we can only act on our own."
"It's time to do this, Albus!" Moody grinned. "Do you need me to find them all?"
"No, I'll let Fox be responsible for informing them..." Dumbledore shook his head. Moody is now the Defence Against the Dark Arts professor at Hogwarts. He needs to prepare for lessons on weekdays. Contact this kind of trivial matter to Phoenix. Just do it.
"Professor Dumbledore, what about us? What should we do?" Harry hurriedly asked, who had not been able to intervene.
"All you need to do is stay in school and protect yourself!" Dumbledore replied earnestly.
"But..." Harry opened his mouth to retort.
"Your safety is as important as protecting the village, Harry!" Dumbledore interrupted Harry's words. "We can't be sure whether Voldemort is actually planning a massacre, or that it is just a cover. So you must be prepared with both hands..."
Then, without waiting for Harry to respond Dumbledore again asked Ivan and others not to disclose what happened tonight, so as not to leak the news again.
"Professor, can I tell Hermione the news?" Ivan asked suddenly. He thought that with Hermione's cleverness, he must be able to extract a lot of information from Harry and Ron, and wanted to hide it from her The difficulty is high.
"Of course, Miss Granger is also a trustworthy person!" Dumbledore nodded.
...
Ten minutes later, Ivan, Harry, and Ron walked out of the principal's room together and walked towards the Gryffindor lounge.
Along the way, several people had a worried expression. Harry and Ron were still immersed in the shocking news that Voldemort wanted to slaughter the village and resurrect.
Ivan sighed helplessly, knowing that his leisurely campus life was about to end before it started, and Voldemort really didn't stop for a moment!
(PS: One more today...)

chapters.title: Chapter 690: Before the game
chapters.content:
Time flew by, and two months passed in a flash.
However, beyond the expectations of Ivan and others, the magical world was very stable during this period, the school's courses were also proceeding as usual, and everything was so peaceful.
Even when he was in the Potions class, Snape rarely asked them for trouble, but his face was still gloomy, and he didn't know if Dumbledore had arranged another task for him.
As it was approaching the end of the term, the little wizards in the castle became more and more urgent as they were no longer leisurely, so that the originally empty library and lounge were suddenly crowded in the afternoon.
As the Warriors, Ivan and Harry have a heavier burden, after all, they still need to prepare for the upcoming third game.
Just as nervous as the two of them is Hermione, who has been sorting out the spells that may be used in the game these days, and ensuring that Ivan and Harry have mastered them all.
"Professor Moody once said that the location of the last game is in a large maze. They will put some ingenious traps and dangerous magical creatures in the passage of the maze as a test... In addition to other warriors. It is also possible to launch an attack on you!"
Hermione talked to Harry about the precautions of the game, and suggested that he practice the offensive spells listed in the list more these days, and be ready to fight the opponents in the maze.
Harry kept nodding his head, but seemed a little absent-minded throughout.
Ron patted him on the shoulder and said comfortingly. "Don't think about mysterious people anymore, Harry! Maybe it's just a nightmare you had. It has been more than two months. If you really want to do it, the mysterious people will already have actions!"
"That can't be a dream, Ron!" Harry retorted. "I didn't even know who Barty Jr. was at the time, but I heard Voldemort mention his death. Do you think it's possible?"
"But even if it's true, we can't do anything now. Compared to this, you might as well think about the game for a few days..." Ron said with his mouth curled.
Harry didn't reply, he knew Ron was right.
In fact, the calm over the past two months has gradually caused him to doubt the authenticity of that dream, worrying that his words will make the professors useless.
Thinking of this, Harry sighed and turned his attention to the long list in front of him, which was a long list of magic spells, most of which he had successfully mastered in the past two months, but such as He still didn't know how to use high-end spells like the Iron Armor Curse.
In contrast, Ivan, who is also a warrior, is much more relaxed.
He had mastered all the basic magic on the list in the early years, and the final exam was never a problem for Ivan, so he became the most laid-back person in the entire lounge, holding a prophet in his hand. Read the daily newspaper carefully.
Before the incident of Barty, Ivan became vigilant, and he paid more and more attention to the importance of intelligence. Reading the newspaper has almost become his daily habit, so as not to miss some key news.
It’s just that during the recent period, the Daily Prophet’s reports are all about the top three matches, otherwise it’s just some lace news, there is not much nutritious content at all, even the arrest of Barty Crouch. Without mentioning a word, Ivan guessed that it was probably suppressed by Fudge.
After reading this for a while, Ivan was suddenly attracted by the content of one of the pages when he thought that today was a lot of lace news.
"You can take a look at this news!" Ivan threw the Daily Prophet on the table and said, pointing to a column of news on it.
Harry, Ron, and Hermione all leaned forward curiously and took a look.
"Three days ago, a Muggle was attacked by a curse?" Hermione said uncertainly after reading the contents of the news.
"Yes! And the place where the accident happened was in the village by the sea!" Ivan said affirmatively.
Although this is not clearly stated in the Daily Prophet, Ivan can still roughly analyze it based on the familiar background in the photos on the layout.
"It must be Peter and Voldemort who started to act, let's go and tell Professor Dumbledore!" Harry threw down the book in his hand happily and was about to run out.
Ivan stretched out his hand to hold him, and said helplessly. "No, Harry! Don't you think that Professor Dumbledore doesn't know the news yet? Don't forget, the professor has always sent someone to stare there!"
"Maybe Professor Dumbledore drove the mysterious man away!" Hermione guessed.
"That said, isn't the mysterious man's plan ruined?" Ron was very pleased. The previous news that the mysterious man planned to slaughter the village and resurrect him scared him enough.
"How easy is it!" Ivan shook his head solemnly, but he felt that Dumbledore and Voldemort hadn't met yet.
Otherwise, based on Voldemort's current half-dead state, it would never be impossible to escape from Dumbledore's hands, and the Daily Prophet did not mention signs of wizard fighting there.
This means that Voldemort is still lurking in the dark waiting for an opportunity.
There was no action for two full months before, and Ivan thought that Voldemort was probably looking for a suitable time to start, such as...the day when the last match of the Goblet of Fire started!
As the referee of the Triwizard Tournament, Dumbledore will stay at Hogwarts that day to preside over the entire game. Without Dumbledore, Voldemort would be more at ease.
This attack may be a temptation , but I don't know how the members of the Order of the Phoenix dealt with it, and whether it exposed their whereabouts and made Voldemort aware of it.
As they were discussing, an owl flew in from the opening of the window. After wandering around in the lounge, he flew straight towards Harry and threw the envelope he was holding on to the table.
Harry unpacked the envelope and pulled out the parchment inside. After reading the contents of the letter clearly, the whole person looked excited.
"Who sent you the letter? What is written on it?" Ivan asked curiously.
"It's Sirius! He said in his letter that in the third game, the Ministry of Magic will invite relatives of the Warriors to watch the game, and he will come to watch that day too!" Harry said with joy, looking very happy. .
"That's good news!" Ivan smiled, but I don't know if Asiah will come. She seems to hate Dumbledore and is always reluctant to enter Hogwarts...
(PS: The state is very bad recently, I won’t be able to adjust for a while, so it’s still a change today, sorry...)

chapters.title: Chapter 691: But it's not that I deliberately avoided him...
chapters.content:
Entering June, the weather gradually warmed, and the time for the start of the third game was getting closer and closer, and the whole castle was filled with tension and excitement.
During this time, Harry has almost become the busiest person at Hogwarts. In addition to class every day, he needs to spend several hours to practice various spells.
However, these efforts were not in vain. Harry's magic level increased rapidly in a large number of battles and exercises, and he had even initially mastered such difficult magic as the Iron Armor Curse.
This also gave him some confidence in the next game.
Of course, this confidence does not mean winning the championship, but being able to complete the game smoothly without making a fool of yourself on the court...
Ivan has not been idle in the past few months either, and has devoted most of his energy to the study of the Transfiguration Curse.
There is a qualitative gap between the seventh-level magic and the sixth-level magic. After some experiments, Ivan found that before the magic power completely dissipated, the creature he deformed was almost the same as the real one.
In addition, he can achieve exaggerated transformations that were impossible to imagine before, such as the fairy tale scene built in the Forbidden Forest a few months ago, or temporarily alienating a tree into a huge treant to assist in the fight... …
And after these days of practice, it has reached the limit of level six.
Although it is impossible to read the mind directly, as long as his eyes meet each other, Ivan can capture the thoughts in a person's mind without chanting a mantra.
However, after gaining this ability, Ivan was not happy at all. He once tried to maintain a full day of panic, but the feedback he received was extremely bad.
The whole world seems to be shrouded in falsehood and malice.
The little wizard who smiled and said hello when he passed by the other second, was filled with deep jealousy in his heart. Two friends who seemed to talk about nothing, had long been grudges secretly, and told each other...
What made Ivan feel helpless is that the feedback he received from several of his friends was not all positive.
So after experimenting for a day, Ivan decisively gave up the idea of ​​keeping mind-consciousness, and if this continued, he worried that he would never find a friend.
Thinking of this, Ivan was also a little emotional. This was just a group of simple-minded children, with so many messy thoughts in his heart. Ivan couldn't imagine what a terrible castle would be if it were all grown-up wizards.
"Halse, Potter! Come here for a minute..." While several people were eating breakfast, McGonagall walked out from the side of the hall and waved at them.
Ivan and Harry looked at each other, and the two stood up together and followed together.
"Professor, isn't the game time at night? What are you looking for us now?" Harry asked strangely.
"Yes, you remember correctly, Potter, the game is tonight." McGonagall nodded and said with a smile. "But the Warriors' family members have been invited to watch the finals. They are now in the conference room. I think you will definitely want to see them before the game..."
While talking, the three of them had already come to the door of the meeting room together, McGonagall twisted the doorknob and pushed the door open, which looked very lively.
Viktor Krum was sitting in the corner of the house with his parents, saying something in Bulgarian. Fleur and Gabriel were also with a middle-aged witch, who was probably her mother.
After Ivan took a look, he withdrew his gaze, and turned his gaze across the conference room. He quickly found Aysia by the stove.
Mrs. Weasley and Sirius were also here. The three seemed to be chatting, but they didn't seem to be having a very happy chat.
Bill on the side smiled bitterly and couldn't intervene at all. When he saw Harry and Ivan coming in, he breathed a sigh of relief and hurriedly said hello.
"Hi, Harry, Hals, this way!"
Bill's words successfully calmed the conflicts between the parents. Aysia gave up the argument with Mrs. Weasley, and immediately turned her attention to Ivan, stepped forward and embraced him enthusiastically.
"Mom, why are you here?" Ivan was both delighted and a little surprised. He thought that Aasia would not step into Hogwarts because of his disgust for Dumbledore.
"Why? Are you not happy to see me come to school?" Aysia pretended to be warm and angry, and squeezed Ivan's cheek with her hand.
"Of course not..." Ivan shook his head hastily.
Aysia laughed, she naturally understood Ivan's doubts, and she explained. "I don't want to be absent for such an important thing as you participate in the Triwizard Tournament, and if you really want to say it, it should be your principal who is worried about meeting me, but it's not that I deliberately avoid him..."
Speaking of this, there was a strong resentment in Aysia's words.
Ivan was very curious, but he didn't ask, and he held the doubt in his heart, because he knew that Aysia would probably not tell him.
At the same time, Sirius and Mrs. Weasley also gathered around Harry and asked for warmth.
Probably because the children were in the meeting room, the atmosphere at the scene eased a lot. After talking to Harry, Mrs. Weasley smiled and hugged Ivan.
Only Sirius kept a straight face, but at least there was no more dispute in the conference room.
Considering how few people can deal with, Ivan took the initiative to let Aysia accompany him to the castle, and stay here awkward.
"It's been a long time since I came to Hogwarts just to see all the changes..." Aisia nodded and readily agreed.
Ivan greeted Harry and the others, and walked out of the meeting room with Aisia.
When passing by the hall, Ivan was surprised to find that the ghosts wandering all around were avoiding them. Even the brave Pippi would flee in horror after seeing Esiah.
Ivan turned to look at his mother, wondering why these ghosts were so afraid of her.
Aysia said with some nostalgia. "When I was in school, I was boring and teasing these ghosts. I didn't expect that after so many years, they still remember..."
The corners of Ivan's mouth twitched, and he felt that it was not just as simple as teasing, because he had also "teased" Pepy Ghost, but it was far less afraid of himself.
From this point of view, Aysia must have used the Fear Curse to toss these ghosts when she was a child, and it is strange that the school hat will specifically complain to herself when she is enrolled...
(PS: One more today)

chapters.title: Chapter 692: Game 3
chapters.content:
If he had cast a fear curse on Pippi Ghost from time to time over the years, he would surely be able to impress himself deeply.
Thinking of this, Ivan smiled, and Aysia was more mischievous than she thought when she was a child.
The two chatted all the way, strolling on the sun-drenched grass, and then went to the Black Lake to look at Boothbarton's luxurious carriage and the huge ghost ship docked by the lake.
After a while of inquiries from the side, Ivan roughly learned that his mother, Isiah, was one year younger than Sirius and Snape. There were not many intersections during the school days, and all the contradictions were accumulated after graduation.
Aysia didn't want to talk much about this matter, and soon shifted the topic to the Finals Cup.
Although the Daily Prophet gave a detailed report on the results and process of each game, even so, she was still very interested in Ivan's defeat of the fire dragon and rescue of the hostages underwater.
Especially the latter, because under the processing of Rita Skeeter, Ivan’s rescue operation at the bottom of the lake has been rendered into a vulgar love triangle love story-the warrior Ivan Hals and his beloved Gran Miss Jie kissed her love at the bottom of the lake, but on the way back, they accidentally ran into Miss Delacour who was in trouble...
The following story is extremely bloody, Rita Skeeter even spent a full five elements to demonstrate why Ivan would prefer to save Fleur, who is also a warrior, ashore instead of Hermione as a hostage.
After listening to Aysia's narration, Ivan couldn't help wondering if Rita Skeeter was tired of life and dared to write anything for the sake of sales, but under Aysia's inquiring eyes, he had no choice but to explain.
"Mom, Fleur and I have only met a few times. There is no such messy emotional entanglement at all. She was saved because of Hermione's suggestion..."
"What about Miss Granger? I saw in the Daily Prophecy that she was still your dancing partner. Is that also a fake?" Aysia asked with a grin.
Ivan was speechless at once, and after Aysia's repeated questioning, she only vaguely said that she had a very good relationship with herself.
But it didn’t take long for Ivan to regret it, because while eating lunch, Aysia showed great enthusiasm for Hermione, and even frankly inquired about the little witch’s family situation, which made Ivan next to him very awkward. Embarrassing, he thought this progress was too fast.
Hermione also seemed to be fidgeting. She didn't know where to go before, and she stammered when answering Aysia's questions.
In the afternoon, the entire auditorium was decorated, and the flags of the three major schools fluttered in the air, looking very grand.
Towards the evening, Minister of Magic Fudge showed up in the hall with a few Aurors, with a dark face all the way, and smiled reluctantly when meeting Dumbledore.
Fortunately, none of this has anything to do with Ivan. He is listening to Esiah's nagging while enjoying today's dinner.
Harry wasn't so leisurely beside him. The game that was about to start made him nervous, so even if today's dinner was a lot richer than usual, he didn't want to enjoy it.
When the last little wizard ate and drank enough to put down the knife and fork in his hand, Dumbledore cleared his throat and stood up from the staff table and spoke.
"Ladies and gentlemen, in five minutes, I will invite everyone to the Quidditch Stadium to watch the final event of the Triwizard Tournament. Now I invite the Warriors and Mr. Bagman to the sports field."
Ivan Shishiran got up and walked out of the auditorium with Harry in the attention of everyone. Fleur and Krum also got up from their seats and walked out together.
Bagman had waited for them outside the hall early, and after seeing Ivan, his face suddenly showed a thick smile.
"Warriors, follow me!" Bagman greeted him, and then led Ivan and others toward the Quidditch Stadium.
On the way, Bagman explained the rules of the third game for several people in great detail.
The whole game was played in a huge maze, and the Goblet of Fire representing the final victory was placed in the center of the maze. The condition for winning is that the Warriors get the Goblet of Fire and get out of the maze smoothly!
"Mr. Bagman, wouldn't the scoring in the first two games be useless in that case?" Harry asked strangely.
Fleur and Krum were very happy because they were too far behind in the previous game. If the third game is still on the points system, they will have no chance of winning.
However, before they were happy for long, Bagman replied with a smile. "No, of course it is useful. The higher the score, the sooner the warrior will enter the maze... For example, Hals, he can enter at least three minutes earlier than you!"
The expressions on Furong and Krum's faces suddenly darkened, and Ivan's strength was far above them. If he entered the maze first, the advantage would be too great!
What's more, Bagman said at least three minutes, which means that Harry, who is now ranked second in the score, needs to wait three minutes to enter, and they will only wait longer if the score is more behind!
The only thing that makes them feel fortunate is that the Warriors won't win on the spot after getting the trophy. They can also choose to volley Ivan out of the labyrinth and grab the Goblet of Fire!
To understand this, Krum deliberately fell behind a few positions and turned to look at Furong, seeking her support.
Krum knew very well that it was impossible for him to grab the trophy from Ivan's hands alone. Only when they united could they have such a chance of winning.
Furong did not directly agree to but hesitated. Ivan helped her a lot in the last game, and she didn't want to avenge her revenge unless necessary.
Just when several people were thinking about it, Bagman had taken them to the Quidditch Stadium.
Compared with the previous days, this place has completely changed its appearance. A hedge of twenty feet high surrounds the edge of the field, but a gap is deliberately left in the front.
Looking in from the entrance, the inside is pitch black, and you can only vaguely see the deep intersecting passages...
About five minutes later, under the leadership of Dumbledore, the students entered the surrounding stands one after another, crowded with noisy voices.
Ivan, Harry, Fleur, and Krum stood at the entrance of the maze, waiting for all the audience to arrive.
A huge crystal ball has been suspended in the sky above the labyrinth. Its function is similar to that of the second game. After the game officially begins, the little wizards in the paddock will relay the wonderful performance of the warriors.
This was also the last insurance Ivan specially prepared, lest Harry would be looted in the maze like the original time and space.

chapters.title: Chapter 693: Between 2 points, the shortest straight line!
chapters.content:
When all the spectators on the paddock were all there, McGonagall walked over here with four patrol members, and said with a solemn expression.
"During the game, we will always patrol the outside of the maze. If you encounter difficulties in the game and want to be rescued, you will shoot red sparks into the sky, and we will come to help as soon as possible."
"But firing the flames means that the Warriors give up a thorough game. The specific weighing is up to you!" Bagman added.
Ivan and the others nodded together.
"Okay, let's start the official game now!" Bagman cleared his throat and blessed himself with a loud curse with his wand, then looked at the crowd on the stage and shouted loudly.
"Ladies and gentlemen, the last match of the Triwizard Tournament is about to begin! I'll report the current score!"
"First of all, Ivan Hals, the warrior of Hogwarts, who cleared the game with full marks and currently has a total of 100 points!"
After Bagman's voice fell, there was a warm applause in the paddock. Ivan gestured to the surroundings with restraint, and several friends were beckoning to him under his glance.
"Then Mr. Harry Potter! He ranked second with a good score of 82 points!" Bagman continued yelling.
The applause in the audience rang again, and when Bagman talked about Fleur and Krum, the cheers suddenly became much smaller. Only Boothbarton and Demstrang wizards were present in the audience. Applause desperately.
After Bagman fully mobilized the audience's atmosphere, he reached out to Ivan and spoke.
"Now... please prepare the warrior Ivan Hals and listen to my whistle action!"
"Three...two...one, start!" Bagman counted loudly.
With a short whistle, Ivan rushed into the maze first.
Although the first two games have won him a lot of advantages, in order to ensure the victory of the game, the time to get the Goblet of Fire is naturally the sooner the better, so as to avoid any baskets in the middle.
Not to mention that he still needs some time to check whether there is a problem with the Goblet of Fire, so after rushing into the maze, Ivan quickly explored without any delay.
However, Ivan soon discovered that the entire maze was bigger than he had imagined, and it was dark and scary. Only tall hedges could be seen all around. Entering it was like being separated from the outside world. The audience was enthusiastic. The cheers and applause stopped abruptly, probably because of some soundproof magic blessed.
"Lumos~ (fluorescence flashing Ivan waved his wand, a ray of light lit up from the top of the wand, spreading in all directions.
After traveling for about fifty steps, Ivan suddenly noticed that there was a fork in the road ahead, which was divided into two passages, one on the left and the other on the right.
"Left or right?" Ivan hesitated.
Once you choose the wrong one, it may take a lot of time to get around.
So Ivan didn't choose either, instead he set his sights on the huge hedge in front of him.
"I remember what's the shortest between two points?" Ivan touched his chin. He remembered that Bagman didn't seem to say that he couldn't break it when he read the rules.
"Of course it is the shortest straight line! Reducto~" Ivan tapped his finger lightly, his wand pointed forward, and a crimson light beam passed by, and the harsh roar sounded.
When the dust cleared, there was an irregular gap in the tall hedge in front of him. Ivan clenched his wand and walked directly in through the gap, followed by another harsh explosion.
Since he couldn't find the right way, he just made one!
"Violation, this is a serious violation!" On the judges stand outside the stadium, Karkaroff looked at the picture displayed by the crystal ball, patted the table angrily, and shouted.
Dumbledore, who also watched this scene, was also very helpless. Obviously following the regular process, Ivan would definitely be able to win the championship, but he happened to think of some crooked ideas every time.
"Strictly speaking, there is no mandatory requirement in the game that the players cannot break these hedges, Karkaroff..." Dumbledore explained in a deep voice, "You should be aware that a special reinforcement spell has been cast on this. Ordinary wizards want to destroy it, it takes a lot of time and energy, and it is no easier than going through a maze!"
Having said this, Dumbledore paused and looked at the crystal ball floating high in the sky, and continued to speak. "And I think... Mr. Hals will soon pay for his actions!"
Karkaroff and Maxim were dubious, and when they looked up, they saw that the form in the maze had changed.
Ivan's irritable behavior of opening the way with magic was like awakening the entire silent maze, and monsters in the dark emerged from every corner.
"Diffindo~ (split to pieces Ivan waved his wand, killed a giant spider that was trying to attack him with the splitting curse, and then pointed the wand at the opening that had just been blasted out.
One by one, the long crab feet came in through the opening, and after the thing got out, Ivan discovered that it was a huge fried snail with a length of several meters.
It looks like a combination of a giant scorpion and a weird crab. Its hard and heavy shell is full of hideous barbs. What is even more terrifying is that a hot flame suddenly spurted from the tail of this snail. The powerful propulsion force made the snails smashed over quickly like a long thorn iron ball.
There is almost no way to escape in the narrow maze aisle Ivan inspired the ring of magic power at the moment when the snails collided with the tail snails, and then only took advantage of the strength to jump up, and the 17 magic words on the bracelet were instantly Lighted up, a shock wave of magic power took his body to avoid the impact of the snails.
The huge size of the snails couldn’t hold back at all. After being evaded by Ivan, they ran into the hedge behind. Several sharp crab feet plunged deeply into the cracks in the wall, half of their body was full. Got stuck.
Of course, Ivan would not let this opportunity pass, waving his wand was a smashing curse hitting it.
The huge hard shell of the snails was stronger than he had imagined. After eating a spell, the hard shell just cracked open, but the snails were still alive and kicking.
However, the cracking of the hard shell broke a certain balance. Just when the snails burst into flames again, the whole body suddenly exploded, and the sky was raining blood everywhere.
"What kind of strange creature is this?"
Ivan looked at the hard shells and minced meat all over the floor and shook his head. It seemed that the deep-fried snails cultivated by Hagrid still needed improvement.

chapters.title: Chapter 694: Aggrieved Sphinx
chapters.content:
After getting the fried snails, Ivan did not delay for a moment, and quickly passed through the hole just exploded.
He knew that the explosion sounded just now would definitely attract more monsters. If you don't want to get into endless battles, you must move quickly!
Ivan walked all the way in the dark, exploring the dim maze with only a little fluorescence from the tip of the wand.
Just when he felt that he was slowly approaching the center of the maze, an extremely strange monster suddenly came into view, leaning across the front like a statue.
It looks like a terrifyingly big lion, with a majestic body and terrifying feet, but what makes people feel strange is that its head is just like an intellectual witch.
"Sphinks!" Ivan muttered to himself.
He had seen this kind of monster in "The Book of Monsters". It was a kind of magical creature from ancient Egypt. The wizards there liked to use sphinx to guard some precious treasures. In his previous life, he was reading ancient Greek mythology. I was also impressed by it when I was in.
"Stop, young man!"
Before Ivan could approach, Sphinx stepped into the middle of the road, staring at Ivan with long almond eyes, and said in a hoarse and low voice. "You need to answer my question to move on!"
"Sorry, I'm in a hurry! Sphinx, can you give me a little bit?" Ivan asked, holding his wand.
"This is the rule! Only the warriors who guessed right are qualified to move on! Otherwise, you can find another way to the end." Sphinx raised his head arrogantly.
After ignoring Ivan, Sphinx cleared his throat and happily prepared to start the guessing game.
After thinking about this riddle for several days, it was never so easy to be guessed...
"Confringo~ (Thunderbolt explosion
Just when Sphinx was about to speak, Ivan raised the wand first, and a hot flame floated out from the top of the wand, and then quickly expanded, becoming a two-meter-diameter one. The big fireball rushed towards the Sphinx with amazing power.
The scorching fire occupies all of its vision, and at the same time blocked Sphinx's words back.
Before it could react, the huge fireball had flown over its head and hit the towering hedge behind it.
The fire blasted into the sky, and the huge roar echoed continuously in the narrow passage. The accompanying billowing heat wave almost ignited its hair. Sphinx’s long almond eyes stared big and stiff. Turning his head, he found that the hedge behind him had collapsed halfway.
"Can I go there? Sphinx?" Ivan put down his wand and asked again.
Sphinx swallowed and spit, moved his body to shrink into the corner, and pointed his paw to the road ahead. "Please, sir!"
"Thank you!" Ivan nodded in satisfaction, put away his wand and walked towards the opening that had just been blown out.
Only when he passed by Sphinx, the huge behemoth suddenly moved. Ivan subconsciously thought that Sphinx wanted to sneak attack him, so he drew his wand and pointed it at the fastest speed.
Sphinx hurriedly fell down, said that he was harmless to humans and animals, and said aggrievedly. "Sir, I just want to remind you that the answer to the question is a spider!"
Ivan looked at the sphinx in front of him speechlessly. It seemed that the "Monster Book of Monsters" was correct. They really liked guessing.
But he doesn't even know the content of the riddle. What's the use of telling him the answer?
Ivan shook his head, too lazy to pay attention to this guy, and continued to move forward.
After climbing over a collapsed hedge, Ivan finally saw the goal of the trip. The tri-final trophy representing the final victory was placed on a large base one meter high.
Ivan cautiously approached the base, his nerves strained to the extreme, guarding against any abnormalities at any time, and after approaching, he gently knocked on the trophy with his magic wand.
Magic power invaded down the mouth of the cup, and slowly the whole trophy lit up.
"Very well, it's a real trophy, no one was touched!" After Ivan used the detection magic to probe for a while, he finally let go of his mind and picked up the trophy.
...
At the same time, Harry, who was in the second action, stepped into this huge maze amid the sharp whistle.
Entering here is like entering another space. The noise and noise outside instantly disappeared without a trace, replaced by a huge roar after another.
Of course Harry knew that these noises were made by Ivan, so he simply followed the direction of the sound.
However, Harry soon regretted his reckless decision, and he was attacked four times after only two or three hundred meters.
The most difficult thing to deal with is the snails cultivated by Hagrid. The hard shell with spikes on his back is extremely stiff. After casting a split spell several times in a row, he couldn't break through the opponent's defense, and finally hit by accident. The soft abdomen of the fried snail was able to solve it.
So after entering for a few minutes, Harry was already disgraced. The maze was even more dangerous than he thought. If it hadn’t been for these months of training, his spell level had improved a lot, and he would have been forced to give up the game long ago. , Applied for off-site support.
Harry ran forward panting, and when he crossed an aisle corner, he suddenly felt the ground shake.
Is there an earthquake?
Harry was confused, and when he was a little confused, he saw Ivan's figure appearing on the other side of the passage.
"Ivan!"
Harry greeted happily, knowing he didn't have to stay in this dangerous maze.
Ivan on the other side naturally saw Harry but he didn't mean to say hello at all, and shouted solemnly.
"Run back, Harry!"
Harry's steps stopped, and then he saw a few crab feet over two meters long sticking out from the end of the tunnel, followed by a hard carapace and a huge body.
That's deep-fried snails!
And it's a bunch of fried snails!
Seeing this scene, Harry's scalp is tingling. How many of this monster Hagrid has he kept?
What made him even more shocked was that in addition to the snails, giant spiders, red hats, and some weird creatures that could not recognize specific species also appeared.
Harry couldn't help wondering if Ivan had brought the monsters in the entire maze!
But it was obviously not about this time. Before Ivan reminded him again, Harry hurriedly turned around and ran...
It's just that compared to their running speed, the monsters are obviously faster...

chapters.title: Chapter 695: What, the game is over before I start?
chapters.content:
Boom~
When the two ran all the way, the tail of the snails that followed behind spewed huge flames from time to time, and they approached at an unimaginable speed. The faint vibration on the ground just now was caused by them.
In front of them, there were some giant spiders out of thin air on the unobstructed road, and they waved their forelimbs ferociously. Harry understood that it was a demonstration before the attack.
"Petrificus~ (all petrochemicals
"Reducto~ (Bone to pieces
...
Harry struggled to cast spells one after another, petrifying a giant spider and blasting its head, but in this gap, another giant spider jumped directly from the side hedge and leaped at him.
When Harry realized that something was wrong, eight shining black eyes and sharp mouthparts were already in front of him, and Harry finally realized that these spiders were all crawling over the tall hedge.
It was only now that it occurred to him that it was obviously late, and the stench from his mouthparts was blowing over his face, almost fainting Harry directly.
Fortunately, Ivan, who was beside him, cast a spell in time to blast the giant spider away, and used a blasting spell to clear all the spiders that were blocking the road.
Harry breathed a sigh of relief slowly, but he couldn't let go of the heart he had been holding. He turned his head and glanced, the snails were getting closer and closer to them under the flame jet.
"Ivan, what should we do now?" Harry asked anxiously. He felt that his two legs were unlikely to beat these monsters.
"Reassure, it's not difficult to solve them!" Ivan said relievedly.
When he reached the end of a passage, Ivan stopped running, but stopped directly, waving his wand and pointing at the snails.
An astonishing wave of magic power swept in all directions with the wand as the center. Under the action of the Transformation Curse, one after another thick vines stretched out from the hedge, forming a large net crisscrossing vertically and horizontally.
The few front snails had no time to stop and ran into them directly, and the terrifying impact broke the sturdy trees and vines apart.
But this "big net" is too dense and too thick, and being caught in it is like stepping into a quagmire. A steady stream of tree vines gushing out from both sides, winding the bulky snails. Strictly.
Harry ran for a while, and when he heard that there was no movement behind him, he panted and stopped. Turning his head, he was shocked to find that the entire aisle was blocked by dense trees and vines. You could still vaguely see inside. Things are struggling hard.
"Since you can solve them, what were we running just now?" Harry asked strangely.
Ivan did not answer, and pointed at the hedge above.
Harry followed Ivan’s direction and looked up, and saw a few giant spiders crawling over from the other side of the hedge.
"You see, there are too many of them! The fight is endless..." Ivan explained, waving his magic wand and knocking down the spiders one by one.
Harry nodded, and then it became clear that the key to winning is to bring the trophies back. There is indeed no need to consume them here.
The two of them ran all the way in the maze. Except for the towering hedges, there were only monsters that came from time to time. If Ivan knew that he was walking along the passage that was blown up when he came, he would almost doubt himself. Will you get lost.
After about half a minute, Ivan led Harry through the last corner, and the exit of the maze finally appeared in front of them.
Unexpectedly, Fleur Delacour, the warrior of Boothbaton, stood beside the exit, as if he had just entered the maze...
When she saw Ivan running over with the trophy, Furong was stunned.
"Hi, Furong!" Seeing that Furong didn't mean to attack him, Yifan greeted her kindly, and then ran past Furong without stopping.
Furong couldn't react until Ivan disappeared behind her, her face was full of astonishment.
Is the game over?
But she just came in...
...
"Mr. Bagman, is it not time yet?"
At the same time, on the field outside the maze, Krum anxiously asked Ludo Bagman next to him.
Now almost seven minutes have passed since Ivan’s departure. Although he could not see the picture in the crystal ball as a warrior, he guessed based on the reflections of the surrounding audience. Krum felt that Ivan might have successfully won the trophy. , And he has to wait here.
"Almost... Almost... wait a minute!" Bagman didn't want to pay attention to Krum at all, staring at the picture in the crystal ball with his eyes, dealing with it in a perfunctory manner.
Krum had no choice but to stand still and waited anxiously.
About ten seconds later, Bagman suddenly became excited. Just when Krum thought he was about to announce that he was officially starting the game, he saw Ivan running out of the maze, still holding it in his hand. A golden trophy, held high, is very dazzling.
"Awesome! I declare that the victory belongs to the warrior of Hogwarts-Ivan Hals!" Bagman hissed and shouted, his voice resounding throughout the arena under the blessing of a loud curse. .
In fact, before Bagman spoke, Dumbledore had already clapped, and the little wizards in the audience cheered enthusiastically.
After all, the crystal ball that had been suspended in mid-air faithfully recorded everything that happened in the maze, and naturally included the scene where Ivan successfully won the trophy.
Krum was stunned and stayed in place.
He hasn't started yet, so the game is over?
After Ivan walked out of the maze, Harry quickly followed him, followed by the lonely Fleur.
But when Fleur saw Krum, who was still standing in front of the maze and hadn't figured out the situation, a little smile suddenly appeared on her face, because she realized that she was not the most unlucky one.
"Very well, the warriors have come out..." Bagman turned his head to look at Krum with a smile, patted him on the shoulder, and said earnestly. "Let's go together, Krum, the referees will make a simple ranking based on the Warriors' performance in the third game..."
Although the candidates for the championship have now been determined, the remaining Warriors still need to be ranked.
"But... Mr. Bagman, I haven't entered yet..." Krum asked hurriedly.
"So, you might be at the bottom this time, Mr. Krum!" Bagman looked at Krum sorrowfully, but his words were somewhat gloating.

chapters.title: Chapter 696: Can I touch your trophy?
chapters.content:
After making a few words about Krum, Bagman greeted the warriors to go to the podium together.
Dumbledore, Karkaroff and Maxim have all been waiting there, and Fudge replaced Crouch as the fifth referee of the game.
After the Warriors stood up, several referees discussed in low voices for a while. Taking into account the facial problems of Boothbatten and Durmstrang, they finally decided unanimously to omit the scoring link and directly announce the result.
The ugly faces of Maxim and Karkaroff only eased a little.
"Next, let us announce the final results of the Warriors!" After the discussion, Bagman cleared his throat, walked to the front of the stage, and shouted loudly.
"First is the first place, the final winner of this Triwizard Tournament, the warrior of Hogwarts-Mr. Ivan Hals!"
"Let us cheer for him!"
After Bagman's voice fell, thunderous applause broke out in the arena, and many little wizards stood up excitedly and shouted in excitement.
"Great, I knew Hals would definitely win the championship!"
"Did you see it? That's our Gryffindor warrior!"
...
In the warm cheers and shouts, the corners of Ivan's mouth slightly curled up, and his right hand held the trophy high and gestured to the surroundings, feeling very happy.
This is not only because of the championship, but more importantly, the system task that was taken before has finally been completed.
[Task: Defeat the Goblet of Fire (completed)
Mission: Participate in the Triwizard Tournament and win the championship!
Task reward: legendary value*3
Mission description: Under your careful planning, this tournament jointly organized by the three major magic schools in Europe has become your personal show. Your outstanding performance and legendary deeds will be loaded with this special tournament. history! 】
Looking at the task information displayed in the system panel, Ivan felt a little awkward, but he couldn't tell what was wrong. After thinking about it, I realized that the task description was too normal, but it made him a little uncomfortable.
While Ivan was distracted, Bagman on the stage kept reading the results of the game.
The second place is rightly owned by Harry. Compared to the other players, he walked around the maze and subdued the snails and a few giant spiders, which is also a good performance.
Bussbarton's Warriors Fleur followed in third place.
As for Krum... Naturally, he can only be the bottom, the last.
When Bagman announced the result loudly, Karkaroff's face was ugly and scary, and Demstrang's little wizards glared at Krum, thinking that he was ashamed of Demstrang.
Furong's situation is a little better. With Krum's background, she is not likely to be complained by the students at the same school, but some of the girls in Boothbarton still criticize her in private. After all, Furong's last two games The reality of the project is terrible.
Amidst the festivities, Fudge, the Minister of Magic, also smiled a little more. The victory of the Goblet of Fire was not just a matter of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, but also related to him as the Minister of Magic. Achievements and the face of the magic world in England!
So after Ivan finished the award-winning speech for several minutes, Fudge personally stepped forward as the award-giver and presented Ivan with the award for this competition-a whole thousand gold gallons were all packed in a bag. Here, Ivan felt heavy when he held it in his hand.
"Finally, please allow me to say one more thing!"
Dumbledore stood up suddenly after the closing ceremony, and his loud voice reverberated continuously in the arena, even suppressing the noisy voices of the little wizards.
For a while, the surroundings fell into a brief silence, and the little wizards all looked at Dumbledore on the judges' stage.
Under everyone's attention, Dumbledore flicked his wand lightly, and a purple beam of light rose into the sky, and exploded after a moment.
Colorful flags and petals in the sky continued to fall from the sky, covering the entire Quidditch stadium...
"Tonight I can acquiesce you to violate some less important school rules, so celebrate, that's all I want to say..." Dumbledore said with a smile.
George and Fred immediately jumped up happily, which means they can move out their usual inventory for use.
The other little wizards also ran down from the stands, rushing towards the podium, and surrounded the warriors in the middle.
"Ivan, you are amazing. You defeated so many monsters in the maze..." Seamus squeezed in front of Ivan and excitedly said the shocking scene he saw in the crystal ball before. .
Then Seamus turned his gaze to the golden trophy in Ivan's hand, his cheeks flushed, and he asked with some embarrassment. "Can I touch your trophy, Ivan?"
"Of course no problem!" Ivan handed the trophy generously.
Seamus took it with trembling hands, as if holding some treasure, very happy.
Just before he could hold it securely, George and Fred snatched the trophy in his hand. They also wanted to touch Ivan's trophy and get a touch of joy!
Watching this scene, Ivan shook his head amusedly, and talked to Esiah on his own, letting George and the others take the trophy to play, it was not very valuable anyway.
He has identified it a long time ago. Regardless of the gorgeous golden appearance of the trophy, it is actually not made of real gold...
The degree of stinginess of the Ministry of Magic can be seen.
"You shouldn't approve of their violation of school rules, Albus..." McGonagall said helplessly while looking at the noisy crowd underneath the audience stand. UU reading www.uukanshu.com
I don't know who threw a few booming fireworks in the venue. For a time, brilliant sparks splashed around, causing a lot of riots. McGonagall was very worried that someone would be injured in such a push.
"But this is indeed a day to celebrate, isn't it? Minerva? There is nothing wrong with relaxing properly..." Dumbledore replied.
McGonagall shook his head, and stopped arguing, but went straight to the business. "When should we go to that village?"
"Of course it is now. Voldemort may act at any time... If it is delayed, they may not be able to wait." Dumbledore said intentionally.
"But if we are all gone, what will Hogwarts do?" McGonagall couldn't help but hesitate.
"Sirius will be by Harry's side at any time tonight, and Severus and Flitwick will stay to protect the safety of the students." Dumbledore explained.
"In addition, the Aurors brought by Fudge will stay here before clearing the maze and transporting all the dangerous magical creatures away. If there is any accident, they will never sit back and watch the students get hurt..."

chapters.title: Chapter 697: You haven't congratulated Harry yet...
chapters.content:
Hearing Dumbledore's words, McGonagall nodded, so it seemed that even if they were not there, the safety of the students didn't need to be worried.
Thinking about this, McGonagall suddenly turned his head to look at Ivan who was surrounded by the crowd, and suddenly pursed his lips and laughed. "I guess the mysterious person would not have expected Hals to end this game so quickly!"
"Perhaps..." Dumbledore said non-committal.
...
"Halse, our hero!"
"Gryffindor's warrior... Hogwarts star!"
On the temporary award platform, a large number of over-excited little wizards lifted Ivan up and threw them into the air, screaming and cheering constantly echoed in the arena.
The colorful flags and petals of various colors in the sky fell like raindrops, which lasted for several minutes without stopping.
When they fall on the ground or on a person, these petals will collapse and disappear without a trace. Obviously, all of this is transformed by magic.
Such a wide range of transformation magic made Ivan speechless and weighed it secretly in his heart.
If there is a period of preparation, Ivan thinks that he should be able to create similar scenes, but the coverage may be smaller.
Looking at it this way, the gap between him and Dumbledore is still very large in terms of the knowledge of Transfiguration. After all, the old professor was obviously only on a whim when he was casting spells, and he did it casually...
After a while, the little wizards of Gryffindor finally released Ivan from the air.
But Ivan couldn't be idle for a moment, because soon more little wizards came up and asked about his exciting experience in the maze.
Compared with Ivan, who was surrounded by many enthusiastic students, the other warriors were much deserted.
Maxim and a few Busbarton girls were comforting Fleur softly.
Karkaroff kept his face black all the time, resisting the urge to swear, and pulled Krum away directly. The students of Demstrang also had no face to stay here, disappointed with Karkaroff. Leave.
Harry, who is also a Hogwarts warrior, was squeezed aside by the crowd. Although from time to time there will be little wizards congratulating him on his second place, but most of the students will choose to go to Ivan's side. Only Ron and Xiao Sirius was still around him.
"You are really amazing, Harry!" Ron reached out and hammered Harry in the chest, talking like a cannon.
"I saw it in that crystal ball. You defeated a few giant spiders and a snail in the maze alone. God, I bet that snail must be fifteen feet long and the one on the back The pointed shell is harder than steel... even if an adult wizard encounters it, it will never be able to pick it up. Unexpectedly, you will succeed in defeating it!"
With Ron's constant boasting, Harry's expression became more and more embarrassed. "It's no big deal, Ron... Ivan managed to solve a dozen snails in one go."
"No, that's different, Harry!" Ron shook his head. "Did you not listen to Professor Dumbledore? Ivan is the best genius in Hogwarts' history, even a mysterious person inferior to him! "
"Although you are not as powerful as Ivan, but you also defeated the warriors of Boothbarton and Demstrang, there is no doubt." Ron emphasized.
"That's just because of your help, and luck is better..." Harry said embarrassedly. He knew how much he was capable.
Without everyone's help, he would probably die in the dragon's mouth in the first game. It would be impossible for him alone to think of using a flying broom and a curse to capture the dragon egg.
"Come on, besides you, the other warriors also have someone to help. This is the same for everyone, but you can be much better than them during the game!"
Ron talked freely about Harry's wonderful performance in every game.
For example, in the second game, when he encountered a mermaid at the bottom of the lake, Krum transformed into a ferocious shark head but was beaten by the mermaid. Furong chased him all the way in a panic, and finally fell into a trap. .
But Harry easily drove the mermaids away by magic...
"And when you were dealing with that Hungarian hornet, you could fly better than Krum!" Ron said appreciatively.
Harry looked at Ron very unexpectedly. He knew how much Ron admired Krum. Before, he posted a portrait of Krum in the dormitory. He even wanted to get out of the bed and let Krum sleep in the dormitory. in!
Ron noticed Harry's eyes, shrugged, and replied freely. "Oh, please don't look at me like that... Harry, it’s true that I liked Krum before, but I’ve seen him clearly these days! I don’t admire a warrior who makes a fool of every game, he is at best. Just a little talent for flying!"
At this point, Ron's words paused, and he looked at Harry with a pair of eyes, hesitated for a long time, then hesitated.
"And... the last time, I'm sorry, Harry! I shouldn't have said that, let alone doubt you..."
"It seems that you finally figured it out, that's really good..." Harry said irritably. He had explained so many times, but Ron was regarded as a deaf ear. It has been more than half a year before he finally came here. Apologize.
Ron smiled awkwardly, when he was about to say something, Sirius suddenly interrupted.
"Want to relax with me? Harry?"
"What? Now?" Harry turned his head and looked at Sirius somewhat unexpectedly, then immediately thought of something, and shook his head quickly. "No, I'm fine, I forgave Ron a long time ago..."
"It has nothing to do with this I want to talk to you alone... Just the two of us, how about? It's too noisy here..." Sirius looked away from the referee's bench Come, said with a smile.
"Can't you say it here? What about Ron? He can't follow either?" Harry was puzzled.
