"That's what Dumbledore meant..." Sirius's eyes were a little erratic.
"What task did the professor arrange for me?" Harry thought of this subconsciously.
"Yes, you can say the same, you should know where they are now...so we'd better hurry up so as not to delay things!" Sirius said urgently.
Harry nodded and agreed, giving Ron an apologetic look...
Sirius laughed, clutching Harry's wrist tightly, and leading him away.
Ron looked at the two people leaving behind for a moment.
He suddenly remembered that until now, Sirius has not congratulated Harry for his good results in the Triwizard Tournament...

chapters.title: Chapter 698: Too many people are fascinated by him
chapters.content:
"Wait... Harry!" Ron gritted his teeth and called out the two who were about to leave.
"What's the matter? Ron?" Harry stopped, turned his head to look at Ron, and asked in surprise.
Sirius also stopped, staring at Ron coldly.
Under the gaze of the two, Ron became more and more nervous.
Although he thought Sirius' behavior today was very weird, he was not 100% sure of this, and he even doubted whether he was too mindful.
The jokes he had made in the past because of his profligacy even flooded his mind, interrupting Ron's courage to question.
"I mean, if you really want to leave, shouldn't you inform the professor first..." Ronka stammered after a while.
While talking, Ron turned his gaze to look at the judges' desk. He really didn't have confidence in his judgment, so he wanted to ask the professors in the school for help.
However, Ron looked around and could not find a few professors and referees. Only a few Aurors were standing on the periphery of the maze, barely maintaining order.
"Don't read it, Dumbledore and the others have received the news that they have gone to the village early." Sirius said slowly, a slight smile appeared between the corners of his mouth.
After a pause, he looked at Harry again and continued. "So he asked me to take Harry along with him after the game, so as to protect him... McGonagall, Moody, and the others are there too!"
Sirius's reason seemed invulnerable to Ron, and his heart became more inclined to guess that his guess was wrong, and his tone became weaker. "Then do you want to talk to Ivan...you haven't had time to congratulate him on winning the game..."
"No, no need!" Sirius looked very impatient.
But he soon realized that his tone was wrong, and quickly remedied it. "I mean it's not too late to celebrate! And Ivan is different from us. He wants to stay to protect Hogwarts. It's impossible to leave!"
"Now we should go, Harry! Dumbledore will be anxious if we wait any longer!" Sirius didn't want to spend time with Ron here, pulling Harry's wrist and pulling slightly hard. he is gone.
Harry was confused at all, but out of trust in Sirius, he gave Ron an apologetic look and followed.
Ron, who was left alone, hesitated. He thought about Sirius' words just now, vaguely feeling something was wrong, but for a while, he couldn't find out what was wrong.
Watching Harry and Sirius disappear into the Quidditch Stadium, Ron gritted his teeth and immediately decided to discuss with Ivan and Hermione.
"Get out... give in!"
Ron rushed directly into the crowd, squeezing hard towards the podium.
Halfway through, I don't know who threw a few fireworks over. With a muffled sound, brilliant sparks splashed around, and the billowing smoke choked Ron even more.
"Damn it!"
Ron scolded secretly, but he had no time to investigate which **** had lost it, and continued to look for Ivan in the crowd.
At this moment, a hand suddenly stretched out and pressed it on his shoulder.
Ron was taken aback at once, and he turned his head hurriedly before discovering that it was George who had intercepted him.
"Little Ronnie, what are you doing in such a hurry? Don't you celebrate with us?" George looked at him with a grin, and stuffed a few fireworks into Ron's hand.
Fred also introduced. "This is our newly improved fireworks, you should have experienced it, how about it? Not bad, right?"
Hearing what they said, Ronner still knew that they were teasing him just now, and he was furious for a while.
"I don't have time to play with you..." Ron said angrily, stuffing the booming firework that George had handed back into their arms, and then anxiously continued to ask. "Right! Where's the Ivan?"
George and Fred looked at each other, not understanding why Ron was so angry, but seeing his seriousness, George pointed to the right.
"No! Over there!"
Ron looked in the direction George was pointing. There was a crowd of people crowded together, and Ivan could not be seen.
"What are you looking for Ivan for? Too many people are fascinated by him. The girls are begging to take pictures and autographs with him. We can't squeeze in. If you want to celebrate him, you'd better be late..." Reid said with comfort.
"I have a very important thing to look for him! Sirius took Harry away just now, and they are leaving Hogwarts, and they are not letting me follow. I think Sirius is a bit wrong today..." Ron is anxious Said,
"What's wrong with this? Maybe Sirius wanted to take Harry to Hogsmeade Village to buy him some gifts or something." George asked.
"Yeah, Harry won second place. I would be very happy if I were Sirius..." Fred also nodded.
"Don't you understand? Sirius didn't care how well Harry did today, so I said he had a problem!" Ron stared at the two angrily. "I suspect Sirius might have been under the Imperius Curse. , Just like Professor Moody!"
George and Fred looked at Ron in surprise. They had naturally heard of the Imperius Curse, and this year Moody even gave them a detailed explanation in the Defence Against the Dark Arts class.
But now Ron actually tells them that Moody and Sirius have been recruited. This is simply a big joke...
He noticed the expressions on the faces of the two of them, and Ron knew that his explanation was in vain, and he didn't bother to waste time with them anymore, and prepared to squeeze in to find Ivan on his own.
"WaitLittle Ronnie, although I don't know if what you said is true, if you are anxious to see Ivan, we should be able to help you!" George suddenly shouted.
Ron turned his head in surprise, wondering how they should call Ivan out.
George and Fred laughed together, and then threw all the fireworks they were holding in the direction of Ivan.
In the next moment, dozens of bang fireworks exploded in the crowd one after another, crackling blasts continued to sound, and for a while, fireworks were everywhere on the court...
The dense crowd suddenly became confused, screaming and verbal abuse one after another, and the little wizards from the periphery who saw this scene glared at George and Fred.
Ron also looked at them angrily, not knowing whether the two were here to help or make trouble.
George and Fred gave him a peaceful look.
Sure enough, Ivan walked out of the crowd a few seconds later...
(PS: One more today...)

chapters.title: Chapter 699: Chaotic field
chapters.content:
Ivan waved his magic wand to stop the riot caused by the booming fireworks, then looked at George and the others, and said helplessly.
"George and Fred, even if you want to celebrate for me, don't you need to make such a joke?"
"No, we have something important to ask you, so we can only use this method..." Fred shook his head.
George also added. "To be precise, Ronnie has something to do with you!"
Ivan turned his head unexpectedly, but Ron said eagerly before he could ask. "Ivan, Sirius... Sirius just took Harry away!"
Hearing this news, Ivan immediately realized that something might be wrong, and frowned. "What did he do with Harry? The reason..."
"Sirius said it was Professor Dumbledore's order, and the professor asked him to take Harry to the village for protection..." Ron replied breathlessly.
"It's impossible!" Ivan interrupted Ron's words, "Professor Dumbledore asked Harry to stay in school a few days ago to protect himself. If he changes his mind temporarily, Sirius should have notified me. ."
"Yes! I also think Sirius is weird today. When Harry met the snails in the maze, he didn't seem to worry at all, and when the game was over, he didn't even congratulate Harry for the first time. , He would be very happy if he changed to the usual one!"
Ron uttered all the doubts about Sirius, then hesitated, then guessed. "I think he might be under the Imperius Curse!"
"Then how long have they been away?" Hermione was very anxious. "Ivan, don't you have a live map? See where they are now?"
Ivan was very aware of the urgency of the matter, and immediately ignored the trivial matter of leaking the password. He pulled out an old baba parchment from his pocket and put his wand on it.
"I solemnly swear that I did nothing good!"
The delicate ink lines extend down the top of the magic wand and outline the picture of the entire castle.
Ivan's gaze swept across the entire map quickly, filtering through the names one after another, and his gaze quickly stopped in the hall.
According to the display of the live spot map, Harry had already walked out of the hall, but Ivan felt a little strange that Sirius' name was not seen next to him.
Just when he was surprised, Harry's name suddenly disappeared on the map after just a second.
"Harry has been taken away by him?" Ron, who also witnessed this scene, only felt a chill on his back.
"But how did Sirius do it? With the door key?" Hermione guessed.
"It's not the door key! If he could take Harry directly, he would have done it in the morning, why wait until now?" Ivan rejected Hermione's guess, and the entire Hogwarts Castle was equipped with special protective magic. , The only exception is the competition venue.
Therefore, Ivan thought that Sirius and Harry must still be in the castle now, and the disappearance of their names was probably because of some method used to temporarily block the exploration of the live spot map, just like Dumbledore did last time.
Hermione also thought of this very quickly, muttering to herself. "If it weren't the door key, then they must have wanted to go to Hogsmeade Village through the underpass under the beating willow, and then Apparition to bring Harry to Voldemort..."
Ivan nodded, this is very possible, but it is not 100% sure, because there is more than one secret road leading to Hogsmeade Village.
"Then what are we waiting for? Go find Harry, maybe you can stop them now!" Ron said hurriedly.
"No, Ron, it's enough for me to find Harry alone! I know Animagus, I can fly in the sky, and my vision is very wide. As long as they are still at Hogwarts, I will definitely find them... …" Ivan's expression was very serious.
Hermione and Ron stopped talking, but they didn't refute, they just asked. "What about us? What should we do now?"
"You have to go to Snape and Professor Flitwick. They are in the office now. There must be a way to contact Professor Dumbledore. All you have to do is to inform him as soon as possible!" Ivan said solemnly.
Hermione and Ron nodded together, and Ivan didn't say much, even if he wanted to use Bogut's transformation.
However, an explosion sounded from the maze at this moment, and the front was suddenly in chaos. Many little wizards ran towards this side in horror, crying and screaming everywhere on the court.
"Run, those monsters rushed out of the maze!"
"It's fried snails..."
"Mom...where are you mom?"
...
Ivan subconsciously looked down there, and suddenly saw an irregular gap in the hedge on the side of the maze, and several snails were spraying flames and rushing out from there.
The Aurors who were guarding nearby did not expect this sudden situation at all, and they launched a counterattack in a panic, and a series of spells hit the shell of the snails, but to no avail, they could barely hinder the actions of the snails. .
After a while, several giant spiders also ran out, breaking through the Aurors' defenses all at once.
"Trash!" Ivan yelled. There were five Aurors, even some rioting magical creatures could not be solved, and they rushed out...
For a while, Ivan was caught in a dilemma. If he helped in the past, he would definitely delay finding Harry, but if he left it alone, what would the students here do?
Do you rely on these Aurors?
Thinking about this, Ivan's heart became colder and colder. He knew that Voldemort had calculated it step by step, so that he could not have time to take care of...
After hesitating, a giant spider rushed over, and his sturdy forelimbs pointed at a startled little wizard of lower grades. Ivan didn't have time to think about it and drew out his wand to save people.
But someone was faster than him, and a crimson beam hit the ferocious giant spider directly, blasting it out.
"Mom? Are you planning to go home?" Ivan looked forward in surprise, and Aysia was squeezing from the chaotic crowd.
"I was planning to go back, I didn't expect something went wrong..." Aysia turned her head to respond, then looked to the side of the maze, and said again. "Don't you have something urgent to do? We will take care of it here... Go ahead!"
Although she hadn't heard the conversation between Ivan and Hermione and Ron before, the anxious color on Ivan's face couldn't be more obvious, and Aysia could naturally see it.
On the other side, Mrs. Weasley and Bill have worked together to solve a blasted snail and organized the little wizards of Hogwarts to a safe place.
After the five Aurors slowed down, they quickly used spells to repair the gap in the maze, ensuring that no more monsters would escape!
Seeing this, Ivan was somewhat relieved. After instructing Esiah to be safe, he immediately transformed into a huge giant eagle, flapping its wings and flying high...
"Animagus transforms? It's amazing! Few people can do this at his age." Mrs. Weasley said with emotion.
"Does that still need to be said? He is my son..." Aysia said proudly.
...
"Damn Where are they? Aren't they leaving?" Ivan flapped his wings and flew over Hogwarts. A pair of eagle eyes quickly scanned everything below, but it was a pity Harry and Sirius were not found.
He seems to be a little late...
Ivan couldn't help being a little impatient. He didn't know the exact location of Voldemort, and he had never been to Riddle's House, so even if he wanted to rush to stop the ceremony, he couldn't do it.
"Go and see Hogsmeade first, what if they haven't left yet?" Ivan hugged luck and flew towards the beating willow outside the castle, planning to find clues in Hogsmeade village. .
Just as Ivan was approaching quickly, a **** dog suddenly emerged from the secret path under the beating willow...
"Sirius!" Ivan recognized it at a glance.
Although it is a bit strange why Harry is not around, and why Sirius is in the form of this Animagus, but Ivan has no time to think about it, and quickly catches up...
(PS: One more today)

chapters.title: Chapter 700: If I knew it, I should have watched that Quidditch game.
chapters.content:
Hurry up... Hurry up!
Sirius was breathing heavily, his magic power running through his body, his limbs intertwined quickly as if convulsed, his figure turned into an afterimage, and he ran towards Hogwarts Castle.
He only hopes that he has time to catch up now...
The noise in the castle gradually spread, and Sirius's mood became more and more urgent, because he vaguely heard a few cries and screams, it was obvious that something had happened there!
As he was thinking in his mind, a strong sense of danger suddenly interrupted his thoughts.
Sirius felt his scalp numb for a while, looked up suddenly, and a huge eagle rushed towards him.
His mind has not yet figured out why an eagle would attack him, but his body has already moved subconsciously!
Sirius bowed his back and quickly retracted his forelimbs. With the impact of running, he rolled away like a black furry ball. The hard ground rubbed his back painfully, but it was also successful. Avoided the sharp claws of the giant eagle.
Sirius resisted the pain, and just stood up, his body shape quickly began to deform, and after a moment of effort, he returned to the form of a wizard. He grabbed the magic wand he was biting in his mouth, waved his hand at the giant eagle, and shouted hoarsely.
"Faint!"
A dazzling red beam flew out from the tip of the wand.
Ivan's wings shook, and he quickly raised his figure to avoid the past. A pair of eagle eyes and Sirius stared at each other. The magic eyes were activated instantly, and a strange sense of solidity instantly dominated Sirius' mind.
Then, Sirius felt that his body was hit hard, and his whole body flew out directly, rolling embarrassingly and hitting the tree behind.
After giving Sirius a head cone, the giant eagle slowly landed and transformed into a wizard form in an instant.
Looking at Sirius who was dizzy and swollen not far away, Ivan didn't dare to be negligent. He waved his magic wand with his right hand and turned into a large python that tied him up, and then walked forward quickly.
Sirius also slowed down this time.
He witnessed the giant eagle transforming into Ivan's appearance. Although it was a bit strange why Ivan's Animagus form was not an owl, it was too late for Sirius to think about it, and his voice hoarsely roared at Ivan.
"Quick...hurry up and inform Dumbledore them!"
"What?" Ivan stopped walking, staring at Sirius suspiciously. "You have broken free from the Imperius Curse?"
Sirius did not answer Ivan's question immediately, but asked more eagerly. "Where is Harry? Where is Harry now?"
"Didn't Harry just be taken away by you?" Ivan frowned, faintly guessing in his heart, but he wasn't sure yet.
"Damn it, I'm a step late!" Sirius gritted his teeth and said, staring at Ivan, and explained anxiously. "It was Peter who did it. He pretended to look like me with the compound decoction, ready to bring Harry to the mysterious man!"
"Little dwarf?!" Ivan asked suspiciously. "Then where are you all this time? How should I trust you?"
"Let go of me first. I don't have time to explain. I know where they will prepare for the ceremony. It might be too late to get there now. I'll tell you on the way!" Sirius said anxiously.
Ivan hesitated for a moment. He couldn't completely trust him because of Sirius' side words, or it was possible that Sirius sent Harry away before returning to fool himself.
However, out of self-confidence in his own strength and the feedback he got from the idea of ​​running Desire, Ivan waved his magic wand to untie his restraints. Anyway, Sirius was not his opponent, and he didn't worry about what the other party might come up with.
Sirius hurriedly got up from the ground, as if he had been hit by a slowing curse. His body was so stiff that he almost fell to the ground again.
"Drink this!" Ivan thought for a while, took out a bottle of potion from his pocket and threw it to Sirius, so that he could relieve the negative influence brought by the magic eye.
If what the other party said is true, then maybe you have to face Voldemort directly, if you maintain this state, then I am afraid that you will die.
Sirius took the potion in one go, unscrewed it and drank it. This is not the first time he has been recruited, so of course he knows the effect of this potion.
After drinking all the potions, Sirius didn't delay a moment, stepped forward and grabbed Ivan's wrist and ran in the direction he was when he was going back and forth. "Let's go! Let's go to Hogsmeade Village quickly, there is no way to change our shape here!"
"Can you tell me what the **** is going on now?" Ivan said as he ran after Sirius.
"Do you remember the World Quidditch match held during the summer vacation last year?" Sirius asked.
Ivan nodded. "Of course I remember that you asked Professor Dumbledore to bring me tickets, but I was so busy that I couldn't spare any time..."
"Yes, it's a pity that you didn't come, but I still invited Harry and the others to watch the game." Sirius said hurriedly, and after a pause, he continued.
"Everything was normal at first, but after we returned to the tent after watching the game, there was a sudden riot outside. A large group of wizards with masks and hoods set fire in the camp wantonly and tortured those nearby. Camped Muggles..."
"I have read these in the Daily Prophet You don't need to introduce it to me specially..." Ivan said impatiently, and then he suddenly spoke as if he was thinking of something. Said. "I once heard Harry say, did you trouble those Death Eaters?"
"No, to be precise, I saw Peter there!" Sirius's expression became serious.
Ivan's pupils shrank slightly, and he looked at Sirius in surprise.
"He was wearing a long robe and sneaking through the crowd. Although the sky was very dark and I couldn't see the face, I knew him too well, so I quickly recognized it!" Sirius Speaking very quickly, "I suspect that this riot is related to him, so I told Harry to find Arthur and the others, and chase after him!"
"You are too reckless, he is obviously deliberately leading you over!" Ivan said angrily.
"You're right, but I didn't think so much at that time, I just knew that I couldn't miss this opportunity to catch Peter!" Sirius responded awkwardly.
He originally thought that Peter was just a bereaved dog, and it was too late to see himself escape. At most, he lurked in the dark to engage in conspiracies and encourage others to cause sabotage. He never thought that this guy would have the courage to lead him over...

chapters.title: Chapter 701: It turns out that you are the inner answer!
chapters.content:
Listening to Sirius' explanation, Ivan sighed and said nothing more. He knew very well how deep Sirius was obsessed with Peter.
When he heard Harry talk about the trouble of Sirius leaving them to find the Death Eaters, he still felt a little strange, but now he understands a little bit, and he can only catch up with Peter regardless of him...
"After that? Did you catch Peter?" Ivan asked again.
"I followed Peter into a woods and watched him take off his coat. Only then did I see that Peter was holding a monster in his arms..." Sirius said solemnly. "I didn't know that the monster was a mysterious man, so I chose to fight with them, and didn't have the first time to escape... and ended up under the Imperius Curse of the mysterious man.
Ivan couldn't hide the shock on his face. He didn't expect Peter to sneak into the World Quidditch Cup with Voldemort at the risk of being discovered.
No wonder Barty Jr. suddenly disappeared in the camp. It was probably because he successfully attracted Voldemort's attention after launching the Dark Mark and ordered Peter to rescue him.
While Ivan was thinking about it, Sirius continued to speak without stopping.
"After being cursed by the mysterious man, there was always a voice in my mind telling me to bring Harry out alone to him."
"But the mysterious man is probably negligent. I have been in Azkaban for more than ten years. Those dementors have sharpened my will very well..."
Having said this, Sirius laughed mockingly, and then spoke again. "So he can't completely control me. I know very well that doing so will kill Harry, desperately resisting the orders given by the mysterious man."
"But the magic of the mysterious man is too powerful, and no matter how hard I try, I can’t get rid of the Imperius curse. Finally, I thought of a way to stop resisting the mysterious man’s instructions and use my last reason to learn from the Death Eaters and set fire It burned the surrounding tents and attracted the nearby Aurors!"
"Are you going to let the Aurors arrest you for questioning, and even expect them to find out that you are under the Imperius Curse?" Ivan immediately guessed Sirius' intentions.
"Yes! I did think so! No matter what, I can lock me up again..." Sirius sighed. "It's just a pity that not long after the Aurors caught me, Arthur rushed over with someone, and he guaranteed me!"
"This is really..." Ivan shook his head helplessly. I really don't know what to say. Arthur Weasley's willingness to take the risk to guarantee Sirius is a very friendly move, but it is a pity that he did it well. bad thing.
Sirius also smiled bitterly. That rebellion exhausted his power. More importantly, he was noticed by the mysterious man, so he strengthened his control.
The only good news is that this accident also made the mysterious man more careful.
After he finished his transcript and returned from the Ministry of Magic, the mysterious man no longer forced him to go to the Burrow and took Harry away directly, but ordered him to go home and wait for orders.
"How about Lupin and Kreacher? You have been under control for so long, they haven't suspected you?" Ivan asked in a puzzled way.
"Lupin found a new job half a month after you left, and has moved out. So the mysterious man has stayed in my mansion for a long time. As for Kreacher..." Sirius' face was revealed. With painful and hideous expressions, his nails were deeply carved into his palms, and his words became cold.
"The mysterious man asked me to order it not to leave this mansion. Kreacher couldn't resist my instructions. In addition, there is a house elf named Shining who is always watching it."
"Sparkling? The house elf who was expelled by Mr. Crouch?" Ivan frowned. He did hear Hermione say that Sirius had adopted Sparkling at the beginning of school.
"Yes! That's it! The mysterious man is short of manpower, so I took Shining away! The house elf was abandoned by the owner and needed a home. The mysterious man ordered Barty Crouch Jr. to re-sign with Shining Contract, Shackles Shining to help him do something.
But the mysterious man distrusts the house elves and thinks they are stupid, lowly, and can't do any big things..." Sirius said as he glanced forward.
They had already ran under the willow tree, Sirius picked up a stone from the grass and hit the knot on the tree, and then took Ivan into the secret tunnel when he came.
On the way through the underpass, Sirius continued to tell Ivan the next thing. A few days before Hogwarts officially opened, the mysterious man planned a conspiracy to bring Harry to the top three cups. In front of him.
"Why didn't Voldemort let you go directly to the Burrow to bring Harry out?" Ivan asked.
"At that time, Arthur had already begun to doubt me. He wrote a letter the next day, asking me why I set fire in the camp. An Auror saw me doing this with his own eyes." Sirius explained. "The mysterious man was worried that I would be seen through, so he asked me to write a reply, saying that this matter was a problem for me by the Ministry of Magic..."
"Arthur may have believed my explanation. In short, he didn't write to me again, but the mysterious man thought that he could no longer let me take risks.
Moreover, his resurrection ceremony is not ready yet, and some special medicinal materials are still lacking. It takes a long time to complete the potion. In contrast, if Harry disappears for too long, it will attract Dumbledore’s attention The mysterious man suspected that Dumbledore had cast a curse on Harry, and could track Harry’s movements with specific magic. In addition, he was afraid that I would resist for the second time, so he temporarily adjusted his plan and let me As an internal response, help Barty Crouch Jr. bring Harry out of the school. "
Sirius sneered at Voldemort's speculation. He thought it was impossible for Dumbledore to curse and watch Harry.
It's just that Voldemort was clearly committed to this, and planned to do it after the preparations were completed. In this case, it would be too late for Dumbledore to react.
"In other words, could Voldemort learn that the news of Barty Crouch Jr.'s death is your secret?"
When Harry got the second dream foretelling the other day, Ivan had suspected that there was an internal response from Voldemort beside them, but he never thought about Sirius.
Sirius nodded. Since the beginning of school, he has asked Harry to write regularly and send him the details of what happened in Hogwarts.
That day Harry suddenly told him about Moody’s change, and Voldemort guessed that Barty Crouch Jr. might have something wrong...

chapters.title: Chapter 702: A duel in front of the cemetery!
chapters.content:
"Harry once told me about dreams in the letter, so the mysterious man knew very well that Harry could get some information through the snake's sight..." Sirius said distressedly, but Voldemort turned it around. Using and passing false information, Dumbledore was successfully transferred today.
There was a chill in Ivan's heart, so Voldemort knew everything they did at Hogwarts.
What makes Ivan more disturbed is that the root of Harry being able to possess Nagini is that he is also one of the Horcruxes, that is, it is not known whether Voldemort has noticed it.
"Wait, Sirius, you just said that Voldemort has been controlling you with the Imperius Curse, so how did you break free from the Imperius Curse?" Ivan suddenly thought of this and asked curiously.
"Thanks to you killing Barty Crouch Jr.... The mysterious man has no extra manpower to use, and he is worried that I will lose control again. He can only take the risk of having Peter pretend to be me with the compound decoction and go to Hogwarts. Go Harry!" Sirius said faintly.
After Peter left, Riddle's mansion was only left with the house-raised elf Shining, Voldemort with mobility problems, and the big snake named Nagini.
"The mysterious man was afraid that Harry could see the situation in the mansion through Nagini, so he only ordered Shine to take care of me, and then... Kreacher sneaked in."
At this point, Sirius's voice became a little hoarse, "It violated the instructions I gave him before, left the house and used magic to stun me and rescued me..."
"Kreacher?" Ivan looked at Sirius very unexpectedly. He remembered that during the summer vacation, Kreacher still had a lot of criticisms about Sirius, and kept talking about the annoying prodigal son all the time.
But he didn't want this house-elf to take such a big risk, and would not hesitate to forcibly defy the order and sneak into Voldemort's mansion to rescue Sirius.
It seemed that after they had fished out Regulus' body from the bottom of the lake together, Kreacher had completely approved the new owner of Sirius.
"By the way, how about the Kreacher? Didn't he come with you?" Ivan was a little strange.
Sirius' face was full of pain and hideous expressions, and after a while, he tremblingly continued.
"It's dead! I... killed it myself!"
"what?"
Ivan looked at Sirius in astonishment, almost thinking that he was joking, but he soon thought of a possibility, and a chill in his heart couldn't help. "Is it the Imperius Curse of the mysterious man?"
"Yes! Imperius Curse!" Sirius gritted his teeth.
"Although Kreacher tried to rescue me from Riddle's mansion, it couldn't undo the Imperius curse in me. The mysterious man is still using this to influence me, forcing me to go back to see him immediately..."
"Kreacher... Kreacher pulled my leg desperately to stop me from going back, and then... and then I used a Heartbreaking Curse on it..." Sirius' voice kept trembling, and he recalled the scene at that time. , My heart is squeezed.
Voldemort did not fully control him, so Sirius knew very well that Kreacher was saving himself, but he could not control his actions at all. His body was controlled by another person. He used the most cruel magic to torture this one. Faithful house elf.
Kreacher’s tragic wailing seemed to still be echoing in his ears...
What makes Sirius most painful is that Kreacher clearly has the opportunity to resist him, but he is not willing to hurt himself...
This torment finally forced him to break free from Voldemort's Imperius curse, but when he did this, Kreacher had no sound.
Because when Voldemort sensed his resistance, he gave him the last order-to kill the house elf in front of him!
"Kreacher saved me, but I killed it..." Sirius's face was a little scary, he muttered to himself like a nervousness, his fists tightened and his sharp nails were deeply carved in. In the flesh, he can't feel the pain at all...
Sirius couldn't remember how he buried Kreacher at the time. His brain was blank. If he hadn't remembered Harry's safety, he might have been lying in the pit he dug out with his own hands.
Ivan, who was listening the whole time, was shocked and speechless, and the complexity of the matter far exceeded his expectations.
Kreacher died? Still died in the hands of Sirius...
Looking at the nearly collapsed Sirius, Ivan opened his mouth, wanting to offer comfort.
After all, this is not Sirius' fault, the real killer of Kreacher is Voldemort!
But Sirius interrupted Ivan's words.
"It won't be long before I will avenge it! Soon!"
Sirius said coldly, his eyes were full of hatred and anger, and the faint light had been shining in from the front of the passage-they were going to the village of Hogsmeade!
"Get ready, let's go now!" At the moment when he stepped out of the tunnel, Sirius squeezed Ivan's wrist and said hoarsely.
Ivan nodded, and then felt that his body was drawn into a whirlpool, and Sirius's voice also reached his ears.
"Apparate! (Apparition
...
Outside Riddle's mansion, in front of a particularly desolate cemetery, Harry, who was unable to retreat, was forced to fight the resurrected Voldemort under the crowd of Death Eaters.
Or maybe this is a unilateral torture...
"Come on, bow to me, Harry!" Voldemort leaned slightly and said in a mocking tone, "At least the etiquette of duel is to be observed... Dumbledore must hope that you will behave in the face of death. It must be very graceful... Bow to death..."
The Death Eaters gathered around laughed Looking at Harry is like looking at a pig waiting to be slaughtered. They knew that the Dark Lord might not kill the kid in front of him so easily. Will die tortured and humiliated!
Harry pursed his mouth and did not move. He knew that his vitality was slim this time, but he would never allow Voldemort to use him wantonly before killing him...
"I said, bow!" Voldemort increased his tone, and the cruel red eyes stared at Harry impatiently.
He lifted his wand gently, without seeing the spell, Harry felt as if his spine was being held down by something heavy, forcing him to bow in a very standard way.
"Very good!" Voldemort relieved his control of Harry with satisfaction, a smile on his snakelike face. "Let us officially start the duel now!"
Harry couldn't help trembling with his wand's hand. He didn't understand why Voldemort didn't kill himself directly, instead he had to fight himself with a lot of effort, but he still plucked up the courage to ask.
"I can fight you, but you have to tell me where Sirius is..."
(PS: One more)

chapters.title: Chapter 703: It's time to make an end!
chapters.content:
"Ah, Sirius, that traitor from the Black family!" The smile on Voldemort's face suddenly gathered, and said somewhat disappointingly. "I was expecting the two of you to get together here and die together. That must be an extremely wonderful scene..."
"So he escaped from here, right?" Harry suddenly felt a little more vitality in his dead heart, and asked eagerly.
"It's not impossible for you to think so." Voldemort said slowly, a strange smile appeared on his face again. "But I think he might prefer to die here!"
Harry did not pay attention to Voldemort's subsequent words at all, and there was a hint of joy in his heart. He only knew that Sirius was still alive and successfully escaped from here...
This is at least good news!
Harry's emotional change, naturally, could not hide Voldemort's insight, which also destroyed his joy after resurrection.
"Where is that incompetent house elf?" Voldemort looked around and said grimly.
There was a brief riot in the surrounding crowd.
Moments later, an ugly, skinny house elf was chased out by the Death Eaters.
"Sparkling?" Harry recognized at a glance that this was Mr. Crouch’s house elf, who was once in the World Quidditch Cup
Shining ignored Harry's shout, trembling all over, her light bulb-sized eyes filled with terror.
"Come here, you idiot!" Voldemort stared at it fiercely. "Potter has intentionally reminded me that I have not punished you for your incompetence and negligence!"
"Sir, Shining... Shining was knocked out..." Shining stammered trying to defend herself.
"I don't want to hear your explanation!" Voldemort sneered, gently raising his wand, and chanting word by word. "! (heart-cutting bones
"Ahhhhh~" The severe pain caused the poor house elf to scream and scream, and fell to the ground unsteadily physically and mentally, twisting and screaming in pain.
The Death Eaters watched this scene with fear, no one gloated, because some of them received the exact same criminal law not long ago!
"Stop it!" Harry yelled with courage, looking at the shimmering sparkle.
However, Voldemort had no intention of stopping at all, just admiring the shimmering and distorted expression.
After almost half a minute, Shining was silent, her face was full of snot and tears, and her body was lying on the ground, like a dying fish, twitching from time to time.
It was as if Voldemort had lost interest in torturing the house elf. He put down his wand and turned to look at Harry. "Don't be so anxious, it will be you soon, Potter!"
"Now, let's continue with what we didn't finish just now!" Voldemort's red eyes gleamed in the dark, and a word floated out of his mouth. "duel!"
Harry took a deep breath and squeezed his wand in his right hand. He knew that he had no way out, and resistance was the only option!
But facing the Dark Lord who made countless wizards dare not call his name directly, Harry's heart was faintly filled with an emotion called despair.
Come to think about it, I learned so many spells this year...
Harry's brain turned desperately. His duel experience was very limited. He had only practiced with Ron and Hermione a few times.
Defense, first build defense!
"Protegos~ (armor bodyguard Harry suddenly thought of this, and the wand quickly pointed at him, and an invisible magic barrier soon enveloped him.
"Yes! Iron Armor Curse, you can master it at this age, so Dumbledore usually teaches you well!" Voldemort raised some interest slightly, and said somewhat unexpectedly.
Under the protection of the Iron Armor Curse, Harry gradually recovered some courage, staring straight at Voldemort's every move, ready to resist all attacks!
But Harry soon understood that he was too naive. Voldemort just raised his hand gently, and an indescribable pain filled his mind, as if someone was constantly scratching him with a hot knife. Like flesh and skin, the headache almost exploded.
Harry resisted not wanting to make a sound, but the pain quickly shredded his sanity, and the sharp screams kept coming out of his mouth.
"It seems that Dumbledore didn't tell you that the Iron Armor Curse cannot defend against some specific spells!" Voldemort stared at Harry's painful face happily, and then gently reminded him like an instructor. .
"And... whether magic can work depends on who is using it!"
As he said, Voldemort waved his wand again, and a black beam of arm-thick black beam flashed in mid-air.
The defense of the Iron Armor Curse was like paper, and it shattered without being able to resist for a second. Harry witnessed the black light hitting himself, his body seemed to fly, and he rolled heavily and hit the tombstone behind him.
Harry's right hand was still holding the wand in his hand tightly. After he landed, he eagerly wanted to get up from the ground, but his whole body hurt so badly that he almost fell in his foot, not long after Peter got it out, before he had time. In the filled pit.
Tom Riddle's name came into view on the tombstone, but Harry suddenly felt that after today, the name on the tombstone would be replaced by himself-if Voldemort really wanted to erect a monument for him.
"I have to say, you disappoint me so much! Potter!" Voldemort approached step by step, saying indifferently.
"I thought you would be special! They all said that you are my nemesis but now it seems that you are not as great as they say, a lot of it is just some good luck! Now there is no The second person will die for you!"
Hearing Voldemort's mention of his mother, Harry's anger came out at once, dispelling the fear in his mind, he said bitterly. "We are all the same, and you are nothing great, Voldemort! Everyone hates and hates you!"
"Really? You won't feel that way anymore!" Voldemort sneered, then raised his wand again, and a dark green light flashed faintly.
"It's time to end it! Potter! Avada Kedavra! (Avada Kedavra Voldemort chanted the spell lightly, and a green beam of light flew out from the tip of the wand.
The fear of facing death made Harry's heartbeat slow by half a beat. He knew very well that the Iron Armor Curse was unable to defend against the Killing Curse, and his too weak body made it impossible to avoid this spell.
Death was approaching, but Harry didn't want to be slaughtered. He wanted to die in self-defense like his parents.
"Expelliarmus~ (except your weapon Harry shouted hoarsely, waving his wand vigorously.

chapters.title: Chapter 704: Courage and faith
chapters.content:
The Death Eaters who watched this scene showed mocking expressions on their faces. Harry's attempt to resist the Killing Curse with the Disarming Curse was tantamount to a dream.
But the accident happened in front of everyone!
After the red light and the green light collided head-on, they were not defeated, but confronted evenly.
Harry holding his wand suddenly felt his wand vibrate as if it was electrified. He didn't release any spells at all, but a golden beam of light flew out from the top of the wand.
Under the shining golden light, Harry saw the same beam of light from the wand of Voldemort opposite, and the two "golden threads" were intertwined in mid-air.
The golden light ball composed of magical power gradually condensed in the center of the interweaving light beams, trembling unsteadily, bursting into several holes, and countless arcs of light erupted and hit all around, finally forming a dome. The golden net, a cage purely made of light, encloses the two people in the center.
A wonderful fairy music rang in the air, it was like a vibrating arc of light played together, and Harry could hear the song of a phoenix.
He almost thought Dumbledore was coming to save himself, but the reassuring figure did not appear beside him...
The Death Eaters on the periphery seemed panicked, no one expected such a thing to happen, and everyone backed up a few steps in unison to avoid being hit by the arc of riot.
Some people yelled hurriedly, asking Voldemort for instructions, while others drew out their wands and were about to attack.
"No one can move without my order!" Voldemort shouted loudly, his red eyes full of anger, incomprehension, and subtle fear.
The current situation also exceeded Voldemort's expectations. The little wizard in front of him was obviously so weak. It was as simple as crushing a bug to kill him, but when he launched a fatal blow, an accident happened... …This reminded him again of the fear of being dominated by prophecy.
No, this is impossible!
Voldemort's complexion became more and more ferocious. He never believed that Harry Potter would be his nemesis. He wanted to personally smash this nightmare in his heart!
"Go to hell, Potter!" Voldemort roared, increasing the output of magic power, and the light bead between the two gold wires quickly moved towards Harry.
Unspeakable pressure surged into Harry's heart. As the light bead approached, he felt the wand in his hand vibrate more and more, and he even felt that the wand was about to explode.
Harry tried to fight back, but his magic power was really low compared to his opponent.
Just when Harry was about to be unable to bear it, vaguely, there seemed to be a voice from the bottom of his heart...
Don't disconnect... the important thing is will, not magic!
The voice seemed to be transmitted from Xianle, Harry almost doubted whether he had any hallucinations, but now he can only do it...
Think about it, the Dark Lord killed my parents and planned to kill me!
Harry kept reminiscing about the night his parents died in his mind, struggling to put his left hand on the wand, his anger turned into strength, and the golden light bead in front of him slowly changed direction and pressed towards the opposite side. Past.
"It's impossible!" Voldemort looked at this scene in shock, and the fear in his heart became stronger and stronger. He could feel that the magic power he inspired was used by the kid in turn.
Harry suddenly felt that the pressure he was under was much less, and he immediately increased his strength. The gold thread on the right swallowed the gold thread on the left frantically. The golden light beads were getting faster and faster, and soon they hit the tip of Voldemort's wand .
The next moment, in Voldemort's horrified expression, a painful scream suddenly rang from the wand, and a human hand made of thick smoke flew out of the tip of the wand and disappeared.
It was the severed hand he made for Wormtail.
Then, a series of illusory and ethereal figures flew out of the wand.
Harry stared at this wonderful scene. The first one to fly out was an old Muggle man who had seen each other in a dream.
Soon a second silhouette made of smoke appeared in front of him. It was an unknown witch. Harry guessed that it should be Bertha Jorkins. Mr. Crouch once said that Voldemort killed her. .
The ghosts gathered around Harry, cheering for him.
Harry gradually understood the effect of this [乐文小说www.lwxs.xyz] magic, his eyes fixed on Voldemort's wand, what he was expecting.
Sure enough, the ghost of a long-haired young woman slowly emerged from the tip of Voldemort's wand and floated to Harry's side.
"Mom..." Harry said in a shaky voice.
"Hold on, Harry, it'll be okay..." Lily Potter stared at him affectionately and said softly. "Your dad is here too... he wants to see you."
Harry turned his head and looked over again, his father James Potter's soul rose from the tip of Voldemort's wand and floated over.
James and Lily were exactly the same as what he had seen in the Mirror of Eris. Harry couldn’t hide the excitement in his heart. He even felt that it wouldn’t matter if he died here. At least he was not alone, his parents. Stay with him all the time.
"Don't think so, Harry! You will definitely escape..." James said gently, "After the connection is disconnected, we will try to buy you some time!"
"But what should I do? I won't Apparate, I can't leave here!" Harry said anxiously, and he regretted not having time to learn this magic this year.
When he came, Peter pulled him to teleport, and he can’t go back like this now The ghosts also made trouble, Bertha Jorkins circled Harry, the Disruptor Death Eater In our eyes, the old Muggle man Frank Bryce was constantly cursing Voldemort with vicious words.
As time passed bit by bit, Harry felt cold sweat on his forehead, and he felt like he couldn't hold it anymore.
At this moment, James seemed to have sensed something suddenly, turning his head and looking into the distance, his eyes seemed to be able to penetrate the dark mist, and there was a little joy on his face.
"Fortunately, someone is here, they are here to save you!" Lily also looked over there and said happily.
what? Confused, Harry wanted to ask, but the gold connecting the two wands had broken.
"Anyway, we will buy you some time! Harry!" James said eagerly, and the erratic figure rushed straight to Voldemort.
"Hurry up! Harry...Run to the right!" Lily whispered softly, and quickly floated out.
right? Harry turned his head and glanced hurriedly, but it was blocked by the Death Eaters.

chapters.title: Chapter 705: Chaotic battlefield
chapters.content:
The ghosts rushed forward, pestering Voldemort, blocking his vision, and buying time for Harry to escape.
However, Harry was not happy at all, he even felt that he might be disappointed by the ghosts.
Because there are seven or eight Death Eaters standing in a semi-circle on his right side, choosing to break through here is definitely an extremely demented decision, but Harry has no choice but to believe in James and Lily. Words, just bite the bullet and rushed forward.
The Death Eaters who formed a circle outside looked a little at a loss. They witnessed Harry Potter once again resisting the Killing Curse, and used an unknown magic to summon a bunch of ghosts to entangle the powerful Dark Lord. .
"Stop him all for me!"
Voldemort's angry voice echoed in the cemetery, and at the same time it awakened the panicked Death Eaters.
The few people who stopped in front of Harry immediately drew out their wands. Lucius, who was standing in front, showed a grinning smile. He raised his cane, and there was a spell in his mouth. A crimson beam came from the rod. The tip flew out and shot straight at Harry.
"Protegos~ (armor bodyguard At the very moment, Harry used the iron armor curse again.
Fortunately, this time the spell worked. The magical barriers that rose around deflected the red light beams. A scream was heard from the crowd, and it was not known that the hapless guy had gotten the move.
Harry didn't have time to look back, a feeling of palpitations was already in his mind, but it was the black wizards beside Lucius who raised their wands at him.
Harry's pupils shrank slightly, and the protection of the iron armor curse couldn't resist so much magic at the same time.
But what made Harry's scalp numb was that a very abstract human face suddenly "grown" on the old tree behind several Death Eaters, with deep eyes, mouth and nose. Holes, pits and pits, as if they were moth-eaten.
A waist-thin branch waved toward him, and Harry shielded his head in despair, and several painful screams and screams soon rang in his ears.
Harry, who could not wait to attack, raised his head unexpectedly, only to discover that the weird old tree did not attack him. The sturdy branches swept across again, drawing on the other Death Eaters, and flying them away. Got out.
Transfiguration!
Harry immediately thought of this, and there was a dash of joy in his heart. He knew that the ghosts were right. Someone really came to save himself!
The road ahead has been opened up, and Harry tried to get out of here, but the magic that Voldemort had put on him was still working. He felt his hands and feet were weak and weak, and the rush just now had exhausted him. One of the few physical strength...
What's bad is that more Death Eaters have reacted. They waved their wands together, and there were 20 or 30 spells flashing in the air.
No one dared to imagine how angry the Dark Lord would be after Harry Potter escaped, so they had to keep the other side at all costs!
Seeing dozens of oncoming spell beams, Harry couldn't avoid it at all.
At this time, another voice sounded in the cemetery.
"The tombstone is coming!"
Harry heard the voice of Sirius, and before he could think about it, the tombstone with Tom Riddle written not far behind flew over and hit him at an extraordinary speed.
The protection of the Iron Armor Charm broke at the sound, resisting some damage for him, but Harry still suspected that his bones might have been broken.
Even so, he clung to the corner of the tombstone tightly and was taken to fly.
The spells of the Death Eaters fell one after another, and the striking sparks one after another on the ground and the tombstone.
The withered old tree was also ignited by a flame curse, and the hot flame burned its broken body. It was still strong under the action of the transformation magic, exerting the last residual heat, and struggling to uproot.
The elongated roots are like the dismemberment of tentacles and centipedes instead of two legs, giving the Treant who should have been immobile the ability to move.
It stood three or four stories high, covered in flames, like a fairy tree spirit in a fairy tale, waving its forearms vigorously and attacking the Death Eaters in front of them, so that they could not pursue Harry.
On the other side, Harry had already smashed to the ground with the tombstone, and rolled on the ground twice in embarrassment, groaning in pain.
"Harry, are you okay?" Sirius ran to Harry quickly, helped him up, and said worriedly.
Harry felt that the skeleton of his whole body was about to fall apart, but he saw that Sirius' excitement suppressed everything, so he shook his head decisively, saying that he was fine now.
"Harry, Sirius, you'd better wait for the old days, we have to go quickly! Those ghosts and my treants can't be delayed for long..." Ivan said hurriedly.
Sirius nodded, and saw that Harry was safe and his anger subsided a bit.
But soon, Sirius seemed to have thought of something, and the expression on his face instantly froze. "But where should we go now? The mysterious man will definitely follow the path of magic. We can't take him to Hogsmeade Village..."
The furious Voldemort might kill people when he sees them. Although there are many wizards there who can buy time for them to escape, he can't do it with someone else's life in exchange for his own.
Ivan's frown was also in trouble. He naturally knew that Apparition could be tracked.
In the second grade, the law enforcers in the wizarding market used a magic item to track Dougert's apparition. Ivan had no doubt that Voldemort could do this.
In other words, no matter where they flee, they will eventually be overtaken...
Ivan thought anxiously. The only hope now is to wait for Dumbledore’s rescue. Hermione and Ron’s have already notified him, but even if the old professor has learned of the news, they will not be able to be sure for a while. Specific location.
Thousands of thoughts flashed through Ivan's mind, and at the same time a fierce roar rang in the cemetery.
"You trash!"
"It's a mysterious man!" Sirius's expression suddenly changed, and he knew that Voldemort might have settled the ghosts.
Sure enough, the next second, a violent explosion sounded in the cemetery, and the flame tree man erected in the center was blown into pieces of wood in the sky by a black magic...
"Harry, Sirius, grab my hand! I know where to go!" Ivan vaguely thought of a place and suddenly shouted loudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 706: Close contact with Voldemort
chapters.content:
Harry and Sirius also knew the urgency of the matter, and grabbed Ivan by the wrist without any delay.
"Apparate~" Ivan said the spell immediately.
However, the magic was forcibly stopped before it was activated, and a pale hand with no trace of blood pressed against his shoulder.
Ivan only felt a chill behind his back, and he turned his head abruptly, Voldemort's strange snake face was in front of him, and his red eyes were fierce.
A cold breath was penetrating his body along his shoulders. Ivan could clearly feel that the hand on his shoulder was tightening quickly, and his vitality was being pulled away a little bit.
It was too late to be surprised or too late to scream and scream. The rich combat experience in the past allowed Ivan to make the right decision-Snake Eye was activated in the first place!
The dark pupils in his eyes turned into orange-yellow without warning.
Those are the eyes of the basilisk!
Voldemort, who was unprepared, was immediately struck, and the hand clasped tightly on Ivan's shoulder stopped tightening, with an expression of anger on his face.
On the other side, Ivan felt that the magic power in his body was pouring out like a flood, and he felt that he would be sucked into a man in at most three seconds.
Fortunately, at this moment, Sirius reacted. He drew his wand at the fastest speed in his life and pointed it at Voldemort's snake face, shouting sharply.
"AvadaKedavra~ (Avada Kedavra
An emerald green light flew out of Sirius' wand!
This voice sounded unmistakable to Ivan. He stared at Voldemort firmly, hoping that this curse would remake Voldemort a remnant soul.
But Ivan was quickly astonished to discover that Voldemort had moved under the influence of his snake eyes, and his lips pressed together as if he was thinking something.
The green light hit Voldemort's body in the next moment, blasting him out, and his figure was broken into a cloud of black mist in mid-air...
Ivan didn't even bother to check Voldemort's state, and immediately put away the magic eye, and activated the teleport magic again.
"Apparate~ (Phantom Shift
...
Along with the interlacing of space, three figures appeared out of thin air on the top of a cliff.
Ivan half-kneeled on the ground, breathing heavily. The confrontation that took less than a second just now exhausted his energy.
Not to mention that he also led people to use Apparition during the battle.
Thinking of this, Ivan was a little scared. I really wanted to say that he could only succeed with less than four levels of certainty when he launched the magic. Fortunately, luck was on their side.
"Mysterious man... is he dead?" Sirius was still thinking about that scene, as if he had hit Voldemort with a killing curse.
Harry was also a little excited. The wizard hit by the death curse would undoubtedly die except in a few cases, and Voldemort would lose his power no matter what, and they seemed to end the Dark Lord once again.
"I think it shouldn't have..." Ivan shook his head. He thought Harry and Sirius were too optimistic. Voldemort should have used some spell in the end and avoided it, so his body would disperse when he was hit Open.
If the power of the Demon Eye were stronger and could completely control Voldemort, Sirius's moment might really bring him back to his original form.
It's a pity that there is only one chance, and I will definitely be defensive if I want to use this to provoke Voldemort in the future.
Thinking of this, Ivan sighed involuntarily, but when he faced Horcrux as early as the second grade, he discovered that the magic eye had a limited effect on Voldemort.
On the one hand, the opponent's power and magic are stronger than his own, and on the other hand, the opponent is also fused with the blood of the basilisk, which is highly resistant and scary.
"Where are we now?" Harry struggled to get up from the ground and looked around. There was a sea in front of him, and they were standing on a cliff by the sea.
The salty and wet sea breeze continued to blow by, and the sound of waves hitting the rocks could be heard from time to time.
"Isn't this the place where we destroyed the mysterious man's Horcrux last time?" Sirius quickly recognized it. He turned his head and looked into the distance and could still vaguely see a Muggle village.
"Yes! The professor is now near that small village. As long as we send out a signal here, he will definitely be able to see and come over!" Ivan talked freely, and then asked Sirius and Phoenix if there is any emergency contact sign.
Sirius thought for a while, raised his hand to point his wand at the sky, and launched a crimson light beam.
"As long as Dumbledore sees it, he can understand that something very urgent is happening here."
Having said that, Sirius's face showed a somewhat relaxed look, as did Harry, and there was nothing more reassuring than knowing that Dumbledore was nearby.
Ivan was a little disturbed in his heart. Only he understood that Dumbledore had been hit by the black magic on the Horcrux, and he was in a bad state now, and he had no idea whether he could beat Voldemort.
"Wait... why is there no sound?" Sirius said strangely. It stands to reason that this curse should explode in mid-air to reveal a soaring phoenix.
Sirius suddenly raised his head and looked towards the sky. Only a black cloud shrouded in the sky, and something seemed to vaguely surging in the cloud.
"It's Voldemort... the magic of a mysterious man! He's chasing it over!" Ivan said eagerly. He originally thought that even if his magic eye and Sirius' death curse couldn't seriously hurt Voldemort, the other party would need a good rest. , I didn't expect Voldemort to come so soon!
"Run!" Sirius roared, and quickly took Harry's hand and ran down the mountain.
"The flames are raging!" Ivan cast a flame curse on the surroundings while running.
Since there is no special logo , it is most obvious that the mountain is set on fire. If Dumbledore is nearby, he will definitely come to investigate in person or by someone!
In fact, Ivan wants to use Lihuo more!
Because the characteristics of fierce fire are very obvious, the wizard can easily tell that it is not a naturally generated flame, but the effect of black magic!
Under the light of the fire, the sky became darker and darker. This abnormal thing cast a shadow over the hearts of Ivan and others.
Suddenly, a gloomy wailing sound passed to the ears of several people along with the sea breeze, and the black mist surging in the air suddenly condensed into a strange skull face.
Skeleton’s mouth was wide open, and a large python made of black mist swooped down from the sky, rushing towards the three people below...
Fear, despair, pain... Countless negative emotions flooded my mind the moment I saw the black python, swallowing their courage and belief.
And those thick black fog is more like it can deprive life, the black big python swiftly passed over the forest, the original lush branches and leaves have withered and withered...

chapters.title: Chapter 707: Long time no see, Tom!
chapters.content:
The large python made of black mist snaked around the snake's body and quickly approached, and the negative emotions that continued to breed in his mind became more and more intense.
Ivan and Sirius can still bear it, but Harry, who is already weak, can’t do much. He fell because of distraction while running. If Sirius hadn’t been dragging him, he might have rolled directly to the bottom of the mountain. went.
"Harry! Are you okay?" Sirius asked worriedly.
Harry panted and shook his head. He didn't even have the strength to answer, he just felt that his legs were about to break.
Ivan knew very well that he couldn't continue like this. It was impossible for them to beat the black mist by relying on their legs.
If he is alone, Ivan is sure to escape smoothly under Voldemort's hands, and even fights with blood magic for a while, but if he needs to protect other people at the same time, this will become an extremely difficult job.
He turned his head and glanced. The large python that was tens of feet long was getting closer and closer to them. The head of the snake at the foremost end opened its mouth wide, as if to swallow them in one bite, and there was something spreading in the snake's mouth. The black mist even faintly revealed Voldemort's weird and ferocious face.
Ivan, who had battled Horcruxes before, didn't dare to let these black mists get close, and immediately waved his wand and shouted loudly.
"ExpectoPatronum~ (Hushen guard
The glaring white light cut through the darkness, and then a crisp neighing sound resounded in the desolate mountains. The vast white mist gushed from the top of Ivan’s wand, quickly condensed into an illusory unicorn, straight He rushed into the open mouth of the snake and ran across the long snake's body.
However, what Ivan did not expect was that Voldemort did not condense the black mist and his unicorn shadow like his Horcrux did. Instead, the huge black mist python broke apart in an instant. Coming, the billowing black mist was like a turbulent ocean wave directly pressed towards the three of them.
Ivan's complexion changed suddenly, and he quickly collected most of the white mist, and surrounded his body into a semi-circular shield, protecting everyone in the middle.
The black mist constitutes a "giant wave" and was photographed in the air. As soon as it touched the shield, they began to melt each other, and the thick shield became thinner and thinner under the corrosion of the black mist...
The previous third game had consumed a lot of his power. In addition to transforming the tree in the cemetery, using the magic eye, and leading people to perform Apparition, the magic power in the body has already been consumed almost.
Without a lot of magical support, the patron saint curse he used was not Hei Mist's opponent at all.
Harry and Sirius also hurriedly waved their wands to release their patron saint, but without the blessing of blood, their patron saint curse was extremely fragile, and it only persisted for a few seconds before it fell apart.
Ivan on the other side also felt that the shield he had created was on the verge of collapse.
"Get ready, I'm afraid we have to move again! Sirius, you take Harry away first, and I'll be there soon!" Ivan said eagerly.
Harry was very worried that Ivan would stay here alone, but he knew better that he was a cumbersome now, so he opened his mouth and said nothing in the end.
Sirius nodded solemnly, and prepared to cast the spell without delay holding Harry's hand.
Although it is extremely dangerous to use Phantom Transformation in battle, it might be split and die here, but the current situation can no longer help him think so much, Sirius can only hope that luck can stand again. They are here once!
At this moment, Ivan, who was maintaining the protective magic, suddenly found that the pressure he had to bear was much less, and the black mist that surrounded him was slowly receding.
Sirius, who was also aware of the abnormality, stopped casting the spell, showing a hint of joy on his face. Voldemort had no reason to let them go. This probably meant that the support they had been waiting for had arrived!
Sure enough, a misty fairy music soon spread into their ears, and the sound got closer and closer. After a while, a phoenix bursting into flames rushed out of the black fog.
"It's Fox!" Harry shouted in surprise.
Ivan and Sirius were really relieved when they saw the phoenix. They knew they were safe.
After seeing the three of them, Fox couldn't help but let out a cheerful scream, and then the golden red flames swaying all around exploded.
The endless fire light occupied the vision of Ivan and others, and the warm flame covered the whole body, instantly dispelling the coldness brought by the black mist.
Ivan thought that Fox was here to take them away, but he didn't. They were still there after the fire dissipated.
And Fox has turned into a huge flame phoenix, and fought in mid-air with the black mist condensed python.
The boa constrictor twisted its body ferociously, biting on the flame phoenix's wings with its big mouth open and tearing it hard, and the long snake body rolled up even more.
The golden-red flaming phoenix pecking at the python's head with its beak regardless, one paw clasps the snake's tail tightly, and strands of golden "feathers" are constantly floating down and burning on the python's body, exploding. Potholes came out one after another.
Watching this battle in mid-air, Ivan really couldn't tell who had the upper hand. He only knew that with the magic of the two, he might not be able to tell the winner for a while.
"ExpectoPatronum~" Ivan was worried that Dumbledore would be defeated if he was not in good condition, so he summoned the patron saint again and planned to intervene in the battle!
As soon as the unicorn appeared, he let out an angry neigh. The defeat of the previous battle made the Soul of Cecilia extremely dissatisfied, when even the sharp horns on the top of his head ran into the black fog boa.
But before it got close to the boa constrictor that knew it was invincible, it collapsed into a black mist...
The victorious flame phoenix didn't mean to pursue it like Nirvana, it turned into a ball of fire and fell straight from the air to the ground. In the burst of fire, Dumbledore's figure emerged.
He just stood in front of the three of them, his robes rattled by the waves of flames, and his long silver-white beard was also blown by the wind, but Dumbledore didn't care, his eyes were tight. Staring not far ahead.
A large amount of black mist was quickly gathering there again, and finally condensed into a figure, that is Voldemort!
The two stood facing each other like this, a faint sense of oppression continued to extend from them, and Harry and Sirius couldn't even speak under such an aura of confrontation.
Ivan's situation is much better, and he is basically unaffected, but he still feels a little uncomfortable...
"Long time no see, Tom!" Dumbledore looked at Voldemort and greeted quietly, as if they were not engaged in a life-and-death confrontation, but an ordinary meeting.
(PS: One more)

chapters.title: Chapter 708: What you do will only push yourself to death faster!
chapters.content:
"Yeah! It's been a few years! Four years ago you messed up my resurrection plan, but it's a pity... this time I won!" Voldemort said in a high tone, showing a bit of delight on his face. color.
"My loyal servants carried out the wonderful plan I came up with and brought Harry Potter out of your protection!"
"Look, I truly defeated death and gained a new body. Now no one can stop me... and you, Dumbledore!"
Voldemort said sullenly, his red eyes fixed on Dumbledore, hoping to see the color of regret and regret on Dumbledore's face.
But none of this, Dumbledore just looked at him with extremely disappointed eyes, and then said in a deep voice.
"I think I told you, Tom, blind optimism will make people lose the most basic ability to judge. All you do is push yourself into the abyss of death faster..."
"Put away your preaching, Dumbledore!" Voldemort interrupted Dumbledore's words viciously, "If you expect a few words to influence me, then save it! Or... you plan to rely on it. Is this to cover up your mistakes?"
"Mistake? It's not unreasonable to think so. The fact that you used the Imperius Curse to control Alastor and Sirius was indeed beyond my expectation..." Dumbledore said multilaterally, gently lifting his wand with his left hand. "But I think it's not too late to make up for this mistake!"
"Are you going to kill me? Here? With some burden?" Voldemort sneered disdainfully.
"Bulky? Do you really think so? Tom? You shouldn't underestimate anyone..." Dumbledore said meaningfully. "If I guessed correctly, you've already suffered a bit, haven't you?"
Voldemort suddenly recalled the scenes of successive failures in the cemetery before, and his face gradually became gloomy and even became a little distorted.
"Then try it!" Without warning, Voldemort raised his wand. The target was not Dumbledore, but Sirius who was not far away from him.
"AvadaKedavra~ (Avada Kedavra
A gloomy green beam flashed in mid-air, and Sirius did not expect that Voldemort would suddenly aim at him. Although he reacted immediately, it was still too late!
Fortunately, at this moment, a group of golden flames blocked Sirius, Fox went out of the flames and swallowed the green light beam, then it burst into flames and fell to the ground, turning into a wrinkle. Baba's nestling.
The moment Voldemort shot, Dumbledore also attacked at the same time, and a crimson light beam shot out from the tip of the rod, flew out with amazing energy, and hit Voldemort directly.
Ivan and others who witnessed this scene all felt a palpitation.
A dignified color also appeared on Voldemort's face. He conjured a shiny silver shield out of thin air to block him, and the golden light beam hit it and exploded immediately.
The rising fire light and air waves spread in all directions, a huge roar echoed continuously in the desolate mountains, and several cracks gradually spread on the solid silver shield.
But Voldemort didn't have the time to manage, a strong sense of crisis enveloped his heart, the attack... came from behind, he didn't turn his head to look, his figure disappeared in a flash.
Less than a second after he left, a big hand made of wood was shot in the air.
At some point, the towering tree beside Voldemort has changed its appearance, and it has completely turned into a tall wooden giant!
Compared with the simple treant in the cemetery, it looks more solid and lifelike. Not only does the thick branch at one end change into the shape of a human arm, it even "grows" two fast moving ones. leg……
When the flames and dust disappeared, Voldemort had disappeared in front of him.
Ivan and the others all held their wands tightly, staring at the surroundings, and did not dare to relax their vigilance at all.
The previous encounters have proved that Voldemort can use Apparition freely in battle!
Suddenly, Harry uttered a heart-piercing scream from behind. He felt that the scar on his forehead was about to split, and the pain was unbearable.
Sirius subconsciously turned his head to look at Harry beside him, but a shout rang in his ears.
"Dodge, he is behind you, Sirius!"
It was Ivan's voice, Sirius heard it all at once, without hesitation, a sharp roll dodges the killing curse shot at him, but Harry, who was originally under his protection, became helpless.
At this moment, Harry was kneeling on the ground in pain, covering his head with his hand, and Voldemort appeared in front of him with a gleaming figure, and the pale hand with no trace of blood quickly stretched out towards his neck.
"Reducto! (Bone shattered Ivan waved his wand, and a beam of light shot at Voldemort, trying to force him away from Harry.
But Voldemort didn't care, the curse passed directly through his body, and at this moment Voldemort's hand had been forced to hit Harry's body.
Harry almost lost consciousness in pain. He could only watch Voldemort's hideous face getting closer and closer to him, vaguely he seemed to hear a sound, and then he felt like his back was being pulled severely. After a while, the whole person flew out directly, and was pulled into Dumbledore's arms.
Voldemort just watched as Dumbledore used a flying curse to pull Harry away by himself I was a little disappointed in my heart.
But he didn't intend to pursue it. This attack exposed his figure and changed his identity from hunter to prey...
Just between the sparks and flints, Ivan rushed towards Voldemort, manipulating the shadow of the unicorn that had not been able to do anything.
Sirius also once again struck out a killing curse and flew towards Voldemort!
This time, the Killing Curse still didn't work, and Voldemort just waved his wand lightly and resisted it.
The shadow of the unicorn in front of him made Voldemort frowned. His figure flashed and he was going to use Apparition again to avoid the attack. However, a brief sense of solidity suddenly appeared and interrupted his casting .
Rooting spell!
Beyond the illusory figure of the unicorn, Voldemort could clearly see that the elder wand held by Dumbledore was pointing at him.
Although he immediately cancelled the magic and restored the ability to act, this moment of delay also caused Voldemort to have no time to perform the second Apparition...

chapters.title: Chapter 709: He is back!
chapters.content:
The shadow of the unicorn came instantaneously, and those shiny hooves stepped on Voldemort's body!
Voldemort's chest was visibly dented, his body as if being hit by a bull, he flew horizontally, tumbled and fell to the tree behind...
Of course Dumbledore would not give up this excellent opportunity. The old magic wand held by his left hand shook, and the golden red flames scattered on the ground quickly floated up and turned into a huge flame whip and slammed it over!
Before Voldemort fell to the ground, the "Long Whip" had already caught up with him and hit him.
The golden-red flame was like a tarsal maggot. As soon as it touched his body, it rushed up, and the screams of screams quickly sounded through the woods...
"Confringo~! (Thunderbolt explosion
"AvadaKedavra~! (AvadaKedavra
Ivan and Sirius didn't mean the slightest sympathy. Instead, they beat down the dog and cast a spell directly at Voldemort!
However, before their magic arrived, Voldemort had disappeared there, and the two curses directly hit the tree behind him, and the fierce fire blasted the innocent, disaster-stricken old tree to pieces.
Countless flaming pieces of wood fell from the air, and Dumbledore gently waved his wand, and a strong wind swept the pieces to the sides.
Sirius was very nervously on guard for a while. He didn't wait for Voldemort's attack, and then relaxed a little, turned his head to look at Dumbledore and asked.
"The mysterious man escaped?"
Dumbledore nodded, staring at the heavily damaged dense forest, and said in a deep voice. "This injury will surely make Tom a good rest for a while!"
Ivan heard the subtext of Dumbledore, somewhat helpless, which means that Voldemort did not hurt the root this time, and he was able to jump around after a period of rest.
After confirming that he was safe, Sirius ran to Harry's side for the first time, helped him up, and asked worriedly.
"Harry, how is it? Does the scar still hurt?"
"Okay... better..." Harry stood up hard, touched the lightning scar on his forehead, muttered to himself.
Since Voldemort left, the scar hasn't been painful anymore, but Harry didn't understand why he was suddenly like that.
So after regaining his senses, Harry looked at Dumbledore anxiously and asked. "Professor Dumbledore, what the **** is going on? Why would I..."
"Obviously this is Tom's magic..." Dumbledore interrupted Harry's words, then said carefully.
"Harry, you bounced the killing curse cast by Voldemort on the night of your birth, depriving him of his power and turning him into a wandering spirit. Perhaps it was at that time that you established a special connection, so Only Voldemort can influence you through some means..."
Dumbledore's words were a bit vague, Harry was confused, but he at least understood one thing, he could see Voldemort's actions through his dreams, on the contrary Voldemort could also influence him in some way.
Ivan knew more, but he didn't mean to interject, after all, there is no difference between telling Harry the truth now and directly telling Voldemort...
As several people were chatting, there was a vague wave of spatial fluctuations on the left. Harry and Sirius, who had become scared birds, subconsciously raised their wands and pointed at them, but they quickly put them down.
Because this time the Apparition was transformed by McGonagall, Arthur, Moody and others, Ron and Hermione were among them, obviously being brought here together.
What the few people saw as soon as they arrived was a tragic post-war scene. The surrounding dense forest was still burning with raging fires. The grass was full of potholes blown out by curses. The only thing that made them feel fortunate was Ivan. , Harry, and Sirius were all standing there.
"Harry, Ivan, are you all right?" Ron saw that Harry's state was a little wrong at a glance, and he immediately surrounded him.
Hermione was even more excited and directly rushed to hug Ivan.
Ivan, who was already a little weak, was almost knocked to the ground, and he took two steps back to stabilize his figure, without being embarrassed in public.
The little witch also keenly noticed Ivan's slightly changed face, quickly let go of her hand, and asked worriedly. "Are you hurt? Ivan?"
"No, no, I'm just a little tired." Ivan shook his head. The continuous high-intensity battles really made him a little overwhelmed, especially his magic power had almost bottomed out.
Hermione scanned him for a while, only to see that his clothes showed no signs of damage.
Being stared at by Hermione so much, Ivan felt very uncomfortable, so he turned the subject and asked what happened in Hogwarts after he left.
The little witch didn't mean to conceal, and she spoke the matter as fast as a cannon.
Soon after Ivan left, Aysia, Jasmine, and the Aurors solved the snails and a large number of giant spiders that had escaped from the maze.
She and Ron went to the castle to find Snape and Professor Flitwick as Ivan had previously ordered.
