It's just that they ran into the professors who sensed the commotion and came out to investigate halfway.
It took a lot of time to explain, and in the end Snape chose to stay in the castle to maintain order. Flitwick took them to the Muggle village not far from here and found Dumbledore and them.
"I told Professor Dumbledore about Sirius taking Harry away Everyone guessed that Sirius was probably controlled by the mysterious man’s Imperius curse, or someone pretended to be a compound decoction. Became the appearance of Sirius...In short, we are all worried, but we can't find where you are..." Hermione said with fear.
Then they saw the flames rising from here. Dumbledore thought it should be a flame caused by magic, so he sent Fox to investigate...
While Hermione was still explaining here, the people from the Order of the Phoenix on the other side also walked up. Moody at the front looked at the traces of battle left nearby, and looked at Dumbledore with a solemn expression. Asked the question.
"Albus, we have all seen the mark of the dark devil in the sky! Did you confront that person?"
"You guessed it right, Alastor, I've seen Tom. He has now regained his strength and gained a brand new body..." Dumbledore nodded and replied.
Although there was speculation before, when Dumbledore confirmed the news, Moody and others could not help but feel a deep chill from the soles of their feet...
The Voldemort who made everyone in the magical world afraid to call his name more than ten years ago has really returned...

chapters.title: Chapter 710: Have you defeated the mysterious man?
chapters.content:
For a while, everyone was stunned by the news, and the atmosphere on the court suddenly became a bit condensed.
In the end, it was Hermione who reacted first and asked curiously. "What about the mysterious man now? You must have defeated him, right?"
"Well, the mysterious man was beaten badly by us and suffered serious injuries. Professor Dumbledore said that he would definitely not be able to come out and make a fuss during this time!" Ivan said with a heart to ease the atmosphere.
"Yes, when I was in the cemetery, the Killing Curse I released almost hit him!" Sirius also pretended to be relaxed, adding.
"There is such a thing?" Lupin was surprised, "then you almost became the second savior of the magic world?"
"I also think it's a pity, just a little bit!" Sirius said with a raised eyebrow.
"Then after you go back, you must tell me how you escaped from Voldemort's hands..." Lupin stepped forward and patted Sirius on the shoulder, laughing and joking.
Amidst the conversation and laughter of several people, McGonagall, Arthur and others also gradually slowed down from the shocking news of Voldemort's resurrection, especially after learning that Dumbledore and others had injured Voldemort once. I feel relieved a lot.
If they can defeat Voldemort once, they can defeat him a second and third time! Until he was sent to hell!
"By the way, Sirius. We just heard Miss Granger and Mr. Weasley say that you brought Harry out of Hogwarts. What is going on? Is it possible that you were also taken by the mysterious man? The soul curse is under control?" Lupin asked strangely.
"It was Peter who used the compound decoction to become me and sneak into Hogwarts..." Sirius sighed, and then briefly said the cause and effect of the matter.
When Sirius talked about Kreacher risking his life to sneak into Riddle’s House, but he was tortured to death by the Imperius curse, the faces of Lupin, McGonagall, and Arthur were full of horror. , It is both the miserable experience of poor Kreacher and the loyalty of this house elf.
When Hermione heard this paragraph, she lay on Ivan's shoulder and sobbed in a low voice...
Ivan calmed Hermione softly, with mixed feelings in his heart. It was Kreacher’s leak in the original time and space that indirectly led to Sirius’s death. I don’t want this house elf now to do the exact opposite and sacrifice his own. His life saved Sirius.
"It's an amazing elf! We should have treated him better..." Lupin sighed.
Sirius's expression was very lonely.
He has always hated Kreacher since he was a child. He thinks that this house elf's mind is full of extremely pure blood thoughts inherited from his mother, so he has never had a good face for Kreacher, and never thought about each other. He was willing to save his life for himself.
Just when everyone was feeling sentimental, Moody interjected wildly. "I have to say, Sirius... you are usually too public, so mysterious people can easily grasp your movements and learn that you and Harry will go to the game..."
Sirius did not refute Moody's words, his face was full of guilt and regret. He understood that Moody was right.
During the time that he was successfully acquitted, he could not wait to make up for the ten-year delay in Azkaban. Voldemort wanted to investigate his itinerary couldn't be easier.
After reprimanding Sirius, Moody turned his gaze to Arthur Weasley, and said with a bit of hatred for iron and steel. "And you, Arthur, I have long reminded you to pay close attention to every doubt when handling the case. If you could find out the difference between me and Sirius earlier, things might not have progressed to such a bad stage!"
Arthur laughed bitterly. At the time of the World Quidditch Cup, the mysterious man had no news at all. How could he imagine that the other party would appear directly in the camp, and controlled Sirius with the Imperius Curse...
Moody slapped his mouth and wanted to continue, but Dumbledore interrupted his words at this time.
"Well, stop for a while, Alastor, now is not the time to discuss these, we still have a lot of things to deal with..."
"In addition, I don't think that this time the failure was caused by the fault of one person. Even if you are always cautious, Tom will make other plans to achieve his goals!" Dumbledore was relieved. Talking.
Lupin nodded together. Voldemort was able to hit them by surprise this time. The most important reason was that no one could have expected that Voldemort had quietly recovered some strength with Peter's help, so they were a little negligent.
"Albus, now that Harry is safe, then it's time for us to return to Hogwarts... The children also need a rest!" McGonagall reminded eagerly.
She had heard Hermione talk about the riot in Hogwarts, and was very worried that if they went back too late, other accidents would happen.
Dumbledore naturally had no objection, and he greeted everyone and prepared to apparate and leave.
"Wait, Professor..." Harry said anxiously as if he had suddenly remembered something. "Sparkling...Sparkling is still there!"
"Sparkling, the house elf who was expelled by Barty? Isn't it working for Voldemort now?" Moody asked strangely.
McGonagall and the others also turned their eyes to Harry. After listening to Sirius, they certainly knew who Shining was Harry quickly tortured Shining with Voldemort in the cemetery. The matter was told, and he felt that Shining should have been forced to obey Voldemort, and now after the death of Little Crouch, it has become an ownerless house elf.
Now that Voldemort had been beaten away by them, those Death Eaters would not dare to stay in the cemetery for a long time. Shining who had been in a coma is likely to be abandoned there.
"Harry, although I don't want to say that, those Death Eaters won't allow Shining to live, it knows too many secrets..." Sirius reminded hesitantly.
Harry's eyes dimmed suddenly.
Dumbledore on the side suddenly spoke. "After I send you back to Hogwarts, I will take the time to look there... Maybe those Death Eaters will spare it if they go in a hurry."
"Thank you, Professor!" Harry turned his head to look at Dumbledore in surprise.
"As for now, holding my wrist, we should go back, Harry!" Dumbledore said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 711: The mysterious man has no heart at all
chapters.content:
Due to the decline of Fox’s strength in Nirvana just now, everyone had to apparate to Hogsmeade Village and then return to school from there.
It was almost ten o'clock in the evening when they arrived. The castle was still brightly lit, and there were noises from the auditorium from time to time.
Aisia, Bill, and Jasmine waited anxiously outside the hall, and when they saw a few people approaching, Mrs. Weasley greeted them with excitement.
"It's great, it looks like you are all safe!" Mrs. Weasley held Harry and Ron tightly in her arms, looked around, and noticed that all the people involved in the operation Not less, the heart she had been holding was completely let go.
Aisia on the other side pulled Ivan to the corner, and looked carefully at Ivan's body. He was relieved to see that his complexion was not bad at all, and he was not injured at all.
Immediately afterwards, Aysia hurriedly questioned the whole story. Although she had already inquired a lot of information from Jasmine, it was not comprehensive enough.
"It's a mysterious man! He sent someone to pretend to be Sirius and captured Harry, and used his blood to restore his strength and obtain a new body." Ivan explained solemnly.
"That is to say, the mysterious man is resurrected?" There was a little haze on Aysia's face. She had experienced the last wizarding war, and she knew exactly what it meant.
"Yes, Professor Dumbledore and I wounded him together, and he should be safe for a while..." Ivan said.
Esiah was not happy because Ivan had injured the legendary Dark Lord, on the contrary, she became more and more sad. She was worried that Voldemort would retaliate against them after he healed the injury.
Ivan also understood this. When he went to save Harry before, he knew that he would definitely attract Voldemort's attention.
Of course, even if there was no such thing, he would have been in the eyes of Voldemort for a long time. After all, he destroyed three whole Horcruxes in the past four years, plus the original enmity of the two eggs, Voldemort would not be able to bypass it anyway. he.
Fortunately, the way to deal with it, he had already thought about it during the summer vacation last year...
"Mom, do you remember the magic that I told you last time?" Ivan suddenly asked.
Aisia was stunned, but soon understood what Ivan meant. "Are you talking about the Courageous Faithful Curse?"
"Yes! We can use this magic to build an absolutely safe stronghold!" Ivan nodded.
The worried look on Aisia’s face disappeared a lot, and she knew the effect of this magic. In this case, even Voldemort would not be able to find them where he wanted revenge...
"Who will be this secretive?"
Aisia frowned at the thought of this.
The power of the Red Loyalty Mantra is powerful, but it is not invincible. The biggest weakness lies in the secretaries!
When Ivan talked to her about this magic, he mentioned that because the secretaries need to bear the secret, they can’t stay in the safe room for a long time, which will cause the power to protect the magic to become weaker and weaker.
If Voldemort arrives near the protected site to explore at this time, it is very likely that he will find some clues...
So it is said that most of the time the confidential person must stay outside at all times facing the risk of being pursued and killed.
This is also the reason why Peter, who took on the important role of the secrecy more than ten years ago, did not live with James and Lily, but needed to find another place to hide.
Because of this, if you don’t want to repeat the same mistakes, the confidential person must be a powerful and truly trustworthy wizard, otherwise, if the other party betrays or is killed, the confidential location may be leaked out.
At this stage, there are too few powerful but trustworthy wizards. Although she and Ivan meet the requirements in all aspects, they are also not suitable to be secretaries, because the use of the loyalty spell to build the safe house is to protect their safety. ...
"How about letting Dougert act as the secretive?" Aysia said hesitantly.
"No, never!" Ivan shook his head resolutely.
After the resurrection of the mysterious man, Dougt's position became blurred, and whether he was trustworthy was still open to question.
After all, this guy has a precedent for betraying his colleagues and taking refuge in Voldemort. Even with a variety of reasons, this can't be completely cleared!
So Ivan can't trust him at all, and the dark mark on Dougt's left arm has not been eliminated. This is a great destabilizing factor!
If Ivan hadn't seen Dougt in the Death Eaters camp when he was rescuing Harry tonight, he should discuss with Aysia how to lock up this guy...
"How about this, Mom, you have been looking for a suitable place in Knockdown Alley these two days, and I will cast the spell myself..." Ivan hesitated for a long time, and finally decided to take the risk by himself.
However, before he could finish speaking, Aysia was strongly opposed.
"Do you want to be a secret security by yourself? Are you crazy? The person the mysterious man wants to kill most is you!" Aysia said angrily. Even if she assumes the role of secret, it is better than Ivan personally. .
"The mysterious man is not as strong as you think, he can't kill me, mother, can't you forget? I just beat him away!" Ivan said helplessly and comforted Actually Ivan has never worried about his own safety. Although he is not yet Voldemort's opponent in terms of strength alone, Ivan is confident to escape Voldemort's pursuit without dragging him down.
Not to mention that he still has the bloodline magic Bogut transformation, can pretend to be anyone, even any creature, it is strange that Voldemort caught him.
After Ivan persuaded him for more than ten minutes, Aysia finally reluctantly agreed.
In its current form, this is already the best plan, because Ivan spends most of the year in Hogwarts, Dumbledore is here, Voldemort has no guts, and summer vacation You can also go to Nico LeMay to learn alchemy...
At least these places seem to be safe from Esiah.
While the two were chatting, Jasmine Weasley and others were also listening to Harry and Sirius talking about what happened.
After learning that Harry was tortured by Voldemort with the Heart Drilling Curse tonight and was almost hit by the Killing Curse, Mrs. Weasley almost couldn't control her emotions and said in a trembling voice. "Oh my god~ how can he... how can he bear to use such a vicious spell on a child... this is terrible!"
"Mysterious people have no heart at all, mother..." Ron murmured, but soon Mrs. Weasley gave him a fierce look.

chapters.title: Chapter 712: Noisy auditorium
chapters.content:
Under Mrs. Weasley's gaze, Ron was forced to hold back the spitting words that followed.
, Bill stepped forward and patted Harry on the shoulder, and said in a speechless voice. "I have to say, you are so brave today, Harry, surrounded by a group of Death Eaters and duel with a mysterious person, if you want to be me, you will definitely be shocked!"
Harry shook his head. He didn't think his performance was so great. He could escape from the cemetery, all relying on luck, the help of the ghosts, and the rescue of Ivan and Sirius.
But the members of the Order of the Phoenix obviously don't think so. They all agree with Bill's words. Harry can be neither humble nor arrogant when facing Voldemort, and even rises up to fight back. This is enough to make most wizards in the magical world feel ashamed...
"Well, guys, if you want to know more details, please wait until tomorrow. What Harry needs most now is to go to the school hospital for an examination, and then take a good rest!" Sirius squeezed out and surrounded Harry. A few people said with unswerving expressions.
Although Bill and others still had a lot of questions to ask, they had to shut their mouths after seeing Harry's pale complexion and tired expression.
After consulting Dumbledore, Sirius took Harry away. Before leaving, he did not forget to turn his head and look at Ivan, suggesting that he also go to the school hospital.
"No, I'm fine!" Ivan shook his head, rejecting Sirius's kindness.
He has learned medical magic himself, and he knows his physical condition better. He is not injured. At most, he consumes too much magic power and is a little sluggish...
……
At the same time in the auditorium, all the students gathered around the long tables of the four colleges waiting anxiously, or whispering to each other about the chaos on the Quidditch pitch in the evening.
The voices of several prefects who maintained order were all screaming, but it was of no avail. In desperation, they had to look at the teacher's seat on the stage.
Snape was sitting alone on the empty teacher's bench, with a sullen expression on his left arm, he didn't even think about the messy discussions underneath, and he didn't even hear the shouts of the prefects.
About a few minutes later, the door of the auditorium was pushed open. Hundreds of little wizards immediately glanced over. Several professors and Dumbledore who had not been seen were walking in from the hall.
Ivan and the others went to the long table in Gryffindor and sat down together.
"Ivan, where did you go tonight? I heard that Harry was taken away. Is that true?" Before a few people had a good rest, George and Fred quickly got together Came over and asked curiously.
"Well, the same can be said, Professor Dumbledore will explain to you in detail later..." Ivan said vaguely.
Hermione, Ron and others on the other side were also surrounded by other Gryffindor wizards, and they all asked their whereabouts.
When the riots broke out in the evening, many people heard the conversations of Ivan and others, and they were naturally very interested in it.
"Quiet!"
On the stage, Dumbledore's voice rang, his face was very serious, not at all as gentle as usual.
The little wizards who sensed this all silenced, and the noisy auditorium suddenly became very silent, as if everyone had been cursed.
"Tonight, many unexpected things happened to us, and I know you must have a lot of questions now, but before telling this news, I still have to say another thing first, so as not to spoil your still beautiful mood……"
Dumbledore looked around the auditorium in a half-moon shape, and finally fixed on Ivan's body. After a pause, he spoke.
"First of all, I need to congratulate Mr. Ivan Hals for winning the first place in the Triwizard Tournament and winning this honor for Hogwarts! And he performed extremely well in the competition and is a well-deserved warrior..."
After Dumbledore’s voice fell, there was a sudden warm applause in the auditorium. Both pairs of eyes looked at the Gryffindor long table, and looked at Ivan sitting there with admiration, admiration, and awe.
After three games, even Bussbarton and Demstrang’s students were convinced that Ivan won the championship. There is no way the gap in strength is too big...
Amid the compliments and applause, Ivan nodded to the crowd at will, but there was no slight fluctuation in his heart. After learning the news of Voldemort's resurrection, he had no intention of celebrating the championship.
"Secondly, Harry Potter, he successfully won the second place in the game!" Dumbledore waited for the applause to pause for a while, then said again.
Hearing the words, everyone present applauded while looking away from Ivan, looking for Harry on the Gryffindor long table.
However, what made them strange was that Harry didn't seem to be there. He could not be found in the entire auditorium. The puzzled little wizard couldn't help but think of the rumor, and began to discuss it underneath.
"Presumably some of you have already guessed part of the truth, this is what I am going to say next!" Dumbledore looked at the expressions on everyone's faces and increased the volume loudly Said.
"Just after the Triwizard Tournament, Azkaban’s fugitive Dwarf Peter used the compound soup to disguise himself as Black, and took Harry Potter from the Quidditch Stadium and took him with him. In front of Voldemort..."
"According to Mr. Potter's post-event description, Voldemort needed to use his blood to complete a dark magic ritual and brew a potion to restore his power!"
Dumbledore’s words condensed the atmosphere in the auditorium. Everyone stared at Dumbledore in horror and disbelief, and some even wondered if he was telling a terrible joke.
But Dumbledore’s expression did not reveal any joking, "I must regret to inform you that he has succeeded... We have done some actions to stop this, but it is obviously a step too late..."
"Now... he is resurrected, yes, you heard it right, his magic allowed him to come back to life!"
Dumbledore’s words completely detonated the depressive atmosphere on the court. The little wizards were talking nervously and fearfully, their voices became louder and louder, and they even had a faint tendency to be overwhelmed...
Ivan, Ron, and Hermione, who are insiders, are even more annoying. At first, they were bothered to explain to the students who asked if things were true or false.
But there were too many people who questioned in the end, and a few people simply didn’t bother to explain, believe it or not...

chapters.title: Chapter 713: Illusion of peace
chapters.content:
The people's doubts did not interrupt Dumbledore's words. He raised the pitch a few times, suppressing the noisy voice on the court.
"The Ministry of Magic would definitely not want me to tell you this. The parents of some classmates may not be able to approve of my move, but this incident happened by your side. It is closely related to everyone. I insist on believing in telling the truth forever. Better than lying! Hogwarts should teach you honesty, not lies!"
Dumbledore's tone was very serious. He looked around at the little wizards below, and continued to speak under a pair of panic or confused gazes.
"In the near future we must all spend a very dark time...
So I sincerely hope that everyone present can unite! There is no time when this quality is needed more than in this period, and only when we unite with each other and show the determination to fight against the darkness can we defeat Voldemort and achieve the final victory! "
Having said that, Dumbledore turned to look at Gryffindor’s long table, "For example, tonight there is a good example... After Mr. Potter was taken away by Pettigrew-Peter, his friends Actively launched rescue operations and successfully rescued him from Voldemort..."
Dumbledore retelled the story very briefly, and gave Ivan, Harry, and Ron each one hundred points, and Hermione added fifty points in recognition of their courage tonight. Wisdom, indomitability and loyalty to friends!
Ron below heard Dumbledore praise himself in public and gave him the same scores as Ivan and Harry. He was surprised and a little frightened.
"The professor shouldn't give me so many points, I haven't even seen the face of the mysterious person..." Ron said awkwardly.
"No, the information you provided is very important, Ron!" Ivan said seriously. "If you didn't see through the disguise of Peter Pettigrew, and notified us as soon as possible, then Harry might be dead by the time we arrive!"
While the two were talking, Dumbledore gently waved his magic wand and replaced the three major school flags floating in the air with the golden red lion flag.
"Although there are still a few days before you leave school, judging from the score gap, I think there is no suspense for this year's Academy Cup-it will belong to Gryffindor Academy!" Dumbledore shouted loudly. Tao.
After the announcement of the news, only sparse applause sounded in the auditorium-after all, the news of Voldemort's resurrection was too shocking, compared with the ownership of the Academy Cup has become insignificant.
When the applause in the auditorium stopped completely, Dumbledore spoke. "Okay, that's probably all I want to say. Next, I will ask the prefects to lead the students back to their respective lounges. I think you should all be tired and need a good rest..."
At this moment, Dumbledore's words were suddenly interrupted by a quick knock on the door.
The little wizards who were about to leave looked at them curiously.
Under the gaze of everyone, Fudge led a few Aurors in quickly.
"What the **** are you doing? Albus?" Fudge looked at Dumbledore very annoyed. "I heard you telling a ridiculous story from all over the world..."
He originally hurried over after receiving news of chaos in the playing field, but he just walked outside the hall when he heard Dumbledore talking about Voldemort...
"This is not a story, Connery, but a real thing. I'm about to tell you in detail..." Dumbledore didn't care about Fudge's offense, and said calmly, after winking at the prefects. , And took Fudge and others to the conference room at the side entrance of the auditorium.
Looking at the backs of several people leaving, Ivan shook his head. After the incident with Little Crouch last time, he completely lost faith in Fudge. It is almost impossible for Dumbledore to win the support of the Ministry of Magic. thing.
If he were Dumbledore, he would use the Imperius Curse to control Fudge, or modify the memory to turn the minister into a puppet. Only in this way can the power of the Ministry of Magic be unified.
It's a pity that Dumbledore couldn't do this, so this conversation is doomed to be fruitless...
Thinking of this, Ivan couldn't help shook his head. After saying goodbye to Aysia, he followed the little wizards of Gryffindor back to the lounge.
Lying on the soft bed in the dormitory, Ivan recalled the scenes that happened tonight, turning over and over and couldn't sleep at all. He knew that such a peaceful life might not last long.
……
In the next two days, the atmosphere in the castle became more and more weird.
The leisurely days before leaving school should have been the happiest time for the little wizards, but on weekdays, there are not many little wizards coming out and playing on the grass. Wizards will deliberately avoid them.
As for the reason, Ivan is clear, probably because he was warned by his parents.
Because in recent days, a large number of owls have often been seen flying outside the castle into the principal’s office at the top of the tower I can still hear the sound of scolding from inside. According to Hermione’s guess, it should be. It's a roaring letter from parents.
Obviously, Dumbledore’s public announcement of Voldemort’s return did not meet the expectations of parents. Some people even insisted that they did not want to believe that the Dark Lord had been resurrected, and that their thoughts would naturally be passed on to the next generation.
In such a tense atmosphere, George and Fred went against the trend. They launched a price reduction promotion with great fanfare. All joke toy goods were sold at 30% off, threatening to make Hogwarts lively again. .
But no matter how Ivan looks at it, they are more like they want to clean up the already full inventory before leaving school.
After a turn of time, it soon arrived the day of leaving school. Ivan packed up his luggage in the morning and went to the auditorium to enjoy today’s breakfast.
While passing by the long table of the academy, Ivan vaguely heard two little wizards arguing whether the mysterious man was resurrected.
Harry and Hermione both looked very angry, and even wanted to come forward and argue with each other, but Ron said with his lips poked. "If they don't believe it, let them go. When the mysterious person stands in front of them, it will be too late to regret it!"
Ivan nodded, arguing with these people is undoubtedly a waste of saliva. There are always some diehard elements who would rather be immersed in this illusion of peace forever without cutting them on their bodies...

chapters.title: Chapter 714: It seems that Knockdown Alley needs to be cleaned up!
chapters.content:
Perhaps because this was the last meal before leaving school, today's breakfast was exceptionally rich, and the temptation of delicious food also made several people temporarily forget their worries and enjoy them intently.
After they ate and drank enough, an owl flew in from outside the hall and landed straight on Ivan's shoulder.
Ivan took down the Daily Prophet that was tied at the feet of Owl, opened it to confirm the contents, and then sighed.
"Sure enough!"
"What's wrong? Ivan?" Hermione leaned forward curiously, took a few glances, and quickly understood why Ivan sighed.
Today’s Daily Prophet only recorded the news of Ivan’s successful victory in the Triwizard Tournament, and spent two pages of content retelling the wonderful race of the Triwizard Cup, and the subsequent Harry’s arrest was nothing but a word. Not mentioned.
As for the riots in the school, it was prevarication by the negligence of the personnel.
"It seems that the Ministry of Magic won't make the mysterious people's affairs public..." Ivan casually threw the newspaper aside, and said with a slight disappointment, although this situation had long been expected by him.
"Is Minister Fudge still reluctant to believe that Voldemort has returned? There are so many people who can testify!" Harry was a little puzzled why Fudge was so stubborn.
"It's not the first day you met him, that idiot will only cause us trouble!" Ivan said gruffly.
Fudge’s stupid and stubborn behaviors have exhausted Ivan’s few patience. If he has the ability, he can’t wait to kick Fudge down immediately and switch to a reliable minister...
Harry recalled what happened to Sirius last year, and when he thought of these few contacts with Fudge, he no longer expected the Minister of Magic to wake up, and instead asked curiously.
"By the way, Ivan, don't you usually call Voldemort? Why have you suddenly changed to a mysterious person these days?"
"He has recovered his strength now, so naturally he needs to be more careful." Ivan shrugged and explained.
"Aren't you afraid of him?" Ron's face was full of shock, as if he suddenly learned that Merlin had crawled out of the coffin board.
Harry and Hermione also looked at Ivan in a puzzled manner. They didn't think Ivan would be afraid of Voldemort, after all, Ivan had just injured him two days ago.
"Of course I am not afraid of him!" Ivan said helplessly. "The key is that Tom used magic on his name. If you call out his name directly, you may be tracked. I don't want to cause trouble."
This is how Harry in the original time and space was hit, and he was chased by the Death Eaters and almost died.
Although Ivan doesn’t know if Voldemort ordered the Death Eaters to use this tracking magic, it’s better to be careful about everything. Who will let him beat the opponent...
Harry and Ron looked at each other. It was the first time they knew that there was such a thing. No wonder that few people in the magical world dared to call Voldemort's name. They originally thought it was just because of Voldemort's prestige.
"Ivan is right...it doesn't matter in Hogwarts. The mysterious people don't dare to come here, but if you are outside, you should pay attention to it. Try not to call Voldemort directly. The young wizard has suffered a lot from this!"
Just as a few people were chatting, a familiar voice came into their ears.
"Sirius?!" Harry turned his head in surprise and saw Sirius walking over from the hall.
"I haven't seen you for these two days, we all thought you had gone back." Harry said.
"That's because your Principal Dumbledore asked me to do errands these two days..." Sirius sat down carelessly, grabbed a few pancakes and stuffed it in his mouth, and then took a sip of a cold drink.
Harry and the others were very curious about what task Dumbledore had arranged for him, but Sirius apparently didn't want to say more, and went over it casually.
"Sirius? What about the Ministry of Magic? How did Professor Dumbledore and Fudge talk?" Ivan asked about the business. He didn't participate in the negotiation. Everything was a guess.
"What else? Of course it's a fallout!" Sirius sighed, thinking of the dispute that night, he couldn't help but feel a little annoyed.
Compared with the resurrection of the mysterious man, Fudge is more concerned about Dumbledore's gathering of a large number of wizards without permission from the Ministry of Magic to conduct private actions, and believes that such behavior is a challenge to the authority of the Minister of Magic...Illegal!
They quarreled all night because of this, but nothing happened...
After listening to Sirius's narration, Ivan was speechless. He had already underestimated Fudge as much as possible, but he did not expect the other party to repeatedly refresh his lower cognitive limit.
He can only say about this...this is Fudge!
Harry and Hermione were also disgusted, and Ron even cursed...
"Where is Sparkle? Did you look for it?" Harry suddenly thought of the house elf he had seen in the cemetery, and asked eagerly.
"We have found it. Just as you thought, those Death Eaters rushed to escape and had no time to take care of the life and death of a house elf, so Professor Dumbledore saved it, and it should be in the kitchen now. "
Sirius said with emotion Really, Shining is also one of the culprits of the persecution of Kreacher. Before, she followed Voldemort's instructions to guard herself.
But seeing the other party's malaise being tortured by Voldemort's heart-piercing curse almost lost his life, he didn't bother to care about it.
"Then, before we leave, let's visit Sparkle together!" Hermione suggested.
Harry and Ron had no objection. Kreacher's death made them feel a little more fond of the house-elves.
Ivan also nodded.
After eating breakfast, a few people went to the kitchen together to care about Shining.
It was just that the purpose of Ivan who came in was not very pure. He found a reason to distract Hermione and the others, and directly searched for Shining's memory with the idea of ​​dementia, and successfully obtained the faces of most of the existing Death Eaters.
After all, the Death Eaters who intended to return to Voldemort's command that night all went to the cemetery, and everyone had appeared in front of Shining!
Although Harry also has this memory, he is not good at directly using the psychic mind on Harry, so he can only wrong the house elf!
Ivan closed his eyes and used Occlusion to sort out his memories, and fixed on those faces, his face gradually becoming gloomy, and his mouth muttered to himself.
"Damn it, after I go back, Knockdown Alley must be cleaned up!"

chapters.title: Chapter 715: Semester end summary
chapters.content:
After searching through her memory, Ivan accidentally saw a few familiar faces, those people he had seen in Knock Down Alley!
But it seems normal if you look closely. In the last Wizarding War, the Death Eaters who escaped the sanctions can generally be divided into three types.
Either relied on power and money to get rid of charges like Lucius Malfoy, or relied on reporting colleagues like Karkaroff to escape.
As for the remaining Death Eaters, luckily they escaped the wanted, and were not caught by the Aurors. Most of them just wandered around in Knock Down Alley with accusations...
These people are all extremely unstable factors. After all, they are a threat to Knockdown Alley, so after Ivan prepares to go back, he will clean the Knockdown Alley and take these Death Eaters out and kill them. ,
Incidentally, he also needs to complete the task of rectifying Knockout Alley released by the system, and get the reward of three legendary points. If he adds the legendary points obtained by winning the Goblet of Fire before, he can immediately perform the next blood fusion and enhance his strength!
Although Dumbledore once said that too much power is not a good thing, but Ivan now has no choice.
After all, digging into the power of blood magic is a relatively long process, and there is not much information to help him. The only thing that can be done is to spend a lot of time slowly researching and groping for practice.
And what he lacks most now is time!
No one knows how long Dumbledore can last. Voldemort may have trouble at any time after he has recovered from his injury, and even Hogwarts may become unsafe at that time.
Therefore, Ivan can only choose to tap the power of the bloodline while fusing more bloodlines. The two proceed simultaneously. Only in this way will he not be too passive when facing Voldemort in the future...
Ivan walked out of the kitchen with a heavy heart, took the packed luggage, and left the castle with Harry and the others, preparing to board the carriage drawn by the Yeqi and head to Hogsmeade Station.
When passing by the hall, Ivan accidentally saw the students of Boothbatten gathered on the spacious lawn outside, and he could vaguely see the big Hagrid enthusiastically helping Ms. Maxim to harness the two giant horses. .
"Hi~ Ivan!" Furong, who was waiting for the car, also saw Ivan and the others who came by. When even enthusiastically walked in front of a few people, he stretched out his hand and said.
"Thank you for what happened last time. You saved me and Gabriel. I will remember this kindness. I really hope we will have a chance to meet again in the future..."
"That's just a game. It's not a life-saving grace. Even without me, Professor Dumbledore wouldn't be able to let you have an accident!" Ivan said helplessly, reaching out his hand and shaking Fleur, he Unexpectedly, Furong would still remember this incident.
Furong smiled, she naturally understood this, but that didn't prevent her from being grateful for Ivan's act of extending a helping hand in that moment of crisis.
"You are leaving today? Will you come after that?" Ron looked a little reluctant, not even noticing that Lavender was staring at him in the distance.
"Yes, we'll leave in a while!" Furong nodded, and then she put her long silver hair on her forehead and smiled brightly at several people.
"But I have graduated from Busbarton, and maybe I will come to England to find a job in the future. I still like it here. It just so happens that I have always wanted to find opportunities to improve my English..."
"If you can, I suggest you stay away from England in the past few years... and come back later." Ivan sighed.
"Why? Because of that mysterious person?" Furong raised her eyebrows and said arrogantly. "You may have many people in England who fear him, but we don't think so!"
Although Fleur, who grew up in France, had heard of Voldemort's name and understood that he was a powerful and cruel wizard, but it was limited to this. Without a clearer understanding, he even felt that it was a big deal to avoid it.
"Put away your arrogance, Miss Delacour, you'd better consider Ivan's suggestion carefully, so as not to lose your life in vain!" Hermione said sharply.
Fleur curled her lips and did not argue with Hermione. Maxim was already calling her behind her.
After a simple goodbye to Yifan and the others, Furong hurriedly ran to that side, and walked into the carriage with Busbarton's students.
Then, under the gaze of everyone, the twelve winged silver-mane horses uttered a neigh. They flapped their wings vigorously, pulling the gorgeous carriage and flying towards the sky.
And the giant magic ship docked on the banks of the Black Lake gradually raised its sails, and the students of Durmstrang looked gloomy, standing on the bow of the ship and looking over here, even saying a few goodbyes. Bong.
Their principal, Karkaroff, ran away urgently the night after Voldemort's resurrection. No one knew where he went. There were even rumors that he had left the country overnight and was preparing to flee to America for refuge.
This embarrassed the students of Durmstrang. In the days before they left school, they couldn't hold their heads up in front of the little wizards at Hogwarts and Boothbarton.
The only thing to be thankful for is that the principal is not required to operate the magic ship, it is operated by a special wizard...
Seeing that the time to leave school was approaching, Ivan and the others did not delay anymore. They boarded an empty car pulled by Ye Qi, bumped all the way to the station, and then boarded the Hogwarts train to leave the castle...
In the sound of Kala Kala’s axles turning Ivan followed the train window and looked at the tower of the castle in the distance. He only hoped that when he arrived at Hogwarts next semester, he heard nothing. It will be Dumbledore's death...
【Ding, this school year is over, do you want to make a school year summary? 】
The system prompt sounded in his mind, Ivan converged his mind and said softly, an illusory panel appeared in front of his eyes.
[As of today, your performance this school year is as follows...
class evaluation: perfect
Reward: 200 academic points
......
Final exam results: Transfiguration class (excellent), Potions (excellent), Magic History class (excellent)...
Reward: 900 academic points
Glory: Triwizard Championship (600 grade points), Gryffindor Academy Cup (100 grade points), Quidditch Cup (not held).
Overall reward: 1600 academic points]
Ivan took a general glance. Because of winning the top three championship, this time the award of academic points is more than any previous time.
But with the improvement of his strength, the role of grade points is no longer as obvious as before, and gradually reduced to a method of increasing knowledge reserves...

chapters.title: Chapter 716: The third dream
chapters.content:
Why can't the rewards summed up in the school year be legendary points?
Ivan thought greedily, while Harry and Ron on the side complained that he had to return to Dursley's house this summer vacation as usual.
Obviously, the protection magic on his body is almost ineffective, there is no need to stay there anymore.
"Professor Dumbledore must have his intention to do this, what if the magic is still working?" Hermione guessed.
"But Voldemort had confirmed that night, and he directly touched me with his hand and was not injured..." Harry said glumly. "Voldemort also told me that the reason he wanted to use my blood to resurrect was to gain the protective power of that blood magic, which would make him stronger than ever..."
"But he still lost to Professor Dumbledore, didn't he?" Ron said lightly.
"Yes! It's no use thinking about it now. With Professor Dumbledore here, things will always get better!" Hermione also uttered comforting words.
Under the comfort of a few people, Harry's mood improved a lot, and he stopped thinking about those bad things.
Ivan looked at the people who were talking and laughing, and shook his head secretly. If I let them know that Dumbledore might not survive this year, I wonder if I can be so optimistic.
As for the reason Dumbledore forced Harry to stay at Dursley's house, Ivan was clear.
Although Voldemort inherited part of the power of blood magic through the resurrection ceremony, he could directly touch Harry.
But Voldemort did not know that this would make him a link for blood magic transmission, greatly strengthening this protection, so even if Harry grows up, the power of blood magic will not disappear...
Ivan even suspected that Voldemort's resurrection was the result of Dumbledore's deliberate indulgence and even secretly pushing the flames.
Because Harry once said that when he and Voldemort were in a duel, a faint voice rang in his heart, guiding him to act, much like Dumbledore's voice.
The general flashback spell has no such effect!
But this kind of speculation is obviously untenable.
After all, the situation was too urgent at the time. If he and Sirius take one step at night, Harry will undoubtedly die!
And Dumbledore is unlikely to sit back and watch Sirius and Moody being controlled by the Imperius Curse. When meeting Dumbledore several times, the expressions on each other's faces did not seem to be acting.
Thousands of thoughts flashed in his mind one by one, Ivan thought of some headaches, but couldn't figure out how many thoughts he was. Finally, he had to put the matter aside for a while, turned to Hermione, and asked.
"Where is the notebook I gave you last time? Hermione?"
"Is this this one? I have been carrying it!" Hermione rummaged in the box where the Extension Charm was cast, and quickly took out a thick notebook.
"Have you finished reading it?" Ivan asked again.
Hermione nodded. She had memorized all the contents as early as a month ago, and kept it with her as a souvenir.
After confirming with the little witch, Ivan took the notebook and threw it to Harry. "then!"
"What is this? A kind of brain-closing magic?" Harry hurriedly took the heavy book, opened it puzzledly, and all of the contents were about how to hide his thoughts.
"Yes, it's called Occlumency, to be precise! You should practice more this summer, and it is best to master it by the beginning of the next school year!" Ivan said.
"Then what's the use of it?" Harry asked puzzledly.
"This kind of magic can protect your brain, so you don't have to be influenced by Voldemort anymore!" Ivan said seriously.
Harry immediately understood.
It was only very fast, and Harry made it difficult again, because he couldn't use magic when he was at home during the summer vacation, and the Ministry of Magic could trace the traces of his spells.
And he has violated the rules twice in a row, and the Ministry of Magic will break his wand and expel him from Hogwarts if there is a third time.
Ivan also thinks about it, the Dursley family will not tolerate Harry practicing magic at home, so they immediately changed their words to let Harry memorize these notes during the summer vacation. Anyway, when school starts next year, Dumbledore should let it. Snape specifically taught Harry Occlumency.
Lay the foundation now, it will not be too late to learn.
"All... memorize it?" Harry flipped through the hundreds of pages of notes in front of him and swallowed hard. He felt that he was busy this summer vacation.
But in the end Harry agreed in distress.
"By the way, if I master this magic, won't I have that kind of dream in the future?" Harry said suddenly.
"As long as your Occlumency is proficient enough, you can prevent mysterious people from invading your brain!" Ivan replied affirmatively.
Harry's face became a little tangled, he opened his mouth, and stopped talking.
Ivan suddenly guessed what he was thinking, and immediately shook his head and spoke.
"I should have warned you, Harry! Don't believe everything you see in your dreams, let alone use it to get information! Voldemort is a master of mind-trapping and Occlumency, I thought I had You have learned enough-the information you passed to us almost caused Voldemort to kill you!"
If all goes well, Voldemort will soon have his undercover by his side, which is absolutely confidential, more concealed than Snape, and will not arouse anyone's suspicion.
So Ivan doesn't need Harry to provide information that is not true or false. If Harry is fooled, he will be in an ambush like the original time and space, it will be troublesome.
Hermione on the side also said to help. "Ivan is right, Harry, forget those dreams! It turns out that what you see is only what mysterious people want you to see!"
Harry, who wanted to say something, had to shut his mouth, and a dull man thought of yesterday’s dream in his mind In that dream, it became the snake again, and Voldemort’s The injury has also healed...
This is faster than everyone expected!
Besides, he also saw Lucius, McNeill and others in his dream, and... Snape!
The Death Eaters gathered in a room. Voldemort furiously rebuked them, but only praised Snape. They seemed to be plotting the next plan...
Everything in the dream seems to be getting more and more blurred, and Harry can't tell for a moment whether this is real or fake...
woo woo...
The sudden roar of the train interrupted Harry's thinking. He turned his head and looked out the window. The familiar nine and three-quarters station was already close in front of him.
Along with a long beep, the Hogwarts train slowly stopped, they had arrived!
……
(PS: The fourth volume is over! In addition, you have some misunderstandings about Voldemort's strength. McGonagall, Kingsley and Slughorn can't beat Voldemort together.
In the chapter of the original book, Harry once explained that after he took the initiative to "sacrifice himself" like Lily, the protective power of blood magic was spread to everyone Harry wanted to protect. , So Voldemort's magical power is greatly reduced, this is the reason why the three of them can temporarily contain Voldemort. )

chapters.title: Chapter 717: Conversation in the principal's room
chapters.content:
Hogwarts, the closed principal's room, Dumbledore was sitting in his seat, looking through the letters from the parents with interest.
From time to time, there will be owls flying in from the open window with a red roaring letter, and then, the harsh roar will resound in the principal's room.
Suddenly, Dumbledore felt as if he had sensed something. He raised his hand and waved his magic wand, closing the open window, and more owls were intercepted outside the window.
The roar in the principal's room also stopped abruptly, and the roaring message was turned to ashes in an instant.
After a while, the door to the principal’s room was opened, and Snape in a black robe walked in. He took a bottle of golden potion from his pocket and put it on the table, and then pushed it to Dumbledore’s. before.
"Your medicine!" Snape said coldly.
"Thank you, Severus, thanks to you!" Dumbledore nodded, took the reagent, gestured to Snape, and drank it.
"This is the last dose of medicine. Next time, when the injury recurs, I will have no way to suppress it!" Snape's words were sharp.
"Severus, I remember you told me that even if this kind of injury recurs, it won't kill me immediately, is it?" Dumbledore's face remained calm, and he was empty of the potion he had drunk. The bottle put down, looked at Snape, and asked.
"It's true... it won't kill you immediately, but it will spread all over your body in just a few months. Trust me, it won't be easier than death!" Snape sneered. Said.
"A few months? How long is it probably?" Dumbledore asked softly, looking at the scorched right hand. "I mean, its influence will not cause me to lose the most basic actions and ability to cast spells..."
"About two months? Three months?" Snape said uncertainly.
"It's shorter!" Dumbledore shook his head, and after a moment of contemplation, he suddenly spoke with a solemn expression. "Maybe I have a way to delay for a while..."
"It doesn't matter if you have a few days or a few days... If you can alleviate it, it won't be delayed, will it?" Snape said impatiently. He even felt that Hogwarts would start next semester. The banquet may evolve into Dumbledore’s funeral.
"We shouldn't think so, Severus, if it is arranged, even the last few months will be enough for us to do something!" Dumbledore said in a relaxed tone.
"For example, to end the life of the Dark Lord?" Snape looked at Dumbledore mockingly, unable to understand where the other party's optimistic form came from. He didn't think things would change if the other party lived longer.
Dumbledore did not mean to reply, but continued to ask. "Has Voldemort been doing anything recently?"
"Thanks to us, he is alive and kicking now!" Snape said unnaturally.
Originally, Voldemort's injury needed to be recuperated for at least half a month, but Dumbledore suddenly found him two days ago, gave him a few drops of Phoenix tears, and asked him to deploy a special potion to treat Voldemort's injury...
"What exactly are you trying to do? Voldemort's injury was serious this time. We could have stopped for a while during this time." Snape's tone was very blunt.
He couldn't understand why Dumbledore wanted to save Voldemort. When he confirmed Voldemort's injury, he even thought it was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. As long as he launched a raid, he could put it to death!
"If he could be killed so easily, then Voldemort would not live today..." Dumbledore naturally understood Snape's doubts and explained in a deep voice.
It is so easy for wizards like them to escape their lives in a battle. Even in the face of dozens of well-trained Aurors at the same time, Voldemort can counterattack and win easily...
The reason why he was injured this time was entirely because Voldemort had just been resurrected and was too swollen. After this lesson, the other party would only be more careful.
"Even so, for Potter's safety, we shouldn't cure him!" Snape was anxiously paced in the principal's room.
After Voldemort recovered from his injury, he was furious, and immediately summoned the Death Eaters to plan a revenge action, which made Snape regretful.
"He can't find where Harry is!" Dumbledore said, and he thought that Voldemort would never want to meet Harry again until he figured out the connection between the two Phoenix wands.
"What about the others?" Snape asked again.
"I'm glad you can consider the safety of other people, Severus!" Dumbledore looked at him in surprise, with a touch of unexpected joy in his tone. "But I reorganized the Order of the Phoenix, and most of those in need of protection are already in a safe place..."
"Mostly? That is to say, there are exceptions?" This time it was Snape's turn to be surprised.
Dumbledore stood up, frowned, and raised his tone slightly. "Isiah! Hals' mother, I persuaded her to join the Order of the Phoenix a few days ago, but she refused my proposal without hesitation, it was even more straightforward than I expected!"
"Perhaps she thought her son was able to contend with the Dark Lord..." Snape said with a sneer He had already met with the Death Eaters yesterday, so he knew some of them. The dead were hiding in Knock Down Alley.
Not only that, Voldemort has been planning to expand his power secretly. In addition to drawing dementors to liberate those imprisoned believers, the dark wizards in Knockdown Alley are also a good choice.
If Aysia and Ivan continue to stay in Knockout Alley, they will meet Voldemort soon.
Dumbledore shook his head. He didn't think Esiah would be so big. Ivan even participated in the battle personally. He should have a clear understanding of Voldemort's strength.
So he originally thought that after leaving school, the child would take the initiative to come to help him, or that Aysia could temporarily change his mind, but none of this, Ivan left very simply, which made him feel very curious.
"As far as I know, there is only one kind of magic that can ensure safety under Voldemort's pursuit..." Dumbledore muttered to himself.
"Are you talking about the Courageous Faithful Curse?" Snape paused, and soon thought of what Dumbledore was referring to.
Dumbledore didn't say a word, he did guess that, but he wasn't sure.
After all, the Courageous Faithful Curse is an extremely advanced magic. It is not even recorded in Hogwarts' forbidden area. They have no way to learn...

chapters.title: Chapter 718: The whimsical Dumbledore?
chapters.content:
"Well, as you said, we don't need to worry about the safety of other people, but you still haven't explained to me why you want me to heal the Dark Lord's injury..." Snape asked with a gloomy expression.
"You are too impatient, Severus!" Dumbledore looked at Snape and sighed slightly disappointed.
"Is anxious? I hope you can understand that you are dead soon, who will fight the Dark Lord once you die? Who will protect Potter's safety?" Snape said angrily.
He couldn't understand why Dumbledore could maintain such an optimistic attitude at such a critical juncture.
"So we must make a plan accordingly, which requires a certain amount of time and patience!" Dumbledore calmed Snape's emotions, and then continued.
"Voldemort has always been very suspicious. If you cure him this time, he will trust you more in the future..."
"You and I should know that the Dark Lord never trusts anyone!" Snape muttered mockingly, thinking of the scene where Voldemort praised him last night, and then looked at Dumbledore.
"Or do you expect me to get the trust of the Dark Lord and kill him when I am not prepared?"
If Dumbledore is alive, then his undercover agent can still play a role in transmitting some information, but if Dumbledore is dead, then he spends so much effort to win the trust of Voldemort, what is the use of being his left and right hand?
"No, I don't expect you to kill Tom, you can never do this with your strength!" Dumbledore said positively.
Hearing this, Snape's face twitched slightly.
"So I just hope you can do something for me when the time is right!" Dumbledore's expression became serious, and then he took out an object from the drawer and placed it on the table. "Give this to him!"
Snape stared at the objects on the table, then quickly looked up at Dumbledore, his face was full of astonishment and incomprehension, he almost doubted that Dumbledore had taken the wrong thing.
"Are you sure you want me to give this to the Dark Lord?"
Snape looked at Dumbledore as if he was looking at a patient with severe Alzheimer's disease.
What does he think of the Dark Lord? The baby in the cradle? Or an ignorant child?
It may have been before, but it is a pity that the Dark Lord has grown up now...
"That's right! I need you to give it to Voldemort yourself, that's very important..." Dumbledore nodded, his expression extra solemn, not joking at all.
Snape took a deep look at him, took the objects on the table into his arms, and asked. "Can you tell me what it does?"
"If the time is right, you and him will understand!" Dumbledore replied.
Snape frowned, dissatisfied with Dumbledore's words in the cloud, and it took him a long time to utter a word. "Then how can I confirm when is the right time?"
Dumbledore groaned for a while, thinking of Trelawney's prediction, the eyes under the meniscus glasses suddenly burst into blue light, and he spoke slowly.
"After I died, if one day Voldemort suddenly fell into great fear and was in panic all day long, it would prove that the time had come!"
Snape was silent, turned around neatly and left.
He intends to go back and study carefully whether the healing potion he has brewed will cause irreversible damage to the wizard's brain, thereby affecting a person's IQ...
How else would Dumbledore suddenly be whimsical...
……
At the same time, London, Wizarding Station.
In a crisp roar, the Hogwarts train stopped on the platform with billowing smoke.
Ivan several people took their luggage early and waited at the door. After the Hogwarts train stopped, they got off the train together and waved in front of the nine and three-quarters platform.
"Goodbye, Harry and Ron, remember to worry a little bit during the summer vacation!" Hermione looked at them reluctantly, and then at Ivan.
"Understood, I will remember to write!" Ivan answered first before Hermione could speak.
However, Hermione shook her head and said with a smile. "I just wanted to say that if I have time during the summer vacation, I will come to you!"
"Don't! Don't come!" Ivan's scalp went numb when Hermione was about to come to Knockout Alley, and he hurriedly refused.
But as soon as I said this, Ivan immediately regretted it.
As expected, the smile on Hermione's face suddenly closed, and her mouth was pursed, staring at him angrily.
"It's not that I don't welcome you, Hermione, but I'm afraid it's not safe there this year... You should know the specific reasons!" Ivan spread his hands helplessly.
Knockdown Alley was already chaotic, and coupled with the influence of Voldemort's resurrection, even he was too busy to take care of himself, how could he bother to entertain Hermione.
"Because of the mysterious person? Are you worried that he will wait for an opportunity to retaliate against you?" Hermione quickly thought of this, and the slight anger disappeared from her heart suddenly, she said eagerly. "What should I do then? Otherwise, you can hide in Hogwarts during the summer vacation. The mysterious person must not dare to go there!"
Harry and Ron on the side looked at Ivan worriedly.
Looking at the little witch who came up with the idea, and Harry and the others who agreed, Ivan couldn't laugh or cry for a while I didn't know how to explain.
At this moment, behind a few people, a voice rang,
"Don't be so troublesome, Hermione, I think in some time, Professor Dumbledore will invite you to my house to gather..."
Everyone turned their heads and looked at it, but Sirius came out of the passageway of platform nine and three-quarters carrying a large box of luggage.
Harry was very happy, so he didn't have to be at Dursley's house during the summer vacation, and he could meet his friends.
"Then why didn't you tell us the news in the morning?" Harry asked strangely.
"Professor Dumbledore intended to let me keep you from you for the time being, so I will give you a surprise in time!" Sirius smiled, and then looked at Ivan, consoling heartily.
"Ivan, after you go back, remember to persuade your mother to let her put down her previous prejudices. After the mysterious man is resurrected, the entire magical world will become unsafe, and Knockdown Alley will only be more dangerous..."
"Sirius, don't I remember that you and my mother have always been troubled? Why do you suddenly care about her?" Ivan asked inexplicably.
"The situation is critical now, but it's not the time to care about those small contradictions." Sirius raised his eyebrows. Although he didn't like Aysia very much, he wouldn't want the other side to have trouble for the sake of Ivan and the dead comrade. of.

chapters.title: Chapter 719: Courageous loyalty curse!
chapters.content:
Listening to Sirius' words, Ivan nodded, but did not agree, but directly refused.
"Thank you Professor Dumbledore for your kindness, but we have other things to do this summer, so I'm afraid I won't be able to visit your house..."
Ivan knows very well how much Asiah hates Dumbledore and them, so it is hard to imagine how Asiah and the members of the Order of the Phoenix will look like when they are together.
That scene must be very embarrassing.
Besides, there are many things waiting for him in Knock Down Alley, which is destined to be impossible for him to seek refuge in the safe house of the Order of the Phoenix like Harry and the others.
Ivan's decisive response was beyond everyone's expectations.
Harry, Ron, and Hermione all looked at him anxiously, trying to comfort them.
But before they could speak, Ivan spoke first. "Actually, you don't have to worry about our safety... Don't forget that I just killed the mysterious man not long ago. He can't help me, and we also have our own safe house!"
Sirius shook his head secretly. Of course, he who participated in that battle could see that Ivan is not Voldemort's opponent yet.
But Sirius did not persuade him anymore, because he probably guessed what Ivan was referring to the safe house, no wonder Aesia was so decisive when he rejected Dumbledore.
Under Ivan's insistence, Harry and the others also gave up the idea of ​​persuasion, but Hermione stepped forward and gave Ivan a hug.
"In this case, you must pay attention to safety during the summer vacation, and remember to contact me often!" said the little witch reluctantly.
"Well! You too..." Ivan responded with a smile
The two held them for a minute, until they saw Mr. Granger in the crowd walking towards this side, Ivan released his hand and said goodbye to Hermione.
After a while, Mrs. Weasley and the Dursleys took Ron and Harry away.
Ivan stood still and waited for Aysia soon. She looked hurried, with a look of exhaustion on her face.
"Did something happen in Knock Down Alley?" Ivan hurriedly asked.
"There have been some strange wizards there recently, and I have sent someone to investigate." Esiah said casually.
Ivan frowned, which is not a good sign.
"Have you chosen the location of the safe house?" Ivan asked again.
"Well, the underground fortress not far from the wizard market is very suitable. There are three entrances and exits for personnel to enter and exit. The most important thing is that it is large enough to store a lot of materials, there are also meeting rooms and places for daily rest..." Ai Xia explained.
After looking for several places, she finally thought that the Knot family's residence in the wizarding market was the most suitable place, but the disadvantages were not without it. After all, hiding underground means that you can't see the sun all year round...
"That's it, I can't take care of that much now!" Ivan immediately clinched that they built the safe house for refuge rather than enjoyment, and it is not impossible to sacrifice some comfort.
The two chatted all the way, avoiding crowded places, and found a remote alley, where they used Apparition to return to Knock Down Alley.
Accompanied by a shift in space, when Ivan came back to his senses again, he had already appeared in the wizarding market.
Different from the chaotic and noisy scenes in the past, today's wizarding market is empty except for them, and it looks extremely desolate.
Ivan turned his head puzzled and looked at Aysia.
"In order to make it easier for you to cast spells, I have ordered them to stay away from here today!" Aysia said.
Ivan then realized that he was using the Curse of Fidelity for the First Time. It is still unclear whether there are any taboos. The fewer people disturbed, the better.
Following the route in memory, Ivan and Aysia walked into the house together, turned the old oil lamp placed next to them, and a passage suddenly appeared in front of the two of them.
The underground fortress was obviously decorated with a layer of carpet on the ground, and a magic lamp was hung at every interval. The bright warm light illuminates the long corridor in front.
The surrounding walls are painted with complex inscriptions, and many magical stone statues have been added to the entrance and corners. As long as intruders are detected, these fortifications will be automatically activated to buy time for them to fight back or escape.
Ivan walked toward the conference room while listening to Aysia's account of the changes in the underlying fortress.
Pushing open the door, Ivan walked straight to the center, and Aysia suddenly asked. "Do you need me to leave?"
"Well, it's better to be careful!" Ivan said hesitantly.
Aisia did not delay, and immediately turned and left.
Then, Ivan drew out his wand, closed his eyes and began to chant a long and slurred spell.
The magic power in his body kept surging, and quickly extended in all directions under Ivan's perception.
Soon the whole view of the entire bottom fortress appeared in Ivan's mind, and the magic power in his body had already been consumed more than half.
This made Ivan a little worried about whether the secret location he chose would be too big, and it would be over if his magic power suddenly wasn't enough.
Fortunately, after chanting the spell, this feeling of magical withdrawal gradually stopped.
Ivan breathed a sigh of relief and then opened his eyes and looked around. Everything in the conference room was as usual. He vaguely felt a little different, but he couldn't tell what had changed.
just another place in my mind...
"Are you ready?" After Ivan walked out of the underground fortress, Aysia greeted him immediately and asked. .
Ivan nodded, and then said suddenly. "Mom, do you remember where our safe house is?"
"Of course..." Aysia asked to answer subconsciously, but suddenly stopped when the words reached her lips, and turned to mutter to herself. "Strange, I remember it very clearly, I even burned a few protective magic texts there a few days ago..."
The more she searched for memories in her brain, the more she couldn't remember it. Even when Ivan opened the entrance to the secret room in front of her, Aysia couldn't see it at all, let alone walk in—whenever she walked. When you reach the door, it will automatically bypass it, a bit like the effect of a Muggle expulsion spell.
Finally, Aisia has begun to question whether the safe house exists...
"It seems that the effect of this magic is better than I expected..." Ivan said with a slight delight.
Aisia glared at him angrily, "Go ahead, where is that place?"
"The safe house is located in the underground fortress of Knockdown Alley Wizard Market, right in front of you!" Ivan smiled and pointed to the front, and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 720: Morning in Knockoff Alley
chapters.content:
Aysia almost thought that Ivan was going to fool herself again, but she followed Ivan’s direction and looked at it. There was a narrow passage on the originally flat wall, and more importantly, the vague memory changes before. It became clearer.
"This magic is really magic!" Aisia said with emotion, the passage was always in front of her, but she couldn't notice it.
"If it is not magical, there is no way to hide from the mysterious person..." Ivan said.
"Then have you figured out what we should do next? Who are you going to let into this safe house?" Aysia asked.
Ivan hesitated for a while and said. "Let’s take a break today. Tomorrow morning I will call everyone here for a meeting!"
"Are you going to tell everyone the location of the safe house?" Aysia frowned. She didn't understand how Ivan would have such unwise thoughts.
Don't look at these wizards who are very obedient, but people's hearts are always unpredictable, and it is hard to guarantee that they will not have a different mind in life.
"I know that some people may not be reliable. Because of this, we need to eliminate those unstable factors as soon as possible!" Ivan explained.
But Ivan’s words made Esiah even more confused. Even if everyone was summoned, how could they confirm who had the problem?
Ivan said confidently without waiting for Esiah to ask. "Of course I have a way! As long as they can be there, then things are much simpler!"
Aixia looked at Ivan suspiciously. She didn't say anything just now, but Ivan guessed what she wanted to say twice and directly answered her.
"Desperate Mind? You were reading my mind just now?" Ivan's behavior was so obvious, of course Aysia quickly understood what was going on, she stretched out her hand and squeezed Ivan's cheek. "What an annoying magic!"
"But sometimes it works, doesn't it?" Ivan grinned.
"I don't deny this. By the way? When did you learn this?" Aisia looked at Ivan curiously.
Contemplation is a very special magic, usually requires related talents to practice. Therefore, there are very few Contemplationists in the entire magical world, and there are only a few well-known ones. Therefore, under normal circumstances, there will be no wizards who specialize in defense. at this point.
"Of course it was at Hogwarts." Ivan rubbed the sore cheek that Asiah had pinched.
Esiah did not ask much, but repeatedly ordered Ivan not to read her thoughts casually.
Ivan hurriedly nodded his head to make a promise. He knew very well how annoying the Sesame Master was, so for relatives and friends, unless agreed, he would not just read the mind.
And this time I specifically offended, just to show Aysia his ability.
"Since you are going to meet Dougt and the others again tomorrow, then the two of us can just get together tonight!" Aysia said with a smile.
Of course, Ivan would not refuse. Because they had been busy dealing with the affairs of Knockout Alley before, the opportunity for them to be alone with each other was rare.
Not to mention that he had to pretend when he was in front of the dark wizard, and he was so exhausted, that was the reason why he didn't call these people right away.
After re-entering the underground fortress, Aisia asked Ivan to sit in the living room, and then personally went to the kitchen to prepare today's dinner.
Because of the house-elf Dobby doing housework on weekdays, she hasn't been cooking for a whole year.
Fortunately, Aysia moved the magic kitchen utensils from the house a long time ago, so the craftsmanship has not regressed at all.
The two of them just ate and talked, tacitly avoiding all the disturbing topics, only talking about the interesting and happy experiences.
It wasn't until late at night when I was about to go to bed that Ivan went out and called Dobby to make it the third creature to know the location of the safe house.
Such a big place cannot be taken care of without house elves...
……
"Sir... wake up, sir!"
The next day, early in the morning, Yifan was awakened by a slight shout.
Ivan opened his eyes, and it was dark all around, with only two big round eyes leaning against the edge of the bed, which shocked him.
Ivan snapped his fingers quickly, and the magic light in the room suddenly lit up. Only then did he realize that Dobby had been standing next to his bed.
"Is it morning now?" Ivan asked. The inconvenience of living underground is that the weather cannot be used to confirm the approximate time.
"It's ten o'clock, the hostess asked me to call you over..." Dobby said sharply.
Ivan immediately got up from the bed, and after washing, he arrived in the living room, and Asia had already been waiting there.
"Why didn't you get up so late today, did you sleep last night?" Aisia asked concerned.
"No, I slept well...so take a break." Ivan grabbed a sandwich on the table and stuffed it into his mouth, then looked at Aysia, and said in a vague tone. "Dougt and them?"
"I have asked Walker to inform them, maybe this will be coming soon." Aysia looked at the clock on the wall and estimated that the time should be almost up.
"Are you going to pick them in yourself?" Aisia asked Ivan shook his head, which would damage his style.
After swallowing the food in his mouth, Ivan asked Dobby to get a piece of parchment paper, wrote down the specific location of the underground fortress on it, and handed it to Aysia.
"Show them this and they can come in! But remember to burn the note after reading it..." Ivan exhorted.
As a confidential person, there are many ways he wants to let people enter the safe house. Saying it directly, writing on paper with a pen, or bringing people in directly is considered a leak.
Aixia solemnly put away the note, and then got up and left.
Ivan was eating breakfast alone, thinking with a headache how to deal with those brains, and how to complete the task of rectifying Knockout Alley.
On the side, Dobby was carrying a broom and fighting against the foxes hiding under the carpet. After Ivan finished eating, he hurriedly put down the broom, began to pack the tableware, and left the two of them. A few pieces of bread for today’s breakfast.
In fact, Ivan and Aysia never mind Dobby’s eating together at the table, but whenever he mentions it, Dobby screams in fear—it thinks he doesn’t deserve such a big honor...
Ivan shook his head secretly looking at the house-elves who were busy going up and down, and without the intention of persuading, walked straight to the meeting room...
