chapters.title: Chapter 721: Everyone is a trustworthy person!
chapters.content:
Knock Down Alley, in the square outside the Wizard Market, a large group of wizards gathered here anxiously waiting, whispering in twos and threes.
"Avery, are you sure that the person is really back?" At the corner of the square, Rozier pulled Avery aside, lowered his voice, and asked with a little fear.
"Of course, I saw the Dark Lord with my own eyes. I think you should have heard some news. If you want to survive, you'd better consider my proposal!" Avery said with a sneer.
Rozier's face changed again and again, but he was still a little bit hesitant and didn't reply.
Avery looked at Rozier, knowing that he was already a little shaken, and continued to persuade him. "I must remind you, Rozier, the master doesn't have so much patience... and the Wizard Market was originally ours, but now it's just a new one!"
"Will a mysterious person be so kind? Willing to help us regain the wizarding market?" Rozier did not believe it. "The price? What do we need to pay?"
Rozier was unwilling to take such a big risk. In the end, he couldn't get anything, and he worked his life for nothing.
"Do you think the master will care about a small wizarding market? As long as we are willing to show our loyalty, we will be able to regain everything we have lost after the plan is successful! Even further, control the entire Knockdown Alley!" Avery is very sure. Said.
Rozier hesitated and fell into a battle between heaven and man. Although Ivan’s magic brought him great fear at the beginning, it also allowed him to fully recognize the other's potential.
But the news of the resurrection of the Dark Lord was too shocking, and Rozier was really hard to choose for a while.
Seeing that Rozier was too late to make a decision, Avery became more and more impatient.
Just when he was about to strike while the iron was hot and then persuade a few words, Aysia had already walked out of the supervision room of the wizard market.
Avery stopped talking immediately, and the noise on the court soon stopped. Dougt strode forward and asked anxiously.
"Asiah, has your Lord Hals come back?"
"Yes! He is about to meet you!" Aisia glanced at Dougt, then looked at Rozier and the others, and said. "Follow me!"
Dougert and others looked at each other and followed together.
Aixia led everyone into an empty room, and more than 30 people quickly packed the inside.
Fren and others, who had received the news in advance, had been hanging at the back of the team, faintly blocking the entrance and exit of the room.
Avery was keenly aware of this, and he was very uneasy, so he asked calmly. "Your Excellency Hals? There is nothing here. What are you bringing us here, Aysia?"
The Wizarding Market was originally built by these pure-blood families, so Avery couldn't be more clear about the layout of the supervision room.
There is nothing special here, and the too narrow space is not like a meeting place at all. On the contrary, it is like a cage. They are prisoners, and the werewolf wizards are jailers.
Avery is not the only one who feels uncomfortable with this. Many wizards looked at Esiah with dissatisfaction, waiting for her explanation.
"Be calm, Avery, the place you are going to is more secret this time, so I have to be more careful..." Aysia explained, then took out a piece of parchment and handed it to Doug. special. "Let's pass it on to each other and see!"
Dougt took the parchment and glanced at it. After a moment of reflection, he understood what it was, and passed it to Gleason.
kept passing like this, and it didn't take long for the parchment to reach Avery's hand. He looked at it curiously, and it was just a line of words on it.
[The combat headquarters is located in the underground fort of the Wizard Market in Knockdown Alley! 】
The moment I saw this line of words, the memory that had been blocked suddenly appeared in my mind.
Avery was taken aback for a moment, and then there was a chill in his heart, almost thinking that his memory had been tampered with before.
Fortunately, he quickly remembered that he had seen an introduction to magic in the family's book collection that could explain such a strange situation.
Avery looked down at the parchment in his hand again, and immediately determined that this should be the effect of the Courageous Faithfulness Curse!
It is a powerful and ancient magic that can hide a secret in the soul of a living person. It is usually used to hide extremely precious things, or to create a safe house free from foreign enemies...
Realizing this, Avery suddenly became a little excited.
This is undoubtedly a very important piece of information!
If he can take this note back, the Dark Lord will forgive him for his previous betrayal, and he will no longer have to engage in such dangerous spying work, and he may even be respected by the Dark Lord.
The more I think about it, Avery's heart gets hotter, but the scene is like a basin of cold water poured down, so Avery wakes up.
As one of the six founding families of the Wizarding Market, Avery knew that the vicinity of the underground fortress had been given anti-phantom shifting magic.
In addition, the werewolf wizards have been guarding the door. It is almost impossible for him to take this parchment with the address and leave!
Thinking of this, Avery was a little disappointed. If he could, he would never give up this hard-won opportunity But being stared at by Aisia and others, it was very difficult to do tricks...
"You haven't finished it yet? Avery?" Aisia stared at Avery's every move and asked him coldly when he saw him staring blankly for a long time.
Hearing this, Avery's expression shrank, and he passed the parchment to another wizard, and said with emotion. "After reading it, I also recalled some things. I didn't expect that Your Excellency Hals would trust us so much and would be willing to tell us all of such an important place..."
"Of course, since standing here, everyone is a trustworthy person!" A little smile appeared on Aysia's face.
Avery put on a deeply touched appearance, but from the bottom of his heart he was mocking, and he felt that his choice was extremely correct by relying on the Dark Lord.
About ten seconds later, the parchment was passed to the hand of the last wizard.
When everyone read it, a black flame emerged from the surface of the parchment, and quickly burned the entire parchment to ashes.
Avery who watched this scene was grateful, he could naturally see that Esiah had cast magic on this parchment that would automatically take effect when the conditions were met.
In other words, even if he escaped with this parchment with luck, he couldn't tell the Dark Lord the specific address.

chapters.title: Chapter 722: That man is more terrifying than before!
chapters.content:
Aysia paid attention to the changes in the expressions on everyone's faces throughout the whole process, and secretly remembered it, then walked to the mahogany table and turned the oil lamp on it.
The wall vibrated and cracked a gap, a large number of stone bricks quickly sank into the ground, and a narrow passage quickly appeared in front of everyone.
"Since you have all read the note, come in!" Aysia turned her head and said to the wizards, and then walked into the passage first.
On the way to the meeting room, Aysia explained the principles and precautions of the Red Loyalty Curse to the wizards who had not yet figured out the situation, which would have caused some unnecessary misunderstandings.
"There is such a magical magic? No wonder I didn't remember that I was here before..." Grace said in a speechless voice after listening to Esiah's story.
The vast majority of the wizards present were also the first to learn about the Scarlet Loyalty Curse, and they were surprised to discuss the magic of this magic in private.
Avery and Rozier did not participate in the discussion, and a sense of superiority faintly rose in their hearts. They had long recognized this as a loyalty curse.
And such high-end magic, only those pure-blood wizards with extraordinary knowledge can understand...
When Aysia pushed open the door of the meeting room, the noisy discussion stopped suddenly.
Faintly, a coercion spread throughout the conference room...
Every wizard who walked into the conference room felt as if he was being stared at by a fierce and cruel fire dragon. Warning signs sounded constantly in his mind, urging his body to escape here as soon as possible.
But no one dared to turn around and leave. Instead, one by one, like the most docile sheep, entered in a long line in an orderly manner.
The entire conference room is very dim, only a magic lamp hung on the ceiling provides lighting, and the range of light is limited to the vicinity of the conference table.
Ivan Hals, who had summoned them, was sitting on the main seat at the moment, half of his face was hidden by the shadows, and the expression on his face could not be seen clearly. The coercion that vaguely wandered in the meeting room was from the opponent's body. Uploaded.
He became more terrifying than before! At the first sight of Ivan, everyone couldn't help but think of this.
A little regret appeared on Avery's face. In his impression, even the powerful Dark Lord had never had such power. He couldn't help but wonder if he was on the wrong team this time...
The remaining wizards were also trembling not to approach. They just walked for ten seconds on the road from the door to the conference table, which was less than three meters.
Even when they walked to the conference table, no one dared to sit down directly, because there were only forty-five seats beside them, and there were fifty people in all!
Who should stand? Who can be allowed to sit down?
Photographed by Ivan's power, everyone didn't dare to ask questions at all, so they had to turn to Aysia for help, hoping that she could give an answer.
However, Aysia pursed her mouth and did not answer. This situation was also beyond her expectation. Ivan hadn't discussed it with her in advance, so she didn't actually know it.
With Aisia's silence, the atmosphere on the court became more and more solemn, and the quietness in this meeting room with a total of 51 people was a little scary...Only the sound of deliberately lowered breathing could be heard between each other.
Some people are puzzled by this, and naturally some people feel terrified.
Avery was one of them. Tension and panic filled his mind, fine beads of sweat permeated through his forehead, and the robe behind his back was even more wet.
Of course Avery knew what these forty-five seats meant, which meant that Ivan Hals thought five of them didn't deserve a seat, or that they didn't deserve to be alive at all!
Unfortunately, I may be one of the five!
But now it was obviously too late to escape. Avery had to hold his wand tightly and hide in the crowd with a trace of luck, trying not to attract attention.
"Long time no see, everyone!"
In the silence, Ivan finally spoke. His black pupils stared at everyone present. After scanning for a while, he nodded again and continued to speak.
"Very well, no one was absent this time. I thought that some of you wouldn't dare to come to this party...so I didn't prepare seats for them."
After the words fell, Ivan clearly felt that some of the wizards' mood fluctuations became more intense.
Although none of the wizards present dared to look directly into his eyes, Ivan first used the dragon's deterrent to deter, and then engaged in mysticism, in order to break through the spiritual defenses of these people and amplify their emotions.
Now it seems that the effect is pretty good. Even if Ivan closes his eyes, he can clearly perceive that the emotions of tension, fear, and regret are escaping from some people's minds.
"Your Excellency Hals, are you calling us all this time, is there anything important to tell?" Walker couldn't help but ask after the silence lasted for about half a minute. He couldn't bear such a repressive atmosphere. .
"There is indeed an important thing." Ivan nodded, and then changed his voice and continued. "But before that I need to announce a message!"
"Fifteen years ago, the Dark Lord Voldemort, who was afraid of everyone in the magic world, who didn't dare to call his name... is back!"
Perhaps it was because the news that Ivan said was too shocking The originally quiet conference room suddenly became noisy.
"Your Excellency Hals, are you sure that it is true? But the mysterious man should have been dead for more than ten years, died in the hands of Harry Potter..." Joseph asked tremblingly.
"He's not dead, Josel, never!" Ivan explained in a mellow voice.
"That cowardly guy is more afraid of death than any of us, so he used some dark magic to make sure that he can survive a life-threatening situation when he encounters a mortal situation!"
Hearing this, everyone present felt a chill in their backs. It was hard for them to imagine what kind of black magic could be powerful enough to avoid death...
Everyone's thoughts, Ivan can see clearly, Dang Even sneered and said. "Believe me, no one can easily evade death, and of course the Dark Lord cannot. If you can see him like that, you will never have such a deep fear of him again!"
"In the past few years, I have also dealt with Voldemort several times. At that time, the black demon lost his power and looked like a poor lonely wild ghost. The ability to cast spells is not even comparable to a goblin..."

chapters.title: Chapter 723: There are some traitors among us
chapters.content:
When Ivan spoke, Joseph and the others bowed their heads in terror. No one dared to arrange a powerful Dark Lord like Ivan.
Ivan, who has been running the mind of the mind, clearly perceives the fear deep in everyone's heart, which makes him frown.
It seems that Voldemort's influence has been deeply rooted in people's hearts, and his words alone are obviously not enough to change their minds.
But even so, Ivan did not regret to announce the news of Voldemort's resurrection directly, because in any case, he could not hide it. Rather than waiting for them to learn from other channels, something happened, it is better to speak up!
Thinking of this, Ivan no longer had any scruples, and continued to speak.
"Now Voldemort has used some means to regain his strength. There is no doubt about it. I believe some of you have already received this news in advance..."
Ivan looked around at the crowd, his gaze stopped for a moment on the faces of the pure-blood wizards, and finally his gaze was fixed on Dougt's body. "I should be right, Dougt? Aren't you going to have a good talk with everyone?"
The eyes of everyone present also glanced over.
Dougt was silent for a while, sighed faintly, and opened the sleeve of his left arm in front of everyone, revealing the weird dark mark on his wrist.
"A few months ago, the Dark Demon mark on my hand became more and more obvious. It was a sign of the growing strength of the Dark Devil. This situation reached its peak four days ago, and the Dark Devil mark suddenly changed. It's very hot... Just as Your Excellency Hals said, that man has regained his strength and is summoning his servants..."
"I never heard you talk about this, Dougt..." Aysia asked, her eyes sharpened when she looked at Dougt.
"Before today, I wasn't sure about this, so I was going to wait for Your Excellency Hals to come back and discuss it with you..." Dougt explained with ease.
After a pause, Dougt might think that this reason was not enough, and then went on to say. "That time, I did not respond to the call of the Dark Lord. A loser who relied on fear to stir up chaos is not worthy of our follow."
Ivan stared at Dougt with a scrutiny gaze.
Of course he knew that the other party had concealed the news of Voldemort's resurrection, not just for the reason just stated.
However, Dougt's careful thinking is still within the range he can tolerate, so Ivan didn't mean to open it, nodded and said.
"A very wise choice, to join a remnant party of the old age is tantamount to self-destruction!"
Dougert was obviously relieved, and the atmosphere on the court seemed to ease a lot, but Ivan's next sentence quickly made some people's hearts come to their throats.
"It's just a pity that not everyone is as clear-headed as you and can make a correct choice..."
"It's a pity, everyone!" Ivan looked at everyone and said in a disappointed tone. "There are a few traitors among us. They may be the power of the Dark Lord, or they may have obtained some promises. In short, they have abandoned us..."
After Ivan's words fell, everyone present looked around, looking for the traitors Ivan said, and soon questioned each other because of various contradictions.
"Five seconds, I can give these people a chance to repent!" Ivan suddenly interrupted everyone's discussion.
The meeting room became quiet again.
Hidden in the crowd, Avery was caught in a battle between heaven and man. When Ivan said this, he almost wanted to take the initiative to stand up.
But reason told him that Ivan would never forgive them such betrayers so kindly.
All this is likely to be a game, the purpose is to catch the betrayers, Avery even suspects that Ivan doesn't even know who the betrayers are. He just received some news and deliberately told them to blow them up.
So as long as you can stay steady, there is a high probability that you can escape this catastrophe!
Avery kept comforting himself, hiding in the crowd without saying a word.
Five seconds passed, and Ivan's voice quickly broke his illusion.
"Avery, I'm very disappointed in you. I thought you would at least have the courage to stand up." Ivan said with a sneer.
Under Ivan's gaze, the wizards gathered there spontaneously stepped away, exposing Avery who was hiding.
When he heard his name, Avery's heart trembled, and he reluctantly maintained the calm on his face, defending. "Your Excellency Hals, I think you have misunderstood..."
Before Avery finished speaking, Ivan spoke again. "Don't you think you were hiding in a crowd that night and I couldn't see you? Avery?"
Ivan was not interested in listening to Avery's defense at all. The opponent's unprotected brain, like a sieve, had exposed all his thoughts and thoughts.
Not to mention, before leaving school, he saw most of the faces of Death Eaters from Shining’s memory, including Avery’s...
The werewolf wizards drew out their wands immediately and surrounded Avery, but no one did it directly without Ivan's order.
Avery's brain was blank, knowing that he was finished, and his body was soft, and he immediately collapsed to the ground, but he quickly climbed up to Ivan's seat as if thinking of something. The voice pleaded.
"Your Excellency Hals! Please believe me, I was persecuted by the Dark Lord, no, the Dark Lord! He kept tormenting me and destroying my will forcing me to him Reveal the information in Knockdown Alley, otherwise...otherwise he will kill my wife and children..."
"It seems that you are not so wicked." Ivan stood up and said in a very kind tone. "But I'm somewhat curious about how Voldemort tortured you..."
"Is it like this?" Ivan looked at Avery who was kneeling next to him, waved his wand without warning, and his voice became very cold. "~ (Drill my heart and cut my bones
"Ahhhhh~" A burst of indescribable pain came from all over the body, and Avery suddenly uttered an unusually screaming scream, like someone tore off a piece of his flesh with his hand. .
Avery rolled frantically on the ground, his nose and tears constantly gushing out.
I don’t know how long this torture finally ended. Avery languidly fell to the ground, twitching like a dead fish from time to time, and the godless eyes were blank, as if I didn’t understand why Ivan was talking. Suddenly do it.
"I gave you a second chance, but unfortunately you lied to me again!" Ivan looked at the puzzled Avery and said indifferently. "The news I received is not like this!"

chapters.title: Chapter 724: Loyal Rozier
chapters.content:
Ivan spoke while reading the memory that emerged in Avery's mind.
"Someone told me that you knelt down at Voldemort's feet on the initiative, and exchanged information from Knockdown Alley for his understanding so that he wouldn't punish you, right? Avery?"
"It's a pity that Voldemort won't spare a former betrayer so easily, so he ordered you to come back to me, listen to the information, draw in more wizards from Knockout Alley, and make them become Death Eaters..."
"But since you miss the Heartbreaking Curse so much, and specifically mentioned this, then I will naturally meet your requirements!"
Ivan’s words were sharp, and every sentence was like a heavy hammer hitting Avery’s heart.
Avery slumped underground and trembled. He looked at the young wizard in horror. He didn't understand where the other party heard the news. The details are as if he had witnessed it with his own eyes. The scene was the same at the time.
However, apart from the Dark Lord, there were only a few Death Eaters present that day, and each of them was someone whom the Dark Lord recognized and trusted...
"You are very secretive, can you hide it from me? Avery, but you may not know it. As long as a third person knows a thing, it is no longer a secret..." Ivan said with a sneer.
Avery's face suddenly looked very ugly. Even if it was confirmed that some of the Death Eaters must have betrayed him and leaked his information...
Yes, if those people are really so loyal to the Dark Lord, then this society should be locked in Azkaban instead of getting away with it...
In Avery's mind, Ivan naturally saw it clearly, and he didn't mean to correct it.
Because this kind of misunderstanding was caused by him deliberately, he made up a spy that didn't exist at all nowadays, to cover up his mind.
After all, no wizard would be willing to be read.
If you are aware that you are using spiritual magic to probe everyone's minds, even though no one will comment on the surface, there will definitely be grievances behind the scenes.
The most important thing is that without chanting the spell to increase the intensity of the spell, his mind can only read a person's superficial thoughts, and there is a possibility of being deceived or concealed.
Therefore, it is particularly important to hide your identity as a master of the gods as much as possible.
Of course, the disadvantages of saying this are not without.
If some of the wizards present in the future were arrested by the Death Eaters and tortured out this information, then Snape's life as a spy for the Order of the Phoenix would definitely be more sad.
Ivan mourned for Snape in his heart for a second, then turned his gaze away from Avery and turned to the other wizards.
"Apart from Avery, is there anyone else who wants to say something? Do you stand up by yourself, or do you want me to say your names one by one?" Ivan asked.
After a short silence, the three wizards stood tremblingly, and to everyone's surprise, one of them was a werewolf.
"Carter, I didn't expect even you to betray us!" Fren looked at the werewolf wizard who stood up, and scolded very angrily.
He didn’t understand why the other werewolves chose to betray. Ivan never treated them badly. Not only did he trust them, he provided everyone with stable and high-paying jobs, but he also developed and improved the wolf’s poison potion. They can live a normal life.
Carter's betrayal now is tantamount to revenge. If Ivan hadn't spoken yet, Fran would have already wished to kill him directly.
Walker and others also stared at the werewolf wizard with contempt and resentment, very worried that Ivan would have suspicions about them because of this incident.
Under the sharp gaze of a group of werewolf wizards, Carter stumbled to his knees, learning Avery climb all the way to Ivan's, begging Ivan's forgiveness.
The other two wizards pointed at Avery angrily, clarifying that they were only bewitched and dizzy for a while, so they made the wrong decision.
At this moment, Ivan had already sat back in his seat, and he didn't bother to pay attention to the excuses of a few people. He had given the opportunity before, but unfortunately these people had not been able to cherish it, and it was too late to regret it now.
While Ivan was silent, the wizards present were still looking for the last betrayer. They all agreed that since Lord Hals deliberately removed the five chairs, there would never be a mistake!
Rozier in the crowd looked restless, he was not sure that the chair that was left was referring to himself.
Because Avery had looked for him last night, even though he was hesitating and did not immediately agree, it was not strictly an act of betrayal... but who knows if Ivan would think so.
Thinking of this, Rozier kept looking around, hoping that someone would stand up, so that he would be completely at ease.
But after waiting for half a minute, Rozier could not see the scene he had hoped for.
As time passed, Rozier's heart pressure also increased, and in the end he gritted his teeth and took the initiative to speak.
"Your Excellency Hals, Avery met with me last night and wanted me to take refuge in the Dark Lord and become a member of the Death Eaters. He also told me that as long as I was willing to take refuge in the Dark Lord, they could help me regain the wizard. Control of the market..."
After speaking Rozier told the whole story like a bamboo tube pouring beans. He didn't dare to conceal the slightest bit. He knew very well that as long as Ivan sent someone to interrogate Avery, these things would be There is no way to hide it.
"So you agree?" Aisia stared at Rozier and said harshly.
Rozier hurriedly shook his head and explained. "No, no, I strictly rejected Avery's proposal, and advised him to think clearly that the person who betrays Your Excellency Hals will never end well..."
"Don't think you can get rid of the relationship by saying that, Rozier!" Avery, who was limp on the ground, got up with difficulty, stared at Rozier fiercely, and interrupted his words, "You were the other day. What I told me was that I was ready to carefully consider my opinion and give me an answer the next day..."
"Joke, I said this deliberately just to confuse you, so as to collect evidence, and tell your Excellency Hals at today's meeting!" Rozier said righteously, then turned to Ivan and said flatly. .
"It's just that I didn't expect Your Excellency Hals to be aware of it and expose your true face first..."
(PS: One more)

chapters.title: Chapter 725: Ivan: This is a win-win move!
chapters.content:
Rozier talked endlessly, and while trying to excuse himself, he did not forget to praise Ivan.
However, under his secret peeping, Ivan's reaction was very flat, just staring at him silently, those black hole eyes seemed to be able to see through everything.
Rozier's heart was uneasy, his voice became lower and lower, and finally his expression stopped...
Ivan's index finger tapped lightly on the desktop, looking at the guy in front of him like a wall of grass, thinking about what to do with him.
Since she was running through the whole process, Ivan naturally knew that Rozier was not as loyal as he himself said.
When Avery proposed that he join the Death Eaters, Rozier did not agree, but he did consider it for a long time.
Based on this, Ivan put Rozier into the untrusted camp in his heart.
Strictly speaking, the other party has not yet betrayed. At best, it can only be said that his thoughts are not firm. In addition, Rozier was the first pure-blood wizard to surrender him, so Ivan did not arrest this guy. Or it means to kill...
Thinking of this, Ivan made a decision, and casually raised his wand and waved it.
Seeing this scene, Rozier's heart suddenly came to his throat, and at that moment he even thought he was about to follow Avery's footsteps.
But after waiting for a while, Rozier did not wait for the pain he imagined. He followed Ivan's direction and looked at it puzzledly. There was an extra seat in an inconspicuous corner of the long table, which was more obvious than the others. Be short.
Rozier didn't care at all, his heart was full of excitement and joy, he knew that at least his fortune was saved.
At the same time, Ivan's voice also reached his ears.
"I don't want another time, understand?" Ivan put away his wand and said indifferently.
Rozier nodded frantically, fearing for a while, secretly glad that he took the initiative to stand up just now, sincerely admit his mistake, and now he is exempt from punishment, the last position is really reserved for himself.
However, Rozier didn't know that he was thinking about it.
Before the meeting, the only betrayer Ivan could confirm was Avery alone. The reason for removing five seats was just to catch more potential enemies.
As for why it is five?
Because setting too many vacancies may cause panic, and even make Avery and others mistakenly believe that they are large in number and directly resist.
If it is too few, it will not have any effect, so five of them are just right in Ivan's eyes. I didn't expect to make do with it now...
Looking at Avery and the others who were still begging on their knees, Ivan waved his hand in annoyance, looked at Fren who was standing by, and said. "Take them down and lock them up, it just so happens that my magic experiment still lacks some subjects!"
For these betrayers, Ivan was not prepared to send them back to the West with Avada's orders several times. That would be too cruel. Too much killing and uncontrolled release of black magic may affect his own character.
Therefore, it is better to use waste and treat them as experiments for practicing magic or developing potions.
This can not only demonstrate one's humanity, but also make full use of resources to quickly increase the level of magic, which can be described as a win-win move!
It's a pity that the few wizards who were dragged down didn't think so. When they heard that Ivan was about to use them as experimental "guinea pigs, they all showed a gray face."
Rozier and others who were watching were even more wars, looking at Avery and others who were dragged away with pity.
All the wizards present know that since last year, their leader Ivan Hals has been conducting some extraordinarily cruel magic experiments.
The prisoners were often still alive when they were summoned, but once they came out of the room, they became lethargic, with a look of despair and fear on their faces.
Although no one was injured from the outside, they would lose the memory of that period of time without exception.
Therefore, it was once speculated that Ivan Hals was studying a dark magic that destroys the soul, and that such strict secrecy measures were needed.
As a result, there are often prisoners who cannot bear this kind of mental pressure after learning the "truth" and choose to end their lives in prison early...
As I probed the thoughts in everyone's minds, Ivan's mouth couldn't help but twitched. During the summer vacation last year, I only found a few prisoners to practice the Imperius Curse, the Fear Curse, and the Mindfulness.
Purging the memories of the prisoners with the Forgetting Curse was only to conceal the secret of being a dementor, but they didn't want to be misunderstood by them.
No wonder he always feels that his "experimental body" is consumed very quickly, and after a long time, the result is a misunderstanding...
"Ha, ha ha ha ha~"
As Ivan was thinking, a burst of laughter suddenly sounded in the silent conference room. Ivan went through the prestige curiously, and unexpectedly discovered that the laughter was actually made by Avery who was dragged to the door.
"Shut up!" Fren, who was pulling Avery's neckline, suddenly became a little annoyed. Even if he punched him in the stomach, he couldn't laugh anymore.
"Let go of him first, Fren!" Ivan said with interest, and he wondered why Avery could still laugh.
Fren Yiyan let go of his hand, and Avery slammed his stomach to the ground, staring at everyone present with a fierce gaze.
"You won't be proud of it for long, Knockdown Alley is the master's next goal, and the Dark Lord will not let you go..."
Having said that, Avery turned his gaze to Ivan again, gritted his teeth and said. "This time you don't have the luck to escape from the master..."
Avery's words immediately caused an uproar in everyone's hearts, not only because of the threat posed by the Dark Lord, but more importantly, the information contained in these two sentences.
"What? You haven't told them what happened that night?" Avery said sarcastically He was in the cemetery that day, and witnessed Ivan's embarrassment under the pursuit of the Dark Lord. And fleeing, this is also the reason why he finally chose to sell his intelligence and completely take refuge in the Dark Lord.
The moment he said this, Avery was ready to provoke Ivan to be killed by the opponent.
Sometimes death is also a kind of relief, which at least means that one does not have to suffer long-term torture.
However, beyond Avery's expectation, Ivan's complexion was very calm, and he didn't seem to be affected by these words.
"What do you want me to say? Avery? Tell me about the great achievements of the Dark Lord?
For example, under the crowd of dozens of Death Eaters, he fought a battle with the famous fifteen-year-old boy Harry Potter in the cemetery? The result is hard to tell the outcome? "
"Or you want me to tell you how after I rescued Harry Potter, came to chase the Dark Lord and almost lost his life?"

chapters.title: Chapter 726: The Dark Lord is invincible!
chapters.content:
Ivan's words were so sharp that Avery was stunned, and he couldn't believe Ivan's words.
"It's absolutely impossible... you're lying!" Avery yelled frantically, struggling to pounce on it.
However, Fran on the side was always vigilant. As soon as Avery made a move, he grabbed his back collar, kicked him to the ground, and forced him to the floor.
Avery twisted his body vigorously, trying to break free from Fren's restraint but could not do anything. In the end, he had to prangle his head with difficulty, staring at Ivan viciously with his eyes, and said angrily.
"You must be lying to me. The Dark Lord is invincible. He is stronger than any living wizard. You just managed to get away with your master by luck. I saw you with my own eyes that day. How did you run away in embarrassment..."
"I don't have to lie to you." Ivan looked at Avery and shook his head, sighing. "Think about it, Avery... I guess you waited all night in the cemetery that night and didn't wait for the Dark Lord to return from victory, did you?"
Under Ivan's questioning, Avery's heart gradually sank to the bottom, and the memory in his mind slowly emerged.
As Ivan said, on that night a few days ago, after the Dark Lord went to hunt down Harry Potter, he never returned to the cemetery, but gave them instructions through the Dark Mark to order them to disband temporarily. Leave there.
In the next few days, he also failed to see the Dark Lord. Voldemort's instructions were all communicated through Severus Snape...
"He was seriously injured, of course he dare not go to see you in person!" Ivan read Avery's mind and continued mockingly. "Voldemort doesn't want to let you know that the so-called Dark Lord is a powerful wizard! He, like everyone else, can get hurt and die..."
Hearing this, Avery trembled involuntarily. He couldn't believe all this, but all the evidence pointed to the fact that the Dark Lord was really defeated...
When he realized this, Avery seemed to have completely lost his vitality, lying limp on the ground, repeating "impossible...this is impossible, the Dark Lord is invincible".
Watching this scene, the wizards felt a chill in their hearts, and their fear of Ivan became more profound.
They heard the conversation between Ivan and Avery just now, and even stupid people could realize that their leader Hals had already fought with the resurrected Dark Lord.
Although the specific details of the battle are still unknown, one thing is certain, that is, Voldemort was severely injured in the battle and was forced to hide, but Ivan stood here fortunately.
It's obvious who wins and loses...
However, there are also many people who question this. After all, Ivan's age is too deceptive, and the fear caused by the Dark Lord is deeply rooted in the hearts of the people.
If Avery’s expression did not seem to be false, and he received a heart-piercing curse firmly, no one would want to believe the fact that the Dark Lord was defeated...
"Pull it down!" Seeing Avery, whose will was almost collapsed, Ivan suddenly lost interest, waved his hand and ordered Fren to take him away.
"Yes, Lord Hals!" Fren said respectfully with a little awe, and then dragged Avery down by his heel.
At this time, Ivan turned his head to look at the people in the conference room, stretched out his hand and gestured, and said. "Sit down, everyone! Now we can start talking about business..."
Ivan's gentle tone dissipated a lot of the depressed atmosphere on the court. The wizards gathered in the conference room were relieved and sat down in their chairs honestly.
Dougt and Aysia sat in the positions of Ivan's left and right hands, and the other wizards also subconsciously followed them and were divided into two factions.
On the left are the pure-blood wizard and Dougt’s friends, while the poor wizards and werewolves from Knockdown Alley are all sitting on the right.
It is worth mentioning that the place next to Esiah was empty, and no one dared to sit down. It was probably reserved for Fren.
Ivan did not interfere, silently saw the situation in his eyes, and then asked freely what happened in the alley during the time he left.
Aysia didn't conceal the slightest bit of concealment, and said everything in detail, Dougt also added.
In general, Knock Down Alley was fairly peaceful during the year, and the wizard market resumed operation after some maintenance, which greatly alleviated the previous lack of funds.
The training of personnel is also carried out every day. Now 60% of wizards have successfully mastered the Iron Armor Curse, and the number of law enforcement officers has increased to more than 20 in one breath, each of whom is an experienced combat expert.
"Even the striker of the Ministry of Magic, in the case of one-on-one combat, will not be the opponent of the law enforcement! If it is an Auror that doubles as a group battle, it will be able to fight!" Dougert is very proud. Said.
These remarks didn't mean anything to exaggerate.
Although the law enforcement officers have only been trained for a year or so, their daily training intensity is several times higher than that of the hitters of the Ministry of Magic. What's more, they have a good foundation in choosing the winners in the duel arena. .
If he could recruit some more people, Dougte would even have the confidence to directly confront the Ministry of Magic!
"Very well, you did a great job!" Yifan glanced across each law enforcement officer, and said admiringly.
The law enforcement officers all straightened their chests, like soldiers under review When Ivan spit out these words, they all felt that this time of hard practice was worthwhile.
Walker asked boldly. "Your Excellency Hals, we have been waiting for a whole year. When will we be able to make a big move?"
The wizards present also looked at Ivan in anticipation, and were eager to try. They had nothing to do except for patrolling, training, and gathering intelligence every day for the past year, and they were about to fall ill.
"Since you all can't wait, let's just set it tonight!" Ivan nodded and nodded, then turned his gaze to Dougert and asked.
"How many wizards are there in the entire Knockdown Alley?"
"The people who have been here for a long time, besides us, there are about one hundred and sixty people..." Dougert hesitated and replied.
Ivan thought about the conditions for achieving the system task [Rectify Knockout Alley], and quickly made a decision. "What you have to do tonight is to bring everyone in Turnover Alley to the Wizarding Market. I have a few words to say!"
(PS: One more today)

chapters.title: Chapter 727: The one-year period has come!
chapters.content:
"Everyone?" Dougt looked at Ivan in astonishment.
"Why? Can't it be done?" Ivan raised his brows and asked.
"No, of course it's okay!" Dougt shook his head quickly.
Although this is a very difficult job, as long as you pick a good time to make a surprise attack in the middle of the night, and a little luck, you can still ensure that there are no fish slipping through the net.
"That's good! You need to pay special attention to these other people. They are all Death Eaters. Remember to be careful when you are arrested. Don't let them have the opportunity to resist." Ivan said as he drew his wand out at the conference table. Tap on it.
Under the influence of deformation magic, several human faces quickly appeared on the mahogany wood table, lifelike and unforgettable.
Dougt stared carefully for a while, and immediately promised that all these people would be caught tonight.
The whole meeting lasted for more than an hour. After the battle plan and specific hands-on time were drawn up, Ivan finally announced that today's meeting was over.
The wizards in the conference room stood up, saluted Ivan respectfully, and then left their seats in an orderly manner.
When the last wizard walked out of the meeting room door, the originally dim room suddenly became much brighter.
Sitting in the main seat, Ivan no longer pretended to be pretentious, and his tight expression suddenly relaxed, and he leaned against the soft back chair very decadently.
"It's really troublesome... finally got it done." Ivan rubbed his stiff face and whispered to himself softly.
If possible, he would rather read a book and practice magic leisurely when he came home during the summer vacation, rather than organizing a meeting of a large group of dark wizards to discuss how to remediate Knockdown Alley.
It's a pity that things were not as expected. Voldemort's resurrection completely disrupted Ivan's plan, and also caused the originally stable situation in Knockdown Alley to suddenly become chaotic.
In order to remove the unstable factors in the Knockover Alley, and to gain enough strength to protect himself, he had to consider completing the tasks released by the system to obtain more legendary points.
The most important thing is that these days is his last chance to complete the task.
Because according to the information given by Avery, the Dark Lord intends to recruit people and expand his influence in Knockout Alley. Once the other party actually intervenes, his task of rectifying Knockout Alley will probably never be completed.
Therefore, the only plan for the present is to cut the mess with a quick knife. Taking advantage of Voldemort's serious injury now, while hiding and training, all the opponents in Knockout Alley are dealt with in one breath...
Thinking of this, Ivan glanced at the system taskbar again, and the information on it had changed again.
[Become the King of Knock Down Alley
Mission objective: rectify the Knockdown Alley (third ring road)
Task progress: 69%
Mission Reward: Mark of Magic
Legendary value: 3 (achievement of the king of Knockturn Alley)
Mission description: The one-year period has come, you finally decided not to forbear, and you will bloodbath the entire Knockdown Alley with thunderous means, sanction opponents, and let everyone worship under your rule...]
Looking at the progress of the mission, Ivan nodded in satisfaction, and it seemed that the direction of his actions was not wrong.
But when he moved his gaze down to see the task description, the corners of his mouth still inevitably twitched.
Sure enough, this is the system he is very familiar with...
But this at least proves that what he thought was not wrong. To complete the task of rectifying Knockout Alley, it does not need all the wizards in Knockout Alley to be convinced by him. Relying on some less humanitarian methods, the goal can be achieved.
Of course, Ivan is not planning to kill all opponents as described in the mission statement, but intends to rely on power and deterrence to allow these people to temporarily recognize his rule.
As for whether these grudge wizards would pretend to obey and regret them in the future, Ivan couldn't control it.
After all, he didn't really want to rule Knockturn Alley, as long as the mission was completed and the legend was reached, the other Ivans would not care at all.
...
At one o'clock at midnight, in the wizard market in Knockdown Alley, Ivan stood alone on the platform of the restored square and issued an assembly instruction.
The next moment, one after another figure appeared in the center of the square out of thin air.
In just three seconds, the forty-six wizards were all counted!
One by one, they were full of energy and fully armed, and they were obviously prepared for action long ago.
Many people's eyes were filled with tension and excitement. After practicing for a whole year, their magic skills have improved significantly, and now it's finally time to come in handy.
"Fren, send the task list down!" Ivan ordered.
Fren should claim it was, and then handed down the stack of parchment he was holding to everyone's hands.
Grace took the share that belonged to her and took a curious look. The map of Knockoff Alley was drawn on the parchment. Five locations were accurately circled and several people's names were faintly written on it.
Grace immediately understood that these people were her goal tonight.
"Wait... Why is your map the same as mine?" Walker leaned forward curiously. He looked at the map in his hand and then at Grace's. There was almost no difference between the two maps.
"Does that still need to be said? This means that we have to act together tonight!" Grace rolled her eyes, looked for a while on the parchment, and quickly saw a conspicuous sign seven. "Well, it seems that we are all from the seventh team!"
Just as Grace thought, when everyone got the map, Ivan on the stage explained it.
Considering that the wizards in Knockdown Alley are not good stubborns, and there may be accidents when acting alone, so he plans to split the forty-six wizards into groups of two to four and take care of each other to carry out tonight's actions.
This can not only ensure efficiency , but also avoid danger to a great extent.
"Remember, your actions must be fast!" Ivan looked around the crowd and said in a serious tone. "Once you start to do something and make a noise, you may be noticed by other wizards, so the time left for you is very urgent. I hope that before dawn, you can invite everyone on the list to come here... …"
Ivan kept talking about the precautions of this operation, the most important of which is to race against time!
After all, the entire Knockdown Alley is not big, even if the ruins on the east side are added, it is only equivalent to a large street square. If there is chaos, it is easy to be noticed.
It's just that some conflicts in Knockdown Alley are common occurrences. The wizards here have always practiced the posture of hanging up high without regard to themselves. No matter how happy they are outside, as long as they feel that they have nothing to do with them, they will be bored and sleepless. .
The key to this action is to take advantage of this, and to kill everyone before they have figured out the situation!
(PS: The plot is difficult to write recently, and it will be updated after eight o'clock in the evening, so I won’t repeat it.)

chapters.title: Chapter 728: Is it really appropriate for you to invite people like this?
chapters.content:
Due to time constraints, Ivan did not discuss the details of the battle in a lengthy manner. After a simple reminder, he looked around at the crowd and signaled that they were ready to go!
The wizards gathered in the square immediately took action. After establishing their respective teams and goals, they all performed Apparition and disappeared in place.
The whole process was efficient and fast, and it only took less than half a minute. Ivan, who was watching this scene, nodded secretly.
Compared to a year ago, these wizards have indeed grown a lot, and they are no longer like a patchwork army, with a certain degree of organization and discipline.
It seems that Aysia has not trained them less this year, and it is no wonder that Dougte confidently said that in the case of group fights, the law enforcement officers can beat twice as many Aurors.
Thinking of this, Ivan suddenly realized that he already possessed an extremely large power, second only to the Ministry of Magic, even the Death Eater army that Voldemort had just rebuilt, or Dumbledore’s Order of the Phoenix. Not as good.
However, it is a pity that the magic world is different from the Muggle world. The level of individual spellcasting ability can directly determine the outcome of a small battle.
Ivan has not forgotten that Dougte once told him that the Ministry of Magic arranged a beheading operation against Voldemort in the last Wizarding War. The Auror and the rebels who spontaneously participated in the war had a total of fifty wizards. !
Everyone is an elite honed in the Wizarding War!
However, even such a resistance team was still defeated by Voldemort!
Because there are no survivors, no one knows whether Voldemort alone did this battle or someone leaked the information in the middle. Voldemort planned to summon his servants to fight against the encirclement...
In contrast, Ivan prefers the former.
Because with the increase in strength, Ivan felt more and more that ordinary wizards were no longer a threat to him.
In the situation of melee, it is not a problem to hit ten Aurors in one breath. This is still limited to too little magic power, let alone Voldemort.
For a wizard of this level, the role of the human sea tactics is very limited.
This also means that even if the law enforcement officers have outstanding combat power, their biggest role is only to help him contain the large number of Death Eaters, and it is difficult to provide him with much help in high-level battles.
Just as Ivan was thinking about it, the slight explosion and the light of fire in the distance came into view, pulling his floating thoughts back...
...
At the same time, two figures appeared out of thin air in the street on the east side of Turnover Alley.
"Well, it should be here. According to intelligence, the wizard we are going to invite this time is living alone. There is no other person in the family. He is of average strength and is the best one to deal with among all the targets." Grace looked at her hand. Map, said enthusiastically.
"But how should we invite him? Just knock on the door and ask?" Walker scratched his head and asked puzzledly.
The smile on Grace's face suddenly froze. She hadn't thought about this problem at all before she came, and now she has heard Walker mention it and realized it.
In the middle of the night, if someone suddenly comes to invite you to a place, it is unlikely that anyone will agree to it...
"Anyway, give me a courtesy first, then try to speak, what if the other party can talk very well?" Grace hesitated for a long time, and finally said.
Walker was a little worried about being stunned and ran away by the other party, but it was not easy to hit him directly... After all, there was more than this room nearby.
After the two discussed, Grace stepped forward quickly and knocked **** the door.
咚咚咚...
After a long time, no one responded.
When the two frowned and wondered if there was no one inside, a husky and nervous male voice rang.
"who?"
Grace felt a shock, and said cautiously. "That's it, sir, we are the law enforcers of the wizarding market. Your Excellency Hals sincerely invites you to meet in the wizarding market immediately..."
Grace's words seemed to relieve the wizard inside, but his words quickly became a little annoyed, and said very impatiently.
"I'm not interested...Get out of here, don't bother me to rest!"
Walker's face suddenly darkened, and Grace was also a little angry.
It's just that they also know that it is very impolite to come to disturb others to sleep in the middle of the night, so they plan to persuade a few more words.
But just as the two were about to speak, there was a wave of spatial fluctuations behind them.
Grace was holding the magic wand and turned her head very vigilantly, but her tight expression soon relaxed, because the apparition was shifted by three law enforcement officers, and Joseph behind was also carrying a coma on the shoulders. The wizard of the past.
"Grace? Walker? Haven't you figured it out yet?" Joseph looked at the two of them, said in surprise.
"Josell? Why did you come here?" Walker said unexpectedly. The goals of each team are unlikely to coincide.
"Hey...does that need to be said? Of course it is because his wife is inside!" Joseph pointed to the wizard who had passed out on his shoulders, and said with a strange smile.
Walker and Grace were a little confused. The information they got was that the owner of this room should be a wizard who lives alone.
The faint voices of a few people gradually spread to this small room, and there was a burst of harassment inside.
"Go, don't let them run away!" Noticing this, Joseph didn't hesitate at all. He waved his magic wand and broke the lock with the opening curse, and then rushed in directly with the wizard on his shoulders.
The other two law enforcement officers were also very decisive, without saying a word, rushed into the house with Joseph.
The next moment, fierce shouts and fighting sounded from the room.
Walker and Grace hurriedly chased after them, and the battle was over after just such a moment of effort.
When the two rushed into the house, the place was in a mess. In addition to Joseph and the others, there were also a man and a woman two wizards on the ground. They looked disheveled and seemed to have just put on their clothes. Has passed out in a coma.
Joseph was instructing a law enforcement officer to take the fainted witch with him, and then turned his head to look at the two people who walked in, and enthusiastically stepped forward and patted Walker on the shoulder. "Don't worry, I won't take credit for your work, I have already caught this person for you, no thanks!"
Seeing the wizard who fell on the ground and passed out into a coma, Walker and Grace looked at each other. If they remember correctly, Your Excellency Hals asked them to "invite" people to the wizarding market...you really "invite people" like this. Is that good?

chapters.title: Chapter 729: Open the door, the community will send warmth!
chapters.content:
A minute later, several people walked out of the house carrying their goals.
Due to the urgent task and other targets to be dealt with, Joseph and the others did not stay here much. After exchanging information with Walker and Grace, they Apparated and disappeared in place.
"It seems that we can't wait any longer..." Grace muttered to herself, who was still staying in place.
Just now she learned from Joseph that those fast teams had already invited three or four goals in this period of time, and they had just settled one.
"Yes, we have to speed up too!" Walker nodded in agreement, he didn't want to be the last one to complete the task.
The high-spirited two took out the map again, and used Apparition to go to the location of the next target.
According to this, in another room ten meters away, Vincent, who was awakened by yelling and breaking the door, slowly lowered the curtain.
While irritated by these people's congresses that affected his sleep at night, Vincent also faintly gloated, secretly guessing what happened to the unlucky guy next door that would have caused such a big battle.
"But what does this have to do with me?" Vincent mumbled secretly, thought for a while, and then gave up the probing.
There are too many similar things in Knockout Alley. Many wizards hide in Knockout Alley because they have criminal records in their hands.
Vincent yawned, then lay back on the bed and went back to sleep.
I don't know how long it took, and vaguely, a dull knock on the door reached Vincent's ears, accompanied by the rough voices of several big guys.
"Open the door, the community will send warmth!"
...
More than an hour passed in a flash, and the originally empty square was already full of invited people, and all kinds of noisy voices reverberated.
Most of these wizards were transported after being forcibly knocked out, and few of them could figure out what happened.
Even when they just woke up, some people tried to rally and resist, trying to escape from here.
But it’s a pity that the law enforcers had already confiscated their magic wands. A group of wizards without magic wands, no matter how large the number of them were, they couldn’t make any waves. The few leaders were even more fierce by the guarded law enforcers. I learned a lesson.
Seeing the fate of these "pioneers", the order on the square was barely maintained. The wizards who were captured temporarily suppressed the rising anger in their hearts and chose to continue to wait and see. When things became clear, they decided on their own. position.
About ten minutes later, Walker and Grace showed up on the square with two wizards. When they realized that they were the last team to arrive, both of them looked a little depressed.
But fortunately, they didn't wait for a long time, and Ivan didn't mean to blame them. After the wizards who had passed out in a coma woke up, he slowly stepped onto the high platform.
The crowd who was talking about it suddenly quieted down, and everyone spontaneously turned their gazes to the high platform.
As Ivan moved forward step by step, a coercion gradually shrouded their hearts.
It feels like someone is holding a heavy object on their shoulders, and is still adding weight bit by bit.
Noting the suspicious expressions on the wizards’ faces, Ivan on the stage nodded secretly. The newly acquired bloodline magic was more powerful than he had imagined. Not to mention the dragonized state, just the extended dragon will help. He solved a lot of troubles.
Under the gaze of everyone, Ivan quickly walked to the center of the high platform, opened his hand, and spoke very enthusiastically.
"Everyone, thank you very much for being invited to participate in this important rally!"
The law enforcement officers onlookers clapped their applause very interestingly, while the wizards who were caught frowned and looked at Ivan on the stage indifferently.
Vincent suffocated his stomach and sneered even more. "Do you mean sending someone to break into our house and knock them out before bringing them here?"
Ivan was not angry at Vincent's sudden interruption, but rather politely explained.
"Please forgive me for the rudeness of the law enforcement officers! Because the incident happened suddenly, in order to bring everyone here smoothly, it is usually necessary to take some special measures, lest...some people with bad intentions take the opportunity to escape! "
As Ivan spoke, his gaze turned slightly to the right. The Death Eaters in Shining's memory were now **** with rope and thrown under the platform, looking very miserable...
Vincent couldn't help shivering as he watched this scene, his tone was slightly reduced, and he asked. "Then your Excellency Hals took so much thought to invite us people here, what are you going to do?"
Ivan looked around at the crowd, and said in a calm tone. "Now all the wizards in Knock Down Alley are here. I invite you to come today to discuss the future that belongs to Knock Down Alley..."
The future of Knockoff Alley?
In the square, the wizards who heard these words showed mocking and disdainful expressions, but Ivan ignored them and continued to speak.
"I have heard people say that Knock Down Alley is a sanctuary for a group of poor people, and some people think it is a concentration camp for villains and dark wizards. However, since the beginning of Knock Down Alley, chaos and killings have always been here. The main theme, I believe none of you will oppose this..."
When Ivan said this, he suddenly paused and turned to look at Vincent. "Vincent, if I remember correctly, your wife died in a melee in Knockoff Alley three years ago.
It was a battle that had nothing to do with you. It was caused by a conflict between several wizards. They fought near your house, and it hit your wife, which led to her unfortunate death..."
"Although you have successfully avenged her, but the dead cannot be restored after all. I don't think that was the result you wanted."
Vincent's expression suddenly became a little gloomy, and Ivan's words were equivalent to forcibly removing the scars that had been buried in his heart for a long time...
Ivan didn't mean to stimulate Vincent too much, and his gaze quickly turned to another wizard. "Mark, I heard that your child was almost taken away, and he almost died at home?"
"What on earth are you trying to say?" Mark's face became a little unsightly. If he hadn't had a wand in his hand and there were spellcasters staring around him, he would have done it a long time ago.
"Good question!" Ivan nodded, and he looked at the wizards in the audience and spoke word by word. "I think Knockdown Alley has been chaotic for too long, and a brand new order is needed here!"

chapters.title: Chapter 730: My friends, it’s time to make a change!
chapters.content:
"I know that among you there are lowly thieves, wicked thugs, and dark wizards who study taboo magic and are not tolerated by the world. You are very comfortable here, and even take the initiative to create chaos and enjoy it..."
"But I think there are more people who are tired of those unreasonable fights. They don't want the blood of strangers to be stained in front of the house. They don't want their children and relatives to face the risk of death when they walk on the street. ...I'm fed up with the endless exploitation of the weak by the strong!"
"Those abusers never have a trace of sympathy, as long as they think you are weak and deceptive, they will take away your only ration without mercy..."
Having said that, Ivan's tone became more and more high, he looked at the moving faces in the audience, and said again.
"So... my friends, it's time to make a change, Knockdown Alley desperately needs an order!"
"From today on, we will not have to worry that we will be affected by an unreasonable melee when we walk outside the door, and we will be stolen from the meager hard-earned income, and we do not need to fear the bullying by the mob...
We will live in a brand new place, a new home that abandons chaos and has order! "
Ivan's words resounded in everyone's minds like Hong Zhong.
Many dark wizards showed uneasy expressions on their faces. They looked around in horror, and the emotions of more people had been aroused by this words.
Just as Ivan had imagined, the largest number of people in a slum is the poor. Most of them grew up here, and a few migrated from other places and settled here.
These people are the victims of the chaotic situation in Knockdown Alley. According to outsiders, they are a group of cockroaches and mice hiding in the corner, a group of... people who have been completely abandoned by the magic world!
No one hates the chaos here more than them, and no one expects order more than them.
To complete the task of rectifying Knockdown Alley, Ivan knew that he must try his best to win the support of these people!
However, just as Ivan was speaking, a very discordant voice suddenly rang.
"Even the Ministry of Magic can't control here, so what are you?"
Ivan's speech stopped. He heard the sound and looked over. The voice was a middle-aged wizard in his thirties, with a gloomy look on his face.
"This is a good question! It's just that I don't like someone interrupting me when I am talking, understand?" The smile on Ivan's face remained unchanged, still so polite.
This caused the onlookers to shudder.
Only the middle-aged wizard showed a somewhat disdainful expression on his face. He thought Ivan’s reaction was a cowardly and fearful expression, but before he could speak again, Ivan on the stage suddenly waved without warning. Up the wand.
"~ (Drill my heart and cut my bones
A burst of unspeakable pain instantly swept through his body. The middle-aged wizard who was still aggressive before fell to the ground in the next second, crazily twisting his body, his nails pierced deeply into his palms, and his mouth sent out stern words. Wailing...
At the beginning, the wizard was quite strong, and even gritted his teeth to lower his voice as much as possible, but after Ivan increased his spells, his will immediately collapsed and turned into a humble and humble one. Begging Ivan's forgiveness...
However, no matter how the other party pleaded, Ivan's expression did not change in any way, casting the spell unwaveringly, just watching the wizard struggling painfully on the ground in silence.
Ivan slowly put away his wand until the other party slid like a dead dog.
The whole square is quiet and scary.
Crowd Zhong Sente looked at the middle-aged wizard who had been tortured into a coma not far away, and then looked at the figure on the high platform, a chill in his heart could not help.
The eyes of the other wizards looking at Ivan were also full of fear and panic.
Before Ivan's polite attitude and slightly immature face, they couldn't help but have some illusions, thinking that they were standing in front of them as a weak and deceiving lamb.
But Ivan’s sudden heart-piercing curse completely tore through this layer of camouflage.
The law enforcement officers surrounding them are reminding everyone that this is not a lamb, but a man-eating tiger!
"Anyone else intends to ask questions?"
Ivan's voice rang again.
No one dared to respond, everyone bowed their heads in fear, and the wail of the wizard seemed to be still echoing in their ears, blocking their words.
Ivan was not surprised by the changes in everyone's expressions. He had long understood that some people in Knockdown Alley were unreasonable.
Only oppression and pain can make the villains remember...
But for the honest wizards, Ivan has always been tolerant, and also meant to ease the dignified atmosphere, lest these people mistakenly think that they are a cruel wizard, so they speak gently.
"You don't need to be afraid of me. Sharp knives are always reserved for those who need to be punished. Those wise men who can recognize the situation and those who are willing to follow the order will receive the most generous treatment!"
"Now please make your choice. All the wizards in Knock Down Alley are here. You have the right to decide for yourself the future of this Forgotten Land, whether you want to continue to follow the chaos of the past or build a new order with me. ?"
"I'll give you one minute to think about it. Those who agree, please raise your arms, those who disagree..." Ivan looked around everyone present and pointed his wand to the empty space under the high platform Please stand up! "
As time passed bit by bit, the wizards gathered in the square hesitated. Although Ivan's words were on their hearts, these few words were not enough to convince them.
The least trustworthy thing in Turnover Alley is the words, not to mention that they were all caught by force this time...
Therefore, compared to the "beautiful new home" portrayed by Ivan, everyone was more afraid of the law enforcement officers who were surrounded by magic wands in all directions.
As for the empty talk about democratic voting by Ivan, no one is so stupid to believe that the wizard who smashed into Ivan is still lying there unconscious, and no one wants to follow in his footsteps.
Half a minute passed in a flash, during which no one raised their hand, and no one dared to stand up, as if they were carrying out some kind of silent protest...
Ivan's complexion remained the same, he was still calm and composed, but he was playing drums in his heart, wondering if he was too impatient...
I knew I should find a few Toan in advance to help myself speak in the crowd...

chapters.title: Chapter 731: Knockover Alley needs order!
chapters.content:
Seeing that time was about to pass, Ivan's heart gradually sank to the bottom.
He made so many preparations today and captured all the wizards in Knockout Alley in one breath. If he succeeded in one fell swoop, it would be nice to say that once he failed, the consequences would be serious.
Fortunately, Ivan was slightly relieved that when there were only ten seconds left, one hand was slowly raised.
The wizards who were still hesitating for a while turned their heads and looked over. It was Mark who raised their hands.
Under everyone's gaze, Mark did not waver at all. He stared at Ivan on the high platform, then glanced at his nine-year-old son who was arrested with him, and finally sighed.
"Perhaps you are right, Knockdown Alley needs order...I don't want what happened that day to happen again..."
Mark's affectionate sigh moved the wizards present.
But the voice of opposition soon rang.
"Who knows if what he said is true?"
"There shouldn't be any need for him to lie to us..." Mark pointed to the law enforcement officers gathered around and reminded him. "Don't forget, we didn't have a choice from the beginning."
Mark's meaning is very obvious, the situation is better than people now, even if Ivan is uneasy and kind, they have nothing to do.
After a while of silence, more and more wizards raised their hands, and those who had opposed opinions had to temporarily bow their heads in this form.
After a while, everyone in the audience raised their hands in agreement, and the heart that Ivan had been holding finally let go. Although the one-minute time limit has long passed, at least the result he wanted has now been achieved.
The only pity is that the reminder of the task completion has not sounded. With a thought, Ivan opened the task bar and took a look. The task of rectifying Knockdown Alley has increased to 97%...
Why is there still 3% of the progress left? Did I miss something?
Ivan's brows were slightly frowned. He looked at the raised hands and suddenly realized something. His brows stretched out. He took a few steps forward, smiling again on his face, and opened his hands. Spoke out.
"I am glad that everyone can make the right choice!"
"You and I are all wizards living in this forgotten land, suffering from hunger and suffering, and now have the same beliefs, and should unite as brothers and sisters..."
"But please allow me to say one more..." The smile on Ivan's face narrowed slightly, and his words gradually became sharper. "Some of you are not worthy to stand with us!"
"They are bullies, perpetrators, murderers, looters, and people who bring us pain and make our lives worse off every day... They are not friends but our enemies!"
Ivan was pacing on the high platform, eagle-like eyes swept over the wizards with sudden changes, and then grinned: "I can understand the resentment and pain in each of you, and allow you to vent now— —Push the perpetrators in front of me and stand trial. This is the first thing I will do for you!"
As soon as this statement came out, the orderly square immediately became chaotic, and an old witch screamed.
"What's a joke? Don't be fooled by him, he just wants to divide and enslave us!"
"We have more than a hundred people here. Why don't they dared to kill us all?" The other wizards also sternly agreed.
However, Ivan didn't pay attention to their words at all, and after blessing himself with a loud voice curse on his backhand, he shouted loudly to everyone in the audience.
"Go ahead, let us rebuild order!"
Ivan’s words were like pressing a certain switch, and the faces of the poor people who were loyal and dare not to resist showed fierce expressions. The squeezed anger in their hearts was completely ignited. Turned to those wizards who just tried to stir up chaos.
"What do you want to do?" a dark wizard asked with a stern voice, he subconsciously wanted to grab the wand hung around his waist, but he rushed for nothing.
Only then did he remember that his wand had been snatched away by the hateful law enforcers, and even some of the dark magic items he had hidden in his pocket were looted when he was in a coma.
Except for the two pairs of fists, he no longer has the ability to fight against this group of mobs... He can only watch a dozen or so angry wizards throw them to the ground.
The noise and chaos lasted for about five minutes. Twenty or so wizards were quickly kicked out by the crowd, each with their noses and faces swollen. Obviously they were beaten during this time...
The last wizard who was pushed out was even more blue and purple, and looked very miserable, but he climbed onto the high platform uncharacteristically, trembling slightly in front of Ivan, crying bitterly. Accusing myself of being wronged and framed...
Ivan looked down at the wizard and said indifferently. "Jamie Davis?"
"Your Excellency Hals, do you know me?" Jamie's heart suddenly slammed.
"Of course I know..." Ivan said playfully. "Twenty-one years ago, you graduated from Hogwarts. Before, you lived in the magic world by selling fake goods. It wasn't until you killed an Auror who saw through you fourteen years ago that you escaped to Knockover Alley. Become a habitual thieves and predators here, am I right?"
Jamie's pupils shrunk slightly and looked at Ivan with horrified eyes. The other party knew his habit of stealing, and he could understand it, but the fact that he once killed the Auror was clearly a secret that no one knew...
He can’t understand where the other party learned about the news but Jamie has already thought so much unintentionally, and the fearful expression on his face has gradually become hideous. He has been from the beginning. Knowing that Ivan would not let him go so easily, the law enforcers around him also cut off his retreat.
The only way to survive is to hijack the young wizard in front of him, and now is the best opportunity!
A trace of excitement surged into his heart, and Jamie knew that the law enforcement officers at such a close distance would never be able to provide support, and the wizard who was close to him would never have the chance to pull out his wand!
Jamie jumped up from the ground almost instantaneously, leaped straight at Ivan, and stretched out his flexible right hand to point at Ivan’s neck...
But beyond Jamie's expectation, after his sudden uproar, Ivan did not move at all, calmly a little scary.
Under the action of the mind-consciousness, Jamie's thoughts and thoughts have long been exposed, so in the face of such an "sudden" attack, Ivan just spit out a few words sarcastically.
"Ridiculous!"

chapters.title: Chapter 732: Interrupted assembly
chapters.content:
While Ivan was speaking, the seventeen magic texts engraved on the left wrist bracelet were instantly lit...A shock wave composed of magic power spread quickly in all directions,
The expression on Jamie's face suddenly froze, as if he was hit by a heavy hammer in his chest, and flew out embarrassedly, rolling all the way and hitting the huge stone pillars erected around the square.
The law enforcement officers guarding over there were not too slow to react, and neatly **** Jamie, who was left with only a breath after landing.
Ivan seemed to have done a trivial thing. He didn't even look there. He turned his gaze to the two dozen dark wizards who had been pushed out by the crowd, and used the spirit of sedentary mind to scrutinize them one by one as before. Their crime...
Robbery... Killing... Stealing... Fraud... Curse...
One by one, overt or undercover crimes were gradually revealed by Ivan.
Every sorcerer who was named has a cold sweat on his head and a warrior figure. Ivan on the stage is like a devil in hell, digging out the deepest secrets in their hearts.
The wizards standing below were filled with righteous indignation, and Ivan's words mobilized all the anger they had accumulated over the years, and they wished to rush up and smash these people immediately.
If the eyes can kill people, these twenty-odd thugs would have been battered long ago.
Dougert was a little curious about Ivan’s source of intelligence. In the afternoon, Ivan asked him to get a list of people who need attention in the Knockover Alley, but the information he wrote in there was far less than Ivan’s current information. It was so detailed.
Could it be that Ivan has other sources of intelligence?
While Dougte was contemplating hard to understand, Ivan had finished talking about everyone's crimes and made a corresponding trial. Among them, nine people were immediately sentenced to death for their crimes, and the remaining sixteen were sentenced to life imprisonment!
In the indifferent sound of Ivan’s trial, the twenty-five wizards were full of ugliness, either kneeling to pray, or crying bitterly. Only one old witch stared at Ivan viciously and shouted with a sharp voice. Tao.
"You have no right to judge us..."
The law enforcement officers gathered around this place laughed, but to their expectations, Ivan nodded and said in agreement.
"You are right, I don't have this right."
Everyone present was startled, even the old witch did not expect that Ivan would actually agree with her words.
However, before she could react, Ivan turned his head and scanned the wizards under the high platform, and continued loudly.
"Yes, I certainly don't have this right, but they do!"
"It is not my selfish desire to judge you, but a choice made by all the wizards in Knock Down Alley..."
Ivan's words immediately awakened the wizards gathered in the square, and soon someone spoke in agreement.
"Yes! Put them to death! Hang these people on a pole!"
"No, you can't make them so cheap, use a heart-breaking curse!" Another wizard looked at the old witch angrily and retorted loudly.
The voices of the crowd made the dark wizards who were about to be judged plunged into deep fear. There were even a few voices in the crowd suggesting that Ivan cut them off, or tortured them to death with a heart-piercing curse...
"quiet!"
Amidst the noise, Ivan raised his hand, and his voice was as loud as thunder under the blessing of magic.
A few seconds later, the chaotic square was silent again, and a pair of eyes looked towards the stage, and compared to the previous look at Ivan, the eyes were a little more agreeable.
At the same time, the system prompt for the completion of the task also rang in Ivan's mind.
It's just that this meeting, Ivan didn't have time to pay attention to it for the time being, he put all his energy on the hundreds of wizards in the audience.
"My fellow citizens, I understand your inner anger very well..."
"But blind killing is undesirable. Some of them are guilty and some are not dead. What we should pursue is order rather than chaos... Judgment is not to vent anger, but to give them the retribution they deserve!"
Having said this, Ivan paused, and then solemnly spoke again. "I promise you that each of them will get the most fair trial! Starting today, Knockdown Alley will also usher in a new chapter!"
With Ivan's encouragement, the enchanting wizards of Knockdown Alley gradually calmed down.
Paying attention to the expressions of everyone, Ivan nodded secretly, he knew that his prestige had been initially established.
It's not in vain that he memorized the entire afternoon's speech, and he secretly rehearsed several times in the middle...
