Now it seems that these efforts are worthwhile, and even the effect is surprisingly good. He originally thought that in the end he would need to rely on a strong policy to make these people succumb, but he did not expect the wizards of Knockdown Alley to cope better than he thought. .
The corners of Ivan's mouth were slightly raised, and at this moment, a slight applause suddenly passed from the right side of the square, breaking the silence on the court.
At first, Ivan thought it was the law enforcement officers who were cheering for him, but when he looked over, he was shocked in a cold sweat. The two law enforcement officers guarding there had fallen to the ground for some time, life and death unknown. .
The faint applause came from the depths of darkness that the fire can't reach...
"Who?" Fren and others also reacted at this time, drawing out their wands and pointing them in the direction of the sound.
Under the dim night, a tall and thin figure slowly walked out, the dark wizard robe and the night almost merged into one, only the red eyes were faintly visible in the night.
"What a wonderful speech..."
He stepped to the front of the stage , stopped applauding, and said in an admiring tone. There was a slight smile on the face of the pale snake with no trace of blood, which was creepy.
Voldemort? !
Ivan's pupils shrunk, staring at the strange figure in front of him in amazement, with a puzzled look in his eyes.
Why is he here? How could it be here?
Was it because there were traitors among those law enforcement officers, or because they called each other's name in the underground fortress, or did the Death Eaters successfully activate the Dark Mark before they were captured?
Countless thoughts flashed through Ivan’s mind.
But these are not the key points. What really puzzled him was that according to Dumbledore's judgment, Voldemort had suffered a fatal injury in that battle, and he needed to lie in bed for a while.
This is why he dared to hold this big rally in the wizarding market.
But now Voldemort, who should have been seriously injured, stood in front of him with good grace...

chapters.title: Chapter 733: You and I are the same people!
chapters.content:
After detecting the invasion, except for the guards, all the other wizards gathered together. Dozens of magic wands formed a semi-circle to surround them, but after seeing the pale and strange snake face of the opponent, there was no one. Dare to do it.
Voldemort seemed to have not seen those wands pointing at him, step by step as if walking in the garden.
On the contrary, the wizards surrounding him seemed to be strangling their throats by the **** of death, and they even needed to breathe hard...
"God...mysterious man?" A law enforcement officer screamed tremblingly, and even his wand was almost unsteady.
Seeing this situation, Ivan on the stage cried out secretly, and the shock that Voldemort brought was far more profound than he had imagined.
As a result of having been using the mind of sedentary mind, Ivan was able to clearly perceive the fear that had arisen in the hearts of everyone, and the situation that he had successfully controlled had returned to chaos.
Compared with the law enforcers who had some courage to face Voldemort, the wizards in Knockdown Alley were even more unbearable. As Voldemort approached and retreated again and again, if they hadn't blocked the square exit, they were afraid they would have dispersed. Escaped...
The happiest person on the scene was the Death Eaters who were caught. Although they were all **** with ropes, they seemed very happy. They wriggled hard and crawled towards Voldemort, headed by a Death Eater. She even cried and said.
"Master! You finally came to save us..."
The dark wizards who should have been on trial also seemed to have seen a savior, and ran to Voldemort's side.
Photographed in the power brought by Voldemort, no one in the audience dared to stop the actions of the dark wizards, just witnessing them humble kneeling on the ground, praying for Voldemort's shelter...
Ivan also didn't mean to care. These Death Eaters could not create any substantial threats without a wand in their hands, but might become a burden to the other party.
The only enemy that really needs to deal with is Voldemort in front of him...
With Voldemort's repeated approach, the law enforcers had retreated to Ivan's side, and everyone was waiting for Ivan to give orders.
"You got better soon!" Ivan looked at Voldemort in front of him, was silent for a while, and said with a hint of sarcasm.
While talking, Ivan moved a few steps closer to Voldemort, and his power became stronger.
The reason for this is not because Ivan deliberately angered the other party.
It was that he knew that he had not acted immediately in the face of Voldemort's repeated provocations, which had already dealt a huge blow to the power he had accumulated during the week.
If he showed his timidity again, Ivan couldn't imagine whether the seemingly loyal law enforcement officers around him would turn his head and aim his wand at him in the next second.
After all, with the exception of Fren and others, the other law enforcement agents have been with him for a very short time, and his credibility is worrying. He can act honestly in normal times, all relying on his strength and power to suppress.
Now Voldemort, who is stronger and harsher than him, is in front of him, and Ivan is not sure that these law enforcement officers will stand firmly with him.
The most important thing is that Ivan wants to test whether Voldemort's injury has healed.
However, facing the encirclement of dozens of magic wands from the opponent, it is still so careless. The probability is that it has returned to its heyday, otherwise the opponent would never dare to support it like this.
"That's natural, there are always a few of my faithful servants who can play some role..." Facing Ivan's secret taunts, Voldemort didn't mean to be angry at all, and he explained casually.
Then he turned his head slightly and waved his wand casually to release the rope that bound the Death Eaters. He slowly grabbed the arm of one of the Death Eaters and opened the other's sleeves. Staring at the hot black mark on the Death Eater's arm, he said playfully.
"For example, now! If I hadn't felt the call of the Dark Mark, I wouldn't have seen such a wonderful scene..."
For a moment, Ivan wanted to take advantage of Voldemort's distraction, but he finally resisted it. In the face of himself and a large number of law enforcement officers, Voldemort could not reveal such an obvious flaw.
While Ivan was thinking about it, Voldemort had put down the Death Eater's hand and turned to look at him.
"Ivan Hals..." Voldemort whispered his name softly, "You know what? I wanted to kill you directly! Because you caused me too much trouble, and ruined my plan time and time again. s plan……"
Having said this, Voldemort's snake face became a little distorted. He thought of the night four years ago and the battle a few days ago.
Had it not been for Ivan to suddenly come out to disrupt the situation, he should have been able to achieve his goal smoothly...
Scenes flashed in my mind, and the tyrannical killing intent escaped from Voldemort's body, and the temperature in the entire square seemed to drop a few minutes...
But Ivan's expression was calmer than before, and he replied with a sneer.
"Speaking without shame..."
If it weren't for the safety of Esiah, and the wizards of Knockout Alley were all here, he could escape directly, no matter how strong Voldemort was, he couldn't help himself.
What's more, he still has a hole card. It is too wasteful to just use it rashly here, and there is no guarantee that he will kill Voldemort...
Voldemort didn't care about Ivan's words. The previous battle had already made him see Ivan's strength. Although it was not as good as his own , it was not something that could be dealt with in twos or twos. He didn't. The reason to do it now.
"In a sense, you are very similar to me, Hals, you should be grateful for this! So I changed my attention now and decided to give you a chance to survive!" Voldemort looked at Ivan with a smile but a smile. It was a little erratic, it seemed that it was deliberately to avoid looking at Ivan, but the words continued.
"I understood a truth when I was still young. Most people in this world are mediocre people. Their vision and talents limit their thinking, and they are destined to be just a dust of the times..."
Voldemort glanced at the casters who had pointed their wands at him, but were in fear and dared not to do it. His eyes were full of disdain, so he quickly turned his eyes around again, with a kind of enthusiasm, exaltation, and enthusiasm. A strange and bewitching voice spoke.
"And you are different, Hals! You and I are both talented people, if we and I can unite, then the entire magical world will no longer have the power to compete with you and me!"
"Are you going to let me deal with Dumbledore with you?" Ivan understood Voldemort in an instant, and finally knew why the other party didn't come up directly and did it, but chose to have a long discussion with him here. It was originally the idea that he made.

chapters.title: Chapter 734: Are you worthy to share the magic world with me?
chapters.content:
"Hogwarts Bloodline Wizard Novel Cool Notes ( to find the latest chapter!
Voldemort was slightly weaker than Dumbledore holding the old wand, that's for sure.
Otherwise, Voldemort's arrogant temper would not be afraid of Dumbledore, and he would not dare to invade Hogwarts guarded by the opponent at the peak of his power.
Of course, it is not so easy for Dumbledore to defeat or kill Voldemort, so to some extent the power of the two people tends to be balanced.
And he has become the key to breaking the balance, standing on either side is enough to reverse the entire battle.
After trying to understand all this, Ivan was not interested in Voldemort's proposal, shook his head bluntly, and said. "I advise you to put away your thoughts of provoking discord, Voldemort."
"Really? Do you think Dumbledore would be on your side? If he knew what you were doing in Knockoff Alley, he might not be able to tolerate you..." Voldemort looked around at the law enforcers who surrounded him, and sneered. Reminded with a word.
In his opinion, Ivan and himself are the same kind of people, pursuing power and recruiting people for the purpose of seizing control of the magic world.
And Dumbledore can never tolerate the existence of such a person. The reason why the two have not broken out of conflict is only because Ivan is better than he was disguised in the past, and Dumbledore has not seen it through...
"If you are willing to join the ranks of Death Eaters, then you will become my most trusted right-hand and successor. When Dumbledore is resolved, we can take charge of the entire magical world together!" Voldemort said bewitched.
Ivan sneered, and didn't reply. He didn't believe a word of Voldemort's words.
If he really agreed, then everything he did in Knockout Alley would be equivalent to making a wedding dress for Voldemort. During this period, he was not only controlled by others, but he had to be careful to prevent Voldemort from digging a corner and disrupting the order of Knockout Alley. The gain was not worth the loss. .
More importantly, it is unknown whether Dumbledore will survive until the beginning of school this year. You don't need to care at all. Therefore, the situation today is not the tripartite checks and balances that Voldemort imagined, but a real battle between the two tigers.
Once the news of Dumbledore's death comes, this non-existent alliance will instantly collapse, and the Legion of Death Eaters that has grown by then will become another trump card for Voldemort to deal with himself.
Thinking of this, Ivan completely dispelled the idea of ​​running away.
He understands that today this one must be fought!
Even if Voldemort cannot be beaten into a remnant soul again, he must make the opponent fear his own power. Only in this way can Voldemort dare not act rashly after Dumbledore's death, and he can gain enough development time.
After making the decision, the jealous look on Ivan's face disappeared without a trace, replaced by an expression mixed with arrogance and contempt.
"You think too much of yourself, Tom, are you worthy to share the magical world with me?"
As Ivan spoke, he took the initiative to approach Voldemort, and patches of scarlet dragon scales emerged from his body, covering his exposed skin.
Under the effect of the dragonized state, Ivan's power has become more and more dignified, and everyone present is like a big enemy, as if a ferocious dragon descended on the square.
"I would rather kill you here, and find another chance to kill Dumbledore... The magic world only needs a ruler!" Ivan stepped up to Voldemort and said word by word.
"I don't know what is good or bad, you are seeking your own death!" Voldemort laughed angrily, and the murderous intent in his heart was no longer suppressed, intertwined with Ivan's momentum, and the two were almost evenly matched.
The law enforcement officers on the field suffered one after another. They felt like a boat driving in a huge wave, and they were at risk of capsizing at any time...
"Come on together, kill him!" Aysia shouted loudly.
Before Ivan was distracted, she resisted the worries in her heart and never interrupted the conversation between the two. Now that Ivan has made the decision to kill Voldemort, she will naturally not refute, and immediately greet everyone together. Hands on.
She didn't believe that so many wizards could not beat Voldemort alone!
Under Aysia’s call, only a handful of more than forty law enforcement officers responded at the first time. The top of the wand lit up with various colors, and the remaining wizards were either slow or cowardly. Hesitated and didn't dare to do it.
"All back! Don't interfere with my interest, you are not his opponents, I will take care of him myself!"
Just when Aixia and others were about to launch an attack, they were interrupted by Ivan's voice.
The law enforcement officers looked at Ivan unexpectedly and didn't quite understand what he meant. However, Ivan just waved his hand and ordered Esiah and the law enforcement officers around here to retreat as far as possible.
Unless you don’t care about the lives of these people at all, there is no difference between an ordinary wizard and a burden in this level of battle...
Especially Aisia is here too, if Voldemort launches a surprise attack on her and forces him to turn around to rescue it, it will be troublesome.
Under Ivan's order, the law enforcement officers secretly breathed a sigh of relief and retreated to the corner of the square.
Aisia looked at Ivan very worried, but stopped talking. She knew very well that Ivan was not Voldemort's opponent.
But seeing Ivan's full of confidence, Aysia hesitated and backed away a few steps with the others, because she knew that she could not help and might become a drag.
Voldemort ignored the actions of the law enforcement officers the whole time, as if they didn't exist at all, but looked at the dragon scales covering Ivan with quite dread.
If he is not mistaken, this is already the third bloodline magic that the other party has shown!
Voldemort's gaze at Ivan gradually changed from jealousy to greed, and at the same time, he merged the three bloodlines without losing control. This was something he couldn't even do.
Obviously Ivan has mastered the method of fusing multiple bloodlines that is what he dreams of!
"It seems that you have a lot of secrets...but I will dig these secrets out of your mind soon!" Voldemort murmured feverishly.
"Compared to this, I advise you to think carefully about how to escape from my hands..." Ivan said sarcastically, and said to himself in his heart.
Protected mode, turn it on!
The five legendary points disappeared, an indescribable sense of power surged into his heart, and the magical power that was silent in his body instantly became active, and the bricks and tiles within a hundred meters of him were in his grasp.
Unlike the past, Ivan did not turn on the protection mode to fuse new blood.
There was only one thought in his mind, and that was... slaughtered Voldemort!

chapters.content:

The sixty-second countdown appeared in the system bar, and Ivan did not dare to delay a moment. When the idea of ​​exploding Voldemort rose from his heart, the whole person disappeared out of thin air, leaving only a word.
"You shouldn't be here today, Tom!"
Just as Ivan spoke, a rush of warning signs suddenly surged into Voldemort's heart, and he suddenly turned his head, and the familiar figure had appeared beside him.
Ivan made a virtual fist with his left hand. The originally white and slender arm quickly swelled in just half a second, turned into a hideous dragon claw, and took Voldemort's face straight...
In the protection mode, such partial deformation, he can complete it almost instantaneously.
Voldemort's pupils shrank, and Ivan's speed was beyond his expectations. It was obviously too late to cast a counterattack, and it was an extremely stupid move to resist this attack.
So Voldemort subconsciously initiated the Apparition, his figure flickered in mid-air, but it quickly condensed again.
At this time, Voldemort was horrified to find that the surrounding space was filled with extremely active magic power. He wanted to perform spatial displacement more than several times more difficult than usual...
Between the lightning and flint, Ivan's fist was firmly printed on his snake face. Voldemort had only time to use blood magic to turn part of his body into black mist, and the whole person was directly blown out. Rolling and crashing into the abandoned house ten meters away.
Ivan was unforgiving, and disappeared in the next second. When he reappeared, he had stepped into the abandoned house. The surroundings were very dim, but under the peep of magic, everything inside was unobstructed. .
A large python, the thickness of a bucket, was curled up on the beam, and when it sensed Ivan's entry, it threw its mouth open with a blood basin.
Ivan raised his head and slid his empty left hand in mid-air at will. A few magical threads that were invisible to the naked eye without chanting a spell appeared in the air, instantly dismembering the terrifying python into several segments.
Blood and meat were spilled all over the sky, but before Ivan's body was contaminated, it quickly deformed. Numerous large or small rocks burning with hot flames were suspended in the air, hiding toward Voldemort at an unimaginable speed. Rushed to the location.
Each flint is like a cannonball, and it bursts immediately when it hits an obstacle.
The fire and explosion sounded continuously in the house, and in just three seconds, the entire abandoned house was destroyed by half.
After a while, Voldemort, half of his body covered in black mist, walked out of the fire, but he didn't seem to have suffered much damage except for his face a little swollen and his mouth crooked.
Ivan's brows were slightly frowned, and it seemed that Voldemort's life-saving ability was more terrifying than he thought. He was quite sure that his two attacks had hit each other solidly, but unfortunately the effect was minimal.
This shows that ordinary methods can't do anything for this man who can turn into a black mist at any time.
The most important thing is that his information was leaked out in the last battle. The other party has been guarding against his snake eyes. This time, it may not be so easy to rely on bloodline magic surprises to win.
"Damn you!"
Voldemort was completely angry, tyrannical fierce fire slowly rose from the cracks in the dilapidated floor, and surrounded his surroundings to avoid Ivan from approaching again. He waved his right hand vigorously and shouted harshly. Extraordinary novel
"AvadaKedavra~ (Avada Kedavra
A green light beam with the thickness of an arm flashed in mid-air, and Voldemort was full of killing intent, and it was so powerful that it was unimaginable.
But Ivan's figure was easily avoided in a flash. In the protection mode, the space of 100 meters in the whole body was under his control. Casting Apparition was as simple as eating and drinking water.
The green light beam suddenly fell into the air, hitting the wall behind, exploding a huge hole.
At this time, Ivan had already flashed to Voldemort's front not far away. With a finger of his wand, a red light flew away from his wand, which was even more powerful than the previous killing curse.
Voldemort's scalp numb for a while, and a rare panic appeared on the hideous snake face. He summoned a solid silver shield out of thin air to block him, and the red light hit the shield and burst open instantly.
Just before he could breathe a sigh of relief, another beam of light came oncoming again, Voldemort blocked it very hard, but was made ashamed by the aftermath of the curse.
Being repeatedly suppressed by a kid made Voldemort look a little frustrated. He constantly waved his wand, and one after another powerful black magic shot out from the wand, but was easily blocked by the opponent.
"Impossible...Impossible!" Looking at Ivan as he got closer, Voldemort's voice trembled slightly, and he was more confused.
In his impression, the little wizard in front of him was indeed very talented. He had a level of magic that far surpassed that of an adult wizard before he graduated, but there was still a big gap between his strength and his own.
If the opponent is so powerful, it would be impossible for him to escape that night a few days ago...
Voldemort even began to wonder if the little wizard in front of him was disguised by Dumbledore drinking the compound soup.
No, even Dumbledore could not suppress himself so easily!
"Very doubtful? Tom?" After a minute has passed, Ivan was extremely anxious, but his face showed a relaxed and arrogant posture.
He waved his wand and summoned the shadow of the unicorn, cooperating with the spell attack, while constantly disturbing Voldemort's mind with words.
"This was a surprise I prepared for Dumbledore, but you stupidly bumped in and ruined my plan..."
"It's a pity If the thing about me killing you goes out today, Dumbledore will definitely be guarded against me... You know, that old man is much more difficult to deal with than your trash..." Fan said with a weird smile, the scarlet dragon scales have covered half of his face, making him look extremely evil.
Voldemort turned into a fog and avoided the two curse beams that hit him, a chill in his heart, and his previous doubts were finally solved.
From what Ivan did in Knockturn Alley, he could see that the little wizard in front of him was not as simple as he knew from the memory of Sirius, but a complete careerist!
The opponent has always retained a portion of his strength, and the third bloodline magic he has mastered is also extremely powerful. In addition to the dragon scales appearing on his body, it can also form a domain with a range of about 100 meters, and the strength of the civil war in this domain is greatly increased.
With such a hole card, as long as Dumbledore's trust can be successfully obtained, it is easy to kill the strongest man in the magical world in a sneak attack...

Ivan knew how hard the fire was, so he frowned slightly, and the wand in his hand shook slightly, and a larger fire emerged from the tip of the stick, swelling into the appearance of a fire dragon in the wind. .
Two groups of fiery fires quickly collided in the air. The splashing flames burned all the tables, chairs and cabinets around. In only two or three seconds, the larger fiery dragon took the opposite flame python. Swallow it...
Voldemort's eyes widened, and he couldn't accept that he would lose to the opponent in the dark magic he was best at.
But before he had time to think about it, the giant dragon formed by fierce fire had already rushed towards him.
Voldemort's face became very dignified, and he swung his wand vigorously, summoning a semi-circular magic barrier, temporarily blocking the fiery dragon from the outside.
The violent heat wave shook his robe, and cracks gradually spread on the solid magic barrier in front of him.
At this moment, a crisp neighing sound rang out in the sea of ​​fire.
An illusory unicorn ignored the blazing fire around him, and easily passed through the magical barrier he set up, and rushed straight towards him.
Voldemort's soul froze and did not dare to stay anymore. Without hesitation, he turned into a cloud of black mist and smashed into the window, rushing away as fast as he could.
He was scared...
Facing this little wizard is simply evil, and staying here I am afraid I will only have a dead end...
"Want to go? Stay for me!"
Ivan glanced at the protection mode, which ended in about seven seconds. He was somewhat unwilling. He didn't want to let Voldemort go so easily. Even if he couldn't kill the opponent today, he had to let Voldemort learn a lesson.
Under the wave of the magic wand, the fierce flames scattered around instantly turned into a long whip, and slammed it against the black mist.
Voldemort, who was flying in the air, naturally felt the danger coming from behind, and when he was about to evade, a sharp voice came from below.
"This is impossible! The Dark Lord is invincible!"
Voldemort's figure stagnated, and only then did he notice that in the square below, five Death Eaters were looking at him with a broken faith, and that scream was exactly what one of the Death Eaters called out.
With such a moment of distraction, the fiery whip behind him was already close at hand, even in the state of black fog, it was unable to complete such an attack, and the screaming screams quickly came out from the black fog.
Under the gaze of everyone, the invincible Voldemort was knocked to the ground by a long flame whip...
The entire square fell into a deathly silence. Except for those Death Eaters whose beliefs had collapsed, Dougert and others nearby were equally shocked.

Dougter thought it would be at least a battle, but he didn't expect that Ivan would fly the seemingly powerful Voldemort just by a single face, and now he completely suppressed Voldemort.
If it weren't for the Dark Lord to be able to incarnate in the black mist and have great pressure, they would all think that this was a fake Voldemort.
The most surprised person on the court is Asia. Only she knows that Ivan’s true strength is far from Voldemort’s opponent. Dumbledore was mostly responsible for repelling Voldemort. Otherwise, they would not have to work so hard. To build a safe house.
As everyone was thinking about it, Voldemort, who was beaten back into a human form, had fallen from the sky and fell heavily on the solid bluestone slab. The black robe was burnt in potholes, and a small group of fierce fire was attached to the bare. Come out on the left arm.
Voldemort waved his wand without hesitation and chopped off his left arm, blood splattered everywhere, and severe pain suddenly poured into his mind.
But under a pair of glances, Voldemort stood up without saying a word, and quickly used black magic to create a brand new arm for himself.
Under the pressure of death, this extremely complicated process of changing hands was literally compressed by Voldemort to within two seconds.
Even so, the new arm hadn't been repaired yet, and the blazing mansion in front of him collapsed, and the demon-like figure appeared in front of him again.
Ivan didn't mean to chat, as soon as they met, three consecutive spell beams flew out of the wand.
Voldemort's complexion changed. The defeat in the previous battle made him lose the thought of fighting Ivan again, so after a few simple resistances, he activated the blood magic.
The endless black mist penetrated from Voldemort's body and spread in all directions, but within a moment of effort, Ivan was drawn into a space made up of black mist.
This scene seemed familiar, and Ivan vaguely remembered that his Horcrux diary also used this trick on him when he was in the second grade.
Compared to that time, the space formed by the black fog was more than several times larger, and it was even more weird. Just staying here all kinds of extreme negative emotions kept pouring into his mind, trying to destroy his will.
However, Ivan’s strength is no longer what it used to be, and it is naturally impossible to be trapped by this little trick. He gently raised his wand, and the expanding fire from the outside world seemed to be called. The movement of Ivan waving his magic wand turned into a giant blade tens of meters long and cut it down in the air!
The huge black mist space trembled violently, and was split into two halves by the huge blade formed by fierce fire...
In front of him, Voldemort's figure had disappeared without a trace, apparently taking advantage of this time to break through the blockade and forcibly perform Apparition and ran away...
Under the powerful perception provided by this special state, Ivan could clearly perceive the sudden spatial fluctuations, and there was no problem even tracing the source to find the coordinates of Voldemort's escape.
It's just that the protection mode provided by the system is coming to an end, Ivan didn't mean to follow the coordinates to kill, and spent the last two seconds to calm the tyrannical fire...

Therefore, Dougte even considered suggesting that Ivan temporarily slow down the pace of expansion, relying on the curse of loyalty for a few years, and waited for his strength to catch up before starting his actions again.
But now those worries no longer exist.

...
At eleven o'clock at noon, Ivan, who had gone back to sleep, sat up from the bed and yawned. After a brief wash, he went to the living room to prepare for today's lunch.

The effect of the protection mode is as powerful as he expected, and it can easily suppress Voldemort during the victory period.
But it is a pity that Voldemort's life-saving ability is too scary, and he can quickly repair it after a broken hand, and he is abruptly hit by a few spells, just like a okay person.
The protection mode of just one minute is not enough to kill the opponent. If it weren't for the strength that he showed was too strong, and he used words to disturb Voldemort's mind and successfully scared the opponent away, the outcome of the battle would be really hard to say...

chapters.title: Chapter 738: Rise of the Dark Lord
chapters.content:
"The Blood Wizard of Hogwarts (
Ivan's heart was a little more gloomy. Although he looked very beautiful this time, and he was dubbed the title of the number one powerhouse in the magic world, Ivan was not happy at all.
He knew very well that they were all disguised appearances in the protection mode, which would be broken with a single poke, and he had no idea how long it could scare Voldemort.
If Voldemort senses something is wrong and tries again in a short time, then he will be completely gone...
Thinking of this, Ivan had some headaches.
With his current level of magic, it is not easy to make a major breakthrough. He was expecting to use the legendary points he had so hard to gather and then integrate a bloodline to increase his strength. Unexpectedly, Voldemort suddenly killed him completely. He messed up his plan.
The only thing to be thankful for is that the legendary title obtained after that battle has made up for the missing legend points, and only two more points should be enough.
Ivan took a sip of tea and opened the task bar of the system, ready to see if there are any tasks that can be completed quickly in the near future.
[Explore Hogwarts], [Housed Elf Savior (Establish a Housed Elf Legion)], Dark Minions (have a Legion of Dementors)...
Glancing at the unfinished tasks displayed in the taskbar, Ivan made trouble for a while, and it seemed that none of these tasks could be handled in a short time.
The first is to explore Hogwarts, which requires the task to reach 100% progress, which is almost impossible in Ivan's view.
This thousand-year-old castle is too mysterious, hiding countless secrets, even the current headmaster Dumbledore can't figure it out, let alone himself.
And the task of saving the house elves is not something that can be done now. At least, after Dumbledore's death, he can think of a way to become Headmaster of Hogwarts before it can be considered.
The only thing that still has some hope is the mission of Dark Minions. The goal is to obtain the allegiance of a hundred dementors. Just go to Azkaban. He had a similar plan before.
But how to persuade these mindless dementors to take refuge in themselves is a difficult problem.
Ivan was thinking hard, but when he was looking at the task list, he unexpectedly discovered a new task, which was probably activated last night and when he got the achievement.
【The Rise of the Dark Lord
Mission: To rule the British magical world
Task progress: 17%
Legendary value: 4
Mission description: After successfully defeating Voldemort, you know that you are invincible in the world without any consideration. You set your next goal on the British magical world and prepare to establish a new order.
Note: Your ambition is more than that, an evil plan has already surfaced in your mind...]
Looking at the system's taskbar, Ivan was stunned, a sip of tea was sprayed on Dobby's body, only a thought remained in his mind.
This broken system is not a short circuit!
It’s fine if other people don’t know the truth, but he has a clear indication on the status bar. How did the system determine that he knew he was invincible?
Not to mention that he didn't think about it at all...Bah, there was no evil plan to rule the magical world at all...
Ivan kept complaining in his mind.
And Dobby, who was sprayed with tea by him, suddenly screamed after a brief stupefaction. He kept knocking on his head with the broom and yelling in his mouth.
"Bad Dobby... bad elf!"
"Don't be like that, Dobby, what are you doing?" Ivan was taken aback, and immediately recovered, and quickly grabbed the broom from the elf's hand, and asked inexplicably.
"Dobby failed to take good care of his master... Dobby must punish himself." Dobby looked terrified. The bulb-sized eyes were filled with tears, and the nose twitched, thinking that it must have been prepared by itself. The tea made Ivan feel dissatisfied and vomited on himself.
The sick brain circuit of the house elves made Ivan a little bit dumbfounded. "It has nothing to do with you, Dobby, I just thought of some funny things. To be honest, I should apologize to you..."
While Ivan was consoling Dobby, the door of the living room was suddenly opened, but Asia, who had gone out before, walked in through the door.
"What's the matter? Ivan? Did something go wrong while I was away?"
As soon as Aysia entered the door, she saw Dobby's head drooping as if she had done something wrong, while Ivan was patiently squatting next to her with a helpless expression.
"No, it's nothing, it's just that Dobby made a fuss." Ivan shook his head and casually explained.
"The house elves are like that. The habits that have been cultivated over the years will not be able to be corrected for a while." Aisia sighed.
When Dobby first came, he took away all the housework from the house, and was so busy all day long Even the floor in the house had to be wiped several times a day until it was clean and translucent. Will give up.
She did intend to reduce Dobby's workload, but once the incident was mentioned, the house elf would use whatever it could to punish herself in fear, and as time went by, Aysia gave up this thought.
"By the way, Mom, how about the things that I arranged last night, Fren and the others have dealt with? Are the wizards in Knockoff Alley still safe? No one is making trouble, right?" Ivan was not involved in Dobby's affairs. Chat more, and soon asked about business.
Aysia didn't mean to conceal, Dang Even gave a rough overview of what happened this morning.
Because the damage caused by that battle was too serious, even if it took a long time to repair, the traces of the battle could not be completely removed, and the hundred-meter-long gap still remained in the square.
And the wizards in Knockoff Alley were scared enough yesterday, one by one honestly, and even many people actively wanted to join them and become members of the law enforcement.
"It just so happens that we also need to recruit some more people, otherwise we won't be able to manage the more than forty wizards after we have captured the Ministry of Magic." Aysia added.
"Well, let's do that." Ivan nodded subconsciously.
Although they could recruit a portion of the Aurors to work for them at that time, they were not very reliable after all, and the wizards that they trained themselves would be more assured to use them.
Vaguely, Ivan always felt something was wrong.
Wait... When did I say I was going to fight the Ministry of Magic?
Before Ivan could ask, Aysia took a newspaper from the pocket of the wizard's robe and put it in front of Ivan, and said solemnly.
"This is today's Daily Prophet, you'd better read it..."

chapters.title: Chapter 739: Ivan: Why are you braver than me?
chapters.content:
"The Blood Wizard of Hogwarts (
Ivan took the newspaper by accident. After reading the contents clearly, his face changed slightly.
On the cover of the newspaper is a large dynamic picture. The scene in the picture is very familiar to him. The fire is blazing and a large area of ​​collapsed ruins. If you look closer, you can see the burning house in the distance...
Obviously, the photo was taken from Knock Down Alley last night.
However, the content of the report below did not mention his fight with Voldemort, but simply stated that a large-scale riot occurred in Knock Down Alley, and it is suspected that two groups of dark wizards broke out in conflict.
"How could this incident be reported so quickly? It doesn't make sense..." Ivan frowned and muttered to himself.
Just as Ivan was puzzled, Aysia spoke out to explain.
Their actions last night were too much to hide from the owners of the Diagon Alley shop and the wizards living in the hotel.
Although no one dared to enter the Knockout Alley to investigate the whole story, it is the instinct of most humans to watch the excitement far away, so everyone who has been rumored about the riot this morning is well known.
"In addition, this photo in the Daily Prophet is not complete...someone else has taken more information." Asia said, he took out a magical dynamic photo from his pocket and handed it to Iraq. In front of Fan.
Ivan took a closer look, and the corners of his mouth twitched...
This photo was also taken from Knock Down Alley last night, but the angle is slightly different from the one on the cover of the newspaper, and it should be a little later in terms of time.
The black mist incarnate Voldemort escaped from the window, but was faithfully recorded the process of being pulled down by a fiery whip, and Voldemort's panicked expression could be vaguely seen in the black mist.
"Is the person who took the picture alive?" Ivan turned his head and looked at Aisia and asked curiously.
"He was alive and well when I went. The mysterious man was just injured by you. Even if he wants to retaliate, he needs to wait a few days." Aysia chuckled lightly, then paused and said again. "Do you want to save him?"
"Forget it! Let someone drive him out of England... Whether he can survive or not depends on his luck." Ivan considered it for a while and decided not to take the muddy water.
If you want to save someone, you must take that person to a safe house to receive his asylum.
But now Ivan is even hanging on self-protection, and the powerful deterrence is all pretending, there is really no need to risk life and death for a stranger, and showing the poor bug a way of life is already a kindness.
"By the way, how many people have seen this photo?" Ivan asked again.
"It's difficult to determine the exact number, but there must be a lot of people who have seen it..." Aysia explained, "In addition, the news of your defeat of the mysterious man also spread, but not many wizards are willing to believe it."
Has even this information been leaked? It seems that the mouths of the wizards in Knockdown Alley are not so strict...
Ivan raised his eyebrows. He had clearly ordered everyone to keep secrets before. If Voldemort was affected by these rumors and came to his door to make trouble for himself, it would be bad.
No wonder the Daily Prophet is so eager to report on this matter, and it is estimated that it is dedicated to "refuting rumors."
Aysia kept talking, continuing to talk about the information she had gathered when she was out in the morning.
According to her speculation, the entire magical world will soon know that something has gone wrong in Knock Down Alley, and the Ministry of Magic will most likely send someone to investigate.
So now there are two paths before them.
Either admit it or hide it...
To this end, she discussed with Dougt, Fren and others for one night last night, and initially worked out a follow-up plan.
They agreed that with the power that Ivan currently possesses, there is no need to hide it, act more radically, admit it directly, and even contribute to the spread of what happened last night.
As long as it can be proved that Voldemort is really alive, it can greatly defeat the prestige of the Ministry of Magic.
And Ivan, who defeated Voldemort, will instantly become a salvation hero and the new strongest wizard in the magic world!
With these titles, Dougert, Rozier, and others can come forward to lobby, threaten those sensible pure-blood wizards and Ministry officials, and pull them into their own ranks.
In addition, they also sent someone to search for Voldemort's hiding place, ready to pick him out, or force him to do things in the magical world, causing panic, so that as many people as possible know that Voldemort has returned...
At this time, as long as Ivan stepped forward to stop Voldemort several times, he would be able to gain a large amount of people's foundation and drive the ineffective Fudge to a dead end!
Finally, when the magic world complains, they can wait for an opportunity to start a war, overthrow Fudge's tyranny, and support an obedient puppet minister to come to power.
Esiah talked freely about the details of the plan Ivan on the side heard one head and two big heads.
He really didn't understand why Aixia and others suddenly became so brave? How dare to use the legendary Dark Lord Voldemort as a tool of prestige...
Obviously, he was worried and afraid before, and he couldn't even mention mysterious people.
Who the **** is... Uh, Ivan suddenly thought as if it was the courage he gave them.
He also finally understood what was going on with the mission of the Dark Lord in the system bar. It turned out that when he was sleeping, Aysia and others discussed a plan to control the Ministry of Magic overnight...
Hurry...it's too fast!
Ivan is having a headache. Can this efficiency be reduced to such a high level, one by one, just like having a chicken blood. I had been busy all night yesterday, so don't everyone need to sleep?
Ivan looked at Esiah with a strange look, and found that although she stayed up all night and didn't sleep, she looked refreshed and not sleepy at all.
Aysia told them all the plans they had come up with in one breath, and then continued. "Anyway, now Dougte and the others are waiting for you to give instructions on the next step..."
"Let's press it down first, this matter won't come in a hurry... We need to take a long-term view." Ivan waved his hand, refusing.
Aixia was taken aback for a moment, and then soon realized something, and asked. "Are you still going to deal with Dumbledore first?"
Ivan sighed helplessly. He knew that Aysia and others must have taken seriously the words he flicked on Voldemort last night.
The reason why he said that at the time was only to make Voldemort fear himself, believing that he was really hiding his strength, rather than exploding in a short while.
Now it seems that his acting skills seem to be so good that he fooled his own people in...

chapters.title: Chapter 740: Mark of Magic
chapters.content:
"The Blood Wizard of Hogwarts (
While feeling helpless, Ivan also hesitated to tell Aysia the truth of the matter.
After hesitating for a moment, Ivan finally gave up the idea.
He didn't plan to disclose the system to anyone, which meant that he couldn't explain the reasons for the fluctuating strength.
If Aysia misunderstood what evil black magic he used, it would be difficult to temporarily increase combat effectiveness.
After all, this kind of drastically improved combat effectiveness, and this kind of black magic that can only be used once, is often accompanied by some huge side effects.
Even if he said that he was in good health, Aysia would have to believe it.
The most important thing is that Ivan has not forgotten that Voldemort is a master of mind-trapping, and Esiah has not practiced Occlumency. What if he gets mind-read when he comes into contact with him?
Thinking of this, Ivan put out the idea of ​​telling the truth directly, and instead vaguely reminded that the blood magic used by Esiah when he defeated Voldemort was too powerful, even he could not use it for a long time.
"In addition, Dumbledore has reorganized the Order of the Phoenix, so the current situation is a tripartite check and balance. If we rashly attack the Ministry of Magic, Dumbledore will never stand idly by..."
Ivan took pains to persuade him, even at the risk of discrediting Dumbledore and the Order of the Phoenix, reminding Aysia to be cautious and not to become swollen just because they have a little bit of strength.
What if Dumbledore has done too much, and made Dumbledore mistakenly believe that he is the next Dark Lord, even more evil than Voldemort, and insists on pulling himself desperately before he is dying?
So keep it low-key... be sure to act low-key!
Based on this idea, Ivan decided to attribute the battle to the conflict between several dark wizards as described in the Daily Prophet.
It just so happened that they had captured a lot of prisoners last night, and the cells of the underground fortress were almost unable to be closed, so they could find a few dark wizards to change their memories, and then throw them out.
As long as everyone in Turnover Alley gave a good confession, they should still be able to hide it.
The Aurors who wanted to come to the Ministry of Magic were also unlikely to investigate carefully.
After all, this result is in line with Fudge's expectations. He is too happy to be too late. Even if he knows that the memories of these dark wizards have been modified, most of them will open one eye and close one eye.
As for the plans of Dougt, Rozier and others to win over officials from the Ministry of Magic, they can be carried out in secret, to extend the time, which is more conducive to secrecy.
In any case, it is necessary to infiltrate the Ministry of Magic.
Although Ivan didn't have much interest in the position of Minister of Magic, according to what happened in the original time and space, it is very likely that Voldemort would attack the Ministry next.
The worst would happen, and of course he needs to make some preparations...
The two of them were eating lunch while revising the plan to be implemented.
After lunch, Aysia didn't stay here much. Even if the plan to raid the Ministry of Magic was postponed, there was still a lot of preparation work to do.
"By the way, mom, call Fren and Dougte back in the evening." As Aysia walked to the door, Ivan suddenly remembered something and reminded him.
"Okay, I will remember." Aysia turned her head to look at Ivan, nodded, and without asking more, left the living room.
Ivan, who was left alone, was still digesting all the information he had received from Aysia, and then opened the system's taskbar.
[Become the King of Knock Down Alley (Completed)
Mission objective: rectify the Knockdown Alley (third ring road)
Task progress: 100%
Task reward: magic mark (whether to receive it)
Legendary value: 3 (achievement of King of Knockdown Alley)
……】
The task of rectifying Knockdown Alley was completed last night by Ivan. Thanks to the three legendary points he obtained when completing the task, he was able to activate the protection mode and slay the troublemaker Voldemort.
The situation at that time can only be described in a cut-and-throw, if Voldemort had arrived earlier... the consequences would be disastrous!
"Fortunately, Tom's luck has always been bad..." Ivan muttered to himself, and then muttered silently in his heart.
Receive award!
In the next moment, a huge amount of knowledge flooded into his mind.
About five minutes later, Ivan opened his eyes again, and he had mastered this special magic.
Generally speaking, the magic mark is similar to Voldemort's dark mark, and should be the same type of spell, but in terms of effect, the magic mark is obviously stronger.
When he planted a mark on any wizard, it was equivalent to directly grasping the life and death of the other party.
Ivan can easily influence and punish the victim through the imprint, and can even directly understand the opponent's life if necessary. As long as the imprint magic is not eliminated, the wizard will be a dead end no matter how far away.
In addition, he can also convey mission instructions to the wizard through specific magic, perceive the opponent's location or cast Apparition to reach the opponent instantly.
And those wizards who have been planted with the imprint can also input magic power on the magic imprint to contact them, and with their consent, know their coordinates and quickly come to gather.
This perfectly resolved one of his concerns.
Before, Ivan had been worried that Voldemort would find his relatives and friends to retaliate after being frustrated in Knockdown Alley, and even use them to threaten him.
In that case, it would be troublesome. No matter how strong his deterrence is, he would not be able to do everything. The appearance of the magic mark undoubtedly solved this problem.
Just plant a mark on Hermione and the others, and then find a way to let the Death Eaters know the news, and Voldemort, who fears him so much, will naturally dispel the unrealistic thoughts in his heart.
In conjunction with the Courageous Loyalty Curse, there should be no need to worry about the deterrence brought by Voldemort in a short time.
Thinking of this, Ivan relaxed his tight emotions, and enthusiastically began to design the magic imprint pattern.
The symbol of Voldemort is the Mark of the Dark Demon, and Grindelwald is associated with the symbol of the Deathly Hallows, so what should I use?
cross? Demon head? Hammer and sickle?
Ivan eliminated the options that flashed in his mind one by one. According to his vision, this pattern should not only be beautiful, but also have a certain meaning.
At least it can't be beaten by Voldemort and Grindelwald.
Ivan pondered for a long time, and the magic wand in his hand lightly tapped on the table, and the dark fluorescence flowed out and turned into a lifelike ouroboros on the table.
No, no!
Ivan looked at this pattern and shook his head. The attribute of snake was repeated with Voldemort, and he didn't want to use it.
Moreover, he always felt that something was missing...

chapters.title: Chapter 741: Misunderstanding... This is all a misunderstanding!
chapters.content:
"Hogwarts Blood Wizard Novel ( Find the latest chapter!
Ivan tapped his index finger on the tabletop, and the slight impact continued to echo in the enclosed living room.
On the desktop, the dark fluorescent composition of ouroboros changed rapidly with the sound of percussion. The flat head slowly became hideous, and two pairs of wings gradually extended on the back, followed by dragon horns and claws...
In just one minute, the pattern in front of us changed from an Ouroboros to a slender Ouroboros, but it was not a posture of spreading its wings and soaring, but curled up together to form a complete circle from head to tail.
Just like this, Ivan still felt a little dissatisfied, but at last he didn't know what he thought of, and suddenly his heart moved, and a crimson-like crystal-like pattern emerged from the table.
The whole crystal is an irregular diamond shape. If Harry were here, he would surely be able to see that this was exactly the shape of the Philosopher’s Stone he had seen in the first grade.
The title-tailed dragon was so embedded in the crystal, it looked like a crystal clear amber at first glance.
However, considering that the direct use of the Philosopher’s Stone as a sign is too conspicuous, it may cause some trouble, so Ivan set out to modify it again, removing the color, and leaving only a very complicated, black magic. A diamond pattern outlined by silk threads.
"It should be almost..." Ivan looked at the pattern in front of him and nodded.
In a hurry, he couldn't think of a more suitable logo, so he just used this one.
咚咚咚...
Just after making a decision, a slight knock on the door rang out.
"Come in!" Ivan waved his hand to erase the pattern on the table, and said casually.
After obtaining permission, the door of the living room was opened quickly, and Aiaea took the lead to enter, and then more than forty wizards such as Dougt and Furen followed in.
The spacious living room was full of people all at once, and it was extremely crowded. Due to Ivan's power, every wizard who came in was honest and well-behaved, just like a rabbit.
If you walked out in this manner, no one would believe that this was a group of evil dark wizards from Knock Down Alley.
Such obedience certainly makes sense, after all, they witnessed a miracle with their own eyes last night!
The seemingly weak young wizard in front of him easily repelled the mighty Dark Lord Voldemort. In their impression, this was something that even Dumbledore could not do.
The number one power in the magic world deserves it!
But while feeling in awe, when facing Ivan, a trace of fear was unavoidable in their hearts.
They understood Ivan's rhetoric in Knockdown Alley last night, so of course they knew what kind of face it was under the other's gentle appearance. It was not enough to describe evil, cunning, and ambitious.
If I really want to put a label on Ivan, it can only be said that this is a darker lord more terrifying than Voldemort!
The thoughts that flashed in the minds of Rozier and the others, naturally, could not be concealed from Ivan, who was using Sensation Mind throughout the process.
Misunderstanding... This is all a misunderstanding!
Ivan was having a headache. At that time, he was patronizing Voldemort, and he never thought that his casual nonsense would bring such a sequelae. Novel No. 6
What makes him feel helpless is that he still needs to maintain this deterrent to check and balance the restless dark wizards.
However, he still can't explain it, because he still needs to maintain this deterrent to intimidate Voldemort, and by the way check and balance these restless dark wizards.
Ivan sighed silently.
Forget it, misunderstanding, it's not the first time anyway, he is used to it.
"Your Excellency Hals... did you have anything to tell us when you called us?" In silence, Dougt asked cautiously.
Although his personal relationship with Ivan is good, Dougt never forgets his identity in public and uses honorific titles.
In the beginning, this was just a means to strengthen prestige, but as Ivan's strength became stronger, he shouted more and more smoothly, and there was no more awkwardness.
"You must have seen the battle last night, right?" Ivan didn't answer Dougert's words directly, took a sip of the tea, and then asked.
"That's natural. I will never forget the heroic appearance and mighty power of Your Excellency Hals that night..." Rozier said with emotion.
This is a bit of suspicion of flattering, but Rozier is sincere, because he really thinks so.
That night Voldemort suddenly appeared in the wizarding market and interrupted Ivan's speech, which made the original good form take a turn for the worse, and once had the upper hand in the confrontation between words and momentum.
So Rozier almost wanted to turn around and switch to Voldemort's camp.
Fortunately, he suppressed the thoughts that had arisen in his mind at the last moment, and persisted for a while, only then was he fortunate to witness that the mighty Voldemort, like a rag doll, was slapped and flew out by Ivan.
This extremely shocking scene, he might not forget it to death.
Just after Rozier’s voice fell, the wizards present also woke up. While irritated by their lack of eyesight, they hurriedly spoke out, praising Ivan’s heroism in beating Voldemort and angering the magic world. Heroic.
It's a pity that all these flattery slapped on the horse's thighs. Ivan has always been indifferent to this black history, so he quickly raised his hand to stop these people's words.
"Stop it all for me, I am not calling you here for you to praise me..."
"Although Voldemort has been defeated by me, I am very likely to make some small actions secretly under the anger, and even directly attack some of you... This has to be guarded!" Ivan said solemnly~www. mtlnovel.com~ Listening to Ivan’s words, Dougte immediately realized the seriousness of the matter. If a strong man like Voldemort were to put him down for assassination, there would be few people present who could hide it.
"Your Excellency Hals, do you want us to find out the hiding place of the mysterious man as soon as possible?" Fren asked, this would happen, the only way to take advantage of the mysterious man's serious injury, get him out and kill him!
"No, if you encounter Voldemort with your strength, I am afraid that there will be no chance to escape and spread the letter..." Ivan shook his head and retorted.
It was just that Ivan soon realized that such a reason was not enough. Even if he did not meet Voldemort, he could still confirm Voldemort's position by catching the Death Eaters, so he immediately added one sentence.
"Besides, Voldemort is still useful to me. It's not time to kill him...understand?"

chapters.title: Chapter 742: Such a spirit is really unimaginable
chapters.content:
"Hogwarts Blood Wizard Novel ( Find the latest chapter!
"Yes, Sir Hals..." Hearing Ivan's words, Fren nodded solemnly.
He understood that he had spoken too much this time, and it was obvious that Ivan was secretly planning some amazing plan, and even the Dark Lord had calculated it together.
No wonder Ivan didn't have any intention of chasing after Voldemort was seriously injured last night, obviously he did it deliberately.
After all, this is the second time Ivan has forgiven the other party's life. With such an obvious reminder, he hadn't thought of it just now, and he was so stupid to ask directly, it was really ashamed.
The rest of the wizards have no shortage of intelligent and sophisticated generations, so naturally they won’t lose sight of this.
But because of this, it makes people feel shocked. It is unimaginable to regard the mysterious people who are afraid of everyone in the magical world as pawns. Such courage is really unimaginable...
Dougte looked at Ivan with emotion in his heart. A few years ago, the little wizard, who was a little immature, has grown to a point where he can't even see it clearly.
Obviously it has the power to run wild in the magic world, but it has been hiding it, just to give the opponent a fatal blow after winning the trust of Dumbledore. Such a city can only be described as unfathomable.
Had it not been for Voldemort's sudden killing, they would have been kept in the dark.
"Your Excellency Hals, since we can't take the initiative to attack, how can we avoid the mysterious person's attack?" Walker asked curiously.
"Next, I will burn a magic mark on each of you. You can talk to me directly through it. When necessary, I can also use this magic mark to determine the coordinates of your location and use it to perform Phantom Shift. shape……"
Ivan didn't mean to sell off, spent a few minutes, roughly speaking about the effect of the magic mark, only concealing his ability to directly kill people through the mark.
Walker and others were excited when they heard the news. They knew that this magic mark was undoubtedly an amulet, and they could apply for support in time if they encountered a powerful enemy that they couldn't handle.
But before they were happy for too long, Ivan poured cold water on his head.
Although the magic stamp can deliver messages instantly, if you happen to be very busy or temporarily delayed by something, you may not be able to rescue in time, so this can only be used as a last resort at best.
"In addition, unless there is something important to report, it is forbidden to contact me directly using the magic mark..." Ivan added. .
He didn't want some trivial things, these people came to ask himself, then he would be bored to death.
The wizards present nodded together, in fact, even without Ivan's reminder, they would not have the guts to do so.
"Let's start with you, Dougt, just to remove the dark mark on your wrist..." Ivan looked around, and his gaze finally stayed on Dougt's body.
"Do you have a way to remove the Dark Mark?" Dougt suddenly became very excited. After Voldemort was resurrected, the Dark Mark on his hand became more and more obvious, with unbearable tingling from time to time.
In the past ten years, he has not thought of removing this dark mark, but he has tried all methods except for cutting hands to no avail, so he had to give up helplessly. He originally thought that he would never be able to get rid of it. The mark of shame.
"Of course, to put it bluntly, this is just a marking magic." Ivan casually explained. Now that he knows the principle of this technique, it is much easier to dispel the magic.
Dougt hurried forward a few steps, shaking the long sleeve of his left hand, revealing the very conspicuous mark of the skull on his wrist. A serpentine snake was crawling out of the big mouth of the skull, forming A horoscope inner ring.
Ivan pulled out his magic wand and pressed it to the wrist stretched out by Doug. With the input of magic power, the Black Demon Mark seemed to have come alive, and the serpentine snake twisted uncomfortably with a weird hissing. The sound resounded in the living room. Literary City
Dougte frowned tightly. He could feel two completely different forces opposing each other on his wrist. The entire forearm was like sticking to a hot iron, and a black air was constantly coming from Floating out there...
About three minutes later, the Dark Mark on Dougt's wrist had disappeared, replaced by a new mark.
Seeing that the spell was successfully cast, Ivan stopped his hands and secretly breathed a sigh of relief. Although he was confident before, it was the first time to use this kind of imprinting magic. If something went wrong accidentally, it would be difficult to step down.
"Go down." Ivan waved his hand to let Dougert return to his original position, and then ordered Fren to step forward...
Dougt walked back to the crowd in a comfortable mood, raised his left wrist and looked carefully, and found that it was a very strange fire dragon with its head and tail connected together, and there were irregular diamond patterns on the outer circle.
Is the dragon dormant about to take off?
Dougter guessed in his mind the meaning of this magic mark, and faintly felt that it was not as simple as he thought.
About an hour later, all forty-five wizards present were engraved with magic marks on their wrists.
With such high-intensity continuous casting, even if Yifan felt a little tired, he didn't show it, and his complexion was assigned to the next work as usual.
The deterrence brought by Voldemort has been ignored for the time being, but there are still many things they need to do next.
"Dougt, Rozier, Parkinson, McMillan... you will be responsible for infiltrating the Ministry of Magic." Ivan looked at several people and exhorted.
"At most half a year we will show you the results, Your Excellency Hals." After removing the dark mark, Dougt was in a good mood and replied with pride.
Rozier and others also patted their chests to ensure that they would prepare for the attack on the Ministry of Magic as quickly as possible.
Actually don’t worry...you can do it slower!
Ivan opened his mouth, but changed his appearance when the words came to his lips.
"Remember, you must act secretly..."
Several people nodded solemnly. Although they couldn't guess what Ivan was planning with their wisdom, they never wanted to make mistakes because of their unfavorable actions.
After a reminder, Ivan stopped looking at them, but turned his gaze to Fren, and said again.
"Fren You lead the law enforcers to manage Knockover Alley and set some rules. The atmosphere here needs to be rectified. If you see a suitable wizard, you can also recruit."
"I'll pay attention, Your Excellency Hals." Fren bowed his head slightly.
Ivan didn't give much reminder. He still trusted Fren's ability and loyalty. Finally, he told Acia to be in charge of the operation of the wizard market and sent people to look for the rare and magical creatures.
"Do you have any questions? Or do you want to add?" Ivan asked, scanning the audience.
There was silence in the living room, and no one made a sound for a long time. Ivan was not surprised. He knew how terrifying his current deterrent power was. Such inquiries were just a matter of routine.
However, when Ivan was about to announce the end of the meeting, a slightly familiar figure in the crowd stood up.

chapters.title: Chapter 743: Let's start, follow the old rules!
chapters.content:
"Hogwarts Blood Wizard Novel ( Find the latest chapter!
"Your Excellency Hals, please forgive me for my offense. I think we should set up a special propaganda department." Gleason walked out of the crowd and suggested a little nervously.
Promote it?
Ivan raised his brows and said. "Talk about it..."
With Ivan's permission, Gleason leaned slightly and began to talk about the importance of setting up a propaganda department.
The entire British magical world is much larger than Knockturn Alley, and the situation is more complicated.
Although they can occupy the Ministry of Magic with powerful force to rule, but doing so will eventually bring a lot of drawbacks, the most direct impact is the endless troubles and riots that follow.
Therefore, it is necessary to carry out propaganda to let all wizards understand that they are the righteous side, and everything they do is for the sake of the future of the magical world...
Hearing this, Ivan nodded. Of course he knew the truth.
Over the years, he asked Rita Skeeter to "truthfully" report on his achievements. In addition to trying to get the legendary points, he also has the meaning of self-promotion and suppressing the authority of the Ministry of Magic.
Regardless of the unsatisfactory performance of Fudge as the Minister of Magic in recent times, most of his mistakes have been forcibly covered up, and they are not recognized.
If these things can be exposed through propaganda, then the angry wizards will spontaneously oust Fudge without them.
The more I think about it, the more Ivan feels that it is indeed necessary to establish an announcement department, because mastering propaganda channels often means mastering the right to speak.
"Your proposal is very good, Gleason, then you will be responsible for this newly established department!" Ivan said appreciatively.
"Thank you very much for your trust, Your Excellency Hals! I won't let you down..." Gleason leaned slightly to signal, concealing his excitement, and stepped back into the crowd.
Looking at the energetic Gleason, Rozier and the others were full of envy. They knew that Gleason's status would be greatly improved from today, leaving them far behind.
"Is anyone else wanting to say something?" Ivan looked around at the crowd, and after waiting for a while, no one stood up, so he waved his hand and said.
"So... now the meeting is over!"
Knowing that they could finally leave, the wizards present were relieved.
No way, the faint pressure on Ivan made them feel terrified just standing here, so after saluting and saying goodbye, one by one left the living room as if fleeing.
Ivan looked at the people leaving in a hurry, and shook his head helplessly. It seems that this misunderstanding will be impossible to clarify for a while...
After this meeting, in the next few days, Ivan turned away most of the chores and devoted himself to magic practice.
Ivan knows very well that expanding power in the magical world and wooing the rich and powerful are small means, and only strong power is the root of everything!
This is also the reason why he often no longer dared to delegate power to Knock Alley.
Dougt, Fren, and Gleason can understand that as long as their brains are not short-circuited, there is only a dead end for party and rebellion.
The reason is very simple. With the strength he showed that night, even if all the wizards in Knockturn Alley were combined, it was not enough for him to fight alone...
So what he needs to do most now is to turn this false combat power into reality as soon as possible, otherwise, once he wears the help, everything he has painstakingly created will instantly fall apart. Xuan Xuan Book Bar
However, it is not so easy to increase the strength in a short period of time. Ivan was soon disappointed to find that he could not complete any of the tasks released by the system for the time being.
Even the easiest dark minion, after he took the time to go to Azkaban, he had no choice but to give up.
Of course, this is not to say that the dementors have forgotten his "great hero" after more than a year.
On the contrary, this time the contact went very smoothly, and most of the dementors were willing to follow his instructions, but even so, the task progress did not increase by the slightest.
While feeling puzzled, Ivan could only guess that the mission target must have these dementors surrender to him.
This is not incomprehensible, after all, he possesses Bogut's transformation, and pretending to be Voldemort can order the Death Eaters, but this does not mean that he has subdued these people.
So after spending a long time developing the dementors into undercover agents, Ivan left Azkaban angrily, temporarily giving up the idea of ​​using the protection mode to improve his strength, instead placing his hopes on hard practice.
The only good news is that more than 30 dark wizards are held in the cages of the underground fortress to serve as sparring partners, which means that he does not need to cast spells on some wooden dummies stupidly, but can actually do it in a field. Improve yourself in battle...
...
In the evening a week later, in the practice room of the underground fortress, a total of fifteen wizards stood in every corner of the room, showing a tendency of encirclement.
In the center, Ivan, who was surrounded by a group of wizards, didn't show any fear on his face. He just slowly pulled out the wand hidden in his sleeve and spoke casually.
"Let's start, or follow the old rules!"
"Oh~ I almost forgot that you don't have the memory of that time. In short, you don't accept surrender. You can encircle and attack at will. If you can defeat me, I will release you from the cage..."
Ivan simply said the rules of the battle, and then just stood in the middle and waited for them to do something.
The fifteen wizards present shook hands holding their magic wands, and they looked at Ivan with horror and despair.
Although they are crowded, none of them think they can win.
This is obviously not the first time for such a battle. Although they have no memory of previous battles, they are not stupid. These days, no wizard has been released at all. On the contrary, everyone was inexplicably wounded, and even a few were seriously injured and killed. .
If it had not been forbidden to surrender, they would have knelt down and begged for mercy.
"Reassure, I won't use my full strength, and I won't kill you. Since you don't plan to move first, let me start!" Ivan was a little impatient and raised his wand first.
At this moment Ivan suddenly stopped casting the spell, but a crimson light beam flew over from the side.
It was Avery who shot, his eyes were red, and he gnashed his teeth and yelled. "There is no way out if you are stuck here, we are fighting with this demon!"
"Confringo~! (Thunderbolt explosion
"Reducto~ (Bone to pieces
...
Under Avery’s scolding, more and more wizards reacted, raising their wands, and magic beams shot out one after another, intertwined in mid-air into a large net, blocking all of Ivan. The escape route.
"That's right!" Ivan said happily, his body shape flashed and disappeared in place, and when he reappeared, he had instantly entered a dragonized state, with a punch on Avery's face. ...
